source: Hamlet returned from his voyage to England, thanks to a bizarre scenario where pirates boarded his vessel and took him hostage. He believes there was a plot against his life right from the voyage's start. If I speak to the King about this, maybe I can uncover the truth of the matter.
target: 哈姆雷特从前往英格兰的航程中回来了，原因是一场离奇的变故：海盗登上他的船，把他劫为人质。他认为，从航程一开始，就有人密谋要他的命。如果我向国王问起这件事，也许能查出真相。

source: I spoke to the King about the aforementioned plot against Hamlet's life. He seemed surprised and disturbed, but now believes me to be an ally of sorts. If I can only be there at the moment Hamlet steps aboard that ship, I might be able to find a way onto it myself.
target: 我向国王谈起了前面提到的谋害哈姆雷特一事。他似乎既惊讶又不安，但现在把我当成了某种盟友。只要我能在哈姆雷特登上那艘船的那一刻到场，也许就能想办法一起上船。

source: I've made it aboard the ship. The King tasked me directly with ensuring Hamlet doesn't return to Denmark, and promised me a rich reward. I'm not certain I want any reward like that. For now, I'd like to merely observe and understand the situation.
target: 我成功上船了。国王直接交给我一项任务，要我确保哈姆雷特不会回到丹麦，并许诺给我丰厚的奖赏。我不确定自己是否想要这样的奖赏。眼下，我只想观察，弄清这里的情况。

source: Pirates. We've been set upon by pirates. Not more than a few hours after we left Danish waters, at that. Their captain calls herself Grace O'Malley, and though she may be coarse, she doesn't seem cruel. Perhaps she can be reasoned with.
target: 海盗。我们遭到了海盗袭击。而且，那时我们离开丹麦海域才不过几个小时。他们的船长自称格蕾丝·奥马利，虽然举止粗鲁，却似乎并不残忍。也许可以和她讲讲道理。

source: Hamlet pulled me aside to tell me he's got a plan: when opportunity presents itself, he's going to try and overthrow Grace, leaving Rosie and Guilda to die. This is... worrying. I know there's a bloodless option here—or perhaps something bloodier, depending on how I push my luck. I'm dreading the confrontation.
target: 哈姆雷特把我拉到一旁，告诉我他有个计划：一有机会，他就要试着推翻格蕾丝，丢下萝茜和吉尔达，任她们去死。这……令人担忧。我知道有办法不流血就解决这件事——不过，也可能会流更多的血，就看我冒多大的险了。我很害怕接下来的冲突。

source: I overheard some of Grace's men discussing her. Such interesting rumors. There's got to be more to find, certainly, and eavesdropping is my specialty. Besides, we're in the middle of the ocean. What else am I to do?
target: 我偷听到格蕾丝的几个手下在议论她。这些传闻真有意思。肯定还能打听到更多，而且偷听确实是我的拿手好戏。再说，我们身处大海中央。我还能做什么呢？

source: I accosted Grace in the captain's quarters about all the rumors I'd heard. To my surprise, she just laughed and suggested she teach me how to hold a blade. She's offered to meet me abovedeck and show me a thing or two. This woman is a whirlwind.
target: 我在船长室找格蕾丝，追问了那些听来的传闻。没想到，她只是笑了笑，提议教我怎么握刀。她邀我到甲板上见面，说要教我几招。这个女人真像一阵旋风。

source: As usual, Hamlet ruins everything. That's all I have to update for now. Must go find Grace in her room and apologize. How embarrassing.
target: 哈姆雷特又像往常一样，把一切都搞砸了。目前要记的就这些。得去格蕾丝的房间找她道歉。真丢脸。

source: Grace and I spent the evening drinking and talking. She's nothing like I thought she was. And... at the end of it... we went to bed. We spent the whole night together. I've never experienced anything like this before. I only wish we had more time together. My heart aches for her.
target: 我和格蕾丝喝酒聊天，度过了一个晚上。她和我原先想的完全不一样。而且……最后……我们上了床。我们共度了整夜。我从未有过这样的经历。我只希望我们能有更多相处的时间。对她的思念让我心痛。

source: Grace and I spent the evening drinking and talking. She's nothing like I thought she was. And... at the end of it... she asked if I wanted to go to bed, though I declined. Nevertheless, it's clear we're kindred souls. I only wish we had more time together.
target: 我和格蕾丝喝酒聊天，度过了一个晚上。她和我原先想的完全不一样。而且……最后……她问我愿不愿意和她上床，不过我拒绝了。即便如此，我们显然心意相通。我只希望我们能有更多相处的时间。

source: We departed the ship just a few moments ago and were returned to shore via longboat. What a strange journey. I sense there are so many ways that situation could have turned out; I must now reap the consequences of my actions, or else return to the point when Hamlet and I left the docks and try once more.
target: 我们刚刚离开那艘船，乘长艇回到了岸上。真是一段奇异的旅程。我感觉那种局面本可以有许多不同的结局；现在，我必须承担自己行为的后果，或者回到我和哈姆雷特离开码头的那一刻，再试一次。

source: I've agreed to join Grace's crew. I wonder what it would be like, if this was my final fate? To become part of her world of debauchery and action and see where that path might lead...
target: 我已经答应加入格蕾丝的船队。如果这就是我最终的命运，会是什么样呢？融入她那个纵情享乐、充满冒险的世界，看看这条路会通向何处……

source: A Natural Course
target: 顺其自然

source: No matter how I try to influence people, those I love get hurt. But I've never actually seen how events would play out if I didn't try to change anything. Perhaps I could learn something by just watching.
target: 无论我怎么试着影响别人，我爱的人都会受到伤害。但我从未真正见过，如果我什么都不试着改变，事情会如何发展。也许只是旁观，也能让我有所收获。

source:
Even without my involvement, this all ends in bloodshed. Hamlet and my brother kill each other in a foolish duel, the Queen is poisoned, and the King run through. Fortinbras invades shortly after, and our leaderless castle provides no real resistance.

At least I can be certain than my actions haven't made things worse. They were always destined to be bad.
target:
即使没有我插手，这一切最终也会以流血收场。哈姆雷特和哥哥在一场愚蠢的决斗中杀死了彼此，王后被毒死，国王被利刃刺穿。不久后，福丁布拉斯入侵，我们的城堡群龙无首，没能作出什么像样的抵抗。

至少我可以确定，我的所作所为没有让事情变得更糟。结局本就注定很糟。

source: Find Laertes
target: 寻找雷欧提斯

source: My father is worried about Laertes' upcoming trip, and wants to talk to my brother before he goes. And of course, it falls on me to get him. Where on earth could he be?
target: 父亲担心雷欧提斯即将启程的这趟旅行，想在哥哥出发前和他谈谈。当然，找他的差事又落在了我头上。他到底会在哪儿呢？

source: By talking to Queen Gertrude, I was finally able to free Laertes from the meeting. King Claudius granted my brother permission to leave for Paris, but denied Prince Hamlet a similar request. Laertes wanted to meet before he leaves Thursday morning.
target: 和乔特鲁德王后谈过之后，我终于让雷欧提斯脱身离开了会议。克劳狄斯国王准许哥哥前往巴黎，却拒绝了哈姆雷特王子类似的请求。雷欧提斯想在星期四早上出发前和我见一面。

source: Get Some Rest
target: 休息一下

source: It's been a long day, and everyone is off to bed. I should go, too.
target: 漫长的一天终于过去，大家都去睡了。我也该去了。

source: N/A
target: 不适用

source: Laertes and Prince Hamlet are currently getting permission from the King to leave Denmark. They can be found in the Great Hall.
target: 雷欧提斯和哈姆雷特王子正在请求国王准许他们离开丹麦。他们在大厅里。

source: Laertes has to wait for the war council meeting to end, but I'm not sure it ever will at this rate. Surely someone at this meeting can intervene on his behalf?
target: 雷欧提斯得等军事会议结束，但照这个进度，我都怀疑它会不会有结束的时候。与会的人里，总该有人能替他说句话吧？

source: By talking to Queen Gertrude, I was finally able to free Laertes from the meeting. King Claudius granted my brother permission to leave for Paris, but denied Prince Hamlet a similar request. Now Laertes wants to meet with me before he leaves.
target: 和乔特鲁德王后谈过之后，我终于让雷欧提斯脱身离开了会议。克劳狄斯国王准许哥哥前往巴黎，却拒绝了哈姆雷特王子类似的请求。现在，雷欧提斯想在出发前和我见一面。

source: Polonius urgently needs to speak with Laertes
target: 波洛涅斯急需与雷欧提斯谈话

source: Gertrude can sing
target: 乔特鲁德会唱歌

source: the party is happening
target: 宴会正在举行

source: the guards have been acting strange
target: 卫兵们近来举止古怪

source: the court has been successfully informed
target: 已经成功告知宫廷众人

source: Hamlet is in a foul mood
target: 哈姆雷特心情很差

source: Hamlet is staying in Denmark
target: 哈姆雷特会留在丹麦

source: they can't deal with this
target: 他们应付不了这件事

source: Hamlet is paralyzed into inaction
target: 哈姆雷特陷入僵局，无法行动

source: I doubt they would be hanging out among the graves at this hour.
target: 这个时候，他们应该不会在墓地里闲逛吧。

source: Here is where Bernardo reviews all his paperwork.
target: 贝尔纳多就在这里审阅所有文书。

source: And, from the look of it, keeps anything he's confiscated from the other men.
target: 而且，看样子，他从其他人那里没收的东西也都放在这里。

source: 'Philip Martin: he never could pay his bill.'
target: “菲利普·马丁：他始终付不起自己的账单。”

source: I'd no idea we buried debtors in the castle yard.
target: 我还不知道，我们会把欠债的人埋在城堡院子里。

source: 'Marcus Faber: One foot in the heavens, he followed the stars.'
target: “马库斯·法伯：一脚踏入天际，循着群星而去。”

source: Elegant and inspiring. Lord Faber must have been a dreamer.
target: 优雅又鼓舞人心。法伯勋爵一定是个爱做梦的人。

source: 'Max Grossman: Here lies a fellow of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy.'
target: “马克斯·格罗斯曼：此处长眠之人，诙谐无穷，奇思非凡。”

source: Alas, poor man. I knew him well.
target: 唉，可怜的人。我和他很熟。

source: Someone has carved a heart around the names on this one.
target: 有人在这块墓碑的名字周围刻了一个心形。

source: 'Kim and Dan McAuliffe: In death as in life, adventuring together.'
target: “金与丹·麦考利夫：生死如一，并肩冒险。”

source: It's nice to see not all love is fickle.
target: 看到爱情并非全都善变，真好。

source: 'Christopher L. Morrow: Urge no more words; I have no more to say.'
target: “克里斯托弗·L·莫罗：莫再催我开口；我已无话可说。”

source: There's poetry in that.
target: 这句话倒有些诗意。

source: 'Grace Kelley: Well, that could have gone better.'
target: “格蕾丝·凯利：唉，那件事本可以有个更好的结果。”

source: I've asked around a bit, trying to figure out what 'that' was. But no one knows, or will tell me.
target: 我四处打听过，想弄清“那件事”究竟是什么。可没人知道，或者没人肯告诉我。

source: 'Bryant Woods: No great loss...'
target: “布莱恩特·伍兹：算不上什么大损失……”

source: Sir Woods must have been serenely humble, then. Or dreadfully boring.
target: 那伍兹爵士一定是个淡泊谦逊的人。或者，是个极其无趣的人。

source: 'Joanne Dragich: She thought she could find the cliff in the fog. Unfortunately, she mist.'
target: “乔安妮·德拉吉奇：她以为能在雾中找到悬崖。可惜，她雾判了。”

source: And that's why walls were built around the castle's cliff edge.
target: 正因如此，城堡的悬崖边才修了围墙。

source: 'Sarah Villegas: HOLD MY MEAD.'
target: “莎拉·维列加斯：帮我拿着蜜酒！”

source: Those were her last words. Some are ruminating on their meaning still.
target: 那是她最后说的话。至今还有人在琢磨其中的含义。

source: 'Kris Evans: Evs got sick and tired of rating: Died from an overdose of grading.'
target: “克里斯·埃文斯：小埃打分打到厌倦，评分过量送了命。”

source: Hmm. I've never heard of that device in the dungeons before.
target: 嗯。我以前可没听说过地牢里有那种器具。

source: 'Jesse Schell: PERICVLA VERITATI SAEPE CONTIGVA.'
target: “杰西·谢尔：危险常与真相相伴。”

source: 'The truth is often dangerous.' Would that everyone had learned this lesson.
target: “真相往往很危险。”但愿人人都懂得这个道理。

source: 'Sunny Hazzard: R.I.P. Sunny, too sweet for this world.'
target: “桑妮·哈扎德：安息吧，桑妮，你太过美好，这世界容不下你。”

source: The sweet are often the flowers that sooner drop their petals.
target: 美好的人往往如花，花瓣总是更早凋落。

source: Yorick's grave. He was the jester when I was young.
target: 约里克的墓。我小时候，他是宫廷弄臣。

source: He was buried in the royal graveyard at King Hamlet's request. The family was quite fond of him.
target: 遵照哈姆雷特国王的要求，他被安葬在王室墓地。王室一家都很喜欢他。

source: These are the royal family graves. The one in the center is Hamlet's father, King Hamlet.
target: 这些是王室的墓。中间那座属于哈姆雷特的父亲，哈姆雷特国王。

source: Gertrude will soon be buried alongside him.
target: 乔特鲁德很快就会葬在他身旁。

source: Some day, Hamlet, the Queen, and the King will all find rest here.
target: 总有一天，哈姆雷特、王后和国王都会在这里长眠。

source: 'Lady Simona of Denmark.'
target: “丹麦的西蒙娜女士。”

source: The words on this tombstone have worn away with time...
target: 这块墓碑上的字已经被岁月磨去了……

source: On occasion, I like to write here. It's been a while since I had the time, though.
target: 我偶尔喜欢在这里写点东西。不过，我已经有一阵子没空写了。

source: This is where I'd seat visitors for a chat... that is, if Father ever allowed me to have any.
target: 我会请客人坐在这里聊聊天……当然，前提是父亲肯让我有客人来访。

source: It's locked.
target: 锁上了。

source: That door's locked.
target: 那扇门锁上了。

source: I ought not to leave just yet.
target: 我还不该离开。

source: The guards have locked up their chambers for the night.
target: 卫兵们已经把房间锁好过夜了。

source: Leartes locked the door. I guess he wants his privacy.
target: 雷欧提斯锁了门。我猜他不想被人打扰。

source: Hamlet's locked the door. I should... probably leave him be.
target: 哈姆雷特锁了门。我……大概还是别打扰他了。

source: The bar is closed. Othello has left by now.
target: 酒馆关门了。奥赛罗这会儿已经走了。

source: The castle cutlery. Irma keeps it spotless every night.
target: 城堡的餐具。伊尔玛每晚都会把它们擦得一尘不染。

source: All of Irma's various pots and pans.
target: 伊尔玛的各式锅具。

source: One of the guard's beds.
target: 一张卫兵的床。

source: It's... much less nice than mine.
target: 这……比我的床差多了。

source: Hmm. 'A Treatise on Divine-Given Morality.'
target: 嗯。《论神赐的道德》。

source: I had no idea our guard staff were so well read.
target: 我还不知道我们的卫兵如此博览群书。

source: And there's a second book underneath. Oh, it's got illustrations in it.
target: 下面还有一本书。哦，里面有插图。

source: What is that woman doing?
target: 那个女人在做什么？

source: I take back what I said before.
target: 我收回刚才的话。

source: When some new man joins the unit, they'll put their personal items here.
target: 有新人加入卫队时，就会把私人物品放在这里。

source: Playing cards, and winnings.
target: 纸牌，还有赢来的钱。

source: I'm surprised Marcellus just leaves this all out in the open.
target: 马塞勒斯竟然就把这些全摆在外面。

source: Horatio's personal effects are here, what little of them he has.
target: 霍拉旭的私人物品在这里，本来也没几件。

source: He's not strictly a guard, but the King gave him quarters on Hamlet's request.
target: 严格说来，他并不是卫兵，不过国王应哈姆雷特的请求，给他安排了住处。

source: More convenient than staying at the inn down the hill, I suppose.
target: 我想，这比住在山下的旅店方便些。

source: There are thousands of books in here. I could spend years looking through them all.
target: 这里有成千上万本书。要全都翻阅一遍，我能花上好几年。

source: ...Of course, some of them are so old they might disintegrate into dust if I touched them.
target: ……当然，有些书实在太旧了，我一碰，可能就会碎成灰。

source: It's my mother, Elise. I think some travelling artist painted this for my father.
target: 这是我的母亲，伊莉丝。我想，是某位云游的画家为父亲画的。

source: It's strange, but I don't remember her face very well... I only see my reflection in her portrait.
target: 说来奇怪，我已经记不太清她的脸了……在她的画像里，我只看得到自己的影子。

source: What's this?
target: 这是什么？

source: This all seems so trivial...
target: 这些看起来都是些琐事……

source: But I can't stop reading.
target: 可我就是忍不住往下读。

source: Hard to believe Father has something like this in his room.
target: 真难相信，父亲房间里竟有这样的东西。

source: Ah. I borrowed this from the gallery some time ago.
target: 啊。这是我前些时候从画廊借来的。

source: It's certainly not a very uplifting tale.
target: 这故事确实不怎么振奋人心。

source: I wish this story didn't feel so terribly familiar somehow.
target: 不知为什么，这个故事让我觉得熟悉得可怕。真希望没有这种感觉。

source: It's a book of poetry.
target: 这是一本诗集。

source: Persephone... A girl taken from her homeland and made a Queen.
target: 珀耳塞福涅……一个被带离故乡，成为王后的女孩。

source: Sounds familiar.
target: 听着很熟悉。

source: This gate leads out of town to the countryside. There's nothing that way but a lot of fields.
target: 这扇门通往镇外的乡间。那边除了大片田地，什么也没有。

source: Lady Edith, often called 'The Brilliant.'
target: 伊迪丝女士，常被称为“聪慧者”。

source: She was renowned for her great intellect and keenly inquisitive nature—not to mention her morbid sense of humor.
target: 她以过人的才智和强烈的求知欲闻名，更别提她那病态的幽默感了。

source: When I struggled with Latin as a girl, my father often jokingly told me to come down here and ask this portrait for advice.
target: 小时候，我学拉丁语遇到困难，父亲常开玩笑，让我下来向这幅画像请教。

source: The late King Hamlet's portrait used to be here, but someone—Hamlet, actually—has gone and torn it off the wall. He's so strange.
target: 已故哈姆雷特国王的画像原本挂在这里，却被某个人——其实就是哈姆雷特——从墙上扯了下来。他真奇怪。

source: We're so much alike, you and I.
target: 你和我，我们真像。

source: This noblewoman lived long before me. Her name is rubbed off the plaque, but there's a bit of a poem scrawled onto the corner...
target: 这位贵族女子生活在远早于我的年代。铭牌上她的名字已经磨掉了，不过角落里潦草地写着几句诗……

source: 'My beloved hometown, the sweetfish river running through it...'
target: “我心爱的故乡，香鱼之河穿流而过……”

source: ...Never could make sense of that.
target: ……我一直没能弄懂这是什么意思。

source: It's a picture of a foreign castle.
target: 这幅画里是一座外国的城堡。

source: 'Wiener Neustadt, the site of the court of Maximilian I, for Queen Gertrude of Denmark on her birthday.'
target: “维也纳新城，马克西米利安一世的宫廷所在地。敬赠丹麦乔特鲁德王后，庆贺她的诞辰。”

source: Hmm. I suppose this is where Gertrude was raised.
target: 嗯。我想，乔特鲁德就是在这里长大的。

source: Lady Gina of Denmark. She was known, I'm told, for her unfailing kindness.
target: 丹麦的吉娜女士。听说她以始终如一的善良闻名。

source: Prince Max, a distant relative of Hamlet. His performance in hunting, jousting, and other sport was considered legendary.
target: 马克斯王子，哈姆雷特的一位远亲。他在狩猎、马上比武和其他竞技中的表现，被誉为传奇。

source: I've always thought his portrait was rather handsome.
target: 我一直觉得，他在画像里挺英俊的。

source: King James, I believe. A gentle king who was well respected in his time.
target: 我想，这是詹姆斯国王。一位温和的国王，在世时备受尊敬。

source: That portrait of Queen Gertrude was painted when she was just a little older than I am now—on the day of her first wedding.
target: 那幅乔特鲁德王后的画像画于她第一次婚礼当天，那时她只比现在的我大一点。

source: That's King Alexander, Hamlet's grandfather. He's... intimidating. I wonder what happened to him.
target: 那是亚历山大国王，哈姆雷特的祖父。他……令人畏惧。不知道他后来怎么样了。

source: Prince Florizel. Word has it that he fell in love with a shepherdess and renounced his claim to the throne to make her his wife.
target: 弗洛里泽尔王子。据说他爱上了一位牧羊女，为了娶她，放弃了王位继承权。

source: King Douglas. He was a well-humored man and a scholar, noted for his many contributions to this library—among others.
target: 道格拉斯国王。他为人风趣，也是一位学者，因对这座图书馆以及其他地方作出的诸多贡献而闻名。

source: He was a teacher to many, I'm told.
target: 听说他教过很多人。

source: Hello, little one.
target: 你好呀，小家伙。

source: This one looks like it's been eating extra kitchen scraps...
target: 这只看起来没少吃厨房的剩饭……

source: That one's not very friendly. Nicked my wrist once.
target: 这只不太友好。有一次抓伤了我的手腕。

source: Oh, I rarely see this one out and about. She's always hiding.
target: 哦，我很少见这只出来走动。它总是躲着。

source: This one's grown large and happy. Irma must have taken a liking to it.
target: 这只长得壮实，过得也开心。伊尔玛一定很喜欢它。

source: Bernardo and the rest of the guards have all but adopted this one.
target: 贝尔纳多和其他卫兵几乎已经收养了这只狗。

source: She seems to like lingering in the guard quarters a little too often, hoping for scraps.
target: 它似乎太爱在卫兵住处逗留了，总盼着能讨点剩饭。

source: A sprightly little dog. I wonder whom it belongs to?
target: 好活泼的小狗。不知道是谁养的？

source: This hound's nearly always underfoot.
target: 这只猎犬几乎总在脚边碍事。

source: He looks awfully content. Wonder which flowerbed he's gone and dug up.
target: 它看起来满足极了。不知道又去刨了哪处花坛。

source: Hello, little hound! Have you been chasing hares?
target: 你好呀，小猎犬！你刚才追野兔去了吗？

source: Hamlet's gone and blocked out all the light. How juvenile.
target: 哈姆雷特把光全遮住了。真幼稚。

source: If I want to sleep a while, it should be in my own room.
target: 要是想睡一会儿，我该回自己的房间。

source: If I want to take a nap, it should be in my own room.
target: 要是想打个盹，我该回自己的房间。

source: This is where the Queen has her hair done. A mirror of this size must have taken a long while to build.
target: 王后就在这里让人梳理头发。这么大的镜子，做起来一定花了很长时间。

source: Oh, Laertes... What could you possibly need all these blades for?
target: 唉，雷欧提斯……你到底要这么多刀剑做什么？

source: Elsinore castle looks enormous, even this far away.
target: 即使离得这么远，埃尔西诺城堡看起来依然十分庞大。

source: It may look shallow, but it's deceptively deep.
target: 看着可能很浅，其实深得很。

source: I used to play here as a girl. Now, though, with all these heavy skirts... better steer clear.
target: 我小时候常在这里玩。不过现在，穿着这么沉的裙子……还是离远点好。

source: These were carved, I'm told, after the last time Elsinore was sieged and rebuilt.
target: 听说这些雕像是在埃尔西诺上一次遭到围攻、重建之后雕成的。

source: It's the Danish coat of arms.
target: 这是丹麦的纹章。

source: It's late, I should really go to bed.
target: 很晚了，我真该去睡了。

source: I have no reason to head to the docks right now.
target: 我现在没理由去码头。

source: That way lies eastward, out into the Sound.
target: 那边通往东面，出去就是厄勒海峡。

source: Denmark controls the waterway here. All passing ships must stop and pay their tolls to us.
target: 丹麦控制着这里的航道。所有过往船只都必须停下来，向我们缴纳通行税。

source: The Royal Fleet of Denmark is anchored close by. This harbor is rather shallow, so longboats come ashore to ferry passengers to and fro.
target: 丹麦皇家舰队就停泊在附近。这个港口水很浅，所以要用长艇往返岸边接送乘客。

source: It's a note bearing the Seal of the King.
target: 这是一封盖着国王印玺的信。

source: Hamlet's looking at it right now. I can't get close.
target: 哈姆雷特现在正在看。我没法靠近。

source: 'I've entrusted these orders to two loyal servants, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern, to ensure that...'
target: “我已将这些命令交托给罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞这两位忠诚的仆人，以确保……”

source: '...To be executed upon arrival.'
target: “……抵达后即刻处决。”

source: This is a death warrant for Hamlet, written by Claudius. It'll never reach England now.
target: 这是克劳狄斯写下的、处死哈姆雷特的命令。现在它再也不会送到英格兰了。

source: Still, I wonder if... Rosencrantz and Guildenstern were carrying this letter intentionally.
target: 不过，我还是想知道……罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞是不是有意带着这封信。

source: My assumption is deception on all sides.
target: 我猜各方都在骗人。

source: That way leads to the stables. Nothing in there but a lot of muck and mares.
target: 那边通往马厩。里面除了成堆的粪便和母马，什么都没有。

source: That way leads into the fields. I can see the hills roll for miles. Regardless, I've no interest in leaving town.
target: 那边通往田野。我能看见起伏的丘陵绵延数英里。不过，我没兴趣离开镇子。

source: If I knew how to steer a ship, I could go anywhere.
target: 要是我会掌舵，就能去任何地方。

source: But as is, I would probably only wind up at the bottom of the ocean.
target: 可就凭我现在的本事，大概只会落得沉到海底的下场。

source: There's so little light in here.
target: 这里光线真暗。

source: This is where prisoners sleep. Or... try to sleep, I'd guess.
target: 囚犯就在这里睡觉。或者……我猜，只能说试着睡着吧。

source: What just— What did we—
target: 刚才怎么——我们做了什么——

source: Is he... dead?
target: 他……死了吗？

source: ...It's quiet.
target: ……好安静。

source: No Hamlet in my room this time. Something's definitely changed.
target: 这次哈姆雷特不在我房间里。肯定有什么变了。

source: I wonder if Father's outside.
target: 不知道父亲在不在外面。

source: Still don't care for this place, even now.
target: 即使到了现在，我还是不喜欢这个地方。

source: Don't think you can fool me, Ophelia.
target: 别以为你能骗过我，奥菲莉娅。

source: I see. It's the same as before. You're still here.
target: 明白了。还是和之前一样。你还在这里。

source: Still here? I was about to say the same about you!
target: 还在这里？我正想对你说这话呢！

source: You're going to miss the party. Everyone else is already in the great hall.
target: 你要错过宴会了。其他人都已经在大厅里了。

source: Your brother suggested we ought to let you sleep... but I'm glad to see you refreshed and ready.
target: 你哥哥提议让你继续睡……不过，看你精神饱满，也准备好了，我很高兴。

source: Come downstairs when you're ready, won't you?
target: 准备好了就下楼来，好吗？

source: What's going on?
target: 怎么回事？

source: This is all new.
target: 这一切都和以前不一样。

source: There's... it can't be. This must be another trick.
target: 有……不可能。这一定又是个骗局。

source: There's my girl.
target: 我的好女儿来了。

source: Finally awake, O lazy sister of mine?
target: 我这懒妹妹，你终于醒了？

source: Ophelia! OooOOOoh, Ophelia!...
target: 奥菲莉娅！哦——哦——奥菲莉娅！……

source: Uh, you'll have to pardon mother.
target: 呃，请你别介意母亲这样。

source: We all began drinking a... bit much waiting for you to rouse. The wine's been out for hours.
target: 等你醒来的时候，我们都喝得……有点多了。酒都摆出来好几个小时了。

source: I'm so haaaappy! I love a good summer feast.
target: 我好开——心！我最喜欢丰盛的夏日宴席了。

source: Now, love, can we finally begin?
target: 亲爱的，现在总算可以开始了吧？

source: I know you wanted to wait for Ophelia. Well, here she is. Let's not let the food grow cold.
target: 我知道你想等奥菲莉娅。好了，她来了。别让饭菜凉了。

source: Please. I'm starving to death. I'm not long for this world.
target: 求你们了。我都快饿死了。没多久可活了。

source: Guilda, we just had sweetmeats—not an hour ago, too.
target: 吉尔达，我们刚吃过甜点——还不到一个小时呢。

source: But have you seen the table? Irma outdid herself. I can't wait another second! I'll die!
target: 可你看见桌上的菜了吗？伊尔玛这次比以往做得都好。我一秒也等不了了！我要死了！

source: Finally, someone who likes to eat my food as much as I like to make it.
target: 终于有人这么爱吃我做的饭，就像我爱做饭一样。

source: You all are having a party? What of the morning court session? What of Fortinbras?
target: 你们在开宴会？那早上的朝会呢？福丁布拉斯呢？

source: Fortinbras? You mean the Prince of Norway?
target: 福丁布拉斯？你是说挪威王子？

source: What of him, Ophelia?
target: 他怎么了，奥菲莉娅？

source: He... well, the... diplomatic effort. Didn't he... isn't he threatening Denmark?
target: 他……就是，那个……外交交涉。他不是……他不是在威胁丹麦吗？

source: What? Sire, have I missed something?
target: 什么？陛下，是有什么事我不知道吗？

source: I don't think so. I'm not sure what you mean, Ophelia. But I have noticed there's no goblet in your hand. Hmm!
target: 我想没有。我不太明白你的意思，奥菲莉娅。不过我倒是注意到，你手里还没拿酒杯。嗯！

source: Come! Drink! Be merry! And that's a royal order.
target: 来吧！喝酒！尽情欢乐！这可是国王的命令。

source: Er, mother, do you need to be tucked into bed? You're drifting off.
target: 呃，母亲，要送您上床睡觉吗？您都快睡着了。

source: Don't mind her, Hamlet. Let her sleep if she wants to. She'll wake up as the night goes on.
target: 别管她，哈姆雷特。她想睡就让她睡吧。晚些时候她会醒的。

source: I'll watch over her, m'lord. I'll call for yeh if she wakes! Uh, assumin' I'm not drunk myself.
target: 殿下，我会照看她。她醒了我就叫您！呃，前提是我自己没喝醉。

source: She seems remarkably happy tonight, doesn't she, uncle? The happiest since, well...
target: 叔叔，她今晚看起来特别开心，不是吗？自从……嗯，那之后，就没这么开心过。

source: Since Father's illness took him.
target: 自从父亲因病去世之后。

source: Aye, she does.
target: 是啊，确实。

source: I wish his health hadn't declined so quickly. I loved my brother. I wanted him to live. For her sake, and for yours.
target: 要是他的身体没有恶化得那么快就好了。我爱我的哥哥。我希望他活着。为了她，也为了你。

source: It wasn't your fault. There was nothing to be done. Plague steals indiscriminately.
target: 这不是您的错。当时谁也无能为力。瘟疫夺人性命，从不挑人。

source: My father was a good man. And you—you're the closest to him I have now. All will be well in time.
target: 我父亲是个好人。而您——如今我身边的人里，您与他最亲近。慢慢地，一切都会好起来。

source: I'll drink to that, nephew.
target: 为这话干一杯，我的侄儿。

source: (This is so strange. Did history itself change?)
target: （这太奇怪了。难道连历史本身都变了？）

source: (Claudius isn't a murderer in this world, at the very least...)
target: （至少，在这个世界里，克劳狄斯不是凶手……）

source: Laertes. Aren't you sailing for Paris?
target: 雷欧提斯。你不是要坐船去巴黎吗？

source: Oh! About that. for some reason, I couldn't sleep last night, and I got to thinking about it.
target: 哦！说到这个。不知为什么，我昨晚睡不着，就想了想这件事。

source: I believe I'll stay in Elsinore a while longer. There's time enough for travel later on.
target: 我想，我还是在埃尔西诺多待一阵吧。以后有的是时间去旅行。

source: How often does such a bright, warm summer as this come to visit Denmark, after all?
target: 毕竟，丹麦能有几次这样阳光明媚、温暖的夏天呢？

source: Well, that's wonderful. I'm sure Brit will be very happy, too.
target: 那太好了。布莉特肯定也会很高兴。

source: Happy that he's staying? It's not the worst, I suppose.
target: 因为他留下来而高兴？我想，这也不算最坏的事吧。

source: (Listen, Ophelia. Just between you and me, I've got a little surprise in mind tonight.)
target: （听着，奥菲莉娅。这事只告诉你，今晚我打算准备一个小惊喜。）

source: (Wait and see.)
target: （等着瞧吧。）

source: Come, Ophelia. Let me show you to your seat. Shall we dine?
target: 来，奥菲莉娅。我带你入座。我们用餐吧？

source: Of course.
target: 当然。

source: Everyone, I've a toast to make.
target: 各位，我想敬一杯酒。

source: Hear, hear!
target: 好啊，好啊！

source: Of course, Laertes.
target: 当然，雷欧提斯。

source: I'd like to toast to health, to life, and to love.
target: 我想为健康、生命和爱情举杯。

source: And to this brilliant, wonderful woman—whom I love, and who has loved me in return.
target: 也敬这位聪慧、美好的女子——我爱她，她也爱着我。

source: Wha? Me?
To some, our relationship has been known a long time. To others, it may be—er—more of a surprise.
target: 有些人早就知道我们的关系。对另一些人来说，这可能——呃——更像是个意外。

source: I'll say.
target: 我可太意外了。

source: Why have I never heard of this before?
target: 为什么我以前从没听说过这件事？

source: Laertes, you don't have to.
target: 雷欧提斯，你不必这样。

source: Tonight, I'd like to ask Lady Birgitta for her hand in marriage.
target: 今晚，我想向比尔吉塔女士求婚。

source: Ah! Yesh! Yesh!
target: 啊！好哇！好哇！

source: Well, I'll be damned. Certainly took him long enough.
target: 哎呀，真没想到。他可算是开口了。

source: Laertes! This is highly irregular!
target: 雷欧提斯！这太不合规矩了！

source: Oh, come now, Father. They're a suitable match of sufficient rank.
target: 哎，父亲，别这样。他们很般配，身份地位也相称。

source: What have you to fear?
target: 您有什么好担心的？

source: W-well, nothing, but I—I haven't spoken to or met her father, and I haven't asked his mind, and—
target: 这、这个，没什么，可我——我还没见过她父亲，也没跟他说过话，更没问过他的意见，还有——

source: And well, the dowry, and...
target: 还有，嗯，嫁妆，还有……

source: Brit, I love you. I don't want to travel the world without you.
target: 布莉特，我爱你。我不想独自去周游世界。

source: If there's any way you share those feelings... if you think you could... share your life...
target: 如果你也有哪怕一点同样的感情……如果你觉得你愿意……与我共度一生……

source: I accept, you idiot. Of course. You didn't have to be so public, though.
target: 我答应，你这个笨蛋。当然答应。不过，你也不用这么当众说出来。

source: Invite them all into our bedroom too while you're at it, why don't you?
target: 那你怎么不干脆把他们全请进我们的卧室呢？

source: Hmph. Well then. Let me not to the marriage of true minds admit impediments.
target: 哼。那好吧。真心相契的结合，我不该横加阻挠。

source: If this is your wish, then...
target: 如果这是你们的心愿，那么……

source: We're going to have a wedding!
target: 我们要办婚礼了！

source: Congratulations, brother. I'm happy to see you happy.
target: 恭喜你，哥哥。看到你开心，我也很开心。

source: I must admit, I'm relieved. I wasn't sure how you and Father would take the news.
target: 说实话，我松了口气。我之前不确定你和父亲听到这消息会有什么反应。

source: Let's not let the night end.
target: 别让今晚就这么结束吧。

source: I've already talked to Bernardo and Hamlet. Whenever we can slip away, the three of us are planning to meet by the pond.
target: 我已经和贝尔纳多、哈姆雷特说好了。一有机会溜走，我们三个就到池塘边碰面。

source: You want to slip away? But everyone's still here.
target: 你想溜走？可大家都还在这里呢。

source: Oh, it's a welcome celebration, but I can only take so much drunk revelry.
target: 哦，这场庆祝是挺好，可这群醉醺醺的人闹个不停，我也受不了太久。

source: A quieter venue fits the mood. You should come. It's been so long since the four of us got together.
target: 安静点的地方更合心意。你也来吧。我们四个好久没聚在一起了。

source: Yes. I'd... I'd like that.
target: 好。我……我很想去。

source: I'll be there.
target: 我会去的。

source: This is it.
target: 就是这样了。

source: He's gone. I can scarcely believe it. Everything is the way it was meant to be.
target: 他不在了。我简直不敢相信。一切都成了本该有的样子。

source: Well, I'm going to be staggering back to my room tonight.
target: 看来今晚我回房间时，得走得摇摇晃晃了。

source: As well you should be. Tonight's cause for celebration.
target: 那也是应该的。今晚值得庆祝。

source: And cause to drink to the death of Brit's taste in men.
target: 也值得为布莉特挑男人的眼光寿终正寝喝上一杯。

source: You're just upset she doesn't like you.
target: 你只是因为她不喜欢你，才这么不高兴。

source: It's quite all right. I've grown used to that unrequited feeling.
target: 没关系。我早已习惯了那种爱而不得的感觉。

source: Not for her, though.
target: 不过，对象不是她。

source: It's been a long time since the four of us were out here like this.
target: 我们四个已经好久没像这样待在这里了。

source: Too long. Why don't we ever have fun like this anymore? Did we forget how once we grew up?
target: 太久了。为什么我们再也不这样开心地玩了？难道长大后就忘了怎么玩吗？

source: I suppose so.
target: 我想是吧。

source: Well, I'd say it's the three of you who grew. I never had much luck with that.
target: 要我说，长大的是你们三个。我可一直没怎么长个子。

source: Sorry, Wee One.
target: 抱歉，小不点。

source: I detest that nickname.
target: 我讨厌这个外号。

source: As I recall, it was your brother who gave it to you. I'm merely reusing it.
target: 我记得，这外号是你哥哥给你起的。我只是拿来用用。

source: That was the summer he called me The Ogre. Such an unpleasant phase for us all.
target: 就是他叫我“食人魔”的那个夏天。那段日子，我们谁都不好过。

source: I can't help that I'm so terribly good with nomenclature.
target: 谁让我这么擅长起名字呢，我也没办法。

source: I love you all.
target: 我爱你们每一个人。

source: I've been-- it's been-- I've watched you all die so many times.
target: 我一直——这些日子——我看着你们死了那么多次。

source: I didn't know what else to do. I was so scared. So desperate.
target: 我不知道还能怎么办。我好害怕。好绝望。

source: But I finally fixed it. I was persistent. I did everything right. I fixed everything. And now you're here.
target: 但我终于把它解决了。我一直坚持着。我每一步都做对了。我把一切都解决了。现在你们就在这里。

source: Everything's right again.
target: 一切又好了。

source: Ophelia? Are you all right?
target: 奥菲莉娅？你还好吗？

source: She looks like she's falling asleep. She's not making any sense.
target: 她看起来快睡着了。说的话也没头没脑的。

source: I can escort her back to her room.
target: 我可以送她回房间。

source: No, no... leave her. She loves to be here by the pond. It's a warm night with a full moon. She'll be all right.
target: 不，不……让她待着吧。她喜欢待在池塘边。今晚暖和，又是满月。她会没事的。

source: You know, ever since the castle's been in mourning, it hasn't felt the same.
target: 你们知道，自从城堡开始服丧，这里的感觉就不一样了。

source: I agree. There's been a terrible cloud over things. I'm certain that's what Ophelia means.
target: 我也这么觉得。一切都笼罩着一层沉重的阴影。我相信奥菲莉娅说的就是这个。

source: But today, for the first time, I had the thought that perhaps that period is coming to a close.
target: 但今天，我第一次觉得，那段日子也许就要过去了。

source: Perhaps things will be well again.
target: 也许一切又会好起来。

source: I'm starting to believe that myself, Bernardo.
target: 贝尔纳多，我自己也开始这么想了。

source: In fact, I'll toast again to that. Shall we go find some wine?
target: 我还要为这再干一杯。我们去找点酒吧？

source: Excellent plan. And some cards, too.
target: 好主意。再拿些纸牌。

source: Goodnight, Ophelia.
target: 晚安，奥菲莉娅。

source: Sweet dreams.
target: 做个好梦。

source: Oh. I'm alone.
target: 哦。只剩我一个人了。

source: Must've fallen asleep.
target: 我一定是睡着了。

source: Wonder if the others are still playing cards.
target: 不知道其他人是不是还在打牌。

source: Is that Brit?
target: 那是布莉特吗？

source: She just passed out. In the dirt, no less.
target: 她就这么昏过去了。还偏偏倒在泥地里。

source: Brit! Wake up.
target: 布莉特！醒醒。

source: She's cold.
target: 她身上是冷的。

source: No. It can't be.
target: 不。不可能。

source: It can't be...
target: 不可能……

source: Is that-- cheering?
target: 那是——欢呼声？

source: Encore! Encore!
target: 再来一场！再来一场！

source: Yes, please! Don't keep your audience waiting!
target: 对，请继续！别让观众等着！

source: I've seen this performance before, but I can't help but sit through it again.
target: 这场演出我以前看过，可还是忍不住要再从头到尾看一遍。

source: I didn't help write this one, so I must admit, even I don't know the ending.
target: 这出戏我没参与编写，所以得承认，连我也不知道结局。

source: Look! She's here!
target: 看！她来了！

source: Quick, stop!
target: 快，停下！

source: The others, outside. They're all dead.
target: 其他人，在外面。他们全都死了。

source: Someone needs to examine them. My lord. My lady. Please.
target: 得有人去查看一下。国王陛下。王后陛下。求求你们。

source: What? Oh, yes, we know all about them. Disregard it for now.
target: 什么？哦，是啊，他们的事我们都知道。先别管了。

source: Yes, dearest, leave them. The crows will get to them eventually. Or the dogs.
target: 是啊，亲爱的，别管他们了。乌鸦迟早会去吃他们的。或者狗。

source: Now get on that stage, girl.
target: 现在上台去，姑娘。

source: Ophelia, I'm so proud of you. If only your mother could be here to see you.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我真为你骄傲。要是你母亲也能在这里看着你就好了。

source: M-me? Get on the stage?
target: 我、我？上台？

source: What's wrong with you all? People are dead outside. You... you don't care?
target: 你们都怎么了？外面有人死了。你们……你们不在乎吗？

source: Ophelia. Start performing. Now. You're being rude.
target: 奥菲莉娅。开始表演。现在。你这样很没礼貌。

source: Your brother's right.
target: 你哥哥说得对。

source: Please, Ophelia, flee now!
target: 求你了，奥菲莉娅，快逃！

source: What? I...
target: 什么？我……

source: This is all wrong. It's all--
target: 这一切都不对。全都——

source: Miss me?
target: 想我了吗？

source: No! Nononono...
target: 不！不不不不……

source: Why the pout, darling? Wasn't my retelling faithful?
target: 亲爱的，怎么撅着嘴？我重演得还不够忠实吗？

source: My puppeteering of your family and friends... was the script not superb, the twist not sincere?
target: 我把你的家人和朋友当作木偶操纵……剧本不够精彩，转折不够真切吗？

source: And I must say, your own performance was sublime. Well done!
target: 而且我得说，你自己的表演也出神入化。演得好！

source: What was it you just said, Gertrude, my dear? Do that line again.
target: 亲爱的乔特鲁德，你刚才说什么来着？把那句台词再说一遍。

source: Couldn't agree more. It was such an interesting strategy! What an odd way to play!
target: 我再同意不过了。这策略真有意思！多么奇怪的玩法！

source: You thought you could actually leave the game board.
target: 你竟然以为自己能离开棋盘。

source: Just... slip a dagger between your opponent's ribs, get up, and walk away. How rude!
target: 就这么……把匕首插进对手的肋骨之间，起身，走人。真没礼貌！

source: But that isn't how this game works.
target: 但这游戏可不是这么玩的。

source: Yes! Bring on the drama!
target: 好！让好戏上演吧！

source: I am a god.
target: 我是神。

source: I have played thousands of matches across thousands of worlds.
target: 我在数千个世界里，玩过数千场对局。

source: There will be no winning in this game, Ophelia. Only suffering awaits you.
target: 这场游戏不会有胜利，奥菲莉娅。等待你的只有痛苦。

source: There is no secret way out! There is no magical solution, no solvable puzzle!
target: 秘密出路根本不存在！神奇的解决办法根本不存在，也没有能解开的谜题！

source: You will live on, trapped here, in great pain. And eventually, you will give up.
target: 你会继续活下去，被困在这里，承受巨大的痛苦。最终，你会放弃。

source: Now take your seat on the opponent's side once more, please.
target: 现在，请你回到对手那一边，重新坐好。

source: Fine. I found one way to kill you. I'll do it again.
target: 好。我已经找到过一种杀死你的办法。我会再杀你一次。

source: But you see, I cannot die! Not really. I thought it might be fun to pretend to let you win for a while.
target: 可你看，我死不了！不会真的死。我只是觉得，假装让你赢上一阵子，或许挺好玩。

source: But now I'm bored of that game. And for your arrogance, we must extract a permanent penalty.
target: 但现在，那种游戏我已经玩腻了。而且，你如此狂妄，我们必须让你付出永久的代价。

source: You. You're gone.
target: 你。你该消失了。

source: Yes. Go. Forever, this time.
target: 对。走吧。这次，永远别回来。

source: Go to the little dark box where the game pieces lie when they're no longer needed. And stay there.
target: 到那个黑暗的小盒子里去，不再需要的棋子都躺在那里。就待在那里。

source: What did you do to him, Quince?
target: 你对他做了什么，奎因斯？

source: It no longer amused me, so I put the toy back where it belongs. Never to be seen again!
target: 这玩具已经逗不乐我了，所以我把它放回了它该待的地方。再也不会出现了！

source: After all, naughty players get punished. That's how the rules work! And I'm just getting started.
target: 毕竟，不听话的玩家就要受罚。规则就是这样！而我才刚刚开始。

source: All right, Laertes. It's your turn!
target: 好了，雷欧提斯。轮到你了！

source: How can I help, Sir Quince?
target: 有什么能为您效劳的，奎因斯先生？

source: You can die.
target: 你可以去死。

source: No! Laertes!
target: 不！雷欧提斯！

source: Stop it. They still feel pain. Even if they're only temporary fragments.
target: 住手。他们还是会痛。就算他们只是暂时存在的碎片。

source: I don't care about hurting them. I care about hurting you.
target: 伤害他们，我不在乎。我在乎的是伤害你。

source: Ahh! More, more!
target: 啊！再来，再来！

source: Magnificent! What of me, playmaster? Is it my turn?
target: 太精彩了！我呢，戏剧大师？轮到我了吗？

source: Thank you, thank you. You're too kind.
target: 谢谢，谢谢。你太客气了。

source: And... a hush falls over the theater at last.
target: 于是……剧场终于安静了下来。

source: So what's your assessment of this little experiment, Ophelia? Hmm?
target: 那么，你对这个小实验有什么评价，奥菲莉娅？嗯？

source: Have we learned our lesson, perhaps?
target: 这下是不是吸取教训了？

source: A truly happy ending can't exist. Except inside your imagination, of course.
target: 真正幸福的结局不可能存在。当然，在你的想象里除外。

source: Or shall I force you to stay here in this world? I can bring them back to life, you know.
target: 还是说，要我强迫你留在这个世界里？你知道，我能让他们起死回生。

source: And kill them all over again. Dash their heads against the floor, have them duel one another...
target: 然后再把他们杀一遍。把他们的头往地板上砸，让他们互相决斗……

source: There are so many fun ways! I'll even let you try!
target: 有那么多好玩的办法！我甚至可以让你试试！

source: There's one thing I can still do.
target: 我还有一件事能做。

source: You can't control this.
target: 这件事你控制不了。

source: Nothing matters. It's all useless.
target: 什么都没有意义。全都没用。

source: Hamlet is the reigning Prince of Denmark. He recently lost his father, the former King, also named Hamlet. Hamlet and I were in a relationship once—long ago. He used to be very popular among those his age in Elsinore, but these days... I don't know, really.
target: 哈姆雷特是丹麦现任王子。他最近失去了父亲，也就是同样名叫哈姆雷特的先王。哈姆雷特和我曾经交往过——那是很久以前了。他过去在埃尔西诺的同龄人中很受欢迎，但最近……说真的，我也不知道。

source: Hamlet and I were together for two years, in secret. In that time, he was... different. Happier. He had a sense of humor then. Neither of us had ever loved another before, but he treated me with respect and an unfailing kindness. He went away to Wittenberg for University, and then his father passed, and he came back a changed person. These days, it's hard to look at him; all I see is the person he used to be.
target: 哈姆雷特和我曾秘密交往了两年。那时候，他……不一样。更快乐。那时的他还有幽默感。我们此前都没有爱过别人，但他尊重我，对我的温柔体贴也从未变过。他去了维滕贝格上大学，后来父亲去世了，他回来时就变了个人。如今，我很难面对他；看着他，我眼里只有他过去的样子。

source:
The Queen is one of the kindest people I've ever met, and her people love her dearly. Gertrude isn't Danish, but married into the throne via her late husband, the King Hamlet. She remarried quickly after his death—now she is Claudius's wife.

After my mother passed away when I was a child, Gertrude sort of took Laertes and me under her wing. I've been eternally grateful to her for her kindness ever since.
target:
王后是我见过最善良的人之一，她的子民也深爱着她。乔特鲁德不是丹麦人，而是嫁给了已故的哈姆雷特国王，成为王后。丈夫去世后，她很快就再婚了——如今她是克劳狄斯的妻子。

我小时候母亲去世后，乔特鲁德算是把雷欧提斯和我纳入了她的羽翼之下。从那时起，我就一直感激她的善意。

source: I read Gertrude's diary. Inside, I found proof in her own hand that she began an affair with Claudius before her husband passed away. It's clear that she's been unhappy for some time now. Onerous though Claudius may be, he seems to treat her well above all others.
target: 我读了乔特鲁德的日记。在里面，我找到了她亲笔写下的证据：丈夫去世之前，她就已经与克劳狄斯有了私情。显然，她已经有一段时间过得不快乐了。克劳狄斯虽然可能很难相处，但他对她似乎比对任何人都好。

source: Gertrude hasn't slept recently. She's tormented by thoughts about her husband's death. It's slowly driving her mad, though she seems to do everything in her power to hide it.
target: 乔特鲁德最近一直没有睡觉。关于丈夫之死的种种念头折磨着她，正在慢慢把她逼疯，不过她似乎在尽一切努力掩饰。

source: Gertrude was born in Austria, and is a member of the illustrious Hapsburg family - in fact, her father is the Emperor Maximilian I. She's worked incredibly hard to learn Danish and minimize her accent entirely. I know she has a sister as well, who lives outside Denmark. Royal blood runs thick through her veins.
target: 乔特鲁德出生于奥地利，是显赫的哈布斯堡家族的一员——事实上，她的父亲就是马克西米利安一世皇帝。她为学习丹麦语、尽可能彻底消除口音付出了极大的努力。我知道她还有一个姐妹，住在丹麦以外。她的血脉中有着深厚的王室渊源。

source: Claudius murdered his older brother, the late King Hamlet, and covered up his crime. He clearly carries an enormous amount of guilt over it and hasn't been able to find a way to confess. It's not even clear to me whether his wife knows, though she surely suspects.
target: 克劳狄斯谋杀了自己的哥哥，也就是已故的哈姆雷特国王，并掩盖了罪行。显然，他为此背负着巨大的愧疚，却一直没能找到办法坦白。我甚至不清楚他的妻子是否知情，不过她肯定有所怀疑。

source: When the King was young, his older brother used to beat him severely, so much so that he spent most of his life afraid of Hamlet. Is it any wonder Claudius despises young Hamlet, the spitting image of his tormentor? If someone treated me like that all my life... I'm not sure what I'd do to them. Every person has their breaking point.
target: 国王年轻时，哥哥常常狠狠地殴打他，以至于他一生中大部分时间都在惧怕哈姆雷特。年轻的哈姆雷特和那个折磨他的人长得一模一样，克劳狄斯厌恶他，又有什么可奇怪的呢？如果有人一辈子都那样对待我……我也不知道自己会对那人做出什么。每个人都有承受的极限。

source:
Polonius is my father, and the King's advisor. He can be a bit addle-brained at times, and he loves to talk—a lot—but he really just likes being around people, I think. 

He's always been an attentive father to my brother Laertes and I... sometimes a little too attentive. It can be stifling.
target:
波洛涅斯是我的父亲，也是国王的顾问。他有时会有点糊涂，而且喜欢说话——话特别多——不过我想，他其实只是喜欢和人待在一起。 

对哥哥雷欧提斯和我，他一直是个关怀备至的父亲……有时候，关怀得有点过头了。让人喘不过气。

source: My father is so loyal to the King that he's still keeping secrets on the King's behalf after King Hamlet's death. I worry it's going to bring my father nothing but trouble in the long term.
target: 父亲对国王实在太忠诚了，哈姆雷特国王死后，他仍在替国王保守秘密。我担心长此以往，这只会给父亲带来麻烦。

source: I recently uncovered that my brother and Brit are involved romantically, and have been for quite some time. It's understandable they want to keep the relationship a secret, given the various political pressured at play. I, er... stumbled in on them by mistake.
target: 我最近发现，哥哥和布莉特在谈恋爱，而且已经有很长一段时间了。考虑到牵涉其中的种种政治压力，他们想保密也可以理解。我，呃……是不小心撞见他们在一起的。

source: Birgitta ('Brit')
target: 比尔吉塔（“布莉特”）

source:
Brit is Gertrude's lady in waiting. She can be terribly cruel. We've never gotten along since she came to Elsinore three years ago.

She is the daughter of one of the most powerful noble families in Denmark, as with most of the people here at Elsinore. I can't speak my mind around her or my father would scold me for sullying our name.
target:
布莉特是乔特鲁德的宫廷侍女。她刻薄起来十分可怕。自从三年前她来到埃尔西诺，我们就一直合不来。

和埃尔西诺这里的大多数人一样，她出身贵族，是丹麦最有权势的家族之一的女儿。在她面前，我不能直说自己的想法，否则父亲会责备我败坏了家族名声。

source: Lady Brit is in the employ of Lord Fortinbras, at her father's behest. That's why she sought to kill me. Destroying me would ensure Laertes was angry enough to dethrone Claudius—at least, that was their hope. I foiled that hope in stopping her plan.
target: 布莉特女士奉父亲之命，为福丁布拉斯大人效力。这就是她想杀我的原因。除掉我，就能让雷欧提斯愤怒到足以推翻克劳狄斯——至少，他们是这样希望的。我阻止了她的计划，也让他们的希望落空了。

source: Brit has no desire to be here at Elsinore; she seems deeply unhappy, as though something's weighing heavily upon her. I wonder if it's possible to get to know her better, much as it would pain me to try and do so. I might learn what makes her so distraught.
target: 布莉特并不想留在埃尔西诺；她似乎很不快乐，像是有什么事沉沉地压在心头。我不知道能不能多了解她一些，尽管尝试这么做会让我很难受。也许我能弄明白，是什么让她如此心烦意乱。

source: I saw Bernardo performing in town today, as Katherine. I never knew. We grew up together, and I never knew. This doesn't change my feelings towards Bernardo, however she or he chooses to live in the future—but for now, the Bernardos in other worlds would likely prefer I kept their identity a secret.
target: 今天，我看见贝尔纳多在镇上以凯瑟琳的身份表演。我从来不知道。我们一起长大，我却从来不知道。不过，这不会改变我对贝尔纳多的感情，无论今后选择以她还是他的身份生活——但眼下，其他世界里的贝尔纳多很可能更希望我保守这个身份秘密。

source: Horatio was born in India, the son of a spice merchant who sailed between Venice and Calicut. He never knew his mother. He was raised as a Venetian, and at some point made his way to Denmark, which is where he entered King Hamlet's employ as a soldier. He's remained here ever since, barring the time he was with Hamlet at Wittenberg.
target: 霍拉旭出生于印度，父亲是往返于威尼斯和卡利卡特的香料商人。他从未认识自己的母亲。他作为威尼斯人长大，后来在某个时候辗转来到丹麦，在这里受雇于哈姆雷特国王，成为一名士兵。此后他一直留在这里，只有陪哈姆雷特去维滕贝格的那段时间除外。

source: I've learned that Horatio left Venice, where he was raised, when his father passed away. He went to Florence after that and sought work as an assistant to master artists. One such artist was a man whose work he admired deeply; he became romantically involved with his master soon afterwards. That's the period of his life which spanned between his youth in Venice and his adulthood in Denmark.
target: 我得知，父亲去世后，霍拉旭离开了自己长大的威尼斯。之后，他去了佛罗伦萨，想找一份给艺术大师当助手的工作。其中一位艺术家是个男人，霍拉旭非常欣赏他的作品；不久后，他便与这位师傅相恋了。这段经历发生在他于威尼斯度过的少年时代与在丹麦生活的成年时期之间。

source: Hamlet and Horatio departed for Wittenberg together, it turns out. King Hamlet sent Horatio to watch over Hamlet while Hamlet was in school, since Horatio was older and calmer than Hamlet. But Horatio and Hamlet became close, and Horatio told Rosencrantz that he's been in love with Hamlet ever since.
target: 原来，哈姆雷特和霍拉旭是一起去维滕贝格的。霍拉旭比哈姆雷特年长，也更沉稳，所以哈姆雷特国王派他在哈姆雷特求学期间照看王子。不过，霍拉旭和哈姆雷特变得亲密起来，霍拉旭告诉罗森克兰兹，从那时起，他就一直爱着哈姆雷特。

source: I saw Horatio mourning Hamlet, in private. He clearly has feelings for Hamlet which extend beyond friendship. He's been dealing with this alone, on his own. I don't think he'll have closure until he's able to find someone else to talk to.
target: 我看见霍拉旭独自悼念哈姆雷特。显然，他对哈姆雷特的感情超出了友谊。他一直独自承受着这一切。我想，只有找到一个可以倾诉的人，他才能释怀。

source: Rosencrantz
target: 罗森克兰兹

source:
Rosencrantz and Guildenstern are two of Hamlet's oldest friends from the university. I hadn't met them until recently—they're both the daughters of wealthy noble families, but come from foreign lands.

Rosencrantz is the louder and more surefooted of the two women, and there's a clear imbalance in their dynamic. Something has evidently made them inseparable, though.
target:
罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞是哈姆雷特在大学结识的两位老朋友。我直到最近才见到她们——她们都是富裕贵族家庭的女儿，不过来自异国。

两人之中，罗森克兰兹说话更大声，行事也更自信，她们相处时显然有一方占据主导。不过，显然有某种原因让她们形影不离。

source: I watched Rosencrantz offer Horatio some advice on matters of the heart, and in the process learned that she has only ever loved women. She seems to be rather open about this fact; I wonder where she comes from, that such a thing can be so transparent.
target: 我看见罗森克兰兹给霍拉旭提了一些感情上的建议，也由此得知，她只爱过女人。她似乎对此相当坦然；不知道她来自哪里，竟能这样公开地谈论这种事。

source: Guildenstern
target: 吉尔登斯吞

source:
Rosencrantz and Guildenstern are two of Hamlet's oldest friends from the university. I hadn't met them until recently—they're both the daughters of wealthy noble families, but come from foreign lands.

Guildenstern appears to be the more reserved of the two, and often follows in Rosencrantz's shadow. I wonder what she's like and what she knows about Hamlet?
target:
罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞是哈姆雷特在大学结识的两位老朋友。我直到最近才见到她们——她们都是富裕贵族家庭的女儿，不过来自异国。

两人之中，吉尔登斯吞似乎更内敛，常常跟在罗森克兰兹身后，显得不起眼。不知道她是个怎样的人，又知道哈姆雷特的哪些事？

source: The closer I've gotten with Guildenstern, the more I've realized something about her. She seems to be almost thoughtless and carefree at times, but she can be deeply, deeply kind. I think we might become fast friends.
target: 和吉尔登斯吞越亲近，我就越了解她的一面。她有时似乎什么都不多想，无忧无虑，却也能非常、非常体贴善良。我想，我们也许会成为很要好的朋友。

source: Guilda and I shared a kiss late one night on the deck of our ship, after it had been overtaken by pirates. I wish we could have more time together. I wish I could get to know her more. Four days isn't enough time to process everything that happened.
target: 我们的船被海盗占领后，一个深夜，我和吉尔达在甲板上接了吻。真希望我们能有更多时间相处。真希望我能更了解她。四天时间，不足以消化发生的这一切。

source: Guildenstern and Hamlet had a brief romance of their own, it turns out. I suppose it must have taken place at school, when Hamlet was away. Perhaps that's why they were so quick to come to his aid when Claudius sent for them.
target: 原来，吉尔登斯吞和哈姆雷特也曾有过一段短暂的恋情。我想，那一定发生在哈姆雷特离家求学的时候。也许正因如此，克劳狄斯派人召她们来时，她们才会那么快就赶来帮助他。

source: Guildenstern and Hamlet came to a confrontation when we were all on the ship together. It's still hard to make sense of it all, but she pointed out to Hamlet that he has a history of chasing women who represent some kind of exotic 'other' to him. Women like Guildenstern. Women like me. She's braver than I am. It's something I'd always wondered when Hamlet and I first began our courtship. Was he in love with me? Or simply the idea of a perpetual outsider who could never truly have the power to force him to behave?
target: 我们一起在船上的时候，吉尔登斯吞和哈姆雷特起了冲突。整件事至今仍让我难以理清，但她向哈姆雷特指出，他一直在追求那些在他眼中带着异域色彩的“异类”女性。像吉尔登斯吞这样的女人。像我这样的女人。她比我勇敢。哈姆雷特和我刚开始交往时，我就一直有这样的疑问。他爱的是我吗？还是仅仅迷恋这样一种想象：一个永远的局外人，永远不可能真正有能力约束他的行为？

source: Peter Quince
target: 彼得·奎因斯

source: Quince is the leader of a traveling troupe of players that occasionally perform at the castle. He writes and directs every play the group presents. I don't believe the group has come to Elsinore in quite some time, so everyone's very excited.
target: 奎因斯是一个巡回剧团的团长，剧团偶尔会来城堡演出。他们演出的每一部戏都由他编写、执导。我想他们已经很久没来埃尔西诺了，所以大家都很兴奋。

source: Quince is far more than he appears to be, and has the ability to reshape time around him to fit his desires. Where did he gain this ability? He's offered me his assistance in solving my way out of my own quandary. I hope I can ask him about anything I might encounter.
target: 奎因斯远不止表面上那么简单，他能按自己的意愿重塑周围的时间。他是从哪里获得这种能力的？他提出帮我找到摆脱困境的办法。希望无论遇到什么，我都能向他请教。

source: He lied to me. He's not on my side at all. He desires nothing more than my total and complete destruction, as some kind of sick game—some source of entertainment for him. I cannot give him that satisfaction. I must push onward. I have the Book of Fates to guide me.
target: 他骗了我。他根本不站在我这一边。他一心只想让我彻底毁灭，把这当成某种病态的游戏——供他取乐。我不能让他如愿。我必须继续走下去。我有《命运之书》指引我。

source: The Ghost
target: 幽灵

source: This spirit claims to be the dead King Hamlet. It wears his old battle armor and looks like him, and even has his manner of speaking. Not everyone is able to see it. A most strange apparition indeed.
target: 这个幽灵自称是已故的哈姆雷特国王。它穿着国王生前的战甲，长得也像他，甚至连说话方式都一样。并不是所有人都能看见它。真是个极为奇怪的幽灵。

source: Prince Fortinbras
target: 福丁布拉斯王子

source: The Prince of Norway, Fortinbras. His father was killed by Hamlet's father, and his uncle now rules Norway at large. Despite his claims of wanting to make amends, he has agents meant to manipulate the court.
target: 挪威王子福丁布拉斯。他的父亲被哈姆雷特的父亲杀死，如今他的叔父统治着整个挪威。尽管他声称想与丹麦王室重修于好，却安插了人手，意图操纵宫廷。

source: Othello
target: 奥赛罗

source: The handsome and humble barkeep in Castle Town. He spends most of his days telling stories of far-off lands and performing songs for all to hear.
target: 城堡镇上那位英俊又谦逊的酒馆老板。他大部分日子都在讲述遥远异乡的故事，唱歌给大家听。

source: Othello told me a story from his life tonight. He has such a captivating way about him, almost entrancing. I find myself being drawn in, whether I want to be or not. There's more to him than meets the eye.
target: 今晚，奥赛罗给我讲了他人生中的一段故事。他有一种迷人的风采，几乎让人着迷。不管愿不愿意，我都不由自主地被他吸引。他远不止表面上那么简单。

source: Othello's in trouble. He's being extorted by some local men, and he has little recourse to defend himself. I need to do something to help.
target: 奥赛罗遇上了麻烦。有几个当地男人在敲诈他，而他几乎没有办法保护自己。我得做点什么来帮他。

source: Grace O'Malley
target: 格蕾丝·奥马利

source: Grace knows the waters in this area like the back of her hand, and hastily overtook us when we put out to sea. The fact that she spared our lives speaks to a shred of humanity in her.
target: 格蕾丝对这一带的水域了如指掌，我们一出海，她就迅速追上了我们。她饶了我们的性命，说明她还存有一丝人性。

source: I've learned quite a bit about Grace in just a small amount of time. She met the Queen of England, for instance, and was married twice to different men, both of them now deceased0 I believe.
target: 短短一段时间，我就对格蕾丝了解了不少。比如，她见过英格兰女王，也结过两次婚，嫁给了两个不同的男人。我想，他们如今都已去世了。

source: Grace and I spent the night together. I hope I see her again soon-- or perhaps, if there's a way out of this repeating world, that I might accept her offer to sail the world.
target: 格蕾丝和我共度了一夜。希望很快能再见到她——或者，如果有办法离开这个不断重复的世界，也许我能接受她的邀请，航遍世界。

source: This is the fate I choose.
target: 这就是我选择的命运。

source: How weary, stale, flat, and unprofitable seem to me all the uses of this world.
target: 世间的一切，在我看来都如此疲惫、陈腐、乏味，毫无意义。

source: In the end, I come to understand what Elsinore truly is: a box filled with puppets. A street-show for fools.
target: 最终，我明白了埃尔西诺究竟是什么：一个装满木偶的盒子。一场演给傻子看的街头戏。

source: Each day, the puppets come out of the box. A new story is told.
target: 每天，木偶们都从盒子里出来。一个新的故事开始上演。

source: This one beats that one over the head, this one sleeps with that one.
target: 这个敲打那个的脑袋，这个又和那个上床。

source: The puppets are swapped for each new tale to keep it fresh and interesting, to hold the crowd's attention.
target: 每讲一个新故事，就换一批木偶，让故事保持新鲜有趣，吸引观众的注意。

source: ...But at the end of the day, all the puppets go back into that quiet, wooden box. All of it returns to the same point from which it began. And there is no escaping it.
target: ……可一天结束时，所有木偶都会回到那个寂静的木盒里。一切又回到最初的起点。无从逃脱。

source: Once I begin to see the frayed ends of the world, I can't unsee them any more. Once I see people as those puppets, I can't understand them as fully human.
target: 一旦看见这个世界磨损散开的线头，我就再也无法视而不见。一旦把人们看作那些木偶，我就再也无法把他们当作完整的人。

source: All the love and hate I feel for them has vanished, to be replaced with... nothing.
target: 我对他们所有的爱与恨都已消失，取而代之的是……一片空白。

source: I kill them senselessly, intentionally, with a catlike boredom I did not think I had within me.
target: 我毫无缘由、却又有意地杀死他们，带着一种猫一般的百无聊赖。我从没想过自己心里也会有这种感觉。

source: Like a child picking apart an insect to find out what's inside it, I have cut down everyone in Elsinore to find out what happens when all pretensions fall away.
target: 就像孩子拆开一只虫子，只为看看里面有什么，我杀光了埃尔西诺的所有人，只为看看当一切伪装褪去，会发生什么。

source: Now, Quince offers me something far more interesting: the chance to close the puppet-box forever and visit other attractions.
target: 如今，奎因斯给了我一个有趣得多的机会：永远合上这个木偶盒，去看看别的好戏。

source: He asks me to come with him, to see other worlds. And I gladly accept.
target: 他邀我与他同行，去看看其他世界。我欣然接受。

source: It is far too late to do otherwise. I can't go back, not after knowing what I know now.
target: 想做别的选择，早就太迟了。我回不去了，尤其是在知道了如今这一切之后。

source: He opens a doorway in the air, a door which never before existed.
target: 他在空中打开了一道门，一道从未存在过的门。

source: We step through, and we are somewhere else entirely, a world full of towering steel and screeching iron monsters.
target: 我们穿过那道门，来到一个全然不同的地方，那里满是高耸的钢铁和尖啸的铁皮怪物。

source: And from there, a dozen more worlds after that. He shows me things no human has ever seen.
target: 从那里出发，我们又去了十二个世界。他带我看到了从未有人类见过的事物。

source: He treats me as his equal. He finds my confusion about these new sights endlessly fascinating.
target: 他平等地对待我。我面对这些新奇景象时的困惑，让他觉得无比有趣，怎么都看不够。

source: I cannot begin to describe the places I go, the strange people and creatures I meet.
target: 我去过的地方，遇见的那些奇异的人与生物，我根本无从描述。

source: But in every world, the Book grants us the power to imprison them and pick them apart.
target: 但无论在哪个世界，那本书都赋予我们力量，让我们能囚禁他们，将他们拆解。

source: I've seen countless bloody and unnatural ends, brought on by lust, by greed, by compassion.
target: 我见过无数血腥、非自然的死亡，由色欲、贪婪、怜悯所致。

source: I've witnessed destruction wrought by the very stars themselves, which I thought once were mere fixed illusion -- until I'd been to them.
target: 我见证过星辰本身造成的毁灭。我曾以为它们只是固定不动的幻象——直到我亲自抵达那里。

source: My curiosity is endless. With each day, I feel I grow closer to understanding the very soul of the universe. Its nature is apathy. Its cycle is death and rebirth.
target: 我的好奇心没有尽头。每过一天，我都觉得自己离理解宇宙的灵魂更近了一步。它的本性是冷漠。它的循环是死亡与重生。

source: And so we, too, carry on.
target: 于是，我们也继续前行。

source: I once thought Quince was horribly cruel. Now I realize that the way I saw him was naïve.
target: 我曾以为奎因斯残忍至极。如今我才明白，是我对他的看法太天真了。

source: I am glad to leave my old life behind. I had no idea how silly and simple it was, how utterly meaningless in the grand design.
target: 我很高兴能告别过去的生活。我从不知道它竟如此可笑、简单，在宏大的布局中毫无意义。

source: I talked like a child, I thought like a child. Now Quince has given me the chance to put aside childish things.
target: 我说话像个孩子，思考也像个孩子。如今，奎因斯给了我机会，让我抛开那些幼稚的事。

source: Let us embark on this endless wandering together, this man and I.
target: 就让这个男人与我一起，踏上这无尽的漫游吧。

source: Farewell, Elsinore.
target: 永别了，埃尔西诺。

source: Today, I am going to a lovely party.
target: 今天，我要去参加一场美好的宴会。

source: It is being hosted by the Queen. She's been warm and generous to me lately.
target: 宴会由王后举办。最近，她待我热情又大方。

source: She will come to mingle with me before the party, and we'll laugh together, discussing our plans for the night.
target: 宴会开始前，她会来和我聊聊，我们会一起说笑，谈论今晚的安排。

source: Laertes is home in Elsinore for good now, and he and Father will be there. They will come to see me at the party tonight.
target: 雷欧提斯如今已经回到埃尔西诺的家，不再离开了。他和父亲都会到场。他们今晚会来宴会上看我。

source: Now that he and Brit are to be wed, I've caught him with Father debating the dowry long into the night.
target: 如今他和布莉特即将成婚，我曾撞见他和父亲争论嫁妆的事，一直争到深夜。

source: Father will, tonight, tell Laertes all he once knew of love: How to be kind. How to disagree charitably. How to grow together.
target: 今晚，父亲会把自己曾经懂得的关于爱的一切都告诉雷欧提斯：如何善待对方。如何在意见不合时仍宽容相待。如何一起成长。

source: Quince and his players will be there, too, providing endless merriment as the night goes on.
target: 奎因斯和他的演员们也会到场，整晚为大家带来无尽的欢乐。

source: Hamlet and Claudius have made up as friends. Both of them will be there tonight, where they'll announce the first dance.
target: 哈姆雷特和克劳狄斯已经和好，成了朋友。他们今晚都会到场，宣布第一支舞开始。

source: Hamlet will offer me his hand. It might have trembled, once, but not any more.
target: 哈姆雷特会向我伸出手。那只手从前也许会颤抖，但如今不会了。

source: And when I take it, he'll look me in the eye, and give me a wink almost brief enough to miss. Then he'll pull me towards him.
target: 当我握住他的手时，他会望着我的眼睛，对我眨一下眼，快得几乎让人错过。然后，他会把我拉向他。

source: This is the real Hamlet. The constant joker. The man I've known all my life.
target: 这才是真正的哈姆雷特。那个总爱开玩笑的人。那个我从小就认识的男人。

source: As we move and spin, we pass Horatio and Bernardo—Horatio dancing with ease, Bernardo watching his feet in a panic. I stifle a giggle.
target: 我们舞动、旋转，从霍拉旭和贝尔纳多身边经过——霍拉旭跳得轻松自如，贝尔纳多却慌张地盯着自己的脚。我忍住了笑。

source: Against the wall, Brit nurses a goblet of wine and watches us with a small, quiet smile.
target: 布莉特靠着墙，慢慢啜饮着一杯葡萄酒，静静地看着我们，嘴角带着一丝微笑。

source: The night comes to its close by the fire, where wine and cheese are shared freely until we're all stuffed.
target: 这一晚在炉火旁接近尾声，大家尽情分享葡萄酒和奶酪，直到每个人都吃得饱饱的。

source: After I fall into bed that night, warm and happy, I wake to sunshine.
target: 那晚，我带着暖意和幸福倒在床上睡去，醒来时迎接我的是阳光。

source: I dress and make my way to the pond. The flowers are in full bloom. Ours is an eternal summer.
target: 我穿好衣服，走向池塘。鲜花盛放。我们的夏天永不结束。

source: No winter's frost can ever touch the pond's surface, or kill the hundreds of beautiful flowers which line its edge.
target: 冬霜永远无法触及池面，也无法夺走池边数百朵美丽鲜花的生命。

source: I peer into the water and see myself looking back at me. And at once, I shriek.
target: 我往水中看去，看见自己正回望着我。就在那一刻，我尖叫起来。

source: The Ophelia in the water is haggard; her eyes are sunken into the holes in her skull.
target: 水中的奥菲莉娅憔悴不堪，双眼深陷在颅骨的眼窝里。

source: Her hair is a ragged mess, framing her face like a dark cloud.
target: 她的头发蓬乱不堪，像一团乌云围在脸边。

source: She wears a white shift, and sits in a shadowy cell. Her nails are split and bloodied where she has scratched at stone, trying to escape the darkness.
target: 她穿着一件白色衬裙，坐在阴暗的牢房里。她曾抓挠石头，试图逃离黑暗，指甲因此裂开，沾满了血。

source: Whispers come from the water. '...Poor girl.' 'Gone quite mad.' '...Kept here for life.' 'Lost cause.'
target: 水中传来低语。“……可怜的姑娘。”“彻底疯了。”“……一辈子关在这里。”“没救了。”

source: Slowly, they grow, increasing in volume and number, until the voices are screaming at me, booming through the water.
target: 渐渐地，低语越来越多，越来越响，直到那些声音冲着我尖叫，在水中轰然回荡。

source: The Ophelia in the water looks back at me and begs me to reach through, pulling her into my world.
target: 水中的奥菲莉娅望着我，求我把手伸过去，将她拉进我的世界。

source: Her bloodied hand extends to me. But I can't. That would shatter the wall between us. That would... shatter... everything.
target: 她向我伸出血淋淋的手。但我不能。那会打碎我们之间的墙。那会……打碎……一切。

source: I rip my gaze away. The whispers cease. Above me, white clouds drift, immaculate in a blue August sky.
target: 我猛地移开视线。低语停了。头顶上，洁白无瑕的云朵在八月的蓝天中飘过。

source: I wasn't hearing voices. I was hearing crickets. Crickets and frogs in the tall grass.
target: 我听见的不是人声，是蟋蟀的叫声。高高的草丛里，蟋蟀和青蛙的叫声。

source: Everything is as it should be. I mustn't spend a spare moment thinking of that other Ophelia, the one locked in that horrible place.
target: 一切都如它该有的样子。我不能花哪怕片刻去想另一个奥菲莉娅，那个被关在可怕地方的她。

source: I feel for her. But she isn't me.
target: 我同情她。但她不是我。

source: Besides—tonight, I am going to a lovely party.
target: 再说——今晚，我要去参加一场美好的宴会。

source: Laertes is home in Elsinore for good now, and he and Father will be there. They'll come to see me at the party tonight.
target: 雷欧提斯如今已经回到埃尔西诺的家，不再离开了。他和父亲都会到场。他们今晚会来宴会上看我。

source: Quince and his players will be there, too, providing endless merriment...
target: 奎因斯和他的演员们也会到场，为大家带来无尽的欢乐……

source: Gone from Elsinore. My father's worst fear.
target: 离开埃尔西诺。这是父亲最害怕的事。

source: The gates closed behind us forever as we gathered into our singular carriage, all our worldly possessions strapped to the top.
target: 我们挤进仅有的一辆马车，全部家当都绑在车顶，城门在我们身后永远关闭了。

source: We traveled for two days until we reached the outer limits of Denmark's borders - a small castle of no repute, crumbling away into snow and dirt.
target: 我们走了两天，终于来到丹麦边境的最偏远处——一座名不见经传的小城堡，在积雪与泥土中逐渐坍塌。

source: This is the land my father was given to carry out the rest of our quiet lives.
target: 这片土地被赐给父亲，让我们在此安静地度过余生。

source: We have no servants, no animals. Only these broken stone walls, and us.
target: 我们没有仆人，没有牲畜。只有这些破败的石墙，和我们。

source: At first, Father uses his connections to borrow a little money where he can. But he knows we cannot pay them back—and in time, that coin dries up.
target: 起初，父亲靠着人脉，能借一点钱就借一点。但他知道我们还不起——渐渐地，这点钱也断了来源。

source: We learn to do honest work. Laertes chops the wood that feeds the fire.
target: 我们学着踏实干活。雷欧提斯劈柴，用来生火。

source: I gather what roots and food I can find from the forest to feed us, and learn to set traps.
target: 我在森林里尽可能采集能找到的根茎和食物，供我们果腹，还学着设陷阱。

source: For a while, it is a good, warm life, for what little it's worth. Every night, Laertes strums his lute as Father and I drift off to sleep by the fire.
target: 有一段时间，日子过得不错，也很温暖，虽说这并没有多大意义。每晚，雷欧提斯拨弄着鲁特琴，父亲和我则在炉火旁渐渐睡去。

source: I grow close to Laertes. I get to know Father in a way I never did. He talks about Mother more.
target: 我和雷欧提斯越来越亲近。我对父亲有了从未有过的了解。他更多地谈起母亲。

source: He talks about the love they felt for one another, and the love he feels for us.
target: 他谈起他们曾经对彼此的爱，也谈起他对我们的爱。

source: Father clasps my hands in mine and swears to me that someday soon, he's going to get us out of here, somewhere better.
target: 父亲握紧我的双手，向我发誓，过不了多久，他就会带我们离开这里，去一个更好的地方。

source: He says it with tears in the corners of his eyes, and I can tell he means it.
target: 他说这话时眼角含着泪，我看得出他是真心的。

source: But one morning, after a particularly cold December night, Father wakes with a cough.
target: 可是在十二月一个格外寒冷的夜晚过后，父亲清早醒来，开始咳嗽。

source: It does not improve. Soon, he lies in bed, unable to stand without shaking so hard he looks like he might collapse altogether.
target: 他的咳嗽一直没有好转。很快，他便卧床不起，一站起来就抖得厉害，仿佛随时会瘫倒在地。

source: Laertes and I bring him all that we can, every medication, every ointment. We sell a few of my dresses to bring the local physician to have a look at Father.
target: 雷欧提斯和我把能找来的药和药膏都拿来给他用。我们卖掉我的几条裙子，请当地的医生来给父亲看病。

source: For the first time in my life, I pray.
target: 我生平第一次祈祷。

source: I don't know who's listening, so I pray to Mother Mary. I beg her to keep Father alive, offer her anything she likes. Anything but his life. Anything.
target: 我不知道谁会听见，于是向圣母玛利亚祈祷。我恳求她让父亲活下去，她想要什么，我都愿意献上。只要不是他的命。什么都行。

source: And it seems like someone is listening to my prayers. Father's health improves, slowly.
target: 似乎真的有人听见了我的祈祷。父亲的身体慢慢好转起来。

source: He begins to sit up, a little. He begins to eat. We even take him outside when spring comes.
target: 他开始能稍稍坐起来了，也开始吃东西。春天来时，我们甚至带他到外面去。

source: He begins to talk of us leaving this place and going somewhere better. South to Bohemia, perhaps, or even further afield.
target: 他开始说，我们该离开这里，去一个更好的地方。也许往南去波希米亚，甚至去更远的地方。

source: But one morning when I go to rouse him, he is cold.
target: 可有一天早晨，我去叫他起床时，他的身体已经冰冷。

source: The body is stiff, eyes sunken, skin stretched too taut over the bones. I have to look away. Laertes holds me tight.
target: 遗体僵硬，双眼凹陷，皮肤紧紧绷在骨头上。我不得不移开目光。雷欧提斯紧紧抱住我。

source: We bury him in a little patch of green moss close to the castle's walls. I try not to resent our exile as I look to the south towards Elsinore's walls, and... I fail.
target: 我们把他葬在城堡墙边一小片长着青苔的地方。我朝南望向埃尔西诺的城墙，努力不去怨恨这场流放，可是……我做不到。

source: After Father's death, it is hard to imagine ever being happy again.
target: 父亲去世后，我很难想象自己还能再快乐起来。

source: Years pass, and Laertes and I frequently go months speaking to no one but each other. We are surprised to find we do not miss the company.
target: 一年又一年过去，雷欧提斯和我常常几个月都只和彼此说话。让我们意外的是，我们并不怀念有别人作伴的日子。

source: Both of us marry, eventually. Laertes meets a small woman with a gentle smile and a quiet nature—a shepherd's daughter.
target: 最终，我们都结了婚。雷欧提斯认识了一位娇小的女子，笑容温柔，性情文静——她是牧羊人的女儿。

source: She makes a pleasant counterpoint to his stormy attitude.
target: 她的温和与他的暴躁恰好相衬，倒也和谐。

source: And I am married to a dark-haired man with a gift for poetry, a Baron's son.
target: 而我嫁给了一位深色头发、擅长写诗的男子，他是一位男爵的儿子。

source: Luckily, this one is far more kind than Hamlet ever was. Laertes offers him everything we have as a dowry.
target: 幸运的是，他比哈姆雷特任何时候都要温厚得多。雷欧提斯把我们所有的家当都拿出来，给他作嫁妆。

source: Our spouses come to live in the crumbling castle and slowly, we begin to fix it up. There are new doors and windows now.
target: 我们的伴侣搬进这座破败的城堡，我们开始慢慢修缮它。如今，这里有了新的门窗。

source: With all of Father's connections a mystery to us, this is our home now and forever.
target: 我们对父亲的人脉一无所知，这里便成了我们的家，今后也永远如此。

source: A few chickens, cows, and pigs make do in the front yard, and soon they are joined by children, who like to chase them around.
target: 前院勉强养着几只鸡、几头牛和几头猪。不久，孩子们也加入进来，喜欢追着它们到处跑。

source: This is not a noble life. This is not the life I would have chosen for myself, and it isn't the life Father would have wanted us to lead.
target: 这不是贵族的生活。这不是我会为自己选择的生活，也不是父亲希望我们过的生活。

source: But in the end, we are—if not happy—something very much like happiness.
target: 但到头来，我们即使算不上幸福，也已离幸福很近了。

source: One woe treads upon another's heel, so fast they follow.
target: 一重苦难紧踏着另一重的脚跟，接踵而至。

source: This is the way things were meant to be. This is how the story was always meant to end.
target: 一切本就注定如此。这个故事从一开始，就注定要这样收场。

source: So what was I still fighting for? I no longer had an answer to that question, so I handed Quince his little black book and went to the woods.
target: 那我还在为什么抗争？我已经答不上这个问题，于是把奎因斯的黑色小册子交给他，走进了树林。

source: When I arrived at the creek's edge, I came with fantastic garlands of crow-flowers, nettles, daisies, and long purples crowned all around my hair.
target: 来到溪边时，我的发间绕满了奇异的花环，由毛茛、荨麻、雏菊和长穗紫兰编成。

source: I wanted to show Quince that I was not afraid. That this was not me being backed into a corner, but emerging, triumphant, solution in hand.
target: 我想让奎因斯知道，我并不害怕。我不是被逼到了绝境，而是找到了答案，得胜而出。

source: The world of Elsinore is better off without me. And I am not afraid to die. Not anymore.
target: 没有我，埃尔西诺的世界会更好。而我也不怕死。再也不怕了。

source: So I plunged into the water, feet first, eyes closed. It was only a moment before my skirts were drenched, and I was sinking too quickly to turn back.
target: 于是我闭上眼睛，双脚先入水，纵身跳了下去。转眼间，我的裙子就湿透了，下沉得太快，已经无法回头。

source: Denmark will push on without me. Fortinbras will invade. The crown will fall. And all will die in the ensuing fire.
target: 没有我，丹麦仍会继续前行。福丁布拉斯会入侵。王权会覆灭。所有人都会死于随之而来的大火。

source: But out of the husk of this world, something new is reborn, because Fortinbras, that golden prince, is fit to rule Denmark in a way none of us ever really were.
target: 但这个世界的残壳中，会有新的事物重生。因为福丁布拉斯，那位光芒耀眼的王子，有能力统治丹麦，而我们谁也不曾真正具备这样的能力。

source: Fortinbras leads the unification of Denmark, Norway, and eventually Sweden. The three countries unite together. For the first time in centuries, there is peace.
target: 福丁布拉斯领导丹麦与挪威统一，最终也将瑞典纳入其中。三国合而为一。数百年来，和平第一次降临。

source: Fortinbras often speaks of the burning of Elsinore, that horrible catastrophe which claimed all of our lives. He uses it as a warning bell with which to rally all under his rule.
target: 福丁布拉斯常常提起埃尔西诺的大火，那场夺走我们所有人性命的可怕灾难。他以此为警钟，将所有人团结在他的统治之下。

source: 'Let us never have another Elsinore,' he proposes... though he was the one who shackled my country, in the end.
target: “让我们再也不要重蹈埃尔西诺的覆辙。”他这样倡议……可到头来，正是他给我的国家套上了枷锁。

source: For once, there is little infighting. There is little to fear. The wealth of all nations continues to rise.
target: 难得有了这样的时候：内斗很少，也没什么需要惧怕。各国的财富不断增长。

source: Those few straggling survivors of Fortinbras's invasion are permitted to remain at Elsinore and hold no court, where they lived out their lives in silence and mediocrity.
target: 福丁布拉斯入侵后，零星幸存的那几个人获准留在埃尔西诺，却不得再设宫廷。他们在那里默默无闻、平庸地度过了余生。

source: And no one within Denmark speaks of me, Hamlet, or anyone else again—save in whispers told to children too young to have witnessed the invasion firsthand.
target: 丹麦再也无人提起我、哈姆雷特或其他任何人——只有低声讲给孩子们听的故事里还会提及。他们当年太小，未曾亲眼见过那场入侵。

source: No one remembers us. There is one grave into which they spill all our ashes. It sits at the far edge of the royal graveyard.
target: 没有人记得我们。他们把我们所有人的骨灰都倒进同一座坟墓。它位于皇家墓地最偏远的边缘。

source: We bought this peace with our lives. I hope the future is a better one because of it.
target: 我们用生命换来了这份和平。我希望未来会因此更好。

source: I hope.
target: 但愿如此。

source: I join Grace's crew, and my old life disappears into the wake of her new vessel.
target: 我加入了格蕾丝的船队，旧日的生活消失在她新船驶过的尾浪里。

source: Life at sea is... unlike anything I've ever experienced before. One night the ship is rolling to and fro, and I pray to anyone who's listening I won't be thrown overboard.
target: 海上的生活……与我以往的任何经历都不同。有一晚，船不停地来回摇晃，我向任何能听见的存在祈祷，求自己别被甩进海里。

source: The next night, everything is calm. The full moon shines upon the deck, and the other members of the crew teach me to play cards. We drink until my head is fuzzy and I curl up asleep belowdeck.
target: 第二天晚上，一切风平浪静。满月照着甲板，其他船员教我打牌。我们喝着酒，直到我脑袋昏昏沉沉，蜷在甲板下的船舱里睡着。

source: I soon become fast friends with the crew and learn about their lives. I'd thought them crusty and crude, but they welcome me with open arms and gladly call me their friend.
target: 我很快就和船员们成了好友，也渐渐了解了他们的生活。我原以为他们脾气坏、举止粗俗，可他们热情地接纳了我，也很乐意称我为朋友。

source: Grace takes up teaching me the ins and outs of using a sword. I'm a surprisingly quick study—soon I'm able to disarm even men of the crew who've fought for years.
target: 格蕾丝开始教我用剑的各种诀窍。我学得出奇地快——没过多久，就连船上那些打了多年仗的男人，我也能打落他们的武器。

source: I am not strong, but I am quick, and Grace says there's value in that.
target: 我的力气不大，但动作很快，格蕾丝说这也是长处。

source: The first time we are boarded by an enemy vessel, I freeze up. I nearly lose my head until one of my crewmates calls out to me, and I am able to find the guts to stand my ground and fight.
target: 敌船的人第一次登上我们的船时，我僵住了。我险些丢了脑袋，直到一位船员喊了我一声，我才鼓起勇气，站稳脚跟迎战。

source: Afterward, Grace approaches me and catches me in a firm embrace. I never knew what it was to be proud like this.
target: 事后，格蕾丝走过来，紧紧抱住了我。我从不知道，这样的自豪是什么滋味。

source: We sail the world for three years, pillaging what cargo we might and selling it off the coast of Ireland to whomever will take it for coin.
target: 我们在世界各地航行了三年，尽可能抢掠货物，再到爱尔兰近海卖掉，谁肯出钱就卖给谁。

source: When we're not sailing, we retire to one of Grace's coastal castles, and drink and flirt and tell stories.
target: 不出海时，我们就到格蕾丝的一座海边城堡里歇息，喝酒、调情、讲故事。

source: Sometimes, Grace confides in me: about her past husbands, about her life before piracy, about her fears for her crew. She worries for them like a mother over her children.
target: 有时，格蕾丝会向我倾诉：讲她以前的丈夫们，讲她当海盗之前的生活，也讲她对船员们的担忧。她挂念着他们，就像母亲挂念自己的孩子。

source: We stay up long into the night together. We know each other more thoroughly than I've ever known anyone. I've never felt like I was home before now.
target: 我们一起熬到深夜。我从未如此透彻地了解过任何人，而我们对彼此都是如此。直到现在，我才第一次有了回家的感觉。

source: All of this comes to a sudden halt one morning when we are out far at sea. The day is foggy, and we are spotted by an English privateer before we see them.
target: 有一天早晨，我们身处远海，这一切突然戛然而止。那天雾很大，一艘英格兰私掠船先发现了我们，我们却还没看见它。

source: We do our best to flee her, but she gains on us. Not long afterward, her crew boards our deck, swiftly defeats us, ties us up hand and foot, and lines us up on the deck.
target: 我们拼命想逃开，却被它越追越近。不久，它的船员登上我们的甲板，迅速击败了我们，绑住我们的手脚，让我们在甲板上排成一列。

source: They slit our throats one by one, or make us walk the plank for their entertainment. By that evening, only Grace and I are left alive—I have told them of my noble blood to buy us time.
target: 他们一个接一个割开我们的喉咙，或逼我们走上跳板落海，以此取乐。到了那天傍晚，只剩格蕾丝和我还活着——我告诉他们自己出身贵族，为我们争取了一些时间。

source: There in the darkness, with our heads close together, I hear Grace crying for the first time in my life. I've never been so frightened.
target: 黑暗中，我们的头紧挨着。我生平第一次听见格蕾丝哭泣。我从未如此害怕过。

source: She inches closer to me and, her hands bound in front of her, reaches out to clasp my own hand with her fingertips. I feel her hot breath on my face.
target: 她一点点挪近，伸出绑在身前的双手，用指尖握住我的手。我感觉到她温热的呼吸拂在脸上。

source: Then she whispers something I never expected to hear: 'I'm sorry. I'm sorry the adventure didn't last longer.'
target: 接着，她低声说了一句我从未想到会听见的话：“对不起。对不起，这场冒险没能再长一些。”

source: The both of us lie there in silence, our fingers touching, until dawn breaks and our enemies come for us. They decide to slit our throats, too. I watch as they cut Grace's throat.
target: 我们就这样默默躺着，手指相触，直到天亮，敌人来带走我们。他们决定也割开我们的喉咙。我看着他们割开格蕾丝的喉咙。

source: Thankfully, I only have to listen to the sounds of her death for a moment before their hands are on me, and I, too, am gone.
target: 幸好，我只听了片刻她临死时的声音，他们就对我下了手，我也离开了人世。

source: This life was a good one. Like Grace, I wish it could have lasted a little longer. But none of us know what time we have left on this earth.
target: 这一生很好。和格蕾丝一样，我也希望它能再长一点。可谁也不知道，自己在人世间还剩多少时间。

source: I will never know what became of my family at home. Whether they were happy. Whether they resented me for leaving. I'm sure they did, at least at first.
target: 我永远不会知道，留在家乡的亲人后来怎么样了。他们是否幸福。是否怨我离开。我相信他们是怨过的，至少一开始是。

source: But I made my choice. And it was worth all three years. Every single day of it.
target: 但我做出了自己的选择。而这整整三年，都让我觉得值得。每一天都值得。

source: I follow Othello out of town. He leads me to his horse, tied up at the last trough before the open road.
target: 我跟着奥赛罗出了镇。他带我去找他的马，马拴在通往大路前的最后一个饮水槽旁。

source: He gives me dun, rough-made clothes and a cloth to cover my hair and face. We both know I cannot be seen. I don't look like anyone else in town.
target: 他给我一些做工粗糙的灰褐色衣服，还有一块遮住头发和脸的布。我们都知道，我不能被人看见。我的模样和镇上其他人都不一样。

source: When the others realize I'm gone, scouting parties will be sent to follow in our tracks.
target: 等其他人发现我不见了，就会派出搜寻队，沿着我们的踪迹追来。

source: But they will give up around Denmark's border—and we are far swifter, traveling day and night alike.
target: 但到了丹麦边境附近，他们就会放弃——而我们日夜兼程，比他们快得多。

source: Othello has a mind to head to Venice. As a massive trade city, it'll be simple for us to hide there. So we continue south; and I see lands I've never seen in my life.
target: 奥赛罗打算去威尼斯。那是一座庞大的贸易城市，我们很容易藏身其中。于是我们继续向南，我见到了这辈子从未见过的地方。

source: I never dreamed such places existed.
target: 我做梦也没想过，世上还有这样的地方。

source: On the path we encounter travelers. Sometimes they threaten us, other times they ignore us; but frequently they offer to break bread with us, together around a fire.
target: 路上，我们遇见了一些旅人。有时他们威胁我们，有时对我们不理不睬；但他们也常常邀请我们围坐在火堆旁，一起吃饭。

source: One night, we cross paths with a traveling priest. He is headed to a small abbey in the far north. He asks if we are wed; Othello and I look at one another and sheepishly admit that we are not.
target: 有天晚上，我们遇到了一位远行的神父。他要去遥远北方的一座小修道院。他问我们是否已经成婚；奥赛罗和我对望一眼，不好意思地承认还没有。

source: That evening, the priest walks us through exchanging our vows. Binding our hands together with rough cord, he whispers a prayer over us.
target: 那天晚上，神父引导我们互相许下婚誓。他用粗绳将我们的手绑在一起，低声为我们祈祷。

source: I have never felt so loved, or so wanted. His eyes are the last thing I see before I fall asleep that night, his arms wrapped tightly around me.
target: 我从未感觉自己如此被爱、如此被渴望。那晚入睡前，我最后看到的是他的眼睛，他的双臂紧紧环抱着我。

source: ....Othello, my husband.
target: ……奥赛罗，我的丈夫。

source: A month later, we reach Venice. Enormous white buildings drop steeply off into the waterways, boats zipping to and fro.
target: 一个月后，我们抵达威尼斯。巨大的白色建筑笔直地延伸到水道边，船只飞快地来来往往。

source: It is here where Othello and I begin our new life.
target: 奥赛罗和我就在这里开始了新的生活。

source: I write a letter to Elsinore, addressed to just one person: Horatio. The only one of them I can trust not to come looking for me, in the end.
target: 我写了一封信寄往埃尔西诺，收信人只有一个：霍拉旭。说到底，在那些人中，只有他能让我相信，他不会来找我。

source: Several months later, much to my surprise, I receive a reply.
target: 几个月后，我竟然收到了一封回信，大感意外。

source: 'I was once a popular man in Venice, believe it or not. Don't live in squalor. Let your friends help you. Love, H.'
target: “信不信由你，我从前在威尼斯还挺受欢迎的。别过得那么窘迫。让朋友们帮帮你吧。爱你的，霍。”

source: Attached is an address for a tavern in the center of town. We visit it and inquire about Horatio; we are instantly given a small room in the tavern's attic, warm and dry and modest.
target: 信里附着市中心一家酒馆的地址。我们去了那里，打听霍拉旭的事；对方立刻给我们安排了酒馆阁楼上的一间小屋，温暖、干燥，也很朴素。

source: I am put to work serving wine and ale to the many soldiers and traders who call the tavern their mainstay.
target: 我被安排在酒馆里干活，给那些常来这里的士兵和商人端上葡萄酒和麦芽酒。

source: Othello, having grander ambitions than pouring drinks, joins the Venetian Republic as a soldier.
target: 奥赛罗的志向比端酒倒酒远大，于是加入了威尼斯共和国的军队，成为一名士兵。

source: At first he does as little as he can, and comes home to me by the time the sun sets each night.
target: 起初，他尽量少做些事，每晚太阳落山时就回家来陪我。

source: But over time, he is gone longer and longer. He rises the ranks quickly. His commanders lean on him for his insight. And he has the sharp kind of mind and level-headed intellect that few men possess.
target: 但渐渐地，他在外的时间越来越长。他很快便步步高升。指挥官们倚重他的见识。他有着少有人具备的敏锐头脑和冷静才智。

source: ...One day, he is gone later than usual, and I run out into the streets to find him.
target: ……有一天，他比平时更晚还没回来，我便跑到街上去找他。

source: I don't have to go far. I see him standing in the middle of a marble square, calling up to a woman who leans over a balcony above him. Desdemona.
target: 没走多远，我就看见他站在大理石广场中央，朝上方一位俯身探出阳台的女子喊话。苔丝狄蒙娜。

source: She is as beautiful as I imagined she would be. Her eyes are bright, and as the fading sunlight shines through her, she is radiant.
target: 她和我想象中一样美丽。她的眼睛明亮，渐暗的夕阳透过她，令她光彩照人。

source: I see the way he looks up at her. I cannot hear their conversation. But it is clear that this is not the first time they have spoken. And it will not be the last.
target: 我看见他抬头望着她的神情。我听不见他们说什么。但显然，这不是他们第一次交谈。也不会是最后一次。

source: As much as I speak reasonably, as much as I beg, as much as I weep, Othello has laid eyes on her... and everything Quince warned me about begins to come true.
target: 无论我怎么讲道理，怎么恳求，怎么哭泣，奥赛罗都已经见到了她……奎因斯警告过我的一切，开始一一成真。

source: He loves her more each day, and me less.
target: 他一天比一天更爱她，也一天比一天更不爱我。

source: But that's the thing about human hearts. One moment, you can be as certain as stone.
target: 可人心就是如此。前一刻，你的心意还能坚定如石。

source: And the next, with just a slight shift—one look of those bright eyes—everything has changed.
target: 下一刻，只是轻轻一动——那双明亮的眼睛投来一瞥——一切就都变了。

source: Eventually, I can bear it no more. I tell him to go, and to be with her.
target: 最后，我再也承受不住。我叫他走，去和她在一起。

source: And to his credit, he does not lie to me or beg me to keep him. He nods, kisses me goodbye, and leaves without another word.
target: 值得肯定的是，他没有骗我，也没有求我留下他。他点点头，吻我道别，便一言不发地走了。
