source: But I stand alone. I need no one. I work at the tavern, and grow to like my small, comfortable, well-defined life.
target: 但我独自站稳了脚跟。我不需要任何人。我在酒馆工作，渐渐喜欢上自己这简单、舒适、界限分明的生活。

source: I even grow to love it sometimes, in the quiet moments.
target: 有时，在那些安静的时刻，我甚至渐渐爱上了这样的生活。

source: For years I loved a man who loved me more than life itself. A love to surpass the stars. A love which outshone even Desdemona.
target: 多年来，我爱着一个爱我胜过生命的男人。那份爱超越星辰。那份爱甚至让苔丝狄蒙娜也黯然失色。

source: I will never forget that love. But it's time for me to move on. And I do.
target: 我永远不会忘记那份爱。但我该继续往前走了。而我也做到了。

source: Venice is a magical city, a breathing, living city. It is full of art and life and God and the smell of the sea.
target: 威尼斯是一座神奇的城市，一座有呼吸、有生命的城市。这里处处是艺术、生活、上帝，还有大海的气息。

source: I find my own comfort here. At least it's not Elsinore. At least it's not Denmark.
target: 我在这里找到了属于自己的慰藉。至少这里不是埃尔西诺。至少这里不是丹麦。

source: But I made my choice. And it was worth it. Every single day of it.
target: 但我做出了自己的选择。而这一切都值得。每一天都值得。

source: No others were qualified to sit the throne of Denmark. It is time to let someone competent rule.
target: 没有其他人有资格坐上丹麦的王位。是时候让有能力的人来统治了。

source: Who better than the woman who has seen all possible fates? Who else can have the power I hold?
target: 谁能比见过所有可能命运的女人更合适？还有谁能拥有我掌握的力量？

source: I was once Cassandra, cursed to warn people and have them reject me.
target: 我曾是卡珊德拉，受诅咒向人们发出警告，却遭到他们拒绝。

source: Now I am Tyche, the goddess who makes her own destiny.
target: 如今我是堤喀，创造自身命运的女神。

source: Fortinbras meets me in Elsinore's throne room, and for the first time we are able to speak as peers.
target: 福丁布拉斯在埃尔西诺的王座厅与我会面，我们第一次能够以平等的身份交谈。

source: He agrees the war is senseless, so I cede him his little swamp, and we end it.
target: 他也认为这场战争毫无意义，于是我把他那一小片沼泽割让给他，我们就此结束了战争。

source: Let him have it. Let him have it all. Men's pride will always be the end of them.
target: 给他就是了。全给他就是了。男人的自傲总会让他们走向灭亡。

source: Denmark is smaller now, certainly, but all the richer—as Norway turns its focus to Sweden and the two tear each other apart.
target: 如今丹麦的疆域确实小了，却也更加富足——挪威转而盯上了瑞典，两国斗得两败俱伤。

source: And all I had to do to avert that fate was listen.
target: 而要避开那种命运，我所需要做的，不过是倾听。

source: The nobility are angry about taxation, about the flow of capital and power away from them. So I invite them to meet with me and I hear their grievances.
target: 贵族们对税收不满，对财富和权力从他们手中流失感到愤怒。于是我邀请他们来与我会面，听取他们的怨言。

source: At first, they think me unfit to rule. They argue over who ought to be King among them.
target: 起初，他们觉得我不配统治。他们争论着该由他们之中的谁来当国王。

source: But averting war with Norway is a point in my favor. Unproven though I might be, I am a Queen.
target: 但避免了与挪威的战争，让我多了几分优势。即使我的能力尚未得到证明，我也是女王。

source: These days I am free of anger, free of ego or envy. I feel nothing at all.
target: 如今，我没有愤怒，没有自负，也没有嫉妒。我什么都感觉不到。

source: I have nothing to lose. I have lost it all a hundred times before. And in that, the nobles find respect for me.
target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。我早已失去过一切，上百次。而这一点，让贵族们对我生出了敬意。

source: Claudius had moved to centralize power within the Danish crown and away from nobility.
target: 克劳狄斯曾着手将权力从贵族手中收回，集中到丹麦王室。

source: But now, I establish a system of checks and balances to ensure all parties have equivalent say.
target: 但如今，我建立了一套相互制衡的制度，确保各方都有同等的话语权。

source: No king should have the power to sway a kingdom and begin a war as he pleases. I've already seen the kind of bloodshed which lies down that route.
target: 任何国王都不该拥有随心所欲地左右国家、发动战争的权力。我已经见过走上那条路会带来怎样的流血。

source: Having earned their great respect, the nobility endeavor to work with me as much as possible.
target: 我赢得了贵族们极大的尊重，他们也尽可能努力与我合作。

source: We are able to enact incredible change. Things I never imagined possible when Claudius ruled alone.
target: 我们得以推行惊人的变革。在克劳狄斯独自统治时，我从未想过这些事能成为现实。

source: Now and then, I hear rumors and insults. People think me cold. They whisper of the deaths which plagued our court, the deaths which made me queen.
target: 偶尔，我会听见流言和辱骂。人们觉得我冷漠。他们低声议论着宫廷里接连发生的死亡，那些让我成为女王的死亡。

source: They believe I ought to grieve more than I do. They wonder if a woman of my standing should ever have been made queen.
target: 他们认为我应该表现得更悲痛。他们怀疑，像我这种身份的女人，究竟该不该被立为女王。

source: They wonder what happened to Ophelia, the girl—not Ophelia, the queen.
target: 他们想知道，奥菲莉娅那个姑娘究竟怎么了——而不是奥菲莉娅这位女王。

source: I know what became of the girl. Her future was stolen from her. She was forced to endure hell. And she came through it, alive but only half human.
target: 我知道那个姑娘变成了什么样。她的未来被夺走了。她被迫承受地狱般的折磨。她熬了过来，还活着，却只剩下一半人性。

source: Over time, those whom I called friends pull away from me. They cannot relate to the world I live in now, and I don't ask them to.
target: 渐渐地，那些我曾称为朋友的人疏远了我。他们无法理解我如今所处的世界，我也不要求他们理解。

source: I must do what is best for my country. Even if that means leaving my old life behind. Even if that means I weather this alone.
target: 我必须做对国家最有利的事。哪怕这意味着抛下过去的生活。哪怕这意味着独自承受这一切。

source: Out behind the castle, a tiny row of new white graves line the small hillock to the north.
target: 城堡后方，北面的小山丘上排列着短短一排新立的白色坟墓。

source: As the years pass, they, too, grow mossy and sink into the earth, joining the others. And memories of those who are buried beneath them fade into obscurity.
target: 岁月流逝，它们也长满青苔，沉入泥土，与其他坟墓一样。而那些埋葬在下面的人，也渐渐淡出人们的记忆，湮没无闻。

source: I do not go to visit them. I do not want to remember.
target: 我不去探望他们。我不想回忆。

source: I do not want to run into those who remain. I do not want their faces to linger.
target: 我不想碰见那些还在的人。我不想让他们的面容在脑海中挥之不去。

source: Living and dead comingle into a tiny box which I bury somewhere deep in my heart: The box of the Elsinore that was.
target: 生者与死者一同收进一个小小的盒子，被我埋在心底某个深处：那是装着昔日埃尔西诺的盒子。

source: From now on, my life will be focused on the Denmark that will be. The great nation to which all others will aspire.
target: 从今往后，我的人生将专注于未来的丹麦。一个其他国家都会向往的伟大国度。

source: I alert the war council to Elsinore's undefended gates, and we are able to rally in time to mount a defense.
target: 我向军事议会示警，告诉他们埃尔西诺的城门无人设防，我们得以及时集结，组织防御。

source: Rather than burning castle town on his way to the Great Hall, Fortinbras finds cohorts of men standing at the ready, weapons drawn.
target: 福丁布拉斯没能在前往大厅的路上焚烧城堡周围的镇子，迎接他的，是一队队严阵以待、兵器出鞘的士兵。

source: And despite his best efforts, when he is thrown deep into the underbelly of Elsinore's dungeons, he does not escape again.
target: 当他被扔进埃尔西诺地牢的最深处后，尽管使尽浑身解数，也没能再逃出去。

source: For all our quiet nature, when backed into a corner, Danes have always risen to defend our country with unrivaled ferocity.
target: 我们丹麦人虽然生性安静，但一旦被逼入绝境，总会奋起保卫自己的国家，勇猛无比。

source: Norway is deflected successfully. But not forever. Fortinbras must be returned to his people, and returned he is -- for a price.
target: 我们成功挡住了挪威。但这并非一劳永逸。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，他也确实被送了回去——不过，得付出代价。

source: But soon Sweden, emboldened by Norway's falter, moves in to attack us anew.
target: 但很快，挪威的失利让瑞典壮了胆，他们又向我们发起进攻。

source: Claudius uses an impending war to turn his image around with the Danish nobility and summon troops from them.
target: 克劳狄斯利用即将到来的战争，扭转自己在丹麦贵族眼中的形象，并向他们征调军队。

source: So when all three countries clash in full force, our masses are equal. Across the salted cliffs leading up to Elsinore's walls, war rages.
target: 所以，当三国倾尽全力交战时，我们的兵力旗鼓相当。通往埃尔西诺城墙、遍布盐渍的悬崖上，战火肆虐。

source: And that fight, unceasing, consumes everything each country had, until we are forced to assume debts from anywhere we can.
target: 这场无休止的战争耗尽了各国的一切，直到我们被迫四处举债，能借到哪里就借到哪里。

source: Father, Laertes and I settle in for several long winters. We watch as Denmark's coffers are drained of gold, day by day.
target: 父亲、雷欧提斯和我安顿下来，度过了几个漫长的冬天。我们看着丹麦国库里的黄金一天天耗尽。

source: Eventually, the war becomes a backdrop to our own personal hardships.
target: 最后，战争成了我们各自艰难生活的背景。

source: Things which had once been luxuries around the castle disappear overnight.
target: 城堡里曾经的那些奢侈品一夜之间消失了。

source: Hamlet is wed, with pomp and celebration, to Brit. All this for the price of more men, more horses, more coins from the pockets of the House of Brockenhuus.
target: 哈姆雷特与布莉特成婚，婚礼隆重，庆祝盛大。这一切，都是为了从布罗肯胡斯家族手中换来更多士兵、更多马匹、更多钱币。

source: Once-lavish feasts become a simple dinner of stew and bread.
target: 曾经丰盛的宴席，变成了只有炖菜和面包的简单晚餐。

source: We celebrate festivals quietly, internally, and do not throw the extravagant galas once common to Queen Gertrude's tastes.
target: 我们只在内部低调庆祝节日，不再举办乔特鲁德王后从前喜爱的那种奢华盛会。

source: At his wit's end, Father has my finest gowns sold to pay for a dowry for me, then offers my hand in marriage to the son of a wealthy family, a man whom I have never met.
target: 父亲无计可施，便让人卖掉我最好的礼服，为我置办嫁妆，然后提出将我许配给一个富裕人家的儿子，一个我从未见过的男人。

source: But my husband-to-be is killed a week later on the war front. A dark-humored blessing.
target: 但一周后，我的未婚夫便死在了前线。一桩带着黑色幽默的幸事。

source: Claudius taxes his countrymen to the greatest extent possible. They starve. We live.
target: 克劳狄斯竭尽所能地向国民征税。他们挨饿。我们活着。

source: We live. That's what's most critical, isn't it? We live. We wait out the rest of our lives, together as one castle, as one extended family.
target: 我们活着。这才是最要紧的，不是吗？我们活着。我们作为同一座城堡里的人，作为一个大家庭，一起等待余生过去。

source: Everyone survives. The first time Fortinbras attacked, I knew that was the future I wanted to see.
target: 所有人都活了下来。福丁布拉斯第一次进攻时，我就知道，这就是我想看到的未来。

source: Through my own labor I was able to make it come true. I had that power.
target: 靠着自己的努力，我让它成为了现实。我拥有那样的力量。

source: It is far better to have survived, intact and unhappy, than to have died at each others' hands, right?
target: 完好无损地活下来，哪怕不快乐，也远比死在彼此手上要好，对吧？

source: As long as we few are still alive... as long as my small tribe still lives... we can find some comfort in one another.
target: 只要我们这几个人还活着……只要我这一小群人还活着……我们就能从彼此身上找到些许慰藉。

source: This life is not glorious. Denmark slips more and more into obscurity as the shadow of war shrinks away.
target: 这样的生活并不光彩。随着战争的阴影渐渐退去，丹麦也越来越默默无闻。

source: We are a poor nation. As long as I live, we will always be a poor nation.
target: 我们是个贫穷的国家。在我的有生之年，我们都会是个贫穷的国家。

source: Let it slip away then, into dusty books and faint memories.
target: 那就让它渐渐淡去吧，留在蒙尘的书页和模糊的记忆里。

source: I will make no choice. I will keep Quince here in this hell with me. Forever.
target: 我不会做任何选择。我会把奎因斯留在这里，和我一起困在这地狱里。永远。

source: I cast the book into the fire of the Great Hall. It burns, but nothing comes of it.
target: 我把书扔进大厅的火里。它烧了起来，却什么也没发生。

source: When Fortinbras' men advance on Elsinore and time resets, the book is there, on my bedroom table.
target: 当福丁布拉斯的士兵向埃尔西诺推进，时间重置时，那本书就在那里，在我卧室的桌上。

source: Then, I clutch the book to my chest for weeks and lie in bed. Every four days, the castle burns to the ground. Every four days, I wake up again.
target: 随后，我把书紧紧抱在胸前，躺在床上，一连躺了几周。每隔四天，城堡便被烧成灰烬。每隔四天，我便再次醒来。

source: At first, Quince would come into my room and threaten me—scream—shout—anything to be frightening.
target: 起初，奎因斯会走进我的房间威胁我——尖叫——怒吼——使尽一切办法来吓唬我。

source: He would cast long shadows on the floor, or summon illusions to whisper my name.
target: 他会在地板上投下长长的影子，或召出幻象，低声呼唤我的名字。

source: Then, when I refused to do anything other than stare at the floor, he began to beg. That was more frightening.
target: 后来，我除了盯着地板，什么都不肯做，他便开始恳求。那反而更吓人。

source: To see such a powerful man being reduced to tears, a limp figure kneeling on the floor, clutching my hand and weeping...
target: 看着这样一个强大的男人沦落到泪流满面，无力地跪在地上，紧抓着我的手哭泣……

source: But even then, I knew precisely what it was: A ruse designed to extract some pity from me. I have none. Not for him.
target: 但即便如此，我也清楚地知道那是什么：不过是想从我这里骗取一点怜悯的伎俩。我没有怜悯。对他没有。

source: Elsinore is no more than a lifeless, empty shell to me now. I have walked its halls for what feels like a hundred years. Weary, stale, flat, and unprofitable.
target: 如今，埃尔西诺对我而言，不过是一具毫无生气的空壳。我在它的厅廊间走来走去，感觉已有百年。令人厌倦，陈腐，乏味，毫无意义。

source: I can never leave. And so long as I refuse to use the book, Quince can't move on, either. He needs it. He needs it to leave this world behind.
target: 我永远无法离开。而只要我拒绝使用这本书，奎因斯也无法继续前行。他需要它。他需要它才能离开这个世界。

source: I will not allow him to cause any more pain, to hurt anyone else the way he's hurt me.
target: 我不会再让他制造痛苦，不会让他像伤害我一样伤害别人。

source: Even if it means I must endure the anguish he imparts on me a thousand times...
target: 哪怕这意味着我必须承受他施加给我的痛苦，重复上千次……

source: Even if he kills me and rips my skin from my bones, or turns me into pulp...
target: 哪怕他杀了我，把我的皮从骨头上撕下来，或把我打成肉泥……

source: Even if he drowns me, or has me stabbed by my brother, or has my father tear my eyes out with his bare hands...
target: 哪怕他淹死我，或让哥哥用刀刺我，或让父亲徒手挖出我的双眼……

source: I will never up give this book to him. Never.
target: 我也绝不会把这本书交给他。绝不。

source: He can be my sole companion in this void of our eternal creation and destruction.
target: 在这片让我们永远经历创造与毁灭的虚空里，他可以做我唯一的同伴。

source: My companion... and my prisoner.
target: 我的同伴……也是我的囚徒。

source: Hamlet and I have been formally betrothed, and as our wedding day dawns, I am awoken to be dressed.
target: 哈姆雷特和我已经正式订婚。婚礼当天，天刚亮，我便被叫醒，准备穿戴。

source: A dozen maids come for me, bearing my gown, silk slippers, a thick white veil, and all manner of scented oils and tools.
target: 十二名女仆来为我梳妆，带着我的礼服、丝绸鞋、一条厚厚的白色面纱，以及各种香油和用具。

source: They cleanse my hands, my feet, my body. They brush my hair and weave flowers into it. No expense may be spared for Hamlet's bride.
target: 她们洗净我的手、脚和身体，梳理我的头发，将鲜花编入发间。为哈姆雷特的新娘打扮，花多少钱都不能吝惜。

source: I sit there like a doll, allowing them to push and pull me any way they please. I am pliant in their hands.
target: 我像个娃娃一样坐在那里，任由她们随意摆弄。在她们手里，我任人摆布。

source: They say... Laertes... has gone quite mad with fury.
target: 他们说……雷欧提斯……已经气得发疯了。

source: After Laertes and Father were ordered out of the castle, they left. I do not know where they went.
target: 雷欧提斯和父亲被勒令离开城堡后，就走了。我不知道他们去了哪里。

source: I know nothing would have changed Hamlet's mind. Two decades of hatred and mistrust doesn't vanish in four short days.
target: 我知道，无论如何都无法改变哈姆雷特的心意。二十年的仇恨与猜忌，不会在短短四天里消失。

source: I love my brother more than anyone in this world. I tell myself that his life is enough. I tell myself I had no other choice.
target: 在这个世上，我最爱的人就是哥哥。我告诉自己，只要他活着就够了。我告诉自己，我别无选择。

source: I try not to think of him somewhere cold and lonesome, hating me.
target: 我努力不去想象他身处某个寒冷孤寂的地方，恨着我。

source: Once, I try to send a letter. Just once. I entrust a chambermaid, give her an entire pouch of gold for her trouble if she'll only take my scrap to the post in town.
target: 有一次，我试着寄出一封信。只有那一次。我把信托付给一名侍女，只要她肯把我那张纸条送到镇上的驿站，我就给她整整一袋金币作为酬劳。

source: ...But nothing ever returns. I convince myself that Laertes read my letter but was unable to reply. It's easier to sleep that way.
target: ……可始终没有回音。我说服自己，雷欧提斯读了我的信，只是没法回信。这样想，夜里会好睡些。

source: One morning three months later, I awake, dress, and am led to the chapel altar.
target: 三个月后的一个早晨，我醒来，穿好衣服，被领到小教堂的祭坛前。

source: There, Hamlet stands ready to greet me, resplendent in red and gold, wearing his father's crown. He gives me a slight bow and a smile.
target: 哈姆雷特站在那里，等着迎接我。他身着华美的红金色礼服，戴着父亲的王冠。他朝我微微鞠躬，露出微笑。

source: I can tell from the glow on his face that he's never been so pleased to see me. Before him, a row of the most powerful men among the nobility sit watching—waiting.
target: 从他容光焕发的脸上，我看得出，他从未因见到我而如此高兴过。在他面前，贵族中最有权势的一群男人坐成一排，注视着——等待着。

source: They stare at me with cold eyes. They have no great love for this union. To them, it is a transaction to ensure the Danish crown remains intact.
target: 他们冷眼盯着我。他们并不喜欢这桩婚事。在他们看来，这是一场确保丹麦王权稳固的交易。

source: And it is an uneven match, at that. The poor Duke's daughter. No true nobility. Not quite the riches they'd hoped to reap in making Hamlet's marriage.
target: 而且，这还是一桩门不当户不对的婚事。穷公爵的女儿。算不上真正的贵族。远非他们为哈姆雷特安排婚事时，所盼望得到的丰厚财富。

source: They will always be watching over us. Hamlet is not a strong King—not yet.
target: 他们会一直盯着我们。哈姆雷特还不是一位强有力的国王——至少现在还不是。

source: They will drive his actions at every turn. We will never be free. I will never be free.
target: 他们会左右他的每一步行动。我们永远不会自由。我永远不会自由。

source: Before this wedding, Gertrude came to speak to me. She told me something I'll never forget.
target: 婚礼之前，乔特鲁德来找我谈过。她说了一番我永远不会忘记的话。

source: She said... that there is no such thing as happiness one finds in marriage.
target: 她说……人根本无法在婚姻中找到幸福。

source: That this life is suffering from start to finish, punctuated by fleeting moments of bliss. Love merely stops the bleeding a while.
target: 她说，人生从头到尾都是苦难，只有短暂的幸福穿插其中。爱不过是暂时止住流血。

source: She's right, I think. Hamlet and I face one another.
target: 我想，她是对的。哈姆雷特和我面对着彼此。

source: Hamlet reaches out and takes my hand. He squeezes tight. The message is clear: I am not alone.
target: 哈姆雷特伸出手，握住我的手。他握得很紧。意思再清楚不过：我并非孤身一人。

source: I hope I made the right choice, in the end. I want to believe I did.
target: 我希望自己最终做出了正确的选择。我愿意相信，我选对了。

source: I want to believe that this is the best possible world I could live in, with the greatest chance of happiness.
target: 我愿意相信，在我可能生活的所有世界中，这一个是最好的，也最有可能让我获得幸福。

source: Hamlet lifts the veil from my face. We both turn to the altar. Light pours through the windows, passing through my gown and veil.
target: 哈姆雷特掀起我脸上的面纱。我们一同转向祭坛。光从窗外倾泻而入，透过我的礼服和面纱。

source: I feel ethereal, like I could float away.
target: 我觉得自己轻飘飘的，仿佛随时都能飘走。

source: After all, it's a beautiful day for a wedding.
target: 毕竟，今天是个适合举行婚礼的好日子。

source: The morning I depart Elsinore is cold and dreary. I do not know where I am being taken. The cart has been arranged on my behalf.
target: 离开埃尔西诺的那个早晨，寒冷而阴沉。我不知道自己要被带去哪里。已经有人替我安排好了马车。

source: It is only late that evening, when my carriage arrives in a small border town, that I realize where I am going: Home.
target: 直到那天夜里，马车抵达一座边境小镇，我才明白自己要去哪里：回家。

source: ...At least, it is my family's home. A small manor with crumbling walls, hardly an intact window, nothing to burn in the hearth.
target: ……至少，那是我们家族的家。一座小庄园，墙壁残破，几乎没有一扇完好的窗户，壁炉里也没有东西可烧。

source: It is all that remains of our house's once-great estate. Here I am to live out my life in silence, unopposed to our new ruler.
target: 我们家族曾经庞大的产业，如今只剩下这里。我将在这里默默度过余生，不反抗我们新的统治者。

source: ...And for two years, I do. I linger.
target: ……两年来，我确实如此。我就这么留着。

source: I sell most of my fine gowns and hire men to patch the windows and walls.
target: 我卖掉大部分华美的衣裙，雇人修补窗户和墙壁。

source: Slowly, the manor-home comes together. It regains its former loveliness.
target: 慢慢地，庄园里的宅邸修整好了，恢复了往日的美丽。

source: But even when intact, it is not my home. It is my father's home, the one Laertes and I never lived in.
target: 可即使修缮完好，这里也不是我的家。这是父亲的家，雷欧提斯和我从未在这里生活过。

source: And nothing remains of Father here. So it can never be mine.
target: 而这里已经没有父亲留下的任何痕迹。所以，它永远也成不了我的家。

source: One day, a messenger arrives. I learn that the new Queen has sent for me—Queen Birgitta.
target: 一天，一名信使来了。我得知新王后召我前去——比尔吉塔王后。

source: She claims she only wishes to talk, but... I don't know what to believe anymore.
target: 她声称只是想谈谈，可……我已经不知道该相信什么了。

source: I have seen Brit cut my gut open, spilling my blood upon the ground. And I have seen her kinder than I could ever imagine. So...
target: 我见过布莉特剖开我的肚腹，让我的血洒在地上。我也见过她善良得超乎我的想象。所以……

source: Rather than obey her summons, I flee. To the south.
target: 我没有应召前去，而是逃走了。向南逃。

source: I take little with me save for my only mare, her saddle, and some jewelry to sell.
target: 除了我唯一的母马、它的马鞍，以及一些可以变卖的珠宝，我几乎没带什么。

source: I don't know why. Perhaps because I am a coward. Because now, if Brit slits my throat, I will never again have a second chance at life.
target: 我不知道为什么。也许是因为我胆小。因为如今，若布莉特割开我的喉咙，我就再也没有重活一次的机会了。

source: I continue south as long as I can. I make it eventually to Navarre; my mother's country, the land where she was born.
target: 我尽可能一直往南走，最终抵达了纳瓦拉；那是母亲的故国，是她出生的地方。

source: Here, in Pamplona, I blend in far better than I ever did in Denmark.
target: 在这里，在潘普洛纳，我比在丹麦时融入得好得多。

source: There are men and women as dark as me, and darker still. Song and dance fill every hall and doorway.
target: 这里的男男女女，有的肤色和我一样深，有的还要更深。每一处厅堂、每一处门口，都充满歌声与舞蹈。

source: After one day in this sunburnt city, I feel my body in full relief. Yes, I think. This is home.
target: 在这座被烈日晒透的城市待了一天，我便觉得全身都彻底放松下来。是的，我想。这里才是家。

source: When I run out of jewelry to sell, I find work as a lady's maid at a splendid estate on the edge of town. My lady Margaret is a stern woman, but not unreasonable.
target: 等珠宝都卖光了，我在城边一座华丽的庄园里找到了贴身侍女的工作。我服侍的玛格丽特夫人很严厉，但并非不讲道理。

source: At night, I walk the lively streets alone. I peek in at every window.
target: 夜里，我独自走在热闹的街上，朝每一扇窗户里张望。

source: I meander wherever my wants take me. I drink and I love whenever and whomever I please.
target: 我随心所欲地四处闲逛。想什么时候喝酒就什么时候喝，想什么时候爱、爱谁，都由我自己决定。

source: I take my time, a tardy explorer—like King Hamlet's spirit wandering the walls, like a fairy-sprite made of dust, never alighting permanently on anything or anyone.
target: 我不紧不慢，做个慢悠悠的探寻者——像哈姆雷特国王的幽灵游荡在城墙上，像尘埃化成的小精灵，永远不会停驻在任何事物或任何人身上。

source: Now and then I think upon the horrible fates all at Elsinore came to, in the end.
target: 偶尔，我会想起埃尔西诺的所有人最终遭遇的可怕命运。

source: I wasn't able to save them. My family. My friends. Denmark has been thoroughly transformed.
target: 我没能救下他们。我的家人。我的朋友。丹麦已经彻底变了样。

source: I hear they've moved the court to Copenhagen. Elsinore Castle now lies dormant and shuttered.
target: 听说他们把宫廷迁到了哥本哈根。埃尔西诺城堡如今已被封闭，沉寂无声。

source: But I escaped with my life intact, and that's what matters... isn't it?
target: 可我逃了出来，保住了性命，这才是最要紧的……不是吗？

source: At least, that's what I tell myself, when caught in lingering memories of those I left behind.
target: 至少，每当我陷入对那些被我抛在身后的人的回忆，久久无法摆脱时，我都会这样告诉自己。

source: It is not a perfect life. It is far from free of hardship.
target: 这并非完美的人生。离没有艰辛的日子还远得很。

source: But it is wholly, thoroughly, blessedly mine.
target: 但幸而，它完完全全、彻彻底底地属于我。

source: Let them all tear each other apart. I'll be out having fun.
target: 让他们互相撕个粉碎吧。我要出去快活了。

source: Rosie, Guilda and I meander from roadside tavern to tavern at first, making our way nowhere in particular.
target: 起初，萝茜、吉尔达和我从一家路边酒馆晃到另一家，没有什么特定的目的地。

source: Every day is the same adventure: What is this tavern selling? Who's telling interesting stories? Who is compelling enough to warrant a closer look?
target: 每天都是同样的探险：这家酒馆卖什么？谁在讲有趣的故事？谁足够吸引人，值得凑近瞧瞧？

source: And... I love it. I get to know Guildenstern better than I ever did in Elsinore. And I see Rosencrantz through new eyes, too.
target: 而且……我很喜欢这样的日子。我对吉尔登斯吞的了解，比在埃尔西诺时深得多。我也开始用全新的眼光看待罗森克兰兹。

source: When we run out of gold, they seem to conjure it up as though by magic. They'll do just about anything for a bit of coin.
target: 每当钱花光了，她们仿佛总能像变魔术一样弄出钱来。为了挣几个钱，她们几乎什么都肯做。

source: Anything to keep us on the move. To where? Where are we going? It doesn't matter. I'm drunk, and I don't even care where we are.
target: 只要能让我们继续上路，做什么都行。去哪里？我们要去哪里？无所谓。我喝醉了，甚至连我们现在在哪里都不在乎。

source: Whenever I see Quince's maddening grin before me in my mind's eye, I drink, and it disappears.
target: 每当奎因斯那令人发狂的笑容浮现在我脑海里，我就喝酒，然后它便消失了。

source: Whenever I think about my father's corpse stuffed under a staircase, I drink, and it's gone.
target: 每当我想到父亲的尸体被塞在楼梯底下，我就喝酒，那画面便消失了。

source: And whenever Hamlet's dark, worried eyes rise up like a vision before me, peering into me, I drink again, and longer, and deeper, until I cannot remember.
target: 每当哈姆雷特那双深色、忧虑的眼睛如幻影般浮现在我面前，仿佛要看透我，我就又开始喝酒，喝得更久，喝得更多，直到再也记不起。

source: It's still summer. So when we cannot afford a room at the inn, and none of the local fireside caravans will have us, we sleep in the fields.
target: 那时还是夏天。所以，当我们住不起旅店，附近围着篝火歇脚的商队也都不肯收留我们时，我们就睡在田野里。

source: On one of these blustery summer nights, as the two of them lie sleeping, I sit alone and I face the moon and think about where we are.
target: 在这样一个风很大的夏夜，她们两个躺着睡着了，我独自坐着，面对月亮，思索我们的处境。

source: We had something strong that evening. My fingers are tingling, my cheeks still warm and flush with it. I feel uniquely alive.
target: 那天晚上，我们喝了些烈酒。我的手指阵阵发麻，脸颊还因酒意而发烫、泛红。我从未如此鲜明地感到自己活着。

source: I sense that some great and distant power is looking down at me, willing me to be free, to experience the world I never knew before.
target: 我感觉有某种伟大而遥远的力量正在俯视我，希望我获得自由，去体验那个我从未了解过的世界。

source: Don't I deserve this freedom? Didn't I earn it? Have I not suffered enough?
target: 难道我不配拥有这份自由？难道这不是我争取来的？难道我受的苦还不够多吗？

source: And yet, I feel something dark, deep in the pit of my stomach.
target: 可我还是觉得，腹中深处有某种阴暗的东西。

source: I cannot outrun this pain. I cannot drink it away or outwalk it. It is always beside me.
target: 我逃不掉这份痛苦。喝酒消不掉它，走得再远也甩不掉它。它始终在我身旁。

source: Occasionally, at bars, we hear snippets of information. The Prince and King are dead. My father is dead. Fortinbras now rules us.
target: 偶尔，我们会在酒馆听到零星的消息。王子和国王都死了。我的父亲死了。如今统治我们的是福丁布拉斯。

source: To peasants who make their living in the fields, what difference does it make who sits on a throne a hundred miles away?
target: 对于靠种地谋生的农民来说，一百英里外的王座上坐着谁，又有什么区别？

source: One day, in autumn, we are lost and off the path. We come to a pond. It is a brisk day. The sky is grey and cold, the grass a dark yellow.
target: 秋天的某一天，我们偏离了道路，迷了路，来到一个池塘边。那天天气清冷。天空灰暗而寒冷，草已枯黄。

source: As we stop to rest a while, I catch sight of myself in the water's surface. I look nothing like the Ophelia I knew before.
target: 停下来歇息时，我看到了水面上的倒影。我看起来一点也不像从前熟悉的那个奥菲莉娅。

source: My eyes are gaunt and hollow; my body is thinner than it's ever been. This is not the version of myself I know.
target: 我的双眼憔悴而凹陷，身体比以往任何时候都瘦。这不是我熟悉的自己。

source: This is not what freedom looks like, I think.
target: 自由不该是这个样子，我想。

source: I don't know how to tell Rosie and Guilda. But somehow, we've been traveling long enough together that they simply know.
target: 我不知道该怎么告诉萝茜和吉尔达。但不知怎的，也许是因为我们结伴走了这么久，她们自然而然就明白了。

source: One morning, Guilda comes up behind me and places a hand on my waist, and leans into me. 'Tired of gallivanting?'
target: 一天早晨，吉尔达从身后走过来，把一只手放在我的腰上，靠着我。“四处游荡，玩累了？”

source: I explain to her everything I've been feeling. The pain I can't run from. The sorrow I can't drink away.
target: 我向她倾诉了这段时间所有的感受。那些逃不掉的痛苦。那些借酒也消不掉的悲伤。

source: She thinks a moment, and then a grin spreads over her. 'You know, the one adventure we've never tried,' she says, 'Is living unadventurously.'
target: 她想了一会儿，然后脸上绽开笑容。“你知道吗，我们还有一种冒险从没试过，”她说，“就是过不冒险的日子。”

source: At the next inn we come to, we don't ask to hear a story or put down coin for a drink.
target: 到了下一家旅店，我们没有求人讲故事，也没有掏钱买酒喝。

source: Instead we ask: Where might we set up a home?
target: 我们问的是：哪里可以安个家？

source: I helped deliver Hamlet safely into Fortinbras' hands. Even if others perished, I think Hamlet's soul found peace that day.
target: 我帮忙把哈姆雷特安全地交到了福丁布拉斯手中。即使其他人丧了命，我想，哈姆雷特的灵魂在那一天找到了安宁。

source: Hamlet doesn't understand how to rule on his own. He's never had the head for it. But he's damn well willing to try.
target: 哈姆雷特不懂如何独自治国。他从来就没有这方面的头脑。可是，妈的，他就是愿意试一试。

source: I see a fire in him I have never seen before. It ignites him from within, spurring him on. He has been called to something.
target: 我在他身上看到了一团从未见过的火焰。它从内心点燃了他，驱使他前进。他感受到了某种召唤。

source: The most sinister among them label him The Player King. He, who sits and deliberates and plays at ruling, but rarely gives his command.
target: 他们之中最阴险的人称他为“戏子国王”。他坐在那里，思量着，扮演着统治者，却很少发号施令。

source: In the meantime, Norway consumes us. The price of peace is our undying fealty to Fortinbras. Shortly, Sweden joins us in chains.
target: 与此同时，挪威吞并了我们。和平的代价，是我们永远效忠福丁布拉斯。不久，瑞典也和我们一样戴上了枷锁。

source: When autumn arrives, we answer to a different crown, though we are intact in spirit.
target: 秋天到来时，我们已经臣服于另一位君主，尽管我们的精神仍未受损。

source: Denmark isn't Denmark anymore.
target: 丹麦已经不再是丹麦了。

source: But-- what I did-- it was the best choice, was it not?
target: 可是——我所做的——那是最好的选择，不是吗？

source: Hamlet's father was avenged. Hamlet rose to the throne which was stolen from him all those months ago.
target: 哈姆雷特的父仇得报了。哈姆雷特登上了数月前被人从他手中夺走的王位。

source: And with Fortinbras over Hamlet's shoulder, the people will no longer suffer beneath incompetence as they did under Claudius.
target: 有福丁布拉斯在哈姆雷特身旁监督，人民不会再像克劳狄斯统治时那样，因统治者的无能而受苦。

source: I often see Hamlet and Fortinbras walking together in the gardens, deep in conversation. Fortinbras cares for Hamlet. I can see it.
target: 我常看见哈姆雷特和福丁布拉斯一起在花园里散步，深入交谈。福丁布拉斯在乎哈姆雷特。我看得出来。

source: They are far more alike than I could ever have imagined, this hot-headed invader and the young man whose world he shattered.
target: 这个冲动的入侵者，与那个被他击碎了整个世界的年轻人，竟远比我所能想象的更加相像。

source: Brit and Hamlet are wed before a crowd of hundreds. As Hamlet stands at the altar, his hands intertwined with hers, he looks out into the crowd.
target: 布莉特和哈姆雷特在数百人的见证下成婚。哈姆雷特站在祭坛前，双手与她的手交握，望向人群。

source: He is searching for something, scanning faces. And then his eyes find mine, and he smiles a small, sad smile.
target: 他在寻找什么，目光扫过一张张面孔。随后，他的目光找到了我，露出一个淡淡的、悲伤的微笑。

source: Autumn turns to winter. I walk the gardens daily even still. I don't mind the cold.
target: 秋去冬来。我依然每天在花园里散步。我不介意寒冷。

source: One morning, I am surprised to come across a soldier climbing out of the frozen pond near the grounds. He did not know the path's extent, and the ice split beneath his feet.
target: 一天早晨，我意外碰见一名士兵，正从庭园附近结冰的池塘里往外爬。他不知道小路到哪里就结束了，脚下的冰面裂了开来。

source: Without thinking, I strip myself of my cloak and surcoat and with my meager weight pull him as far up the bank as I can. His feet find purchase, and he stumbles up onto the shore.
target: 我不假思索地脱下披风和外衣，借着自己那点体重，尽力把他往岸上拉。他的双脚终于有了着力处，踉跄着爬上了岸。

source: Safely back in the great hall, warming his calloused fingers before the fire, he introduces himself as 'Ferdinand' and asks my name.
target: 平安回到大厅后，他在炉火前烘着长满老茧的手指，自称“费迪南德”，并问我的名字。

source: But I have seen the sigil of the Norwegian crown on the front of his tunic, so I refuse to give it. He is plenty warm. I leave him there, alone.
target: 但我已看见他上衣胸前的挪威王室徽记，所以不肯告诉他。他已经暖和得很了。我把他独自留在那里，转身离开。

source: Still, he comes to see me the next day, and the day after that, and every day for weeks. Always strolling around the grounds. What kind of soldier has so much free time?
target: 可他第二天又来看我，第三天也是，接连几周，天天如此。总是在庭园里闲逛。什么样的士兵会有这么多闲暇？

source: When he sees me reading on a bench, he brings me books of Norwegian poetry. When he hears me humming, he asks me to sing for him. He is a flatterer, this Ferdinand.
target: 他看见我坐在长椅上读书，就给我带来挪威诗集。听见我哼歌，就请我唱给他听。这个费迪南德，真会讨人欢心。

source: But I cannot help myself. I find his simple infatuation endearing. One morning, my father sees us out on a stroll, and he freezes up in surprise.
target: 可我还是忍不住动心。他那份单纯的痴情让我觉得可爱。一天早晨，父亲看见我们一起散步，惊讶得愣住了。

source: 'Ophelia!' He says to me later, pulling me aside. 'When did you become acquainted with King Fortinbras's brother, pray tell?'
target: “奥菲莉娅！”后来，他把我拉到一旁，说道，“你倒是告诉我，你什么时候认识了福丁布拉斯国王的兄弟？”

source: Fortinbras's brother? Not just Ferdinand. Prince Ferdinand. That he kept it secret is not surprising given his unpretentious nature. Perhaps he never considered it.
target: 福丁布拉斯的兄弟？他不只是费迪南德，而是费迪南德王子。以他那不摆架子的性子，隐瞒身份也不奇怪。也许他从没想过这回事。

source: Prince Ferdinand, as it turns out, came to Elsinore to support his brother in the unification effort. I don't want to love another politician, so I guard my heart against him.
target: 原来，费迪南德王子来埃尔西诺，是为了协助他的兄弟推进统一。我不想再爱上一个政客，所以不让自己对他动心。

source: But slowly, winter turns to spring, and each time Ferdinand comes to take me for a walk, I find my resolve... weakening.
target: 可冬天渐渐过去，春天到来。费迪南德每次来带我散步，我都发现自己的决心……又动摇了几分。

source: When February comes, he asks my father for my hand in marriage. My father, of course, turns to me. 'I like him, Father,' I say, laughing. 'Truly, I do.'
target: 到了二月，他向父亲求娶我。父亲自然转头看向我。“我喜欢他，父亲。”我笑着说，“真的喜欢。”

source: Fortinbras cares not whether his brother marries beneath his station. The relationship between our three nations is ironclad. He gladly grants us his blessing.
target: 福丁布拉斯不在乎自己的兄弟是否娶了地位低于他的女子。我们三国的关系牢不可破。他欣然祝福了我们。

source: By the time the flowers are blooming, Ferdinand and I marry in the grounds we love so dearly. Neither of us was ever much for the church. Some find it scandalous. We don't mind.
target: 鲜花盛开时，费迪南德和我在我们深爱的庭园里成婚。我们两人向来都不怎么热衷于教会。有些人觉得这有伤风化。我们并不在意。

source: But now the future lies before us. Ferdinand was never meant to stay in Elsinore. Now he makes preparations to go to Kalmar, to assist in Sweden's integration.
target: 而如今，未来就在我们眼前。费迪南德本就不打算长留埃尔西诺。现在，他正准备前往卡尔马，协助瑞典融入统一后的国家。

source: He demands my father and brother stay behind. After all, they remain far more loyal that faded old world than I do. They belong in Elsinore.
target: 他要求父亲和哥哥留下。毕竟，他们对那个已然衰落的旧世界，仍比我忠诚得多。他们属于埃尔西诺。

source: Ferdinand assures me that Kalmar is not so different-- another country, yes, but very alike. And so we pack our things, and one month after our wedding day, we set forth.
target: 费迪南德向我保证，卡尔马并没有多大不同——没错，是另一个国家，但十分相似。于是我们收拾行李，在婚礼一个月后启程。

source: I have to believe that the world I'm leaving behind is a strong one. At the same time, leaving Elsinore with a man who knows little of my old life is... strange.
target: 我必须相信，我留下的那个世界足够坚强。与此同时，和一个对我过去的生活知之甚少的男人离开埃尔西诺，感觉……很奇怪。

source: I come close to telling him of those lost days I spent, when time repeated over and over again, when I thought I was going mad.
target: 我差点就向他讲起那些迷失的日子：时间一遍遍重复，而我以为自己快要疯了。

source: But he wouldn't understand. No one could. Time to close this book of horrors and open a new one with fresh, unyellowed pages.
target: 但他不会理解。没人能理解。是时候合上这本满载恐怖的书，翻开一本新书，让书页洁白如新，尚未泛黄。

source: And I left others behind. Father. Laertes. It feels as though the closing of my old life has cut me in two.
target: 我也留下了其他人。父亲。雷欧提斯。旧生活的落幕，仿佛把我劈成了两半。

source: But it's time to abandon the old and grow the new. Only by forgetting the dead do we have a chance at reaching for life.
target: 但该舍弃过去，培育新生了。只有忘记死者，我们才有机会伸手拥抱生命。

source:
This world wishes I had died. That was my original fate.
I could accept the way things were meant to be.
A simple fate. One where I follow the story to its end.
target:
这个世界希望我已经死去。那是我原本的命运。
我可以接受一切原本注定的样子。
一个简单的命运。我只需沿着故事走到结局。

source:
My family and I could leave Elsinore behind forever.
We are utterly without land, coffers, or a way to get by.
But at least we'd have each other.
target:
我和家人可以永远离开埃尔西诺。
我们没有土地，没有钱财，也没有谋生的办法。
但至少，我们还能彼此相依。

source:
The Queen is dead. Long live the Queen.
If I sat on the throne, I could create nearly any world I liked.
But that sort of power comes with a price.
target:
王后已死。女王万岁。
如果我坐上王位，几乎就能创造任何我想要的世界。
但这样的权力，是有代价的。

source:
I was always meant to rise beyond this world.
Besides, there isn't a way back. Not anymore.
Not after what I've done.
target:
我本就注定要超越这个世界。
况且，已经没有回头路了。再也没有了。
做过那些事后，我就回不去了。

source:
Hamlet will make a good King... with me at his side, that is.
Still, this world would cost me my family.
The heaviest price at all.
target:
哈姆雷特会成为一位好国王……当然，前提是有我在他身边。
可这个世界会让我失去家人。
那是最沉重的代价。

source:
I have the power to create the perfect world.
It might exist only in my mind, but it'd be real to me.
Some call it insanity. I call it closure.
target:
我有能力创造一个完美的世界。
它也许只存在于我的脑海，但对我而言，它就是真实的。
有人称之为疯狂。我称之为释怀。

source:
No, Quince. You may not leave. Not now. Not ever.
I'm not your prisoner anymore. You're mine.
Let's both live out eternity in this hell.
target:
不，奎因斯。你不准离开。现在不准。永远不准。
我不再是你的囚徒。你才是我的囚徒。
就让我们一起在这地狱里度过永恒吧。

source:
I found a world where nobody's life was lost.
Fortinbras's assault was repelled... for now.
But the fires of war cannot be so easily doused.
target:
我找到了一个无人丧命的世界。
福丁布拉斯的进攻被击退了……暂时如此。
但战火没那么容易扑灭。

source:
Othello promised me the world, and I want to take it.
Quince warned me our time together is fated to end.
Is brilliant bliss worth the sorrow which follows?
target:
奥赛罗许诺给我整个世界，而我想接受。
奎因斯警告我，我们相伴的时光注定会结束。
灿烂的幸福，值得用随之而来的悲伤换取吗？

source:
I have begun to yearn for the sea.
Grace may be volatile, but her heart is true.
With her at the helm, who knows where we might go?
target:
我开始向往大海。
格蕾丝或许喜怒无常，但她的心是真诚的。
由她掌舵，谁知道我们会去往何方？

source:
Fortinbras' arrival shatters my old life into pieces.
But I am left alive. I could leave Elsinore behind.
Where would I go if I were beholden to no one?
target:
福丁布拉斯的到来，将我过去的生活击得粉碎。
但我还活着。我可以离开埃尔西诺。
如果不再受任何人牵绊，我会去哪里？

source:
Guildenstern and Rosencrantz invited me on an adventure.
An endless caper, wherever the path might lead.
Life is short and brutal. Why not have fun?
target:
吉尔登斯吞和罗森克兰兹邀我一起冒险。
无论道路通向何处，这场嬉闹都永无止境。
人生短暂而残酷。何不寻些乐趣？

source:
Fortinbras will make Hamlet into a beautiful puppet king.
All of us will dance at Norway's behest.
But if it means we all live on, that might be worth the price.
target:
福丁布拉斯会把哈姆雷特变成一个漂亮的傀儡国王。
我们所有人都要听从挪威的摆布。
但如果这能让我们都活下去，也许值得付出这个代价。

source: How now, spirit! Whither wander you?
target: 你好啊，精灵！你要游荡到何方？

source: Ah. Quince.
target: 啊。奎因斯。

source: You sound terribly glum.
target: 听起来，你很消沉。

source: It's been a long time since I thought about Elsinore. But I find myself wanting to return.
target: 我已经很久没想过埃尔西诺了。可现在，我却想回去。

source: Oh, dear. I thought this might happen.
target: 哎呀。我就想过，可能会这样。

source: You could do it if you liked. You are a powerful author in your own right, now.
target: 想回去的话，你就可以回去。如今，你自己也是一位力量强大的作者了。

source: But you wrote the fate you wanted to see. You used the power I gave you.
target: 但你已经写下了自己想要的命运。你用过我给你的力量了。

source: We've been all over the universe, haven't we? And there are a thousand worlds more to see still!
target: 我们已经游遍宇宙了，不是吗？还有上千个世界等着我们去看呢！

source: What is there to possibly look at in that dusty old box anymore?
target: 那个满是灰尘的旧盒子里，还能有什么值得看的？

source: I suppose you're right. There's nothing for me there. Certainly I don't care to see any of them.
target: 我想你说得对。那里已经没有什么值得我留恋的了。我当然也不想见他们中的任何一个。

source: Well, you can look at the empty castle, if you like.
target: 嗯，你要是愿意，可以去看看那座空城堡。

source: You have the power to resurrect it on your own terms now.
target: 现在，你有能力按自己的意愿让它重获生机。

source: Do enjoy it while it lasts.
target: 趁它还在，好好享受吧。

source: in her bed. Enter to her
target: 在她床上。有人上场，来到她身边

source: What happened?
target: 发生什么事了？

source: You're here in daylight?
target: 你白天也能来这里？

source: Indeed. It is possible, though difficult, for me to manifest.
target: 确实。我可以显形，虽然很困难。

source: I find it most curious that you are still here.
target: 你竟然还在这里，实在令我费解。

source: At the end of the last cycle Fortinbras was rebuked. Was he not?
target: 上一次循环结束时，福丁布拉斯被击退了。不是吗？

source: Yes. I had thought maybe if I could keep them all alive, something would change.
target: 是的。我原以为，也许只要能让他们都活下来，就会有什么改变。

source: A natural assumption, of course. And yet, here you are, and here I am, trapped under the lip of the goblet still.
target: 当然，这样想很自然。然而，你还在这里，我也还在这里，依然困在高脚杯的杯沿之下。

source: There exist certain undiscovered elements of this world.
target: 这个世界里，还有一些尚未被发现的事物。

source: You know something. You always have. Why are you playing coy with me?
target: 你知道些什么。你一直都知道。为什么要跟我卖关子？

source: Would that I could tell you. These lips are sealed with a far more gruesome power than death.
target: 但愿我能告诉你。封住我双唇的力量，远比死亡可怖。

source: But that information, created when I still lived, sleeps inside the castle's walls...
target: 但那份在我生前留下的信息，正沉睡在城堡之内……

source: In plain sight of all, and accessible to those curious enough to find it.
target: 就在所有人眼前，只要有足够的好奇心去寻找，就能找到。

source: Begone with you. I have work to do.
target: 走开。我还有事要做。

source: Stop! No—Please! I—
target: 住手！不要——求你了！我——

source: Back in my own bed? But...
target: 又回到自己的床上了？可是……

source: How is this possible?
target: 这怎么可能？

source: I know what I saw. Someone—definitely—killed me.
target: 我知道自己看到了什么。有人——确确实实——杀了我。

source: Again? Killed?
target: 又来？又被杀了？

source: All right. Let's think about this a moment. I know I will be killed three days from now.
target: 好吧。先想一想。我知道，三天后我会被杀。

source: That gives me time to stop it.
target: 这样，我就有时间阻止这件事。

source: Now that I know that Brit is the one trying to harm me, I can act on it swiftly.
target: 既然知道想害我的人是布莉特，我就能迅速采取行动了。

source: I know there are people in the castle who can protect me. I just have to find them.
target: 我知道，城堡里有人能保护我。我只需要找到他们。

source: At the same time, this assassin... if I can't survive their attack, then what's the point of anything more?
target: 还有，这个刺客……如果我躲不过刺客的袭击，再做别的又有什么意义？

source: There must be someone who can help me root out this assassin's identity.
target: 一定有人能帮我查出这个刺客的身份。

source: His death—I've seen it with my own eyes! And the traitor is my own blood, and my mother... oh, dear God, my mother...
target: 他的死——我亲眼看见了！而那个叛徒竟是我的血亲，还有我的母亲……哦，上帝啊，我的母亲……

source: Worms, worms and wriggling earth! All I can see is bile and rot everywhere!
target: 虫子，虫子，还有蠕动的泥土！我眼里到处都是胆汁和腐烂之物！

source: I can't stay here. I can't breathe. I need to go.
target: 我不能待在这里。我喘不过气。我得走。

source: I suppose I should at least get up.
target: 我想，至少该起床了。

source: What... What just--
target: 什么……刚才怎么——

source: That book is over on my table now. How did it get here?
target: 那本书现在就在我的桌上。它怎么到这里来了？

source: His death—
target: 他的死——

source: Go now, Hamlet! Out, out, out, out!
target: 快走，哈姆雷特！出去，出去，出去，出去！

source: I thought...
target: 我以为……

source: I suppose I thought that might have been the end of all this. But it wasn't.
target: 我想，我原以为这一切也许就此结束了。可并没有。

source: ...There it is. What's it doing there? What should I do now?
target: ……它在那里。它怎么会在那里？我现在该怎么办？

source: Had quite a nasty surprise back there, didn't you?
target: 刚才吃了一惊，滋味很不好受吧？

source: I see you've become acquainted with a good friend of mine.
target: 看来，你已经认识了我的一位好朋友。

source: King Hamlet. I thought he was dead.
target: 哈姆雷特国王。我以为他已经死了。

source: Oh, he was. Is. But death isn't quite so linear as all that. As you've no doubt observed!
target: 哦，他是死了。现在也死着。不过，死亡可没有那么一条直线走到底。你想必已经发现了！

source: You see, you both share some unfinished business. As do I.
target: 你看，你们都有未了之事。我也一样。

source: What business is that?
target: 什么未了之事？

source: The same business which keeps you trapped in this world, repeating indefinitely.
target: 就是让你困在这个世界里，无休止地重复循环的那件事。

source: And so shall it continue until you follow this thread where it might lead.
target: 这一切会继续下去，直到你顺着这条线索，追到它所通向的地方。

source: Wait. What's happened to Hamlet? His eyes... they're... empty.
target: 等等。哈姆雷特怎么了？他的眼睛……它们……空洞无神。

source: Ah. He is, shall we say, on pause.
target: 啊。他现在，可以说，处于暂停状态。

source: ...You've put Hamlet on pause, haven't you? His eyes... they're... empty.
target: ……你让哈姆雷特暂停了，对不对？他的眼睛……它们……空洞无神。

source: Yes. Thought I'd buy us a little alone time.
target: 是啊。我想给我们争取一点独处的时间。

source: One moment.
target: 稍等。

source: There we are.
target: 好了。

source: His death—I've seen it with my own eyes! And the traitor is my own blood, and my mother-- Oh, dear God, my mother!
target: 他的死——我亲眼看见了！而那个叛徒竟是我的血亲，还有我的母亲——哦，上帝啊，我的母亲！

source: Listen, Hamlet. Your father's ghost? I've seen him, too.
target: 听我说，哈姆雷特。你父亲的幽灵？我也见过他。

source: I believe you, Hamlet. I believe you saw your father's spirit. You're not insane.
target: 我相信你，哈姆雷特。我相信你见到了父亲的亡魂。你没有疯。

source: Now, tell me: Where did you see this spirit, and when?
target: 现在告诉我：你是在哪里见到这个亡魂的，什么时候？

source: M-midnight. On the walls. It was around the witching hour. But how did you--
target: 午、午夜。在城墙上。就在鬼魂出没的时辰前后。可你怎么——

source: Midnight, on the walls. That's what he said.
target: 午夜，在城墙上。他是这么说的。

source: Such a feeble, tender-hearted boy, that one.
target: 那孩子真是软弱，心肠又软。

source: I shall leave you to it, then.
target: 那我就不打扰你了。

source: You know where to find me. As always.
target: 你知道去哪里找我。和往常一样。

source: I'm not ready to make that choice just yet.
target: 我还没准备好做那个选择。

source: Hamlet, you're not going mad, but you need to take a moment to calm yourself.
target: 哈姆雷特，你没有发疯，但你得先让自己冷静一下。

source: Ophelia, I--
target: 奥菲莉娅，我——

source: I know. I know what you saw. Go to your chambers, pause, and breathe.
target: 我知道。我知道你看到了什么。回你的房间去，缓一缓，喘口气。

source: His death—I see it with my own eyes! And the traitor is—
target: 他的死——我亲眼看着！而那个叛徒是——

source: —Your own blood.
target: ——你的血亲。

source: I knew you were going to say that. How did I know? Have I seen this before?
target: 我知道你会这么说。我怎么会知道？我以前见过这一幕吗？

source: Everything's gone upside down. I need to get out of here. I can't breathe. I can't think...
target: 一切都颠倒了。我得离开这里。我喘不过气。我没法思考……

source: What is happening to me?
target: 我这是怎么了？

source: My head's not pounding any more.
target: 我的头不再一阵阵疼了。

source: Hamlet. Again.
target: 哈姆雷特。又来了。

source: So it's repeating again.
target: 所以，一切又在重演了。

source: Why am I still alive? I thought...
target: 我为什么还活着？我以为……

source: No. I know I died.
target: 不。我知道自己死了。

source: Yes. There's certainly something strange going on.
target: 对。一定有什么怪事正在发生。

source: I must go.
target: 我必须走了。

source: If things always begin like this, I'm going to be seeing quite a lot of Hamlet, aren't I?
target: 如果每次都是这样开始，那我岂不是要经常见到哈姆雷特了？

source: Back at the beginning again.
target: 又回到了起点。

source: Here we go again...
target: 又要来一遍了……

source: I've come to dread the sight of my bed-canopy.
target: 现在一看到自己的床幔，我就害怕。

source: All right, Hamlet. Come on.
target: 好吧，哈姆雷特。来吧。

source: His death—I see it with my own eyes! And—
target: 他的死——我亲眼看见了！而且——

source: —the traitor is your own blood. Yes, yes.
target: ——那个叛徒是你的血亲。对，对。

source: What? How did you—?
target: 什么？你怎么会——？

source: Hamlet, leave me be. I have things to do.
target: 哈姆雷特，别烦我了。我还有事要做。

source: What number is this? Two thousand? Three?
target: 这是第几次了？两千次？三千次？

source: I suppose it doesn't really matter anymore.
target: 我想，这已经不重要了。

source: Enter Hamlet, stage left.
target: 哈姆雷特从舞台左侧上场。

source: Another round, then.
target: 那就再来一轮吧。

source: Maybe I'll just go back to sleep.
target: 也许我干脆接着睡算了。

source: I hope Quince is as bored as I am.
target: 希望奎因斯也跟我一样无聊。

source: Go away, Hamlet.
target: 走开，哈姆雷特。

source: What? I--
target: 什么？我——

source: I know there's no going back from what I did. I don't regret burning that book.
target: 我知道，做了这件事就再也无法回头了。我不后悔烧掉那本书。

source: Every minute of these four days is like the brick of a cell wall. And I've memorized them all.
target: 这四天里的每一分钟，都像牢房墙上的一块砖。而我已经把它们全都记住了。

source: But it's worth it if Quince can never hurt anyone again.
target: 但只要奎因斯再也不能伤害任何人，这就值得。

source: It has has to be worth it.
target: 这必须、必须是值得的。

source: Come on, Hamlet.
target: 来吧，哈姆雷特。

source: Go, Hamlet. You're distraught. You need time alone.
target: 走吧，哈姆雷特。你心绪太乱了。你需要独自待一会儿。

source: What a strange dream.
target: 真是个奇怪的梦。

source: Is someone there?
target: 有人在吗？

source: Hamlet? Is everything all right?
target: 哈姆雷特？一切都好吗？

source: His death—I've seen it with my own eyes! And the traitor is my own blood, and my mother... Oh, God, my mother...
target: 他的死——我亲眼看见了！而那个叛徒是我的血亲，还有我的母亲……哦，上帝啊，我的母亲……

source: Hamlet. Stop for a moment. What in the world are you talking about?
target: 哈姆雷特。先停一下。你到底在说什么？

source: And why are you in my bedchamber?
target: 还有，你为什么会在我的卧室里？

source: I'm sorry. S-sorry.
target: 对不起。对、对不起。

source: He looked so peculiar. Something's wrong.
target: 他的样子好奇怪。有些不对劲。

source: Ugh. My head feels strange.
target: 唔。我的头感觉怪怪的。

source: That dream seemed so real.
target: 那个梦感觉好真实。

source: Lord Fortinbras's invasion is frightening and powerful.
target: 福丁布拉斯大人的入侵来势凶猛，令人恐惧。

source: Unaffected by internal affairs, his march seems to signal the abrupt end of my timeline.
target: 他的进军不受国内事务的影响，似乎预示着我的时间线会突然终结。

source: Even if I am still alive...
target: 即使我还活着……

source: Then what is keeping me here? What traps me in these four days? Why must I languish in this hell?
target: 那究竟是什么把我留在这里？是什么把我困在这四天里？为什么我必须在这地狱里受折磨？

source: It's not fair. None of this is right.
target: 这不公平。这一切都不该如此。

source: There has to be a way out. There has to be.
target: 一定有办法逃出去。一定有。

source: Whatever lies inside that cursed book must be the answer.
target: 不管那本受诅咒的书里藏着什么，答案一定就在其中。

source: If I can only find it...
target: 只要我能找到它……

source: Perhaps doing the spirit's bidding and finding King Hamlet's notes is the way forward.
target: 也许照幽灵的吩咐，找到哈姆雷特国王的笔记，才能找到出路。

source: If whatever's in those notes can raise the dead, then they're certainly powerful.
target: 如果那些笔记里的东西能让死人复活，那它们一定有强大的力量。

source: Perhaps this mysterious spirit everyone's whispering about has an answer for me.
target: 也许大家私下议论的那个神秘幽灵，能给我一个答案。

source: If I can only cause it to appear, that is.
target: 当然，前提是我能让它现身。

source: Perhaps the answer lies not in the future, but in the past.
target: 也许答案不在未来，而在过去。

source: Maybe there's something in the castle that can lead me forward.
target: 也许城堡里有什么东西，能为我指明出路。

source: So Brit is the person who's been after my life and spying on Norway's behalf.
target: 原来一直想要我的命、替挪威刺探情报的人，就是布莉特。

source: It almost seemed so obvious I couldn't imagine it being true. She's always disliked me.
target: 这几乎太明显了，反倒让我无法想象这会是真的。她一直不喜欢我。

source: And yet--
target: 可是——

source: She seems... trapped. In her own way.
target: 她似乎……也被困住了。只不过她有她的困境。

source: I have to tell others about her, of course. I can't very well just let her kill me.
target: 当然，我必须把她的事告诉别人。我总不能就这么让她杀了我。

source: But maybe-- maybe there's a way out of this, for both of us...
target: 但也许——也许有办法让我们两个都摆脱这一切……

source: Brit would have died for me, back there.
target: 刚才在那里，布莉特本会为我而死。

source: I can't believe it.
target: 我不敢相信。

source: Of course, right now, she doesn't remember any of that. Right now, she hates me.
target: 当然，现在她完全不记得那些事。现在，她恨我。

source: Still, I can't let that other Brit's sacrifice be meaningless.
target: 可我不能让另一个布莉特的牺牲变得毫无意义。

source: Now I know. Fortinbras is hiding out in Castle Town. I have all the proof I need to find him.
target: 现在我知道了。福丁布拉斯就藏在城堡镇里。我已经掌握了找到他所需的全部证据。

source: All that remains to be seen is whether the others will believe me.
target: 现在只剩一件事还不确定：其他人会不会相信我。

source: Father and Claudius had me taken to an asylum, of all places.
target: 父亲和克劳狄斯让人把我送走了，送的居然是疯人院。

source: They thought me insane. I suppose I cannot lay blame with them.
target: 他们以为我疯了。我想，我也不能怪他们。

source: It would appear that telling people things they find extremely strange raises the likelihood of me being labeled insane.
target: 看来，告诉别人那些在他们看来极其离奇的事，会让我更容易被当成疯子。

source: Perhaps I should observe when this happens, and consider who might find the information I know useful rather than disclosing everything to everyone.
target: 也许我该留意这种情况什么时候会发生，并且想想我知道的消息可能对谁有用，而不是把一切都告诉所有人。

source: Don't think I missed Hamlet leaving your room just now, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，别以为我没看见哈姆雷特刚才从你房间里出来。

source: Ophelia! Why are you skulking in your room?
target: 奥菲莉娅！你为什么偷偷躲在房间里？

source: (So much for skipping my father's lecture...)
target: （看来还是躲不过父亲的训话……）

source: Only last night, we discussed—
target: 就在昨晚，我们才谈过——

source: Y-you're... is this real?
target: 你、你……这是真的吗？

source: I can assure you, young lady, it most certainly is.
target: 姑娘，我可以向你保证，这当然是真的。

source: (This is so strange.)
target: （这太奇怪了。）

source: (Everything's happening all over again. I know I've done this before.)
target: （一切都在重演。我知道自己以前经历过这些。）

source: (Time is somehow repeating itself. I'm being given a second chance.)
target: （不知为什么，时间正在循环往复。我得到了第二次机会。）

source: (And that means... Hamlet will murder Father again, just as it was in my dream.)
target: （这也就是说……哈姆雷特会再次杀害父亲，就像我的梦里那样。）

source: (Someone's after my life, too. There really is a spy in the castle. And that person wants me dead.)
target: （也有人想要我的命。城堡里真的有间谍。而那个人想让我死。）

source: (I can change it. I have to.)
target: （我能改变这一切。我必须做到。）

source: No mumbling! Speak clearly! How many times have I told you—
target: 别嘟嘟囔囔的！说清楚！我告诉过你多少次——

source: I know. I'll be careful around Hamlet. I promise, Father, I promise.
target: 我知道。和哈姆雷特在一起时，我会小心的。我保证，父亲，我保证。

source: Only last night—
target: 就在昨晚——

source: Hamlet accosted me. But I drove him out. Everything's all right, Father.
target: 是哈姆雷特来纠缠我。但我把他赶走了。没事的，父亲。

source: I must share this with the King, unless you have some further explanation to offer.
target: 我必须把这件事告诉国王，除非你还有什么进一步的解释。

source: Father. What's wrong?
target: 父亲。怎么了？

source: Only last night, we discussed this. Why did I see Hamlet coming out of your chambers?
target: 就在昨晚，我们才谈过这件事。为什么我会看到哈姆雷特从你的房间里出来？

source: Did nothing I say stick with you? Were you deceiving me?
target: 我说的话，你一句都没记住吗？你是在骗我吗？

source: I can explain—
target: 我可以解释——

source: And he was half clothed, too. If only someone else had seen him dashing out like that... I shudder to think of it.
target: 而且他还衣衫不整。要是让别人看见他那样冲出来……我想想都害怕。

source: I'm going to have to speak to the King about this. I cannot hide this from him. Unless, I suppose, you can offer some explanation for this transgression!
target: 我必须跟国王谈谈这件事。我不能瞒着他。除非，我想，你能解释一下这种越轨行为！

source: I'm sorry, Father. I don't feel well. I had such an odd vision last night--
target: 对不起，父亲。我不太舒服。昨晚我看到了那么奇怪的幻象——

source: A vision?
target: 幻象？

source: No. Never mind it. It's passed now. I'll sleep better this evening, I think.
target: 不。别在意。现在已经过去了。我想今晚我会睡得好些。

source: Be careful, love. That's all I ask. Carrying on like this--it terrifies me. I don't want you hurt.
target: 要小心，亲爱的。我只求这一点。你这样下去——我实在害怕。我不想你受到伤害。

source: (I'm somehow being given... another chance to survive. I could change my own fate.)
target: （不知为什么，我得到了……另一次活下来的机会。我或许能改变自己的命运。）

source: (I should tell someone about my impending demise. But whom can I trust?)
target: （我应该告诉别人，我很快就会死。可我能相信谁？）

source: Right. Sorry!
target: 好的。对不起！

source: Greetings, Voltemand. Am I to assume this is the latest on Fortinbras and his men?
target: 你好，伏尔提曼德。这是福丁布拉斯和他手下的最新消息吗？

source: Thank you.
target: 谢谢。

source: So the Norwegian prince accepted the offer. If only we could take him at his word.
target: 这么说，挪威王子接受了提议。要是能相信他的话就好了。

source: This is exciting, but troubling news all the same.
target: 这消息令人振奋，却也让人忧虑。

source: The Norwegian prince accepted our peace offer?
target: 挪威王子接受了我们的和平提议？

source: This should be wonderful news for Denmark. Still... something in me feels unsettled.
target: 这对丹麦应该是个天大的好消息。可我……心里还是有些不安。

source: I think the time may be ripe to tell the court about our suspicions regarding a spy in our midst.
target: 我想，也许时机已经成熟，该告诉宫廷，我们怀疑身边有间谍。

source: It's time to start spreading awareness so everyone can keep an eye out.
target: 该让大家知道这件事了，好让每个人都能留意。

source: I'll do so this morning.
target: 我今天上午就去办。

source: My lord. Are yeh well?
target: 殿下，您还好吗？

source: Of course I'm not well. How could I be? You were there! You saw everything!
target: 我当然不好。我怎么可能好？你当时就在场！你全都看见了！

source: Perhaps you ought to lie down a while.
target: 也许您该躺下歇一会儿。

source: Or 'ave a drink. Yeh know, I've a bottle of brandy from the year you were born!
target: 或者喝一杯。您知道吗，我有一瓶您出生那年的白兰地！

source: Prolly turned to shit by now, though.
target: 不过，现在八成已经难喝得跟屎一样了。

source: Leave me, Marcellus. Your kindness is wasted.
target: 让我一个人待着吧，马塞勒斯。你的好意是白费了。

source: M'lord, will you not even come to this morning's court?
target: 殿下，您连今天的早朝都不去了吗？

source: I don't think I can face him. Not after what I heard last night.
target: 我想我没法面对他。昨晚听了那些事之后，我做不到。

source: But if yeh don't come... won't he be displeased?
target: 可您要是不去……他不会不高兴吗？

source: I knew yer father well. He always kept a strong face in times like these.
target: 我很了解您父亲。遇到这种时候，他总会保持坚强的样子。

source: An' so should you.
target: 您也该如此。

source: Come, m'lord. I'll accompany you.
target: 走吧，殿下。我陪您去。

source: So be it.
target: 那就这样吧。

source: Marcellus, I fear I'm truly going mad.
target: 马塞勒斯，我怕自己真的要疯了。

source: Not at all, my Prince. Not at all.
target: 不会的，王子殿下。绝对不会。

source: Try an' wipe what you saw from yer mind.
target: 试着忘掉您看见的那些事吧。

source: But it was real, wasn't it?
target: 可那是真的，不是吗？

source: I don't think I can face my uncle.
target: 我想我没法面对叔父。

source: I'll stay out here.
target: 我就待在外面。

source: As you wish, m'lord.
target: 如您所愿，殿下。

source: Thank you for inviting us back to the castle, Your Majesty.
target: 陛下，谢谢您邀请我们回到城堡。

source: Yes, it's good to be back in Elsinore!
target: 是啊，能回到埃尔西诺真好！

source: (God's wounds if I can remember which is which. They're Hamlet's little schoolfriends, never seen apart.)
target: （见鬼，我哪记得清谁是谁。她们是哈姆雷特那两个小同学，从来都形影不离。）

source: I thought I sent for two of you.
target: 我记得召见的是你们两个人。

source: You did, my lord, but at the moment my companion Guildenstern appears to be missing.
target: 是的，陛下，但我的同伴吉尔登斯吞目前似乎失踪了。

source: You did, my lord, but my companion Guildenstern is...
target: 是的，陛下，但我的同伴吉尔登斯吞……

source: I come alone.
target: 只有我一个人来了。

source: I call you here to help my and my wife's predicament: Hamlet's melancholy.
target: 我召你们来，是想请你们帮我和妻子解决一个难题：哈姆雷特的忧郁。

source: My nephew's wits have left him as of late, and he's become altogether too dour.
target: 我的侄子最近失了理智，整个人也变得过于阴郁。

source: We've heard tell of it, my lord.
target: 我们听说过这件事，陛下。

source: But cheer is what we specialize in!
target: 可让人开心正是我们的拿手好戏！

source: Yes, cheer and a little whimsy.
target: 是啊，让人开心，再加一点奇思妙想。

source: Good lord, you're both insufferably bright.
target: 天哪，你们两个活泼得真让人受不了。

source: I've a task for you. One which is richly rewarded.
target: 我有个任务交给你们，报酬丰厚。

source: Uncover the reason for Hamlet's madness, if you can. Report all of his movements back to me.
target: 如果办得到，就查出哈姆雷特发疯的原因。把他的一切动向都报告给我。

source: A spying mission!
target: 一项监视任务！

source: We can certainly attend to that.
target: 我们一定能办好。

source: Oho! It's not spying, per se—we're just worried about him. That's all.
target: 哦！严格来说，这不是监视——我们只是担心他。仅此而已。

source: Well, it's all the same to us, my lord!
target: 好吧，对我们来说都一样，陛下！

source: We'll report back anything we learn as soon as we learn it.
target: 我们一有消息，就会立刻向您汇报。

source: I see. You want me to spy on him.
target: 我明白了。您想让我监视他。

source: I can certainly attend to that.
target: 我一定能办好。

source: It's all the same to me, my lord.
target: 对我来说都一样，陛下。

source: I'll report back anything I learn as soon as I learn it.
target: 我一有消息，就会立刻向您汇报。

source: My thanks for your swift attendance. Let us hear the report.
target: 感谢各位这么快就赶来。现在听听报告吧。

source: My King, I have new reason to dispute the belief that Fortinbras' intent in crossing Denmark is peaceful.
target: 陛下，我有了新的理由，质疑福丁布拉斯借道丹麦的意图是和平的这一说法。

source: When we convene the small war council in private, we ought to discuss further.
target: 等我们私下召开小型军事会议时，应当进一步讨论。

source: But not here. Not now. Privacy is critical in this, my lord.
target: 但不能在这里，也不能是现在。陛下，此事必须保密。

source: Very well. We shall convene later.
target: 很好。我们稍后再议。

source: Indeed, the circumstances are troubling. We are pursuing it with all options available to us.
target: 确实，眼下的情况令人担忧。我们正在用一切可行的办法处理此事。

source: My lord, as to the issue of Fortinbras... he presents a duplicitous face to us.
target: 陛下，关于福丁布拉斯的事……他对我们表里不一。

source: If there is some cause for new alarm, I should be aware of it.
target: 如果又有什么值得警惕的情况，我应该知道。

source: Later, of course. A public morning court is not an appropriate venue for such matters.
target: 当然，稍后再谈。公开的早朝不适合讨论这类事情。

source: Very well. We shall convene.
target: 很好。我们会召集会议。

source: Fortinbras has decided there is no need to continue the bad blood between our nations, my lord.
target: 陛下，福丁布拉斯决定，不必再让两国间的仇怨延续下去。

source: He wishes for safe passage to Poland. That requires him to cross our lands.
target: 他希望能安全通行，前往波兰。为此，他需要穿过我们的领土。

source: Hmmm. A harmless enough request, given his recent peace offer...
target: 嗯。既然他最近提出了和平提议，这个请求倒也无害……

source: In the interest of repairing our friendship, I will allow him passage.
target: 为了恢复我们的友好关系，我会准许他通行。

source: Right, my lord.
target: 是，陛下。

source: My King, there is another matter!
target: 陛下，还有一件事！

source: My King, I also have a grievance!
target: 陛下，我也有件不满的事要说！

source: Sorry to, ah, to interrupt the flow of the 'war chamber', so to speak, but it's a pressing personal concern.
target: 抱歉，呃，打断了这场所谓的“军事议事”，但我有件紧迫的私事。

source: Speak your mind.
target: 有什么就说吧。

source: Hamlet is acting quite mad. He threatens Ophelia's safety, and her happiness, too.
target: 哈姆雷特的举止十分疯狂。他威胁着奥菲莉娅的安全，也威胁着她的幸福。

source: Oh, my poor Hamlet...
target: 哦，我可怜的哈姆雷特……

source: I agree, he's been doing poorly as of late.
target: 我同意，他近来的状况确实很糟。

source: I thought I had identified the cause. I thought he was merely lovesick.
target: 我以为自己已经找到了原因。我以为他只是害了相思病。

source: Ophelia's given me reason to doubt that belief. However, what remains true is this: He's a threat to my daughter's safety.
target: 奥菲莉娅让我有理由怀疑这个判断。但有一点仍然是事实：他威胁着我女儿的安全。

source: But I believe I have identified the cause.
target: 但我相信自己已经找到了原因。

source: Hamlet is lovesick. He's a man obsessed. And he's after my daughter.
target: 哈姆雷特害了相思病。他已经着了魔。他正在追求我的女儿。

source: Do you have any further information on what Hamlet experienced last night to cause this behavior, my lord?
target: 陛下，哈姆雷特昨晚经历了什么，才会有这样的举止，您还知道些什么吗？

source: Why would I? I haven't the faintest idea where Hamlet was yesterday. Or last night, for that matter.
target: 我怎么会知道？我根本不知道哈姆雷特昨天在哪里。昨晚在哪里也一样不知道。

source: I see. But you agree with me that he's a danger to himself and to others at the very least, certainly?
target: 我明白了。但至少您肯定也同意，他对自己和别人都构成了危险，对吧？

source: She told me he accosted her in her private chambers! In her own bed. Mad as a horse in heat!
target: 她告诉我，他在她的私人卧房里纠缠她！就在她自己的床上。像匹发情的马一样发疯！

source: Heated as a stag in rut, as a hound in—
target: 像发情的雄鹿一样躁动，像条发情的猎犬——

source: I get the point, Polonius.
target: 我明白你的意思了，波洛涅斯。

source: Excellent. That's all I wanted to impart.
target: 很好。我想说的就是这些。

source: Of course I've given word to Ophelia to rebuke him, disregarding whatever dalliance they once had.
target: 当然，我已经吩咐奥菲莉娅斥责他，不必顾念他们从前有过的那点风流情事。

source: As well we know they did, once.
target: 我们都清楚，他们从前确实有过一段。

source: I saw him departing my daughter's room just a few minutes ago.
target: 就在几分钟前，我看见他从我女儿的房间里出来。

source: She wouldn't tell me anything about it, either.
target: 她也不肯把这件事告诉我。

source: But if all of this is true, then Hamlet is in a worse state than even I anticipated.
target: 但如果这些都是真的，那哈姆雷特的状况比我预料的还要糟。

source: Are you sure he wasn't invited in?
target: 你确定不是她请他进去的？

source: Not a chance!—That is, no offense to young Hamlet, of course.
target: 绝不可能！——我是说，当然，我无意冒犯年轻的哈姆雷特。

source: My lady, what my father says is true. I didn't invite Hamlet into my chambers.
target: 王后陛下，我父亲说的是真的。我没有请哈姆雷特进我的卧房。

source: And he seemed to be unusually disturbed.
target: 而且他看起来异常不安。

source: Oh, my. My apologies, then, Ophelia.
target: 哦，天哪。那我向你道歉，奥菲莉娅。

source: When he returned from Wittenberg, I thought... well.
target: 他从维滕贝格回来时，我还以为……唉。

source: Now, now. None of that talk here, love.
target: 好了，好了。亲爱的，这些话就别在这里说了。

source: There may be more to this than mere lovesickness.
target: 这件事可能不只是相思病那么简单。

source: What do you mean by that?
target: 您这话是什么意思？

source: You and I should meet to discuss this further, privately. Perhaps tomorrow. In the meantime, Lady Ophelia, I urge you to stay away from Hamlet.
target: 你我应该私下见面，再仔细谈谈这件事。也许就明天吧。在那之前，奥菲莉娅小姐，我劝你离哈姆雷特远些。

source: Of course, my lord.
target: 当然，陛下。

source: I believe convening the war council is our highest priority at the moment.
target: 我认为，眼下最紧要的是召集军事会议。

source: I'll withhold my less pressing security concerns until we've had the opportunity to meet.
target: 那些不太紧迫的安全隐患，我会等我们有机会会面后再汇报。

source: But you should also know, my lord, I've taken Lady Brit into custody.
target: 不过，陛下，您还应当知道，我已经拘押了布莉特女士。

source: Just this morning, Lady Ophelia informed me of some suspicious behavior, and I had my men investigate Lady Brit's chambers.
target: 就在今天早上，奥菲莉娅小姐向我报告了一些可疑行为，我便派人调查了布莉特女士的卧房。

source: Brit? Truly?
target: 布莉特？真的？

source: Lord Fortinbras will stop at nothing to prize apart our court. Even turning good, strong Danish families against us.
target: 福丁布拉斯殿下会不择手段地分裂我们的宫廷，甚至让那些正派而有实力的丹麦家族与我们为敌。

source: I fear this is a sign of far graver things to come.
target: 我担心，这预示着往后会有严重得多的事发生。

source: Isn't it possible that this is all in error, Bernardo? Being mistaken here would be a grave insult to the Brockenhuus family.
target: 贝尔纳多，这一切难道不可能是误会吗？要是弄错了，那将是对布罗肯胡斯家族的极大侮辱。

source: Unlikely, my lady. The connection was clear once we found quite a lot of documentation in her chambers.
target: 不太可能，王后陛下。我们在她卧房里找到了大量文件，关联已经很清楚了。

source: I... I see. Then what should come of this?
target: 我……我明白了。那这件事该如何处理？

source: While the news is certainly distressing, let us keep it within Elsinore for now.
target: 这个消息确实令人不安，但暂时还是不要让它传出埃尔西诺。

source: As new information presents itself, we shall be compelled to do more. Let us stay our hands until then. Those are my wishes.
target: 等有了新的消息，我们就不得不采取进一步行动。在那之前，先按兵不动。这就是我的意思。

source: I-if you're certain that's the correct course of action, my King, then so be it.
target: 如、如果您确信这样做是对的，陛下，那就依您所言。

source: That is all. You may adjourn.
target: 就这些。散会吧。

source: I turn to the court with a more pressing matter.
target: 我有一件更紧迫的事要向宫廷禀报。

source: My lord, I believe the possibility exists that someone disloyal to Denmark exists within this court, and they may wish to do you harm.
target: 陛下，我认为这宫廷里可能有人对丹麦不忠，而且此人可能有意加害于您。

source: And yet perhaps it is no more than a hunch.
target: 不过，也许那只是你的直觉。

source: I have good reason to believe this threat is real.
target: 我有充分的理由相信，这个威胁确实存在。

source: Would you stake a life on it?
target: 你愿意拿一条人命来赌吗？

source: Let him continue, Polonius.
target: 让他说下去，波洛涅斯。

source: You mean a spy?
target: 你是说，间谍？

source: Indeed. A spy amongst us. I have good reason to believe this threat is real. It may even be from outside Denmark.
target: 没错。我们之中有个间谍。我有充分的理由相信，这个威胁确实存在，甚至可能来自丹麦之外。

source: For example, though I welcome Fortinbras' request to cross our lands on his way to attack Poland, we cannot ignore that he recently threatened to wage war on us.
target: 比如，虽然我欢迎福丁布拉斯提出借道我国、前去攻打波兰的请求，但我们不能忘记，他不久前还威胁要向我们开战。

source: A missing keyring, coded messages found just outside the castle—these are the signs of subterfuge. We have dealt with it before.
target: 丢失的一串钥匙，在城堡外发现的密文——这些都是暗中作祟的迹象。我们以前就应对过这样的事。

source: I believe the threat is not simply outside Elsinore's walls, but within them as well.
target: 我相信，威胁不仅在埃尔西诺的城墙外，也在城墙内。

source: Hrm. Come to think of it, I found certain personal items of mine disturbed last night, after my door was bolted for the evening.
target: 唔。说起来，昨晚我把房门闩上之后，发现自己的一些私人物品被动过。

source: If true, this is deeply worrying. We must be dilligent.
target: 如果属实，这就非常令人担忧了。我们必须认真查办。

source: However, as we have no culprit in hand, I cannot yet take this threat seriously.
target: 不过，既然我们还没抓到罪魁祸首，我暂时还不能认真看待这个威胁。

source: Bernardo, I task you with speaking to all those who might have further information.
target: 贝尔纳多，我命你去询问所有可能掌握更多消息的人。

source: Yes, my lord.
target: 是，大人。

source: I am already investigating some compelling leads.
target: 我已经在调查一些很有说服力的线索了。

source: I believe the investigation has merit.
target: 我认为这项调查值得继续。

source: My lord, I've taken Lady Brit into custody.
target: 陛下，我已经拘押了布莉特女士。

source: I-If you're certain that's the correct course of action, my King, then so be it.
target: 如、如果您确信这样做是对的，陛下，那就依您所言。

source: What are you reading, my Prince?
target: 王子殿下，您在读什么？

source: Nothing. Just words. Words, words, words.
target: 没什么。只是些字。字，字，字。

source: Certainly one presumes so, unless you have become illiterate! But do tell me, words about what?
target: 那是自然，除非您已经不识字了！不过请告诉我，这些字写的是什么？

source: Meaningless drivel. This author thinks old men have wrinkled faces and grey beards. What does he know? About anything?
target: 毫无意义的废话。这作者认为老头子都满脸皱纹，胡子花白。他懂什么？他有哪样是懂的？

source: He says that they prattle on and on and on, thinking they are wise when really they have no wisdom at all.
target: 他说他们唠叨个没完没了，自以为很有智慧，其实一点智慧也没有。

source: And weak thighs, at that. I find the notion odd, since old men could be as young as I if they only walked backwards like crabs.
target: 还说他们大腿无力。我觉得这说法很奇怪，毕竟老头子只要像螃蟹一样倒着走，就能像我这样年轻。

source: (The boy's insane. Or is he simply mocking me? Though this be madness, yet there is method in it.)
target: （这孩子疯了。还是他只是在嘲弄我？虽是疯话，却也有章法。）

source: What did you say?
target: 你说什么？

source: Nothing, my Prince. I should take my leave.
target: 没什么，王子殿下。我该告辞了。

source: Ah, good. There is nothing I'd rather you take. Except, perhaps, my life.
target: 啊，好。没有什么比你的告辞更让我乐意接受了。也许，除了让你取走我的性命。

source: What's happening to me...?
target: 我这是怎么了……？

source: Rosie? Guilda? What... what in Hell are you both doing here?
target: 罗茜？吉尔达？你们……你们俩到底来这里干什么？

source: Coming to visit you, of course!
target: 当然是来看你啊！

source: We were on our way to stuff our faces at the German court—
target: 我们本来要去德意志宫廷大吃一顿——

source: —To pay our respects, she means—
target: ——她是说，去拜会致意——

source: Right, right. And we thought we'd pay you a visit, too.
target: 对，对。我们就想，也来看看你。

source: You came... purely to see me?
target: 你们来……只是为了看我？

source: Of course! So what's got you down, old friend?
target: 当然！那么，老朋友，是什么让你这么消沉？

source: I mean, aside from your father dying in that awful snake incident... bitten in the garden, was it?
target: 我是说，除了你父亲死于那场可怕的蛇患……是在花园里被咬的，对吧？

source: Guilda, you're being obscene.
target: 吉尔达，你说话太不像话了。

source: Who knew Danish snakes were such a prolific threat?
target: 谁知道丹麦的蛇竟然这么能祸害人？

source: Honestly!—Hamlet, we truly are sorry to hear about your father's passing. Really.
target: 真是的！——哈姆雷特，听说你父亲去世，我们真的很难过。真的。

source: It's... it's all right. Listen. You're not being straight with me. Why are you both here?
target: 没……没关系。听我说。你们没对我说实话。你们俩为什么来这里？

source: Did you really come of your own accord?
target: 你们真的是自己想来的？

source: What? Rosie, that's not true. What about that letter from his uncle—
target: 什么？罗茜，这可不是真的。他叔叔寄来的那封信呢——

source: I see.
target: 我明白了。

source: My uncle sent you.
target: 是我叔叔派你们来的。

source: I knew it. The dog... he's got even you two watching me now.
target: 我就知道。那条狗……他现在连你们俩都派来监视我了。

source: No. Believe us, Hamlet, we came only to pay our respects. Not for anything nefarious.
target: 不是。相信我们，哈姆雷特，我们只是来拜会致意的，没有什么险恶的目的。

source: Your new father seems worried about you!
target: 你的新父亲好像很担心你！

source: Ah, Hamlet, you know, business aside, that odd little performer man you like so much is coming to Denmark. We saw him coming up the road.
target: 啊，哈姆雷特，先不说正事，你那么喜欢的那个古怪的小个子演员要来丹麦了。我们在路上看见他往这边来。

source: Peter Quince? Really?
target: 彼得·奎因斯？真的？

source: Peter Quince? Yes, so I've learned.
target: 彼得·奎因斯？是，我已经听说了。

source: (So they are coming after all. Ophelia was right...)
target: （原来他们真的要来。奥菲莉娅说对了……）

source: Er, Hamlet? You're muttering?
target: 呃，哈姆雷特？你在嘀咕什么？

source: Nothing, nothing. What was it you were saying?
target: 没什么，没什么。你们刚才说什么来着？

source: It's been years since we last saw Quince perform, hasn't it?
target: 我们上次看奎因斯演出，已经是好几年前了吧？

source: A show's already been arranged for the whole court tomorrow night!
target: 已经安排好明晚给整个宫廷演一场了！

source: Yes. That sounds... more wonderful than anything that's happened lately.
target: 是啊。听起来……比最近发生的任何事都要美好。

source: When I was younger, I believe he often allowed me to provide input on his performance.
target: 我记得小时候，他常常让我对他的演出提些意见。

source: Sometimes he'd even let me contribute to the script.
target: 有时他甚至会让我帮着写剧本。

source: Sounds delightful. And distracting from all the darkness lately!
target: 听起来真让人高兴。也能让人暂时忘掉最近那些阴暗的事！

source: Yes. Distracting.
target: 是啊。暂时忘掉。

source: The Playmaster Peter Quince has already arrived in Elsinore. He should be nearby.
target: 戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯已经到埃尔西诺了。他应该就在附近。

source: ...Peter Quince, right.
target: ……彼得·奎因斯，对。

source: Well, my friends, I think you may have been of use to me after all.
target: 好吧，我的朋友们，我想你们终究还是帮了我一点忙。

source: I'll see you both at the performance.
target: 我们看演出时再见。

source: I shall go to see him.
target: 我这就去见他。

source: Maybe it'll help to... distract me from less savory matters.
target: 也许这样能……让我暂时忘掉那些不愉快的事。

source: I've already been to see him, in fact.
target: 其实，我已经去见过他了。

source: I'll see you both at the performance tomorrow night.
target: 明晚看演出时，我们再见。

source: Quince, my good man! Welcome to Elsinore!
target: 奎因斯，我的好朋友！欢迎来到埃尔西诺！

source: My pleasure. It is truly a treat to return.
target: 不胜荣幸。能回来真是一件乐事。

source: I think we could use some drama right now. Some comedy or tragedy. Perhaps one, then the other.
target: 我想我们现在需要看点戏。喜剧或悲剧都好。也许先来一种，再来另一种。

source: Though a tragedy better fits the mood of the castle, I think.
target: 不过，我觉得悲剧更符合这城堡的气氛。

source: Hee hee hee... I can more than provide, my dear Prince.
target: 嘻嘻嘻……亲爱的王子殿下，我能给您的远不止这些。

source: I've heard the performance is to start tomorrow night?
target: 我听说演出定在明晚开始？

source: Indeed, my lord. Why, I'm already hard at work on the script!
target: 正是，殿下。这不，我已经在埋头写剧本了！

source: Wait. Are you already planning a performance here in Elsinore?
target: 等等。你已经打算在埃尔西诺演出了？

source: Indeed, my lord. For tomorrow night. Why, I'm already hard at work on the script!
target: 正是，殿下。就在明晚。这不，我已经在埋头写剧本了！

source: You mean... you haven't written it yet?
target: 你是说……你还没写完？

source: Oh, no. I'm an improvisational artist, you see. My performances adapt to the local conversation at hand.
target: 哦，还没有。要知道，我是个即兴艺术家。我的演出会根据当地眼下议论的话题来调整。

source: So much more topical that way. You understand, I'm sure.
target: 这样才更能切合时事。我相信您一定明白。

source: How interesting. I have some ideas, but no stroke of genius quite yet. Let me think on it a while.
target: 真有意思。我有些想法，但还没有什么绝妙的灵感。让我再想一会儿。

source: We'll speak more tomorrow.
target: 我们明天再谈。

source: Of course, my lord. I'll be waiting.
target: 当然，殿下。我会等着您。

source: My good man Quince.
target: 奎因斯，我的好朋友。

source: Lord Hamlet! Good morning.
target: 哈姆雷特殿下！早上好。

source: If I have your permission, Quince, I have some suggestions for what play to perform tonight.
target: 奎因斯，如果你同意，关于今晚演什么戏，我有些建议。

source: Something... appropriately sobering. Something... reflective.
target: 演些……能让人适当清醒清醒的。让人……有所反思的。

source: And if you wouldn't mind, I'd like to add a line or two myself.
target: 如果你不介意，我还想亲自添上一两句台词。

source: I'm told I'm quite handy with a goosequill.
target: 有人说，我使起鹅毛笔来颇有两下子。

source: But of course, my lord. I would not dream of denying you a voice.
target: 那是当然，殿下。我绝不会不让您发表意见。

source: And I do so love a guest writer. What have you brought me?
target: 而且我特别喜欢有人客串编剧。您给我带来了什么？

source: Here. The script.
target: 给。剧本。

source: Hmm. 'The Murder of Gonzago?' Fascinating. Yes, I think we can work with this.
target: 唔。《贡扎古之死》？真有意思。是的，我想这个可以演。

source: But won't your dear uncle the King be upset?
target: 不过，您那位亲爱的国王叔叔不会不高兴吗？

source: I certainly hope so.
target: 我正巴不得他不高兴。

source: Speak the speech, I pray you, trippingly on the tongue.
target: 请你念这些台词时，让它们轻快流畅地从舌尖吐出。

source: I will, sir!
target: 我会的，殿下！

source: Tell me, did you learn anything about the origins of Hamlet's insanity?
target: 告诉我，你们有没有查到哈姆雷特发疯的原因？

source: No. It's most confusing, my lord.
target: 没有，陛下。这实在让人摸不着头脑。

source: Certainly unlike him!
target: 他确实不像从前了！

source: Yes, most unlike him, certainly!
target: 是啊，确实和从前大不一样！

source: Hmmm. Maybe Polonius had more luck.
target: 唔。也许波洛涅斯运气好些。

source: By the way, Hamlet was cheered to hear the Playmaster Quince is returning.
target: 对了，哈姆雷特听说戏剧大师奎因斯要回来，精神好了些。

source: Yes, I thought inviting him might lift Hamlet's spirits just a little.
target: 是啊，我想请他来，也许能让哈姆雷特稍微振作一点。

source: We can stand to give up the Great Hall for just an evening, I think.
target: 我想，把大厅让出来一晚上，我们还是承受得起的。

source: Then perhaps you'll be cheered to know that Hamlet's rather keen on the idea.
target: 那您听说哈姆雷特很期待这件事，也许会高兴些。

source: So I've heard, but I didn't dare to believe it. How wonderful!
target: 我也听说了，可一直不敢相信。太好了！

source: Wonderful! Hamlet? Really? You're certain?
target: 太好了！哈姆雷特？真的？你们确定？

source: Hamlet's father always liked to see Quince perform. I think he found the man's work relatable. I'm glad to see my son does, too.
target: 哈姆雷特的父亲一直喜欢看奎因斯演出。我想，他能从这个人的作品中找到共鸣。看到我儿子也一样，我很高兴。

source: Isn't that right, my love?
target: 是吧，亲爱的？

source: Yes. Right.
target: 是啊。没错。

source: All recent events have made it clear Hamlet is dangerous and must be dealt with.
target: 最近发生的种种事情已经清楚表明，哈姆雷特很危险，必须加以处置。

source: Perhaps it's time we fulfilled his request to be sent away.
target: 也许是时候答应他的请求，把他送走了。

source: Back to university at Wittenberg, you mean?
target: 您是说，送他回维滕贝格的大学？

source: Wittenberg? No, no. The prince deserves to see new sights, don't you think?
target: 维滕贝格？不，不。王子也该见识些新风景，你说呢？

source: I was thinking England. Something like... assisting on a 'diplomatic' endeavor. On behalf of the Danish throne, that is.
target: 我想的是英格兰。比如……协助进行一项“外交”事务。也就是代表丹麦王室。

source: My lord, I recommend a bit of targeted spying, first.
target: 陛下，我建议先有针对性地暗中监视一番。

source: Maybe we can learn something that will help us.
target: 也许我们能查到些有用的东西。

source: Very well, Polonius. If that is what you think best.
target: 好吧，波洛涅斯。如果你觉得这样最好。

source: I shall give you another chance to prove yourself. Let us hope you learn something of use.
target: 我就再给你一次证明自己的机会。但愿你能查到些有用的东西。

source: Perhaps if we catch him and my daughter together, I can finally show my theories are justified!
target: 也许只要撞见他和我女儿在一起，我就终于能证明我的推断有道理了！

source: Hmmm. Yes.
target: 唔。没错。

source: To be or not to be...
target: 生存，还是毁灭……

source: That is the question.
target: 这是一个值得考虑的问题。

source: Whether it's nobler to try and suffer through the pain...
target: 究竟是强忍痛苦、勉力支撑更为高贵……

source: Or turn our backs to all of it and welcome the inevitable embrace of death a little earlier.
target: 还是抛却这一切，早些投入那终将到来的死亡的怀抱？

source: To die—to sleep no more—And by sleeping, I mean to end the heartache, the thousand little pains I have to bear.
target: 死去——便是睡去，不过如此。我说的睡眠，是让心头的创痛，以及我必须承受的千般细碎苦楚，就此终结。

source: I wish I could. Just die—sleep, sleep, and maybe dream... that would be it. Who knows what I might dream of in death?
target: 但愿我能如此。死去——睡去；睡去，也许还会做梦……那便一切了结了。可谁知道，死后我会梦见什么？

source: What do you think... Ophelia?
target: 你觉得呢……奥菲莉娅？

source: All this fortune coming your way, and still you wax philosophical?
target: 这么多好事都落到你头上了，你还在谈哲学？

source: It's not in my nature to be pleased with things like this. You know that.
target: 我天生就不会为这种事高兴。你知道的。

source: Of course. But I might suggest that, as the future ruler of Denmark, you have greater worries than your own mortality to contend with.
target: 当然。不过我想提醒你，作为丹麦未来的统治者，比起自己终有一死，你还有更大的难题要面对。

source: Let death claim you when it's time. There's nothing to fear in it.
target: 等时候到了，就让死亡带走你吧。没什么可怕的。

source: (Certainly I know that.)
target: （这一点，我当然清楚。）

source: You've become wise. Wiser than you were before.
target: 你变得明智了。比以前更明智了。

source: Do you—do you think you could lend me your aid, Ophelia?
target: 你——你觉得你能帮帮我吗，奥菲莉娅？

source: I'm afraid of what happens next. I don't know how to rule.
target: 我害怕接下来会发生的事。我不知道怎样治理国家。

source: If there were someone who could show me how, give me advice...
target: 要是有人能教教我，给我一些建议……

source: I'd trust only you to find that person and send them to me.
target: 我只信得过你，能找到那个人，让那个人来见我。

source: I'll see what I can do.
target: 我看看能做些什么。

source: Hamlet, I can't listen to you go on like this. Not anymore. There are still things of yours in my room. I'd prefer you took them back.
target: 哈姆雷特，我听不下去你这样说个不停了。再也听不下去了。我房里还有些你的东西。我希望你把它们拿回去。

source: Honest as always, and ever so naïve! I loved you once for those very qualities.
target: 还是那么诚实，也还是那么天真！我曾经爱你，正是因为这些。

source: I believed it.
target: 我当时信了。

source: You shouldn't have.
target: 你不该信的。

source: Then I was the more deceived.
target: 那我受的骗就更深了。

source: You'd be better off as a nun. You'd make an excellent nun, you know.
target: 你还不如去当修女。你知道吗，你会是个很出色的修女。

source: Don't involve yourself with men like me. We're all alike, deep down.
target: 别跟我这样的男人纠缠。说到底，我们都一样。

source: And some day, some man will crumple you like a flower underfoot.
target: 总有一天，会有个男人把你像花一样踩在脚下，碾得粉碎。

source: Maybe we should do away with marriage altogether. No good has ever come from it, or ever will.
target: 也许我们该彻底废除婚姻。它从没带来过任何好事，以后也不会。

source: You were a fool if you truly believed me. Ophelia, I never loved you.
target: 如果你真的信了我，那你就是个傻瓜。奥菲莉娅，我从来没爱过你。

source: (I don't believe that. I don't even think he believes that. But he's in a fit.)
target: （我不信。我觉得连他自己都不信。可他正在发作。）

source: Mmm, I'll forego opinion on this one.
target: 嗯，这件事我就不发表看法了。

source: (I'd rather actually become a nun than suffer this again.)
target: （我宁可真去当修女，也不想再受一次这种罪。）

source: Thank you for coming, Lords and Ladies.
target: 感谢各位大人、各位女士光临。

source: I, your humble Playmaster, have arranged a most magnificent show for you tonight!
target: 在下是诸位的戏剧大师，今晚为诸位安排了一场精彩绝伦的演出！

source: And with my many-changing faces... I aim to please all who look upon me.
target: 我要用这千变万化的面孔……让每一位看着我的观众都尽兴。

source: So, without further ado... a tale of tragedy and woe:
target: 那么，闲话少说……请看这个充满悲剧与哀愁的故事：

source: The Murder of Gonzago!
target: 《贡扎古之死》！

source: I don't think we've seen this one before, have we, my love?
target: 我想我们以前没看过这出戏吧，亲爱的？

source: ...It's not familiar to me, no.
target: ……是啊，我没什么印象。

source: I, for one, am thoroughly excited.
target: 我可满心期待呢。
