source: (Horatio, keep a close eye on Claudius. Watch his face for me.)
target: （霍拉旭，盯紧克劳狄斯。替我留意他的表情。）

source: (Certainly. But why...?)
target: （当然。不过为什么……？）

source: ...Our tale, my friends, takes us to the fair city of Vienna, where King Gonzago and his wife, Baptista, are not-so-happily wed...!
target: ……朋友们，这个故事将带我们来到美丽的维也纳。在那里，贡扎古国王和他的妻子巴普蒂斯塔，婚后过得并不那么幸福……！

source: My King, let us count a thousand journeys of the sun and moon again before our love be done!
target: 我的国王，愿日月再轮转千回，你我之爱才到尽头！

source: Oh, my love. I must leave you soon. My form is weak, and frail. And thou shalt live in this fair world behind.
target: 啊，我的爱人。我很快就要离你而去。我这身躯虚弱不堪。而你将独留在这美好的世间。

source: But never fear: A new husband you shall find!
target: 但不必害怕：你会找到一位新的丈夫！

source: Oh, confound the rest! Loving anyone else would be treason in my breast.
target: 啊，让其他人都见鬼去吧！若爱上别人，便是背叛了我的心。

source: The only women who can love a second husband must surely have killed the first!
target: 能爱上第二任丈夫的女人，必定亲手杀了第一任！

source: ...Naturally, Gonzago's evil brother, Lucianus, has something more sinister in mind. He plans to steal his brother's crown for himself.
target: ……当然，贡扎古那邪恶的兄弟卢西安纳斯，心里还藏着更阴险的打算。他计划夺走兄弟的王冠，据为己有。

source: Wah hah hah! None of you shall sit upon the throne but I, Lucianus!
target: 哇哈哈！除了我卢西安纳斯，你们谁也休想坐上王位！

source: Lucianus poisons his own brother as he lies sleeping in the garden.
target: 卢西安纳斯趁自己的亲兄弟在花园里熟睡时，对他下了毒。

source: Die, you old fool! Once and for all.
target: 死吧，你这老蠢货！永远别再起来。

source: What do you call this play, again, Gerta?
target: 这出戏叫什么来着，格尔塔？

source: I-- I cannot recall.
target: 我——我想不起来了。

source: The Queen comes across the body of her dead husband...
target: 王后发现了亡夫的尸体……

source: My love, my King, please awaken from your slumber and hold me—
target: 我的爱人，我的国王，请从沉睡中醒来，拥我入怀——

source: My love? Why are your lips so pale? And your cheeks so white?
target: 我的爱人？你的嘴唇为何如此苍白？脸颊为何毫无血色？

source: Oh... oh, he's dead!
target: 啊……啊，他死了！

source: (What is this performance? Who organized this?)
target: （这演的是什么？是谁安排的？）

source: (Hamlet, stop the performance. Haven't you seen what you meant to—)
target: （哈姆雷特，让演出停下。你不是已经看到你想看的——）

source: (Shh. Here's the important part.)
target: （嘘。关键的地方来了。）

source: Now as King, the evil Lucianus swoops in to retrieve his prize: the Queen!
target: 如今已成为国王的邪恶卢西安纳斯，迫不及待地赶来领取他的奖赏：王后！

source: Come now, Queen Baptista, to the altar we must hurry...
target: 来吧，巴普蒂斯塔王后，我们得赶快去祭坛……

source: I protest! I'll never love you!
target: 我不答应！我永远不会爱你！

source: But... milady!
target: 可是……夫人！

source: How can I ever love another after Gonzago?
target: 爱过贡扎古之后，我怎能再爱上别人？

source: What do you think, Mother?
target: 你觉得呢，母亲？

source: The lady protests too much.
target: 这位夫人把话说得太满了。

source: I need to leave.
target: 我得走了。

source: I feel ill. I need to leave now.
target: 我不太舒服。我现在就得走。

source: Cancel the play.
target: 停止演出。

source: The entire play?
target: 整出戏都不演了？

source: ...Well, that was odd.
target: ……嗯，真奇怪。

source: Hush, Horatio.
target: 别说了，霍拉旭。

source: Everyone, we'll have sweetmeats served in the grand hall shortly. Nothing to worry about!
target: 各位，大厅里很快就会送上甜点。没什么好担心的！

source: I knew it.
target: 我就知道。

source: Did you see his face, Horatio? I'll take that spirit's word for a thousand pounds.
target: 你看见他的表情了吗，霍拉旭？我敢拿一千英镑担保，那幽灵说的是真话。

source: I saw it too.
target: 我也看见了。

source: He's gone and run off. I'm going to pursue him.
target: 他跑了。我要去追他。

source: I have to know the truth, one way or another.
target: 无论如何，我都得弄清真相。

source: (Now where did he run off to? I have to know the truth, one way or another.)
target: （他到底跑哪儿去了？无论如何，我都得弄清真相。）

source: For some reason, Claudius was deeply upset by that play.
target: 不知为什么，那出戏让克劳狄斯十分不安。

source: So, without further ado... A saucy tale, of betrayal and scandal:
target: 那么，闲话少说……请看这个充满背叛与丑闻的香艳故事：

source: The Greedy Mistress!
target: 《贪婪的情妇》！

source: The title alone gives me pause. Is this appropriate, my dear...?
target: 光是这名字就让我有些犹豫。这个合适吗，亲爱的……？

source: Nonsense! This sounds like a riotous amusement! Carry forth!
target: 别多虑！听起来会让人笑个痛快！演下去！

source: What? 'The Greedy Mistress?' That's not what I intended to...
target: 什么？《贪婪的情妇》？这不是我打算……

source: Well, let's see where this goes.
target: 好吧，看看接下来会怎样。

source: Our play begins in the court of an ancient kingdom, where a fair King lies sleeping as his Queen flits away on slippered feet...
target: 我们的戏从一个古老王国的宫廷开始。一位英俊的国王正在熟睡，而他的王后穿着软鞋，轻轻溜了出去……

source: ...Down to the stable, where she meets with another man. Not only that—the King's own brother, right under his nose!
target: ……来到马厩，与另一个男人相会。不仅如此，那人还是国王的亲兄弟，就在国王眼皮底下！

source: We must tell no one. Not a single whisper, my love.
target: 我们不能告诉任何人。一个字都不能泄露，我的爱人。

source: You won't have time to whisper with your mouth under mine!
target: 你的嘴被我的嘴封住，哪还有工夫说话！

source: They make the 'beast with two backs' in every conceivable location, ladies and lords, in sunshine and shade, in filth and in wealth!
target: 各位女士、各位大人，他们在一切想得到的地方交合，化作那“双背兽”，从阳光下到阴影中，从污秽之地到富贵之所！

source: What if my husband should find us?
target: 要是我丈夫发现了我们，怎么办？

source: Then he'll know that my love for you burns brighter than anything in this world—and that I am unafraid.
target: 那他就会知道，我对你的爱比世间一切都燃烧得更耀眼——而我无所畏惧。

source: I have stolen his most prized possession. Why should I worry? I have won!
target: 我已夺走他最珍爱的宝物。我何必担心？我已经赢了！

source: T-this is—this is awful!
target: 这、这是——这太可怕了！

source: When the Queen's own son leaves for faraway lands, she even makes love to her brother-in-law on her son's bed, knowing the door is locked tight!
target: 王后的亲生儿子远赴他乡后，她知道房门锁得严严实实，竟在儿子的床上与丈夫的兄弟欢爱！

source: Both men have been in my body... their flesh is my flesh, their lust is my love...!
target: 两个男人都曾进入我的身体……他们的肉体就是我的肉体，他们的欲望就是我的爱……！

source: Oh, my illicit queen—I'd ravish you anywhere. Yes—even here!
target: 啊，我偷情的王后——无论在哪里，我都愿与你纵情欢爱。没错——就算在这里！

source: This is quite inappropriate! Excuse me—stop this!
target: 这太不成体统了！听我说——停下来！

source: Y-yes, it's, er...
target: 是、是啊，这个，呃……

source: I'm feeling faint. Please. Haven't any of you a single shred of mercy?
target: 我快晕倒了。求求你们。你们难道连一点怜悯之心都没有吗？

source: Or have you each been laughing at me all this time?
target: 还是说，你们每个人一直都在笑话我？

source: Hamlet. Aren't you going to defend her?
target: 哈姆雷特。你不打算替她说句话吗？

source: While I may not have penned the sordid story myself... I can't say I disagree.
target: 虽说这个龌龊的故事不是我亲手写的……可我也不能说我不认同。

source: She's been everywhere and back in the months I was gone, Horatio. Who knows what she's done?
target: 我不在的那几个月，她可什么地方都去过了，霍拉旭。谁知道她都干了些什么？

source: What the hell did you say? Louder, boy!
target: 你他妈的说什么？大声点，小子！

source: Ergh. Even for Hamlet, this is too much.
target: 唉。就算是哈姆雷特，这也太过分了。

source: What good could come from hurting the Queen?
target: 伤害王后能有什么好处？

source: I've no reason to back down now.
target: 我现在没理由退让。

source: You heard precisely what I said, Claudius.
target: 我说了什么，你听得一清二楚，克劳狄斯。

source: My mother is a whore. And now, thanks to this play, the whole castle knows it. Not that they didn't already.
target: 我母亲是个婊子。现在，托这出戏的福，整座城堡的人都知道了。虽说他们早就知道。

source: How dare you.
target: 你竟敢这么说。

source: You would tell lies like this in front of my court? In front of my wife?
target: 你竟敢当着我的朝臣撒这种谎？当着我妻子的面？

source: Draw your sword.
target: 拔剑。

source: Only if you promise it'll be a fair fight, usurper.
target: 那你得先保证公平决斗，篡位者。

source: No! Please—!
target: 不要！求求你们——！

source: The law of the kingdom is that treason is punishable by death, or by cutting of the tongue.
target: 王国的法律规定，叛国者应处以死刑，或割去舌头。

source: Naturally, I prefer to do things the old-fashioned way.
target: 当然，我更喜欢按老规矩办事。

source: That's if you win.
target: 那也得你赢了才行。

source: Yes. If.
target: 是啊。如果。

source: I'll be glad to avenge Father's dignity against you then. Certainly no one else in this world has.
target: 那我很乐意向你讨还父亲所受的屈辱。这世上显然没有别人为他出过头。

source: All right, Hamlet. En garde.
target: 好，哈姆雷特。准备接招。

source: Bernardo, you'll oversee the duel.
target: 贝尔纳多，由你监督决斗。

source: (My lord, are you sure this is wise? Your nephew?)
target: （陛下，您确定这样明智吗？他可是您的侄子啊？）

source: I did not ask for your advice.
target: 我没问你的意见。

source: Hamlet. You still have time to stand down. Recant what you said.
target: 哈姆雷特。你现在退让还来得及。收回你说的话。

source: This is between him and me. Leave us.
target: 这是我和他之间的事。走开。

source: He is my friend, milord. Please.
target: 他是我的朋友，陛下。求您了。

source: He murdered my favorite advisor. He embarrassed my wife.
target: 他谋杀了我最器重的顾问。他让我妻子受辱。

source: He's embarrassed my wife, and he's embarrassed me.
target: 他让我妻子受辱，也让我受辱。

source: Interfere, Bernardo, and I'll have you duel him to the death in my place.
target: 贝尔纳多，你再插手，我就让你代替我，跟他决斗至死。

source: How could it all... is this... really happening?
target: 怎么会变成这样……这……真的发生了吗？

source: If it wasn't for this sad excuse for a prince, my love would still be alive.
target: 要不是这个不配当王子的废物，我的爱人就还活着。

source: He deserves everything that is coming to him.
target: 接下来他遭受的一切，都是他应得的。

source: Let's begin. I'm not afraid anymore.
target: 开始吧。我已经不怕了。

source: On three.
target: 数到三。

source: One. Two.
target: 一。二。

source: My wife is avenged. He went down like a half-wit. Not even a single parry.
target: 我妻子的仇报了。他像个傻子一样倒下，连一下都没挡住。

source: Oh, my God, no—
target: 天啊，不——

source: I can't look. I can't—I—
target: 我看不下去。我不能——我——

source: I... please, Claudius, please let me have the body to bury.
target: 我……求你了，克劳狄斯，请把遗体交给我安葬。

source: So Her Majesty needn't see her son like this.
target: 这样王后陛下就不必看见儿子这副模样了。

source: I beg of you.
target: 我求你了。

source: Fine. Take it. Useless bit of decomposing flesh to me now.
target: 好吧。拿走。对我来说，现在不过是块正在腐烂的废肉。

source: Bernardo, help me with him. Please.
target: 贝尔纳多，帮我抬他。求你了。

source: Gather his sword.
target: 把他的剑捡起来。

source: It is done.
target: 结束了。

source: My baby.
target: 我的宝贝。

source: My only son.
target: 我唯一的儿子。

source: My love. Come here. Let me dry your tears.
target: 亲爱的。过来。让我擦干你的眼泪。

source: Don't you dare call to me. Don't even touch me.
target: 不许叫我过去。更别碰我。

source: How dare you!
target: 你怎么敢！

source: You killed him. You murdered our son. No—not our son. My son.
target: 你杀了他。你谋杀了我们的儿子。不——不是我们的儿子。是我的儿子。

source: Good riddance to that scourge.
target: 那个祸害死得好。

source: My lady...
target: 王后陛下……

source: Well? Isn't someone going to follow her?
target: 怎么？没人去跟着她吗？

source: The death falls hard upon her, my lord. Perhaps—
target: 他的死对她打击很大，陛下。也许——

source: Stop! The rest of you handle his body. I'll follow her.
target: 别说了！你们其他人处理他的尸体。我去跟着她。

source: I never thought this night could end like this.
target: 我从没想过今晚会这样收场。

source: And with my many-changing faces, I aim to please all who look upon me!
target: 我要用这千变万化的面孔，让每一位看着我的观众都尽兴！

source: So, without further ado, a comedy of errors:
target: 那么，闲话少说，请看这出阴差阳错的喜剧：

source: The Stone Prince!
target: 《石头王子》！

source: No, but it sounds quite entertaining!
target: 没有，但听起来很有趣！

source: What... what is this?
target: 这……这是什么？

source: This isn't what I wanted!
target: 这不是我想要的！

source: My lord, are you all right?
target: 殿下，您还好吗？

source: No. I'm not. But it's too late now.
target: 不。我不好。可现在已经太迟了。

source: We come across a young prince lost in a dark place.
target: 我们看到一位年轻王子，迷失在黑暗之中。

source: His father, you see, was murdered by a vengeful rival, cut down in the prime of his life!
target: 要知道，他的父亲被一个寻仇的对手谋杀了，正值壮年就惨遭杀害！

source: And yet here the prince sits, overcome with his own thoughts, unable to even lift his sword to action.
target: 可王子却坐在这里，被自己的思绪困住，连举剑行动都做不到。

source: He rests his chin upon his fist, back hunched as though from years of labor. Yet for all his father's years of toil, he has none!
target: 他用拳头托着下巴，弓着背，仿佛劳作了多年。可他的父亲多年辛劳，他自己却一天也没劳作过！

source: Is this... about me?
target: 这……是在说我？

source: Centuries pass, and the young man turns to stone. Meanwhile, his father's usurper storms the castle, stealing the throne.
target: 几百年过去了，年轻人变成了石头。与此同时，篡夺他父亲王位的人攻入城堡，夺走了王座。

source: The prince's men go to him and shake him, begging him to rise and fight. But it is then they realize: He is no longer a man of flesh, but of stone!
target: 王子的部下来到他身边，摇晃着他，恳求他起身战斗。可这时他们才发现：他已不再是血肉之躯，而成了石头！

source: And the stone prince is carried to the basement to gather dust.
target: 于是，石头王子被搬进地下室，任灰尘堆积。

source: Ha! Excellent, excellent! What a clown!
target: 哈！精彩，精彩！真是个小丑！

source: This isn't funny.
target: 这不好笑。

source: None of this is funny in the slightest.
target: 这一切没有半点好笑的。

source: Oh, come, Hamlet. Don't be so sensitive.
target: 哎，得了吧，哈姆雷特。别这么敏感。

source: The only cause I would have to take offense from it were if you thought it was fact, not fiction.
target: 只有当你把它当成事实而非虚构时，我才有理由觉得受了冒犯。

source: Well, the portrayal of the young man certainly resonates, at the very least!
target: 嗯，至少那个年轻人的样子，确实让人觉得很熟悉！

source: Why, if these four walls were falling down around you, you'd still sit there paralyzed with fright!
target: 哎，就算你四周的墙壁都塌了，你也还是会坐在那里，吓得动弹不得！

source: Don't be so easily offended. You really are such a child.
target: 别动不动就生气。你真是太孩子气了。

source: ...And you really are a monster.
target: ……而你真是个怪物。

source: Indeed, after all these years I've never seen you for who you are so vividly before.
target: 确实，这么多年来，我从未像现在这样看清你的真面目。

source: Dearest, please. Both of you. I think that's enough.
target: 亲爱的，求你了。你们两个都别说了。我想已经够了。

source: Well, that was odd.
target: 嗯，真奇怪。

source: And with my many-changing faces, I aim to please all who look upon me.
target: 我要用这千变万化的面孔，让每一位看着我的观众都尽兴。

source: So, without further ado... a tale of espionage, subterfuge, and deception:
target: 那么，闲话不多说……请看这个关于间谍、阴谋与欺骗的故事：

source: The Traitor of Spain!
target: 《西班牙的叛徒》！

source: It's not familiar to me, no.
target: 没有，我没听说过。

source: This is wrong.
target: 这不对。

source: What do you mean, Hamlet?
target: 什么意思，哈姆雷特？

source: This isn't what I—oh, never mind.
target: 这不是我——唉，算了。

source: Our tale begins in the sunburnt city of Granada...
target: 我们的故事始于烈日炙烤下的格拉纳达城……

source: Where Queen Isabella and King Ferdinand wage war on the fearsome King Lucianus, even as Lucianus's country slides backwards into despair.
target: 在那里，伊莎贝拉女王与斐迪南国王向可怕的卢西安纳斯国王开战，而卢西安纳斯的国家也正每况愈下，陷入绝望。

source: My lord Lucianus, the people are unhappy. What will you do?
target: 卢西安纳斯陛下，百姓心怀不满。您打算怎么办？

source: I care not!
target: 我才不在乎！

source: Oh, my lord, it will come to bite you in the end!
target: 啊，陛下，您终究会自食其果的！

source: The King rules with God-given might, but there are thieves and liars in his court, and—even worse—a spy in his midst, leaking information to his enemies!
target: 国王凭着上帝赐予的权力统治，可他的宫廷里尽是窃贼与骗子，更糟的是——他身边还藏着一个间谍，向他的敌人泄露情报！

source: My lord, I love you with all my heart.
target: 陛下，我全心全意地爱着您。

source: And I will make you my Queen, fair lady, if you answer me this: where do you go each night?
target: 美丽的女士，只要你回答这个问题，我便立你为王后：你每夜都去了哪里？

source: Oh! Merely to walk in the cold moonlight a while!
target: 啊！只是在清冷的月光下散一会儿步！

source: Even now, this traitorous woman claims to love her King, yet plots to slit his throat...
target: 即便此刻，这个叛逆的女人仍声称爱着她的国王，心中却谋划着割断他的喉咙……

source: I love my King, but my country hates him so.
target: 我爱我的国王，可我的国家如此憎恨他。

source: Surely another ruler could do better, wiser, stronger...
target: 换一位君主，一定能治理得更好，更明智，更有力……

source: And on the night before Lucianus is to attack, she slips a dagger between his shoulders, thus sending all those who ever trusted her to ruin.
target: 就在卢西安纳斯即将发动进攻的前一夜，她将一把匕首刺入他两肩之间，让所有曾信任她的人一同走向毁灭。

source: Think of how different the world might have been, had this girl not taken it upon herself to destroy a nation!
target: 想想吧，若这姑娘没有擅自毁掉一个国家，这世界可能会有多么不同！

source: Hamlet, what are you doing?
target: 哈姆雷特，你在干什么？

source: What do you mean?
target: 你什么意思？

source: Quince, I think we've had enough of this play. It's troubling the tenderer ones amongst us, myself included.
target: 奎因斯，我想这出戏我们已经看够了。我们当中心肠较软的人都看得很不安，我也一样。

source: As you wish, my lady.
target: 遵命，陛下。

source: I think the whole thing's terrible. Terrible and strange.
target: 我觉得整出戏都糟透了。糟糕又古怪。

source: How topical.
target: 真是应景。

source: It makes me shudder to think Brit of all people was going to betray us like that.
target: 一想到竟然连布莉特都打算那样背叛我们，我就不寒而栗。

source: Art is a mirror to inspect life's deeper truths, is it not?
target: 艺术是一面镜子，让我们审视人生更深处的真相，不是吗？

source: (It doesn't matter, though. I already know Brit's the one.)
target: （不过，这不重要。我已经知道那个人就是布莉特。）

source: So, without further ado, a thigh-slapping comedy of ineptitude...
target: 那么，闲话不多说，请看这出以无能为题、令人捧腹的喜剧……

source: The False Wise Man!
target: 《冒牌智者》！

source: The... false wise man?
target: 冒牌……智者？

source: An, erm, a fascinating choice for a a performance. Yes, this ought to be interesting.
target: 这，呃，选了个很有意思的剧目来演、演出。是啊，想必会很有趣。

source: In the kingdom of a certain Lord Gonzago, there rests a terrible predicament...
target: 有一位名叫贡扎古的君主，他的王国正面临可怕的困境……

source: He finds himself assaulted by his enemies at every step, embattled and in need of some good advice.
target: 他处处遭到敌人的攻击，四面受困，急需一些良策。

source: Woe be to him, though: He has only Corambis, the idiot advisor, at his side!
target: 可他真是不幸：身边只有科兰比斯这个蠢货顾问！

source: Corambis fails to 'inform' his master on even the simplest subjects.
target: 哪怕是最简单的事情，科兰比斯也无法向主人“指点”一二。

source: I know not what I hunger for... Corambis, what ought I to eat for supper?
target: 我不知自己想吃什么……科兰比斯，我晚餐该吃些什么？

source: O, my lord, there is soup in the kitchen today! A most wonderful bone-broth of savory roots and meats.
target: 啊，陛下，今天厨房里有汤！用鲜美的根菜和肉熬成的骨汤，滋味绝佳。

source: But also, my lord, the cook has prepared a freshly-caught boar, and hanged it in the pantry for preparation tonight.
target: 不过，陛下，厨师也备好了一头刚猎来的野猪，挂在食品储藏室里，准备今晚烹制。

source: Of course, there's also a platter of sweetmeats on the hearth... and a roast duck in the guardhouse, and a hundred other things besides!
target: 当然，炉边还有一盘甜点……卫兵室里有一只烤鸭，此外还有上百种别的吃食！

source: Corambis, I only wanted your best professional opinion. What good is a list of opportunities to me? I need a firm decision!
target: 科兰比斯，我只想听你最好的专业意见。列出一堆选择对我有什么用？我要的是一个明确的决定！

source: And if you can't help me with even this, old man, how are we ever supposed to win this god-awful war?
target: 老头，你要是连这点事都帮不了我，我们又怎么能打赢这场该死的战争？

source: W-what? What is this?
target: 什、什么？这是怎么回事？

source: Is that supposed to be... me?
target: 那演的难道是……我？

source: One night, Corambis sneaks into the Queen's chambers to observe a most interesting conversation.
target: 一天夜里，科兰比斯偷偷溜进王后的寝宫，窥听一场极有意思的谈话。

source: But as the exchange turns heated, he debates with himself: what ought he to do? Should he flee, or defend the Queen, or something more?
target: 可当双方争执起来时，他却在心里反复盘算：自己该怎么办？是逃走，还是保护王后，还是做些别的？

source: Unable to decide, he merely cries out—and gives away his position!
target: 他迟迟拿不定主意，只喊了一声——便暴露了自己的藏身之处！

source: He's run through immediately. Poor Corambis. Dead too soon, and yet not dead soon enough!
target: 他立刻被刺了个对穿。可怜的科兰比斯。死得太早，却又死得不够早！

source: O, I am slain!
target: 啊，我被杀了！

source: That's a horrid caricature of me. Not like me at all.
target: 他们把我丑化得太过分了。一点都不像我。

source: Thus die I... thus... thus, thus!
target: 我就这样死去……这样……这样，这样！

source: Oh, for Heaven's sake.
target: 唉，真是够了。

source: Is this what the King and Queen think of me? Useless and rambling? Unable to perform my basic duties?
target: 国王和王后就是这么看我的？毫无用处、唠叨不休？连最基本的职责都做不好？

source: A-all these years, I thought I was good, and dutiful.
target: 这、这么多年来，我一直以为自己很称职，也很尽责。

source: I've seen quite enough. Ladies, gentlemen, my lieges, please excuse me.
target: 我已经看够了。各位女士，各位先生，两位陛下，请恕我先行告退。

source: Goodness. Dearest, did you request that script?
target: 天哪。亲爱的，是你要求演这个剧本的吗？

source: Not at all. I hope Polonius didn't take offense.
target: 完全没有。我希望波洛涅斯没觉得受了冒犯。

source: Well, no mind. He'll recover. Good old Polonius, faithful as an aged drafthorse.
target: 好吧，不必在意。他会缓过来的。我们的老波洛涅斯，像一匹老役马一样忠实。

source: Quince, I think we've had quite enough. A wonderful performance. Thank you.
target: 奎因斯，我想我们已经看够了。演得很精彩。谢谢你。

source: Of course, my lord. As you command!
target: 当然，陛下。谨遵您的命令！

source: (That wasn't the play I intended to perform.)
target: （这不是我打算上演的那出戏。）

source: (Not in the slightest. I can't trust that Quince fellow at all.)
target: （完全不是。奎因斯那家伙根本靠不住。）

source: So, without further ado... a surreal tale, of destiny and circumstance!
target: 那么，闲话不多说……请看这个关于命运与际遇的奇诡故事！

source: The Goat's Song!
target: 《山羊之歌》！

source: What on earth is this? And what on earth is a goat's song?
target: 这到底是什么？山羊之歌又到底是什么？

source: It's another way to call something a tragedy.
target: 这是悲剧的另一种叫法。

source: This isn't what Quince and I agreed upon at all...
target: 这根本不是我和奎因斯说好的那出戏……

source: In the kingdom of a certain Lord Gonzago, there rests a terrible predicament.
target: 有一位名叫贡扎古的君主，他的王国正面临可怕的困境。

source: Every morning he wakes up, and like a good ruler, attends to his duties.
target: 每天早晨，他醒来后，便像一位贤明的君主那样，履行自己的职责。

source: Yet every night, when he goes to sleep, he wakes up on the very same day once more.
target: 可每晚入睡后，再次醒来时，他又回到了同一天。

source: The poor King reflects upon his situation...
target: 可怜的国王思索着自己的处境……

source: I am trapped here, it seems, for worse or for ill.
target: 看来我被困在这里了，不是更糟，便是更坏。

source: Doomed to see the same dawn a thousand times or more!
target: 注定要看同一个黎明上千遍，甚至更多！

source: What ails you, my lord, my love?
target: 陛下，我的爱人，什么事让您如此苦恼？

source: Fret not, my dear Baptista. I could not make you understand.
target: 别担心，我亲爱的巴普蒂斯塔。我无法让你明白。

source: As the years pass—and yet pass not at all—madness overtakes him.
target: 岁月流逝——却又根本没有流逝——他逐渐陷入疯狂。

source: No matter what I try, when I open my eyes again, there my wife lies beside me, as peaceful as a lamb!
target: 无论我尝试什么，再次睁开眼时，我的妻子依然躺在身旁，像羔羊一样安详！

source: Unaware of the pain I've suffered, the madness I've endured, caught between life and death—
target: 她全然不知我受过的痛苦，熬过的疯狂，不知我困在生死之间——

source: This is a strange performance. I'm not certain I follow.
target: 这出戏真古怪。我不太确定自己看懂了。

source: S-something about an endless day, my love? It's confusing to me, as well.
target: 是、是说一个永远过不完的日子吧，亲爱的？我也看得糊涂。

source: Stop this, Quince. We're yawning ourselves into the grave down here.
target: 停下吧，奎因斯。我们在台下都快打着哈欠进坟墓了。

source: From where did you find the inspiration for this terrible story?
target: 你从哪儿找来的灵感，编出这么糟糕的故事？

source: Why, from the dear Ophelia herself. She came to me and asked me to spin this tale.
target: 当然是亲爱的奥菲莉娅本人。她来找我，请我编出这个故事。

source: Hrm. From Ophelia?
target: 嗯。奥菲莉娅？

source: How peculiar. It's unlike her to suggest something this... odd.
target: 真奇怪。提出这么……古怪的东西，可不像她。

source: Your majesties, I merely meant to highlight something fantastical. Think nothing of it.
target: 两位陛下，我只是想呈现一点奇幻的故事。请别放在心上。

source: (I do worry about the girl's tendencies. She may become hysterical.)
target: （这姑娘的倾向实在让我担心。她可能会变得歇斯底里。）

source: (D-do you think we ought to call the physician?)
target: （你、你觉得我们该叫医生来吗？）

source: (Let's discuss this in private, dearest.)
target: （我们私下再谈吧，亲爱的。）

source: So, without further ado, a surreal tale, of destiny and circumstance!
target: 那么，闲话不多说，请看这个关于命运与际遇的奇诡故事！

source: (Maybe this is the play he was 'meant' to perform before Hamlet got to him.)
target: （也许这才是哈姆雷特找上他之前，他“本该”上演的那出戏。）

source: (Or—perhaps it's something else entirely.)
target: （或者——也许完全是另一回事。）

source: But... where is everyone?
target: 可是……大家都去哪儿了？

source: I know what you're doing.
target: 我知道你在做什么。

source: Well, I should hope so. Couldn't be more blatant if I tried!
target: 嗯，我当然希望你知道。我就是想再明显一点，也做不到了！

source: And what are you trying to achieve with this?
target: 那你这么做究竟想达到什么目的？

source: My dear girl, everything I do in this world is but a pathetic move to entertain myself a little before death eventually gets me.
target: 亲爱的姑娘，我在这世上做的一切，不过是想在死亡最终找上我之前，给自己找点乐子的可怜举动。

source: Isn't that true of all human beings?
target: 所有人不都是这样吗？

source: Isn't that true of you as well?
target: 你不也是这样吗？

source: Entertainment? You call this entertainment?
target: 找乐子？你管这叫找乐子？

source: Oh, maybe not for you. Certainly for me!
target: 哦，对你来说也许不是。对我来说当然是！

source: But I think the show's rather over, isn't it?
target: 不过我想，这出戏也算结束了，不是吗？

source: What a disappointing performance. I didn't even reach the beautiful conclusion!
target: 真是场令人失望的演出。我连那个美妙的结局都没演到！

source: I don't know how to do this.
target: 我不知道该怎么做。

source: Are you even listening, Lord?
target: 主啊，您究竟有没有在听？

source: Oh my offense is rank. It smells to Heaven.
target: 啊，我的罪恶腐臭不堪，臭气直达天国。

source: Even if you cannot forgive me...
target: 即使您无法宽恕我……

source: I can't bear this alone, not anymore.
target: 我再也无法独自承受这一切了。

source: I killed my brother.
target: 我杀了我的哥哥。

source: The oldest crime, and the worst.
target: 最古老，也最深重的罪。

source: The castle believes it to be a snake bite which froze his blood as he slept in the garden.
target: 城堡里的人都以为，他在花园熟睡时被蛇咬伤，血液因此凝结。

source: B-but I poured that poison into his ear myself. I remember the feel of it in my hands.
target: 可、可是，是我亲手把毒药倒进了他的耳朵。我还记得把它握在手中的感觉。

source: I don't deserve anything of his. Not this crown, not my wife, none of it. I know it. I know I was wrong.
target: 他的任何东西，我都不配拥有。这顶王冠，我的妻子，一切都不配。我知道。我知道自己错了。

source: But in that moment, i-it felt... You know my heart, don't you, Lord? I could see no other way out.
target: 可在那一刻，我、我觉得……主啊，您明白我的心，不是吗？我看不到别的出路。

source: I need salvation. Yet I am beyond salvation. All those who murder must go to hell. So your divine hand has written. Is it even possible to save my soul?
target: 我需要救赎，却又已无可救赎。凡杀人者，必下地狱。您的圣手如此写下。我的灵魂真的还有可能得救吗？

source: (How can it be? Is it really true?)
target: （怎么会这样？这真是真的吗？）

source: (So you murdered my father, eh? Now you die for it.)
target: （原来是你谋杀了我父亲，是吗？现在你就为此偿命吧。）

source: God, please save me.
target: 上帝啊，求您救救我。

source: Save me from myself.
target: 救我摆脱我自己。

source: Surely you didn't forget me when you made me, Lord?
target: 主啊，您创造了我，总不至于忘了我吧？

source: Surely there is still some hope for a sinner, a murderer like me?
target: 像我这样的罪人、杀人凶手，总还留有一丝希望吧？

source: (If I kill him while praying--)
target: （如果我趁他祈祷时杀了他——）

source: (He's a lunatic. He confessed to murdering my father. I should kill him.)
target: （他是个疯子。他承认谋杀了我父亲。我应该杀了他。）

source: (But if I do it now, while he's praying, he'll go to Heaven--)
target: （可如果我现在动手，趁他还在祈祷，他就会上天堂——）

source: (I can't. I can't do it.)
target: （我不能。我下不了手。）

source: I should go.
target: 我该走了。

source: I'm going to be ill. I can't stay here.
target: 我快吐了。我不能待在这里。

source: (It's exactly as my daughter warned me—he's—he's gone insane—)
target: （正如女儿警告我的那样——他——他已经疯了——）

source: (I need to leave—!)
target: （我得离开——！）

source: He must be disciplined. This has gone on too long.
target: 必须管教他了。这已经持续太久了。

source: Now, my lady, the time has long since passed to talk sense into him.
target: 陛下，如今早已不是跟他讲道理的时候了。

source: He's made a fool of the King. You've been far too graceful.
target: 他让国王出了丑。您对他实在太宽厚了。

source: Please, be honest with him—
target: 请您把话跟他说明白——

source: Out. Out, Polonius. Now. I cannot bear to listen to you right now. Please.
target: 出去。出去，波洛涅斯。马上。我现在实在听不下去你说话。求你了。

source: (I'll not leave yet.)
target: （我还不能走。）

source: Hamlet. You have been truly terrible to your uncle today.
target: 哈姆雷特。你今天对你叔叔实在太过分了。

source: And you have been truly terrible to my father.
target: 而你对我的父亲才实在太过分了。

source: What on earth?
target: 这到底是怎么回事？

source: This is her final chance to prove her loyalty and renounce her sin.
target: 这是她证明忠诚、摒弃罪恶的最后机会。

source: I think you know why I'm here, don't you? Why the play had to show that awful scene?
target: 我想你知道我为什么来这里，对吧？也知道那出戏为什么非得演出那可怕的一幕？

source: I don't understand.
target: 我不明白。

source: Patience, Hamlet.
target: 耐心些，哈姆雷特。

source: This ghost whispers patience in my ear. Father, how can you ask for patience?
target: 这个幽灵在我耳边低语，要我耐心。父亲，你怎么还能要我耐心？

source: You are seeing... spirits?
target: 你看见了……幽灵？

source: My father's ghost stands right there! Can you not see him? He comes to pass judgement! Do you not understand Claudius's sin?
target: 我父亲的幽灵就站在那里！你看不见他吗？他是来审判的！你难道不明白克劳狄斯犯下的罪？

source: Are you trying to say you don't know what he's done? After you married him?
target: 你是想说，你不知道他做过什么？你都嫁给他了？

source: I have no idea what you're talking about. My love, please, why are you shouting at me?
target: 我根本不知道你在说什么。亲爱的，求你了，你为什么冲我大喊大叫？

source: This is just another trap to try and convince me I'm insane.
target: 这不过又是一个圈套，想让我相信自己疯了。

source: No, Hamlet, it's not! Please, you must be mad—
target: 不，哈姆雷特，不是的！求你了，你一定是疯了——

source: You vile woman. You won't escape punishment.
target: 你这卑劣的女人。你逃不过惩罚。

source: Help! Someone, stop him!
target: 救命！来人，拦住他！

source: What was that?
target: 刚才那是什么声音？

source: Are you and Claudius... spying on me?
target: 你和克劳狄斯在……监视我？

source: Die, rat.
target: 去死吧，老鼠。

source: (I'm sorry...)
target: （对不起……）

source: Hamlet, Hamlet, what have you done?
target: 哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特，你做了什么？

source: I took him for his better.
target: 我把他当成他的主子了。

source: I warned you to stay your hand. It's happened again.
target: 我警告过你，不要动手。事情又发生了。

source: Ergh. Damn it.
target: 呃。该死。

source: You! You put him up to this!
target: 你！是你指使他这么做的！

source: Hamlet, I didn't know he was there, I swear!
target: 哈姆雷特，我不知道他在那里，我发誓！

source: Please, darling. Stop this.
target: 求你了，亲爱的。别再这样了。

source: Claudius murdered my father. He murdered my father, you suspected it, and yet you still slept with him!
target: 克劳狄斯谋杀了我父亲。他谋杀了我父亲，你也曾怀疑这件事，却还是和他上了床！

source: I should let the whole castle know we have a whore for a Queen!
target: 我该让整座城堡的人都知道，我们的王后是个娼妇！

source: He did what?
target: 他做了什么？

source: Hamlet. Leave her. She is not your enemy. See how amazement sits upon her face. Speak to her gently.
target: 哈姆雷特。放过她。她不是你的敌人。看看她脸上的震惊。温柔些跟她说话。

source: No, Father. I need to do this!
target: 不，父亲。我必须这么做！

source: Claudius... killed Hamlet?
target: 克劳狄斯……杀了哈姆雷特？

source: Father is dead because of that snake.
target: 父亲就是被那条毒蛇害死的。

source: I don't understand. How could he?
target: 我不明白。他怎么能这样？

source: You're saying you... truly didn't know?
target: 你是说你……真的不知道？

source: Can you not tell she is innocent?
target: 你难道看不出她是无辜的吗？

source: Father, enough. Stop whispering in my ear!
target: 父亲，够了。别再在我耳边低语了！

source: Father's spirit implores me to show you mercy.
target: 父亲的亡灵恳求我对你宽容。

source: So be it, then. If he asks, then I shall grant it.
target: 那就这样吧。如果是他开口请求，我就答应。

source: I... I only ever suspected Claudius. And never out loud. I never knew he was capable of such a thing.
target: 我……我只是怀疑过克劳狄斯。而且从没说出口。我从不知道他竟能做出这种事。

source: My son, I swear to you I never knew. I swear it.
target: 儿子，我向你发誓，我从不知情。我发誓。

source: Dry your eyes, Mother. I'm going to get revenge. For both of us.
target: 擦干眼泪吧，母亲。我会报仇的。为我们两个人。

source: You'll see soon enough. For now, speak none of this to my uncle. I'll handle the rest.
target: 你很快就会知道。现在，别向叔叔透露这件事。剩下的我来处理。

source: Time to lug this poor old fool's corpse.
target: 该把这个可怜的老糊涂的尸体拖走了。

source: Hamlet! Stop!
target: 哈姆雷特！住手！

source: Oh, my God.
target: 哦，天哪。

source: This evil woman!
target: 这个恶毒的女人！

source: Please, Hamlet, don't do this!
target: 求你了，哈姆雷特，别这样！

source: My son-- My son-- No...
target: 儿子——我的儿子——不……

source: I should have killed you the moment I suspected you helped that snake Claudius with his foul deeds!
target: 我一怀疑你帮克劳狄斯那条毒蛇干了那些卑劣的事，就该杀了你！

source: Were it up to me, you'd die a death a thousand times more painful than what you're about to suffer!
target: 要是由我做主，你的死法会比你马上要承受的痛苦一千倍！

source: Hamlet. Get on the ground immediately. Stand down.
target: 哈姆雷特。立刻趴到地上。停止抵抗。

source: You cannot stop me. Not now. I refuse to stand down.
target: 你阻止不了我。现在不行。我绝不停止抵抗。

source: He's just unconscious, my lady.
target: 他只是昏过去了，王后。

source: What about you, my Queen? Are you...
target: 您呢，王后？您有没有……

source: Bernardo... My son. What's wrong with him?
target: 贝尔纳多……我的儿子。他到底怎么了？

source: He's not in his right mind. He's not himself.
target: 他神志不清。已经不像他自己了。

source: I'll have to let the King know what has happened here.
target: 我必须把这里发生的事报告给国王。

source: I'm not letting you throw me in some filthy cell for avenging my father's death.
target: 我为父亲报仇，绝不会让你因此把我扔进什么肮脏的牢房。

source: No—! No, Hamlet—!
target: 不——！不要，哈姆雷特——！

source: My son, you fool...
target: 我的儿子，你这个傻瓜……

source: This is wretched.
target: 这太惨了。

source: I'm sorry, my lady.
target: 对不起，王后。

source: And to you, Hamlet.
target: 也对不起你，哈姆雷特。

source: Close his eyes. I can't see him like that.
target: 让他闭上眼睛。我看不得他这个样子。

source: I'll remove him, my lady.
target: 我会把他搬走，王后。

source: Warm yourself by the fire, please. And turn away. Don't look at this gruesome scene.
target: 请到炉火旁暖暖身子。转过身去，别看这惨状。

source: Leave it to me. Hamlet was one of my oldest, most beloved friends. I will clean what remains.
target: 交给我吧。哈姆雷特是我相识最久、最珍爱的朋友之一。我会收拾好这里。

source: You murderous, traitorous woman. You owe my father's honor your life.
target: 你这杀人害命、背信弃义的女人！你得用命来偿还我父亲的名誉。

source: I love you with all my heart. Please don't let it come to this.
target: 我全心全意地爱你。求你，别走到这一步。

source: Now, good riddance to a traitorous woman.
target: 现在，该除掉这个背叛的女人了。

source: My little baby boy...
target: 我的宝贝儿子……

source: N-No, please, no...
target: 不、不要，求你，不要……

source: This can't be happening.
target: 这不可能是真的。

source: Why did it have to come to this? Why?
target: 为什么非要走到这一步？为什么？

source: There's no longer any reason for me to be here.
target: 我已经没有任何理由留在这里了。

source: My son is dead, and I...
target: 我的儿子死了，而我……

source: Nothing on this earth matters anymore. All good and beloved things are dust.
target: 这世上已经没有什么重要了。一切美好、珍爱的事物都已化为尘土。

source: Come, blade. Find your noble resting place.
target: 来吧，利刃。找到你高贵的安息之所。

source: Holy Father, grant me a Heaven set before this evil summer began.
target: 圣父啊，赐我一个停留在这邪恶夏日开始之前的天堂。

source: One where the people I loved are still alive.
target: 在那里，我爱的人都还活着。

source: My lady, His Majesty wishes to speak with you.
target: 小姐，国王陛下想与您谈谈。

source: (Goodness. What now?)
target: （天哪。这次又是什么事？）

source: Lady Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅小姐。

source: My deepest condolences again about your father. He was an incredible man.
target: 对于你父亲的离世，我再次致以最深切的哀悼。他是个了不起的人。

source: Thank you, my lord. What is this about?
target: 谢谢您，陛下。您找我有什么事？

source: Earlier, you mentioned something to me about a voyage at sea.
target: 先前，你向我提过一次海上航行的事。

source: You told me I would be unsuccessful in sending Hamlet to his demise.
target: 你告诉我，我想送哈姆雷特去死，是不会成功的。

source: You knew this long before I myself even formed this thought. And yet, you told no one.
target: 早在我自己产生这个念头之前，你就已经知道了。可你却没有告诉任何人。

source: Am I to understand that your secrecy is a tacit approval?
target: 我是否可以理解为，你保守秘密就是在默许？

source: What of it if so, my lord?
target: 是又如何，陛下？

source: I understand my nephew has caused you no small amount of pain.
target: 我知道，我的侄子给你带来了不少痛苦。

source: You may be interested to hear this: I plan to give Rosencrantz and Guildenstern a letter to deliver to the Queen of England.
target: 你或许有兴趣听听：我打算交给罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞一封信，让她们送给英格兰女王。

source: You may be interested to hear this: I plan to give the crew of this ship a letter to deliver to the Queen of England.
target: 你或许有兴趣听听：我打算交给这艘船的船员一封信，让他们送给英格兰女王。

source: And within that letter is writ my nephew's death warrant, a request to have him quietly executed.
target: 那封信里写着我侄子的处决令，请求将他秘密处死。

source: I have faith that my letter will reach its intended audience safely. Even so...
target: 我相信，我的信会平安送到该收信的人手中。即便如此……

source: As far as I know, you are the only one who knows my true intentions. I shall not be telling anyone else about what the letter itself contains.
target: 据我所知，只有你知道我的真实意图。我不会再告诉其他人信里写了什么。

source: If you wish to avail yourself to a King, and so earn my personal favor, perhaps you can join Hamlet on his journey. Ensure he does not make it back.
target: 如果你愿意为国王效力，赢得我本人的恩宠，或许可以陪哈姆雷特一同出行。确保他回不来。

source: The ship sails at ten in the morning. Go with him, and do my bidding. Make sure Hamlet dies, and you will be justly rewarded.
target: 船在上午十点启航。跟他一起去，按我的吩咐行事。务必让哈姆雷特死去，你就会得到应有的奖赏。

source: Well? What happened?
target: 怎么样？发生了什么？

source: I was hiding for ages!
target: 我躲了好久好久！

source: Do you know how hungry I was? I nearly gnawed my own leg off!
target: 你知道我有多饿吗？我差点把自己的腿都啃掉了！

source: I'm sorry, Guilda. I forgot to tell Rosencrantz.
target: 对不起，吉尔达。我忘了告诉罗森克兰兹。

source: You forgot? Well, remember this: That's the last fake funeral I'll ever ask you to plan!
target: 你忘了？好吧，记住：这是我最后一次请你安排假葬礼！

source: I'm sorry, Guilda. I told Rosencrantz, but I guess there just wasn't enough time.
target: 对不起，吉尔达。我告诉罗森克兰兹了，不过大概还是没来得及。

source: Not enough time? Well, remember this: That's the last fake funeral I'll ever ask you to plan!
target: 没来得及？好吧，记住：这是我最后一次请你安排假葬礼！

source: Probably for the best.
target: 这样大概也好。

source: Now I've got to go explain to Rosie all about my prank. She's going to be angry.
target: 现在我得去跟罗茜解释这个恶作剧了。她会生气的。

source: Oops. She's here.
target: 糟了。她来了。

source: You're not... dead.
target: 你没有……死。

source: Rosie. I can explain.
target: 罗茜。我可以解释。

source: I don't care. I don't need to know.
target: 我不在乎。我不需要知道。

source: Just never do that to me again.
target: 只要你再也别这样对我。

source: Do you know how awful that felt? How frightened I was?
target: 你知道那有多难受吗？知道我有多害怕吗？

source: I never want to feel that way. Not ever again.
target: 我不想再有那种感觉。永远都不想。

source: Sorry, Rosie.
target: 对不起，罗茜。

source: I thought it'd be funny. I really did.
target: 我以为会很好笑。我真的这么想。

source: Oh, Guilda, my peach.
target: 唉，吉尔达，我的宝贝。

source: Having you around is the only part which makes life funny.
target: 只有你在身边，才让生活有了乐趣。

source: Without you, I don't quite know that there's a point to any of it at all.
target: 没有你，我真不知道这一切还有什么意义。

source: I'll give you two some time alone.
target: 我让你们俩单独待一会儿。

source: My thanks, Ophelia.
target: 谢谢你，奥菲莉娅。

source: There's nothing that can be done now.
target: 现在已经无能为力了。

source: Hamlet must be separated from us. From everyone.
target: 必须让哈姆雷特远离我们。远离所有人。

source: For the safety of those around him, and of himself.
target: 为了他身边的人，也为了他自己的安全。

source: Lady Rosencrantz, Lady Guildenstern, I'm ordering you to go to England with him.
target: 罗森克兰兹女士，吉尔登斯吞女士，我命令你们陪他去英格兰。

source: I might point out, my lord, that just a moment ago we were sitting in your dungeon, accused of treason.
target: 容我提醒您，陛下，就在刚才，我们还因叛国的指控被关在您的地牢里。

source: Rosie! What's that saying? Never look a gift horse in the mouth! They're a particularly aggressive breed!
target: 罗茜！那句俗话怎么说来着？赠马不看牙！赠马可是特别凶的一种马！

source: A gift horse isn't a breed of horse, Guilda.
target: 赠马不是马的品种，吉尔达。

source: Are you going to be the one to tell the gift horse that? It'll bite your face off!
target: 那你要亲自去跟赠马说吗？它会把你的脸咬下来！

source: What? What's this got to do with biting? I... Oh, dear. Allow me to explain the saying.
target: 什么？这跟咬人有什么关系？我……哎呀。让我解释一下这句俗话。

source: Yes, sir!
target: 是，陛下！

source: Just looking at the two of you gives me a headache. Nevertheless, my options are limited here. You shall go with Hamlet to England.
target: 光是看着你们俩，我就头疼。不过，我现在也没多少选择。你们要陪哈姆雷特去英格兰。

source: If you can do this for me, then I shall lift all accusations of treason against you.
target: 如果你们能替我办成这件事，我就撤销对你们的所有叛国指控。

source: So... we aren't going to be executed and we get a free vacation to England. Today might be the best day of my life.
target: 所以……我们不但不会被处死，还能免费去英格兰度假。今天可能是我这辈子最美好的一天。

source: In exchange, I ask a simple favor.
target: 作为交换，我请你们帮一个小忙。

source: When there, make sure to deliver this letter to the Queen.
target: 到了那里，务必把这封信交给女王。

source: She will prescribe a fitting treatment for Hamlet.
target: 她会为哈姆雷特安排合适的治疗。

source: Something to lift his spirits for good?
target: 能让他永远振作起来的治疗？

source: In a manner of speaking.
target: 某种意义上，可以这么说。

source: My lord, we've been informed that we may be in grave danger if we board a ship to England.
target: 陛下，有人告诉我们，如果登船去英格兰，我们可能会面临极大的危险。

source: And after that last fortune-teller told me my hands would swell up in the bath, I'm a believer.
target: 而且，上次那个算命的说我的手洗澡时会泡肿，从那以后我就信了。

source: But they always do t--
target: 可手本来就会那——

source: Bah. Never mind.
target: 哼。算了。

source: My good lady, have you not learned to distrust those who claim to know the future?
target: 女士，你还没学会不去相信那些自称知道未来的人吗？

source: Well, this time it wasn't a fortune-teller. It was Lady Ophelia! I trust her even more!
target: 可这次不是算命的。是奥菲莉娅小姐！我更信她！

source: Lady Ophelia?
target: 奥菲莉娅小姐？

source: (Curse that girl.)
target: （那女孩真该死。）

source: Where—how—could she have heard something like that?
target: 她从哪里——怎么会——听到这种话？

source: At any rate, please let me clarify. You are going to England. I will aim to make your journey both a comfortable and safe one.
target: 无论如何，让我把话说清楚。你们要去英格兰。我会尽力让你们的旅程既舒适又安全。

source: And please, don't take further advice from Lady Ophelia. She's deeply, deeply unwell as of late.
target: 还有，请不要再听奥菲莉娅小姐的建议了。她最近病得很重，很重。

source: Hamlet's gone nutters. Can't blame you.
target: 哈姆雷特疯了。这也不能怪您。

source: Hush, Guilda. For God's sake. A man is dead. Can't we be appropriate?
target: 别说了，吉尔达。拜托。有人死了。我们就不能说话得体些吗？

source: Hush, Guilda. For God's sake. His father died. Can't we be appropriate?
target: 别说了，吉尔达。拜托。他父亲去世了。我们就不能说话得体些吗？

source: Fine. I suppose so.
target: 好吧。大概是该这样。

source: Off you go, my good ladies. The ship sails soon.
target: 去吧，两位女士。船很快就要启航了。

source: Rosencrantz? Guildenstern? Why are you here? I thought--
target: 罗森克兰兹？吉尔登斯吞？你们怎么在这里？我以为——

source: All a misunderstanding, my good nephew. And I am to blame.
target: 都是误会，我的好侄子。责任在我。

source: What I initially believed to be treason, I now realize was a momentary error in judgement on my part.
target: 我起初认定那是叛国，现在才明白，是我一时判断失误。

source: As a result, the good Lady Rosencrantz and Lady Guildenstern are here to accompany you on your voyage to England.
target: 所以，罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士这两位好女士来这里，是要陪你一同航行去英格兰。

source: Not to mention your uncle forced us to make him a secret promise!
target: 而且你叔叔还逼我们向他许了个秘密承诺！

source: --Errrr, what Guilda means is, we made a secret promise that we would take utmost care of you on this journey!
target: ——呃……吉尔达的意思是，我们私下承诺了，这一路会尽心尽力地照顾你！

source: (Guilda, you dolt.)
target: （吉尔达，你这个笨蛋。）

source: Right. Yes. Exactly what she said.
target: 对。是的。就是她说的那样。

source: So. It's time we bid goodbye to Denmark once and for all.
target: 那么。是时候与丹麦永远告别了。

source: This will be good for you, Hamlet.
target: 这对你会有好处的，哈姆雷特。

source: It'll be just like the old days again!
target: 又能像从前一样了！

source: We'll be running through London, in and out of trouble...
target: 我们会在伦敦四处奔走，闯了祸再脱身……

source: All the diplomatic immunity, none of the down sides!
target: 外交豁免权的好处全都有，坏处一个也没有！

source: When you say it like that, it sounds almost like this isn't a banishment.
target: 听你们这么说，几乎都不像是在流放我了。

source: But let us all make no mistake. My uncle is sending this monster where I cannot cause further harm.
target: 但我们都别弄错了。叔叔是在把我这个怪物送到一个无法再造成伤害的地方。

source: Farewell, my dearest nephew.
target: 再见，我最亲爱的侄子。

source: May your journey be swift and uneventful, and may you be delivered quickly to England's arms.
target: 愿你此行迅速而平顺，早日投入英格兰的怀抱。

source: Terribly poetic of you.
target: 您可真有诗意。

source: Ah. You're here, Ophelia.
target: 啊。你来了，奥菲莉娅。

source: What's all this? Where are you going?
target: 这是怎么回事？你们要去哪里？

source: I'm now away to England, perhaps never to return. I hesitate to even ask if you'll think of me. If you'll miss me.
target: 我现在要去英格兰了，也许再也不会回来。我甚至不敢问，你会不会想起我。会不会想念我。

source: Ah, Hamlet. There's been a change in plans.
target: 啊，哈姆雷特。计划有变。

source: Ophelia's going to join you aboard the ship!
target: 奥菲莉娅会和你一起上船！

source: Yes, Hamlet. I've been tasked with escorting you.
target: 是的，哈姆雷特。我受命陪同你出行。

source: In these troubled times... Claudius felt it would be best for you to have a familiar face close by.
target: 如今这么不安宁……克劳狄斯觉得，最好有个熟悉的人陪在你身边。

source: Perhaps... so.
target: 也许……是吧。

source: Be off, then. The both of you. The wind is getting stronger each moment.
target: 那就出发吧。你们两个都去。风越来越大了。

source: Bon voyage, beloveds. Take care.
target: 亲爱的，祝你们一路顺风。多保重。

source: My father is dead because of you. I can't say I will.
target: 我父亲因你而死。我可不敢说我会。

source: I cannot blame you.
target: 我不能怪你。

source: Know only that, for whatever an idiot's word is worth, I'm sorry.
target: 你只需知道，无论一个傻瓜的话有多少分量，我都很抱歉。

source: I never meant to kill him.
target: 我从没想过要杀他。

source: That's an unfair question, isn't it?
target: 这么问对我不公平，不是吗？

source: Mm. I suppose it is.
target: 嗯。我想是的。

source: For whatever little it's worth, I'm sorry about all that happened with your father. I truly am.
target: 即使这话没多少分量，对于你父亲遭遇的一切，我很抱歉。真心的。

source: To England! Farewell for now, Hamlet.
target: 去英格兰吧！暂且告别了，哈姆雷特。

source: For now, perhaps for ever.
target: 暂别，也许是永别。

source: Hamlet. Why so dismal? This is our chance to embark on a new adventure!
target: 哈姆雷特。何必这么沮丧？这可是我们开始一场新冒险的机会！

source: Yes, a new life, a new journey—in England!
target: 是啊，新的生活，新的旅程——就在英格兰！

source: Let's be off. I sense a storm coming on.
target: 出发吧。我觉得风暴要来了。

source: Well, looks like it's time for me to depart.
target: 好了，看来我该出发了。

source: This castle has been good to me these long few years.
target: 这漫长的几年里，我在这座城堡过得很好。

source: But fairer places await!
target: 但还有更美好的地方在等着我！

source: I can imagine the ship waiting out in harbor now.
target: 我已经能想象那艘船此刻在港口等着的样子了。

source: I always dreamed one of these ships might sail for me.
target: 我一直梦想着，这些船里能有一艘为我启航。

source: Your trunks have been loaded, my lord. Shall we board the longboat?
target: 您的行李箱已经装好了，大人。我们上接驳艇吧？

source: Yes, I think that appropriate, Reynaldo.
target: 好，我想是该上船了，雷纳尔多。

source: Goodbye, you loon. Don't dig yourself into a hole too deep.
target: 再见，你这个疯子。别给自己惹上太大的麻烦。

source: I'll miss you too, Brit.
target: 我也会想你的，布莉特。

source: You ought to be off while the winds are good.
target: 您该趁风向有利的时候出发。

source: Yes, yes, the winds will go, and so must we.
target: 是，是，风不等人，我们也得走了。

source: Goodbye, sister. Be safe.
target: 再见，妹妹。注意安全。

source: Goodbye, everyone.
target: 各位，再见。

source: To Paris, then!
target: 那就去巴黎吧！

source: ERROR: If you're seeing this text, something has gone very wrong!
target: 错误：如果你看到了这段文字，就说明出了很严重的问题！

source: Bartender, a flagon of the finest, if you please.
target: 酒保，请来一壶最好的酒。

source: You must be that one they call Othello.
target: 你一定就是他们说的奥赛罗。

source: ...So it would seem. And you must be the one they call Lord Laertes.
target: ……看来是的。那您一定就是他们说的雷欧提斯大人。

source: Lord Laertes... it always was a funny title. I suppose I am now a Duke, aren't I?
target: 雷欧提斯大人……这个称呼一直都挺好笑的。我现在应该是公爵了，对吧？

source: Unfortunate news about your father, m'lord.
target: 令尊的噩耗，真令人遗憾，大人。

source: He was a good man. The best sort of man, a stalwart advisor, and a wonderful father.
target: 他是个好人。再好不过的人，一位坚定可靠的顾问，也是一位出色的父亲。

source: What sad luck that our ship was delayed in its leave of harbor.
target: 真不走运，我们的船离港时耽搁了。

source: I was presented with a letter the moment I stepped ashore here...
target: 我刚在这里上岸，就有人递给我一封信……

source: I still don't know how he died. The letter didn't mention more than his murder. Though I have my suspicions.
target: 我还是不知道他是怎么死的。信里只说他被谋杀了，没提别的。不过我心里有些怀疑。

source: A blackhearted rumor floats around town, my lord. I'd desire you to hear it from a kind voice first. Your sister, perhaps.
target: 大人，镇上流传着一个恶毒的传闻。我希望您先听一个心怀善意的人说起这件事。比如您的妹妹。

source: You and I are brothers of a kind. What is this vile rumor?
target: 你我也算是同类兄弟。那恶毒的传闻是什么？

source: The people whisper he was murdered, my lord. By the King's hand.
target: 大人，人们私下说他是被谋杀的。是国王下的手。

source: I see. Somehow I can't find it in me to be surprised.
target: 我明白了。不知为什么，我一点也不觉得意外。

source: Here I assumed that bastard Hamlet would have done the deed. But the King is his blood, and murderers tend to generate more of their kind.
target: 我还以为是哈姆雷特那个混蛋干的。不过国王和他血脉相连，杀人凶手往往也会造就更多同类。

source: With the bastard dead, it's too bad there's no one to ask about it.
target: 那混蛋已经死了，可惜也没人能问个明白。

source: Lord Laertes... it always was a funny title.
target: 雷欧提斯大人……这称呼一直都挺可笑的。

source: What fortunate luck that our ship was delayed in its leave of harbor.
target: 我们的船迟迟没能离港，真是走运。

source: The letter I received spoke of something horrible.
target: 我收到的信里提到了一件可怕的事。

source: Prince Hamlet made an attempt on my father's life. And now I must repay the deed in kind.
target: 哈姆雷特王子企图杀害我父亲。现在我必须以牙还牙。

source: Any honorable man would surely feel the same, my lord.
target: 大人，任何有气节的人肯定都会有同样的想法。

source: Though the precise interpretation of 'repaying the deed' is subject to some discussion, I should think.
target: 不过，我想这“以牙还牙”究竟该怎么做，还可以商量。

source: After all, the Prince is dead.
target: 毕竟，王子已经死了。

source: He-- Hamlet-- is dead?
target: 他——哈姆雷特——死了？

source: Yes. It came as a surprise to me, too.
target: 是的。我也很意外。

source: Can you not bring him to justice?
target: 您就不能将他绳之以法吗？

source: Perhaps. But as things stand, I desire only his death and my family's immediate safety.
target: 也许能。但眼下，我只想要他死，让我的家人立刻脱离危险。

source: I have to believe Claudius was behind this somehow. That he ordered Hamlet to come after my father.
target: 我不得不相信，这件事背后一定有克劳狄斯的手笔。是他命令哈姆雷特对我父亲下手的。

source: Hamlet may be a fool, but he wouldn't plot against my father alone. Not without being... pushed.
target: 哈姆雷特也许是个蠢货，但他不会独自谋害我父亲。除非有人……推了他一把。

source: The letter spoke only of 'urgent matters' requiring my attention back at home.
target: 信里只说家中有“急事”，需要我回去处理。

source: Ah. That'll likely be the Prince, rest his soul.
target: 啊。那多半是指王子的事，愿他的灵魂安息。

source: I... I see.
target: 我……我明白了。

source: I suppose woes spring forth other woes wherever they might land. And I sense more are soon to follow.
target: 我想，灾祸无论落在哪里，都会生出新的灾祸。而我感觉，很快还会有更多灾祸接踵而来。

source: Speaking of springing forth... I've heard that Prince Hamlet and Lady Birgitta are to be wed soon.
target: 说起接踵而来的事……我听说哈姆雷特王子和比尔吉塔女士很快就要结婚了。

source: Wed? You cannot be serious!
target: 结婚？你一定是在开玩笑！

source: It's a new brand of gossip, my lord, but I believe it trustworthy.
target: 大人，这是刚传出的消息，但我相信它是真的。

source: The servants who wait upon them both bring swift news to my bar-top.
target: 伺候他们两人的仆人总会很快把消息带到我的吧台来。

source: Brit... marrying him?
target: 布莉特……要嫁给他？

source: Of course the second I depart, Hamlet plots to make her his.
target: 果然，我前脚刚走，哈姆雷特就盘算着让她成为他的人。

source: The bastard.
target: 那个混蛋。

source: Ah, and have you heard the news regarding King Claudius, my lord?
target: 啊，大人，您听说克劳狄斯国王的消息了吗？

source: He is dead.
target: 他死了。

source: Well, that's certainly news.
target: 嗯，这倒真是个新消息。

source: And what is to become of the throne, then?
target: 那王位又会如何？

source: They whisper that Hamlet shall rule now.
target: 人们私下说，接下来将由哈姆雷特统治。

source: What? That incompetent boy?
target: 什么？那个无能的小子？

source: Not if I can help it.
target: 只要我还能阻止，就绝不会让这事发生。

source: I have heard nothing yet, my lord.
target: 大人，我还没听到任何消息。

source: How can all this have taken place in just two days' time?
target: 怎么可能短短两天就发生了这么多事？

source: I, too, am continually surprised. You Danes are an awfully busy, bloody sort, aren't you.
target: 我也总是感到意外。你们丹麦人可真是忙个不停，血流不止，是不是？

source: Although I don't know you well, I wish you fortune in whatever you may find when you make your return.
target: 虽然我和您不太熟，但无论您回去后会遇上什么，我都祝您好运。

source: And I welcome it. I've really no idea what's happening. I suppose I'll soon find out.
target: 那我就借你吉言了。我真的不知道发生了什么。想必很快就会明白。

source: ... Look at me.
target: ……瞧瞧我。

source: Not half a day back from France and all I can think about is murder. The longer I must linger among awful men...
target: 从法国回来还不到半天，我满脑子就都是杀人的念头。我在这些恶人中待得越久……

source: The closer I grow to them. Well, fine, then. Let it suit my bloody purpose.
target: 就越像他们。好吧，那就这样。就让它帮我达成这染血的目的。

source: It's time. I should have been King. The post was always rightfully mine.
target: 时候到了。我本该成为国王。王位本来就理应属于我。

source: Hamlet's mad, the people always hated Claudius... Who better than myself to rule?
target: 哈姆雷特疯了，人民一直都憎恨克劳狄斯……还有谁比我更适合统治？

source: Time to take what belongs to me.
target: 该夺取属于我的东西了。

source: My lord, a letter arrives from Hamlet by pigeon.
target: 陛下，信鸽送来了一封哈姆雷特的信。

source: H—Hamlet? Good captain, I must have misheard you—surely?
target: 哈——哈姆雷特？队长，我一定是听错了——是吧？

source: Forgive me, my lord, I'm as surprised as you. He ought to be in England by now!
target: 请恕罪，陛下，我和您一样惊讶。他现在应该已经到英格兰了！

source: C-certainly so. What does it say?
target: 当、当然。信里写了什么？

source: It says he's returning to Denmark. And his ship was overtaken by... pirates?
target: 信里说他正在返回丹麦。他的船被……海盗劫了？

source: Not one day at sea and they were beset by pirates?
target: 出海还不到一天，他们就遭遇海盗了？

source: Stranger still, those same pirates are helping him return to Denmark.
target: 更奇怪的是，那伙海盗正在帮他返回丹麦。

source: Pah! This is preposterous! Bernardo, can you believe this?
target: 呸！简直荒唐！贝尔纳多，你能信吗？

source: Knowing Hamlet, I absolutely can, my lord.
target: 陛下，以我对哈姆雷特的了解，我完全相信。

source: The letter goes on to say that Rosencrantz and Guildenstern are dead.
target: 信里接着说，罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞死了。

source: That's a shame.
target: 真遗憾。

source: This is terrible, terrible news...
target: 这消息太糟了，太糟了……

source: Indeed, my lord. I know they were dear friends of Hamlet's.
target: 的确，陛下。我知道她们是哈姆雷特的挚友。

source: No—not that, you idiot! Out with you! Everyone, out!
target: 不——我说的不是这个，你这蠢货！出去！所有人都出去！

source: Indeed, my lord. But perhaps Hamlet will convalesce better at home.
target: 的确，陛下。但也许哈姆雷特在家里能恢复得更好。

source: You have crossed the line. The people hate you, as do I.
target: 你已经越过了底线。人民恨你，我也一样。

source: My ship, delayed by mishap, returned to harbor...
target: 我乘的船因意外耽搁，返回了港口……

source: And the moment I stepped ashore, I learned my father was slain.
target: 我刚一上岸，就得知父亲被杀了。

source: Who else would have arranged his death other than you? You never trusted him—and I knew it to be true.
target: 除了你，还会有谁安排杀害他？你从来就不信任他——这一点我心知肚明。

source: Soon I will rally more men to knock at your gates. It's time for a new King.
target: 很快，我就会召集更多人来叩响你的大门。该换个国王了。

source: Denmark calls out for blood, and the blood of my father must answer!
target: 丹麦呼唤鲜血，我父亲的血脉必须回应！

source: Wait! This is about your father?
target: 等等！你是为了你父亲的事？

source: My father's death is on your head. Murdering the man who trusted and defended you most? That's sick, Claudius.
target: 我父亲的死，你要负责。你竟然杀害了最信任你、最维护你的人？克劳狄斯，你真令人作呕。

source: W-wait! Don't act just yet! You must know the truth!
target: 等、等等！先别动手！你必须知道真相！

source: The truth? Spit it out.
target: 真相？快说。

source: Hamlet killed my father due to your negligence. You noticed the signs of his madness. We all did.
target: 是你的疏忽，才让哈姆雷特杀了我父亲。你看出了他发疯的征兆。我们都看出来了。

source: And yet you sent him, a dog unchained, to run in my father's path and bite him. You might as well have laid the killing blow!
target: 可你还是放他这条脱了锁链的狗去拦住我父亲，撕咬他。这和你亲手杀了他有什么区别！

source: I never laid a hand on your father. It was Hamlet who killed him, of his own volition.
target: 我从未对你父亲动过手。是哈姆雷特杀了他，完全出于他自己的意愿。

source: And you had no indirect involvement?
target: 你也没有间接参与？

source: No. None whatsoever.
target: 没有。完全没有。

source: If you want proof, ask Hamlet himself!
target: 你要是想求证，就去问哈姆雷特本人！

source: How could Hamlet have acted alone?
target: 哈姆雷特怎么可能独自做出这种事？

source: Had something changed in him?
target: 他发生了什么变化吗？

source: (Of course, I know all this is true already.)
target: （当然，我早就知道这一切都是真的。）

source: (But Hamlet's grief is as deep as mine. He regrets what he did.)
target: （但哈姆雷特的悲痛和我一样深。他后悔自己做过的事。）

source: (Still, I must act as though I am true to Claudius.)
target: （不过，我必须装作忠于克劳狄斯。）

source: Laertes. Listen, boy. I had no hand in your father's death.
target: 雷欧提斯。听着，孩子。你父亲的死与我无关。

source: Hamlet intended to kill him and struck the killing blow. I wasn't even present for your father's death... much to my regret.
target: 哈姆雷特有意杀他，也下了致命的一击。你父亲死的时候，我甚至不在场……这让我深感遗憾。

source: I will forever wish I could have saved him. He was a fine advisor, the best I ever saw in Denmark.
target: 我会永远希望自己当时能救下他。他是位出色的顾问，是我在丹麦见过最好的。

source: Hamlet isn't here to answer for the truth of your word, Claudius.
target: 克劳狄斯，哈姆雷特不在这里，没法证实你的话是真是假。

source: He returns to Denmark anon. We've received word of his return. Patience, Laertes. Patience is a true virtue for a man of your age.
target: 他很快就会回到丹麦。我们已经收到了他要回来的消息。耐心些，雷欧提斯。对你这个年纪的人来说，耐心确实是一种美德。

source: Ask anyone in Elsinore, and they shall tell you the truth of what happened that night.
target: 你去问埃尔西诺的任何一个人，他们都会告诉你那晚发生的真相。

source: If you receive any other answer, then you may rally against me. But you won't. Patience is a true virtue for a man of your age, you know.
target: 如果你听到了不同的答案，到时你大可以召集人来反对我。但你不会听到的。要知道，对你这个年纪的人来说，耐心确实是一种美德。

source: Be patient, and it will richly reward you. Of that, I am certain.
target: 耐心些，它会给你丰厚的回报。这一点，我确信无疑。

source: Let me help you achieve your goals, Laertes. They are mine, too.
target: 让我帮你达成目标，雷欧提斯。那也是我的目标。

source: How can I trust you? You're his uncle. What's to stop you from lying to me?
target: 我怎么能信你？你是他的叔叔。谁能保证你不会骗我？

source: I'll give you the very weapon to gut him with.
target: 我会给你一把武器，让你剖开他的肚子。

source: I had poison I could dip the blade in—only a single nick would have been needed to rid him.
target: 我原本有毒药，可以涂在剑刃上——只要划破一点皮，就能除掉他。

source: It has been... misplaced.
target: 只是现在……找不着了。

source: But you are unparalleled as a swordsman. Your skill is demonstrable. You will prevail.
target: 但你的剑术无人能及。你的本领有目共睹。你会赢的。

source: I have in my chambers a certain... set of tools, poison amongst the most useful.
target: 我寝宫里有一套……工具，其中最有用的就有毒药。

source: I shall apply it to one of my sharpest blades. All you need do is nick him a single time and he'll be dead for good.
target: 我会把它涂在我最锋利的一把剑上。你只需划伤他一次，他就会彻底死去。

source: Barring that, I'll lay a few drops upon the rim of a wine goblet. If the duel comes to a draw, I'll offer the wine to him as a blessing.
target: 若是这招不成，我还会在酒杯边缘滴上几滴。如果决斗打成平手，我就把那杯酒送给他，以表祝福。

source: Our two problems, intertwined, solved all at once.
target: 我们两个纠缠在一起的难题，就能一并解决了。

source: (My word to Hamlet, that is. Your hourglass trickles down, Claudius.)
target: （我是说，我对哈姆雷特的承诺。克劳狄斯，你的沙漏正在一点点流尽。）

source: I will await this blade, Claudius. Make good on your word, and I'll make good on mine.
target: 我会等着这把剑，克劳狄斯。你兑现你的承诺，我就兑现我的。

source: Everyone left rather hastily, it seems.
target: 看来大家都走得很匆忙。

source: I ought to go find out where the others went.
target: 我该去看看其他人都去哪儿了。

source: Ah, but it's about the hour when last time...
target: 啊，可现在差不多就是上次那个时候……

source: Well, there's no use in crying out. I won't be heard.
target: 唉，喊也没用。没人会听见。

source: Wish they wouldn't all turn heel on a moment's notice.
target: 真希望他们别一有动静就全都转身走了。

source: Who's there?
target: 谁在那里？

source: I am sorry for what I must do.
target: 对于我必须做的事，我很抱歉。

source: W-who are you?
target: 你、你是谁？

source: For whatever little it's worth, you are innocent of this matter.
target: 虽然这句话没什么用，但在这件事里，你是无辜的。

source: Denmark as it stands now must fall. It must fall. And you are the lamb whose blood must be spilled.
target: 如今的丹麦必须倒下。它必须倒下。而你就是那只必须流血的羔羊。

source: So you're the spy the King warned about. You are real.
target: 原来你就是国王警告过的间谍。你真的存在。

source: The King is so abjectly useless, he cannot even whiff out an enemy in his own court.
target: 国王实在无能透顶，连自己宫廷里的敌人都察觉不到。

source: The King is so abjectly useless, he cannot even whiff out a spy in his own court.
target: 国王实在无能透顶，连自己宫廷里的间谍都察觉不到。

source: Y-you've been spying on us? On me? What do you intend to do?
target: 你、你一直在监视我们？监视我？你想做什么？

source: But it has fallen. Claudius is dead. What more could my death offer?
target: 可它已经倒下了。克劳狄斯已经死了。我死了还能有什么用？

source: Your continued existence, by its very nature, poses a threat to long-laid plans.
target: 只要你还活着，你的存在本身就会威胁到筹划已久的计划。

source: I didn't want to hurt you. Not really.
target: 我并不想伤害你。那并非我的本意。

source: They'll never know about this, of course. They'll think you drowned in the end, the louts.
target: 当然，他们永远不会知道这件事。那些蠢货，到头来只会以为你是淹死的。

source: I feel my body growing cold.
target: 我感觉身体渐渐变冷了。

source: I've got a feeling I'm about to be 'accosted' again.
target: 我有种感觉，我又要被人“找麻烦”了。

source: Stay your hand a moment. I need to talk to you.
target: 先别动手。我有话要对你说。

source: Who are you? Why are you doing this? What do you want?
target: 你是谁？你为什么要这么做？你想要什么？

source: I'm sorry.
target: 对不起。

source: Denmark must fall. It must fall. And you are the lamb whose blood must be spilled.
target: 丹麦必须倒下。它必须倒下。而你就是那只必须流血的羔羊。

source: How does my death play into Denmark's fall? I am no one to you.
target: 我的死跟丹麦倒下有什么关系？对你来说，我什么都不是。

source: To me, you are nothing. But you are an important person to important people. And that makes you useful.
target: 对我来说，你确实什么都不是。但对一些重要人物来说，你很重要。所以你有用。

source: (I failed to stop it again.)
target: （我又没能阻止这件事。）

source: Help! Someone, please—
target: 救命！来人啊，求求你们——

source: Fine. Do what you will. But I will find you, and uncover your crime. This will end.
target: 好吧。随你怎么做。但我一定会找到你，揭露你的罪行。这一切一定会结束。

source: Do it quickly.
target: 快点动手。

source: A piece in someone's larger schemes.
target: 某个人更大阴谋中的一枚棋子。

source: Lady Brit.
target: 布莉特女士。

source: I knew it. You may kill me now, but I know everything I need to know.
target: 我就知道。你现在可以杀了我，但我需要知道的事，我已经全都知道了。

source: Just wait. I know I'll succeed in stopping you.
target: 等着吧。我知道我一定能阻止你。

source: Shut up! Just--die! I have to do this!
target: 闭嘴！你就——去死吧！我必须这么做！

source: A piece in her larger schemes.
target: 她更大阴谋中的一枚棋子。

source: Ah. Ophelia. Convenient to run into you.
target: 啊，奥菲莉娅。正好碰到你。

source: Where are you off to?
target: 你要去哪儿？

source: Hamlet's returned, against all odds. He sent word to me to meet him. He did ask for you, too.
target: 哈姆雷特竟然回来了。他捎信让我去见他。他也说了想见你。

source: Though I wasn't certain I'd find you, or that you'd want to see him even if I did.
target: 不过，我不确定能不能找到你，就算找到了，也不确定你愿不愿意见他。

source: He's not in England?
target: 他不在英格兰？

source: Something's gone horribly wrong, though I know not what.
target: 一定是出了什么严重的变故，但我还不知道是什么。

source: Heed Hamlet's request?
target: 答应哈姆雷特的请求？

source: No, Horatio. You meet him alone. I'll not go.
target: 不，霍拉旭。你自己去见他吧。我不去。

source: For better or for worse, I have returned.
target: 不管是好是坏，我回来了。

source: Of course, I trust things have fared excellently in my absence.
target: 当然，我相信我不在的时候，一切都顺利极了。

source: It's certainly been... quiet, if nothing else. A little too still.
target: 别的不说，确实很……安静。有点太安静了。

source: Good. Things are about to awaken once more.
target: 很好。很快又要热闹起来了。

source: My dear uncle wants me murdered, just as he did my father.
target: 我亲爱的叔叔想谋杀我，就像他杀害我父亲那样。

source: I beg your pardon?
target: 你说什么？

source: I uncovered his treachery nearly the moment we set sail. I had a sneaking feeling something was amiss.
target: 我们几乎刚起航，我就发现了他的阴谋。我隐隐觉得有些不对劲。

source: He sent a note along with Rosencrantz and Guildenstern to the Queen of England, ordering her to hang me upon arrival.
target: 他让罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞带了封信给英格兰女王，命令她在我抵达时把我绞死。

source: F-for what reason?
target: 为、为什么？

source: In the interest of 'betterment' of our two nations' friendship, or some sort of rubbish of that nature.
target: 为了“增进”两国的友谊，或者诸如此类的鬼话。

source: I must believe Rosencrantz and Guildenstern intended to bear this letter to England and carry out these orders at my uncle's behest.
target: 我不得不相信，罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞本打算遵照我叔叔的吩咐，把这封信带到英格兰，执行这些命令。

source: I thought them my friends. More the fool am I.
target: 我还以为她们是我的朋友。真是我太蠢了。

source: Nevertheless, they're all outhanded. I changed the letter to order them killed instead.
target: 不过，他们都被我摆了一道。我改了信，命令他们杀掉送信的人。

source: But how? Certainly it bore the King's seal?
target: 可你是怎么做到的？信上肯定盖着国王的印章吧？

source: I still have my father's signet ring. It was simple. Alarmingly so.
target: 我还留着父亲的印章戒指。这事很简单。简单得让人心惊。

source: ...Then we were besieged by pirates just outside the sound—and they took me as their hostage.
target: ……然后，我们刚出海峡就被海盗围攻了——他们把我抓去当了人质。

source: ...Pirates? Surely you cannot be serious.
target: ……海盗？你不会是认真的吧。

source: Extraordinarily serious, Horatio.
target: 再认真不过了，霍拉旭。

source: Once they learned my identity, I promised to send them a good fortune and safe harbor if they deposited me here. And so they have.
target: 他们得知我的身份后，我答应，只要把我送到这里，我就给他们一大笔钱，还给他们一个安全的港口。他们就这么做了。

source: So Rosie and Guil are—dead?
target: 这么说，罗茜和吉尔——死了？

source: If not now, then when they reach England. They'll perish then. Just as they wanted for me.
target: 就算现在没死，到了英格兰也会死。她们到时就会丧命。正如她们希望我遭遇的那样。

source: Horatio—with all that's happening—who doesn't want me dead? Who can I trust?
target: 霍拉旭——出了这么多事——还有谁不想让我死？我还能相信谁？

source: Me, your lordship.
target: 我，殿下。

source: Of that I have no doubt. And Ophelia has made her hatred towards me quite clear.
target: 这一点我毫不怀疑。而奥菲莉娅也已经把对我的恨意表露得很清楚了。

source: In that way, she's safe as well. Better a former paramour turned sour than one whose alignment is ambiguous.
target: 这样一来，她也可以放心。与其面对一个立场不明的人，倒不如面对一个由爱生恨的旧情人。

source: That's why I summoned you both, to make you aware that my return to Denmark is one great intent.
target: 所以我把你们两个叫来，就是要让你们知道，我回丹麦只为一个重大目的。

source: In my heart there's been a kind of fighting that won't let me sleep.
target: 我心里一直有一场争斗，让我无法入睡。

source: I shall no longer hesitate in bringing down my uncle.
target: 我要扳倒叔父，不再犹豫。

source: He that killed my King and whored my mother, popping between the election and my hopes...
target: 他杀了我的国王，玷污了我的母亲，又在王位选举中横插一脚，夺走了我的希望……

source: I cannot let this canker of our nature come to further evil.
target: 我不能让这个败坏人性的毒瘤继续作恶。

source: H-Hamlet, you know, Laertes has a standing challenge to duel you. I believe the King is behind it somehow.
target: 哈、哈姆雷特，你知道，雷欧提斯向你发出的决斗挑战还算数。我觉得国王在背后也有所牵涉。

source: Of course, Horatio. And of course, I cannot refuse, as they both well know. It is intended to murder me, not to out any honor of mine.
target: 当然，霍拉旭。而我当然也无法拒绝，他们两个都很清楚。这是为了谋杀我，不是为了证明我有什么荣誉可言。

source: Divinity shapes our ends. So be it, friends. We'll duel.
target: 神意决定我们的结局。那就这样吧，朋友们。我们就决斗。

source: Is this a skull...?
target: 这是个头骨……？

source: My lord, you mustn't touch that, I can't imagine how filthy it—er—
target: 殿下，您不能碰那个，我都不敢想它有多脏——呃——

source: I recognize him! Yorick!
target: 我认出他了！约里克！

source: I knew him, Horatio. A fellow of infinite jest. When I was a boy, he used to give me rides on his back.
target: 我认识他，霍拉旭。他有说不完的笑话。我小时候，他常让我骑在他背上。

source: And now he's dead. His flesh is rotten.
target: 可现在他死了。他的血肉已经腐烂。

source: Hamlet, please. Let me take that from you.
target: 哈姆雷特，求你了。把那个交给我吧。

source: Hamlet, you son of a bitch.
target: 哈姆雷特，你这个狗娘养的。

source: Where is my father's body? What have you done with it?
target: 我父亲的遗体在哪儿？你把它怎么了？

source: Certainly I am much too mad to know... hee hee.
target: 我当然是疯得太厉害，什么也不知道了……嘻嘻。

source: I hate you, Hamlet. I've always hated you.
target: 我恨你，哈姆雷特。我一直都恨你。

source: Well, at least Yorick liked me. Tit for tat.
target: 好吧，至少约里克喜欢我。一报还一报。

source: ...You're not making any sense.
target: ……你说的话完全不知所云。

source: You've ruined my father's honor and stolen my sister's happiness. Hamlet, stand up to me like a man.
target: 你毁了我父亲的名誉，夺走了我妹妹的幸福。哈姆雷特，像个男人一样面对我。

source: A man! Is that what I am?
target: 男人！原来我是个男人吗？

source: Very well. What do I care if I live or not?
target: 好吧。我还在乎自己是死是活吗？

source: A duel. You. At 11 sharp. We'll settle this for good.
target: 决斗。你和我。十一点整。我们彻底做个了断。

source: All right. I'm here.
target: 好了。我来了。

source: You're late.
target: 你迟到了。

source: Take Laertes' hand, as gentlemen do.
target: 和雷欧提斯握手，要有绅士风度。

source: (Shall we improvise?)
target: （我们即兴发挥？）

source: (He cannot know anything is amiss. Play your part.)
target: （不能让他察觉任何不对劲。演好你的角色。）

source: My lord, a moment, please. There is a point which must be made. I've wronged you most grievously.
target: 阁下，请稍等。有件事必须说清楚。我曾深深地伤害了你。

source: All the wrong I've done you lately—all the insult I've borne you—it was madness. I've not been in my right mind.
target: 我最近对你做的所有错事——对你的所有侮辱——都是疯病所致。我一直神志不清。

source: Listen. I'm sorry for all of it. Or rather, my madness itself can offer an apology. And if I'm truly as mad as everyone says I am...
target: 听我说。这一切，我都很抱歉。或者说，该由我的疯病来道歉。如果我真的像大家说的那样疯了……

source: No. I won't use that as an excuse. I killed a man. I did something I can never take back. And for that, no apology is enough.
target: 不。我不会拿这个当借口。我杀了一个人。我做了一件永远无法挽回的事。对此，任何道歉都不够。

source: Is this remorse? From Hamlet? I can hardly believe what I'm hearing, truth be told.
target: 这是在悔过？哈姆雷特在悔过？说实话，我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

source: Laertes, we've fought forever. And none of it ever came to anything useful or good. I've been a fool for so long.
target: 雷欧提斯，我们一直争斗不休。可从来没争出过什么有用的、好的结果。我当傻瓜当得太久了。

source: We share a brotherly bond in some ways. We've fought like siblings. And I'm... I miss your father. I loved him, though I was poor at showing it.
target: 从某些方面来说，我们之间有兄弟般的情谊。我们也像兄弟一样争吵。而我……我想念你的父亲。我爱他，只是不善于表达。

source: You mean, even though you murdered him.
target: 你是说，尽管你谋杀了他。

source: No. I understand. I accept your apology, Hamlet. But something must be done to preserve my honor here. You understand.
target: 不。我明白。我接受你的道歉，哈姆雷特。但在这里，我必须做点什么来维护自己的荣誉。你明白的。

source: We can't call the whole thing off. We've done the work to gather everyone here. We need some sort of show, don't we?
target: 我们不能把整件事都取消。好不容易把大家聚到这里，总得给他们点什么看吧？

source: Come, now. Let's skirmish like we did as children. One final time before our final peace.
target: 来吧。像小时候那样比划比划。最后打一回，然后彻底和好。

source: I like the sound of that.
target: 这话我爱听。

source: My lord Claudius, this blade is too heavy, methinks. I'll need another.
target: 克劳狄斯陛下，我觉得这把剑太重了。我得换一把。

source: Of course. Kubilius, will you hand him mine?
target: 当然。库比利乌斯，把我的递给他，好吗？

source: (And I'll prepare a fitting draught, should Hamlet's thirst run strong...)
target: （我也准备一杯合适的酒，以防哈姆雷特渴得厉害……）

source: Now. On the third count.
target: 好了。数到三就开始。

source: This is exhausting to watch. I need a drink.
target: 看得我都累了。我得喝一杯。

source: This isn't going to end well. I can feel it.
target: 这不会有什么好结果。我能感觉到。

source: I'm sure Hamlet won't mind if I sip from his goblet.
target: 我用哈姆雷特的酒杯喝一口，他肯定不会介意。

source: I'm sure Hamlet won't mind if I sip from his—
target: 我喝一口，哈姆雷特肯定不会介意，用他的——

source: Ahh. Cool wine on a summer day. Something wrong, my love?
target: 啊。夏日里的一杯凉酒。怎么了，亲爱的？

source: O-oh—I feel unwell.
target: 哦、哦——我不太舒服。

source: Please, my son. Caution!
target: 求你了，儿子。小心！

source: En garde, Hamlet.
target: 准备接招，哈姆雷特。

source: Touché, Laertes.
target: 你刺中了，雷欧提斯。

source: Ngh. Likewise.
target: 唔。你也一样。

source: And I made a mark with your own blade, at that! Maybe I'm not half so awful a swordsman as I thought...
target: 而且我还是用你自己的剑刺中的！也许我的剑术没自己想的那么糟……

source: (How did he nick me? T-that's the poisoned one!)
target: （他怎么划伤我的？那、那把剑上有毒！）

source: (Ergh. He's been practicing.)
target: （呃。他一直在练习。）

source: I submit, my lord.
target: 我认输，殿下。

source: My love, a-are you—look at me—are you all right?
target: 亲爱的，你、你——看着我——你还好吗？

source: The... grrgh... the drink...
target: 那……呃啊……那杯酒……

source: The drink is—poisoned. Hamlet, poison—
target: 酒里——有毒。哈姆雷特，有毒——

source: Guards, one of you help my lady, immediately!
target: 卫兵，来个人帮帮王后，快！

source: Although if it is poison, we're too late.
target: 不过，如果真是毒药，我们已经来不及了。

source: W-what? What villainy is this?
target: 什、什么？这是什么阴谋？

source: Mother... She's turning pale...
target: 母亲……她的脸越来越苍白了……

source: No, no, no-- this cannot be! It cannot be real, can it?
target: 不，不，不——这不可能！这不会是真的，对吧？

source: Who would have done something like this? Whoever it is, I'll kill them!
target: 谁会干出这种事？不管是谁，我都要杀了他！

source: Gertrude's dead? It all happened so fast.
target: 乔特鲁德死了？这一切来得太快了。

source: You may not submit.
target: 不准认输。

source: Play on until this fated duel has run its course.
target: 继续打，直到这场命中注定的决斗结束。

source: It was me, Hamlet.
target: 是我干的，哈姆雷特。

source: The blade was poisoned from the start of our duel. There's not half an hour of life left in you.
target: 从决斗一开始，剑上就涂了毒。你剩下的命还不到半小时。

source: No medicine in the world can do either of us good now. Or her, for that matter.
target: 现在，世上任何药都救不了我们两个。也救不了她。

source: No medicine in the world can do either of us good now.
target: 现在，世上任何药都救不了我们两个。

source: We're all dead. And the King is to blame. It's all useless now.
target: 我们都死定了。都怪国王。现在一切都没用了。

source: I'm sorry to you. And to you, Ophelia. I... guess I won't be... able to take Father's place for you after all.
target: 我对不起你。也对不起你，奥菲莉娅。我……想，我终究还是……没法代替父亲照顾你了。

source: I wish when the King told me his plans, I had come to my senses.
target: 要是国王告诉我他的计划时，我能清醒过来就好了。

source: Then it's too late for the both of us. But not too late to make things right.
target: 那么，我们两个已经没救了。但要纠正这一切，还来得及。

source: You did this.
target: 这一切都是你干的。

source: H-Hamlet, be reasonable—
target: 哈、哈姆雷特，理智一点——

source: No. You've taken my father, my mother, my crown, and soon my life from me.
target: 不。你夺走了我的父亲、母亲、王冠，很快还会夺走我的命。

source: No. You've taken my father, my crown, and soon my life from me.
target: 不。你夺走了我的父亲、王冠，很快还会夺走我的命。

source: You murdered my father in cold blood. I heard you confess it yourself.
target: 你冷血地谋杀了我的父亲。我亲耳听见你承认。

source: You've stolen everything I've ever loved in this life. You've robbed me of my ability to feel joy, to want anything good.
target: 你夺走了我这一生所爱的一切。你让我再也无法感受快乐，无法渴望任何美好的事物。

source: But I'm not dead yet, Claudius. There's still time for one last thing. Venom, do your work.
target: 但我还没死，克劳狄斯。我还来得及做最后一件事。毒药，发挥你的效力吧。

source: Then come and destroy me, Hamlet. You've always wanted this.
target: 那就来毁了我吧，哈姆雷特。你一直都想这么做。

source: No. You're being manipulated.
target: 不。你在被人操纵。

source: By him. He's the one who ought to pay for his crimes.
target: 被他操纵。该为罪行付出代价的是他。

source: You did this, Claudius.
target: 这一切都是你干的，克劳狄斯。

source: But I'm not dead yet, Claudius. There's still time to do one last thing.
target: 但我还没死，克劳狄斯。我还来得及做最后一件事。

source: Now's our chance, Hamlet. Take back the crown.
target: 现在就是我们的机会，哈姆雷特。夺回王冠。

source: ...At last.
target: ……终于。

source: Soon, my father can finally rest.
target: 很快，我父亲终于可以安息了。

source: Uncle... it's time to atone for your sins.
target: 叔父……该为你的罪行赎罪了。

source: Venom, to thy work.
target: 毒药，发挥你的效力吧。

source: Help! Help, guards, he's run me through, but I--I--augh...
target: 救命！救命，卫兵，他刺穿了我，可我——我——啊……

source: He's justly served. Hamlet, listen...
target: 他罪有应得。哈姆雷特，听我说……

source: My father's death wasn't your fault. Nor mine. I want you to—ngh—to know that.
target: 我父亲的死不是你的错。我的死也不是。我想让你——唔——知道这一点。

source: And Ophelia-- you know-- I-- it--
target: 还有，奥菲莉娅——你知道——我——这——

source: I know. I love you, Laertes.
target: 我知道。我爱你，雷欧提斯。

source: How did this happen?
target: 怎么会变成这样？

source: Listen, Horatio. There isn't much time, old friend.
target: 听我说，霍拉旭。时间不多了，老朋友。

source: You have to survive. Tell everyone what happened here.
target: 你一定要活下去。把这里发生的事告诉所有人。

source: I don't think I can, Hamlet. I'm more an antique Roman than a Dane. I'd rather die with my captain.
target: 我想我做不到，哈姆雷特。比起丹麦人，我更像个古罗马人。我宁愿和我的统帅一起死。

source: The wine... there's still some poison left. Let me be with you.
target: 那杯酒……还剩下一些毒。让我陪着你吧。

source: That blade... there's still some poison left. Let me be with you.
target: 那把剑……上面还留着一些毒。让我陪着你吧。

source: Don't you dare. If you ever loved me, Horatio, as I do you...
target: 你敢。霍拉旭，如果你曾爱过我，像我爱你一样……

source: Then you'll have to wait to join me. And I hope it's years. Long, happy years.
target: 那你就得等一等，再来陪我。我希望那是多年以后。漫长而幸福的岁月之后。

source: I need you to tell the story of what we went through. Don't let all this be in vain.
target: 我需要你把我们的经历讲出来。别让这一切付诸东流。

source: And... Fortinbras... I can hear his men approaching now...
target: 还有……福丁布拉斯……我听见他的人正在接近……

source: The election lights on him. He'll be King. I believe it in my heart. The rest is silence.
target: 王位选举会选中他。他会成为国王。我心里坚信这一点。余下的，只有沉默。

source: ...He's fainted.
target: ……他昏过去了。

source: Fools. All of them.
target: 蠢货。全都是。

source: Perhaps he played his part a little too well.
target: 也许他演得有点太好了。

source: Claudius... He's dead!
target: 克劳狄斯……他死了！

source: The time has come, Mother. Peace has come to Elsinore.
target: 时候到了，母亲。埃尔西诺迎来了和平。

source: Mother. I'm sorry.
target: 母亲。对不起。

source: Excellent. Excellent. Watch your footing, Laertes.
target: 很好。很好。注意脚步，雷欧提斯。

source: (At this rate, I may not need this goblet at all.)
target: （照这样下去，我可能根本用不着这杯酒。）

source: (One way or another, this will come to an end soon.)
target: （无论如何，这一切很快就会结束。）

source: Get on with it!
target: 快继续！

source: If you insist.
target: 既然你坚持。

source: The castle clock just struck midnight.
target: 城堡的钟刚刚敲过午夜。

source: Did I survive? Is it over?
target: 我活下来了吗？结束了吗？

source: I don't hear anything. Perhaps the invasion was turned away.
target: 我什么也没听见。也许入侵被击退了。

source: Maybe it's done. Maybe I've ended the loop for good...
target: 也许结束了。也许我已经彻底终结了循环……

source: Oh-- my head hurts--
target: 哦——我的头好疼——

source: Pulled back through time.
target: 被拉回了过去。

source: Ergh—here it comes—
target: 呃——又来了——

source: What was that?
target: 那是什么？

source: It came from the Great Hall.
target: 是从大厅传来的。

source: I hear a commotion. The castle's being stormed again.
target: 我听见一阵骚动。城堡又遭到强攻了。

source: It's just outside the doors of the hall.
target: 就在大厅门外。

source: For those of you who have not made Our acquaintance: We are Prince Fortinbras of Norway.
target: 还不认识本王的人听好了：本王是挪威的福丁布拉斯王子。

source: Now, stand down, Denmark. The day is won before you have carried forth.
target: 现在，丹麦人，放下武器。你们还没出手，胜负就已经定了。

source: After all, it seems your new King met with an unfortunate fate.
target: 毕竟，你们的新国王似乎遭遇了不幸。

source: You mean-- Hamlet?
target: 你是说——哈姆雷特？

source: He could have accepted Our offer of peace and unity.
target: 他本可以接受本王提出的和平与联合。

source: Instead, warlike as he was, he insisted on attempting to match Us. And he lost.
target: 可他生性好战，执意要与本王较量。结果，他输了。

source: (Hamlet. You idiot. I knew it would come to this.)
target: （哈姆雷特。你这个傻瓜。我早就知道会变成这样。）

source: (You were so close to being the man your country needed.)
target: （你就差一点，就能成为你的国家需要的人了。）

source: Prince Fortinbras? What are you doing here? We had an agreement.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子？你来这里干什么？我们有过协议。

source: Unfortunately for you, your own country's nobility made a far better one.
target: 对你来说很不幸，你本国的贵族提出了一份好得多的协议。

source: Prince Fortinbras. I liked you better in our dungeon.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子。我还是更喜欢你待在我们地牢里的样子。

source: No one must die, Claudius.
target: 谁都不必死，克劳狄斯。

source: Declare your fealty to Us, and We will leave you with some small status. We are not a savage ruler.
target: 宣誓效忠本王，本王就给你留一点地位。本王不是野蛮的统治者。

source: Declare fealty to you? A boy no older than my nephew?
target: 向你宣誓效忠？你这小子，年纪还没我侄子大？

source: I wrested this throne to my hand on the labors of my own sweat and ambition. I will hand it to no one!
target: 我凭自己的汗水和野心，费尽心力才把这王位夺到手。我绝不会把它交给任何人！

source: My lady, you are his wife. As I understand it, you are beloved by your people. Can you speak no sense to him?
target: 王后，您是他的妻子。据我所知，您深受人民爱戴。您就不能劝他明白事理吗？

source: You speak to me so kindly, but assume I will be pliant to you. So long as my husband lives, Denmark is ours. I will die to keep it so.
target: 你对我说话这么客气，却以为我会顺从你。只要我丈夫还活着，丹麦就属于我们。为守住这一点，我愿意死。

source: Very well. You sign your own death warrants. So be it.
target: 好吧。你们亲手签下了自己的死刑令。那就如此吧。

source: Men, to arms.
target: 士兵们，拿起武器。

source: Prince Hamlet. Perhaps you will prove yourself wiser. Wise enough, perhaps, to submit peacefully.
target: 哈姆雷特王子。也许你会更明智一些。也许明智到愿意和平归顺。

source: Stand down?
target: 放下武器？

source: Your father killed Our father. Now, young Prince, what's yours must return to Our hands.
target: 你的父亲杀了本王的父亲。现在，年轻的王子，你所拥有的一切必须回到本王手中。

source: But this need not be a bloody coup.
target: 但这场夺权不必血流成河。

source: No one must die. Surrender peacefully, and you will be permitted to sit the throne.
target: 谁都不必死。和平投降，本王就允许你坐上王位。

source: So long, of course, as you swear your undying fealty to Ours and to Norway.
target: 当然，前提是你宣誓永远效忠本王和挪威。

source: As the Queen of this castle, I now represent its interests and rule.
target: 作为这座城堡的王后，现在由我代表这里的利益，行使统治权。

source: We will submit to you.
target: 我们愿意向你归顺。

source: With my husband and son gone, I see little other choice which preserves the life that remains here.
target: 我的丈夫和儿子都已离世，我看不出还有什么别的选择，能保住这里剩下的人命。

source: My queen, we can't simply roll over!
target: 王后，我们不能就这么屈服！

source: Please, Laertes, still your tongue. I have seen enough loss.
target: 求你了，雷欧提斯，别再说了。我已经失去太多了。

source: But why?
target: 可为什么？

source: All that was once good has gone from this world.
target: 曾经美好的一切，都已离开这个世界。

source: What do I care who wears the silly golden crown?
target: 谁戴上那顶可笑的金王冠，又与我何干？

source: Burn Elsinore to the ground if you so desire. I care not a whit. No more death. Please.
target: 你若想把埃尔西诺烧成平地，就烧吧。我一点也不在乎。别再有人死了。求你。
