source: We are glad to hear it. Let the terms of surrender be drawn immediately.
target: 我们很高兴听到这句话。立刻拟定投降条款。

source: Men, We must take to Our war camp to determine the bounds of victory.
target: 将士们，我们必须回军营，确定此次胜利所带来的权益。

source: Who are you to march in here and demand the throne for yourself?
target: 你凭什么闯进这里，要求把王位交给你？

source: We'll never give Denmark over to you. Not while I'm still living.
target: 我们绝不会把丹麦交给你。只要我还活着，就绝不可能。

source: Where are those of royal blood who would rise to meet me?
target: 那些身负王室血统、愿意站出来迎战我的人在哪里？

source: All dead.
target: 全都死了。

source: ...We see.
target: ……我们明白了。

source: So the true royal line has ended.
target: 这么说，真正的王室血脉已经断绝了。

source: I and my sister remain! Both of us are willing candidates to the throne!
target: 我和我妹妹还在！我们两个都愿意继承王位！

source: You are Laertes? This hot-tempered young rebel?
target: 你就是雷欧提斯？这个脾气暴躁的年轻叛逆者？

source: I am. And I am proud. If you expected us to merely roll over, you'd be wrong.
target: 没错。而且我为此自豪。你要是以为我们会乖乖屈服，那就错了。

source: Then you force my hand. Men, to arms.
target: 那是你逼我动手的。将士们，拿起武器。

source: Better to eradicate this line than to regrow it from an inferior branch.
target: 与其让这支血脉从低劣的旁支重新延续，不如将它彻底根除。

source: Laertes! No—
target: 雷欧提斯！不要——

source: Ugh. You fool.
target: 唉。你这个傻瓜。

source: What is this sight?
target: 眼前这是什么景象？

source: What is it you were looking for?
target: 你原本在寻找什么？

source: If it was woe or wonder, cease your search.
target: 若是悲苦或奇事，就不必再找了。

source: Oh, proud Death.
target: 啊，骄傲的死神。

source: What feast have you prepared that caused you to strike so many lives at once?
target: 你筹备了怎样的盛宴，竟要一次夺去这么多条性命？

source: A bloody question. You've arrived from conquering Poland. And now you're here to conquer us.
target: 这是个血淋淋的问题。你刚征服波兰，便来到这里。如今又要征服我们。

source: So I'll tell you how these things came about.
target: 那我就告诉你，这一切是如何发生的。

source: These carnal, bloody, unnatural acts...
target: 这些淫欲、血腥、违背人伦的行径……

source: These accidental judgements, casual slaughters...
target: 这些意外的惩罚，偶然的杀戮……

source: These deaths put on by cunning and forced cause.
target: 这些由诡计和逼迫造成的死亡。

source: Let us hasten to hear it, then.
target: 那就让我们尽快听听吧。

source: Soon enough. He-- Hamlet-- from my mouth, his voice shall speak. He... wished you to lead.
target: 很快就会说的。他——哈姆雷特——我会代他说出他的心声。他……希望由你来领导。

source: Soon enough. He-- Hamlet-- from my mouth, his voice shall speak.
target: 很快就会说的。他——哈姆雷特——我会代他说出他的心声。

source: It is written upon your face that you loved him a great deal.
target: 你的脸上写得很清楚，你深爱着他。

source: With sorrow, We embrace this fortune. Let four captains bear Hamlet to his funeral.
target: 我们怀着悲痛，接受这份机缘。让四位军官抬着哈姆雷特，为他送葬。

source: He would have proved to be a magnificent King.
target: 他本会成为一位出色的国王。

source: Such violence that none of noble blood even remain to tell the tale.
target: 如此惨烈，竟连一个贵族都没留下，讲述这一切。

source: Carnage without cause. Senseless, cruel, childish.
target: 毫无缘由的屠杀。荒唐、残忍、幼稚。

source: All of you have suffered greatly.
target: 你们所有人都受了太多苦。

source: We will bring a new era of peace to this land. The people of Denmark have been punished as of late with the curse of a mad, warlike hunger.
target: 我们将为这片土地带来一个和平的新时代。近来，丹麦人民饱受一种疯狂、好战的欲望所带来的诅咒与折磨。

source: Kept under the thumb of a man too focused within to notice the siege without.
target: 他们被一个男人牢牢掌控，而他只顾着内部的事，对外面的围攻浑然不觉。

source: Now is the time for Denmark's new glory.
target: 现在，是丹麦迎来新荣耀的时候了。

source: A sight like this befits the battlefield, but here shows much amiss.
target: 这样的景象出现在战场上尚属寻常，出现在这里，却说明出了太多差错。

source: Out of respect for all this land has suffered...
target: 为悼念这片土地所遭受的一切苦难……

source: Go. Bid the soldiers shoot.
target: 去吧。命士兵鸣枪。

source: If you had proposed this choice to me not three days prior, I'd have sworn never to serve you.
target: 若你在不到三天前让我做这个选择，我一定会发誓，绝不为你效力。

source: Until my uncle's death, I gave no thought to matters of state, nor to Denmark as a whole.
target: 在叔父死前，我从未考虑过国事，也从未考虑过整个丹麦。

source: But I've received some dear advice in that time.
target: 但这段时间里，我得到了一些宝贵的劝告。

source: And it has cleared the cobwebs from my eyes.
target: 它让我看清了眼前的一切。

source: The Prince is right. No one else is going to die today.
target: 王子说得对。今天不会再有人死了。

source: You're going to concede?
target: 你要让步？

source: My father and my uncle... both put their pride above all else. That's not something I'm willing to do.
target: 我的父亲和叔父……都把自己的骄傲看得高于一切。我不愿这么做。

source: I have no pride. I have been a fool before the court until now. You've all seen me in my worst, darkest moments.
target: 我已经没有什么骄傲可言了。直到现在，我在整个宫廷面前都像个傻瓜。你们都见过我最糟糕、最阴暗的样子。

source: Now it's time to turn that weakness of mine into a strength for this country.
target: 现在，是时候把我的这个弱点，变成这个国家的力量了。

source: Can you ensure there will be peace if we give our surrender?
target: 如果我们投降，你能保证和平吗？

source: With absolute conviction.
target: 我可以毫不迟疑地保证。

source: We desire only that you rule under Our judgement.
target: 我们只要求你在我们的裁决之下治理国家。

source: And what of the people who currently live under your judgement? Are they happy? Are their lives improved by your rule?
target: 那现在受你裁决的人民呢？他们幸福吗？你的统治让他们的生活变好了吗？

source: Our uncle currently sits the throne of Norway. As with your uncle, We presume he is not long for this world.
target: 如今坐在挪威王位上的是我们的叔父。和你的叔父一样，我们想，他也时日无多了。

source: Not for any lack of love We bear him—but because he is old, he wanders the halls recognizing no one, and his body is feeble.
target: 这并非因为我们不爱他——而是因为他老了，在厅廊间游荡，谁也认不出，身体也很虚弱。

source: But the people of Norway have full tables each night, fertile fields in summer, and warm shelter in winter.
target: 但挪威人民每晚都有满桌的饭菜，夏天有肥沃的田地，冬天有温暖的住处。

source: We do not abandon our sick, our poor, and our old. We care for them.
target: 我们不会抛弃病人、穷人和老人。我们照顾他们。

source: All the spoils of war flow through me to the people themselves. It is only by their will that I and my family rule.
target: 所有战利品都经由我，交到人民自己手中。我和我的家族能够统治，只因人民愿意。

source: So we do not desire their fear, but rather their continued wealth, and thereby their happiness.
target: 所以我们不求他们畏惧，只求他们一直富足，并因此幸福。

source: Then I grant Denmark to you.
target: 那么，我把丹麦交给你。

source: You make the right decision.
target: 你做了正确的决定。

source: All that remains is to handle the details... and to properly cement this union in conjugal arrangement.
target: 接下来只需处理细节……再通过婚姻安排，稳固这份联合。

source: You mean—marriage?
target: 你是说——结婚？

source: I understand you and Lady Birgitta have made such an arrangement already. Her father has been loyal to Us for some time.
target: 据我所知，你和比尔吉塔女士已经有了这样的安排。她的父亲效忠我们已有一段时间了。

source: Her house is entwined with those good noble families of Norway like vines grown long together.
target: 她的家族与挪威那些名门望族关系紧密，就像长久交缠的藤蔓。

source: Her father assisted Us heavily with Our invasion of Denmark, desiring your uncle's downfall.
target: 她的父亲希望你的叔父倒台，为我们入侵丹麦提供了很大的帮助。

source: As a reward for that loyalty, your betrothal to her will stay intact.
target: 作为对这份忠诚的奖赏，你与她的婚约将维持不变。

source: Lady Birgitta's father has already petitioned me with such an arrangement.
target: 比尔吉塔女士的父亲已经向我请求过这样的安排。

source: As a reward for that loyalty, you shall marry her.
target: 作为对这份忠诚的奖赏，你将娶她为妻。

source: (The both of them look positively miserable.)
target: （他们两个看起来都痛苦极了。）

source: If that will guarantee everyone's life, then so be it.
target: 如果这样能保住所有人的命，那就这样吧。

source: Our younger sister, Maria, is unmarried.
target: 我们的妹妹玛丽亚尚未婚配。

source: We had been making arrangements—but with this new change of winds, I believe it is proper to bring the two of you together.
target: 我们一直在为她安排婚事——但如今局势有变，我认为让你们两个结为夫妻才是合适的。

source: I will send for Maria. And when she arrives, the two of you will live here, she as Queen.
target: 我会派人接玛丽亚来。等她到了，你们两个就住在这里，她将成为王后。

source: (He looks positively miserable.)
target: （他看起来痛苦极了。）

source: Then let us make the necessary arrangements.
target: 那么，让我们做好必要的安排吧。

source: And let all here bear witness to what has transpired today—to the union of our nations.
target: 让在场的所有人见证今天发生的一切——见证我们两国的联合。

source: ...I cannot.
target: ……我做不到。

source: My father and uncle are dead. I am all that remains of this place.
target: 我的父亲和叔父都死了。这里只剩下我了。

source: What do I care for serving you? I have nothing worth living for in that servitude.
target: 我凭什么要为你效力？在那样的奴役下，没有什么值得我活下去。

source: To become dust now or in a short time, it matters little.
target: 现在化作尘土，还是过不久再化作尘土，没什么区别。

source: Don't be rash, Prince. We have a short tolerance for those who do not submit.
target: 别冲动，王子。对于不肯臣服的人，我们的耐心很有限。

source: I have nothing left to lose. Again, what do I care for your tolerance?
target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。还是那句话，你的耐心与我何干？

source: You hot-headed fool.
target: 你这个冲动的蠢货。

source: My son!
target: 我的儿子！

source: Men, bar her in her chambers. Treat her with dignity. Her people respect her greatly.
target: 将士们，把她关在寝宫里。以礼相待。她的人民十分敬重她。

source: You cruel man.
target: 你这个残忍的人。

source: You've just destroyed the best among us.
target: 你刚刚毁掉了我们当中最好的人。

source: We had no choice in the matter.
target: 这件事上，我们别无选择。

source: Because of what? Your honor? Is honor more precious than human life? Can honor laugh? Can it grow old?
target: 为什么？为了你的荣誉？荣誉比人命还珍贵吗？荣誉会笑吗？它会变老吗？

source: No. Your honor means nothing. Your father is just as dead as King Hamlet. And now the Prince is dead, too.
target: 不会。你的荣誉毫无意义。你的父亲和哈姆雷特国王一样，都已经死了。现在，王子也死了。

source: Perhaps all that remains is for some errant fool to put this brood of four men to rest, once and for all.
target: 也许现在只差某个莽撞的傻瓜，让你们这四个男人彻底安息，一了百了。

source: But I loved Hamlet. And I would proudly put my hands around your neck if I thought it would stop further bloodshed.
target: 可我爱哈姆雷特。如果我认为扼住你的脖子就能阻止更多流血，我会骄傲地这么做。

source: Then We are afraid your direct threat of violence necessitates Our direct action.
target: 那么，恐怕你这直接的暴力威胁，迫使我们必须直接采取行动。

source: Such a pity.
target: 真是可惜。

source: So. Some noble element of Elsinore remains, massacres aside.
target: 看来，尽管发生了这些屠杀，埃尔西诺还是有贵族活了下来。

source: And what will you do with me?
target: 那你会怎么处置我？

source: What is done to all houses who fall from grace. Exile.
target: 和所有失势家族的下场一样。流放。

source: Certainly it is no longer safe for you in Denmark. Many of your noblemen have turned to my allegiance. And as a lady of this court, you represent the old ways.
target: 你留在丹麦，显然已经不安全了。你们的许多贵族已转而效忠于我。而你身为这个宫廷的贵族女士，代表的是旧秩序。

source: We will not feed you to their dripping fangs. They offer a far worse fate.
target: 我们不会把你送进他们滴着涎水的獠牙之间。落到他们手里，你的下场会悲惨得多。

source: (I sense this world is ending.)
target: （我感觉这个世界正在走向终结。）

source: (I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever, if I wanted to.)
target: （只要我愿意，就可以用命运之书永远保留这个世界。）

source: Fortinbras sends me away. But fate pulls me back.
target: 福丁布拉斯将我送走，命运却又把我拉了回来。

source: (B-But I'm still alive. Even though they're all...)
target: （可——可我还活着。尽管他们都已经……）

source: (Does that mean it's over?)
target: （这是不是意味着，一切都结束了？）

source: (No. Something feels off. Wrong. It's as if...)
target: （不。感觉有点不对。不对劲。就好像……）

source: A strange, yanking sensation rips me back through time.
target: 一股奇异的拉扯感猛地将我拽回过去。

source: I can feel the pull already.
target: 我已经能感觉到那股拉力了。

source: I'll not be able to leave the loop. Not this way. Not without something more.
target: 我还是无法离开循环。这样不行。还得有别的东西才行。

source: Just send me back already.
target: 快把我送回去吧。

source: It's the strangest thing.
target: 这实在太奇怪了。

source: Ever since my uncle died, I've been in a blind panic, my mind racing.
target: 自从叔父死后，我就一直慌得不知所措，脑子一刻也停不下来。

source: All these ways I might fail as King—all these pressures and fears were closing in on me.
target: 我当国王可能遭遇的种种失败——这些压力和恐惧一直向我逼来。

source: I imagined a thousand scenarios. And I started to run myself through preparing for each of them.
target: 我设想了上千种情况，开始在脑海中逐一演练，为每一种做好准备。

source: But never did I imagine this.
target: 可我从没想过会是这样。

source: What will you do now?
target: 你现在打算怎么办？

source: Lord Fortinbras has given me the chance to serve my country.
target: 福丁布拉斯大人给了我为国家效力的机会。

source: I intend to do all the things my father and uncle could not, for the sake of their pride.
target: 父亲和叔父因为自己的骄傲而做不到的事，我打算全都做到。

source: Even if that means we no longer have a nation?
target: 即便这意味着我们不再拥有自己的国家？

source: We do have a nation, Ophelia. It's merely under Norway's control.
target: 我们有自己的国家，奥菲莉娅。它只是受挪威控制罢了。

source: If our people are happy, what difference does the color of our flag make?
target: 如果我们的人民幸福，国旗是什么颜色又有什么关系？

source: Today, I want to begin something new. Fortinbras will return soon to make the word official.
target: 今天，我想开启一个新的局面。福丁布拉斯很快就会回来，正式宣布这件事。

source: (B-but, I'm still alive. Even though they're all...)
target: （可——可是，我还活着。尽管他们都已经……）

source: What do you want, Horatio?
target: 你想干什么，霍拉旭？

source: I don't want to talk about that night.
target: 我不想谈那天晚上的事。

source: Ah, and yet, we must. Ophelia has been asking questions.
target: 唉，可我们必须谈。奥菲莉娅一直在问这件事。

source: I'm aware. The problem has been handled.
target: 我知道。问题已经处理好了。

source: Handled how?
target: 怎么处理的？

source: All the participation I require of you is to wait, and watch.
target: 我只需要你等着，看着。

source: Let me help you. Please. One friend to another.
target: 让我帮你吧。求你了。就当是朋友之间的请求。

source: You didn't tell her anything, did you?
target: 你没告诉她什么吧？

source: No... of course not. Not yet.
target: 没有……当然没有。还没有。

source: Not yet?
target: 还没有？

source: Hamlet. I get the sense that Ophelia, strange as it may sound, wants to help you.
target: 哈姆雷特。我觉得奥菲莉娅想帮你，虽然这听起来可能很奇怪。

source: It might be good to talk to her, confide in her. Let her know what's going on.
target: 也许你该和她谈谈，向她吐露心事。让她知道发生了什么。

source: Don't be a fool. If the King got wind of a rumor like this...
target: 别犯傻。如果国王听到了这种传闻……

source: You know her better than that.
target: 你了解她，该知道她不会那样。

source: Do I?
target: 是吗？

source: Hmm. Good point.
target: 嗯。说得也是。

source: Still, she's a curious person. You could use that right now.
target: 不过，她是个好奇心很强的人。你现在可以利用这一点。

source: My prince, if that was really your father's ghost we saw on the walls—
target: 王子殿下，如果我们在城墙上看到的真是你父亲的幽灵——

source: You never know who might be listening, Horatio.
target: 你永远不知道谁可能在偷听，霍拉旭。

source: We saw your father's spirit. It was real. It spoke to us. What else must I say? Do you doubt your own eyes?
target: 我们看见了你父亲的亡魂。它是真的。它和我们说过话。我还要说什么？难道你连自己的眼睛都不信？

source: No. I know I saw my father's ghost. I know it spoke of his murder.
target: 不。我知道自己看见了父亲的幽灵。我知道它说过他被谋杀的事。

source: And that he's trapped, unable to truly live or die.
target: 还说他被困住了，既不能真正活着，也不能真正死去。

source: He told me that blood would be shed, that revenge would come to Elsinore.
target: 他告诉我，将会有人流血，复仇将降临埃尔西诺。

source: B-but Claudius is suspicious already. If he knew we'd seen—and spoken to-—a spirit...
target: 可——可克劳狄斯已经起疑了。如果他知道我们见过一个亡魂——还和它说过话——……

source: The King even has turned my childhood friends against me. Rosie and Guilda were prying earlier.
target: 国王甚至让我的儿时好友来对付我。萝茜和吉尔妲先前就在打探我的事。

source: I doubt nothing now. My purpose is clear, my thoughts bloody. I've been given proof.
target: 我现在已没有任何怀疑。我的目标很明确，满脑子都是鲜血。我已经得到了证据。

source: As I said before, that purpose is mine alone to know. Ophelia was able to help me realize that, today.
target: 我之前说过，那个目标只有我自己能知道。今天，奥菲莉娅让我明白了这一点。

source: Hearing you say that is not even mildly reassuring.
target: 听你这么说，我一点也放心不下来。

source: We can't trust anyone. Especially not Ophelia.
target: 我们不能相信任何人。尤其是奥菲莉娅。

source: Very well, my lord. I can respect your wishes.
target: 好吧，殿下。我会尊重你的意愿。

source: And Horatio, not another mention of the ghost. We shall never speak of it again, nor look for it.
target: 还有，霍拉旭，不许再提那个幽灵。我们再也不谈它，也不去找它。

source: Oh, Hamlet. As you wish.
target: 唉，哈姆雷特。就依你吧。

source: Everyone, thanks for your ears. I'm pleased to inform you all there will be a special show tonight.
target: 各位，谢谢你们听我说。我很高兴地告诉大家，今晚会有一场特别的演出。

source: Hamlet, what exactly do you think you're doing?
target: 哈姆雷特，你到底想干什么？

source: Yes, my dear, what's this about?
target: 是啊，亲爱的，这是怎么回事？

source: It would ordinarily be rather difficult to top one of Sir Quince's excellent performances.
target: 通常来说，要胜过奎因斯先生的精彩演出，可不是件容易的事。

source: But I assure you, listeners, that my mother's activities of late are a far more interesting drama.
target: 但各位听众，我向你们保证，母亲近来的所作所为，是一出有趣得多的戏。

source: What is this?
target: 这是怎么回事？

source: I finally have the proof I need.
target: 我终于有了需要的证据。

source: It's all contained within these pages, Mother.
target: 全都写在这几页里了，母亲。

source: For the rest of you: In summary, for all her faith, my mother is not faithful.
target: 至于各位，简单来说：我母亲虽然虔诚，却并不忠贞。

source: She gave her body to Claudius while my father was still living!
target: 我父亲还活着的时候，她就把身体交给了克劳狄斯！

source: No! That's not...
target: 不！不是那样……

source: Hamlet. Stop. Now.
target: 哈姆雷特。住口。立刻。

source: Not only that, but Claudius had some hand in my father's death.
target: 不仅如此，克劳狄斯还插手了我父亲的死。

source: No. Not his death. His murder.
target: 不，不是他的死。是他被谋杀的事。

source: Hamlet, you're making no sense, my love. Please, stop!
target: 哈姆雷特，亲爱的，你说的话毫无道理。求你别说了！

source: You mean you had no idea anyone would find out. That's what this was about, isn't it? Keeping it hidden from me?
target: 你是说，你没想到会有人发现。你们做这一切就是为了这个，对不对？为了瞒着我？

source: My father's death was no accident. You two planned to kill him. Admit it!
target: 我父亲的死绝非意外。你们两个合谋杀了他。承认吧！

source: I beg you, stop this now!
target: 我求你了，马上停下！

source: Is something wrong?
target: 出什么事了吗？

source: You've got to come quickly.
target: 你得赶快过来。

source: I believe the Queen is a danger to herself at the moment. She needs you.
target: 我想王后现在可能会伤害自己。她需要你。

source: She's in the graveyard.
target: 她在墓地。

source: Take me to her.
target: 带我去找她。

source: Gerta. Look at me.
target: 格尔塔。看着我。

source: I can't.
target: 我做不到。

source: She's been like this, mute, since... well.
target: 自从……唉，她就一直这样，不说话。

source: Hamlet is... dead.
target: 哈姆雷特……死了。

source: Hamlet brought this diary before us all. It spoke of the Queen's private life, and it was not kind.
target: 哈姆雷特把这本日记拿到了我们所有人面前。里面写着王后的私生活，内容很不客气。

source: The King cut him down. It was like nothing I've ever seen. Ophelia, it was horrifying.
target: 国王砍死了他。我从没见过那样的场面。奥菲莉娅，太可怕了。

source: (I brought that on Gertrude. On Hamlet. Oh, my God. He's dead?)
target: （是我害了乔特鲁德。害了哈姆雷特。天哪。他死了？）

source: That play Hamlet put on. It spoke of the Queen's private life, and it was cruel.
target: 哈姆雷特上演的那出戏，讲的是王后的私生活，内容很残酷。

source: The King cut him down. It was like nothing I've ever seen.
target: 国王砍死了他。我从没见过那样的场面。

source: The going word is he threw himself from the walls. The Queen tried to stop him, but was unsuccessful.
target: 现在的传闻是，他从城墙上跳了下去。王后想阻止他，却没能成功。

source: Claudius had berated him cruelly for what he perceived to be rumormongering. Hamlet wasn't in his right mind.
target: 克劳狄斯认为他在散布谣言，为此狠狠斥责了他。哈姆雷特当时神志不清。

source: She won't speak to anyone.
target: 她不肯跟任何人说话。

source: I can imagine not. She's just lost her son.
target: 我能理解。她刚刚失去了儿子。

source: Is that Ophelia?
target: 是奥菲莉娅吗？

source: He's dead. My little boy is dead.
target: 他死了。我的小男孩死了。

source: And he died hating me. I saw his face.
target: 而且他死的时候还恨着我。我看到了他的表情。

source: How can that be possible? How can the little boy I poured my heart into want to hurt me so much?
target: 怎么会这样？那个倾注了我全部心血的小男孩，怎么会这么想伤害我？

source: They bore him barefaced on the bier.
target: 他们抬着灵床上的他，面容无遮。

source: And in his grave rained many a tear.
target: 泪水如雨，落入他的坟墓。

source: I'm so sorry, my lady. This is all my fault.
target: 对不起，王后。这都是我的错。

source: It cannot be your fault, my sweet. I had hoped you would be my daughter in marriage someday.
target: 这不可能是你的错，亲爱的。我曾盼着有一天你能成为我的儿媳。

source: Now that day will never come to pass.
target: 如今那一天永远不会来了。

source: My lady, we shall all reunite with our departed loved souls in Heaven above. Until then, we shall pray for the boy he was.
target: 王后，我们终将在天国与逝去的挚爱重逢。在那之前，让我们为曾经的那个男孩祈祷。

source: Aye. My Prince—he may have been led astray in the end, but we will remember him as he was before.
target: 是啊。我的王子——他最后或许受了蛊惑，走上歧途，但我们会记住他从前的样子。

source: It had to be done. I killed him for you. Why did you run from me?
target: 这是必须做的。我杀他是为了你。你为什么要躲开我？

source: I berated the boy, but he did the deed himself. His mind was broken. I was merely the last straw on his back.
target: 我是斥责了那孩子，但事情是他自己做的。他精神已经崩溃了。我不过是压垮他的最后一根稻草。

source: Why must you blame me?
target: 你为什么非要怪我？

source: O-Ophelia, please don't let him near me...
target: 奥、奥菲莉娅，求你别让他靠近我……

source: Not another step, Claudius.
target: 别再往前一步，克劳狄斯。

source: You are my wife. I made a vow to protect you. And I'll uphold that vow, no matter what.
target: 你是我的妻子。我发誓要保护你。无论如何，我都会守住这个誓言。

source: Hail, Claudius.
target: 向你致意，克劳狄斯。

source: Hail the brother you killed.
target: 向你杀死的兄弟致意吧。

source: My God—
target: 我的上帝啊——

source: What is that?
target: 那是什么？

source: T-the spirit...?
target: 幽、幽灵……？

source: You cannot escape the eye of Heaven, brother.
target: 你逃不过上天的眼睛，兄弟。

source: I came not to bring peace, but to bring a sword.
target: 我来不是带来和平，而是带来刀剑。

source: And now you have murdered my son. My only child. My greatest treasure.
target: 如今，你又谋杀了我的儿子。我唯一的孩子。我最珍贵的宝物。

source: This is madness!
target: 这太疯狂了！

source: This isn't...
target: 这不是……

source: I put you in the grave once, and I'll damn well do it again!
target: 我已经把你送进过一次坟墓，他妈的，我还会再送你进去！

source: Grrrahh! Die!
target: 呃啊啊！去死！

source: Look upon me. Did Christ not say, 'Surely I am with you always'? As am I with you... my black touch descends on your sullied court...
target: 看着我。基督不是说过，‘我必常与你们同在’吗？我也与你同在……我的黑暗之触降临于你污浊的宫廷……

source: Why are you doing this?
target: 你为什么要这么做？

source: How strange and peculiar that you and I should meet now, at the end of time, at the end of this world.
target: 你我竟在此刻相遇，在时间的尽头，在这个世界的尽头，何其奇异。

source: Find me on the first night. You are too late for this fragment to exist. It will soon melt.
target: 第一晚来找我。你来得太迟，这个碎片已无法存在。它很快就会消融。

source: Die, damn you! Die! Die! Die!
target: 去死，该死的！去死！去死！去死！

source: The Ghost has made itself known.
target: 幽灵已经现身。

source: I thought, last time...
target: 我记得，上次……

source: (The ghost didn't appear.)
target: （幽灵没有出现。）

source: Don't you dare touch her, Claudius.
target: 你敢碰她试试，克劳狄斯。

source: Shut the hell up. She's my wife. I'll do as I please.
target: 给我闭上你的臭嘴。她是我的妻子。我想怎样就怎样。

source: Get up. Now. Stop making a scene.
target: 起来。立刻。别再闹了。

source: Ahh—what have you done?
target: 啊——你做了什么？

source: Throw me in jail if you like, my lady. Or have me hanged. Or worse.
target: 王后，您愿意的话，就把我关进监牢吧。或是绞死我。或是用更残酷的刑罚。

source: I could not bear to watch him take another step.
target: 我实在无法看着他再往前走一步。

source: Not after...
target: 尤其是在……之后。

source: No. It is done.
target: 不。已经结束了。

source: Thank you, Horatio.
target: 谢谢你，霍拉旭。

source: ...We must bury the dead.
target: ……我们必须埋葬死者。

source: I've let everyone down. Absolutely everyone.
target: 我让所有人都失望了。所有人，无一例外。

source: I cannot live for this, Lord. I'm sorry. I cannot obey your law.
target: 主啊，我无法再这样活下去了。对不起。我无法遵守您的律法。

source: Even though I know it is the gravest sin.
target: 尽管我知道，这是最深重的罪。

source: Every minute I spend forcing a smile, feeling like I want to die—
target: 每一分钟，我都在强颜欢笑，心里却只想死——

source: I feel such a weight upon me.
target: 我感到有如此沉重的东西压着我。

source: And Margaret has already gone to your side, Lord.
target: 而玛格丽特已经去了您的身边，主啊。

source: It seems so unfair that she should be in Heaven, and I here.
target: 她在天堂，我却在这里，这似乎太不公平了。

source: I long to hold her hand. To have just one conversation with her. To embrace her.
target: 我多想握住她的手。哪怕只和她说一次话。拥抱她。

source: Hamlet, if you can hear my prayers, help me!
target: 哈姆雷特，如果你能听见我的祈祷，帮帮我！

source: Everything we worked so hard to build has crumbled without your presence.
target: 没有你在，我们辛辛苦苦建立的一切都崩塌了。

source: Our son, our kingdom, your legacy. I tried to keep it all together. But it was like sand slipping through my fingers.
target: 我们的儿子，我们的王国，你留下的基业。我努力过，想守住这一切。可它就像沙子一样，从我的指缝间流走。

source: Hamlet, my love, my husband.
target: 哈姆雷特，我的爱人，我的丈夫。

source: Can you see the hell I'm in?
target: 你能看见我身处的地狱吗？

source: Speak to me, please, if you're there!
target: 如果你在，求你跟我说句话！

source: My lady.
target: 王后。

source: Oh. Ophelia.
target: 哦。奥菲莉娅。

source: Don't do this.
target: 别这样做。

source: Please. Come with me. Come off the ledge.
target: 求您了。跟我走吧。从边沿上下来。

source: We still need you. I need you.
target: 我们还需要您。我需要您。

source: Ophelia. You must keep her safe.
target: 奥菲莉娅。你必须护她周全。

source: After he died, I thought I could go on. I thought I would recover.
target: 他死后，我以为自己能继续活下去。我以为自己会好起来。

source: But I haven't. And my head-- is screaming at me that the world would be better off without me.
target: 可我没有。而我的脑海里——有声音在对我尖叫，说这个世界没有我会更好。

source: That I wouldn't make everyone else around me miserable anymore, that they could all move on and find happiness if I were just gone.
target: 说我不会再让身边所有人痛苦了，只要我不在了，他们就都能继续生活，找到幸福。

source: I know it feels that way, my lady. But it isn't true. It's only the voices in your head.
target: 我知道您感觉是这样，王后。但这不是真的。这只是您脑海里的声音。

source: Come no closer. Stay, my sweet. Stay in the world of the living.
target: 别再靠近了。留下吧，亲爱的。留在生者的世界。

source: Ophelia, plead some sense with her!
target: 奥菲莉娅，快劝劝她，让她想明白！

source: My lady, let's go somewhere warmer and talk a while. I want to help you.
target: 王后，我们去个暖和些的地方，聊一会儿吧。我想帮助您。

source: But first, you must come down from that ledge. Take my hand.
target: 但您得先从那边沿上下来。握住我的手。

source: No! No, my mind is made, my purpose clear.
target: 不！不，我心意已决，我清楚自己要做什么。

source: Margaret, perhaps God will pity me and let me join you still.
target: 玛格丽特，也许上帝会怜悯我，仍然准许我与你团聚。

source: Here will I set up my everlasting rest...
target: 我将在此永远安息……

source: And shake the yoke of inauspicious stars from this world-wearied flesh.
target: 让这厌倦尘世的躯体，摆脱凶星命数的枷锁。

source: I brought this on her.
target: 是我害了她。

source: This is but one fragment.
target: 这不过是一个碎片。

source: A thousand times I've seen her die. Not once has it been less easy to bear.
target: 我已见过她死去一千次。没有哪一次变得更难承受。

source: You must save her, Ophelia. Save her from her pain.
target: 你必须救她，奥菲莉娅。救她脱离痛苦。

source: But I haven't. And my head is screaming at me that the world would be better off without me.
target: 可我没有。而我的脑海里有声音在对我尖叫，说这个世界没有我会更好。

source: Let's go somewhere warmer and talk a while. I want to help you.
target: 我们去个暖和些的地方，聊一会儿吧。我想帮助您。

source: Thank you all for heeding my summons.
target: 感谢各位应召前来。

source: My liege, what is this about?
target: 陛下，所为何事？

source: Rumors. Insidious rumors are chipping away at my throne, Bernardo.
target: 谣言。阴险的谣言正在一点点动摇我的王位，贝尔纳多。

source: The ghost of my brother? Truly? My brother's soul is at peace, God rest him.
target: 我兄弟的幽灵？当真？我兄弟的灵魂已经安息，愿上帝让他安眠。

source: How did you hear of this?
target: 你是怎么听说这件事的？

source: Lady Ophelia told me, of course.
target: 当然是奥菲莉娅女士告诉我的。

source: Ophelia? You told him?
target: 奥菲莉娅？是你告诉他的？

source: I thought it could help.
target: 我以为这样能有帮助。

source: Regardless of the spread of this rumor, what is important is that it stops.
target: 不管这个谣言传到了哪里，重要的是，它必须停止。

source: If I hear any more of this, I will be forced to action.
target: 如果我再听到这种话，我就不得不采取行动了。

source: This is a direct threat to me and to my rule. And I will not suffer your indignities to the extent your mother has.
target: 这是对我和我的统治的直接威胁。我绝不会像你母亲那样，一再忍受你的无礼。

source: My lord, it was just idle chatter. You know how gossip spreads.
target: 陛下，那只是闲聊。您知道流言就是这样传开的。

source: 'Idle' chatter? Claiming to see the spirit of my dead brother is insulting. It's macabre at best and a detriment to his name at worst.
target: ‘闲聊’？声称看见了我已故兄弟的幽灵，这是侮辱。往轻了说，是拿死人取乐；往重了说，是损害他的名誉。

source: My brother's immortal soul rests in Heaven, with the Almighty. Where he belongs.
target: 我兄弟不朽的灵魂安息于天堂，与全能的上帝同在。那才是他的归宿。

source: I expect better from all of you than to speak ill of a dead man. No more wagging tongues.
target: 我本以为各位不至于说一个死人的坏话。别再嚼舌头了。

source: Are you afraid?
target: 你害怕了？

source: Tch. Afraid! Hardly.
target: 嗤。害怕！怎么可能。

source: Your quaking hand gives you away.
target: 你发抖的手已经出卖了你。

source: Hmm. I bid you all a less imaginative evening.
target: 哼。祝各位今晚少些胡思乱想。

source: How... how could you?
target: 你怎么……怎么能这样？

source: When you spoke to my uncle about seeing my father's ghost. It... he... threatened me.
target: 你跟我叔叔说看见了我父亲的幽灵。这……他……威胁了我。

source: Because of you, he now wants me dead, and all my best laid plans are useless.
target: 因为你，他现在想要我死，我所有精心安排的计划都没用了。

source: Hamlet, I... I thought if I—
target: 哈姆雷特，我……我以为如果我——

source: No. You helped me see.
target: 不。你让我看清了。

source: I was weak. I let my feelings get in the way of my judgement. But it's all become clear to me now.
target: 我太软弱了。我让感情妨碍了自己的判断。但现在我全都看清了。

source: 'Become clear'?
target: ‘看清了’？

source: Oh! Everyone thinks I'm mad. And they're right. I am. I'm daft. I'm insane.
target: 哦！大家都觉得我疯了。他们说得对。我是疯了。我傻了。我神志不清了。

source: Time to take action at last!
target: 终于该采取行动了！

source: You see, Ophelia, when I came to understand you of all people had betrayed me, I realized something wonderful.
target: 你看，奥菲莉娅，当我明白连你都背叛了我时，我发现了一件美妙的事。

source: None of this matters. It doesn't matter if I get revenge for my father's death. It doesn't matter if I expose my uncle.
target: 这一切都无所谓了。能不能为父亲的死报仇，无所谓。能不能揭露我叔叔，无所谓。

source: There's nothing worth living for. Not you, not my mother, not Claudius, not any of them or any of it.
target: 没有什么值得我活下去了。你不值得，我母亲不值得，克劳狄斯不值得，他们所有人，这所有的一切，都不值得。

source: As long as I thought you were still my friend, there was some shred of purpose in living. But now? I'm free.
target: 只要我还觉得你是我的朋友，活着就还有一丝意义。可现在呢？我自由了。

source: Hamlet. I am your friend. I don't want to bring harm to you. I was just trying to help.
target: 哈姆雷特。我就是你的朋友。我不想伤害你。我只是想帮忙。

source: You're too clever to possibly believe that.
target: 你那么聪明，不可能真相信这种话。

source: My mind is clear for the first time in a long time. And I feel peaceful. And you won't take that from me.
target: 这么久以来，我的头脑第一次如此清醒。我感到很平静。你别想夺走这份平静。

source: Time to do now what I ought to have done months ago.
target: 现在该去做几个月前就该做的事了。

source: (This isn't good. He's coming undone.)
target: （这可不妙。他正在崩溃。）

source: So. I'm not going to Paris after all.
target: 所以，我到底还是不去巴黎了。

source: I hope staying behind is worth the trouble. And that father isn't too enraged with me.
target: 希望留下来值得这番折腾。也希望父亲不会太生我的气。

source: The game is Ruff and Honours, gentlemen.
target: 各位先生，我们玩的是将牌荣誉牌。

source: What's wrong, Marcellus?
target: 怎么了，马塞勒斯？

source: Marcellus is quite the poor loser, ja?
target: 马塞勒斯可真输不起，是吧？

source: Close yer lips, old woman. I ain't about to lose t'yeh!
target: 闭嘴，老太婆。我才不会输给你！

source: I'm jus' so bloody tired of this game, thas' all!
target: 我只是他妈的玩腻了，就这么回事！

source: Deal 'em out, Horatio. Gimme somethin' good!
target: 发牌吧，霍拉旭。给我点好牌！

source: It's spades. Of course. Bloody hell.
target: 是黑桃。果然。该死。

source: Lucky play, obviously. Your trick, Marcellus.
target: 显然只是运气好。这一墩归你，马塞勒斯。

source: Next—looks like spades again.
target: 下一轮——看来又是黑桃。

source: Mein Gott, Marcellus. I swear to Heaven—
target: 我的上帝啊，马塞勒斯。我对天发誓——

source: He had King and Queen?
target: 他有国王牌，还有王后牌？

source: Warrrhar har har! I'm only gettin' started!
target: 哇哈哈哈哈！我这才刚开始呢！

source: (I don't even know the rules.)
target: （我连规则都不知道。）

source: Ophelia told me you'd be here. But I didn't believe it.
target: 奥菲莉娅告诉我你会在这里。但我没相信。

source: G-Guard Captain!
target: 卫、卫队长！

source: If you have time to gamble, surely you have time to train harder. Need I remind you all that we could be at war at any moment?
target: 有时间赌博，想必也有时间加紧训练。还需要我提醒你们，我们随时都有可能开战吗？

source: This level of discipline is shameful. I won't have it in my ranks.
target: 这副纪律涣散的样子真丢人。我的队伍里绝不容许这样。

source: Laps. Now. Put the cards down and get running.
target: 跑圈。立刻。放下牌，跑起来。

source: Y-yes, sir!
target: 是、是，长官！

source: You can't make me run! I'm not under your command!
target: 你不能命令我跑步！我不归你管！

source: You've been arranging games like this for months. I know where all your earnings are kept.
target: 你组织这样的赌局已经好几个月了。我知道你赢来的钱都放在哪里。

source: If you'd like me not to confiscate those, I suggest you spend less time acting like a two-copper tavern wench and more time serving your ladyship. Now—go.
target: 如果你不想让我没收那些钱，我劝你少像个只值两枚铜板的酒馆女郎一样胡混，多花点时间侍奉你的夫人。现在——走。

source: Y-you're a tyrant!
target: 你、你就是个暴君！

source: Clearly I haven't supervised them closely enough.
target: 显然是我管得还不够严。

source: Where did I go wrong, Ophelia? Was it the drills?
target: 奥菲莉娅，我哪里做错了？是操练出了问题？

source: Was I too hard on them? Are they acting out in spite? Is this merely a phase?
target: 我对他们太严厉了吗？他们是故意跟我作对？还是只是一时闹脾气？

source: I gave them everything! They just don't appreciate me!
target: 我为他们付出了一切！他们就是不懂得感激我！

source: Some fresh air and exercise never hurt anyone. I'm sure they'll forgive you.
target: 呼吸点新鲜空气，活动活动，总不会有坏处。我相信他们会原谅你的。

source: Yes, Lady Birgitta? Does something trouble you?
target: 怎么了，比尔吉塔女士？有什么事困扰着你吗？

source: My lady, I have a request.
target: 王后，我有一个请求。

source: I cannot bear it any longer.
target: 我再也受不了了。

source: I'd like to leave Elsinore.
target: 我想离开埃尔西诺。

source: You want to leave the castle? For what purpose?
target: 你想离开城堡？为了什么？

source: Has someone given you trouble? Made you uncomfortable in any way?
target: 有人找你麻烦吗？或是有什么让你不舒服的举动？

source: No, my lady. But Ophelia mentioned she saw me killed in a dream of hers.
target: 没有，王后。但奥菲莉娅提到，她在梦里看见我被杀了。

source: Oh, Brit.
target: 唉，布莉特。

source: But it's more than that. That was merely an echoing of thoughts I've already been having.
target: 但不只是因为这个。那不过是印证了我早已有的想法。

source: I want to be near my family again. Near my mother and father. This castle is stifling.
target: 我想重新回到家人身边。回到父母身边。这座城堡让我喘不过气。

source: Oh, Brit. Come now. Your father wants you here. With me.
target: 唉，布莉特。别这样。你父亲希望你留在这里。留在我身边。

source: I know you may not have settled into your role here yet, but to leave now would be dishonorable.
target: 我知道，你可能还没适应在这里的职责，但现在离开会有失体面。

source: Your family worked hard, no doubt, to place you in my retinue. And my husband desires a better connection with the Brockenhuus family.
target: 毫无疑问，你的家人为让你成为我的随从，费了不少心力。而我的丈夫也希望与布罗肯胡斯家族建立更紧密的联系。

source: Your family worked hard, no doubt, to place you in my retinue. They wanted you at Elsinore for a reason. It's excellent exposure for a young lady.
target: 毫无疑问，你的家人为让你成为我的随从，费了不少心力。他们希望你留在埃尔西诺，自有他们的理由。对年轻姑娘来说，这可是出入社交场合、让人认识你的大好机会。

source: Did you know your father and I have been discussing the possibility of a betrothal between you and Hamlet?
target: 你知道吗？我和你父亲一直在商量，是否让你和哈姆雷特订婚。

source: I did not, my lady. I would be-- er-- honored, of course.
target: 我不知道，王后。我会——呃——当然，我会深感荣幸。

source: We were even discussing the possibility of a betrothal between you and Hamlet. Things are different now, of course.
target: 我们甚至商量过，是否让你和哈姆雷特订婚。当然，现在情况不同了。

source: Listen, Brit. When I was but a girl I came to Elsinore and it felt to me, too, like a prison.
target: 听我说，布莉特。我来到埃尔西诺时，也还是个小姑娘，那时我也觉得这里像一座牢笼。

source: For years I thought I could never be happy here. Then, somehow, I found rapture. I found joy as a mother not only to my son, but to my country.
target: 有好多年，我都觉得自己永远不可能在这里幸福。后来，不知怎么，我找到了无比的喜悦。我不仅是儿子的母亲，也是这个国家的母亲，这让我感到快乐。

source: And what was once my prison became my domain. Soon it will be the same for you.
target: 曾经囚禁我的地方，成了由我掌管的天地。很快，你也会如此。

source: But you must be patient, my dear. Trust that your place here at Elsinore will bring great things.
target: 但你必须耐心些，亲爱的。要相信，你在埃尔西诺的这个位置会给你带来美好的未来。

source: Very well, my lady.
target: 好吧，王后。

source: Thank you for the private audience.
target: 谢谢您单独接见我。

source: I hoped you'd come.
target: 我一直盼着你来。

source: I wasn't sure I would.
target: 我本来也不确定自己会不会来。

source: And yet, here I am.
target: 可我还是来了。

source: And yet, here I am again.
target: 可我还是又来了。

source: What was it you wanted to discuss?
target: 你想谈什么？

source: I... I wanted to apologize, first, I think. For coming upon you in your room, speaking nonsense.
target: 我……我想，我得先道个歉。为那次突然到你房里找你，胡言乱语的事。

source: I was beside myself. I didn't know where I was going. I was stumbling through the castle, and it was dark.
target: 我当时心神大乱，不知道自己要去哪儿。我在城堡里跌跌撞撞地走着，四周一片漆黑。

source: It had nothing to do with you, or with us. I was just lost.
target: 那与你无关，也与我们之间的事无关。我只是迷失了方向。

source: I forgive you.
target: 我原谅你。

source: You do?
target: 真的？

source: (Hamlet barging in is a constant I'll have to grow used to, at least for now.)
target: （哈姆雷特总会闯进来，这件事我得慢慢习惯，至少眼下如此。）

source: Of course. But now, I must admit, I find the notion of 'rekindling' our courtship rather a strange one.
target: 当然。但现在，我得承认，所谓让我们的恋情“重燃”，我觉得这想法挺奇怪的。

source: After all, I've returned the letters you sent me and rebuffed your advances at every turn.
target: 毕竟，我把你寄来的信都退了回去，也一次次拒绝了你的示好。

source: Yes. I know you've despised me from afar all summer. I wanted to respect that boundary.
target: 是的。我知道你整个夏天都避着我、厌恶我。我想尊重你，不越过那条界线。

source: Yet in a moment of desperation, you came running to find me?
target: 可你一陷入绝望，就跑来找我了？

source: I-it had nothing to do with you, or with us. Like I said, I was beside myself.
target: 那、那与你无关，也与我们之间的事无关。我说过，我当时心神大乱。

source: I'll say.
target: 那可不是。

source: I swear, what is it about your power to cut me so? I can say nothing intelligent or curt in my own defense, even. I just let you tear right into me.
target: 说真的，你怎么就能把我伤得这么深？我甚至连一句机智或冷硬的辩解都说不出来。就这么任由你狠狠刺伤我。

source: Does how I feel matter so little to you?
target: 我的感受对你来说，就这么无关紧要吗？

source: And when did you consider my feelings? You've been nothing but inconsiderate since we broke off our courtship!
target: 那你什么时候考虑过我的感受？自从我们分手，你就从没体谅过我！

source: I haven't properly apologized for how I treated you. Allow me to say this: I am sorry. Deeply and truly. I was wrong.
target: 我还没有为我那样对待你好好道过歉。请让我说一句：我确实很抱歉。发自内心，真心实意。我错了。

source: And if there's even the faintest chance... you told me you loved me, once.
target: 如果还有哪怕一丝机会……你曾经说过，你爱我。

source: So I did.
target: 我是说过。

source: But no longer? If your heart has truly changed, I'll go, and I'll never trouble you again with my affections, nor stumble blindly into your room at dawn.
target: 但现在不爱了？如果你真的变了心，我就走，再也不会拿我的爱意来打扰你，也不会在黎明时迷迷糊糊地闯进你房里。

source: You have only to say the word.
target: 你只要开口就行。

source: Does it matter? I am powerless to choose to love you, even if I could.
target: 这重要吗？就算我还能爱你，我也没有权力选择去爱你。

source: What does that mean?
target: 这话是什么意思？

source: You know well. The forces at work in Elsinore are far stronger than whatever I might desire.
target: 你很清楚。在埃尔西诺左右一切的力量，远比我的任何愿望都强大。

source: Your uncle looks at me as what I am: an obstacle to you becoming betrothed to someone else. Haven't you noticed?
target: 你叔父眼中的我，就是我实际所处的位置：你与别人订婚的障碍。你没注意到吗？

source: I have never had any intention of allowing my uncle to run my life.
target: 我从来就没打算让叔父摆布我的人生。

source: Everyone in this castle looks at me as what I am: an obstacle to you becoming betrothed to someone else. Haven't you noticed?
target: 这座城堡里所有人眼中的我，就是我实际所处的位置：你与别人订婚的障碍。你没注意到吗？

source: I have never had any intention of allowing others to run my life.
target: 我从来就没打算让别人摆布我的人生。

source: Listen. I am Prince of this country. And someday, God willing, I will be King. What could you desire that would be beyond my power to control?
target: 听着，我是这个国家的王子。上帝若愿意，总有一天，我会成为国王。你想要的东西，有什么是我的权力无法左右的？

source: It is because you are Prince that you cannot possibly understand.
target: 正因为你是王子，你才根本无法理解。

source: You and I are bound by different privileges. That's a truth of this castle.
target: 你我拥有的特权不同，受到的束缚也不同。这就是这座城堡里的现实。

source: And what if it weren't?
target: 那如果现实不是这样呢？

source: No. You've been right to stay away from me.
target: 不……你一直和我保持距离，是对的。

source: The more I think on it, the heavier my heart becomes. I--
target: 我越想，心就越沉重。我——

source: Ophelia, I know there's a world where you and I can be free. I believe in that world with all my soul.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我知道，有一个世界，你我能在那里自由生活。我全心全意地相信那个世界。

source: But first, I need to strengthen myself for vengeance against my uncle.
target: 但首先，我得让自己足够强大，才能向叔父复仇。

source: And until that comes to pass, I can think of little else.
target: 在那之前，我几乎无心顾及别的事。

source: Just—I beg you—know that my belief in that future is the thing driving me to this vengeance.
target: 只是——我求你——请你明白，正是对那个未来的信念，驱使我去复仇。

source: Once my dark work is complete, I'm going to return for you, and I'm going to show you that things can be different.
target: 等我完成这桩黑暗之事，我就会回来找你，让你看见，一切可以变得不同。

source: You'll see.
target: 你会看到的。

source: (I see. While his uncle's crime still stands unanswered, he's focused solely on revenge.)
target: （我明白了。只要他叔父的罪行还没有得到报偿，他就一心只想着复仇。）

source: (But soon he's going to act against Claudius. And then—)
target: （但他很快就会对克劳狄斯采取行动。然后——）

source: (Then perhaps he'll find me.)
target: （然后，也许他会来找我。）

source: (I wonder what the outcome would be if circumstances were different.)
target: （如果处境不同，结果又会怎样呢？）

source: Your 'dark work'? What do you mean by that?
target: 你的“黑暗之事”？这是什么意思？

source: Think nothing of it. Go. Fret on lighter things.
target: 别放在心上。去吧。操心些轻松的事。

source: That was cruel.
target: 你真残忍。

source: Not meeting me. Written me off entirely, have you?
target: 你没来见我。已经彻底放弃我了，是吗？

source: I waited by the pond. I am a fool after all, I suppose.
target: 我一直在池塘边等着。我想，我终究是个傻子。

source: You won't make a fool of me again.
target: 你别想再耍我了。

source: Mother! Uncle. To what do I owe this pleasure?
target: 母亲！叔父。什么风把你们吹来了？

source: Your mother and I demand an audience with you. Since you have not sought us out, we come to find you.
target: 你母亲和我要求与你谈话。既然你不来找我们，我们就来找你。

source: Love, not so prickly. Calm yourself, please.
target: 亲爱的，别这么咄咄逼人。请冷静些。

source: Ergh. What I intended to say was: We'd like to speak to you about reconciliation.
target: 唔。我本来想说的是：我们想和你谈谈和解的事。

source: Lady Ophelia observed you've been menacing towards her.
target: 奥菲莉娅女士提到，你近来对她颇有威胁之意。

source: Always a keen eye, that one. Nothing escapes her observation.
target: 她的眼睛一向很尖。什么都逃不过她的观察。

source: This period of mourning has gone on far too long.
target: 你这哀悼的日子，拖得实在太久了。

source: The young earth lies lazily-packed on my father's ribs, and you're ready to settle into his throne. That's how it is, isn't it?
target: 新土还松松地覆在我父亲的肋骨上，你就已经准备好安坐他的王位了。就是这样，对不对？

source: I am your uncle by blood and father by law. I order you to listen to me without retort.
target: 论血缘，我是你的叔父；论法理，我是你的父亲。我命令你听我说，不许顶嘴。

source: You've no place intimidating the people of this castle. Women especially. It's crude, and beneath a young lord of your standing.
target: 你无权恐吓这座城堡里的人，尤其是女人。这种行为粗鄙不堪，有失你这样身份的年轻贵族的体面。

source: Men must be strong, stalwart, and noble in this house. To perform otherwise shames the Danish crown.
target: 在这个家里，男人必须坚强、坚定、高尚。做不到这些，就是给丹麦王室蒙羞。

source: And furthermore—
target: 还有——

source: I'm leaving.
target: 我要走了。

source: Darling, no, please stay!
target: 亲爱的，别走，求你留下！

source: I think this 'intervention' has run its course.
target: 我想，这场“劝导”也该结束了。

source: My love, you must be tender with him.
target: 亲爱的，你得对他温柔些。

source: Why? Because the sniveling brat can't handle the touch of a firm hand? My brother was a fool of a father, and the boy is weak as a result.
target: 为什么？就因为那哭哭啼啼的小子受不了严厉的管教？我哥哥当父亲当得糊涂，才把这孩子养得这么软弱。

source: Some noble hearts cannot be beaten into obedience. But love them well, and they will love back, ever faithful.
target: 有些高贵的心，靠打是打不服的。但好好爱他们，他们就会回报你的爱，永远忠贞。

source: My son is such a heart.
target: 我的儿子就有这样一颗心。

source: Enough. It was a waste to come here. For all of us.
target: 够了。来这里就是白费工夫。对我们所有人都是。

source: You actually came.
target: 你居然真的来了。

source: When a beautiful woman beneath my station calls, who am I to resist?
target: 一位地位低于我的美人相邀，我又怎能拒绝？

source: You do have a history with that, don't you.
target: 你以前还真没少做这种事，是吧。

source: Why don't you come a little closer? It's terribly dark.
target: 怎么不再靠近一点？这里实在太黑了。

source: Mm. Much.
target: 嗯。好多了。

source: I wanted a moment to speak with you. I've heard some rumors about you and me lately.
target: 我想找个机会和你谈谈。最近，我听到了一些关于你和我的传闻。

source: I know my father called upon the Queen to approach the subject of a betrothal.
target: 我知道父亲拜访过王后，提起了订婚的事。

source: Yes. Do you think there's still any truth to it? Or was your mother merely gossiping?
target: 是的。你觉得这事现在还有几分真的吗？还是你母亲只是在闲聊？

source: I'm sure it's real. Discussions of whom I ought to marry are as old as I am. Older still, perhaps.
target: 我相信是真的。关于我该娶谁的讨论，和我的年纪一样久了。或许还要更久。

source: But I pay no mind to those sorts of matters until I must answer to them.
target: 不过，没到非得表态的时候，我不会去理会这种事。

source: You know, it was cruel of you to have Ophelia ask me to meet you tonight.
target: 你知道吗，让奥菲莉娅来约我今晚见你，这对她太残忍了。

source: It might have given her the wrong impression. I'd hate to hurt her.
target: 这可能会让她误会。我不愿伤害她。

source: Oh, hmph. As if I care what that hysterical hanger-on thinks.
target: 哼。说得好像我会在乎那个歇斯底里的跟屁虫怎么想似的。

source: What did you call her?
target: 你叫她什么？

source: S-She's strange! It's not just me! Everyone thinks so! H-how could you--
target: 她、她就是很奇怪！又不只是我这么觉得！大家都这么想！你、你怎么能——

source: Ophelia is a Lady of Denmark. The same as you. And from the look of it, she's three times the woman you are.
target: 奥菲莉娅是丹麦的贵族女士。和你一样。而且照我看，她比你强上三倍。

source: Don't you ever treat her cruelly again.
target: 你永远不许再欺负她。

source: Stop. You're—scaring—me—
target: 住手。你——吓到——我了——

source: You evil girl. You don't think I see how manipulative you are? Just how stupid do you think I am?
target: 你这恶毒的姑娘。你以为我看不出你有多会操纵别人？你到底把我当成什么傻子了？

source: Ow... My god, you really are insane, aren't you? I'm leaving. How dare you push me!
target: 哎哟……天哪，你真的疯了，是不是？我要走了。你竟敢推我！

source: She's right.
target: 她说得对。

source: I am insane. Or swiftly becoming so.
target: 我疯了。或者很快就要疯了。

source: Hahaha... ha... haha!
target: 哈哈哈……哈……哈哈！

source: Hamlet. You actually came.
target: 哈姆雷特。你居然真的来了。

source: My darling son! Lady Brit! What a pleasure!
target: 我亲爱的儿子！布莉特女士！真高兴见到你们！

source: Your Majesty!
target: 陛下！

source: I do so love strolling out in the utter darkness at midnight, alone. Don't you?
target: 我可喜欢在午夜独自出来，在一片漆黑中散步了。你们呢？

source: Especially unchaperoned!
target: 尤其是没有陪护的时候！

source: We were merely talking, my lady.
target: 我们只是在聊天，王后。

source: Oh? What about?
target: 哦？聊什么？

source: Idle things.
target: 些许闲事。

source: T-The moon is quite full.
target: 月、月亮挺圆的。

source: Oh, of course! I have often known you to take an interest in the phases of the moon, Hamlet.
target: 哦，当然！哈姆雷特，我可没少见你关心月亮的阴晴圆缺。

source: Well, I hope you won't mind if I take my leave of you two, children. I grow tired.
target: 好了，孩子们，希望你们不介意我先告辞。我有些累了。

source: And Brit, I believe you've some needlepoint to attend to, haven't you?
target: 还有，布莉特，我记得你还有些刺绣要做，是不是？

source: Ugh. There's always needlepoint to attend to.
target: 唉，总是有做不完的刺绣。

source: I ought to go.
target: 我该走了。

source: And I as well.
target: 我也是。

source: I should update Irma on the card game. I'm sure she'll be pleased.
target: 我该把牌局的事告诉伊尔玛。我想她一定会高兴的。

source: You say they'll be there for the game?
target: 你说他们会来打牌？

source: That's what they told me.
target: 他们是这么跟我说的。

source: Most excellent. Time to break out the old liar's deck!
target: 太好了。该把那副老千牌拿出来了！

source: Irma never plays a fair game of cards!
target: 伊尔玛打牌可从来不守规矩！

source: Wait. What about the key to Gertrude's room?
target: 等等。乔特鲁德房间的钥匙呢？

source: It's true. A deal is a deal.
target: 也是。说好了就得算数。

source: Truth be told, I never keep that old thing on me. I stash it in the shrubberies by Gerta's room.
target: 说实话，我从不把那老东西带在身上。我把它藏在格尔塔房间旁的灌木丛里。

source: You can go fetch it yourself. I have cards to play!
target: 你自己去拿吧。我还要打牌呢！

source: I should report back to Brit.
target: 我该回去告诉布莉特了。

source: You did it? Thanks. I'm sure he and I will have a wonderful evening.
target: 你办成了？谢谢。我相信我和他会度过一个美好的夜晚。

source: And it's all thanks to you, 'Feely.
target: 这全都要感谢你，菲莉。

source: But you know, I'll be keeping my key all to myself.
target: 不过，我的钥匙还是要留给我自己。

source: But you promised!
target: 可你答应过的！

source: Oh, don't go getting your undergarments rustled. There's another way in.
target: 哎呀，别这么气急败坏。还有别的办法进去。

source: Irma stores her key in the plants outside Gertrude's chambers. I don't think she realizes I know.
target: 伊尔玛把钥匙藏在乔特鲁德寝室外的植物里。我想她还不知道我发现了。

source: If it happened to go missing for a while, who would notice?
target: 要是它碰巧不见了一阵子，谁会注意呢？

source: Hello, Irma.
target: 你好，伊尔玛。

source: Ah, Gerta. Come to bother this old woman?
target: 啊，格尔塔。来烦我这个老太婆了？

source: Don't be like that. I'm sorry I haven't been by recently. I've been busy.
target: 别这样。我最近没来看你，很抱歉。我一直很忙。

source: Yes. I've been cooking. You've been ruling. Everyone's busy.
target: 是啊。我忙着做饭，你忙着治国。大家都忙。

source: Well, I'm here now!
target: 这不，我现在来了嘛！

source: How is that fat husband of yours?
target: 你那个胖丈夫怎么样了？

source: You shouldn't speak of him like that.
target: 你不该这么说他。

source: I suppose he's grown rather round in the past months, hasn't he?
target: 不过，他这几个月好像确实圆润了不少，是吧？

source: It was not an insult. Fat is happy! Fat is proud!
target: 我又不是在骂他。胖就是开心！胖就是得意！

source: He eats everything I make! He keeps me busy. His appetite is a compliment.
target: 我做什么他都吃！他让我忙个不停。他的好胃口，就是对我的夸奖。

source: You know, Norway has extended an olive branch. I'm hoping that will help put Claudius at ease.
target: 你知道吗，挪威已经向我们伸出了橄榄枝。我希望这能让克劳狄斯安心些。

source: A peace offering from the Prince of Norway? You think it is genuine?
target: 挪威王子提出讲和？你觉得他是真心的？

source: There is the possibility Norway will betray us, you know. It's possible the peace agreement wasn't genuine.
target: 你知道，挪威也有可能背叛我们。那份和平协议，可能并非出于真心。

source: Of course it isn't genuine. That young Fortinbras was trying to make war on us all just last week!
target: 当然不是真心的。那个年轻的福丁布拉斯，就在上周还想向我们开战呢！

source: You're always so suspicious, Irma.
target: 你总是这么多疑，伊尔玛。

source: Only of those who have wanted to kill us in the past. Or whose parents we have killed.
target: 我只怀疑那些以前想杀我们的人。或是父母被我们杀了的人。

source: Or in this case, both.
target: 而这次，两样都占了。

source: It is right to be suspicious. Suspicion of every one, and every thing, is the only reason I survive.
target: 多疑是对的。我能活到现在，全靠对每个人、每件事都存着疑心。

source: That aside, I believe that today's meal will be to your liking. The men brought home a boar from the hunt.
target: 先不说这个了，我想今天的饭菜会合你的胃口。男人们打猎带回来一头野猪。

source: I've also stewed some kohlrabi. For old times' sake. Just the sort I made for you when you were a girl.
target: 我还炖了些苤蓝，让你回味回味从前。就是你小时候我给你做的那种。

source: Truly? But you know the others don't care for them!
target: 真的？可你知道其他人都不爱吃！

source: Hm. A pity. I guess you'll have to eat them all yourself.
target: 嗯。真可惜。看来只能让你一个人全吃了。

source: I suppose I will.
target: 看来是这样。

source: Hello again, Irma.
target: 又见面了，伊尔玛。

source: How are you getting by, my lady? Are your spirits high?
target: 您最近过得怎么样，夫人？心情还好吗？

source: I'm managing all right. Nothing I can't handle.
target: 我还应付得来。没什么是我处理不了的。

source: Do you have any more of that kohlrabi?
target: 你那苤蓝还有吗？

source: Things have been sort of trying these last few weeks. But eating these brought me comfort that everything might be all right. I felt like I was a girl again.
target: 这几个星期有些难熬。不过，吃着这些，我心里就有了些安慰，觉得一切也许会好起来。仿佛自己又变回了小姑娘。

source: Hamlet acting up again?
target: 哈姆雷特又闹了？

source: Yes. I'm out of ideas.
target: 是啊。我已经没办法了。

source: If you need to borrow one of my spoons, I give you my blessing. I'm sure you could put it to good use.
target: 要是你想借我一把勺子，我很乐意。我相信你一定能好好用上它。

source: Could even help straighten out the Prince.
target: 说不定还能把王子管教好。

source: I'm still hoping it's just a phase. I'm sure it will pass. But your offer is, as always, very kind.
target: 我还是希望他只是暂时这样。我相信会过去的。不过，你愿意帮忙，还是一如既往地好心。

source: I am sorry about Hamlet, my dear Gerta.
target: 哈姆雷特的事，我很难过，亲爱的格尔塔。

source: Although the boy had his edges, he is gone too soon.
target: 那孩子虽然有些棱角，可还是走得太早了。

source: It's still dawning on me that he's dead. It's like I haven't quite believed it.
target: 我还在慢慢接受他已经死了这件事。好像一直都没真正相信。

source: You've lost a child. You know what it's like. How do I live through this?
target: 你也失去过孩子。你知道那是什么滋味。我该怎么熬过这一切？

source: You don't. A part of you dies.
target: 熬不过去。你的一部分会死去。

source: The part of you that dreamed of embracing them on their wedding day, of watching them grow old, bear children of their own...
target: 那个曾梦想着在孩子婚礼上拥抱他们，看着他们慢慢变老、有自己的孩子的你……

source: That part of you is gone forever.
target: 你的那一部分，永远都回不来了。

source: But the rest of you somehow carries on. And so shall you, little Gerta. So shall you.
target: 可剩下的你，总会以某种方式继续活下去。你也会的，小格尔塔。你也会的。

source: This one is a little crooked.
target: 这幅有点歪。

source: Such a lovely painting. I wonder what your story is?
target: 真是一幅美丽的画。不知道你有怎样的故事？

source: Finally, some peace and--
target: 终于能清静一会儿——

source: Oh, wonderful, it's you. Can't a girl admire art in peace?
target: 哦，真好，是你啊。就不能让一个姑娘安安静静地欣赏艺术吗？

source: I wasn't aware you had such a connection to the royal gallery.
target: 我倒不知道你对皇家画廊这么有感情。

source: You're not aware of much, really, so that's not surprising.
target: 说真的，你不知道的事多了，这也没什么奇怪的。

source: What brings you in here, then?
target: 那你为什么来这里？

source: I enjoy the excuse to be in here, away from the noise.
target: 我喜欢有个借口待在这里，远离那些喧闹。

source: Things are so emotional in the court lately. You'd think royalty would be raised better.
target: 最近宫廷里的人个个都情绪激动。按理说，王室成员的教养该好些才对。

source: You mean Hamlet?
target: 你是说哈姆雷特？

source: Yes. Don't you hear what he says about you?
target: 是啊。你没听见他都怎么说你吗？

source: It's always, 'Ophelia said this!' and 'Ophelia said that!' and 'Get her to a nunnery!' and the like. He can be so tedious.
target: 整天就是“奥菲莉娅说了这个！”“奥菲莉娅说了那个！”“把她送进修道院！”之类的。他有时候真是烦人。

source: And now with Hamlet dead, things have only devolved.
target: 现在哈姆雷特死了，情况反而更糟了。

source: I often come here simply to escape everyone. You included, obviously.
target: 我常来这里，只是为了躲开所有人。当然也包括你。

source: For what little it's worth, I like to hide away sometimes, too.
target: 虽然这话可能没什么用，不过我有时候也喜欢躲起来。

source: Would that we were born men, Ophelia, and had nothing to hide from.
target: 要是我们生来就是男人，没有什么需要躲避的，该多好啊，奥菲莉娅。

source: Look at these beautiful works. Nothing about the artist's will is hidden. He paints beautifully, every expression exquisite in its uniqueness.
target: 看看这些美丽的作品。画家想表达的一切都毫无遮掩。他画得那么美，每一个表情都独具神韵，精妙无比。

source: The colors are incredible. It's as though he's reaching through the frame to grab you by the hand and say, I cannot be ignored.
target: 这些色彩真是绝妙。仿佛他正穿过画框，抓住你的手，说：你不能无视我。

source: I've never looked at these paintings that closely before, I suppose.
target: 我想，我以前还从没这么仔细地看过这些画。

source: I sit here, a golden idiot, idling at the Queen's side. And I brush her hair and listen to her chatter. And it's all...
target: 我却坐在这里，像个镀了金的傻子，在王后身边无所事事。给她梳头，听她絮叨。一切都是……

source: If I were born a man, I would paint and fight and run free. And I would go as far as my feet could take me.
target: 如果我生来是个男人，我就会画画、战斗，自由地奔跑。我的双脚能带我走多远，我就走多远。

source: A-anyhow. No sense telling you in all of that. Begone. De-summon. How do I banish you?
target: 总、总之。跟你说这些也没意义。退下。解除召唤。我到底怎么才能把你驱走？

source: Oh, never mind. I'll go. Bye.
target: 哦，算了。我走。再见。

source: She seems, ah, unusually distressed. I wonder if anyone else in the castle knows why.
target: 她看起来，呃，比平时苦恼得多。不知道城堡里有没有其他人知道原因。

source: Who were you?
target: 你生前是谁？

source: Astrid. Queen Astrid.
target: 阿斯特丽德。阿斯特丽德王后。

source: Such a sad, longing face for a Queen.
target: 身为王后，脸上却满是悲伤与渴望。

source: And such beautiful color work. True artistry.
target: 用色还如此美妙。真正的艺术。

source: I wonder if I could replicate this technique.
target: 不知道我能不能学会这种技法。

source: Who are you talking to?
target: 你在跟谁说话？

source: Not you, 'Feely.
target: 反正不是你，菲莉。

source: Did I ask to be accosted? Why are you here?
target: 我有叫人来搭话吗？你来这里干什么？

source: You sound lonely, for a girl who has the company of the Queen herself.
target: 有王后本人陪着，你听起来却很孤独。

source: Yes, well.
target: 是啊，不过。

source: The company of a Queen means very little. Ask Astrid herself. Ah, right, you can't. Because she's dead.
target: 陪在王后身边，根本没什么意义。你去问问阿斯特丽德本人吧。啊，对了，你问不了。因为她死了。

source: Ophelia? Dear?
target: 奥菲莉娅？孩子？

source: What is it, Father?
target: 怎么了，父亲？

source: I need you to come with me. Quickly, now.
target: 你得跟我来。现在就走，快。

source: Father. King Claudius. Do as you will.
target: 父亲。克劳狄斯国王。随你们的意吧。

source: Are you certain you want to see this through, my lord?
target: 大人，您确定要把这件事进行到底吗？

source: As we discussed earlier, her mind's not well. She needs help.
target: 正如我们先前所说，她的精神出了问题。她需要帮助。

source: It's what's best for her. You know that to be true, Polonius.
target: 这对她最好。你知道这是事实，波洛涅斯。

source: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, Ophelia. But everything you've been saying-- these visions--
target: 对不起。真的对不起，奥菲莉娅。可你一直说的那些事——那些幻象——

source: I don't want any harm to come to you. We'll only send you away for a little while. I promise.
target: 我不想让你受到任何伤害。我们只会把你送走一小段时间。我保证。

source: I'll ensure she's delivered with all the care my men can provide. We'll watch over her, my lord.
target: 我会确保手下的人在护送途中尽力照顾她。大人，我们会看护好她。

source: Thank you, Bernardo.
target: 谢谢你，贝尔纳多。

source: A prison there, or a slightly larger prison here. What difference does it make?
target: 那边是牢笼，这里是稍大一点的牢笼。又有什么区别？

source: Both are the box that was built just for me.
target: 两边都是专为我造的盒子。

source: What is this? What's going on?
target: 这是怎么回事？发生什么了？

source: Do as you will.
target: 随您的意吧。

source: Oh, no.
target: 哦，不。

source: It's what's best for her, Polonius.
target: 这对她最好，波洛涅斯。

source: I'm not delusional, Father. Don't do this.
target: 父亲，我没有妄想。别这样做。

source: You're sending me to an asylum? Really?
target: 你们要把我送进疯人院？真的？

source: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. But everything you've been saying-- these visions--
target: 对不起。真的对不起。可你一直说的那些事——那些幻象——

source: I don't want any harm to come to you. It'll only be for a little while. I promise.
target: 我不想让你受到任何伤害。只要一小段时间。我保证。

source: I was telling you the truth. If you won't believe me, why not just let me go?
target: 我告诉你的都是真话。如果你不肯相信我，为什么不干脆放我走？

source: What is--
target: 这是——

source: Oh no.
target: 哦，不。

source: No, no, no-- this again?
target: 不，不，不——又来？

source: Stop her!
target: 拦住她！

source: Bernardo, give her the dwale. I can't bear to see her like this.
target: 贝尔纳多，给她喝安眠药。我受不了看她这样。

source: Come and drink this, my lady.
target: 来，把这个喝了，小姐。

source: Stay away from me!
target: 离我远点！

source: Why does this keep happening? I'm trying to save you all!
target: 为什么总是这样？我是在想办法救你们所有人！

source: Ophelia. Don't fight me. Please.
target: 奥菲莉娅。别反抗。求你了。

source: Things will be better on the other side, my love.
target: 到了那边就会好起来的，亲爱的。

source: You'll be safe. Nothing will harm you there.
target: 你会很安全。在那里，什么都伤害不了你。

source: I could use the Book of Fates to embrace madness, if I wanted to.
target: 如果我愿意，我可以用命运之书拥抱疯狂。

source: I tried. I tried to tell them. But they wouldn't believe me.
target: 我试过了。我试着告诉他们。可他们不肯相信我。

source: What was that play about, Hamlet?
target: 那出戏到底是什么意思，哈姆雷特？

source: I've been asking myself the same question.
target: 我也一直在问自己同样的问题。

source: Were you upset by it?
target: 那出戏让你不快了？

source: In a number of ways, yes.
target: 是的，好几处都让我不快。

source: Listen. Meet me at midnight. There's something I want to discuss, but this courtyard is neither the time nor the place.
target: 听着。午夜来见我。有件事我想跟你谈谈，可现在不是时候，这个庭院也不是合适的地方。

source: Then I have just the place in mind.
target: 那我正好想到一个地方。

source: My personal chambers are far from the King's ears.
target: 在我的私人寝室里，国王听不到我们说话。

source: Perfect. When I'm done attending to the Queen, I'll come see you.
target: 很好。等我侍奉完王后，就来见你。

source: About that play earlier.
target: 关于先前那出戏。

source: Enough about the play. I ought to have Quince expelled from Elsinore for changing the script I wrote.
target: 别再提那出戏了。奎因斯改了我写的剧本，我就该让人把他赶出埃尔西诺。

source: So you didn't write that script?
target: 所以那个剧本不是你写的？

source: No. Someone else changed the bloody play.
target: 不是。有别人改了那该死的戏。

source: All this after Quince and I had an agreement.
target: 我和奎因斯明明都说好了，居然还出了这种事。

source: Is that what you came here to ask me about? You look white with rage.
target: 你来这里就是想问我这个？你看起来气得脸都白了。

source: No, no, it's nothing.
target: 不，不，没什么。

source: Brit. Why are you shaking so?
target: 布莉特。你怎么抖得这么厉害？

source: Do you know something about the spy's identity?
target: 关于那个间谍的身份，你知道些什么吗？

source: I think we all do.
target: 我想我们都知道。

source: Now no one will disturb us.
target: 现在没人会打扰我们了。

source: (She barred the door?)
target: （她把门闩上了？）

source: Hamlet. We should leave. Now.
target: 哈姆雷特。我们该走了。现在就走。

source: In a moment. I want to understand first.
target: 等一会儿。我想先弄明白。

source: Hold your tongue if you value your life.
target: 还想活命就闭嘴。

source: So it is you. You're the spy.
target: 所以真是你。你就是那个间谍。

source: And here I thought you were at Elsinore to serve my mother.
target: 我还以为你来埃尔西诺是为了侍奉我母亲。

source: You're as much a liar as everyone else in this castle!
target: 你跟这城堡里的其他人一样，都是骗子！

source: I warned you.
target: 我警告过你。

source: Ophelia was right. You should have run.
target: 奥菲莉娅说得对。你本该逃走的。

source: But you never could listen to anyone, could you? Poor idiot.
target: 可你从来就听不进别人的话，对吧？可怜的傻瓜。

source: You knew about me, and you didn't go to Bernardo. I don't know why, but I know you're a threat.
target: 你知道我的身份，却没去找贝尔纳多。我不知道为什么，但我知道你是个威胁。

source: You. You orchestrated that performance somehow, didn't you?
target: 你。是你用什么办法安排了那场演出，对不对？

source: Wait, Brit. We can discuss this.
target: 等等，布莉特。我们可以谈谈。

source: No. We can't.
target: 不。没什么可谈的。

source: Only you had to die. His death was unnecessary.
target: 本来只有你必须死。他没必要死。

source: Now I'm going to have to explain to all of them how Hamlet attacked you, and I had no choice but to turn on him.
target: 现在我得向所有人解释，说哈姆雷特袭击了你，而我别无选择，只能对他动手。

source: Lovers' spats can turn violent so quickly, after all.
target: 毕竟，情侣拌嘴，转眼就可能动起手来。

source: I didn't want to do this. To do any of this.
target: 我并不想这么做。这些事，我一件都不想做。

source: They'll all believe her lies. I know they will.
target: 他们都会相信她的谎话。我知道他们会。

source: I don't think the explanation matters. You're committing treason. That's all I care about.
target: 我觉得解释不重要。你在叛国。我只在乎这一点。

source: I fought to tell Fortinbras I wasn't going to be a killer on his behalf. But that performance was...
target: 我据理力争，告诉福丁布拉斯，我不会替他杀人。可那场演出……

source: I don't know how you knew all of that. It's like you were inside my head. What are you?
target: 我不知道你怎么会知道那些事。就像你钻进了我的脑子。你到底是什么？

source: I didn't want to kill you. I still don't. But that performance...
target: 我不想杀你。现在也不想。可那场演出……

source: They'll all believe her lie. I know they will.
target: 他们都会相信她的那个谎言。我知道他们会。

source: I'm sorry, Brit.
target: 对不起，布莉特。

source: For what?
target: 有什么好道歉的？

source: I know you wouldn't be doing this unless you felt you had no other choice.
target: 我知道，要不是你觉得自己别无选择，你不会这么做。

source: Doing 'this?'
target: “这么做”？

source: You're about to kill me. I don't blame you. But you know you're being used. By your father, by Fortinbras.
target: 你就要杀我了。我不怪你。可你知道自己正在被利用。被你父亲，被福丁布拉斯。

source: Don't act as though you know me! You don't know a damn thing about what I've been through!
target: 别装得好像你了解我！我经历过什么，你他妈的一无所知！

source: She's wrong. I know exactly what she's been through. But that's not enough to save her.
target: 她错了。我清清楚楚地知道她经历过什么。可这还不足以救她。

source: How could you change the play, Quince? We we had a deal!
target: 你怎么能改那出戏，奎因斯？我们、我们明明说好了！

source: A deal? What an interesting interpretation of my words!
target: 说好了？你对我的话，理解得可真有意思！

source: You merely had some suggested material for rewriting the performance. I elected not to follow that material.
target: 你只是提供了一些素材，建议我用来改写演出。我选择不采用那些素材。

source: It's more than that. Someone else is giving you orders. Your play was a mockery of me.
target: 不止如此。有别人在给你下令。你那出戏是在嘲弄我。

source: Who talked to you? Are you working with Claudius?
target: 谁找你谈过？你在跟克劳狄斯合作吗？

source: Who talked to you?
target: 谁找你谈过？

source: I act of my own free will. The same cannot, of course, be said for you.
target: 我的行动出于自己的意愿。当然，你就不是这样了。

source: If he's trying to drive me insane, it's working. I can't do this anymore.
target: 如果他想把我逼疯，那他已经做到了。我再也撑不下去了。

source: E-everyone's against me--
target: 所、所有人都在跟我作对——

source: Everyone's laughing at me now.
target: 现在所有人都在嘲笑我。

source: You don't understand! I had things riding on that performance. Now it's all for nothing.
target: 你不明白！我有些事全指望那场演出。现在一切都白费了。

source: You can't control art, Hamlet. My muse told me to go in a different direction, so I did.
target: 你控制不了艺术，哈姆雷特。我的缪斯让我换个方向，我就照做了。

source: Now please, leave me alone. Putting on a performance of this caliber can be quite draining.
target: 现在，请别打扰我。办一场这样的演出，可是相当耗费精力的。

source: Father. Are you there?
target: 父亲。您在吗？

source: Show yourself. I know you're listening.
target: 现身吧。我知道您在听。

source: My brother lives.
target: 我的弟弟还活着。

source: You had every chance to extinguish him.
target: 你有的是机会除掉他。

source: I had a plan, Father. I was going to reveal him before the entire court. But it failed.
target: 我有个计划，父亲。我本想当着整个宫廷的面揭穿他。可计划失败了。

source: I am a failure. I look the fool.
target: 我是个失败者。我成了个笑话。

source: My son. Remember what I told you in life: One must prevail until no other possible method remains.
target: 我的儿子。记住我生前对你说过的话：只要还有办法，就必须坚持到底。

source: Father, the mantle of my life is crushing me beneath its weight. I want to die. I want to stop the pain so badly, Father. I'd do anything.
target: 父亲，我这一生肩负的重担快把我压垮了。我想死。我太想结束这痛苦了，父亲。为此我什么都愿意做。

source: I know, my son.
target: 我知道，我的儿子。

source: I can sense that you are in the throes of darkness.
target: 我能感觉到，你正在黑暗中苦苦挣扎。

source: And I've disappointed you, too.
target: 而且，我也让您失望了。

source: I'm... I'm sorry.
target: 我……我对不起您。

source: Hamlet. What are you doing up here?
target: 哈姆雷特。你在这上面做什么？

source: Where are the others? Does anyone else know you're up here?
target: 其他人呢？还有谁知道你在这里吗？

source: Hamlet. I came to convince you not to give up.
target: 哈姆雷特。我是来劝你别放弃的。

source: I failed everyone. I failed to protect my father's life and to avenge him of his killer.
target: 我辜负了所有人。我没能保住父亲的性命，也没能向杀害他的凶手报仇。

source: I'm the laughingstock of everyone I've ever known and loved. Even my closest friends have turned on me.
target: 所有我认识过、爱过的人都把我当成笑柄。连最亲近的朋友也背叛了我。

source: Hamlet, stop!
target: 哈姆雷特，住手！

source: Please, stop, I beg of you!
target: 别这样，求求你了！

source: Mother. Go away.
target: 母亲。走开。

source: He berated and insulted me, Mother. The murderer under our noses. He tricked me.
target: 他斥责我，侮辱我，母亲。凶手就在我们眼皮底下。他骗了我。

source: Claudius is a vile, vile man. He tried to threaten my life. How my days must be numbered now!
target: 克劳狄斯卑鄙，卑鄙至极。他竟想威胁我的性命。看来我现在时日无多了！

source: Y-your life? Claudius?
target: 你、你的性命？克劳狄斯？

source: I thought it might be worth standing up to that villainy. But there's no point. Why must violence beget more violence so endlessly?
target: 我原以为，也许值得挺身反抗那种恶行。可这根本没有意义。为什么暴力总是催生更多暴力，永无止境？

source: Time to rid the world of one more pile of human filth.
target: 该让这世上再少一个人渣了。

source: No, no, no, no!
target: 不，不，不，不！

source: This-- This isn't real, is it?
target: 这——这不是真的，对不对？

source: I know he'll be alive again soon enough, but that doesn't matter now.
target: 我知道他很快就会重新活过来，可现在这并不重要。

source: Because of that performance he saw, I hurt him so much.
target: 他看了那场演出，我因此把他伤得那么深。

source: Soon he will have no memory of his pain.
target: 很快，他就不会再记得自己的痛苦。

source: But here, right now, I caused him to take his own life. That he will retain no memory of the death doesn't make it right.
target: 可就在此时此地，是我害他自尽的。他不会记得这次死亡，并不代表我做得对。

source: No. It makes it 'nothing.' Neither right nor wrong. It is meaningless. Rid yourself of guilt. You will need all wits about you if you are to prevail.
target: 不。这意味着它“什么也不算”。无所谓对，也无所谓错。它毫无意义。放下你的愧疚。要想获胜，你就必须保持头脑清醒。

source: How can you say that?
target: 你怎么能这么说？

source: I will never see their deaths as nothing.
target: 我绝不会把他们的死当作什么也不算。

source: Sometimes necessary, maybe. I learned a lot here, today. But never 'nothing.'
target: 也许有时候，这是必要的。今天在这里，我学到了很多。但他们的死绝不是什么也不算。

source: His suffering was real. And his blood is on my hands.
target: 他的痛苦是真实的。他的死，我脱不了干系。

source: We shall see how your opinion evolves as your time spent in this world does.
target: 等你在这个世界待得更久，我们再看看你的想法会如何变化。

source: Next time around, perhaps, will be different.
target: 也许下一次，会有所不同。

source: I hurt him so much.
target: 我把他伤得那么深。

source: I couldn't help you this time, Hamlet. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
target: 这一次，我没能帮上你，哈姆雷特。对不起。真的对不起。

source: Lady Birgitta!
target: 比尔吉塔女士！

source: Brit! Oh, come, now. Don't look so surprised!
target: 布莉特！哎，得了吧。别这么惊讶！

source: Did you miss me?
target: 想我了吗？

source: Shouldn't you be on the sea by now?
target: 你现在不是应该已经出海了吗？

source: Couldn't stay away from you. As always.
target: 舍不得离开你。一直都是。

source: So you're, what? You've returned?
target: 所以你这是，怎么回事？你回来了？

source: Mmm... indefinitely delayed my departure, more like.
target: 嗯……准确地说，是把出发的日子无限期推迟了。

source: My family needs me close right now. My sister especially.
target: 家人现在需要我留在身边。尤其是我妹妹。

source: Oh, come on. 'Feely can't be without her big brother for one little summer?
target: 哎，得了吧。菲莉离了哥哥，连短短一个夏天都过不了？

source: Don't call her that.
target: 别这么叫她。

source: Fine. I won't. But you're tense. What's really going on, Laertes?
target: 好吧。我不叫了。可你绷得这么紧。到底出了什么事，雷欧提斯？

source: We'll talk about it tonight. When we're alone, away from prying eyes.
target: 今晚再说吧。等只有我们两个人，没有旁人窥探的时候。

source: I will see you tonight, yes?
target: 今晚你会来见我，对吧？

source: Of course. Always, love.
target: 当然。一直都会，亲爱的。

source: So much for your time in Paris.
target: 你的巴黎之行就这么结束了。

source: I received some news from home which couldn't be ignored.
target: 我收到了家里的消息，不能置之不理。

source: I'm sorry about your father.
target: 你父亲的事，我很遗憾。

source: So am I. Someone must bury him, and here I am.
target: 我也是。总得有人安葬他，所以我回来了。

source: My father was not perfect. But he was kind, and his heart was noble, and I pray that I do his name justice in the future.
target: 我父亲并不完美。但他为人和善，心地高尚。我祈愿自己将来能不辱他的名声。

source: Might I visit you later?
target: 我晚些时候能见见你吗？

source: My chambers.
target: 在我房里。

source: I'll think on it. I suppose the least I can do is entertain the invitation.
target: 我会考虑的。至少，我想我该考虑一下你的邀请。

source: It's not often you invite me into your chambers, where anyone might see us.
target: 你可不常邀请我到你房里来，谁都有可能看见我们。

source: And it's even less often I would entertain such an invitation at all. Just so we're perfectly clear.
target: 而我愿意考虑这种邀请的时候就更少了。这一点，我们可得说清楚。

source: Fickle as your heart is, it is fond of me. This, I know.
target: 你的心再怎么善变，也还是喜欢我的。这一点，我知道。

source: You fool. Why didn't you go to Paris?
target: 你这个傻瓜。为什么没去巴黎？

source: Maybe then you would've found a girl you could actually wed.
target: 也许去了，你就能找到一个真能娶的姑娘。

source: You fool. Why didn't you stay in Paris?
target: 你这个傻瓜。为什么不留在巴黎？

source: I wish with all my heart your father were still alive, and you had stayed in Paris.
target: 我真心希望你父亲还活着，而你也留在了巴黎。

source: Perhaps then you'd have had the summer you deserved.
target: 也许那样，你就能度过一个你本该拥有的夏天。

source: And you would've found a girl you could actually wed.
target: 也能找到一个你真能娶的姑娘。

source: You already know how I feel about that. Besides...
target: 你早就知道我对此是什么想法。而且……

source: I'm worried for you.
target: 我担心你。

source: I heard you were unwell, and I came to find you.
target: 我听说你不舒服，就来找你了。

source: 'Unwell?' Hmph! Who told you that?
target: “不舒服”？哼！是谁跟你这么说的？

source: She mentioned you were out of sorts. Acting strangely. I told her I hadn't noticed.
target: 她提到你状态不好。举止也很奇怪。我跟她说，我没注意到。

source: Of course, men never notice these things.
target: 当然，男人从来都注意不到这些。

source: Needless to say, these last few months have been some of the darkest of my life.
target: 不用说，这几个月是我一生中最灰暗的一段日子。

source: Thankfully, your sister changed that.
target: 幸好，你妹妹改变了这一切。

source: Yes. I owe her. More than you'll ever know.
target: 是的。我欠她的。欠了多少，你永远不会知道。

source: Did your sister put you up to this?
target: 是你妹妹让你这么做的？

source: She's been awfully friendly lately. Trying to perform all sorts of feats on my behalf.
target: 她最近友好得过了头。总想替我办成各种了不起的事。

source: N-not at all!
target: 没、没有的事！

source: You're a horrible liar.
target: 你真不会撒谎。

source: It's been months, Laertes. I still haven't heard from her.
target: 已经几个月了，雷欧提斯。我还是没有她的消息。

source: Your mother?
target: 你母亲？

source: Yes. She promised she'd write to me each month. And... now... nothing.
target: 是的。她答应过每个月都给我写信。可……现在……什么都没有。

source: I must assume she finds me wretched, or is displeased with me somehow.
target: 我只能猜，她觉得我很糟糕，或者我哪里让她不高兴了。

source: I've spent each day wracking my mind trying to think of why. And I just can't.
target: 我每天都绞尽脑汁，想弄明白为什么。可就是想不通。

source: You haven't received one letter? Wasn't the Queen to make sure you received them?
target: 你连一封信都没收到？不是该由王后确保你收到这些信吗？

source: Yes. But she hasn't brought me anything.
target: 是的。但她什么都没给我带来。

source: In the meantime, I sit, and I thread needles and I read Latin and I advise my lady on her choice of dress and—
target: 这段时间，我就坐着，穿针引线，读拉丁文，给我侍奉的贵人挑衣服出主意，还有——

source: It's all meaningless, Laertes. All of it.
target: 这些都毫无意义，雷欧提斯。全都毫无意义。

source: It's not meaningless, Brit.
target: 并非毫无意义，布莉特。

source: What of your art? Have you found a desire to create lately?
target: 那你的艺术呢？最近有没有创作的念头？

source: Perhaps. If I had the means to do so. But I haven't.
target: 也许有。要是我有创作所需的条件。可我没有。

source: And that ugly little town outside the castle has nothing of use to me.
target: 城堡外那个丑陋的小镇，也没有任何我用得上的东西。

source: It's nothing like Copenhagen, where the masters throw their workshop doors wide in the summertime.
target: 这里一点也不像哥本哈根，那里一到夏天，大师们都会敞开工坊的大门。

source: Have you spoken to Horatio? I believe he's an artist of sorts. He might be of use to you.
target: 你跟霍拉旭聊过吗？我想他也算是个艺术家。也许能帮上你。

source: Perhaps. Perhaps I might. It just seems pointless.
target: 也许吧。也许我会去。只是感觉没什么意义。

source: I shall die here. Or else become someone else's pawn. Just a carved figure they can push around however they like.
target: 我会死在这里。或者成为别人的棋子。只是一个雕出来的小人，任他们随意摆布。

source: Anyhow. Enough of the macabre. So glad to know my despair is castle gossip now.
target: 算了。不说这些阴森的事了。知道我的绝望如今成了城堡里的闲话，我可真高兴。

source: Well, I heard something else. Something strange. But it didn't ring entirely false, either.
target: 嗯，我还听说了另一件事。很奇怪。但听着也不完全像假的。

source: Brit, I heard something strange. But it didn't ring entirely false, either.
target: 布莉特，我听说了一件怪事。但听着也不完全像假的。

source: I see. And you think I can echo it.
target: 明白了。你觉得我也能说出同样的话。

source: Well, you're uncannily good at it, aren't you? But this rumor must remain in absolute confidence.
target: 嗯，你在这方面确实厉害得出奇，不是吗？但这条传闻必须绝对保密。

source: Of course, love. You have my word. You always do.
target: 当然，亲爱的。我向你保证。一向如此。

source: Do you think there's any chance King Claudius might have murdered his brother?
target: 你觉得有没有可能，克劳狄斯国王谋杀了自己的哥哥？

source: Are you serious?
target: 你是认真的吗？

source: W-well, I did think it sounded far-fetched.
target: 呃、嗯，我确实觉得这听起来太离谱了。

source: No, I think it's absolutely true!
target: 不，我觉得这绝对是真的！

source: At least, I think so. I've absolutely no proof to that extent. But I can only imagine he did.
target: 至少，我是这么想的。我完全没有这方面的证据。但在我看来，只可能是他干的。

source: Haven't you seen the official death report in the gallery? It's ludicrous.
target: 你没看过画廊里那份官方死亡报告吗？简直荒唐。

source: You think it's true? If it is...
target: 你觉得是真的？如果真是这样……

source: Then he's fully gotten away with his crime.
target: 那他犯下的罪就彻底逃过了惩罚。

source: Then Claudius died having gotten away with his crime. And he's gone now, so I suppose it doesn't matter.
target: 那克劳狄斯直到死，都没为自己的罪行受过惩罚。现在他已经死了，我想也就无所谓了。

source: Just another way our country is poisoned.
target: 这不过是毒害我们国家的又一种方式。

source: I'm far less concerned. Murder is a tool. Those who wear a crown must use it, and use it well.
target: 我倒没那么担心。谋杀是一种工具。戴王冠的人必须使用它，而且要用得好。

source: If he killed King Hamlet, it's only because his expertise with that tool was defter than King Hamlet's.
target: 如果他杀了哈姆雷特国王，那也只是因为他比哈姆雷特国王更擅长使用这种工具。

source: Well, not everyone feels as secure as you do, I'm afraid.
target: 恐怕不是每个人都像你这样觉得自己很安全。

source: Sadly, you're not the only person I'm worried about.
target: 可惜，我担心的人不止你一个。

source: My sister believes someone wants to hurt her.
target: 我妹妹觉得有人想伤害她。

source: Ultimately, that's the real reason I didn't go to Paris. I couldn't. Not after seeing her face.
target: 说到底，这才是我没去巴黎的真正原因。我走不了。看到她的神情之后，我就走不了了。

source: Ophelia thinks someone wants to hurt her? For what reason?
target: 奥菲莉娅觉得有人想伤害她？为什么？

source: I'm not certain. I know how it sounds. But I believe her.
target: 我不确定。我知道这听起来很奇怪。但我相信她。

source: You've always got your ear to the ground when it comes to gossip within the castle.
target: 城堡里的流言蜚语，你向来消息灵通。

source: Does anyone harbor ill will towards Ophelia? Anyone who would want to cause her trouble or frighten her?
target: 有人对奥菲莉娅怀有恶意吗？有没有谁想给她找麻烦，或者吓唬她？

source: I think you ought to watch Ophelia's back.
target: 我觉得你该保护好奥菲莉娅。

source: If you don't watch over her, what Claudius did to his brother could happen again with her.
target: 如果你不护着她，克劳狄斯对他哥哥做的事，也可能重演在她身上。

source: If you don't watch over her, Claudius might...
target: 如果你不护着她，克劳狄斯可能会……

source: That's what she spoke to me about. What I don't understand is why.
target: 她跟我说的就是这个。我不明白的是为什么。

source: You think the King might harm her? That's quite an assertion.
target: 你觉得国王可能会伤害她？这个说法可非同小可。

source: Think a moment. She broke Hamlet's heart, and he's still smitten with her powerfully.
target: 你想想。她伤透了哈姆雷特的心，可他还是深深迷恋着她。

source: He watches her like a lovesick fool. The King believes it's what's driven him mad.
target: 他像个害相思病的傻瓜一样盯着她。国王认为，这就是他发疯的原因。

source: If Hamlet were to do something foolish, such as ask for her hand in marriage...
target: 如果哈姆雷特做出什么傻事，比如向她求婚……

source: Then Claudius couldn't use him to make political allegiances any longer.
target: 那克劳狄斯就再也不能利用他来结成政治联盟了。

source: And he isn't a popular King. He needs all the ties he can make.
target: 而他并不是一位受拥戴的国王。他得尽可能多地建立关系。

source: Hamlet's been harassing her. Against all possible wisdom, of course.
target: 哈姆雷特一直在纠缠她。当然，这实在是愚蠢至极。

source: You think Hamlet might harm her?
target: 你觉得哈姆雷特可能会伤害她？

source: I don't know. In the worst case scenario, Hamlet might become violent.
target: 我不知道。最坏的情况下，哈姆雷特可能会动粗。

source: And in the best case scenario, the lovesick idiot might ask her to marry him, and she might consent.
target: 而最好的情况下，那个害相思病的蠢货可能会向她求婚，她可能会答应。

source: She seems to be coming apart at the seams somewhat.
target: 她似乎有些撑不住了。

source: I worry that with your father dead, something has changed in her. She's been asking all manner of odd questions.
target: 我担心你父亲死后，她发生了某种变化。她一直在问各种奇怪的问题。

source: I worry that with Hamlet dead, something has changed in her. She's been asking all manner of odd questions.
target: 我担心哈姆雷特死后，她发生了某种变化。她一直在问各种奇怪的问题。

source: Ophelia told me about a strange thing she heard.
target: 奥菲莉娅跟我说了一件她听说的怪事。

source: She said that you had asked her to facilitate a meeting between you and Hamlet.
target: 她说，你曾请她帮忙安排你和哈姆雷特见面。

source: Is that something your father asked you to do?
target: 是你父亲让你这么做的吗？

source: The King and my father both want me to marry Hamlet so that House Brockenhuus will align with Elsinore's intentions.
target: 国王和我父亲都想让我嫁给哈姆雷特，好让布罗肯胡斯家族与埃尔西诺的意图保持一致。

source: Surely you can't mean your father would just give you over to him! Against your will, too!
target: 你该不会是说，你父亲会就这样把你交给他！还不顾你的意愿！

source: I think it's possible.
target: 我觉得有这个可能。

source: My father will do as he pleases. I am merely his extension. A tool.
target: 我父亲会随心所欲。我不过是他的延伸。一个工具。

source: That's horrid.
target: 这太可怕了。

source: It isn't what you want. Not at all. Or is it?
target: 这不是你想要的。完全不是。还是说，你想要？

source: Laertes, you know how I feel. Would that my fate were my own...
target: 雷欧提斯，你知道我的心意。要是我的命运能由自己做主……

source: You and I would...
target: 你和我就会……

source: But, well, look. There's no sense in dwelling on all this.
target: 不过，嗯，算了。一直想这些也没有意义。

source: Besides, we must celebrate you being here. With me.
target: 而且，你在这里，我们该庆祝一下。你在我身边。

source: And here I thought you weren't the sort to be romantic, or something of the like.
target: 我还以为你不是那种会浪漫的人，或者诸如此类的呢。

source: If you don't hush, I'm going to turn right around and leave again.
target: 你再不闭嘴，我可就马上转身走了。

source: (Laertes is--)
target: （雷欧提斯在——）

source: (And Brit is--)
target: （还有布莉特也在——）

source: (I can't even look. I need something to block the sounds out.)
target: （我都不敢看。我得找个东西把声音挡住。）

source: (Oh no. Not again.)
target: （噢，不。怎么又来了。）

source: Before I go, there's something that's on my mind.
target: 走之前，我有件事一直惦记着。

source: Isn't there always?
target: 你不总是这样吗？

source: You said Ophelia asked you to come speak to me.
target: 你说奥菲莉娅让你来跟我聊聊。

source: She did.
target: 是她让我来的。
