source: That explains it, then.
target: 那就说得通了。

source: Reveal yourself, you little pervert. I can hear you mouth breathing.
target: 出来吧，你这个小变态。我听得见你张着嘴喘气。

source: Who are you talking t--
target: 你在跟谁说——

source: I can explain.
target: 我可以解释。

source: How creepy you are? Don't worry, we're thoroughly aware.
target: 解释你有多恶心？别担心，我们清楚得很。

source: I knew something wasn't right with you, Brit. I thought my brother could... help you.
target: 我知道你有些不对劲，布莉特。我以为我哥哥能……帮帮你。

source: I wanted to make things better for you.
target: 我想让你过得好一些。

source: Because I know how hard they've been lately.
target: 因为我知道你最近过得有多艰难。

source: Why would you...
target: 你为什么要……

source: Great. Just great.
target: 好啊。真是好极了。

source: It's so fittingly self-centered that your reaction to 'Please leave me alone, Ophelia, I don't want to become friends' was to try and do even more.
target: 听到“请别来烦我，奥菲莉娅，我不想交朋友”，你的反应居然是试着做更多的事。真是自我中心得很像你。

source: Maybe after I've actually had that drink, I'll be able to better explain how insufferable you are.
target: 也许等我真喝了那杯酒，就能更清楚地说出你有多让人受不了了。

source: No. No. I don't believe you. You're lying to me. You must be. You must want something.
target: 不。不。我不信你。你在骗我。你肯定在骗我。你肯定想要什么。

source: I assure you it's no trick. I don't want anything. Just to be on friendly terms.
target: 我保证，这不是耍花招。我什么都不想要。只是想和你好好相处。

source: You think you can run a couple errands and suddenly we're bosom-born sisters? Y-you... you...
target: 你以为跑几趟腿，我们突然就成了亲密无间的姐妹？你、你……你……

source: Leave me alone! I don't want to be friends. With anyone in this castle. Has that ever occurred to you? That I don't need you?
target: 别来烦我！我不想交朋友。不想和这城堡里的任何人交朋友。你有没有想过这一点？想过我并不需要你？

source: What if you get to know me and you don't even like the real me? The person I really am? You'll just be disappointed.
target: 万一你了解我之后，根本不喜欢真正的我呢？不喜欢我本来的样子呢？你只会失望。

source: I'm going to town as soon as I can. I need a drink. And if you dare tell anyone you saw me leaving the castle, I'll slit your damn throat.
target: 我一有机会就去镇上。我得喝一杯。你要是敢告诉别人，你看见我离开了城堡，我就割断你那该死的喉咙。

source: And don't you dare follow me there, either!
target: 还有，你也休想跟着我去！

source: ...I'm no fool.
target: ……我可不是傻子。

source: (...She still doesn't trust me. I wonder if there's something more I can do. My brother mentioned Horatio and Gertrude.)
target: （……她还是不信任我。不知道我还能做些什么。哥哥提到了霍拉旭，还有乔特鲁德。）

source: I'll be departing now.
target: 我现在就走。

source: You won't tell Father, will you?
target: 你不会告诉父亲吧？

source: You won't tell anyone, will you?
target: 你不会告诉任何人吧？

source: Let's both agree to pretend this never happened.
target: 我们说好了，都当这事从没发生过。

source: Right. That's... probably for the best.
target: 好。这样……大概最好。

source: Lady Ophelia. There's to be a betrothal announcement for Lady Brit and Prince Hamlet in the chapel anon.
target: 奥菲莉娅女士。布莉特女士与哈姆雷特王子的订婚消息，马上就要在礼拜堂宣布了。

source: Right now?
target: 就现在？

source: Yes. Admittedly, it is rather sudden.
target: 是的。这确实有些突然。

source: Nevertheless, I've come to collect you—it would be inappropriate for you to miss this affair.
target: 不过，我是来接您的——您缺席这场仪式不太合适。

source: Lead the way.
target: 带路吧。

source: Lady Ophelia. There's to be a betrothal announcement for Lady Brit and Prince Hamlet here shortly.
target: 奥菲莉娅女士。布莉特女士与哈姆雷特王子的订婚消息，很快就要在这里宣布了。

source: The others will be here in just a moment.
target: 其他人马上就到。

source: My thanks for your prompt attendance, everyone.
target: 感谢各位这么快就赶来。

source: Without further ado, we've something proud to announce.
target: 那就不多说了。我们有一件值得骄傲的事要宣布。

source: My nephew Prince Hamlet and Lady Birgitta are to be betrothed today.
target: 我的侄子哈姆雷特王子与比尔吉塔女士，今日将订立婚约。

source: In light of Lady Birgitta settling into her role within the court, we felt it was the right time to make such a match.
target: 比尔吉塔女士已逐渐适应了自己在宫廷中的身份，我们认为，是时候促成这桩婚事了。

source: Now may Denmark be all the more strengthened by the union of our throne with one of our greatest noble houses.
target: 愿王室与我国最显赫的贵族家族之一联姻，让丹麦更加强盛。

source: My son Prince Hamlet and Lady Birgitta are to be betrothed today.
target: 我的儿子哈姆雷特王子与比尔吉塔女士，今日将订立婚约。

source: (Oh, God.)
target: （哦，天哪。）

source: A-ah, why hadn't I heard of this?
target: 啊、啊，我怎么没听说这件事？

source: Never mind it... yes, never mind it. Pleasant news all around.
target: 不碍事……对，不碍事。总归是件喜事。

source: Bernardo, as the next-closest holy man amongst us, if you would do the honors?
target: 贝尔纳多，在我们之中，你算是最接近神职人员的人了，能否请你主持仪式？

source: My lord, are you certain you don't wish to wait for the castle chaplain to return from his countryside tour?
target: 陛下，您确定不等城堡的牧师从乡间巡访回来吗？

source: Absolutely certain, Bernardo.
target: 十分确定，贝尔纳多。

source: I see. Then of course, my liege. I'll do my best.
target: 明白了。那我当然遵命，陛下。我会尽力。

source: My lady, are you certain you don't wish to wait for the castle chaplain to return from his countryside tour?
target: 王后陛下，您确定不等城堡的牧师从乡间巡访回来吗？

source: I see. Then of course, my lady. I'll do my best.
target: 明白了。那我当然遵命，王后陛下。我会尽力。

source: Let us all bear witness to the betrothal of Prince Hamlet of Denmark, and Lady Birgitta of House Brockenhuus.
target: 让我们共同见证丹麦的哈姆雷特王子，与布罗肯胡斯家族的比尔吉塔女士订立婚约。

source: Honor, riches, marriage, blessing, long continuance, and increasing hourly joys be still upon you.
target: 愿荣誉、财富、婚姻与祝福长久相伴，愿喜乐时时增长，永伴你们左右。

source: Scarcity and want shall shun you.
target: 愿匮乏与贫困远离你们。

source: Are there any who would provide testimony against this venerable union in the eyes of the law and of God Almighty?
target: 在法律与全能的上帝面前，可有人愿意提出证言，反对这庄重的婚约？

source: My poor brother. His face is trembling.
target: 可怜的哥哥。他的脸都在发抖。

source: I've long believed marriage to be a dead institution, but regardless: Best wishes.
target: 我早就认为婚姻制度已经死了。不过无论如何，祝二位幸福。

source: Certainly none from me!
target: 我当然没有异议！

source: Hmph. Perhaps marriage will finally settle the boy's wild side. I support such a union.
target: 哼。也许结了婚，这孩子总算能收敛些。我赞成这门婚事。

source: Excellent. Then...
target: 很好。那么……

source: May the Lord bless this union and guide this couple in their path to marriage.
target: 愿主赐福这份婚约，指引二位走向婚姻。

source: May He watch over them these coming weeks and keep their hearts and souls pure of sin.
target: 愿祂在接下来的几周里守护他们，使他们的心灵纯净，不染罪恶。

source: And may we all remain in good health and good fortune to witness that union.
target: 也愿我们所有人身体康健，福运常在，得以见证他们成婚。

source: (They look miserable, too. I did this to them.)
target: （他们看起来也很痛苦。是我害他们变成这样的。）

source: (And as a result, Laertes' heart is breaking.)
target: （也因此，雷欧提斯的心都要碎了。）

source: (They look miserable. I did this to them.)
target: （他们看起来很痛苦。是我害他们变成这样的。）

source: (I wonder what my brother would think.)
target: （不知道哥哥会怎么想。）

source: (I imagine he'd be suffering now, too.)
target: （我想，他现在也会很痛苦吧。）

source: All is well. There shall be a wedding in several weeks' time!
target: 一切顺利。几周之后，我们就有婚礼了！

source: What do you want?
target: 你想干什么？

source: I came to find you. I thought you might be out here.
target: 我来找你。我想你可能在外面。

source: Did you know this would happen?
target: 你早知道会这样吗？

source: Not precisely, but sort of.
target: 不算确切知道，但多少猜到了。

source: I suspected. My father sent me to Elsinore to make a suitable match.
target: 我有过猜测。父亲送我来埃尔西诺，就是为了找一门合适的婚事。

source: I was the last to know. As usual.
target: 我又是最后一个知道的。一向如此。

source: It happened so swiftly.
target: 这一切来得太快了。

source: Listen, Hamlet. Neither of us were pleased to be in that chapel. I know how you still feel for Ophelia.
target: 听我说，哈姆雷特。我们两个都不愿意站在那间礼拜堂里。我知道你对奥菲莉娅仍有感情。

source: But perhaps there's some kind of arrangement we can broker. Some way we can both find happiness in this mess.
target: 但也许我们能商量出某种安排。找到一个办法，让我们俩都能在这团乱麻里得到幸福。

source: Large things are coming. Events larger than us both. And I fear for you.
target: 大事将至。那些事远非你我能左右。我很担心你。

source: You may be mad, but of the crimes of the others, you are innocent.
target: 你也许疯了，但别人犯下的罪，你并没有份。

source: Surely we can work together within the confines of our matchmaking, no?
target: 就算受这门婚事束缚，我们总能一起想办法，对吧？

source: It's not that simple.
target: 没那么简单。

source: My country expects this of me. My mother—my father—my whole life I knew this would come to pass some day.
target: 我的国家盼着我这么做。我的母亲——我的父亲——我从小就知道，总有一天会走到这一步。

source: But I feel it bearing down on me, crushing me—
target: 可我感觉它正压在我身上，要把我压垮——

source: All of this...
target: 这一切……

source: What about my life? What about what I want?
target: 那我的人生呢？我想要的东西呢？

source: I never asked to be here.
target: 我从没要求过要身处这里。

source: You don't understand what it's like to live under this kind of pressure.
target: 你不明白顶着这种压力生活是什么滋味。

source: You can never truly understand, and I can never truly explain.
target: 你永远都无法真正理解，我也永远无法真正说清。

source: I don't understand? Why, you--
target: 我不明白？你这——

source: You sniveling, spineless, self-absorbed, melodramatic, idiotic child!
target: 你这个哭哭啼啼、没骨气、自私自利、无病呻吟的蠢小孩！

source: You have no idea what I've been through. What I've had to do to be here today.
target: 你根本不知道我经历过什么。为了今天能站在这里，我不得不做些什么。

source: I hoped to come here to barter peace, but you can think of nothing beyond the end of your nose, can you?
target: 我本想来这里谈个和解，可你除了自己眼前那点事，什么都想不到，是不是？

source: In the end, I guess it doesn't really matter.
target: 说到底，我想这也无所谓了。

source: In a few short days, all your burdens shall be lifted from you, poor fool.
target: 再过短短几天，你身上的所有重担都会卸下，可怜的傻瓜。

source: I suspect this betrothal shall be far more drawn-out than that.
target: 我想，这段婚约可会拖得比那久得多。

source: That's not even remotely what I was referring to.
target: 我说的根本就不是那回事。

source: Then you speak in riddles.
target: 那你就是在打哑谜。

source: No. You're just all too clueless to look beyond what's happening right here, in Elsinore.
target: 不。你们实在太糊涂，眼里只有埃尔西诺这里发生的事，看不到外面。

source: And not even I can save you from that short-sightedness.
target: 就连我也救不了你，救不了你的短视。

source: I realize that now.
target: 现在我明白了。

source: I thought there might be a way to help. But it's useless to try.
target: 我本以为也许能帮上忙。但试了也是白费力气。

source: Good night, Hamlet.
target: 晚安，哈姆雷特。

source: I hope you can find some small peace in the days ahead.
target: 希望你在接下来的日子里，能得到些许安宁。

source: I've no time for this. No time to be lectured by you, or anyone else.
target: 我没时间管这些。也没时间听你或任何人说教。

source: That idiot.
target: 那个白痴。

source: S-stupid bottle's nearly empty.
target: 这、这破瓶子都快空了。

source: Laertes! There y'are.
target: 雷欧提斯！原来你在这儿。

source: We, er... well, Brit told us you might be upset. About the impending betrothal, that is.
target: 我们，呃……是这样，布莉特说你可能心情不好。我是说，因为即将订婚的事。

source: We, er... well, we all saw the betrothal, of course.
target: 我们，呃……是这样，订婚仪式我们当然都看到了。

source: We came to see if you were all right, lad.
target: 我们来看看你有没有事，小伙子。

source: Where did you get a bottle of rum in that size?
target: 你从哪儿弄来这么大一瓶朗姆酒？

source: And perhaps more crucially, do you intend to drink the whole thing?
target: 还有，也许更要紧的是，你打算把它全喝光吗？

source: Don't ask, and yes.
target: 别问。还有，是的。

source: She's going to marry him. She's going to be sharing a bed with him.
target: 她要嫁给他了。她要和他睡在一张床上。

source: Low-lifed, small-pricked thief of a boy that he is!
target: 他就是个下三滥、鸡巴小得可怜的毛头小贼！

source: Now, which girl is 'e all besotten over again?
target: 话说，他迷上的到底是哪个姑娘来着？

source: Are you blind, Marcellus? Can you not see Cupid's radiant arrows fly? This is a battlefield!
target: 你瞎了吗，马塞勒斯？没看见丘比特那闪亮的箭在飞吗？这里可是战场！

source: Young Laertes here is deeply in love with Lady Birgitta. Who, as we all know, is a mite above his station.
target: 咱们这位小雷欧提斯，深深爱着比尔吉塔女士。大家都知道，她的身份比他高了那么一点。

source: Grrgh... My father's a Duke, though our coffers may be slim. Don't belittle my options.
target: 唔呃……我父亲可是公爵，哪怕家里钱不多。别小看我能找什么样的人。

source: Ah, titles. I never can remember them. Apologies, Young Laertes.
target: 啊，爵位。我总记不住这些。抱歉，小雷欧提斯。

source: I wish you'd stop calling me that, too.
target: 还有，希望你别再这么叫我。

source: Calling you what, Young Laertes?
target: 怎么叫你，小雷欧提斯？

source: Come now. It's not all bad.
target: 好了。也没那么糟。

source: Besides, didn't Hamlet return your lute to you after all?
target: 再说，哈姆雷特最后不是把鲁特琴还给你了吗？

source: In fact, he never stole it in the first place. Perhaps there is a way to make amends.
target: 其实，那琴从一开始就不是他偷的。也许还有办法和好。

source: He did. But that's not important.
target: 他是还了。可那不重要。

source: Yes. It truly is.
target: 是。确实很糟。

source: H-he's going to take her to bed.
target: 他、他要和她上床了。

source: She'll bear his children, awful rotten creatures in their father's image...
target: 她会给他生孩子，一群跟他们父亲一个样的可恶小混蛋……

source: He's going to treat her as foully as he did my sister.
target: 他会像对待我妹妹那样恶劣地对待她。

source: He knows no kindness. He's petulant. Anxious.
target: 他根本不懂善待别人。他爱耍脾气。焦躁不安。

source: No. He won't marry her.
target: 不。他不会娶她。

source: Not if I have anything to say about it.
target: 只要我还能说得上话，他就别想。

source: I have seen the light. When I was a child, I spoke like a child. But the time has come to put aside childish things.
target: 我已经醒悟了。孩提之时，我说话如同孩童。如今，是时候放下那些幼稚的事了。

source: My father would have wanted me to make this match.
target: 父亲若还在，一定希望我结下这门亲事。

source: No matter what I might desire, the kingdom comes first. That's the sort of King I want to be.
target: 无论我想要什么，王国都该摆在第一位。我想成为这样的国王。

source: You and I both know this is the last thing we desired. And I've no intention of trying to court you, or turn your disgust to love.
target: 你我都知道，这是我们最不想要的结果。我也无意向你求爱，或让你对我的厌恶变成爱。

source: But... you, too, understand the chess board we stand upon.
target: 但……你也明白，我们身处怎样的棋局。

source: You need me for my father's support. I know.
target: 你需要我，好得到我父亲的支持。我知道。

source: With your father's men in my army, I will forge a new destiny for this country. Denmark shall become a feared military power. And soon, others will join us.
target: 有你父亲的人马加入我的军队，我就能为这个国家开创新的命运。丹麦将成为令人畏惧的军事强国。很快，还会有其他人加入我们。

source: So are you ready? To become my bride, that is?
target: 那么，你准备好了吗？我是说，成为我的新娘？

source: And I shall never be ready.
target: 而我永远也准备不好。

source: But if this is the way forward, then I must be.
target: 但如果这是前进的路，我就必须准备好。

source: Well then. We've announcements to make, haven't we?
target: 那好。我们有些事要宣布，对吧？

source: Come, then.
target: 那就走吧。

source: Lady Brit, Hamlet—the time has long since come to get you two together.
target: 布莉特女士，哈姆雷特——早就该让你们两个结为一对了。

source: My wife is champing at the bit to make a good match, as always.
target: 我的妻子还是老样子，迫不及待地想促成一桩好姻缘。

source: Lady Birgitta, we've spoken with your father Soren already. He has given his word. You will be wed.
target: 比尔吉塔女士，我们已经与你的父亲索伦谈过了。他已应允。你们将结为夫妻。

source: And with this union, Denmark's ties with our own local houses will grow to be more powerful than any previous King's.
target: 有了这桩联姻，丹麦王室与本国贵族家族的联系，将比以往任何一位国王在位时都更强。

source: Especially in light of my husband's passing. I know he would have wanted this.
target: 尤其是在我的丈夫去世之后。我知道，他若还在，也会希望如此。

source: Lady Birgitta, we've spoken with your father Soren already. As the de facto speaker for the noble houses, he has given his word. You will be wed.
target: 比尔吉塔女士，我们已经与你的父亲索伦谈过了。他是贵族各家实际上的代言人，已经应允。你们将结为夫妻。

source: My son, are you ready to become a man and take a wife?
target: 我的儿子，你准备好成为一个男人，娶妻成家了吗？

source: Now? You're certain?
target: 现在？您确定吗？

source: Mother, this is rather sudden.
target: 母亲，这有些太突然了。

source: I understand. And for that, I apologize. But Denmark must have a King upon the throne.
target: 我明白。为此，我向你道歉。但丹麦的王位上必须有一位国王。

source: My dear Hamlet. If you do not take Lady Brit as your wife, then you and I will surely be ousted from Elsinore.
target: 亲爱的哈姆雷特，如果你不娶布莉特女士，你我一定会被赶出埃尔西诺。

source: We no longer control the nobility. They will elect any successor they deem fit. This union is the best for all parties.
target: 我们已经无法控制贵族了。他们会选出任何一个自己认为合适的继承人。这桩婚事对各方都是最好的。

source: But truly, we should be grateful that Brit's father is so amenable to this marriage.
target: 说真的，布莉特的父亲如此赞同这门婚事，我们应该心怀感激。

source: So... my son, are you ready?
target: 那么……我的儿子，你准备好了吗？

source: No. I'm not. My heart belongs elsewhere. And I will not force it to withhold.
target: 不。我没有。我的心另有所属。我不会强迫自己压抑这份感情。

source: But Hamlet--
target: 可是，哈姆雷特——

source: Enough. If I am to be King, I need to make my own decisions.
target: 够了。如果我要成为国王，就得自己做决定。

source: I made a promise to Ophelia that I would ensure our future was ours alone.
target: 我向奥菲莉娅许过诺，要确保我们的未来只由我们自己决定。

source: Unless she herself rejects me, my faith is with her. I apologize, Brit, but I cannot marry you.
target: 除非她亲自拒绝我，否则我会忠于她。对不起，布莉特，但我不能娶你。

source: This is very like my son.
target: 这可真像我儿子的作风。

source: He'll come around. I'm sure of it.
target: 他会回心转意的。我确信。

source: No. But Father would have wanted me to make this match.
target: 没有。但父亲若还在，一定希望我结下这门亲事。

source: What about you, Lady Brit? Will you take Hamlet as your God-given husband?
target: 你呢，布莉特女士？你愿意接受哈姆雷特，做你上帝赐予的丈夫吗？

source: If that is your wish, my lady.
target: 如果这是您的心愿，王后陛下。

source: Brit. Listen.
target: 布莉特。听我说。

source: I was not in love with Hamlet's father when I met him. I found him to be cold. Distant. Frightening. But I soon came to love him all the same.
target: 初见哈姆雷特的父亲时，我并不爱他。我觉得他冷漠。疏远。令人害怕。但尽管如此，我很快还是爱上了他。

source: Time can turn even the most unwilling heart to softness. Time will grow a boy into a husband worth honoring, or a girl into a proud wife.
target: 时间能让最不情愿的心也变得柔软。时间会让男孩成为值得敬重的丈夫，或让女孩成为自豪的妻子。

source: And there is yet time for us all, now that peace has come to Elsinore.
target: 如今埃尔西诺迎来了和平，我们大家都还有时间。

source: Come. Celebrations must be made. Let us depart for now.
target: 来吧。这事得好好庆祝。我们先走吧。

source: Well, it's fortunate for both of us, then, that you have no choice in the matter.
target: 那么，你在这件事上没有选择，对我们两个来说倒是好事。

source: I hope this process might change your heart, my son.
target: 我的儿子，我希望在这个过程中，你能改变心意。

source: This is the best possible thing for you and for Denmark. Some day you will understand I do this not to cause you pain, but out of love.
target: 对你和丹麦而言，这是最好的安排。总有一天你会明白，我这么做不是为了让你痛苦，而是出于爱。

source: What about you, Brit? Will you take Hamlet as your God-given husband?
target: 你呢，布莉特？你愿意接受哈姆雷特，做你上帝赐予的丈夫吗？

source: Wonderful. Now, Hamlet.
target: 太好了。那么，哈姆雷特。

source: I was not in love with your father when I met him. I found him to be cold. Distant. Frightening. But I soon came to love him all the same.
target: 初见你的父亲时，我并不爱他。我觉得他冷漠。疏远。令人害怕。但尽管如此，我很快还是爱上了他。

source: Time can turn even the most unwilling heart to softness. Time will grow a boy into a man, or a girl into a loving wife.
target: 时间能让再不情愿的心也变得柔软。时间会让男孩长成男人，让女孩成为满怀爱意的妻子。

source: Such a strange season, this one.
target: 这个时节真是古怪。

source: The air becomes thicker with each passing hour.
target: 每过一个小时，空气就更沉闷一些。

source: Y-you... Yer a damn fool.
target: 你、你……你就是个该死的蠢货。

source: Are you drunk?
target: 你喝醉了？

source: How very like you.
target: 还真像你会干的事。

source: Y'don't even love her.
target: 你根本就不爱她。

source: Brit. Y'don'deserve to be her husband.
target: 布莉特。你不配当她的丈夫。

source: That's what this is about? That bloody betrothal?
target: 就为了这个？那桩该死的婚约？

source: What are you going on about now?
target: 你现在又在胡说些什么？

source: Yyyer goin' to marry her. H-heard about it from her myself. On account of her father's wishes. But she doesn' want to marry you.
target: 你、你、你要娶她。我、我亲耳听她说的。因为她父亲希望如此。可她不想嫁给你。

source: I don't want her either. All she does is sneer. I think she's vile.
target: 我也不想娶她。她成天只会冷嘲热讽。我觉得她很卑劣。

source: What did you call her?
target: 你说她是什么？

source: You're a God-damned fool.
target: 你就是个他妈的蠢货。

source: Did you come all this way only to tell me that?
target: 你大老远跑来，就为了跟我说这个？

source: You-- You killed him. You'd known him all your life. And still you killed him.
target: 你——你杀了他。你从小就认识他。可你还是杀了他。

source: You-- You tried to kill him. You'd known him all your life. And still you tried to kill him.
target: 你——你想杀他。你从小就认识他。可你还是想杀了他。

source: My father was always good and kind to you, was he not? Was he not the consummate gentleman?
target: 我父亲一直对你很好，很和善，不是吗？他难道不是一位无可挑剔的绅士吗？

source: All you've ever done is ruin things. Everything. Everything you touch.
target: 你从来就只会毁掉一切。一切。所有你碰过的东西。

source: Everyone around you bears the brunt of the hole that threatens to rip you open.
target: 你心里那个快把你撕裂的空洞，伤得最深的却是你身边所有人。

source: It'd be far better if you— just—
target: 要是你——干脆——就好得多了。

source: You're right.
target: 你说得对。

source: It's as I told you before—when I returned your lute to you. You're right. All I do is ruin things.
target: 就像我以前跟你说过的——在我把鲁特琴还给你的时候。你说得对。我只会毁掉一切。

source: And now I want to build something, for once.
target: 现在，我想创造些什么，哪怕只有这一次。

source: I need Brit to do that. Neither of us are happy with this arrangement.
target: 为此，我需要布莉特。我们两个都不满意这个安排。

source: You think I don't know you love her?
target: 你以为我不知道你爱她？

source: I want to honor that, Laertes.
target: 我想尊重这份感情，雷欧提斯。

source: I'm sorry about your father. I never meant that night to end as it did. Truly.
target: 你父亲的事，我很抱歉。我从没想让那一晚落得那样的结局。真的。

source: And if I could go back and unwind all that transpired, I would.
target: 如果能回到过去，逆转发生过的一切，我一定会。

source: I am a sick, strange fool, and always shall be. But from now on...
target: 我是个病态、古怪的蠢货，也永远都会是。但从今以后……

source: No more of me, Laertes. I shall trouble you and yours no more. This, I promise.
target: 你再也不用受我的烦扰了，雷欧提斯。我不会再给你和你身边的人添麻烦。我保证。

source: You don't want to do this, Laertes.
target: 你并不想这么做，雷欧提斯。

source: I know that face. I've been there many a time.
target: 我认得那种神情。我也有过很多次。

source: Go. Leave me, and we'll pretend this never happened.
target: 走吧。离开我，我们就当这事从没发生过。

source: He would have killed me.
target: 他本来会杀了我的。

source: Good riddance.
target: 死了倒清净。

source: H-he's dead—
target: 他、他死了——

source: What have I done?
target: 我都干了些什么？

source: What's wrong?
target: 怎么了？

source: Your face is so peculiar right now.
target: 你现在的表情好奇怪。

source: He's dead.
target: 他死了。

source: He's dead.
target: 他死了。

source: What did you do, Laertes?
target: 你做了什么，雷欧提斯？

source: No. Surely you didn't...
target: 不。你该不会……

source: I was angry, and I didn't know what I was doing.
target: 我当时很生气，根本不知道自己在做什么。

source: I pushed Hamlet off the walls. Hamlet is dead. I killed him.
target: 我把哈姆雷特推下了城墙。哈姆雷特死了。是我杀了他。

source: Come here, love.
target: 过来，亲爱的。

source: What shall become of us now?
target: 现在我们会落得什么下场？

source: Listen, Laertes. Listen closely to my words.
target: 听着，雷欧提斯。仔细听我说。

source: Your hands are stained with blood. But now that they are, you must stain them once more.
target: 你的双手已经沾了血。可既然已经沾了，就必须再沾一次。

source: And I know now that you have the courage to do it.
target: 而现在我知道，你有勇气这么做。

source: The other nobles, including my father, want Claudius dead. He's a poor King.
target: 其他贵族，包括我父亲，都想让克劳狄斯死。他是个不称职的国王。

source: In fact, my father asked me to spy on his court and find a way to kill him off.
target: 其实，我父亲让我窥探他的宫廷，想办法除掉他。

source: So you were the spy the King was so concerned about.
target: 原来你就是那个让国王如此担心的间谍。

source: Did you try to kill my sister?
target: 你想过要杀我妹妹吗？

source: Me? Harm your sister? Of course not, love. Just frightened her a little by accident.
target: 我？伤害你妹妹？当然没有，亲爱的。只是无意中稍微吓着她了。

source: Ophelia has such an imaginative quality to her, don't you think?
target: 奥菲莉娅这个人特别爱幻想，你不觉得吗？

source: Of course you would never do my sister harm. I don't know why I suspected you.
target: 你当然不会伤害我妹妹。我也不知道自己为什么会怀疑你。

source: (I should've known it was Brit all along.)
target: （我早该知道，一直都是布莉特。）

source: (If I move now, she'll only kill me again. I have to find another way.)
target: （如果我现在有所动作，她只会再杀我一次。我得另想办法。）

source: I... I am. But trust me, Laertes. I never would have hurt anyone except Claudius.
target: 我……我是。但相信我，雷欧提斯。除了克劳狄斯，我绝不会伤害任何人。

source: If you could find it in your heart to use these hands further, then the whole bad tree will be uprooted.
target: 如果你能狠下心，让这双手再做些事，就能把整棵恶树连根拔起。

source: And with all these vile men dead and gone, you and I would linger to love in peace.
target: 等这些卑劣的男人都死了，你我就能留下来，安安稳稳地相爱。

source: There would no longer be anyone to obstruct us. You see?
target: 再也不会有人阻挠我们。明白吗？

source: I'll do it. I'll go to see the King. I'll take his life. It should be me.
target: 我来做。我会去见国王。我会取他的性命。这事该由我来。

source: Whatever we do now, we do it together. I'll accompany you.
target: 现在无论做什么，我们都一起做。我会陪你去。

source: Your hands are stained with blood. That can never be forgotten. But it can be turned into something powerful for us.
target: 你的双手已经沾了血。这件事永远无法被遗忘。但它可以化为我们强大的助力。

source: The other nobles, including my father, wanted Claudius and Hamlet dead. Claudius was an awful King. His people hated him.
target: 其他贵族，包括我父亲，都想让克劳狄斯和哈姆雷特死。克劳狄斯是个糟糕透顶的国王。他的子民都恨他。

source: He planned to marry me to Fortinbras. This betrothal to Hamlet was a mere sham. But I never wanted that. You know that to be true.
target: 他打算把我嫁给福丁布拉斯。与哈姆雷特的婚约不过是个幌子。可我从来都不愿意。你知道这是真的。

source: And with the both of them gone, we can cement my claim to the throne quickly. My father will push through the election in my favor.
target: 克劳狄斯和哈姆雷特都不在了，我们就能迅速巩固我对王位的继承权。我父亲会推动选举，让我当选。

source: I'm going to be Queen of Denmark. And you shall be my King Consort. No one will ever put a stop to me loving you again.
target: 我将成为丹麦女王。而你会成为我的王夫。再也没有人能阻止我爱你。

source: Not now. Not ever. Laertes, this is good for the both of us. We've triumphed.
target: 现在不会。永远都不会。雷欧提斯，这对我们两个都是好事。我们赢了。

source: This is nothing like I thought it would be.
target: 这和我想象的完全不一样。

source: I don't know what to say.
target: 我不知道该说什么。

source: There's no need to fear any longer, my love.
target: 不用再害怕了，亲爱的。

source: I'll send word to Prince Fortinbras to strike quickly at Elsinore's heart while the castle is weakened.
target: 我会给福丁布拉斯王子传信，让他趁城堡虚弱，迅速直击埃尔西诺的心脏。

source: From there, everything will proceed quickly. You'll see.
target: 到那时，一切都会进展得很快。你会看到的。

source: You've done right. Sometimes what is right and what is good are at odds.
target: 你做得对。有时候，正确的事与善良的事并不一致。

source: But make no mistake. This was right. Even if it didn't feel good.
target: 但你要明白。这事确实做对了。哪怕心里并不好受。

source: You know what has to be done.
target: 你知道必须做什么。

source: And I came prepared to do it.
target: 我就是为此准备好了才来的。

source: He lies down there, asleep in his chamber.
target: 他就躺在那边，在自己的寝室里睡着。

source: I'll go and do the deed.
target: 我去把这事办了。

source: What? What's wrong? Is it done?
target: 什么？怎么了？办成了吗？

source: No. No, it's not done. H-his face is-- it's--
target: 没有。没有，还没办成。他、他的脸——那张脸——

source: Hush. You'll wake him. Go outside.
target: 嘘。你会吵醒他的。到外面去。

source: If Claudius hadn't resembled my father as he slept, I'd have done it.
target: 要不是克劳狄斯睡着的样子像我父亲，我早就下手了。

source: I could have. Would have.
target: 我本可以下手。一定会下手。

source: I see... a dagger before me, the handle turned towards my hand.
target: 我看见……一把匕首悬在眼前，刀柄朝着我的手。

source: Come, let me clutch it.
target: 来，让我握住你。

source: I-- I have you not-- and yet I see you still--
target: 我——我握不住你——却依然看得见你——

source: This is a false creation. A fatal vision.
target: 这是虚妄的幻象。致命的幻影。

source: Yet I do see you still, and on your blade... gouts of blood.
target: 可我确实仍看得见你，还有你刀刃上……一团团的血。

source: No. There's no such thing.
target: 不。根本没有这东西。

source: While I stand here entertaining this insanity, he lives.
target: 我站在这里胡思乱想时，他还活着。

source: This heated deed must not be cooled.
target: 这炽热的杀意，绝不能冷却。

source: It's as good as done. I can practically hear the guards ringing the midnight bell.
target: 这事就算成了。我几乎已经能听见卫兵敲响午夜的钟。

source: But you can't hear it, Claudius, can you?
target: 可你听不见了，克劳狄斯，是不是？

source: It is a knell. It summons you to Heaven-- or to Hell.
target: 那是丧钟。它召你去天堂——或是地狱。

source: W-who's there?
target: 谁、谁在那儿？

source: ...Only an owl.
target: ……只是一只猫头鹰。

source: He must be... doing it... right now, surely.
target: 他现在一定……正在做那件事……一定是。

source: The deed is done. Could you hear any noise?
target: 事已办成。你听见什么声响了吗？

source: I heard the owl scream and the crickets cry.
target: 我听见猫头鹰尖叫，蟋蟀啼鸣。

source: My hands are a sorry sight. Covered in his blood.
target: 我的双手惨不忍睹。沾满了他的血。

source: That's foolish. Don't call it 'a sorry sight'. We did what we had to.
target: 别说傻话。别说什么“惨不忍睹”。我们做了不得不做的事。

source: You mustn't think of what we did. It'll make us mad.
target: 别去想我们做过的事。那会让我们发疯的。

source: I thought I heard a whisper in there. It cried, 'Sleep no more'. It felt like a curse.
target: 我好像听见里面有个声音在低语。它喊着：“从此不得安眠。”像是诅咒。

source: Come. Lift your head. Wash your hands, and I'll wash mine.
target: 来。抬起头。洗洗你的手，我也洗洗我的。

source: My hands are just as bloody as yours, but I'd be ashamed to be carrying on like this.
target: 我的手和你的一样沾满了血，可要是我也像你这样闹个没完，我会觉得羞耻。

source: Let's return to your chambers. A little water will clear away all of this.
target: 我们回你的房间吧。一点水就能洗掉这一切。

source: Claudius is dead. As it should have been. As it shall now be.
target: 克劳狄斯死了。本来就该如此。如今也就如此了。

source: I know what has to be done.
target: 我知道必须做什么。

source: Is this a dagger I see before me? The handle turned towards my hand?
target: 我眼前的是一把匕首吗？刀柄朝着我的手？

source: The deed is done.
target: 事已办成。

source: I thought I heard a whisper, in there. It cried, 'sleep no more.' It felt like a curse.
target: 我好像听见里面有个声音在低语。它喊着：“从此不得安眠。”像是诅咒。

source: You told me you were afraid.
target: 你跟我说过，你很害怕。

source: I want you to know that I believe you. I believe you're in danger.
target: 我想让你知道，我相信你。我相信你有危险。

source: But if what you say is true—then you'd better leave the investigation to me.
target: 但如果你说的是真的——那你最好把调查交给我。

source: And why is that?
target: 为什么？

source: Because if someone does want to cause you harm, they're watching any moves you make already.
target: 因为如果有人确实想害你，那人早就在盯着你的一举一动了。

source: I don't want you caught up in this further.
target: 我不想让你再牵扯得更深。

source: So... I'm going to turn to someone I trust implicitly.
target: 所以……我打算找一个我完全信任的人帮忙。

source: They have a keen insight into everyone's comings and goings within Elsinore, and might be able to help us narrow down a suspect.
target: 那人对埃尔西诺每个人的来往行踪都很了解，或许能帮我们缩小嫌疑人的范围。

source: Someone you 'trust?'
target: 一个你“信任”的人？

source: And who might that be, exactly?
target: 具体是谁呢？

source: Just because you're my sister doesn't mean you know all my secrets, you know.
target: 你是我妹妹，可不代表你知道我所有的秘密啊。

source: (Hmm. If he won't be honest with me, perhaps I can do some investigation of my own.)
target: （嗯。要是他不肯跟我说实话，或许我可以自己调查一下。）

source: A 'contact'?
target: 一个“熟人”？

source: You mean Brit.
target: 你是说布莉特。

source: How did you know?
target: 你怎么知道的？

source: You're so many wonderful things, Laertes. Subtle is not one of them.
target: 你有很多优点，雷欧提斯。可藏得住心思不在其中。

source: True enough. Yes, Brit's got a knack for understanding the undercurrents in Elsinore, so to speak.
target: 说得没错。对，布莉特很擅长看透埃尔西诺的那些暗流，可以这么说。

source: I'll meet with her and understand what I must do from there.
target: 我会去见她，再弄清楚接下来该做什么。

source: I used to have someone I could trust in times like these.
target: 以前遇上这种事，我还有个能信任的人。

source: But she proved herself a liar. So it's just you and me.
target: 可她原来是个骗子。所以现在只剩你和我了。

source: Don't tell anyone the things you told me, all right? I wouldn't want this to create a larger panic than it must.
target: 你跟我说的那些事，别再告诉别人了，好吗？我不希望这事引起不必要的恐慌。

source: Lady Birgitta, a moment, please.
target: 比尔吉塔女士，请留步。

source: I need to ask you some questions.
target: 我需要问您几个问题。

source: My men have begun a search of your chambers.
target: 我的人已经开始搜查您的房间了。

source: Is there anything they might find there which you wish to disclose?
target: 他们可能会在那里找到什么，您想提前说明一下吗？

source: Are you asserting something about me, Guard Captain? Is there some charge you wish to levy on me?
target: 卫兵队长，你是在指控我什么吗？你想给我安上什么罪名？

source: Let us assume charges are forthcoming for the time being.
target: 眼下，您不妨先当作很快就会受到指控。

source: This must be a mistake. And frankly, the Queen would be livid to know you detained one of her ladies.
target: 这一定是弄错了。说实话，王后若知道你扣押了她的一位侍女，一定会大发雷霆。

source: This must be a mistake. And frankly, it's embarrassing for you to detain a lady like this.
target: 这一定是弄错了。说实话，像这样扣押一位贵族女士，丢的是你的脸。

source: I do not require the Queen's permission to act in the Crown's best interests.
target: 为了王室的最大利益行事，我不需要王后的许可。

source: I do this with the Crown's full permission. Things have changed, Lady Brit.
target: 我的行动得到了王室的全权许可。形势已经变了，布莉特女士。

source: So I shall ask you just once more. Is there anything you want to tell me, before they find it?
target: 所以我再问您最后一次。在他们找到东西之前，您有什么想告诉我的吗？

source: What are you insinuating?
target: 你在暗指什么？

source: No! There isn't! Leave me alone!
target: 没有！什么都没有！别来烦我！

source: I'm going now. I was just on my way to town.
target: 我要走了。我正要去镇上。

source: I am afraid I cannot let you depart the castle.
target: 恐怕我不能让您离开城堡。

source: You are to be detained for the time being.
target: 您将被暂时拘押。

source: No! You're not going to put me in that rotten dungeon. You have no proof of anything!
target: 不！你休想把我关进那个烂地牢。你什么证据都没有！

source: Stop struggling. I can sling you over my shoulder if I must. Or you can take my arm and go quietly.
target: 别挣扎了。必要的话，我可以把您扛在肩上带走。或者，您也可以挽着我的手臂，安安静静地跟我走。

source: I owe you an apology.
target: 我欠您一个道歉。

source: For what?
target: 为什么？

source: I did not believe you. Not at first. Please, come with me.
target: 我没有相信您。起初没有。请跟我来。

source: For putting you in danger until now.
target: 因为我让您一直身处险境，直到现在。

source: Laertes relayed your fears to me, and at first, I did not believe them. Please, come with me.
target: 雷欧提斯向我转达了您的担忧，起初我并不相信。请跟我来。

source: See the announcement?
target: 要看宣布消息吗？

source: All, I bring rather unfortunate news. We have uncovered certain illegitimate activities within the castle which collectively amount to treason.
target: 各位，我带来了一个很不幸的消息。我们查出了城堡内的一些非法活动，综合来看，这些行为已构成叛国。

source: I apprehended Lady Birgitta earlier today. She is in custody now.
target: 今天早些时候，我逮捕了比尔吉塔女士。她现在已被拘押。

source: Brit? You're saying she is the one who's been passing information to Norway?
target: 布莉特？你是说，一直向挪威传递情报的人是她？

source: Although you had spoken to us earlier, I still find this distressing beyond belief. I welcomed Lady Brit to this court myself. Are we certain it's true?
target: 虽然你之前已经跟我们说过，我还是难过得无法相信。我亲自欢迎布莉特女士来到宫廷。我们确定这是真的吗？

source: I'm afraid so, my lady. And were it not for Lady Ophelia's involvement, we'd never have uncovered the link.
target: 恐怕是的，王后。若不是奥菲莉娅女士参与其中，我们绝不会查出这层联系。

source: Brit's the one who's been passing information to Norway?
target: 一直向挪威传递情报的人是布莉特？

source: I knew the Brockenhuus family was sympathetic to them, but I didn't expect Brit to be capable of this, truth be told.
target: 我知道布罗肯胡斯家族倾向于支持他们，但说实话，我没想到布莉特会做出这种事。

source: I'm afraid so. And were it not for Ophelia's involvement, we'd never have uncovered the link.
target: 恐怕是的。若不是奥菲莉娅参与其中，我们绝不会查出这层联系。

source: She must be punished to the fullest extent, just as any other scoundrel would be.
target: 必须像对待其他恶徒一样，给予她最严厉的惩罚。

source: If that is your wish, my lord. She is in the dungeon now.
target: 如果这是您的意愿，陛下。她现在就在地牢里。

source: We ought not to lend her any delicacy just because she's a woman. She ought to be punished.
target: 我们不该因为她是女人就对她手下留情。她应当受罚。

source: I must admit I didn't think her capable of such a thing, either.
target: 我得承认，我也没想到她能做出这种事。

source: She seemed to be wholly uninterested in international affairs.
target: 她看起来对国际事务完全不感兴趣。

source: She is in the dungeon now, my Prince.
target: 王子殿下，她现在关在地牢里。

source: We intend to get to the bottom of her deception, and to fully understand the circumstances of her crimes.
target: 我们打算查清她的骗局，彻底弄清她犯罪的来龙去脉。

source: I'll be interrogating her there each day until I've received satisfactory answers.
target: 我会每天在那里审问她，直到得到令我满意的回答。

source: This is not a thing I find joy in. It is dark work, interrogation. But it is open to any who would bear witness.
target: 我并不以此为乐。审讯是件阴暗的差事。但任何愿意作见证的人都可以来旁观。

source: I must return to work. Good day, ladies and gentlemen.
target: 我得回去办事了。女士们，先生们，告辞。

source: (I know now that Brit truly was after my life.)
target: （我现在知道，布莉特确实想要我的命。）

source: (If that's the case, and she's in the dungeon, then... )
target: （如果真是这样，而她又关在地牢里，那么……）

source: (I can't rest easy until I know for certain I might live.)
target: （我得确定自己有可能活下来，才能安心。）

source: (If I live to see Saturday afternoon, then I'll know.)
target: （如果我能活到星期六下午，就知道了。）

source: (Quince did something to make it so Brit no longer tries to take my life. She's already been spying for some time, though.)
target: （奎因斯确实做了什么，让布莉特不再试图杀我。不过，她已经当了一阵子间谍了。）

source: Thank you for letting me know. I don't need to see anything more.
target: 谢谢你告诉我。我不需要再看什么了。

source: I understand. This must be frightening news. Let me know if there's anything I can do.
target: 我理解。这消息一定很吓人。如果有什么我能做的，请告诉我。

source: My apologies.
target: 请原谅我。

source: For not initially believing you about Lady Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.
target: 一开始，你说罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士有问题时，我没有相信你。

source: Please, come with me.
target: 请跟我来。

source: For putting you in danger with my ignorance to something taking place right under my nose.
target: 事情就在我眼皮底下发生，我却一无所知，害你身陷险境。

source: All, I bring rather unfortunate news. We have uncovered certain suspicious behavior which, regrettably, warranted an arrest.
target: 各位，我带来了一个不幸的消息。我们发现了一些可疑行为，遗憾的是，这些行为足以构成逮捕的理由。

source: Lady Rosencrantz and Guildenstern were apprehended earlier. They are both in custody now.
target: 罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士先前已被逮捕。她们现在都已被拘押。

source: Hamlet's friends? But they've only just arrived. It cannot be!
target: 哈姆雷特的朋友？可她们才刚到啊。不可能！

source: I believe it is only a temporary detainment, my lady, until I understand the cause of their strange behavior.
target: 王后陛下，我想这只是暂时拘留，等我查清她们行为异常的原因。

source: Still, matters of national security being what they are lately, I would rather be overly cautious.
target: 不过，近来国家安全形势如此，我宁可谨慎过头。

source: I understand entirely.
target: 我完全理解。

source: Them? Treason? Why, they're an inane side show.
target: 她们？叛国？她们不过是两个无聊的活宝。

source: Yes. I believe it is only a temporary detainment until I understand the cause of their strange behavior.
target: 是的。我想这只是暂时拘留，等我查清她们行为异常的原因。

source: If indeed they're found guilty, they ought to be punished.
target: 如果确实查明她们有罪，就应当惩罚她们。

source: You shall be the first to know if so, my lord. They are in the dungeon now.
target: 陛下，若是如此，我会第一时间禀报您。她们现在关在地牢里。

source: They are both in the dungeon now, and shall remain so until I can learn more.
target: 她们现在都关在地牢里，在我查明更多情况之前，会一直关在那里。

source: Once there is relevant information to share, you shall all be the first to know. Good day, ladies and gentlemen.
target: 一旦有相关消息可以告知，我会第一时间通知各位。女士们，先生们，告辞。

source: Knowing they're safely contained is enough.
target: 知道她们已经被严加看管，就够了。

source: I'll take my leave of you, then.
target: 那么，我就告辞了。

source: I come bearing dismal news. My apologies.
target: 我带来了一个坏消息。很抱歉。

source: Your father has been arrested for treason.
target: 你父亲因叛国被逮捕了。

source: I'll need to let the others know of your father's arrest.
target: 我得把你父亲被捕的事告诉其他人。

source: All, I bring rather unfortunate news. We have uncovered certain suspicious behavior which warranted an arrest.
target: 各位，我带来了一个不幸的消息。我们发现了一些可疑行为，足以构成逮捕的理由。

source: Lord Polonius was arrested and charged with treasonous activity. He is in custody now.
target: 波洛涅斯大人已被逮捕，并被控犯有叛国罪。他现在已被拘押。

source: Lord Polonius? But he's long been faithful to both of my husbands-- and to me. It cannot be!
target: 波洛涅斯大人？可他多年来一直忠于我的两任丈夫——也忠于我。不可能！

source: I'm afraid so, my lady. And were it not for Ophelia's involvement, I'd never have known.
target: 恐怕确实如此，王后陛下。而且，若不是奥菲莉娅介入，我永远不会知道。

source: And here I thought Polonius would chew his own arm off before betraying the King. Faithful to a fault.
target: 我还以为波洛涅斯宁可咬掉自己的胳膊，也不会背叛国王。他忠诚得简直过了头。

source: Suppose I've been wrong before, though.
target: 不过，我以前也看错过人。

source: I'm afraid so. And were it not for Ophelia's involvement, I'd never have known.
target: 恐怕确实如此。而且，若不是奥菲莉娅介入，我永远不会知道。

source: I ought to have known he would turn on me. He always was more faithful to my brother. How blind I was.
target: 我早该知道他会背叛我。他一向更忠于我的兄弟。我真是有眼无珠。

source: He must be punished to the fullest extent, just as any scoundrel would be.
target: 必须给他最严厉的惩罚，和其他恶棍一样。

source: Of course, my lord. He is in the dungeon now.
target: 当然，陛下。他现在关在地牢里。

source: Of course, there's no concern for alarm. He's in the dungeon now, and shall remain so until I can learn more.
target: 当然，不必惊慌。他现在关在地牢里，在我查明更多情况之前，会一直关在那里。

source: As soon as I have more information to share, I shall bear it to you all. Good day, ladies and gentlemen.
target: 一有更多消息可以告知，我就会向各位禀报。女士们，先生们，告辞。

source: (He'll be safe in the dungeon for the time being.)
target: （他待在地牢里，暂时会是安全的。）

source: I don't think I can endure it, Bernardo.
target: 贝尔纳多，我觉得我承受不了。

source: I understand completely.
target: 我完全理解。

source: It pains me to have to do this. I trusted your father deeply. I hope you know that. These are strange times we live in.
target: 不得不这么做，我也很痛苦。我曾非常信任你父亲。希望你明白这一点。我们身处的这个时代真是古怪。

source: My men found certain letters in your rooms, Lady Brit, which are written in a most peculiar fashion.
target: 布莉特女士，我的人在你的房间里找到了一些信，写法十分古怪。

source: At first, simply mundane. A letter to a lady-friend asking her to visit. Then another. Then one to your mother.
target: 起初看着只是些寻常信件。一封写给女性朋友，邀请她来探望。然后又是一封。接着是一封写给你母亲的信。

source: Birgitta Sophie Brockenhuus. That's your full name, correct? As I've heard it, the roots of the Brockenhuus family run deep.
target: 比尔吉塔·索菲·布罗肯胡斯。这是你的全名，对吧？据我所知，布罗肯胡斯家族的根基很深。

source: Yours is the Danish branch, but if one traces the generations up the tree, one quickly finds the stock wanders... northward.
target: 你们是丹麦这一支，但只要沿着族谱往上追溯几代，很快就会发现，这一族的血脉延伸到了……北方。

source: You seem to write your mother fondly. And you've been sending her drawings of the countryside, haven't you?
target: 你写给母亲的信似乎很亲切。你还一直给她寄乡间风景画，是不是？

source: I draw. And I paint. Is there harm in that?
target: 我画素描，也画油画。这有什么错吗？

source: At first I thought them simple drawings of the world seen from Elsinore's heights. But these are no idle sketches. These are maps. And troop markings.
target: 起初，我以为那只是你从埃尔西诺高处看到的景色。但这根本不是随手画的素描。这是地图。上面还有驻军标记。

source: You've passed them information about every stationed man from here to the next northern harbor!
target: 从这里到北边下一个港口，每一名驻军的情报都被你送给了他们！

source: For what purpose have you passed this information to your family?
target: 你把这些情报传给家人，究竟是什么目的？

source: If you're waiting for me to cave, we'll be here a long time.
target: 如果你在等我屈服，那我们可得在这里耗上很久。

source: Allow me to be frank. Your crime is immutable. But the punishment is yet to be determined.
target: 我就直说了。你犯罪的事实已经无法改变。但惩罚还没定。

source: My men have been dispatched to your family's home. I'm confident that by tonight, we'll have our answer, with or without your consent to speak.
target: 我已经派人去了你家。我确信，无论你愿不愿意开口，今晚我们都会得到答案。

source: Leave my family out of this. I acted alone.
target: 别把我的家人牵扯进来。这是我一个人干的。

source: That's impossible. I don't believe it for a single moment. I know your father. I know what sort of man he is.
target: 不可能。我一点也不信。我认识你父亲。我知道他是什么样的人。

source: I said, I acted alone.
target: 我说了，这是我一个人干的。

source: I will not permit you to sign your death warrant yet. I will return tomorrow.
target: 我还不会让你就这么自寻死路。我明天会再来。

source: Perhaps a night of sleeping on stone will rouse your reason.
target: 也许在石头上睡一晚，就能让你清醒些。

source: Then you must bear the full burden of the crime.
target: 那你就得承担这桩罪行的全部责任。

source: Lady Birgitta Brockenhuus, I sentence you to die this night.
target: 比尔吉塔·布罗肯胡斯女士，我判你今晚处死。

source: Regardless of any confession you make now—it's too late for that.
target: 无论你现在招供什么都没用——已经太迟了。

source: The King is in danger. And so are you.
target: 国王有危险。你也一样。

source: Nothing you do can save the throne of Denmark now.
target: 如今，无论你做什么，都救不了丹麦的王位。

source: Even killing me won't stop the axe from falling.
target: 就算杀了我，也阻止不了斧头落下。

source: God, please, I don't want to die.
target: 上帝啊，求求你，我不想死。

source: Someone, save me from this hell!
target: 谁来救救我，让我离开这地狱！

source: Good day.
target: 日安。

source: P-Please, may I have something to eat?
target: 求、求求你，能给我一点吃的吗？

source: Or water, please...
target: 或者给点水，求求你……

source: Ah. I see a night in the cell has broken your silence.
target: 啊，看来在牢里过了一夜，你终于肯开口了。

source: I have a flagon of water here. Are you ready to talk about the letters?
target: 我这里有一壶水。你准备好谈谈那些信了吗？

source: You'll get nothing until then.
target: 在那之前，你什么也得不到。

source: The sketches are for Norway.
target: 那些素描是给挪威的。

source: For Prince Fortinbras?
target: 给福丁布拉斯王子？

source: H-His men have been coming to my father's home to retrieve them.
target: 他、他的人一直来我父亲家取这些画。

source: For what purpose?
target: 是什么目的？

source: Please, God, the water!
target: 求求你，上帝啊，给我水！

source: No. Not yet.
target: 不行。还不行。

source: Fortinbras... he's looking for weak points in the court. In Claudius's court. He thinks he can take the throne.
target: 福丁布拉斯……他在寻找宫廷的弱点。克劳狄斯宫廷的弱点。他觉得自己能夺取王位。

source: M-my father is working with him. He voted against Claudius's approval to the throne. The nobility are unhappy. Please, the water, I'm begging you, please!
target: 我、我父亲在和他合作。表决是否认可克劳狄斯继位时，他投了反对票。贵族们很不满。求求你，给我水，我求你了，求求你！

source: So Soren Brockenhuus finally shows his colors. Gutless bastard.
target: 索伦·布罗肯胡斯终于露出真面目了。没种的混蛋。

source: I think I'll keep this water. There's some confession left in you yet.
target: 我想，这水还是留着吧。你还有些事没交代。

source: Were I you, I'd be singing like a bird when I return tomorrow.
target: 换作是我，等我明天再来时，就会把一切都招出来。

source: See you soon, Lady Birgitta.
target: 很快再见，比尔吉塔女士。

source: I believe I've heard more than enough, then.
target: 那么，我想我听到的已经够多了。

source: Let's resume.
target: 我们继续。

source: Wake up, traitor.
target: 醒醒，叛徒。

source: Or I'll empty this water skin over your head.
target: 不然我就把这水囊里的水全倒在你头上。

source: I thought I heard Mother.
target: 我还以为听见母亲的声音了。

source: Mother, please, I need water, this fever's getting worse, tell Father to call for the doctor...
target: 母亲，求求你，我需要水，我烧得越来越厉害了，让父亲去请医生……

source: And something ice cold to eat, too, please, Mother...
target: 还要一点冰凉的东西吃，求求你，母亲……

source: Your constitution's even weaker than I thought. Three days and you've come completely undone. Pitiful.
target: 你的体质比我想的还弱。才三天，你就彻底垮了。可悲。

source: Tell me.  When does Norway plan to move against Denmark?
target: 告诉我。挪威打算什么时候对丹麦动手？

source: I never wanted to come to Elsinore. I hate it here, Mother, please, I want to go home!
target: 我从来就不想来埃尔西诺。我讨厌这里，母亲，求求你，我想回家！

source: I want to paint the ceiling, I want to paint the floors, why are they always black?
target: 我想给天花板涂上颜色，我想给地板涂上颜色，为什么它们总是黑的？

source: No matter how long I let the oil sit, it doesn't dry. It just... won't dry!
target: 不管我把油彩放多久，它都不干。它就是……怎么也不干！

source: I did everything I was told. I thought I was being good. Wasn't I enough?
target: 他们叫我做的事，我全做了。我以为我很乖了。我还不够好吗？

source: Stop this.
target: 别这样了。

source: There must be some sanity left in you. I'll repeat it: When does Norway plan to attack?
target: 你肯定还剩一点理智。我再问一遍：挪威打算什么时候进攻？

source: Why does Father shout at us all the time? Why does he shake me? Mother, we can leave! You can come with me!
target: 父亲为什么总是冲我们吼？为什么要摇晃我？母亲，我们可以走！你可以跟我一起走！

source: We can go somewhere... far away from him...
target: 我们可以去一个地方……离他远远的……

source: Well, regardless—you are a confessed traitor now.
target: 好了，不管怎样——你现在已经承认自己是叛徒了。

source: Hee hee hee... ha ha ha ha ha ha!
target: 嘻嘻嘻……哈哈哈哈哈哈！

source: The King is in danger!
target: 国王有危险！

source: Nothing you do can save Denmark now.
target: 如今，无论你做什么，都救不了丹麦。

source: Even killing me.
target: 就算杀了我也一样。

source: God, please, I don't want to die!
target: 上帝啊，求求你，我不想死！

source: Someone help me!
target: 谁来救救我！

source: It is only by the grace of the Queen's earlier orders to me that we perform this execution here, and not out in public.
target: 全凭王后先前给我的命令所赐，我们才会在这里处决你，而不是当众行刑。

source: I cannot pretend to have sympathy for you otherwise. I never thought you capable of this.
target: 除此之外，我无法假装同情你。我从没想过你能做出这种事。

source: And Lady Ophelia, my apologies that you came to witness something like this. I must warn you, it is unpleasant work, though necessary.
target: 还有，奥菲莉娅女士，很抱歉让你来目睹这样的事。我必须提醒你，这件差事虽然必不可少，却很不好受。

source: I understand, Bernardo. Thank you.
target: 我明白，贝尔纳多。谢谢。

source: On your knees, Lady Brit.
target: 跪下，布莉特女士。

source: Lady Birgitta Brockenhuus, you are hereby sentenced to die for the crime of highest treason against the Danish Crown.
target: 比尔吉塔·布罗肯胡斯女士，你犯下了背叛丹麦王室的重罪，现判处你死刑。

source: You have passed correspondence directly with the head of an enemy state.
target: 你曾直接与敌国首领通信。

source: And so I have.
target: 是，我确实这么做了。

source: Let this be a warning to all who threaten the sanctity of the Body of Denmark.
target: 愿此事警示所有胆敢侵犯丹麦国体神圣尊严的人。

source: May they meet the same fate.
target: 愿他们落得同样的下场。

source: My Queen?
target: 王后陛下？

source: I order you to free her.
target: 我命令你放了她。

source: My lady, I cannot do that. This order comes from your husband.
target: 王后陛下，我不能这么做。这是您丈夫的命令。

source: Yes. He seeks to make an example of her. But all three of us know the truth.
target: 是的。他想拿她杀一儆百。但我们三个人都知道真相。

source: Her father Lord Brockenhuus is the true culprit behind this treason. He has sought the throne for months now. She is merely the puppet.
target: 她的父亲布罗肯胡斯大人才是这场叛乱背后的真正主谋。他觊觎王位已经好几个月了。她不过是个傀儡。

source: My husband knows that killing her will temper Lord Brockenhuus's ambitions. But I know Brit. This is not her design.
target: 我丈夫知道，杀了她就能遏制布罗肯胡斯大人的野心。但我了解布莉特。这不是她的谋划。

source: My lady, I cannot do that. This order was among the King's last.
target: 王后陛下，我不能这么做。这是国王生前最后的几道命令之一。

source: Yes. He wished to make an example of her. But he's gone now, and all three of us know the truth.
target: 是的。他当时想拿她杀一儆百。但他已经不在了，而我们三个人都知道真相。

source: My husband knew that killing her would temper Lord Brockenhuus's ambitions. But I know Brit. This is not her design.
target: 我丈夫当时知道，杀了她就能遏制布罗肯胡斯大人的野心。但我了解布莉特。这不是她的谋划。

source: Isn't that right, Brit?
target: 是这样吧，布莉特？

source: M-My lady, stop. I don't deserve your intervention.
target: 王、王后陛下，别这样。我不值得您出面相救。

source: Yes, you do.
target: 你值得。

source: I will not have you spill the blood of a young girl over her father's crimes.
target: 我不会允许你因为父亲犯下的罪，就让一个年轻姑娘流血。

source: I understand your sympathies, my lady, and I share them. But I cannot disobey a direct order.
target: 王后陛下，我理解您的同情，也有同样的感受。但我不能违抗直接下达的命令。

source: Then we shall kill her, to all the world.
target: 那么，就让世人以为我们杀了她。

source: I'm—confused. Did you not ask me to stay my hand?
target: 我——不明白。您不是让我住手吗？

source: We shan't kill her, merely make a show that she is dead. I will remove her from Elsinore.
target: 我们不杀她，只做出她已经死了的假象。我会把她送离埃尔西诺。

source: I see. So you intend to smuggle her out.
target: 我明白了。您是打算偷偷把她送出去。

source: My lady, if the King finds out...
target: 王后陛下，要是国王发现了……

source: He won't. Because you're to leave Denmark entirely, Brit.
target: 他不会发现的。因为你要彻底离开丹麦，布莉特。

source: My lady, if anyone were to find out...
target: 王后陛下，要是有人发现了……

source: They won't. Because you're to leave Denmark entirely, Brit.
target: 他们不会发现的。因为你要彻底离开丹麦，布莉特。

source: What are you doing?
target: 您在做什么？

source: You will stay at my sister's court, Margaret of Austria, in her care.
target: 你会住在我的姐妹、奥地利的玛格丽特的宫廷里，由她照顾你。

source: Although my sister Margaret of Austria is dead, you will stay with her nephew, at her court.
target: 虽然我的姐妹、奥地利的玛格丽特已经去世，但你会住在她的宫廷里，和她的侄子一起。

source: You will assume a new name and a new title. You will not speak of your old life.
target: 你会换一个名字，一个头衔。不得提起过去的生活。

source: And you will go alone, in a carriage I arrange for you in utmost privacy. Do you understand?
target: 你要独自离开，乘坐我为你秘密安排的马车。明白了吗？

source: O-Oh, my God.
target: 哦——哦，天哪。

source: You're-- you want me to-- leave Denmark forever?
target: 您——您要我——永远离开丹麦？

source: Now you understand.
target: 现在你明白了。

source: I don't, though. Why are you doing this for me?
target: 可我不明白。您为什么要这样帮我？

source: This can never be a world worth living in if women don't protect one another.
target: 如果女人不互相保护，这个世界就永远不值得我们活下去。

source: Men will sell us, breed us, hit us, dishonor us, and kill us. They rend us apart the moment they're born from us.
target: 男人会贩卖我们，让我们生育，殴打我们，羞辱我们，杀害我们。他们从我们体内出生的那一刻，就把我们撕裂了。

source: Someday there will be a young girl in your care suffering the way you've suffered recently.
target: 总有一天，你照顾的一个年轻女孩，会遭受你最近遭受的苦难。

source: And you must protect her life with your last breath. Do you understand?
target: 你必须保护她的性命，直到自己咽下最后一口气。明白了吗？

source: I do.
target: 是的。

source: Now get up.
target: 现在起来。

source: I have one final command to you, as your Queen and the lady you serve.
target: 作为你的王后，也是你侍奉的女主人，我还有最后一道命令给你。

source: Never return to Denmark. Never write to your father or your mother. Never think of the life you had.
target: 永远不要回丹麦。永远不要给父亲或母亲写信。永远不要再想起过去的生活。

source: My lady, I would honor this request outright, but I have promised your husband some proof.
target: 陛下，我本愿直接遵从您的要求，但我已经答应您的丈夫，要给他一些证据。

source: Especially in light of your request that Lady Birgitta be executed in a hidden place, rather than in public.
target: 尤其是您要求在隐秘的地方处决比尔吉塔女士，而不是公开行刑。

source: I see. My husband knows my true character. He likely suspects me of something like this.
target: 我明白了。我的丈夫知道我的真实秉性。他大概怀疑我会做出这种事。

source: Will cutting off a hand do?
target: 砍下一只手够吗？

source: I think that should suffice, yes.
target: 是的，我想应该够了。

source: You're going to take off my hand?
target: 你们要砍掉我的手？

source: Would you rather it was your head?
target: 你宁愿被砍掉的是脑袋吗？

source: Cut away, then.
target: 那就砍吧。

source: Just, please, not my left hand. That's the one I hold a brush in.
target: 只是，求求你，别砍左手。我用那只手握画笔。

source: The right hand it is, then. The flesh on your wrist must be singed to stop the bleed. And Her Majesty and Lady Ophelia need not be present.
target: 那就右手吧。必须烧灼你手腕上的皮肉来止血。王后陛下和奥菲莉娅女士不必在场。

source: All of us shall agree to never speak of this incident. Isn't that right, Ophelia?
target: 我们所有人都要答应，永远不提这件事。对吧，奥菲莉娅？

source: If that's what the Queen wants.
target: 如果这是王后的意思。

source: Of course. My eternal thanks, Ophelia, Bernardo.
target: 当然。奥菲莉娅，贝尔纳多，我会永远感激你们。

source: Today, Brit is dead.
target: 今天，布莉特已经死了。

source: I don't know how to repay you, my lady.
target: 陛下，我不知道该怎么报答您。

source: I was so cruel to you. And to everyone. I followed Fortinbras' commands. I can never change that.
target: 我曾那么残忍地对待您。也对待所有人。我听从了福丁布拉斯的命令。那些事，我永远也改变不了。

source: You were a child in the middle of war. Go, and join no more battles.
target: 你只是个身陷战争的孩子。去吧，别再参与任何争斗。

source: Go, and live.
target: 去吧，活下去。

source: I shall be brief with the cutting, and use a sharp axe.
target: 我会用一把锋利的斧头，尽快砍完。

source: Come with me.
target: 跟我来。

source: Please, Bernardo, will you do me one kindness? Will you write my mother?
target: 求你了，贝尔纳多，能再帮我一个忙吗？能给我母亲写封信吗？

source: Will you tell her I love her, now and forever?
target: 能告诉她，我爱她，现在爱她，永远都爱她吗？

source: Kindness is a virtue not normally afforded to traitors.
target: 仁慈是一种美德，但通常不会施予叛徒。

source: But, yes. I will promise you that one small thing.
target: 不过，好吧。这件小事，我答应你。

source: Thank you. Thank you. Goodbye, the both of you. And get on with it.
target: 谢谢。谢谢。再见了，你们两位。动手吧。

source: It is you. Excellent.
target: 是你。太好了。

source: No! This shouldn't be happening! I—
target: 不！这不该发生！我——

source: I did not intend to trouble you, lady.
target: 小姐，我无意让你烦恼。

source: What are you doing out here?
target: 你在这里做什么？

source: Commending you for your most excellent performance. I've heard Lady Brit was apprehended for her, mm, shall we say, aspirations.
target: 来赞赏你极其出色的表现。我听说布莉特女士被捕了，因为她的，嗯，不妨说是，志向。

source: I'd like to trim the fat from this act, as it were. Cut straight to the action. Reduce the tedium.
target: 我想给这一幕删去些冗余，可以这么说。直接进入正戏。少些乏味。

source: I find repetition in plays absolutely boring. I've even been known to walk out at the intermission!
target: 我觉得戏里反复重复的情节实在无聊。人们都知道，我甚至会在幕间休息时离场！

source: What are you talking about?
target: 你在说什么？

source: What was once canonical can be rewritten.
target: 曾经既定的情节，也可以改写。

source: Take my word for it that Lady Brit will never trouble you again.
target: 相信我的话，布莉特女士再也不会给你添麻烦了。

source: The dangling plot thread is, shall we say, snipped.
target: 那条悬而未决的剧情线，怎么说呢，已经剪断了。

source: I look forward to seeing what tomorrow brings. It will be a refreshing change of pace for both actor and audience, I think.
target: 我很期待明天会带来什么。我想，对演员和观众而言，这都会是一次令人耳目一新的节奏变化。

source: Farewell, my lady! Adieu!
target: 再见，我的小姐！告辞了！

source: Does this mean I'm free of all this? Of this repeating world? And I'll move forward with the rest of my life now?
target: 这是不是说，我摆脱这一切了？摆脱这个不断重复的世界了？从现在起，我就能继续过完余生了？

source: That nightmare I had—it didn't end when Hamlet killed my father.
target: 我做过的那个噩梦——并没有在哈姆雷特杀死父亲时结束。

source: I also saw the King and Queen dead. I saw my brother murder Hamlet.
target: 我还看到了国王和王后死去。看到了哥哥谋杀哈姆雷特。

source: Does that mean... that's what's coming for me? And they're all going to die, all of them?
target: 这是不是说……这些就是我接下来要面对的？他们全都会死，一个也不剩？

source: Oh, my dear. You know, the weather is quite wonderful in Elsinore this time of year!
target: 哦，亲爱的。你知道吗，每年这个时候，埃尔西诺的天气都美妙极了！

source: Do try to enjoy the next day fully. One mustn't trouble oneself with the future until it has come to pass.
target: 务必尽情享受接下来的一天。未来还没到来，就不该为它烦恼。

source: Strange, as usual.
target: 还是一如既往地古怪。

source: He's clearly trapped outside the flow of time, like me. But... in a different sort of way. More powerful.
target: 他显然和我一样，被困在时间的流动之外。但……方式有所不同。他更有力量。

source: I can use him to my advantage. He seems to know more about my situation than he lets on.
target: 我可以利用他来帮自己。对于我的处境，他似乎知道得比透露出来的更多。

source: Brit, please tell me everything I've heard is untrue.
target: 布莉特，求你告诉我，我听到的一切都不是真的。

source: I heard you have been passing information to Norway.
target: 我听说，你一直在向挪威传递情报。

source: This is ridiculous, right? It's not true, is it?
target: 这太荒唐了，对吧？这不是真的，对不对？

source: It's true.
target: 是真的。

source: Then why? Why would you do it?
target: 那为什么？你为什么要这么做？

source: Listen closely.
target: 仔细听我说。

source: I last began passing information to Fortinbras by way of my father several months ago. It's why I was sent to Elsinore.
target: 最近这一次，我是几个月前开始通过父亲向福丁布拉斯传递情报的。这就是我被派到埃尔西诺的原因。

source: The other nobles, including my father, wanted Claudius dead. He was a poor King.
target: 其他贵族，包括我父亲，都想让克劳狄斯死。他不是个好国王。

source: He disregarded all advice and requests which came his way. He ignored my father.
target: 送到他面前的所有建议和请求，他都置之不理。他不理睬我父亲。

source: And to ignore powerful men is to wish for one's own death.
target: 而无视那些有权势的男人，就是自寻死路。

source: And then I found you. And your father. And you knew so much. You're a startlingly perceptive man.
target: 后来，我遇见了你。还有你父亲。你知道那么多事。你的洞察力强得惊人。

source: I... see.
target: 我……明白了。

source: So you were using me for information.
target: 所以你一直在利用我获取情报。

source: No! No, I wasn't! Listen, Laertes: I love you.
target: 不！不，我没有！听我说，雷欧提斯：我爱你。

source: But a coup is what the country needs. I truly believe it in my heart. Denmark deserves a better King.
target: 但这个国家确实需要一场政变。我打心底里相信这一点。丹麦值得拥有一个更好的国王。

source: If my father succeeds in helping Norway overthrow the throne, then the whole bad tree be uprooted. You see?
target: 如果我父亲能成功帮助挪威推翻王权，那整棵烂树就会被连根拔起。你明白吗？

source: And with all these vile men dead and gone, you and I would remain to love in peace.
target: 等这些卑鄙的男人全都死去，你和我就能留下来，平静地相爱。

source: There would no longer be anyone to stop us. You see?
target: 再也不会有人阻止我们。你明白吗？

source: I do see.
target: 我确实明白了。

source: I see that I was the more deceived.
target: 我明白了，原来我被骗得更深。

source: I've been passing information from my father to you in confidence for months.
target: 这几个月来，我出于信任，一直私下把从父亲那里听来的消息告诉你。

source: You're saying all of that went right to Norway?
target: 你是说，那些消息全都直接传到了挪威？

source: Even if you intended to keep me alive, do you really believe Norway would stage a coup without bloodshed?
target: 就算你打算让我活下来，你真的相信挪威会发动一场不流血的政变？

source: What about my sister? She's clearly terrified. She thinks someone's after her. Was that your doing, too?
target: 那我妹妹呢？她显然吓坏了。她觉得有人要害她。这也是你干的？

source: She's not wrong. It was me.
target: 她没想错。确实是我。

source: But I had no choice. Fortinbras and my father came up with this plan.
target: 但我别无选择。这个计划是福丁布拉斯和我父亲想出来的。

source: Then why weren't you honest with me? We could have uncovered a solution together!
target: 那你为什么不对我说实话？我们本可以一起找到解决办法！

source: I was afraid.
target: 我害怕。

source: I didn't truly believe I could trust you.
target: 我并不真的相信自己可以信任你。

source: It's been discussed. Her death would have put many things in motion.
target: 这件事有人商议过。她的死本会推动许多事情。

source: But no. I couldn't. I wouldn't. She's done nothing to deserve it.
target: 但不。我下不了手。我不愿意。她没做过任何该受这种惩罚的事。

source: Well, in the end, that's not what's important.
target: 算了，说到底，这并不重要。

source: You lied to me and used me. That's as much as I need to know.
target: 你欺骗我，利用我。知道这些就够了。

source: Bernardo, you may come in now. I had hoped to prove her innocence, but I believe you heard everything you needed to hear.
target: 贝尔纳多，你现在可以进来了。我本想证明她的清白，但我相信，该听到的你都听到了。

source: I'm here to escort you to the dungeon until we're able to thoroughly investigate your confession, my lady.
target: 女士，我来押送您去地牢。在我们能彻底查清您供认的事情之前，您都要待在那里。

source: And my men will be looking through your personal effects.
target: 我的手下还会搜查您的私人物品。

source: Then this is to be the end of me.
target: 那么，我就要这样完了。

source: So be it. I knew this might happen.
target: 那就这样吧。我知道可能会有这一天。

source: I wished with all my heart that things could have been different.
target: 我曾真心希望，事情能有不同的结果。

source: And for what little it's worth, Laertes, I am truly, abysmally sorry.
target: 尽管这话没什么用，雷欧提斯，我真的、深深地感到抱歉。

source: You're right. That's worth nothing at all.
target: 你说得对。这话一点用也没有。

source: Please. Listen.
target: 求你了。听我说。

source: Lord Laertes.
target: 雷欧提斯大人。

source: I don't know why I bothered to come. I have nothing to say to you.
target: 我不知道自己为什么还要来。我和你没什么可说的。

source: Then go.
target: 那就走吧。

source: No. Actually, there's one thing. Bernardo tells me you wanted to have my sister murdered.
target: 不。其实还有一件事。贝尔纳多告诉我，你想让人杀了我妹妹。

source: I didn't know.
target: 我当时不知道。

source: I didn't know she was my target. Not until very recently.
target: 我不知道她就是我的目标。直到最近才知道。

source: And then, I didn't want to kill her. I fought. But...
target: 知道以后，我也不想杀她。我抗争过。可是……

source: You fought? But you still meant to go through with it? You still meant to kill Ophelia?
target: 你抗争过？可你还是打算照办？你还是打算杀了奥菲莉娅？

source: I don't know.
target: 我不知道。

source: You're a liar, a murderer, and a traitor to everyone in this castle who knew you.
target: 你是骗子，是凶手，背叛了这座城堡里所有认识你的人。

source: Please, God, leave, Laertes. Please. Just have mercy. I'll be dead soon. Then you never have to look at me again.
target: 看在上帝的份上，求你走吧，雷欧提斯。求你了。发发慈悲吧。我很快就要死了。到时你就再也不用看见我了。

source: It may not make sense now, or ever, but I'm sorry I deceived you. Everything I felt for you was honest. I love you more than anyone in the world.
target: 这些话现在也许说不通，或许永远都说不通，但我很抱歉欺骗了你。我对你的一切感情都是真的。我爱你胜过世上任何人。

source: But I didn't have a choice about your sister. I never did. My whole life was—
target: 但在你妹妹的事上，我没有选择。从来都没有。我这一生都是——

source: No more. I don't care.
target: 别再说了。我不在乎。

source: I shouldn't have come here.
target: 我就不该来这里。

source: I hope you go to Hell for threatening my sister.
target: 你威胁了我妹妹，我希望你为此下地狱。

source: And for using me.
target: 还有，你利用了我。

source: Oh, God, I'm so scared.
target: 哦，上帝啊，我好害怕。

source: You're here?
target: 你来了？

source: I came home early, Father. Never mind the details. Look at you. What have they done to you?
target: 父亲，我提前回家了。细节先不说。看看您。他们对您做了什么？

source: They arrested you for treason? Truly?
target: 他们以叛国罪逮捕了您？真的？

source: I can't believe they would do this to you. After all you've done for this court.
target: 您为宫廷做了那么多，我不敢相信他们竟然这样对您。

source: It is not unusual for royalty to turn on those who serve them.
target: 王室反过来对付侍奉自己的人，并不稀奇。

source: And... there are things you don't know about my history with this court. About my service to King Hamlet.
target: 而且……我在这个宫廷的往事，有些是你不知道的。是我为哈姆雷特国王效力时的事。

source: I suppose it was only a matter of time until that past came back to haunt me.
target: 我想，那段过去迟早会回来纠缠我。

source: But Father, you aren't a threat to anyone. This is merely meant to make an insult of you. Of us.
target: 可是父亲，您对任何人都构不成威胁。这不过是为了羞辱您。羞辱我们。

source: And I won't allow it.
target: 我绝不允许。

source: Don't act in haste, Laertes.
target: 别冲动行事，雷欧提斯。

source: You mean as they did with you? With this mockery of justice?
target: 您是说，别像他们对待您那样？别像这场践踏正义的闹剧一样？

source: Claudius must be punished for this. He must know that he's crossed a line. And I will be the one to make him understand.
target: 克劳狄斯必须为此受到惩罚。他必须知道，他已经越界了。我会让他明白。

source: The rest of the castle needs to know what happens when they cross a line with us. I will be the one to make them understand.
target: 城堡里其他人必须知道，越过我们的底线会有什么后果。我会让他们明白。

source: I know I cannot stop you. So please-- just be safe.
target: 我知道拦不住你。所以求你——一定要平安。

source: I'll do my best. Farewell for now, Father. You'll be free soon enough.
target: 我会尽力。父亲，先告辞了。您很快就会自由了。

source: My poor son. He knows not what he does.
target: 我可怜的儿子。他不知道自己在做什么。

source: Hamlet mentioned I could meet the ghost here.
target: 哈姆雷特提过，我可以在这里见到幽灵。

source: But it doesn't look like that's true.
target: 可看来并不是这样。

source: Hamlet said I could meet the ghost on the walls at midnight.
target: 哈姆雷特说，午夜时我可以在城墙上见到幽灵。

source: It's nearly time now.
target: 现在快到时间了。

source: Go to the walls?
target: 去城墙上？

source: Not right now. I've more important things than ghost hunting.
target: 现在不去。我还有比找幽灵更重要的事。

source: Luckily, I arrived early.
target: 幸好我来得早。

source: Things are almost peaceful, here at the start of it all.
target: 在这一切的开端，这里几乎称得上平静。

source: You and I are the only ones who know about what's coming for them. The rest of them—they'll never believe me, will they?
target: 只有你我知道，他们将要面临什么。其他人——他们永远不会相信我，对吗？

source: It is impossible, yes. It is the rules of the larger game.
target: 是的，那不可能。这是一场更大的游戏的规则。

source: This is a game to you?
target: 在你看来，这是一场游戏？

source: I did not give it that name. But it is a game all the same, and you the one forecasted to lose.
target: 这个名字不是我取的。但它终究是一场游戏，而你是被预言会输的那个人。

source: Now then. What news do you bring?
target: 那么，你带来了什么消息？

source: Death becomes you.
target: 死亡很衬你。

source: And you as well, clearly.
target: 显然，也很衬你。

source: Be wary of every familiar face.
target: 提防每一张熟悉的面孔。

source: One of them will betray you.
target: 他们中会有人背叛你。

source: Who? If you know, why won't you tell me?
target: 谁？如果你知道，为什么不肯告诉我？

source: Would that I could. But I am unable, through no law of my own.
target: 但愿我能。可我做不到，约束我的规则并非我自己定下的。

source: I'm sure you'll find out soon enough.
target: 我相信你很快就会知道。

source: I see one of your compatriots has had you killed.
target: 看来，你的一位同胞派人杀了你。

source: Welcome to the ranks of the famous and esteemed. Those who die before their time live on in memory longer.
target: 欢迎加入那些声名显赫、受人敬重的死者之列。那些过早死去的人，会在人们的记忆中活得更久。

source: Though yours is a more heroic fate than dying on your stomach in the garden.
target: 不过，你这样的结局，比趴在花园里死去更有英雄气概。

source: Of course, they will find your waterlogged corpse in the pond and say you drowned...
target: 当然，他们会在池塘里发现你泡透了水的尸体，然后说你淹死了……

source: Leaving out the gash in your neck when they tell the tale.
target: 讲述这件事时，却不提你脖子上的伤口。

source: They'd lie about why I died? Why?
target: 他们会在我的死因上撒谎？为什么？

source: Because a gash on an innocent maiden defies explanation. Suicide is a story easily told.
target: 因为无辜少女身上的一道伤口难以解释。自杀的故事却很容易讲。

source: There has to be a way around it. So far as there always has been.
target: 一定有办法避开。到目前为止，总有办法。

source: Yes. There is. Your killer may be known to you, as mine was.
target: 是的。有办法。杀你的人也许是你认识的人，就像杀我的人一样。

source: Who do you trust to help you unmask them?
target: 你信任谁，愿意让谁帮你揭穿他们的真面目？

source: The hourglass empties. The days have passed.
target: 沙漏将尽。几日已逝。

source: Less than one cock's crow remains.
target: 所剩时间，已不足等到下一声鸡鸣。

source: I won't die this time. I'll find a way to stop it. I have to.
target: 这次我不会死。我会找到办法阻止这一切。我必须做到。

source: Godspeed, Ophelia.
target: 愿你一切顺利，奥菲莉娅。

source: I understand now why my son adores you so.
target: 我现在明白，我的儿子为什么如此爱慕你了。

source: By the by, I've noticed you are free of your assassin, are you not? You have won this battle.
target: 对了，我注意到你已经摆脱了那个刺客，不是吗？这一仗，你赢了。

source: But not the war. Not so long as I'm still stuck in this world.
target: 但整场战争还没赢。只要我还困在这个世界里，就不算赢。

source: No. Not the war.
target: 是的。整场战争还没赢。

source: Quince told me something odd when I first had Brit arrested.
target: 我第一次让人逮捕布莉特时，奎因斯对我说了些奇怪的话。

source: He said he had 'adjusted' the state of the world so that it would never happen again. Can he really do that?
target: 他说他已经“调整”了世界的状态，让这件事再也不会发生。他真的能做到吗？

source: Indeed, it appears he has already done so. See for yourself if he speaks true.
target: 确实，看来他已经这么做了。他说的是真是假，你可以亲自验证。

source: Though by what power he does these things, I know not.
target: 不过，他凭借什么力量做到这些，我并不知晓。

source: Ah. Still living, I see. So you managed to stay your fate.
target: 啊，看来你还活着。你成功暂缓了自己的命运。

source: I'm impressed. But tomorrow, it will save you no more than the others.
target: 令人佩服。但到了明天，你仍会和其他人一样，难逃一劫。

source: More ominous warnings. Do you have anything else to offer me?
target: 又是不祥的警告。除此之外，你还能给我点什么？

source: It's what the dead do best.
target: 这是死者最擅长的事。

source: Fortinbras marches even now. Less than a day, Ophelia.
target: 福丁布拉斯此刻仍在进军。不到一天了，奥菲莉娅。

source: Can you save them from him?
target: 你能从他手中救下他们吗？

source: Fortinbras is merely doing what conquerors do. But my family and friends...
target: 福丁布拉斯不过是在做征服者都会做的事。可我的家人和朋友……

source: They are tearing each other apart like men on patrol in a starving winter.
target: 他们正彼此撕咬，如同饥寒冬日里巡逻的士兵。

source: It shall not end until Elsinore lies silent.
target: 直到埃尔西诺归于死寂，这一切才会结束。

source: Now. What news do you bring?
target: 那么，你带来了什么消息？

source: S-Spirit? Do you-- are you here?
target: 幽、幽灵？你——你在这里吗？

source: Indeed. I am that body once called King Hamlet.
target: 正是。我就是那个曾被称为哈姆雷特国王的人。

source: (It does look just like Hamlet's father.)
target: （他确实和哈姆雷特的父亲一模一样。）

source: Do you remember me, my lord?
target: 陛下，您还记得我吗？

source: In vague silhouettes and shadows. Memory in death is a struggle. It is faint and infrequent.
target: 只记得模糊的轮廓与影子。死后想要回忆，十分艰难。记忆淡薄，鲜少浮现。

source: I recall you were a young girl once. Such a rambunctious child. I knew you then.
target: 我记得你还是个小姑娘的时候。那样一个活泼淘气的孩子。那时我认识你。

source: Yes. You did.
target: 是的。您认识我。

source: There's something I need to confirm. You also experience time repeating?
target: 有件事我需要确认。您也经历着时间的重复吗？

source: In the graveyard, you told me to meet you here, now. But that was a different world.
target: 在墓地里，您让我这个时候来这里见您。但那是在另一个世界里。

source: Yes. A world now forever locked behind time's barrier.
target: 是的。那个世界如今已永远封锁在时间的屏障之后。

source: You came to protect Gertrude.
target: 您是来保护乔特鲁德的。

source: The desire to see her safe is often the only thing powerful enough to rouse me.
target: 希望她平安的愿望，往往是唯一足以唤醒我的力量。

source: But in this world, she does not even know of my existence. Would that she and I could speak alone just once.
target: 但在这个世界里，她甚至不知道我的存在。但愿她能与我单独交谈，哪怕只有一次。

source: I have only a single selfish request.
target: 我只有一个出于私心的请求。

source: But it may be of use to you.
target: 但它或许也能帮到你。

source: What is it, my lord?
target: 是什么，陛下？

source: Seek out your father. Watch what he does when he believes he is alone.
target: 去找你的父亲。看看他在自以为独处时，会做些什么。

source: My notes—my notes, taken by him, out of love, out of protection—
target: 我的笔记——我的笔记，被他拿走了，出于爱，出于保护——

source: They contain the terrifying details of my ordeal. Details I cannot recall. Things too hazy to remember fully.
target: 其中记载着我那场磨难的可怕细节。那些我想不起的细节。那些过于模糊、无法完整忆起的事。

source: But that ordeal is the reason I still linger, trapped here.
target: 但正是那场磨难，让我至今仍徘徊于此，受困于此。

source: Find the notes, and there may be freedom for us both.
target: 找到那些笔记，也许我们就都能重获自由。

source: I have witnessed that your father keeps my possessions under most private lock and key.
target: 我亲眼见过，你的父亲把我的东西锁起来，极其隐秘地保管着。

source: The key is on his person at all times. Only he may access what is mine.
target: 他始终随身带着钥匙。只有他能取到我的东西。

source: You're saying you don't remember any of this?
target: 您是说，这些事您全都不记得了？

source: How can that be possible?
target: 这怎么可能？

source: There are stronger forces than I at work. Even now, I can only hold my form for so long. Everything from before I walked these walls is... distant.
target: 有比我更强大的力量在起作用。即使此刻，我也只能维持形体片刻。在我开始游荡于这些城墙之前，一切都……遥不可及。

source: Find those pages. They rest in your father's care. Please.
target: 找到那些纸页。它们由你的父亲保管。求你了。

source: Another one to ashes.
target: 又一份化为灰烬。

source: What's best for Her Majesty and for Hamlet.
target: 这样对王后陛下和哈姆雷特最好。

source: With everything that's going on, precautions must be taken.
target: 如今发生了这么多事，必须有所防备。

source: Stop—stop, Father!
target: 住手——住手，父亲！

source: Ophelia, you couldn't possibly understand. What these documents contained—
target: 奥菲莉娅，你不可能明白。这些文件里写的东西——

source: Burning these papers is a blessing to the one who wrote them.
target: 烧掉这些纸，对写下它们的人来说，是一件幸事。

source: Some day I hope you will understand the everlasting dedication I bear to this royal family. This is the depth of it.
target: 希望有一天，你能理解我对这个王室始终不渝的忠诚。我愿为他们做到这一步。

source: If you tell His Majesty about this, it'll be my head.
target: 如果你把这件事告诉国王陛下，我就要掉脑袋了。

source: Ah. My lady!
target: 啊，王后陛下！

source: Lord Polonius. I've come to claim some property of mine.
target: 波洛涅斯大人。我来取回一些属于我的东西。

source: Property, my lady?
target: 您的东西，王后陛下？

source: Tell me, Polonius. When my husband died...
target: 告诉我，波洛涅斯。我丈夫去世时……

source: What was it, precisely, that my husband and I requested of all in Elsinore?
target: 我和我的丈夫，究竟向埃尔西诺的所有人提出了什么要求？

source: Ah. Yes, I recall.
target: 啊。是的，我记得。

source: You asked us all to turn over everything of King Hamlet's we owned, my lady. And I did.
target: 您要求我们交出手中所有属于哈姆雷特国王的东西，王后陛下。我照做了。

source: Did you?
target: 是吗？

source: Or have you hidden something from me still?
target: 还是说，你至今仍藏着什么，不让我知道？

source: W-well, my lady—I was trying to—
target: 这、这个，王后陛下——我是想——

source: Preparing to destroy evidence of something, perhaps?
target: 也许是准备销毁什么证据？

source: Please. My lady. I destroyed those things to protect him.
target: 求您了。王后陛下。我毁掉那些东西，是为了保护他。

source: If there ever were such documents, they are long gone now.
target: 即使曾经有过那样的文件，如今也早已不在了。

source: I have destroyed nothing. I merely withheld these documents to protect him.
target: 我什么也没毁掉。我只是扣下了这些文件，为了保护他。

source: So you still have them in your possession?
target: 所以，它们还在你手里？

source: So it's true? You—are saying—my husband left something you never showed us?
target: 所以是真的？你——是说——我丈夫留下了什么东西，而你从没给我们看过？

source: You lied to us. After I trusted you implicitly.
target: 你骗了我们。我曾那么毫无保留地信任你。

source: I regret that I have broken your trust.
target: 我辜负了您的信任，对此深感愧疚。

source: A man has two deaths, they say.
target: 人们说，一个人会死两次。

source: Once when he dies, and once when his legacy is forgotten.
target: 一次是生命终结之时，一次是他留下的一切被遗忘之时。

source: I served your husband Hamlet for all of his life. I didn't want anyone—you, least of all—to have to see the way he was, in the end.
target: 您的丈夫哈姆雷特在世时，我一直侍奉着他。我不想让任何人——尤其是您——看到他最后的样子。

source: You don't think I know how he was? How he looked at me with such pity and despair?
target: 你以为我不知道他当时的样子吗？不知道他是怎样满怀怜悯与绝望地看着我吗？

source: He was my husband, Polonius. Nothing he could have written in those notes could be so shameful as to be worth hiding.
target: 他是我的丈夫，波洛涅斯。无论他在那些笔记里写了什么，都不可能羞耻到需要藏起来。

source: I am sorry, my lady. It is done. The notes are burned, their contents ash.
target: 对不起，王后陛下。事已至此。笔记烧掉了，里面写的一切也都化为了灰烬。

source: Then there's nothing more to say to you.
target: 那我跟你没什么可说的了。

source: I thought I could trust you.
target: 我以为我可以信任你。

source: All I have of him are the things he left behind, now.
target: 如今，他留给我的，就只有那些遗物了。

source: And it seems even those are going to ash—one by one.
target: 可现在看来，连它们也在化为灰烬——一件接着一件。

source: (So the notes have already been destroyed this time. I see. I'm too late.)
target: （所以这次笔记已经被毁掉了。我明白了。我来晚了。）

source: Give me those notes. Now.
target: 把那些笔记给我。现在。

source: I will not, my lady. I served—and still serve—King Hamlet above any other.
target: 我不会给您的，王后陛下。我过去侍奉哈姆雷特国王——如今也依然如此——他高于任何人。

source: What do you think you're doing?
target: 你这是在干什么？

source: What I should have done the day he died.
target: 做我在他去世那天就该做的事。

source: I promised your late husband I would burn these, and I am not about to forego such a promise. I apologize sincerely, but I cannot hand these to you.
target: 我答应过您已故的丈夫，会烧掉这些东西，我绝不会背弃这样的承诺。我真心向您道歉，但我不能把它们交给您。

source: Right in front of me. The gall.
target: 竟然就当着我的面。真是胆大包天。

source: You feeble, old, doddering fool!
target: 你这个衰弱、老迈、昏聩的蠢货！

source: (Oh, my God. His head is in the flames.)
target: （天哪。他的头在火里。）

source: No! No...
target: 不！不……

source: But he crossed me. It was in defense. Defense of my husband, not my own life.
target: 可他违抗了我。我是为了保护。保护我的丈夫，而不是我自己的性命。

source: I—I had to do it.
target: 我——我不得不这么做。

source: You killed him.
target: 你杀了他。

source: I had no choice. I had no choice, Hamlet, my love. I swear it.
target: 我别无选择。我别无选择，哈姆雷特，我的爱人。我发誓。

source: Oh, Hamlet, Hamlet, Hamlet!.
target: 哦，哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特！

source: (She's not in her right mind.)
target: （她已经失去理智了。）

source: I must know. The price paid!
target: 我必须知道。付出的代价！

source: These notes--
target: 这些笔记——

source: This cannot be right. My husband didn't write this.
target: 这不可能。这不是我丈夫写的。

source: What does it say?
target: 上面写了什么？

source: I-it isn't real, Ophelia, is it?
target: 这、这不是真的，奥菲莉娅，对不对？

source: Tell me it isn't true. It cannot be.
target: 告诉我这不是真的。不可能是真的。

source: T-these notes are pure madness! They make no sense! My husband, he suffered alone—
target: 这、这些笔记全是疯话！完全说不通！我的丈夫，他独自承受着痛苦——

source: Just like my poor Hamlet.
target: 就像我可怜的哈姆雷特一样。

source: I f-failed them both.
target: 我辜、辜负了他们两个。

source: She left the notes sitting in that chest.
target: 她把笔记留在了那个箱子里。

source: Though now, I'm worried about the Queen's state. Where did she run off to?
target: 不过，我现在很担心王后的状态。她跑到哪里去了？

source: My King? W-What brings you here?
target: 陛下？您、您怎么来了？

source: Evening, Polonius. I've come from a most fascinating conversation.
target: 晚上好，波洛涅斯。我刚和人进行了一场极有意思的谈话。

source: On what topic?
target: 谈了什么？

source: As I understand it, you have some personal writings my brother may have left behind.
target: 据我所知，你手里有一些私人手稿，可能是我哥哥留下的。

source: Did I not ask upon his death that all of his remaining belongings be turned over to me, immediately?
target: 他去世时，我难道没有要求，把他留下的所有物品立刻交给我吗？

source: You did.
target: 您确实要求过。

source: I don't know what you speak of, my lord. I turned everything over. Truly.
target: 我不知道您在说什么，陛下。我已经全都交出去了。真的。

source: Is it possible you have hidden something from me still?
target: 莫非你至今还藏着什么，不让我知道？

source: That chest of yours. The one by the fire. Open it.
target: 你的那个箱子。炉火旁边那个。打开它。

source: I cannot, my lord.
target: 我不能，陛下。

source: Open it, or spend an evening in a darkened cell as we take the keyring off your neck.
target: 打开它，否则你就在黑牢里过上一晚，由我们从你脖子上取下那串钥匙。

source: There. It is open.
target: 好了。打开了。

source: And here you have its contents.
target: 里面的东西都在这里了。

source: What is this?
target: 这到底是什么？

source: Do you take me for an idiot?
target: 你把我当傻子吗？

source: This is a handful of ash!
target: 这是一把灰！

source: It is all that remains.
target: 只剩下这些了。

source: You are too late to read his words, now. But I will never forget them.
target: 如今，您想读他写下的话，已经太迟了。但我永远不会忘记。

source: I know what you did. I know who you truly are.
target: 我知道您做过什么。我知道您的真面目。

source: And your brother knew, too.
target: 您的哥哥也知道。

source: He wrote about it as a prophet might. He spoke of a poisoning. Of dying in the garden. And all of it came to pass.
target: 他写下那些事，就像一位先知。他提到了下毒。提到了死在花园里。而这一切都发生了。

source: This is certainly his handwriting.
target: 这确实是他的笔迹。

source: What is this rambling nonsense?
target: 这些胡言乱语到底是什么？

source: This is—lunacy. Sheer lunacy. There's no sense in it!
target: 这简直——是疯话。彻头彻尾的疯话。根本说不通！

source: He sounds like a raving madman. Half of this is indecipherable.
target: 他写得像个胡言乱语的疯子。这里有一半都读不懂。

source: This is what my brother left behind?
target: 我哥哥留下的就是这个？

source: Well, then. So be it. This is no threat to me.
target: 那好吧。就这样吧。这对我毫无威胁。

source: Let the flames take it all.
target: 让火把它们全烧了吧。

source: Did anyone else read them?
target: 还有别人读过吗？

source: Good. Then good riddance to that drivel.
target: 很好。那这些废话烧掉也好。

source: Truth, you mean.
target: 您说的是真相。

source: Some of that was fiction, certainly. But my lord Hamlet spoke of dying by your hand.
target: 其中确实有些是虚构的。但哈姆雷特陛下提到了自己会死在您的手里。

source: I do not believe that is a falsehood.
target: 我不相信那是假话。
