source: So my brother suspected me, did he? I can't imagine how!
target: 这么说，我哥哥怀疑我，是吗？真想不通他怎么会这么想！

source: Never was especially sharp in knowing what I felt about him.
target: 对于我究竟怎么看他，他向来没什么敏锐的察觉。

source: I can hardly imagine what would have come from it, had my wife or nephew seen those notes.
target: 如果我的妻子或侄子看过那些笔记，我实在难以想象会发生什么。

source: What a blessing it is that we've spared them such pain.
target: 我们让他们免受这样的痛苦，真是一件幸事。

source: I will always know the truth.
target: 我会永远记得真相。

source: You may wear the crown, Claudius, but so long as you do, your brother will be my only King.
target: 克劳狄斯，你尽可以戴着王冠，但只要你还戴着它，你哥哥就会是我唯一的国王。

source: Hmm. Interesting.
target: 嗯。有意思。

source: Am I to understand, then, that you intended to use these notes to have me declared a murderer?
target: 那么，我是不是可以理解为，你本打算用这些笔记，让人认定我是杀人凶手？

source: Originally, yes.
target: 起初，是的。

source: I held onto them for that purpose. I wanted to see you brought to justice.
target: 我为此保留了它们。我想看到您受到应有的惩罚。

source: But I have my daughter and son to think about. I have no interest in that now.
target: 但我还得为我的女儿和儿子考虑。我现在已经不想那么做了。

source: Why, I misjudged you, old fool. Seems age does come with wisdom.
target: 哎呀，老糊涂，我看错你了。看来年岁增长，确实能带来智慧。

source: Make no mistake. It would have ended very poorly for you. And for Ophelia, too.
target: 你要清楚，你的下场本会非常凄惨。奥菲莉娅也一样。

source: I suggest you consider your next steps very carefully, my good Duke.
target: 我劝你仔细考虑接下来该怎么做，我的好公爵。

source: If ever your tongue starts to loosen, I want you to drink a glass of something stiff and imagine what your children's corpses might look like.
target: 如果你什么时候开始管不住自己的嘴，我要你喝一杯烈酒，想象一下你儿女的尸体会是什么模样。

source: And then I want you to leave Elsinore. Permanently.
target: 然后，我要你离开埃尔西诺。永远别回来。

source: You're a monster, Claudius. But I've always known that.
target: 你是个怪物，克劳狄斯。不过我一直都知道。

source: So have I.
target: 我也一直都知道。

source: It is in my nature, sweet Ophelia. Don't begrudge me for it.
target: 这是我的天性，亲爱的奥菲莉娅。别因此怨我。

source: Good night, my lord, my lady.
target: 晚安，大人，小姐。

source: We should all be grateful your daughter brought this to my attention.
target: 我们都该感谢你的女儿，让我知道了这件事。

source: I'm sorry you had to see this, Ophelia.
target: 抱歉让你看到这些，奥菲莉娅。

source: This is the ugly side of ruling. Sometimes one must take drastic measures to keep the peace.
target: 这就是统治丑陋的一面。有时，为了维持和平，必须采取严厉的手段。

source: Ophelia? What's going on? He hasn't threatened you, has he?
target: 奥菲莉娅？怎么回事？他没有威胁你吧？

source: No, he hasn't. I'm fine, Father.
target: 没有，他没有。我没事，父亲。

source: We'll be leaving. Until next time, Polonius.
target: 我们该走了。下次再见，波洛涅斯。

source: Lord Hamlet?
target: 哈姆雷特殿下？

source: You snake. What have you been hiding?
target: 你这条毒蛇。你一直藏着什么？

source: My lord. I don't understand.
target: 殿下。我不明白。

source: My father died, and you were ordered to turn over anything of his belongings to my mother.
target: 我父亲去世后，你奉命把他的所有遗物交给我母亲。

source: Why did you not obey?
target: 你为什么不服从？

source: W-well, my Prince, I w-was—I was trying to—
target: 这、这个，王子殿下，我、我是——我是想——

source: No. I destroyed those things to protect him.
target: 不是。我毁掉那些东西，是为了保护他。

source: You mean you've already destroyed them?
target: 你是说，你已经把它们毁掉了？

source: What could you possibly protect him from? Surely not death!
target: 你究竟能保护他免受什么？总不可能是死亡吧！

source: I apologize, my lord. But if such notes existed, they are long gone now.
target: 对不起，殿下。但即使曾有过那样的笔记，如今也早已不在了。

source: What are you trying to hide, Polonius?
target: 你想掩盖什么，波洛涅斯？

source: Give them to me at once!
target: 立刻把它们给我！

source: This is something you cannot yet understand, my Prince.
target: 这件事您还无法理解，王子殿下。

source: I served your father for all of his life. I didn't want anyone—least of all you, or your mother—to have to see the way he was in the end.
target: 您父亲在世时，我一直侍奉着他。我不想让任何人——尤其是您和您的母亲——看到他最后的样子。

source: You don't get to make that choice for us.
target: 你无权替我们做这个决定。

source: No. You don't get to take that away from me.
target: 不。你无权从我这里夺走它。

source: I am sorry, my lord. It is done. The notes are burned, their contents ash.
target: 对不起，殿下。事已至此。笔记烧掉了，里面写的一切也都化为了灰烬。

source: You're a monster and a fool. You hideous little man.
target: 你是个怪物，也是个蠢货。你这个丑恶的小人。

source: You can never understand what you've stolen from me. Never.
target: 你永远不会明白，你从我这里夺走了什么。永远不会。

source: (I'm too late. They were already destroyed this time.)
target: （我来得太晚了。这一次，它们已经被毁掉了。）

source: I will not, my Prince. I serve your father above any other man.
target: 我不会的，王子殿下。我对您父亲的忠诚高于任何人。

source: I promised your father I would burn the contents of this chest, and I am not about to forego such a promise. I apologize sincerely.
target: 我答应过您父亲，要烧掉这只箱子里的东西，我不会违背这样的承诺。我由衷地向您道歉。

source: You will not destroy them.
target: 你不准毁掉它们。

source: (Oh, my God. His head is in the flames!)
target: （天哪。他的头在火里！）

source: T-that was-- What I just did--
target: 那、那是——我刚才做的事——

source: He's dead. It's done.
target: 他死了。事已至此。

source: Now I can take what is rightfully mine.
target: 现在，我可以拿走本就属于我的东西了。

source: You murdered him.
target: 你杀害了他。

source: Don't try to stop me, Ophelia. You brought this on us. On both of us.
target: 别想阻止我，奥菲莉娅。是你让我们落到这一步的。我们两个。

source: The chest is unlocked. There's parchment inside.
target: 箱子没锁。里面有羊皮纸。

source: This is his handwriting.
target: 这是他的笔迹。

source: T-this is... this can't be real.
target: 这、这是……这不可能是真的。

source: This is a farce. A lie. It must be.
target: 这是场闹剧。是谎言。一定是。

source: Father wouldn't  write something like this.
target: 父亲不会写这种东西。

source: What can those notes possibly say, to make him react like that?
target: 那些笔记里究竟写了什么，竟让他有这样的反应？

source: Ah. Hello, Othello.
target: 啊。你好，奥赛罗。

source: Have you any need to buy a little barley-wine today? I've three casks outside.
target: 今天要不要买点大麦酒？我在外面放了三桶。

source: A 'little!' Hah. You know this place. The field-fellows drank it all within the first three days.
target: “一点”！哈。你也知道这里是什么样。头三天，田里干活的伙计们就把酒喝光了。

source: If you can sell me thrice as much, I can pay it.
target: 你要是能卖给我三倍的量，我付得起。

source: Aye. That's well enough.
target: 行。那就好。

source: A drink before you unpack? I'm in no hurry.
target: 卸货前先喝一杯？我不急。

source: I'll indulge these bones a while, yes.
target: 好，就让我这把老骨头享受一会儿吧。

source: Oh. Ophelia. You're here.
target: 哦。奥菲莉娅。你来了。

source: Do you know what today is?
target: 你知道今天是什么日子吗？

source: Of course. It's the day you and Mother were first wed.
target: 当然。今天是你和母亲当年成婚的日子。

source: T-that's right. I'm... surprised you know.
target: 对、对。我……没想到你知道。

source: I miss her so very much, Ophelia.
target: 我真的非常想念她，奥菲莉娅。

source: I know, Father.
target: 我知道，父亲。

source: I'm not certain what you mean. Judging by where we are, I'd assume it's got something to do with Mother?
target: 我不太明白你的意思。看我们现在所在的地方，我猜是和母亲有关？

source: Today marks the day your mother and I were first wed.
target: 今天是我和你母亲当年成婚的日子。

source: She was close to your age then. We were so very—so wonderfully young. I wish I could remember my own mind at that point in my life.
target: 她那时和你差不多年纪。我们是那么——那么年轻，多么美好的年纪。真希望我还记得自己那时候的心境。

source: Everything was so clean and simple, and matters so easy to sort through.
target: 一切都那么清楚、简单，事情也都那么容易理清。

source: Do you ever miss your mother?
target: 你会想念你母亲吗？

source: I... think so.
target: 我……想是的。

source: You were so small when Elise died. Hardly able to move on your own. And sickly, too. She was terrified she'd lose you as she lay ill.
target: 伊莉丝去世的时候，你还那么小。几乎不能自己活动，身体也弱。她卧病在床时，很怕会失去你。

source: She handed you to a nursemaid instead of continuing to feed you. It likely saved your life, though it brought her immense pain to do.
target: 她把你交给了乳母，没有继续亲自喂养你。这样做很可能救了你的命，可她为此痛苦万分。

source: I'm lucky, then.
target: 那我真是幸运。

source: Your mother was the light of my life.
target: 你母亲曾是我生命中的光。

source: When she left us, my life—well—I have you, and Laertes. Were it not for you two, my world would have gone completely dark.
target: 她离开我们以后，我的生活——唉——我还有你，还有雷欧提斯。如果没有你们两个，我的世界就彻底黑暗了。

source: For many years it was as though nothing would ever make me smile again. My hair grew white, and my hands feeble. I felt I needed her to live.
target: 很长一段时间里，仿佛再也没有什么能让我微笑。我的头发白了，双手也没了力气。我觉得，没有她，我就活不下去。

source: You are the spitting image of her. Sometimes, when you were small, I could hardly bear to look at your face. It was too painful.
target: 你和她长得一模一样。你小时候，有时我几乎不忍看你的脸。那实在太痛苦了。

source: But I know she'd be so terribly, terribly proud of you and Laertes.
target: 但我知道，她一定会非常、非常为你和雷欧提斯骄傲。

source: That's what has kept me alive these many years.
target: 正是这个念头，让我这些年来一直活了下来。

source: Father, I'm sorry to ask now, but what do you know about Queen Astrid and Mother's relationship?
target: 父亲，抱歉在这时候问，但关于阿斯特丽德王后和母亲的关系，你知道些什么？

source: I'll stay out here just a little longer, I think.
target: 我想，我会在外面再待一小会儿。

source: If there is anything more you'd like to know about your mother, you have only to ask.
target: 关于你母亲，如果你还想知道什么，尽管问我。

source: It's difficult remembering. But important.
target: 回忆很难受。但很重要。

source: Father, you know how deeply I love you, right?
target: 父亲，你知道我有多爱你，对吧？

source: I do. I have often felt I was failing my family as of late, most of all you.
target: 我知道。最近，我常觉得自己辜负了家人，尤其是你。

source: I understand that you love me, too.
target: 我也明白，你同样爱着我。

source: That brings me some small relief.
target: 这让我稍稍宽慰了一些。

source: I'll leave you be. Be safe, Father.
target: 我不打扰你了。注意安全，父亲。

source: Oh, Elise.
target: 哦，伊莉丝。

source: I miss you in every waking morning and every evening's fire.
target: 每个醒来的清晨，每晚的炉火旁，我都在想念你。

source: It smells like old cloth and parchment in here.
target: 这里有股旧布和羊皮纸的味道。

source: Looks like nothing's been touched in years.
target: 看来这里的东西已经好多年没人动过了。

source: Why is it that Hamlet gets to speak with his father's spirit, but my mother is gone from me without a word?
target: 为什么哈姆雷特能和父亲的亡灵说话，我的母亲却一句话也没留下，就离我而去了？

source: How can that be fair? Is their presence, their worth, not equal?
target: 这怎么公平？他们的存在、他们的价值，难道不该是平等的吗？

source: There must be something of hers here. Father told me...
target: 这里一定有她的东西。父亲告诉过我……

source: This place is as melancholy as ever.
target: 这里还是一样让人伤感。

source: And dusty, too.
target: 还满是灰尘。

source: I'd better make my business here quickly, and go.
target: 我最好赶快办完这里的事，然后离开。

source: Your mother was close with the Queen, during her service to her. Certain events transpired which no King since would want to come to light.
target: 你母亲侍奉王后时，和王后很亲近。那时发生过一些事，之后的任何一位国王都不愿让它们公之于世。

source: But you could read about them—if you so desired.
target: 但你可以读到那些事——如果你愿意的话。

source: There's something I've never told you before. Something you won't like, I think, and your brother would like even less. But it's the truth.
target: 有件事，我从没告诉过你。我想，你不会愿意听到，你哥哥就更不会了。但这是事实。

source: When she took ill, King Hamlet ordered her put into one of the sanitariums on the southern coast.
target: 你母亲病倒后，哈姆雷特国王下令把她送进南部海岸的一所疗养院。

source: Y-you mean the ones far from here? She died... like that?
target: 你、你是说，离这里很远的那些？她就……那样死了？

source: The King was not kind to her, and would not let her convalesce within the castle along with the rest of the noble-affiliated victims.
target: 国王对她并不仁慈，不肯让她和其他与贵族有关的病人一起留在城堡里养病。

source: He never treated her with kindness, though he was kind to other noblewomen of similar rank.
target: 他从没善待过她，却对其他地位相近的贵族女子很友善。

source: Because she was foreign-born, you mean.
target: 你是说，因为她出生在外国。

source: Yes. Her only crime was being born into a world that could not understand her worth.
target: 是的。她唯一的罪，就是生在一个不懂得她价值的世界。

source: The Guard Captain at the time, Bernardo's father, was ordered to prevent me from seeing her. The King feared I would take ill, too, and leave him with no advisor.
target: 当时的卫队长，也就是贝尔纳多的父亲，奉命阻止我去见她。国王怕我也会病倒，让他没了顾问。

source: I wasn't able to say goodbye.
target: 我没能和她道别。

source: How could someone do something like that? If she'd been in the sanitarium—she might be—alive!
target: 怎么会有人做得出这种事？如果她当时在疗养院里——她可能——还活着！

source: We both knew when we fell in love that it would end like this. It could be no other way.
target: 我们相爱时，就都知道会是这样的结局。不可能有别的结果。

source: I'm a man of the present. I don't like to remember. Painful memories tend to linger and grasp at us far past their right.
target: 我是个活在当下的人，不喜欢回忆。痛苦的记忆总会久久不散，纠缠我们太久，远超它们应有的分量。

source: But—if you were so inclined—she left behind some notes, composed at the very end of her life.
target: 不过——如果你愿意——她留下了一些笔记，是在生命最后的日子里写下的。

source: When she died, some kind soul sent her belongings back to me on a ship. But it was simply too painful for me to dream of looking through them.
target: 她去世后，有位好心人把她的遗物用船送还给了我。但对我来说，翻看那些东西实在太痛苦了，连想都不敢想。

source: They're located in that shack by the docks. They're locked off, along with the other belongings of those who fall to the plague. You'll need to find a way in.
target: 它们放在码头边的那间小屋里，和其他死于瘟疫的人的遗物一起锁着。你得想办法进去。

source: Hardly anyone in the castle will go in there. It's a bad omen. But you're sharp as your mother was. I'm sure you'll find a way.
target: 城堡里几乎没人愿意去那里。那是不祥之兆。但你和你母亲一样聪明，我相信你会找到办法。

source: So good of you to come.
target: 你能来，真是太好了。

source: You know, I had expected you much earlier. You've been awfully tardy on this front, haven't you?
target: 你知道吗，我本以为你会早得多就来。这件事上，你可真是拖了很久，是不是？

source: ...On what front?
target: ……什么事？

source: I felt certain from the moment we met you would come find me like this. But you haven't. And now—here we are.
target: 从我们见面的那一刻起，我就确信你会这样来找我。可你一直没来。而现在——我们终于在这里了。

source: I do so love this gallery. King Claudius may be a buffoon, but King Hamlet loved the great dramas and tragedies.
target: 我实在喜欢这间长廊。克劳狄斯国王或许是个丑角，但哈姆雷特国王很喜爱那些伟大的戏剧与悲剧。

source: There are even type-printed copies on these shelves. There's something so relaxing about a deep, bloody drama.
target: 这些架子上甚至还有活字印刷的版本。深刻又血腥的戏剧，总有种让人放松的魅力。

source: Not me. I prefer to read happier tales.
target: 我可不觉得。我更喜欢读快乐些的故事。

source: Stories can be beautiful without being happy, don't you think?
target: 故事即使不快乐，也可以很美，你不觉得吗？

source: Here. Ovid's 'Pyramus et Thisbe', the greatest love story ever written—for now, of course, until some half-rate bard steals and replicates it!
target: 看这里。奥维德的《皮拉摩斯与提斯柏》，有史以来最伟大的爱情故事——当然，目前是，直到某个二流诗人把它偷去再写一遍！

source: 'Alas! Only death could take you from me; therefore, let us not be parted by death.'
target: “啊！唯有死亡能将你从我身边夺走；因此，莫让死亡将我们分离。”

source: Two young lovers, so deeply fallen into one another that they'd rather die gruesomely than live apart.
target: 两个年轻恋人，爱彼此爱得那么深，宁愿惨死，也不愿分开活着。

source: Don't you think that's beautiful?
target: 你不觉得这很美吗？

source: You have a funny definition of 'beautiful'. I'd rather see them alive and well.
target: 你对“美”的定义真奇怪。我更愿意看到他们好好活着。

source: Death is never the ideal solution. Not for me.
target: 死亡从来都不是理想的解决办法。对我来说不是。

source: Ahh. You're a woman all about solutions, aren't you? I knew you were a bright girl.
target: 啊。你是个凡事都想着如何解决的姑娘，对不对？我就知道你很聪明。

source: Unfortunate things happen to bright girls in this world.
target: 在这个世界，聪明的姑娘会遭遇不幸。

source: Why did you really ask me to come here, Quince? What do you want?
target: 奎因斯，你叫我来这里，到底是为什么？你想要什么？

source: Indeed... what do I want? A larger question for another world. But for now...
target: 是啊……我想要什么？这问题更宏大，留给另一个世界吧。不过现在……

source: I'm going to give you the ability to change the content of the play I perform.
target: 我要让你能够改变我所演出的戏的内容。

source: If you have any juicy gossip you'd like to see on stage, you need only ask.
target: 如果你想让什么有趣的秘闻搬上舞台，只管开口。

source: Terribly generous of me at this late point in our match—I know, I know!
target: 我们的较量都到了这么晚的阶段，我还如此慷慨——我知道，我知道！

source: That's all?
target: 就这些？

source: What more were you expecting? Adieu, Lady Ophelia.
target: 你还期待什么呢？再会，奥菲莉娅女士。

source: My dear, what a funny little play you wove for me.
target: 亲爱的，你给我编了出多么有趣的小戏啊。

source: And a desperate one, at that.
target: 而且，还是出拼命挣扎的戏。

source: I don't expect they'll understand.
target: 我不指望他们能明白。

source: A word of advice, Lady Ophelia, if I may be so bold. Don't ask the others to try and understand what you and I are.
target: 奥菲莉娅女士，请容我冒昧给你一句忠告。别要求其他人试着理解，你和我究竟是什么。

source: Can the insects on the floor of the great hall understand the intelligence of humans who walk above them? Certainly not!
target: 大厅地上的虫子，能理解从它们上方走过的人类的智慧吗？当然不能！

source: No more can the men and women of Elsinore understand the rules governing our current predicament.
target: 埃尔西诺的男男女女，同样无法理解支配我们眼下困境的规则。

source: They will only shun you for it.
target: 他们只会因此疏远你。

source: You're saying they'll never believe me?
target: 你是说，他们永远不会相信我？

source: That is correct, yes. They are fundamentally incapable of it. Now, if you'll excuse me.
target: 正是如此。他们根本就做不到。好了，恕我失陪。

source: I find myself both unamused and overtaxed. The worst of both worlds.
target: 我觉得既无趣，又疲惫不堪。两头的坏处全占了。

source: Now, are you going to return to making a choice, or shall we play this tedious back-and-forth longer?
target: 现在，你要回去做选择，还是要我们继续这无聊的来回纠缠？

source: I don't much care for it, I must admit.
target: 我得承认，我并不喜欢这样。

source: If you'll excuse me, I'll take my leave of you now.
target: 恕我失陪，我现在要告辞了。

source: I do wish you'd find something else to perform. You won't glean any information from me repeating this same rehashed tale.
target: 我真希望你能找些别的内容来演。让我反复演这同一个老故事，你得不到任何信息。

source: Wait a minute. I'm not done with you.
target: 等一下。我还没跟你说完。

source: I am done with you.
target: 我已经不想再理会你了。

source: Ah, there you are.
target: 啊，你来了。

source: His Majesty and Bernardo are already inside. I'll open the door. You will enter after me and remain concealed. When you sense the meeting is over, depart before us.
target: 陛下和贝尔纳多已经在里面了。我来开门。你跟在我后面进去，一直藏好。等你觉得会议快结束了，就在我们之前离开。

source: Say and do nothing. Do you understand?
target: 什么都别说，什么都别做。明白了吗？

source: Captain. I was the one who asked Claudius to call this meeting.
target: 队长。是我请克劳狄斯召开这次会议的。

source: And you as well, I suppose.
target: 我想，也请了你。

source: Let's just say I have the King's ear for the time being.
target: 这么说吧，眼下国王听得进我的话。

source: Aah-- I see.
target: 啊——我明白了。

source: Well, then, my lady, please, take caution. Conceal yourself and make no noise or word.
target: 那么，女士，请务必小心。把自己藏好，别出声，也别说话。

source: His Majesty would certainly not appreciate me allowing a lady of the court into a meeting like this.
target: 我让一位宫廷女士进入这样的会议，陛下一定不会高兴。

source: I'll merely listen and remain concealed. My thanks, Bernardo.
target: 我只会听着，一直藏好。谢谢你，贝尔纳多。

source: Captain. My father told me this meeting was taking place.
target: 队长。我父亲告诉我，这里要开会。

source: As did you, I suppose.
target: 我想，你也告诉过我。

source: And if I promise to stay concealed?
target: 如果我保证一直藏好呢？

source: This is important, Bernardo. I won't give myself away. I promise.
target: 这很重要，贝尔纳多。我不会暴露自己。我保证。

source: I don't know what this is all about. But given you seem rather intent, I'll permit it this one time. Make no noise or word.
target: 我不知道这到底是怎么回事。不过，看你这么坚决，我就允许你这一次。别出声，也别说话。

source: My lord? Are you present?
target: 陛下？您在吗？

source: My King, good Captain, I convened this council for good reason.
target: 陛下，队长，我召集这次会议，是有充分理由的。

source: I believe circumstances have shifted beneath our feet. We must be compelled to act now, or lose everything.
target: 我认为，局势已经在我们脚下发生了变化。我们现在必须采取行动，否则就会失去一切。

source: Your Highness. In short, we are in danger.
target: 陛下。简单来说，我们正身处险境。

source: Your Highness. What is this about?
target: 陛下。这是怎么回事？

source: I have new cause to believe we are in danger, Bernardo.
target: 贝尔纳多，我有了新的理由，相信我们正身处险境。

source: Is this about Ophelia's little rumormongering?
target: 是为了奥菲莉娅散布的那点谣言吗？

source: Rumormongering, sir?
target: 散布谣言，陛下？

source: What rumors, my lord?
target: 什么谣言，陛下？

source: She came to me trying to peddle some little words about Fortinbras hiding out nearby.
target: 她来找我，想兜售些福丁布拉斯藏在附近的说辞。

source: Did Ophelia come to you with this?
target: 奥菲莉娅找你说过这件事吗？

source: She's been saying something of the sort lately. That's all.
target: 她最近一直在说类似的话。仅此而已。

source: A-ah, my lord, that was... that is to say... she was only repeating what I've told her.
target: 啊、啊，陛下，那是……我是说……她只是把我告诉她的话又说了一遍。

source: She's parroting what I have already learned via our usual warfront network, of course.
target: 当然，她只是复述了我通过我们惯常的前线情报网已经获知的消息。

source: She did?
target: 她说过？

source: Why, my lord, of course she did. She overheard my men and I discussing it. Of course, I am the true source of this information.
target: 啊，陛下，她当然知道。她听到了我和手下谈论这件事。当然，这消息真正的来源是我。

source: I see. Very well, then. It merely gave me a nasty surprise, to have her walk up to me and assert something of that nature.
target: 我明白了。那好吧。只是她走到我面前，断言有这种事，着实让我吃了一惊。

source: Lady Ophelia was the one who delivered me promising information about Prince Fortinbras hiding out nearby.
target: 是奥菲莉娅女士向我提供了有价值的情报，说福丁布拉斯王子就藏在附近。

source: This is not a new possibility to me, of course. But she presented her case most convincingly.
target: 当然，这种可能我早就想过。不过，她的说辞极有说服力。

source: More of this Prince Fortinbras business. An eminent thorn in my side, that one.
target: 又是福丁布拉斯王子的事。那家伙真是我的心头大患。

source: My lord, I have learned—not only does Fortinbras intend to betray his peacetime agreement with us, he intends to stage a coup.
target: 陛下，我已经得知——福丁布拉斯不仅打算背弃与我们的和平协议，还打算发动政变。

source: The Prince and his men are, at this very moment, hiding out in town, just outside the castle gates. They intend to lay siege to us by Sunday.
target: 此时此刻，王子和他的手下就藏在城堡大门外的镇上。他们打算最迟在星期日围攻我们。

source: Oh, not all this again. I understand that none of us are used to trusting Norway, but they are our allies now. We must keep the faith.
target: 唉，别再提这一套了。我明白，我们都还不习惯信任挪威，但他们现在是我们的盟友。我们必须继续相信他们。

source: Hasty moves have lost us many a battle in the past.
target: 过去，贸然行动让我们输过不少仗。

source: I fully believe it now. The fool has overextended himself and crossed a line which cannot be uncrossed.
target: 现在我完全相信了。那个蠢货不自量力，越过了无法回头的界线。

source: Still, hasty moves here have lost us many a battle in the past.
target: 不过，过去在这种事上贸然行动，让我们输过不少仗。

source: Prince Fortinbras has no intentions beyond our lands. He wants to take the Danish throne. His request to cross Danish lands is a ruse.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子的目标根本不在我们的国土之外。他想夺取丹麦王位。他请求借道丹麦，只是个幌子。

source: He hides out now, in town, with a small group of officers.
target: 他现在和一小群军官一起藏在镇上。

source: Sir, perhaps this is a time to reiterate... I've long believed Prince Fortinbras has no intentions beyond our lands. He wants to take the Danish throne.
target: 陛下，或许该再说一次了……我一直认为，福丁布拉斯王子的目标根本不在我们的国土之外。他想夺取丹麦王位。

source: You finally believe me, my lord?
target: 陛下，您终于相信我了？

source: I do. And I give you suitable permission to act.
target: 是的。我也准许你采取适当行动。

source: My lord, I beg of you. Something like this should be simple to verify.
target: 陛下，求您了。这种事应该很容易查证。

source: Allow me to take my men into town. If all is as we believe it to be, we will come away with Prince Fortinbras as prisoner.
target: 请准许我带手下进镇。如果一切如我们所想，我们就能把福丁布拉斯王子抓回来。

source: And if not, there will be nothing to fear. We can frame it as a routine investigation of the town's seedier alleyways.
target: 如果不是，也没什么可担心的。我们可以说，这只是对镇上那些藏污纳垢的小巷进行例行调查。

source: There can be no harm in investigating.
target: 调查一下，不会有什么坏处。

source: So be it. Keep your profile low.
target: 那就这样吧。行事低调些。

source: Of course, my lord, of course.
target: 当然，陛下，当然。

source: And one last thing. If you come away empty-handed...
target: 还有最后一件事。如果你们空手而归……

source: There shall be no more talk of pulling peace agreements with Norway. Now, or evermore.
target: 就不许再提废除与挪威的和平协议。现在不许，以后也永远不许。

source: This sort of thing has the power to grow from rumor to dangerous absolute if we do not either confirm it or hinder it at the knees.
target: 这种事，要么查证属实，要么彻底遏止。否则，传闻就可能变成人人深信不疑的危险定论。

source: Yes, my lord. If this town investigation bears no fruit, I think that's wise.
target: 是，陛下。如果在镇上的调查一无所获，我认为这样做很明智。

source: Then we may need to pursue further action. I'm convinced Fortinbras means to act against us somehow. We simply haven't identified the method yet.
target: 那我们可能还需要采取进一步行动。我确信福丁布拉斯打算以某种方式对付我们。我们只是还没查清具体手段。

source: Let us be done with this, then.
target: 那就到此为止吧。

source: Thank goodness. It sounds like everyone's collectively come to their senses.
target: 谢天谢地。听起来大家总算都清醒过来了。

source: Bernardo and his men should mobilize soon. Here's hoping they find Fortinbras.
target: 贝尔纳多和他的手下应该很快就会出动。希望他们能找到福丁布拉斯。

source: Then there won't be a coup.
target: 这样就不会有政变了。

source: Men, follow me.
target: 弟兄们，跟我来。

source: Wot's all this about, Captain?
target: 队长，这是要干啥？

source: We're operating on a special request from the King, to find Prince Fortinbras.
target: 我们奉国王的特别指示行动，寻找福丁布拉斯王子。

source: We have recent cause to believe the Prince is hiding out in town.
target: 最近得到的线索让我们有理由相信，王子正藏在镇上。

source: P-P-Prince Fortinbras?!
target: 福、福、福丁布拉斯王子？！

source: Why, that lyin', connivin' dog...
target: 哼，那个满嘴谎话、阴险狡诈的狗东西……

source: This will take the form of an ordinary sweep. Raise no alarm, and mention nothing of our business.
target: 这次行动要装作普通搜查。不要引起恐慌，也不要提起我们的真正目的。

source: If we do find him, bringing him under arrest is our first priority.
target: 如果我们确实找到了他，首要任务就是将他逮捕。

source: And if we find nothing, it is the King's desire that we give the townspeople nothing to fear.
target: 如果我们一无所获，国王希望我们不要让镇民感到害怕。

source: Aye, Captain.
target: 是，队长。

source: Given the turmoil within Elsinore, I don't feel right leaving the court unprotected—so we'll be rather light for this endeavor.
target: 埃尔西诺内部动荡，我放心不下让宫廷无人保护——所以这次行动的人手会比较少。

source: Are the five o' us enough? What if Fortinbras 'as men of 'is own?
target: 咱们五个够吗？要是福丁布拉斯也带了人呢？

source: It's certainly not an ideal staffing scenario. But we must do what we must do.
target: 这样的人手安排确实不理想。但该做的事，我们还是得做。

source: (This doesn't seem promising.)
target: （看来不太乐观。）

source: The five of us will lead the initial foray, but the rest of the Castle Guard will be swift to follow.
target: 我们五个先行，其余城堡卫兵很快就会跟上。

source: I'm confident that we're well-staffed to handle this endeavor. We'll quickly overtake whatever cohort Fortinbras has.
target: 我相信我们有足够的人手完成这次行动。无论福丁布拉斯带了什么队伍，我们都能迅速将他们击败。

source: Aye, captain!
target: 是，队长！

source: Let's have at it!
target: 动手吧！

source: Knock on every door.
target: 挨家挨户敲门。

source: If the occupants refuse, force entry.
target: 如果住户不肯开门，就强行进入。

source: We found somethin'!
target: 我们有发现！

source: Who are you?
target: 你是谁？

source: Marcellus. Remove his hood.
target: 马塞勒斯。摘下他的兜帽。

source: As I thought. You are the singular Prince Fortinbras.
target: 果然不出我所料。你就是那位非同一般的福丁布拉斯王子。

source: And you are here with the intent of usurping the King of Denmark.
target: 你来这里，是想篡夺丹麦国王的王位。

source: Indeed. I came to do what my father could not.
target: 没错。我来完成父亲没能做到的事。

source: You came ill-prepared and undermanned, I see.
target: 看来，你们准备不足，人手也不够。

source: An ambush?
target: 有埋伏？

source: We can't hold them off, Captain!
target: 队长，我们挡不住他们！

source: They're retreating—
target: 他们在撤退——

source: They were deflected, but—the Prince escaped, no doubt to whatever rathole they maintain.
target: 他们被击退了，可是——王子逃了，肯定逃回了他们藏身的哪个鼠窝。

source: We failed.
target: 我们失败了。

source: We should report these events to the King.
target: 我们应该把这些事报告给国王。

source: ...We were short, m'lord. We knew it wos a risky move.
target: ……大人，咱们人手不够。我们早就知道，这一趟很冒险。

source: Aye. Had we not left men back in Elsinore, we might have prevailed today.
target: 是啊。要是没有留人驻守埃尔西诺，我们今天也许就赢了。

source: Had all been peaceful within the castle, then perhaps...
target: 要是城堡里一直平安无事，那或许……

source: But there's no sense waxing philosophical about what might have been.
target: 但对本可能发生的事大发感慨，也没有意义。

source: Our failure here was absolute, and I must acknowledge it to everyone.
target: 这次我们彻底失败了，我必须向所有人承认这一点。

source: You killed my finest officers. Good men of large standing.
target: 你们杀了我最优秀的军官。他们都是声望卓著的好人。

source: I know not how you found us, but it would appear I have been summarily outmatched.
target: 我不知道你们是怎么找到我们的，但看来，我已经被彻底击败了。

source: We received a tip from Lady Ophelia here. She knew you would be in town.
target: 我们收到了这位奥菲莉娅女士提供的线索。她知道你会在镇上。

source: I have heard tell of this Lady Ophelia before. Who is she?
target: 我以前就听人提起过这位奥菲莉娅女士。她是谁？

source: I'm the one you were going to have killed. Not anymore.
target: 我就是你原本打算让人杀掉的那个人。现在不可能了。

source: Men, take him to the dungeon. I shall work with the King on how best to proceed.
target: 弟兄们，把他押进地牢。我会和国王商议接下来怎么处理最好。

source: Well! What have the dogs sniffed out now?
target: 哦！猎犬们这回又嗅出了什么？

source: A hare in our trap! And a fat one, at that.
target: 陷阱里落了一只野兔！还是只肥的。

source: Young Prince Fortinbras. Welcome to Elsinore.
target: 年轻的福丁布拉斯王子。欢迎来到埃尔西诺。

source: Had I but one more day, our positions would have been exchanged here, Denmark.
target: 丹麦王，只要再给我一天，此刻你我的处境就会颠倒过来。

source: Yes, well, you didn't, and they aren't.
target: 是啊，可你没有那一天，我们的处境也没颠倒。

source: What shall I do with you now? Perhaps write to your uncle and ransom you back in chains?
target: 现在该怎么处置你呢？或许写信给你叔父，让他付赎金，再把你锁着送回去？

source: That old man Norway, impotent and bedridden. He doesn't know about this deceit of yours, does he?
target: 那位挪威老国王，衰弱无力，卧床不起。他还不知道你这番背信弃义的勾当，是吧？

source: Yes. I will use you to re-fill Denmark's coffers, and secure a true peace between us.
target: 没错。我要利用你重新充实丹麦的国库，也为我们两国争取真正的和平。

source: But not just yet, I think.
target: 不过，我想还不用急。

source: First, I think I'll let you enjoy the darkness and the silence a little while.
target: 我想，先让你享受一阵黑暗与寂静吧。

source: Perhaps Bernardo can give you a turn on the rack. Or a little carving to remember us by.
target: 或许可以让贝尔纳多给你上一次拉刑架。或者在你身上刻几刀，让你记住我们。

source: (My lord, is that wise?)
target: （陛下，这样明智吗？）

source: Mmm, perhaps not. But neither was this coup of the Prince's. I'm only having a little fun.
target: 嗯，也许不明智。但王子这场政变也不明智。我只是找点乐子。

source: Regardless, the day is won. This battle goes to Denmark.
target: 无论如何，今天我们赢了。这场战斗的胜利属于丹麦。

source: Sweet dreams, my dear Prince.
target: 祝你好梦，亲爱的王子。

source: We must uncover a way to communicate this checkmate to all in Elsinore.
target: 我们得想个办法，让埃尔西诺的所有人都知道，我们已将对手将死。

source: At once, Your Highness. As soon as we're prepared to make an announcement, let us do so.
target: 遵命，陛下。一准备好，我们就立即发布公告。

source: That's the herald's horn.
target: 那是传令官的号角声。

source: Bernardo and the King are preparing to make a statement about Fortinbras, I expect. I should attend.
target: 我想，贝尔纳多和国王正准备公布福丁布拉斯的事。我应该去听听。

source: This is an unusual time for an announcement. I ought to go see.
target: 这个时候发布公告，可不寻常。我该去看看。

source: This is an unusual time for an announcement.
target: 这个时候发布公告，可不寻常。

source: My apologies for the sudden disturbance, my lords and ladies.
target: 各位大人、女士，抱歉突然打扰大家。

source: I bring to you some sudden news.
target: 我有一则突发消息要告诉各位。

source: My men and I learned earlier of a Norwegian plot to overthrow His Majesty and bring about the subjugation of Denmark.
target: 此前，我和手下得知，挪威人正在密谋推翻陛下，征服丹麦。

source: Prince Fortinbras aimed to violate his peacetime agreement with us in the name of bloody revenge.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子打算以血腥复仇之名，违背与我们的和平协议。

source: However, thanks to some well-timed information, we were able to stop him in his tracks and bring him under arrest.
target: 不过，多亏情报来得及时，我们得以阻止他，并将他逮捕。

source: He's now safely contained in Elsinore's dungeon, down in the casemates.
target: 如今，他已被严密关押在埃尔西诺地下堡垒的地牢里。

source: Does this mean peace?
target: 这意味着和平了吗？

source: Is the war with Norway at an end?
target: 与挪威的战争结束了吗？

source: Does this mean peace for us, at last?
target: 这意味着我们终于能过上太平日子了吗？

source: I have never known a longtime peace in Elsinore.
target: 我从没见过埃尔西诺有过长久的太平。

source: Does this mean peace for Denmark at last?
target: 这意味着丹麦终于迎来和平了吗？

source: What happens now?
target: 接下来会怎么样？

source: Why, we'll make a show of force to old King Norway, bedridden back home!
target: 当然是向那位在国内卧床不起的挪威老国王展示我们的实力！

source: Send his nephew home in chains. Show him what happens to unruly boys who cannot learn to act with civility.
target: 把他的侄子锁上镣铐送回家。让他看看，不肯学着守礼、胡作非为的小子会有什么下场。

source: Regrettably, I remain unconvinced this is the end of anything.
target: 遗憾的是，我仍不相信这意味着任何事情的结束。

source: This is merely the beginning.
target: 这仅仅是个开始。

source: I do not believe Prince Fortinbras has any intentions of relenting. The wise thing to do would be to execute him as an enemy of the state.
target: 我不认为福丁布拉斯王子有任何收手的打算。明智的做法，是将他作为国家的敌人处决。

source: However, were we to do so, we would invoke the wrath of his uncle, the King of Norway.
target: 然而，如果我们这么做，就会激怒他的叔父，挪威国王。

source: There is no simple solution. All this is but a temporary peace.
target: 没有简单的解决办法。这一切换来的，不过是暂时的和平。

source: Thanks to some well-timed information, we were able to intercept the Prince in town and drive him off.
target: 多亏情报来得及时，我们得以在镇上截住王子，将他击退。

source: We... had hoped to capture him. But recent losses have stretched our forces thin, it seems. He escaped our grasp.
target: 我们……原本希望抓住他。但看来，近期的损失让我们的兵力捉襟见肘。他从我们手里逃了。

source: Still--whatever he was planning has been delayed, at least.
target: 不过——无论他原本有什么计划，至少现在都被延缓了。

source: (With any luck, this has brought me enough time to meet Simona.)
target: （但愿这为我争取到了足够的时间，让我去见西蒙娜。）

source: Let us prepare for a longer fight.
target: 准备迎接更漫长的战斗吧。

source: I leave it in your hands, Bernardo.
target: 这就交给你了，贝尔纳多。

source: I'll have word sent to rally all troops who would hear the call.
target: 我会派人传信，集结所有愿意响应号召的部队。

source: Until then, everyone, please remain vigilant.
target: 在那之前，请各位保持警惕。

source: So? Now what, my lord?
target: 那么，大人，现在怎么办？

source: Both of us in a birdcage.
target: 我们俩都被关进了鸟笼。

source: Hmph. Far from it.
target: 哼。还远没到那一步。

source: Don't fret, Lady Birgitta.
target: 别担心，比尔吉塔女士。

source: I haven't given up hope on returning to my men. This court is already fraying, I can see it. If any piece falls, we'll have our chance.
target: 我还没放弃回到手下身边的希望。我看得出来，这个宫廷已经开始分崩离析。只要有一枚棋子倒下，我们就有机会。

source: I have other loyal agents. All they need is an excuse to act.
target: 我还有其他忠心的密探。他们只缺一个行动的借口。

source: I'm less optimistic.
target: 我可没这么乐观。

source: Lady Birgitta.
target: 比尔吉塔女士。

source: My lord!
target: 大人！

source: How did they discover my location? Did you--
target: 他们怎么发现我的藏身之处的？是不是你——

source: Of course not! But you were imprisoned. The other men had no clarity of action behind them.
target: 当然不是！可您被关了起来。其余的人都不知道该怎么行动。

source: I'm certain they'll rally regardless.
target: 我确信，无论如何，他们都会重新集结。

source: Without you, they won't accomplish anything against Elsinore. They're scattered. Frightened. They needed you.
target: 没有您，他们对付埃尔西诺就不会有任何成果。他们散了。怕了。他们需要您。

source: Perhaps they shall have me yet. This court is already fraying, I can see it. If any piece falls from the board, we'll have our chance.
target: 或许他们还能有我在。我看得出来，这个宫廷已经开始分崩离析。只要有一枚棋子从棋盘上倒下，我们就有机会。

source: If there is but a moment of chaos...
target: 只要有片刻的混乱……

source: Then I—or one of your officers—must come here to free you. I understand.
target: 那我——或者您手下的一位军官——就得来这里救您出去。我明白了。

source: ('If any piece falls.')
target: （“只要有一枚棋子倒下。”）

source: (I need to keep them all alive.)
target: （我得让他们全都活下来。）

source: (No one must die. I can save them. I have to.)
target: （谁都不能死。我能救他们。我必须做到。）

source: Ah, my captain. It's good to see your face.
target: 啊，我的队长。见到你真好。

source: I never doubted you would come for me.
target: 我从没怀疑过你会来救我。

source: The King's untimely death has brought them all together... and left you unkept, my lord.
target: 大人，国王的突然去世让他们全聚到了一起……也让您这边无人看守。

source: The Queen's untimely death has brought them all together... and left you unkept, my lord.
target: 大人，王后的突然去世让他们全聚到了一起……也让您这边无人看守。

source: The young Prince's untimely death has brought them all together... and left you unkept, my lord.
target: 大人，年轻王子的突然去世让他们全聚到了一起……也让您这边无人看守。

source: The old Master Chamberlain's untimely death has brought them all together... and left you unkept, my lord.
target: 大人，老宫廷总管的突然去世让他们全聚到了一起……也让您这边无人看守。

source: Lord Laertes' untimely death has brought them all together... and left you unkept, my lord.
target: 大人，雷欧提斯大人的突然去世让他们全聚到了一起……也让您这边无人看守。

source: Let their chaos be our convenience.
target: 就让他们的混乱成为我们的便利。

source: Come, Your Highness. I'll return you to the gates.
target: 走吧，殿下。我会送您回城门。

source: Come, Your Highness. We'll get you to the gates.
target: 走吧，殿下。我们会送您到城门。

source: Let's make haste. I'm not sure how long Bernardo's men will let down their guard.
target: 我们快走吧。我不知道贝尔纳多的手下还会放松警戒多久。

source: I have failed in my duties most utterly.
target: 我彻底辜负了自己的职责。

source: As I brought everyone together for the announcement this morning, one of my men reported back from Fortinbras's cell.
target: 今天早上，我召集大家来听公告时，一名手下从福丁布拉斯的牢房回来禀报。

source: The Prince has escaped.
target: 王子逃走了。

source: Lady Birgitta is missing as well.
target: 比尔吉塔女士也不见了。

source: (So I witnessed.)
target: （我亲眼见到了。）

source: What happened? How could he escape?
target: 发生了什么？他怎么会逃出去？

source: I believe his men watched for any sign of chaos within our ranks to come forth.
target: 我想，他的手下一直在等我们内部出现混乱的迹象，好趁机行动。

source: That moment of congregation was the only moment they needed.
target: 我们集合的那一刻，就足够他们动手了。

source: So if someone dies... I see, now.
target: 所以，如果有人死了……现在我明白了。

source: Surely, the Prince's forthcoming assault will be delayed, but—not spurned, as we'd hoped.
target: 王子即将发动的进攻肯定会推迟，但——不会像我们希望的那样就此作罢。

source: I'm rallying my men now. I'm certain we will still prevail.
target: 我正在集结手下。我相信我们仍然能获胜。

source: (I had everything lined up! It seems fixing our external affairs means little, if internal affairs are still bloody.)
target: （我明明把一切都安排好了！看来，只要内部还在流血，解决外患也没多大用处。）

source: It is truly a detestable situation.
target: 这局面实在令人痛恨。

source: (There has to be a way to keep them all alive.)
target: （一定有办法让他们全都活下来。）

source: I'm aware of the situation, Bernardo. Please—do your best.
target: 情况我知道了，贝尔纳多。请你——尽力而为。

source: (It won't matter regardless.)
target: （反正也不会有什么用。）

source: I must inform the others. I'm sorry I could not do more.
target: 我得去通知其他人。抱歉，我没能做得更多。

source: (Hopefully, this at least bought me enough time to meet Simona.)
target: （希望这至少为我争取到了足够的时间，去见西蒙娜。）

source: Everyone, out of the bar. Immediately.
target: 所有人，离开酒馆。立刻。

source: In the name of Norway, submit!
target: 以挪威之名，投降！

source: If you flee, you'll be killed!
target: 逃跑就没命！

source: It's time. Begin the siege.
target: 时候到了。开始围攻。

source: And what have we here...?
target: 瞧瞧，这是谁……？

source: Who are you, dressed in fine clothing?
target: 你是谁，穿得这么华贵？

source: ...Ah. Dark little noblewoman. I've heard of you: Lord Polonius's daughter.
target: ……啊。肤色黝黑的小贵族姑娘。我听说过你：波洛涅斯大人的女儿。

source: Headed up to the castle to tell the King about our siege, it would seem.
target: 看来，你是要去城堡，把我们围攻的消息告诉国王。

source: My lady, the old ways are over. Your family means nothing now. The reign of Norway begins today.
target: 小姐，旧时代结束了。你的家族如今已经无足轻重。挪威的统治从今天开始。

source: Submit to me, and there is no need for useless bloodshed. I do not wish your life.
target: 向我投降，就不必白白流血。我不想要你的命。

source: If you're waiting for fear or deference, I'll show you neither.
target: 如果你在等我害怕或恭顺，那你一样也别想看到。

source: You're attacking my home and my family. If you so eschew violence, what's all this?
target: 你正在攻击我的家园，还有我的家人。既然你这么反对暴力，这一切又算什么？

source: I did not come here for debate. I came to take action against a tyrant. If you would defend him, so be it. Men, keep her in our custody. Indefinitely.
target: 我来这里不是为了争辩，而是为了讨伐暴君。如果你要维护他，那就随你。来人，把她关押起来。无限期关押。

source: The invasion marches onward.
target: 入侵仍在继续。

source: We're here to rescue our Prince from you louts!
target: 我们是来从你们这帮混账手里救出王子的！

source: And we won't stop until every wall is rubble.
target: 不把每一道墙都夷为废墟，我们绝不罢休。

source: (I can't stay here. If they capture me, they'll use me as ransom.)
target: （我不能留在这里。如果被抓住，他们会拿我索要赎金。）

source: Fortinbras's capture was an insult to Norway, but now that he's returned, we'll return the action tenfold!
target: 俘虏福丁布拉斯是对挪威的侮辱，如今他回来了，我们要十倍奉还！

source: Men, something unusual has happened today in capturing Prince Fortinbras.
target: 弟兄们，今天发生了一件不寻常的事：我们俘虏了福丁布拉斯王子。

source: This may seem advantageous to us, but I anticipate it is only an omen of more to come.
target: 这或许看起来对我们有利，但我预料，这只是更多事端的前兆。

source: All of you are to be on highest guard over the next few days.
target: 接下来几天，你们所有人都要保持最高警惕。

source: Any sign of suspicious activity—any outbreaks of violence in town—relay them to me personally.
target: 任何可疑活动的迹象——镇上发生的任何暴力事件——都要直接向我报告。

source: Do you all understand?
target: 都明白了吗？

source: A' course, Cap'n.
target: 当然明白，队长。

source: Good. Dismissed.
target: 很好。解散。

source: Lady Ophelia—please come wiv' me.
target: 奥菲莉娅小姐——请跟我来。

source: The King's requested everyone gather in the Great Hall.
target: 国王让大家去大厅集合。

source: No need to be alarmed, everyone.
target: 各位，不必惊慌。

source: E-everything's quite under control.
target: 一、一切都在掌控之中。

source: (He doesn't look confident.)
target: （他看起来没什么底气。）

source: I've ordered you all here for your own protection.
target: 我命令你们来这里，是为了保护你们。

source: Right now, all remaining men, including Bernardo, are fortifying our outer walls against Norway's attacks.
target: 现在，包括贝尔纳多在内，所有剩余的士兵都在加固外墙，抵御挪威的进攻。

source: As we have Prince Fortinbras now, they've agreed to a temporary truce. But in all likelihood, it shall not last.
target: 因为福丁布拉斯王子如今在我们手里，他们同意暂时休战。但这恐怕不会持续太久。

source: I've sent word to the nobility to commit themselves to me and send reinforcements posthaste.
target: 我已经传话给贵族们，要他们效忠于我，并火速派遣援军。

source: No matter what, this central tower is strong. It has withstood many an invasion throughout its history.
target: 无论如何，这座中央高塔十分坚固。在它漫长的历史中，曾抵挡过多次入侵。

source: Indeed, it is the only section that remained when Elsinore was last reduced to rubble.
target: 事实上，上一次埃尔西诺被夷为废墟时，只有它留存了下来。

source: You mean we're all meant to sequester here?
target: 您是说，我们都得躲在这里？

source: For the time being, yes. Everyone must remain here.
target: 暂时是这样。所有人都必须留在这里。

source: Make yourselves comfortable. If need be, the kitchen is stocked and the fire is stoked.
target: 大家尽管自在些。如有需要，厨房里储备充足，炉火也烧得正旺。

source: There is an adjacent chamber with servants' quarters as well. It is meager, but sufficient.
target: 旁边还有一间屋子，设有仆人的住处。虽然简陋，但也够用了。

source: We shan't be here longer than a day if our allies respond as they ought.
target: 如果盟友们如期响应，我们在这里待的时间就不会超过一天。

source: Nothin' to fear, folks! I'll be keepin yeh all safe in the meantime.
target: 大家伙儿，没什么好怕的！这段时间我会护着你们。

source: How long do you think this will go on, Horatio?
target: 霍拉旭，你觉得这会持续多久？

source: Hard to say.
target: 很难说。

source: Now the true war begins.
target: 现在，真正的战争才开始。

source: This will not be easily finished.
target: 这不会轻易结束。

source: I'll be the first to say it, Ophelia. I am afraid.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我先说吧。我很害怕。

source: Of what?
target: 怕什么？

source: Not of death. I have seen battle many a time.
target: 不是怕死。我经历过许多次战斗。

source: But of... the war.
target: 而是怕……战争。

source: Some wars are over swiftly. The fight is won, one side destroys another, and all rebuild.
target: 有些战争很快就结束了。胜负已分，一方击溃另一方，然后大家开始重建。

source: But some wars... are wasting wars.
target: 但有些战争……是消耗战。

source: When men whittle each other to the bone, refusing to acknowledge a victor, yet failing to force the other to defeat...
target: 双方把彼此消耗到山穷水尽，谁也不肯承认对方获胜，却又没法逼对方认输……

source: It's hell on a country. Everyone loses in a wasting war.
target: 这会让整个国家陷入地狱。消耗战里，所有人都是输家。

source: But we have Prince Fortinbras in jail. We could win, couldn't we? If the reinforcements arrive?
target: 可福丁布拉斯王子还被我们关在牢里。如果援军到了，我们能赢的，不是吗？

source: Those, too, will be meager.
target: 援军也不会有多少。

source: Claudius was dismissive of the nobility. They will be hesitant to lend him their men. Some may have outright allied with Fortinbras.
target: 克劳狄斯以前不把贵族们放在眼里。他们不会轻易把兵借给他。有些人可能已经直接与福丁布拉斯结盟了。

source: And even with the Prince in jail, they will not yield to Claudius.
target: 即使王子被关在牢里，他们也不会向克劳狄斯屈服。

source: Many are quietly praying for a coup, and a new election to the throne...
target: 许多人都在暗暗祈盼一场政变，重新选出一位国王……

source: But we're still alive.
target: 但我们还活着。

source: Isn't that what matters? We survived. We lived on.
target: 这才是最重要的，不是吗？我们活下来了。我们继续活着。

source: It's certainly a perk.
target: 这确实算是个好处。

source: And when the war is over, something will remain, one way or another.
target: 等战争结束，不管怎样，总会有些什么留下来。

source: We'll build a new Denmark. We'll raise new walls. We'll patch the holes.
target: 我们会建起一个新的丹麦。我们会筑起新的城墙。我们会补好缺口。

source: Well, then. I daresay you are far too chipper at the moment.
target: 好吧。我得说，这种时候你也太乐观了。

source: Where is the wine? Surely there's some in the kitchen, right?
target: 酒在哪里？厨房里总该有些吧？

source: If we're all going right into the mouth of Hell, might as well be drunk when we arrive.
target: 如果我们都要走进地狱的大门，那不如醉着进去。

source: Hear, hear.
target: 说得好。

source: Don't wander too far.
target: 别走太远。

source: (I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever.)
target: （我可以用命运之书，永远保留这个世界。）

source: (This world is collapsing now. I feel it.)
target: （这个世界正在崩塌。我感觉到了。）

source: Carried back again.
target: 又被带了回去。

source: (...I still don't know what keeps me trapped here.)
target: （……我还是不知道，是什么把我困在这里。）

source: (Until then, I can never see what lies beyond the horizon of this world.)
target: （在弄清之前，我永远无法看见这个世界的地平线之外有什么。）

source: Good morning, Horatio.
target: 早上好，霍拉旭。

source: Are you well this morning?
target: 今天早上你还好吗？

source: Of course. Always up for a walk to lift the spirits!
target: 当然。我随时都愿意散散步，振奋一下精神！

source: You are the only man who will take me for a stroll these days, Horatio.
target: 霍拉旭，如今只有你这个男人肯陪我散步了。

source: It's as though half the time these days my husband is concealed away in his chambers, lost in thought.
target: 这些日子，我丈夫似乎有一半时间都躲在自己的房间里，沉思不语。

source: My husband would have gone on these strolls with me, once.
target: 从前，我丈夫会陪我这样散步。

source: Even if my husband were available to do it, I don't know that I'd care to walk with him much. Not now, at least.
target: 即使我丈夫有空，我也不确定自己还愿不愿意常常和他散步。至少现在不愿意。

source: My Queen, these walks are a treat. Your beauty is so great that when people see us out, I look handsome just standing next to you.
target: 王后，陪您散步是一种享受。您如此美丽，人们看见我们出门时，连站在您身旁的我都显得英俊了。

source: Heh. You flatter me.
target: 呵。你真会夸人。

source: Say, Horatio...
target: 对了，霍拉旭……

source: I know nothing about you. Have you ever told me of yourself?
target: 我对你一无所知。你跟我讲过自己的事吗？

source: My late husband often spoke of your prowess on the battlefield. But what before that?
target: 我已故的丈夫常常提起你在战场上的英勇。可在那之前呢？

source: There's not much to tell, my lady. I'm but a poor footsoldier. Then I followed Hamlet to Wittenberg, for a time.
target: 没什么可说的，王后。我不过是个穷步兵。后来我跟着哈姆雷特去了维滕贝格，待过一段时间。

source: I didn't care much for the area, I'm afraid. No offense to your Bohemian heritage.
target: 恐怕我不太喜欢那一带。我无意冒犯您的波希米亚出身。

source: No offense taken. I consider myself Danish now. But where were you born?
target: 我不介意。我现在觉得自己是丹麦人了。不过，你出生在哪里？

source: Italy, your Highness.
target: 意大利，殿下。

source: Italy! What! So far from here? What is it like?
target: 意大利！什么！离这里那么远？那里是什么样的？

source: Italy is... hard to describe. Loud and hot, and at once, brimming with quiet beauty.
target: 意大利……很难形容。喧闹而炎热，却又处处有着静谧的美。

source: My father was a spice merchant in Venice, originally of Calicut. He sailed the route and took me with him often, when I was a boy. It was in Calicut he met my mother.
target: 我父亲是威尼斯的香料商人，原籍卡利卡特。他往返于这条航线，我小时候，他常常带着我一起。他就是在卡利卡特遇见我母亲的。

source: But their love was brief, her pregnancy was a secret, and they were unwed. After I was born, my father absconded with me to Venice to save her reputation.
target: 但他们的爱情很短暂，她怀孕的事也瞒着别人，而且他们没有结婚。我出生后，为了保全她的名声，父亲带着我悄悄去了威尼斯。

source: How sad for your mother, don't you think?
target: 你母亲该有多难过，你不觉得吗？

source: I wouldn't know. I saw her just once or twice when I was a boy. She was married off to another man. After that, Father and I never saw her again.
target: 我也不知道。我小时候只见过她一两次。她被安排嫁给了另一个男人。从那以后，父亲和我就再也没见过她。

source: But my father loved me dearly.
target: 但父亲非常疼爱我。

source: What of your life after that? Venice, India, Denmark—you've traveled perpetually.
target: 那之后你又过着怎样的生活？威尼斯、印度、丹麦——你一直在四处奔走。

source: Why, my lady, my secrets are the key to my charm!
target: 哎呀，王后，我的魅力可全靠这些秘密！

source: It's just a lot of nothing anyhow. I far prefer my life these days. Venice holds certain painful memories for me.
target: 反正都是些无关紧要的事。我更喜欢现在的生活。威尼斯留给我一些痛苦的回忆。

source: I'm sorry to hear that. Well, regardless, I'm glad you're here.
target: 听你这么说，我很难过。不过，无论如何，我很高兴你在这里。

source: As am I.
target: 我也是。

source: I must go. Same time tomorrow?
target: 我得走了。明天还是这个时候？

source: Of course, Your Highness.
target: 当然，殿下。

source: My lady, shall we stroll?
target: 王后，我们去散步吧？

source: Of course!
target: 当然！

source: Yesterday I spilled all my secrets to you, my Queen. Are you going to return the favor?
target: 王后，昨天我把自己的秘密都告诉您了。您也要礼尚往来吗？

source: Hmm. You want to know about me?
target: 嗯。你想了解我？

source: Is that so surprising?
target: 这有那么意外吗？

source: N-no, it's just... I've never been asked before. Hmm, where to begin...
target: 不、不是，只是……以前从没人问过我。嗯，该从哪里说起呢……

source: When I was a girl in Bohemia, my father the Emperor once told me I would be one of the most powerful women in the world.
target: 我还是个在波希米亚生活的小姑娘时，身为皇帝的父亲曾告诉我，我会成为世上最有权势的女人之一。

source: And he was right. He sent me here to Denmark when I was just a girl. I grew up here, between Copenhagen and Elsinore, betrothed to Hamlet's father.
target: 他说得没错。我还是个小姑娘时，他就把我送来了丹麦。我在这里长大，往返于哥本哈根和埃尔西诺之间，与哈姆雷特的父亲订了婚。

source: I followed Hamlet everywhere. He was all I knew, for a time. The only friend I had. He, and Claudius, his brother, and my elder sister Margaret.
target: 哈姆雷特走到哪里，我就跟到哪里。有一段时间，我的世界里只有他。他是我唯一的朋友。还有他的兄弟克劳狄斯，以及我姐姐玛格丽特。

source: My elder sister Margaret stayed behind in Austria. She's very powerful now, with land all to her own, and armies at her beckon...
target: 我姐姐玛格丽特留在了奥地利。如今她权势显赫，有自己的领地，还有听她号令的军队……

source: I suppose this is... all a very different life from the one you've lived. I hope I'm not offending.
target: 我想，这一切……与你过的生活很不一样。希望这些话没有冒犯你。

source: On the contrary, I find it very interesting.
target: 恰恰相反，我觉得很有意思。

source: What became of your sister Margaret? Do you speak to her still?
target: 您姐姐玛格丽特后来怎么样了？您还和她联系吗？

source: Margaret was everything to me when we were young. I loved her more than life itself.
target: 小时候，玛格丽特就是我的一切。我爱她胜过自己的生命。

source: When I came to Elsinore... I wrote her letters every day. And she wrote back, sometimes.
target: 来到埃尔西诺后……我每天都给她写信。她有时也会回信。

source: But it was always to encourage me to cease contact, to study more, to love my new country and forget Austria entirely.
target: 但她总是劝我别再联系她，多用功学习，爱我的新国家，把奥地利彻底忘掉。

source: Eventually, she stopped responding entirely. And I haven't seen her since.
target: 最后，她彻底不再回信了。此后我也没再见过她。

source: I missed her. I still dream of her sometimes—of us, playing as children again.
target: 我很想她。现在我有时还会梦见她——梦见我们又变成孩子，一起玩耍。

source: I'm so sorry, my lady.
target: 王后，真为您难过。

source: How perfectly awful. I've never had siblings, but I can imagine.
target: 这实在太难受了。我没有兄弟姐妹，但我能想象。

source: It is no matter. All the love I had for Margaret, I have poured into my husband and son. I hope they have appreciated it.
target: 没关系。我把对玛格丽特的爱，全都倾注到了丈夫和儿子身上。希望他们领会了这份心意。

source: Apologies, but I must go.
target: 抱歉，我得走了。

source: Understood. See you tomorrrow.
target: 明白。明天见。

source: Ah, my lady... fresh as a rose.
target: 啊，王后……您如玫瑰般娇艳。

source: You flatterer. Shall we stroll?
target: 你这张嘴真会哄人。我们去散步吧？

source: So. My Queen. I find myself poring over an interesting dilemma.
target: 那么，王后。我一直在琢磨一个有意思的难题。

source: Oh? Do you, now?
target: 哦？是吗？

source: What is to become of Hamlet now?
target: 哈姆雷特今后会怎么样？

source: Are you to quietly betroth him somewhere, given all that's happened?
target: 发生了这么多事，您打算悄悄给他安排一门婚事吗？

source: Send him away into some new life?
target: 把他送走，让他开始新的生活？

source: Not with the predicament he's in.
target: 以他现在的处境，不行。

source: Yes. You see, your son is a fascinating creature in a fascinating position. High-born, yet utterly unsurrounded by ladies of his equivalence.
target: 是啊。您看，您的儿子是个有意思的人，处境也很有意思。他出身高贵，身边却一个与他身份相当的女子都没有。

source: My husband and I have both noticed this problem.
target: 我和丈夫都注意到了这个问题。

source: Is that why he remains unbetrothed to any woman?
target: 所以他才一直没有与任何女子订婚？

source: That, among other... problems. I don't know that I'd be able to make a suitable match with the state he's in.
target: 这是原因之一，还有别的……问题。以他现在的状态，我也不知道能不能为他安排一门合适的婚事。

source: His mind's all strange at the moment.
target: 他现在的精神状态很不对劲。

source: He's killed a man. No court will want him. He shall be an outlaw in reputation, if not in name. I fear for his immediate future.
target: 他杀了人。没有哪个宫廷会接纳他。即使名义上不是，他也会背上亡命之徒的名声。我担心他眼下的前途。

source: Horatio, what will I do? I just...
target: 霍拉旭，我该怎么办？我只是……

source: My lady-in-waiting, Brit—Birgitta—comes from a high house. She'd make a suitable match, if a bit low in rank. But... I just don't know.
target: 我的宫廷侍女布莉特——比尔吉塔——出身名门。她会是个合适的婚配对象，虽然身份稍低了些。不过……我实在拿不定主意。

source: Low in rank, eh? Is that how it works?
target: 身份低，是吗？原来是这么回事？

source: Yes. In a perfect world, we would marry him to the daughter of a neighboring court to build strong ties, as I was at his age.
target: 是的。若一切理想，我们会让他迎娶邻国王室的女儿，以巩固两国关系。我在他这个年纪时，也是这样。

source: But all the eligible girls are tied up at the moment.
target: 可眼下，所有适龄的姑娘都已有婚约了。

source: Whatever is to happen to my son, when it has been done, I am sure things will be made right in the end.
target: 不管我儿子将来会经历什么，等一切尘埃落定，我相信最终都会好起来的。

source: Everything will be all right, my lady. You must hope so.
target: 一切都会好的，王后。您一定要抱着这个希望。

source: I certainly do.
target: 我当然是这么希望的。

source: I must bid you adieu, my lady.
target: 我得向您告辞了，王后。

source: And I you.
target: 那么，再会。

source: Let us hope we walk again tomorrow.
target: 但愿明天我们还能一起散步。

source: Ah. Hello, Horatio.
target: 啊。你好，霍拉旭。

source: I must admit, I hadn't thought I'd find you here.
target: 说实话，我没想到会在这里遇见你。

source: The castle has a somber air.
target: 城堡里的气氛很沉重。

source: Yes. Today is not a day for walking.
target: 是啊。今天不适合散步。

source: I believe it's safest if we part ways, lady.
target: 王后，我想我们还是各自离开最安全。

source: Retire to somewhere quieter.
target: 去个更安静的地方吧。

source: I believe you're right, Horatio.
target: 我想你说得对，霍拉旭。

source: Let us hope we can return to these summer strolls soon.
target: 但愿我们很快就能再像这样，在夏日里散步。

source: For now... farewell.
target: 眼下……就此别过吧。

source: What ails you, Gerta?
target: 你有什么烦心事，格尔塔？

source: I sense your unhappiness seeping through the floors of your chambers and into my kitchen.
target: 我感觉你的愁绪都穿过了寝宫的地板，渗进我的厨房来了。

source: My own son is against me. Is there anything worse in this world? What can a mother do?
target: 连我的亲生儿子都与我作对。这世上还有比这更糟的事吗？做母亲的能怎么办？

source: Even though he is to be King, I still sense Hamlet has been against me. What can a mother do?
target: 虽然哈姆雷特就要当国王了，可我仍觉得他一直在与我作对。做母亲的能怎么办？

source: The same as I once did for a troublesome little Queen-in-the-making.
target: 就像我当年对待某个淘气的小姑娘那样，她后来可是成了王后。

source: You mean... me?
target: 你是说……我？

source: Gerta, don't you remember? You were all scraped knees and dirty hair for years! Running with the hounds, clambering around the stables...
target: 格尔塔，你不记得了吗？那些年，你的膝盖总是擦破，头发总是脏兮兮的！跟着猎犬到处跑，在马厩里爬上爬下……

source: I told you then what I'll tell you now: children must be formed, through discipline, into adults.
target: 我当年对你说过的话，现在还要再说一遍：孩子必须经过管教，才能被塑造成大人。

source: Just as dough must be beaten nearly to its limit before it can rise, so too must Lord Hamlet be forced to leave his gloom.
target: 就像面团得捶打到几乎受不住，才能发起来一样，哈姆雷特殿下也得有人逼着，才能摆脱消沉。

source: I... I've tried, Irma, but I could never force my son from his grief before he's ready.
target: 我……我试过了，伊尔玛，可在儿子还没准备好之前，我实在不忍心逼他走出悲痛。

source: I believe he must find his own way out of this darkness.
target: 我相信，他必须自己找到走出这片黑暗的路。

source: (My lady merely needs a gentle push.)
target: （王后只需要有人轻轻推她一把。）

source: (And I am the one to deliver it.)
target: （而这个人就是我。）

source: With Claudius gone, can't we all simply take a reprieve from all this? From pressuring one another?
target: 克劳狄斯已经不在了，我们就不能暂时放下这些事，喘口气吗？别再互相逼迫了吗？

source: My son must find his own way. And now that he is to be King, I know he shall. I believe it in my truest heart.
target: 我的儿子必须自己找到出路。如今他就要当国王了，我知道他一定会找到的。我打心底里相信这一点。

source: Hmm. Perhaps. Perhaps bearing the mantle of his country will make his spine strong at last.
target: 嗯。也许吧。也许肩负起国家的重担，终于能让他挺直脊梁。

source: (My lady has shown Hamlet such gentleness.)
target: （王后对哈姆雷特如此温柔。）

source: (I merely pray that he returns the deed when he sits the throne.)
target: （我只祈求他登上王位后，也能以同样的温柔回报她。）

source: Irma, lovely lovely lovely Irma!
target: 伊尔玛，亲爱的、亲爱的、亲爱的伊尔玛！

source: My Prince.
target: 我的王子殿下。

source: Why did you invite me to this filthy kitchen, of all places?
target: 地方那么多，你为什么偏偏请我来这脏兮兮的厨房？

source: We needed to speak, Hamlet. About you. You run amok in the castle, grieving like a great dramatist...
target: 我们得谈谈，哈姆雷特。谈谈你的事。你在城堡里胡闹，悲痛起来像个大戏剧家……

source: Meanwhile, my lady weeps, wishing her son would come back to her.
target: 而王后却在哭泣，盼着她的儿子能回到她身边。

source: Hamlet is dead.
target: 哈姆雷特已经死了。

source: Only the one Hamlet, my lord. Please—treat your mother with respect—
target: 死的只有一位哈姆雷特，殿下。请您——尊重您的母亲——

source: No. I hear your request, but I feel no obligation to honor it.
target: 不。我听见你的请求了，但我觉得自己没有义务照办。

source: Are all your spoons where they should be? I heard tell they were considering wandering around.
target: 你的勺子都待在该待的地方吗？我听说它们正打算四处游荡呢。

source: Hitting unsuspecting princes upon the rear? Wanting to discipline me like a child?
target: 趁王子不备，往他的屁股上打？想把我当小孩子一样管教？

source: I imagine that would end very poorly.
target: 我想，那样的下场会非常糟糕。

source: My kitchen is full and well busy, Lord Hamlet. I have no time for idle chatter.
target: 哈姆雷特殿下，我的厨房人满为患，忙得不可开交。我没时间闲聊。

source: You're nothing but an old maid whispering in my mother's ear.
target: 你不过是个在我母亲耳边搬弄是非的老姑娘。

source: Until now, I have tolerated you merely... don't give me a reason to have you stabled like a cow.
target: 到现在为止，我不过是在容忍你……别给我理由，把你像母牛一样关进圈里。

source: My lady is distressed, Lord Hamlet. She wants to make amends. I have loved her since she was a child.
target: 哈姆雷特殿下，王后很难过。她想弥补。我从她还是个孩子时起，就一直疼爱着她。

source: If you had any sense of obedience—
target: 如果您还懂得半点服从——

source: —Which I don't.
target: ——我不懂。

source: —Or any love deep in the fog of your madness!
target: ——或者在您那疯狂的迷雾深处，还剩半点爱！

source: Certainly no love, either.
target: 爱当然也没有。

source: You are truly hopeless, aren't you?
target: 您真是无可救药了，是不是？

source: So they say. But at least I don't have one foot in the grave like you, old shrew.
target: 他们都这么说。可至少我不像你，一只脚都踏进棺材了，老泼妇。

source: Leave my kitchen. Now. At once. Out! Out!
target: 离开我的厨房。现在。立刻。出去！出去！

source: My lady, he is incorrigible.
target: 王后，他已经无可救药了。

source: Your son. Do you know what he says to me? Me, Irma, the woman who tended him as a babe?
target: 您的儿子。您知道他对我说了什么吗？对我，伊尔玛，在他还是婴儿时就照顾他的女人？

source: What now? I scarcely think I can stand to know.
target: 这次又怎么了？我几乎不敢听下去了。

source: He threatens me. In my own kitchen. He tells me I have one foot in the grave.
target: 他威胁我。就在我自己的厨房里。他说我一只脚已经踏进棺材了。

source: Oh, dear.
target: 唉，天哪。

source: Something must be done, lady. If I learned anything with you as a girl, it's that children need firm rails to grow straight and tall.
target: 王后，必须想想办法了。照顾小时候的您，让我明白了一件事：孩子需要牢靠的护栏，才能长得又直又高。

source: A wall which gives when pushed is one which can be clambered over. You see?
target: 一堵一推就松动的墙，自然也能翻过去。您明白吗？

source: I must try to speak with him again. I'll do so as soon as I can.
target: 我得再试着和他谈谈。我会尽快去的。

source: Mother, you have been a busy little bird... shrilling in everyone's ear about me.
target: 母亲，你这只小鸟可真忙……在每个人耳边尖声叽喳，说着我的事。

source: Hamlet. As the Queen and as your mother, I-I-I insist you drop this act at once!
target: 哈姆雷特。我既是王后，也是你的母亲，我、我、我要求你立刻停止这套把戏！

source: If not, I'll need to have the guards confine you to your room. Y-you're a nuisance to the whole castle in this mood.
target: 否则，我就得让卫兵把你关在房间里。你、你这副样子，搅得整个城堡不得安宁。

source: S-so... Irma's right, you simply must listen to me! Act cheerful and polite, or stay in isolation. It's your choice!
target: 所、所以……伊尔玛说得对，你必须听我的！要么表现得开朗有礼，要么独自关着。你自己选！

source: You want me to put on an act?
target: 你要我装样子？

source: Oh, but I have already. If you think my disgust is all but thinly-veiled now, you have only to wait.
target: 哦，可我早就在装了。要是你觉得我现在的厌恶已经快掩饰不住了，那就等着瞧吧。

source: You cheated me out of my inheritance by marrying that idiot Claudius as soon as you could remove Father's hat from the doorknob.
target: 父亲的帽子才刚能从门把手上拿下来，你就嫁给了克劳狄斯那个蠢货，骗走了本该由我继承的一切。

source: Then you have the gall to insist I act happy about it? You've made me look like a fool. The boy who would have been King, now forever a Prince.
target: 然后你还有脸要求我为此表现得高兴？你让我成了个笑话。一个本该成为国王的男孩，如今却永远只能当王子。

source: I hate you. I loathe you.
target: 我恨你。我厌恶你。

source: Be silent at once!
target: 立刻闭嘴！

source: No—you be silent, bitch.
target: 不——该闭嘴的是你，贱人。

source: I'll do whatever I please.
target: 我想做什么就做什么。

source: You will rob me of nothing more.
target: 你休想再夺走我的任何东西。

source: Hamlet, Hamlet, Hamlet.
target: 哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特。

source: You've gone too far, my boy. Too far for even the Lord's greatest forgiveness.
target: 孩子，你太过分了。过分到连主最宽大的赦免也容不下你。

source: A son who would treat his mother so is utterly without any redeeming light.
target: 一个会这样对待母亲的儿子，心里已经没有半点可救赎的光了。

source: My lady is blind with her pain. I must stanch this bleeding wound on her behalf.
target: 王后已经被痛苦蒙蔽了双眼。我必须替她止住这道伤口流出的血。

source: And unlike Gerta, I am far less patient.
target: 而我的耐心，比格尔塔少得多。

source: Please, Lord. Give me strength.
target: 主啊，求您赐我力量。

source: H-He battered her aside, Lord, as if she were nothing!
target: 主啊，他、他粗暴地把她打到一旁，仿佛她什么都不是！

source: But she loves him more than anything in the world.
target: 可她爱他，胜过世上的一切。

source: What do you want me to do, Lord? How shall I carry out Your justice?
target: 主啊，您要我怎么做？我该如何施行您的公义？

source: Must I not strike evil when I see it?
target: 看到邪恶，我难道不该出手惩治吗？

source: For surely, the boy is evil. I see the devil within him.
target: 那孩子无疑是邪恶的。我看见了他体内的魔鬼。

source: Please, help me. Help me to kill him.
target: 求您帮帮我。帮我杀了他。

source: But I don't need you to guide my hand. This is the sort of dish I understand how to make.
target: 但我不需要您指引我的手。这种菜肴，我知道该怎么做。

source: I didn't come here to apologize.
target: 我来这里不是为了道歉。

source: Nor to grovel at your tomb.
target: 也不是为了在你的墓前卑躬屈膝。

source: But there's something... I never said to you.
target: 但有件事……我从没对你说过。

source: I wish I'd died that night, the first time I tried to kill myself after Father's death.
target: 我真希望自己死在了那一夜，父亲去世后，我第一次试图自杀的那一夜。

source: Then you wouldn't have had to suffer like this.
target: 那样，你就不必受这样的苦了。

source: You could have lived on, grieving the loss of one branch of your family tree all at once.
target: 你本可以继续活下去，一次哀悼家族树上一整条枝脉的凋零。

source: A-And you could have made a new life with him. With Claudius.
target: 而、而你也可以和他开始新的生活。和克劳狄斯。

source: After Father's death, when I tried to end my life, when I frightened you--I've been thinking ever since then that I wish I'd succeeded.
target: 父亲去世后，我试图结束自己的生命，吓坏了你——从那时起，我就一直在想，要是当时成功了就好了。

source: But then, this past week, it was as though someone lit a candle on my life. There are new things to live for. I'm slowly finding my footing.
target: 可过去这一周，仿佛有人为我的人生点起了一支蜡烛。我又有了值得活下去的理由。我在慢慢站稳脚跟。

source: Everything's changed so quickly this summer. Sometimes nothing feels real. But I'm going to change, too, from today onward.
target: 这个夏天，一切都变得太快了。有时什么都像假的。但从今天起，我也要改变。

source: It won't be fast. And I still wake up each morning with a stone in my stomach. I don't think that will disappear.
target: 这不会很快。而且我每天早上醒来，胃里仍像压着一块石头。我想，这种感觉不会消失。

source: But I no longer spend every day desiring my own death.
target: 但我已经不再每天都盼着自己死去了。

source: I only hope I can create a world that makes you smile upon me from Heaven.
target: 我只希望，自己能创造一个世界，让天堂里的你看着我露出微笑。

source: I can only hope I'll see you soon.
target: 我只能盼着很快就能见到你。

source: No—I know I won't. Because you're among the angels. Or at the very least, waiting patiently for your turn.
target: 不——我知道见不到。因为你在天使之中。至少，也正耐心地等着轮到自己。

source: Me... I'm going right to Hell.
target: 而我……我会直接下地狱。

source: I love you. I loved you, Mother. I'm sorry. So very, horribly sorry.
target: 我爱你。我一直爱着你，母亲。对不起。我真的、真的对不起你，愧疚得无以复加。

source: And I can't live carrying this feeling for long. It weighs me down, pulls me to the grave.
target: 背负着这种感受，我活不了多久。它压得我喘不过气，把我拖向坟墓。

source: Lord, I'm a miserable idiot.
target: 主啊，我真是个可悲的蠢货。

source: I want you to know that I never truly hated you.
target: 我想让你知道，我从没有真正恨过你。

source: And I never got to tell you in time. But someday...
target: 可我没来得及告诉你。但总有一天……

source: Someday I'll see you again, and then you'll know that deep in my heart, I always wanted to be the son you needed me to be.
target: 总有一天，我会再见到你。到那时你就会知道，在我心底，我一直想成为你需要的那个儿子。

source: I'm sorry. I'll come to visit you as soon as I can. I swear it.
target: 对不起。我会尽快来看你的。我发誓。

source: Why did you come?
target: 你为什么来？

source: To understand why.
target: 为了弄明白原因。

source: Why did you kill them?
target: 你为什么杀了他们？

source: That poison was for you.
target: 那毒药是给你准备的。

source: You, who caused my lady to suffer day and night and tear her hair!
target: 是你，让王后日夜受苦，愁得揪扯自己的头发！

source: You, who turned on her, insulted her, threatened her—you ungrateful, disgusting child!
target: 是你，反过来与她为敌，侮辱她，威胁她——你这个忘恩负义、令人作呕的孩子！

source: All my lady ever did was try to love you with all of her soul.
target: 王后从始至终，都只是在努力全心全意地爱你。

source: But you are not worthy of that love.
target: 可你不配得到这份爱。

source: So you took matters into your own hands.
target: 所以，你就擅自做主了。

source: So be it. Allow me to take them into mine.
target: 那好。现在该由我来做主了。

source: More bloodshed, Hamlet? Was that the solution?
target: 还要继续流血吗，哈姆雷特？这就是解决办法？

source: All that brings is more death.
target: 那只会带来更多死亡。

source: Had I let her live, she would have found a way to kill me.
target: 如果我让她活着，她就会想办法杀了我。

source: You know of Irma's past. Of her history. Poison isn't the only 'solution' she can procure, even behind bars.
target: 你知道伊尔玛的过去。知道她做过的事。即使身在牢里，毒药也不是她唯一能弄到的“解决办法”。

source: She left me with no choice.
target: 是她让我别无选择。

source: They're gone.
target: 他们都不在了。

source: It still doesn't feel real.
target: 我还是觉得不真实。

source: Then again, nothing has lately. Throw two more deaths into the fog. What does it matter?
target: 不过，最近什么都不真实。再往这片迷雾里添上两条人命，又有什么关系？

source: My lady. If he treats you cruelly tonight—
target: 王后。如果他今晚对您很刻薄——

source: He won't.
target: 他不会的。

source: But if he does. Will you not see to it that he is disciplined?
target: 可如果他真的这样做了呢。您难道不该好好管教他吗？

source: He needs a mother, Irma. Not a militant leader.
target: 伊尔玛，他需要的是母亲，不是强硬的统帅。

source: Very well. I shall have the servants set the table.
target: 好吧。我这就叫仆人摆好餐桌。

source: Dinner is served.
target: 晚餐已经备好了。

source: Irma, this is wonderful, as always, my dear.
target: 伊尔玛，亲爱的，这饭菜一如既往地美味。

source: Of course, love.
target: 那当然，亲爱的。

source: Yes, many thanks, Irma. You've made my wife a happier—and plumper—woman during these hard times.
target: 是啊，多谢你，伊尔玛。在这段艰难的日子里，你让我妻子更开心了——也更丰腴了。

source: Laertes! Such a wonderful surprise to see you dining with us. I thought we'd lost you.
target: 雷欧提斯！看到你和我们一起用餐，真是惊喜。我还以为你已经离开我们了。

source: Ah, I'm soon to Paris, my lady. This is merely a temporary stay.
target: 啊，王后，我很快就要去巴黎了。这次只是暂住。

source: Well, I'm certainly glad to have you with us a little longer. And I'm certain your father is, too.
target: 嗯，你能多陪我们一阵，我很高兴。我相信你父亲也一样。

source: Aren't you hungry?
target: 你不饿吗？

source: My appetite fails me. Perhaps it's just a stench on the wind, blowing in from the graveyard.
target: 我没胃口。也许只是风里有股恶臭，从墓地吹来的。

source: Oh, Hamlet.
target: 唉，哈姆雷特。

source: Enough. Sit up straight. Look at your mother when you speak to her.
target: 够了。坐直。跟你母亲说话时，看着她。

source: Or what?
target: 不然怎样？

source: Or I'll have to teach you discipline at the tip of my blade.
target: 不然，我就得用剑尖教你守规矩了。

source: You ought to have sent me away when you had the chance.
target: 你当初有机会的时候，就该把我送走。

source: Please. You make a weak child of yourself, and an embarrassment to your father.
target: 得了吧。你把自己弄得像个软弱的孩子，还让你父亲蒙羞。

source: Were he here, he would look upon you with only shame. He was ten times the man you are.
target: 如果他在这里，看着你只会觉得羞耻。他比你像个男人十倍。

source: Some of us have more class.
target: 我们当中，有些人还是更有教养的。

source: What did you say, you lute-brained fop?
target: 你说什么，你这个满脑子鲁特琴的花花公子？

source: Is that the best you've got?
target: 你就这点本事？

source: No one asked you to stay here in Denmark. We thought you were leaving, and I, for one, was overjoyed.
target: 没人求你留在丹麦。我们都以为你要走了，至少我可是高兴得不得了。

source: You're joking, surely? Watching the bottom fall out of your entire life is far better than anything I could have seen in Paris.
target: 你是在开玩笑吧？看着你整个人生彻底崩塌，比我在巴黎能看到的任何东西都精彩。

source: No, I'm glad I stayed.
target: 不，我很高兴自己留了下来。

source: I'm leaving. My appetite fails me.
target: 我要走了。我没胃口。

source: Not until this madness you express has subsided.
target: 你这股疯劲没消下去，就不许走。

source: Then we will all be waiting a while for my behavior to become pleasant, I expect.
target: 那我想，大家都得等上一阵子，我才能变得讨人喜欢了。

source: My food looks like it was pushed around by a pig's snout. It's insulting.
target: 我的饭菜像是被猪鼻子拱来拱去过。真是侮辱人。

source: Oh, Hamlet. How can you be like that?
target: 唉，哈姆雷特。你怎么能这样？

source: (No manners at all. What an imp.)
target: （一点礼貌都没有。真是个小恶魔。）

source: What was that, Laertes?
target: 你说什么，雷欧提斯？

source: Nothing, my lord. The stew tonight is excellent.
target: 没什么，殿下。今晚的炖菜很好吃。

source: The quality is not in its appearance, but its taste, my lord.
target: 殿下，菜好不好，靠的是味道，不是卖相。

source: Well, Mother's dinner has been well plated. Only mine looks like it's been stirred up.
target: 可母亲的晚餐摆得就很漂亮。只有我这份像是被搅乱了。

source: Here. If it truly bothers you so, I'm more than happy to switch.
target: 来。如果你真这么在意，我很乐意跟你换。

source: No, no, my lady—
target: 不，不，王后——

source: If the food does not please your majesty, I will return it to the kitchen at once!
target: 如果饭菜不合陛下的口味，我立刻把它送回厨房！

source: No need, Irma. Truly.
target: 不用，伊尔玛。真的。

source: See? Delicious.
target: 你看？很好吃。

source: Oh, goodness.
target: 哦，天哪。

source: Er, I feel suddenly ill. I'm going to be sick here, I fear. Can someone--
target: 呃，我突然有些不舒服。恐怕要吐在这里了。谁能——

source: Can someone help me to--
target: 谁能扶我去——

source: What in God's name—?
target: 天哪，这是怎么——？

source: Her mouth— blood--
target: 她的嘴——血——

source: What was she fed? Who put such a thing in her meal?
target: 她吃了什么？是谁在她的饭菜里放了这种东西？

source: Seize Irma immediately!
target: 立刻抓住伊尔玛！

source: Uncle. Your mouth.
target: 叔叔。你的嘴。

source: I don't feel right, either.
target: 我也觉得不太对劲。

source: You've got blood on your lips.
target: 你的嘴唇上有血。

source: Poison. Poison?
Men, t-to me, at once! Urgh--
target: 来人，快、快到我身边来！呃——

source: She killed them both.
target: 她把他们两个都杀了。

source: N-no! My lady, I meant-- I intended--
target: 不、不！王后，我本来是想——我打算——

source: She was trying to murder me.
target: 她想杀的是我。

source: What is happening? Why?
target: 这是怎么回事？为什么？

source: You idiot child! I meant it to be you!
target: 你这个蠢小子！我要杀的是你！

source: Guards, take her at once. Let her rot in the cell until I decide what to do with her.
target: 卫兵，立刻把她带走。在我决定怎么处置她之前，就让她在牢里烂着。

source: You treat me as if I am a child.
target: 你把我当小孩子看。

source: In the scheme of things, you are.
target: 从长远来看，你确实还是个孩子。

source: I detest you utterly. You know that, don't you?
target: 我讨厌你，讨厌透了。你知道吧？

source: That's the strange thing about motherhood, darling. You may despise me more than anything in the world, but I will love you ever still.
target: 亲爱的，做母亲就是这么奇怪。你可以把我当成世上最厌恶的人，可我还是会永远爱你。

source: No amount of anger or rejected dinners can take that love from me.
target: 无论你发多少脾气，拒绝吃多少顿晚餐，都夺不走我对你的爱。

source: So it would seem.
target: 看来是这样。

source: Everyone, please, a moment.
target: 各位，请稍等片刻。

source: I... felt it appropriate to address the room tonight, in light of everything that's happened.
target: 我……考虑到发生的这一切，觉得今晚应该对在座各位说几句话。

source: My lord?
target: 殿下？

source: It's all right, Bernardo. Really.
target: 没事的，贝尔纳多。真的。

source: I wanted to disclose the identity of my uncle's killer.
target: 我想公布杀害我叔叔的凶手是谁。

source: I'm certain many of you are wondering about the circumstances under which he died.
target: 我相信你们很多人都想知道，他究竟是怎么死的。

source: Let there be no more secrets between us. I killed him.
target: 我们之间不要再有秘密了。是我杀了他。

source: Hmm. Bold. I like it.
target: 嗯。够大胆。我喜欢。

source: Oh, Hamlet...
target: 唉，哈姆雷特……

source: Allow me to tell you all why.
target: 请让我告诉各位原因。

source: Before Claudius wore the crown, he poured poison into my father's ear as he slept.
target: 克劳狄斯戴上王冠之前，趁我父亲熟睡时，把毒药倒进了他的耳朵。

source: That poison killed my father instantly, and left my mother and I bereft.
target: 那毒药让我的父亲当场丧命，也让我和母亲陷入了丧亲之痛。

source: Claudius did this knowing the pain it would cause my mother, and the instability it would cause our country.
target: 克劳狄斯明知这会给我母亲带来痛苦，给我们的国家带来动荡，却还是这么做了。

source: He did it for the sake of his own petty greed.
target: 他这么做，只为满足自己卑劣的贪欲。

source: I saw an opportunity to seek vengeance for my father's death, and I took it.
target: 我看到了为父亲报仇的机会，就抓住了它。

source: That is all. No more, no less.
target: 事情就是这样，仅此而已。

source: Please, excuse me.
target: 请恕我失陪。

source: Leave her be. I'll speak to her when I can.
target: 让她一个人待着吧。等我能抽身了，我会去和她谈谈。

source: Please, all of you, take great care with my mother during this time.
target: 这段时间，请各位多多照顾我的母亲。

source: For what little made him good, Claudius loved my mother a great deal.
target: 克劳狄斯的好处虽少，但他确实深爱着我的母亲。

source: And what makes you fit to be King, Hamlet?
target: 那你凭什么当国王，哈姆雷特？

source: You've been a blubbering mess of a fool these last few months. We all saw it.
target: 这几个月，你就是个哭哭啼啼、不成样子的蠢货。我们都看在眼里。

source: Now you're going to stumble your way into the throne of Denmark?
target: 现在你就要这么稀里糊涂地坐上丹麦的王位？

source: Failure should be its own reward.
target: 失败者得到的，就该只有失败。

source: I, for one, would support the nobility voting on another candidate entirely.
target: 至少我赞成让贵族们投票，另选一个人。

source: You've never failed to make your preferences known, Laertes, have you?
target: 雷欧提斯，你从来都不忘让别人知道你的意愿，是吧？

source: And of course, your first preference has always been that I would curl up and die.
target: 当然，你最希望的，一直都是我缩成一团死掉。

source: I'm not going to do that. I'm here to rule.
target: 我不会如你所愿。我是来统治这个国家的。

source: So if you'd like to express concerns with my claim to the throne, do so in whatever way you deem fit.
target: 所以，如果你对我继承王位有异议，尽管用你觉得合适的方式表达。

source: It won't matter.
target: 都不会有用。

source: My lords and ladies: Eat up, for your health. Please.
target: 各位大人、女士：为了身体好，请多吃些。请吧。

source: It all tastes like ash.
target: 吃什么都像在吃灰。

source: Is something wrong, my dear?
target: 怎么了，亲爱的？

source: How did things become like this?
target: 事情怎么会变成这样？

source: You know you aren't to blame.
target: 你知道，这不是你的错。

source: If my son's gone away where I can never see him again, how can that be what's best for him?
target: 如果我儿子去了一个我再也见不到他的地方，怎么能说这对他最好？

source: He's so young, Claudius.
target: 他还那么年轻，克劳狄斯。

source: Does he even understand what he did? Will anyone be there to guide him? To comfort him?
target: 他真的明白自己做了什么吗？那里会有人引导他吗？会有人安慰他吗？

source: The thought of him being frightened and cloudy, alone, in England-- it's too much for me.
target: 一想到他独自在英格兰，害怕又迷茫——我就受不了。

source: I can't bear the thought of my poor son like this.
target: 我受不了想到我可怜的儿子变成这样。

source: I promise you, this journey is exactly what the boy needs.
target: 我向你保证，这孩子需要的正是这趟旅程。

source: Dearest, please. You mustn't give into the dark.
target: 亲爱的，求你了。你不能向黑暗屈服。

source: Be strong for your country. Be strong for me.
target: 为了你的国家，坚强起来。为了我。

source: (Besides, the wretched boy will be back soon enough.)
target: （再说，那个可恶的小子很快就会回来了。）

source: It doesn't matter.
target: 已经无所谓了。

source: I wish God had taken me, too.
target: 我真希望上帝也把我带走了。

source: Dearest, please. You mustn't give into the dark like this.
target: 亲爱的，求你了。你不能就这样向黑暗屈服。

source: Be strong for your country. Be strong for me. Even if Hamlet's gone, I need you. You see that, don't you?
target: 为了你的国家，坚强起来。为了我。就算哈姆雷特不在了，我还需要你。你明白，对吧？

source: Right now, I see nothing.
target: 现在，我什么都看不明白。

source: Hamlet won't even attend his supper.
target: 哈姆雷特连晚餐都不肯来吃。

source: The boy's simply being his usual surly self. He'll come round.
target: 这孩子只是像平常一样闹脾气。他会想通的。

source: And if he doesn't? What then?
target: 要是他想不通呢？那怎么办？

source: Then we shall address it—together.
target: 那我们就来解决——一起。

source: Please excuse me. I have no appetite.
target: 请恕我失陪。我没有胃口。

source: The sun has long gone down. Father will be after me if I'm not in my rooms.
target: 太阳早就落山了。要是我还没回房，父亲会来找我算账的。

source: Something's different. The book on the table's not where I left it.
target: 有些不对劲。桌上的书不在我原来放的位置。

source: Is someone in here?
target: 有人在这里吗？

source: T-the door—
target: 门、门——

source: N-no, I'm sure it's nothing...
target: 不、不，肯定没什么……

source: I really ought to get some sleep.
target: 我真该睡一会儿了。

source: My head won't stop throbbing.
target: 我的头一直一阵阵地疼。

source: It feels as if something's--
target: 感觉好像有什么——

source: Oh, dear. This won't do.
target: 哎呀。这可不行。

source: Thank goodness.
target: 谢天谢地。

source: Father? What happened?
target: 父亲？发生什么事了？

source: You had a fainting spell. You've been asleep.
target: 你晕倒了。之后一直在睡。

source: We're fortunate someone saw you collapse and raised the alarm.
target: 幸好有人看见你倒下，喊人来帮忙。

source: Ah, some traveling thespian. Peter Quince, his name was, I think. Here to perform a play for His Majesty.
target: 啊，是个巡游演员。我记得他叫彼得·奎因斯。来这里为陛下演一出戏。

source: Ophelia, you must be more careful. I've called for the court physician, but I don't know how soon he'll be here.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你一定要多加小心。我已经派人去请宫廷医生了，但不知道他多久能到。

source: If something worse had happened, I--
target: 要是出了更严重的事，我——

source: Father, I'm all right. I feel perfectly fine now.
target: 父亲，我没事。我现在感觉完全好了。

source: And how wonderfully grateful I am for that.
target: 为此，我真是万分感激。

source: If you see that Quince man, you must thank him profusely.
target: 要是见到那个奎因斯，你一定要好好谢谢他。

source: I believe he's putting on a performance in just a few minutes in the Great Hall. If you dress and go now, you'll make the start of it.
target: 我想他再过几分钟就要在大厅演出了。你现在穿好衣服过去，还能赶上开场。

source: That would be an opportune time to express your gratitude, don't you think?
target: 这正是向他道谢的好时候，你说呢？

source: I've got to attend to His Majesty--but please don't overtax yourself. I beg of you.
target: 我得去侍奉陛下了——但请你千万别太劳累。我求你了。

source: The performance is about to start.
target: 演出就要开始了。

source: I wonder if that's the man my father mentioned.
target: 不知道他是不是父亲提到的那个人。

source: So terribly good to see you in the land of the living.
target: 看见你又回到活人的世界，真是太好了。

source: I must express my most sincere thanks to you, Sir Quince.
target: 奎因斯先生，我必须向您致以最诚挚的谢意。

source: Please, no 'sir'. Peter Quince, the one-man thespian. At your service anytime, my lady.
target: 请别叫我“先生”。彼得·奎因斯，独角戏演员。小姐，随时为您效劳。

source: I'm passing through to put on one of my performances for His Majesty's court.
target: 我途经此地，为陛下的宫廷献上一场我的演出。

source: When I saw you collapse earlier, you gave me quite a start!
target: 先前看见你倒下，可把我吓了一跳！

source: Were it not for you, I'm not certain what would have happened.
target: 要是没有您，我真不知道会发生什么。

source: It is rather disarming when one's mortal coil fails one, isn't it?
target: 这副凡人之躯不听使唤时，确实让人措手不及，对吧？

source: Indeed. On that topic, have you been to Elsinore before? We've had performers at the castle often, but I cannot say I recall your face.
target: 确实。说起来，您以前来过埃尔西诺吗？城堡里常有演员来演出，可我对您的面孔没什么印象。

source: I've visited now and then over the years. It is unfortunate I have never made your acquaintance. Coincidence, perhaps. Or fate!
target: 这些年，我偶尔会来。可惜一直没能与您相识。也许是巧合。也许是命运！

source: Now please, you must excuse me. My performance is about to begin, after all.
target: 现在，请恕我失陪。毕竟，我的演出就要开始了。

source: But if you ever find you need assistance in your endeavors, please do find me.
target: 不过，要是你在做事时需要帮助，请一定来找我。

source: And what 'endeavors' might those be?
target: 您说的“做事”，指的是做什么事？

source: That's neither here nor there. Suffice to say, there are fascinating things at work in Elsinore Castle.
target: 这无关紧要。你只需知道，埃尔西诺城堡里，有些奇妙的事正在发生。

source: The machine which has been set in motion can no longer be halted. Not now.
target: 机器既已运转，就再也停不下来了。现在已经不行了。

source: It will be frightening at first. But then everything will become clear.
