target: 起初会让人害怕。但随后，一切都会变得清楚。

source: And then we shall speak further, you and I.
target: 到那时，你我再详谈。

source: Hmm. He's not here. Strange.
target: 嗯。他不在这里。奇怪。

source: It's the middle of the night. I tried to stay asleep. I really did. But I just couldn't.
target: 现在是半夜。我试过继续睡。我真的试过。可就是睡不着。

source: Not after what I saw.
target: 看见了那一幕，我怎么也睡不着。

source: S-So King Claudius is a murderer. And no one but Hamlet and I know.
target: 这、这么说，克劳狄斯国王是个杀人凶手。除了哈姆雷特和我，没人知道。

source: There were whispers he'd killed his brother after King Hamlet's sudden death. But... nothing with substance.
target: 哈姆雷特国王突然去世后，就有人私下说，是他杀了自己的兄长。可是……都没有实据。

source: Hamlet must have worked with Quince to put on a performance he thought would get Claudius to confess.
target: 哈姆雷特一定是和奎因斯一起安排了那场演出，认为它能让克劳狄斯认罪。

source: But he didn't kill Claudius when he heard his confession, though I feared he might.
target: 但听到克劳狄斯认罪后，他并没有杀他，尽管我当时担心他会。

source: Come to think of it, Claudius might come after us now, too.
target: 这么一想，克劳狄斯现在也可能会对我们下手。

source: I don't know what will happen tomorrow. I'm afraid. What if things get worse?
target: 我不知道明天会发生什么。我很害怕。要是事情变得更糟呢？

source: Ah. Found you. What brings you here?
target: 啊，找到你了。你怎么会来这里？

source: Have you seen Father?
target: 你见到父亲了吗？

source: Ophelia, something unfortunate has happened.
target: 奥菲莉娅，发生了一件不幸的事。

source: What is it?
target: 什么事？

source: Ah. Found you. It's early for you to be wandering out like this.
target: 啊，找到你了。你这么早就出来走动了。

source: I couldn't sleep. Do you need something?
target: 我睡不着。你有什么事吗？

source: Something unfortunate has happened.
target: 发生了一件不幸的事。

source: Ah. You're awake. I thought you might be asleep.
target: 啊，你醒着。我还以为你可能在睡觉。

source: I'm deeply sorry to be the one to tell you this.
target: 要由我来告诉你这件事，我深感抱歉。

source: Your father has passed away. He was involved in an altercation with Prince Hamlet.
target: 你的父亲去世了。他和哈姆雷特王子发生了冲突。

source: W-what? Father?
target: 什、什么？父亲？

source: How? You're saying Hamlet killed Father?
target: 怎么会？你是说哈姆雷特杀了父亲？

source: Hamlet wasn't in his right mind, Ophelia. He was... raving, insane. I've never seen him like that.
target: 奥菲莉娅，哈姆雷特当时神志不清。他……胡言乱语，像是疯了。我从没见过他那样。

source: I'm so sorry. It happened in the Queen's private chambers last night. I wasn't there to save him.
target: 我真的很抱歉。事情发生在昨晚，就在王后的私人寝室里。我当时不在，没能救他。

source: Why was my father in the Queen's chambers? How did all of it come to pass?
target: 我父亲为什么会在王后的寝室里？这一切究竟是怎么发生的？

source: At this time, my lady, I have no information.
target: 小姐，目前我还没有这方面的消息。

source: Apologies to have come to you like this, so abruptly. I felt certain you'd want to know.
target: 抱歉这么突然地来找你。我觉得你一定想知道。

source: Please take me to see him.
target: 请带我去见他。

source: Er—we have not been able to find the body, as of yet.
target: 呃——我们目前还没能找到遗体。

source: Hamlet has gone and hidden it somewhere. My men are searching as we speak.
target: 哈姆雷特把遗体藏到什么地方去了。我的人现在正在搜寻。

source: I think Hamlet himself is undergoing a complete break from reality, of sorts.
target: 我觉得哈姆雷特自己也像是已经完全脱离了现实。

source: Your father was a good man. This was a horrible tragedy. Nothing you might have done would have prevented this.
target: 你的父亲是个好人。这是场可怕的悲剧。无论你做什么，都无法阻止它。

source: That's not true. I saw it. I saw him die by Hamlet's hand in my dream, Bernardo.
target: 不是这样的。我看见了。贝尔纳多，我在梦里看见他死在哈姆雷特手上。

source: And I did nothing!
target: 可我什么都没做！

source: I could've saved him. But I thought it was only a dream!
target: 我本来可以救他的。可我以为那只是个梦！

source: Ophelia, it was just a dream. Dreams aren't reality. Whatever vision you saw, it was just that.
target: 奥菲莉娅，那确实只是个梦。梦不是现实。不管你看到了什么景象，都只是梦而已。

source: All this-- I feel like I'm going mad.
target: 这一切——我觉得自己快疯了。

source: What am I to do now, Bernardo?
target: 贝尔纳多，我现在该怎么办？

source: I just want to be with Laertes. I need my brother.
target: 我只想和雷欧提斯在一起。我需要哥哥。

source: I know, Ophelia. I know.
target: 我知道，奥菲莉娅。我知道。

source: I'll do my absolute best to bring Laertes back to Elsinore as soon as possible.
target: 我会竭尽全力，让雷欧提斯尽快回到埃尔西诺。

source: And... for what little it's worth, I am deeply, truly sorry.
target: 还有……虽然这话没什么用，我真的深感抱歉。

source: You and I have both known Hamlet all our lives. Never did we think him capable of murder.
target: 你我从小就认识哈姆雷特。我们从没想过他会杀人。

source: At the end of the day I am the one wearing the armor. It was my duty to protect your father, and I failed him.
target: 说到底，穿着铠甲的人是我。保护你父亲是我的职责，可我没能保护好他。

source: Come. I have to break the news to the rest of the castle.
target: 来吧。我还得把这个噩耗告诉城堡里的其他人。

source: My lord, I understand there is the matter of a missing lute from many years ago to attend to.
target: 殿下，我听说有件多年前鲁特琴失踪的事需要处理。

source: You mean Laertes' lute. Did Ophelia send you after me?
target: 你是说雷欧提斯的鲁特琴。奥菲莉娅让你来找我的？

source: Indeed, my lord.
target: 是的，殿下。

source: I imagine he's holding quite the grudge over it.
target: 我想他为这件事记了不少仇。

source: Can we drop the titles just for a minute, Bernardo? We're talking about a time when we used to dare each other to eat mud.
target: 贝尔纳多，能不能先别叫头衔了？我们说的可是当年互相激对方吃泥巴的时候。

source: The dog thinks I stole it from him. I didn't, right? You remember, don't you?
target: 那混蛋以为是我偷了他的琴。我没偷，对吧？你记得的，是不是？

source: Of course I do. He lent it to me, though he doesn't remember, of course. Laertes always was quick to blame you.
target: 当然记得。他把琴借给了我，不过他当然不记得了。雷欧提斯总是动不动就怪你。

source: Well, the solution to the matter is simple. If he lent it to you, just give his lute back.
target: 那这事很好解决。他既然把琴借给了你，你把鲁特琴还给他就行。

source: Err, w-well...
target: 呃，这、这个……

source: Ah. My God. You lost it, didn't you?
target: 啊。我的天。你把它弄丢了，是不是？

source: In a manner of speaking. But it's somewhere in the castle. I believe.
target: 可以这么说。不过它就在城堡里的某个地方。我想。

source: He's going to kill me.
target: 他会杀了我的。

source: Not that I'm frightened of Laertes, or anything. I'm not. Of course.
target: 倒不是说我怕雷欧提斯什么的。我不怕。当然不怕。

source: It could only be in a couple of places, truly. My memory is ever-so-slightly hazy.
target: 说真的，它只可能在那么几个地方。我的记忆只是稍微有那么一点模糊。

source: However, I seem to recall there was one night we took the lute up on the walls.
target: 不过，我好像记得有天晚上，我们把鲁特琴带上了城墙。

source: We were all three together, were we not? And I had it then. I know I did.
target: 我们三个当时都在一起，对吧？那时琴就在我手里。我确定。

source: The walls! Of course! The blasted walls. It's got to be up there!
target: 城墙！当然！那该死的城墙。它肯定就在上面！

source: Let us meet when we have a moment from our respective duties.
target: 等我们各自的差事都有空当了，再碰个面吧。

source: Goodness. I don't often take the patrol up here. I forget how cold and damp it is.
target: 天哪。我不常到这上面巡逻，都忘了这里有多冷、多潮湿了。

source: That damn lute has to be here somewhere.
target: 那把该死的鲁特琴肯定就在这附近。

source: I would have expected it to be here.
target: 我还以为它会在这里。

source: I don't see it.
target: 我没看见。

source: Neither do I. And besides, even if it were here, it'd be soaked through with seaward mist.
target: 我也没看见。再说，就算它真在这里，也早被海雾浸透了。

source: Laertes is going to throttle us both.
target: 雷欧提斯会把我们两个都掐死的。

source: You're stronger than he is. My money's on you.
target: 你比他强壮。我赌你赢。

source: That is decidedly not the point here.
target: 这绝对不是重点。

source: What? Worried you haven't kept your sparring skills up-to-date?
target: 怎么？担心自己疏于练习，身手生疏了？

source: En garde.
target: 准备接招。

source: Ow! What was that for?
target: 哎哟！你干什么？

source: Come, now. It was merely the flat of the blade. Aren't you going to dodge?
target: 得了吧。我用的只是剑身。你不躲吗？

source: To show you the flat of my blade would be unseemly for a man of my role.
target: 以我的身份，用剑身打您可不合礼数。

source: Ow! Stop! All right, point-- made-- Bernardo. Stop!
target: 哎哟！停下！好了，我——懂了——贝尔纳多。停下！

source: As you wish, my lord.
target: 如您所愿，殿下。

source: No, wait. Don't grow serious, now. I was only joking. We can continue sparring.
target: 不，等等。别突然这么严肃嘛。我只是开个玩笑。我们可以继续切磋。

source: I think that's quite enough for now, my lord. Were I to injure you, it would draw significant ire.
target: 我想今天就到这里吧，殿下。要是伤了您，可会招来不小的怒火。

source: I remember when we used to spar all morning as boys, and I'd come home with bruises.
target: 我还记得小时候，我们常常切磋一整个上午，然后我带着一身淤青回家。

source: I guess some things have changed.
target: 看来有些事已经变了。

source: You are much more a prince and much less a boy, for one.
target: 比如说，您如今更像一位王子，不再那么像个小男孩了。

source: Suppose so.
target: 大概吧。

source: Well, in any case, the lute isn't here.
target: 好吧，不管怎么说，鲁特琴不在这里。

source: If Laertes were here, I'm certain he'd remember.
target: 要是雷欧提斯在这里，我确信他会记得。

source: Might it not be in the woods by the pond? I seem to recall us going out there the last time you were home from Wittenberg.
target: 会不会在池塘边的树林里？我好像记得，上次你从维滕贝格回家时，我们去过那里。

source: Indeed. When it's next convenient, let's meet and search the woods.
target: 确实。下次方便的时候，我们碰个面，去树林里找找。

source: I don't believe I've been out here in quite some time.
target: 我想我已经好久没来这里了。

source: This is the only place I can stop and think a while. It can be so stifling in there.
target: 只有在这里，我才能停下来想一会儿。里面实在让人喘不过气。

source: 'There'? The castle, you mean?
target: “里面”？您是说城堡？

source: Yes. All those eyes around. Here, the only things watching are birds.
target: 是啊。到处都是盯着人的眼睛。在这里，只有鸟儿在看。

source: Now—where would that lute be?
target: 那么——那把鲁特琴会在哪里呢？

source: In the brush, I imagine. Over here.
target: 我想在灌木丛里。这边。

source: Say, Bernardo.
target: 我说，贝尔纳多。

source: It feels as though it's been ages since you and I had a real conversation. It has, hasn't it?
target: 感觉我们已经很久没好好聊过了。确实很久了，对吧？

source: Years, I wager.
target: 我估计有好几年了。

source: Are you well? Are you happy? Getting on? With the guard, and all?
target: 你还好吗？开心吗？过得顺利吗？卫队里的事，还有其他事情？

source: My lord, I find your sudden concern for others extremely unusual, and therefore upsetting. But yes, I'm all right.
target: 殿下，您突然关心起别人来，实在太反常，让我有些不安。不过，是的，我还好。

source: These days, it seems as though there's a cloud over you. There's something strange about you.
target: 这些日子，你好像一直被阴云笼罩着。你有些不对劲。

source: Most would say the same about you, my lord.
target: 大多数人也会这样说您，殿下。

source: That's the problem with growing old. We were carefree once. Now things are different.
target: 年纪渐长就是这点不好。我们也曾无忧无虑。如今不一样了。

source: And so they are.
target: 确实不一样了。

source: Say, Bernardo. What we saw that night—my father's ghost—that was real, wasn't it? I didn't dream it? I'm not mad, am I?
target: 我说，贝尔纳多。那晚我们看见的——我父亲的幽灵——是真的，对吧？那不是我做的梦？我没有疯，对不对？

source: Not at all, my lord. Did you ever doubt?
target: 您当然没疯，殿下。您曾经怀疑过吗？

source: I... I think I did, a little. I don't know what to do. I want to forget what I saw. But I can't, I can't, all I do is see his face, burned into the back of my mind—
target: 我……我想，是有一点。我不知道该怎么办。我想忘掉自己看见的东西。可我做不到，做不到，我眼前全是他的脸，深深烙在我脑海里——

source: My lord, perhaps it is the devil speaking to you. Or perhaps it is a sign. I know not which.
target: 殿下，也许是魔鬼在对您说话。也许那是某种征兆。我不知道是哪一种。

source: A sign of what?
target: 什么征兆？

source: Bernardo, what is this distance I feel?
target: 贝尔纳多，为什么我觉得我们之间这么疏远？

source: I know... I haven't been the most ardent friend lately. But I knew everything about you once, and you me.
target: 我知道……最近我这个朋友不够热心。可从前，我对你的一切都了如指掌，你对我也是。

source: Can we not be that way once more? I am in short supply of men I can trust these days.
target: 我们不能再像从前那样吗？如今，我能信任的人实在太少了。

source: My lord, the things which weigh on my mind would only make your humor worse, and would improve little for me.
target: 殿下，我心里的烦恼只会让您的心情更糟，对我也没多少帮助。

source: Is it because you're Katherine more and more these days?
target: 是因为这些日子，你越来越常以凯瑟琳的身份生活了吗？

source: I hadn't thought of it. In some ways, perhaps, I am becoming more myself.
target: 我没想过这一点。在某些方面，也许我正变得更像真正的自己。

source: And I am mourning the person I left behind.
target: 而我也在悼念那个被我留在身后的自己。

source: For what it's worth, I don't mourn that person. And I would like to know you as you are.
target: 不知道这话有没有用，但我并不为那个你感到惋惜。而且，我想了解现在的你。

source: I am honored, my Prince. But right now...
target: 我很荣幸，王子殿下。但眼下……

source: Please. Focus on yourself, on your own health. For Denmark's sake. We need you.
target: 请您多关心自己，照顾好自己的身体。为了丹麦。我们需要您。

source: Wait a moment...
target: 等一下……

source: H-here. The lute! Look.
target: 这、这里。鲁特琴！看。

source: You found it?
target: 你找到了？

source: And it's entirely dry. A miracle, if I've seen one.
target: 而且一点都没湿。这可真是个奇迹。

source: I wish I knew how to make this right, Bernardo. But Laertes is gone.
target: 真希望我知道该怎么弥补，贝尔纳多。可雷欧提斯已经走了。

source: Indeed. If only Laertes were here, we could give it to him.
target: 是啊。要是雷欧提斯在这里，我们就能把琴交给他了。

source: I'm certain he's playing some other, better lute in Paris.
target: 他现在肯定在巴黎弹着另一把更好的鲁特琴。

source: Yes. When he returns, you ought to give this back to him swiftly. Perhaps even make proper amends.
target: 是啊。等他回来，您应该赶快把琴还给他。也许还该好好赔个不是。

source: Until then, I bid you good-bye. I've my rounds to make.
target: 那我就先告辞了。我还得去巡逻。

source: See you about, friend.
target: 回头见，朋友。

source: (I know if Laertes were here, things would've gone differently.)
target: （我知道，要是雷欧提斯在这里，事情就会不一样。）

source: (There's more to this situation.)
target: （这件事还有内情。）

source: I'd like to make things right with Laertes.
target: 我想和雷欧提斯和好。

source: Indeed. Since he has remained in Elsinore, I'll return it to him anon.
target: 是啊。既然他留在了埃尔西诺，我一会儿就把琴还给他。

source: No. Allow me. I've been avoiding Laertes far too long. I'll put an end to this constant back-and-forth between us.
target: 不，让我来。我躲着雷欧提斯太久了。我们之间没完没了的纠葛，该由我来结束。

source: Is that wise, my lord?
target: 这样明智吗，殿下？

source: Let me be the judge of that.
target: 这就让我自己判断吧。

source: Thought I'd find you here.
target: 我就想会在这里找到你。

source: Come to insult me, then?
target: 怎么，来羞辱我？

source: No. To make a return, in fact.
target: 不。其实我是来还东西的。

source: I have something of yours.
target: 你有件东西在我这里。

source: My lute. I knew you'd stolen it.
target: 我的鲁特琴。我就知道是你偷的。

source: I didn't. But you won't believe me, regardless.
target: 我没偷。不过反正你也不会信我。

source: You're right. Put it over there, and leave.
target: 你说得对。放到那边，然后走吧。

source: You know, Laertes...
target: 你知道吗，雷欧提斯……

source: You're the consummate gentleman. Everyone in Elsinore admires you so.
target: 你是个无可挑剔的绅士。埃尔西诺人人都那么敬重你。

source: Even my uncle, a man who bends to no one, gives you his ear freely.
target: 就连我叔父，那种从不向任何人低头的人，也乐意听你说话。

source: All I ever wanted was a sliver of that same admiration.
target: 我一直想要的，只是同样的敬重，哪怕只有一点点。

source: But you've hated me all these years, haven't you?
target: 可这些年来，你一直恨我，对吧？

source: I can feel your stare upon my back wherever I go.
target: 不管走到哪里，我都能感觉到你的目光盯着我的背。

source: You tore my sister's heart open. Who wouldn't hate you?
target: 你把我妹妹的心伤得支离破碎。谁不会恨你？

source: You detested me long before that. Let us not pretend this is some new grievance.
target: 早在那之前，你就厌恶我了。别装得像是最近才结下的怨。

source: You gallivant around in your own little world, paying no mind to the needs of the country you will someday run.
target: 你只顾在自己的小天地里寻欢作乐，对这个将来要由你统治的国家需要什么，毫不关心。

source: Is that not reason enough to hate you?
target: 这还不够让我恨你吗？

source: If I were meant to run this country, I would already be doing so. I'm but a stallion for show. Nobody wants me to wear the crown.
target: 如果这国家注定该由我统治，我早就在统治它了。我不过是一匹供人观赏的骏马。没人想让我戴上王冠。

source: I'll be honest, Laertes. I came here hoping to forge a peace.
target: 说实话，雷欧提斯。我来这里，是希望我们能和解。

source: It is hard enough to think of wearing my father's crown with so few of his friends willing to stand at my side.
target: 父亲的朋友里，愿意站在我身边的寥寥无几，光是想到要戴上他的王冠，就已经够难受了。

source: You murdered my father, Hamlet.
target: 你谋杀了我的父亲，哈姆雷特。

source: You murdered him, and then you hid his body, and you continued to bury your head in the sand.
target: 你谋杀了他，藏起他的尸体，然后继续装作什么都没发生。

source: How can you be so naïve as to think you and I could ever be friends? In this world, or the next?
target: 你怎么会天真到以为我们还能成为朋友？无论今生，还是来世？

source: I learned a new language of hatred in order to know my own feelings for you.
target: 我学会了“憎恨”这门新语言，才读懂自己对你的感情。

source: I didn't know what it was to hate anyone like this. Until now.
target: 我以前不知道，这样恨一个人究竟是什么滋味。直到现在。

source: You destroyed my sister's happiness, neglected your country, and abandoned your father's legacy.
target: 你毁了我妹妹的幸福，对自己的国家不闻不问，还抛弃了你父亲留下的事业。

source: All of these things I despise. All things which sap my respect.
target: 这些事，每一件都让我鄙视。每一件都在消磨我对你的尊重。

source: Get out.
target: 滚出去。

source: Get out, now. Leave the lute and go.
target: 滚出去，现在就走。留下鲁特琴，走人。

source: I can never fix the horrible things I've done to you over the years, Laertes.
target: 雷欧提斯，这些年来我对你做的那些可怕的事，我永远都无法弥补。

source: I swear to you it was a mistake. I didn't mean to hurt your father.
target: 我向你发誓，那是个意外。我没想伤害你的父亲。

source: I'm not like you. My mind doesn't work like yours. Something's broken in my head, I think.
target: 我跟你不一样。我的脑子不像你的脑子那样运转。我想，我脑子里有哪里坏掉了。

source: And I wish with all my soul it could be otherwise.
target: 我打心底希望，事情能不是这样。

source: Do you think I enjoy disappointing everyone? No one does. But please believe me—
target: 你以为我喜欢让所有人失望吗？没人喜欢。可请你相信我——

source: I never meant to cause you harm.
target: 我从没想过要伤害你。

source: So if you would continue to despise me in light of that, then I urge you: Kill me.
target: 所以，如果知道了这些，你还是要继续鄙视我，那我求你：杀了我。

source: Kill me, and have your peace.
target: 杀了我，让你自己得到安宁。

source: Hamlet. What trick is this?
target: 哈姆雷特。你这是什么把戏？

source: It is no trick. I have wanted to die for months. Please. I'm exhausted.
target: 这不是把戏。我想死已经好几个月了。求你了。我已经精疲力竭了。

source: Everyone hates me, but none more than I hate myself. And I'm ready. May it bring you comfort and vengeance.
target: 所有人都恨我，可谁也没有我自己恨得深。我已经准备好了。愿这能让你得到慰藉，报了仇。

source: I... thought I wanted your death.
target: 我……原以为我想让你死。

source: I don't want your death, Hamlet.
target: 我不想让你死，哈姆雷特。

source: But I do seek your destruction, of a sort.
target: 但我确实想让你以某种方式毁灭。

source: ...The destruction of your family line, and its undue influence upon my country.
target: ……让你的家族，以及它对我国的不当影响，彻底消亡。

source: The men of your line have brought this country to its knees, embattled it in needless wars, and drained its coffers.
target: 你家族的男人们让这个国家一蹶不振，把它拖进毫无必要的战争，耗尽了国库。

source: And I have no reason to believe you will be any stronger or better than they were.
target: 而我没有理由相信，你会比他们更坚强、更优秀。

source: If anything, I see many of their vices reflected back in you.
target: 真要说的话，我倒是在你身上看到了他们的许多恶习。

source: So—you and I—we cannot be allies.
target: 所以——你和我——我们不可能成为盟友。

source: And now that I vote on behalf of our lands in my father's place, I will never alight upon you as my King.
target: 如今，我代替父亲，代表我们的领地投票，我绝不会选你做我的国王。

source: I shall work to turn the nobility against you.
target: 我会设法让贵族们转而反对你。

source: ...Even if you prove to me that you can do otherwise. I know who you are. And who you have been, and will always be.
target: ……即使你向我证明，你能有所改变。我知道你是什么样的人。过去如此，往后也永远如此。

source: You will never be a King.
target: 你永远都当不了国王。

source: That's all I want.
target: 我想要的，仅此而已。

source: Your uncle asked me to kill you, Hamlet.
target: 你叔父让我杀了你，哈姆雷特。

source: What? Truly?
target: 什么？真的？

source: He posted a formal challenge of a duel between us. But the duel won't be a fair one.
target: 他发布了让我们两人决斗的正式挑战书。但这场决斗不会公平。

source: He has poisoned a blade for me to use against you—and a goblet of wine as a fallback.
target: 他在一把剑上涂了毒，让我用它对付你——还在一杯酒里下了毒，作为后备手段。

source: And I agreed to help him kill you.
target: 而我答应了帮他杀你。

source: But I cannot.
target: 可我做不到。

source: This is wrong. My father would never have asked for this.
target: 这样做不对。我父亲绝不会希望我这么做。

source: I think you and I ought to forge a truce.
target: 我想，我们应该休战。

source: Y-you mean it?
target: 你、你是认真的？

source: I mean it.
target: 我是认真的。

source: Your uncle is a vile man. This, I know. His people are summarily displeased with his rule.
target: 你叔父是个卑鄙的人。这一点我很清楚。他的子民普遍不满他的统治。

source: I came back to Elsinore to depose him. But I let him drive me towards vengeance against you. I was so blind.
target: 我回到埃尔西诺，本是为了废黜他。可我却任由他驱使，一心找你报仇。我真是瞎了眼。

source: Let us work together. There is a world in which neither of us must suffer at each others' hands ever again.
target: 我们一起合作吧。我们可以有另一种未来，谁都不必再受对方伤害。

source: It's what my father would have wanted—the right thing for Denmark. The county you and I both love.
target: 这才是我父亲会希望看到的——为丹麦做正确的事。为了这个你我都深爱的国家。

source: But... what... do you intend to do?
target: 可是……你……打算怎么做？

source: We'll turn Claudius's plot back upon him.
target: 我们要让克劳狄斯的阴谋反过来对付他自己。

source: At the moment he hands me the poisoned sword, I'll turn it upon his heart.
target: 他把毒剑交给我的那一刻，我就会把剑刺向他的心脏。

source: He won't expect it, and we'll soon be victorious.
target: 他绝不会料到，我们很快就能获胜。

source: Yes. I consent. I'll keep the ruse.
target: 好。我同意。我会继续配合演下去。

source: This-- Laertes-- you don't know how sweet these words are to hear from you.
target: 这——雷欧提斯——你不知道，听到你说这些话，我有多高兴。

source: Spare me the sentimentality. We still aren't friends. But I'll fight by your side all the same.
target: 别跟我煽情了。我们还不是朋友。但我仍会与你并肩作战。

source: When next we meet, I hope it will be to take back our country. For good.
target: 希望下次见面时，我们就能夺回自己的国家。彻底夺回来。

source: Aye. For good.
target: 好。彻底夺回来。

source: I don't want your death.
target: 我不想让你死。

source: The destruction of your family line, and its undue influence upon my country.
target: 让你的家族，以及它对我国的不当影响，彻底消亡。

source: Even if you prove to me that you can do otherwise. I know who you are. And who you have been, and will always be.
target: 即使你向我证明，你能有所改变。我知道你是什么样的人。过去如此，往后也永远如此。

source: What I saw...
target: 我看见的东西……

source: No. no, it's not possible.
target: 不。不，这不可能。

source: It must be some trick Horatio pulled.
target: 这一定是霍拉旭耍的什么把戏。

source: But why? How?
target: 可为什么？怎么做到的？

source: My God, what is happening?
target: 我的天，到底发生了什么？

source: Father? Are you there?
target: 父亲？您在吗？

source: You've returned.
target: 你回来了。

source: I promised myself I wouldn't, but something's changed.
target: 我答应过自己不会再来，可事情有了变化。

source: My only desire is to remove my uncle from the throne of Denmark, as you bid me do.
target: 我唯一的愿望，就是照您的吩咐，把叔父从丹麦的王位上赶下来。

source: And I had formed a plan to do that—in tandem with the playmaster Peter Quince.
target: 我已经为此拟好了一个计划——与戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯合作。

source: Father, what do you know of that man? Do you have any reason to fear him?
target: 父亲，您对那个人了解多少？您有什么理由怕他吗？

source: Of course the spirit isn't here.
target: 幽灵当然不在这里。

source: I truly have started to come apart, haven't I?
target: 我真的开始崩溃了，是不是？

source: I ought not to trust Ophelia. She might be in my uncle's pocket after all. Or far worse.
target: 我不该相信奥菲莉娅。说不定她终究还是被我叔叔收买了。或者情况糟糕得多。

source: I'll avenge you, Father. I swear it. Propriety will be restored to this castle.
target: 我会为您报仇，父亲。我发誓。这座城堡一定会恢复应有的礼法。

source: He really is gone.
target: 他真的走了。

source: Of course I know him, but of what might I be afraid?
target: 我当然认识他，可我有什么好怕的？

source: Ophelia told me you believed he was dangerous. That he might have some mission here in Elsinore.
target: 奥菲莉娅告诉我，您觉得他很危险。他可能在埃尔西诺有什么任务。

source: What cause would I have to believe that? If anything, he was a great help to me.
target: 我有什么理由这么想？真要说起来，他倒是帮了我很大的忙。

source: Then Ophelia was wrong.
target: 那就是奥菲莉娅错了。

source: I ought not to trust her. She might be in my uncle's pocket after all. Or far worse.
target: 我不该相信她。说不定她终究还是被我叔叔收买了。或者情况糟糕得多。

source: I believe you, my son.
target: 我相信你，儿子。

source: Father, are you afraid? Are you suffering at all?
target: 父亲，您害怕吗？您有没有在受苦？

source: No. I don't want to know. I can't. Goodbye, Father. I'll keep my promise. I swear.
target: 不。我不想知道。我承受不了。再见，父亲。我会遵守承诺。我发誓。

source: My son, listen carefully to me.
target: 儿子，仔细听我说。

source: I was wrong.
target: 我错了。

source: Claudius is not our enemy. A more insidious foe awaits.
target: 克劳狄斯不是我们的敌人。还有一个更阴险的敌人在等着我们。

source: I misspoke in accusing my brother of my death. He was driven by something far more peculiar. Quince is such a peculiar man.
target: 我说错了，不该指责我的弟弟害死了我。驱使他的是某种奇异得多的东西。奎因斯是个如此奇异的人。

source: He is not human, Hamlet. He is a demon of some twisted persuasion. Or a god. I do not know which.
target: 他不是人，哈姆雷特。他是某种邪恶的恶魔。或者是神。我不知道究竟是哪一种。

source: The Playmaster? Father, are you certain?
target: 那个戏剧大师？父亲，您确定吗？

source: How can someone inhuman look so normal?
target: 不是人的东西，怎么会看起来这么普通？

source: I do not know. But I do know that I have seen many strange things in this life of mine.
target: 我不知道。但我知道，我这一生见过许多怪事。

source: You know I am dead, my son, and yet here I stand before you.
target: 儿子，你知道我已经死了，可我却站在你面前。

source: The power we discuss is something greater than the bounds of this world, greater than anything we know.
target: 我们所说的这种力量，超出了这个世界的界限，也超出了我们所知的一切。

source: His can even transcend death. It caused me years of anguish and grief. I was trapped in Elsinore, unable to live or die, in some hellish version of this world where time repeated itself.
target: 他的力量甚至能超越死亡。它让我承受了多年的痛苦与悲伤。我被困在埃尔西诺，求生不得，求死不能，身处这个世界如地狱般的另一种模样，时间在那里不断重复。

source: And now Ophelia is trapped, too.
target: 而现在，奥菲莉娅也被困住了。

source: Earlier, Ophelia told me that he conspired to kill you, Father. Is it true?
target: 父亲，之前奥菲莉娅告诉我，他曾密谋杀害您。是真的吗？

source: In a manner of speaking. Quince is the one who kept me in that shadowy version of Elsinore. I knew Claudius was trying to murder me from the start. But...
target: 从某种意义上说，是的。把我困在那个阴暗的埃尔西诺里的，就是奎因斯。我从一开始就知道克劳狄斯想谋杀我。可是……

source: Whenever I stopped him, things only became worse. In one world, your mother drowned herself and took you with her.
target: 每次我阻止他，事情都只会变得更糟。在一个世界里，你母亲投水自尽，也把你一同带走了。

source: In another, Claudius created a conspiracy, then convinced my own men to turn against me and have me imprisoned indefinitely.
target: 在另一个世界里，克劳狄斯策划了一场阴谋，随后说服我自己的部下背叛我，把我关了起来，永无出头之日。

source: Every world was more vile than the world where I did nothing at all.
target: 每一个世界，都比我什么也不做的那个世界更加险恶。

source: And so, eventually, I gave up. I lay in that garden for years, broken into three-day spans of time.
target: 所以，到最后，我放弃了。我在那座花园里躺了多年，时间被分割成一段又一段的三天。

source: Eventually, I did not return to life. And yet my spirit still lingers.
target: 终于，我没有再活过来。然而，我的灵魂依旧徘徊不去。

source: It is Peter Quince's power that keeps me here. Ophelia has helped me realize this. We were merely the puppets to his infinite jest.
target: 是彼得·奎因斯的力量把我留在这里。奥菲莉娅帮我认清了这一点。我们不过是他那无尽戏谑中的傀儡。

source: Please, my son. Save me. Save my soul. Kill him. It's the only choice I have left.
target: 求你了，儿子。救救我。救救我的灵魂。杀了他。这是我仅剩的选择。

source: Merely destroying your uncle will not free me, or Ophelia.
target: 仅仅除掉你叔叔，无法让我们解脱，无论是我，还是奥菲莉娅。

source: I don't know how to feel about all this.
target: 面对这一切，我不知道自己该是什么心情。

source: If what you say is true, then we've got to turn the tables on Quince somehow.
target: 如果您说的是真的，那我们就得想办法反过来对付奎因斯。

source: We need to destroy him. For your sake and for Ophelia's.
target: 我们必须除掉他。为了您，也为了奥菲莉娅。

source: But what will happen when he's dead? Will you disappear, Father?
target: 可他死后会发生什么？父亲，您会消失吗？

source: I do not know.
target: 我不知道。

source: My form is feeble. I feel my flesh disintegrating. I must go.
target: 我的形体很虚弱。我感到自己的血肉正在消散。我必须走了。

source: Be careful, my son. Think long upon your plans. I don't wish to cause you any more suffering than I've already brought you.
target: 小心，儿子。好好斟酌你的计划。我已经给你带来了苦难，不愿再让你承受更多。

source: Father, I'm going to destroy him.
target: 父亲，我会除掉他。

source: I'm going to free you. I promise.
target: 我会让您解脱。我保证。

source: No matter what might happen afterward.
target: 不管之后可能发生什么。

source: I believe you now. And my father. I don't understand fully, but I want to.
target: 我现在相信你了。也相信我父亲。我还没完全明白，但我想弄明白。

source: I wish I had known earlier. Claudius no longer trusts me. The castle watches me like a hungry wolf, waiting for a moment of weakness.
target: 真希望我能早点知道。克劳狄斯已经不信任我了。整座城堡像一头饿狼，盯着我，等我露出一丝破绽。

source: Ophelia, is it true you've seen this all before?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你真的已经见过这一切了吗？

source: What happens now? What will become of me?
target: 接下来会发生什么？我会怎么样？

source: Fortinbras will march on us all. You may survive to see that. You may not.
target: 福丁布拉斯会率军攻打我们所有人。你也许能活到那时候。也许不能。

source: You sound so strange. It's like all the warmth has gone out of you.
target: 你说话的样子好陌生。好像你身上所有的温暖都消失了。

source: How... many... times have you seen me die?
target: 你看见我死了……多少……次？

source: I don't keep count of deaths any more.
target: 我已经不再数死亡的次数了。

source: Listen. If this world is truly nothing but a fragment, then begin anew. Start over. Come back.
target: 听我说。如果这个世界真的只是一块碎片，那就重新开始。从头来过。再回来。

source: And when you find me and persuade me again, I'm certain I'll think of the same plan: to turn the play upon the Playmaster.
target: 等你找到我，再次说服我，我一定还会想到同一个计划：用戏来对付戏剧大师。

source: We'll use his own production to expose him in public, and then I'll take him down.
target: 我们用他自己的演出，当众揭穿他，然后由我来解决他。

source: I'll find you again, Hamlet. I'm sorry.
target: 我会再找到你的，哈姆雷特。对不起。

source: Go. Do it now. Don't waste another minute in this hell.
target: 去吧。现在就去。别再在这地狱里浪费一分钟。

source: I feel hopeful.
target: 我觉得有希望了。

source: I've thought of a plan.
target: 我想到一个计划。

source: We'll turn the play upon the Playmaster. I've been working with him to concoct a performance to shame my uncle in public.
target: 我们用戏来对付戏剧大师。我一直在和他筹划一场演出，好让我叔叔当众出丑。

source: But if we surprise him, and turn the tables on him instead...
target: 可如果我们出其不意，反过来把矛头指向他……

source: Then we can catch him where he can't hide, and kill him before an audience.
target: 那我们就能在他无处藏身的地方抓住他，当着观众的面杀了他。

source: And what then? The others will believe we've murdered a man in cold blood.
target: 然后呢？其他人会以为我们冷血地谋杀了一个人。

source: Come what may. We'll figure it out together.
target: 不管发生什么。我们一起想办法。

source: As long as the two of us are alive, I know we can manage.
target: 只要我们两个还活着，我相信我们就能应付。

source: Quince is highly intelligent. If we use a performance to trap him, we'll need to surprise him somehow.
target: 奎因斯非常聪明。如果要用一场演出困住他，我们得想办法让他措手不及。

source: If we can get your father's spirit to appear, that may sufficiently frighten him.
target: 如果我们能让你父亲的灵魂现身，也许就足以吓住他。

source: He and I can keep Quince distracted while you plunge a blade into his heart.
target: 我和他可以分散奎因斯的注意力，趁这时候，你把刀刺进他的心脏。

source: My thoughts precisely.
target: 我也是这么想的。

source: It's a shame we aren't in the business of killing. We'd be quite good at it, I think.
target: 可惜我们不靠杀人谋生。我觉得我们会很擅长的。

source: You have no idea.
target: 你根本不知道。

source: Let's prepare. You speak to your father and tell him of our plan. I'll ready myself when the time comes.
target: 我们准备吧。你去找你父亲，把我们的计划告诉他。时候到了，我会做好准备。

source: Ophelia, it's time. Are you ready?
target: 奥菲莉娅，时候到了。你准备好了吗？

source: I don't know that we can be ready for something quite like this. But I'm going to try.
target: 我不知道，面对这种事，我们是否能做好准备。但我会试试。

source: If something terrible happens to me, you can always try once more, can't you?
target: 如果我遭遇了什么不幸，你总能再试一次，对吧？

source: I don't know. I think so.
target: 我不知道。应该可以吧。

source: My good playmaster, I've prepared some material of my own.
target: 亲爱的戏剧大师，我自己准备了一些内容。

source: Oh? Brilliant!
target: 哦？太好了！

source: How keen of you, my prince. I don't often relinquish the stage. But you have such charisma when you're in the mood for it.
target: 王子殿下，您真有兴致。我很少把舞台让给别人。不过，您有兴致的时候，可真是魅力非凡。

source: Come on up, then!
target: 那就上来吧！

source: My thanks.
target: 多谢。

source: No script! Are you improvising today, my lord?
target: 没带剧本！殿下，您今天要即兴表演吗？

source: I certainly am.
target: 正是。

source: Everyone, I have something to tell you. Please, listen carefully.
target: 各位，我有话要告诉你们。请仔细听。

source: I know the cloud of death already hangs over Elsinore. Far be it from me to bring more dismal news.
target: 我知道，死亡的阴云已经笼罩了埃尔西诺。我绝不愿再带来更多噩耗。

source: But, nevertheless--
target: 可是，尽管如此——

source: We are all in grave danger. This man, Peter Quince, wishes to cause us great suffering.
target: 我们所有人都身处险境。这个人，彼得·奎因斯，想让我们承受巨大的痛苦。

source: In fact, he has. In past worlds—in other versions of the world we live in now.
target: 事实上，他已经这么做了。在过去的世界里——在我们如今所处世界的其他版本里。

source: Er, other worlds?
target: 呃，其他世界？

source: He's finally broken.
target: 他终于崩溃了。

source: He's telling the truth.
target: 他说的是真的。

source: Quince is a murderer. He's orchestrated all of your deaths. The when—the why—is not important.
target: 奎因斯是个杀人凶手。他策划了你们所有人的死亡。什么时候——为什么——这些都不重要。

source: But if you don't listen to us, you'll all be dead within two days' time.
target: 但如果你们不听我们的话，两天之内，你们就都会死。

source: Ophelia! Get down from there!
target: 奥菲莉娅！从那儿下来！

source: What on earth are you doing?
target: 你到底在干什么？

source: I wouldn't have learned about Quince's plans if it weren't for Ophelia's help. We owe her our lives.
target: 没有奥菲莉娅的帮助，我就不会知道奎因斯的计划。我们的命都是她救的。

source: Everything calamitous that's happened as of late—it all has been Peter Quince's doing, his wishes, to see us suffer.
target: 最近发生的一切灾祸——全都是彼得·奎因斯所为，也全都出自他的意愿，为的就是看我们受苦。

source: He is treasonous. Indirectly, he organized my father's murder at Claudius's hands.
target: 他犯下了叛国之罪。他间接策划了我父亲的谋杀，让克劳狄斯下手。

source: What is happening?
target: 这究竟是怎么回事？

source: H-How is such a thing possible?
target: 怎、怎么可能有这种事？

source: Stop this at once. I am no murderer, and I don't know what you're talking about!
target: 立刻住口。我不是杀人凶手，也不知道你们在说什么！

source: Clear the stage. This performance is over.
target: 清空舞台。演出结束了。

source: Hamlet. Don't you think this 'play' has gone far enough?
target: 哈姆雷特。你不觉得这出“戏”已经演得够过分了吗？

source: Everyone's looking at you as though-- as if-- this is some bizarre game.
target: 大家都看着你，好像——仿佛——这是什么荒诞的游戏。

source: Please. Stop this.
target: 求你了。停下吧。

source: On the contrary, this performance has just begun.
target: 恰恰相反，这场演出才刚刚开始。

source: A-a-- a ghost!
target: 鬼、鬼——有鬼！

source: Is that...?
target: 那是……？

source: King Hamlet's spirit.
target: 哈姆雷特国王的灵魂。

source: No. It can't be. You're dead. I put you into your grave myself!
target: 不。不可能。你已经死了。我亲手把你葬进了坟墓！

source: You again? Haven't you got an empty wall to haunt?
target: 又是你？你就没面空墙可以去闹鬼吗？

source: Brother, Gerta, be not afraid.
target: 弟弟，格尔塔，别害怕。

source: Hamlet, is that really you?
target: 哈姆雷特，真的是你吗？

source: Gerta, be not afraid.
target: 格尔塔，别害怕。

source: Everyone, be not afraid.
target: 各位，别害怕。

source: I come not to destroy, but to rebuild.
target: 我来不是为了毁灭，而是为了重建。

source: It cannot be!
target: 这不可能！

source: Hamlet? Is that really you?
target: 哈姆雷特？真的是你吗？

source: Are you truly here? Or is this some spirit sent from Hell to claim me at last?
target: 你真的在这里吗？还是说，这是地狱派来的幽灵，终于要来带走我了？

source: I am a spirit, but not here to claim you, Gerta.
target: 我是灵魂，但我不是来带走你的，格尔塔。

source: Don't weep, my love. I have heard your prayers and whispers. I was with you in your loneliest moments.
target: 别哭，我的爱人。我听见了你的祈祷和低语。在你最孤独的时候，我一直陪着你。

source: You were never alone. Not for a minute. And now I wish you only happiness.
target: 你从未孤身一人。一分钟也没有。而现在，我只愿你幸福。

source: Oh, Hamlet... i-is... is it true you were murdered?
target: 哦，哈姆雷特……是、是……你真的是被谋杀的吗？

source: Yes. It is true.
target: 是的。是真的。

source: Look upon your husband's face. You have only to look to see the truth.
target: 看看你丈夫的脸。只需看一眼，你就能看见真相。

source: Do not hate him, my love. His hand was forced by the plodding pace of fate.
target: 不要恨他，我的爱人。是命运沉缓的步伐逼他出手。

source: My King, is that really you?
target: 陛下，真的是您吗？

source: Are you truly here? Or is this some spirit sent from Hell?
target: 您真的在这里吗？还是说，这是地狱派来的幽灵？

source: I am a spirit, but not here to claim you, Bernardo.
target: 我是灵魂，但我不是来带走你的，贝尔纳多。

source: Your Highness, I tried to meet your spirit after... after the first time Hamlet spoke to you.
target: 陛下，我曾试着去见您的灵魂，在……在哈姆雷特第一次和您交谈之后。

source: I am sorry. I am sorry I could not save your life. I know now that Claudius betrayed you.
target: 对不起。对不起，我没能救下您的性命。我现在知道，是克劳狄斯背叛了您。

source: I swore to serve you faithfully, and when it came to keep you alive, I failed.
target: 我发过誓，要忠心侍奉您，可在保住您的性命这件事上，我却失败了。

source: You, who were like a father to me.
target: 您对我而言，就像父亲一样。

source: Don't weep. I have heard your prayers, Bernardo.
target: 别哭。贝尔纳多，我听见了你的祈祷。

source: You were the most stalwart man any King could hope for. I wish you only happiness.
target: 你是最忠诚坚定的人，任何国王都渴望拥有这样的臣属。我只愿你幸福。

source: And do not hate Claudius, my good man. My brother's hand was forced by the plodding pace of fate.
target: 也不要恨克劳狄斯，我的好臣子。是命运沉缓的步伐逼我弟弟出手。

source: And the one cranking that wheel was Peter Quince.
target: 而转动那命运之轮的人，就是彼得·奎因斯。

source: Peter Quince? This little countryside playmaster? But I don't understand!
target: 彼得·奎因斯？这个不起眼的乡下戏剧大师？可我不明白！

source: He's just a visitor. What reason could he have to desire your death?
target: 他只是个访客。他有什么理由想要你死？

source: Peter Quince? This little countryside playmaster? But I don't understand.
target: 彼得·奎因斯？这个不起眼的乡下戏剧大师？可我不明白。

source: He's just a visitor. How could he possibly have caused your death?
target: 他只是个访客。怎么可能是他害死了您？

source: Yes, do explain yourself. I'm merely a humble traveling thespian!
target: 对，务必说个明白。我不过是个卑微的流浪戏子！

source: If ever you trusted me, then know also that this man is a danger to you, innocent though he seem.
target: 如果你们曾经信任我，就也请相信，这个人看似无辜，却会危及你们。

source: It is because of him that I linger here in this world, unable to pass on.
target: 正是因为他，我才徘徊在这个世界，无法安息。

source: It's true, my lords, my ladies. We have to act against him.
target: 这是真的，各位大人，各位女士。我们必须出手对付他。

source: Claudius, if you wish to save what remains of your kingdom and its future, help us end this man's life.
target: 克劳狄斯，如果你想保住你王国剩下的一切，以及它的未来，就帮我们杀了这个人。

source: Help us, and redeem yourself.
target: 帮助我们，也救赎你自己。

source: Do not leave me in this state any longer, brother. Let me pass on. Kill this man.
target: 弟弟，别再让我困在这种境地了。让我安息。杀了这个人。

source: Seize him.
target: 拿下他。

source: Bernardo, if ever you considered me a friend, or my father a father of your own, help us end this man's life.
target: 贝尔纳多，如果你曾把我当作朋友，或者把我父亲当作自己的父亲，就帮我们杀了这个人。

source: Do not leave me in this state any longer, Bernardo. Let me pass on. Kill this man.
target: 贝尔纳多，别再让我困在这种境地了。让我安息。杀了这个人。

source: Hamlet. Seize the playmaster.
target: 哈姆雷特。拿下戏剧大师。

source: Oh, come now, Claudius. You don't actually want to kill me. All this exhausting, confusing drivel. What does it mean to you?
target: 哦，别这样，克劳狄斯。你并不是真的想杀我。这些让人疲惫又摸不着头脑的胡言乱语，对你有什么意义？

source: What difference does it make if you killed your brother? Look at all you gained! Look at the richness of your reward! Doesn't that make it God's own will?
target: 就算你杀了自己的哥哥，那又有什么关系？看看你得到的一切！看看你的回报有多丰厚！这难道不正说明，这就是上帝的旨意吗？

source: All this is just a misunderstanding. The insane delusions of your insane nephew, who hijacked a community event to make his final stand.
target: 这一切只是个误会。是你那疯侄子的疯狂妄想，他把一场大家的活动据为己有，借此作最后的抗争。

source: Can't we have him off to an asylum and be done with it?
target: 我们就不能把他送进疯人院，了结这件事吗？

source: Be silent! I believe my brother's spirit. Hamlet, grab him.
target: 闭嘴！我相信我兄长的亡灵。哈姆雷特，抓住他。

source: Oh, come now, Bernardo. You don't actually want to kill me. All this exhausting, confusing drivel. What does it mean to you?
target: 哦，别这样，贝尔纳多。你并不真的想杀我。这一堆让人头昏脑胀的胡话，对你又有什么意义？

source: You truly believe that what the Mad Prince says is real?
target: 你真相信那个疯王子说的都是真的？

source: All this is just a misunderstanding. The insane delusions of your insane friend here, who hijacked a community event to make his final stand.
target: 这一切只是个误会。全是你这位疯朋友的疯狂妄想，他把大家的活动据为己用，好做最后的挣扎。

source: Be silent! I believe His Majesty's spirit. Hamlet, grab him.
target: 闭嘴！我相信陛下的亡灵。哈姆雷特，抓住他。

source: No, thank you. I don't like to be touched.
target: 不必了，谢谢。我不喜欢别人碰我。

source: He's—he's dead?
target: 他——他死了？

source: H-he's not even touching them!
target: 他、他根本就没碰他们！

source: I warned you, Ophelia. I don't feel like playing anymore.
target: 我警告过你，奥菲莉娅。我不想再玩了。

source: Let's call this round a draw and return to the beginning. That way, I won't have to punish you.
target: 这一局就算平手吧，我们回到最开始。这样，我就不用惩罚你了。

source: Or maybe I'll teach you how much further this pain can go.
target: 不然，我也许会让你见识一下，这痛苦还能加深到什么地步。

source: Even then, I won't give up. I'm going to keep coming at you.
target: 即便如此，我也不会放弃。我会继续对抗你。

source: How do you want me to kill Hamlet next time, love? Shall we watch him gurgle to death on his own bile and blood? Shall we hang him and watch his face turn blue?
target: 亲爱的，下次你想让我怎么杀哈姆雷特？看着他被自己的胆汁和鲜血呛得咯咯作响，直到死去？还是把他吊起来，看着他的脸变得青紫？

source: I wonder how many pieces of you I can break before you die. Shall I begin with your wrists and ankles and go from there?
target: 我想知道，在你死之前，我能折断你身上多少地方。不如从你的手腕和脚踝开始，再一路往上？

source: Snapping every little bone like a winter twig, working my way up to your neck...
target: 像折断冬日的枯枝一样，把每一块小骨头折断，一直折到你的脖子……

source: Oh, I simply can't wait! We're going to have a lovely time.
target: 哦，我简直等不及了！我们会玩得很愉快的。

source: You think I'd let you do that?
target: 你以为我会让你这么做？

source: I can do anything I want to you. There's nothing you can do to stop me.
target: 我想怎么对你，就能怎么对你。你无论做什么，都阻止不了我。

source: And this story? This is mine. I will not allow you to steal it from me.
target: 至于这个故事？它是我的。我不会让你把它从我手里夺走。

source: Now, Ophelia, I simply must congratulate you on a heroic attempt. It was nearly well-executed.
target: 好了，奥菲莉娅，你这番英勇的尝试，我实在不能不道声恭喜。你差一点就做得很漂亮了。

source: But, well, nearly doesn't count for very much, does it?
target: 可是，唉，差一点也没多大用，对吧？

source: Die... die, die, die!
target: 去死……去死，去死，去死！

source: You demon! You can come after me, but so help the witless devil who comes for my family!
target: 你这恶魔！你可以冲我来，但哪个不长脑子的魔鬼敢动我的家人，我就绝不饶他！

source: My family--
target: 我的家人——

source: You demon. You can come for all of us, but so help the witless fool who comes after Hamlet.
target: 你这恶魔。你可以对付我们所有人，但哪个不长脑子的蠢货敢动哈姆雷特，我就绝不饶他。

source: Is he really...
target: 他真的……

source: Can it be over?
target: 难道就这样结束了？

source: The world has come undone. Now a new story begins.
target: 世界已然崩解。如今，一个新的故事开始了。

source: I thought I heard something.
target: 我好像听到了什么。

source: King Hamlet!
target: 哈姆雷特国王！

source: It is with my last fragments of will that I appear to you. I do not know how long I can linger.
target: 我凭着最后一丝残存的意志，出现在你面前。我不知道自己还能停留多久。

source: I'm sorry. I didn't think the plan would turn out like this.
target: 对不起。我没想到计划会变成这样。

source: There has to be another way. Something else I can try. Killing him didn't work.
target: 一定还有别的办法。还有什么是我能试的。杀了他也没用。

source: But maybe...
target: 但也许……

source: Maybe there's another way.
target: 也许还有别的办法。

source: No, Ophelia. There is no other way.
target: 没有，奥菲莉娅。没有别的办法了。

source: What he says is true.
target: 他说的是真的。

source: I know that now more than ever. The confines surrounding this world are insurmountable.
target: 如今，我比以往任何时候都更清楚这一点。这个世界周围的界限，无法逾越。

source: Ophelia, there will be no way out from this.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我们无法从中脱身。

source: I don't understand. What's the point, Hamlet? Of any of this?
target: 我不明白。有什么意义，哈姆雷特？这一切到底有什么意义？

source: I just want to give up, the way you did, and be done with it.
target: 我只想像你那样放弃，让这一切结束。

source: I'm so tired.
target: 我太累了。

source: The only way out is to sentence some of my friends to die.
target: 唯一的出路，就是判我的一些朋友去死。

source: No matter what I do, someone is going to die. I can't save them! I can't do it!
target: 不管我做什么，总有人会死。我救不了他们！我做不到！

source: There's no good ending. There's no good world! I've tried everything I could...
target: 没有好的结局。没有好的世界！我已经试过一切能试的办法了……

source: That kind of world was never a possible outcome for you, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，那样的世界，从来就不是你能得到的结局。

source: No such world of eternal bliss exists. For you, or for anyone on earth.
target: 永远幸福的世界并不存在。对你如此，对世上任何人都如此。

source: And it never shall.
target: 也永远不会存在。

source: But there is something even more powerful.
target: 但还有一种更强大的力量。

source: It is the oldest, most primal power of humankind.
target: 那是人类最古老、最原始的力量。

source: The power to choose with kindness and wisdom is the only thing separating human beings from utter darkness.
target: 以善意和智慧做出选择的力量，是人类免于彻底陷入黑暗的唯一依靠。

source: You have seen the possibilities of this universe. Now it's up to you to envision its fate.
target: 你已见过这个宇宙的种种可能。现在，该由你来设想它的命运了。

source: Let me be clear. There is no perfect world to be found.
target: 我把话说清楚。你找不到完美的世界。

source: But the choice between worlds is a power so critical as to be divinely given, is it not? Freedom of will! The first and last gift granted to Eve herself!
target: 但在不同世界之间做出选择，是如此至关重要的力量，堪称神赐，不是吗？自由意志！那是赐予夏娃本人的第一份，也是最后一份礼物！

source: Yes... free will is a sword to cut through the darkness. It is a small boat we cling to in this lifelong storm!
target: 是的……自由意志是劈开黑暗的剑。也是在这场贯穿一生的风暴中，我们紧紧抓住的小舟！

source: In that, Ophelia, is everything. You must choose, and you must then live in the world which comes from it.
target: 奥菲莉娅，一切都在于此。你必须做出选择，然后在由这选择造就的世界里生活。

source: You must do the thing you fear most, and move forward rather than back.
target: 你必须去做自己最害怕的事，向前走，而不是往后退。

source: I don't want to leave. As long as I stay here, it's as though there's something new I can try...
target: 我不想离开。只要我还留在这里，就好像还有新的办法可以试……

source: Some new way out to discover.
target: 还有新的出路等着我去发现。

source: What if I burn the book? What if I destroy it?
target: 要是我把书烧了呢？要是我毁了它呢？

source: You would punish Quince. But you would condemn every human heart in this castle to their fates. You'd abandon them.
target: 那样，你会惩罚奎因斯。但你也会让这座城堡里的每个人都只能承受自己的命运。你会抛弃他们。

source: I-- This is-- But there has to be another way! A good way--a best path!
target: 我——这——可一定还有别的办法！一个好办法——一条最好的路！

source: No. Perfection is impossible. No such world could ever exist. Not so long as imperfect human beings fill it.
target: 没有。完美是不可能的。那样的世界永远不可能存在。只要其中生活着不完美的人，就不可能。

source: Use the Book of Fates, Ophelia. Do what I could not.
target: 使用命运之书吧，奥菲莉娅。去做我没能做到的事。

source: Refuse to give up!
target: 绝不要放弃！

source: I... I will. Much as I don't want to.
target: 我……我会的。尽管我很不情愿。

source: I promise.
target: 我保证。

source: Not long now...
target: 时间不多了……

source: If only I had known the kind of strength you possess when I was alive, child.
target: 孩子，要是我生前就知道你有这样的力量，该多好。

source: Though your body might be frail, you are brilliant as the sun.
target: 你的身体或许柔弱，你却如太阳般耀眼。

source: Someday many years hence, let us play a game of chess together sometime.
target: 多年以后的某一天，我们一起下一盘棋吧。

source: Or walk amongst those verdant, shimmering gardens I once slept in peacefully...
target: 或是在那些苍翠、流光闪烁的花园里漫步，我曾在那里安然入睡……

source: I... hope it is permissible that I call you a friend in death, though I hardly knew you in life.
target: 我……希望你允许我在死后称你为朋友，尽管生前我几乎不了解你。

source: Of course. Of course it is.
target: 当然。当然可以。

source: I'm certain we'll see one another again.
target: 我相信我们一定会再见。

source: It is the end.
target: 终点到了。

source: And I am not afraid.
target: 而我并不害怕。

source: Goodbye, King Hamlet.
target: 再见，哈姆雷特国王。

source: I'll find a way to make all this worthwhile. Whatever that end is. I promise.
target: 我会找到办法，让这一切都值得。无论最终的结局是什么。我保证。

source: You were sorely missed at Hamlet's departure this morning.
target: 今天早上哈姆雷特启程时，你没来，实在令人遗憾。

source: Apologies, my lord. I didn't make the ship in time.
target: 抱歉，陛下。我没能及时赶上船。

source: Hmph. Never mind it. There are always alternatives.
target: 哼。算了。总还有别的办法。

source: We've got a long journey ahead of us.
target: 前面还有一段漫长的旅程等着我们。

source: My lord, my ladies, welcome aboard, your excellencies.
target: 大人，女士们，各位贵客，欢迎登船。

source: By your faces, I don't recall having sailed with any of you before, save His Majesty here.
target: 看各位的面孔，除了这位陛下，我不记得以前曾和你们一起出过海。

source: My name is Captain Norby. We'll be three days at sea, and—
target: 我是诺比船长。我们将在海上航行三天，而且——

source: Yes, I've a burning question! When is supper?
target: 是的，我有个急着想问的问题！晚饭什么时候吃？

source: Guilda, we've only just left port. It's not quite noon.
target: 吉尔达，我们才刚离港。还没到中午呢。

source: Lunch, then?
target: 那午饭呢？

source: I'm sure provisions can, er, be arranged for you.
target: 我想，呃，应该能给你安排些吃的。

source: Guilda! Honestly, you're so common sometimes...
target: 吉尔达！真是的，你有时候实在太没教养了……

source: I wouldn't even—hrgh... Oh, no.
target: 我连——呃……哦，不好。

source: Lady Rosencrantz, are you... all right?
target: 罗森克兰兹女士，你……还好吗？

source: I've forgotten how horribly seasick I get. P-please, excuse me.
target: 我都忘了自己晕船有多厉害了。请、请恕我失陪。

source: ...Farewell to Denmark. Farewell to that awful tower.
target: ……别了，丹麦。别了，那座可怕的塔。

source: May we be delivered to England as swiftly as possible.
target: 愿我们尽快抵达英格兰。

source: (The King has tasked me with ensuring Hamlet's demise before we return to Denmark.)
target: （国王交给我的任务，是确保哈姆雷特在我们返回丹麦前死去。）

source: (That could change the fate of Elsinore... but I'm not certain I can bring myself to do that.)
target: （那或许能改变埃尔西诺的命运……但我不确定自己能不能狠下心来那么做。）

source: (I should investigate while I'm here.)
target: （既然来了，我应该调查一下。）

source: This is all meaningless to me. I'm only here to have fun!
target: 这些对我都没什么意义。我来这里只是为了玩得开心！

source: Say, you said I was going to die here, didn't you?
target: 对了，你说过我会死在这里，是不是？

source: Well, that's foreboding.
target: 唉，这可真不吉利。

source: Say, Ophelia, have you ever looked at the stars at sea?
target: 对了，奥菲莉娅，你在海上看过星星吗？

source: They're so much bigger and brighter!
target: 它们看起来大得多，也亮得多！

source: I don't mind if I live or die, but we should look at the stars together!
target: 我不在乎自己是生是死，但我们应该一起看星星！

source: All right, Guilda. I'll be there.
target: 好，吉尔达。我会去的。

source: (She won't survive past tomorrow if I can't find a way to keep her and Rosie alive.)
target: （如果我找不到办法让她和萝茜活下来，她就活不过明天。）

source: (Yet another task lies before me.)
target: （眼前又多了一件要做的事。）

source: ...Hi, Ophelia.
target: ……你好，奥菲莉娅。

source: What're you doing up here alone?
target: 你一个人在这上面做什么？

source: Waiting for you! I told you we'd meet, didn't I?
target: 等你呀！我说过我们要见面的，不是吗？

source: Hi, Ophelia. I slept in late.
target: 你好，奥菲莉娅。我睡了个懒觉，起晚了。

source: Fancy a walk in the gardens?
target: 想去花园散散步吗？

source: I thought you'd come find me. Let's stroll a while.
target: 我就想着你会来找我。我们散会儿步吧。

source: Why here? Why this place?
target: 为什么来这里？为什么选这个地方？

source: I just come here to think sometimes. That's all.
target: 我有时会来这里想想事情。就这样。

source: I had the oddest feeling.
target: 我有种很奇怪的感觉。

source: I think Hamlet's angry with us. With me.
target: 我觉得哈姆雷特在生我们的气。生我的气。

source: And I don't know what things will be like when we next go ashore.
target: 而且我不知道，下次上岸时会是什么情形。

source: And I don't know what things will be like in a little while.
target: 而且我不知道，再过一会儿会是什么情形。

source: ...I think your intuition is correct.
target: ……我觉得你的直觉是对的。

source: Well, it's all right. I always knew the fun would end eventually.
target: 唉，没关系。我一直都知道，开心的日子总会结束。

source: It had to. Rosie and I always move on at some point.
target: 总会的。我和萝茜总会在某个时候离开。

source: We sort of—go where we go, and meet who we meet, and when the party's concluded, on we move.
target: 我们差不多就是——走到哪儿算哪儿，遇见谁算谁，等宴会散了，就继续走。

source: Say, Ophelia. Do you think we would have liked England if we'd made it there?
target: 对了，奥菲莉娅。如果我们真到了英格兰，你觉得我们会喜欢那里吗？

source: Say, Ophelia. I don't think I want to go back to Wittenberg, where we all went to school.
target: 对了，奥菲莉娅。我想我不愿意再回维滕贝格了，就是我们一起上学的地方。

source: Do you think you'd like it there?
target: 你觉得你会喜欢那里吗？

source: I don't think I can say. I've never been. And—now I likely never shall.
target: 我说不准。我从来没去过。而且——现在看来，我大概永远也去不了了。

source: You know, I don't really even believe in it. England, I mean.
target: 你知道吗，我其实都不太相信它真的存在。我是说英格兰。

source: Every time we try to go there, something happens.
target: 每次我们想去那里，总会出点什么事。

source: Last time, our carriage broke down. Lovely detour to Paris we had. And this time, pirates.
target: 上次，我们的马车坏了。结果绕道去了巴黎，玩得很愉快。这次呢，又遇到了海盗。

source: I'm not certain England really exists at this point.
target: 到了这份上，我都不确定英格兰是不是真的存在了。

source: It's just a conspiracy of cartographers, you mean?
target: 你是说，那只是画地图的人合谋编出来的？

source: Yes! That's exactly it!
target: 对！就是这样！

source: Now there's no telling where we'll end up. And there isn't even anything to drink.
target: 现在，谁也说不准我们最后会去哪儿。而且连喝的酒都没有。

source: What kind of monstrously sober pirates take over a ship and don't even bring liquor with them?
target: 哪有海盗抢占一艘船，连酒都不带的？他们清醒得简直可怕！

source: These pirates are far more efficient and businesslike than I was led to believe they'd be.
target: 这些海盗做事比别人说的利落得多，也正经得多。

source: Oh, there's a wineskin stashed under the helm. I noticed earlier.
target: 哦，船舵下面藏着一只酒囊。我之前看见了。

source: It's over there.
target: 就在那边。

source: You know, I think there's a big, large life ahead of you.
target: 你知道吗，我觉得你往后的人生会很宽广，很精彩。

source: You're like a fish in a little pond. One of the pretty fish, that is.
target: 你就像小池塘里的一条鱼。我是说，那种漂亮的鱼。

source: But some day, you're going to realize you can get past the log at the other end of it.
target: 但总有一天，你会发现，自己能越过池塘另一头的那根木头。

source: And then you'll be free! Free to swim all the way to the sea!
target: 到时你就自由了！可以自由地一路游向大海！

source: I think river fish die when they meet the sea.
target: 我想，河里的鱼到了海里会死的。

source: Yes! In a brilliant blaze of glory! Go out blazing, Ophelia!
target: 对！死得光彩夺目，轰轰烈烈！奥菲莉娅，就这样灿烂地落幕吧！

source: Maybe... it's time for me to strike out and do that, too.
target: 也许……我也该出去闯一闯，做同样的事了。

source: With the situation in the castle, there's no telling what'll happen. And there isn't even anything to drink.
target: 城堡里现在这情形，谁也说不准会发生什么。而且连喝的酒都没有。

source: That's why these Danes are at each others' throats constantly. They're all so dreadfully sober.
target: 难怪这些丹麦人整天斗个不停。他们一个个都清醒得要命。

source: Isn't this part of the world famous for its halls full of glory and drink?
target: 这一带不是以满载荣耀和美酒的厅堂闻名吗？

source: You haven't looked in the kitchen beside the hearth, have you?
target: 你没去厨房的炉边看过吧？

source: That's where Irma keeps all the castle wine.
target: 伊尔玛把城堡里所有的葡萄酒都放在那里。

source: Y-you're serious?
target: 你、你说真的？

source: Ophelia! You beautiful, marvelous, lavender-coated little sugarplum!
target: 奥菲莉娅！你这个穿着淡紫色衣裳、漂亮又可爱的小甜心！

source: Ooh, I'm so happy I could kiss you!
target: 哦，我高兴得真想亲你一口！

source: Oh, is that so?
target: 哦，是吗？

source: (So we've come to this point again.)
target: （我们又走到这一步了。）

source: W-well, actually...
target: 嗯、嗯，其实……

source: Since we're in the company of unholy people, and that seems an appropriate time for confessions...
target: 既然我们正和一群不敬神的人待在一起，这似乎很适合坦白些什么……

source: Since we're in the garden, and that seems an appropriate place for confessions...
target: 既然我们在花园里，这似乎是个很适合坦白些什么的地方……

source: I've had a little fancy for you whenever I've visited Elsinore over the years. But I've only ever known you from afar.
target: 这些年来，每次来埃尔西诺，我都有些喜欢你。但我一直只是远远地看着你，并不了解你。

source: I think the only time we ever spoke was across the dining table in the great hall.
target: 我想，我们唯一说过话的时候，就是在大厅里隔着餐桌聊天。

source: You always seemed so graceful, but sad, in a quiet way. You stood apart from everyone.
target: 你总是显得那么优雅，却又带着一种安静的忧伤。你总和其他人保持着距离。

source: I always thought that if I knew you better, maybe I'd be able to give you a kiss that would make you smile.
target: 我总在想，要是我更了解你一些，也许就能给你一个吻，让你笑起来。

source: A-and now, well, here we are.
target: 而、而现在，嗯，我们就在这里了。

source: B-but if you don't want to, we'll still be friends, and I won't be mad!
target: 但、但如果你不愿意，我们还是朋友，我也不会生气的！

source: Kiss Guildenstern?
target: 亲吻吉尔登斯吞？

source: Your cheeks are all red.
target: 你的脸颊都红了。

source: Gah. I feel all warm.
target: 啊。我觉得浑身都热起来了。

source: It is August.
target: 毕竟是八月嘛。

source: I suppose.
target: 大概吧。

source: Ooh! So you did like it!
target: 哦！原来你确实喜欢！

source: Well, yes. I like you, Guilda. I wish we had more time together.
target: 嗯，是的。我喜欢你，吉尔达。真希望我们能有更多时间在一起。

source: Oh, my. With pirates at our throats and imminent death on the horizon, I'm really clinching a new girlfriend at the last minute, aren't I?
target: 哎呀。海盗都快把刀架到我们脖子上了，眼看就要没命，我居然还在最后一刻交到了新女友，是不是？

source: Oh, my. With the political situation crumbling and imminent death on the horizon, I'm really clinching a new girlfriend at the last minute, aren't I?
target: 哎呀。政局都快崩了，眼看就要没命，我居然还在最后一刻交到了新女友，是不是？

source: Um, speaking of which...
target: 嗯，说到这个……

source: I'd rather we were just friends. But that doesn't mean I don't like you.
target: 我更希望我们只做朋友。但这不代表我不喜欢你。

source: All right! You know, you're the first good friend I've had since Hamlet and Rosie came along.
target: 好啊！你知道吗，认识哈姆雷特和萝茜之后，你是我交到的第一个好朋友。

source: If the pirates decide to cannibalize our flesh after all, as I suspect they might, I hope you find someone who makes you feel happy all the time.
target: 如果海盗最后还是决定吃我们的肉——我怀疑他们真有可能这么做——我希望你能找到一个让你一直开心的人。

source: If Norway sweeps in and murders us all, as I have an inexplicable inkling they might, I hope you find someone who makes you feel happy all the time.
target: 如果挪威人杀进来，把我们全杀了——我莫名有种预感，他们可能真会这么做——我希望你能找到一个让你一直开心的人。

source: Rosie makes me feel that way. And you do, too.
target: 萝茜就能让我有这种感觉。你也一样。

source: You even helped me plan a fake funeral. If that's not friendship, what is?
target: 你甚至帮我筹划了一场假葬礼。这要还不算友谊，那什么才算？

source: You deserve something like that.
target: 你值得拥有这样的感情。

source: Oh, I'm certain we'll meet again. No matter what happens.
target: 哦，我确信我们会再见的。不管发生什么。

source: Can you keep a secret?
target: 你能保守秘密吗？

source: Well, I suppose it doesn't matter much either way.
target: 嗯，我想能不能都没多大关系。

source: I have something to tell you.
target: 我有件事要告诉你。

source: Are you a spy? I knew it!
target: 你是间谍吗？我就知道！

source: No. But I've been experiencing something most curious.
target: 不是。但我一直在经历一件非常奇怪的事。

source: For me, time is repeating itself. I've seen the ebb and flow of Elsinore castle, but—changed.
target: 对我来说，时间在不断重复。我见过埃尔西诺城堡里的种种起落，但——又有所不同。

source: And I'm trying to change that outcome. To reach a better place for us all.
target: 而我正在努力改变那个结局。让我们所有人都能有更好的未来。

source: And I've been trying to change our collective dismal future for a long time now.
target: 而我已经努力了很久，想改变我们所有人惨淡的未来。

source: Oh! I see. Like a time loop!
target: 哦！我懂了。就像时间循环！

source: You believe me?
target: 你相信我？

source: I've-- I've actually been here with you before.
target: 我——我其实以前就和你一起待在这里过。

source: Well, not in this precise moment. But something quite similar.
target: 嗯，不是完全一样的这一刻。但情形很相似。

source: It's still surprising you believe me so easily.
target: 你这么容易就相信我，还是让我很惊讶。

source: Of course. Rosie and I travel everywhere. We've seen all sorts of strange things. Like a Danish boy named Hamlet, for example. What a ridiculous name.
target: 当然。萝茜和我到处旅行，见过各种各样的怪事。比如有个丹麦男孩叫哈姆雷特。这名字真荒唐。

source: It sounds like the kind of thing you'd put in a room to decorate a corner. 'Oh, and here's an antique vase, next to that Hamlet over there. Brightens up the room.'
target: 听起来像是摆在房间角落里当装饰的东西。“哦，这儿还有个古董花瓶，就在那边那个哈姆雷特旁边。给房间添点亮色。”

source: Although I wouldn't have believed you if I hadn't gotten to know you like this. You do have a reputation as a bit of a loon.
target: 不过，要是没有这样了解你，我是不会信的。毕竟大家确实都说你有点疯疯癫癫。

source: Even if you were to die tomorrow, we'll see each other again. That's what I mean by all this.
target: 就算你明天死了，我们也会再见。我说这么多，就是这个意思。

source: That's wonderful.
target: 那真好。

source: Well, if I do die, then I hope the Guilda you meet in the next world is a good one.
target: 嗯，要是我真死了，希望你在下一个世界遇到的吉尔妲是个好人。

source: And I hope you can find a way to help her be just as happy as I am now.
target: 也希望你能想办法，让她和现在的我一样开心。

source: I'll do my absolute best. I promise.
target: 我一定会尽全力。我保证。

source: Good. Then let's enjoy the nighttime stillness while we can.
target: 好。那趁现在还有机会，我们一起享受这夜晚的宁静吧。

source: I've only a moment. I must make haste.
target: 我只有片刻时间，得抓紧了。

source: What were they doing in here earlier, so secretive?
target: 她们刚才在这里做什么，神神秘秘的？

source: A letter from Claudius?
target: 克劳狄斯的信？

source: It bears the Seal of Denmark. Luckily, I've one of my own to match.
target: 上面盖着丹麦的印章。幸好，我自己也有一枚一样的。

source: I've entrusted these orders to two loyal servants, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern, to ensure that...
target: 我已将这些命令托付给两位忠诚的仆人，罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞，以确保……

source: He is to be executed upon arrival. He's asking for my death. The Queen of England is to remove my head.
target: 他一抵达，便须处决。他要我死。他要英格兰女王砍下我的头。

source: Rosie and Guilda. They must know about this.
target: 萝茜和吉尔妲。她们一定知道这件事。

source: I knew they were under Claudius's thumb, but this is too far.
target: 我知道她们受克劳狄斯摆布，但这也太过分了。

source: Were they ever my friends at all? Was anything they said to me about our camraderie ever true?
target: 她们到底有没有把我当过朋友？她们对我说过的那些情谊，有一句是真心的吗？

source: And of course, Claudius never had any intention of letting me live free in England. Ought to have seen that one coming.
target: 当然，克劳狄斯从来就没打算让我在英格兰自由地活下去。我早该料到的。

source: I've made a fool of myself. And now the murderer rules Denmark free of anyone who knows his secret.
target: 我把自己变成了个笑话。如今那个杀人凶手统治着丹麦，再也没有知道他秘密的人碍事了。

source: Ahh. Aren't you excited for our big return to England?
target: 啊。我们终于要重返英格兰了，你不兴奋吗？

source: It's been such a long time since we ate and gallivanted our way around London!
target: 我们好久没在伦敦到处吃吃玩玩了！

source: A chance at something new.
target: 一个尝试新事物的机会。

source: You seem unhappy.
target: 你好像不太开心。

source: Merely cautious.
target: 只是谨慎些。

source: I'd prefer to be on solid ground in England, away from my uncle's clutches.
target: 我更希望能脚踏实地地站在英格兰，远离叔父的魔爪。

source: Listen, Guildenstern.
target: 听我说，吉尔登斯吞。

source: It's been good to see you both again. But once we set foot on land, I think we should depart one another's company.
target: 能再见到你们两个，我很高兴。但一上岸，我想我们就该分开了。

source: For a long while, if not forever.
target: 就算不是永别，也该分开很长一段时间。

source: I'm well aware you were working with my uncle to watch over me. I don't like that.
target: 我很清楚，你们一直在帮我叔父监视我。我不喜欢这样。

source: Merely to observe, Hamlet. Everything we told you was the absolute truth.
target: 只是观察而已，哈姆雷特。我们对你说的一切都是真话。

source: They're worried about you, your mother and father. This—our voyage—it's all they can think to do.
target: 他们担心你，你的母亲和父亲。这件事——我们这趟航行——是他们唯一能想到的办法。

source: So you see me as a menace, then.
target: 所以，你也把我当成威胁了。

source: I don't. And you know I never have!
target: 我没有。你也知道，我从来没有这么想过！

source: Initially, I persuaded Rosie to come to Elsinore in part because... of what happened between us in Wittenberg.
target: 起初，我劝萝茜来埃尔西诺，部分原因是……我们在维滕贝格发生的那些事。

source: I had assumed I would be part of your future.
target: 我原以为，你的未来里会有我。

source: I believe you were mistaken.
target: 我想你误会了。

source: I apologize for not being clearer with my intentions.
target: 抱歉，我没有把自己的心意说得更清楚。

source: Perhaps even for a short time back then I did love you. But things are different now.
target: 也许当时有那么一小段时间，我确实爱过你。但现在不同了。

source: I see. My feelings changed, too. I met someone. She's indescribably wonderful.
target: 我明白了。我的感情也变了。我遇到了一个人。她好得让我无法形容。

source: Well that's not something I expected to hear.
target: 嗯，这话可真是我没想到的。

source: I'm not certain how she feels. But you know, I think I understand now why you could never love me over her.
target: 我不确定她是什么心意。但你知道吗，我想我现在明白了，为什么你始终更爱她，而不是我。

source: In that moment, I forgave you. I forgave you for hurting me.
target: 那一刻，我原谅了你。原谅了你对我的伤害。

source: Then perhaps it's even better we parted ways in England. I can't reconcile your confession with the way I feel.
target: 那也许我们到了英格兰就分开，会更好。你这番坦白，我实在无法释怀。

source: For years I have had trouble feeling strongly for anything, Guilda.
target: 吉尔妲，这些年来，我很难对任何事产生强烈的感情。

source: And now I feel strongly about this. Even if Ophelia doesn't return my affections, I love her still.
target: 但如今，这件事让我有了强烈的感情。即使奥菲莉娅不回应我的爱，我依然爱她。

source: You don't love her. You love the idea of Ophelia.
target: 你不爱她。你爱的是想象中的奥菲莉娅。

source: Rosie warned me about you when we all first met. She said you were the type to bed foreign women. That we should stay away.
target: 我们刚认识的时候，萝茜就提醒过我要提防你。她说你是那种会找外国女人上床的人，我们该离你远点。

source: I was hoping that—when we arrived in England—we might discuss the future.
target: 我原本希望——等我们到了英格兰——能谈谈未来。

source: I had assumed I might be a part of that future for you.
target: 我原以为，你的那个未来里，也许会有我。

source: Everything that happened between us in Wittenberg seemed...
target: 我们在维滕贝格发生的一切，似乎……

source: I thought you had come to feel for me the way I had you.
target: 我以为，你也开始像我爱你一样爱我了。

source: Oh, no, don't tell me. I already know the answer. It's her, isn't it.
target: 哦，不，别说了。我已经知道答案了。是她，对不对。

source: You certainly felt strongly enough about me to bed me.
target: 你对我的感情倒是足够强烈，强烈到愿意和我上床。

source: Rosie warned me about you. She said you were the type to bed foreign women. That we should stay away.
target: 萝茜提醒过我要提防你。她说你是那种会找外国女人上床的人，我们该离你远点。

source: That's it, isn't it? And that's why you'd do anything to be with Ophelia, too.
target: 就是这样，对不对？所以你才会为了和奥菲莉娅在一起，不惜做任何事。

source: You can't simplify my feelings that way!
target: 你不能把我的感情说得那么简单！

source: Oh, but it's true, isn't it?
target: 哦，可事实就是如此，不是吗？

source: We're like little items for you to collect! To build out your harem!
target: 我们就像供你收集的小物件！用来充实你的后宫！

source: Before me, it was Emine, and others like her. Don't think I've forgotten.
target: 在我之前，是埃米内，还有其他像她一样的女人。别以为我忘了。

source: I can see this concerns me, so I've come to insert myself.
target: 我看这事跟我有关，所以过来插句话。

source: You've heard what I said, then. I stand by it all the same.
target: 那你都听见了。即便如此，我还是坚持刚才说的话。

source: What Guilda says is the truth, Hamlet. I've noticed it myself.
target: 吉尔妲说的是实话，哈姆雷特。我自己也注意到了。

source: T-that's not true. My feelings for you have always been—complex.
target: 这、这不是真的。我对你的感情一直都——很复杂。

source: And the others?
target: 那其他人呢？

source: Have you ever loved another Danish woman?
target: 你爱过别的丹麦女人吗？

source: I mean a true-blooded Dane, Hamlet. Not like me. Not someone foreign-born.
target: 我是说纯正血统的丹麦人，哈姆雷特。不是像我这样的。不是在外国出生的人。

source: I don't see what that has to do with anything.
target: 我不明白这有什么关系。

source: All men prefer a certain kind of beauty which is amenable to their tastes.
target: 所有男人都会偏爱符合自己口味的某一种美。

source: So do I. What have I done wrong to find women like the two of you attractive?
target: 我也一样。觉得像你们俩这样的女人有魅力，我做错了什么？

source: What does it matter if I've never loved anyone who looks like Brit?
target: 就算我从没爱过长得像布莉特的人，那又有什么关系？

source: I find that sort of woman to be tiresome anyway.
target: 反正我觉得那种女人很烦人。

source: I don't think he realizes.
target: 我觉得他还没意识到。

source: Hamlet. Think upon it a moment. What did you mean when you said you found that sort of woman to be tiresome?
target: 哈姆雷特。好好想一想。你说觉得那种女人很烦人，是什么意思？

source: Women like 'her.' The lily-faced, fair-haired sort who loudly protest every whim. And Danish women who look like her are all that way.
target: 像“她”那样的女人。皮肤白皙、头发浅色，随便提个念头就要大声反对的那种。长得像她的丹麦女人全都这样。

source: Merely being near women like that is exhausting. I far prefer the company of women of your nature. You know. real women.
target: 光是待在那种女人身边就够累的。我更喜欢和你们这样的女人相处。你们懂的，真正的女人。

source: And so--you feel that 'all women' like myself and Lady Guildenstern are somehow—different?
target: 所以——你觉得，像我和吉尔登斯吞女士这样的女人，“全都”跟她们——不一样？

source: Of course. Isn't that clear? You sort are far kindlier, with greater cheer and a captivating graciousness.
target: 当然。这还不明显吗？你们这类女人要和善得多，更开朗，还那么温和有礼，令人着迷。

source: Graciousness? Is that what you call it?
target: 温和有礼？你是这么称呼的？

source: At Wittenberg, women who looked like Ophelia and me were afraid to refuse you. You're a Prince.
target: 在维滕贝格，长得像奥菲莉娅和我这样的女人，不敢拒绝你。你是王子。

source: And if one of us was to spurn your advances, and you were to become angry for it? Well, then.
target: 如果我们中有人拒绝你的追求，而你又为此动怒呢？那可就……

source: I would never begrudge a woman for something like that!
target: 我绝不会因为这种事怨恨一个女人！

source: Oh, never? Come now, Hamlet.
target: 哦，绝不会？得了吧，哈姆雷特。

source: Do not mistake fear for graciousness, Hamlet. Or you're more the fool than I ever thought.
target: 别把恐惧当成温和有礼，哈姆雷特。不然，你就比我想的还要蠢。

source: We may be landed, styled women, but we are not equal to you. Not in this world. Not in Denmark.
target: 我们虽有土地、有头衔，却不能与你平起平坐。在这个世界如此，在丹麦也如此。

source: And you used that against us to find your next match.
target: 而你就利用我们的弱势，物色你的下一个伴侣。

source: What she says is the truth. It is the reason I told you never to speak to me again.
target: 她说的是实话。我就是因此才告诉你，再也别跟我说话。

source: It is all too easy for you to ruin us.
target: 你要毁了我们，实在太容易了。

source: And we know this. It is only you who remain blind to it.
target: 而我们知道这一点。只有你还浑然不觉。

source: Clearly I've made a great number of women uncomfortable.
target: 显然，我让很多女人感到不自在。

source: Am I truly so blind to this element of the world, then?
target: 难道我对这个世界的这一面，真的如此无知吗？

source: You're both right. I have this power, whether I ever wanted it or not. And I was too absorbed within myself to see it.
target: 你们两个说得对。无论我是否想要，我都拥有这种权力。而我太沉浸在自己的世界里，没能看清这一点。

source: Please excuse me. We may be friends still, but I find a sudden pressing urge to flee you.
target: 请容我告辞。我们也许仍是朋友，但我突然迫切地想离你远点。

source: Ugh. Ophelia, what have I done?
target: 唉。奥菲莉娅，我都做了些什么？

source: Don't look to me for answers or comfort. You'll find your own way. You always seem to.
target: 别来找我寻求答案或安慰。你会自己找到出路的。你似乎总能做到。

source: I am a fool.
target: 我是个傻瓜。

source: Trustworthiness aside, what Guilda said...
target: 先不谈她是否值得信任，吉尔妲说的那些话……

source: It wasn't wrong.
target: 并没有错。

source: The way I think about her, and Ophelia...
target: 我看待她和奥菲莉娅的方式……

source: I didn't think there was anything amiss with it, until now.
target: 直到现在，我才发现其中有问题。

source: But how many women have I hurt?
target: 可我已经伤害了多少女人？

source: Am I just some irredeemable monster?
target: 难道我就是个无可救药的怪物？

source: Everyone despises me. All I do is cause pain.
target: 所有人都鄙视我。我只会带来痛苦。

source: I don't know how to fix it. Or how to be better.
target: 我不知道该怎么弥补，也不知道该怎么变得更好。

source: But starting today, I have to be better.
target: 但从今天起，我必须变得更好。

source: So long as I choose to live, I choose to better myself.
target: 只要我选择活下去，我就选择让自己变得更好。

source: C-Captain, we're under attack!
target: 船、船长，我们遭到袭击了！

source: Stations, men. Hold firm.
target: 各就各位，伙计们。守住。

source: Under attack? No, friends. You've already lost.
target: 遭到袭击？不，朋友们。你们已经输了。

source: How did she—?
target: 她怎么——？

source: Came 'round yer flank. You were all lookin' at the cannons of my ship, weren't you?
target: 从你们侧面绕过来的。你们都盯着我船上的大炮呢，是不是？

source: Anyhow, be on yer knees and relinquish yer cargo, and nobody has to lose a limb.
target: 总之，都给我跪下，把货交出来，就谁也不用缺胳膊少腿。

source: Cease at once! Don't you know who this ship belongs to?
target: 立刻住手！你不知道这艘船属于谁吗？

source: Well, the Danish emblem on th'sails gives me a wee inkling...
target: 嗯，看帆上那丹麦徽记，我倒是能猜个大概……

source: He won't let you take her over so easily. Will you, Hamlet?
target: 他不会让你这么轻易夺走这艘船的。对吧，哈姆雷特？

source: Ah... Guildenstern...
target: 啊……吉尔登斯吞……

source: Well, well. 'Hamlet'! Yer the most English-soundin' Dane I've ever met in all m'years. That wouldn't be Prince Hamlet, would it?
target: 哟，哟。“哈姆雷特”！我活了这么多年，还没见过哪个丹麦人说话比你更像英格兰人。该不会是哈姆雷特王子吧？

source: Yes. I am Prince Hamlet. And on behalf of my people aboard this ship, I order you to stand down at once, or risk immediate war with my country.
target: 是的。我就是哈姆雷特王子。我代表这艘船上的我国子民，命令你立刻停手，否则你可能马上就要与我的国家开战。

source: After three seconds o' deliberation, my answer is 'no.' However, I'll happily take you as a hostage for ransom.
target: 慎重考虑了三秒之后，我的回答是“不”。不过，我倒很乐意把你抓去当人质，换笔赎金。

source: Hamlet. We're outnumbered. There's no sense in anyone losing their life.
target: 哈姆雷特。我们人少，打不过他们。没必要让任何人丢了性命。

source: Go with them. Do what they say.
target: 跟他们走吧。照他们说的做。

source: No. I can't leave you, Ophelia.
target: 不。我不能丢下你，奥菲莉娅。

source: Sweet on the Moor, eh?
target: 看上这个摩尔姑娘了，嗯？

source: I won't abandon her. She's here by my sake. And I won't leave her behind. So kill me if you must. I'll not go, nor deliver her into the hands of thieves.
target: 我不会抛弃她。她是因为我才在这里的。我不会把她丢下。所以，如果非杀不可，你就杀了我吧。我不会走，也不会把她交到盗贼手里。

source: Well. That's a trick, ey?
target: 好吧。还挺有一手，是吧？

source: Normally I'd have ol' Finnegan here throw you over 'is shoulder and be on with it, but...
target: 平时我就让这儿的老芬尼根把你往肩上一扛，直接带走了，不过……

source: Tell you wot. If you won't come to O'Malley's vessel, we'll take over yer beaten old ship for ourselves.
target: 这样吧。你不肯上我奥马利的船，那我们就把你们这条破旧的船据为己有。

source: We'll never swear allegiance to some Pirate Queen, nor serve under you.
target: 我们绝不会向什么海盗女王宣誓效忠，也不会听你差遣。

source: Yes! I don't like being loyal to things! Pirates included!
target: 没错！我不喜欢向任何东西效忠！海盗也一样！

source: My tender ladies, you've no choice in the matter. Starting today, I'm yer captain.
target: 娇滴滴的女士们，这事可由不得你们。从今天起，我就是你们的船长。

source: Name's Grace O'Malley, though you can call me 'evil salty bitch' if it makes yeh feel any better.
target: 我叫格蕾丝·奥马利。不过，你们要是觉得解气，叫我“恶毒的臭婊子”也行。

source: I and my men will be taking the captain's bunk, effective immediately.
target: 我和我的手下要占用船长的铺位，立刻生效。

source: And what are we to do, exactly? We were bound for England—
target: 那我们到底该怎么办？我们原本是要去英格兰的——

source: I don't give a horse's ass what yeh do or where yeh were bound. So make of that what yeh will.
target: 你们要干什么，原本要去哪儿，老娘才懒得管。你们爱怎么理解就怎么理解。

source: ...Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll be chartin' a new course.
target: ……好了，失陪，我得去规划新航线了。

source: ...You shouldn't have done that, Hamlet.
target: ……你不该那么做的，哈姆雷特。

source: Neither should I have slain your father. What's done is done.
target: 我也不该杀了你父亲。可做都做了。

source: Too late now. What's done is done.
target: 现在太迟了。做都做了。

source: Ophelia. May I speak to you alone?
target: 奥菲莉娅。我能和你单独谈谈吗？

source: That's a tall order on a cramped ship.
target: 船上这么挤，想单独谈可不容易。

source: ...Perhaps the forecastle deck?
target: ……要不去艏楼甲板？

source: The what?
target: 什么甲板？

source: The forecastle deck. The one near the bow.
target: 艏楼甲板。就是靠近船头的那块。

source: You've scarcely been on a sailing vessel—if ever. How do you know that?
target: 你就算坐过帆船，也没坐过几次。你怎么会知道这个？

source: Well, I read, for one.
target: 嗯，至少我会看书啊。

source: The time has come to discuss our deliverance back to shore.
target: 该商量一下怎么脱身回岸上了。

source: A mutiny, you mean.
target: 你是说，发动叛乱。

source: Yes. Are you... is that... amenable to you?
target: 对。你……这……你能接受吗？

source: It's going to happen regardless. I'll be ready.
target: 反正这事总会发生。我会做好准备。

source: (What's gotten into her?)
target: （她这是怎么了？）

source: We must rise up against the captain and take her by surprise.
target: 我们必须起来反抗船长，打她个措手不及。

source: And then do what, exactly?
target: 然后到底要做什么？

source: We're utterly surrounded, and outnumbered. We've no weapons of any kind. I can't bear a sword. Uncertain about Rosie and Guilda.
target: 我们被团团包围，人数也比不过他们。我们什么武器都没有。我不会使剑。萝茜和吉尔达会不会，我也不清楚。

source: There are still men loyal to us aboard. And I've a plan, besides.
target: 船上还有忠于我们的人。再说，我有个计划。

source: Soon, the good captain will need to sleep—and at that point, she'll be unarmed.
target: 很快，那位好船长就得睡觉了——到时候，她身上不会带武器。

source: Meanwhile, her lieutenant keeps the night watch. If he can be incapacitated, leaving her with no warning...
target: 那时，她的副手负责守夜。只要能让他失去行动能力，让她收不到警报……

source: ...Then we rush her?
target: ……然后我们就冲上去拿下她？

source: ...But... that woman didn't come here alone. Her first ship is fully manned and sails ahead of us. How will we return to Denmark once we've captured the ship?
target: ……可是……那个女人不是一个人来的。她原来的船上人手齐全，就航行在我们前面。就算夺下了这条船，我们又怎么回丹麦？

source: That's just it. We don't have to return to Denmark. Merely run close enough to her shores that Grace's men dare not pursue us longer.
target: 关键就在这里。我们不必回到丹麦。只要驶到离丹麦海岸足够近的地方，让格蕾丝的手下不敢再追就行。

source: Without their leader's signal, they may be slow to react. I hate to admit this, but we might have the merest chance, if the wind favors us.
target: 没有首领的信号，他们可能会反应迟缓。我不想承认，可要是风向有利，我们也许真能有那么一线机会。

source: I'm glad I have your faith.
target: 很高兴你信任我。

source: This plan of mine... there's a contingency built within it.
target: 我的这个计划……还留了一手，以防万一。

source: Ought I to be afraid?
target: 我是不是该害怕了？

source: Ophelia—if it should come to the worst of this matter, and Rosie and Guilda are captured...
target: 奥菲莉娅——要是事情落到最坏的地步，萝茜和吉尔达被抓住了……

source: ...I've every intent of leaving them to Grace's sword.
target: ……我打定主意，要把她们留给格蕾丝的剑。

source: You'd... let them die?
target: 你会……任由她们死掉？

source: ...Something happened. I don't want to discuss it. Not yet.
target: ……发生了一些事。我不想谈。至少现在不想。

source: They're loyal to my uncle. He fills their pockets with coin, and they've spied on me in return.
target: 她们效忠的是我叔叔。他把她们的口袋塞满金币，她们就替他监视我。

source: In some ways, I'm merely their source of income. Whatever friendship we once had... it's... changed.
target: 从某种意义上说，我只是她们的收入来源。不管我们曾经有过什么交情……都……变了。

source: I should have realized they'd only look after themselves, and each other. It's always been that way, deep down.
target: 我早该看出来，她们只会顾自己，还有彼此。说到底，一直都是这样。

source: You and I are the only ones who matter in this horrible, ugly world. And I'd sooner you live than I.
target: 在这个可怕又丑陋的世界里，只有你我值得在乎。而我宁愿活下来的是你，不是我。

source: ...Hamlet, I think your priorities may be misplaced, if keeping me alive is your goal.
target: ……哈姆雷特，如果你的目标是让我活着，我觉得你可能弄错了轻重。

source: What? Why wouldn't it be?
target: 什么？这怎么会不是我的目标？

source: Never mind it. Let's put this plan to action and see what happens.
target: 算了。我们照计划行动，看看会怎么样吧。

source: After they lied to me, nearly costing me my life...
target: 她们骗了我，差点要了我的命……

source: You think me a fool?
target: 你当我是傻子？

source: Not quite. You see, there's someone else who wanted Hamlet dead.
target: 不完全是。你看，想要哈姆雷特死的另有其人。

source: The King!
target: 是国王！

source: Oh, I know all about it, loves.
target: 哦，亲爱的，这事我全都知道。

source: I don' have much in th'way of integrity, but I do have a code o' sorts.
target: 我没多少操守，但我确实有自己的规矩。

source: An' that code stipulates that friends don't betray friends.
target: 其中一条就是，朋友不能背叛朋友。

source: That letter you bore... I canna' allow you to pollute any shore ever again.
target: 你们带来的那封信……我不能再让你们去祸害任何一片海岸。

source: ... I should have known it would come to this.
target: ……我早该知道会走到这一步。

source: And to think I thought it might go better this time.
target: 亏我还以为这次可能会好一点。

source: Now. You.
target: 现在。轮到你。

source: Do I have to worry about you overthrowing me, too?
target: 我是不是还得担心你也来推翻我？

source: Even if I wanted to, I've no means to do so.
target: 就算我想，我也没那个本事。

source: I'll be returned to the past soon regardless. This fate means little to me.
target: 反正我很快就会被送回过去。这样的命运对我没多大意义。

source: Hmph. Sounds like a lot of poetic nothing.
target: 哼。听起来就是一堆好听的空话。

source: All of you have lied to me, nearly costing me my life...
target: 你们所有人都骗了我，差点要了我的命……

source: ...For the dog who would throw his companions to the depths, I've a special punishment.
target: ……对那种要把同伴扔进深海的狗东西，我有特别的惩罚。

source: Y-you mean—Hamlet—was going to have us killed?
target: 你、你是说——哈姆雷特——打算让我们被杀？

source: Why would he do that? What did we do to wrong him?
target: 他为什么要这么做？我们做了什么对不起他的事？

source: He uncovered the truth of the letter from the King you two bore.
target: 他发现了你们俩带来的那封国王的信的真相。

source: It asked for his execution.
target: 信里要求处死他。

source: What? Truly?
target: 什么？真的？

source: But I didn't know that! The letter was sealed, after all...
target: 可我不知道啊！那封信毕竟是封着的……

source: Hamlet. Let him go.
target: 哈姆雷特。放了他。

source: Heh heh heh. You must think me a fool. You'd run ashore an' keep runnin' until you were clear of me!
target: 呵呵呵。你们一定当我是傻子。你们会上岸逃跑，一直跑到甩掉我为止！

source: ... Not quite. However haphazard the circumstances may have been, Hamlet's uncle will be glad to have him dead.
target: ……不完全是。无论过程多么意外，哈姆雷特的叔叔都会很高兴他死了。

source: H-he was ready to kill us. He'd gone completely mad.
target: 他、他都准备杀了我们了。他已经彻底疯了。

source: So the reward won't come from us, but rather, from King Claudius.
target: 所以赏金不是由我们来付，而是由克劳狄斯国王来付。

source: Sounds like a lopsided trade to me.
target: 在我听来，这买卖可不公平。

source: Hamlet. Stand down. Please.
target: 哈姆雷特。收手吧。求你了。

source: ...Apologies, Ophelia.
target: ……抱歉，奥菲莉娅。

source: I'll kill you too. Gladly.
target: 我连你也会杀。而且很乐意。

source: I can out-fight yeh with one arm, boy.
target: 小子，我一只手就能打赢你。

source: Is that a bet you're willing to take?
target: 你愿意赌一把吗？

source: ...Yer more than you seem.
target: ……你比看上去厉害。

source: But not more than I.
target: 可还没我厉害。

source: (Damn it...)
Seems we've both got collateral to make a trade, Prince Hamlet.
target: 看来我们双方手里都有做交易的筹码，哈姆雷特王子。

source: Release my lieutenant, an' I won't kill yer friends. Or you.
target: 放了我的副手，我就不杀你的朋友。也不杀你。

source: Then we can proceed to Ireland in peace, with you in the hold.
target: 然后我们就能太太平平地继续驶向爱尔兰，你就待在底舱里。

source: ...Now's your chance, Lady Grace.
target: ……现在就是机会，格蕾丝女士。

source: He won't come easily.
target: 他不会乖乖就范的。

source: W...what? What's going on?
target: 什……什么？怎么回事？

source: We were alerted to your plan, Hamlet. You uncouth, lackless, friendless fool.
target: 有人告诉了我们你的计划，哈姆雷特。你这个粗鲁、贪得无厌、连朋友都没有的蠢货。

source: Yer ladies here have struck a bargain. They've offered me gold for yer head.
target: 你身边这两位女士已经跟我谈妥了。她们出金币，要买你的人头。

source: A-ah... no...
Now, ladies. As to the matter of yer payment.
