target: 好了，女士们。来谈谈你们该付的钱。

source: I...It'll be arranged upon arrival at Denmark.
target: 到……到了丹麦，就会安排的。

source: ...Well, well. Time for the masks t'come off.
target: ……哎呀呀。该摘下面具了。

source: Well played, everyone.
target: 各位，演得不错。

source: Ophelia told all of us about your plans.
target: 奥菲莉娅把你的计划告诉了我们所有人。

source: Women talk, you know!
target: 女人之间也会聊天的，你知道吧！

source: Why? Why would you tell them?
target: 为什么？你为什么要告诉她们？

source: Yes, what on earth is happening?
target: 是啊，这到底是怎么回事？

source: Heard about yer little plan to overthrow me, Princey.
target: 听说你打算推翻我啊，小王子。

source: Luckily, yer lass Ophelia here tipped me off ahead o' time.
target: 幸好，你的奥菲莉娅姑娘提前给我报了信。

source: A mutiny?
target: 叛乱？

source: Ergh. Why would you betray my confidence, Ophelia?
target: 呃。你为什么要辜负我的信任，奥菲莉娅？

source: You plotting bitch. Canna' believe I fell for it.
target: 你这满肚子算计的婊子。真不敢相信我竟然上了当。

source: I have to keep my friends alive first.
target: 我得先保住朋友们的命。

source: And if I refuse to give in?
target: 要是我不肯屈服呢？

source: ...Ophelia. Is 'e always like this?
target: ……奥菲莉娅。他一直都这样吗？

source: Release myself and Lady Ophelia in a longboat close to Danish shores. You can keep the ship and all within it.
target: 在靠近丹麦海岸的地方，让我和奥菲莉娅女士乘长艇离开。这条船和船上的一切都归你。

source: For no further cost, you can have a new vessel. You're a sharp woman. You see the value in such a trade, don't you?
target: 不用再花任何代价，你就能多得一条船。你是个精明的女人。你看得出这笔交易的价值，不是吗？

source: We're no good to you as a ransom. A mad prince set for slaughter—who would pay for me?
target: 留着我们换赎金，对你没什么用。一个等着被宰的疯王子——谁会花钱赎我？

source: Now yer speakin' a common tongue.
target: 这下咱们算是说到一块儿了。

source: Very well, Prince Hamlet. You've proved your mettle.
target: 好吧，哈姆雷特王子。你已经证明了自己的胆识。

source: I'll return you an' your lady-love to Denmark.
target: 我会送你和你的心上人回丹麦。

source: Mercy is a gift I don't often grant.
target: 仁慈这份礼物，我可不常给。

source: Yeh are well and truly mad.
target: 你真是彻头彻尾地疯了。

source: So they say.
target: 他们都这么说。

source: This is why I hate yeh all, the courtly, crowned lot. All yeh do is murder one another.
target: 这就是我讨厌你们这些宫廷贵族、戴王冠的家伙的原因。你们只会互相残杀。

source: Yeh speak so prettily. And it all amounts to nothin'.
target: 你们话说得那么好听。到头来却全是空话。

source: One day yer family, the next yer at each other's throats. Out here on the sea, I trust my crew more'n any one of you.
target: 今天还是一家人，明天就斗得不可开交。在这片海上，我信我的船员，胜过信你们中的任何一个。

source: I'd kill yeh all outright, but seein' as Ophelia here saw fit t'warn me in advance...
target: 我本想直接把你们全杀了，不过看在奥菲莉娅肯提前提醒我的份上……

source: I'll be takin' this ship as my prize, an' I'll leave yeh on Danish shores.
target: 这条船就当我的战利品了，我会把你们留在丹麦岸上。

source: An' clean up this blood in the meantime, too. Stains the wood.
target: 这期间也把血擦干净。会在木头上留下污渍。

source: ...That letter. The one my uncle gave you.
target: ……那封信。我叔叔交给你们的那封。

source: Inside, I found a warrant for my own death—orders for me to be executed upon arrival in England.
target: 我在里面发现了要我命的处决令——命令我一到英格兰就被处死。

source: I trusted you both.
target: 我曾经信任你们两个。

source: We didn't know about the contents of the letter. I swear to you, Hamlet.
target: 我们不知道信里写了什么。我向你发誓，哈姆雷特。

source: If we thought we were delivering something like that...
target: 如果我们知道自己送的是那种东西……

source: Certainly, there are far less convoluted ways to murder someone.
target: 当然，要杀一个人，有的是远比这简单的办法。

source: My thoughts exactly! Like pushing Hamlet overboard and making it look like an accident!
target: 我也是这么想的！比如把哈姆雷特推下船，伪装成意外！

source: Or staging an attack on the ship!
target: 或者安排一场对这条船的袭击！

source: Or poisoning his dinner...
target: 或者在他的晚餐里下毒……

source: What about strangling him in his sleep?
target: 趁他睡觉时掐死他怎么样？

source: Are you idiots done?
target: 你们这两个蠢货说完了没有？

source: Oh, I suppose. Just sort of lost in thought, there. Where were we?
target: 哦，应该说完了。刚才只是有点想入神了。我们说到哪儿了？

source: Despite promising Ophelia I wouldn't hurt you lot, I find myself reconsiderin'.
target: 虽然我答应过奥菲莉娅不伤害你们，可现在我想改主意了。

source: Maybe I'll just take a coupla hands off.
target: 也许我就砍掉两只手吧。

source: Grace. Please don't.
target: 格蕾丝。请别这样。

source: Wot? Still aching for his sword?
target: 怎么？还馋着他那把剑？

source: You can't harm him. He's important to me, and to his country.
target: 你不能伤害他。他对我很重要，对他的国家也是。

source: Not even a little slice? What about a thumb? Surely he can get by with just one thumb up his arse.
target: 连割一小块都不行？那砍根拇指呢？他闲着没事，把拇指往屁股里塞，留一根也够用了吧。

source: Not even a thumb.
target: 一根拇指也不行。

source: I resent that statement.
target: 你这话让我很不快。

source: I didn't ask yeh, Royal Pain.
target: 我没问你，王室烦人精。

source: It appears my three companions have their own stones to cast at one another.
target: 看来我的三位同伴各自都有理由指责对方。

source: Uh, yes! What she said!
target: 呃，没错！她说得对！

source: We apologize so very humbly for this inconvenient disturbance, your pirate ladyship.
target: 尊贵的海盗女士，这场骚乱给您添了麻烦，我们万分谦卑地向您道歉。

source: Additionally, please don't kill us.
target: 另外，求您别杀我们。

source: Yer lucky to owe yer life to this woman, Prince.
target: 王子，你能靠这位姑娘保住命，真是走运。

source: She's at least got a drop of integrity. The rest of yeh, not so much.
target: 她至少还有那么一点操守。你们其余几个，可就没多少了。

source: I'll return you all to Denmark.
target: 我会送你们所有人回丹麦。

source: Mercy is a gift I don't often grant. Yer all fortunate today.
target: 仁慈这份礼物，我可不常给。你们今天都很走运。

source: Mercy means returning to Elsinore? Certainly doesn't feel that way.
target: 仁慈就是送我们回埃尔西诺？可我一点也感觉不到。

source: Back we go, then.
target: 那我们就回去吧。

source: We've arrived. This ship and all her wares are mine now. On yer way, now!
target: 到了。这条船和船上所有货物现在都归我了。赶紧走吧！

source: So it's true. I'd heard you returned.
target: 原来是真的。我听说你回来了。

source: And so has Hamlet, looking the picture of health.
target: 哈姆雷特也回来了，看着还十分健康。

source: I put my faith in you. I won't make a mistake like that again.
target: 我曾信任你。我不会再犯这样的错了。

source: And my idiot nephew is 'handled' at last. I'm impressed; you've done exactly what I needed of you.
target: 我那个蠢侄子终于被“处理”了。真让我刮目相看，你把我需要你做的事办得分毫不差。

source: It appears you are quite a whit more cunning than you seem.
target: 看来你比表面上狡黠得多。

source: You have my thanks, and my gratitude.
target: 我要向你道谢，也向你表达我的感激。

source: You're as clever as you are beautiful.
target: 你的聪慧与你的美貌不相上下。

source: I aim to please.
target: 我就是想让您满意。

source: My sweet. The time has come. Are you prepared to announce our news?
target: 亲爱的。时候到了。你准备好宣布我们的消息了吗？

source: This is all happening so fast.
target: 这一切来得太快了。

source: These things tend to.
target: 这种事往往如此。

source: I shall announce some news without further ado.
target: 我就不多作耽搁了，要宣布一个消息。

source: Lady Ophelia and I are to be betrothed. Today.
target: 我将与奥菲莉娅女士订婚。就在今天。

source: A-ah... why hadn't I heard of this?
target: 啊、啊……我怎么没听说这件事？

source: Never mind it... yes, never mind it.
target: 算了……是啊，算了。

source: My lord, are you sure you don't want to wait for the castle chaplain to return from his countryside tour?
target: 陛下，您确定不等城堡牧师从乡间巡访回来吗？

source: Absolutely certain, Bernardo. We shan't wait another minute.
target: 十分确定，贝尔纳多。我们一分钟也不再等了。

source: A-and—Lady Ophelia—this is your desire as well? This union?
target: 还、还有——奥菲莉娅女士——这也是您的心愿吗？这桩婚事？

source: It is rather, er, surprising, given the circumstances.
target: 考虑到眼下的情况，这实在，呃，有些令人意外。

source: I know it's sudden, Bernardo. But it's what I want. Truly.
target: 我知道这很突然，贝尔纳多。但这是我想要的。真的。

source: Let us all bear witness to the betrothal of His Majesty Claudius of Denmark, and Lady Ophelia, daughter of Duke Polonius.
target: 让我们一同见证丹麦国王克劳狄斯陛下与波洛涅斯公爵之女奥菲莉娅女士的订婚。

source: As Bernardo is elsewhere, I'd like to request that Voltemand here do the honors.
target: 贝尔纳多不在这里，我想请在场的伏尔提曼德来主持仪式。

source: He may not look like a man of the cloth, but I assure you his stature is legitimate.
target: 他看起来或许不像神职人员，但我向你保证，他的身份是合法的。

source: Aye, my lord.
target: 是，陛下。

source: None from me!
target: 我没有异议！

source: Or me. Or anyone, if they know what's good for 'em!
target: 我也没有。谁都不会有，只要他们识相！

source: My whole heart, for my whole life. This, I promise you.
target: 我的整颗心，一生都属于你。这是我对你的承诺。

source: ...And I you.
target: ……我对你也一样。

source: (...Of course, knowing everything I know about Claudius—what he's done—what's been done to him—)
target: （……当然，我知道克劳狄斯的种种事情——他做过什么——别人对他做过什么——）

source: (Is this right? Is this something I could ever want?)
target: （这样对吗？这会是我想要的吗？）

source: (Or is this merely an exploration of all possible worlds? An attempt to sate some sick curiosity?)
target: （还是说，我只是在探索所有可能的世界？试图满足某种病态的好奇心？）

source: (I cannot know for certain.)
target: （我无法确定。）

source: (Even knowing everything I know about Claudius... I stand here, again.)
target: （即使知道克劳狄斯的种种事情……我还是又一次站在了这里。）

source: (The Book of Fates will make this reality, if I really want it...)
target: （如果我真的想要，《命运之书》就会让这一切成为现实……）

source: My lord, I beg you now to turn your attention to the war front. We've received news that Norwegian soldiers are on their way.
target: 陛下，恳请您现在关注前线战事。我们收到消息，挪威士兵正在赶来。

source: If we act now, we can secure the castle and repel them.
target: 如果现在行动，我们就能守住城堡，击退他们。

source: Yes, to arms, to arms! Barricade the gates. We've not a moment to spare or a life to lose.
target: 好，拿起武器，拿起武器！封住城门。我们一刻也不能耽误，一条性命也不能损失。

source: After all, there's to be a wedding in several weeks' time!
target: 毕竟，再过几周就要举行婚礼了！

source: Shall we plan a grand celebration?
target: 我们筹办一场盛大的庆典，好吗？

source: (...No. I can already feel myself slipping away.)
target: （……不。我已经能感觉到自己正在逐渐离开。）

source: (But I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever, and to become Queen. Just like Simona before me.)
target: （但我可以用《命运之书》永远保留这个世界，成为王后。就像在我之前的西蒙娜一样。）

source: As my family and friends trickle from the chapel, I feel a familiar yanking sensation...
target: 家人和朋友陆续离开礼拜堂时，我感到一股熟悉的拉扯感……

source: (No, there won't be. At least, not yet.)
target: （不，不会有婚礼。至少现在还不会。）

source: (I must first uncover what keeps me here.)
target: （我必须先查清，是什么把我困在这里。）

source: My King, where is Prince Hamlet?
target: 陛下，哈姆雷特王子在哪里？

source: I witnessed his ship's return, but haven't heard or seen him anywhere.
target: 我亲眼看见他的船回来了，可到处都没见到他，也没听到他的消息。

source: ...Now, I suppose, is a timely moment. Everyone, I have somber news.
target: ……我想，现在正是时候。各位，我有一个沉痛的消息。

source: Is... it about Hamlet?
target: 是……关于哈姆雷特的吗？

source: The Prince is dead.
target: 王子死了。

source: He met his end at sea. I've been informed by the remaining crew.
target: 他死在了海上。剩下的船员向我报告了这件事。

source: He went mad once he could no longer see land. He slew the ship's captain, as well as his dearest friends, Ladies Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.
target: 一看不见陆地，他就发了疯。他杀了船长，还有他最亲密的朋友，罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士。

source: It is only by the good Lord's grace that he was subdued by the remaining crew.
target: 全靠仁慈的主施恩，剩下的船员才将他制服。

source: N...no... is it... can it be true? It can't, can it...?
target: 不……不……这……这会是真的吗？不会的，对不对……？

source: We should mourn Hamlet, and mourn what he became, but know his soul sleeps peacefully now in God's tender arms.
target: 我们应当哀悼哈姆雷特，也为他后来变成的样子悲伤，但要知道，他的灵魂如今已在上帝温柔的怀抱中安睡。

source: T-this... no...
A life for a life. Ophelia, our father's death is revenged.
target: 一命偿一命。奥菲莉娅，父亲的仇报了。

source: Ophelia... how did it happen? How did he... die?
target: 奥菲莉娅……究竟发生了什么？他是怎么……死的？

source: Apologies, my lady. It... all happened so quickly, I cannot recall the details.
target: 抱歉，王后。那……一切发生得太快，我记不清细节了。

source: He was broken, but he didn't deserve to die.
target: 他是崩溃了，可他不该死。

source: Hamlet, Hamlet...
target: 哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特……

source: Is it really true you didn't witness Hamlet's death?
target: 你真的没有亲眼看到哈姆雷特死去吗？

source: I see. You don't have to say anything.
target: 我明白了。你什么都不用说。

source: But, thank you. Thank you for father. For me. You did what was right.
target: 不过，谢谢你。替父亲谢谢你。也替我自己。你做得对。

source: The King has requested your presence in his private chambers.
target: 国王请您去他的私人寝室。

source: I am to indicate that this... is not a request you can deny.
target: 我奉命告知您，这……不是您可以拒绝的请求。

source: I wonder what he wants. Perhaps I've said something amiss.
target: 不知道他找我有什么事。也许我说错了什么话。

source: He's going to kill me, Bernardo.
target: 他会杀了我的，贝尔纳多。

source: Please don't take me there.
target: 求你别带我去那里。

source: I would never let that happen, Ophelia.
target: 我绝不会让那种事发生，奥菲莉娅。

source: Besides, I cannot refuse the King's request either. I am at his command, too.
target: 再说，我也不能拒绝国王的要求。我也得听从他的命令。

source: If anything odd happens, we'll leave. You have my word.
target: 只要有任何不对劲，我们就离开。我向你保证。

source: Wonderful. You've come.
target: 很好。你来了。

source: Firstly: Thank you for coming right to me to dispel such an insidious rumor.
target: 首先，谢谢你直接来找我，澄清如此阴险的传闻。

source: Firstly: Thank you for bringing to my attention such an insidious rumor.
target: 首先，谢谢你让我知道了如此阴险的传闻。

source: I would naturally have preferred you come to me instead of troubling my wife, but it can't be helped.
target: 我当然更希望你来找我，而不是去烦扰我的妻子，不过事已至此，也没办法了。

source: I hear you have recently learned of an insidious rumor. It was good of you to investigate it.
target: 我听说你最近得知了一个阴险的传闻。你肯去调查，很好。

source: I would have preferred you come to me instead of spreading the lie, but it can't be helped.
target: 我更希望你来找我，而不是散播那个谎言，不过事已至此，也没办法了。

source: Your behavior befits a woman of your standing. And it is appreciated.
target: 你的举止很符合你这样的女士的身份。我也很感激。

source: Now leave us, Bernardo.
target: 现在退下吧，贝尔纳多。

source: My lord, I don't think that's wise.
target: 陛下，我认为这样不妥。

source: Did I ask you to speak? No. Go.
target: 我让你说话了吗？没有。出去。

source: I won't. I can't.
target: 我不会走。我不能走。

source: Do you want everyone to know the truth about you?
target: 你想让所有人都知道你的真相吗？

source: Ophelia already knows who I am. All of me. And she taught me that I've nothing to hide.
target: 奥菲莉娅已经知道我是谁。知道我的一切。而且她让我明白，我没有什么需要隐瞒的。

source: So I'll be taking her and leaving, now.
target: 所以，现在我要带她离开。

source: This is treason!
target: 这是叛国！

source: I'm not so certain others would see it that way.
target: 别人未必会这么看吧。

source: The Lord knows what is in your heart. And Ophelia and I both do, too. If you act against us, we'll tell the others.
target: 主知道你心里藏着什么。奥菲莉娅和我也都知道。如果你对我们动手，我们就会告诉其他人。

source: Let's go, Ophelia.
target: 走吧，奥菲莉娅。

source: He was going to kill me, wasn't he?
target: 他刚才是要杀了我，对吗？

source: He may still very well try.
target: 他很可能还会动手。

source: Please be careful. I'll have my men keep a close watch on your chamber.
target: 请小心。我会让手下严密看守你的房间。

source: You put your life on the line for me. I'll never forget that.
target: 你为我冒了生命危险。我永远不会忘记。

source: I already know.
target: 我已经知道了。

source: I know about you, Katherine. I know, too, that Claudius has been trying to keep you living in fear.
target: 我知道你的事，凯瑟琳。我也知道，克劳狄斯一直想让你活在恐惧里。

source: But I want you to know that I stand by you, no matter what.
target: 但我想让你知道，不管怎样，我都会支持你。

source: And what Claudius tells you... that others would hate you... that's a lie.
target: 还有克劳狄斯对你说的……说别人会恨你……那是谎话。

source: I promise you.
target: 我向你保证。

source: So please. Don't abandon me to him. He'll kill me. And you know that now, don't you?
target: 所以，求你了。别把我丢下，留给他。他会杀了我的。你现在也知道了，对不对？

source: I am not certain how you know this.
target: 我不知道你是怎么知道这件事的。

source: But Claudius, I'll be taking her and leaving, now.
target: 但克劳狄斯，我现在要带她离开。

source: I am not so certain others would see it that way.
target: 别人未必会这么看吧。

source: I don't... know how you found out about me. But please... don't tell anyone.
target: 我不……知道你是怎么发现我的事的。但求你……别告诉任何人。

source: For now, that's a part of me I'm not ready to discuss with others.
target: 关于我的这一面，我暂时还没准备好和别人谈。

source: Of course. I understand.
target: 当然。我理解。

source: I'm sorry, Ophelia.
target: 对不起，奥菲莉娅。

source: I'll leave you two alone.
target: 我让你们两位单独谈。

source: Unfortunately for you, it's no rumor.
target: 可惜，对你来说不幸的是，那不是传闻。

source: It's true. I murdered my brother. I poured poison into his ear as he slept. How you learned it is no concern of mine.
target: 那是真的。我谋杀了我的哥哥。趁他熟睡时，我把毒药倒进了他的耳朵。你是怎么知道的，我不在乎。

source: Everyone thinks him a hero. But I know the truth. I know what he really was: a monster, like my father before him. And... like me.
target: 所有人都把他当成英雄。但我知道真相。我知道他究竟是什么：一个怪物，和先前的父亲一样。也……和我一样。

source: All we beget is monsters, this family. All we know how to do is hurt. An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
target: 我们这个家族，生出来的全是怪物。我们只会伤害别人。以眼还眼，以牙还牙。

source: But now I am the last monster alive.
target: 但现在，我是最后一个还活着的怪物。

source: You need to come clean—tell the rest of the castle.
target: 你必须坦白——告诉城堡里的其他人。

source: At the very least, Hamlet and the Queen... they deserve to know, don't they?
target: 至少，哈姆雷特和王后……他们有权知道，不是吗？

source: You poor idiot girl.
target: 你这个可怜的傻姑娘。

source: That won't be happening.
target: 那是不可能的。

source: It'll be rather a nuisance to have you disposed of. But one I must suffer nonetheless.
target: 派人除掉你会很麻烦。但这麻烦，我也只能忍了。

source: Now die.
target: 现在，去死吧。

source: A pawn in someone's larger schemes.
target: 某人更大阴谋中的一枚棋子。

source: Ophelia was telling me of a strange nightmare she had. It reminded me to ask you of your own dreams.
target: 奥菲莉娅跟我说起了她做的一个奇怪的噩梦。这让我想起，该问问你做的梦。

source: Biene... it's clear something has been weighing heavily on you. You've visited me more and more as of late.
target: 姑娘……你显然有很重的心事。最近你来看我的次数越来越多了。

source: I... I need to hide away, just for a bit. Do you mind if I just stay a while as you clean up?
target: 我……我想躲一会儿，就一小会儿。你收拾的时候，我在这里待一会儿，可以吗？

source: Of course not. I'm always glad to see you.
target: 当然可以。见到你，我总是很高兴。

source: Though I must ask, Biene, why you do not go to your husband in times like these?
target: 不过我得问问，姑娘，这种时候你为什么不去找你的丈夫？

source: Well, there's... something I wanted to speak to you about. I couldn't tell him.
target: 嗯，有……一件事我想跟你说。我没法告诉他。

source: It's about Hamlet. My husband, I mean. Well—former—husband, that is.
target: 是关于哈姆雷特的。我是说，我的丈夫。嗯——以前的——丈夫。

source: Irma, do you... believe in the power that dreams hold?
target: 伊尔玛，你……相信梦有某种力量吗？

source: Aye, my lady. I believe the Lord sends us visions through dreams, to inspire us to follow His word in our waking hours.
target: 相信，王后。我相信主通过梦赐予我们异象，引导我们在清醒时遵循他的话语。

source: Are you ever... afraid of them?
target: 你会不会……害怕那些梦？

source: Sometimes. But I believe we grow stronger through the Lord in confronting them. Why do you ask?
target: 有时候会。但我相信，面对它们时，主会让我们变得更坚强。你为什么这么问？

source: Ophelia said something to me about a nightmare she had, and...
target: 奥菲莉娅跟我提起了她做的一个噩梦，然后……

source: I keep having this... dream. That my husband Hamlet is trapped somewhere, calling to me...
target: 我一直在做这个……梦。梦里，我的丈夫哈姆雷特被困在某个地方，呼唤着我……

source: As though he's somewhere underneath me, under the floor. And I run through the castle, trying to find him, but his voice keeps echoing from below...
target: 仿佛他就在我脚下的某个地方，在地板下面。我在城堡里四处奔跑，想找到他，可他的声音一直从下面传来，回荡着……

source: T-then I realize, I need to go under the floor. As long as I'm running above him, I can't reach him. And he's in pain. He's screaming now.
target: 然、然后我意识到，我得去地板下面。只要还在他上面跑，我就到不了他身边。他很痛苦。现在他开始尖叫了。

source: Crying, begging me to help him.
target: 哭着，求我帮他。

source: So I... start to dig... with my fingernails on the stone...
target: 所以我……开始挖……用指甲挖那些石头……

source: No, you must listen—
target: 不，你一定要听我说——

source: A-and my fingers are bleeding, the nails torn right off, but I c-can't stop myself—I have to help him—
target: 而、而且我的手指在流血，指甲都被掀掉了，可我停、停不下来——我必须帮他——

source: Then I finally reach the layer of dirt under the cobblestones, and I pull the first stone away from the earth.
target: 然后，我终于挖到了石块下面的土层，把第一块石头从土里拔了出来。

source: And I see his face. He's dead. I see the deathly white skin, shrunken and stretched horribly over his skull, like a grimace—
target: 我看见了他的脸。他死了。我看见那死白的皮肤，干瘪收缩，可怕地紧绷在他的头骨上，像是在龇牙咧嘴——

source: My lady! Stop—
target: 王后！别说了——

source: No! Irma, I can't stop seeing him! Every time I close my eyes—
target: 不！伊尔玛，我总是看见他！每次闭上眼睛——

source: I loved him so much, so damned much, I just—
target: 我那么爱他，爱得要命，我只是——

source: Why did he have to die and not take me with him, Irma?
target: 伊尔玛，为什么他非得死，却不把我一起带走？

source: Why didn't God kill me, too?
target: 为什么上帝没有把我也杀了？

source: Why must I live through this hell? Why can't I go with him?
target: 为什么我必须活着受这地狱般的煎熬？为什么我不能跟他一起走？

source: I t-think the dream is his way of telling me...
target: 我觉、觉得，他是在用这个梦告诉我……

source: That he's unhappy, and suffering, even in death...
target: 即使死了，他也不快乐，也在受苦……

source: Oh, Gerta...
target: 哦，格尔塔……

source: Come here. Let me dry your eyes, love.
target: 过来，亲爱的。让我替你擦干眼泪。

source: I loved him, Irma.
target: 我爱他，伊尔玛。

source: And I love Claudius. I do. But not like him. It's not the same.
target: 我也爱克劳狄斯。真的。但不像爱他那样。那不一样。

source: It all happened so quickly, Biene. The death, the funeral, and the wedding. It was over so soon.
target: 一切都发生得太快了，姑娘。他的死、葬礼，还有婚礼。那么快就都结束了。

source: I just wish... I could have known... if he wanted me to be happy. If only there was that...
target: 我只希望……能知道……他是不是希望我幸福。哪怕只知道这一点……

source: Gerta, we can never know for certain. But you knew his heart.
target: 格尔塔，我们永远无法确定。但你了解他的心。

source: I can't...
target: 我做不到……

source: Shh. There, there.
target: 嘘。好了，好了。

source: It will pass. The grief will pass. I have lost half a dozen loves in my lifetime, and this I know for certain. But you must give it time.
target: 会过去的。悲伤会过去的。我这一生失去过六位爱人，所以这一点我很确定。但你得给它一些时间。

source: I... I think I can go now.
target: 我……我想我现在可以走了。

source: Of course, Biene. After all, you have a kingdom to run.
target: 当然，姑娘。毕竟，你还有一个王国要治理。

source: My strong, brave, beautiful girl.
target: 我坚强、勇敢、美丽的姑娘。

source: My thanks, Irma.
target: 谢谢你，伊尔玛。

source: (Where is it? It must be here.)
target: （在哪里？一定在这里。）

source: (Perhaps inside his desk?)
target: （也许在他的书桌里？）

source: (No, it isn't here either...)
target: （不，这里也没有……）

source: I'm certain he took it.
target: 我确定是他拿走了。

source: But why?
target: 可为什么呢？

source: I wonder what she's looking for.
target: 不知道她在找什么。

source: I hope she finds that amulet.
target: 希望她能找到那枚护身符。

source: Quince, is it? Well met. I've heard a lot about your work.
target: 是奎因斯吧？幸会。你的作品，我听说过不少。

source: And I about yours, my good man! Hee hee...
target: 我也听说过不少你的事迹，好先生！嘻嘻……

source: Although I've already made an arrest, I still felt it important to speak to you.
target: 虽然我已经逮捕了一个人，但我还是觉得有必要和你谈谈。

source: I'm certain you're wondering about why you were summoned here.
target: 你一定在想，为什么被召到这里来。

source: Oh, not at all, not at all. My people find it quite ordinary to be under suspicion, in fact.
target: 哦，一点也不，一点也不。事实上，我的同胞们觉得，被人怀疑是很平常的事。

source: Perhaps you even think me to be one of those spies the King is so concerned about.
target: 也许你甚至觉得，我就是国王那么担忧的那些间谍之一。

source: What brings you down here this morning?
target: 今天早上你来这里有什么事？

source: Ophelia told me I ought to speak to you! You see, I'm aware you have a certain enemy within the castle.
target: 奥菲莉娅说我应该来找你谈谈！是这样的，我知道城堡里有个与你为敌的人。

source: A little spy problem, perhaps. You're going to speak to the court about it this morning, aren't you?
target: 也许是出了点间谍方面的小问题。你今天早上要向宫廷众人谈起这件事，对吧？

source: How could you—h-how—
target: 你怎么会——怎、怎么——

source: Perhaps you are thinking to yourself, even now, that I could be such an enemy.
target: 也许此刻你就在想，我可能就是那个敌人。

source: And if I do? What have you to say?
target: 如果我真这么想呢？你有什么话说？

source: Then I'd tell you, my good man, that the health of Denmark is foremost in my thoughts.
target: 那我会告诉你，好先生，丹麦的安危在我心里是第一位的。

source: In fact, I've concocted a lovely plan to out the real spy, if you're so inclined.
target: 事实上，我已经想出了一个揭露真正间谍的妙计，就看你愿不愿意了。

source: A plan, eh?
target: 一个计策，是吗？

source: You see, my performances can rouse certain... strong feelings in all who attend.
target: 你看，我的演出能让所有到场的人产生某些……强烈的感受。

source: Were I to, say, put on a performance that highlighted this spy...
target: 比如说，如果我上演一出戏，把这个间谍的事突出展现出来……

source: Any cloak-and-dagger type without a heart of steel would quickly turn heel, I think!
target: 我想，任何暗中搞阴谋的人，只要没有钢铁般的心肠，都会立刻转身逃走！

source: I've heard word of your performances having such an effect.
target: 我听说过，你的演出确实有这样的效果。

source: If it becomes necessary, I'll call upon you to do so.
target: 如果有必要，我会请你这么做。

source: In the meantime, you are free to go. I believe your plea of innocence.
target: 现在，你可以走了。我相信你是无辜的。

source: Hmph. What is the meaning of calling me here?
target: 哼。把我叫来这里是什么意思？

source: I've a kitchen to run and only these two arms to feed a castle.
target: 我还得管厨房，靠这两条胳膊给整座城堡的人做饭。

source: I'll be swift. I know you're a busy woman.
target: 我会尽快说完。我知道你很忙。

source: Ophelia recommended I speak with you. I understand there's reason to believe you may have exhibited—or witnessed—suspicious behavior as of late.
target: 奥菲莉娅建议我找你谈谈。据我了解，有理由怀疑你最近可能有过——或目睹过——可疑行为。

source: What have you to say on this subject?
target: 对此，你有什么要说的？

source: Is this about that 'spy' rumor? I am innocent! I am good! I never leave the castle—
target: 是为了那个“间谍”的传闻吗？我是清白的！我是好人！我从不离开城堡——

source: Yes, that's it. I haven't left Elsinore in weeks!
target: 对，就是这样。我已经好几个星期没离开埃尔西诺了！

source: And what of any letters you might be passing? Notes of a sort?
target: 那你有没有传递什么信件？或是字条之类的？

source: Do my men have your willing permission to search your room for such letters?
target: 你是否自愿同意我的手下搜查你的房间，寻找这类信件？

source: Search away! I cannot read or write. Do I look like a learned woman to you?
target: 尽管搜！我既不识字，也不会写字。你看我像是个有学问的女人吗？

source: Ah... interesting. So you have no means of communication.
target: 啊……有意思。也就是说，你没法通信。

source: Think upon it, Bernardo. Who wishes to see the King and my lady brought to their knees?
target: 想想吧，贝尔纳多。谁巴不得看见国王和我的女主人屈膝求饶？

source: Who hates them more than anything? Who crows his displeasure with them day and night, as far and as wide as he possibly can?
target: 谁最恨他们？谁日夜叫嚷着对他们的不满，恨不得让所有人都听见？

source: ...You're implying Hamlet is the spy?
target: ……你是说，哈姆雷特就是间谍？

source: Of course! That boy is dangerous and unpredictable. It is him you ought to interrogate.
target: 当然！那小子既危险又难以捉摸。你该审问的是他。

source: That's all for now, Irma. You may go.
target: 暂时就问到这里，伊尔玛。你可以走了。

source: Hrmf. A waste of my day and my words...
target: 哼。浪费我的时间，还让我白费口舌……

source: Irma. How can I assist?
target: 伊尔玛。有什么需要我帮忙的？

source: Lady Ophelia told me to come down here and speak with you! What is it you desire?
target: 奥菲莉娅小姐让我下来找你谈谈！你到底有什么事？

source: Apologies. Lady Ophelia must have been mistaken. I've no need to speak with you.
target: 抱歉。奥菲莉娅小姐一定是弄错了。我没有什么事要找你谈。

source: (Ah, right, the morning meeting hasn't occurred yet... He hasn't delivered news about the spy. I'm too soon.)
target: （啊，对，早会还没开始……他还没宣布间谍的消息。我来得太早了。）

source: Now, Lord Hamlet... I'm certain this is just a formality.
target: 那么，哈姆雷特殿下……我相信这只是走个程序。

source: You can drop that, you know.
target: 你可以省掉那个称呼的。

source: The 'Lord.' I never liked it from you and I don't like it now.
target: 就是“殿下”。我从来都不喜欢你这么叫我，现在也不喜欢。

source: But then you always were more inclined to formalities than Laertes or me, I suppose.
target: 不过，我想你一向就比雷欧提斯和我更讲究礼节。

source: Let's keep things on task, Hamlet.
target: 我们还是说正事吧，哈姆雷特。

source: Your summoning here indicates that you have been, ah, the subject of some suspicion.
target: 把你叫到这里来，是因为你，呃，受到了一些怀疑。

source: What a surprise! My uncle suspects me a spy?
target: 真是出人意料！我叔叔怀疑我是间谍？

source: Of course not—because I would never suspect such a thing. I've known you all my life. Don't you think I'd know if you were?
target: 当然不是——因为我绝不会这么怀疑你。我从小就认识你。你要真是间谍，我还能不知道吗？

source: You coming to see me is timely. Your uncle, ah, asked me to speak with you about the information leaks we've experienced lately.
target: 你来找我，来得正好。你叔叔，呃，让我跟你谈谈我们最近遭遇的情报泄露。

source: Listen. I had dismissed my uncle's concerns as paranoia, but they may be founded.
target: 听着。我原本以为叔叔的担忧只是多疑，没当回事，但也许并非毫无根据。

source: My lord Hamlet? What are you doing here?
target: 哈姆雷特殿下？您怎么来了？

source: Ophelia told me to come find you.
target: 奥菲莉娅让我来找你。

source: She did? What for?
target: 她让你来的？为了什么？

source: You mean you don't know? Well, then, it's of no consequence.
target: 你是说你不知道？好吧，那就没什么了。

source: Although, while I'm here, there is one matter worth discussing...
target: 不过，既然我来了，有件事倒是值得谈谈……

source: I've found a set of odd notes in the gallery.
target: 我在画廊里发现了几张奇怪的字条。

source: The... gallery? Where, my lord?
target: 画……画廊？殿下，具体在哪里？

source: The notes were tucked away in one of the bookshelves near the door.
target: 那些字条藏在靠近门口的一个书架里。

source: I thought nothing of them before, but now, I'm not so sure.
target: 我之前没把它们当回事，但现在，我有些拿不准了。

source: They're very odd. I... had thought someone left them in the gallery by mistake. So I left them.
target: 它们很奇怪。我……原以为是有人不小心把它们落在画廊里了，所以就没动。

source: Fascinating. When I've a spare moment, I'll have a look in the gallery.
target: 有意思。等我有空，就去画廊看看。

source: But Hamlet, more to the point... your mental state lately. Your ramblings, your wanderings. Are you...
target: 不过，哈姆雷特，更要紧的是……你最近的精神状态。你那些胡言乱语，还有四处游荡。你是不是……

source: Is there anything I can do?
target: 有什么我能帮上忙的吗？

source: No. No, there isn't.
target: 没有。没有，你帮不了。

source: All I need is to be left in peace.
target: 我只想一个人清静清静。

source: You can trust me, Hamlet. I hope you know that.
target: 你可以相信我，哈姆雷特。我希望你明白这一点。

source: I should go. Farewell for now.
target: 我该走了。先告辞了。

source: Guard Captain. Why did Ophelia ask me to come here?
target: 卫队长。奥菲莉娅为什么让我来这里？

source: My lady, I hate to trouble you, but someone has recommended you visit me for an interrogation.
target: 王后，我实在不愿打扰您，但有人建议让您来我这里接受审问。

source: Ophelia did?
target: 是奥菲莉娅建议的？

source: It bears investigation, however trivial it may seem.
target: 无论看起来多么微不足道，这件事都值得调查。

source: Ah. I see. She thinks I'm this horrible 'spy' my husband's so concerned about.
target: 啊，我明白了。她觉得我就是我丈夫那么担心的那个可恶的“间谍”。

source: Tell me, good captain. Do you believe I'm capable of sabotaging my husband?
target: 告诉我，好队长。你觉得我会暗中破坏我丈夫的事吗？

source: ...No, my lady. I don't.
target: ……不，王后。我不这么认为。

source: Have you any proof to reinforce this interrogation?
target: 你有什么证据，能支持这次审问吗？

source: I'm embarrassed, my lady. My profound apologies.
target: 我很惭愧，王后。请接受我诚挚的歉意。

source: Hmph. I thought not. I'll take my leave of you now. This is an incredible insult. I don't know what to say.
target: 哼。我就知道没有。我现在要告辞了。这简直是难以置信的侮辱。我都不知道该说什么。

source: To you, Ophelia, or anyone else.
target: 无论是对你、奥菲莉娅，还是任何其他人。

source: Yes. She mentioned you'd want to speak to me.
target: 是的。她说你想找我谈谈。

source: I can't imagine what about. Apologies, my lady.
target: 我想不出有什么事要谈。抱歉，王后。

source: (Ah, right. He hasn't delivered news to the court about his suspicions yet. I'm too early.)
target: （啊，对。他还没向宫廷宣布自己的怀疑。我来得太早了。）

source: My lady, I hate to trouble you, but I've been informed of some troublesome news.
target: 王后，我实在不愿打扰您，但我得到了一些令人不安的消息。

source: It bears investigation, however unbelievable it may be.
target: 无论多么令人难以置信，这件事都值得调查。

source: What do you mean? My husband's investigating me? Whatever for?
target: 你是什么意思？我丈夫在调查我？究竟是为了什么？

source: He's concerned about some recent behavior of yours. I'll stop short of naming any further accusations aloud.
target: 他对您最近的一些行为感到不安。至于进一步的指控，我就不说出口了。

source: So someone must have seen me going through his things. Is that it?
target: 这么说，一定是有人看见我翻他的东西了。是这样吗？

source: I see. Ophelia saw my rummaging and came right to you about it. Is that it?
target: 我明白了。奥菲莉娅看见我翻找东西，就直接来告诉你了。是这样吗？

source: So... you admit to it?
target: 这么说……您承认了？

source: I do. But not for the reasons you might think.
target: 我承认。但原因可能与你想的不同。

source: Bernardo, can you keep a secret?
target: 贝尔纳多，你能保守秘密吗？

source: I... it depends, my lady, on what that secret might be...
target: 我……这得看，王后，得看是什么秘密……

source: My late husband gave me a very special gift. I think my darling Claudius is hiding it from me.
target: 我已故的丈夫曾给过我一件很特别的礼物。我想，我亲爱的克劳狄斯把它藏起来，不让我找到了。

source: A certain amulet of mine. It was... near and dear to me, and incredibly special.
target: 是我的一枚护身符。它……是我心爱的珍宝，有着格外特殊的意义。

source: Hamlet wore it into battle. It was a present for him. It came with me when I arrived from my father's lands, as a girl.
target: 哈姆雷特戴着它上战场。那是送给他的礼物。我还是个姑娘时，从父亲的领地来到这里，就带着它。

source: He wore it when we were wed. And when he was to be buried... I draped it round his neck. But then... at the funeral... it was gone.
target: 我们成婚时，他戴着它。后来，他将要下葬时……我把它挂在他的脖子上。可是……到了葬礼上……它却不见了。

source: I know for certain Claudius took it. And I thought perhaps I could find it. But I'm sure he's absconded with it.
target: 我确定是克劳狄斯拿走了它。我原以为也许能找到。可我确信，他已经把它偷偷拿走了。

source: Dropped it into the ocean, melted it down. Buried it deep and far away, as he does with all things painful.
target: 扔进海里，熔掉，或是埋到很远的地方，深深埋起来。他对所有令人痛苦的事物，都是这样处理的。

source: And I don't think I shall ever find it again.
target: 我想，我再也找不到它了。

source: I had no idea.
target: 我完全不知道这些。

source: My lady, I apologize for the intrusion.
target: 王后，恕我冒昧打扰。

source: This is a hole I must fill alone. Thank you for your understanding, Bernardo.
target: 这份空缺，只能由我独自填补。谢谢你的理解，贝尔纳多。

source: How terrible.
target: 真令人难过。

source: What's all this, now? You summoned, good Captain?
target: 这到底是怎么回事？好队长，是你传我们来的？

source: Are we in trouble? If so, I didn't do it!
target: 我们惹麻烦了吗？要是惹了，那可不是我干的！

source: My ladies, I'm afraid you are, in fact, in trouble.
target: 两位女士，恐怕你们确实惹上麻烦了。

source: Someone spotted you acting strangely in various places around the castle, and it's my duty to investigate.
target: 有人看见你们在城堡各处行为古怪，而我有责任展开调查。

source: Can you offer any elaboration as to what you were doing?
target: 你们能详细说明一下，当时在做什么吗？

source: Oh, of course! You see, we were in deep trouble, and—Ow!
target: 哦，当然！是这样的，我们当时遇到了大麻烦，然后——哎哟！

source: (Quiet, Guilda. If we tell him the truth, it'll just make us look like idiots.)
target: （别说了，吉尔达。要是告诉他实情，只会显得我们像两个傻子。）

source: (Do you want your father to know about our dilemma? Because I don't.)
target: （你想让你父亲知道我们的困境吗？反正我不想。）

source: Nothing, Captain.
target: 没什么，队长。

source: You have no excuse for your behavior? Are you aware that failing to comply with this investigation is tantamount to treason?
target: 你们对自己的行为没有任何解释？你们知不知道，不配合这次调查，就等同于叛国？

source: Very well, then. Perhaps some time in a cell will loosen your tongues.
target: 那好吧。也许在牢房里待上一阵，你们就肯开口了。

source: What? Surely you can't mean—
target: 什么？你总不至于真要——

source: Oh, I do.
target: 哦，我就是认真的。

source: As of yet, I've no reason to suspect you. Although now that I have you here, I might as well ask.
target: 目前，我还没有理由怀疑你们。不过，既然你们来了，我不妨问问。

source: What do you know of any attempts to spy on the residents of this castle?
target: 有人企图窥探这座城堡里的居民，对此，你们知道些什么？

source: I have some rather troubling news to announce at this morning's court pertaining to some possible treason occurring under our noses.
target: 今天早上的朝会上，我有些相当令人不安的消息要宣布，涉及可能就在我们眼皮底下发生的叛国行为。

source: It is eerily opportune you came to visit me.
target: 你们来找我的时机，巧得有些蹊跷。

source: W-Well, nothing in particular!
target: 这、这个，没什么特别的！

source: We only came here to eat!
target: 我们只是来吃东西的！

source: And meet with the King, of course.
target: 当然，还要觐见国王。

source: He summoned us. Said he wanted to meet with us. I imagine it has to do with the prince?
target: 是他召我们来的，说想见见我们。我想是与王子有关吧？

source: But we haven't met him yet! We'd hardly arrived, and whoosh! Ophelia appeared out of nowhere and sent us to talk to you.
target: 可我们还没见到他呢！我们才刚到，嗖！奥菲莉娅不知从哪儿冒了出来，让我们来找你谈话。

source: And to watch over Hamlet, of course.
target: 当然，还要照看哈姆雷特。

source: Watch over... Hamlet?
target: 照看……哈姆雷特？

source: The King has asked us to keep an eye on Hamlet's comings and goings. He's concerned about his nephew's health.
target: 国王让我们留意哈姆雷特的出入行踪。他担心侄子的健康。

source: I see. That does make a good deal of sense.
target: 明白了。这确实很有道理。

source: Do you feel you've been successful in your efforts?
target: 你们觉得自己做得怎么样？

source: Well, er...
target: 这个，呃……

source: We haven't even met him yet! We'd hardly arrived, and whoosh! Ophelia appeared out of nowhere and sent us to talk to you.
target: 我们连他的人都还没见到呢！我们才刚到，嗖！奥菲莉娅不知从哪儿冒了出来，让我们来找你谈话。

source: The man's not the same as we remember!
target: 他和我们记忆中的那个人不一样了！

source: Something does seem to be weighing on his conscience terribly. Perhaps you ought to give him a visit. Or he a visit to you.
target: 他似乎确实有什么事压在良心上，让他备受煎熬。也许你该去看看他。或者让他来看看你。

source: You may go. Apologies for the distraction.
target: 你们可以走了。抱歉耽误了你们。

source: No concern, Bernardo. We'll take our leave of you.
target: 没关系，贝尔纳多。那我们就告辞了。

source: Some time in the cells will straighten them out.
target: 在牢里待上一阵，她们就会老实了。

source: Stay out of trouble, ladies.
target: 两位女士，别再惹麻烦了。

source: No promises!
target: 这可不敢保证！

source: Ah, the good poet. Surprising to see you here.
target: 啊，诗人先生。没想到会在这里见到你。

source: Ophelia asked me to speak with you. It was only a matter of time, I suppose. I'm a troublemaker at heart.
target: 奥菲莉娅让我来找你谈谈。我想，这也是迟早的事。我骨子里就是个爱惹事的人。

source: Well, perhaps a troublemaker knows how to curb others' troublemaking.
target: 那么，也许爱惹事的人，知道怎么阻止别人惹事。

source: What do you know of any threats to the state?
target: 关于威胁国家的事，你知道些什么？

source: Me? Why, nothing. Although, come to think of it...
target: 我？什么都不知道。不过，仔细想想……

source: From the guard quarters' window, I've seen multiple people leaving the castle in the wee hours of the morning.
target: 我从卫兵宿舍的窗户往外看，见过好几个人在凌晨离开城堡。

source: Sometimes they seem to head to town, other times to the docks.
target: 他们有时似乎是往镇上去，有时则往码头去。

source: Of course, one might reason they'd woken up in the night with a sudden powerful thirst for a mug of wine, but-- it seems unlikely.
target: 当然，也可以说，他们是半夜醒来，忽然特别想喝上一杯酒，但——似乎不太可能。

source: More like they're up to something they'd rather not be caught doing.
target: 更像是在做什么不愿被人撞见的事。

source: Ahem. Fascinating. Late at night, you said?
target: 咳。有意思。你说是在深夜？

source: I'll have Marcellus investigate further as soon as I'm, er, able to do so.
target: 我会尽快，呃，在能安排的时候，让马塞勒斯进一步调查。

source: You don't know?
target: 你不知道？

source: I can't think of anything immediate, no.
target: 是的，我一时想不出有什么事。

source: Well, then! I'll get out of the hot seat and be on my merry way.
target: 那好吧！我就不在这里受审了，开开心心地走我的路去。

source: (Right. Bernardo hasn't addressed the spy publicly yet—and won't for a couple hours. I'm a bit too early.)
target: （对。贝尔纳多还没公开提起间谍的事——还得再过几个小时才会提。我来得有点早了。）

source: My lady Brit, I'll be brief.
target: 布莉特女士，我长话短说。

source: I already know, Captain. You're going to ask me about this spy business, aren't you?
target: 我已经知道了，队长。你要问我间谍的事，对吧？

source: Well, I know who your so-called 'spy' is. It's the Queen.
target: 我知道你所谓的“间谍”是谁。就是王后。

source: M-my lady, that's a rather serious accusation. Don't you think?
target: 女、女士，这可是相当严重的指控。您不觉得吗？

source: Not at all, for she's no spy. I saw her rummaging through the King's rooms myself. She's the one who's given him such cause to fear.
target: 一点也不，因为她不是间谍。我亲眼看见她在国王的房间里翻找。让他如此担惊受怕的，就是她。

source: Merely a wife looking for something lost in her husband's items... every evening, just before midnight. Perfectly reasonable behavior!
target: 不过是个妻子，在丈夫的物品里寻找丢失的东西……每天晚上，就在午夜前。再合理不过了！

source: If her intentions are pure, then it would seem he has no spy to fear. Isn't that true?
target: 如果她没有恶意，那看来他也没什么间谍可怕了。不是吗？

source: Yet we have proof that someone has been passing letters to Fortinbras. This spy reaches beyond the King's disturbed belongings.
target: 可我们有证据，证明有人一直在向福丁布拉斯传递信件。这个间谍所做的，可不只是翻动国王的物品。

source: I see. Then you're looking for someone who hates King Claudius enough to want him deposed.
target: 明白了。那么你要找的，是个恨克劳狄斯国王恨到想让他被废黜的人。

source: Were I you, I'd be looking at the surly, unstable teen right under my nose.
target: 换作是我，就会留意我眼皮底下那个脾气乖戾、情绪不稳的少年。

source: Obviously! He's got an axe to grind and a throne to reclaim.
target: 这还用说！他有怨要报，还有王位要夺回。

source: Er, fascinating theory. At any rate, you're free to go. Thank you for your time, my lady Brit.
target: 呃，很有意思的推测。无论如何，您可以走了。谢谢您抽出时间，布莉特女士。

source: Anytime, good Captain. By which I mean: Don't do this to me again. I'm a very busy girl.
target: 随时乐意效劳，好队长。我的意思是：别再这样折腾我了。我可是个很忙的姑娘。

source: So? What did you need me for? Ophelia failed to explain anything crucial.
target: 所以呢？你找我有什么事？奥菲莉娅连一件要紧的事都没说清楚。

source: Need you for? Why, nothing, my lady.
target: 找您有什么事？没有啊，女士。

source: Ugh! She was just wasting my time. How like her. I'll be going now.
target: 呸！她就是在浪费我的时间。还真像她的作风。我走了。

source: (Right. That meeting hasn't happened yet... no one knows about the spy.)
target: （对。那场会议还没开始……还没人知道间谍的事。）

source: My good lord Polonius. A pleasure, as always.
target: 波洛涅斯大人。见到您总是令人愉快。

source: How can I help, my lad?
target: 小伙子，有什么需要我帮忙的？

source: Is this about the King's troubling suspicions?
target: 是为了国王那些令人不安的疑虑吗？

source: Indeed. You know as well as I how rattled he's been lately.
target: 正是。您和我一样清楚，他最近有多么惶惶不安。

source: And... as you are the man closest to him, I must ask you what you know of any threats to the crown.
target: 而且……你是与他最亲近的人，我必须问问你，关于可能威胁王室的事，你知道些什么。

source: Help with what, my lord?
target: 帮什么忙，大人？

source: Ophelia told me you requested my presence. Didn't you?
target: 奥菲莉娅说你叫我过来。不是吗？

source: I'm afraid not. Although, now that I have you here...
target: 恐怕没有。不过，既然你已经来了……

source: I heard a rumor as well, one which I'd like to expunge or confirm rather quickly.
target: 我也听到了一则传闻，希望尽快查明，好澄清或证实。

source: Lord Polonius, you've always been closest to the crown. Do you know of anyone who might threaten the safety of our court?
target: 波洛涅斯大人，你一直是王室最亲近的人。你知道有谁可能威胁宫廷的安全吗？

source: I'm afraid I know precious little. I'm by His Majesty's side all day.
target: 恐怕我知道的很少。我整天都陪在陛下身边。

source: And what of the times when you aren't by His Majesty's side?
target: 那你不在陛下身边的时候呢？

source: I'll be curt, Lord Polonius. We have it on good word that you were spotted discarding documents in private.
target: 我就直说了，波洛涅斯大人。我们收到可靠消息，有人看见你私下丢弃文件。

source: Was King Claudius ever privy to these documents? And if not, what cause would you have to hide them?
target: 克劳狄斯国王知道这些文件的内容吗？如果不知道，你又有什么理由瞒着他？
我、我……

source: I cannot say. My word prevents me.
target: 我不能说。我有承诺在先。

source: You must understand how this appears, my lord. You, the King's most trusted advisor, withholding this during wartime...
target: 大人，你应该明白，这会让人怎么想。你是国王最信任的顾问，却在战时隐瞒这种事……

source: I'm no spy, Bernardo.
target: 我不是间谍，贝尔纳多。

source: Then prove it. Tell me what was in those documents.
target: 那就证明给我看。告诉我那些文件里写了什么。

source: Ah! In my few spare personal hours, I am often locked in my room. I've a right to my privacy!
target: 啊！我难得有一点自己的空闲时间，常常就待在房间里，锁着门。我有权保留自己的隐私！

source: Rest assured that I've given His Majesty my weight in loyalty thrice over. As I did to his brother before him.
target: 你大可放心，我献给陛下的忠诚，足有我体重的三倍。先前对他的兄长，我也是如此。

source: To whom would you be more loyal, had you the choice?
target: 如果可以选择，你会更忠于谁？

source: W-well, that's not entirely a fair question. Were His Majesty Hamlet still alive, King Claudius would be but a King in waiting.
target: 这、这个问题不完全公平。如果哈姆雷特陛下还活着，克劳狄斯国王也不过是在等着继位。

source: Pardon my forwardness, Lord Polonius. You're right, of course.
target: 请原谅我的冒昧，波洛涅斯大人。你说得对，当然。

source: You're free to leave.
target: 你可以走了。

source: Thank you, Guard Captain.
target: 谢谢你，卫队长。

source: You've brought this upon yourself, then. Whatever the King decides.
target: 那无论国王作何决定，都是你自找的。

source: Were I you, I'd prepare to make a statement before His Majesty—one which is better than what you just told me.
target: 换作是我，就会准备好向陛下作一番陈述——至少得比你刚才对我说的更有说服力。

source: (Oh, God, what will become of me?)
target: （哦，上帝啊，我会落得什么下场？）

source: Best wishes, Lord Polonius.
target: 祝你好运，波洛涅斯大人。

source: Lord Polonius.
target: 波洛涅斯大人。

source: My final request. Show me those documents.
target: 这是我最后一次要求。把那些文件给我看。

source: Look upon the hearth. You'll see the remains of them there.
target: 看看壁炉吧。你会在那里看到它们的残余。

source: Then I'm here to place you under arrest, my lord.
target: 那我就要逮捕你了，大人。

source: Of course you are. As I knew you would be.
target: 当然。我早就知道你会这么做。

source: Please come with me. I expect I won't have to have my men take you to your cell in chains.
target: 请跟我来。我想，应该用不着让手下给你戴上镣铐，押你进牢房吧。

source: Come, now, Bernardo. We're both gentlemen here. I find even the query offensive. I'll go gladly.
target: 得了，贝尔纳多。我们都是体面人。连这么问，我都觉得受了冒犯。我很乐意跟你走。

source: Ophelia, I apologize. You needn't be here for this, if you don't want to.
target: 奥菲莉娅，对不起。如果你不愿意，可以不用留在这里看着。

source: Of course I'll go too.
target: 我当然也要一起去。

source: (Father... he's putting on such a face. He's terrified.)
target: （父亲……他装得若无其事，其实怕得要命。）

source: Well, then.
target: 那么，好吧。

source: I trusted you. My brother trusted you. How can it have come to this?
target: 我信任你。我的兄长也信任你。怎么会走到这一步？

source: It is precisely because of the trust your brother and I had for one another that we are standing here now.
target: 正是因为你的兄长与我彼此信任，我们如今才会站在这里。

source: Hmph. Pretty words, but treason is treason. You've been smuggling information about our comings and goings to our enemies.
target: 哼。话说得漂亮，可叛国就是叛国。你一直在把我们的行踪偷偷传给敌人。

source: And for that reason, you shall stay here as long as you live.
target: 因此，你将在这里待到死。

source: Even despite your station, house arrest is too kind for a treasoner.
target: 就算顾及你的身份，对一个叛国者来说，软禁在家也太仁慈了。

source: ...Very well, my lord.
target: ……遵命，陛下。

source: Here I shall remain.
target: 我会留在这里。

source: Father, this is insane. Just show them the notes. I know you're not a spy!
target: 父亲，这太荒唐了。把笔记给他们看就好了。我知道你不是间谍！

source: Why must you be so stubborn?
target: 你为什么非要这么固执？

source: My love, for your own sake, you'd better not speak to me again.
target: 亲爱的，为了你自己，你最好别再跟我说话了。

source: Go. Please. Go and leave me in peace.
target: 走吧。求你了。走吧，让我安静一会儿。

source: (Oh, Father...)
(He'll do anything to protect King Hamlet's legacy—but even now, he's going too far.)
target: （为了守护哈姆雷特国王留下的一切，他什么都肯做——可到了这一步，他还是做得太过了。）

source: (What could possibly be in those notes? I have to find out.)
target: （那些笔记里到底写了什么？我一定要弄清楚。）

source: It isn't possible you can really be dead, is it?
target: 你不可能真的死了，对吧？

source: You absolute sniveling fool. How dare you leave us like this. And in such a trivial, horrible way.
target: 你这个只会哭哭啼啼的蠢货。你怎么敢就这样丢下我们。而且还是以这么不值一提、这么可怕的方式。

source: What on earth are the people who love you going to do now, Hamlet?
target: 哈姆雷特，爱你的人现在到底该怎么办？

source: What in hell am I going to do now?
target: 我现在到底该怎么办？

source: I followed you everywhere. Across the entire world and back. Through all these years...
target: 你去哪里，我就跟到哪里。跟着你走遍世界，又回到这里。这么多年来……

source: And finally you go somewhere I can't follow you. How is that fair?
target: 可最后，你去了一个我无法跟去的地方。这怎么公平？

source: I never worked up the courage to say it. I'm a bloody fool.
target: 我始终没能鼓起勇气说出口。我真是个该死的蠢货。

source: Even now, it's hard to say it...
target: 即使现在，还是难以说出口……

source: Well, then. Well then, Hamlet.
target: 那么，好吧。好吧，哈姆雷特。

source: I loved you, you bloody idiot. I will always love you.
target: 我爱过你，你这个该死的笨蛋。我会永远爱你。

source: It feels sometimes like I've been through several men's lifetimes. Like I should have died on your father's battlefield, or at sea, or of plague.
target: 有时候，我觉得自己像是活过了好几个人的一生。仿佛我早该死在你父亲的战场上，或死在海上，或死于瘟疫。

source: But I always felt I was meant to live for something more. And then I only wanted to live for you.
target: 可我总觉得，我活着是为了更重要的事。后来，我只想为你而活。

source: Your stupid cocky smile. Your easily-suffering heart. I've loved a lot of men, but none like you.
target: 你那傻乎乎又自大的笑容。你那颗动不动就受伤的心。我爱过很多男人，却从没像爱你这样爱过谁。

source: Your lack of any and all sense of humor. Damn you. I loved it all, and I wanted you all for myself, body and soul.
target: 还有你那一丁点都没有的幽默感。你这混蛋。你的一切我都爱，我想独占你的全部，你的身体，你的灵魂。

source: But I, like all the others, realized it was useless to try and have you.
target: 可我和其他人一样，明白了想拥有你只是徒劳。

source: Always did hunger for the unreachable things in life.
target: 我总是渴望那些遥不可及的东西。

source: At least I got to speak with you about it. Just once. I had hoped for that, I think. This closure.
target: 至少我有机会跟你说起这件事。哪怕只有一次。我想，我一直盼着能这样。能有个了结。

source: Now... I have to go on, somehow. I have to... rebuild.
target: 现在……不管怎样，我都得继续走下去。我得……重新开始。

source: And I don't want to. I'd rather give up and die right here. It'd be easy.
target: 可我不想。我宁愿放弃，就死在这里。那样很容易。

source: But I'm not going to, Hamlet.
target: 但我不会那么做，哈姆雷特。

source: I'm going to live. I can never know for sure, but I think you would've wanted me to live.
target: 我要活下去。我永远无法确定，但我想，你会希望我活下去。

source: And someday, maybe I can find some other dark-haired man to follow to the ends of the earth.
target: 也许有一天，我还能找到另一个深色头发的男人，跟着他走到天涯海角。

source: He'll never be you. But perhaps I can love him just the same.
target: 他永远不会是你。但也许，我仍能同样爱他。

source: Farewell, my friend. You were the best of them, even if you never believed it.
target: 永别了，我的朋友。你是他们之中最好的，即使你从来不肯相信。

source: You would've wanted flights of angels to sing you to rest. For you, I can believe in a God that has you wrapped in His embrace.
target: 你会希望成群的天使唱着歌，送你安眠。为了你，我愿相信有一位上帝，正将你拥在怀中。

source: Rest in peace. Now, and forevermore.
target: 安息吧。此刻，直到永远。

source: Do we have to talk to her, Rosie?
target: 萝茜，我们非得跟她说话吗？

source: Of course we do. We are of noble blood. We pay our debts, no matter how unsavory they might be.
target: 当然。我们是贵族出身。欠下的债就要还，无论多么不情愿。

source: B-but I'm afraid of her!
target: 可、可是我怕她！

source: Don't be silly. She's just one woman.
target: 别犯傻了。她不过是一个女人。

source: ...Hello, Irma.
target: ……你好，伊尔玛。

source: So if I turn you upside down and shake you, will all the money you owe me fall out?
target: 那么，要是我把你们倒过来抖一抖，你们欠我的钱会不会全掉出来？

source: Er-r-r... not quite. We are, as it were, in a particularly delicate position—
target: 呃、呃、呃……不太会。可以说，我们眼下的处境格外微妙——

source: We're penniless!
target: 我们身无分文了！

source: Precisely. All those card games have drained what funds we brought to Elsinore.
target: 正是。打了那么多场牌，我们带到埃尔西诺的钱已经全输光了。

source: (...And Irma's trick deck didn't do us any favors, either...)
target: （……伊尔玛那副做过手脚的牌，也没让我们好过……）

source: As you've won more games than we have funds to pay, we are, in short, unable to pay you.
target: 你赢得太多，我们带的钱不够付。简单来说，我们还不起你了。

source: This is a wonderful position to be in.
target: 这处境可真不错。

source: It... is?
target: 是……吗？

source: For me. Now I have two new servant girls to help me get my work done.
target: 对我来说。现在，我多了两个小女仆，帮我把活干完。

source: N-now hold on just a minute...
target: 等、等一下……

source: We're nobody's servants!
target: 我们可不是谁的仆人！

source: Do I need to extract my payment from you some other way? Rip those fine clothes off your bodies and sell them, perhaps?
target: 要我换个办法，从你们身上讨回欠款吗？比如，把你们身上那些漂亮衣服扒下来卖掉？

source: What do you need us to do...?
target: 你要我们做什么……？

source: Oh, a bit here, a bit there.
target: 哦，这里干一点，那里干一点。

source: First, I want you both to collect some moss from that old fountain in the courtyard.
target: 首先，你们俩去庭院里那座旧喷泉，采些苔藓回来。

source: Gives all of my soups a nice, earthy flavor. Don't ask.
target: 能给我做的汤添点好闻的泥土味。别问。

source: After that... since you're both educated little birds, I need you to go to the gallery and find me something new to make for the Queen's birthday next month.
target: 然后……既然你们是两只读过书的小鸟，就去画廊给我找道新菜，好在下个月王后生日时做。

source: After that... since you're both educated little birds, I need you to go to the gallery and find me something new to make.
target: 然后……既然你们是两只读过书的小鸟，就去画廊给我找道新菜做。

source: I can't read, so you'll have to remember it for me, then come tell it to me later.
target: 我不识字，你们得替我记住，之后回来讲给我听。

source: And finally, I want you to gather the mushrooms that grow near the pond in the woods.
target: 最后，你们去采树林里池塘边长的蘑菇。

source: About ten dozen should be enough.
target: 大概十打就够了。

source: ...What! All of that?
target: ……什么！这些全都要做？

source: You can't be serious. We are women of noble families! Not your scullery maids!
target: 你不是认真的吧。我们可是贵族家的女士！不是你厨房里的杂役女仆！

source: And who do you think I am? My connections run far and wide, ladies. You know I have friends in powerful places.
target: 那你们以为我是谁？女士们，我的人脉可广得很。你们知道，我有些朋友很有权势。

source: Either get to work, or I'll take collateral from you in any way I see fit... By force, if needed.
target: 要么去干活，要么我就按自己喜欢的方式，从你们身上拿点东西抵押……必要的话，就动用武力。

source: Y-yes, ma'am...
target: 是、是的，夫人……

source: ...Then let's get to work.
target: ……那就去干活吧。

source: It's in here.
target: 就在这里面。

source: How can you be sure...?
target: 你怎么能确定……？

source: I don't want to reach my hand in there. This fountain probably hasn't been cleaned since Ogier the Dane was alive!
target: 我可不想把手伸进去。这喷泉大概从丹麦人奥吉尔还活着的时候起，就没清理过！

source: Well, I don't want to get my hands dirty, either.
target: 我也不想弄脏手。

source: We'll need to choose by some sort of objective, reasonable criteria.
target: 我们得按某种客观、合理的标准，决定谁来。

source: For example: Age. I'm older, so I say you have to put your hand in the fountain.
target: 比如，年龄。我年纪更大，所以我说，该由你把手伸进喷泉。

source: Well, I can't argue with that logic.
target: 好吧，这套道理我可反驳不了。

source: I-it's so slimy!
target: 好、好黏啊！

source: And it's all over my hand...
target: 弄得我满手都是……

source: Got some!
target: 抓到一些了！

source: Do you think this much is enough?
target: 你觉得这么多够了吗？

source: (Is she... holding... moss?)
target: （她……手里拿着的……是苔藓？）

source: I can't see ever needing any more. Blech.
target: 我想不出还会需要更多的理由。呕。

source: Let's go. Quickly, before anyone more sees us making uncomely idiots of ourselves.
target: 走吧。快点，别让更多人看见我们这副丢人现眼的傻样。

source: There should be one particular tome here...
target: 这里应该有一本我们要找的书……

source: Do you see it?
target: 你看见了吗？

source: Shh. Do you want people to see us?
target: 嘘。你想让别人看见我们吗？

source: Here it is. 'Das Buch von guter Speise.' The book of good food.
target: 在这里。《Das Buch von guter Speise》，《美食之书》。

source: But where is it?
target: 可它在哪儿呢？

source: I don't know. I'll select something at random.
target: 不知道。我随便选一个吧。

source: There's so much in here. And i-it's all in German!
target: 这里面的内容可真多。而、而且全是德语！

source: Say, Rosie... I've never looked at these portraits up close.
target: 对了，萝茜……我从来没凑近看过这些肖像。

source: Queen Astrid was... beautiful, wasn't she?
target: 阿斯特丽德王后……很美，是不是？

source: I heard from my father she passed away, but... why did she die?
target: 我听父亲说她去世了，可是……她为什么会死？

source: Hamlet won't say. I think it was rather bloody.
target: 哈姆雷特不肯说。我想，死得挺血腥的。

source: I know she died a raving lunatic.
target: 我知道，她死时已经是个胡言乱语的疯子了。

source: It's not the sort of thing one asks about in polite company. At least, not here.
target: 在体面人面前，不该打听这种事。至少在这里不该。

source: Regardless, we've done the job we came here to do. Let us head to our next task anon.
target: 总之，我们来这里要办的事已经办完了。赶紧去做下一件吧。

source: Found some over here.
target: 这边找到一些。

source: And more, here!
target: 这里还有！

source: We look like idiots.
target: 我们看起来像两个傻瓜。

source: H-how many do we need to gather, again?
target: 我、我们到底要采多少来着？

source: Ten dozen. We didn't bring anything to carry them in, so I'll have to use my skirts...
target: 十打。我们没带装蘑菇的东西，只好用裙摆兜着了……

source: Guilda! Stop eating them!
target: 吉尔妲！别吃了！

source: But we've been working all day, and I'm hungry.
target: 可我们干了一整天的活，我饿了。

source: You're unbelievable.
target: 你真是让人没话说。

source: Let's report our findings.
target: 我们去汇报收获吧。

source: Your reign of tyrrany has come to an end, Irma. We've done everything on your list.
target: 伊尔玛，你的暴政到此结束了。你清单上的事，我们全做完了。

source: Such helpful lasses. I see you arranged everything I asked for. We'll have a stew of champions this eve.
target: 多能干的姑娘啊。我看，我要的东西你们都备齐了。今晚咱们就能吃上一锅配得上勇士的炖菜了。

source: Now begone. You're both horrid at cards and even worse at paying your gambling debts.
target: 现在走吧。你们俩牌打得烂，还赌债的本事更烂。

source: But as of this moment, we are settled, are we not?
target: 可到现在，我们已经两清了，对吧？

source: You've added a single coin to the pile, but I intend to shake you for the rest at some later date.
target: 这也就算还了一枚硬币，剩下的，我打算改天再从你们身上抖出来。

source: From one 'friend' to another, I recommend you never deal in at my table again.
target: 看在咱们是“朋友”的份上，我劝你们以后别再上我的牌桌。

source: We never will!
target: 我们绝不会再来了！

source: (She's a cheat, anyhow...)
target: （反正她就是个出老千的……）

source: What was that?
target: 你说什么？

source: N-nothing! We'll be going now!
target: 没、没什么！我们这就走！

source: This is a mere formality, Marcellus. Thank you for coming.
target: 只是走个程序，马塞勒斯。谢谢你过来。

source: Wot's this all about now?
target: 这又是咋回事？

source: Have you witnessed any strange comings and goings lately? Anyone who might be a threat to the throne?
target: 最近有没有看见什么人行踪异常？有没有谁可能威胁王位？

source: W-well... yeh know, I can't say I have.
target: 这、这个……你也知道，我没见着。

source: Horatio asked me about a certain figure he saw leavin' Elsinore and headin' to town...
target: 霍拉旭看见有个人离开埃尔西诺，往镇上去了，还向我打听那人来着……

source: But I told him it could be all kinds o' people, and not to fret.
target: 可我跟他说，那人是谁都有可能，别瞎担心。

source: I think he's keepin' a vigilant watch, though.
target: 不过，我觉得他还在警惕地盯着呢。

source: That isn't his area of responsibility. I ought to have him removed from the watch rounds.
target: 那不在他的职责范围内。我该把他从巡逻队伍里撤掉。

source: He's tardy enough as it is.
target: 他本来就够爱迟到了。

source: Erm... but, Captain... Suppose someone does attempt to track down this mysterious figure...?
target: 呃……可是，队长……假如真有人去追查这个神秘人……？

source: Aren't yeh concerned what they might find?
target: 你就不担心他们会查出什么？

source: I'm absurdly busy at the moment, Marcellus. I haven't time to worry about the one-man Italian Anti-Crime Brigade.
target: 我现在忙得不可开交，马塞勒斯。没工夫操心那支只有一个人的意大利打击犯罪大队。

source: Verona, for a while I take my leave, to see my friends in Padua.
target: 维罗纳，我暂且告别，去帕多瓦探望朋友。

source: (Oh. The play's just starting.)
target: （哦。戏才刚开始。）

source: Watch the performance?
target: 观看演出？

source: But of all—my best beloved and approved friend, Hortensio; and I trow this is his house.
target: 而其中——我最亲爱、最可信赖的朋友便是霍滕西奥；我想，这就是他的家。

source: (Katherine's onstage. I won't disturb her this time.)
target: （凯瑟琳正在台上。这次我就不打扰她了。）

source: Good morrow, Kate! For that's your name, I hear.
target: 早安，凯特！听说你叫这个名字。

source: Hmm. Well have you heard, but something hard of hearing. They call me Katharine that do talk of me.
target: 哼。你是听说了，可耳朵不大灵光。说起我的人，都叫我凯瑟琳。

source: (Katherine looks so familiar. Who is she?)
target: （凯瑟琳看着好眼熟。她是谁？）

source: (I feel as if I know that voice.)
target: （这声音好像在哪里听过。）

source: (She looks happy.)
target: （她看起来很开心。）

source: ...Husband, let's follow to see the end of this ado.
target: ……夫君，我们跟上去，看看这场风波如何收场。

source: First kiss me, Kate, and we will.
target: 先吻我一下，凯特，我们就去。

source: W-what, in the midst of the street?
target: 什、什么，就在大街上？

source: What, art thou ashamed of me?
target: 怎么，你以我为耻吗？

source: No, sir, God forbid, but ashamed to kiss.
target: 不，夫君，绝无此意，我只是羞于亲吻。

source: Why, then, let's home again.
target: 那好，我们还是回家吧。

source: Nay, I will give thee a kiss!
target: 别，我吻你就是了！

source: Now pray thee, love, stay.
target: 现在，亲爱的，求你留步。

source: Is not this well? Come, my sweet Kate! Better once than never, for never too late!
target: 这样不是很好吗？来吧，我亲爱的凯特！有一次总胜过没有，何时都不算太迟！

source: Is... is that you?
target: 是……是你吗？

source: What are you doing here?
target: 你怎么会在这里？

source: Oy! Kate! You've lost yer nerve!
target: 喂！凯特！你怯场啦！

source: What's goin' on?
target: 怎么回事？

source: I paid for this!
target: 我可是花了钱的！

source: C'mon! Say something!
target: 快点啊！说句话！

source: Wait! Don't go—
target: 等等！别走——

source: I shouldn't have done that.
target: 我不该那么做的。

source: But I never knew.
target: 可我一直都不知道。

source: She went to the bar.
target: 她去吧台了。

source: Something stiff, Othello. Please.
target: 奥赛罗，来点烈酒。拜托了。

source: Oh, so you're drinking again?
target: 哦，你又开始喝酒了？

source: Saw you out there earlier tonight. That's some good delivery.
target: 今晚早些时候看见你在台上了。台词说得真不错。

source: Looked like you had the crowd in a vise.
target: 看起来你把观众都牢牢吸引住了。

source: Is... that... really you?
target: 那……真的……是你吗？

source: How can you be outside the castle?
target: 你怎么能到城堡外面来？

source: And how long did it take you to recognize me?
target: 还有，你过了多久才认出我？

source: Never mind that. Look, I came because I was worried about you. You ran off so quickly.
target: 先别管那个。我来是因为担心你。你一下子就跑走了。

source: Well, there's no point pretending now.
target: 唉，现在再装也没意义了。

source: What you saw on stage... is me. Or the 'rest' of me, I suppose.
target: 你在台上看到的……就是我。或者说，是我的“另一部分”吧。

source: For many years, I've been a player. It started when I was a child, playing Juliet.
target: 我做演员已经很多年了。从小时候扮演朱丽叶开始。

source: And tonight... it ended, as Katherine.
target: 而今晚……就以凯瑟琳这个角色，结束了。

source: Why must it end?
target: 为什么一定要结束？

source: For a boy player, there are only two options when one grows old: Take the male parts, or leave the stage.
target: 男童演员长大以后，就只有两条路：改演男性角色，或者离开舞台。

source: And I would rather leave.
target: 而我宁愿离开。

source: I never thought the day would come when I would have to stop. I never wanted to.
target: 我从没想过，有一天我会不得不停下来。我从来都不想停。

source: In the moments when I was up there... I felt... like I was showing the world the truer form of myself.
target: 站在台上的那些时刻……我觉得……自己在向世人展现更真实的我。

source: The 'me' who was not just strong, but beautiful.
target: 那个不只有力量，还很美丽的“我”。

source: You and that Petruchio actor...
target: 你和那个演彼特鲁乔的演员……

source: It was stageplay, Ophelia.
target: 那是在演戏，奥菲莉娅。

source: Very convincing stageplay.
target: 演得可真像。

source: My lady, please. I don't want to... I can't think about all of this right now.
target: 小姐，求你了。我不想……我现在没法去想这些。

source: In my life at the castle, I spend every shred of my willpower trying not to think about it.
target: 在城堡里生活时，我用尽了所有意志力，努力不去想这件事。

source: Does anyone in Elsinore know?
target: 埃尔西诺有人知道吗？

source: Only Claudius. He used it to keep me in fear.
target: 只有克劳狄斯。他拿这件事让我一直活在恐惧里。

source: A-and you now know, I suppose. I've used a pseudonym these long years, kept my face hidden when I left the changing room.
target: 还、还有你，现在也知道了吧。这么多年来，我一直用化名，离开更衣室时也一直遮着脸。

source: My father found out. Hated me for it. But he's dead now, and took his shame with him, and told no one.
target: 我父亲发现了。他因此恨我。不过他现在已经死了，把他那份羞耻也带走了，没告诉任何人。

source: Right before he died, he told me the world would turn on me if they ever knew.
target: 临死前，他告诉我，世人一旦知道，就会与我为敌。

source: Well, he was wrong about that. About me, at least.
target: 那他就错了。至少对我来说，他错了。

source: You can trust me. How many years have we known each other? You've always taken care of me. Now it's my turn.
target: 你可以信任我。我们认识多少年了？你一直都在照顾我。现在轮到我了。

source: Hamlet... you could trust in him, too, I think.
target: 哈姆雷特……我想，你也可以信任他。

source: Hamlet? No. I think not.
target: 哈姆雷特？不。我看不行。

source: There are others you could trust in, too, I think.
target: 我想，还有其他人值得你信任。

source: No. No, certainly not.
target: 不。不，绝对不行。

source: What if word got out, Ophelia? Think! Would I be Guard Captain still? Or would they snicker and taunt just as they did tonight, right to my face?
target: 要是这件事传出去了呢，奥菲莉娅？想想吧！我还能当卫队长吗？还是说，他们会像今晚一样，当着我的面窃笑、嘲弄我？

source: Or worse, would they try to destroy me?
target: 或者更糟，他们会不会想毁掉我？

source: I pray to God daily, but I don't know that He listens to me anymore.
target: 我每天向上帝祈祷，却不知道祂是否还在听。

source: Bernardo—Katherine—whomever you desire to be...
target: 贝尔纳多——凯瑟琳——无论你想成为谁……

source: My father has a saying for times like this. 'To thine own self be true.'
target: 遇到这种时候，我父亲总有一句话：“忠于你自己。”

source: If this is your truth, then God will love you for it.
target: 如果这就是真实的你，上帝就会因此爱你。

source: What you choose to tell others is up to you. But I will always—always be your friend.
target: 要告诉别人什么，由你自己决定。但我会永远——永远是你的朋友。

source: There's that, at least.
target: 至少，我还有你这个朋友。

source: How should I call you?
target: 我该怎么称呼你？

source: By which I mean, how would you like to be called?
target: 我是说，你希望别人怎么称呼你？

source: Call me Bernardo. Man or woman, I know not which. Some days one, then the other. Both are to my liking.
target: 叫我贝尔纳多吧。是男人还是女人，我也说不清。有些日子是一个，过些日子又是另一个。两者我都喜欢。

source: It would be easier for now if you called me as a man before my own men. Some of them... would... react poorly to who I am, I suspect.
target: 暂时在我的部下面前，把我当男人称呼会方便些。我猜，他们有些人……会……难以接受真实的我。

source: If that's your wish, I'll honor it.
target: 如果这是你的意愿，我会尊重。

source: Will you not speak to Hamlet and my brother? They've known you since you were a child, after all.
target: 你不愿跟哈姆雷特和我哥哥谈谈吗？毕竟你从小就认识他们了。

source: Will you not speak to any others whom you trust?
target: 你不愿跟其他信任的人谈谈吗？

source: They might fear me. Hate me. Pity me.
target: 他们可能会怕我。恨我。可怜我。

source: I can trust no one with this. Not right now, not when I'm in the position I am, and when the country's at war.
target: 这件事我没法放心告诉任何人。至少现在不行，我身居这个职位，国家又正在打仗。

source: I've felt so alone for so long.
target: 这么长时间以来，我一直觉得无比孤独。

source: I must return to the castle soon. But for now, I'll linger a while.
target: 我很快就得回城堡了。不过现在，我想再待一会儿。

source: Please be careful in town. Were I in my right mind I'd escort you home, but I hope you'll forgive me for sending you alone.
target: 在镇上请小心。如果我现在心绪正常，就会送你回家，但希望你能原谅我让你独自回去。

source: M-my prince Fortinbras!
target: 福、福丁布拉斯王子殿下！

source: I didn't believe you'd come in person. A-and without guard. Is it safe?
target: 我没想到您会亲自来。还、还没带卫兵。这样安全吗？

source: Safe enough through the woods. Our father cared mightily about royal appearances in war. We rather prefer victory.
target: 穿过树林，倒还算安全。我们父王极为看重战时的王室排场。我们倒更喜欢胜利。

source: Lady Brockenhuus. You look well. And your father?
target: 布罗肯胡斯女士。你看起来气色不错。你父亲呢？

source: As well as ever, my lord.
target: 他和往常一样安好，殿下。

source: What news can you deliver?
target: 你有什么消息？

source: The King believes your peace offering is legitimate. He wishes to pursue an end to the present squabble.
target: 国王相信您是真心求和。他希望设法结束眼下的争端。

source: He will offer you and your men safe passage through Denmark.
target: 他会准许您和您的部队安全穿过丹麦。

source: What a fool. He is his brother's lesser, to be certain.
target: 真是个蠢货。他确实远不如他哥哥。

source: The King is suspicious of you. I observed his War Council meeting in private. But he's not yet suspicious enough to act against you.
target: 国王对您有所怀疑。我暗中观察了他的军事会议。但他的疑心还没重到要对您采取行动的地步。

source: Be cautious, my lord.
target: 请谨慎行事，殿下。

source: I suspect it shall take the old man far longer to act against me than I against him.
target: 我想，等那个老头对我动手，恐怕要比我对他动手晚得多。

source: The King is dead.
target: 国王死了。

source: For the time being, you're free to act as you please. The castle is in chaos.
target: 眼下，您可以随意行动。城堡已经乱成一团了。

source: Well, then. This certainly a pleasant surprise.
target: 哦，这样啊。这可真是个意外之喜。

source: This is wonderful news. Were my father alive to see how our mobilization has succeeded, he'd certainly be proud.
target: 真是好消息。要是我父王还活着，看到我们的军事动员如此成功，他一定会很骄傲。

source: ...And when I am King of Denmark, your family will be justly rewarded for your show of faith.
target: ……等我成为丹麦国王，你的家族会因你所展现的忠诚，得到应有的奖赏。

source: T-thank you, sire.
target: 谢、谢谢您，陛下。

source: Keep your ears to the earth. I'll see you tomorrow night.
target: 继续留意动静。明晚见。

source: (...Brit's the spy plaguing Elsinore? Her?)
target: （……困扰埃尔西诺的间谍是布莉特？她？）

source: (It can't be possible... can it?)
target: （这不可能……对吧？）

source: (Bernardo and the King must know about this. Immediately.)
target: （必须让贝尔纳多和国王知道这件事。马上。）

source: I... I've further news for you, my lord Fortinbras.
target: 我……我还有消息要告诉您，福丁布拉斯殿下。

source: Excellent. My time is increasingly limited as we prepare for the siege.
target: 很好。我们正在准备围城，我的时间越来越紧了。

source: Claudius's efforts are regaining focus. I'm... concerned. His throne may need to be melted at the base, so to speak.
target: 克劳狄斯的行动又开始有了明确方向。我……很担心。打个比方，也许得把他王座的底座熔掉。

source: The people are starving and unhappy under Claudius's ill-fitted rule. All they need is an excuse to storm the castle.
target: 克劳狄斯治国无方，百姓饥饿又不满。他们只差一个攻打城堡的理由。

source: If there were someone who could lead a siege, better if it was a Dane... perhaps the prince?
target: 要是有人能带头围城，最好是个丹麦人……也许那位王子可以？

source: No. He's far too indecisive in his own right.
target: 不。他自己就太优柔寡断了。

source: There is another. A Duke's son. He has the love of the people. He would be amenable to your rule.
target: 还有一个人。是一位公爵的儿子。他深受百姓爱戴，也会愿意接受您的统治。

source: But... Laertes has sailed for Paris. He's not within Denmark at the moment.
target: 不过……雷欧提斯已经乘船去巴黎了。他目前不在丹麦。

source: What would cause him to return, furious and full of righteous fire?
target: 什么事能让他怒气冲冲、满怀义愤地回来？

source: What would cause him to take action against the king, furious and full of righteous fire?
target: 什么事能让他怒气冲冲、满怀义愤地对国王采取行动？

source: ...I don't know.
target: ……我不知道。

source: No. Wait. He has a sister.
target: 不，等等。他有个妹妹。

source: A delicate little thing, hardly grown. If something were to happen to her—he'd get his revenge in an instant.
target: 一个娇弱的小姑娘，还没怎么长大。要是她出了什么事——他会立刻报仇。

source: He loves her more than anything in this world.
target: 他爱她，胜过这世上的一切。

source: Claudius is dead, as well I'm sure you've heard by now.
target: 克劳狄斯死了，我相信您现在已经听说了。

source: And Hamlet is to succeed him.
target: 哈姆雷特将继承他的王位。

source: I believe my father has sent his recommendation that Hamlet and I be betrothed. What would you have me do, my lord?
target: 我想，我父亲已经送出了让我和哈姆雷特订婚的提议。您想让我怎么做，殿下？

source: You know that I have indomitable faith in the way you think and act. If young Hamlet is King, then you must stand by his side.
target: 你知道，我对你的判断和行事方式有着坚定不移的信心。如果年轻的哈姆雷特成为国王，你就必须站在他身边。

source: After my men have settled the castle and flown the flag of Norway, he will need someone to steer him under my interests.
target: 等我的部队控制城堡、升起挪威国旗后，他就需要有人引导他，让他按我的利益行事。

source: So you aim to make him a puppet.
target: 所以您打算让他成为傀儡。

source: Yes. A King in name, but a vassal to me in spirit.
target: 是的。名义上是国王，实质上是我的附庸。

source: I fear there's something impossible in that. He would reject a betrothal at the moment, I think.
target: 恐怕这件事有行不通的地方。我想，他眼下会拒绝订婚。

source: Even though Hamlet agreed to the betrothal, I fear any attempt to use it to sway him would fail.
target: 虽然哈姆雷特答应了订婚，但恐怕想利用婚约左右他，都会失败。

source: His heart belongs to someone else.
target: 他心里另有其人。

source: To whom?
target: 是谁？

source: The daughter of Duke Polonius. Her name is Ophelia. And she is a strong-headed girl. She cannot be easily persuaded.
target: 波洛涅斯公爵的女儿。她叫奥菲莉娅。是个固执的姑娘，很难说服她。

source: So long as Ophelia lives, Hamlet will never be fully faithful to any bride he's given.
target: 只要奥菲莉娅还活着，无论给哈姆雷特安排什么新娘，他都不可能全心全意地忠于她。

source: I see. Then the path forward is clear.
target: 我明白了。那么，接下来该怎么做就很清楚了。

source: Are you prepared to eliminate her of your own hand?
target: 你准备好亲手除掉她了吗？

source: You know her face, her habits, her comings and goings. My men and I are utterly at your liberty.
target: 你知道她的长相、习惯和行踪。我和我的部下完全听你调遣。

source: ...You want me to kill her?
target: ……您要我杀了她？

source: I know it is no easy request. The taking of a life should never be treated lightly.
target: 我知道，这个要求并不容易做到。夺走一条生命，绝不该被轻率对待。

source: But... for the good of your country, and for the sake of your father, are you willing?
target: 但是……为了你的国家，也为了你的父亲，你愿意吗？

source: Your people will no longer starve. Your King will no longer be a cruel despot. I promise you kindness and prosperity.
target: 你的人民将不再挨饿。你的国王将不再是残酷的暴君。我向你许诺仁政与繁荣。

source: I... I don't think I can.
target: 我……我觉得我做不到。

source: Something doesn't feel right about it. I've never liked the girl, but evidently there's something very wrong here.
target: 这件事让我觉得不对劲。我从来没喜欢过那姑娘，但这显然很不对。

source: I don't know if I could kill her.
target: 我不知道自己能不能杀了她。

source: Very well. I understand.
target: 好吧。我理解。

source: I will find some other path forward. Worry not. Everything proceeds as it was planned.
target: 我会另找办法。别担心。一切都按计划进行。

source: Let us meet tomorrow night—in town, not here. I shall have further information on keeping you and your family safe.
target: 我们明晚见——在镇上，不在这里。到时我会有更多消息，告诉你如何保全你和家人的安全。

source: I'll do what I can.
target: 我会尽力。

source: I must prepare.
target: 我得做些准备。

source: You're doing a magnificent thing, Lady Birgitta. You mustn't forget it.
target: 你在做一件伟大的事，比尔吉塔女士。千万别忘了这一点。

source: Let us meet tomorrow night. I shall have further logistical information for your father then.
target: 我们明晚见。到时我会有更多后勤方面的消息，交给你父亲。

source: Explain yourself.
target: 解释一下。

source: It's a nice evening for a walk?
target: 今晚挺适合散步的？

source: It's freezing down here.
target: 这里冷得要命。

source: I like looking at all the ships?
target: 我喜欢看看那些船？

source: Harbor's empty.
target: 港口里一条船都没有。

source: I wanted to see what you were up to?
target: 我想看看你在做什么？

source: Mmm hm. There it is.
target: 嗯，哼。这才是真话。

source: Good night.
target: 晚安。

source: Oh. 'Feely. You gave me a fright.
target: 哦，菲莉。你吓了我一跳。

source: What brings you down here?
target: 你怎么来这里了？

source: I like to leave the castle when I can.
target: 有机会的话，我喜欢到城堡外面来。

source: Call it a break, of sorts.
target: 就当是出来歇一歇吧。

source: As you well know, Gertrude seems to frown on courtly women going to town too often. So I come here instead.
target: 你也很清楚，乔特鲁德似乎不喜欢宫廷里的女人太常去镇上。所以我就来这里了。

source: Oh, yes. I know all about that.
target: 哦，是啊。这事我再清楚不过了。

source: What of you? It's three in the morning. Oughtn't you to be in bed?
target: 你呢？已经凌晨三点了。你不是该上床睡觉了吗？

source: Or are you planning to sneak into Hamlet's?
target: 还是你打算偷偷钻进哈姆雷特的床上？

source: ...Never mind. I don't particularly care. Good night.
target: ……算了。我也没多在意。晚安。

source: It all comes back to where I began.
target: 一切又回到了起点。

source: From the first time I died...
target: 从我第一次死去的时候起……

source: I suspected—perhaps—that this was how things were meant to be.
target: 我就怀疑——也许——事情本来就注定如此。

source: I've seen so many terrible things. The world tearing itself apart. And all for nothing.
target: 我见过太多可怕的事。这个世界在把自己撕碎。而这一切都毫无意义。

source: It's all useless.
target: 一切都是徒劳。

source: Perhaps the only good outcome is to do nothing, and see where that fate might lead.
target: 也许只有什么都不做，看看命运会把我带到哪里，才可能有个好结果。

source: Where... am I?
target: 我……在哪儿？

source: What just happened?
target: 刚才发生了什么？

source: You've arrived!
target: 你来了！

source: What's... everyone... doing here?
target: 大家……都在这里……做什么？

source: Um, you mean you don't know? The show's nearly over!
target: 呃，你是说你不知道？戏都快结束了！

source: We're here for the final act, of sorts.
target: 我们是为最后一幕来的，算是吧。

source: We all came here to see what you'd do next.
target: 我们都来看看，你接下来会做什么。

source: After you've left this world, that is.
target: 我是说，在你离开这个世界之后。

source: And of course, to offer our sincere and heartfelt advice on these matters.
target: 当然，我们也会就这些事给出真诚、发自内心的建议。

source: Not that we have the final say in anything.
target: 不过，任何事都不是我们说了算。

source: Indeed. It's all up to you, love.
target: 没错。全由你决定，亲爱的。

source: Consider this a temporary space to explore what has been and might be.
target: 把这里当作一个暂时的空间，探索已经发生的事，以及可能发生的事。

source: ...So this is...
target: ……所以这里是……

source: ...This is some kind of... curtain call?
target: ……这算是某种……谢幕？

source: And if I leave here... then... all of this... will be over?
target: 如果我离开这里……那……这一切……就会结束？

source: Time will move forward—and this will—be my fate?
target: 时间会继续向前——而这就会——成为我的命运？

source: Yes, that would seem to make good sense.
target: 是的，这样说倒是很有道理。

source: ...Or, Option B, you could just stop thinking about it so hard.
target: ……或者，还有第二种选择，你可以别再这么费劲地琢磨了。

source: I hate those people at the theater. Always scrutinizing everything to death.
target: 我讨厌剧院里的那些人。什么都要翻来覆去地分析个没完。

source: We're all here to see you off. Even the dead are here. Isn't that enough?
target: 我们都是来给你送行的。连死去的人都来了。这还不够吗？

source: The dead?
target: 死去的人？

source: Indeed. For a small while, the Book of Fates can make even this miracle possible.
target: 没错。命运之书甚至能让这样的奇迹短暂地成为现实。

source: Then I won't waste this chance, everyone.
target: 那我不会浪费这个机会的，各位。

source: I'm going to make the best decision I can.
target: 我会尽我所能，做出最好的决定。

source: Marvelous. Let's get to it.
target: 太好了。我们开始吧。

source: Aah, she's here, she's here!
target: 啊，她来了，她来了！

source: Places, everyone! Please! It's time for the final curtain call!
target: 各位，请就位！拜托了！最后的谢幕要开始了！

source: If you'll allow me, I shall set the scene.
target: 容我先交代一下眼下的情形。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to end her life.
target: 上次我们离开奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用命运之书结束自己的生命。

source: What say you about this, friends?
target: 朋友们，你们对此有什么看法？

source: I'm opposed, of course.
target: 我当然反对。

source: As am I. Ophelia, how could you even think of leaving us like that?
target: 我也反对。奥菲莉娅，你怎么连这样离开我们的念头都能有？

source: I love you. I want you to live on. I can't imagine a complete life without you.
target: 我爱你。我希望你继续活下去。我无法想象，没有你的人生还能完整。

source: Oh, you can't imagine life without her? You, who would leave her to gallivant around Paris?
target: 哦，你无法想象没有她的生活？你可是会丢下她，跑去巴黎寻欢作乐的人啊？

source: Forty thousand brothers could not, with all their quantity of love, make up my sum—
target: 四十个千，也就是四万个兄弟，把他们所有的爱加在一起，也抵不过我的爱——

source: Stop that, lads. Stop bickering. Need everything be a competition with you two?
target: 够了，小伙子们。别吵了。你们两个非得什么事都争个高下吗？

source: ...Ophelia, dear heart, you already know my thoughts.
target: ……奥菲莉娅，心爱的孩子，你已经知道我的想法了。

source: To think of losing you the way I lost your mother—it would crush me.
target: 想到我会像失去你母亲那样失去你——我会崩溃的。

source: I'm certain I couldn't survive it.
target: 我知道自己一定撑不下去。

source: You are one of the few good things in our life. In all of our lives.
target: 你是我们生命中为数不多的美好之一。我们所有人都是如此。

source: Things might seem dark now. But isn't there another way, my love? Surely there must be.
target: 现在也许看不到希望。可是，亲爱的，就没有别的办法了吗？一定还有的。

source: You're wrong.
target: 你错了。

source: I understand why you're saying this, Polonius. But you're wrong.
target: 我理解你为什么这么说，波洛涅斯。但你错了。

source: You know exactly what you're doing, don't you, Ophelia?
target: 你很清楚自己在做什么，对吧，奥菲莉娅？

source: If you were to die...
target: 如果你死了……

source: Then one by one, the next pieces fall. Your brother gets his revenge. The Danish throne begins to implode. Hamlet dies.
target: 接下来，局面就会一步步崩塌。你的哥哥会报仇。丹麦王室会开始从内部瓦解。哈姆雷特会死。

source: Everything goes to ruin.
target: 一切都会毁灭。

source: But the way things are now, in this country—it's festering from the inside. You see a side of it we don't.
target: 可是，看看这个国家如今的情形——它正在从内部腐烂。你看到了我们看不到的一面。

source: If you die, then that allows something new to be born. That's why I was sent to kill you once.
target: 如果你死了，就能让新的事物诞生。所以我曾经奉命去杀你。

source: To be frank, that's a future we should all be grateful for.
target: 坦白说，那是我们所有人都该心怀感激的未来。

source: But what is a future like that worth if Ophelia must suffer for it?
target: 可如果奥菲莉娅必须为此受苦，这样的未来又有什么价值？

source: She has done nothing wrong. She is innocent.
target: 她什么都没做错。她是无辜的。

source: It doesn't matter. She's the only one who can die to create this fate.
target: 那不重要。只有她的死，才能造就这样的命运。

source: My husband and I will suffer, too. This is a death sentence for us, Ophelia.
target: 我和我丈夫也会受苦。奥菲莉娅，这等于判了我们死刑。

source: It's true we... weren't always good. Both of us did things we aren't proud of.
target: 我们确实……不是一直都做得对。我们两个都做过让自己感到羞愧的事。

source: But if what Brit's saying is true, is it right that you condemn us to death for it?
target: 可如果布莉特说的是真的，你就该因此判我们死刑吗？

source: You have the choice to save us. I don't want to die! I want to live and find a way to be good!
target: 你可以选择救我们。我不想死！我想活下去，找到办法做个好人！

source: My wife speaks the truth. Choosing this ending leaves me with no path to redeem myself.
target: 我妻子说得对。选择这个结局，我就再也没有机会赎罪了。

source: Nor Hamlet.
target: 哈姆雷特也一样。

source: Yes. Although death is what I wished for, once--in my heart I've always been uncertain.
target: 是的。虽然我曾经渴望死亡——但在心里，我始终拿不定主意。

source: What if I was meant to live? What if there are greater things I could do for this world than to die?
target: 如果我本该活下去呢？如果比起死去，我还能为这个世界做些更有意义的事呢？

source: If you choose this fate, I'll never get to find out.
target: 如果你选择这个命运，我就永远没机会知道了。

source: This was the fate I brought upon myself by virtue of my inaction, once.
target: 我曾经因为自己的无所作为，给自己招来了这样的命运。

source: I did not know I had a choice to make at the time. I never found the Book of Fates. But in my heart of hearts, I chose it all the same.
target: 当时，我不知道自己还有选择。我从未找到命运之书。但在内心最深处，我终究还是选择了它。

source: If this is the future you desire, choose it with intent, Ophelia.
target: 如果这就是你想要的未来，就明确地选择它，奥菲莉娅。

source: Do not shy away from the world, as I did. Go into the darkness with strength. Go with purpose.
target: 不要像我一样逃避这个世界。坚强地走进黑暗。带着目标前行。

source: That is all.
target: 我要说的就这些。

source: Thank you, everyone.
target: 谢谢大家。

source: I think I know what I ought to know, now.
target: 我想，现在我已经知道了自己该知道的事。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to become Queen of Denmark.
target: 上次我们离开奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用命运之书成为丹麦王后。

source: We recently announced the news to all at Elsinore.
target: 我们最近已经向埃尔西诺的所有人宣布了这个消息。

source: Once the tide of war has receded, we'll make the leap from betrothal to wedding.
target: 等战火平息，我们就会从订婚走向成婚。

source: Admittedly, there will be some pushback, but... I believe there's ample standing here to make Ophelia my wife.
