target: 诚然，会有一些反对的声音，但……我相信，我有足够的依据迎娶奥菲莉娅。

source: But she... is the reason I'm dead.
target: 可是她……就是我死去的原因。

source: Were it not for you, Ophelia, I'd be with my husband.
target: 如果不是因为你，奥菲莉娅，我还会和我丈夫在一起。

source: I-- I know it is the birthright of a King that he have a Queen beside him.
target: 我——我知道，国王身边有一位王后，是他与生俱来的权利。

source: And my husband might have come to you himself in time, it's true.
target: 而且，假以时日，我丈夫也许会主动来找你，这倒是真的。

source: But you went to him and you ployed his affections in his moment of deepest despair, didn't you?
target: 但你去找了他，趁他最绝望的时候，耍手段利用了他的感情，不是吗？

source: You knew what you were doing.
target: 你清楚自己在做什么。

source: Yes, yes, that's certainly true! You played me like a fiddle!
target: 对，对，确实如此！你把我玩弄于股掌之间！

source: We ought to both hope that the real me never uncovers what you did!
target: 我们两个都该祈祷，真正的我永远不会发现你做过的事！

source: Yes, this was far from a healthy match. One might call it outright predatory on both ends.
target: 是啊，这段婚姻远谈不上健康。甚至可以说，双方都在肆无忌惮地掠夺对方。

source: Still, in spite of that, I think you'd make an excellent queen.
target: 不过，即便如此，我还是觉得你会成为一位出色的王后。

source: ...He's right, you know.
target: ……他说得没错。

source: I... don't think I can ever accept you marrying Claudius. I'll always be furious about that.
target: 我……觉得自己永远都无法接受你嫁给克劳狄斯。我永远都会为此愤怒。

source: He murdered my father. And you sided with him. That makes you a monster. You're no better than he is.
target: 他谋杀了我的父亲。而你站在了他那边。这样一来，你也是个恶魔。你并不比他好。

source: But even despite that, as a ruler, you have something in you that I never did.
target: 但即便如此，作为统治者，你身上有我从未拥有的东西。

source: You will need to be ruthlessly determined if you intend to survive the damage my father's death left behind.
target: 如果你想在我父亲的死所留下的创伤中活下来，就必须有冷酷而坚定的决心。

source: Well, I'm glad that I don't have to marry Hamlet or Claudius.
target: 嗯，我倒是很庆幸，既不用嫁给哈姆雷特，也不用嫁给克劳狄斯。

source: I was afraid my father would want to make a political match. And I came rather close.
target: 我原本怕父亲想安排一桩政治联姻。而我差一点就躲不过去了。

source: Now the two of us may be wed.
target: 现在我们两个可以结婚了。

source: I didn't think of that! Yes, hrm... yes... a delightful match, if her father is willing.
target: 我倒没想到这一点！是啊，嗯……是啊……如果她父亲愿意，那会是一桩美好的婚事。

source: Under ordinary circumstances, he wouldn't be. But with Laertes' sister as the new Queen, things have shifted.
target: 通常他是不会愿意的。但雷欧提斯的妹妹成了新王后，情况就不同了。

source: So thank you, Ophelia. Your decision might bring the two of us some happiness, at least.
target: 所以，谢谢你，奥菲莉娅。你的决定至少可能给我们两个带来一些幸福。

source: Although I never knew for certain that Claudius was his brother's killer...
target: 虽然我从未确知克劳狄斯就是杀害他哥哥的凶手……

source: I always suspected it, in my heart of hearts. I don't know that I could ever live happy, seeing my daughter at his side.
target: 但在内心最深处，我一直有所怀疑。看着女儿陪在他身边，我不知道自己还能不能过得快乐。

source: It is strange, how these matters bear forth.
target: 这些事竟会这样发展，真是奇怪。

source: You are a source of myriad surprises. I would never have anticipated this.
target: 你总能带来无数意外。我绝想不到会有这样的结果。

source: It is not my place to pass judgement on this union. Nor is it Gertrude's, in the end.
target: 我没有资格评判这段婚姻。说到底，乔特鲁德也没有。

source: After all, this is not our world any longer.
target: 毕竟，这已经不再是我们的世界了。

source: It belongs to the living. To you.
target: 它属于活着的人。属于你。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to sail off on Grace O'Malley's stolen vessel.
target: 上次我们离开奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用命运之书，乘着格蕾丝·奥马利偷来的船扬帆远去。

source: I see. So you're leaving us.
target: 我明白了。所以你要离开我们。

source: If you go, Ophelia, the rest of them shall tear each other apart, I fear.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果你走了，恐怕剩下的人会自相残杀。

source: Without you, there's nothing good remaining in Elsinore. We will all surely die.
target: 没有你，埃尔西诺就再没有任何美好的东西了。我们所有人肯定都会死。

source: And I'm already dead in this world, or so traumatized by my experiences with Hamlet that I ask to leave Elsinore forever. There's no returning from that.
target: 而在这个世界里，我要么已经死了，要么被与哈姆雷特之间的遭遇伤得太深，主动要求永远离开埃尔西诺。那之后就再也回不来了。

source: It's true. Every time, we are sent to sea because I tried to kill your father. Because I am too dangerous to contain.
target: 确实如此。每一次，我们都是因为我试图杀死你父亲，才被送出海的。因为我太危险，已经无法控制。

source: Ophelia... why would you leave us in our darkest hour?
target: 奥菲莉娅……你为什么要在我们最黑暗的时刻离开？

source: Are we so utterly worthless to you that you'd cast us aside for your own joy?
target: 在你眼里，我们就那么一文不值，让你为了自己的快乐就能抛下我们？

source: Even I must admit the thought is troubling.
target: 就连我也得承认，想到这个就让人不安。

source: Please. Don't abandon us.
target: 求你了。别抛弃我们。

source: Don't go, sister. We still need you.
target: 别走，妹妹。我们还需要你。

source: Ophelia! What'd I miss?
target: 奥菲莉娅！我错过什么了？

source: What are you doing here?
target: 你怎么会在这里？

source: Coulda asked myself that same question. But hell, here I am.
target: 我也想问自己这个问题。可管他呢，我反正来了。

source: I hate bein' out 'ere on shore. I jes' feel useless.
target: 我讨厌待在这岸上。总觉得自己一点用都没有。

source: Anyway. Off we go! C'mon!
target: 不管了。咱们走！快来！

source: Hold a moment. Ophelia has not consented to leave us behind yet.
target: 等一下。奥菲莉娅还没有答应抛下我们。

source: And if she does, we shall all perish.
target: 而如果她答应了，我们就全都会死。

source: Oh, I see! This is such an interestin' quandary.
target: 哦，我懂了！这可真是个有意思的难题。

source: So yer options, Ophelia, are t' come with me an' set sail for a life of adventure...
target: 所以，奥菲莉娅，你的选择是跟我走，扬帆出海，过上冒险的日子……

source: Drinkin', fuckin', and pillagin' every island we come across, cartin' mountains of gold from secret cove to secret cove...
target: 喝酒、操个痛快，洗劫每一座遇上的岛，把堆成山的金子从一个秘密海湾运到另一个……

source: Seein' sights no man or woman has ever laid eyes on before...
target: 看遍无论男人还是女人都从未见过的景色……

source: Then retirin' with yer pile o' gold to the private castle of yer choosin'...
target: 然后带着你那堆金子，挑座属于自己的城堡，退休享福……

source: Or dyin' here like a dog with all o' these self-righteous, boring-as-boiled-chicken fools!
target: 或者留在这儿，跟这群自以为是、像白水煮鸡一样寡淡无趣的蠢货，像狗一样死掉！

source: What an interesting, nuanced decision.
target: 这选择可真是有趣，又耐人寻味啊。

source: Don't you ever get tired o' strugglin' so much?
target: 你这么苦苦挣扎，就从来不觉得累吗？

source: Seems t'me like it's time to look out for number one—to scratch yer own back for once.
target: 要我说，也该把自己放在头一位了——就为自己着想一次。

source: It's not that simple, Grace. This is my family. These are people I've known my whole life.
target: 没那么简单，格蕾丝。这是我的家人。这些人，我从小就认识。

source: This world requires me to leave the people I love to die by each other's hand, and to take Denmark down with them.
target: 在这个世界里，我得抛下我爱的人，让他们死在彼此手里，把丹麦也一同拖向毁灭。

source: It is tempting to flee responsibility for the lives of those you love.
target: 逃避对所爱之人生命的责任，确实很诱人。

source: I sought to do the same.
target: 我也曾想这么做。

source: No man or woman could lay blame with you.
target: 没有人能责怪你。

source: But I fled, and I have spent every moment of consciousness since regretting the world I chose.
target: 但我逃了，从那以后，只要意识还在，我每时每刻都在后悔自己选择的世界。

source: Whatever you choose—whatever fate you grant yourself—do not forget that you must live dreaming of the faces you left behind.
target: 无论你选择什么——无论你赋予自己怎样的命运——都别忘了，此后活着的日子里，那些被你留下的面孔会一直出现在你的梦中。

source: I love you, Ophelia.
target: 我爱你，奥菲莉娅。

source: As do I. With all my heart. A world without my little sister in it isn't one worth having.
target: 我也爱你。全心全意地爱你。一个没有我妹妹的世界，不值得拥有。

source: Yes. What would we do without you?
target: 是啊。没有你，我们该怎么办？

source: I cannot imagine it. Not without great difficulty.
target: 我无法想象。至少很难想象。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to elope with Othello the barkeep.
target: 上次我们离开奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用命运之书，与酒馆老板奥赛罗私奔。

source: You hardly know this man, Ophelia. How can you be certain you want to leave with him?
target: 你几乎不了解这个男人，奥菲莉娅。怎么能确定自己想跟他走？

source: Oh, that's no matter to me. Why, my sister married a man she'd met but once as a child. It's very common!
target: 哦，我倒不在意这个。你看，我的姐妹嫁给了一个只在小时候见过一面的男人。这很常见！

source: In fact, perhaps the best matches are made between strangers.
target: 其实，也许最美满的婚姻，恰恰是由陌生人结成的。

source: There's room for the marriage to grow, you see.
target: 你看，这样婚姻才有慢慢发展的余地。

source: I merely hope your heart is ready for the difficulties which lie ahead of you. Leaving your life behind is no small feat, my love.
target: 我只是希望，你心里已经准备好面对前方的困难。亲爱的，抛下原来的生活可不是件容易的事。

source: The Queen is correct. Are you prepared for the burdens you might have to endure?
target: 王后说得对。你准备好承受可能要面对的重担了吗？

source: She'll be just fine. I'm certain of it.
target: 她会过得很好的。我对此深信不疑。

source: After all, Ophelia's been no stranger to hardship lately!
target: 毕竟，奥菲莉娅最近可没少经历苦难！

source: If this is what you desire, then so be it.
target: 如果这就是你想要的，那就这样吧。

source: Please, everyone, listen.
target: 各位，请听我说。

source: I know my origins are humble, my intentions unclear.
target: 我知道自己出身卑微，也没让大家看清我的用意。

source: I have never been a man given to certainty and to stability. My life has woven its course through many ditches and peaks.
target: 我从来不是一个笃定、安稳的人。我的人生一路曲折，经历过许多低谷与高峰。

source: But... I love Ophelia. And I know it to be true to the core of everything in me.
target: 但是……我爱奥菲莉娅。我整个人，从内到外，都确信这份爱是真的。

source: Never before could I see that my life was weaving towards something.
target: 过去，我从未看出自己曲折的人生竟在走向某个目标。

source: But now, all roads lead to her. My old life has turned to ash. And I wish for nothing more.
target: 可如今，所有的路都通向她。我过去的生活已化为灰烬。而我别无所求。

source: Come with me, Ophelia. Take my hand.
target: 跟我走吧，奥菲莉娅。牵住我的手。

source: Not so fast, Ophelia.
target: 先别急，奥菲莉娅。

source: You've heard my warning, and yet you still explore this world.
target: 你听过我的警告，却仍然在探索这个世界。

source: You know all these words he's saying will go right into someone else's ear someday!
target: 你明知道，他现在说的这些话，总有一天也会说给别人听！

source: It's like watching a moth drive itself right into the open lantern.
target: 这就像看着一只飞蛾，一头扑进敞开的灯笼里。

source: I wouldn't call us chums, you and me, but even I must admit I'd wish better for you.
target: 你我算不上好朋友，但就连我也得承认，我希望你能有个更好的结果。

source: Then leave. You don't have to be here for this.
target: 那就走吧。你没必要留在这里看这些。

source: Have it your way, then.
target: 那就随你吧。

source: The fleeting worlds are always the sweetest, and the harshest when they're gone.
target: 转瞬即逝的世界总是最甜美的，消逝时也最残酷。

source: Though he trades in deception, he speaks one truth.
target: 他虽以欺骗为业，却有一句话说得不错。

source: This world guarantees a short but true happiness.
target: 这个世界能给你短暂却真实的幸福。

source: Most live life without ever experiencing such a thing. I certainly did. So shall many of these good people before us.
target: 大多数人终其一生都未曾拥有过这样的幸福。我便是如此。眼前这些好人中，也有许多人会这样度过一生。

source: Do not underestimate the power of a few good years to transform the course of your life...
target: 不要小看几年美好时光的力量，它足以改变你的人生轨迹……

source: ...Even if those good years are certain to end.
target: ……即使那些美好的岁月注定会结束。

source: Most ordinary folk choose love not knowing where the future might lead.
target: 大多数普通人选择去爱时，并不知道未来会走向何方。

source: Quince has cursed you with this knowing. He's poisoned you. And he knows it.
target: 奎因斯让你知晓未来，给你下了这样的诅咒。他毒害了你。而他自己知道这一点。

source: But your feelings for Othello, and his for you, are written on both of your faces.
target: 但你对奥赛罗的感情，还有他对你的感情，都写在你们各自的脸上。

source: If you choose this world, go into it gladly. Do not let the inevitable pain rob the intensity of your love.
target: 如果你选择这个世界，就欣然走进去。不要让注定到来的痛苦削弱你爱的热烈。

source: Or surely, the Playmaster will have won in the end.
target: 否则，最终赢的就一定是那位戏剧大师。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to leave Elsinore on her own after Fortinbras' invasion, abandoning everyone to their respective fates.
target: 上回说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备使用《命运之书》，在福丁布拉斯入侵后独自离开埃尔西诺，抛下所有人，让他们各自面对自己的命运。

source: That's certainly an option. Leave your old life behind. Find a fresh start.
target: 这当然也是一种选择。告别过去的生活，重新开始。

source: A fresh start?
target: 重新开始？

source: What does that mean? The rest of us are left to slaughter each other in that world!
target: 这话是什么意思？我们其他人就被留在那个世界里自相残杀！

source: I-I agree! And I'm the very one most likely to die! I do have an interest in self-preservation, you know!
target: 我、我也这么想！而且我才是最可能死的那个！要知道，我可也想保住自己的命！

source: As... do I, I'm afraid. Ophelia. You would be leaving us all to a most disconcerting fate.
target: 恐怕……我也是。奥菲莉娅。你这样会把我们所有人留给一个令人极度不安的命运。

source: Certainly none of us are perfect beings. But do we deserve death and the destruction of all we hold dear?
target: 我们当然都不完美。但我们就该死，就该眼看珍视的一切都被毁掉吗？

source: Tell me how that can be fair! It cannot, can it?
target: 告诉我，这怎么能算公平！这不公平，不是吗？

source: I must admit...
target: 我得承认……

source: I am... frightened... to die. I don't know what it might be like.
target: 我……害怕……死亡。我不知道那会是什么样。

source: It is a sleep which one has no memory of entering.
target: 那是一场沉睡，你不会记得自己是如何睡去的。

source: It is not the sovereign Heaven we were promised, Bernardo. But it is a dreamless peace, and an untroubled one.
target: 贝尔纳多，那并非我们曾被许诺的至高天堂。但那是一份无梦的安宁，没有任何烦扰。

source: I suppose I was holding out hope. Well, that's no good.
target: 看来我一直还抱着希望。唉，这可不好。

source: My sweet.
target: 我的宝贝。

source: Please. Listen. I beg of you.
target: 请你。听我说。求你了。

source: All I've ever wanted for you, more than anything in this world, is to live and be happy.
target: 我一直只希望你能活着，过得幸福。这比世上任何事都更让我在意。

source: From the moment I first held you and looked into your eyes, I knew that I would gladly die to give you a chance at that happiness.
target: 从我第一次抱着你、望进你眼睛的那一刻起，我就知道，只要能给你一个获得那份幸福的机会，我就甘愿赴死。

source: If you think this is the fate you desire, then I am powerless to tell you otherwise.
target: 如果你认为这就是你想要的命运，那我也无力劝你改变心意。

source: Your brother and I sealed our fates long ago. We dealt in the world of wicked men. We knew we were making war. But we didn't care.
target: 你哥哥和我早已注定了自己的命运。我们在恶人的世界里周旋。我们知道自己在挑起争斗，却毫不在乎。

source: Father's right.
target: 父亲说得对。

source: None of us were innocent in this bloodbath. If Elsinore must fall, then perhaps we should fall with it.
target: 这场血腥杀戮里，我们谁都不无辜。如果埃尔西诺注定要覆灭，那也许我们就该与它一同覆灭。

source: That's... why...
target: 所以……才……

source: You must live, Ophelia. You must live on. No matter what happens. Please!
target: 你一定要活着，奥菲莉娅。你一定要活下去。无论发生什么。求你了！

source: Tell me you will!
target: 告诉我，你会活下去！

source: I have a request of you, too.
target: 我也有件事想求你。

source: ...If this is the fate you choose, and you really do leave Elsinore...
target: ……如果这就是你选择的命运，如果你真的离开了埃尔西诺……

source: I want you to find people who love you with all their heart. People who are—good, and whole. Not like me. Not like all of us.
target: 我希望你能找到全心全意爱你的人。那些——善良、内心完整的人。别像我。别像我们这些人。

source: If you leave Elsinore, then the whole, wide world awaits you. You could go anywhere. See anything.
target: 如果你离开埃尔西诺，整个辽阔的世界都在等着你。你可以去任何地方。见识任何事物。

source: You have a room full of people here who all thought they loved you, of course.
target: 当然，这一屋子的人都曾以为自己爱你。

source: But I'm only realizing this now. To us, love is owning something, breaking it, crushing it as you hold it too tightly.
target: 但我直到现在才明白。对我们来说，爱就是占有，就是把它弄坏，因为抓得太紧而将它捏碎。

source: Think carefully upon this, Ophelia.
target: 仔细想一想，奥菲莉娅。

source: You can never turn back.
target: 你永远都无法回头。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to leave Elsinore with myself and Guildenstern, abandoning everyone to their respective fates.
target: 上回说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备使用《命运之书》，和我、吉尔登斯吞一起离开埃尔西诺，抛下所有人，让他们各自面对自己的命运。

source: I must admit, I'm a tad biased towards this proposal.
target: 我得承认，我对这个提议有那么一点偏心。

source: Me, too! We'll have so much fun, Ophelia. It really is a massive world out there, you know!
target: 我也是！我们会玩得很开心的，奥菲莉娅。你知道吗，外面的世界真的大得很！

source: And after a while, you just cease caring about anything you leave behind. It's simple! Just crunch it all down into a little ball of nothingness!
target: 而且过一阵子，你就不会再在乎留下的任何东西了。很简单！把它们全都压成一小团虚无就行！

source: Nary so much as a 'goodbye' wave. That's how we like to travel.
target: 连挥手道别都省了。我们就喜欢这样出发。

source: Hm. I must say, this is an option I myself have pursued a few times.
target: 嗯。我得说，我自己也做过几次这样的选择。

source: So that's it? You're off to go enjoy yourself across Europe as the rest of us die here?
target: 就这样？你要去欧洲各地逍遥快活，留我们其他人死在这里？

source: I thought you a stronger woman than that, Ophelia. I would never in all my life abandon you.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我以为你是个更坚强的女人。我这辈子都不会抛下你。

source: He's right, Ophelia. Certainly none of us are perfect. It could be argued that few of us are good. But I am... afraid to die.
target: 他说得对，奥菲莉娅。我们当然都不完美。或许可以说，我们中没几个算得上好人。但我……害怕死亡。

source: Please. I've always loved you like my own daughter. Don't abandon me now. You have a responsibility to us, just as we did to you.
target: 求你了。我一直像爱亲生女儿一样爱你。别在这时候抛下我。你对我们有责任，就像我们曾对你有责任一样。

source: Yes. Responsibility. That's the word.
target: 对。责任。就是这个词。

source: Irresponsible? That's what you think this choice is? I never asked to be here!
target: 不负责任？你们觉得这个选择就是不负责任？我从没要求来这里！

source: Is it so selfish of me to seek out some happiness in this miserable situation?
target: 身处这样悲惨的境地，我想找一点幸福，就有那么自私吗？

source: You went to Paris for that same reason, didn't you? To escape Elsinore. To be free.
target: 你去巴黎，不也是为了这个吗？为了逃离埃尔西诺。为了自由。

source: I told your brother this once, a long time ago.
target: 很久以前，我曾对你哥哥说过这句话。

source: To thine own self be true.
target: 忠于你自己。

source: It's true now more than ever. Even if--
target: 如今这句话比以往任何时候都更有道理。即使——

source: Even if it means I'll never see my beloved daughter again.
target: 即使这意味着我再也见不到心爱的女儿。

source: Just know that I have always loved you with everything in my heart, and I would gladly die if it brought you eternal happiness.
target: 你只要知道，我一直全心全意地爱着你。只要能换来你永远的幸福，我就甘愿赴死。

source: I suppose Father's right.
target: 我想父亲说得对。

source: I did try to leave for Paris to make a new life for myself.
target: 我确实试过离开这里，去巴黎开始自己的新生活。

source: And perhaps, if I had succeeded, none of these horrible worlds would have come to pass.
target: 而且，如果我当时成功了，也许这些可怕的世界就都不会出现。

source: Go, Ophelia.
target: 走吧，奥菲莉娅。

source: You were the only thing worth living for.
target: 你曾是我活下去的唯一理由。

source: If you leave Elsinore, then the rest of us might as well perish, in my humble opinion.
target: 如果你离开埃尔西诺，依我拙见，我们剩下的人也不如死了算了。

source: I--  think I could make something good and useful of myself, had I lived. But I'll never know for sure.
target: 我——觉得，如果我活下来了，我也许能成为一个善良、有用的人。但我永远没法确定了。

source: And that is not an obligation you bear me: to trade your own destiny for mine.
target: 而你并没有义务为我这么做：拿你自己的命运来换我的。

source: So, go. Go, and live.
target: 所以，走吧。走吧，活下去。

source: Pfft. You're all taking this so seriously.
target: 嘁。你们也太当真了。

source: I admit, it rather takes me by surprise, Guilda.
target: 我承认，这还真让我挺意外的，吉尔达。

source: No wonder you're all shanking each other and soliloquizing all over the place!
target: 难怪你们一个个互相捅刀子，还走到哪儿都要来一段独白！

source: Let's begone from this place. All three of us.
target: 我们离开这地方吧。我们三个一起。

source: Ophelia, let me give you a little advice, Guildenstern Special Style:
target: 奥菲莉娅，让我给你一点吉尔登斯吞式的独家忠告：

source: You aren't responsible for the horrible things anyone does to anyone else.
target: 别人对彼此做出的那些可怕的事，不是你的责任。

source: So stop thinking about it, and just enjoy yourself!
target: 所以别再想这些了，好好享受吧！

source: Truly, that's all that matters in this world.
target: 说真的，这就是世上唯一要紧的事。

source: That, and understanding exactly how many sweetrolls you can eat before you puke.
target: 还有，要弄清楚你究竟能吃多少个甜面包卷才会吐。

source: Thirteen. Thirteen is that number.
target: 十三个。答案就是十三个。

source: Let's see if we can reach fourteen tonight!
target: 看看我们今晚能不能吃到十四个！

source: Agreed. Shall we go?
target: 好。我们走吧？

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to choose exile for her family from Elsinore forever.
target: 上回说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备使用《命运之书》，选择让她的家人永远被流放出埃尔西诺。

source: Certainly, it's no trouble to me. I've longed for nothing more than to leave the castle behind.
target: 当然，我没什么意见。我一直最盼望的就是离开这座城堡。

source: But if we leave court... Father must relinquish his advisory role to the throne.
target: 但如果我们离开宫廷……父亲就必须辞去王室顾问的职务。

source: That role means everything to him.
target: 那个职位就是他的一切。

source: It did, once.
target: 曾经是。

source: But these last few days have given me unnatural pause.
target: 但这几天让我产生了异乎寻常的犹疑。

source: After all, in other worlds, Hamlet kills me, and... no one grieves my loss.
target: 毕竟，在其他世界里，哈姆雷特杀了我，而……没有人为我的死感到悲伤。

source: If that's the measure of my use to the King and Queen, then what must I do to make them rethink their feelings towards me?
target: 如果这就是我在国王和王后眼中的价值，那我到底要怎么做，才能让他们重新考虑对我的感情？

source: You gave me no reason to trust you, Polonius!
target: 你从没给过我信任你的理由，波洛涅斯！

source: You were never secretive about your undying faith to my brother.
target: 你从来不掩饰自己对我兄长至死不渝的忠诚。

source: Always hiding things from me, going behind my back to stir up trouble...
target: 总是对我隐瞒事情，背着我挑起事端……

source: Because I swore an oath to him in life!
target: 因为我在他生前就向他立过誓！

source: To you, my lord!
target: 向您立过誓，陛下！

source: I will always honor your memory, my King.
target: 我会永远怀着敬意缅怀您，我的国王。

source: But it is time for my children and me to move on.
target: 但我和孩子们也该继续自己的人生了。

source: I could never hold such a thing against you, Polonius.
target: 我绝不会因此怪你，波洛涅斯。

source: After all, you let even your own lands and estates go fallow in your mission to uphold the throne.
target: 毕竟，为了维护王位，你甚至任由自己的土地和庄园荒废。

source: It's true. Our family has nothing, for all our titles. We are quite penniless, I'm afraid.
target: 确实如此。我们家虽有这些头衔，却一无所有。恐怕已经身无分文了。

source: Had I been more actively managing our estates, we might have found more success.
target: 如果我当初更用心经营庄园，我们或许会过得更好。

source: But years of idleness on that front--all in the interest of better dedicating myself to His Majesty--have run our coffers dry.
target: 但我为了更好地效忠陛下，多年来疏于经营——如今家里的钱已经耗尽了。

source: Then where shall we live, Father?
target: 那我们要住在哪里，父亲？

source: In the last remaining estate we have. A small and forgotten place. It is far from the luxury of Elsinore Castle.
target: 住在我们仅剩的那座庄园里。那地方很小，也被人遗忘了。远比不上埃尔西诺城堡的奢华。

source: That's unfortunate to hear. But it is clear we cannot stay here.
target: 听到这消息真遗憾。但显然，我们不能留在这里。

source: If this is the world Ophelia chooses, then we must go to that forgotten place and see if we can't turn our fortunes around.
target: 如果这就是奥菲莉娅选择的世界，那我们就得去那个被遗忘的地方，看看能不能让家里的境况好转。

source: I find the notion unlikely. I fear this may be the very last of our noble house.
target: 我觉得希望不大。恐怕我们这个贵族家族就要走到尽头了。

source: That's what this world would mean.
target: 这个世界会意味着这样的结局。

source: I see. Then, sister, I hope you make the right choice.
target: 我明白了。那么，妹妹，希望你能做出正确的选择。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to remain in a perfect place forever.
target: 上回说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备使用《命运之书》，永远留在一个完美的地方。

source: We're all ready for you.
target: 我们都准备好迎接你了。

source: Ophelia! We were just saying your name. Speak of the devil!
target: 奥菲莉娅！我们刚刚还在说你呢。说谁谁就到！

source: What's going on here, everyone?
target: 大家，这里是怎么回事？

source: Well, we were waiting for you to tell us that.
target: 嗯，我们正等着你来告诉我们呢。

source: Yes, Lady Ophelia. You're the storyteller of this world. Anything you imagine, we can do.
target: 是的，奥菲莉娅女士。你是这个世界的故事讲述者。你想象得到的事，我们都能做到。

source: If you wanted to write me a larger part, I wouldn't be opposed to that...
target: 如果你想给我多写点戏份，我也不会反对……

source: Or if you wanted to cut Hamlet out of the narrative altogether. That's an option, too.
target: 或者你想把哈姆雷特从故事里彻底删掉，也可以。

source: Lads! Stop that talk, immediately. This is about Ophelia's desires. Not yours.
target: 小伙子们！立刻住口。这里要考虑的是奥菲莉娅的愿望，不是你们的。

source: You're right, Father.
target: 您说得对，父亲。

source: Ophelia, I apologize. Merely command us and we will do your bidding.
target: 奥菲莉娅，对不起。你只管下令，我们会照你的吩咐做。

source: And if you don't like the result—merely tell us to act differently, again and again.
target: 如果你不喜欢结果——只要叫我们换一种做法就行，一遍又一遍。

source: We'll be here forever. And we'll never leave, or be harmed by anything, or pass away.
target: 我们会永远留在这里。永不离开，不受任何伤害，也不会死去。

source: Unless that's your desire, of course.
target: 当然，除非你希望如此。

source: In which case, we'd be happy to oblige.
target: 那样的话，我们也很乐意照办。

source: You could even create a world where I was nice to you. Just think about that for a moment!
target: 你甚至可以创造一个我会对你友善的世界。好好想想吧！

source: It's insane, isn't it?
target: 真是疯了，对吧？

source: Ophelia. Cease this.
target: 奥菲莉娅。停下。

source: You cannot stay in this world.
target: 你不能留在这个世界里。

source: It has lingered long past its due.
target: 它早就该结束了，却拖延至今。

source: How can you be certain of that?
target: 你怎么能确定？

source: Look at this. Look at how happy they all are.
target: 你看看。看看他们都多么开心。

source: This version of Elsinore... is merely a fantasy.
target: 这样的埃尔西诺……不过是个幻想。

source: It is a trick invented by your own mind.
target: 这是你自己的头脑编造出来的骗局。

source: This version of events may never come to pass. This is the reality of this world when all illusion is wiped away. You are alone.
target: 这样的事情也许永远不会发生。当一切幻象被抹去，这才是这个世界的真实面貌。你只有自己一个人。

source: In life, I did not fight Insanity. I relinquished myself to her. I was subjugated, consumed, and finally death took me.
target: 生前，我没有与疯狂抗争。我把自己交给了她。我被她征服、吞噬，最终被死亡带走。

source: Think carefully on whether you wish to do the same.
target: 仔细想想，你是否也想这么做。

source: While you lie in the grip of your delusion, everyone still alive will meet a grisly fate. No amount of dreaming can save them from that.
target: 当你困在妄想之中时，所有还活着的人都会遭遇惨烈的命运。做再多的梦也救不了他们。

source: If I choose this ending... I have to accept... that it can never be real.
target: 如果我选择这个结局……我就必须接受……它永远不可能是真的。

source: But it felt real. It still can.
target: 可它感觉那么真实。它仍然可以给我这种感觉。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to hold off Fortinbras' invasion and save everyone's lives.
target: 上次说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用《命运之书》阻止福丁布拉斯的入侵，救下所有人的性命。

source: S-so she did it! She's saved us all from a tragic fate!
target: 那、那她成功了！她让我们所有人都逃过了悲惨的命运！

source: Ah... so it would seem.
target: 啊……看来是这样。

source: I for one am thrilled to not be the only one left alive.
target: 至少我高兴极了，总算不是只有我一个人活下来了。

source: As much as you're all a group of rather moody, melodramatic fools, you've become my melodramatic fools.
target: 虽然你们都是一群情绪多变、爱小题大做的傻瓜，但如今，你们已经是我的那群傻瓜了。

source: I did not think I would live long enough to spend all the money I made fleecing the guards out of their pay.
target: 我本以为自己活不到把从卫兵那里骗来的军饷全花光的那一天。

source: What a relief it is to be proven wrong.
target: 发现自己想错了，真让人松了一口气。

source: And I'm sure you'll steal a lot more of their pay before you go to your grave kicking, old woman.
target: 我相信，在你蹬着腿、不甘心地进坟墓之前，你还会偷走他们更多的军饷，老太婆。

source: Yes, or until they grow wiser about my loaded dice. I'm sure I'll die before that happens. Idiots.
target: 没错，除非他们长点脑子，看出我的骰子做了手脚。不过我肯定等不到那天就死了。一群蠢货。

source: At one point, I wanted nothing more than to die.
target: 曾有一段时间，我一心只想死。

source: Now the gift of life is thrust upon us.
target: 如今，生命这份礼物却被硬塞给了我们。

source: Even those of us who didn't deserve to live are here.
target: 就连我们当中那些不配活着的人，也还在这里。

source: Stop that, Hamlet.
target: 别这样说，哈姆雷特。

source: It's true you and your uncle have been at odds lately. However...
target: 你和你叔叔最近确实不和。不过……

source: Now that the war is won, there is time for peace to come to us all, in our own ways, in our own time!
target: 如今战争已经打赢了，我们都有时间按自己的方式、自己的步调，找到各自的安宁！

source: Yes, we ought to celebrate this gift of peace we've all been given!
target: 是啊，我们应该庆祝这份赐予我们所有人的和平！

source: Your Highness... the war is not won.
target: 殿下……这场战争还没打赢。

source: Did you think the war was over?
target: 您以为战争已经结束了吗？

source: It... it isn't?
target: 还……还没有？

source: No. Of course it isn't.
target: 没有。当然没有。

source: Fortinbras may have been stopped for now, but he is relentless, and his men are brutally faithful to him.
target: 福丁布拉斯眼下或许被挡住了，但他不会善罢甘休，他的手下也对他死心塌地，凶残至极。

source: They will come for him. And when he is free, they will come for our country.
target: 他们会来救他。等他重获自由，他们就会来夺取我们的国家。

source: But we are well prepared. I've rallied good men to my side. Useful men.
target: 但我们已经做好了充分的准备。我已经召集了一批优秀的人到我身边。都是能派上用场的人。

source: Let us give them a fight worth fighting!
target: 就让我们和他们痛痛快快地打一场！

source: This won't be a fight. It'll be a slow massacre.
target: 这不会是一场交战，而是一场缓慢的屠杀。

source: Only a war of attrition lies ahead.
target: 前方等着我们的，只有一场消耗战。

source: What she speaks is truth, my lord. Fortinbras will not relent. And neither shall we.
target: 陛下，她说的是真的。福丁布拉斯不会退让，我们也不会。

source: The men we have rallied are sufficient, but not a force worth marveling at. I predict weary years ahead.
target: 我们召集的兵力够用，却远称不上强大。我预计，往后多年都会疲于征战。

source: We averted a coup. We have not won a war.
target: 我们阻止了一场政变，却没有赢得一场战争。

source: Then we shall all bear witness to whatever mysteries the future brings.
target: 那么，无论未来带来怎样的未知，我们都将一同见证。

source: I suppose we cannot truly know. Not yet.
target: 我想，我们确实无从知道。至少现在还不知道。

source: That is the summary of it, yes.
target: 是的，大致就是如此。

source: Consider your options carefully, Ophelia.
target: 仔细考虑你有哪些选择，奥菲莉娅。

source: Life in place of death is not always a gift. You and I know that truest of all.
target: 以生代死，并不总是一份恩赐。你我比谁都清楚这一点。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to marry Prince Hamlet and become Queen of Denmark.
target: 上次说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用《命运之书》嫁给哈姆雷特王子，成为丹麦王后。

source: What say you all about this?
target: 大家对此有什么看法？

source: Excellent. Good riddance to both of you.
target: 太好了。总算摆脱你们两个了。

source: And a special thanks to you, Ophelia. You've saved me from a life of having to be near Hamlet.
target: 尤其要谢谢你，奥菲莉娅。多亏了你，我不用一辈子待在哈姆雷特身边了。

source: Evidently my mood of late was more offensive to all of you than I thought.
target: 看来我最近的坏情绪，比我想的还要让大家讨厌。

source: Happens to the best of us, Hamlet. But it seems as though this betrothal has turned your state around.
target: 再好的人也有这种时候，哈姆雷特。不过，看来这次订婚让你的状态好转了。

source: Much as I hate to admit it, I've never seen you happier.
target: 虽然不愿承认，但我从没见过你这么开心。

source: I suppose... it's changed me.
target: 我想……这确实改变了我。

source: Everyone, I must apologize for my mood as of late.
target: 各位，我必须为最近的坏情绪向大家道歉。

source: It's been the darkest year of my life. There were moments when I prayed for death more fervently than I've ever wanted anything.
target: 这是我一生中最黑暗的一年。有些时候，我祈求死亡的心，比我对任何事物的渴望都要强烈。

source: But... Ophelia showed me a world where it was possible to reclaim who I was before.
target: 但是……奥菲莉娅让我看到了一个世界，在那里，我还有可能找回从前的自己。

source: The old me wasn't gone. He was merely buried under the weight of paralyzing fear.
target: 从前的我并没有消失。他只是被令人动弹不得的恐惧压在了深处。

source: And I'm no longer afraid.
target: 而如今，我不再害怕了。

source: Especially with you by my side.
target: 尤其是有你在我身边。

source: This was the union I always desired.
target: 我一直盼望的就是这桩婚事。

source: I merely wish it had happened sooner. But...
target: 我只希望这一天能来得更早些。不过……

source: Well, circumstances were different then.
target: 唉，当时的情况不同。

source: I am, and shall always be, opposed to this union.
target: 我反对这桩婚事，而且永远都会反对。

source: We know Polonius's estate is dry. No dowry to her name, no social ties, no status... it weakens Denmark.
target: 我们都知道，波洛涅斯的家产已经空了。她没有嫁妆，没有人脉，没有地位……这会削弱丹麦。

source: A King ought to marry strategically. Not on his own blind whim!
target: 国王的婚姻应当讲究策略，不能凭自己一时的盲目冲动！

source: Hush, brother.
target: 安静些，弟弟。

source: This world belongs to the living.
target: 这个世界属于活人。

source: We are merely passing through, here only for this singular moment in time.
target: 我们只是过客，只在此刻短暂停留。

source: Ophelia. Would that I could offer you the embrace of love a father-in-law ought to have for his daughter.
target: 奥菲莉娅。多希望我能给你一个慈爱的拥抱，就像公公应当给予女儿的那样。

source: My son... the darkness which unfolded within him in these past months has been buried, but not truly forgotten.
target: 我的儿子……过去几个月里在他心中蔓延的黑暗，虽然被埋藏了，却并没有真正被遗忘。

source: And someday, it shall rise up again to lash against you both.
target: 总有一天，它会再次浮现，伤害你们两个人。

source: Can you be prepared for that eternity? Can you love him despite that, knowing it has hurt you before?
target: 你能准备好，一生面对这一切吗？明知它曾经伤害过你，你还能不顾这一切，继续爱他吗？

source: Think on that before you decide his fate, and yours.
target: 决定他和你自己的命运之前，先想清楚这一点。

source: And then there's Father and I. He exiled us, Ophelia.
target: 还有父亲和我呢。他把我们流放了，奥菲莉娅。

source: He'd kill us if he could.
target: 如果可以，他会杀了我们。

source: Try as you might, you won't change his heart on this front. He knows I'm a danger to him. And he's right. I'll never serve him as my King.
target: 无论你怎么努力，都改变不了他在这件事上的心意。他知道我对他是个威胁。而他是对的。我永远不会奉他为王，向他效忠。

source: You will grow old without either of us in your life.
target: 你会慢慢老去，而你的生活里再也没有我们两个人。

source: Do Father and I mean so little to you that you're willing to throw us away?
target: 父亲和我对你就这么不重要，让你甘愿抛弃我们吗？

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to allow Norway to rule through Hamlet, bringing the two countries into a partnership of sorts.
target: 上次说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用《命运之书》让挪威通过哈姆雷特进行统治，使两国形成某种合作关系。

source: Is this not the world any decent person would seek? A world where all survive?
target: 这不正是任何一个正直的人都会追求的世界吗？一个所有人都能活下来的世界？

source: One where Hamlet is free to take his father's throne, and forced by virtue of another ruler to act, rather than remain paralyzed?
target: 在这个世界里，哈姆雷特能够继承父亲的王位，又因另一位统治者的存在而被迫行动，不再困在原地、动弹不得？

source: Certainly I think so.
target: 我当然这么认为。

source: W-well, what about me? Where is my life in all this?
target: 那、那我呢？我的命又算什么？

source: Ophelia, have you deemed me beyond redemption? Am I not included in your salvation?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你已经认定我无可救赎了吗？你要拯救的人里，没有我吗？

source: Feh! Should've considered that before you offed a perfectly good king!
target: 呸！你杀掉一位好端端的国王之前，就该想想这事！

source: Look at the mess you made of it all!
target: 瞧瞧你把这一切弄成了什么样！

source: The mess I've made? What of Denmark? What of our nation?
target: 我弄成的烂摊子？那丹麦呢？我们的国家呢？

source: We're scarcely our own people now. Merely a pale shadow of Norway's ambitions.
target: 如今，我们几乎已经失去了自主，只是挪威野心投下的一道黯淡影子。

source: And what shall become of Denmark in a dozen years, or in a hundred? Shall we even exist?
target: 十几年后，或是一百年后，丹麦又会变成什么样？我们还会存在吗？

source: All of our stories, all of our selves forgotten!
target: 我们所有的故事，我们所有人的自我，都会被遗忘！

source: Have all of you forgotten Ogier, that knight of Charlemagne? Legend says his spirit dwells within this very castle.
target: 你们都忘了奥吉尔，查理曼的那位骑士吗？传说他的灵魂就栖居在这座城堡里。

source: And when Denmark is most at peril, he shall rise and take arms to defend us all. Have you forgotten what others sacrificed?
target: 当丹麦面临最大的危难时，他会起身拿起武器，保卫我们所有人。你们忘了别人付出过怎样的牺牲吗？

source: It is the King of Denmark's calling to fight on her behalf. What kind of coward merely hands her over to her enemies?
target: 为丹麦而战，是丹麦国王的使命。怎样的懦夫，才会就这么把她交到敌人手里？

source: An entire nation's identity must not be snuffed out by the whims of a boy!
target: 一个国家的全部认同，绝不能被一个毛头小子的任性抹去！

source: Claudius is not wrong.
target: 克劳狄斯说得没错。

source: But of all foreign rulers, I think my husband respected Fortinbras and his family as the greatest.
target: 但在所有外国统治者中，我想，我丈夫最敬重的就是福丁布拉斯和他的家族。

source: Is that true, Hamlet?
target: 是这样吗，哈姆雷特？

source: Indeed. You always knew my heart best, Gerta.
target: 确实如此。你一直最懂我的心，格尔塔。

source: At the same time...
target: 不过……

source: I am certainly not proud to lose everything I spent my life fighting for.
target: 失去我毕生为之奋斗的一切，我当然不会感到骄傲。

source: I wish my son were strong enough to stand and fight.
target: 我多希望我的儿子足够坚强，能够挺身而战。

source: As do I, Father.
target: 我也这么希望，父亲。

source: I fear I shall think of that every morning until you and I can discuss it at length in Heaven one day.
target: 恐怕今后的每个清晨，我都会想起这件事，直到有一天，你我能在天堂里好好谈一谈。

source: We mustn't be too hard on Hamlet.
target: 我们不能对哈姆雷特太苛刻。

source: A war with Fortinbras would have cost more than any of us know.
target: 如果与福丁布拉斯开战，代价会比我们任何人所知的都要大。

source: I cannot say whether we would have won. But the destruction would have been... extensive.
target: 我说不准我们能不能赢。但造成的破坏一定会……极其惨重。

source: Many would have died to keep Denmark as Denmark.
target: 许多人会为了让丹麦仍是丹麦而死。

source: Ophelia, you're trading away a nation to keep people alive.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你是用一个国家，换取人们的生存。

source: My father would not have made that trade. Claudius would not. Neither would King Hamlet.
target: 我父亲不会做这样的交换。克劳狄斯不会，哈姆雷特国王也不会。

source: ...Nor, truthfully, can I claim that I would, either.
target: ……说实话，我也不能说我会这么做。

source: But you aren't like any of us. That's why you were able to keep all of us alive.
target: 但你和我们任何人都不同。正因如此，你才能让我们所有人活下来。

source: Just be careful. Be careful what you're willing to give up. Know that it cannot be recovered.
target: 只是，一定要慎重。想清楚你愿意放弃什么。要知道，失去了就再也拿不回来了。

source: Ah. You're here. Come. Have a seat.
target: 啊，你来了。来，坐吧。

source: What're you having?
target: 喝点什么？

source: No wine tonight. I think this calls for some of that aqua vitae you keep in the back.
target: 今晚不喝葡萄酒。我想，这时候该来点你藏在后面的生命之水。

source: I didn't come here to drink.
target: 我不是来喝酒的。

source: Of course you did. You just don't know it yet. Once more: Have a seat.
target: 你当然是，只是自己还不知道。我再说一遍：坐吧。

source: I think you already suspect what this is about, don't you?
target: 我想，你已经猜到这是为了什么，对吧？

source: I spend quite a lot of time in town. And I've seen you around quite often, too.
target: 我经常待在镇上，也经常在那里看见你。

source: I... I don't know why I came.
target: 我……我不知道自己为什么要来。

source: You should thank Ophelia for getting us together. It was her doing.
target: 你该谢谢奥菲莉娅，是她让我们见了面。这都是她安排的。

source: I've seen your performances, you know. Several times. You have talent.
target: 你知道吗，我看过你的表演。看过好几次。你很有天赋。

source: There are times when player and part align, and the human being onstage truly becomes their character...
target: 有些时候，演员与角色融为一体，台上的人真正成为了他所扮演的角色……

source: When the performer leaves the stage, it's impossible for me to see them as anything other than the person they played. It is the ultimate resonance.
target: 演员离开舞台后，我依然无法把他看作那个角色以外的任何人。这便是极致的共鸣。

source: So I shall leave it to you to tell me. What part of your heart is Bernardo, and what part of you is someone else?
target: 所以，这就留给你来告诉我。你心里哪一部分是贝尔纳多，哪一部分又是另一个人？

source: How can you ask me that?
target: 你怎么能这样问我？

source: I cannot know that.
target: 我不可能知道。

source: I think you do.
target: 我想你知道。

source: And I think you're afraid, because you know the answer will change your world greatly.
target: 而且我想，你在害怕，因为你知道，这个答案会让你的世界发生巨大的变化。

source: Let me tell you a story, my friend, whomever you are.
target: 让我给你讲个故事吧，我的朋友，无论你是谁。

source: I was raised in Italy. When my father passed, I made my way to Florence seeking work.
target: 我在意大利长大。父亲去世后，我去了佛罗伦萨找工作。

source: There, I found a world of creation. Every small building held an artist's workshop, it seemed. Every street was full of music.
target: 在那里，我发现了一个充满创作的世界。似乎每一座小楼里都有艺术家的工坊，每一条街上都回荡着音乐。

source: I stumbled into one of these workshops once, and became an assistant to a great artist. He painted human beings as I'd never seen them.
target: 有一次，我偶然走进其中一间工坊，成了一位伟大画家的助手。他笔下的人体，是我从未见过的。

source: I learned that human bodies were—not dirty and sinful, as my father once had me believe, but full of light. Beautiful and wondrous.
target: 我才明白，人的身体——并不像父亲曾让我相信的那样肮脏、有罪，而是充满光辉。美丽而奇妙。

source: And there... I learned about what the French call the 'Italian vice.'
target: 也在那里……我了解了法国人所谓的“意大利恶习”。

source: I fell in love with my master, and he with me. He taught me that love-making, like painting, is an art form unto itself.
target: 我爱上了我的师傅，他也爱上了我。他教会我，做爱和绘画一样，本身就是一门艺术。

source: In Florence, love between men is common. The Germans call a man like me Florenzer. I never thought it strange.
target: 在佛罗伦萨，男人之间相爱是很常见的事。德国人把我这样的男人叫作佛罗伦萨人。我从不觉得这有什么奇怪。

source: It was only upon coming here, to Denmark, that I realized the rest of the world treats these matters as sinful.
target: 直到来到这里，来到丹麦，我才意识到，世界上其他地方把这些事视为罪恶。

source: An... entire city of sodomites? Surely God will smite Florence for such wickedness.
target: 整……整座城里都是鸡奸者？上帝一定会因这种邪恶降罚于佛罗伦萨。

source: Ah. You see, that's the curious thing.
target: 啊，你看，有意思的就在这里。

source: Upon leaving Florence, I felt compelled to travel to see that little chapel Michelangelo painted. I'd heard it was rather a nice work of his.
target: 离开佛罗伦萨时，我很想去看看米开朗琪罗画过的那座小礼拜堂。听说那是他相当不错的一件作品。

source: Looking up into the face of the Christian God, reaching out to touch Man... I realized.
target: 我仰望着基督教上帝的面容，看着他伸手触碰人……我明白了。

source: Your God is pure, infinite love. A love for humankind which surpasses even the stars. How could he ever hate his own creation?
target: 你们的上帝，是纯粹而无尽的爱。他对人类的爱，甚至超越了群星。他怎么会憎恨自己创造的生命？

source: How could a being of such magnificence ever turn upon the thing he had created in his own image?
target: 如此伟大的存在，怎么会反过来伤害他照着自己的形象创造的生命？

source: So when you came to Elsinore, you hid your preference for men.
target: 所以，你来到埃尔西诺后，就隐瞒了自己喜欢男人这件事。

source: I did. For my own safety. It was simple: There is only one Dane worth loving at the moment, and he is thoroughly unavailable to me.
target: 是的，为了自己的安全。这很简单：眼下只有一个丹麦人值得我爱，而我和他完全没有可能。

source: You mustn't think of it like some sad, one-sided, pining-away sort of thing, though. I love him in a number of ways.
target: 不过，你可别把这想成什么悲伤的单相思，让人日夜思念、日渐憔悴那种。我对他的爱有很多种。

source: Above all, he is my dearest, truest friend-- though he might be going through the darkest time of his life right now.
target: 最重要的是，他是我最亲密、最真挚的朋友——尽管他现在可能正经历人生中最黑暗的时光。

source: I wanted to see his grief through to its sticking place. I'll leave Elsinore and return to Italy very soon, I expect.
target: 我想陪他度过悲伤，直到他能稳住自己。我想，我很快就会离开埃尔西诺，回到意大利。

source: I did. For my own safety. It was simple: There was only ever one Dane worth loving at the moment, and he was thoroughly unavailable to me.
target: 是的，为了自己的安全。这很简单：当时值得我爱的丹麦人始终只有一个，而我和他完全没有可能。

source: You mustn't think of it like some sad, one-sided, pining-away sort of thing, though. I loved him in a number of ways.
target: 不过，你可别把这想成什么悲伤的单相思，独自苦苦思念之类的事。我对他的爱不止一种。

source: Above all, he was my dearest, truest friend.
target: 最重要的是，他是我最亲密、最真诚的朋友。

source: I wanted to see his grief through to its sticking place. Now that he's gone, I'll leave Elsinore and return to Italy very soon, I expect.
target: 我想陪他熬过悲痛，直到他能安定下来。如今他不在了，我想我很快就会离开埃尔西诺，回意大利去。

source: And-- did you ever, with Hamlet...
target: 那——你有没有和哈姆雷特……

source: Well, now. That's a story I'll take to the grave.
target: 这个嘛。那件事，我会带进坟墓里。

source: I never noticed all this about you before. I never looked closely enough, I suppose.
target: 我以前从没发现你还有这些事。大概是我从没仔细留意过吧。

source: It is surprising what the eye misses when it does not understand what is possible.
target: 人若不知道什么是可能的，眼睛就会漏掉许多东西，多得让人惊讶。

source: Maybe that's why I never felt afraid as Katherine. Several of my men have seen me perform and never realized. I felt... safe.
target: 也许这就是我做凯瑟琳时从不害怕的原因。我手下有几个人看过我的演出，却从没认出我。我觉得……很安全。

source: They weren't looking for Bernardo, so they didn't see Bernardo.
target: 他们没想着找贝尔纳多，所以也就没看见贝尔纳多。

source: I believe... if I could... if I could do anything... I'd be Katherine whenever I pleased, and Bernardo whenever I pleased.
target: 我想……如果我能……如果我想做什么都可以……我就想做凯瑟琳时做凯瑟琳，想做贝尔纳多时做贝尔纳多。

source: At once both—or neither.
target: 同时是两个人——或者两个都不是。

source: Can you not?
target: 你不能这样吗？

source: Not here. Not in Elsinore.
target: 在这里不行。在埃尔西诺不行。

source: Then where?
target: 那在哪里可以？

source: I don't... know where else to go. I have my father's estate. It's mine now. But going there feels... wrong.
target: 我不……知道还能去哪儿。我还有父亲的庄园。现在它归我了。但去那里感觉……不对。

source: Come with me to Florence, then.
target: 那就跟我去佛罗伦萨吧。

source: You'd like it there. Theater on every doorstep. And hundreds of Petruchios. Can't throw a stone without hitting ten beautiful men in their beautiful faces.
target: 你会喜欢那里的。家门口到处都有戏看。还有成百上千个彼特鲁乔。随手扔块石头，都能砸中十个美男子的漂亮脸蛋。

source: I want to. But... if I... think about it too heavily, I'll become too afraid to leave.
target: 我想去。可是……如果我……想得太多，就会害怕得不敢走了。

source: Then let's leave Sunday.
target: 那我们星期日就走。

source: You heard me. Isn't it easier to make a snap decision like this? Pull a pack together and we'll leave. Two horses from the royal stables won't be missed for a few days.
target: 你没听错。像这样当机立断，不是更容易吗？收拾个包，我们就走。皇家马厩少了两匹马，过上几天才会有人发现。

source: That would be... so nice... to just vanish, and start anew...
target: 那该……多好啊……就这样消失，重新开始……

source: I'll need to find time to say goodbye to Hamlet, of course.
target: 当然，我得找时间跟哈姆雷特道别。

source: And I to Marcellus. I owe him that much.
target: 我也得跟马塞勒斯道别。这是我起码该为他做的。

source: Let us part for now, then. On Sunday, we'll depart.
target: 那我们就先告别吧。星期日，我们一起出发。

source: Wot's this about? Something wrong?
target: 这是怎么了？出什么事了？

source: I have some news for you, old friend.
target: 老朋友，我有件事要告诉你。

source: I'm... departing Elsinore. On Sunday.
target: 我要……离开埃尔西诺了。星期日走。

source: Ah. War business? When'll you be back?
target: 啊。为打仗的事？什么时候回来？

source: No. It's got nothing to do with that. This is a... personal endeavor.
target: 不。跟那毫无关系。这是……我自己的事。

source: I don't know when—or if—I'll return.
target: 我不知道什么时候回来——甚至不知道还会不会回来。

source: B-but—what about th'men here?
target: 可、可是——这里的弟兄们怎么办？

source: That's why I wanted to speak with you. They need someone capable and seasoned to lead them.
target: 所以我才想跟你谈谈。他们需要一个有能力、有经验的人来带领他们。

source: They need you, Marcellus. There's no man I trust more. And now the King will be relying on you, too.
target: 他们需要你，马塞勒斯。我最信任的人就是你。现在，国王也要仰仗你了。

source: I... knew in my heart th'day would come when you'd leave eventually. Jus' never thought it'd be like this. So sudden.
target: 我……心里一直知道，你终究会有离开的一天。只是没想到会是这样。这么突然。

source: I'm sorry, my friend. I truly am.
target: 对不起，朋友。真的对不起。

source: I cannot speak of my reasons. But trust that I do this now to cause as little pain to everyone here as possible. Including myself.
target: 我不能说出原因。但请相信，我现在这么做，是想尽量少让这里的每个人痛苦。也包括我自己。

source: T-then... it must be the right thing. Yer a sharp man, Captain. I jus' wish you well. I hope yer safe.
target: 那、那……一定是对的。队长，你是个明白人。我只愿你一切顺利。希望你平平安安。

source: When I depart, I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell anyone where I went.
target: 我走以后，还请你别告诉任何人我去了哪里。

source: Aye. You have my word.
target: 好。我向你保证。

source: I'm sorry to trouble you.
target: 抱歉打扰你。

source: Is it about my uncle?
target: 是关于我叔叔的事吗？

source: Afraid not.
target: 恐怕不是。

source: I'm leaving, Hamlet. Leaving Denmark, I mean.
target: 我要走了，哈姆雷特。我是说，离开丹麦。

source: Yes. Quite soon.
target: 是的。很快就走。

source: No. Sunday. But soon, I think.
target: 不。星期日走。不过，我觉得也快了。

source: What? Why?
target: 什么？为什么？

source: What changed to cause you leave at a time like this?
target: 是什么变了，让你要在这种时候离开？

source: I did. Or rather, I am not the man I was yesterday.
target: 是我变了。或者说，我已经不是昨天的那个我了。

source: You know I am, and shall always be, your most ardent friend. But there's someone who needs me more right now.
target: 你知道，我是你最热忱的朋友，今后也永远如此。但眼下，有个人比你更需要我。

source: And I need to follow that path where it leads, just as I followed your path here once.
target: 我得顺着那条路走下去，无论它通向哪里，就像当初追随你来到这里一样。

source: I wish this weren't so sudden. But sometimes, haste is required in these matters.
target: 我也希望这一切别这么突然。但有时候，这种事就是得赶快行动。

source: Can you tell me earnestly that you aren't angry with me? That this decision isn't driven by our discussion earlier?
target: 你能真心告诉我，你没有生我的气吗？这个决定不是因为我们先前的谈话吗？

source: Perhaps it was in part.
target: 也许有一部分是。

source: But I think my heart was the last of me to catch up. My mind knew what your words would be before you said them.
target: 但我想，我的心是最后才接受这一切的。你还没开口，我的理智就知道你会说什么了。

source: I had imagined us having that conversation a hundred times. Truth be told, I thought I would feel surprised, or sorrowful, or frightened. But it was none of those things. I felt only peace.
target: 我曾无数次想象我们会有那场谈话。说实话，我以为自己会惊讶，会悲伤，或是害怕。但这些都没有。我只感到平静。

source: And for that, I thank you, even as I say farewell.
target: 为此，即使是在道别的时候，我也要谢谢你。

source: Your blood and judgement are so well commingled. I've always admired that.
target: 你的感情与理智总能如此融洽。我一直很钦佩这一点。

source: Go, then. Do what you must. But write me. From wherever you land, I mean. I'll come see you.
target: 那就去吧。做你必须做的事。但要给我写信。我是说，无论你在哪里落脚，都写信给我。我会去看你。

source: After all this business is over.
target: 等这一切都结束以后。

source: You know I will.
target: 你知道我会的。

source: Good. Then let us not dwell further on morose matters.
target: 好。那我们就别再谈这些伤感的事了。

source: Is it true, Bernardo?
target: 是真的吗，贝尔纳多？

source: These rumors I've heard--about you, about these... 'theater performances?'
target: 我听到的那些传闻——关于你，关于这些……“戏剧演出”？

source: Ophelia. How many people did you tell?
target: 奥菲莉娅。你到底告诉了多少人？

source: I thought... it would help...
target: 我以为……这样会有帮助……

source: You were wrong.
target: 你错了。

source: You told him, Ophelia?
target: 是你告诉他的，奥菲莉娅？

source: I did.
target: 是我。

source: What? From whom did you hear about that?
target: 什么？你听谁说的？

source: From Ophelia. She must have seen you.
target: 奥菲莉娅。她一定是看见你了。

source: What you heard is true, my lord.
target: 殿下，您听说的都是真的。

source: I cannot claim it did not give me great pause.
target: 我不能否认，这确实让我迟疑了很久。

source: But over the years, you've given me cause to rethink many a time.
target: 但这些年来，你已经许多次让我重新审视自己的想法。

source: When you devoted your life to God, I began to think for the first time about life after death.
target: 你把一生奉献给上帝时，我第一次开始思考死后的世界。

source: The first time you defeated me in a duel, I rethought everything I knew about my footwork. And there was quite a lot to rethink.
target: 你第一次在决斗中击败我时，我重新审视了自己对步法的全部认识。而要重新审视的东西，着实不少。

source: When you spent your father's remaining years of illness at his bedside, I realized how little I truly knew my own father.
target: 你父亲患病的最后几年，你一直陪在他的床边，那时我才意识到，自己其实多么不了解我的父亲。

source: And when you, as a youth, defended me from being cuffed on the head by the bigger servant-boys...
target: 还有，年少时，你护着我，不让那些个头更大的小男仆打我的脑袋……

source: I knew then I would forever owe you a great debt to your own defense.
target: 那时我就知道，我永远欠你一份大恩，理当在你需要时护着你。

source: And now that day has come.
target: 如今，这一天到了。

source: You see, you reflect back at me a pure sort of introspection I never could muster.
target: 你看，你让我看到了一种纯粹的自省，而我始终做不到。

source: My thoughts are crazed, jumbled, constantly shifting. You always seemed so self-assured by comparison.
target: 我的思绪疯狂、混乱，时刻都在变化。相比之下，你总显得那么笃定。

source: But now I see you are uncomfortable. Am I wrong?
target: 但现在，我看得出你很不自在。我看错了吗？

source: It feels like a private thing for you to know, Hamlet.
target: 哈姆雷特，这对我来说是件私密的事，让你知道了，我有些不自在。

source: It is... difficult... to feel... so vulnerable.
target: 感觉自己……如此脆弱……实在……不好受。

source: I do not know what I ought to say, in times like this.
target: 这种时候，我不知道该说些什么。

source: Nor I.
target: 我也不知道。

source: I never had a brother, Bernardo. But I always had you. Now, perhaps, I have a sister as well. Is that... right?
target: 贝尔纳多，我从来没有兄弟。但我一直有你。如今，也许我还多了个姐妹。这样说……对吗？

source: The specificities are, I think, irrelevant in this circumstance. I am, and shall always be, devoted to you, Hamlet.
target: 我想，在这种时候，具体的称呼并不重要。哈姆雷特，我现在忠于你，今后也永远如此。

source: And I in like kind.
target: 我对你也是一样。

source: Why were you afraid to tell us?
target: 你为什么不敢告诉我们？

source: Your uncle...
target: 你叔叔……

source: He told me you would hate me. And Laertes as well.
target: 他告诉我，你会恨我。雷欧提斯也会。

source: He threatened to tell everyone in Elsinore. He promised it would ruin me.
target: 他威胁要告诉埃尔西诺的所有人。他说，这一定会毁了我。

source: That delusional fool.
target: 那个满脑子妄想的蠢货。

source: It is a testament to how little he understands the people around him that he would say such a thing.
target: 他能说出这种话，足以证明他有多不了解身边的人。

source: Don't worry about my uncle. If ever he threatens you, it will be summarily handled.
target: 别担心我叔叔。他要是再威胁你，这事会立刻得到解决。

source: You have my solemn word.
target: 我郑重向你保证。

source: Farewell, Bernardo.
target: 再见，贝尔纳多。

source: My lord.
target: 殿下。

source: It feels as though a thousand bales of hay were lifted from my back.
target: 感觉就像背上的一千捆干草都被卸了下来。

source: I am grateful you brought Hamlet to me.
target: 谢谢你带哈姆雷特来找我。

source: These rumors I've heard. Are they true?
target: 我听到的那些传闻，是真的吗？

source: About you?
target: 关于你的那些？

source: About where you go at night, I mean.
target: 我是说，关于你晚上去了哪里的那些。

source: From whom did you hear of such a thing?
target: 你听谁说的这件事？

source: From Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅。

source: Ophelia? But how...
target: 奥菲莉娅？可她怎么……

source: At first, I could not believe I had to hear it from my sister—rather than from you, one of my oldest friends.
target: 起初，我真不敢相信，这件事居然得由我妹妹来告诉我，而不是由你——我最相熟的老朋友之一。

source: Laertes. If you're here to berate me... please.
target: 雷欧提斯。如果你是来责骂我的……求你了。

source: Oh, make no mistake. I am angry.
target: 哦，别误会。我确实很生气。

source: I'm angry you didn't include me, a professional, in any of these so-called 'performances'.
target: 我气的是，你那些所谓的“演出”，居然一次都没叫上我这个专业人士。

source: Do you even have any real musicians in the pit? Or is it some country no-man on a fiddle?
target: 你们的乐池里到底有没有真正的乐师？还是只有一个拉提琴的乡下无名小卒？

source: What is the quality bar of this troupe? Surely not very high, if you haven't bothered to include me.
target: 这剧团的水准到底如何？连我都懒得请，想必高不到哪里去。

source: Don't lie to me. You've been acting for how many years? And I've played the lute my entire life!
target: 别骗我了。你演戏多少年了？而我从小到大一直在弹鲁特琴！

source: You know that!
target: 你明明知道！

source: I could have been performing with you. Then, maybe, I wouldn't have to go to Paris to improve further.
target: 我本来可以和你一起演出的。那样，也许我就不非得去巴黎才能精进技艺了。

source: The least I ask is to be included in any further such activities. Preferably preceded by—and followed by—wine and dance.
target: 我最起码的要求，就是今后有这种活动都要叫上我。最好开始前——还有结束后——都能喝酒跳舞。

source: Honestly, Bernardo.
target: 贝尔纳多，你真是的。

source: Y-you're... not... you didn't... come to mock me?
target: 你、你……不是……你不是……来嘲笑我的？

source: Why would I do that?
target: 我为什么要那样？

source: Claudius told me you would. That you and Hamlet both would.
target: 克劳狄斯告诉我，你会的。他说你和哈姆雷特都会。

source: I was so afraid.
target: 我害怕极了。

source: Claudius said that?
target: 克劳狄斯这么说的？

source: Well, make no mistake. I haven't seen your performance yet.
target: 不过，你可别误会。我还没看过你的演出呢。

source: If you deliver your lines without expression—if they fall flat and stale—rest assured. I will mock you.
target: 要是你念台词毫无感情——又平淡又乏味——那你放心。我一定会嘲笑你。

source: I have no patience for dreadful acting. Life is far too short.
target: 我可没耐心看糟糕的表演。人生太短了。

source: But as to the rest: I have known you since you were scarcely old enough to hold a sword. You have been a sibling to Ophelia, and to me.
target: 至于其他的事：你刚到能握住剑的年纪，我就认识你了。对奥菲莉娅和我来说，你一直如同手足。

source: Have faith in me, Bernardo. As I do in you.
target: 相信我，贝尔纳多。就像我相信你一样。

source: Am I permitted to attend your next production?
target: 我能去看你们下一场演出吗？

source: But I must warn you... I look... different.
target: 但我得先提醒你……我的样子……会不一样。

source: If you're any performer worth your salt, then I'm assuming petticoats are involved, yes.
target: 要是你算得上个称职的演员，那我想你肯定得穿衬裙，没错。

source: Perhaps we'll have to line you and Irma up, toe to toe, and see which of you is more formidable.
target: 也许得让你和伊尔玛面对面站着，比一比，看谁更厉害。

source: In the interest of total honesty, my bet's on Irma.
target: 老实说，我赌伊尔玛赢。

source: Regardless, I'd better be off. See you on stage, Bernardo.
target: 不管怎样，我该走了。舞台上见，贝尔纳多。

source: Er... L-likewise.
target: 呃……见、见。

source: I am grateful you brought your brother to me.
target: 谢谢你带你哥哥来找我。

source: ...It is hard to trust you at the moment.
target: ……现在，我很难信任你。

source: I thought you a friend. I thought you too stalwart to accomplish something like this.
target: 我以为你是朋友。我以为你足够可靠，不会做出这种事。

source: Clearly, I was mistaken.
target: 显然，我看错了。

source: Regardless, this was not your rumor to spread.
target: 无论如何，这传闻都不该由你来散播。

source: I am not even certain how you learned of this in the first place, to be frank.
target: 说实话，我甚至不清楚你当初是怎么知道这件事的。

source: Do you understand? Tell no one.
target: 你明白吗？别告诉任何人。

source: ...I apologize, Bernardo. I know it wasn't right.
target: ……对不起，贝尔纳多。我知道这样不对。

source: But I wanted to—I thought—I could change your fate.
target: 但我想——我以为——我能改变你的命运。

source: My 'fate' is not yours to change. It is between me and my God.
target: 我的“命运”不该由你来改变。那是我与我的上帝之间的事。

source: Never forget that. From now on.
target: 从今往后，永远别忘了这一点。

source: I'm sorry. Truly. How can I make it up to you?
target: 对不起。真的。我该怎样才能弥补你？

source: You may leave me alone with my thoughts for a while.
target: 你可以让我独自想一会儿。

source: ...Perhaps a long while.
target: ……也许得很久。

source: ...Lady Ophelia.
target: ……奥菲莉娅小姐。

source: You've made me wait for a very long time, you know.
target: 你可知道，你让我等了很久很久。

source: Quince? Where's... my... father?
target: 奎因斯？我……父亲……在哪儿？

source: Never mind that. I've put him on pause for the moment.
target: 别管那个。我暂时让他处于暂停状态了。

source: How have you been, my lady? And where have you been wandering?
target: 小姐，你近来可好？又去哪里闲逛了？

source: Nowhere, other than my chambers.
target: 除了自己的房间，我哪儿也没去。

source: Let's bare some leg, shall we? I saw you.
target: 咱们坦白一点，好不好？我看见你了。

source: A familiar little lavender gown, trailing its way down to Castle Town...
target: 一袭熟悉的淡紫色长裙，一路拖曳着，走向城堡镇……

source: And what did you find there? Hmm...?
target: 你在那里找到了什么？嗯……？

source: I was meeting an acquaintance. It was nothing of note.
target: 我去见一个熟人。没什么特别的。

source: Nothing of note, she says! Ahh, but I don't believe it!
target: 她说没什么特别的！啊，可我不信！

source: You've found something incredible, haven't you?
target: 你发现了什么不得了的东西，是不是？

source: I mentioned once to you that I was here to find a lost item. Something of mine.
target: 我曾跟你提过，我来这里是为了寻找一件失物。一件属于我的东西。

source: And now you've gone and done the deed, all on your own. So very admirable.
target: 如今，你居然独自把这事办成了。真是令人钦佩。

source: I spoke with Simona. I know who you are. Who you really are.
target: 我和西蒙娜谈过了。我知道你是谁。知道你真正的身份。

source: All of this—everything that's happened to me—it was just a game you were playing to get me to find that stupid book for you.
target: 这一切——发生在我身上的所有事——都只是你玩的一个游戏，为的就是让我替你找到那本蠢书。

source: And, by the way, my thanks. This little adventure of ours has been truly delightful! Now—simply choose a fate and I can leave Elsinore forever.
target: 对了，还得谢谢你。我们这场小小的冒险，实在令人愉快！现在——只要选一个命运，我就能永远离开埃尔西诺了。

source: You want me to use the book? Why? I thought you wanted it for yourself?
target: 你想让我使用这本书？为什么？我以为你想把它据为己有？

source: Because if you use the Book of Fates... it comes right back to me!
target: 因为只要你使用命运之书……它就会立刻回到我手里！

source: It's just like a chess game, you see. First your turn, then mine, then yours, then mine, and so on, and so forth.
target: 你看，这就像下棋。先轮到你，再轮到我，然后是你，然后是我，如此循环，往复不休。

source: Lady Simona merely granted you the human seat at the board. You inherited her match!
target: 西蒙娜女士只是把棋盘前属于人类的席位让给了你。你接手了她的棋局！

source: And let me tell you, in the past she's made some rather atrocious moves.
target: 而且我告诉你，她以前下过几步相当糟糕的棋。

source: So all of this is just spectacle to you.
target: 所以这一切在你眼里，都只是供你观赏的戏。

source: That's right, isn't it? That's what all of this is. It's just a performance you're putting on.
target: 是这样，对吧？这一切就是这么回事。只不过是你在上演的一出戏。

source: In that case, I'll never make a decision. You cannot force my hand.
target: 既然如此，我就永远不做决定。你逼不了我。

source: Right now, I choose to stay in Elsinore.
target: 现在，我选择留在埃尔西诺。

source: Heh... heh. Heh... heh...
Hah hah hah hah hah! How clever!
target: 哈哈哈哈哈！真聪明！

source: Wrong call, Ophelia.
target: 你选错了，奥菲莉娅。

source: This is your last chance to be reasonable.
target: 这是你最后一次讲道理的机会。

source: Give me the Book, or suffer an eternal hell in a prison I've designed especially for you.
target: 把那本书交给我，否则你就要在我专为你设计的牢笼里，永远承受地狱般的折磨。

source: Do you think this little game I've put you in is the worst it can be? Oh, no, dearest...
target: 你以为我把你困在这场小游戏里，就已经糟到头了吗？哦，不，亲爱的……

source: It can be far worse still.
target: 还可以比这糟糕得多。

source: I alone can understand the details of your pain, for I have seen it all...
target: 只有我能理解你痛苦的每一处细节，因为这一切我都看在眼里……

source: This match we're in, Ophelia... you and I... it's like playing with a child.
target: 我们这场对局，奥菲莉娅……你和我……就像我在陪一个孩子下棋。

source: Your strategy lacks efficacy; your designs are impotent. I will ensnare you every time. Don't you understand?
target: 你的策略毫无成效，你的谋划无能为力。我每一次都会把你困住。你还不明白吗？

source: You will linger here, undying, growing bored and stupid and slow. Just like King Hamlet before you.
target: 你会一直困在这里，死不了，渐渐变得厌倦、愚笨、迟钝。就像先前的哈姆雷特国王一样。

source: I've told you I won't give you the Book. Leave me.
target: 我说过了，我不会把那本书给你。离我远点。

source: Leave you? I am Elsinore. I am the eye in every wall and my fingers run through every flagstone. I can no more leave you than you can leave me!
target: 离开你？我就是埃尔西诺。我是每一面墙里的眼睛，我的手指穿行于每一块石板之中。我无法离开你，就像你无法离开我一样！

source: And my dear, you can never truly leave me. Even when the Book is back in my hands. I will always linger.
target: 而且，亲爱的，你永远无法真正离开我。哪怕那本书已经回到我手里。我也会始终徘徊不去。

source: And while you're here, I will dismantle you piece by piece. I will not allow you to find more than the smallest happiness.
target: 只要你还在这里，我就会一点一点地摧毁你。我不会让你得到超过一丝一毫的幸福。

source: I will smother you until every shred of your flesh is ground beneath my toes.
target: 我会让你窒息，直到你的每一丝血肉都在我脚趾下碾碎。

source: Yes. That's the face I came to see.
target: 对。这就是我来这里想看的表情。

source: I hope to be seeing more of it very soon...
target: 希望很快就能多看几次……

source: 'Til then, Ophelia.
target: 到时再见，奥菲莉娅。

source: This isn't over. This cannot be over. There must be a way to stop him.
target: 这还没结束。不能就这样结束。一定有办法阻止他。

source: My lord Hamlet! What an odd occasion to come across you here.
target: 哈姆雷特殿下！竟然在这里碰见您，真是稀奇。

source: Odd, you say? These days the very walls seem to sing my name... now that's odd.
target: 你说稀奇？这些天，连墙壁似乎都在吟唱我的名字……那才叫稀奇。

source: I... er, don't understand, my lord. What do you mean?
target: 我……呃，不明白，殿下。您是什么意思？

source: I'm sure you think you're being very coy accosting me here, my lady Brit. And yet!
target: 布莉特女士，你在这里拦着我搭话，想必自以为掩饰得很巧妙吧。可惜！

source: I see right through your womanly act. You feign concern for me, but there's something more in it.
target: 你那套女人的做作姿态，我一眼就看穿了。你假装关心我，其实另有目的。

source: I was merely curious to see your, ahem, strange condition up close.
target: 我只是好奇，想近距离看看您那，咳，奇怪的状况。

source: Well, then. Oughtn't you to come a little closer?
target: 好啊。那么，你是不是该再靠近一点？

source: Ah... my lord, it isn't proper.
target: 啊……殿下，这不合礼数。

source: How are you to assess my condition, then, if you won't even look into my eyes?
target: 你连我的眼睛都不肯看，又怎么判断我的状况呢？

source: Or test my sanity via some other method, then. Take my hand, and see if I flinch. Sing to me, and see if I sit quietly. Kiss me, and see if my heart is stirred.
target: 那就用别的方法试试我是否神志清醒吧。握住我的手，看我会不会退缩。唱歌给我听，看我会不会安静地坐着。吻我，看我会不会心动。

source: Er... my lord... I think I ought to take my leave of you.
target: 呃……殿下……我想我该告辞了。

source: So be it, then. Your errant behavior is most strange to me, Lady Brit.
target: 那就这样吧。布莉特女士，你这不合规矩的举动，实在让我觉得奇怪。

source: (The man's absolutely mad. Ophelia was right.)
target: （这人彻底疯了。奥菲莉娅说得没错。）

source: (Ergh. Lock him up and throw away the key, that's what I think!)
target: （呸。我看就该把他关起来，再把钥匙扔掉！）

source: (S-still, there is a certain attractive air about him, though...)
target: （可、可是，他身上倒也有种迷人的气质……）

source: Gentlemen. Can I get you a drink?
target: 各位先生。要喝点什么吗？

source: We've come fer our coin, 'n fact.
target: 其实，咱们是来拿钱的。

source: Aye. We're here to collect what yeh owe.
target: 对。咱们是来收你欠的钱。

source: Before the lord come the barking hounds, I suppose.
target: 看来主人还没到，吠叫的猎犬倒先来了。

source: Can that master not come to see me himself?
target: 你们那位主人就不能亲自来见我吗？

source: I've told him I'd pay him. And when I have the coin, I intend to keep my word.
target: 我告诉过他，我会还钱。等我有了钱，自然会守诺。

source: The Danish King has squeezed every coin from my pockets in tax to fuel his lavish wedding.
target: 丹麦国王为了办他那奢华的婚礼，收税收得我口袋里一枚钱币都没剩下。

source: He's a rich man, and I a poor one. That's the way of the world. I've nothing to give you yet.
target: 他是富人，我是穷人。世道就是如此。我现在还没钱给你们。

source: Can we not settle this reasonably?
target: 我们就不能讲道理，好好解决这件事吗？

source: One day, Othello. That's what yeh get.
target: 一天，奥赛罗。就给你一天。

source: Today we've given yeh early warning.
target: 今天咱们算是提前警告你了。

source: Tomorrow we'll be less kind.
target: 明天可就没这么客气了。

source: ...I see.
target: ……我明白了。

source: So you have no reasonable intent whatsoever. Merely the thuggish rallying cry of 'more coin!'
target: 所以你们根本无意讲道理，只会像暴徒一样叫嚷着“多拿钱来！”

source: And you intend to brutalize me regardless... as if I could grind gold out of the stones in the floor of this old inn.
target: 你们无论如何都打算对我施暴……好像我能从这家老客栈的地砖里磨出金子似的。

source: Words, words, words. That's all yeh got.
target: 空话，空话，空话。你也就会说这个。

source: How about bein' a man of yer word?
target: 怎么不做个说话算话的人呢？

source: Wah hah hah!
target: 哇哈哈！

source: Go. Get out.
target: 走。滚出去。

source: What's going on here?
target: 这里怎么回事？

source: Guard captain.
target: 卫队长。

source: Nothin', sir! We wos just coming around for a drink...
target: 没啥，长官！咱们就是过来喝一杯……

source: That's not what I've heard from the good Lady Ophelia here.
target: 我从这位好心的奥菲莉娅小姐那里听到的，可不是这么回事。

source: Leave, and never return, or I'll have my men rout out all of you and clean the back alleyways until they sparkle.
target: 滚，再也不许回来，否则我就让手下把你们全都揪出来，把后巷清理得干干净净。

source: T-thank you, sir.
target: 谢、谢谢您，长官。

source: Don't thank me. Thank Lady Ophelia.
target: 别谢我。谢奥菲莉娅小姐吧。

source: Now. Was I sufficiently intimidating?
target: 好了。我刚才够吓人吗？

source: I think so. With any luck, they won't return.
target: 我觉得够了。运气好的话，他们就不会再来了。

source: I owe you a great debt, my lady. You are as noble-hearted as you are beautiful.
target: 小姐，我欠您一个天大的人情。您的心地和您的容貌一样美好。

source: While I wish I could pay you, all I have to offer are my stories.
target: 我也希望能用钱酬谢您，但我能献上的，只有我的故事。

source: I would love to spin you a tale in private, have you the time to listen.
target: 如果您有时间听，我很愿意私下给您讲个故事。

source: This evening at midnight, I close the bar. Perhaps you could meet me then?
target: 今晚午夜，酒馆就打烊了。或许您可以那时来见我？

source: ...Say, we've been drinking all day.
target: ……我说，咱们都喝一整天了。

source: Haven't we earned a tall tale?
target: 也该给咱们讲个离奇故事了吧？

source: So you only patronize my tavern for the stories I tell?
target: 所以你们来光顾我的酒馆，就只是为了听我讲故事？

source: Come, friends. You offend me. My ale's at least twice as good as the horse piss in the alley outside.
target: 得了，朋友们。你们可真伤人。我的麦酒至少比外头巷子里的马尿好喝一倍。

source: And besides, you only want to hear a tale so you can doze off at my tables.
target: 再说，你们想听故事，不过是为了在我的桌边打瞌睡。

source: Tell the one about the sea-witch!
target: 讲那个海巫婆的故事！

source: Yeah, that old evil hag!
target: 对，那个邪恶的老妖婆！

source: Ha—so be it, then.
target: 哈——那好吧。

source: ...Now, friends. As you may recall, I was a haggard sailor in my youth...
target: ……好了，朋友们。你们或许还记得，我年轻时是个饱经风霜的水手……

source: And I spent my years in servitude to many captains, some good, and some evil, but all greedy.
target: 那些年，我为许多船长效过力，有些是好人，有些是恶人，但个个都贪婪。

source: Now, it so happens that in the middle of a mysteriously stormy summer, our ship the Titania was called upon for a private mission.
target: 有一年夏天，暴风雨莫名地频繁。就在那个夏天，我们的泰坦妮娅号接到了一项私人委托。

source: We were invited to the glistening palace of the Sultan himself, and landed on the coast of Algiers soon after.
target: 我们受邀前往苏丹那金碧辉煌的宫殿，不久便在阿尔及尔的海岸登陆。

source: There were women from his harem there to greet us, gilded and sinuous, clad all in white.
target: 他后宫里的女子前来迎接我们，身披白衣，佩着金饰，身姿婀娜。

source: And wine was poured, and we were plied with sweet music and song for all the long night.
target: 美酒斟满了杯，甜美的乐声与歌声招待了我们整整一夜。

source: Get to the part with Sycorax!
target: 快讲到西科拉克斯那段！

source: Patience, friend. Patience!
target: 耐心点，朋友。耐心点！

source: The Sultan himself begged us to take a certain... 'problem' off his hands. A murderous witch, but a pregnant one.
target: 苏丹亲自恳求我们，帮他带走一个……“麻烦”。一个杀人害命的女巫，可她怀着身孕。

source: The vile witch Sycorax had committed numerous bloody crimes against the Sultan, and for that, he wanted her banished. He could not kill a woman with child, he said.
target: 邪恶的女巫西科拉克斯犯下了多起针对苏丹的血腥罪行，因此他想将她放逐。他说，自己不能杀死一个孕妇。

source: He asked our crew to take her to an island far from his shores and leave her there forever, for magic cannot travel over the ocean.
target: 他让我们把她带到一座远离他国土海岸的岛上，永远把她留在那里，因为魔法无法越过大海。

source: In return, we were each offered a mountain of gold; enough to last us seven lifetimes over, if not more, as wealthy men.
target: 作为回报，他答应给我们每个人一座金山；足以让我们富足地过上七辈子，甚至更久。

source: Then... we saw her. The witch.
target: 然后……我们见到了她。那个女巫。

source: Was she uglier than a goat?
target: 她比山羊还丑吗？

source: The blue-eyed hag... she defies description.
target: 那个蓝眼睛的老妖婆……根本无法用言语形容。

source: The first time she came aboard our ship in chains, we could see she was heavily with child. She stared at me, and I knew she could see all my thoughts laid bare.
target: 她第一次戴着锁链登上我们的船时，我们看得出她已经大腹便便。她盯着我，我知道，我所有的心思都在她眼前暴露无遗。

source: We pushed out from the Sultan's port that day and set sail. We chained her in the hold. Two suns later, our captain died suddenly in the night.
target: 那天，我们驶离苏丹的港口，扬帆起航。我们把她锁在底舱。两天后，船长在夜里突然死了。

source: The men whispered that she had cursed him. But who were we to say? After all, the captain loved his rum and often drank to uselessness. This time he'd simply gone too far.
target: 船员们私下说，是她诅咒了他。可我们又凭什么断言呢？毕竟，船长嗜好朗姆酒，经常喝得烂醉。这次不过是喝过了头。

source: ...But by the time we had reached the Mediterranean, one man had gone insane and jumped overboard, and one man had slit another's throat, then his own.
target: ……可等我们抵达地中海时，已经有一个人发疯跳进了海里，还有一个人割开了别人的喉咙，接着又割开了自己的。

source: Now I had become the ship's captain, by the crew's vote.
target: 这时，船员们投票选出了新船长，那就是我。

source: Wait a minute.
target: 等一下。

source: Wasn't that island in the New World before?
target: 你之前不是说，那座岛在新大陆吗？

source: You're telling it differently!
target: 你这次讲得不一样了！

source: Useless details of no consequence.
target: 都是些无关紧要的细节。

source: I went to visit the witch myself. She sat in the darkness of the hold, her hair limp, her eyes haggard, her gaze poison.
target: 我亲自去见了那个女巫。她坐在黑暗的底舱里，头发软塌塌地垂着，双眼憔悴，目光狠毒。

source: 'Witch,' I told her, 'I will free you from your chains and give you my cabin if you kill no more of my men.'
target: “女巫，”我对她说，“只要你不再杀我的船员，我就解开你的锁链，把我的船舱让给你。”

source: At that, she merely laughed. 'And what will I do then to entertain myself? You must give me something better.'
target: 听了这话，她只是笑。“那我靠什么消遣呢？你得给我更好的东西。”

source: So I gave her all I had.
target: 于是，我献上了我仅有的东西。

source: 'If you leave my men alive,' I said, 'I will tell you one story each night, until we land on the island's shores.'
target: “只要你让我的船员活着，”我说，“我就每晚给你讲一个故事，直到我们登上那座岛的海岸。”

source: She laughed again. But in the end, she consented. And I spent every night telling her long tales, just as I sit here now, keeping her enthralled.
target: 她又笑了。但最后，她答应了。于是，我每晚都给她讲长长的故事，就像此刻坐在这里一样，让她听得入迷。

source: True to her word, no more of my men died. But when we approached shore, we were beset with a violent storm. The ship railed so wide on the waves I thought we would certainly perish.
target: 她信守承诺，我的船员再也没有人死去。但临近海岸时，我们遭遇了一场猛烈的风暴。船在波涛中剧烈摇摆，我以为我们必死无疑。

source: Rain and hail pummeled us through the darkness as I maintained course. The lamps had all been sodden. Only lightning briefly lit our path forward, followed by screaming thunder.
target: 黑暗中，雨水和冰雹不断砸在我们身上，我仍维持着航向。灯全都被水浸透了。只有闪电短暂照亮前路，紧接着便是刺耳的雷鸣。

source: At last I saw land, a hundred meters out.
target: 终于，我看见了百米之外的陆地。

source: And suddenly—out of nowhere—craggy rocks rose into the air. We were going to hit rock! We were going to drown! The ship shuddered and screeched.
target: 突然——毫无征兆地——嶙峋的礁石高高耸起。我们就要撞上礁石了！我们就要淹死了！船身颤抖着，发出刺耳的声响。

source: As men flew overboard, I heard their dying screams. And as I looked at the bow of the ship... I saw Sycorax.
target: 船员们被甩进海里，我听见了他们临死前的惨叫。而当我望向船头……我看见了西科拉克斯。

source: Sycorax was laughing. Standing at the bow of the ship, unaffected by rain or the jerk of the now-dead ship. Just laughing, and laughing, and laughing.
target: 西科拉克斯在笑。她站在船头，雨水和这艘已毁的船的颠簸都影响不了她。她只是笑，不停地笑，不停地笑。

source: I ran to her and grabbed her by the shoulders. 'Witch,' I screamed, 'You must save us from this hell!'
target: 我跑到她面前，抓住她的双肩。“女巫，”我喊道，“你必须把我们从这地狱里救出去！”

source: She looked at me then. The rain ceased. The waters calmed. The ship stabilized. And she smiled.
target: 这时，她看着我。雨停了。海面平静了。船稳住了。她笑了。

source: 'You alone showed me kindness,' she said to me. 'This island belongs to me now. Begone, and take your life as your due reward.'
target: “只有你善待过我，”她对我说，“这座岛现在归我了。走吧，留你一命，就是你应得的回报。”

source: ...And then I awoke.
target: ……然后我醒了。

source: You... awoke?
target: 你……醒了？

source: I was covered in sand, lying on the shore of a mysterious beach. It was day, and the sun heated my back. I'd been there for God knows how long.
target: 我浑身是沙，躺在一片陌生的海滩上。那时是白天，太阳晒得我的后背发热。天知道我在那里躺了多久。

source: As I crawled up onto the shore, I saw the white tip of the Sultan's palace breaking the treeline. I was in Algiers.
target: 我往岸上爬去，看见苏丹宫殿的白色尖顶露出了树梢。我回到了阿尔及尔。

source: I tried to tell him what I'd seen, but with no ship and no crew, he assumed I'd gone mad and deserted my men. He wouldn't hear my tale.
target: 我试着告诉他自己看见了什么，但船和船员都没了，他便认定我发了疯，抛弃了自己的船员。他不肯听我的讲述。

source: With no gold, no ship, and no crew, I left Algiers on foot. But I never forgot the blue-eyed hag, or the gift she gave to me.
target: 没有金子，没有船，也没有船员，我徒步离开了阿尔及尔。但我从未忘记那个蓝眼睛的老妖婆，也从未忘记她给我的礼物。

source: God's blood, what time is it?
target: 天哪，现在几点了？

source: We've been here all day.
target: 咱们在这儿待了一整天了。

source: The missus is waiting. I've got to go.
target: 我老婆还等着呢。我得走了。

source: Til next time, friends.
target: 下次再见，朋友们。

source: The poor soul sat singing by a tree, sing all a green willow...
target: 可怜的人儿坐在树旁歌唱，唱那青青的垂柳……

source: Her hand on her bosom, her head on her knee...
target: 她手抚胸口，头枕膝上……

source: The fresh streams ran by her, and murmur'd her moans...
target: 清溪流过她身旁，低声应和她的哀叹……

source: Her salt tears fell from her, and soften'd the stones...
target: 她咸涩的泪珠滴落，连石头也为之柔软……

source: Sing willow, willow, willow.
target: 唱吧，垂柳，垂柳，垂柳。

source: Apologies, my lady. I forgot myself. Can I get you something to drink?
target: 抱歉，小姐。我有些忘情了。您要喝点什么吗？

source: No, I was merely listening. It's a sad song, isn't it? A song about hopelessness.
target: 不用，我只是听听。这首歌很悲伤，对吧？唱的是绝望。

source: Yes. But so are many things in this age. You know, you remind me a little of the woman in the song. You have that air of sadness about you.
target: 是啊。不过，这个时代有许多事都是如此。你知道吗，你让我有点想起歌里的那个女人。你身上也有那种忧伤的气息。

source: Are you that one they call Lady Ophelia? It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am Othello. I've heard much about you.
target: 你就是大家说的奥菲莉娅女士吗？很高兴认识你。我是奥赛罗。听过不少关于你的事。

source: Oh. My apologies for not introducing myself.
target: 哦。抱歉，我还没自我介绍。

source: Think nothing of it.
target: 别放在心上。

source: I suppose we haven't met before, have we. Yes, I'm Ophelia.
target: 看来我们以前没见过，对吧。是的，我是奥菲莉娅。

source: The pleasure is all mine. I am Ophelia.
target: 我也很荣幸。我是奥菲莉娅。

source: You were singing alone. Do you not sing to music?
target: 你刚才在清唱。你唱歌不用伴奏吗？

source: I used to play the lute. But it's been a long time since I had one in working shape.
target: 我以前弹鲁特琴。不过，我已经很久没有一把能用的琴了。

source: My brother plays as well. He's quite the talent.
target: 我哥哥也会弹。他很有天赋。

source: That so! Why, you should have him come down and we'll raise a real hell sometime, seeing who is the master among us.
target: 是吗！那你该找个时候叫他来，我们好好闹上一场，看看谁才是真正的高手。

source: What you did out there was bold.
target: 你刚才在外面做的事很有胆量。

source: It won't help anything. There's nowhere left for me now.
target: 那也无济于事。现在已经没有我的容身之处了。

source: I've thought that many times in my life, and I've always been wrong.
target: 我这辈子也这么想过很多次，可每次都想错了。

source: You'll survive. I have faith.
target: 你会挺过去的。我相信你。

source: Ah, the good lady Irma, so glad you could join us.
target: 啊，亲爱的伊尔玛女士，真高兴你能来。

source: Shut up, you sly-tongued fool. Let's drink!
target: 闭嘴吧，你这个油嘴滑舌的傻瓜。喝酒！

source: Oh, Othello, you needn't suffer her to speak to you like that.
target: 哦，奥赛罗，你没必要忍着，让她这样跟你说话。

source: Irma's got a spine of iron. She can talk to me any way she pleases.
target: 伊尔玛可是铁骨铮铮。她想怎么跟我说话都行。

source: Now, then. What shall we play this evening?
target: 那么，今晚我们玩什么？

source: Time's up, old fool.
target: 时间到了，老蠢货。

source: Yeh can't shirk payment forever.
target: 你别想一直赖着不还钱。

source: ... Friends, please stay here.
target: ……朋友们，请留在这里。

source: Gentlemen. I see that reason has failed your master once more.
target: 先生们。看来你们的主人又一次失去了理智。

source: For the last time: My word is good, but so long as my coin goes to the king, I've nothing to pay with. What more can I offer you?
target: 我最后再说一次：我说话算数，可只要我的钱还得交给国王，我就没钱还债。我还能拿什么给你们？

source: Our master sends 'is final word.
target: 我们主人让我们带来最后一句话。

source: If you've truly nothin', we'll take blood.
target: 你要是真没钱，就拿血来还。

source: Othello! N-no—
target: 奥赛罗！不、不要——

source: Aimed for the heart, got 'im in the shoulder. Half-wits.
target: 瞄着心脏，却打中了肩膀。一群蠢货。

source: Quickly--I must bandage it. You. Fetch me cloth.
target: 快——我得给他包扎。你。给我拿块布来。

source: Found some. Is he—is it—
target: 找到了。他是不是——这是不是——

source: I've found some. Behind the bar.
target: 我找到了。在吧台后面。

source: Quiet. Hold him still.
target: 安静。扶住他，别让他动。

source: He's not conscious.
target: 他失去意识了。

source: There's... so much blood...
target: 流了……好多血……

source: I do so despise blood.
target: 我实在讨厌血。

source: Then look away, and let me work. This is the kind of thing you don't learn in that university of yours.
target: 那就看别处去，让我干活。这种事，你在那所大学里可学不到。

source: There. That should do it. He's lucky only his arm was pierced.
target: 好了。这样应该就行了。他运气不错，只有胳膊被刺穿了。

source: My thanks, Irma. You're too kind.
target: 谢谢你，伊尔玛。你真是太好了。

source: Can't believe they got me so easily. Heh.
target: 真不敢相信，他们这么轻易就伤到了我。呵。

source: I'm all right, friends. I feel better even as we speak.
target: 我没事，朋友们。就说话这会儿，我已经感觉好多了。

source: Don't move that arm.
target: 别动那条胳膊。

source: It's my sword arm. Am I not to defend myself against thugs?
target: 这是我握剑的胳膊。难道遇上暴徒，我也不能自卫吗？

source: If you don't let it heal, you won't be alive to ask yourself such introspective questions!
target: 你要是不让伤口愈合，就没命再琢磨这些自省的问题了！

source: Othello. You... you're in danger, aren't you?
target: 奥赛罗。你……你有危险，对不对？

source: It's only going to get worse if you stay. A war is coming. Taxes on your inn will only increase.
target: 你要是留下，情况只会更糟。战争就要来了。你这家旅店要交的税只会越来越多。

source: Though I do wish the circumstances of our introduction were rather different.
target: 不过，我确实希望我们能在别的情形下认识。

source: Yes. My... acquaintance, indeed. It's very nice to... meet you, Othello.
target: 是啊。认识我……确实。很高兴……认识你，奥赛罗。

source: Ah, the pleasure is all mine!
target: 啊，我也很荣幸！

source: Now, then...
target: 那么……

source: Do I detect concern on my behalf, Lady Ophelia? I shall consider myself a fortunate man.
target: 你这是在担心我吗，奥菲莉娅女士？那我可真是个幸运的人。

source: Don't fret about me. I've lived through worse.
target: 别担心我。更糟的事我都挺过来了。

source: Worse than... death?
target: 比……死亡还糟？

source: ...Othello. It may be time to consider alternative options.
target: ……奥赛罗。也许该考虑别的出路了。

source: Hiding, for example. A thoroughly tried and true strategy—if not the most noble.
target: 比如躲起来。这可是久经考验、确实行得通的办法——虽然不怎么光彩。

source: You could go anywhere. Why, you could visit my hometown of Venice!
target: 你去哪儿都行。对了，你可以去我的家乡威尼斯看看！

source: I'm not leaving. That's not up for discussion.
target: 我不会走。这件事没得商量。

source: Hmph. Suit yourself. You're more stubborn than even I.
target: 哼。随你的便。你比我还固执。

source: Irma, I think it's high time we retired for the evening. Let's leave Othello to lick his wounds.
target: 伊尔玛，我想我们今晚也该回去休息了。让奥赛罗自己养伤吧。

source: Shut up, you sly-tongued fool. Let's drink.
target: 闭嘴吧，你这个油嘴滑舌的傻瓜。喝酒。

source: Now, then. What shall we play?
target: 那么，我们玩什么？

source: Ah! I have just the thing.
target: 啊！我正好有个主意。

source: When I was with Hamlet at Wittenburg, there was a game some of the students liked to play.
target: 我和哈姆雷特在维滕贝格的时候，有些学生很喜欢玩一个游戏。

source: The rules are simple. I call it two truths, one lie. All one must do is this...
target: 规则很简单。我叫它两句真话，一句假话。只要这么做就行……

source: The speaker delivers two truths about themselves, and one falsehood. Then someone attempts to guess the falsehood.
target: 轮到的人说三件关于自己的事，两件真的，一件假的。然后由别人来猜哪句是假话。

source: If they're correct, the speaker drinks. If they're incorrect, they drink, and the speaker continues to a new round. Simple, yes?
target: 猜对了，说话的人喝酒。猜错了，就由猜的人喝酒，说话的人继续下一轮。很简单，对吧？

source: Suspiciously simple. You first.
target: 简单得有点可疑。你先来。

source: Agreed. We'll guess about you.
target: 同意。我们来猜你说的。

source: As you wish. Here they are, then.
target: 如你们所愿。那就听好了。

source: Number one: I was born in Italy.
