target: 第一：我出生在意大利。

source: Number two: I once bested a man twice my size in armed combat.
target: 第二：我曾在持械交战中击败一个体格有我两倍大的男人。

source: And number three: I am a truly excellent sailor.
target: 第三：我确实是个出色的水手。

source: W-well, the second one's the lie, of course! I've heard you speak Italian, and I remember when you served in the King's fleet.
target: 那、那当然是第二句假话了！我听过你说意大利语，也记得你在国王的舰队里服过役。

source: But you're a small and frail man. God's blood, I could snap you in half over my knee like an errant bit of kindling.
target: 可你又瘦小又虚弱。老天爷，就连我也能把你往膝盖上一压，像根零散的柴火一样折成两半。

source: Wrong. Drink.
target: 错了。喝酒。

source: I was born in Calicut. And I'll have you know I'm far stronger than I look. On that fateful day when King Hamlet and Fortinbras' father crossed arms...
target: 我出生在卡利卡特。而且我要让你知道，我可比看起来强壮多了。哈姆雷特国王与福丁布拉斯的父亲交战的那个命运攸关的日子……

source: It was all able enlisted bodies to the field. I may be delicate, but I am technically able.
target: 所有有作战能力的军人都得上战场。我或许柔弱，但严格来说，我确实有作战能力。

source: One of those great Norwegian lieutenants came at me, unhorsed but angry, his blade held high. I went left. He went left.
target: 一个高大的挪威副官朝我冲来，他被打落了马，满腔怒火，高举着刀。我向左躲。他也向左。

source: The gnarled root in between us, however, did not go left. It remained fixed. He tripped, cracked his skull, and died. I fled.
target: 不过，我们中间那根盘曲的树根可没有向左。它待在原地。他绊倒了，摔裂了头骨，死了。我逃了。

source: You-- you can't call that 'besting' anything!
target: 你——这哪能叫“击败”了谁！

source: Let's not argue semantics, my dear Irma. I find it so tiresome.
target: 别咬文嚼字了，亲爱的伊尔玛。我觉得这太烦人了。

source: I commend you, Horatio. I have fought a thousand battles and bested ten thousand opponents in my time.
target: 我佩服你，霍拉旭。我这辈子打过一千场仗，击败过一万个对手。

source: At the end of the day, the better warrior is the warrior who survives. No more, no less. We drink in your honor.
target: 说到底，活下来的战士才是更优秀的战士。仅此而已。我们敬你一杯。

source: Does this not mean you are entitled to a second round?
target: 这么说，你不是可以再来一轮吗？

source: Ah, yes. Allow me to think.
target: 啊，没错。让我想想。

source: One: I am but a young man of twenty.
target: 第一：我只是个二十岁的年轻人。

source: Two, I bought the 'heretic' Martin Luther a drink for doing us all the favor of collective honesty. Ninety-nine times, to be precise.
target: 第二，我请那位“异端”马丁·路德喝过酒，感谢他帮了我们所有人一把，让大家都说了实话。准确地说，请了九十九次。

source: And three? I once allowed the great Signore Michelangelo to draw me, many years ago. It is the only depiction of myself I own.
target: 第三呢？许多年前，我曾让伟大的米开朗琪罗先生为我画像。那是我唯一收藏的自己的画像。

source: Hmph! We know that to be a simple one.
target: 哼！这一轮肯定很容易猜。

source: You just came from Wittenberg. I've no doubt Martin Luther is bar crawling, basking in his unpopularity there still... for now.
target: 你刚从维滕贝格回来。我毫不怀疑马丁·路德还在那里一家酒馆接一家地喝，享受着自己不受欢迎的名声……暂时如此。

source: But you? What could the great Michelangelo want with a little poorly-shod wanderer like you?
target: 可你呢？像你这样瘦小、连双像样的鞋都没有的流浪汉，伟大的米开朗琪罗能看上你什么？

source: He is the best artist in all the world, they say. And he has many admirers and students!
target: 人们都说，他是全世界最好的艺术家。他的仰慕者和学生可多了！

source: Well, then. Call me an 'admirer' of his. And he an admirer of me.
target: 那好吧。就当我是他的“仰慕者”。而他也仰慕着我。

source: What on earth do you mean by that?
target: 你这话到底是什么意思？

source: Irma, God above, can we leave nothing to imagination anymore? Regardless, it's true. I keep it among my things in the castle.
target: 伊尔玛，老天爷，难道就不能留点想象的余地吗？总之，这是真的。那幅画就放在城堡里我的东西当中。

source: I think this is our cue to drink, friends.
target: 朋友们，我想这就该轮到我们喝酒了。

source: If I keep up this rate, I'll be no good to serve.
target: 照这个速度喝下去，我就没法招待客人了。

source: I don't want to play anymore, either.
target: 我也不想再玩了。

source: Sore loser, Irma?
target: 输不起了，伊尔玛？

source: For the last time: my word is good, but so long as my coin goes to the king, I've nothing to pay with. What more can I offer you?
target: 我最后再说一次：我说话算数，可只要我的钱还得交给国王，我就没钱还债。我还能拿什么给你们？

source: That's enough. Stand down, thieves.
target: 够了。住手，你们这群贼。

source: L-l-lord Bernardo!
target: 贝、贝、贝尔纳多大人！

source: ... I see we were wise to become involved. Lady Ophelia, are you unharmed?
target: ……看来我们插手是明智的。奥菲莉娅女士，你没受伤吧？

source: It's not me you need to worry about.
target: 你该担心的可不是我。

source: Very well then. Marcellus, take these brigands to the dungeon. They'll be tried for extorting an innocent man.
target: 那好。马塞勒斯，把这些强盗带到地牢去。他们将因勒索无辜的人而受审。

source: Aye. Come on then, gents. The both of yeh.
target: 是。走吧，两位。你们俩都得走。

source: Othello... are you... all right?
target: 奥赛罗……你……没事吧？

source: Think nothing of it, my lady. I'm simply truly glad to have crossed paths.
target: 别放在心上，女士。能与你相遇，我实在很高兴。

source: I'm fine, thanks to your vigilance. It would seem I've got at least one angel smiling upon me.
target: 多亏你及时留意，我没事。看来至少有一位天使在眷顾我。

source: It's nothing. I'm sure Bernardo and Marcellus are happy to help.
target: 没什么。我相信贝尔纳多和马塞勒斯都很乐意帮忙。

source: ...Hmph. With this threat summarily dispatched, I will be returning to my regular duties, such as preventing imminent political collapse.
target: ……哼。既然这个威胁已经迅速解决，我就回去履行我的日常职责了，比如防止迫在眉睫的政局崩溃。

source: Ophelia, mind you don't get into any other business which would be unseemly for a lady of your status.
target: 奥菲莉娅，记住，别再卷进与你这样身份的女士不相称的事情。

source: And I'm watching you too, Othello.
target: 还有，奥赛罗，我也会盯着你。

source: But of course, my lord Bernardo. The lady will be in safe hands with those thieves gone.
target: 当然，贝尔纳多大人。那些贼走了，这位女士在我这里会很安全。

source: I would love nothing more. But—as you can see—I've received quite the wound.
target: 我求之不得。可是——你也看到了——我伤得不轻。

source: Those brigands set upon my establishment earlier. Were it not for a pinch of luck, I'd be dead, I think.
target: 那些强盗先前袭击了我这家店。要不是有那么一点运气，我想我已经死了。

source: I feel too faint to give you a proper introduction, and as such, I'd request that we postpone this meeting until the wound's healed.
target: 我现在虚弱得没法好好向你介绍自己，所以我想请你把这次见面推迟到伤好以后。

source: I do prefer to make a good first impression. You understand.
target: 我确实希望留下一个好的第一印象。你能理解的。

source: So. You came after all.
target: 那么。你还是来了。

source: It's strange. I've... never been out this late on my own before. I don't know what compelled me.
target: 真奇怪。我……以前从没这么晚独自出门过。我也不知道是什么驱使我来的。

source: Yes, I seem to have that effect on people.
target: 是啊，我似乎就是会让人这样。

source: You promised me a story, and I've come to collect.
target: 你答应给我讲个故事，我来听你兑现承诺了。

source: Then have a seat and a mug of wine, and I'll tell you all my secrets.
target: 那就坐下，喝杯葡萄酒，我会把所有秘密都告诉你。

source: Tell me, my lady. Have you ever been to Athens?
target: 告诉我，女士。你去过雅典吗？

source: Athens? I've hardly been here.
target: 雅典？我连这里都没来过几次。

source: What a pity! I was there once, ashore to make a trade with my crew.
target: 真可惜！我去过一次，和我的船员一起上岸做买卖。

source: In the middle of the night, I awoke to hear the most beautiful singing I'd ever heard in my life.
target: 半夜，我醒来，听到了这辈子听过最美的歌声。

source: It was a woman's voice, calling to me through the darkness, and I... felt so strange. As though I must certainly find that voice.
target: 那是一个女人的声音，穿过黑暗呼唤着我，而我……感觉很奇怪。仿佛非得找到那个声音不可。

source: So I stumbled out of my quarters, into the deep, dark forest beyond the city's lanterns. And there I became truly and deeply lost.
target: 于是我跌跌撞撞地走出住处，走进城中灯火照不到的幽暗密林。在那里，我彻底迷失了方向。

source: After what seemed like hours, I burst into a wooded glen and saw her: the Queen of the Faeries. She wore nothing, and her hair was down to her knees, woven with flowers.
target: 不知过了多久，仿佛有好几个小时，我闯进林间的一处幽谷，看见了她：仙灵女王。她一丝不挂，头发垂到膝盖，发间编着鲜花。

source: Even so, I sensed that she was strong. When she glanced at me, I knew she was deciding whether to greet me or consume me—as though she were a massive spider.
target: 即便如此，我仍能感觉到她的强大。她瞥向我时，我知道她正在决定是向我问好，还是把我吞食——仿佛她是一只巨大的蜘蛛。

source: Oh, come now. Surely you aren't saying faeries are real...?
target: 哦，别逗了。你该不会是说，仙灵真的存在……？

source: Hmm! I make no claims, my lady, beyond what I saw that night.
target: 嗯！女士，我只说那晚亲眼所见的事，除此之外不作任何断言。

source: Titania pulled me into her arms and—everything went strange after that.
target: 泰坦妮娅把我拉进怀里，然后——一切都变得奇怪了。

source: I thought she kept me there for years. Wandering her woods, listening to her singing, lying on beds of flowers.
target: 我感觉她把我留在了那里好多年。我在她的林间漫步，听她唱歌，躺在鲜花铺成的床上。

source: She told me she loved me and demanded I love her in return. I told her I could not. And she promised never to let me leave until I was hers.
target: 她说她爱我，要求我也爱她。我告诉她，我做不到。她便说，只要我还不属于她，她就绝不会让我离开。

source: Were... you... did you and she... lie together intimately?
target: 你……你和她……有过肌肤之亲吗？

source: I think so. It's hard to remember. B-but I think so. When you're pulled into the embrace of a being like that... nothing makes sense.
target: 我想是的。很难记清了。不、不过我想是的。被那样的存在拥入怀中时……一切都变得无法理解。

source: Still, I always knew I didn't love her. Sometimes she brought other mortal men and women into her fold. They professed their love to her immediately, and she consumed their hearts.
target: 可我始终知道，我不爱她。有时，她会把别的凡人男女带到她身边。他们立刻向她表白爱意，她便吞食了他们的心。

source: In some sick way, I wanted her to consume my heart, too. I wanted to give in. But I couldn't. Something wouldn't let me.
target: 说来有些病态，我也想让她吞食我的心。我想屈服。可我做不到。有某种东西不让我这么做。

source: One night, Titania grew furious. She raged at me, threw me against a tree with the force of her magic.
target: 一天夜里，泰坦妮娅大发雷霆。她朝我怒吼，用魔法把我狠狠摔向一棵树。

source: She buried me under the earth so I couldn't breathe, tore my limbs apart and grew them anew.
target: 她把我埋进土里，让我无法呼吸，扯断我的四肢，又让它们重新长出来。

source: She demanded I give in. Still, I refused, with the last of the strength I had.
target: 她要求我屈服。我却仍用尽最后的力气拒绝了她。

source: And when dawn came, Titania spat me out of her web, leaving me alone in the woods. When I found my way back to my men... they hadn't even realized I was gone.
target: 天亮时，提泰妮娅把我从她的网里吐了出来，留我独自在树林里。等我找到路，回到手下身边……他们竟然都没察觉我离开过。

source: All those years I'd spent with Titania amounted to but one night in the mortal world. Doesn't that seem impossible, that time would pass in such a strange way?
target: 我和提泰妮娅一起度过的那些年，在凡人的世界里竟只是一夜。时间会以这样奇怪的方式流逝，你不觉得这简直不可能吗？

source: Somehow, I don't find that impossible at all.
target: 不知为什么，我一点也不觉得这不可能。

source: Tell me. Do you... think you've ever been in love, my lady?
target: 告诉我，小姐。你……觉得自己曾经爱上过谁吗？

source: I was, once.
target: 曾经有过。

source: What was it like?
target: 那是什么感觉？

source: You mean you've never been in love?
target: 你是说，你从来没有爱上过谁？

source: I cannot say I have.
target: 我不能说有过。

source: Loving women and having been in love are rather different matters to me.
target: 对我来说，喜欢女人和真正爱上一个人，是很不一样的两回事。

source: Well, then. It's... it's wonderful. It's painful, too. You spend all your time thinking about the other person—what they're feeling, whether they're happy.
target: 好吧。那感觉……那感觉很美好，也很痛苦。你会时时刻刻想着对方——对方是什么心情，开不开心。

source: Their pain becomes your own. When they suffer, so do you.
target: 对方的痛苦也成了你的痛苦。对方受苦，你也一样。

source: Even when you aren't in love anymore, that link still remains. I know he's suffering even now.
target: 就算已经不再相爱，那份牵连也还在。我知道，他现在依然很痛苦。

source: Ah! I've finally been struck with something. This must be Prince Hamlet-- the romance you mentioned earlier!
target: 啊！我终于想到了。这一定是哈姆雷特王子——就是你之前提到的那段恋情！

source: Well, that does make it rather a more interesting tale.
target: 这么一来，这个故事确实更有意思了。

source: And when you lay with him, what was it like? Was he sweet to you, or was he cruel with you, as some men are?
target: 那你和他同床时，又是什么感觉？他对你温柔吗，还是像有些男人一样，对你很残忍？

source: T-that's, um...
target: 这、这个，嗯……

source: Aha! Of course. I forget you're a Lady of the Court. Please forgive me.
target: 啊！当然。我忘了你是宫廷里的贵族小姐。请原谅我。

source: I never told anyone about it. That's all.
target: 我从没跟任何人说过这件事。仅此而已。

source: I'm terribly sorry. Have I embarrassed you? If so, please accept my gravest apologies.
target: 实在抱歉。我让你难堪了吗？如果是，请接受我最诚恳的道歉。

source: No, it's not that.
target: 不，不是因为这个。

source: Are you... still in love with him, then?
target: 那么，你……还爱着他吗？

source: I've known him all my life. We were children together. He's not just a person. He's home.
target: 我从小就认识他。我们一起长大。对我来说，他不只是一个人。他是家。

source: You can't easily stop loving someone when they're all you've ever known.
target: 如果一个人就是你一直以来熟悉的一切，你很难轻易不再爱他。

source: And I've explored what a future with him might look like, too.
target: 我也探索过，和他在一起的未来可能会是什么样。

source: 'Explored,' you say? In what manner?
target: 你说“探索过”？怎么探索的？

source: You wouldn't understand. It would only sound peculiar.
target: 你不会明白的。听起来只会很古怪。

source: Well, I can offer you something a little less 'peculiar,' I think.
target: 那么，我想我可以给你点没那么“古怪”的东西。

source: Well, I can certainly think of one way to find out.
target: 嗯，我倒是能想到一个弄清楚的办法。

source: Kiss Othello?
target: 亲吻奥赛罗？

source: I see. Some other time, then.
target: 我明白了。那就改天吧。

source: Believe you me, I wish circumstances were different, my lady.
target: 相信我，小姐，我也希望情况能有所不同。

source: Perhaps they can be.
target: 也许可以。

source: Ah, never mind that. Merely thinking aloud.
target: 啊，别在意。我只是把心里的想法说出来了。

source: Ah, look. Dawn approaches. It felt as though it was but a moment.
target: 啊，你看。天快亮了。感觉才过了一瞬间。

source: Seems you have some magic powers of your own.
target: 看来你也有自己的魔力。

source: ...You know, I'd like to see you again tomorrow night. That is, if you aren't dissuaded by my boldness.
target: ……其实，我想明晚再见到你。当然，前提是你没有被我的大胆吓退。

source: Perhaps it could be my turn to hear you tell a story of your own.
target: 也许可以轮到我，听你讲一个自己的故事。

source: I'll be waiting. Sweet dreams.
target: 我会等你的。做个好梦。

source: I'm grateful for the time we've spent together. I hope to see you in my bar soon.
target: 谢谢你陪我度过这段时光。希望很快能在我的酒馆里再见到你。

source: Please be safe on the road back to the castle. The men who threaten my establishment surely find their courage when the sun is down.
target: 回城堡的路上，请注意安全。那些威胁我酒馆的人，一到太阳落山，胆子就大起来了。

source: Ah... I don't think I should.
target: 啊……我觉得我不该这么做。

source: I see. Of course.
target: 我明白了。当然。

source: As I said before, please forgive my forwardness.
target: 还是那句话，请原谅我的冒昧。

source: I wish nothing more than to be able to follow our plans for tonight. But—as you can see—I've received quite the wound.
target: 我最希望的，就是能照我们今晚的计划去做。可你也看到了——我受了不轻的伤。

source: But I should be recovered after several days rest. Perhaps... we could meet again next week?
target: 不过休息几天，我应该就能恢复了。也许……我们可以下周再见？

source: Of course, Othello. Next week.
target: 当然，奥赛罗。下周见。

source: Ah, my mysterious paramour. We meet again.
target: 啊，我神秘的情人。我们又见面了。

source: You mentioned 'rumors' about me earlier. What did you mean by that?
target: 你之前提到了关于我的“传闻”。你指的是什么？

source: Oh... I don't know that they're, er, appropriate. I misspoke. My apologies.
target: 哦……我不知道那些话是不是，呃，适合说。我失言了。对不起。

source: I'm old enough not to be shielded from what others think.
target: 我已经长大了，不需要为了保护我，就不让我知道别人的想法。

source: W-well, the few who have been within the castle walls claim you're the loveliest woman in Claudius's court.
target: 这、这个，有少数进过城堡的人说，你是克劳狄斯宫廷里最美的女人。

source: And I must say, I'm inclined to agree.
target: 而且我得说，我也倾向于赞同。

source: There are also rumors of a... less savory nature. About your mother's origins, and her marriage to your father.
target: 还有些……不太好听的传闻。是关于你母亲的出身，以及她和你父亲的婚姻。

source: My mother was a servant. That's not a rumor. That's the truth.
target: 我母亲曾是仆人。这不是传闻，是事实。

source: Is it true, then, that her mother—your grandmother—was a slave?
target: 那么，她的母亲——也就是你的外祖母——曾是奴隶，这是真的吗？

source: I don't know. My father won't speak of where she came from. A-and... I've been told never to speak of it, either.
target: 我不知道。我父亲不肯说她来自哪里。而、而且……我也被告诫过，永远不许提这件事。

source: You have the look of a proud Aethiopian about you.
target: 你看起来像个骄傲的埃塞俄比亚人。

source: Were it not for your green eyes, I'd think you could be related to Empress Eleni herself.
target: 要不是你有一双绿眼睛，我会觉得，你说不定和埃莱妮皇后本人有亲缘关系。

source: Surely you aren't saying... there's more than one empress?
target: 你该不会是说……世上不止一位皇后吧？

source: Of course! Surely you don't think Denmark is the whole of the world? The Romans don't own everything! Haven't you been elsewhere?
target: 当然！你总不会以为丹麦就是整个世界吧？又不是一切都归罗马人所有！你没去过别的地方吗？

source: ...No. Until now, I'd never even left Elsinore, except to summer in Copenhagen as a girl.
target: ……没有。在这之前，除了小时候去哥本哈根过夏天，我连埃尔西诺都没离开过。

source: And even then, I rode in a carriage. A small walled box leading to a larger walled box.
target: 就算那时，我也是坐马车去的。一个四面封闭的小盒子，把我送到一个四面封闭的大盒子里。

source: God above. I'd no idea. How, then, do you live in the castle? Are you not lonely?
target: 天哪。我完全不知道。那你在城堡里是怎么过日子的？你不孤独吗？

source: No, of course not. I've got my father. And my brother, Laertes.
target: 不，当然不孤独。我有父亲，还有哥哥雷欧提斯。

source: And your friends?
target: 那你的朋友呢？

source: I'm afraid I don't have many of those.
target: 恐怕我的朋友不多。

source: I grew up playing with my brother, the Guard Captain Bernardo and the Prince. Most people in court were... unkind to my brother and me.
target: 从小到大，我都和哥哥、卫队长贝尔纳多，还有王子一起玩。宫廷里大多数人对我和哥哥……都不太友善。

source: We looked odd and they made sure we knew it. I know there are worse rumors about me floating around.
target: 我们的长相和别人不同，他们也总要让我们知道这一点。我知道，还有更难听的传闻在流传。

source: So I've... never known anyone my own age, not really. I much prefer the company of books. If a book hurts or disappoints me, I can simply close it.
target: 所以我……从来没有真正了解过任何同龄人。我更喜欢和书作伴。如果一本书让我受伤或失望，我只要把它合上就行了。

source: What is it like living here, in Castle Town?
target: 住在这里，住在城堡镇，是什么感觉？

source: Ha! I've only lived here two years. No, Ophelia--I am Somali, and was sold into slavery as a child.
target: 哈！我在这里才住了两年。不，奥菲莉娅——我是索马里人，小时候就被卖作奴隶了。

source: I lived a slave for nearly fifteen years.
target: 我做了将近十五年的奴隶。

source: I can scarcely remember the village I grew up in, but it was many distant worlds away from anything I see around me now.
target: 我几乎已经记不起自己长大的村庄了，但它和我如今眼前的一切，仿佛隔着无数个遥远的世界。

source: When I was captured, I know not where my parents went—I never saw either of them again.
target: 我被抓走时，不知道父母去了哪里——我再也没见过他们中的任何一个。

source: I recall our captors put us into the dark hold of a ship, hundreds of us chained so close together that we could scarcely move an inch.
target: 我记得，抓走我们的人把我们塞进了一艘船漆黑的货舱。几百个人被锁在一起，挤得几乎动弹不得。

source: This, for weeks, in sweltering heat and through rolling waves a hundred feet high. We cried and prayed in our moving coffin.
target: 就这样过了好几个星期，忍着闷热，穿过翻滚的百尺巨浪。我们在这口移动的棺材里哭泣、祈祷。

source: The woman next to me screamed for the first week, then died the next. I know not of what. Her corpse began to stink and swell and rot beside me.
target: 我身旁的女人整整尖叫了一个星期，第二个星期就死了。我不知道她是怎么死的。她的尸体就在我身边开始发臭、肿胀、腐烂。

source: Ophelia, if there is a hell, it is in the hold of that ship.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果世上有地狱，那就是那艘船的货舱。

source: I... was given over to my master's house in Constantinople, sold at market with all the other young men.
target: 我……和其他年轻男子一起在市场上被卖掉，送进了我主人在君士坦丁堡的家。

source: I was made to convert to Islam, though as a child, I had scarcely had time to know my village's pagan gods.
target: 我被迫改信伊斯兰教，可我当时还是个孩子，连村里信奉的异教诸神都还来不及了解。

source: And I learned to fight. I kept my master's gates and watched over his family as they slept.
target: 我也学会了战斗。我替主人守门，在他的家人熟睡时保护他们。

source: When I grew older, I saw my opportunity to bring my master great glory as a recruit in the sultan's army of slaves. My master permitted me to leave his household and serve him there.
target: 长大一些后，我发现了一个能为主人赢得莫大荣耀的机会：加入苏丹的奴隶军队，成为一名新兵。主人准许我离开他的家，到军中为他效力。

source: ...As I trained and fought for the sultan, I watched the Ottomans expand their empire ever westward, and roll through the white-faced men like lightning.
target: ……我为苏丹训练、征战，眼看着奥斯曼人不断向西扩张帝国，像闪电一样横扫那些白面孔的人。

source: I saw the magnificence of the world unfold before me, and I learned there was an Elsewhere. There were other places to be seen.
target: 壮丽的世界在我面前展开，我才知道，原来还有远方。还有别的地方值得去看。

source: When the opportunity came, I slipped my bonds of war and fled on foot to the west, where I have meandered ever since.
target: 机会来临时，我挣脱了战争的束缚，徒步逃往西方，从此一直在那里辗转游荡。

source: Othello, I... don't... know what to say. I'm so sorry.
target: 奥赛罗，我……不……不知道该说什么。听到这些，我真的很难过。

source: I cannot even imagine.
target: 我甚至无法想象。

source: All I've ever known is... well... comfort. This.
target: 我一直以来过的都是……嗯……安逸的生活。就是眼前这些。

source: You've endured so much. I could never have survived that.
target: 你承受了那么多。换作是我，绝不可能活下来。

source: Don't say that. The world is full of cruelty and ugliness and gold for the taking, Ophelia.
target: 别这么说。奥菲莉娅，这世上充满残酷与丑恶，也有黄金等着人去取。

source: You and I alike both understand how cruel some can be.
target: 有些人能有多残忍，你我都一样清楚。

source: But you're correct that likewise, I find your upbringing so strange, I don't know that I can imagine it. In the same way it is hard for you to know the inside of that darkened ship.
target: 不过你说得对，反过来也一样。你的成长经历对我来说如此陌生，我不知道自己能不能想象得出来。就像你也很难体会那艘漆黑的船里是什么样。

source: Well, come see me, then. Come see the castle.
target: 那就来看看我吧。来看看城堡。

source: Why don't I show you the way I live? After all, I've seen your inn, and I've heard your stories.
target: 让我带你看看我的生活，怎么样？毕竟，我看过你的旅店，也听过你的故事了。

source: ...I don't know that I'd be welcome at the palace. Not among lily-faced, blue-blooded Danes.
target: ……我不知道宫里会不会欢迎我。那些面色白皙、出身高贵的丹麦人，未必容得下我。

source: Then don't come to the palace. Let me show you the gardens, the grounds, the places I love to roam and read.
target: 那就别进宫。我带你看看花园，看看城堡周围的地方，看看我喜欢散步和读书的地方。

source: You'll be safe if you accompany me. I promise it. It's the least I can do.
target: 只要和我一起，你就会安全。我保证。这是我至少能为你做的。

source: I-if that's what you wish, then so be it.
target: 如、如果这是你的心愿，那就这么办吧。

source: I can hardly understand what I'm seeing. The gate I passed through... it was enormous!
target: 我简直不敢相信眼前的一切。刚才穿过的那扇门……太大了！

source: A-and the greenery, so maintained, and these trees, foreign and full-bloomed...
target: 还、还有这些草木，打理得这么好，还有这些异域来的树，花开得这么盛……

source: Ophelia, how do you live here and not walk about with your mouth agape?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你住在这里，怎么能不走到哪儿都惊讶得张大嘴巴？

source: It's all familiar to me. To me, this seems as plain and ordinary as anything else in my life.
target: 这一切我都很熟悉。对我来说，这和生活里的其他事物一样，平平无奇。

source: Anything becomes far less compelling when one sees it each morning.
target: 什么东西每天早上都看见，也就没那么吸引人了。

source: That pond... look at it. It's the perfect size for swimming!
target: 那片池塘……你看。大小正适合游泳！

source: And I'd expect it's just the right temperature for a summer night.
target: 我想，在夏夜里，它的水温也一定正合适。

source: Ahh... excellent. Care for a swim, my dear?
target: 啊……太好了。想游个泳吗，亲爱的？

source: I... can't swim. I don't even think I can float.
target: 我……不会游泳。我觉得自己连浮起来都做不到。

source: Fortunately for you, I can do both. Come and take my hand.
target: 算你走运，这两样我都会。来，握住我的手。

source: Easy, now. You can lean on me. I'll make sure you don't go under.
target: 慢慢来。你可以靠着我。我不会让你沉下去的。

source: My skirts—they're getting soaked. They're heavy like this.
target: 我的裙子——都浸湿了。这样好重。

source: I suppose you'll simply have to take them off, then.
target: 那我想，你就只好把裙子脱掉了。

source: There's no one around to see, after all.
target: 反正周围也没人会看见。

source: Enter a sexual relationship with Othello?
target: 与奥赛罗建立性关系？

source: Here. Help me with my dress.
target: 来，帮我脱裙子。

source: I don't think that's appropriate, Othello.
target: 我觉得这样不合适，奥赛罗。

source: So be it. Shall we just swim, then? I did promise to teach you.
target: 那好吧。我们就只游泳，怎么样？我可是答应了要教你的。

source: Try turning over and floating on your back. Here. I'll show you. It's simple.
target: 试着翻过身来，仰面浮在水上。来，我示范给你看。很简单。

source: Goodness. I'm soaked through.
target: 天哪。我浑身都湿透了。

source: You might not recover that gown. Silk and pond scum weren't made to mix.
target: 你那条裙子恐怕救不回来了。丝绸可不适合沾上池塘里的浮垢。

source: What in God's name?
target: 天哪，这是怎么回事？

source: ...Ophelia? Is that you I see?
target: ……奥菲莉娅？我看见的是你吗？

source: Who in hell is that?
target: 那该死的是什么人？

source: Step away from Lady Ophelia. At once!
target: 离奥菲莉娅小姐远点。立刻！

source: The King?
target: 国王？

source: Do you have some protest to offer here? Some explanation?
target: 你有什么要辩驳的吗？有什么要解释的？

source: That's what I thought.
target: 果然不出我所料。

source: You. Leave.
target: 你。离开。

source: With all due respect, my lord, I've done nothing wrong.
target: 恕我直言，陛下，我没有做错任何事。

source: The lady invited me here of her own free will. We were merely having a swim.
target: 是这位小姐自愿邀请我来的。我们只是游了个泳。

source: A swim, he says.
target: 游泳，他是这么说的。

source: Will you be honest with him, Ophelia, or should I?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你要自己跟他说实话，还是让我来说？

source: Surely, the poor man deserves to know.
target: 这个可怜人总该知道真相吧。

source: Ophelia, what is he talking about?
target: 奥菲莉娅，他在说什么？

source: Clearly, this woman is a serial seductress. After all, she's certainly made me look a fool.
target: 显然，这个女人惯于勾引男人。毕竟，她可是让我出了丑。

source: And now you, too, it seems.
target: 看来，如今也轮到你了。

source: What? Ophelia, this can't be true.
target: 什么？奥菲莉娅，这不可能是真的。

source: Go. I desire never to see your face again.
target: 走。我再也不想看见你的脸。

source: Well, it would be for the best you didn't allow that to happen.
target: 那么，你最好别让这种事发生。

source: As for you...
target: 至于你……

source: You've taken advantage of my weakness and of my trust.
target: 你利用了我的软弱，也利用了我的信任。

source: You took the broken heart of an old man and shattered it further.
target: 一个老人的心本已破碎，你却把它摔得更碎了。

source: You have proven yourself beneath me and my attention. Stay out of my way, and out of my sight.
target: 你已经证明，你配不上我，也不值得我关注。别挡我的路，也别出现在我眼前。

source: My lord—Your Highness—it's all right! I'm safe!
target: 大人——陛下——没事的！我很安全！

source: This is a friend of mine.
target: 这是我的一位朋友。

source: My King! I am Othello, of—
target: 陛下！我是奥赛罗，来自——

source: I don't give a damn who you are. Leave.
target: 我才不管你是谁。滚。

source: He's a friend, and a guest of mine. There's no reason to treat him with anything but respect.
target: 他是我的朋友，也是我的客人。您没有理由不尊重他。

source: A friend? Is that what you call this?
target: 朋友？你把这叫作朋友？

source: My nephew was right. You're nothing but a low-born whore.
target: 我侄子说得没错。你不过是个出身低贱的娼妇。

source: What did you say to her?
target: 你刚才对她说了什么？

source: I'll say whatever I like. I'm the King of this country, and I own your life within my hand.
target: 我想说什么就说什么。我是这个国家的国王，你的命就握在我手里。

source: Will you raise a hand against me, mongrel? Then I could gouge you on the spot. Nothing would give me greater pleasure.
target: 你敢对我动手吗，杂种？那我就能当场剜了你。没有什么能让我更痛快了。

source: I could mount your head on my wall like an old black ram.
target: 我可以把你的脑袋挂在墙上，就像挂一只老黑公羊的头。

source: Othello. Go.
target: 奥赛罗。走吧。

source: Leave. Please. I'll handle this.
target: 走吧。求你了。我来处理。

source: Go now.
target: 现在就走。

source: Do as she says.
target: 照她说的做。

source: Goodbye, Lady Ophelia.
target: 再见，奥菲莉娅女士。

source: As for you... I hope you feel appropriately and utterly ashamed.
target: 至于你……我希望你知道自己该有多羞耻，羞耻到无地自容。

source: Dry yourself off. Pick yourself up. You've clearly been allowed to cavort freely for too long. Idleness breeds sin.
target: 把身上擦干。站起来。显然，放任你胡闹的日子已经太久了。游手好闲滋生罪恶。

source: You know, Claudius, you've wanted me to suffer ever since I was a girl, and I never knew why.
target: 你知道吗，克劳狄斯，从我还是个小姑娘的时候起，你就想让我受苦，而我一直不知道为什么。

source: It took meeting Othello to realize that. You've always wanted Laertes and me isolated. Hated.
target: 直到遇见奥赛罗，我才明白。你一直想让雷欧提斯和我被孤立。被憎恨。

source: I'm not good enough for Hamlet, but I'm not good enough for anyone else either, am I?
target: 我配不上哈姆雷特，可我也配不上任何其他人，是吗？

source: ...That's insane. You're merely angry I disrupted this encounter and spitting fire at me appropriately.
target: ……简直是疯话。你只是气我打断了这次私会，所以才冲我大发脾气。

source: You're fortunate I won't tell the others of this incident.
target: 算你走运，我不会把这件事告诉别人。

source: Do as you like! Tell everyone if you must!
target: 随你的便！你非要说，就告诉所有人好了！

source: All of my life, men have been telling me to stay indoors, speak more softly, read less—as though I were a statue!
target: 从小到大，男人们一直叫我待在屋里，说话小声些，少读些书——好像我是一尊雕像！

source: Well, I'm not. And I won't be told what to do anymore. Not by you, or anyone.
target: 可我不是。以后我再也不会任人摆布。你不行，任何人都不行。

source: If I am not permitted to choose for myself, I'll forge that permission by my own hand.
target: 如果不允许我自己选择，我就亲手争来这个权利。

source: Who's out there?
target: 外面是谁？

source: ...Lady Ophelia? Is that you I see?
target: ……奥菲莉娅女士？我看见的是您吗？

source: T...the royal guards?
target: 王……王家卫兵？

source: No, don't—it's all right! I'm safe!
target: 不，别——没事的！我很安全！

source: Good sir. I am Othello, of—
target: 这位先生。我是奥赛罗，来自——

source: I said, step away from Lady Ophelia!
target: 我说了，离奥菲莉娅女士远点！

source: She is a Lady of the Court. This behavior is—highly inappropriate!
target: 她是宫廷贵女。这种行为——极不合礼数！

source: I-if I were to report this to anyone...
target: 我、我要是把这件事报告给谁……

source: He was a friend.
target: 他是我的朋友。

source: And you had no right to do that.
target: 而你没有权利那么做。

source: I-I was merely trying to protect your modesty, my lady. Think of your reputation—
target: 我、我只是想维护您的端庄，女士。想想您的名声——

source: My reputation is not yours to protect!
target: 我的名声用不着你来维护！

source: What just happened?
target: 刚才到底发生了什么？

source: ...Othello must have returned to the bar.
target: ……奥赛罗想必已经回酒馆了。

source: I... ought to find him to apologize.
target: 我……应该去找他道歉。

source: You... came back.
target: 你……回来了。

source: I'm sorry. About everything.
target: 对不起。为这一切。

source: Come here.
target: 过来。

source: Don't apologize. Never once, from now until death. Understand?
target: 别道歉。从现在起，直到死都不要再道歉，一次也不要。明白吗？

source: You must never apologize for the intolerance inflicted by others.
target: 你绝不该为别人施加的偏见而道歉。

source: But... you know that this... our relationship... there are reasons why it cannot be.
target: 可是……你知道，这……我们的关系……我们不能在一起，是有原因的。

source: How can you be so certain?
target: 你怎么能这么肯定？

source: You have your place. The castle is your home.
target: 你有你的归属。城堡是你的家。

source: Unless, that is... you were to...
target: 除非……你愿意……

source: Come with you? Where?
target: 跟你走？去哪儿？

source: I'm leaving town. With no way to pay back my debt on the tavern, my days here are numbered.
target: 我要离开这座镇子。我无力偿还酒馆的债务，在这里待不了多久了。

source: Where will you go from here?
target: 离开这里后，你要去哪儿？

source: South. South to Italy, I think. South to where the summer nights last forever, and there are no snows.
target: 往南。我想，往南去意大利。往南去一个夏夜永不结束、不会下雪的地方。

source: Yes, I can see a bright beach in my mind's eye, and a small but sturdy room to call my own...
target: 是啊，我脑海里已经浮现出一片明亮的海滩，还有一间属于自己的小屋，虽小却坚固……

source: You could come with me. But you could never return. They'd have me killed. You and I both know that.
target: 你可以跟我走。但你就再也不能回来了。他们会派人杀了我。这一点，你我都清楚。

source: But if you were to come with me, Ophelia, I'd make you my wife. I'd love you with a ferocity to rival the stars.
target: 但如果你真的跟我走，奥菲莉娅，我会娶你为妻。我对你的爱会炽烈得足以与群星争辉。

source: And you'd be free to live however you pleased.
target: 你也能自由地过自己想要的生活。

source: That sounds... wonderful, Othello.
target: 听起来……真美好，奥赛罗。

source: But I can't.
target: 可我不能。

source: What? Why not? What's stopping you?
target: 什么？为什么不能？是什么让你走不了？

source: You... wouldn't believe me if I told you.
target: 你……就算我说了，你也不会相信。

source: All I ask is that you think about my offer. Whether you accept or reject me is your choice alone.
target: 我只求你考虑一下我的提议。接受还是拒绝我，都由你自己决定。

source: If you'd like to escape with me, then you need only say the word. And we'll leave this whole sorry mess behind together.
target: 如果你愿意跟我一起逃走，只要说一声。我们就一起把这堆烂摊子抛在身后。

source: And... if not... then I'll take my leave of you. I swear it. I shall never cross your path or trouble your mind with uneasy thoughts again.
target: 而……如果你不愿意……我就向你告别。我发誓。我再也不会出现在你面前，也不会再让你心神不宁。

source: Entertaining Othello's offer, are we?
target: 在考虑奥赛罗的提议，是吗？

source: How did you come here?
target: 你怎么到这里来的？

source: Does it matter?
target: 这重要吗？

source: How did you come here? What's wrong with Othello?
target: 你怎么到这里来的？奥赛罗怎么了？

source: I've put him on pause.
target: 我让他暂时停住了。

source: I see all stories. And I know that down this path lies unhappiness.
target: 我能看见所有故事。我知道，这条路通向不幸。

source: Though of course, it won't matter, will it? You're still at the mercy of forces larger than yourself.
target: 不过，当然，这也无关紧要，对吧？你依然受着远比你强大的力量摆布。

source: I... I know I'm trapped. That I can't truly go with him. But I... can't help but wonder what might happen.
target: 我……我知道自己被困住了。知道自己不能真的跟他走。可是我……还是忍不住想，那样会发生什么。

source: Poor girl. Even now, you're at the mercy of forces larger than yourself.
target: 可怜的姑娘。即使现在，你也仍受着远比你强大的力量摆布。

source: I'll give that young man one thing: he's true to his word. He'd love you more brightly than the stars.
target: 那个年轻人有一点值得肯定：他说到做到。他对你的爱会比群星更耀眼。

source: ...For a while, that is.
target: ……不过，只会维持一段时间。

source: But he is fated to love another more powerfully than you. And someday, he'll win her over with songs and stories.
target: 但他命中注定会爱上另一个人，爱得比爱你更深。总有一天，他会用歌声和故事赢得她的心。

source: How can you be so sure of that?
target: 你怎么能这么肯定？

source: I see the lines of fate that run through all worlds.
target: 我能看见贯穿所有世界的命运之线。

source: Her name is Desdemona. How peculiar that even her name means 'ill-fated.'
target: 她叫苔丝狄蒙娜。真奇妙，就连她的名字都意味着“命运多舛”。

source: She will be far unluckier than you. You will lose a love when Othello leaves you. But she will lose her life to him.
target: 她会比你不幸得多。奥赛罗离开你时，你会失去一段爱情。而她会丧命于他手。

source: Y-you mean—he—murders her?
target: 你、你是说——他——会谋杀她？

source: Indeed. A terrible thing.
target: 没错。真是可怕。

source: I daresay it shall tear him apart.
target: 我想，这会让他痛不欲生。

source: But rest easy that the next few years will be blissfully happy ones. This is, perhaps, the happiest of all possible worlds for you. And in that time, he will always be faithful.
target: 但你可以放心，接下来的几年会无比幸福。对你而言，这或许是所有可能的世界中最幸福的一个。在那段时光里，他会始终忠于你。

source: Can you settle for a brief but brilliant bliss?
target: 你能满足于短暂却灿烂的幸福吗？

source: Always watching for the pale woman with the quiet eyes who will eventually, assuredly, win his heart?
target: 始终提防着那个肤色苍白、目光沉静的女人，知道她终有一天必定会赢得他的心？

source: Ooh, I do so love little puzzles like this!
target: 哦，我真是太喜欢这种小难题了！

source: Leave me be, Quince.
target: 别来烦我了，奎因斯。

source: Hee hee hee. As you wish.
target: 嘻嘻嘻。如你所愿。

source: I'm just trying to help, my dear. But as you wish.
target: 我只是想帮忙，亲爱的。不过，如你所愿。

source: There are a lot of jilted lovers out there who would pay dearly for this sort of clairvoyance!
target: 有多少被抛弃的恋人，愿意花大价钱换取这样的预知能力啊！

source: ...So. What do you say?
target: ……那么。你怎么说？

source: Leave with Othello?
target: 跟奥赛罗离开？

source: I want to come with you.
target: 我想跟你走。

source: I hadn't known how terrified I was until right this moment.
target: 直到这一刻，我才知道自己刚才有多害怕。

source: My love. My love. We're going to see the world together.
target: 我的爱人。我的爱人。我们要一起去看看这个世界。

source: (...He has no idea.)
target: （……他什么都不知道。）

source: I'd like that. To see the world, I mean. With you.
target: 我很愿意。我是说，去看看这个世界。和你一起。

source: I'm sorry, Othello... but I can't.
target: 对不起，奥赛罗……可我不能。

source: My place is here in Elsinore. There are still things I must do.
target: 我的归属就在埃尔西诺。我还有必须做的事。

source: And—you—there's a whole world waiting for you, unconstrained.
target: 而——你——整个世界都在等着你，你可以自由自在地去探索。

source: You have to pursue that. It's what you want. I know that to be true.
target: 你得去追求那样的生活。那是你想要的。我知道，这一点不会错。

source: Then let us part ways for now.
target: 那我们就暂且分别吧。

source: I want you to know I wish you everlasting happiness.
target: 我想让你知道，我愿你永远幸福。

source: Even if it's not in my company.
target: 即使陪在你身边的不是我。

source: Find someone who loves you truly and madly, enough to light the stars.
target: 找一个真心而热烈地爱你的人，那份爱足以点亮群星。

source: And if they don't, discard them, and find the one who does.
target: 如果对方做不到，就离开对方，去找那个做得到的人。

source: That's my parting wish to you.
target: 这是我临别时对你的祝愿。

source: Let us depart immediately. I'll gather my things, and you gather yours.
target: 我们立刻出发吧。我去收拾我的东西，你去收拾你的。

source: This... shall be... the dawning of my life. And you shall be the sun.
target: 这……将是……我人生的黎明。而你就是那轮太阳。

source: Come, my love.
target: 来吧，我的爱人。

source: Let down your hair and abandon your heavy skirts.
target: 放下你的长发，丢开你沉重的裙子。

source: It's a beautiful summer, and we are the masters of our own joy.
target: 这是个美丽的夏天，我们的快乐由我们自己做主。

source: I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever, and see what lies beyond Elsinore's walls.
target: 我可以用命运之书永远保留这个世界，去看看埃尔西诺城墙之外的天地。

source: Until then, this world is swiftly fading.
target: 在那之前，这个世界正在迅速消逝。

source: Othello and I rode out into the fields and fog—that is, until I was pulled back once more.
target: 奥赛罗和我骑马奔向田野和迷雾——直到我又一次被拉了回来。

source: A clever little play to put on. To whit, it sends Lady Birgitta scrambling, not that she poses a danger to you anymore.
target: 上演这么一出小戏，倒是很聪明。它让比尔吉塔女士乱了阵脚，虽说她已经不再对你构成威胁。

source: That's a little cruel of you, don't you think?
target: 你这样有点残忍，不觉得吗？

source: I was curious.
target: 我只是好奇。

source: You are 'curious' like a small child holding two halves of an insect between their pinched fingers.
target: 你的“好奇”，就像一个小孩子，用指尖捏着一只虫子的两半。

source: Pulling until the insides spill out... yes. Cruel, but ignorant of that cruelty.
target: 一直撕扯，直到内脏流出来……没错。残忍，却对自己的残忍一无所知。

source: I'm not ignorant. I'm trying to do everything in my power to find a way around you.
target: 我不是一无所知。我在尽我所能，想找到摆脱你的办法。

source: And innocent people are the collateral? Isn't that the very thing you stood against?
target: 于是，无辜的人就要受牵连？这不正是你一直反对的事吗？

source: Don't misunderstand me. I didn't come to insult you. I'm so very pleased to see you doing these sorts of things.
target: 别误会。我不是来羞辱你的。看到你做出这种事，我真是非常高兴。

source: It's a funny thing, that play.
target: 那出戏可真有意思。

source: I edited the timeline--for your benefit, I might add--by telling Lady Brit just one little thing.
target: 我修改了时间线——顺便说一句，是为了你好——只是告诉了布莉特女士一件小事。

source: She and Fortinbras both believed that by eliminating you, Laertes would be driven to seize the throne, and Claudius would fall.
target: 她和福丁布拉斯都以为，只要除掉你，就能逼雷欧提斯夺取王位，让克劳狄斯倒台。

source: But the truth of the matter is, your death is inconsequential!
target: 可事实是，你的死无关紧要！

source: No matter if you are dead or alive, it all crumbles regardless.
target: 无论你是死是活，这一切照样会崩塌。

source: And by proxy, your very life itself matters not!
target: 也就是说，你的生命本身同样无关紧要！

source: Until now, you've had such great care for these little humans and their lives. Even after you were nothing to them, after all.
target: 直到现在，你都那么在乎这些渺小的人类，在乎他们的生命。毕竟，就算你在他们眼里已经什么都不是，你也依然如此。

source: So play on, Ophelia. Play all you like.
target: 所以，继续玩吧，奥菲莉娅。想怎么玩就怎么玩。

source: I'll be watching with a smile.
target: 我会微笑着看下去。

source: You sent for me?
target: 你派人叫我来？

source: What is it, love?
target: 怎么了，亲爱的？

source: That day Hamlet died. You told me you were hunting.
target: 哈姆雷特死的那天。你告诉我，你去打猎了。

source: As always.
target: 和平时一样。

source: What did you catch?
target: 你猎到了什么？

source: You were gone for hours. You returned only after the alarm had been raised for Hamlet's death.
target: 你离开了好几个小时。直到哈姆雷特的死讯引发警报后，你才回来。

source: What did you catch while you were out hunting?
target: 你出去打猎，猎到了什么？

source: Ah-- a large brown hare.
target: 啊——一只很大的棕色野兔。

source: And why didn't you bring it to Irma to prepare?
target: 那你为什么没把它交给伊尔玛烹制？

source: I know you hated him.
target: 我知道你恨他。

source: And I know that in time, hatred can turn to intent.
target: 我也知道，时间久了，仇恨可能变成动手的念头。

source: But please, if you killed my husband, tell me now. Tell me so I can know for certain.
target: 但求你，如果是你杀了我的丈夫，现在就告诉我。告诉我，让我知道确切的真相。

source: And tell me so I don't have to look into your eyes and wonder every time if I married a murderer!
target: 告诉我，这样我就不用每次看着你的眼睛，都怀疑自己是不是嫁给了一个杀人凶手！

source: Gerta. Gertrude. Who told you this rubbish?
target: 格尔塔。乔特鲁德。是谁跟你说了这些胡话？

source: Ophelia said she saw you confess to it. In this very room.
target: 奥菲莉娅说，她看到你承认了。就在这间屋子里。

source: Ophelia told you?
target: 是奥菲莉娅告诉你的？

source: I'll need to speak with her.
target: 我得和她谈谈。

source: But my love, look at me. Please.
target: 可是，亲爱的，看着我。求你了。

source: What I say to you is the utter truth. I did not kill Hamlet.
target: 我对你说的句句属实。我没有杀哈姆雷特。

source: I know Ophelia was telling the truth, Claudius.
target: 我知道奥菲莉娅说的是真话，克劳狄斯。

source: I know what you did to him.
target: 我知道你对他做了什么。

source: There's a larger story here, Gerta. Please—
target: 这件事还有更多内情，格尔塔。求你——

source: I let you lie to me because I wanted to believe you so badly.
target: 我任由你欺骗我，是因为我太想相信你了。

source: You were a good child and I thought you could learn to be a good man. But I should have known.
target: 你曾是个好孩子，我以为你能学着成为一个好人。可我早该明白。

source: That darkness has always been within you, hasn't it?
target: 那份黑暗一直藏在你心里，是不是？

source: You were always going to hurt someone, some day. I watched you even then, and I saw it. Perhaps I could have loved you still, had you been honest with me.
target: 你迟早会伤害别人。那时候我就留意着你，也看出来了。如果你曾对我坦诚，也许我还能继续爱你。

source: But covering your deed was one step further. You brought a lie into our marriage so deep and so wide it created an uncrossable chasm.
target: 可掩盖你的所作所为，就又多走了一步。你把一个谎言带进我们的婚姻，它如此深、如此宽，化成了一道无法跨越的鸿沟。

source: And now that hole must be filled.
target: 现在，必须填上这道深渊。

source: G-Gerta, you—you know how cruel he was to me. How my father hated me. You knew!
target: 格、格尔塔，你——你知道他对我有多残忍。知道我父亲有多恨我。你都知道！

source: A-all I ever wanted was to be free of them... a-and you helped me see that.
target: 我、我一直只想摆脱他们……而、而且是你让我明白了这一点。

source: You don't think I understand that? I was married to him, you coward!
target: 你以为我不明白吗？我可是嫁给了他，你这个懦夫！

source: But murder—cold murder—that was wrong. You took my family away from me.
target: 可是谋杀——冷血的谋杀——那是错的。你夺走了我的家人。

source: You tore me from my son. My son from his father.
target: 你毁了我们母子的感情，也让我的儿子失去了他的父亲。

source: I know. I know it was wrong, and I've repented and prayed daily to the Lord...
target: 我知道。我知道那是错的，我每天都在向主忏悔、祈祷……

source: No. It's not the Lord you need to repent to. It's me.
target: 不。你需要忏悔的对象不是主。是我。

source: And I will not forgive you.
target: 而我不会原谅你。

source: My love?
target: 亲爱的？

source: Please, let's discuss this.
target: 求你，我们谈谈吧。

source: You are avenged, Hamlet.
target: 你的仇已经报了，哈姆雷特。

source: I am sorry I couldn't save you.
target: 对不起，我没能救你。

source: Look at me. Look at me as I say this to you.
target: 看着我。我对你说这些话的时候，看着我。

source: Do you believe me?
target: 你相信我吗？

source: Yes. I believe you.
target: 是的。我相信你。

source: Good. Then the matter is settled. Please take things Ophelia tells you with a skeptical heart, my love.
target: 好。那这件事就到此为止了。亲爱的，奥菲莉娅告诉你的事，请多存几分疑心。

source: I think Hamlet's being simply terrible. He really is in some sort of state.
target: 我觉得哈姆雷特的表现简直糟透了。他的状态确实不太对劲。

source: He's suspicious of us. He must know what the King asked of us.
target: 他在怀疑我们。他一定知道国王让我们做什么了。

source: Or maybe... do you think he's still upset with me about the way things ended between us?
target: 又或者……你觉得他还在为我们当初分开的事生我的气吗？

source: I thought you handled yourself like a perfectly Godly woman. He couldn't be upset.
target: 我觉得你当时的举止完全符合一个虔诚女子的本分。他不可能生气。

source: Me? Godly? Well then, I suppose that makes you my angel!
target: 我？虔诚？那好吧，这么说来，你就是我的天使了！

source: Now that you mention it, though, perhaps we ought to speak with Hamlet.
target: 不过，既然你提到了，也许我们该去和哈姆雷特谈谈。

source: Or we could do what we do best: avoid all men, and drink to our own renewed health!
target: 或者我们可以做最拿手的事：躲开所有男人，为我们恢复健康干杯！

source: Hmm. A very compelling argument.
target: 嗯。这个理由很有说服力。

source: All right, then. I'll bring the wine if you'll find us a little grassy patch somewhere.
target: 那好吧。你要是能给我们找块小草地，我就带酒来。

source: I'm sure when Hamlet's in better health we can show him our friendship is no less true.
target: 我相信，等哈姆雷特身体好些了，我们就能让他知道，我们的友情依然真挚。

source: Gather around, ladies and gentlemen, spirits and sprites!
target: 围过来吧，女士们、先生们，幽魂们、精灵们！

source: Welcome to the performance at the edge of the world! I call this script...
target: 欢迎来到世界尽头的演出！这出戏，我叫它……

source: The Mirthful Merchant.
target: 《欢笑商人》。

source: Once there was a strange little man who collected and sold strange little trinkets.
target: 从前有个古怪的小个子男人，专门收集、售卖古怪的小玩意儿。

source: Of course, the toys weren't strange to him. For every strange thing is beloved unto someone else.
target: 当然，这些玩具在他看来并不古怪。因为每一样古怪的东西，总会有人喜爱。

source: And the merchant made it his life's endeavor to find an owner who would love every odd thing he ever found.
target: 这位商人毕生追求的，就是为他找到的每一样奇物寻得一个喜爱它的主人。

source: He traveled the wide world, handing out his wares: Painted wooden shoes for the legless man. An ugly little doll for the bereaved mother.
target: 他走遍广阔的世界，分送自己的货物：把彩绘木鞋送给没有双腿的男人，把丑陋的小娃娃送给失去孩子的母亲。

source: He gave sugar to the gumless old women, and wooden teeth to the prettiest village girls.
target: 他把糖送给牙龈都没了的老妇人，把木头假牙送给村里最漂亮的姑娘。

source: Every man, woman, and child who received a gift had to laugh, in a lopsided, crooked way.
target: 每个收到礼物的男人、女人和孩子，都忍不住笑起来，笑得歪歪扭扭。

source: ...For they had been given the gift most incompatible with them, and that brought them a perverse joy.
target: ……因为他们收到的，偏偏是最不适合自己的礼物，却从中得到了一种乖谬的快乐。

source: But all this time, within him gnawed an incurable loneliness, a hatred of himself so deep and so dark he could scarcely tell day from night.
target: 可始终有一种无法治愈的孤独啃噬着他的内心。他对自己的憎恨如此深重，如此黑暗，让他几乎分不清白昼与黑夜。

source: He moved through the world in a fog, handing out his gifts, collecting some others here and there, bearing a solemn wish of his own...
target: 他浑浑噩噩地行走世间，分送礼物，又在各处收集一些，心中怀着一个沉重的愿望……

source: The wish to die.
target: 那就是求死的愿望。

source: Yes, this merchant had never felt any semblance of happiness, no matter how grateful the recipients of his gifts might be.
target: 是的，无论收到礼物的人多么感激，这位商人都从未感受到一丝幸福。

source: And one night, he lay himself down on the shore of a foreign beach, and he lay there until the night was dark and silent.
target: 有一天夜里，他在异乡的海滩上躺下，一直躺到夜色深沉，万籁俱寂。

source: The tide came up and washed over his face. Even still, he did not move.
target: 潮水涨起，漫过他的脸。即便如此，他也没有动。

source: The tide grew powerful and swept his bag of trinkets out to sea. But still—he did not move!
target: 潮水愈发汹涌，把他那袋小玩意儿卷进了海里。可他依然——一动不动！

source: And as the waves carried him out to sea again, he lay still, and he sank down, and down, and down into the depths.
target: 海浪再次向外涌去，将他带入海中。他静静躺着，往下沉，再往下沉，一直沉入深处。

source: He felt his soul rise like the last lingering air bubble, shifting and squirming in the muck of the ocean floor.
target: 他感觉自己的灵魂像最后一颗迟迟不散的气泡，在海底的淤泥里辗转挣动，缓缓升起。

source: At the bottom of the black waters, he heard a voice, and it sang to him. It was the voice of God. Or perhaps all the Gods who had ever been and would ever be.
target: 在漆黑的水底，他听见一个声音，正对他歌唱。那是上帝的声音。又或许，是过去曾存在、未来将存在的所有神明的声音。

source: And this Almighty bore the merchant back in His arms, back to shore, back to the sand, and He left the merchant sleeping on the shore.
target: 这位全能者将商人抱在怀中，送回岸边，送回沙滩，留下他在岸上沉睡。

source: When the merchant awoke, he found the sack of trinkets sitting beside him on the sand. But it was empty.
target: 商人醒来时，发现装小玩意儿的袋子就在身旁的沙地上。但袋子已经空了。

source: No—he realized—not empty. There was one item in the bottom: a trinket just for him. A special, life-giving object. It filled him with utter glee.
target: 不——他意识到——并没有空。袋底还有一样东西：一件专属于他的小玩意儿。一件特别的、赋予生命的物品。它让他满心欢喜。

source: Yes, turning this object in his hands, he knew for certain the Gods had given it to him, and that he could no more throw it away than part with his own beating heart.
target: 是的，他在手中翻看着这件东西，确信这是诸神赐给他的。他无法将它丢弃，就像无法舍弃自己那颗仍在跳动的心。

source: For this trinket was utterly incompatible with him in every way. It bestowed eternal life, and it whispered to him that he must write stories, marvelous stories.
target: 因为这件小玩意儿，在各方面都与他格格不入。它赐予永生，还低声告诉他，他必须写故事，写奇妙的故事。

source: Each of these stories would take on a life of its own. In this way, he was not just condemned to live forever—no—he must create life.
target: 每一个故事都会拥有自己的生命。这样一来，他受罚的方式就不只是永远活着——不——他还必须创造生命。

source: For all stories are worlds, and there can be no worlds truly without life.
target: 因为每个故事都是一个世界，而没有生命，便称不上真正的世界。

source: The merchant took to the road, and he traveled all around the world, telling stories and creating life. A century passed. Then another.
target: 商人踏上旅途，走遍世界，讲述故事，创造生命。一个世纪过去了。又一个世纪过去了。

source: And as the years passed, he grew stronger. His mastery only increased. What a treat, this infinite gift! What a joy!
target: 随着岁月流逝，他变得更强大了。他的技艺不断精进。这份无穷的馈赠，多么美妙！多么令人欢喜！

source: For he so loved bringing together the story threads in pleasing ways. And over the years, he had become quite talented at it—dare he say!
target: 因为他如此喜爱将故事的线索编织在一起，让人赏心悦目。多年下来，他已经十分擅长此道——他敢这么说！

source: But then... one day... his prized trinket was stolen from him.
target: 可后来……有一天……他珍爱的小玩意儿被人偷走了。

source: Brutally taken, and hidden. He searched the land far and wide, but even after many decades passed, he... found nothing at all.
target: 被蛮横地夺走，藏了起来。他找遍各地，可即使几十年过去，他……依然一无所获。

source: And so, unable to move on, he languished. He could no longer create beautiful stories. His master's tool had been taken away.
target: 于是，他无法向前，日渐消沉。他再也不能创造美好的故事。他赖以施展精湛技艺的工具，被夺走了。

source: Meanwhile, the ripples of his lost trinket were felt by all those around him. He felt its gift upon them—the gift of eternal life—but to them, it was no gift at all.
target: 与此同时，那件遗失的小玩意儿产生的波澜，影响到了他身边的所有人。他感觉到，它的馈赠落在了他们身上——永生的馈赠——可对他们而言，那根本不是什么馈赠。

source: It was a terrible curse.
target: 那是一个可怕的诅咒。

source: That is the end of our tale.
target: 我们的故事到此结束。

source: Thank you, everyone. Thank you.
target: 谢谢各位。谢谢。

source: (There's no one else watching...)
target: （根本没有其他人在看……）

source: Quince, I don't understand. What does all this mean?
target: 奎因斯，我不明白。这一切到底是什么意思？

source: ...I wish I could tell you. I don't even know, myself.
target: ……我也希望能告诉你。连我自己都不知道。

source: Let us merely say that we are odd friends under unfortunate circumstances, you and I.
target: 就当你我是在不幸的境遇中结下了一段古怪的友情吧。

source: I must apologize for the situation you find yourself in now. I certainly never intended this outcome.
target: 你如今身陷这样的处境，我必须向你道歉。这绝不是我原本想要的结果。

source: But, well, here you are, and until my trinket returns, it can't be helped. Good day!
target: 不过，唉，事已至此，在我的小玩意儿回来之前，也无计可施。祝你愉快！

source: Let me think a moment.
target: 让我想一想。

source: Quince is... stuck in time, just like me. But I knew that already.
target: 奎因斯……也和我一样，被困在时间里。不过这点我早就知道了。

source: He's looking for something. Some kind of object, a 'trinket'.
target: 他在找一样东西。某种物品，一个“小玩意儿”。

source: And he's trapped, like me, until he can find it.
target: 在找到它之前，他也和我一样，无法脱身。

source: He must be talking about the book my mother mentioned in her testament.
target: 他说的一定是母亲在遗嘱里提到的那本书。

source: I need to find and meet Simona. If I can accomplish that, maybe I can make headway.
target: 我得找到西蒙娜，和她见面。如果能做到，也许事情就能有所进展。

source: He must be talking about the book King Hamlet mentioned in his raving notes.
target: 他说的一定是哈姆雷特国王在那些满是疯言疯语的笔记里提到的那本书。

source: I'm certain I can find it, if only I dig a little deeper. Someone in Elsinore must know more.
target: 只要再深入查一查，我肯定能找到它。埃尔西诺一定有人知道更多。

source: ...That means the three people trapped in time are myself, Quince, and King Hamlet's spirit.
target: ……也就是说，被困在时间里的三个人，是我、奎因斯，还有哈姆雷特国王的幽灵。

source: Perhaps that spirit knows something it hasn't revealed just yet. I ought to listen to what it has to say.
target: 也许那个幽灵知道些什么，只是还没有说出来。我应该听听它要说什么。

source: There are so many supernatural things taking place in Elsinore.
target: 埃尔西诺发生了这么多超自然的事。

source: ...I wonder if they're all connected—to all that's happening to me.
target: ……不知道这些事是不是都有关联——和发生在我身上的一切有关。

source: Pull the thread, and the tapestry comes apart. Perhaps that's all I have to do.
target: 抽出一根线，整幅织锦就会散开。也许我只需要这么做。

source: I know Father ought to perish on Friday evening, by Hamlet's hand. But circumstances have changed.
target: 我知道，父亲本该在星期五晚上死于哈姆雷特之手。但情况已经变了。

source: Could it be... could I have actually saved him this time?
target: 难道……这一次，我真的救下他了吗？

source: I feel as though I need to see him.
target: 我觉得我得去见见他。

source: I wonder if something happened to Hamlet, then.
target: 那么，会不会是哈姆雷特出了什么事？

source: Could it be... could I have actually saved Father this time?
target: 难道……这一次，我真的救下父亲了吗？

source: Whether or not I intended it, I'm responsible for Hamlet's death.
target: 不管我是不是有意的，哈姆雷特的死，我都负有责任。

source: And-- that means--
target: 而且——这意味着——

source: He can't kill Father in this world. Father is alive.
target: 在这个世界里，他不可能杀死父亲了。父亲还活着。

source: Can that really be true? Is Father going to live?
target: 这真的可能吗？父亲能活下来吗？

source: Ah, my heart, come in.
target: 啊，我的心肝，进来吧。

source: Thank you. You tore me from most troubling thoughts.
target: 谢谢你。你让我从那些烦心的思绪中回过神来了。

source: What happened to Hamlet-- it was horrible. Though he was no son of mine, I've known the boy since he was born.
target: 哈姆雷特遭遇的事——太可怕了。虽然他不是我的儿子，但从他出生起，我就认识这孩子了。

source: I couldn't help but think of you and Laertes. Of what I'd do if you came to such an end like that.
target: 我忍不住想到了你和雷欧提斯。要是你们也落得这样的下场，我该怎么办。

source: It was horrible, Father.
target: 父亲，那确实很可怕。

source: But Hamlet had changed. If he hadn't been struck down, he might have-- he would have done something worse.
target: 但哈姆雷特已经变了。要是他没有被杀死，他也许会——他一定会做出更糟的事。

source: I have to hope you're right.
target: 我只能希望你说得对。

source: When I cannot sleep tonight, I'll try and hold on to that.
target: 今晚睡不着的时候，我会试着记住这一点。

source: In times like this, all one can do is appreciate the living who remain. You, for instance. On that note...
target: 这种时候，人能做的只有珍惜还活着的人。比如你。说到这里……

source: What have I done to warrant a willing visit from my daughter?
target: 我做了什么，竟让女儿主动来看我？

source: Whatever it was, I hope I can replicate it for future visits!
target: 不管是什么，我都希望能再做一遍，让你以后也常来！

source: Father. I can't believe y-you're... um...
target: 父亲。我不敢相信，你、你还……嗯……

source: (He'll only think me insane...)
target: （他只会觉得我疯了……）

source: What were you thinking about before I came in? You looked worried.
target: 我进来之前，您在想什么？您看起来很担心。

source: Oh—the sorts of idle things an old man dreams about when he begins to contemplate the end of his life.
target: 哦——不过是一个老人开始思考自己生命的尽头时，会胡思乱想的那些事。

source: Namely, your mother. Were she still here... what she'd think of me. Of the way I've lived my life.
target: 也就是你母亲。要是她还在……她会怎么看我，怎么看我这一生的所作所为。

source: I've served the throne faithfully for so many years. Sometimes I look around and wonder what all this unflagging allegiance is worth.
target: 这么多年来，我一直忠心侍奉王室。有时候环顾四周，我会想，这份始终不渝的忠诚究竟值多少。

source: And I wonder if your mother would be proud of the way I've raised you and Laertes... or if she'd wish we'd left Elsinore long ago.
target: 我也会想，你母亲会不会为我养育你和雷欧提斯的方式感到骄傲……还是说，她会希望我们早就离开了埃尔西诺。

source: I know she'd be proud. You've done everything you could, Father.
target: 我知道她会为您骄傲的。父亲，您已经尽了全力。

source: You know, Ophelia...
target: 奥菲莉娅，你知道吗……

source: Some time in the future, I've been thinking I ought to take you to summer somewhere outside of Elsinore.
target: 我一直在想，将来找个时候，应该带你去埃尔西诺以外的地方过夏天。

source: Not now. But perhaps in a year, when we've made you a suitable match and you're intended to be wed.
target: 不是现在。也许一年后，等我们为你找到了合适的对象，你也准备成婚了。

source: When this Norway nonsense passes and it's safe out there for you... you, I, and Laertes will leave these walls a small while.
target: 等挪威这摊荒唐事过去，外面对你来说安全了……你、我，还有雷欧提斯，就离开这城墙一阵子。

source: That does sound nice.
target: 听起来确实不错。

source: Father, I... know it doesn't make sense to you now, but I... I'm glad you're alive and well.
target: 父亲，我……知道您现在听不明白，但我……我很高兴，您还平安地活着。

source: I thought I'd lost you. Maybe forever. And I was so scared.
target: 我以为我失去您了。也许是永远失去了。我当时好害怕。

source: Lost me? Why, I'm right here.
target: 失去我？哎，我不是就在这里吗。

source: Look at me. Don't cry.
target: 看着我。别哭。

source: Why would you fret? I'm here.
target: 有什么好担心的？我就在这里。

source: And I'm not going anywhere. Not for some time yet, at least.
target: 我哪儿也不去。至少暂时不会。

source: Unfortunately, for now, I must ask you leave me be. I have some rather distasteful planning I need to complete and some duties to attend to.
target: 可惜，现在我得请你让我独处一会儿。我还有些令人不快的安排要完成，也有些职责要履行。

source: To lose both the Prince and the Queen in one night... I can scarcely believe it. It will take a while for Denmark to recover from such tragedy.
target: 一夜之间，王子和王后都离我们而去……我几乎不敢相信。丹麦要从这样的悲剧中恢复过来，还需要一段时间。

source: For all the Prince's ills, I would never have wished this on him. May his soul rest in God's good arms.
target: 无论王子有多少过错，我都绝不希望他遭遇这种事。愿他的灵魂在慈爱的上帝怀中安息。

source: To think Her Majesty would leave us so soon, and under such horrible circumstances... the castle will be quieter without her laugh.
target: 没想到王后陛下会这么早离开我们，还是在如此可怕的情形下……少了她的笑声，城堡会冷清许多。

source: Bernardo served Denmark loyally for many years, right up until the end. He was a good man. He deserves a proper account of his accomplishments.
target: 贝尔纳多多年来一直忠心为丹麦效力，直到生命的最后一刻。他是个好人。他的功绩理应得到妥善记载。

source: Then I'll leave you be, Father.
target: 那我就不打扰您了，父亲。

source: Ophelia. One last thing.
target: 奥菲莉娅。还有最后一件事。

source: If I... ever... if... something like this happens again, and I don't survive, I want you to have something of mine.
target: 如果我……哪天……如果……这样的事再次发生，而我没能活下来，我想让你收下一样我的东西。

source: It's a key. It opens a chest in this room containing my most private belongings. I keep it on me at all times.
target: 是一把钥匙。它能打开这房间里的一个箱子，里面放着我最私密的物品。我一直把它带在身上。

source: This chest cannot be opened via any other method. It contains things which could cause people in this castle no small amount of grief, if uncovered.
target: 这个箱子无法用任何其他方法打开。里面的东西要是被人发现，可能会给城堡里的人带来很大的苦恼。

source: If ever I perish, I want you to take the key from me, to open this chest and burn everything inside it. Do you understand me?
target: 如果有一天我死了，我要你从我身上取走钥匙，打开这个箱子，把里面的一切都烧掉。你明白我的意思吗？

source: (He's safe in this world, but he won't be safe in the next one.)
target: （在这个世界里，他是安全的，但下一个世界就不会了。）

source: Of course, Father. If that's what you want.
target: 当然，父亲。如果这是您的心愿。

source: I understand.
target: 我明白。

source: Farewell, love. Sweet dreams.
target: 再见，亲爱的。做个好梦。

source: Father is alive and well.
target: 父亲还平安地活着。

source: ...Though... it was not without a price.
target: ……虽然……这并非没有代价。

source: But at least for now... my father is alive. That's what matters.
target: 但至少现在……我的父亲还活着。这才是最重要的。

source: I'm not going to be able to save Father every time. I know that. There is so much that needs to be done.
target: 我不可能每次都救下父亲。我知道。还有太多事需要去做。

source: And his death was only one small part of my nightmare.
target: 而他的死，只是我噩梦中的一小部分。

source: But... no matter the cost, being able to change his fate this much...
target: 可是……无论付出了什么代价，能让他的命运改变这么多……

source: It's a victory, albeit a small one.
target: 这也是一次胜利，虽然只是小小的胜利。

source: Even so, I won't live much longer now.
target: 即便如此，我现在也活不了多久了。

source: Unless I find a way to stop whoever's killing me, Father and I can never survive together and live on.
target: 除非我找到办法，阻止那个杀我的人，否则父亲和我就永远无法一起活下来，继续生活。

source: I'll just be returned to the beginning again... and Hamlet will still be a threat to Father's life.
target: 我只会再次被送回起点……而哈姆雷特仍会威胁父亲的性命。

source: I've got to find someone who believes me about this assassin so I can plan further.
target: 我得找到一个愿意相信我所说的刺客之事的人，才能做下一步打算。

source: Ophelia! There you are. There's something important we need to discuss with Father.
target: 奥菲莉娅！原来你在这儿。我们有件重要的事要和父亲商量。

source: There is nothing left for me in Elsinore.
target: 埃尔西诺已经没有什么值得我留恋了。

source: Even if I leave for Paris, I feel the knowledge that I would one day return would overshadow the trip.
target: 即使去了巴黎，我觉得，一想到总有一天还要回来，这趟旅程就会蒙上一层阴影。

source: I never desire to return to Elsinore again. And I know not why we linger here.
target: 我再也不想回到埃尔西诺了。我也不明白，我们为什么还留在这里。

source: When you summoned us, Father, you were right. We should have left long ago.
target: 父亲，您召集我们时说得对。我们早就该离开了。

source: This castle is a wretched place. A sorrowful place.
target: 这座城堡是个糟糕的地方。一个充满悲伤的地方。

source: Well, it seems there's a drop of wisdom left in my bones yet.
target: 嗯，看来我这把老骨头里还剩着一点智慧。

source: Ophelia, my love, what do you say? Your brother and I desire to leave. What of you?
target: 奥菲莉娅，亲爱的，你怎么说？你哥哥和我都想离开。你呢？

source: Shall we make preparations?
target: 我们开始准备吧？

source: Flee Elsinore with my family?
target: 和我的家人一起逃离埃尔西诺？

source: This castle is a wretched place. A sorrowful place. We should have left long ago.
target: 这座城堡是个糟糕的地方。一个充满悲伤的地方。我们早就该离开了。

source: Flee Elsinore with your family?
target: 和你的家人一起逃离埃尔西诺？

source: My son, I know that you are distressed, but this is a drastic response.
target: 儿子，我知道你心里难受，但这样做也太过激了。

source: Life at court can be difficult, it's true. Many of the nobility aren't able to handle such pressure.
target: 宫廷生活确实不容易。许多贵族都承受不了这样的压力。

source: But I have respect and influence here at Elsinore. People desire my counsel.
target: 但在埃尔西诺，我受人尊重，也有影响力。人们都想听取我的意见。

source: Do you? Do you truly?
target: 是吗？真是这样吗？

source: I have no reason to believe otherwise. The court still values my advice.
target: 我没有理由不这么认为。宫廷仍然重视我的建议。

source: No. I am needed here. I cannot in good conscience leave.
target: 不行。这里需要我。我不能昧着良心离开。

source: If you have some proof to the contrary, I'll gladly hear it. But I find the notion unlikely.
target: 如果你有什么证据能证明并非如此，我很愿意听。但我觉得不太可能。

source: Ophelia. We have matters we must discuss as a family.
target: 奥菲莉娅。有些事，我们一家人必须一起商量。

source: Yes. When I called our first meeting, I was hoping your heart would change, Father.
target: 是的，父亲。我第一次召集大家商量时，就希望您能改变心意。

source: I'm merely sorry it happened in such a strange and cruel way.
target: 我只是很遗憾，这件事竟以如此离奇而残酷的方式发生。

source: As am I. But at least it has made the decision a simple one.
target: 我也是。但至少，这让我们容易做出决定了。

source: Ophelia? What do you say?
target: 奥菲莉娅？你怎么说？

source: I've been struggling with similar thoughts, I must admit.
target: 我得承认，我也一直在为类似的想法纠结。

source: Ophelia, what are your thoughts?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你有什么想法？

source: I cannot leave, Father.
target: 我不能走，父亲。

source: What? But for weeks, you've been pleading to leave for Paris!
target: 什么？可这几个星期，你一直求着要去巴黎！

source: Yes. But that was meant to be temporary. The remains of the summer, at best.
target: 是的。但那只是暂时离开。最多待到这个夏天结束。

source: I always knew, or believed, that I would return here.
target: 我一直知道，或者说相信，我还会回到这里。

source: There's... someone very important to me I couldn't bear to leave.
target: 有……一个对我非常重要的人，我舍不得离开。

source: Not just yet. Not until I know if the way I feel for her can ever be returned.
target: 至少现在还不行。我要先知道，我对她的感情究竟能不能得到回应。

source: A lover? Come now, Laertes. How frivolous of you.
target: 心上人？得了吧，雷欧提斯。你也太轻率了。

source: Apologies, Father. But my mind is made up. I love her.
target: 对不起，父亲。但我已经决定了。我爱她。

source: (Does he mean—Brit?)
target: （他说的是——布莉特？）

source: Very well. We'll stay for now. But the moment your 'heart' has made up its mind, we'll depart.
target: 好吧。我们暂且留下。但等你的“心”一拿定主意，我们就走。

source: Brit is dead.
target: 布莉特死了。

source: I'm not certain what the two of you knew—but I loved her.
target: 我不确定你们两人知道多少——但我爱她。

source: And I've loved her ever since she came to Elsinore. I had hoped to leave her safely behind as I went to Paris.
target: 从她来到埃尔西诺起，我就一直爱着她。我原本希望，自己去巴黎时，她能平平安安地留在这里。

source: And maybe, when I'd returned, I'd come for her, even if her father wouldn't approve, even if she was promised elsewhere...
target: 也许等我回来，我就会来接她，哪怕她父亲不同意，哪怕她已经许配给别人……

source: Now, suddenly, that dream is gone.
target: 现在，那个梦想突然破灭了。

source: I'm so sorry. I am.
target: 我真的很难过。真的。

source: Lady Brit has been uncovered as a traitor to the court, thanks to Ophelia.
target: 多亏奥菲莉娅，布莉特女士背叛宫廷的事被揭发了。

source: But this has dealt me a devastating blow.
target: 但这对我来说，是个毁灭性的打击。

source: She wanted to kill Ophelia.
target: 她竟然想杀死奥菲莉娅。

source: I am truly sorry, Laertes, that it turned out this way.
target: 雷欧提斯，事情变成这样，我真的很难过。

source: I have had a moment in which to reflect upon all that's occurred lately, and it has removed some of the doubt from my heart.
target: 我抽空想了想最近发生的这一切，心中的疑虑也消除了一些。

source: Something happened between His Highness and I, and it gave me a much-needed chance to reflect on the way Claudius feels about me.
target: 我和陛下之间发生了一些事，让我有机会好好想想克劳狄斯究竟怎么看我。这正是我需要的。

source: I now have cause to fear my very life may be in jeopardy if we linger here.
target: 现在我有理由担心，如果我们继续留在这里，恐怕连我的性命都会有危险。

source: That performance I saw—it was—unlike anything I'd ever witnessed.
target: 我看的那场演出——那真是——我从没见过那样的东西。

source: To have your worst fears about yourself echoed back at you as truth... it was a mockery. Insult in the highest form.
target: 把自己最害怕自己会是的模样，当成事实摆到自己面前……那就是嘲弄。莫大的侮辱。

source: Much as it pains me to believe this, my use to this dynasty has come to a close, I think.
target: 虽然承认这一点让我很痛苦，但我想，我对这个王朝已经没有用处了。

source: Now, of course, I regret that I invested everything we had into King Hamlet's war.
target: 如今，我当然后悔把我们所有的财产都投入了哈姆雷特国王的战争。

source: We still own a little land and a single estate. It is old, but sufficient, and the three of us will be together there.
target: 我们还剩一点土地和一处庄园。虽然老旧，但也够住了，我们三个人可以在那里一起生活。

source: Perhaps we can make some new life for ourselves, though much of our current comfort will be lost.
target: 也许我们能开始一种新的生活，虽然会失去眼下许多舒适的享受。

source: I think you're both correct. Let's leave together. We'll be happier on our own. I know it.
target: 我觉得你们说得都对。我们一起走吧。过我们自己的生活，会更幸福的。我知道。

source: (Even if this world only lasts a short while.)
target: （哪怕这个世界只能持续短短一会儿。）

source: Then we shall depart as soon as possible.
target: 那我们就尽快启程。

source: Necessary preparations ought to be made—but of course, there is little use in me making them, as I owe the court nothing further.
target: 临走前总该做些安排——不过，我已不欠宫廷什么了，再由我来操办，也没什么意义。

source: Let us gather our belongings, Father. I'll have Reynaldo staff a carriage.
target: 我们收拾行李吧，父亲。我会让雷纳尔多为马车安排人手。

source: I cannot. I need to remain here in Elsinore for the time being.
target: 我不能走。我暂时还得留在埃尔西诺。

source: For what possible purpose?
target: 你留在这里究竟还能做什么？

source: I'm sorry—I cannot say.
target: 对不起——我不能说。

source: Then we shall depart without you.
target: 那我们就先走了。

source: When the time is right, you may join us. We'll send for you as often as we can, certainly.
target: 等时机合适，你可以来和我们团聚。我们一定会尽可能多派人来接你。

source: This is only a temporary parting, Ophelia. We shall meet one another soon. I know it.
target: 这只是暂时的分别，奥菲莉娅。我们很快就会再见面的。我知道。

source: They all think me a fool.
target: 他们都觉得我是个傻瓜。

source: I am a fool. They despise me.
target: 我就是个傻瓜。他们瞧不起我。

source: I've given everything I could. Everything!
target: 我已经付出了一切能付出的东西。一切！

source: And this is what it's worth?
target: 到头来，就只值这么点？

source: ...Nothing at all.
target: ……一文不值。

source: Is any of this real?
target: 这一切有哪一点是真的吗？

source: Does any of it matter? Or is this all but a dream?
target: 这一切有哪一点有意义？还是说，全都只是一场梦？

source: It must be a dream... Yes, all a dream...
target: 一定是场梦……对，全都是梦……

source: It's no good. I haven't woken up.
target: 没用。我还是没醒。

source: Then if they hate me so—if this is to be my life—
target: 那么，如果他们如此恨我——如果我以后就要这样活着——

source: I want none of it. I care not a whit.
target: 这一切我都不要了。我一点也不在乎。

source: King Hamlet, if what you wrote in your notes is true...
target: 哈姆雷特国王，如果您在笔记里写的都是真的……

source: There's a way to be reborn again, to try once more to right these wrongs...
target: 有一种办法能让我重获新生，再试一次，纠正这些错误……

source: My love, all the necessary preparations have been made.
target: 亲爱的，一切必要的准备都做好了。

source: The carriage is loaded outside the walls. Are you prepared?
target: 马车就在城墙外，行李都装好了。你准备好了吗？

source: As well as I can be, Father.
target: 我已经尽力准备好了，父亲。

source: Something has become alarmingly clear in these last few hours.
target: 这几个小时里，有件事变得格外清楚，清楚得让人心惊。

source: Elsinore is no longer our home.
target: 埃尔西诺已经不再是我们的家了。

source: And so we shall go on and forge a new home, the three of us.
target: 所以，我们三个人要继续向前，建一个新的家。

source: We may lack the deep coffers and guards and gardens, but... I have the two of you. And that's all I've ever needed.
target: 我们也许不再有丰厚的家底、卫兵和花园，可是……我还有你们两个。我一直以来需要的，也只有这些。

source: That's wealth enough for me, I think.
target: 我想，对我来说，这就已经足够富有了。

source: Yes. The three of us together.
target: 是啊。我们三个人在一起。

source: And to think, how suddenly things can change!
target: 真没想到，事情会变得这么快！

source: There... are things we leave behind, certainly.
target: 当然……有些东西，我们得留在这里。

source: But it's time to replace those things with a world of our own creation.
target: 但现在，该用我们亲手创造的天地来取代那些了。

source: Let's go. Father. Ophelia.
target: 走吧。父亲。奥菲莉娅。

source: I'm ready.
target: 我准备好了。

source: I didn't make it twenty acres in the carriage before I was pulled back in time.
target: 马车载着我连二十英亩的地都没走过，我就被拉回了过去。

source: (Though... as things stand now, I shall never see what comes of this world.)
target: （不过……照现在的情况，我永远也看不到这个世界后来会怎样了。）

source: Father is still alive, locked away in a cell... accused of being a spy.
target: 父亲还活着，被关在牢房里……被指控是间谍。

source: That means Hamlet can't get to him, but...
target: 这样一来，哈姆雷特就接近不了他了，可是……

source: This... doesn't feel like a victory.
target: 这……感觉并不算胜利。

source: I brought this fate upon him... I have to be able to bring an even better one.
target: 是我让他落到了这步田地……我必须能为他争取一个更好的命运。

source: I need to visit him.
target: 我得去看看他。

source: Oh. Ophelia. Hello.
target: 哦。奥菲莉娅。你好。

source: It's good to see you, Father. Even if it's like this.
target: 见到您真好，父亲。就算是在这种情况下。

source: You know, Ophelia, I've been thinking.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你知道吗，我一直在想些事情。

source: The sorts of idle things an old man dreams about when he begins to contemplate the end of his life.
target: 都是些老人开始考虑自己生命的终点时，会胡思乱想的事。

source: Namely, about your mother. Were she still here... what she'd think of me. Of the way I've lived my life.
target: 具体来说，是你母亲。如果她还在……会怎么看我。怎么看我这一生的活法。

source: I've served the throne faithfully for so many years. So many times I wondered what all that unflagging allegiance was worth.
target: 这么多年来，我一直忠心为王室效力。我无数次想过，这份始终不渝的忠诚究竟值什么。

source: Would she have wanted me to lie to the king? Would she have wanted me to... betray a promise?
target: 她会希望我对国王说谎吗？她会希望我……违背承诺吗？

source: Some time in the future, I had been thinking I ought to take you to summer somewhere outside of Elsinore.
target: 我之前一直想着，将来该找个时候，带你去埃尔西诺以外的地方过夏天。

source: I expect the King will exile us soon. I won't stay in this cell forever. And then... we'll have our chance.
target: 我想国王很快就会流放我们。我不会永远待在这间牢房里。到那时……我们就有机会了。

source: We'll leave Elsinore and we'll never return.
target: 我们会离开埃尔西诺，再也不回来。

source: Look at me. Don't cry, love.
target: 看着我。别哭，亲爱的。

source: And I'm not going anywhere.
target: 而且，我哪儿也不会去。

source: I won't be executed. Not over this. This is merely Claudius's pettier side at work. Rest assured of that.
target: 我不会被处死。不会因为这件事。这只是克劳狄斯小心眼的一面在作祟。你尽管放心。

source: Unfortunately, for now, I must ask you leave me be. I don't want you caught up in all this. The King mustn't see you speaking with me.
target: 可惜，现在我得请你先别来找我了。我不想让你卷进这一切。不能让国王看见你和我说话。

source: I'm sorry. I'll leave you be, father.
target: 对不起，父亲。我不打扰您了。

source: I want you to take this and keep it safe.
target: 我想让你拿着这个，好好保管。

source: It's a key. It opens the chest in my room. I keep—kept—it on me at all times.
target: 这是一把钥匙。能打开我房间里的箱子。我一直随身带着——以前一直带着。

source: This chest cannot be opened via any other method. It contained those notes, but they're long gone now.
target: 那个箱子用别的办法都打不开。里面原本放着那些笔记，但现在早就没了。

source: Please take it. If Bernardo finds it, then they'll surely search my room, yours, and Laertes'. And I don't want to give them cause to do that.
target: 拿着吧。如果贝尔纳多发现了它，他们一定会搜查我的房间、你的房间，还有雷欧提斯的房间。我不想给他们这样做的理由。

source: Keep it close to you.
target: 把它随身带好。

source: (So Father has a key on him. Perhaps, in the future, there's a way to examine that chest before it comes to this...)
target: （原来父亲随身带着一把钥匙。也许以后，我能找到办法，在事情走到这一步之前查看那个箱子……）

source: At least for now... my father is alive. That's what matters.
target: 至少现在……父亲还活着。这才是最重要的。

source: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
target: 万福玛利亚，你充满圣宠，主与你同在。

source: Blessed art thou among women...
target: 你在妇女中受赞颂……

source: And blessed is the fruit of thy womb...
target: 你腹中的圣子也受赞颂……

source: I say, I didn't know you were a Catholic, Bernardo! Aren't those rather detested around these parts?
target: 哎呀，贝尔纳多，我还不知道你是天主教徒呢！这一带不是很讨厌天主教徒吗？

source: ... Do you mind?
target: ……能别打扰我吗？

source: I wish to be alone.
target: 我想一个人待着。

source: Oh, please, don't mind me. Carry on, carry on. Terribly sorry. I'll be like a mouse's shadow over here. Promise.
target: 哦，别在意我。继续，继续。真对不住。我会在这边安静得像只老鼠的影子。我保证。

source: ... Holy Mary, Mother of God...
target: ……天主圣母玛利亚……

source: Pray for us sinners now and at the hour of our death.
target: 求你现在和我们临终时，为我们罪人祈求。

source: Well, then. What awful thing have you done this week that needs the Virgin's forgiveness?
target: 那么，你这个星期干了什么坏事，需要圣母宽恕？

source: Gone whoring? Been reading salacious literature? Caught embedded in a sheep?
target: 去嫖娼了？看了淫秽读物？还是跟羊交配时被逮着了？

source: ...You're absolutely vile.
target: ……你真是下流透了。

source: I have committed no sins that I know of.
target: 据我所知，我没有犯过什么罪。

source: And yet you come to pray outside of mass. Why is that?
target: 可你还在弥撒之外来祈祷。这是为什么？

source: My father was of the clergy. I, like him, am a man of God in spirit.
target: 我父亲曾是神职人员。我和他一样，心里也是侍奉上帝的人。

source: Seems a waste of time to me. Isn't the whole notion of the Christian God that he knows how you feel regardless?
target: 我觉得这是浪费时间。基督教的上帝，不是无论如何都知道你心里在想什么吗？

source: We could be playing cards right now instead.
target: 我们现在本来可以去打牌的。

source: Did you come here merely to engage me in your frivolous opinions?
target: 你来这里，就是为了让我听你这些轻浮的见解？

source: And besides, card games are a sin! I ought to refuse your temptations... and Irma's too, for that matter. It leads to drinking and dancing. Awful business.
target: 再说，打牌是罪！我应该拒绝你的诱惑……说起来，伊尔玛的也一样。打牌会让人去喝酒、跳舞。真是糟糕透顶。

source: (She always uses the trick deck anyhow...)
target: （反正她总是用那副做过手脚的牌……）

source: Hmm. No cards? No drinking, no dancing? Well then. What does your God promise you that's so very compelling in return?
target: 嗯。不打牌？不喝酒，不跳舞？好吧。那你的上帝答应给你什么回报，能有这么大的吸引力？

source: Infinite bliss in the afterlife.
target: 死后无尽的福乐。

source: What, when you're dead? Rotten deal, if you ask me.
target: 什么，等你死了以后？要我说，这买卖可真不划算。

source: Mortal life is but a blink of an eye. As a soldier, I could die any day. But Heaven is eternal, and I will sit at God's side.
target: 凡人的一生不过转瞬之间。我是个士兵，随时都可能死去。但天堂永恒，我将坐在上帝身旁。

source: Hmm. Now that sounds like a slightly better wager.
target: 嗯。这么一说，这赌注听起来倒稍微划算些了。

source: Do you not speak to the Lord? Are you truly so uninvested in His word?
target: 你不向主祈祷吗？你真的对祂的话如此漠不关心？

source: Oh, I don't much care what your Christ has to say, though he seems kind-intended enough. Where I come from, we have hundreds of gods.
target: 哦，我不怎么在意你们的基督说些什么，虽然他看起来倒是一片好心。在我的家乡，我们有几百位神。

source: As we discussed earlier, I like your Christ well enough, but he isn't mine. Where I come from, we have hundreds of gods.
target: 就像我们之前说的，我对你们的基督还挺有好感，但他不是我信奉的神。在我的家乡，我们有几百位神。

source: H-hundreds? You're... a h-heathen?
target: 几、几百位？你是……异、异教徒？

source: That's correct, yes. I am a heathen. I prefer my devas and asuras. Some wisdom here, a little trickery there... Gods with real personality.
target: 对，没错。我是个异教徒。我更喜欢我们信奉的提婆和阿修罗。有的颇有智慧，有的耍点诡计……这些神才真有个性。

source: Hmph. Well, I suppose we've little to say to one another, then. Let's speak no more ill of any gods, especially in a church.
target: 哼。好吧，那我们大概没什么可聊的了。别再说任何神的坏话了，尤其是在教堂里。

source: Such a shame. I do so enjoy discussing this lily-faced, bearded, fatherly Lord of yours.
target: 真可惜。我还挺喜欢聊聊你们那位面色白皙、留着胡须、慈父般的主。

source: But as you wish, I'll leave you in peace.
target: 不过，就依你的意思，我不打扰你了。

source: ...Listen, Rosie. Do you think... we've made a mistake in answering the King's letter?
target: ……听我说，萝茜。你觉得……我们应国王的来信而来，是不是做错了？

source: Of course not. We're here to help Hamlet.
target: 当然没有。我们是来帮助哈姆雷特的。

source: But if the King is hanging on every little detail we tell him...
target: 可如果国王对我们告诉他的每个小细节都那么在意……

source: ...We do look like spies from the outside, don't we.
target: ……在旁人看来，我们确实很像密探，对吧。

source: But if we love Hamlet, and want to see him flourish, then...
target: 可如果我们爱哈姆雷特，希望他过得好，那……

source: ...We owe it to his parents to tell them about his state of mind.
target: ……我们就有责任向他的父母说明他的精神状况。

source: My only concern...
target: 我唯一担心的是……

source: ...Is that Hamlet may not see it the same way.
target: ……哈姆雷特可能不这么想。

source: And if he doesn't...
target: 而如果他不这么想……

source: ...It could mean our deaths.
target: ……我们可能会因此丧命。

source: Surely Hamlet wouldn't harm us, would he?
target: 哈姆雷特总不会伤害我们吧？

source: I cannot say what he'll do in his maddened grief. No one can.
target: 悲痛让他发了狂，我说不准他会做出什么事。谁也说不准。

source: What's clear is that we cannot trust this Ophelia girl.
target: 有一点很清楚：我们不能相信奥菲莉娅这个姑娘。

source: She may have the best intentions, but her inquisitive nature is a threat to us.
target: 她也许完全出于好意，但她爱刨根问底的性子对我们是个威胁。

source: Let's put our thoughts to action. We'll dog Hamlet's heels.
target: 我们把想法付诸行动吧。紧紧跟着哈姆雷特。

source: What was that sound?
target: 刚才那是什么声音？

source: The... outer gates...
target: 外……外城门……

source: B-Bernardo, who... who's comin' up the bridgeway?
target: 贝、贝尔纳多，谁……谁正从桥上过来？

source: Marcellus, I believe we have fallen into a trap.
target: 马塞勒斯，我想我们中了圈套。

source: Prince Fortinbras.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子。

source: He's coming... I can see smoke from the town.
target: 他来了……我看见镇上冒烟了。

source: We have nothing prepared, thanks to the command to disarm. This is to be the end of us.
target: 就因为那道解除武装的命令，我们毫无准备。我们要完了。

source: I guess Elsinore is really fallin', innit?
target: 看来埃尔西诺真要陷落了，是吧？

source: Yeh know, if yeh don' want to die here, Bernardo... yer a young man. You could get out. Get to the docks. Have a long, quiet life.
target: 你知道，要是你不想死在这儿，贝尔纳多……你还年轻。你可以逃出去。去码头。安安稳稳地过完长长的一辈子。

source: You ought to know me better than that.
target: 你该清楚我不是那种人。

source: ...Marcellus, there's something I've never told you before.
target: ……马塞勒斯，有件事我从没对你说过。

source: I consider you to be one of the greatest, noblest, most kindhearted men it has ever been my pleasure to know.
target: 在我有幸结识的人中，你是最了不起、最高尚、最善良的人之一。

source: Let us swear that whatever happens today, we shall someday raise our cups to one another in Heaven.
target: 我们发誓吧，无论今天发生什么，总有一天，我们会在天堂里向彼此举杯。

source: Don' say that yet! The day's not over! Tryin' to jinx us?
target: 先别说这种话！今天还没过完呢！你想咒我们啊？

source: Who do you think, Marcellus?
target: 你觉得会是谁，马塞勒斯？

source: Good thing we were prepared, eh?
target: 还好我们早有准备，是吧？

source: Men! To Arms!
target: 弟兄们！拿起武器！

source: Good afternoon, gentlemen. We come with the utmost goodwill.
target: 下午好，诸位。我们怀着最大的善意而来。

source: Goodwill? Do plumes of smoke signal goodwill in your land?
target: 善意？在你们的国家，滚滚浓烟代表善意吗？

source: We have no tolerance for invaders.
target: 我们绝不容忍入侵者。

source: Or liars, for that matter.
target: 骗子也一样。

source: No one further need die today, so long as you submit to the will of my rule.
target: 只要你们服从我的统治，今天就不必再有人死去。

source: M'lord, we'd be awful sorry guards if we let yeh traipse on in and imprison our lord!
target: 大人，要是让你大摇大摆地进去，把我们的君主关起来，那我们这守卫当得也太窝囊了！

source: Denmark will never belong to the likes of you. Not if we can help it.
target: 丹麦绝不会落到你这种人手里。只要我们还能阻止，就绝不会。

source: ...So be it. The olive branch was refused.
target: ……那就这样吧。和平的橄榄枝已遭拒绝。

source: Die, then.
target: 那就去死吧。

source: Useless men that they are, they are no match for Our glorious might.
target: 这些无用之辈，根本敌不过我们威赫的力量。

source: Onward, men. To the seat of power. Slay all who stand in our way.
target: 前进，士兵们。直取权力中枢。杀掉所有挡路的人。

source: The march towards the castle takes no prisoners.
target: 向城堡进军的队伍不留俘虏。

source: At yer service, Captain.
target: 听候吩咐，队长。

source: Stand down, Fortinbras.
target: 退兵吧，福丁布拉斯。

source: I am most impressed, Guard Captain, at your ability to rally in response to us.
target: 卫队长，你竟能集结人手应对我们，真让我刮目相看。

source: But will it be sufficient? I think not.
target: 可这就够了吗？我看不够。

source: Even if you take us all down, Elsinore will still stand with Denmark. Of that, I'm certain.
target: 即使你把我们全部打倒，埃尔西诺也仍会与丹麦站在一起。这一点，我确信无疑。

source: Let us find out, then. For me, with sorrow I embrace my fortune.
target: 那就让我们见分晓吧。至于我，我怀着悲哀接受命运的馈赠。

source: Why, it would seem you're outnumbered, my good man.
target: 哎呀，好汉，看来你们的人数比我们少啊。

source: Now. Would you like to stand and fight, or turn tail and flee? We are honorable men, and will give you the option.
target: 那么，你是想留下来打，还是掉头逃跑？我们是讲荣誉的人，会给你选择的机会。

source: You have approximately ten seconds to make your choice.
target: 你大约有十秒钟来做决定。

source: After that, we'll gladly enjoy rending your armor plate from plate.
target: 过了这个时间，我们会很乐意把你的铠甲一片片撕开。

source: W-we will return! You cannot rebuke us forever!
target: 我、我们一定会回来！你们不可能永远把我们击退！
