source: Good. Bring every man who can hold a sword. We'll show you what Elsinore is really capable of.
target: 很好。把所有拿得动剑的人都带来。我们会让你们见识埃尔西诺真正的本事。

source: We en't defended the sound for hundreds a' years without showing a few of yer kind who's in charge!
target: 我们守了这海峡几百年，早就教训过不少你们这种人，让他们知道这儿谁说了算！

source: Run along home, and tell 'em Bernardo an' Marcellus sent you!
target: 赶紧回家去，告诉他们，是贝尔纳多和马塞勒斯把你们赶回去的！

source: Ungh... retreat!
target: 呃……撤退！

source: You are persistent, aren't you?
target: 你还真是不肯放弃啊，是不是？

source: Look at you, burning away all the fates you earned. You've seen so many outcomes! So many possibilities!
target: 瞧瞧你，把自己挣来的命运全都烧掉了。你见过那么多结局！那么多可能！

source: And yet you've elected to choose none of them. Not only that, you've taken a match to them.
target: 可你却决定一个都不选。不仅如此，你还划根火柴把它们烧了。

source: Your indecisiveness is, mmm, impressive.
target: 你这份优柔寡断，嗯，真是令人叹服。

source: Lord, what fools these mortals be!
target: 天哪，这些凡人何其愚蠢！

source: Need I tell you to go away once more?
target: 还要我再叫你走开一次吗？

source: How rude. I come bearing a gift. Something to, ah, change up the game, so to speak.
target: 真没礼貌。我可是带着礼物来的。一件能，啊，换个玩法的东西，可以这么说。

source: You've already witnessed a small amount of the power the Book of Fates can bestow.
target: 你已经见识过一点《命运之书》所能赋予的力量。

source: Wouldn't you like to... try something new?
target: 你不想……试点新东西吗？

source: To see things from my point of view?
target: 从我的角度看待事物？

source: I'll give you a little phrase you can say to harness the Book's power and alter the story.
target: 我会告诉你一句可以念出来的短语，让你驾驭这本书的力量，改变故事。

source: What's the catch?
target: 有什么代价？

source: Oh! None at all, none at all.
target: 哦！完全没有，完全没有。

source: Save that you'll know what using that power feels like.
target: 只不过，你会知道使用那种力量是什么感觉。

source: And I think you'll find that once you've tried your hand at it... going back will be very, very difficult.
target: 而我想你会发现，一旦亲手试过……想回头就会非常、非常困难。

source: If you use it too much, some might even say it's impossible to return to the way things were!
target: 如果你用得太多，有人甚至会说，一切都不可能恢复原样了！

source: But of course, you'll know when you've reached that point. We both will.
target: 不过当然，到了那一步，你会知道的。我们两个都会知道。

source: If the clock strikes midnight on Friday evening and you've used this power on everyone, we'll speak further.
target: 如果星期五夜里的钟敲响了午夜，而你已经对每个人都用过这种力量，我们就再好好谈谈。

source: You'll be a very different girl then, I suspect.
target: 我猜，到那时你会变成一个截然不同的姑娘。

source: That was the last death.
target: 那是最后一次死亡。

source: All of them, gone.
target: 他们全都死了。

source: What beautiful horrors you've wrought upon this world.
target: 你给这个世界带来的恐怖，真是美妙。

source: Do you feel thrilled now? Or frightened?
target: 你现在觉得兴奋吗？还是害怕？

source: I feel...
target: 我觉得……

source: I feel nothing.
target: 我什么感觉都没有。

source: They're just bodies. Just things. Just little dolls, or characters. They're not people, not really.
target: 他们只是躯体。只是东西。只是小人偶，或者角色。他们不是人，并不是真正的人。

source: Yes. Yes!
target: 对。对！

source: Now you see. Now you understand. I did warn you you'd be a different woman when you came to this point.
target: 现在你看清了。现在你明白了。我确实警告过你，走到这一步时，你会变成另一个人。

source: And so you are.
target: 而你果然变了。

source: Yes. There's simply nothing. No sadness. No pain.
target: 对。真的什么感觉都没有。没有悲伤。没有痛苦。

source: As I thought. Come with me.
target: 正如我所想。跟我来。

source: We've somewhere to go, you and I. Somewhere far away from Elsinore.
target: 你和我，我们还有个地方要去。一个远离埃尔西诺的地方。

source: What can you mean? Somewhere else on earth?
target: 你这是什么意思？世上的另一个地方？

source: No, Ophelia. Somewhere else entirely. A different world. A new place.
target: 不，奥菲莉娅。是个完全不同的地方。另一个世界。一个全新的地方。

source: I must admit, I didn't realize how nice it would be to see someone else like me. Someone who understands.
target: 我得承认，我没想到，见到另一个和我一样的人会这么好。一个明白这一切的人。

source: The first time I used the Book's power to kill, I was so very frightened-- but that was so very long ago.
target: 第一次用这本书的力量杀人时，我怕得要命——不过，那已经是很久很久以前了。

source: Once you learn to see them as tools, as pieces, there are so many more things you can do.
target: 一旦你学会把他们看作工具、看作棋子，你能做的事就会多得多。

source: And there is yet time for all of them, now that peace has come to Elsinore.
target: 而现在，和平已降临埃尔西诺，我们还有时间把那些事一一做完。

source: I do so cherish this silence.
target: 我真是珍爱这份寂静。

source: The ending!
target: 结局！

source: Everyone, please, your swift attention is required. I'll be brief.
target: 各位，请立刻听我说。我会长话短说。

source: One of my men has located a... corpse.
target: 我的一名手下发现了一具……尸体。

source: I-it was in a rather horrifying state. Mangled beyond belief. Almost as if by a wild animal, but...
target: 那、那具尸体的状况相当骇人。扭曲破损得难以置信。简直像是遭了野兽袭击，可是……

source: Without a wound.
target: 没有一处伤口。

source: Those of us who can are investigating further. Please stay alert. Remain in groups. Do not go anywhere alone.
target: 我们中能抽身的人正在进一步调查。请保持警惕。结伴行动。不要独自去任何地方。

source: Elsinore is locked down until further notice.
target: 埃尔西诺即刻封锁，直到另行通知。

source: One of the guards has located a... corpse.
target: 一名守卫发现了一具……尸体。

source: And Guard Captain Bernardo is... dead.
target: 而卫队长贝尔纳多……死了。

source: I've changed the world to create deaths in the past. Sometimes even deaths of people I loved.
target: 过去，我也曾改变世界，造成过死亡。有时死去的甚至是我爱的人。

source: But it wasn't like this. That was horrific.
target: 但不是这样的。刚才那一幕太可怕了。

source: Enjoying your new tool?
target: 新工具用得开心吗？

source: Not at all. This tool is cursed. Take it from me.
target: 一点也不。这工具受了诅咒。把它从我这里拿走。

source: I thought this might happen. Indeed, I expected it! But you're mistaken.
target: 我就想过可能会这样。的确，我早料到了！但你弄错了。

source: You see, there is no such thing as a cursed tool, not really. A stone can be used to build a home or bludgeon a skull. The stone has no intention either way.
target: 你看，所谓受诅咒的工具，其实根本不存在。一块石头可以用来造房子，也可以用来砸碎人的头颅。石头本身并不想做其中任何一件事。

source: Regardless, this is wrong, what I'm doing.
target: 不管怎样，我现在做的这些事是错的。

source: Why am I listening to you anymore?
target: 我为什么还在听你说话？

source: Why, indeed?
target: 是啊，究竟为什么呢？

source: Au revoir for now!
target: 暂且告辞！

source: Please, everyone, I know you have questions, but I have no answers at the moment.
target: 各位，请体谅。我知道你们有疑问，但我目前还没有答案。

source: At this time I'm ordering that all remaining citizens of Elsinore stay near the castle's center.
target: 现在我命令，埃尔西诺所有尚存的居民都留在城堡中心附近。

source: My men and I will patrol further.
target: 我和我的手下会继续巡逻。

source: Folks, I know yeh've got questions. My thanks for gatherin' here.
target: 各位，我知道你们有疑问。谢谢大家聚到这儿来。

source: Those bodies you've heard about by now-- I saw one of the murders wiv' my own eyes.
target: 那些尸体的事，你们现在都听说了——其中一次，我亲眼看见了杀人的过程。

source: Folks, I know yeh've got questions, but I ain                                                                                              ' got answers jus' yet.
target: 各位，我知道你们有疑问，可我眼下还没答案。

source: Right now, we're mandatin' that all remaining citizens o' Elsinore stay near the castle's center.
target: 现在我们要求，埃尔西诺所有还活着的居民都得留在城堡中心附近。

source: The remainin' guards an' I will patrol further an' see what we can spot.
target: 我会跟剩下的守卫继续巡逻，看看能发现什么。

source: I called all of you here out of a desire to seek safety in numbers. Bernardo, Marcellus... both dead.
target: 我把各位召集到这里，是希望人多一些能更安全。贝尔纳多、马塞勒斯……都死了。

source: More mangled bodies have been uncovered.
target: 又发现了更多扭曲破损的尸体。

source: We have yet to identify the cause. Everyone, group up. Watch your backs. Trust no one.
target: 我们还没查明原因。各位，聚在一起。留神背后。不要相信任何人。

source: Remain close to the castle center.
target: 留在城堡中心附近。

source: Let us pray for a swift end to this nightmare.
target: 让我们祈祷，这场噩梦早日结束。

source: (Why? Why can't I stop?)
target: （为什么？为什么我停不下来？）

source: (It's so easy to crush them all.)
target: （把他们全部碾碎，竟然这么容易。）

source: I called all of you here because I didn't know what else to do. Bernardo, Marcellus, my uncle... all dead.
target: 我把各位召集到这里，是因为我不知道还能做什么。贝尔纳多、马塞勒斯、我的叔父……都死了。

source: Remain in the Great Hall. No one is to leave.
target: 留在大厅里。任何人都不准离开。

source: I never thought life would come to this. My husband and son are both dead in the mere blink of an eye. And none of us know the cause.
target: 我从没想过，人生会走到这一步。转眼之间，我的丈夫和儿子都死了。而我们谁也不知道原因。

source: There are bodies everywhere.
target: 到处都是尸体。

source: What little I know, I know this: We must trust one another if we are to survive. We must keep close.
target: 我知道的很少，但有一点我清楚：想要活下去，我们就必须彼此信任。必须待在一起。

source: Please don't stray too far. Please. For your own safety.
target: 请别走得太远。求你们了。为了你们自己的安全。

source: Please stay in this hall. Please. For your own safety.
target: 请留在这座大厅里。求你们了。为了你们自己的安全。

source: L-ladies and gentlemen of the court, I... must inform you that there has been no end to the horror you've witnessed.
target: 各、各位宫廷的女士、先生，我……必须告诉你们，你们目睹的恐怖事件还没有结束。

source: More bodies were discovered.
target: 又发现了更多尸体。

source: H-his majesty Claudius, Prince Hamlet, and Her Majesty Gertrude... all... have passed away.
target: 克、克劳狄斯国王陛下、哈姆雷特王子，还有乔特鲁德王后陛下……都……已经去世了。

source: You must all remain close. And calm. Please stay within sight of the Great Hall.
target: 大家必须待在一起。保持冷静。请留在能看见大厅的地方。

source: You must all remain close. And calm. Please stay within the Great Hall.
target: 大家必须待在一起。保持冷静。请留在大厅里。

source: The wolf could be any one of us.
target: 那匹狼可能是我们中的任何一个人。

source: Everyone, remain close. All members of the Royal Family have perished.
target: 各位，待在一起。王室成员已经全部遇难了。

source: A-and of my own family, only Ophelia and I remain.
target: 而、而我家里，也只剩下奥菲莉娅和我了。

source: At this point, I don't trust a single one of you save for my sister.
target: 到了这一步，除了我妹妹，你们当中我一个人都不信。

source: All of you remain within sight of the Great Hall, or I'll cut you down myself.
target: 你们全都给我待在能看见大厅的地方，否则我会亲手砍了你们。

source: All of you remain within the Great Hall, or I'll cut you down myself.
target: 你们全都给我待在大厅里，否则我会亲手砍了你们。

source: Look. It's safer for all of us to gather here.
target: 听着。大家聚在这里，对我们所有人都更安全。

source: Someone is killing members of the court. All of us are in immediate danger.
target: 有人正在杀害宫廷里的人。我们所有人都面临迫在眉睫的危险。

source: If you value your life, don't leave sight of the Great Hall. The closer we are, the better a chance of survival we have.
target: 如果你珍惜自己的性命，就别离开能看见大厅的地方。我们靠得越近，活下来的机会就越大。

source: If you value your life, don't leave the Great Hall. The closer we are, the better a chance of survival we have.
target: 如果你珍惜自己的性命，就别离开大厅。我们靠得越近，活下来的机会就越大。

source: If you haven't got a weapon, make one. Pick up whatever you can find to defend yourselves.
target: 没有武器，就做一件。能找到什么就拿什么来保护自己。

source: And watch each other. Any one of us could be the killer.
target: 还有，留意彼此。我们中任何一个人都可能是凶手。

source: At this time I'm ordering that all remaining citizens of Elsinore form a group here in the castle's center.
target: 现在我命令，埃尔西诺所有剩下的居民都到城堡中央这里集合。

source: By my order, we are not to leave this place until this horror is contained.
target: 我命令大家，在这场恐怖事件得到控制之前，不得离开这里。

source: Folks, I know yeh've got questions, but I ain' got answers jus' yet.
target: 各位，我知道你们有疑问，可我眼下也还没答案。

source: Right now, we're mandatin' that all remaining citizens o' Elsinore form a group here in the castle's center.
target: 现在，埃尔西诺所有剩下的居民都必须到城堡中央这里集合。

source: We en't leavin'. Not until the killer's left outside, if 'e be a stranger, or dead, if 'e be one of our own.
target: 我们不走。如果凶手是外人，就得把他挡在外头；如果是自己人，就得等他死了再走。

source: The truth will out.
target: 真相总会水落石出。

source: More mangled bodies have been showing up.
target: 又陆续发现了更多残破不堪的尸体。

source: This isn't natural. No human could have done this.
target: 这不合常理。人类不可能做出这种事。

source: I fear whatever was capable of killing these people far more than I fear any person. No person could've done that.
target: 不管杀死这些人的是什么，我对它的恐惧都远胜过对任何人的恐惧。没有人能做出那种事。

source: At this point, I don't trust a single one of you.
target: 到了这个地步，你们中任何一个人我都不信。

source: Dead. They're all dead. I-is... is such a thing... possible?
target: 死了。他们全死了。这、这……这种事……可能吗？

source: I don't know what we ought to do. Remain close, I suspect. That's what Hamlet would say.
target: 我不知道我们该怎么办。我想，待在一起吧。哈姆雷特会这么说的。

source: Safety in numbers, and so on, and so forth.
target: 人多才安全，诸如此类的话。

source: I am certain now that all of us shall die.
target: 现在我确信，我们所有人都会死。

source: I fear whatever killed those people far more than I fear any person. For surely, it was no person at all.
target: 不管杀死那些人的是什么，我对它的恐惧都远胜过对任何人的恐惧。因为那绝不可能是人。

source: What sort of person will I be if I reach the end? If I kill all of them?
target: 如果我走到最后，会变成什么样的人？如果我把他们全都杀了呢？

source: You'll find out soon enough. That is, if you're clever enough to hunt down the rest of these little mice.
target: 你很快就会知道了。当然，前提是你够聪明，能猎杀剩下的这些小老鼠。

source: Mice. That's what they look like to you. Prey.
target: 老鼠。在你眼里，他们就是这样。猎物。

source: More or less. What is it Hamlet always says? What a piece of work is man!
target: 差不多吧。哈姆雷特总说的那句话是什么来着？人类是何等杰作！

source: How noble in reason, how infinite in faculty!
target: 理性何其高贵，才能何其无穷！

source: And yet, to me, what is this quintessence of dust? Man delights not me.
target: 然而在我眼中，这尘土的精华又算得了什么？人类不能使我欢喜。

source: Quince, be honest with me. If I finish this mission you've handed to me, what's going to become of me?
target: 奎因斯，跟我说实话。如果我完成了你交给我的任务，我会怎么样？

source: You will have been thoroughly divested of the bonds which connect you to these people and this world.
target: 到那时，你与这些人、与这个世界之间的羁绊，都将被彻底剥离。

source: And then what? To what end?
target: 然后呢？这样做到底是为了什么？

source: My sincerest thanks for gathering here, everyone. I'll be brief.
target: 衷心感谢各位来这里集合。我长话短说。

source: Lady Ophelia, the door's been locked.
target: 奥菲莉娅女士，门已经锁上了。

source: I saw what you did. I don't know how you were able to kill like that. But I saw it all the same.
target: 我看见你做了什么。我不知道你是怎么那样杀人的。但我确实看见了。

source: Everyone, Lady Ophelia is in possession of a certain strange power which enables her to kill without touch.
target: 各位，奥菲莉娅女士拥有某种奇怪的力量，让她不必触碰别人就能杀人。

source: If we value our lives and each other, we cannot allow her to live.
target: 如果我们珍惜自己的生命，也珍惜彼此，就不能让她活下去。

source: No matter how... much... it pains me to say this.
target: 无论……说出这话……让我有多痛苦。

source: Uncovered for my acts.
target: 我的所作所为被揭穿了。

source: I know with absolute certainty. Lady Ophelia did this.
target: 我绝对确信。这是奥菲莉娅女士干的。

source: Without so much as laying a hand on her victim's body. It was-- it should have been impossible.
target: 她甚至没有伸手碰过受害者的身体。这——这本该是不可能的。

source: She has to die. I'm ordering her swift and immediate execution, on behalf of all our lives.
target: 她必须死。为了我们所有人的性命，我命令立即将她处决，不得拖延。

source: Guards, strike her where she stands!
target: 卫兵，就地杀了她！

source: Lady Ophelia killed 'em without even touching 'em. S-she's--there's something wrong wiv' 'er.
target: 奥菲莉娅女士连碰都没碰他们，就把他们杀了。她、她——她不对劲。

source: She's not human. S-she's some kind of... demon!
target: 她不是人。她、她是什么……恶魔！

source: S-so, I'm orderin' her immediate execution, fer lack of any other reasonable option.
target: 所、所以，我命令立即处决她，因为实在没有别的合理选择。

source: It's the only thing'll ensure all of th'rest of us survive this 'orrible day.
target: 只有这样，才能保证我们剩下的所有人活过这可怕的一天。

source: Guards, to me!
target: 卫兵，到我这里来！

source: I saw the murder. It was-- it was my sister.
target: 我看见了那场谋杀。是——是我妹妹干的。

source: Isn't that right, Ophelia?
target: 是这样吧，奥菲莉娅？

source: It's true. I made Father go away. But only for a little while.
target: 是真的。我让父亲离开了。但只是暂时的。

source: It's true. I made someone go away. But only for a little while.
target: 是真的。我让一个人离开了。但只是暂时的。

source: I can bring them back, Laertes. And I can do it to any of the others, too. Any time I'd like.
target: 我能让他们回来，雷欧提斯。其他人我也能这样对待。只要我想，随时都行。

source: There's something wrong with her. She's mad. Or worse.
target: 她不对劲。她疯了。或者更糟。

source: But this is my blood. I will not allow any harm to come to her.
target: 但她是我的血亲。我不会让她受到任何伤害。

source: I'll bind her hands myself, and take her somewhere she can harm no one, even herself.
target: 我会亲手绑住她的双手，把她带到一个她伤害不了任何人的地方，连她自己也伤害不了。

source: I love you, sister. No matter what you've become.
target: 我爱你，妹妹。不管你变成了什么。

source: I saw someone. Or... something.
target: 我看见了一个人。或者说……某种东西。

source: That murder. I was there.
target: 那场谋杀。我当时在场。

source: Ophelia-- she-- killed someone without even laying her hands on them. I saw her myself.
target: 奥菲莉娅——她——连碰都没碰那个人，就把人杀了。我亲眼看见了她。

source: We have to execute her. Not even throwing her in prison is safe.
target: 我们必须处决她。就算把她关进监狱也不安全。

source: Otherwise, all of our lives are in immediate danger. Please, you all have to believe me.
target: 否则，我们所有人的性命随时都会有危险。求求你们，一定要相信我。

source: S-she's some kind of monster!
target: 她、她是某种怪物！

source: You. Ophelia!
target: 你。奥菲莉娅！

source: Little devil bitch. Look at me.
target: 你这恶魔小贱人。看着我。

source: You killed Gerta. Some would throw you in prison. Some would exile you.
target: 你杀了格尔塔。有人会把你关进监狱。有人会把你放逐。

source: That won't work on me. Not now. Not like this.
target: 那对我没用。现在没用。我这个样子，没用。

source: Oh, I know that. But girl, I fear no spirits. And I'm not soft like them.
target: 哦，我知道。可丫头，我不怕鬼魂。我也不像他们那么心软。

source: Thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
target: 你在群龙栖息之地重创了我们，又以死亡的阴影笼罩我们。

source: If you came from hell, that's where you'll go. I'll put you there myself.
target: 如果你来自地狱，那你就回那里去。我会亲手送你回去。

source: I know who the killer is.
target: 我知道凶手是谁。

source: Hamlet died at Ophelia's hand. She's not sane. I'm not even particularly convinced she's still human.
target: 哈姆雷特死在奥菲莉娅手里。她神志不清。我甚至不太相信她还是人。

source: With Hamlet gone, I bear little regard for silence. She's the culprit.
target: 哈姆雷特已经死了，我也不太在乎是否保持沉默了。她就是凶手。

source: And whatever this is, I'm certain if we don't fight back, it'll cost us our lives.
target: 而且不管这究竟是什么，我确信，如果我们不反抗，就会赔上性命。

source: She's an imminent threat to all of us. Please, heed my warning.
target: 她随时可能危及我们所有人。请听进我的警告。

source: It pains me t' say it, but I saw someone. Lady Ophelia.
target: 说出来让我很难受，可我确实看见了一个人。奥菲莉娅女士。

source: She killed 'em without even touching 'em. S-she's--there's something wrong wiv' 'er.
target: 她连碰都没碰他们，就把他们杀了。她、她——她不对劲。

source: I saw...
target: 我看见了……

source: Never mind.
target: 算了。

source: Yes, Father?
target: 什么事，父亲？

source: N... nothing.
target: 没……没什么。

source: Yes, Your Highness?
target: 什么事，殿下？

source: Ding, dong! Time's up!
target: 叮，咚！时间到！

source: Well, the clock's struck midnight. The witching hour is upon us, but you're a poor imitation of a devil!
target: 好了，午夜的钟声响了。鬼魅出没的时刻已至，可你这恶魔扮得也太不像样了！

source: And you were only beginning to make your moves.
target: 而你才刚刚开始行动。

source: Yet you turned upon your family first and foremost.
target: 不过，你最先下手的倒是自己的家人。

source: You managed quite a bit of progress, didn't you? I find it's easier, after you understand the way their minds work...
target: 你进展不小，是不是？我发现，只要摸清他们的心思，就容易多了……

source: These lot are predictable when they're afraid.
target: 这帮人一害怕，就很好猜了。

source: Why, you got more than half of them! Such sport! Setting snares right and left.
target: 哎呀，你干掉了他们一半以上！多有趣的狩猎！到处布下陷阱。

source: You were just the faintest little bit away from a perfect victory. And yet! Time is time.
target: 你离完胜只差那么一丁点。可惜啊！时间到了就是到了。

source: Do remember, the challenge was to ensure that everyone met an early demise.
target: 可别忘了，这次挑战是要确保每个人都早早丧命。

source: That includes Claudius, Hamlet, Gertrude, Bernardo, Polonius, Laertes, Marcellus, Irma, Horatio, Rosencrantz, and Guildenstern.
target: 包括克劳狄斯、哈姆雷特、乔特鲁德、贝尔纳多、波洛涅斯、雷欧提斯、马塞勒斯、伊尔玛、霍拉旭、罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞。

source: I do congratulate you on the attempt and wish you the best of luck in the next world over.
target: 我倒要祝贺你这次尝试，也祝你在下一个世界好运。

source: After all, there's not much point to lingering in this world any more, is there?
target: 毕竟，继续留在这个世界已经没什么意义了，不是吗？

source: They've all gone broken and afraid. No use to anyone now. They'll simply cower until their hearts give out.
target: 他们都已崩溃，惶惶不可终日。现在对谁都没用了。他们只会畏缩着，直到心脏停止跳动。

source: I'm returning to the beginning now.
target: 我现在要回到最开始了。

source: This world's no good to me anymore.
target: 这个世界对我已经没用了。

source: No. Your eyes are too cold.
target: 不。你的眼神太冷了。

source: You must be some imposter, some spirit like the one I saw before. Ophelia isn't capable of this.
target: 你一定是个冒牌货，是和我之前看见的那个一样的鬼魂。奥菲莉娅做不出这种事。

source: I've had enough of spirits lately.
target: 最近这些鬼魂，我已经受够了。

source: Die, then--whoever you are.
target: 那就去死吧——不管你是谁。

source: N-no. You canna' be her. Ophelia'd never do somethin' like this...
target: 不、不。你不可能是她。奥菲莉娅绝不会做这种事……

source: Yer jus' like that vile impersonation of King Hamlet we saw! Some illusion!
target: 你就跟我们见过的那个冒充哈姆雷特国王的邪恶东西一样！也是个幻象！

source: Time to go back to hell an' leave us good folk in peace.
target: 该回地狱去了，别再搅扰我们这些好人。

source: My wife told me about this. About what you did. But I didn't believe it.
target: 我妻子跟我说过这件事。说过你做了什么。可我没信。

source: I don't know what you are-- spirit or demon or otherwise. But no justice could apply to you.
target: 我不知道你是什么——鬼魂、恶魔，还是别的东西。但任何公正的裁决都不适用于你。

source: I've no intention of letting you do your vile work on me. Come.
target: 我不会让你把那邪恶的手段用在我身上。来吧。

source: I saw what you did.
target: 我看见你做了什么。

source: What are you? Who are you?
target: 你到底是什么？你到底是谁？

source: I can't let you leave.
target: 我不能让你离开。

source: You know, don't you? You know I have to stop you.
target: 你知道，对吧？你知道我必须阻止你。

source: I need to see you alone.
target: 我得单独见你。

source: Must it be now?
target: 非得现在吗？

source: You... and... Father. Are you mad? Did something happen?
target: 你……和……父亲。你疯了吗？是出了什么事吗？

source: What do you intend to do?
target: 你打算做什么？

source: I can bring him back, Laertes. And I can do it to any of the others, too. Any time I'd like.
target: 我能让他回来，雷欧提斯。其他人我也能这样对待。只要我想，随时都行。

source: You are not my sister.
target: 你不是我妹妹。

source: No. Something else. Whoever's in there -- whatever you are.
target: 不。是别的东西。不管里面是谁——不管你是什么。

source: I cannot shake that terrible aim in your gaze.
target: 你眼神里那可怕的意图，我怎么也忘不掉。

source: But you are my blood. I will not allow any harm to come to you.
target: 但你是我的血亲。我不会让你受到任何伤害。

source: I promised Mother I would take care of you until the day I died.
target: 我答应过母亲，会照顾你，直到我死的那一天。

source: But I cannot allow you to go free.
target: 但我不能放任你自由行动。

source: What are you doing? Get off!
target: 你干什么？放开！

source: Let go of me!
target: 放开我！

source: I'll bind your hands myself, and take you somewhere you can harm no one.
target: 我会亲手绑住你的双手，把你带到一个你伤害不了任何人的地方。

source: Father is dead.
target: 父亲死了。

source: I know what you did.
target: 我知道你做了什么。

source: You... are you mad? Did something happen?
target: 你……你疯了吗？是出了什么事吗？

source: Please. Stop. Please.
target: 求你了。停下。求你了。

source: Eliminate Laertes?
target: 除掉雷欧提斯？

source: You're right. No more of this.
target: 你说得对。不能再这样了。

source: This ends now.
target: 这一切到此为止。

source: Oh, my God, Ophelia.
target: 天哪，奥菲莉娅。

source: What did you do? Why would you kill someone?
target: 你做了什么？你为什么要杀人？

source: A-and in that kind of way... like... like you weren't human.
target: 而、而且用那种方式……好像……好像你不是人。

source: Come with me. Let me send you somewhere you won't hurt anyone else.
target: 跟我来。让我送你去一个你不会伤害别人的地方。

source: I love you. I love you so much.
target: 我爱你。我真的很爱你。

source: No more of this. Please. No more.
target: 别再这样了。求你了。别再这样。

source: Ophelia. It cannot be true.
target: 奥菲莉娅。这不可能是真的。

source: What I saw.
target: 我看见的那些。

source: What I saw you do.
target: 我看见你做的那些事。

source: It isn't real. It can't be. D-death like that... is... impossible!
target: 这不是真的。不可能是真的。那、那样的死法……是……不可能的！

source: I didn't mean for you to see it, Father.
target: 我没想让你看见，父亲。

source: So it was real!
target: 所以那确实是真的！

source: Ooh... Elise... I...
target: 哦……伊莉丝……我……

source: He's gone off somewhere.
target: 他不知道跑哪儿去了。

source: And making such strange noises, at that.
target: 还发出那么奇怪的声音。

source: Claudius. Ophelia-- she's--
target: 克劳狄斯。奥菲莉娅——她——

source: What's happened?
target: 出什么事了？

source: She's done something so peculiar.
target: 她做了件非常古怪的事。

source: There's something inside her. Something evil.
target: 她体内有什么东西。某种邪恶的东西。

source: I didn't think her capable, but the way she committed such violence...
target: 我没想到她能做出这种事，可她施暴时的那种手段……

source: Whatever you saw, she is still flesh and blood.
target: 不管你看见了什么，她仍是血肉之躯。

source: I'll bring an end to this.
target: 我会结束这一切。

source: Bernardo. Did you... see... Ophelia?
target: 贝尔纳多。你……看见……奥菲莉娅了吗？

source: When? In what sort of way?
target: 什么时候？看见她什么样子？

source: She's... done something horrible.
target: 她……做了件可怕的事。

source: A-as in, some sort of spirit?
target: 您、您是说，某种鬼魂？

source: She took a life without laying a hand to anyone!
target: 她连碰都没碰任何人，就夺走了一条人命！

source: W-with merely a word!
target: 只、只用了一句话！

source: I see. A trick of the Devil, sent to test us.
target: 明白了。是魔鬼用来考验我们的诡计。

source: There's been far too much of spirits lately.
target: 最近鬼魂作祟的事太多了。

source: I'll handle this, my lady.
target: 王后，让我来处理。

source: Marcellus. Did you... see... Ophelia?
target: 马塞勒斯。你……看见……奥菲莉娅了吗？

source: Wot happened, Yer Highness?
target: 出什么事了，殿下？

source: There's something in her eyes. And her hands are stained with blood.
target: 她眼里有什么东西。她的双手也沾满了鲜血。

source: She took a life with mere words. This cannot be human, can it? This cannot be possible for a woman to do!
target: 她只凭几句话就夺走了一条人命。这不可能是人能做到的，对吧？一个女人不可能做到这种事！

source: M'lady, the devil's been at work aroun' this castle.
target: 王后，魔鬼一直在这城堡周围作祟。

source: This ain't the first apparition this week.
target: 这不是本周出现的第一个幽灵了。

source: Let me 'andle this, Yer Highness.
target: 让我来处理吧，殿下。

source: Polonius. Have you seen your daughter?
target: 波洛涅斯。你见过你女儿了吗？

source: What happened? Is she all right?
target: 出什么事了？她没事吧？

source: No. Something's wrong.
target: 不。她不对劲。

source: I'm sure there's been a misunderstanding.
target: 我相信这里面一定有误会。

source: No. I know what I saw.
target: 不。我清楚自己看见了什么。

source: She's possessed by a dark spirit. Or worse.
target: 她被邪灵附身了。或者更糟。

source: I must go to her.
target: 我必须去找她。

source: Ophelia could never do something like that. I'll set all this right.
target: 奥菲莉娅绝不会做那种事。我会把这一切处理好。

source: T-they're all dead-- all of them--
target: 他、他们都死了——所有人都死了——

source: She's nearby... I...
target: 她就在附近……我……

source: There's no one left to help me...
target: 已经没人能帮我了……

source: I shall perish here. Someone, please! Help me!
target: 我要死在这里了。谁来救救我，求求你！救命！

source: Oh, God...
target: 上帝啊……

source: Oh, God, oh, God, oh, God...
target: 上帝啊，上帝啊，上帝啊……

source: Save me. Save me from this.
target: 救救我。救我脱离这一切。

source: Everyone's talking about you.
target: 大家都在议论你。

source: What happened-- was that-- was that real?
target: 发生的那些事——那是——那是真的吗？

source: It can't be real, can it?
target: 不可能是真的，对吧？

source: Yes. It's real.
target: 是的。是真的。

source: A-and were you-- are you-- are you going to kill us all?
target: 那、那你之前——你现在——你要把我们全杀了吗？

source: Would you kill me?
target: 你会杀了我吗？

source: I can't promise you anything in this world, Hamlet.
target: 在这个世界里，我什么都不能向你保证，哈姆雷特。

source: I can't let you continue this.
target: 我不能让你继续这样下去。

source: I won't. Whatever I felt for you-- watching all this-- it's too much.
target: 我绝不会允许。不管我曾对你有过怎样的感情——看着这一切——实在让人无法承受。

source: I have to act.
target: 我必须行动。

source: I'll take whatever punishment comes my way.
target: 无论受到什么惩罚，我都认了。

source: After you're dead, that is.
target: 当然，得等你死了之后。

source: Howl, howl, howl, howl...
target: 哭吧，哭吧，哭吧，哭吧……

source: She's gone forever.
target: 她永远地走了。

source: I know when one is dead and when one lives.
target: 一个人是死是活，我分得清。

source: She's dead as earth. Lend me a looking-glass!
target: 她像泥土一样，毫无生气。借我一面镜子！

source: If that her breath will mist or stain the stone--
target: 要是她的气息能让镜面蒙上雾气，留下痕迹——

source: Why then, she lives.
target: 那她就还活着。

source: Look on her. Look, her lips. Look there, look there.
target: 看看她。看，她的嘴唇。看那里，看那里。

source: Oh... oh... oh...
He wasn't in his right mind. Not at the end.
target: 他神志不清了。最后那时候已经不清醒了。

source: Hamlet, we need to act. Now.
target: 哈姆雷特，我们得行动了。现在就得行动。

source: People are dying by Ophelia's hand. She's not sane. I'm not even particularly convinced she's still human.
target: 有人正死在奥菲莉娅手里。她已经疯了。我甚至都不太确定她还是不是人。

source: Fight back? You mean-- kill Ophelia?
target: 还击？你是说——杀了奥菲莉娅？

source: She's an imminent threat to all of us.
target: 她随时可能危及我们所有人。

source: No. I can't do that. It wouldn't come to that.
target: 不。我做不到。不会走到那一步的。

source: Allow me to speak with her. Get her to see reason.
target: 让我跟她谈谈。让她听进道理。

source: Whatever mystics are taking place here, she's at the center of them, and she can make them cease.
target: 不管这里发生的是什么怪事，她都是这一切的中心，她能让它们停下来。

source: I hope for all of our sakes that you're right.
target: 为了我们所有人，但愿你是对的。

source: Just-- be prepared to take swift action if it comes to that.
target: 只是——如果真到了那一步，你得做好迅速行动的准备。

source: I'll bring an end to this. One way or another.
target: 我会结束这一切。无论用什么办法。

source: Uncle. Thank you for agreeing to meet me.
target: 叔叔。谢谢你愿意见我。

source: Of course, of course. What's this about, Hamlet?
target: 当然，当然。找我有什么事，哈姆雷特？

source: I have just one question to ask.
target: 我只想问一个问题。

source: Of course. Anything.
target: 当然。什么都可以问。

source: I know you killed him. I have proof. A trusted witness.
target: 我知道是你杀了他。我有证据。有一个可信的证人。

source: All I want to know is, why?
target: 我只想知道，为什么？

source: Killed who? I don't know what you mean.
target: 杀了谁？我不明白你在说什么。

source: Don't play me for a fool. I know you took my father's life. I know with certainty.
target: 别把我当傻子。我知道你杀了我父亲。我确定无疑。

source: I have no intentions of telling anyone else. But I wanted to hear the truth from you.
target: 我没打算告诉别人。但我想听你亲口说出真相。

source: I knew this day might come. But I didn't know when.
target: 我知道这一天可能会来。只是不知道会在什么时候。

source: Perhaps in my heart I've been quietly praying for you to know the truth.
target: 也许我心里一直在默默祈祷，希望你知道真相。

source: Have mercy, Hamlet. I killed him. But I live with the weight of a regret so deep I cannot touch the bottom.
target: 饶了我吧，哈姆雷特。我杀了他。但我一直背负着悔恨，那悔恨深得让我触不到底。

source: I have punished myself enough for my crime.
target: 为了这桩罪行，我给自己的惩罚已经够多了。

source: I know it was wrong to have done it. I know it now with everything in my soul.
target: 我知道那么做是错的。如今，我整个灵魂都明白这一点。

source: If... If you have only a shred of mercy within your heart, cling to that, and let it fill you.
target: 如果……如果你心里还有哪怕一丝怜悯，就抓住它，让它充满你的心。

source: It would bear you a rich reward.
target: 它会给你带来丰厚的回报。

source: We could rule together. You could be Prince not only in name, but in act and deed.
target: 我们可以一起治理国家。你可以不只空有王子的名号，而是真正行使王子的权力。

source: The country would love you for it. Can you imagine? And with my expertise on the throne now, I'd be able to tutor you.
target: 全国都会因此爱戴你。你能想象吗？如今我有了治理国家的经验，也能教导你。

source: Preparing you for the day when you would become King yourself.
target: 让你为自己成为国王的那一天做好准备。

source: Yes, that's how I could make this right, I think. Restore you to where you ought to be. Where my brother would've wanted you.
target: 对，我想，我可以这样弥补这一切。让你回到你应有的位置。回到我哥哥希望你在的位置。

source: You're saying... you... you really did kill him?
target: 你是说……你……你确实杀了他？

source: I-- find your offer intriguing. I think that would ease Father's spirit, knowing I was preparing to take his place.
target: 我——对你的提议很感兴趣。我想，父亲若知道我正在准备接替他，他的灵魂也会得到安慰。

source: Yes. Let me contemplate the offer.
target: 好。让我考虑一下你的提议。

source: You truly mean it?
target: 你真是这么想的？

source: Oh, my boy, my poor nephew. I cannot apologize enough.
target: 哦，孩子，我可怜的侄子。我怎么道歉都不够。

source: I need a night's time to think it over, and to pray. We'll speak further after that.
target: 我需要一晚的时间，仔细想想，也祈祷一下。之后我们再谈。

source: Of course, of course! Anything you desire. Anything at all!
target: 当然，当然！你想怎样都行。什么都行！

source: First, I want you to do one thing. I've witnessed my father's spirit, Uncle. I spoke to it.
target: 首先，我要你做一件事。叔叔，我亲眼见过父亲的灵魂。我跟他谈过。

source: You see Father's portrait there on the wall?
target: 你看见墙上那幅父亲的画像了吗？

source: It's strange. I've not seen it in the gallery in months. He looked so cruel, there.
target: 真奇怪。我已经好几个月没在画廊里看见它了。画里的他看上去那么冷酷。

source: My brother was a stern man, but the cruelty he earned from our own father.
target: 我哥哥是个严厉的人，但他的冷酷是从我们父亲那里得来的。

source: What would you say to him?
target: 你会对他说什么？

source: I... I'd say...
target: 我……我会说……

source: Why, there's so much to say.
target: 唉，要说的话实在太多了。

source: ...How... much I miss...
target: ……我有……多么想念……

source: I don't give a damn.
target: 我才不在乎。

source: You and your apologies can burn in hell.
target: 你和你的道歉一起下地狱去吧。

source: I loved my father with all my heart. As did his country. And you took him from all of us.
target: 我全心全意地爱着父亲。他的子民也一样。而你把他从我们所有人身边夺走了。

source: No peace-offering of power can bring him back from the dead—or save your soul.
target: 无论拿多少权力来求和，都不能让他死而复生——也救不了你的灵魂。

source: At last. At last. He is justly served.
target: 终于。终于。他得到了应有的报应。

source: Ophelia. A word in private, please.
target: 奥菲莉娅。请让我和你私下谈谈。

source: I can scarcely believe it.
target: 我几乎不敢相信。

source: I just wish I knew what Father would say.
target: 我只希望能知道父亲会怎么说。

source: And Mother, her life-- she was caught up in all this.
target: 还有母亲，她的一生——她也被卷进了这一切。

source: Would that she still lived.
target: 但愿她还活着。

source: (Poor Gertrude. She didn't deserve that.)
target: （可怜的乔特鲁德。她不该落得那样的下场。）

source: I never thought I'd make it this long. I thought...
target: 我从没想过自己能撑这么久。我以为……

source: Everything was so dark for so long. I couldn't feel, couldn't think.
target: 那么长时间里，一切都那么黑暗。我无法感受，也无法思考。

source: All I wanted to do was die. Some part of me still does.
target: 我只想死。现在，我心里还有一部分仍然这么想。

source: I know. But now you've got to make the hardest decision of your life.
target: 我知道。但现在，你得做出一生中最艰难的决定了。

source: Where do you go from here, now that you've chosen to live?
target: 既然你已经选择活下去，接下来你打算走哪条路？

source: I think I already know.
target: 我想，我已经知道了。

source: I suppose my betrothal to Brit is something I ought to honor.
target: 我想，我应该履行和布莉特的婚约。

source: That's what a good King does, is it not? Honors his word. Much as I might despise the thought of spending my life with her.
target: 一个好国王就该这样，不是吗？信守承诺。即使一想到要和她共度一生，我就十分厌恶。

source: You spoke earlier to me of revisiting things. Seeing them through new eyes.
target: 你之前跟我说过，要重新看待一些事。用新的眼光去看。

source: I've spent these long months trying to purge you from my mind, but I couldn't do it.
target: 这漫长的几个月里，我一直想把你从脑海里抹去，可我做不到。

source: All the same, I know you've despised me from afar all summer. I wanted to respect that boundary.
target: 不过，我知道整个夏天你都疏远我，厌恶我。我想尊重你划下的界限。

source: If it's true that you love me no longer, I'll go, and I'll never trouble you again with my affections, nor stumble blindly into your room at dawn.
target: 如果你真的不再爱我，我就离开，再也不会用我的感情来打扰你，也不会再在黎明时莽撞地跌跌撞撞闯进你的房间。

source: What will the others say, Hamlet?
target: 别人会怎么说，哈姆雷特？

source: Don't you think I saw the way your uncle looked at me, as though I were an annoying insect?
target: 你以为我没看见你叔叔看我的眼神吗？仿佛我是一只讨厌的虫子。

source: But he's gone now, Ophelia. He's dead.
target: 可他现在已经不在了，奥菲莉娅。他死了。

source: Listen. I am Prince of this country. And soon, God willing, I will be King. What could you desire that would be beyond my power to control?
target: 听我说。我是这个国家的王子。上帝若愿意，我很快就会成为国王。你想要的东西，有什么是我的权力左右不了的？

source: But it doesn't have to be. Not anymore.
target: 可这不必如此了。如今不必了。

source: Is that still something of interest to you?
target: 你现在还愿意吗？

source: Revisiting our relationship, you mean?
target: 你是说，重新考虑我们的关系？

source: Do you want me still?
target: 你还想和我在一起吗？

source: I... was vile to you. I knew it even then. I've done things to you that would shame my father, were he still alive.
target: 我……曾经对你很恶劣。当时我就知道。我对你做过的那些事，若父亲还活着，他也会感到羞耻。

source: No amount of apology can ever remove what I've done to you.
target: 无论道歉多少次，都无法抹去我对你做过的事。

source: But despite all that, I am deeply, truly, eternally sorry for things I said and did to you.
target: 但即便如此，对于我对你说过的话、做过的事，我深深地、真心地感到抱歉，这份歉意永远不会消失。

source: And—if you can find it in your heart to—ever think of me with affection—
target: 而且——如果你心里还能——再带着爱意想起我——

source: When I was on board our ship to England, Lady Guildenstern took me aside.
target: 在我们前往英格兰的船上，吉尔登斯吞女士把我叫到了一旁。

source: You recall that altercation on the boat. It gave me much to think about.
target: 你还记得船上那场争执吧。它让我想了很多。

source: I have failed you many a time, I think. More deeply than I will ever understand.
target: 我想，我辜负过你很多次。伤害之深，恐怕我永远都无法理解。

source: She explained to me that there are ways in which I have failed the women in my life.
target: 她向我解释了，我在哪些方面辜负了生命中的那些女性。

source: Hamlet, what you did to me was wrong.
target: 哈姆雷特，你那样对我，是错的。

source: You tried to wound me with everything you had. You came after me again and again. And it hurt.
target: 你竭尽所能地想伤害我。你一次又一次地针对我。而我确实受到了伤害。

source: I don't know that I can ever trust you again after that. Or whether you deserve my trust.
target: 经历那些事以后，我不知道自己还能不能再信任你。也不知道你值不值得我信任。

source: With my uncle's passing, I have come to believe in a world of fundamental justice.
target: 叔叔死后，我开始相信，这个世界终究是公正的。

source: Justice for all who have been wronged. Including you.
target: 所有受过伤害的人都能得到公道。包括你。

source: And in a just world, I'd treat you as my partner and better for the rest of our lives.
target: 而在一个公正的世界里，我会在我们余下的一生中，把你当作我的伴侣，视你为比我更优秀的人。

source: The mistakes of our pasts teach us where those whom we love deserve to be.
target: 我们过去犯下的错误，让我们明白所爱的人应当得到怎样的位置。

source: And you—you deserve to rule Denmark at my side. You'd be a magnificent Queen. I've always said as much, even in my cruelest moments.
target: 而你——你理应和我并肩统治丹麦。你会是一位出色的王后。我一直这么说，哪怕在我最冷酷的时候也是如此。

source: Can you share that vision with me? Can you trust me again?
target: 你愿意和我一起憧憬这样的未来吗？你能再次信任我吗？

source: Rekindle my relationship with Hamlet?
target: 和哈姆雷特重燃旧情？

source: Hmm. Your mother would be thrilled, I'm certain.
target: 嗯。你母亲一定会很高兴，我确信。

source: So? Your answer?
target: 那么？你的回答呢？

source: I don't forgive you, Hamlet. Not yet. But—
target: 我没有原谅你，哈姆雷特。还没有。但是——

source: I suspect something in me misses you, after all.
target: 我想，我心里终究还是有一部分在想念你。

source: I, ah...
target: 我，啊……

source: Why are you crying? Isn't this what you wanted?
target: 你怎么哭了？这不是你想要的吗？

source: No, no. It's not that.
target: 不，不。不是因为这个。

source: These last few days have been-- these last few months have been a living hell.
target: 这几天简直——这几个月简直就是活在人间地狱里。

source: I couldn't agree more.
target: 我再同意不过了。

source: Are you afraid of what comes next?
target: 你害怕接下来会发生的事吗？

source: More than I've ever been.
target: 从来没这么害怕过。

source: No one is certain what the chain of command ought to be.
target: 谁也不确定该由谁掌权，又该听谁的命令。

source: I intend to take advantage of that ambiguity. It's time I sat the throne.
target: 我打算利用这种权责不明的局面。该由我登上王位了。

source: What's your plan?
target: 你有什么计划？

source: I don't have one. Not yet.
target: 我没有计划。还没有。

source: If only there were someone who could give me advice. Help me through this.
target: 要是有人能给我些建议，帮我渡过这个难关就好了。

source: I might have some ideas.
target: 我或许有些主意。

source: Where are you going? Will I see you tonight?
target: 你要去哪儿？今晚我能见到你吗？

source: Don't be afraid, Hamlet. The future belongs to you.
target: 别害怕，哈姆雷特。未来属于你。

source: Allow me to put thought to action on your behalf.
target: 让我替你把想法付诸行动吧。

source: Until we meet again.
target: 后会有期。

source: You know, Ophelia, you and I are a tree grown together under the soil. We always have been.
target: 你知道吗，奥菲莉娅，你我就像在泥土下长在一起的一棵树。我们一直如此。

source: We may come apart, but our trunks rejoin eventually. Even if it's not in love.
target: 我们或许会分开，但树干终究会再次相连。即使不再是因为爱情。

source: My feelings for you will always linger. But sensations other than affection grow stronger. Respect. Admiration.
target: 我对你的感情永远不会完全消散。但爱意之外的感情正变得更强烈。尊重。钦佩。

source: I'll find my own path. I'm sorry I pushed myself onto you once more.
target: 我会找到自己的路。抱歉，我又一次强求你接受我。

source: I need rest. But every time I close my eyes, all I can see are the bloodied faces of two men buried under the earth.
target: 我需要休息。可每次闭上眼睛，我看见的都只有两个埋在地下的男人，他们满脸是血。

source: My uncle. My father. And it all feels so empty, like the bottom's fallen out of the world.
target: 我的叔叔。我的父亲。一切都显得那么空虚，仿佛整个世界的底都塌了。

source: I feel so alone.
target: 我觉得自己好孤独。

source: The dawn will come. I promise.
target: 黎明会来的。我保证。

source: Where are you going?
target: 你要去哪儿？

source: Leaving you be for now. I've got to go.
target: 暂时让你一个人待着。我得走了。

source: I'm afraid, Ophelia.
target: 我很害怕，奥菲莉娅。

source: Now that your uncle's passed?
target: 因为你叔叔去世了？

source: Aye. No one is certain what the chain of command ought to be right now.
target: 是啊。现在谁也不确定该由谁掌权，又该听谁的命令。

source: Will I see you tonight?
target: 今晚我能见到你吗？

source: Perhaps. Don't be afraid, Hamlet. The future belongs to you.
target: 也许吧。别害怕，哈姆雷特。未来属于你。

source: Hmm. Your mother would be thrilled, I'm certain...
target: 嗯。你母亲一定会很高兴，我确信……

source: I forgive you, Hamlet.
target: 我原谅你，哈姆雷特。

source: But I cannot love you the way you've loved me.
target: 但我无法像你爱我那样爱你。

source: I ah... oh.
target: 我，啊……哦。

source: I'll be the first to admit it, though. I am well and truly afraid.
target: 不过，我愿意坦白承认。我确实很害怕。

source: I intend to take advantage of that ambiguity and extinguish my fear, though. It's time I sat the throne.
target: 不过，我打算利用这种权责不明的局面，消除自己的恐惧。该由我登上王位了。

source: Everything all right?
target: 还好吗？

source: It's as if nothing's changed.
target: 好像什么都没变。

source: He's dead. And all moves on without him.
target: 他死了。可没有他，一切仍然照常继续。

source: Though surely, I know my mother grieves him.
target: 不过，我知道，母亲当然在为他悲伤。

source: How quickly the loss of a King and Queen is recoverable.
target: 失去国王和王后，竟然这么快就能恢复如常。

source: Perhaps... the moment after one's King has been taken is a quiet one.
target: 也许……国王被吃掉后的那一刻，就是如此安静。

source: The game is over, and must be started anew.
target: 棋局结束了，必须重新开始。

source: And now I line myself up on the edge of the board, ready to fight in his stead.
target: 而现在，我把自己摆在棋盘边缘，准备代替他迎战。

source: This should be a moment of triumph for you.
target: 这本该是你胜利的时刻。

source: This is what your father wanted, isn't it?
target: 这正是你父亲想要的，不是吗？

source: You've eliminated the fox from your hen-house. Murder has been answered with its own kind.
target: 你除掉了鸡舍里的狐狸。以谋杀偿还了谋杀。

source: Come, now! Isn't that cause for celebration?
target: 来，振作点！这难道不值得庆祝吗？

source: My father is still dead.
target: 我的父亲依然死了。

source: I thought Claudius's death would make it all feel right. But it doesn't. It's exactly the same, and now somehow worse.
target: 我以为克劳狄斯死了，一切就会好起来。可并没有。一切都和从前一样，如今却不知为何更糟了。

source: I never wanted to be King.
target: 我从来没想过当国王。

source: And I'm going to fail them all. How long will it take them to realize what an idiot I am, if they haven't yet?
target: 我会辜负他们所有人。如果他们还没看出来，要多久才会发现我是个多么愚蠢的人？

source: How useless I am—no less a pretender than my uncle—
target: 我有多么无能——和我叔叔一样，根本不配坐上王位——

source: Hamlet. Look at me.
target: 哈姆雷特。看着我。

source: Chin up.
target: 抬起头来。

source: That's a good lad. Now—deep breath.
target: 这才对，好孩子。现在——深呼吸。

source: A big one.
target: 深深吸一口气。

source: There. I see a little color in your cheeks.
target: 好了。你的脸颊有点血色了。

source: Feeling any better?
target: 感觉好些了吗？

source: ...I don't deserve you, really.
target: ……我真不值得你对我这么好。

source: I know. And yet, here I am.
target: 我知道。可我还是在这儿。

source: The road before you is a difficult one.
target: 你面前的路很艰难。

source: But it is one many men have trodden before you, and will tread after you are gone. You can do this. I promise it.
target: 但在你之前，已经有许多人走过这条路；在你离去后，也会有人继续走。你做得到。我保证。

source: I have everlasting faith in you, in the goodness that lies within your frail little heart.
target: 我永远相信你，相信你那颗脆弱的小小心灵里藏着的善良。

source: And if you cannot believe in your own heart, believe in my good taste, at least.
target: 如果你不能相信自己的心，至少相信我看人的眼光吧。

source: You need to face this head-on. And you shall. In a scant few days' time, when all this has passed, you will go before the nobility and ask their vote to wear the crown.
target: 你得正面迎接这一切。而你会做到的。再过短短几天，等这一切过去，你就要站到贵族们面前，请他们投票支持你戴上王冠。

source: If you can find it within you to be ready for that day... then you will make a great King.
target: 如果你能从心里做好准备，迎接那一天……那你就会成为一位伟大的国王。

source: ...My thanks.
target: ……谢谢你。

source: You're right. The time has come to put aside childish things.
target: 你说得对。是时候放下那些孩子气的东西了。

source: Never forget that I'm here.
target: 别忘了，我一直在这里。

source: And Ophelia's here, even if she likes to skulk around pretending we don't see her.
target: 奥菲莉娅也在，虽然她总喜欢躲躲藏藏，装作我们看不见她。

source: And as long as you have friends in this world, you can do just about anything.
target: 只要这世上还有你的朋友，你就几乎什么都能做到。

source: Now go about your business as usual. But keep your head turned up and your shoulders back. Act like the King you will be.
target: 现在照常去忙你的事吧。不过要抬头挺胸，拿出未来国王的样子。

source: Indeed. Indeed, I will.
target: 没错。没错，我会的。

source: Thank you both. This was... this is... exactly what I needed.
target: 谢谢你们两个。这正是……正是我需要的。

source: You know where to find me if you need me.
target: 需要我的时候，你知道去哪儿找我。

source: If there were... someone who could show me how, give me advice...
target: 要是有……有人能教我怎么做，给我些建议……

source: Ophelia. The time has come for me to make a decision.
target: 奥菲莉娅。我该做决定了。

source: How have your first days as Prince-Elect gone?
target: 成为候任王储后的头几天，你过得怎么样？

source: Quickly. Frighteningly.
target: 过得很快。快得让人害怕。

source: I'm not ready to be King.
target: 我还没准备好当国王。

source: Perhaps no one is, really.
target: 或许其实谁都没准备好。

source: My uncle was. He committed a grave sin to achieve it.
target: 我叔叔准备好了。为了当上国王，他犯下了重罪。

source: But in the end, he was no more fit than any other man.
target: 可到头来，他也不比别人更适合。

source: He reached for the crown, but could not keep it. Denmark has struggled under his rule, I'm told.
target: 他夺取了王冠，却没能保住。听说丹麦在他的统治下举步维艰。

source: The situation is worse than I thought. We have to fix things, Ophelia. It's going to be a long path forward.
target: 情况比我想的还糟。我们必须改变这一切，奥菲莉娅。前面的路还很长。

source: All that assuming the nobility will elect me to the position, of course.
target: 当然，这一切的前提是贵族们会选我登上王位。

source: You know... I realized something today.
target: 你知道吗……我今天明白了一件事。

source: As I contemplated all these decisions before me, I thought to myself—what would Ophelia say of this?
target: 思考眼前这些决定时，我不禁想——奥菲莉娅会怎么看？

source: I need you by my side if we're to bring great things to this country.
target: 如果我们要为这个国家成就一番伟业，我需要你在我身边。

source: Without you, I'm... nothing.
target: 没有你，我就……什么都不是。

source: Hamlet, I've even less experience than you do at managing affairs of state.
target: 哈姆雷特，处理国事的经验，我比你还少。

source: Yes—but you understand people. The way they think. What they love and fear most.
target: 是啊——可你懂人。懂他们怎么想，最爱什么，最怕什么。

source: And you understand how to fix people, too. You understand that healing is more powerful than destroying.
target: 你也懂得怎么治愈人。你懂得，治愈比毁灭更有力量。

source: That's something Claudius never understood. He saw power and reached for it without understanding that power obtained through fear is fragile.
target: 这是克劳狄斯从未明白的道理。他一看见权力就伸手去夺，却不懂靠恐惧得来的权力有多脆弱。

source: Then let's establish a new way.
target: 那我们就开辟一条新路吧。

source: Tell me. What have you decided? How will you rule?
target: 告诉我，你做了什么决定？你打算怎样治理国家？

source: Rosie and Guilda... told I ought to think of myself.
target: 萝茜和吉尔达……说我应该为自己考虑。

source: They want to return to Wittenberg, and for me to join them.
target: 她们想回维滕贝格，也想让我一起去。

source: Wittenberg? At a time like this?
target: 维滕贝格？在这种时候？

source: I must admit, I found something tempting in the notion.
target: 我得承认，这个想法让我有些心动。

source: Many Prince-Elects have gone abroad in a time of mourning. It would only be a short stay.
target: 很多候任王储都曾在服丧期间出国。我也只会短住一阵。

source: That's foolish. You know how foolish that would be. How can you even consider it?
target: 这太傻了。你知道这样做有多傻。你怎么还会考虑？

source: You're right. Of course you're right.
target: 你说得对。当然是你说得对。

source: Forget I even raised the subject. It was just a fleeting notion.
target: 就当我没提过吧。那只是个一闪而过的念头。

source: My first matter of concern was to understand where the biggest threat to the throne of Denmark lies.
target: 我首先关心的是，丹麦王位面临的最大威胁究竟来自哪里。

source: I know that the Danish nobility are deeply unhappy at the present moment.
target: 我知道，丹麦的贵族们现在极为不满。

source: As Claudius largely ignored them, their fealty trended towards Norway's growing power. Now they're borderline treasonous.
target: 克劳狄斯基本不理会他们，于是他们逐渐转向效忠日益强大的挪威。如今，他们已经濒临叛国。

source: As much as I would have liked to receive some advice here, I heard none.
target: 虽然我很希望在这件事上听到些建议，却一条也没听到。

source: So I shall move forward under my original instinct.
target: 所以，我会按最初的直觉行事。

source: Most people who came to speak with me offered me the advice to be forceful with the nobility.
target: 来找我谈话的人，大多建议我对贵族强硬一些。

source: My father would have handled this matter by riding out in full decorum to greet these men, reminding them of their King's presence.
target: 要是父亲来处理这件事，他会以齐全的礼仪骑马出行，亲自去见这些人，提醒他们国王的存在。

source: I intend to do the same. Perhaps once the noblemen see me in person, they shall remember that I am my father's son, not Claudius's.
target: 我打算照着做。或许贵族们亲眼见到我，就会想起我是父亲的儿子，而非克劳狄斯的儿子。

source: However, the advice I received surprised me. It became clear to me that the biggest threat is truly within my own court.
target: 不过，我收到的建议让我很意外。我终于明白，最大的威胁其实就在我自己的宫廷里。

source: I now believe the nobility can wait. My first order of business will be to provide clarity and peace here. That peace shall come soon.
target: 现在我认为，贵族的事可以先放一放。我首先要厘清这里的局面，让这里恢复安宁。这份安宁很快就会到来。

source: The second matter of concern is, predictably, understanding who will rule beside me.
target: 不出所料，第二件要考虑的事，就是谁会在我身边一同治国。

source: When the world thought me just a mad Prince it wasn't a popular topic, but once you inherit a crown, everyone looks at you like you're a piece of meat.
target: 世人还把我当成一个疯王子时，没多少人关心这个话题。可一旦你继承了王位，所有人看你的眼神就像在看一块肉。

source: For better or worse, my betrothal to Brit was timely.
target: 不管是好是坏，我和布莉特的订婚都来得很及时。

source: As Prince, I could marry for love. As King, I must wield marriage as a tool. The marriage I make can improve the world or leave things as they are.
target: 身为王子，我可以为爱结婚。身为国王，我必须把婚姻当作手段。我的婚姻可以让这个世界变得更好，也可以让一切维持原样。

source: She'll unite her family's power with mine. Things will be stable, if dreadfully dull.
target: 她会把她家族的势力与我的联合起来。局面会很稳定，尽管乏味得可怕。

source: Try to sound a mite more excited on your wedding day, at least.
target: 至少到婚礼那天，说话时尽量显得高兴一点吧。

source: When I thought about becoming King, I knew I'd have to learn to put aside the idle dreams I had before.
target: 想到自己要成为国王时，我就知道，得学着放下从前那些不切实际的梦想。

source: But I always believed I'd marry for love. Putting that dream aside will be the hardest of all.
target: 可我一直以为自己会为爱结婚。放下这个梦想，会是最难的一件事。

source: Though Brit and I won't be married now, of course, it changed the way I thought about this process.
target: 当然，现在我和布莉特不会结婚了，但这件事改变了我对婚姻的看法。

source: My wife will likely be another powerful family's daughter.
target: 我的妻子很可能会是另一个显赫家族的女儿。

source: In short, I must make a proposal.
target: 总之，我必须求婚了。

source: Being with you again has made me happier than I ever thought possible in a time like this.
target: 重新和你在一起，让我如此幸福。我从没想过，在这种时候还能有这样的幸福。

source: But something changed, Ophelia.
target: 可是有些事变了，奥菲莉娅。

source: When you asked my mother to speak with me, she was honest with me. So honest, it sent me reeling.
target: 你请母亲来跟我谈话时，她对我说了实话。那些话太直白，让我一时缓不过来。

source: My mother's advice was that my life is no longer my own. It belongs to my country. And I must use my life in service to improving my countrymen's.
target: 母亲给我的忠告是，我的人生已不再属于我自己。它属于我的国家。我必须用自己的一生，让国人的生活变得更好。

source: So as much as it goes against everything I've ever wanted, I'm choosing to follow Mother's advice.
target: 所以，尽管这违背了我一直以来的所有愿望，我还是选择听从母亲的忠告。

source: I'm going to marry Brit, uniting her powerful family with our house.
target: 我要娶布莉特，让她显赫的家族与我们家族联姻。

source: Brit was the obvious candidate. But... no longer.
target: 布莉特本是最合适的人选。可是……现在不是了。

source: My wife will likely be another Brockenhuus, or perhaps another powerful family's daughter.
target: 我的妻子很可能会是布罗肯胡斯家族的另一位女子，或是另一个显赫家族的女儿。

source: (Hmm. I ought to have known Gertrude would give him that sort of advice.)
target: （嗯。我早该知道，乔特鲁德会给他这样的建议。）

source: Do what you must. I am only sorry that our dalliance made your decision all the harder.
target: 做你必须做的事吧。我只是很抱歉，我们这段短暂的恋情让你更难做决定了。

source: Never say that. If I could choose my own fate-- it's always been you, Ophelia. You know that.
target: 别这么说。如果我能选择自己的命运——我选择的一直都是你，奥菲莉娅。你知道的。

source: I must admit I found myself dwelling on what I'd say to you now.
target: 我得承认，我一直在反复想着，现在该对你说些什么。

source: But now that we're here, the speech is failing me.
target: 可真到了这一刻，我却说不出那些话了。

source: Hmm. I have an idea.
target: 嗯。我有个主意。

source: It's a lovely night for a walk, don't you think?
target: 今晚很适合散步，你不觉得吗？

source: Would you accompany me?
target: 你愿意陪我吗？

source: Of course we'd end up here.
target: 果然，最后还是来了这里。

source: Is something wrong? We can go elsewhere, if you like.
target: 怎么了？你愿意的话，我们可以去别处。

source: No—this is fine. But Hamlet, what is it about this graveyard you find so compelling?
target: 没有——这里挺好。可是哈姆雷特，这片墓地到底有什么让你这么着迷？

source: I feel as though you've been lurking here for years. You're a permanent fixture at this point.
target: 我感觉你都在这里待了好多年了。现在简直成了这里固定的一景。

source: Truth be told, I cannot say, precisely.
target: 说实话，我也说不清。

source: Perhaps it's the solitude. The emptiness. I can rest assured no one will bother me here.
target: 也许是这里的清静。空寂。在这里，我可以放心，没人会来打扰我。

source: Or—maybe it's the certainty of death in an otherwise-uncertain world. There's something comforting in that.
target: 又或者——这世上什么都难以确定，唯有死亡是确定的。也许这让我感到些许安慰。

source: Hm. Morbid.
target: 嗯。真阴郁。

source: I prefer 'practical'.
target: 我更愿意叫它“务实”。

source: And besides, haven't you often wondered what it must be like to die?
target: 再说，你难道不常想，死去究竟是什么感觉吗？

source: To die, to sleep, perchance to dream..
target: 死去，睡去，也许还会做梦……

source: No. I don't have to wonder. I've already died. There is no dream. There is nothing at all.
target: 不。我不用猜想。我已经死过了。没有梦。什么都没有。

source: Or perhaps this is the dream, forever repeating itself—a fever dream, more like.
target: 又或许，这一切才是梦，永远不断重复——更像是高烧中的梦。

source: Yes. Perhaps this is what death is truly like, for all. And you and I are simply illusions. Ghosts.
target: 是啊。或许死亡对所有人来说，真正的样子就是这样。而你我不过是幻象。幽灵。

source: You're worrying me.
target: 你让我有些担心。

source: Don't mind me.
target: 别在意我说的。

source: Hamlet. Earlier you mentioned you'd wanted me for some time.
target: 哈姆雷特。你之前说，你想和我在一起已经有一段时间了。

source: How do you know it's not merely familiarity?
target: 你怎么知道，那不只是因为彼此熟悉？

source: How do you know this is more than the happenstance closeness we've experienced for so long?
target: 你怎么知道，这不只是我们这么多年来恰好相伴而生出的亲近感？

source: Even when we were lovers, I often thought—soon you'll grow bored, or exhausted, or irritated of me at some point.
target: 就算我们还是恋人的时候，我也常想——很快，你总会有一天觉得我无趣，或是累了，或是厌烦我。

source: My father often warned me you would.
target: 父亲经常告诫我，你会变成那样。

source: I wasn't sure before, myself.
target: 以前连我自己也不确定。

source: I didn't know until recently, in fact.
target: 其实，我也是最近才明白的。

source: When I was at Wittenberg I was surrounded by men and women in the midst of a great rebirth. Arts, culture, knowledge—it was fantastic.
target: 在维滕贝格时，我身边的男男女女都置身于一场伟大的复兴之中。艺术、文化、知识——那一切都太精彩了。

source: The world is changing around us. The future is thrilling. New ways of governing and thinking and building, all possible and within my grasp.
target: 我们身边的世界正在改变。未来令人振奋。全新的治理方式、思考方式、建造方式，都能实现，也都在我的掌握之中。

source: I attended every gala and low-brow party I was invited to. I danced and I drank and I wandered with abandon. And—
target: 凡是邀我参加的盛大宴会和粗俗聚会，我都去了。我跳舞，喝酒，放纵地四处游荡。而且——

source: I was with other women.
target: 我和别的女人在一起过。

source: I assumed you were. You don't need to flush red like that.
target: 我猜也是。你不用脸红成那样。

source: It's embarrassing to admit that to you. Because, of course, the only thing I learned was that all other women were nothing like you.
target: 向你承认这件事，实在有些难为情。因为，到头来，我唯一明白的就是，其他女人都一点也不像你。

source: But—I knew—or I thought—things had ended between us, that you would never want me near you once more.
target: 可是——我知道——或者说，我以为——我们之间已经结束了，你再也不会愿意让我靠近你。

source: And so I tried to forge new connections, find new faces to dream about. And some of them made my heart throb weakly, but none with as much passion as you.
target: 于是我试着结识新的人，寻找新的、能让我魂牵梦萦的面孔。她们中有些人让我稍稍心动，却没有谁能像你一样，让我满怀热情。

source: All I could think about, whenever I saw some new marvel or heard some magnificent lecture, was—'I wish she could hear this.'
target: 每当我看见什么新奇的事物，或听到什么精彩的讲座，我心里想的只有——“真希望她也能听到。”

source: 'I wonder what she would think.'
target: “不知道她会怎么想。”

source: Ophelia, you are everything to me. And I'm going to spend the rest of my life showing you how true that is.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你就是我的一切。我会用余生向你证明，这句话有多真。

source: Now you're making me flush.
target: 现在你倒让我脸红了。

source: There's something I need to say.
target: 有件事我必须说出来。

source: I want to ask for your hand in marriage.
target: 我想向你求婚。

source: What? Really? Now?
target: 什么？真的？现在？

source: Quite a sudden change of heart from only a week ago, don't you think?
target: 才过了一周，你的心意就变了这么多，不觉得有些突然吗？

source: You know me. You know I'm quite serious.
target: 你了解我。你知道我是认真的。

source: I don't doubt you are.
target: 这一点我不怀疑。

source: What would this mean for your—my—future?
target: 这对你的——我的——未来意味着什么？

source: We'll uncover that much together.
target: 我们会一起找到答案。

source: For now, all that matters is that you're the one helping me make these decisions.
target: 眼下，只要是你在帮我做这些决定，就够了。

source: There's no one else whose mind I trust more implicitly, no one I've known half so deeply.
target: 没有谁的判断能让我如此全心信任，也没有谁能让我了解得有你的一半那么深。

source: ...And something else has weighed heavily upon me.
target: ……还有一件事，一直沉沉地压在我心上。

source: You recall that altercation on the boat, with Lady Guildenstern.
target: 你还记得船上与吉尔登斯吞女士发生的那场争执吧。

source: When I was on board our ship to England... Lady Guildenstern took me aside.
target: 当时，我在我们前往英格兰的船上……吉尔登斯吞女士把我叫到了一旁。

source: I cannot promise that the world will always be kind to you if you stand at my side.
target: 如果你站在我身边，我不能保证这个世界会始终善待你。

source: I understand there are forces at work beyond both of our control. The world is a hateful place.
target: 我明白，有些力量在起作用，你我都无法控制。这个世界充满了仇恨。

source: But I have to believe there's a way we can work to root out that vileness wherever it lives.
target: 但我必须相信，无论那种卑劣藏在哪里，我们总有办法努力将它根除。

source: Both in the world, and in me.
target: 无论是在这世上，还是在我心里。

source: My time on the throne will be markedly different from the men before me. There will be no more calls for blood or shows of force.
target: 我的统治将与前代那些国王截然不同。不会再有嗜血的呼声，也不会再有武力的炫耀。

source: The era for that has passed.
target: 那个时代已经过去了。

source: Will you become the future Queen of Denmark?
target: 你愿意成为丹麦未来的王后吗？

source: Agree to marry Hamlet?
target: 答应嫁给哈姆雷特？

source: I cannot deny you would have been my first choice. But in all these days, you've said not a thing.
target: 我不能否认，你本会是我的第一选择。可这些天来，你一句话也没说。

source: I will.
target: 我愿意。

source: Oh... ha. My heart's fluttering as fast as a rat's. I can hardly breathe.
target: 哦……哈。我的心跳得像老鼠的心一样快。我都快喘不过气了。

source: Your face is so pale. You look absolutely frightened.
target: 你的脸好苍白。看起来简直吓坏了。

source: You do terrify me thoroughly. Er, I mean that in the nicest possible way.
target: 你确实让我怕得不得了。呃，我是说，这是好话，绝对是好话。

source: No offense taken.
target: 我没介意。

source: And I wasn't sure you would say yes.
target: 而且我也不确定你会答应。

source: Neither was I, truly. But I want to see where this path leads with you.
target: 说真的，我自己也不确定。但我想和你一起看看，这条路会通向哪里。

source: I think you'll make a wonderful king, in time.
target: 我想，假以时日，你会成为一位出色的国王。

source: I don't think I can properly convey how much I've missed you.
target: 我想，我没法用言语说清自己有多想你。

source: Even as I'm terrified I'll hurt you.
target: 尽管我也很怕自己会伤害你。

source: Then don't hurt me. It's not complicated.
target: 那就别伤害我。这并不复杂。

source: Heh. When did you get so bold?
target: 呵。你什么时候变得这么大胆了？

source: I've changed. My life has been strange lately. Let's leave it at that.
target: 我变了。最近我的生活很古怪。就说到这里吧。

source: I... I can't remember the last time I felt this happy.
target: 我……我已经不记得，上次这么开心是什么时候了。

source: All that's left is to tell the others.
target: 接下来只要告诉其他人就好了。

source: I'll arrange a meeting soon. We ought to notify them as soon as we can.
target: 我会尽快安排见面。我们应该尽早通知他们。

source: Good. Let's not wait a moment longer than we have to.
target: 好。能早一刻就别多等一刻。

source: (Even if this world can only last a little longer...)
target: （即使这个世界只能再维持一小会儿……）

source: (For now I can pretend, at least. Can't I?)
target: （至少现在，我还可以假装。不是吗？）

source: (Surely I haven't lost every ability to feel.)
target: （我总不至于已经完全失去感受的能力了吧。）

source: I don't think I can, Hamlet.
target: 我想我做不到，哈姆雷特。

source: So when you said you... wanted to begin things again, did you... mean it?
target: 所以，你说你……想重新开始的时候，你……是真心的吗？

source: I did then. But that's all it was.
target: 当时是真心的。但也仅限于当时。

source: I gave you the push you needed to become king. And you will. You'll be magnificent.
target: 我推了你一把，让你能成为国王。你会当上国王的。你会非常出色。

source: You'll be the best King Denmark has ever had. I believe that with all my soul.
target: 你会是丹麦有史以来最好的国王。我打心底里相信这一点。

source: But I don't know if I can give you the rest of my life. I'm not ready to do that much.
target: 但我不知道自己能不能把余生交给你。我还没准备好走到那一步。

source: Right, then.
target: 那好吧。

source: I hope you won't mind if I pick up my bruised pride and leave you be.
target: 我想收拾一下受伤的自尊，就不打扰你了。希望你别介意。

source: I believe you. And so am I. But I need to be alone now.
target: 我相信你。我也一样。但我现在需要一个人待着。

source: Farewell, Ophelia.
target: 再见，奥菲莉娅。

source: (This world can only last a little longer...)
target: （这个世界只能再维持一小会儿……）

source: (The fewer feelings I have, the more effective I'll be.)
target: （感情越少，我做事就越有效。）

source: (Solving my way out of the loop is all that matters now.)
target: （现在唯一重要的，就是找到摆脱循环的办法。）

source: Laertes? What is it?
target: 雷欧提斯？怎么了？

source: Come with me. Quickly.
target: 跟我来。快。

source: Laertes? What is all of this?
target: 雷欧提斯？这到底是怎么回事？

source: Thank you all for gathering here tonight.
target: 感谢各位今晚来到这里。

source: ...All of you are faithful to your respective lords.
target: ……各位都忠于自己侍奉的领主。

source: But I have a new request of you.
target: 但我有一个新的请求，要请各位帮忙。

source: Of course, I wouldn't call you unless I had a desperate message for the men you serve.
target: 当然，若不是有万分紧迫的话要传给各位侍奉的人，我也不会召集各位。

source: ...Soon, all of them will be called to elect the next King of Denmark.
target: ……很快，他们就会全体受召，选出丹麦的下一任国王。

source: My request is simple. I beseech them not to elect Hamlet, no matter what transpires.
target: 我的请求很简单。我恳求他们，无论发生什么，都不要选哈姆雷特。

source: Although Hamlet may be his father's son, I urge you to consider the cost this family has had upon our nation.
target: 哈姆雷特固然是他父亲的儿子，但我恳请各位想想，这个家族让我们的国家付出了怎样的代价。

source: Bloodiness begets bloodiness. Death begets death.
target: 血腥滋生血腥。死亡滋生死亡。

source: Shall we wager our country upon the fruit newly borne off that poisoned tree?
target: 我们要把国家的命运，押在那棵毒树新结出的果实上吗？

source: Or shall we rise up and declare a new, prosperous direction of our own making?
target: 还是要挺身而出，宣告由我们自己开辟一条通往繁荣的新路？

source: A most welcome return and a good evening, Laertes.
target: 热烈欢迎你归来，雷欧提斯。晚上好。

source: ...And to you, Ophelia.
target: ……你也晚上好，奥菲莉娅。

source: He found us? How?
target: 他找到我们了？怎么找到的？

source: Hamlet, what's this about?
target: 哈姆雷特，这是怎么回事？

source: I could ask you the same, couldn't I?
target: 我也可以这么问你，不是吗？

source: All this, after you professed to love me.
target: 你口口声声说爱我，之后却有了这一切。

source: Of course, I would be a fool to make you choose between me and your family, or to suggest your loyalty was tied to me alone.
target: 当然，要是让你在我和家人之间做选择，或者说你只能忠于我一个人，那我就是个傻瓜。

source: Look before you. Your brother was rallying my own people against me.
target: 看看你眼前吧。你哥哥刚才在煽动我的人反对我。

source: All this because, of course, he desires to sit the throne himself.
target: 他做这一切，当然是因为他自己想坐上王位。

source: I received some thoughtful advice at your behest, Ophelia, warning me that such a thing might come to pass.
target: 奥菲莉娅，多亏你的安排，我得到了一番周到的建议，提醒我可能会发生这样的事。

source: Laertes, I cannot suffer one I do not trust at my court.
target: 雷欧提斯，我不能容忍一个我不信任的人留在我的宫廷。

source: I know you'd come after me, sooner or later.
target: 我知道你迟早会来对付我。

source: Even with all our efforts to make amends, you made it clear you believed me an unworthy king.
target: 即使我们竭力修复关系，你还是明确表示，你认为我不配做国王。

source: And just like his uncle, he means to have me killed, I'm certain.
target: 而且，他和他叔叔一样，打算让人杀了我。我确信如此。

source: Spirit me off into the night as though I was never here.
target: 把我悄悄带走，消失在夜色里，就像我从未来过。

source: Denmark will be different this time. I am not a man who desires that blood be spilled.
target: 这一次，丹麦会不一样。我不是一个渴望流血的人。

source: I need you gone. Not dead. That would have been my uncle's way.
target: 我要你离开。不是要你死。那是我叔叔的做法。

source: So here is what I offer: banishment. Leave Denmark, never return, and never write to your sister again.
target: 所以，我给你的选择是：放逐。离开丹麦，永远不要回来，也永远不许再给你妹妹写信。

source: I will leave you in peace as long as we both live. But, should you return...
target: 只要我们都还活着，我就不会打扰你。但如果你回来……

source: I'll have you quartered before the entire court.
target: 我会让人当着整个宫廷的面，把你肢解成四块。

source: Never speak to Ophelia again?
target: 永远不能再和奥菲莉娅说话？

source: Leave everything in Elsinore behind? ...Would that you'd merely killed me.
target: 把在埃尔西诺的一切都抛下？……我宁愿你直接杀了我。

source: This is the end of my life.
target: 我的人生就此结束了。

source: How can I be certain you'd keep my father safe?
target: 我怎么能确定你会保证我父亲的安全？

source: I shan't. Your father will go with you.
target: 我不会。你父亲会跟你一起走。

source: The both of you shall remain in exile until your dying breath.
target: 你们两个都将被终身放逐，直到咽下最后一口气。

source: And what of my sister?
target: 那我妹妹呢？

source: I love Ophelia more fiercely than anyone in this world.
target: 我对奥菲莉娅的爱，比这世上任何人都要强烈。

source: I would rather die than allow her to suffer.
target: 我宁愿死，也不愿让她受苦。

source: I care deeply that no harm comes to Ophelia. More deeply, apparently, than you do.
target: 我非常在意奥菲莉娅会不会受到伤害。显然，比你还要在意。

source: That's why once you've gone, you must not contact her.
target: 所以，你一旦离开，就不许再联系她。

source: If you maintain a correspondence, she'll only want to join you all the more. And that will never come to pass.
target: 如果你们保持通信，她只会更想去找你。而那永远不会发生。

source: And I need her here, with me, on the throne, with her mind fully focused on ruling our country.
target: 而我需要她留在这里，和我一同坐在王位上，一心一意治理我们的国家。

source: Her advice is invaluable. She's going to be twice the advisor your father ever was.
target: 她的建议无比珍贵。作为顾问，她会比你父亲出色一倍。

source: What? Hamlet, surely that cannot be necessary.
target: 什么？哈姆雷特，真的没必要这样吧。

source: I'm sparing his life. That's generosity enough.
target: 我饶了他的命。这已经够宽宏大量了。

source: Your father's old estate awaits you on the borderlands to the south. The estate is barren, but the land is fertile and warm in the winters.
target: 你父亲在南部边境的旧庄园正等着你。庄园虽然荒废了，但土地肥沃，冬天也很暖和。

source: You will be well cared for—but you will not be permitted to leave that estate, nor have correspondence with anyone outside its walls.
target: 你会得到妥善照料——但不许离开那座庄园，也不许和围墙外的任何人通信。

source: And you must be gone before dawn.
target: 而且，你必须在天亮之前离开。

source: Make haste, Laertes.
target: 动作快点，雷欧提斯。

source: I failed you. I'm sorry.
target: 我辜负了你。对不起。

source: Hamlet, there must be another way. Isn't there any way you can be convinced?
target: 哈姆雷特，一定还有别的办法。难道就没有任何办法能说服你吗？

source: ...Not this time.
target: ……这次没有。

source: Men, escort him to his chambers, and there ensure he takes all that is his.
target: 来人，护送他回房，确保他带走所有属于他的东西。

source: And Lord Polonius as well. He must be gone the very same moment his son departs.
target: 波洛涅斯大人也一样。他必须和他儿子同时离开。

source: This is how things end in this world?
target: 这个世界的结局，就是这样吗？

source: It's the same, every time.
target: 每一次，都是一样的。

source: That's the herald's horn. It's... likely Hamlet calling me to make an announcement.
target: 那是传令官的号角。大概是……哈姆雷特叫我过去，要宣布什么事。

source: Friends, family, a word, if I may.
target: 各位亲友，请容我说几句话。

source: Some of you have offered invaluable advice to me over the last few days.
target: 过去几天，你们之中有些人给了我极其宝贵的建议。

source: For your assistance, I hold you dearly in my hearts, and highly in my regard.
target: 承蒙各位相助，我由衷珍视各位，也对各位深怀敬意。

source: Some of the best advice I received was of matters concerning the heart.
target: 我得到的一些最好的建议，是关于感情的。

source: I... love Ophelia. I've loved her since we were children.
target: 我……爱奥菲莉娅。从我们还是孩子的时候起，我就一直爱着她。

source: And now she has agreed to take my hand and become my wife. And someday, your Queen.
target: 如今，她已答应与我携手，成为我的妻子。将来，也会成为各位的王后。

source: T-that's... wonderful news, Hamlet.
target: 这、这真是……好消息，哈姆雷特。

source: Aye! Congrats, to the both o' you!
target: 是啊！恭喜你们两个！

source: I never thought I'd see the day a woman agreed to marry you of her own free will. But...
target: 我从没想过，有生之年竟能看到一个女人自愿嫁给你。不过……

source: If anyone can handle the likes of you, it must be her.
target: 要是有谁能应付你这种人，那一定就是她了。

source: So they managed to reconcile after all.
target: 看来他们终究还是和好了。

source: I suppose that's for the best.
target: 我想，这样最好。

source: Are you all right, my dear?
target: 你还好吗，亲爱的？

source: Y-yes, fine—
target: 嗯、嗯，没事——

source: (I can already feel something pulling me. This world won't last.)
target: （我已经能感觉到有什么在拉扯我。这个世界维持不了多久了。）

source: (It seems as though when things become quiet... the timeline comes to an end.)
target: （似乎每当一切平静下来……这条时间线就会走到尽头。）

source: Everyone, we'll prepare a magnificent ceremony for seven days hence. And when we are wed...
target: 各位，我们会筹备一场盛大的仪式，于七天后举行。等我们成婚……

source: Peace will finally come to Denmark. Now, and forevermore.
target: 和平终于会降临丹麦。从此刻起，直到永远。

source: (Oh, no. Here it comes.)
target: （啊，不。来了。）

source: (But I can return here—if I need to.)
target: （但我可以回到这里——如果有必要的话。）

source: (I could use the Book of Fates to choose this world forever.)
target: （我可以用命运之书，选择永远留在这个世界。）

source: Forced back to the past.
target: 被迫回到过去。

source: My lord, I heard you were seeking advice. Is that so?
target: 殿下，我听说您正在征求建议。是这样吗？

source: I am. What can you tell me of ruling, Bernardo?
target: 是的。关于治国，你有什么建议，贝尔纳多？

source: You've proven yourself to be a great strategic commander.
target: 你已经证明了自己是一位出色的战略指挥官。

source: I'm sure that sort of skill will become useful in the near future.
target: 我相信，这样的才能不久就会派上用场。

source: Hmm. If there's one thing I've learned through my time in this position...
target: 嗯。要说我在这个职位上学到了什么……

source: It's that one must never show weakness or vulnerability.
target: 那就是绝不能显露软弱，也不能让人看到自己的弱点。

source: My father taught me that, and he was the strongest man I knew—outside of your own father, of course.
target: 这是我父亲教我的。他是我所认识的人中最坚强的——当然，您的父亲除外。

source: Presently, the Danish nobility has demonstrated quite a threat to your rule.
target: 如今，丹麦贵族已经对您的统治构成了相当大的威胁。

source: With rumors of spies, wartime treason, and other efforts underfoot... it's time they were quieted once more.
target: 关于间谍、战时叛国以及其他暗中行动的传闻不断……是时候再次让他们安分下来了。

source: Only a show of force will make them acknowledge the true legitimacy of the throne.
target: 只有展示武力，才能让他们承认王位真正的合法性。

source: But don't the nobility possess a greater standing army than ours? What if they go to war with us?
target: 可贵族们的常备军不是比我们的更多吗？要是他们向我们开战呢？

source: Then we shall fight them, and show them we aren't afraid.
target: 那我们就迎战，让他们知道我们并不害怕。

source: (That's terrible advice. I expected better of Bernardo.)
target: （这建议太糟糕了。我以为贝尔纳多会更明智些。）

source: (If Brit's family is working with Fortinbras against us, then we've no hope of beating the nobles.)
target: （如果布莉特的家族正与福丁布拉斯联手对付我们，那我们就毫无希望击败贵族们。）

source: (I wonder if there's anyone who can encourage Hamlet to form an alliance instead...)
target: （不知道有没有谁能劝哈姆雷特改为结盟……）

source: Well, well. Looking for kingly advice, are we?
target: 哎呀，哎呀。想请教为君之道，是吗？

source: For the moment, yes.
target: 目前是的。

source: I've spent my whole life listening to my father's machinations through the walls.
target: 我这一辈子，没少隔着墙听父亲谋划那些阴谋。

source: I'm a wealth of advice. Just ask me!
target: 我有一肚子的建议。尽管问我！

source: I know the nobility is... unhappy with the Danish throne. What do you believe I should do to make amends?
target: 我知道贵族们对丹麦王室……很不满。你觉得我该怎么做，才能修复关系？

source: Well, you've definitely got no hope of overpowering them. And they won't be thrilled that you've decided to take your uncle's place.
target: 嗯，你肯定没希望靠武力压倒他们。而你决定接替你叔叔的位置，他们也不会高兴。

source: As you obviously know, the Danish throne is elected, not ascended. And after two failed candidates from your lineage... well, it might be time for a change!
target: 你当然知道，丹麦的王位是选出来的，不是继承来的。你的家族已经有两位人选令大家失望了……嗯，也许是时候换一换了！

source: But. Hmmm.
But what?
target: 不过什么？

source: An alliance. It's the only way.
target: 结盟。这是唯一的办法。

source: Start listening to the nobility, including my father. Ask them what they need, and promise to help them achieve it.
target: 开始听听贵族们的意见吧，包括我父亲。问问他们需要什么，再承诺帮他们实现。

source: Most of them simply want their coffers full of gold. If you can make that happen, all this nonsense with Fortinbras will blow over.
target: 他们大多数人只是想让自己的金库装满黄金。只要你能做到，和福丁布拉斯有关的这些破事就会平息。

source: My father and Claudius always had an uneasy relationship with your father and his ilk.
target: 我父亲和克劳狄斯与令尊及他那一类人，关系一直不太融洽。

source: But I am not like them.
target: 但我和他们不一样。

source: That's a good thing. Just be smart about it.
target: 这是件好事。只是处理起来要聪明些。

source: And be forewarned that if you start to speak with the nobility, you may need to watch for disloyalty within Elsinore.
target: 还有，先提醒你一句：如果你开始与贵族们交谈，就可能需要提防埃尔西诺内部的不忠。

source: After all, some of these courtesans have made their careers trying to keep the nobility stamped down for decades. They'll be rightfully upset if you make nice.
target: 毕竟，这些宫廷人物中，有些人几十年来都是靠打压贵族立足的。你要是和贵族交好，他们自然会不高兴。

source: You've given me much food for thought. Thanks, Lady Brit.
target: 你给了我许多值得深思的建议。谢谢，布莉特女士。

source: My prince. I heard you were looking for advice.
target: 王子殿下。我听说你在征求建议。

source: O-oh. Irma. I hadn't expected... Well... very well. What would you like to tell me?
target: 哦、哦。伊尔玛。我没想到……嗯……好吧。你想对我说什么？

source: You may not recognize my wisdom or respect my age, but Ophelia is a smart lass. She knows better.
target: 你也许不认可我的智慧，也不敬重我的年纪，但奥菲莉娅是个聪明姑娘。她比你懂得多。

source: Tell me, Prince. Do you know what my life was before I became your mother's faithful servant?
target: 告诉我，王子。在成为你母亲的忠仆之前，我过着怎样的生活，你知道吗？

source: I cannot say I do, nor that it has ever crossed my mind.
target: 我并不知道，也从来没想过这件事。

source: They called me Lady Asmodeus, after the demon who mans the baccarat tables at Satan's side.
target: 他们叫我阿斯摩蒂尔斯女士，取的是那个在撒旦身边掌管百家乐赌桌的恶魔的名字。

source: My gambling-house was the largest in the city, with hundreds of fine men and women passing through my doors each night.
target: 我的赌场是城里最大的，每晚都有数百位体面的男女登门。

source: Many of them came to cast dice, play cards, or drink without the watchful eye of their loved ones over them!
target: 他们很多人来这里掷骰子、打牌，或是喝酒，图的就是不用被亲近的人盯着！

source: I was feared and loathed by every guard in town. And yet, they did nothing to stop me. Do you know why?
target: 城里的每个守卫都怕我，也都厌恶我。可他们却从没阻止我。你知道为什么吗？

source: I'll bite. Why didn't they stop you?
target: 那我就问问吧。他们为什么没阻止你？

source: Because they needed me more than I needed to operate in their city. And because I was a professional.
target: 因为比起我需要在他们的城里经营，他们更需要我。也因为我是个行家。

source: One can get away with horrible deeds and distasteful behavior if one offers a... necessary service in a clear-cut way.
target: 只要把一项……不可或缺的服务提供得明明白白，即使做了恶事、行为惹人厌，也能安然无事。

source: Someone must always pour the cheap drink and deal the cards, no matter how loud the priests cry about its sinful nature.
target: 不管神父们如何高声谴责这是罪恶，总得有人倒便宜酒、发纸牌。

source: If they were to chase me out of town, then what? Some other man or woman would surely come along and do the same!
target: 要是他们把我赶出城，又能怎样？肯定会有另一个男人或女人来做同样的事！

source: Better they come to sit at my table, knowing full well where to find me and what my services were.
target: 倒不如让他们来坐我的赌桌，清楚地知道去哪里找我，也知道我提供什么服务。

source: So must you be with the nobility of Denmark. They both hate and fear the reach offered by the throne.
target: 你对丹麦贵族也得如此。他们对王位赋予的权势既憎恨，又畏惧。

source: If you can show them you are sweet if beloved, but vile if spurned, they will avail themselves of you... and see no need to replace you.
target: 如果你能让他们看到，拥戴你时你便和善，拒斥你时你便凶狠，他们就会借助你……也就觉得没必要换掉你了。

source: It is a delicate balance of power. And there are some within Elsinore who would prefer to tip the whole scale.
target: 权力之间的平衡十分微妙。而埃尔西诺有些人却宁愿把整个天平都掀翻。

source: Yes, I suspect that there will be those within Elsinore who are your true enemies. They will make their faces known to you soon.
target: 是的，我怀疑你真正的敌人会是埃尔西诺内部的某些人。他们很快就会在你面前露出真面目。

source: Women understand subtlety and statesmanship. Men understand only how to rule by force and fear. Do not let fools in Elsinore run your country.
target: 女人懂得分寸和治国之道。男人只知道靠武力和恐惧统治。别让埃尔西诺的蠢货掌管你的国家。

source: I see. Fascinating.
target: 明白了。真有意思。

source: Irma, I'm sorry I have kept you at arm's length these years. It's clear I have much to learn from you.
target: 伊尔玛，很抱歉这些年来一直疏远你。看来我还有很多东西要向你学习。

source: I'm sure I will be coming to you for advice in the future as well.
target: 以后我一定还会来向你请教。

source: Good luck. May you be twice the man your uncle was.
target: 祝你好运。愿你比你叔叔出色一倍。

source: Heard you were looking for encouragement, so I came to find you.
target: 听说你想找人给你打打气，我就来找你了。

source: You more than anyone else, my friend.
target: 朋友，我最想听的就是你的鼓励。

source: What advice do you have for me?
target: 你有什么建议给我？

source: More warnings than wisdoms, unfortunately.
target: 可惜，比起良策，我更多的是警告。

source: I fought beside your father when he went to war. I saw the way he rallied the Danish nobility to his cause.
target: 你父亲出征时，我曾与他并肩作战。我亲眼见过他如何让丹麦贵族团结在他麾下。

source: And... then... I witnessed your uncle cast them aside, leaving them angry and unsettled. He pretended they didn't exist.
target: 而……后来……我目睹你叔叔把他们抛到一边，弄得他们愤怒不安。他装作他们根本不存在。

source: Currently, a great deal of them are quite angry. At you. And it will fall to your shoulders to settle their hearts.
target: 如今，他们中有很多人都很愤怒。愤怒的对象是你。安抚他们的责任会落到你肩上。

source: Do you think you're up to the task?
target: 你觉得自己能担起这个重任吗？

source: I... don't know. I think so.
target: 我……不知道。我想能吧。

source: It feels like I've inherited a court full of men who hate and fear me.
target: 我感觉自己接手的这个朝廷，满是既恨我又怕我的人。

source: Perhaps if you can assuage the enemies outside your court, you can deal with the ones within.
target: 也许你安抚了朝廷之外的敌人，就能腾出手来对付里面的敌人。

source: Enemies within? Who do you mean?
target: 里面的敌人？你指谁？

source: You know well enough who I mean. Who has treated you with stable revulsion for years? Who has claim to the throne?
target: 你很清楚我指的是谁。这么多年来，是谁始终厌恶你？又是谁有权继承王位？

source: Aye. And he'll not be thrilled to hear you've taken your uncle's seat.
target: 对。听说你坐上了你叔叔的王位，他可不会高兴。

source: Are you saying I... must... be rid of him?
target: 你是说我……必须……除掉他？

source: He's Ophelia's brother. Though I bear him no great love, it would tear her apart to lose him.
target: 他是奥菲莉娅的哥哥。我虽然对他没多少好感，可失去他会让她痛不欲生。

source: Being a King involves making hard decisions. Decisions you know may hurt the ones you love.
target: 做国王就得做出艰难的决定。明知可能伤害自己所爱的人，也得做。

source: Laertes is a decision you must make.
target: 如何处置雷欧提斯，是你必须做出的决定。

source: Were I in your place, he'd be gone by nightfall.
target: 换作是我，他活不过天黑。

source: You've given me much to consider. Thanks, friend, as always.
target: 你的话让我有很多事要考虑。朋友，还是像往常一样，谢谢你。

source: Love, I heard you were looking for advice.
target: 亲爱的，听说你在找人给你出主意。

source: I was.
target: 刚才是在找。

source: Hamlet. I know you still hold me in revulsion.
target: 哈姆雷特。我知道你仍然厌恶我。

source: And I cannot change that, nor can I soften your heart.
target: 我改变不了这一点，也无法让你心软。

source: Actually, Mother, I believe I owe you an apology.
target: 其实，母亲，我想我欠你一个道歉。

source: I have been devastatingly cruel to you, I'm afraid.
target: 恐怕我对你太过残忍，让你受了很深的伤害。

source: I've treated you in ways no son should treat his mother.
target: 没有哪个儿子应该像我这样对待自己的母亲。

source: You are Denmark's Dowager-Queen. For now, we rule together. Mother and son.
target: 你是丹麦的王太后。眼下，我们共同执政。母亲和儿子。

source: You don't know how long I've desperately wanted to hear you say that.
target: 你不知道，我盼着听你说这句话，盼了多久。

source: My child. My little love. I'm so sorry. Everything that's transpired...
target: 我的孩子。我的小宝贝。我真的很抱歉。发生的这一切……

source: Some moments I think the events of the last few months have all been one terrible dream.
target: 有时候，我觉得过去几个月发生的一切，都只是一场噩梦。

source: Then think of them that way. I certainly do.
