target: 那就把它们当作一场梦吧。我就是这么想的。

source: Oh. You wanted advice. Please excuse me.
target: 哦。你是来听建议的。请原谅。

source: You have already acted on the best advice I might give-- to marry well, and quickly.
target: 我能给你的最好建议，你已经照着做了——选一门好婚事，尽快成婚。

source: I know it can't have been easy, but your union with Lady Brit will prove a strong one for Denmark.
target: 我知道这绝非易事，但你与布莉特女士的婚姻，会成为丹麦的一股强大助力。

source: Then what a simple matter it is to receive such advice.
target: 那接受这条建议可真是轻而易举。

source: Look at you. Your whole demeanor has changed. There's something new in you.
target: 看看你。你整个人的举止都变了。你身上多了一些新的东西。

source: And something familiar. Something beloved.
target: 也有些熟悉的东西。是我深爱的东西。

source: You are going to make a fine King.
target: 你会成为一位好国王。

source: I saw you escorting Ophelia to your chambers.
target: 我看见你陪奥菲莉娅去了你的寝室。

source: Ah. Mother.
target: 啊。母亲。

source: If there is one good word I can give to you, it is to marry well, and marry carefully.
target: 如果我能给你一句忠告，那就是选一门好婚事，而且要慎重。

source: The nobles will call a vote to determine whether you may truly be their King when you take the throne.
target: 你登上王位时，贵族们会发起投票，决定你是否真能成为他们的国王。

source: At that time, if they dislike you, it will come to war, or worse. You will be ousted, and all of us will be forced from Elsinore.
target: 到时候，若他们不喜欢你，就会爆发战争，甚至有更糟的后果。你会被赶下王位，我们所有人都会被迫离开埃尔西诺。

source: But if you can select a suitable marriage which appeases the nobility, then such a crisis could be avoided.
target: 但如果你能选择一门合适的婚事，让贵族们满意，这样的危机就有可能避免。

source: Luckily, there is one obvious candidate here at court for that very reason. I had hoped to make peace between all parties.
target: 幸运的是，单从这一点来看，宫廷里就有一位再明显不过的人选。我原本希望能让各方和睦相处。

source: You mean Brit?
target: 你是说布莉特？

source: If you were to marry Brit, it would be an alliance between Denmark's crown and her nobility.
target: 如果你娶了布莉特，丹麦王室就能与本国贵族结盟。

source: We had hoped to make such a match with Lady Brit, of course. But no longer. Still--
target: 我们原本当然希望你能与布莉特女士结成这样的姻缘。但现在不再有这个打算了。不过——

source: If you were to marry the daughter of a Danish noble house, it would be an alliance between Denmark's crown and her nobility.
target: 如果你娶了一位丹麦贵族家的女儿，丹麦王室就能与本国贵族结盟。

source: And all would be at peace.
target: 这样各方就都能和睦相处。

source: But I don't think I can make that promise.
target: 但我想，我没法做出这样的承诺。

source: There's someone else.
target: 我心里有别人。

source: I know. I know you love her. But listen to me.
target: 我知道。我知道你爱她。但听我说。

source: In my long years of reign I have learned but one thing to be forever true.
target: 执政这么多年，我只明白了一个永远不变的道理。

source: We do not rule for our own desires. Our hearts must live outside us, on public display.
target: 我们执政，不是为了满足自己的欲望。我们的心必须放在身外，任众人审视。

source: If you marry Ophelia, peace will be hard won. Brit's family will see it as a rejection of the impending betrothal we had planned.
target: 如果你娶奥菲莉娅，想要和平就会很难。布莉特的家族会认为，你拒绝了我们原本安排好、即将订立的婚约。

source: And that will make your work in the future all the more difficult.
target: 那会让你今后的事务更加难办。

source: Out of love, I beg you to reconsider asking for Ophelia's hand, and to marry Brit instead.
target: 因为我爱你，所以我恳求你重新考虑向奥菲莉娅求婚的事，改娶布莉特。

source: If you marry Ophelia, peace will be hard won. The nobility will see it as a rejection of all other options.
target: 如果你娶奥菲莉娅，想要和平就会很难。贵族们会认为，你拒绝了其他所有选择。

source: I love Ophelia.
target: 我爱奥菲莉娅。

source: But I have lived selfishly a long time. I cannot live just for myself anymore. Not now.
target: 但我已经自私地活了很久。我不能再只为自己而活了。现在不能。

source: Besides, she's made it very clear that she doesn't return my feelings. I should respect that.
target: 况且，她已经说得很清楚，她对我没有同样的感情。我应该尊重她的心意。

source: Perhaps you're right. Perhaps there's truth in what you say.
target: 也许你是对的。也许你说的有道理。

source: I will think on it. I can promise that much. Thank you, Mother.
target: 我会考虑的。这一点我可以保证。谢谢你，母亲。

source: I do not say these things to cause you pain. Merely to help you be the best King you can be.
target: 我说这些不是为了让你痛苦。只是想帮你尽可能成为最好的国王。

source: I love you, Hamlet. Regardless of what I say, I know you'll make a choice all your own, and be the wiser for it.
target: 我爱你，哈姆雷特。不管我说什么，我知道你都会做出自己的选择，并从中变得更明智。

source: Hamlet! Why, we've been informed you're looking for a sage's word.
target: 哈姆雷特！哎呀，听说你正想听听智者的忠告。

source: We're the smartest people we know, so of course we wanted to help.
target: 我们是自己认识的人里最聪明的，所以当然想来帮忙。

source: Is it true that you'll be ascending to your uncle's throne?
target: 你要继承你叔叔的王位，这是真的吗？

source: Not just yet. But in the future... God willing, yes.
target: 还没到时候。但将来……若上帝允准，是的。

source: But Hamlet, you've never been the type to sit in a room all day and hand out judgements.
target: 可是哈姆雷特，你从来都不是那种能整天坐在屋里，做出各种裁决的人。

source: It does seem a little out of character.
target: 这确实有点不像你。

source: Won't you be bored? Won't you come to hate your duties as soon as you take them up?
target: 你不会觉得无聊吗？你不会刚接下那些职责，就开始厌恶它们吗？

source: What Guilda is impolitely moving towards... is... an invitation, Hamlet. To join us.
target: 吉尔达说得不太客气，其实她想说的是……是……一个邀请，哈姆雷特。邀请你和我们一起走。

source: Come back to Wittenberg with us. Let some other fool run the country!
target: 跟我们回维滕贝格吧。让别的蠢货去治理这个国家！

source: What she means is, you needn't take the crown unless you feel it would truly bring you happiness.
target: 她的意思是，除非你觉得王位真能带给你幸福，否则你不必接下王冠。

source: Entertainment is not one of my concerns. This is my country. These are my people. And with my uncle and father gone...
target: 我考虑的不是消遣。这是我的国家。这些是我的人民。而我叔叔和父亲都已经不在了……

source: Denmark's back is bare, and she is exposed to any who would drive a stake through her.
target: 丹麦毫无防备地袒露着后背，任何想用木桩刺穿她的人都能下手。

source: Hamlet, we know that in light of your uncle's death, you feel a great sense of duty to your country. That is noble-hearted.
target: 哈姆雷特，我们知道，你叔叔去世后，你对国家有了强烈的责任感。这份心意很高尚。

source: But you've been through much lately, all of it difficult and straining. It has taken a great toll on you.
target: 但你最近经历了太多事，每一件都艰难又煎熬。你已经为此付出了很大的代价。

source: If this isn't something that will make you happy, is it worth throwing your life away for?
target: 如果这件事不能让你幸福，值得为它赔上自己的一生吗？

source: Do you want to be King? Weren't you telling us just yesterday how much you wanted to sail away and never return?
target: 你想当国王吗？你昨天不是还跟我们说，你多想乘船远去，再也不回来吗？

source: All this has been so fast. What I wanted didn't factor into my thinking.
target: 这一切发生得太快了。我根本没考虑过自己想要什么。

source: Perhaps a man who has the kinds of thoughts I've had isn't the best man to rule Denmark after all.
target: 也许像我这样有过那些念头的人，终究不是治理丹麦的最佳人选。

source: Perhaps my doubts unmake me. Certainly my father never had them.
target: 也许这些疑虑让我无法胜任。我的父亲肯定从来没有过这些疑虑。

source: We just want what's best for you, Hamlet, and your happiness.
target: 我们只是希望你能得到最好的，哈姆雷特，希望你幸福。

source: We leave soon. If you care to journey with us, you're more than welcome.
target: 我们很快就要走了。你要是愿意同行，我们再欢迎不过。

source: You've given me much to think about. Thank you, Rosie, Guilda.
target: 你们的话让我有很多事要想。谢谢你们，萝茜，吉尔达。

source: (Seems like that advice wasn't useful at all. I'm not sure what I expected.)
target: （看来这些建议一点用也没有。我也不知道自己原本在期待什么。）

source: My prince! Heard yeh were lookin' for advice earlier.
target: 王子殿下！听说您先前想找人出出主意。

source: So! Yer goin' to seat the throne after all, eh?
target: 这么说！您到底还是要坐上王位了，是吧？

source: Well. As th' oldest serving guard in the castle, I've seen me a lot a' trouble in my day.
target: 嗯。城堡里还在当差的卫兵，就数我年纪最大，这辈子也见过不少乱子。

source: An' all of it stems from those blasted nobles! They're never happy. Weren't with yer father, weren't with yer uncle...
target: 全是那些该死的贵族惹出来的！他们就没个满意的时候。对您父亲不满意，对您叔叔也不满意……

source: I think it's high time we crushed 'em beneath our boots!
target: 我看早就该把他们踩在靴子底下碾碎了！

source: You'd have us go to war with them? Truly?
target: 你想让我们跟他们开战？当真？

source: They don' respond to threats, bribery, peace talks, or any other strategy... what's left?
target: 威胁、贿赂、和谈，什么法子他们都不吃……还能怎么办？

source: To hell with 'em. All of 'em. And may Denmark long rule!
target: 让他们见鬼去吧。一个不剩。愿丹麦的统治长久不衰！

source: I see. Thank you, Marcellus.
target: 明白了。谢谢你，马塞勒斯。

source: Perhaps there is no way forward with the nobility which involves peace.
target: 也许想解决贵族的问题，根本没有和平的路可走。

source: Perhaps shows of force are all they respect.
target: 也许只有展示武力，才能让他们敬畏。

source: (That's terrible advice. I expected better of Marcellus.)
target: （这建议太糟糕了。我以为马塞勒斯能说出更好的话。）

source: (If Brit's family is working with Fortinbras against us, then we've no hope of attacking our own nobility. Not that we'd even want to.)
target: （如果布莉特的家族正与福丁布拉斯联手对付我们，那我们就根本不可能攻打本国的贵族。当然，我们本来也不想那么做。）

source: (I wonder if there's anyone who can encourage Hamlet to form an alliance instead.)
target: （不知道有没有人能劝哈姆雷特改为结盟。）

source: My lord. How is your state of mind?
target: 殿下。您现在心境如何？

source: Better than it's been in a long time. What can I do for you, sir?
target: 很久没有这么好过了。先生，有什么我能为你做的吗？

source: Oh ho! It's been a long time since you addressed me with any form of title. Well, then.
target: 哦嚯！您很久没用过任何敬称来称呼我了。那好吧。

source: I've come to offer you a little advice. I'm sure other men and women can offer you better words on matters going on outside the castle.
target: 我是来给您一点建议的。关于城堡外发生的事，我相信别人能给您更好的意见。

source: The nobility is a problem you must solve. How you do so is up to you. But I come here to warn you about something more formidable.
target: 贵族是您必须解决的问题。怎么解决，由您决定。但我来这里，是要提醒您一件更棘手的事。

source: There are always going to be enemies within your own walls.
target: 您的城墙之内，永远都会有敌人。

source: Something I wish your father had known deeply was that any man can be driven by jealousy to commit foul deeds.
target: 我真希望您父亲当年能深刻明白，任何人都可能受嫉妒驱使，做出卑劣的事。

source: Rid yourself of enemies at court, and you will live harmoniously, young Prince. I promise it.
target: 年轻的王子，除掉宫廷里的敌人，您就能安稳度日。我向您保证。

source: Enemies at court? You mean here, in Elsinore?
target: 宫廷里的敌人？你是说这里，埃尔西诺？

source: Ah, but who would want me dead? I can only--
target: 啊，可谁会想要我死？我只能——

source: Y-you're right, Polonius. I can't believe I was so blind.
target: 你、你说得对，波洛涅斯。真不敢相信，我竟然这么盲目。

source: Of course there will need to be a purging when I become King.
target: 等我成为国王，当然得进行一场清洗。

source: Anyone within a King's court understands the need for privacy and safety, my lord. None will be offended.
target: 殿下，国王宫廷中的每个人都明白，隐私和安全是必需的。不会有人因此不满。

source: Just, please, don't wait. I wish every day your father were still with us. Had we been more prudent then, he might have been.
target: 只是，请您别再等了。我每天都希望您父亲还在我们身边。如果我们当时更谨慎些，他或许就还在。

source: Thank you for the advice, Polonius. I'll think on it.
target: 谢谢你的建议，波洛涅斯。我会考虑的。

source: Very well.
target: 那好。

source: Bernardo, give the ready signal. Our dispatch will ride ahead shortly.
target: 贝尔纳多，发出就绪信号。我们的传令兵很快就会骑马先行。

source: Yes, my lord. All is at attention here.
target: 是，殿下。这里所有人都已待命。

source: Marcellus, are the men in town ready to move forth?
target: 马塞勒斯，镇上的人马准备好出发了吗？

source: Aye, all that I kin see.
target: 嗯，我看得见的都准备好了。

source: Good. Then let's go.
target: 好。那就出发吧。

source: Hamlet, where are you going?
target: 哈姆雷特，你要去哪里？

source: I'm leaving to visit the countryside.
target: 我要去乡间走一趟。

source: I didn't anticipate we'd go so soon, of course.
target: 当然，我也没想到我们会这么快出发。

source: Are you sure this is wise?
target: 你确定这样做明智吗？

source: It is what's best. We intend to make a small show of force to shake the nobility.
target: 这是最好的办法。我们打算稍稍展示一下武力，震慑贵族。

source: Nothing extreme. Hamlet will be in the care of the best men I can offer him.
target: 不会做什么过激的事。我会把能派出的最好的人手安排在哈姆雷特身边保护他。

source: Marcellus and I will be staying behind to maintain security at home while Hamlet is away.
target: 哈姆雷特外出期间，马塞勒斯和我会留下来，守卫这里的安全。

source: And what if he doesn't return?
target: 那要是他回不来呢？

source: I have full faith in Bernardo on this matter.
target: 这件事上，我完全相信贝尔纳多。

source: I was given some advice I now believe in. Force is all these noblemen will listen to. I must be the one bearing the whip.
target: 有人给过我一个忠告，如今我信了。这些贵族只听得进武力。我必须成为执鞭的人。

source: I need you to trust me. All will be well, and I'll be back home soon, safe and sound. You needn't worry.
target: 我需要你相信我。一切都会好起来，我很快就会平平安安地回家。你不用担心。

source: So be it, then. I wish you the best of luck.
target: 那就这样吧。祝你一切顺利。

source: Have a little faith in me, Ophelia.
target: 对我有点信心，奥菲莉娅。

source: Thanks for arranging all of this, Bernardo.
target: 谢谢你安排这一切，贝尔纳多。

source: Of course, my lord. Anything.
target: 当然，殿下。什么都愿意效劳。

source: TEMP: this is a dummy event you shouldn't see, meant to fix an error!
target: 临时：这是一个用于修复错误的占位事件，你不应该看到它！

source: Ophelia! I'm already envisioning the grand title o' this event. I'm callin' it... the Unmakin' of a Lady.
target: 奥菲莉娅！我已经想好这件事该取个什么响亮的名头了。我管它叫……淑女的蜕变。

source: Now, defendin' yerself in the heat o' battle... that's what we should live for.
target: 在激战中保护自己……这才是我们活着该追求的事。

source: Although yer a wee mite smaller than most—we might have to settle for teachin' you to be annoying rather than dangerous.
target: 不过，你比大多数人都娇小些——恐怕得退而求其次，教你给对手添点麻烦，还谈不上让你成为多大的威胁。

source: You're going to teach me to fight?
target: 你要教我打斗？

source: Oh, no, these blades are fer cuttin' hair an' trimmin' roses.
target: 哦，不，这些刀剑是用来剪头发、修玫瑰的。

source: Yes, I'm gonna teach you how to fight!
target: 没错，我要教你怎么打斗！

source: There you go. Just take it an' feel the heft of it.
target: 给你。拿着，感受一下它的分量。

source: It's... heavier than I thought such a small blade could be.
target: 它……这么小的一把剑，居然比我想的还重。

source: Aye. They all are. Now spread yer stance wide an' bend your knees a little. Get low to the ground.
target: 是啊。都这样。现在把两脚分开站宽些，膝盖稍微弯一点。身子压低。

source: ...Er. Not that low.
target: ……呃。不用那么低。

source: Ah. Sorry.
target: 啊。抱歉。

source: Give it a go.
target: 试试看。

source: Better. See? Yer already gettin' it. And don't forget: the blade goes out.
target: 好多了。瞧，你已经上手了。还有，别忘了：剑要朝外。

source: I wagered that much.
target: 这点我猜到了。

source: Well, look at that! Yer a natural!
target: 哟，瞧瞧！你还真有天分！

source: Guess I picked up a bit from watching.
target: 看来我光看着也学会了一点。

source: Always aim for the center of yer target. Don't try an' get fancy. The easiest place you can put yer blade... take it.
target: 始终瞄准目标的正中间。别耍花招。哪里最容易刺中……就刺哪里。

source: Now, let's try a drill, shall we?
target: 现在，来做个练习，怎么样？

source: What on earth is this?
target: 这到底是在干什么？

source: The good Captain is teaching me how to hold a blade.
target: 好心的船长在教我怎么握剑。

source: A blade? Her men just slaughtered good Danish crewmen! How can you speak to her?
target: 剑？她的手下刚刚屠杀了无辜的丹麦船员！你怎么还能跟她说话？

source: Who asked yeh to come in on us, golden boy?
target: 谁让你来打扰我们的，天之骄子？

source: I killed yer crewmen because they were weak an' left their flanks undefended. If you were wise, you'd learn from me.
target: 我杀了你们的船员，是因为他们太弱，侧翼又毫无防备。你要是聪明，就该向我学学。

source: You're a murderer. There is nothing worth learning from you.
target: 你是个杀人凶手。你身上没有任何东西值得学。

source: Ophelia, I... don't understand.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我……不明白。

source: I grow tired of yer idiot antics. This ship's too god damned small. I can't wait to be rid of yeh.
target: 你那些蠢把戏我已经看腻了。这条船他妈的太小。我巴不得早点摆脱你。

source: Kill or be killed, boy. That's the way o' this world. Believe it or succumb to it. I care not.
target: 不是杀人，就是被杀，小子。这世界就是这样。你可以相信，也可以死在这规矩下。我不在乎。

source: I'll be in my quarters. That's right. My quarters.
target: 我会在我的舱房里。没错。我的舱房。

source: I'll be there all evenin' if yeh desire a further parley, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你要是还想聊聊，我整个晚上都会在那里。

source: Oh. Thank you, Grace.
target: 哦。谢谢你，格蕾丝。

source: Ah. Yeh came after all.
target: 啊。你还是来了。

source: Apologies for Hamlet's behavior earlier.
target: 哈姆雷特刚才的举动，我替他道歉。

source: Why're you apologizin' for him? He's the clod-headed rooster shit, not you!
target: 你干吗替他道歉？那个蠢得像鸡屎的混账是他，又不是你！

source: Yeh seem like you've got a good head on yer shoulders. Maybe y'can lend a hand.
target: 你看着挺有头脑。也许能帮上忙。

source: I desire to learn more about this vessel I'm now commandin'.
target: 我想多了解一下现在由我指挥的这条船。

source: Where do yeh normally make port? An' where were you headed? An'... who're those two women travelin' with the prince?
target: 你们平时在哪儿靠港？原本要去哪儿？还有……跟王子同行的那两个女人是谁？

source: We came from Elsinore, from the castle's dock. We were headed to London. Not anymore, of course. The two women are Hamlet's friends, Lady Rosencrantz and Lady Guildenstern.
target: 我们从埃尔西诺的城堡码头出发，原本要去伦敦。当然，现在不去了。那两位是哈姆雷特的朋友，罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士。

source: Ah... I've heard tell of that castle. And a few legends about th'prince's father. A great ruler and a stalwart commander, I've heard.
target: 啊……我听说过那座城堡，也听过一些关于王子父亲的传奇。据说他是位伟大的君王，也是一位坚毅的统帅。

source: That King is dead. His brother Claudius now rules. And Claudius was the one who killed him.
target: 那位国王已经死了。如今在位的是他的弟弟克劳狄斯。而杀死他的，正是克劳狄斯。

source: I see. So the Prince is bein' sent away so as not to prove a royal distraction.
target: 明白了。所以他们把王子送走，免得他给王室添麻烦。

source: Yes. Hamlet's health has been... off and on, as of late. He killed my father by mistake just last night.
target: 是的。哈姆雷特最近的健康状况……时好时坏。就在昨晚，他误杀了我父亲。

source: I—oh. Ophelia. I wish I knew somethin' kind to say. Was he a good man? Did yeh love him?
target: 我——哦。奥菲莉娅。真希望我能说些什么安慰你。他是个好人吗？你爱他吗？

source: I loved him dearly. But I have faith I'll meet him again.
target: 我很爱他。但我相信，我会再见到他的。

source: If yer God is as kind as he looks in the paintings, then surely yeh will. So... why'd you come with young Hamlet?
target: 如果你的上帝真像画上看着那样仁慈，那你一定会的。那么……你为什么跟年轻的哈姆雷特一起来？

source: Yes. Hamlet's health has been... off and on, as of late. He almost killed my father by mistake just last night.
target: 是的。哈姆雷特最近的健康状况……时好时坏。就在昨晚，他差点误杀了我父亲。

source: So... why'd you come with young Hamlet?
target: 那么……你为什么跟年轻的哈姆雷特一起来？

source: W-well, it's... complicated. Hamlet's uncle wants him dead. He sent me to ensure Hamlet's sentence was complete upon reaching England. But we're not going to England.
target: 这、这个……说来复杂。哈姆雷特的叔叔想要他死。他派我来，确保哈姆雷特抵达英格兰后被处决。但我们不会去英格兰了。

source: But you love him. Or did, once.
target: 可你爱他。或者，曾经爱过。

source: Because I've loved many a man and woman in my life, an' those eyes don't lie.
target: 因为我这辈子爱过不少男人和女人，那样的眼神骗不了人。

source: Let me guess. Dark, foreign woman at the Elsinore court. Yer not a match for th'prince's rank, an' his uncle sought to make a more strategic match. Am I right?
target: 让我猜猜。一个身处埃尔西诺宫廷的深肤色异乡女子。你的身份配不上王子，他叔叔又想给他找一门更有利的婚事。我说得对吗？

source: Something like that, yes.
target: 是的，差不多就是这样。

source: Better off without 'im, I say.
target: 依我说，没了他你反而过得更好。

source: I only ever found use in men for stealin' their fortunes. I've never been happier than in the arms o' a beautiful woman.
target: 在我看来，男人唯一的用处就是让我偷走他们的钱财。没有什么比依偎在美丽女人的怀里更让我快活了。

source: In the arms of... oh.
target: 依偎在……哦。

source: Yer face is ridiculous right now. Don' give me that look.
target: 你现在这副表情真好笑。别这么看着我。

source: Now, there's gotta be a bottle or two somewhere aroun' here... Aha!
target: 好了，这附近肯定有一两瓶酒……啊哈！

source: Anyway. Fancy a drink an' a yarn while you're here?
target: 总之。既然来了，要不要喝一杯，讲讲故事？

source: Alternatively, yeh can go down to th'bunks an' sleep with yer idiot companions.
target: 或者，你也可以下去，到铺位那儿跟你那些蠢同伴一起睡。

source: No, this is much improved.
target: 不了，这里好多了。

source: What brought you all the way to Danish waters? This hardly seems like ordinary fare for you.
target: 你怎么会一路来到丹麦海域？这似乎不像你平时会来的地方。

source: Bad winds, as always. We ne'er meant to come down this far south. Sometimes yeh don't get a choice.
target: 还是那倒霉的风。我们从没打算到这么远的南边来。有时候就是没得选。

source: But then we saw yer little vessel, an' opportunity rang.
target: 不过后来我们看见了你们这条小船，机会就来了。

source: At the time, I wondered why yer ship was poorly guarded. Nary a soldier aboard.
target: 当时我还纳闷，你们船上的守卫怎么那么薄弱。连一个士兵都没有。

source: O' course, now that yeh've told me about the King's wantin' his nephew dead, it makes sense.
target: 当然，现在你告诉我国王想要他侄子死，这就说得通了。

source: We were supposed to be t'executioners, I wager.
target: 我猜，他原本指望我们当刽子手。

source: Well, you haven't killed us yet.
target: 至少你还没杀我们。

source: When that mutiny comes t'pass tomorrow, I'll let yer friends live. No bloodshed if it ain't necessary.
target: 等明天那场叛乱发生，我会饶你朋友们一命。没必要，就不流血。

source: My thanks, Grace.
target: 谢谢你，格蕾丝。

source: What will you do with us once we're in Ireland?
target: 到了爱尔兰，你打算怎么处置我们？

source: Hmm. I find myself reconsiderin'.
target: 嗯。我现在有点想改主意了。

source: If yeh'd asked me before now, I'd have said-- I'll probably see what ransom I can get for the lot o' ye.
target: 要是你早些问，我会说——大概会看看拿你们这群人能换多少赎金。

source: Or, if no one would pay, would've left you at th'nearest brothel in Dublin.
target: 要是没人肯付钱，就把你们扔在都柏林最近的一家妓院。

source: You'd do that? You know what would happen to us.
target: 你真会这么做？你知道我们会遭遇什么。

source: I've no particular kindness fer women especially.
target: 我可不会因为是女人就格外仁慈。

source: In my position, you've got to be ruthless. The day I get soft is the day some privateer gains on us an' takes my head clean off.
target: 坐在我这个位置，就得心狠手辣。我一心软，就会有私掠船追上我们，把我的脑袋一刀砍下来。

source: I steal an' exploit everything I possibly can.
target: 凡是能偷、能利用的，我一样都不放过。

source: Figured I could get a pretty few coin for Hamlet alone. Maybe you too, dependin' on how much yer mother cares.
target: 我寻思，光哈姆雷特一个人就能换不少钱。也许你也能，就看你母亲有多在乎你了。

source: With yer father dead, I can only assume she's grievin' something fierce.
target: 你父亲死了，我想她一定悲痛万分。

source: ...My mother died a long time ago.
target: ……我母亲很久以前就去世了。

source: Ah. So yer an orphan like me.
target: 啊。那你和我一样，也是孤儿。

source: Yes. My brother, Laertes, was—is—like a second father to me, though.
target: 是的。不过，我哥哥雷欧提斯以前——现在也是——就像我的第二个父亲。

source: Has your mind changed on the subject of ransom, then?
target: 那么，关于赎金的事，你改变主意了吗？

source: Not for the others. But if gettin' home's in the cards for you, I'll see what I can do when we land in Dublin.
target: 其他人还是照旧。不过，如果你还有机会回家，等我们在都柏林上岸，我会看看能帮什么忙。

source: There'll be no need for that.
target: 不用那么做。

source: It's a long story. And you wouldn't believe me. So let us say only: I will travel on with you wherever you go.
target: 说来话长。而且你不会相信我的。所以我只说一句：不论你去哪里，我都会跟你继续走下去。

source: Have you sailed all of these waters?
target: 这些海域你都航行过吗？

source: Aye. Everything in this area, an' things outside this map's boundaries.
target: 是啊。这一带全都去过，还去过这张地图以外的地方。

source: You mean the New World?
target: 你是说新大陆？

source: Wah hah hah! Of course! An' a couple things you wouldn't find on any map, save for the truly good ones.
target: 哇哈哈！当然！还有几个地方，除非地图真的够好，否则上面根本找不到。

source: What sorts of places do you mean?
target: 你说的是什么样的地方？

source: Well. Where shall I begin? How about th'time we were washed out on a strong current an' decided to visit the frozen Snelandia...
target: 嗯，该从哪儿说起呢？不如说说那次，我们被强劲的海流冲远了，于是决定去一趟冰封的斯内兰迪亚……

source: Truly? I've heard of it, but I thought that wasn't a real place.
target: 真的？我听说过，但一直以为那地方并不存在。

source: Of course it's real! An' your people settled it!
target: 当然存在！而且是你们的人在那里定居的！

source: As I said, it all began when we were washed out on a strong current with no wind fer days...
target: 就像我说的，一切都始于那次我们被强劲的海流冲远，一连几天都没风……

source: ...An' that's when I realized, it wasn't another ship at all.
target: ……就在那时，我才发现那根本不是另一条船。

source: It wos a cliff!
target: 那是座悬崖！

source: Barely got out o' there wiv' both my hands an' my head attached.
target: 差点就没能保住两只手和脑袋，从那儿逃出来。

source: I can hardly believe this is the kind of life you live.
target: 真不敢相信，你过的竟然是这样的生活。

source: It scarcely seems real.
target: 简直像是假的。

source: Hmph. Yer sharp. You'd do well in it, too.
target: 哼。你很机灵。过这种日子，你也会应付得很好。

source: There's still so much I don't know about the world.
target: 这个世界还有那么多我不知道的事。

source: And talking to you, I realize... I may never get to see it all.
target: 跟你聊过后，我才意识到……我可能永远也没法看遍这一切。

source: Well, perhaps between now an' Dublin, we can find a few new experiences for you.
target: 嗯，或许在抵达都柏林之前，我们能让你有几番新体验。

source: Always more fun to show someone else th'things you love when they 'aven't done them before.
target: 带别人体验你喜欢的事，总是更有意思，尤其是他们从没做过的时候。

source: Speaking of which...
target: 说到这个……

source: Earlier, yeh looked surprised when I said I prefer women.
target: 刚才我说自己更喜欢女人时，你看着很惊讶。

source: I can show you a few things I almos' guarantee yeh haven't done before.
target: 我可以带你体验几件事，我几乎能保证你以前没做过。

source: My new bunk's decidedly roomy. Danish shipwrights know how t'build comfort.
target: 我的新床铺可真宽敞。丹麦的造船匠还挺懂怎么让人住得舒服。

source: Spend the night in Grace's bed?
target: 在格蕾丝的床上过夜？

source: I'd like that.
target: 我很愿意。

source: My intuition's never wrong with th'ladies.
target: 对女人，我的直觉从来不会错。

source: Now. How ought we to pass the time?
target: 那么，我们该怎么打发时间呢？

source: I don't think so, Grace.
target: 还是不了，格蕾丝。

source: Ah! I thought I detected interest, but my intuition failed me.
target: 啊！我还以为你有兴趣，看来我的直觉出错了。

source: Well, I'll tell yeh what.
target: 嗯，要不这样吧。

source: How about we tell stories instead? I only 'ave three livin' friends in the entire world, so for tonight, you can be my surrogate.
target: 我们改讲故事，怎么样？这世上我还活着的朋友总共只有三个，今晚你就暂时代他们陪陪我吧。

source: Happily. I could certainly tell you some interesting stories of life at court...
target: 很乐意。我倒是有些宫廷生活的趣事可以讲给你听……

source: ...I must have fallen asleep. Where has she gone?
target: ……我一定是睡着了。她去哪儿了？

source: Milady's consorting with the nobles again.
target: 夫人又跟那些贵族混在一块儿了。

source: Think she relates to them better'n us salty old sharks?
target: 你说，比起我们这些海里的老鲨鱼，她是不是跟他们更谈得来？

source: Dunnah. I think she ought've killed 'em all on the spot.
target: 不知道。依我看，她就该当场把他们全杀了。

source: She's still blue-blooded in 'er heart, no matter what she says. She's loyal to her first husband's family.
target: 不管她怎么说，骨子里还是个贵族。她还忠于第一任丈夫的家族。

source: Lady O'Flaherty! May Donal rest in peace. If only he could see what she's doin' these days...
target: 奥弗莱厄蒂夫人！愿多纳尔安息。他要是能看见她如今在干什么就好了……

source: Old Donal would be in for a shock, that's for sure. He loved 'is sweet, bonny wife. But that wife is gone. The Pirate Queen took 'er place.
target: 老多纳尔肯定会大吃一惊。他爱的是那个温柔漂亮的妻子。可那个妻子已经不在了，取而代之的是海盗女王。

source: (I sense there's still more I can learn if I listen in a bit longer.)
target: （我觉得再听一会儿，还能知道更多。）

source: (Grace hasn't called me out yet. Perhaps if I keep listening.)
target: （格蕾丝还没叫我出来。也许再听下去……）

source: I heard some of th'other men calling her the Lady of Rockfleet Castle last night. Do y'know why?
target: 昨晚我听见其他几个弟兄叫她罗克弗利特城堡的女主人。你知道为什么吗？

source: No. What's Rockfleet?
target: 不知道。罗克弗利特是什么？

source: She married Sir Richard Burke three years ago today, and divorced him two years ago today.
target: 三年前的今天，她嫁给了理查德·伯克爵士，两年前的今天，又跟他离了婚。

source: What! Married for only one year? War har har... well, at least it was legitimate in the law's eye.
target: 什么！就结了一年婚？哇哈哈……好吧，至少在法律上是正经夫妻。

source: That's not all. Th'day she divorced him, she locked herself inside Rockfleet Castle, climbed to the highest window, threw it open...
target: 还不止呢。离婚那天，她把自己锁在罗克弗利特城堡里，爬到最高的窗户前，一把推开窗……

source: An' called out the terms of her divorce!
target: 大声喊出了她的离婚条件！

source: The balls of six bulls, that one.
target: 这女人的胆子，六头公牛的卵蛋都比不上。

source: I'll bet she kept all 'is gold too. Isn't that right?
target: 我敢说，她还把他的金子全留下了。是不是？

source: More'n half of it, by the time the divorce was complete, if I remember correctly.
target: 要是我没记错，等离婚办完，她拿走了一大半。

source: Ruthless, wonderful, terrifying bitch that she is.
target: 这婆娘，心狠手辣，又厉害，又吓人。

source: (Still nothing from Grace. A bit more should do it.)
target: （格蕾丝还是没动静。再听一会儿应该就行了。）

source: So why're we all the way down in Danish waters, anyhow?
target: 话说，我们干吗一路跑到丹麦海域来？

source: Didn't yeh hear about her meeting with the Queen?
target: 你没听说她跟女王见面的事？

source: Aye! I heard they're bosom friends now. Close as can be.
target: 听说了！据说她们现在是知心好友，亲得不得了。

source: An' that she refused to acknowledge her as her Queen. There is no Irish queen!
target: 还听说她不肯承认那位是自己的女王。爱尔兰没有女王！

source: Aye to that, friend.
target: 说得对，朋友。

source: So long as we don't attack English ships, we're in th'clear for the far future.
target: 只要我们不袭击英格兰的船，往后很长一段日子都能平安无事。

source: Any other kind o' ship is fine. Including Danish. And gold's gold no matter what flag flies over it.
target: 其他地方的船都能动，包括丹麦的。不管上面挂的是什么旗，金子都是金子。

source: Makes sense t'me.
target: 我觉得挺有道理。

source: (Grace met the Queen of England? The one who was asked to execute Hamlet?)
target: （格蕾丝见过英格兰女王？就是受托处死哈姆雷特的那位？）

source: What t'hell are you doin'?
target: 你到底在搞什么？

source: Think I don't see yeh skulking around, eavesdropping right and left?
target: 以为我没看见你鬼鬼祟祟地到处偷听？

source: If yeh want t'know about me so badly, you can come ask me yerself!
target: 这么想知道我的事，就自己来问我！

source: About earlier—I was merely curious. Your men speak freely of you when you're not present.
target: 刚才的事——我只是好奇。你不在的时候，你的手下谈起你来都毫不避讳。

source: 'M sure they do, the bastards.
target: 那帮混蛋，想也知道。

source: Well, then. What have yeh learned?
target: 那好。你都打听到什么了？

source: That you've lived quite a life. Married twice. And you've met the Queen of England herself.
target: 你的人生很不一般。结过两次婚，还见过英格兰女王本人。

source: I may not look like it, but I was a lady like yerself once.
target: 别看我现在这样，我以前也跟你一样，是个贵族小姐。

source: Grace O'Malley, daughter of Eoghan and Maeve O'Malley, Lady of Bunowen Castle, among others.
target: 格蕾丝·奥马利，欧文和梅芙·奥马利的女儿，布诺温城堡的女领主，头衔还不止这些。

source: An' a fat lot of good it did me after my father died. Men swarmed in on all sides.
target: 可我父亲一死，这些就屁用都没有了。男人从四面八方蜂拥而来。

source: They took my hand, my home, an' my body. In return they gave me children, cattle, an' several hundred headaches.
target: 他们娶了我，拿走了我的家和身体。作为回报，给了我孩子、牛，还有几百桩烦心事。

source: After marryin' my second husband, I realized there was nothin' men gave me that I couldn't give myself.
target: 嫁给第二任丈夫后，我才明白，男人能给我的，我全都能自己挣来。

source: An' I've been gifting myself nice things ever since. Ships, stalwart crew, castles... yeh know. The simple things in life.
target: 从那以后，我就一直给自己添置好东西。船、忠诚可靠的船员、城堡……你懂的。人生里那些简单的乐趣。

source: It must be nice, having that sort of power. You go wherever you please.
target: 有那样的力量，一定很好吧。你想去哪儿就去哪儿。

source: So could all women, if they pleased.
target: 只要她们自己愿意，所有女人都能这样。

source: No. That kind of freedom is not available to me.
target: 不。我没有那样的自由。

source: It's... a long story.
target: 这……说来话长。

source: I cannot leave Elsinore. Not at the... present moment.
target: 我不能离开埃尔西诺。至少……目前还不能。

source: But yeh've already left. Look around you, lass. I don't see yer castle nowhere.
target: 可你已经离开了。看看四周，姑娘。我可没在这儿看见你的城堡。

source: We have different definitions of the term 'present'.
target: 我们对“目前”的理解不太一样。

source: You're a strange little woman. I can see why the prince is so taken with yeh.
target: 你这小姑娘真奇怪。我倒是明白王子为什么那么迷恋你了。

source: You mentioned their plans t'rise up against me and mutiny. I can't say I blame them. But...
target: 你说过，他们打算反抗我，发动叛乱。我也不能怪他们。不过……

source: Soon this ship will meet up with my regular fleet, an' we'll sort through what to do with you an' where you'd like to go.
target: 这艘船很快就会跟我平时的船队会合，到时再商量怎么安置你，还有你想去哪儿。

source: Until such a time comes to pass, how about I teach yeh a thing or two about what it means to stand on yer own two feet?
target: 在那之前，我教你几招，让你知道什么叫靠自己站稳脚跟，怎么样？

source: I can stand on my own just fine, thank you.
target: 我自己站得很稳，谢谢。

source: What was that for?
target: 你这是干什么？

source: You don' really stand alone, my lady. Yer stance is weighted all wrong.
target: 你还真没法自己站稳，小姐。你这站姿，重心全错了。

source: Heavy towards the back, like yer afraid anyone yer talkin' to might kill you.
target: 重心偏后，像是怕每个跟你说话的人都会杀了你。

source: (Well, given the circumstances...)
target: （嗯，考虑到眼下的情况……）

source: Well, well! I'm almost impressed.
target: 哟，哟！差点就让我刮目相看了。

source: But bein' able to stay on yer feet will only get yeh so far.
target: 不过，光能站稳可不够。

source: So what? You intend to teach me how to fight?
target: 所以呢？你打算教我打架？

source: It's a day or two o' sailing to Ireland. You think I can teach anyone t'fight that quickly?
target: 航行到爱尔兰也就一两天。你以为我能这么快教会谁打架？

source: Seven hells, no!
target: 见鬼，当然不能！

source: Best I can do is teach yeh how to hold a dagger. Let's start there, shall we?
target: 最多教你怎么握匕首。就从这儿开始，好吧？

source: Meet me abovedecks.
target: 到甲板上来找我。

source: Ophelia. A word wiv' yeh, if I may?
target: 奥菲莉娅。能跟你说几句话吗？

source: What just happened... it could've been far bloodier. But thanks t'you, it wasn't.
target: 刚才的事……本来可能会流更多血。多亏了你，才没闹到那一步。

source: If there's one thing I've learned, it's that unnecessary death always comes t'bite me eventually.
target: 这些年我至少学会了一件事：闹出没必要的人命，迟早总会给我惹来麻烦。

source: You may've saved me from all-out war with yer country.
target: 你或许让我免于跟你的国家全面开战。

source: My pleasure. Consider it all in a day's work.
target: 不客气。就当是我的日常工作吧。

source: Few have had my back in this life like that. An' the ones that have are on this ship with me.
target: 我这辈子，没几个人这样帮过我。帮过我的，现在都跟我在这艘船上。

source: When I find 'em, I like to treat 'em well and never let 'em go.
target: 碰上这样的人，我就愿意好好待他们，绝不放他们走。

source: I believe you're such a woman.
target: 我相信你就是这样的女人。

source: Are you... is this... an invitation to join your crew?
target: 你是……这是……在邀请我当你的船员吗？

source: Aye. But you'd never be able to return to Elsinore.
target: 对。不过，你就再也回不了埃尔西诺了。

source: The life you had—that'll be gone. You'll need to change your name, your hair, your clothes.
target: 你从前的生活——会一去不返。你得改名字，换发型，换衣服。

source: Do you want to join us?
target: 你想加入我们吗？

source: Join Grace's Crew?
target: 加入格蕾丝的船员队伍？

source: Consider me your newest recruit.
target: 那我就是你的新船员了。

source: Excellent. Then... crewmate Ophelia...
target: 太好了。那么……奥菲莉娅船员……

source: Yer first order of business is to get rid of that lavender dress. Burn it if yeh have to!
target: 你要做的第一件事，就是处理掉那条淡紫色裙子。实在不行就烧了！

source: Gladly, Captain Grace.
target: 乐意之至，格蕾丝船长。

source: My place is back with my family in Elsinore.
target: 我该回埃尔西诺，跟家人在一起。

source: Thought you less bland than all that, but if that's yer choice, that's yer choice.
target: 还以为你没这么无趣，不过，既然你这么选，那就随你。

source: Get going then! And try not to regret it too much.
target: 那就走吧！尽量别太后悔。

source: (If I do, I can always come back again.)
target: （真后悔了，我随时都能再回来。）

source: ...So the others have gone. And I remain.
target: ……其他人都走了。我留了下来。

source: Murphy, set our bow towards Ireland. We're heading t'Castle Rockfleet for supplies and ships.
target: 墨菲，把船头转向爱尔兰。我们要去罗克弗利特城堡，补充物资和船只。

source: And after that—the wide an' wind-tossed summer sea!
target: 然后——就是辽阔、风浪翻涌的夏日大海！

source: Ophelia, meet the crew. Crew, meet Ophelia. She's divested herself of 'er genteel trappings, much like yours truly.
target: 奥菲莉娅，来认识一下船员们。各位，来认识一下奥菲莉娅。她已经脱下了贵族小姐的那身行头，就跟我一样。

source: Hello, everyone.
target: 大家好。

source: Er, you all right, lass? Lookin' a bit pale there.
target: 呃，你没事吧，姑娘？脸色有点白啊。

source: (I can return here—if I need to.)
target: （如果有必要——我可以回到这里。）

source: The sound of the waves fades softly as I'm pulled through time.
target: 我被拉着穿越时间，海浪声也轻轻地渐渐消散。

source: Farewell, Grace.
target: 再见，格蕾丝。

source: See you in another life, perhaps.
target: 或许，在另一段人生里还能再见。

source: This can't truly be happening, can it?
target: 这不是真的，对吧？

source: I can hardly believe it.
target: 我实在难以相信。

source: What do I do now, Guilda?
target: 我现在该怎么办，吉尔达？

source: For the first time, I don't know.
target: 我第一次不知道该怎么办了。

source: I'm sorry, Rosencrantz.
target: 对不起，罗森克兰兹。

source: Oh. Hamlet.
target: 哦。哈姆雷特。

source: I heard about Guildenstern. I came to find you.
target: 我听说吉尔登斯吞的事了，就来找你。

source: I came as soon as I received your word. I'm still stunned. I could scarcely believe it.
target: 一收到你的消息，我就赶来了。我现在还没缓过来，实在不敢相信。

source: Guilda, I—I know it's too late, but I—want to apologize.
target: 吉尔达，我——我知道已经太迟了，可我——想向你道歉。

source: I was so cruel to you. And needlessly, at that.
target: 我对你太残忍了。而且完全没必要。

source: All you ever wanted was to bring some cheer to this ugly, worthless world.
target: 你一直以来，只是想给这个丑陋、毫无价值的世界带来一点快乐。

source: There are few who would do such a thing. You were a rare soul.
target: 愿意这样做的人很少。像你这样的人，实在难得。

source: And I should never have discouraged you.
target: 我真不该打击你。

source: I'd stop you at every turn, shout you down...
target: 我总是处处拦着你，大声呵斥，不让你说话……

source: No. What am I saying? She can't hear me. It's pointless.
target: 不。我在说什么呢？她听不见了。说这些有什么用。

source: I wish I'd said it before.
target: 要是我早些说出来就好了。

source: You know she would've forgiven you.
target: 你知道，她会原谅你的。

source: She always knew you loved her regardless.
target: 她一直都知道，不管怎样，你都是爱她的。

source: I know you're right, Hamlet. And I was lucky.
target: 我知道你说得对，哈姆雷特。我曾经很幸运。

source: I long thought myself fortunate to have two great friends in this world.
target: 很长时间里，我都觉得，能在这世上有两位挚友，是我的幸运。

source: How times change.
target: 世事变得真快。

source: Surprise! I'm not dead, everyone!
target: 惊喜！各位，我没死！

source: Wait... where is everyone?
target: 等等……大家都去哪儿了？

source: Did no one come? Really?
target: 一个人都没来？真的？

source: ...Not even one pity attendee?
target: ……连出于同情来参加的人都没有一个？

source: More spirits!
target: 又有幽灵！

source: C-could it really be a ghost? No.
target: 难、难道真是幽灵？不。

source: No. This one's flesh and blood.
target: 不。这个可是有血有肉的。

source: I can't believe no one came to my funeral. I don't understand!
target: 我的葬礼竟然一个人都没来，真不敢相信。我不明白！

source: This was... a prank?
target: 这是……恶作剧？

source: Guilda, I'm going to strangle you.
target: 吉尔达，我要掐死你。

source: How dare you—
target: 你怎么敢——

source: You're an idiot.
target: 你就是个白痴。

source: How dare you be cruel like that? Ugh. I'm leaving.
target: 你怎么能这么残忍？真是的。我走了。

source: Rosie! Wait!
target: 罗茜！等等！

source: Now you've really made a fool of yourself, Guildenstern.
target: 这回你真是丢尽了脸，吉尔登斯吞。

source: This is definitely the worst funeral I've ever had.
target: 这绝对是我有过的最糟糕的葬礼。

source: Well. I suppose I really don't matter in the scheme of things, after all.
target: 好吧。看来，放眼整个世界，我果然无足轻重。

source: Just a tragic side character in the play of life!
target: 不过是人生这出戏里，一个可悲的配角！

source: A poor player who struts and frets her hour upon the stage... and then fakes her funeral, and then is heard no more.
target: 一个可怜的伶人，在台上趾高气扬、焦躁不安地演过片刻……然后假办自己的葬礼，再然后便销声匿迹。

source: But Guilda--pranks aside, your funeral was attended by those who truly love you. Isn't that enough?
target: 可是吉尔达——先不说恶作剧，来参加你葬礼的，都是真正爱你的人。这还不够吗？

source: Love me? Love is overrated. I want fame! I want entire harems full of fanatic admirers!
target: 爱我？爱被捧得太高了。我要名气！我要一座座后宫，里面全是狂热的仰慕者！

source: I want a monument with my name on it! First and last. 'Lady Gu—'... Wait a minute. What is my first name?
target: 我要一座刻着我姓名的纪念碑！名字和姓氏都要。“吉尔——”……等等。我的名字到底是什么？

source: Oh, my God. Ophelia, what is my full name? That's how little I matter in the cosmic plan! I don't even have a first name!
target: 天哪。奥菲莉娅，我的全名是什么？在宇宙的安排里，我就是这么无足轻重！我连名字都没有！

source: Is anything real anymore?!
target: 到底还有什么是真的？！

source: Er. You might be overthinking this a small amount, Guilda.
target: 呃。吉尔达，你可能想得稍微多了那么一点。

source: Phew. You're right. I just need to relax. See, this is why I keep you around.
target: 呼。你说得对。我只要放松一下就好。看吧，这就是我把你留在身边的原因。

source: Hmm. You know...
target: 嗯。你说……

source: Perhaps this is a blessing in disguise. I think we should do something to celebrate!
target: 说不定这还是因祸得福呢。我觉得我们该做点什么庆祝一下！

source: Yes... how about a party to celebrate my total uselessness to the world?
target: 对……办场派对，庆祝我对世界毫无用处，怎么样？

source: The opposite of a funeral! A tribute to nothing important, and those who fall under that label!
target: 跟葬礼完全相反！向一切无关紧要的事物，还有那些无关紧要的人致敬！

source: I'll plan it. We'll have it... er... in the woods. Of course.
target: 我来安排。我们就在……呃……树林里办。当然了。

source: All good liquor-fueled binges start in the woods somewhere.
target: 所有痛快的酗酒狂欢，都是从某片树林里开始的。

source: And you're invited, Ophelia! Who's less important than you, after all?
target: 你也在邀请之列，奥菲莉娅！毕竟，还有谁比你更无足轻重呢？

source: I resent that.
target: 这话让我很不高兴。

source: Ooh, bit touchy, are we?
target: 哟，有点容易生气啊？

source: Once we've all recognized our own worldly unimportance—well—acknowledging the problem is the first step in fixing it!
target: 等我们都认清自己在这世上有多无足轻重——嗯——承认问题，就是解决问题的第一步！

source: Welcome, one and all, to the gathering of those who are utterly unimportant!
target: 欢迎各位，来到这场无足轻重之人的聚会！

source: I'm still peeved at you for your little prank earlier, but I can't resist a good gala.
target: 我还在为你先前的恶作剧生气，不过，精彩的宴会实在让人无法拒绝。

source: I'd like to raise a mug in tribute... to us!
target: 我要举杯致敬……敬我们！

source: 'Unimportant'? Can you please clarify for our benefit, Guilda?
target: “无足轻重”？吉尔达，能给我们解释清楚吗？

source: Yes, do.
target: 对，说清楚。

source: Well, of course, none of you are all that crucial to life here at Elsinore.
target: 嗯，当然了，对于埃尔西诺这里的生活，你们都没那么重要。

source: A bitter drop to swallow, but... well, I've swallowed mine already.
target: 这滋味不太好咽，可是……嗯，我已经把自己的那份咽下去了。

source: I thought we ought to celebrate ourselves, for once. And drink to our own health, because no one else will!
target: 我觉得，我们也该为自己庆祝一回了。为我们自己的健康干杯，因为没人会替我们举杯！

source: Nonsense! I've served m'lord's house faithfully since I was just a lad. I'm the most useful man in 'is retinue!
target: 胡说！我从小就忠心耿耿地为大人家效力。我是他手下最有用的人！

source: Hrmph. If yer lord finds you so useful, why does he ask you to guard the bedchambers and empty walls?
target: 哼。要是你家大人觉得你这么有用，为什么让你守着寝室和空无一人的城墙？

source: Because... w-well...
target: 因为……这、这个……

source: Don't answer it! Just think about it.
target: 不用回答！自己想想就好。

source: And drink.
target: 再喝点酒。

source: Oh, an' I expect you think yer so important to th'Queen?
target: 哦，那我猜你觉得，你对王后就很重要了？

source: I'm an old woman. I've no time to debate my own importance to the world. Death is coming soon. For both of us.
target: 我一把年纪了，没空争论自己对这世界有多重要。死期不远了。我们俩都是。

source: Well, that's horribly morbid. Lady, I like your style.
target: 哎呀，这话可真够阴沉的。女士，我喜欢你这风格。

source: And what of you, Playmaster? Are yeh gonna sit around an' let a bunch of girls call yeh useless?
target: 那你呢，戏剧大师？你就坐在那儿，任由一群姑娘说你没用？

source: Ah, my good Marcellus, how kind of you to call upon me.
target: 啊，好马塞勒斯，承蒙你点名，真是客气。

source: As a master of the stage, my position is behind the curtains, out of sight and mind.
target: 身为舞台的掌控者，我的位置在幕后，不露面，也不被人惦记。

source: Therefore, I have little interest in this debate.
target: 所以，我对这场争论没什么兴趣。

source: Guilda, I'm ever so slightly concerned about your mental state at the moment.
target: 吉尔达，我对你现在的精神状态有那么一点点担心。

source: A toast to celebrate how useless we are? Isn't that odd?
target: 举杯庆祝我们有多没用？这不奇怪吗？

source: Hee hee hee... not at all!
target: 嘻嘻嘻……一点也不！

source: You see, when I realized nobody had come to my funeral... I was crushed, at first.
target: 你看，当我发现没人来参加我的葬礼时……一开始，我的确很受打击。

source: But after that, I felt—free. Free to do whatever I wanted, to go wherever I felt like going.
target: 可后来，我觉得——自由了。想做什么就做什么，想去哪儿就去哪儿。

source: No longer afraid of death.
target: 再也不怕死了。

source: And if I die, I die. I won't know I'm dead anyway, will I? It's silly to be depressed by it.
target: 死了就死了。反正我也不会知道自己死了，对吧？为这事沮丧，多傻啊。

source: I see. Yes, this is starting to make a little sense to me.
target: 我明白了。嗯，我开始觉得这有点道理了。

source: You know, I've found it a relief to be of little importance at court. With the rate at which this particular family seems to, uhm...
target: 你知道吗，我发现自己在宫里无足轻重，反倒轻松。毕竟，这一家人似乎隔三差五就会，呃……

source: Encounter 'unfortunate accidents'...
target: 遇上“不幸的意外”……

source: I don't think I'd like to be of much significance.
target: 我想，我也不愿意成为什么重要人物。

source: Exactly! So let's drink!
target: 正是如此！所以，喝酒吧！

source: And I'd like to give a special toast to Ophelia, who helped me realize all this.
target: 我还要特别敬奥菲莉娅一杯，是她帮我明白了这一切。

source: Anyone got a deck o' cards? Could get a game goin'...
target: 谁有一副牌？可以来玩几局……

source: Heh! Play against me? Only if you're eager to lose everything in your pockets.
target: 呵！想跟我玩？除非你急着把口袋里的东西全输光。

source: Yer on, old woman.
target: 奉陪，老太婆。

source: I'll run and fetch some. Guilda, won't you refill my glass?
target: 我去拿副牌来。吉尔达，帮我把酒杯满上，好吗？

source: How long was I out?
target: 我睡过去多久了？

source: Um, an hour, maybe. The others picked up and left.
target: 嗯，大概一个小时吧。其他人都收拾东西走了。

source: I thought I ought to wait for you to rouse. Although you did look cute sleeping.
target: 我觉得该等你醒来。不过，你睡着的样子确实很可爱。

source: The party went well, didn't it?
target: 派对办得不错，是吧？

source: That it did, partner!
target: 那当然，搭档！

source: Hmm. It's rather late.
target: 嗯。时间挺晚了。

source: I'd better turn in for the night.
target: 我该回去睡觉了。

source: Ophelia... Thank you.
target: 奥菲莉娅……谢谢你。

source: I... hadn't thought I'd find another friend before the end of my life.
target: 我……没想过在有生之年，还能再交到一个朋友。

source: But I have. I suppose that makes me a pretty lucky girl.
target: 可我交到了。看来，我也是个挺幸运的姑娘。

source: And the same for you. Good night, Guilda.
target: 我也一样。晚安，吉尔达。

source: Soon, she won't remember me...
target: 很快，她就不会记得我了……

source: But at least she isn't aboard a ship to England.
target: 但至少，她没在开往英格兰的船上。

source: I was able to change her fate... this time.
target: 我改变了她的命运……这一次。

source: I'm certain we'll speak again tomorrow.
target: 我相信，明天我们一定还会再聊。

source: There's still time to save her, perhaps.
target: 也许还来得及救她。

source: If I don't intervene, I know Father will be killed.
target: 我知道，如果我不干预，父亲就会被杀。

source: That means Hamlet will likely be sent to England, unless further circumstances deem otherwise.
target: 这意味着哈姆雷特很可能会被送往英格兰，除非之后的情况发生变化。

source: If I can find a way to keep Rosencrantz and Guildenstern alive until the England-bound ship returns to harbor...
target: 如果我能想办法让罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞活到那艘驶往英格兰的船返回港口……

source: Maybe there's a way.
target: 也许还有办法。

source: I'll need to get onto the ship first.
target: 我得先登上那艘船。

source: Who would have the authority to allow me on board, though?
target: 不过，谁有权允许我上船呢？

source: I already know the King has the power to grant me access.
target: 我已经知道，国王有权允许我上船。

source: There's another option, too. If I can save Father's life-- perhaps I can keep them both safe from further harm.
target: 还有另一个选择。如果我能救下父亲——也许就能让她们两人都不再受到伤害。

source: I'll have to see what the next few days become.
target: 我得看看接下来几天会怎么样。

source: By now, without my intervention, I know Father cannot be saved.
target: 到了这个时候，我知道，如果我不干预，父亲就没救了。

source: Oh, nothing. Rosie and I are leaving the castle, is all.
target: 哦，没什么。只是萝茜和我要离开城堡了。

source: We have found Elsinore a most chilly welcome.
target: 埃尔西诺对我们的招待可真是冷淡。

source: Totally unsatisfying.
target: 完全不能让人满意。

source: Patently without class, poise, or even good wine.
target: 明摆着毫无格调、风度，连好酒都没有。

source: Which would be all right, if the people were attractive...
target: 要是这里的人长得好看，这些也就算了……

source: But they aren't.
target: 可他们并不好看。

source: Well, except for you. And, I suppose, Hamlet. And... Horatio?
target: 嗯，你除外。还有哈姆雷特，我想。还有……霍拉旭？

source: Certainly Horatio is a handsome man.
target: 霍拉旭当然是个英俊的男人。

source: Yes, yes, we've debated this. Bernardo looks wonderful in everything. But I'm confident neither of them like women.
target: 是，是，我们争论过这件事。贝尔纳多穿什么都好看。但我确信，他们两个都不喜欢女人。

source: Lady Brit...?
target: 布莉特女士……？

source: With that attitude? Eugh.
target: 就她那态度？啧。

source: Hmm. Yes. 'Eugh' indeed.
target: 嗯。是啊。确实该“啧”一声。

source: What she means to say is, we'll be departing shortly, forevermore.
target: 她的意思是，我们很快就要走了，再也不回来。

source: And we wanted to bid you farewell.
target: 所以我们想来向你道别。

source: Our everlasting thanks for saving us on the ship back there.
target: 之前你在船上救了我们，我们会永远感激你。

source: We'd most certainly have gone to a watery grave otherwise!
target: 不然我们肯定就葬身水底了！

source: So, farewell, dearest Ophelia, you sweet angel of social manipulation.
target: 那么，再见了，最亲爱的奥菲莉娅，你这位善于操纵人际关系的可爱天使。

source: Happiest of trails to you!
target: 愿你一路欢喜！

source: That is, unless...
target: 当然，除非……

source: ...you wanted to come with us.
target: ……你想跟我们一起走。

source: Oh, what a fascinating idea! You see, Guilda's taken quite the shine to you.
target: 哦，这个主意真有意思！你看，吉尔妲可是相当喜欢你呢。

source: You're already color-complementary to the two of us, as trios go!
target: 要是我们组成三人组，你的配色已经和我们两个很相衬了！

source: I'd love to. Let me gather my things and I'll come with you.
target: 我很愿意。等我收拾好东西，就跟你们一起走。

source: Let's be off, then, shall we?
target: 那我们这就出发，好吗？

source: W-well, I was in the middle of something rather important.
target: 呃、呃，我正忙着一件相当重要的事。

source: More important than us? Unlikely.
target: 比我们还重要？不太可能吧。

source: Come, now. Put that aside and live a little.
target: 好啦。先把那件事放一边，享受一下生活吧。

source: Back on the ship... you told me that time is repeating for you.
target: 之前在船上……你告诉我，对你来说，时间正在反复循环。

source: Back by the pond... you told me that time is repeating for you.
target: 之前在池塘边……你告诉我，对你来说，时间正在反复循环。

source: So simply come back and try it all again, why don't you?
target: 那你之后回来，把这一切再试一遍不就好了？

source: You've got forever, after all. But this is our only lifetime!
target: 毕竟，你有无穷无尽的时间。可我们只有这一辈子啊！

source: Leave with Rosencrantz and Guildenstern?
target: 和罗森克兰兹、吉尔登斯吞一起离开？

source: (...She has a point.)
target: （……她说得有道理。）

source: All of this—everything—has been so dire.
target: 这些事——所有这一切——一直都如此险恶。

source: Maybe it's time I relaxed a moment.
target: 也许我该放松片刻了。

source: That's the spirit!
target: 这就对了！

source: (I could leave with them forever, now that I have the book.)
target: （现在我拿到了那本书，可以和她们一起离开，再也不回来了。）

source: (Is this a life I could be happy with?)
target: （这样的生活，能让我幸福吗？）

source: We spent a long night cavorting and drinking at the pub in town. By the time the invasion inevitably swept through, we were all too inebriated to care.
target: 我们在镇上的酒馆里喝酒嬉闹，度过了漫长的一夜。等到不可避免的入侵席卷而来时，我们都已经醉得顾不上在意了。

source: I... can't.
target: 我……不能。

source: Thank you for the invitation, but... I think I need to stay here, in Elsinore.
target: 谢谢你们的邀请，可是……我想我得留在这里，留在埃尔西诺。

source: I'm sorry, Guildenstern.
target: 对不起，吉尔登斯吞。

source: Ah, well... your loss. I hope you have a splended life amongst the dour and dismal, my lady.
target: 啊，好吧……那是你的损失。小姐，愿你在这群阴沉又无趣的人中间过得精彩。

source: Come on, Guilda.
target: 走吧，吉尔妲。

source: Goodbye, Ophelia.
target: 再见，奥菲莉娅。

source: (Perhaps in another life.)
target: （也许，换一段人生就可以了。）

source: How is her condition today?
target: 她今天的状况怎么样？

source: I dunnah! Not improved, certainly. Still three kinds o' loony.
target: 我哪知道！反正肯定没好转。还是疯得没边。

source: Ah, Ophelia...
target: 啊，奥菲莉娅……

source: Ophelia. Do you know us?
target: 奥菲莉娅。你认识我们吗？

source: Of course. Perdita. You are lovelier than I ever thought possible.
target: 当然。珀迪塔。你比我能想象的还要美丽。

source: And there's Florizel, the gallant prince, come to you at last.
target: 还有弗洛里泽尔，那位英勇的王子，终于来到你身边了。

source: Everything is lovely in the springtime.
target: 春日里，一切都那么美好。

source: Imagine me, gentle spectators, that I now may be in fair Bohemia!
target: 亲爱的观众们，请想象我此刻已身在美丽的波希米亚！

source: The hills dotted with sheep, the trees all abloom... yes.
target: 山坡上散落着羊群，树上繁花盛开……是啊。

source: It shall stay so forever.
target: 这一切将永远如此。

source: She's not comin' back, is she?
target: 她不会清醒过来了，是吗？

source: Not from this.
target: 成了这样，回不来了。

source: The Ophelia we knew is dead.
target: 我们认识的那个奥菲莉娅已经死了。

source: But she looks—happy. Peaceful. She's not in any pain.
target: 可她看起来——很快乐。很平静。她没有任何痛苦。

source: Thank God for that. We've all suffered enough. Her, especially.
target: 谢天谢地。我们都受了太多苦，尤其是她。

source: I wonder what her fantasy must be like. I wonder what she's seeing in there.
target: 不知道她的幻想是什么样的。不知道她在那个世界里看到了什么。

source: I just wish I could see that, at least.
target: 我只希望，至少能让我看看那个世界。

source: I lie in an endless summer.
target: 我躺在永无尽头的夏日里。

source: All right. Prepare yerselves for Irma house rules, peasants! No complaining, no shortchanging!
target: 好啦。乡巴佬们，准备按伊尔玛的规矩来！不许抱怨，不许少给钱！

source: An' I'll watch the pot, of course.
target: 当然，赌注就由我看着。

source: And what's to stop you from sneaking off with the coin?
target: 那谁能保证你不会带着钱偷偷溜走？

source: The fact that I'm a man of my damn honor, that's what!
target: 就凭我他妈是个讲信誉的人！

source: Is the 'honor' part what makes your fingers so sticky?
target: 你就是因为“讲信誉”，才这么爱顺手牵羊？

source: Enough racket. Do you want Bernardo to hear you shouting and come running? No. I shall deal.
target: 别吵了。你们想让贝尔纳多听到叫嚷，跑过来吗？不想吧。我来发牌。

source: Tonight we play primero. I tire of Ruff and Honors. We play it far too often.
target: 今晚玩普里梅罗。拉夫荣誉牌我已经玩腻了。我们玩得太频繁了。

source: How abou' a little wine while you play, gents?
target: 各位，边玩边喝点酒怎么样？

source: We... we're not supposed to...
target: 我们……我们不该……

source: The last time we drank before our shift, I ended up under the table, and Bernardo caught me and made me run thirty laps.
target: 上次我们值勤前喝酒，我最后醉倒在桌子底下，被贝尔纳多逮住，罚我跑了三十圈。

source: And I ended up in the bushes, and he made me clean all of his clothing by hand... even his undergarments!
target: 我最后倒在灌木丛里，他罚我把他所有的衣服都手洗一遍……连内衣都不放过！

source: Enough ninnyin' about. Let's play! You. Drink!
target: 别再磨磨唧唧了。开玩！你，喝酒！

source: I've seen quite enough.
target: 我已经看够了。

source: How long's she been hidin' in—I mean—ergh—m'lady!
target: 她在这儿躲了多久——我是说——呃——小姐！

source: We weren't doin' no harm!
target: 我们又没干什么坏事！

source: Mmm. This looks awfully covert for a group who are operating above board.
target: 嗯。你们要是行事光明正大，这样子也太鬼鬼祟祟了。

source: Just give it to 'er! Whatever she needs. I can't run laps again like last time... my legs won' last another mile like that!
target: 她要什么就给她吧！不管是什么。我可不能再像上次那样被罚跑圈了……再那么跑上一英里，我这双腿可受不了！

source: I'll meet an early grave if I, too, must run laps again. That bastard...
target: 要是我也得再跑圈，非得折寿不可。那个混蛋……

source: M-my lady, if you keep this quiet, I swear, I'll go against your father's orders! I'll let you into Castle Town!
target: 小、小姐，只要您不把这事说出去，我发誓，我愿意违背您父亲的命令！我会放您进城堡镇！

source: Just meet me at the gates. Any time, my lady, I promise it!
target: 您来大门找我就行。随时都可以，小姐，我保证！

source: Fascinating. Enjoy the rest of your card game, then.
target: 真有意思。那你们继续好好玩牌吧。

source: My silence has a price, you know.
target: 你们知道，想让我保密，可是要付出代价的。

source: She's ruthless. What'd I tell you, Marcellus?
target: 她可真不留情。马塞勒斯，我之前怎么跟你说的？

source: Just like her mother.
target: 跟她母亲一模一样。

source: A-aye! Terrifyin'!
target: 是、是啊！太吓人了！

source: Just please don't tell Bernardo! I can't run laps again like last time... my legs won' last another mile like that!
target: 只求您别告诉贝尔纳多！我可不能再像上次那样被罚跑圈了……再那么跑上一英里，我这双腿可受不了！

source: Cygnus, I'll see you at the castle gates.
target: 西格纳斯，我会在城堡大门找你。

source: G-guard captain!
target: 卫、卫队长！

source: If you have time to gamble, surely you have time to train harder. Need I remind you all we are at war?
target: 既然有时间赌博，想必也有时间加紧训练。还需要我提醒你们，我们正在打仗吗？

source: If you'd like me not to confiscate those, I suggest you spend less time mired in vice like a two-copper tavern wench and more time serving your ladyship. Now—go.
target: 要是不想让我没收那些东西，我劝你别再像个两个铜板就能买下的酒馆荡妇一样沉迷恶习，多花点时间伺候你家小姐。现在——去。

source: Honestly. I'm too lax on them...
target: 真是的。我对他们太宽松了……

source: Was I too hard on them? Are they acting out in spite?
target: 难道我对他们太严了？他们是在赌气，故意胡来吗？

source: I gave them everything! They just don't appreciate me.
target: 我把一切都给了他们！他们就是不领情。

source: (A gambling ring? So that's what the guards get up to in the evenings.)
target: （聚众赌博？原来卫兵们晚上都在干这个。）

source: (I doubt Bernardo would approve of this.)
target: （贝尔纳多恐怕不会赞同这种事。）

source: Now is as good of a time as any to bring these supplies to Horatio.
target: 不如现在就把这些材料送给霍拉旭吧。

source: I've collected what you asked for. Can you make the supplies you said you would?
target: 你要的东西我都找齐了。你能做出之前说的那些用品吗？

source: Horatio, do you think if I gave you some supplies, you could produce some tools with which to make art?
target: 霍拉旭，如果我给你一些材料，你觉得能做出些用于艺术创作的工具吗？

source: Certainly. But I'd need some--
target: 当然。但我需要一些——

source: --Eggs, charcoal, and linen.
target: ——鸡蛋、木炭和亚麻布。

source: That's both eerie and unnerving.
target: 这既诡异，又让人心里发毛。

source: So you'll do it? They're for Lady Brit.
target: 那你愿意做吗？这些是给布莉特女士的。

source: Ah, of course!
target: 啊，当然！

source: Give me just a moment.
target: 给我一点时间。

source: What are you two idiots doing? I have a permanent reservation on loitering here. Alone.
target: 你们两个蠢货在干什么？我可是长期预约了在这儿闲待的。一个人。

source: Actually, Brit, we brought you a gift.
target: 其实，布莉特，我们给你带了份礼物。

source: I know you weren't able to find painting supplies here—so I've created some, with Horatio's help.
target: 我知道你在这里找不到绘画用品——所以在霍拉旭的帮助下，我做了一些。

source: Now you can paint and draw again.
target: 现在你又能画彩画和素描了。

source: (...She still doesn't trust me. I wonder if there's something more I can do. Perhaps someone close to her knows.)
target: （……她还是不信任我。不知道我还能做些什么。也许和她亲近的人会知道。）

source: Might as well bring Brit these letters now.
target: 不如现在就把这些信送给布莉特吧。

source: Brit, I have something for you.
target: 布莉特，我有东西要给你。

source: What are these?
target: 这些是什么？

source: Is this... are these... real?
target: 这……这些……是真的？

source: They're from my mother.
target: 这些是我母亲写来的信。

source: Some of these are... months old. Where did you find them?
target: 有些信已经……是几个月前的了。你在哪儿找到的？

source: They were hidden inside the well on the grounds. I believe they were hidden there from you.
target: 它们被藏在庭院的井里。我想，有人把它们藏在那里，就是为了不让你看到。

source: I see. Gertrude hid these from me.
target: 我明白了。乔特鲁德把这些信藏起来，不让我看。

source: And I thought I was the cruelest bitch I knew. Evidently not.
target: 我还以为，我认识的人里，我才是最狠毒的贱人。显然不是。

source: Mother wrote me every day, and she hid them from me. She lied to me.
target: 母亲每天都给我写信，她却把信藏起来，不让我看。她骗了我。

source: Only because she thought she was keeping you happier by denying them to you.
target: 只是因为她以为，不让你看到这些信，你会过得更开心。

source: Happy? The first month I came here, I wept every night, alone and afraid. How is that happy?
target: 开心？我来这里的第一个月，每晚都在哭，孤独又害怕。这算哪门子的开心？

source: I heard nothing from my mother and thought she had abandoned me, forgotten me completely. Now I learn it was all a lie?
target: 我一点母亲的消息都没收到，还以为她抛弃了我，把我彻底忘了。现在却告诉我，这一切都是谎言？

source: What kind of—she just—ugh. I hate Gertrude.
target: 这算什么——她居然——呸。我恨乔特鲁德。

source: What kind of--she just--ugh. I wish I could... speak to her about this. To ask her why. But I can't even do that, can I?
target: 这算什么——她居然——呸。我真希望能……跟她谈谈这件事。问问她为什么。可我连这个都做不到，是不是？

source: Why won't you leave me alone? Why did you keep doing these things for me?
target: 你为什么就不能让我一个人待着？为什么一直为我做这些事？

source: Why did you do this?
target: 你为什么要这么做？

source: I want to be kind to you, Brit. I've been needlessly mean.
target: 我想对你好一点，布莉特。我之前实在没必要对你那么刻薄。

source: We don't have to be at odds.
target: 我们没必要针锋相对。

source: I don't buy it. Get thee gone, you sniveling suck-up.
target: 我才不信。滚开，你这个低声下气的马屁精。

source: (...She still doesn't trust me. I wonder if there's something more I can do. Maybe I could find someone to help me.)
target: （……她还是不信任我。不知道我还能做些什么。也许我可以找个人帮忙。）

source: I told you to leave me alone.
target: 我说过，让我一个人待着。

source: What is wrong with you? You're like the thing that won't die. You keep coming back again and again.
target: 你到底有什么毛病？你就像个怎么都死不了的东西，一次又一次地回来。

source: I just—want to be—alone.
target: 我只是——想要——一个人待着。

source: I know about Fortinbras. About your mission.
target: 我知道福丁布拉斯的事。也知道你的任务。

source: Yes, we went over this already. Though you still haven't elaborated how you know so much.
target: 是，我们已经说过这件事了。不过，你还是没详细解释，你怎么会知道这么多。

source: That doesn't matter now. I'm not here to have you locked up. I want to help you, Brit.
target: 现在那不重要。我不是来让人把你关起来的。布莉特，我想帮你。

source: To the greatest extent that you'll let me. You can trust me.
target: 只要你愿意让我帮，我就会尽力。你可以相信我。

source: W-what mission?
target: 什、什么任务？

source: You don't have to act surprised. I'm not here to have you locked up. I want to help you, Brit.
target: 你不用装惊讶。我不是来让人把你关起来的。布莉特，我想帮你。

source: Not here. Somewhere private. Come with me.
target: 别在这里说。找个没人的地方。跟我来。

source: Claudius was supposed to die.
target: 克劳狄斯本来应该死的。

source: That's what I came to Elsinore to ensure.
target: 我来埃尔西诺，就是为了确保这件事。

source: Because my father thought, if Claudius were dead--
target: 因为我父亲觉得，只要克劳狄斯死了——

source: All this would be over. The war would end. Prince Fortinbras and my father would be appeased. And I could go home again.
target: 这一切就会结束。战争会结束。福丁布拉斯王子和我父亲都会满意。而我就能回家了。

source: As with many noble families, our roots run strong in Denmark. But Father believes Fortinbras will be a more sympathetic ruler.
target: 和许多贵族家族一样，我们在丹麦有很深的根基。但父亲相信，福丁布拉斯会是个更体谅我们的统治者。

source: Claudius has ignored most of the nobility's requests, even after I was placed here at court. Now my father and the other nobles want him gone.
target: 克劳狄斯对贵族的大多数请求都置之不理，就连我被安排到宫廷之后也一样。现在，我父亲和其他贵族都想除掉他。

source: The longer I go without succeeding, the more I just want to put down my head and sleep for a long time. Maybe forever.
target: 越是迟迟不能成功，我就越想倒头睡上一大觉。也许永远不醒。

source: But Fortinbras was placed under arrest. He's in the dungeon this very moment. What does it matter?
target: 可是福丁布拉斯已经被捕了。他现在就关在地牢里。这还有什么要紧的？

source: As if a prison can hold a man like that. He may be in prison now, but don't think for a moment he'll stay there.
target: 监牢怎么可能关得住他那种人。他现在或许在牢里，但你可千万别以为他会一直待在那里。

source: His associates are almost certainly watching, just waiting to make their move and spring him free.
target: 他的同伙几乎肯定正在盯着，只等时机出手，把他救出去。

source: Hrm. Fortinbras's invasion... we spoke of it earlier. Do you remember?
target: 嗯。福丁布拉斯的入侵……我们之前谈过。你还记得吗？

source: What of it?
target: 那又怎么了？

source: On the subject of domestic matters, I know Lord Fortinbras is going to invade Denmark soon.
target: 说到国内的事，我知道福丁布拉斯大人很快就要入侵丹麦了。

source: I'm not certain how you learned that, but what difference does it make?
target: 我不清楚你是怎么知道的，但这又能改变什么？

source: As I said before: leave me alone. We cannot be friends. And there can be no trust between us until this matter is resolved.
target: 还是那句话：让我一个人待着。我们不可能成为朋友。在这件事解决之前，我们之间也不可能有信任。

source: Now you know the truth. I hope it brings you boundless happiness.
target: 现在你知道真相了。希望它能给你带来无尽的快乐。

source: Why won't you talk to me, Brit? Is something that horribly wrong?
target: 布莉特，你为什么不肯跟我说？事情真的糟到那种地步了吗？

source: I could, if you'd tell me.
target: 只要你肯告诉我，我就能。

source: I'm sure by now you've heard the rumors about a Norwegian confidante within Elsinore's court.
target: 埃尔西诺宫廷里有人是挪威的心腹，这个传闻你现在肯定已经听说了。

source: You're not saying... the spy... is...
target: 你该不会是说……那个间谍……是……

source: Yes. Well, really, it's my father, but he gets his information from me.
target: 是的。其实是我父亲，但他的情报都是从我这里得到的。

source: My father is angry with Claudius. He's been trying to centralize power behind the throne.
target: 我父亲对克劳狄斯很不满。克劳狄斯一直想把权力集中到王室手中。

source: He finds him unfit to rule, and believes Claudius misled the nobility about his intentions when they elected him King.
target: 他觉得克劳狄斯不配统治，还认为贵族们选他当国王时，他隐瞒了自己的真实意图，误导了他们。

source: But if Claudius is murdered, everyone will suspect my father was behind it.
target: 但如果克劳狄斯被谋杀，所有人都会怀疑是我父亲在幕后主使。

source: So my father plotted a secret coup.
target: 所以，我父亲秘密策划了一场政变。

source: A rebellion from within Elsinore's walls. Coax a man who already dislikes Claudius into offing him.
target: 让叛乱从埃尔西诺城墙之内爆发。诱使一个本来就不喜欢克劳狄斯的人干掉他。

source: That man is your brother.
target: 那个人就是你哥哥。

source: Laertes? But Laertes wouldn't attack the throne of Denmark. He's frustrated, certainly, but he's not a natural killer.
target: 雷欧提斯？但雷欧提斯不会对丹麦王室动手。他确实心有不满，可他不是天生的杀人凶手。

source: ...He would be if you were dead. Everyone sees the love your brother has for you. It's unparalleled.
target: ……如果你死了，他就会变成那样。所有人都看得出你哥哥有多爱你。无人能及。

source: I don't know why I'm telling you this.
target: 我不知道自己为什么要告诉你这些。

source: Maybe because you were the only one who'd ever been kind to me in this horrid place.
target: 也许是因为，在这个可怕的地方，只有你曾经善待过我。

source: And whatever little it means, I'm sorry for this. I didn't want to do this. I really didn't.
target: 不管这话还有多少意义，我都想说，对不起。我并不想这么做。真的不想。

source: You can still choose not to.
target: 你现在仍然可以选择不做。

source: No. I can't.
target: 不。我不能。

source: Perished at Brit's hand.
target: 死于布莉特之手。

source: If Fortinbras's invasion were rebuked, your father would have no choice but to work with the king.
target: 如果福丁布拉斯的入侵被击退，你父亲就别无选择，只能与国王合作。

source: And that might grant a more lasting peace than anything Claudius's death could provide.
target: 而这或许能带来更持久的和平，胜过克劳狄斯之死所能带来的一切。

source: But that's impossible. How are you going to repel a national invasion?
target: 但那不可能。你要怎么击退一个国家的入侵？

source: I don't know. But there's got to be a way.
target: 我不知道。但一定有办法。

source: I wouldn't have told you this before, but—Fortinbras is already here. Just outside Elsinore. He's been here a little over a week.
target: 以前我不会告诉你这些，但——福丁布拉斯已经到这里了。就在埃尔西诺外面。他已经来了一个多星期。

source: I've been visiting him. In town. He's staying in a small room with some officers, in civilian dress.
target: 我一直有去见他。在镇上。他和几个军官穿着便服，住在一间小屋里。

source: They meet late at night in the town square, long after all are asleep. They plan to meet next right before the siege begins on Sunday.
target: 他们深夜在镇上广场碰面，那时所有人都早已睡下。他们打算下次在星期日围攻开始前碰面。

source: I can get you into that meeting. But you... can't reveal me. You have to pretend to be loyal to Norway, no matter what you see or hear.
target: 我可以带你参加那次会面。但你……不能揭发我。不管看见什么、听见什么，你都得装作效忠挪威。

source: Understood. I won't expose you, Brit. I swear it.
target: 明白。我不会揭发你的，布莉特。我发誓。

source: If you're lying to me...
target: 如果你在骗我……

source: I'm not.
target: 我没有。

source: Be there. I'll take care of the rest.
target: 到时来吧。其他的交给我。

source: I know.
target: 我知道。

source: What? How--
target: 什么？你怎么——

source: It's a long story. But I know.
target: 说来话长。但我知道。

source: I'm convinced you're some kind of witch. Just haven't figured out if you're using your powers for good or evil.
target: 我确信你是某种女巫。只是还没弄清，你用自己的力量是在行善还是作恶。

source: In this case, it's for your good. Trust me on that.
target: 这一次，是为了你好。这一点请相信我。

source: Well, if you want to meet the Prince, he and I have a standing rendezvous.
target: 那么，如果你想见王子，我和他有定期碰面的约定。

source: But you... can't reveal me. You have to pretend to be loyal to Norway, no matter what you see or hear.
target: 但你……不能揭发我。不管看见什么、听见什么，你都得装作效忠挪威。

source: It'll end poorly for both of us if I'm there. I'd rather not.
target: 如果我去了，我们两个都不会有好下场。我还是不去了。

source: You sound strange.
target: 你这话听着真奇怪。

source: Call it a hunch of sorts.
target: 就当是某种预感吧。

source: Well, come to the meeting or don't. I'll be safe regardless. Blue blood is just as blue no matter who wears our country's crown.
target: 好吧，来不来随你。反正我都会平安无事。不管谁戴上我们国家的王冠，贵族的血统都一样高贵。

source: Ophelia. A word in private, please?
target: 奥菲莉娅。能私下说几句话吗？

source: It's nothing. I merely came to... thank you.
target: 没什么。我只是来……谢谢你。

source: Claudius is dead. And Hamlet and I will be betrothed soon.
target: 克劳狄斯死了。我和哈姆雷特也很快就要订婚了。

source: Claudius is dead. I'm hearing rumors that Hamlet and I are to be betrothed soon.
target: 克劳狄斯死了。我听到传闻，说我和哈姆雷特很快就要订婚了。

source: I thought you'd be happier, somehow.
target: 不知怎么的，我以为你会更开心些。

source: That makes two of us.
target: 我自己也是这么想的。

source: This may be only a temporary arrangement. If Fortinbras arrives, I'm certain our betrothal will be disbanded as soon as possible.
target: 这可能只是暂时的安排。如果福丁布拉斯来了，我确信我们的婚约会尽快解除。

source: And then, under his rule, I will become Fortinbras' wife. The Queen of Denmark.
target: 然后，在他的统治下，我会成为福丁布拉斯的妻子。丹麦的王后。

source: But in either case, with either of these men, I should be overjoyed. I'm out of my father's hands now. He can't control me from the throne of Denmark.
target: 但无论是哪一种情况，无论嫁给这两人中的哪一个，我都应该欣喜若狂。我现在已经摆脱父亲的掌控了。等我坐上丹麦的王位，他就无法控制我了。

source: I can paint any time I like. I can paint the whole castle if I so desire.
target: 我想什么时候画画，就什么时候画。只要愿意，我可以把整座城堡都画下来。

source: At first I thought this meant I was free—more free than I've ever been in my life.
target: 起初，我以为这意味着我自由了——比我这辈子任何时候都自由。

source: But I'm not really. My ownership has merely changed hands.
target: 但其实并没有。我只是换了个主人。

source: I'm sorry, Brit. I wanted this to be good for you.
target: 对不起，布莉特。我原本希望这对你是件好事。

source: (Perhaps if Hamlet were betrothed already... no. That's a thought I ought not to explore.)
target: （也许如果哈姆雷特已经订婚了……不。这种念头我不该再想下去。）

source: (I wonder if there's a world where Brit wouldn't have to be wed.)
target: （不知道有没有一个世界，布莉特可以不必嫁人。）

source: Don't apologize. You've done everything I asked. And you've showed me kindness.
target: 别道歉。我拜托你的事，你都做到了。而且你一直善待我。

source: The invasion comes for us all soon enough, but when the dust has settled, I know at least that you and I will be all right.
target: 入侵很快就会波及我们所有人，但等尘埃落定，我至少知道，你和我都会没事。

source: With Claudius dead, Fortinbras has assured my father that Elsinore will fall all the more swiftly.
target: 克劳狄斯已经死了，福丁布拉斯向我父亲保证，埃尔西诺会更快陷落。

source: He will liberate the castle tomorrow and formally place it under Norwegian rule.
target: 他明天就会解放这座城堡，正式将它置于挪威的统治之下。

source: And now, at last, I am free.
target: 而现在，我终于自由了。

source: Certainly. With Hamlet gone, there's no suitable betrothal left to make within this family line.
target: 当然。哈姆雷特不在了，这个家族里就没有合适的订婚对象了。

source: I will allow Gertrude to remain here, given all she's done for me, of course.
target: 当然，看在乔特鲁德为我做了那么多的份上，我会允许她继续住在这里。

source: Certainly. Hamlet is betrothed—to you, in fact—preventing anyone from trying to barter a truce.
target: 当然。哈姆雷特已经订婚了——订婚对象就是你——这样谁也没法拿联姻来换取停战。

source: If not for that, we'd be halfway to the altar by now. You've saved me from such a fate.
target: 要不是这样，我们现在都快走到婚礼祭坛前了。是你让我免于这样的命运。

source: Provided Hamlet doesn't stand in Fortinbras' way, the future before us is a painless one.
target: 只要哈姆雷特不挡福丁布拉斯的路，我们未来就不会受苦。

source: Now I can sit the throne of Elsinore in peace. Until the nobility can sort out which poor sod of a man gets to marry me, that is.
target: 现在我可以安安稳稳地坐上埃尔西诺的王位了。当然，只能安稳到贵族们决定让哪个倒霉男人来娶我为止。

source: The throne?
target: 王位？

source: Yes. I am to be crowned Queen regnant, as soon as the nobles are able to congregate.
target: 是的。只要贵族们能聚到一起，我就会加冕成为女王。

source: I have their unanimous approval, thanks to my father's lobbying.
target: 多亏父亲的游说，他们一致支持我。

source: I didn't know. You'll make for a fearsome queen, Brit.
target: 我还不知道呢。布莉特，你会成为一位令人敬畏的女王。

source: Thanks. Speaking of which...
target: 谢谢。说到这个……

source: Ophelia. Er. I-- well.
target: 奥菲莉娅。呃。我——嗯。

source: This is hard to say.
target: 这话很难说出口。

source: I'm sorry. I was needlessly cruel to you. For years, in fact.
target: 对不起。我毫无缘由地对你那么刻薄。其实，这样已经好几年了。

source: But you were kind to me, again and again, regardless.
target: 可即便如此，你还是一次又一次地善待我。

source: You made me feel like I had choice again. As though my life were not as ironclad as I had imagined.
target: 你让我觉得，我又有了选择。仿佛我的人生并不像我想象的那样，早就被定死了。

source: I hope things can be different between us. I hope we can be something else.
target: 我希望我们之间能有所改变。希望我们能有一种不同的关系。

source: Are we friends?
target: 我们是朋友了吗？

source: Oh, no, no. I haven't got any friends, and I plan to keep it that way. But 'allies' may be sufficient.
target: 哦，不，不。我没有朋友，也打算一直这样。不过，“盟友”也许就够了。

source: I'll take it.
target: 那也行。

source: Brit asked me to meet her in town around this time.
target: 布莉特约我差不多这个时候在镇上见面。

source: Go to Castle Town?
target: 前往城堡镇？

source: I won't go yet, though.
target: 不过，我暂时还不去。

source: Naturally, I've arrived early.
target: 我当然是提前到了。

source: So you did come after all.
target: 看来你最后还是来了。

source: Go to the Fortinbras Meeting?
target: 前去参加与福丁布拉斯的会面？

source: Ophelia? What are you doing here?
target: 奥菲莉娅？你在这里干什么？

source: Ophelia? What are you doing out here?
target: 奥菲莉娅？你跑到外面来干什么？

source: You can see me?
target: 你看得见我？

source: No, I'm clearly talking to the wall.
target: 看不见，我显然是在跟墙说话。

source: Yes, I can see you. This area's rather well-lit.
target: 是的，我看得见你。这里光线挺亮的。

source: I was taking an evening stroll.
target: 我在夜里散步。

source: What about yourself?
target: 你呢？

source: Well, I was having a nice personal break from my mountain of courtly duties.
target: 我本来正从堆积如山的宫廷事务里抽出空，好好享受一下自己的闲暇。

source: Until you came along. Stop following me.
target: 直到你出现。别再跟着我了。

source: She practically ran from me.
target: 她几乎是跑着躲开了我。

source: I suppose this area is a lot better lit than the docks. That tactic won't work here.
target: 这里的光线确实比码头亮多了。那招在这里行不通。

source: Stay silent. Say nothing. If asked, reply only 'yes, my lord,' or 'no, my lord.' That is all. Do you understand?
target: 保持沉默。什么都别说。如果有人问你，只回答“是，大人”或“不，大人”。就这些。你明白了吗？

source: Come on, then. I hear their boots nearby.
target: 那就走吧。我听见附近有他们的靴子声。

source: Ah, Brit... I've had a change of heart.
target: 啊，布莉特……我改变主意了。

source: Meeting Fortinbras would end poorly for me. Trust me, I know it.
target: 去见福丁布拉斯，我不会有好下场。相信我，我知道。

source: After all that, huh?
target: 折腾了这么多，结果就这样？

source: Well. I guess I'm on my own. Even now.
target: 好吧。看来我只能靠自己了。到了现在也一样。

source: I know about everything, Brit. I know you've been leaking information to Norway. I know about your family. Your father. Fortinbras.
target: 布莉特，我全都知道了。我知道你一直在向挪威泄露情报。我知道你家族的事。你父亲的事。福丁布拉斯的事。

source: All I want is to hear what Fortinbras has to say. I know he'll meet with you tonight. I want to be present.
target: 我只是想听听福丁布拉斯会说些什么。我知道他今晚会与你会面。我想在场。

source: You? Present for this?
target: 你？要参加这种会面？

source: (I hear their boots... they're coming now...)
target: （我听见他们的靴子声了……他们这就过来了……）

source: Fine. You must be some kind of witch, but you've always been obsessed with me, so I ought to have known it'd come to this.
target: 好吧。你一定是某种女巫，可你一直对我这么执着，我早该料到会有这一天。

source: Come on, then.
target: 那就走吧。

source: Good evening, my lord.
target: 晚上好，大人。

source: Lady Birgitta. Tomorrow is the morning we've waited for.
target: 比尔吉塔女士。明天就是我们等待已久的那个早晨。

source: All attempts at a coup have failed. No other bloodless option remains.
target: 所有政变尝试都失败了。已经没有其他不流血的办法了。

source: ...Who is this?
target: ……这是谁？

source: My servant, Your Majesty. She speaks little Danish, and she's quite the ignorant clout.
target: 我的女仆，陛下。她不太会说丹麦语，是个无知的蠢货。

source: Can she be trusted?
target: 她可信吗？

source: As I was saying, we must attack head on. We will begin by sieging the town at dawn.
target: 就像我刚才说的，我们必须正面进攻。我们会在黎明时先围攻这座镇子。

source: Are you prepared to assist us in getting into the castle by any means necessary?
target: 你准备好不惜一切手段，协助我们进入城堡了吗？

source: ...There is no need, my lord. The King is already preoccupied.
target: ……不必这样，大人。国王已经被别的事情牵住了心思。

source: You will be able to enter with ease. The castle will be ill prepared.
target: 您能轻易进去。城堡的防备会很不足。

source: Excellent. I so detest needless bloodshed.
target: 很好。我实在厌恶无谓的流血。

source: It is my uncle's way to murder and poison his way to the top. Not mine.
target: 靠谋杀和下毒爬上高位，那是我叔父的做法。我不会那样。

source: Mind you be clear of this town at dawn. My men have already begun their approach.
target: 记住，黎明时务必离开这座镇子。我的士兵已经开始逼近了。

source: I wish no harm to come to any Danes. But if they protest, then I shall lay down my boot unflinchingly.
target: 我不希望任何丹麦人受到伤害。但如果他们反抗，我会毫不犹豫地镇压。

source: Still, I have high hopes to take Prince Hamlet alive. From what his subjects say, I believe him to be a good man at heart.
target: 不过，我很希望能活捉哈姆雷特王子。从他的臣民所说的话来看，我相信他本性善良。

source: And you will be his bride.
target: 而你会成为他的新娘。

source: Are you not eager? This is a great honor for your family.
target: 你不期待吗？这对你的家族可是莫大的荣耀。

source: I am. It's just... he's been through so much lately. I fear he'll be broken by the time this siege is over.
target: 我期待。只是……他最近经历了太多。我怕等这场围攻结束，他会彻底崩溃。

source: He seems odd and mad lately. Not in his right mind. Please... have your men be gentle with him.
target: 他最近看起来古怪又疯癫。神志不太清醒。请您……让您的士兵对他温和些。

source: I will. We'll take him prisoner as quickly as possible. He'll be surrounded by all members of his family who submit to the authority of Norway.
target: 我会的。我们会尽快将他俘虏。他家族中所有服从挪威统治的人，都会陪在他身边。

source: Hamlet has passed away, in truth. He'll never be King now.
target: 其实，哈姆雷特已经去世了。他再也当不了国王了。

source: I see. I hadn't heard the news. Now cracks a noble heart.
target: 我明白了。我还没听到这个消息。一颗高贵的心，就此碎了。

source: My younger brother, then. Or someone of his like. We shall see who yet has the muster to rule this country fittingly.
target: 那就让我弟弟来吧。或者与他相仿的人。我们会看看，还有谁具备妥善治理这个国家的本事。

source: Mind you be clear of this town at dawn, my lady.
target: 女士，记住，黎明时务必离开这座镇子。

source: ...One last, unfortunate thing.
target: ……最后还有一件遗憾的事。

source: Your servant girl here.
target: 就是你身边这个女仆。

source: I once heard the most fascinating story about the Danish court.
target: 我曾听过一个关于丹麦宫廷的故事，实在引人入胜。

source: They say that a woman of some noble birth with a dark look about her held the Danish Prince's heart.
target: 据说，有位出身贵族、肤色深的女子，俘获了丹麦王子的心。

source: And you, Lady Brit, mentioned yourself that a certain young girl's death could bring about Claudius's demise at her brother's hand.
target: 而你，布莉特女士，也亲口提过，某个年轻姑娘的死，可能会让她的哥哥杀死克劳狄斯。

source: The way she stands, the way she looks... this woman is no clout, nor is she common.
target: 看她的站姿，看她的模样……这个女人不是蠢货，也不是平民。

source: It's true. I am Lady Ophelia.
target: 没错。我是奥菲莉娅女士。

source: Given your desire to overtake my country, I cannot rightly say it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Prince Fortinbras.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子，既然您想夺取我的国家，我实在无法说，很高兴认识您。

source: I assume you're going to kill me now.
target: 我想，您现在要杀我了。

source: Unfortunately, you're correct. I cannot let you return to Elsinore and warn the others. A full defense mounted against us would mean more death.
target: 很遗憾，你说对了。我不能让你回到埃尔西诺，向其他人报信。如果他们全面设防抵抗我们，就会有更多人死去。

source: Although I truly despise the killing of women, in this case, we have no sufficient place in which to hold you until our work is complete.
target: 虽然我确实厌恶杀害女人，但眼下我们没有合适的地方，能把你关到行动结束。

source: I shall need every man available for our coup, and this town may well be rubble if the castle will not surrender.
target: 这场政变需要我调动所有可用的人手，而且如果城堡拒不投降，这座镇子很可能会化为废墟。

source: It is a most regrettable situation.
target: 这实在令人遗憾。

source: My lord, please... y-you're really going to kill her?
target: 大人，求您……您、您真的要杀她？

source: B-but she was just—she hasn't—done anything wrong!
target: 可、可她只是——她没有——做错任何事！

source: I was the one who brought her—
target: 是我把她带来的——

source: Quiet, Brit.
target: 别说了，布莉特。

source: My lord, if you're going to kill me anyway, then please, tell me...
target: 大人，既然您无论如何都要杀我，那就请您告诉我……

source: What do you intend to do with everyone in Elsinore? With those who survive the coup?
target: 你打算怎么处置埃尔西诺的所有人？那些在政变中活下来的人呢？

source: Restore young Hamlet to his rightful throne, and command him as his ruling lord, of course.
target: 当然是让年轻的哈姆雷特登上本就属于他的王位，再以宗主的身份号令他。

source: From everything Lady Brit has told me, Hamlet is young, malleable, and mad. He will be accepted as an heir to the throne by the nobility, but easily controlled.
target: 根据布莉特女士告诉我的一切，哈姆雷特年轻、容易摆布，而且疯了。贵族们会认可他的王位继承人身份，但他很容易控制。

source: Restore the glory of Denmark's ruling house, of course. Given everything Lady Brit has told me, this work is sorely needed.
target: 当然是恢复丹麦王室的荣光。从布莉特女士告诉我的情况来看，这件事已经刻不容缓。

source: And from there, we will forge a lasting peace between our two nations, and consume Sweden into this unity with haste.
target: 然后，我们会在两国之间建立长久的和平，再迅速吞并瑞典，让它也加入这个统一体。

source: I intend to act swiftly to save as many lives as possible. I will eliminate only those who directly threaten me.
target: 我打算迅速行动，尽可能保住更多人的性命。我只会除掉那些直接威胁到我的人。

source: You, for example.
target: 比如你。

source: No. I won't let you kill her.
target: 不。我不会让你杀她。

source: You can't. She's not the enemy, my lord. I brought her here. She's... she's...
target: 你不能这么做。她不是敌人，殿下。是我带她来的。她……她……

source: Please. Isn't there any other way?
target: 求求你。难道没有别的办法吗？

source: B-because if not... you're going to have to fight me, too.
target: 因、因为要是没有……你就得连我一起打。

source: Chivalrous, Lady Brit. But I do not murder women indiscriminately.
target: 真有骑士风范，布莉特女士。不过，我不会不分青红皂白地杀女人。

source: Brit. That's enough.
target: 布莉特。够了。

source: Thank you for defending me. But you don't have to anymore. I know what I need to know.
target: 谢谢你护着我。但已经不必了。我已经知道了我需要知道的事。

source: It's strange, so strange I could laugh. You killed me, once. And here we are now, you defending me.
target: 真奇怪，奇怪得让我想笑。你曾经杀过我。可现在，我们在这里，你却在护着我。

source: Of all the worlds we could have ended up in, this is the one I least expected.
target: 在所有我们可能最终置身的世界里，这个是我最没想到的。

source: What are you saying? Stop talking like that! Are you insane?
target: 你在说什么？别再这么说了！你疯了吗？

source: My lord, please spare her! She's just a girl like me. We never had a choice in any of this.
target: 殿下，求你饶了她！她跟我一样，只是个姑娘。这一切，我们从来都没得选。

source: A-and-- she's not like me. I might be cruel to her, but... she's a good person!
target: 而、而且——她又跟我不一样。我也许对她很残忍，可……她是个好人！

source: Goodbye for a moment, Brit.
target: 暂别片刻，布莉特。

source: Eliminated by Fortinbras.
target: 被福丁布拉斯除掉。

source: White her shroud as the mountain snow...
target: 她的寿衣白如山间雪……

source: Gerta's dead.
target: 格尔塔死了。

source: Not now. Please not now. Whatever it is can wait.
target: 现在不行。求你了，别在这时候。无论什么事，都可以等等。

source: There's nothing I need. You don't seem well, my lord.
target: 我没什么事要麻烦您。陛下，您看起来不太好。
