source: I am deeply, deeply unwell.
target: 我很不好，很不好。

source: I did all of this for her. Everything. If my wife is gone—what remains of me?
target: 我做这一切都是为了她。所有的一切。如果我的妻子不在了——我还剩下什么？

source: She came to Elsinore far too young. She was just a frightened child. Even then, I found her so striking.
target: 她来到埃尔西诺时实在太小了。她只是个受惊的孩子。可即使那时，我也觉得她那么动人。

source: We... my brother and I, we always knew she was to be Hamlet's bride, when all three of us were older. My father made that much clear.
target: 我们……我哥哥和我，一直都知道，等我们三个长大些，她就要成为哈姆雷特的新娘。父亲把这点说得很清楚。

source: She was to marry him and bear him children to fill out a scant royal line.
target: 她要嫁给他，为他生儿育女，让人丁稀少的王室血脉得以壮大。

source: But she-- I-- we loved each other.
target: 可是她——我——我们彼此相爱。

source: The only person who ever deemed me worthy of love.
target: 她是唯一一个觉得我值得被爱的人。

source: My brother used to beat me. I'm certain no one knows it.
target: 我哥哥以前常常打我。我确信没人知道这件事。

source: My father forced us to duel each other as children, to train against one another.
target: 小时候，父亲逼我们互相决斗，让我们彼此对练。

source: Hamlet won every time. He'd come after me later, drag me to the stables, kick me in the gut and leave me there in a pile of hay stinking of urine.
target: 哈姆雷特每次都赢。事后他还会来找我，把我拖到马厩里，踢我的肚子，再把我扔在一堆散发着尿臭的干草上。

source: Gerta... she... found... places to hide from Hamlet. Little nooks and crannies. We'd climb into the knotted hole of a tree and curl up asleep under the stars.
target: 格尔塔……她……找到了……能躲开哈姆雷特的地方。那些小角落、小缝隙。我们会爬进树节上的洞里，蜷缩着，在星空下睡着。

source: She's the only reason I've survived until now.
target: 我能活到现在，全都是因为她。

source: She had this infinite capacity to love, and to love him, and me, no matter what we did, or how sad she was to be trapped in a foreign land...
target: 她心里的爱无穷无尽。无论我们做了什么，无论困在异国他乡让她有多难过，她都能爱着他，也爱着我……

source: I always wanted to free her, to make her happy, and I never knew how.
target: 我一直想让她自由，让她幸福，却始终不知道该怎么做。

source: They all think my brother was a strong King. And I cannot disagree. He was more than strong. He was a brute.
target: 他们都觉得我哥哥是个强大的国王。我也无法反驳。他不只是强大。他是个暴徒。

source: I tried to be a man worthy of being her husband, in the short time we had together. My life's dream achieved, only to lose her like this.
target: 在我们相守的短暂时光里，我努力做一个配得上当她丈夫的人。我一生的梦想终于实现，却就这样失去了她。

source: I'm sorry, my lord. It's clear to me how deeply you loved her.
target: 我很遗憾，陛下。我看得出来，您爱她爱得很深。

source: And for what it's worth, it was plain to me how happy you made her in return.
target: 不知这能否让您好受些，但我也看得很清楚，您同样让她非常幸福。

source: It is the hope of all that they might find a love like that someday.
target: 每个人都希望，有一天自己也能找到这样的爱情。

source: I've tried to love other women before, women who weren't her, but I couldn't.
target: 我以前也试着去爱别的女人，去爱她以外的人，但我做不到。

source: She was all I dreamed about. She was all I knew. No woman could hold a candle to Gerta.
target: 我的梦里全是她。我所知道的一切也都是她。没有哪个女人能比得上格尔塔。

source: But now, after just three short months, Gerta is dead.
target: 可现在，才短短三个月，格尔塔就死了。

source: Y-you remind me of her in some ways.
target: 你、你有些地方让我想起了她。

source: You have her cleverness, her curiosity, and her mercy.
target: 你有她的聪慧、她的好奇心，还有她的仁慈。

source: I have a favor to ask. It is terribly imprudent.
target: 我想请你帮个忙。这个请求实在很冒失。

source: What did you have in mind?
target: 您想让我做什么？

source: I... feel... so tired. As though I could sleep for weeks.
target: 我……觉得……好累。像是能一连睡上几个星期。

source: But... she always sat with me when falling asleep at night.
target: 可是……晚上入睡时，她总会坐在我身边陪着我。

source: She'd lie next to me, embrace me, and wait until I dozed off before she went back to her own chambers.
target: 她会躺在我身旁，抱着我，等我睡着了，才回自己的寝宫。

source: I know it is inappropriate to ask, and unbecoming of a man in my position. But...
target: 我知道提出这样的请求很不妥，也有失我这个身份的体面。可是……

source: Would you be willing to sit with me a while?
target: 你愿意坐下来陪我一会儿吗？

source: Sit with Claudius as he falls asleep?
target: 坐着陪克劳狄斯入睡？

source: Here, my lord. Your chambers.
target: 到了，陛下。您的寝宫。

source: You are a girl no longer.
target: 你已经不是小姑娘了。

source: I have often thought to myself...
target: 我常常在想……

source: M-maybe there's a world where I could love you.
target: 也、也许有一个世界，我能爱上你。

source: Not the way I loved her. But different.
target: 不像我爱她那样。会是另一种爱。

source: Sleep now, Claudius. You're not making any sense.
target: 睡吧，克劳狄斯。你说的话都没头没脑的。

source: (He's asleep downstairs, at last.)
target: （他终于在楼下睡着了。）

source: (Even though I know what he's capable of—what he's done—I still somehow feel terrible for him.)
target: （虽然我知道他做得出什么——也知道他做过什么——可不知为什么，我还是很同情他。）

source: (I've seldom been in Claudius's chambers, let alone unattended...)
target: （我很少来克劳狄斯的寝宫，更别说像这样无人陪同了……）

source: (Right before I left, he mentioned he would send someone to find me later today. I wonder what for.)
target: （就在我离开前，他说今天晚些时候会派人来找我。不知道是为了什么。）

source: I'm sorry, Claudius, but I can't.
target: 对不起，克劳狄斯，但我不能。

source: I see. Of course. As I said, it was imprudent of me.
target: 我明白了。当然。就像我说的，是我冒失了。

source: Please pardon me. It's been an incredibly strange day.
target: 请原谅我。今天实在是太不同寻常了。

source: I need to be alone now.
target: 我现在需要一个人待着。

source: My lady, the King requests your presence in his private chambers.
target: 小姐，国王请您到他的私人寝宫去。

source: He... er... wishes to see you alone and unchaperoned.
target: 他……呃……希望单独见您，不要有人陪同。

source: Visit Claudius's chambers alone?
target: 独自前往克劳狄斯的寝宫？

source: Please tell the King I'm not available tonight—or at all.
target: 请告诉国王，我今晚没空——以后也都没空。

source: So. You came.
target: 那么，你来了。

source: You beckoned, my lord.
target: 是您召我来的，陛下。

source: I apologize. I am not good at... this.
target: 抱歉。我不太擅长……这种事。

source: I pray you'll spare your laughter at my expense.
target: 希望你别笑话我。

source: What is this about?
target: 到底是什么事？

source: Would you do the honors of accompanying me for a goblet of wine?
target: 你愿意赏光，陪我去喝杯葡萄酒吗？

source: Accompanying you where?
target: 陪您去哪儿？

source: Here, I mean. Er. Joining. Not... accompanying.
target: 我的意思是，就在这里。呃。一起喝。不是……陪我去。

source: If you insist, my lord.
target: 如果您坚持的话，陛下。

source: I insist on nothing. This is merely a request.
target: 我并不强求。这只是个请求。

source: Yes, and I accepted. But it's rather cold and dreary in here, isn't it?
target: 是啊，我也答应了。不过这里又冷又阴沉，不是吗？

source: Hrm... Yes. It is. Dark, too.
target: 嗯……是啊。确实。也很暗。

source: I used to go to Gerta's chambers for evenings like this.
target: 以前这样的夜晚，我都会去格尔塔的寝宫。

source: The hearth is quite large in there. As you've no doubt noticed, these chambers have only one furnace, down in my private bedchamber.
target: 那里的壁炉很大。你一定也注意到了，我这寝宫里只有一个暖炉，在楼下我自己的卧室里。

source: Your bedchamber is the same way, is it not?
target: 你的卧室也是这样，对吧？

source: I've often insisted my maids bring the bed-warmer with hot coals—at least in the wintertime.
target: 我常常非要女仆拿装了热炭的暖床器来——至少冬天是这样。

source: So have I!
target: 我也是！

source: Drat this old, moldy castle. My father had such a love for it.
target: 这座又老又发霉的城堡，真烦人。我父亲却那么喜欢它。

source: But sometimes I find the annoyances pile up over the years.
target: 可有时候我觉得，住得越久，烦心的事就越多。

source: Come. If you don't find it too macabre, let us drink in there. The fire's far warmer.
target: 来吧。如果你不觉得那里太阴森，我们就去那儿喝。那边的炉火暖和多了。

source: Certainly warmer.
target: 确实暖和多了。

source: I never thought I'd be here.
target: 我从没想过自己会在这里。

source: You've not been in my wife's rooms before?
target: 你以前没来过我妻子的寝宫？

source: That's not what I mean.
target: 我不是这个意思。

source: You must think it strange, an old man like me asking for your company.
target: 像我这样的老头请你来陪伴，你一定觉得很奇怪。

source: Perhaps you find me odious.
target: 也许你觉得我很讨厌。

source: It is strange. I'm merely unused to seeing you in this way, I suppose.
target: 确实很奇怪。我想，我只是不习惯见到您这副模样。

source: It's unlike anything I'd ever imagined, Ophelia.
target: 这和我曾经想象过的都不一样，奥菲莉娅。

source: The burden of all this. I never wanted to be King, you know. I just wanted to beat my brother. Just once.
target: 这一切的重担。你知道，我从来没有想过当国王。我只是想赢过我哥哥。哪怕只有一次。

source: He was so perfect. He could do no wrong—in Gertrude's eyes, in my nephew Hamlet's. And then there was me, his foolish little shadow.
target: 他那么完美。在乔特鲁德眼里，在我侄子哈姆雷特眼里，他做什么都不会错。而我呢，只是他身后那个愚蠢的小影子。

source: Well, more the fool am I. I am a terrible King. I would throw all this away if I could.
target: 唉，到头来我更像个傻瓜。我是个糟糕的国王。如果可以，我愿意抛下这一切。

source: Why did you invite me here?
target: 您为什么请我来这里？

source: Are you certain you want to know?
target: 你确定想知道？

source: I think so.
target: 我想是的。

source: I must confess to having suffered some... impure thoughts lately.
target: 我必须承认，最近我受一些……不纯洁的念头困扰。

source: In the last year especially, you have grown lovelier than ever before.
target: 尤其是过去这一年，你出落得比以往任何时候都美。

source: It's hard not to notice. Certainly all of the red-blooded men in Elsinore have.
target: 想不注意到都难。埃尔西诺所有血气方刚的男人，肯定都注意到了。

source: Of course, in her lifetime, my wife occupied the entirety of my world.
target: 当然，妻子在世的时候，她就是我的整个世界。

source: I was always urged to take additional lovers, as all men in my position are.
target: 总有人劝我再找些情人，像我这个身份的男人，都会受到这种劝说。

source: Even your father insisted upon it once or twice. But I always found the notion at odds with who I am.
target: 连你父亲也曾一两次坚持让我这么做。但我一直觉得，这个念头和我的本性格格不入。

source: I loved Gertrude. And only Gertrude. But now I am forced to contend with the possibility that, in her absence, I am only human.
target: 我爱乔特鲁德。只爱乔特鲁德。可现在，我不得不面对一种可能：她不在了，我也终究只是个凡人。

source: You were very, very kind to me the other night.
target: 那天晚上，你待我真的、真的很好。

source: You needed help. You were distraught.
target: 您需要帮助。您当时悲痛欲绝。

source: Yes. But there was something more there, wasn't there? I felt it strongly. I think—or I hope—you did, too.
target: 是的。但那时还有些别的感情，对吧？我强烈地感觉到了。我想——或者说，我希望——你也感觉到了。

source: And I propose there is now time to explore those feelings further.
target: 所以我提议，现在我们可以花些时间，进一步探寻这些感情。

source: Enter a sexual relationship with Claudius?
target: 与克劳狄斯建立性关系？

source: I agree. And I'd like to come to know you in all senses.
target: 我同意。而且，我想从各个方面了解你。

source: Why don't you show me what a King can do?
target: 不如让我见识一下，国王有什么本事？

source: Cheeky, cheeky girl.
target: 你这姑娘，胆子可真不小。

source: But I warn you, now that you're mine, you won't be going anywhere soon...
target: 不过我可要提醒你，既然你已经是我的了，一时半会儿你就哪儿也别想去……

source: (...He's asleep. For now, at least.)
target: （……他睡着了。至少暂时是这样。）

source: (I lay with the King. It feels like a dream. But it really happened.)
target: （我和国王上床了。感觉像一场梦。可这真的发生了。）

source: (I wonder what the others will say if they find out. Likely nothing good.)
target: （不知道其他人发现后会怎么说。大概不会是什么好话。）

source: You flatter me. But I think this has gone on long enough, my lord.
target: 您过奖了。但我觉得这件事该到此为止了，陛下。

source: I've no interest in pursuing anything like that with you.
target: 我无意和您发展那样的关系。

source: Ah. I see. How inappropriate of me. Of course you wouldn't be.
target: 啊。我明白了。我真是太失礼了。你当然不会有兴趣。

source: I have intruded long enough upon your time and graces. I hope you can forgive my transgression.
target: 我已经耽误了你太多时间，也辜负了你的好意。希望你能原谅我的冒犯。

source: I'll leave you in peace, now.
target: 我现在就不再打扰你了。

source: My lady, the King requests your presence.
target: 小姐，国王请您过去。

source: Continue my romantic liaison with Claudius?
target: 继续与克劳狄斯的情人关系？

source: Please tell the King I'm not available tonight.
target: 请告诉国王，我今晚没空。

source: You beckoned, my King?
target: 你召我来，我的国王？

source: How could I stay away after yesterday evening?
target: 有了昨晚，我怎么还忍得住不见你？

source: I have begun to look forward to—this. Whatever this is.
target: 我已经开始期待——这一切。不管这一切究竟算什么。

source: And I as well, my lord. But, of course... you could come ask for me yourself.
target: 我也是，陛下。不过，当然……您也可以亲自来找我。

source: I'm not ready to face the others. I wanted privacy for myself. And for you.
target: 我还没准备好面对其他人。我想给自己留些私密的空间。也给你。

source: They would understand, I think. But I don't want to have to explain all this to your father. Not yet, at least.
target: 我想，他们会理解的。但我不想向你父亲解释这一切。至少现在还不想。

source: Now then. I have something for you.
target: 好了。我有东西要送给你。

source: I thought it might please you.
target: 我想你也许会喜欢。

source: It belonged to my mother. I rediscovered it recently.
target: 这是我母亲的东西。我最近又找到了它。

source: It's a very old, fine pendant. The jewel laid within is called 'ruby.'
target: 这是一枚很古老、很精美的吊坠。里面镶嵌的宝石叫作“红宝石”。

source: It's beautiful. Thank you, my lord.
target: 真漂亮。谢谢您，陛下。

source: You ought to call me Claudius. I find my own title strange on the tongue these days.
target: 你该叫我克劳狄斯。这些日子，连我自己说起自己的头衔，都觉得别扭。

source: Thank you, Claudius. You know, some women would see a gift like this as a promise.
target: 谢谢你，克劳狄斯。你知道，有些女人会把这样的礼物看作一个承诺。

source: And if it were?
target: 如果它就是呢？

source: What would you have to say then?
target: 那你会怎么说？

source: We've only just begun this, whatever this is.
target: 我们才刚刚开始这段关系，不管它究竟算什么。

source: No one has to know. Not yet. But you'd make a fine queen, you know.
target: 不必让任何人知道。至少现在不必。但你知道，你会是个好王后。

source: That's not what you said when Hamlet and I were together.
target: 我和哈姆雷特在一起的时候，你可不是这么说的。

source: Ah. Yes. Call it a little jealousy, that.
target: 啊。是啊。就当我那时有点嫉妒吧。

source: Or some misguided attempt to deny my brat of a nephew anything which might validate his behavior further.
target: 也可能是我想错了，以为不能让那个混账侄子得到任何会让他更加认定自己行为没错的东西。

source: And that aside—I'm the King. I do as I please.
target: 再说了——我是国王。我想怎么做就怎么做。

source: I don't know how I feel about this.
target: 我不知道自己对这件事是什么感觉。

source: Give it some thought. I've spent the entire day mulling over this.
target: 好好想想吧。我已经琢磨这件事一整天了。

source: You needn't wear that pendant. But keep it safe. Some day, you might.
target: 你不必戴上那枚吊坠。但要好好保管。也许有一天，你会戴的。

source: Thank you, my l—Claudius. It's beautiful. Truly.
target: 谢谢你，陛——克劳狄斯。它很美。真的。

source: I imagine it glows all the brighter against bare flesh.
target: 我想，衬着裸露的肌肤，它会更加耀眼。

source: Let's find out, shall we?
target: 我们来看看，好吗？

source: Yes. Let's.
target: 好。来吧。

source: I cannot accept this gift.
target: 我不能接受这份礼物。

source: And I don't think we can continue this liaison any longer.
target: 而且，我觉得我们不能再继续这段私情了。

source: Ah. I see. How inappropriate of me. Of course... we... mustn't.
target: 啊。我明白了。是我太失礼了。当然……我们……不能这样。

source: You're right. It was all moving terribly fast. I see that now.
target: 你说得对。这一切发展得实在太快了。我现在明白了。

source: I have intruded long enough.
target: 我已经打扰得够久了。

source: Please leave me be. I need to be alone now.
target: 请别再打扰我了。我现在需要独处。

source: I thought you'd gone.
target: 我以为你已经走了。

source: If you'd like to return to your chambers, you're free to go, of course.
target: 如果你想回自己的房间，当然随时可以走。

source: Ophelia. Follow me. There's something I'd like to show you.
target: 奥菲莉娅。跟我来。我想给你看样东西。

source: Please, be seated.
target: 请坐。

source: On the Queen's...?
target: 坐在王后的……？

source: I cannot bear to let it sit empty. And it isn't right that it should remain so.
target: 我不忍心让它空着。它也不该一直空着。

source: She would have wanted you to sit there, I think.
target: 我想，她会希望你坐在那里。

source: This is strange.
target: 感觉很奇怪。

source: Yet, somehow—natural.
target: 可不知为什么——又很自然。

source: As I said before: you would make a fine Queen.
target: 就像我之前说的：你会是一位出色的王后。

source: And, as well as I could have hoped, peace has at last come to Denmark.
target: 而且，丹麦终于迎来了和平，一切都如我所能期望的那般美好。

source: Is that... would being my wife... be... amenable... to you?
target: 那……做我的妻子……你……愿意……吗？

source: The betrothal would be long. As long as one might be. To give the both of us time.
target: 订婚期会很长。能有多长就多长。给我们两个人都留些时间。

source: (This is moving so quickly...)
target: （这一切发展得太快了……）

source: (Then again, I have only... a little time remaining. Perhaps it would be worthwhile to follow this path to its end.)
target: （不过，我也只剩下……一点时间了。也许值得沿着这条路走到最后。）

source: Accept Claudius's offer of a betrothal?
target: 接受克劳狄斯的订婚提议？

source: I have... never found a place for myself within Elsinore.
target: 我……从来没有在埃尔西诺找到属于自己的位置。

source: Perhaps it was because my fate lay here, on the throne.
target: 也许是因为，我命中注定的位置就在这里，在这王座上。

source: The marriage must be approved. You are, of course, of sufficient rank, but they may question your mother's lineage.
target: 这桩婚事必须得到批准。当然，你的身份足够尊贵，但他们可能会质疑你母亲的血统。

source: I won't let that stand in the way, though.
target: 不过，我不会让这成为阻碍。

source: My dear, there's going to be a wonderful end to this terrible summer after all.
target: 亲爱的，这个糟糕的夏天终究会有一个美好的结局。

source: I can't accept this, Claudius. I'm sorry.
target: 我不能答应，克劳狄斯。对不起。

source: I... it would be... too much. Too soon.
target: 我……这会……太过了。也太早了。

source: Maybe the Queen would have wanted this, but maybe she wouldn't.
target: 也许王后会希望如此，但也许她不会。

source: She's been dead just a short time. It... feels wrong.
target: 她才去世没多久。这……感觉不妥。

source: Yes, I see. Of course I do.
target: 是的，我明白。我当然明白。

source: Please... excuse me. I have merely awoken from a short and horrible dream.
target: 请……原谅我。我不过是刚从一场短暂而可怕的梦中醒来。

source: Apologies, ladies and gentlemen, for disturbing you.
target: 女士们，先生们，抱歉打扰各位。

source: There have been some... troubling circumstances. The castle is in a state of emergency until my men and I are able to investigate thoroughly.
target: 发生了一些……令人不安的事情。在我和手下彻底调查清楚之前，城堡将处于紧急状态。

source: Lord Polonius died very suddenly last night as part of a deeply unfortunate accident. He died at the Prince's hand.
target: 波洛涅斯大人昨夜在一场极为不幸的意外中突然身亡。他死于王子之手。

source: That boy.
target: 那个小子。

source: My men and I are still uncovering information about the event itself. I ask for your compassion for Lady Ophelia and Lord Laertes in this horrific time.
target: 我和手下仍在调查事情的经过。在这可怕的时刻，请各位体谅奥菲莉娅女士和雷欧提斯大人。

source: Lord Polonius served the castle faithfully all his life.
target: 波洛涅斯大人一生都忠心为城堡效力。

source: Whatever particulars surround his death, let us remember him as he was: a stalwart advisor to His Majesty Claudius, and to King Hamlet before him.
target: 无论他的死有怎样的内情，让我们记住他生前的为人：他是克劳狄斯陛下坚定可靠的顾问，在此之前，也曾这样辅佐哈姆雷特国王。

source: Ophelia. I'm so sorry. This is rotten. All of this.
target: 奥菲莉娅。我真的很难过。这太糟了。这一切都是。

source: Is there anything I can do for you? Anything you need?
target: 有什么我能为你做的吗？你需要什么？

source: No. Just send word to my brother, please.
target: 不用。只要请你给我哥哥捎个信。

source: It still hardly feels real, Horatio.
target: 我到现在还觉得这不是真的，霍拉旭。

source: Be kind to yourself today. Give it time.
target: 今天对自己好一点。慢慢来。

source: I'm so sorry to hear about your father's passing. No one should have to witness such a thing.
target: 听说你父亲去世，我很难过。谁都不该亲眼目睹这样的事。

source: I'm sorry to be the one to tell you this.
target: 很抱歉，要由我来告诉你这个消息。

source: Your father is dead.
target: 你父亲去世了。

source: There was an... altercation with the Prince.
target: 他与王子发生了……冲突。

source: There was an... altercation with the Queen.
target: 他与王后发生了……冲突。

source: There was an... incident involving His Majesty.
target: 发生了一起……涉及国王陛下的事件。

source: In the King's chambers?
target: 在国王的寝室里？

source: Yes. How did you know?
target: 是的。你怎么知道？

source: Call it an inkling.
target: 就当是直觉吧。

source: What? But I thought Father was--
target: 什么？可我以为父亲已经——

source: (I thought I saved him.)
target: （我以为我已经救了他。）

source: What happened? Where was he?
target: 发生了什么？他当时在哪里？

source: All I know is that your father was in the King's chambers with him, alone.
target: 我只知道，你父亲当时在国王的寝室里，和他单独待在一起。

source: Then one of the guards was called in, only to find your father had collapsed.
target: 后来，一名卫兵被叫了进去，却发现你父亲已经倒下了。

source: The King claims he fainted suddenly. It's possible it was a natural death.
target: 国王说他突然昏倒了。有可能是自然死亡。

source: Possible? This is Claudius we're talking about.
target: 有可能？我们说的可是克劳狄斯。

source: I have no means to know for certain. I was not present for your father's passing.
target: 我无从确定。你父亲去世时，我并不在场。

source: And without that knowledge, I must take the King's word on faith about what occurred.
target: 既然不知道实情，我就只能相信国王对事情经过的说法。

source: He took his own life rather suddenly.
target: 他突然结束了自己的生命。

source: I know it's not easy to hear it this way. I'm sorry to cause you shock.
target: 我知道，这样听到消息很难接受。很抱歉让你受到这样的冲击。

source: (His death was by my hand this time. Even though it's temporary, it still hurts.)
target: （这一次，他死在我手里。即使这只是暂时的，还是让我很痛苦。）

source: My lady, if there's anything I can do...
target: 女士，如果有什么我能做的……

source: No, Bernardo. That's quite all right. I'll see him again soon enough.
target: 不用了，贝尔纳多。没关系。我很快就会再见到他。

source: I can only hope so. May we all be reunited in Heaven.
target: 但愿如此。愿我们都能在天堂重聚。

source: Heaven. Of course.
target: 天堂。当然。

source: But I am searching for answers with all my power right now. I wanted to assure you of that.
target: 不过，我现在正全力查明真相。我想让你放心，我一定会尽力。

source: I couldn't save him this time, after all.
target: 这一次，我终究还是没能救下他。

source: No one would dare believe this was your fault, Ophelia. Please don't blame yourself.
target: 没人敢认为这是你的错，奥菲莉娅。请别责怪自己。

source: No. You're wrong.
target: 不。你错了。

source: I will save him. I have to.
target: 我一定会救下他。我必须做到。

source: S-save him? Er...
target: 救、救下他？呃……

source: My lady, please... Get some rest tonight. We'll speak soon.
target: 女士，请……今晚好好休息。我们过些时候再谈。

source: He was a good man. A great man.
target: 他是个好人。一个了不起的人。

source: I can only hope so. May we all be reunited in the afterlife.
target: 但愿如此。愿我们都能在死后的世界重聚。

source: Yes. The afterlife. Of course.
target: 是啊。死后的世界。当然。

source: It's difficult to process, I'm sorry. I should leave you be.
target: 这很难接受，抱歉。我该让你静一静。

source: Your brother has already been informed. You should go to him.
target: 你哥哥已经得到消息了。你应该去找他。

source: My father... there was something he wanted me to have. A key to the chest in his room.
target: 我父亲……他有样东西想交给我。是他房间里那只箱子的钥匙。

source: Ah, yes. We did find something like that.
target: 啊，是的。我们确实找到了这样的东西。

source: It's yours now. The least I can do, my lady.
target: 现在归你了。女士，这点小事是我应该做的。

source: I'm truly sorry, Ophelia. But... now I must inform the rest of the castle.
target: 我真的很难过，奥菲莉娅。不过……我现在必须去通知城堡里的其他人。

source: ...That's the herald's horn.
target: ……那是传令官的号角声。

source: Something's happened.
target: 出事了。

source: Listen to the announcement?
target: 听取公告？

source: I have an important update regarding the alleged spy in our midst.
target: 关于那个据称潜伏在我们之中的间谍，我有重要的新消息要宣布。

source: The King has passed.
target: 国王驾崩了。

source: As a result, no festivals or celebration will be observed for some days. His loss is keenly felt by us all, I'm certain.
target: 因此，接下来几天将不举行任何节庆活动。我相信，他的离世让我们所有人都深感悲痛。

source: It was a horrible accident. I ask all of you to give Her Majesty space to heal and grieve at this time.
target: 这是一场可怕的意外。请各位在此时给王后陛下留些空间，让她哀悼，慢慢平复伤痛。

source: It appears Her Majesty raised a weapon against him. I'm still trying to understand why this took place.
target: 看来，王后陛下曾举起武器对付他。我仍在查明事情为什么会发生。

source: His Majesty and the Prince... well, I'll leave it to His Highness to describe what transpired between them.
target: 国王陛下和王子……嗯，他们之间发生了什么，还是由王子殿下来说明吧。

source: Needless to say, it was a tragic accident. We shall all mourn him deeply.
target: 毫无疑问，这是一场悲惨的意外。我们都会深切悼念他。

source: His Majesty and the Prince... well. Needless to say, it was a tragic accident. We shall all mourn him deeply.
target: 国王陛下和王子……唉。毫无疑问，这是一场悲惨的意外。我们都会深切悼念他。

source: He was murdered by an unknown assailant. We have no context at this time.
target: 他被一名身份不明的凶手杀害。我们目前还不了解事情的来龙去脉。

source: Still, I believe there is little immediate threat of danger to the rest of us. I'll announce information as I obtain it.
target: 不过，我认为我们其他人目前面临的危险很小。我一有消息就会公布。

source: As most of you have no doubt heard by now, the King and Queen became suddenly ill in the middle of their meal, and perished shortly afterwards.
target: 相信大多数人已经听说了，国王和王后在用餐时突然发病，不久后便双双身亡。

source: We confirmed that Irma had poisoned them both. She confessed immediately, and has been imprisoned and formally sentenced for her crime.
target: 我们已确认，伊尔玛给他们两人下了毒。她当即认罪，现已被关押，并因所犯罪行正式获刑。

source: May God rest their souls.
target: 愿上帝让他们的灵魂安息。

source: We're still attempting to get to the bottom of what happened.
target: 我们仍在努力查明事情的真相。

source: This is 'orrible. I canna' believe it.
target: 这也太惨了。我真不敢相信。

source: (He's really dead.)
target: （他真的死了。）

source: Good riddance, I say.
target: 要我说，死得好。

source: H-his majesty?
target: 陛、陛下？

source: The nobility will soon meet to arrange a vote. In the interim, by our custom, Hamlet would traditionally carry on the duties his uncle leaves behind.
target: 贵族们很快就会召开会议，安排投票。在此期间，按照我们的惯例，通常应由哈姆雷特接手他叔父留下的职责。

source: My lord, are you prepared for that?
target: 殿下，您准备好了吗？

source: I-- if that's what I must do.
target: 我——如果这是我必须做的。

source: I need-- some time to think about it.
target: 我需要——一点时间考虑。

source: But I think my own father would have wanted this of me. For me to take the throne.
target: 但我想，我自己的父亲会希望我这样做。希望我登上王位。

source: You don't have to do this, my Prince.
target: 王子殿下，您并非必须这样做。

source: Please. Just give me time.
target: 拜托。给我一点时间就好。

source: Of course. As you wish.
target: 当然。遵从您的意愿。

source: Unfortunately, with Hamlet's passing, there is no immediate successor to the throne.
target: 遗憾的是，哈姆雷特已经去世，如今没有人能立即继承王位。

source: The noblemen of Denmark will convene within a week to determine the best path forward.
target: 丹麦的贵族们将在一周内召开会议，决定接下来最妥当的安排。

source: This is a dark moment for us all.
target: 对我们所有人来说，这是一个黑暗的时刻。

source: And the Queen's death was, truly, entirely unexpected.
target: 而王后的离世，确实完全出乎意料。

source: The Queen's death was entirely unexpected.
target: 王后的离世完全出乎意料。

source: That my lady's closest confidante would do this to her is nearly unthinkable.
target: 王后最亲近的知己竟会这样对她，实在令人难以想象。

source: We found her at the foot of the eastern wall this morning, on the beach.
target: 今天早上，我们在东侧城墙下的海滩上发现了她。

source: We're not sure what occurred, or whether she was alone at the moment she died.
target: 我们还不确定发生了什么，也不知道她去世时身边是否有人。

source: She appears to have suddenly lost her life during a confrontation with the Prince.
target: 她似乎是在与王子对峙时突然丧命的。

source: N-no... Gerta...
target: 不、不……格尔塔……

source: T-truly? How awful.
target: 真、真的吗？太可怕了。

source: (He looks pale. Paler than I've ever seen him. I wonder if he'll be all right.)
target: （他的脸色很苍白。我从没见他这么苍白过。不知道他会不会有事。）

source: Some of you know that Hamlet has also departed us far too soon.
target: 各位中有些人已经知道，哈姆雷特也过早地离开了我们。

source: Some of you know that Hamlet has departed us far too soon.
target: 各位中有些人已经知道，哈姆雷特过早地离开了我们。

source: He lost a duel against the king.
target: 他在与国王的决斗中落败了。

source: The Queen has not been located as of yet, but we hope to do so soon.
target: 目前还没有找到王后，但我们希望很快就能找到她。

source: His body was found at the foot of the walls. He was--
target: 他的遗体是在城墙下发现的。他当时——

source: I hope to never see the like of that scene again.
target: 我希望再也不用看见那样的场面。

source: A most unfortunate accident.
target: 一场极为不幸的意外。

source: Lady Brit found him alone in his chambers. His assailant is unknown.
target: 布莉特女士在他的房间里发现了他，当时那里只有他一个人。凶手的身份尚不清楚。

source: His body was found alongside his mother's.
target: 他的遗体被发现时，就在他母亲的遗体旁边。

source: Our best guess is that he became hostile, and with no one else around, she was forced to defend herself.
target: 我们认为最有可能的是，他起了敌意，当时周围没有其他人，她被迫自卫。

source: (If I had stayed...)
target: （如果我当时留下了……）

source: Hamlet was a lifelong friend of mine. I will miss him from the deepest part of my heart.
target: 哈姆雷特是我一生的朋友。我会从心底深深地怀念他。

source: H-Hamlet. This... feels... unreal.
target: 哈、哈姆雷特。这……感觉……不是真的。

source: With both the King and the Prince having passed, we are left without a clear direction to proceed.
target: 国王和王子都已去世，我们如今还不清楚该何去何从。

source: I'm afraid the throne will remain vacant until the nobles can reconvene.
target: 恐怕在贵族们能够再次召开会议之前，王位都将空缺。

source: I also must regret to inform you all that Lord Polonius has passed away.
target: 我还必须遗憾地告诉各位，波洛涅斯大人也去世了。

source: There was an incident with Prince Hamlet. The situation escalated.
target: 他与哈姆雷特王子之间出了事。局势随后升级。

source: Although neither can be faulted for the outcome, this tragic accident cost Lord Polonius his life.
target: 虽然这一结果不能归咎于他们任何一方，但这场悲惨的意外夺去了波洛涅斯大人的生命。

source: Hamlet's soul must surely be beyond saving now.
target: 哈姆雷特的灵魂如今一定已无可救赎。

source: Not to mention that Laertes, who passed away suddenly, must be put to rest as soon as possible.
target: 更何况，突然去世的雷欧提斯也必须尽快安葬。

source: (...I'm so sorry, Laertes.)
target: （……我真的很抱歉，雷欧提斯。）

source: Even during these tragedies, I have carried out my duty. The traitor Birgitta has been put to death.
target: 即使接连发生这些悲剧，我也履行了自己的职责。叛徒比尔吉塔已被处死。

source: The traitor Birgitta has been put to death.
target: 叛徒比尔吉塔已被处死。

source: Let this serve as a warning for all that would betray the Crown.
target: 愿此事警示所有企图背叛王室的人。

source: So be it, then.
target: 那就这样吧。

source: I apologize, everyone, for the disturbance. But sudden death like this always warrants a heightened awareness.
target: 各位，抱歉打扰了。但遇到这样的突然死亡，我们总该提高警惕。

source: I encourage all of you to report anything troubling you see to me at once. And remain within the castle, if possible.
target: 请各位一旦发现任何令人不安的情况，就立刻向我报告。可以的话，请留在城堡内。

source: No, I'd rather be alone right now.
target: 不了，我现在更想一个人待着。

source: Not now. I'm busy.
target: 现在不行。我正忙着。

source: So terribly good to see you once again.
target: 再次见到你，真是太好了。

source: Especially after what transpired last time.
target: 尤其是上一次发生了那样的事之后。

source: You. Do you...
target: 你。你是不是……

source: ...Do I remember you?
target: ……我是不是还记得你？

source: Thank goodness. I'm not going insane.
target: 谢天谢地。我没有发疯。

source: Time is repeating, somehow. Everything's so strange. First that horrible dream, and now this.
target: 不知为什么，时间在重复。一切都这么奇怪。先是那个可怕的梦，现在又是这样。

source: Your father's death, and then your own. Surely the vision you had showed you such a fate.
target: 你父亲的死，然后是你自己的死。你看到的幻象想必已经向你展示了这样的命运。

source: How do you know these things?
target: 你怎么会知道这些事？

source: Did you cause them to happen? Are you some sort of-- sorcerer?
target: 是你让这些事发生的吗？你是什么——巫师？

source: No, I didn't. I mean you no harm, Lady Ophelia. I merely aim to offer my assistance in your journey.
target: 不，不是我做的。我无意伤害你，奥菲莉娅女士。我只是想在你的旅途中助你一臂之力。

source: Just as I did for His Majesty King Hamlet, once.
target: 就像我曾经帮助哈姆雷特国王陛下那样。

source: Is my vision a portent of the future? Will my father's murder continue to come to pass?
target: 我的幻象是在预示未来吗？我父亲被谋杀的事还会不断发生吗？

source: A-and-- someone's coming to kill me too, aren't they?
target: 还、还有——也有人要来杀我，对不对？

source: Who can save us? Who can protect us?
target: 谁能救我们？谁能保护我们？

source: Who indeed, Lady Ophelia?
target: 是啊，谁呢，奥菲莉娅女士？

source: Unfortunately, this is a road which must be traveled alone. And it is a lonely one, indeed.
target: 遗憾的是，这条路必须独自走下去。而它也确实是一条孤独的路。

source: I look forward to watching you discover the solutions for yourself.
target: 我很期待看着你亲自找到解决办法。

source: But I aim to not leave you entirely defenseless. I'll be here to provide assistance if you have further need of me.
target: 不过，我也不打算让你毫无应对之力。如果你还需要我帮忙，我就在这里。

source: How may I assist you?
target: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

source: Rather late for a look at the library, isn't it?
target: 这么晚了才来逛图书馆，是不是有点迟了？

source: I might say the same to you.
target: 我也可以这么问你。

source: I always seem to return to my favorite tale.
target: 我似乎总会回头重读我最喜欢的故事。

source: It's called 'The Great Gatsby'. Have you read it?
target: 它叫《了不起的盖茨比》。你读过吗？

source: Afraid not. What is a Gatsby?
target: 恐怕没有。盖茨比是什么？

source: A tragedy from a faraway place.
target: 一个来自遥远地方的悲剧故事。

source: Do you know what makes a tragedy excellent?
target: 你知道怎样才能成就一部出色的悲剧吗？

source: It's in the construction of the hero, you see.
target: 你看，关键在于主角的塑造。

source: One must feel such a hero is rational, relatable, and sane—doing all in their power to succeed against the odds before them.
target: 必须让人觉得，这样的主角理智、令人共鸣、神志清醒——为了克服眼前的重重困难，竭尽所能地争取成功。

source: However, there must also be some insurmountable difficulty in the hero's circumstances.
target: 然而，主角的处境中也必须有某种无法克服的困难。

source: Some aspect of themself or the people around them must prevent them from achieving happiness and success. This is called the tragic flaw.
target: 主角自身或周围人的某些特质，必须阻碍主角获得幸福与成功。这就叫作悲剧性缺陷。

source: The audience feels their suffering as a form of deeply emotional release. This is called catharsis.
target: 观众感受主角的苦难，从中获得深刻的情感释放。这就叫作净化。

source: And no matter how rational that hero might be, they simply can't win. Not without divine intervention, at least.
target: 而无论主角多么理智，都无法获胜。至少，没有神明干预就不行。

source: I could use some of that. Divine intervention, I mean.
target: 我倒是很需要这个。我是说，神明的干预。

source: As I said before, my dear—my greatest desire is to nudge you along the path to enlightenment.
target: 亲爱的，正如我之前说过的——我最大的愿望，就是在你通往领悟的路上，轻轻推你一把。

source: But make no mistake; one must be led. Not moved there posthaste.
target: 但别误会；人需要的是引导，而不是被急急忙忙地直接送到终点。

source: Who... or what... are you really, Quince?
target: 奎因斯，你究竟是谁……或者说，是什么……？

source: That's rather a sad tale of its own.
target: 那本身也是个相当悲伤的故事。

source: Good night, gentle Ophelia.
target: 晚安，温柔的奥菲莉娅。

source: I've many a room to haunt before the evening is over, I think.
target: 我想，今夜结束之前，我还得在许多房间里游荡呢。

source: (Ah. Here's the key.)
target: （啊。钥匙在这里。）

source: (Apologies, Your Highness.)
target: （请恕罪，殿下。）

source: (I ought to be swift.)
target: （我得快一点。）

source: (Is this...)
I-it... what's this vial?
target: 这、这……这个小瓶是什么？

source: Oh, this scent!
target: 啊，这气味！

source: Poison! But it cannot be—
target: 毒药！可这不可能——

source: Ophelia was... correct?
target: 奥菲莉娅说的……是对的？

source: None should possess such a horrid thing.
target: 谁都不该拥有这种可怕的东西。

source: To the flagstones. Let it sink into the earth. It shall do no harm now.
target: 倒在石板上吧。让它渗进土里。这样它就不会再害人了。

source: (There's nothing here.)
target: （这里什么都没有。）

source: (Nothing at all!)
target: （什么都没有！）

source: Of course Ophelia was her usual fanciful self.
target: 果然，奥菲莉娅还是像往常一样胡思乱想。

source: What an old fool I am.
target: 我真是个老糊涂。

source: Mmm, yes. Here's the key.
target: 嗯，对。钥匙在这里。

source: Hello! Your majesty?
target: 有人吗！陛下？

source: No response.
target: 没有回应。

source: (I detect a faint odor. Odd.)
target: （我闻到一股淡淡的气味。奇怪。）

source: (Ah. This vase. What's in here?)
target: （啊。这个花瓶。里面有什么？）

source: (A vial?)
target: （一个小瓶？）

source: It's hemlock. Oh, Claudius. What have you been doing?
target: 是毒芹。唉，克劳狄斯。你究竟在做些什么？

source: Claudius must not have this.
target: 不能让克劳狄斯留着这个。

source: I'll dump it out. There's no other way.
target: 我要把它倒掉。没有别的办法。

source: (I detect a faint odor... odd.)
target: （我闻到一股淡淡的气味……奇怪。）

source: But there's nothing here. As I thought.
target: 但这里什么都没有。和我想的一样。

source: Ophelia sent me on a chase. Why would she do that?
target: 奥菲莉娅让我白跑了一趟。她为什么要这么做？

source: (What my husband doesn't know won't worry him.)
target: （我丈夫不知道，就不会为此烦心。）

source: (I'm certain the allegations are false.)
target: （我确信那些指控都是假的。）

source: What's that scent? Such a strange, familiar smell.
target: 那是什么气味？好奇怪，却又很熟悉。

source: This vase...
target: 这个花瓶……

source: What's this? There's something in the bottom.
target: 这是什么？底下有东西。

source: A vial? W-what is—oh... Claudius.
target: 一个小瓶？这、这是什么——啊……克劳狄斯。

source: This can't be. But it reeks of hemlock.
target: 这不可能。可它散发着浓烈的毒芹气味。

source: H-he wouldn't.
target: 他、他不会的。

source: Is this-- did he use it on-- Hamlet?
target: 这是——他把它用在了——哈姆雷特身上？

source: No one must have this. Least of all him.
target: 谁都不能留着这个。尤其是他。

source: How could I have been so blind?
target: 我怎么会如此有眼无珠？

source: There's nothing here. And nothing in his desk, either.
target: 这里什么都没有。他的书桌里也没有。

source: I am a fool to have doubted him.
target: 我竟然怀疑他，真是愚蠢。

source: My husband is a good man. He must be.
target: 我的丈夫是个好人。他一定是。

source: But the lock is old, and weak, as I thought.
target: 不过，这把锁又旧又不结实，正如我所料。

source: He must have something hidden here. I know it.
target: 他一定在这里藏了什么。我知道。

source: What's this? In the bottom, something small.
target: 这是什么？底下有个小东西。

source: A vial.
target: 一个小瓶。

source: That scent. I know that scent. Hemlock.
target: 这气味。我认得这气味。毒芹。

source: Oh, Claudius. You've been a rotten, vile beast, haven't you?
target: 啊，克劳狄斯。你一直是个卑劣恶毒的畜生，对不对？

source: And now it's time to pay for your crimes. The proof is in hand. What must be done...
target: 现在，该为你的罪行付出代价了。证据已经在手。必须做的事……

source: And his desk is mere letters, too. All of it. There's nothing here.
target: 他的书桌里也只有信件。全都是。这里什么都没有。

source: Y-you mean—he cannot be—innocent.
target: 你、你是说——他不可能是——无辜的。

source: There must be something else, some... real... proof. Somewhere. Musn't there?
target: 一定还有别的东西，有些……真正的……证据。在某个地方。一定有，对不对？

source: Hmph. Locked. Of course.
target: 哼。锁着。果然。

source: But with a twist of the hand, a knife inserted there...
target: 不过，把刀插到那里，再把手一拧……

source: I smell hemlock.
target: 我闻到了毒芹的气味。

source: And of course. Here it is. The fool would keep it in his chambers.
target: 果然。就在这里。那个蠢货就是会把它留在自己的寝室里。

source: This is much too potent to remain in his hands.
target: 这东西毒性太强，不能再留在他手里。

source: I'll keep it for myself. Perhaps it can be of some use to me.
target: 我自己留着吧。也许能派上用场。

source: But this vase is empty. There's nothing here. And nothing in these drawers, either.
target: 可这个花瓶是空的。这里什么都没有。这些抽屉里也没有。

source: I let that fool of a girl run me around. Stupid, Irma. Stupid.
target: 我竟然被那个蠢姑娘指使得团团转。愚蠢，伊尔玛。愚蠢。

source: Ophelia. I found it.
target: 奥菲莉娅。我找到了。

source: In his chambers, just as you described...
target: 就在他的寝室里，和你说的一模一样……

source: It was the final proof I needed. Let me not pause further. Let this proof unstick me.
target: 这就是我所需的最后一份证据。我不能再迟疑了。就让这份证据让我不再裹足不前。

source: And what will you do now?
target: 那你现在打算做什么？

source: Take the matter to him plainly, without further ado. You'll see.
target: 直接去找他把这件事说清楚，不再拖延。你会看到的。

source: My heart is resolved for the first time in months.
target: 几个月来，我头一次下定了决心。

source: Claudius killed my father. I feel it firmly in my gut. And he'll kill again if he isn't stopped.
target: 克劳狄斯杀了我父亲。我的直觉对此深信不疑。如果不阻止他，他还会再杀人。

source: We cannot let that happen.
target: 我们不能让那种事发生。

source: This is further proof of my Uncle's crimes. However...
target: 这是我叔父罪行的又一份证据。不过……

source: It took so much for me to be sure. I no longer know what to do. And now everything's become stranger than before.
target: 我费了那么多周折才确信。我已经不知道该怎么办了。而现在，一切都变得比之前更古怪了。

source: Too much is already in motion. We have no choice but to see where it leads, now.
target: 已经有太多事情在发展了。现在，我们只能看看它们会走向何处。

source: But I will take heart in having at least stolen one of his tools.
target: 不过，至少我偷走了他的一件工具，这多少能让我振作起来。

source: Ophelia. I found the poison you described.
target: 奥菲莉娅。我找到了你说的毒药。

source: I wish that I had not.
target: 我真希望自己没有找到。

source: I'm sorry, my lady. I felt you needed to see it.
target: 对不起，王后。我觉得您需要亲眼看看。

source: Deep down, I knew.
target: 在心底，我早就知道了。

source: There were whispers after Hamlet died. Of the way his body looked. The... suddenness of it.
target: 哈姆雷特死后，有过一些私下的议论。关于他尸体的模样。关于他死得……那么突然。

source: There are no poisonous snakes in Denmark, Ophelia.
target: 丹麦没有毒蛇，奥菲莉娅。

source: But I turned away from it all. I didn't want to know.
target: 可我对这一切都视而不见。我不想知道。

source: Even then I realized the truth. There are no good men. We women see the wickedness in their hearts. And we ignore it out of love.
target: 那时我就已经明白了真相。没有哪个男人是好人。我们女人看得见他们心里的邪恶，却因为爱而选择无视。

source: I will deal with my husband. I will smite this wickedness by my own hand. I owe him that much.
target: 我会处理我丈夫的事。我会亲手惩治这份邪恶。这是我欠他的。

source: I will find some immediate use of it myself, I believe.
target: 我想，我自己很快就能用上它。

source: Some rats have been troubling the kitchen for far too many years. Eighteen, to be precise.
target: 有些老鼠在厨房里作乱，已经太多年了。准确地说，是十八年。

source: And one of them, the Prince of them all, has scurried too far out of his hole, making trouble...
target: 其中一只，那群老鼠的王子，已经窜出了洞，跑得太远，到处惹事……

source: Better to be rid of him as swiftly as possible.
target: 还是尽快除掉他为好。

source: I shall retain it close for now, Fräulein. At the very least, the King should not have it.
target: 小姐，我暂且把它留在身边。至少，不能让国王留着它。

source: That vile man. I shudder to think what pain he might have caused my lady. Or perhaps it was meant for her. I shall never know.
target: 那个卑鄙的男人。一想到他可能给我的女主人带来怎样的痛苦，我就不寒而栗。也许这本来就是给她准备的。我永远不会知道。

source: What will be done to the King as a result?
target: 那国王会因此受到什么处置？

source: I've dumped it out. He shall not use it to harm again.
target: 我已经把它倒掉了。他不能再用它害人了。

source: But Bernardo, that doesn't stop him harming others. It merely removes his tool.
target: 可贝尔纳多，那阻止不了他伤害别人。只是拿走了他的工具。

source: There's nothing more I can do, my lady. I'm sorry. I'm merely glad Hamlet and the Queen didn't learn of it. They may have... reacted poorly.
target: 小姐，我也无能为力了。对不起。我只是庆幸哈姆雷特和王后没有得知此事。他们可能会……反应过激。

source: If you ask me, this has saved us all from a bloodbath.
target: 依我看，这让我们所有人都免于一场血洗。

source: I went to your chambers to find you, but one of the guards let me know you'd gone to town of all places.
target: 我去你的房间找你，可有个卫兵告诉我，你哪儿不好去，偏偏去了镇上。

source: Despite, if memory serves, my explicit orders that you were not to be permitted to leave Elsinore.
target: 如果我没记错，我明明下过命令，不准放你离开埃尔西诺。

source: We'll discuss that problem another day, daughter of mine.
target: 我的女儿，那件事我们改天再谈。

source: Regardless, I was... troubled to find the vial. I still don't know what to make of it.
target: 无论如何，找到那个小瓶让我……很不安。我到现在也不知道该怎么看待这件事。

source: And what do you intend to do with it, Father?
target: 那您打算怎么处理它，父亲？

source: ...It is gone.
target: ……已经没了。

source: I've dumped it out upon the floor. It shall never harm further.
target: 我把它倒在地上了。它再也不会害人了。

source: Father, he won't hesitate to harm others. The poison's been stopped, but not the man.
target: 父亲，他伤害别人时可不会犹豫。毒药是没了，可那个人还在。

source: My love, no one man or woman can stop a vengeful king. It takes a proper coup.
target: 亲爱的，无论男女，谁都无法独自阻止一个一心复仇的国王。那需要一场真正的政变。

source: And we are both far too small to raise one of those.
target: 而我们两个人都太过渺小，根本无力发动政变。

source: Someday, you'll understand—how futile these things can be in reality, yet feel so close to grasp in the mind's eye.
target: 总有一天，你会明白——这些事在想象中仿佛触手可及，可在现实里，却可能只是徒劳。

source: Claudius? I'm unlocking the door.
target: 克劳狄斯？我要开锁进来了。

source: What calls you to me, love?
target: 亲爱的，什么事让你来找我？

source: It's been a week or so since we had time together like this. Alone.
target: 我们上次像这样相处，已经是一周左右之前了。只有我们两个。

source: ...Yes, you've been rather involved, haven't you.
target: ……是啊，你这阵子忙得很，不是吗。

source: Shall we make the beast with two backs?
target: 我们要不要亲热一番？

source: I know, Claudius.
target: 我知道了，克劳狄斯。

source: And now that chasm calls out for blood.
target: 而如今，那道深渊正呼唤着鲜血。

source: G-gerta, you—you know how cruel he was to me. How my father hated me. You knew!
target: 格、格尔塔，你——你知道他对我有多残忍。知道我父亲有多恨我。你都知道！

source: But murder—brutal murder—that was wrong. You took my family away from me.
target: 可谋杀——残忍的谋杀——那是错的。你夺走了我的家人。

source: I am truly a fool.
target: 我真是个傻瓜。

source: I never saw it. All this time. I gave everything to Denmark, and it gave me nothing in return.
target: 我一直没看出来。这么长时间。我把一切都献给了丹麦，它却没有给我任何回报。

source: How could I have been so naïve? When Hamlet died, I thought with Claudius, things would be the same.
target: 我怎么会如此天真？哈姆雷特死后，我以为换了克劳狄斯，一切也会和从前一样。

source: After all, I've known Claudius all his life. Ever since he was born. I even knew about—
target: 毕竟，克劳狄斯一出生我就认识他了。他这一辈子我都看在眼里。我甚至还知道——

source: Well, never mind it.
target: 唉，算了，不提了。

source: But these people see me as dispensable. Useless. Obtuse. Idiotic.
target: 可这些人觉得我可有可无。没用。迟钝。愚蠢。

source: There's no longer any point to remaining here. My children and I should have left long ago.
target: 留在这里已经毫无意义。我和我的孩子们早就该走了。

source: This court has done nothing but take from us. My wife, my daughter's purity, my own dignity—I owe these people nothing more.
target: 这个宫廷除了夺走我们的东西，什么也没做。我的妻子，我女儿的贞洁，我自己的尊严——我再也不欠这些人什么了。

source: H-how long have you been listening?
target: 你、你听了多久了？

source: Long enough to know that I agree.
target: 听得够久了，知道我赞同您的想法。

source: You'd be happier away from all this. Living a simpler life.
target: 远离这一切，过更简单的生活，您会更快乐。

source: Would you... resent me for taking you away from everything here?
target: 如果我带你离开这里的一切，你会……怨我吗？

source: Not if it meant you were happy and free.
target: 如果那能让您快乐、自由，我就不会。

source: ...Oh, Ophelia.
target: ……啊，奥菲莉娅。

source: I've been a horrid father to you, haven't I? Questioning your every move, hovering over your shoulder—
target: 我这个父亲对你很糟糕，对不对？质疑你的一举一动，时时刻刻盯着你——

source: You and your brother are the only truth that matters.
target: 只有你和你哥哥，才是真正重要的。

source: Let me never forget that. Never again.
target: 愿我永远不再忘记这一点。再也不忘。

source: It's boarded up.
target: 被木板封住了。

source: You see why I asked you, now.
target: 现在你知道我为什么找你了吧。

source: Aye. But a good shove...
target: 是啊。不过，用力推一下……

source: I heard cracking.
target: 我听见断裂的声音了。

source: One more...
target: 再来一下……

source: There. It snapped.
target: 好了。断了。

source: Is all well?
target: 还好吗？

source: Come see for yourself.
target: 你自己过来看看吧。

source: Those are hers?
target: 那些是她的东西？

source: I don't think I can do this.
target: 我觉得我做不到。

source: Everything's coming back. I feel ill.
target: 一切都涌回来了。我很难受。

source: I thought I'd forgotten her. It was easier like that.
target: 我以为自己已经忘了她。那样会好受些。

source: Sometimes I merely pretended she was a dream, that she was never alive.
target: 有时我只是装作她是一场梦，装作她从未活过。

source: I have to go.
target: 我得走了。

source: You don't have to be strong all the time, Laertes.
target: 雷欧提斯，你不必时时刻刻都那么坚强。

source: I know I was small. I know I don't remember her the way you do. It must be worse for you.
target: 我知道那时我还小。我知道我不像你那样记得她。你一定更难受。

source: I don't...
target: 我不……

source: I can't...
target: 我做不到……

source: This feels wretched. I never should have come here.
target: 太难受了。我根本就不该来这里。

source: Ophelia... this shack is already open.
target: 奥菲莉娅……这间小屋已经打开了。

source: Oh. Yes. So it is.
target: 哦。对。确实打开了。

source: I... don't think I can go in there.
target: 我……觉得我没法进去。

source: I'll leave yo to it.
target: 你自己看吧，我先走了。

source: You see why I asked you to come, now.
target: 现在你知道我为什么请你来了吧。

source: ...And what do you expect me to do?
target: ……那你指望我做什么？

source: What men are good for. Brute force.
target: 男人擅长的事。使蛮力。

source: I heard cracking. Do that again.
target: 我听见断裂的声音了。再来一下。

source: It's given way a little.
target: 松动了一点。

source: I believe it's open. Perhaps.
target: 我想是打开了。也许吧。

source: Ophelia? Are you... all right?
target: 奥菲莉娅？你……还好吗？

source: Come and see this.
target: 过来看看这个。

source: Are those...
target: 那些是……

source: I believe so. My mother's belongings.
target: 我想是的。我母亲的东西。

source: It looks as though there's a journal, too.
target: 看起来还有一本日记。

source: Yes. My mother's belongings.
target: 是的。我母亲的东西。

source: Do you... remember her?
target: 你……还记得她吗？

source: Not at all. I have a thin memory of her face... but that could be my memory, or the portrait Father keeps on his wall.
target: 完全不记得了。我对她的脸有一点模糊的印象……但那可能是我的记忆，也可能只是父亲挂在墙上的画像。

source: She was very like that painting. And like you. I was old enough to remember her, a little.
target: 她和那幅画很像。也和你很像。那时我已经够大了，还能记得她一点。

source: I'm not... I've never been... good at things like this.
target: 我不……我从来就不……擅长应付这种事。

source: I've spent so long trying to find out anything I could about Mother. And for so long, there was nothing to find.
target: 我花了那么长时间，想尽可能多地了解母亲。可那么久以来，我什么都找不到。

source: All of this was hidden from me.
target: 这些东西一直都被藏着，不让我知道。

source: I wish she could be here now.
target: 真希望她现在能在这里。

source: Me, too.
target: 我也是。

source: W-well, then.
target: 那、那好吧。

source: I'll leave you in peace.
target: 我就不打扰你了。

source: I... don't understand.
target: 我……不明白。

source: This shack is already open. Is this some sort of prank?
target: 这间小屋已经打开了。这是什么恶作剧吗？

source: Oh. No, no prank. I guess... I forgot? Laertes opened it earlier.
target: 哦。不是，不是恶作剧。我大概……忘了？雷欧提斯之前就把它打开了。

source: Ah. Forgot. I see.
target: 啊。忘了。我明白了。

source: Well, better he catch the plague than I, I suppose. Be careful in there, Ophelia.
target: 好吧，我想，他染上瘟疫总比我染上好。奥菲莉娅，在里面小心点。

source: Ugh! I can't even look at Hamlet!
target: 唉！我连看都不想看哈姆雷特一眼！

source: There, there. Have a seat.
target: 好了，好了。坐吧。

source: What can I get you two ladies?
target: 两位女士想喝点什么？

source: The largest flagons of wine you can manage, sir...
target: 先生，给我们来几杯葡萄酒，杯子越大越好……

source: Call me Othello. Done, and done.
target: 叫我奥赛罗就好。没问题，马上来。

source: You have that look about you—women troubled by men. Which is a look I see every day in this bar.
target: 看你们的样子，就是为了男人烦心的女人。这种神情，我在这家酒馆里每天都能见到。

source: It's her former lover. He's gone stark raving mad.
target: 是她以前的情人。他彻底疯了。

source: Did you see the way he was carrying on, Rosie? That strange, twitchy look in his eye?
target: 萝茜，你看见他那副大吵大闹的样子了吗？还有他那古怪、神经兮兮的眼神？

source: He's certainly changed quickly.
target: 他确实变得太快了。

source: Say, Rosie, you don't think he...
target: 我说，萝茜，你不会觉得他……

source: Absolutely. I was thinking exactly that.
target: 当然。我想的正是这个。

source: But if that's true, then...
target: 可要是真的，那……

source: Oh, my goodness.
target: 哦，天哪。

source: How dare he!
target: 他怎么敢！

source: I cannot believe him.
target: 真不敢相信他会这样。

source: Er. I've missed a crucial piece somewhere.
target: 呃。我好像漏听了什么关键的事。

source: What are you talking about? Who is 'he'? What has 'he' done?
target: 你们在说什么？“他”是谁？“他”做了什么？

source: (And how do they know what in hell the other one's talking about...?)
target: （而且她们到底是怎么听懂对方在说什么的……？）

source: W-well, you see, Guilda and this man... have a long history.
target: 这、这个，吉尔达和这个男人……有一段很长的往事。

source: And it's not like him to act the way he did when we spoke to him.
target: 我们跟他说话时，他那副样子实在不像平时的他。

source: He's hanging on to some secret. And we're not sure what it might be.
target: 他藏着什么秘密不肯说。我们也不确定会是什么。

source: Or maybe we are, because that secret...
target: 也许我们其实知道，因为那个秘密……

source: ...Is that he's in love with someone else.
target: ……就是他爱上了别人。

source: These things have a way of happening, my ladies.
target: 两位女士，这种事总是难免的。

source: Othello, what would you do if someone you loved found a new love of their own?
target: 奥赛罗，要是你爱的人另有新欢，你会怎么办？

source: Me? Well, to be certain, I've never loved all that deeply.
target: 我？嗯，说实在的，我从没爱得那么深过。

source: I'd prefer to think I have a free and open nature. I think men honest who seem to be so.
target: 我更愿意相信自己生性坦荡。别人看起来诚实，我就相信他们诚实。

source: Someone once told me I was easy to lead around, like a donkey...
target: 曾经有人说我很容易被牵着走，像头驴一样……

source: So I suppose I'd try to support the new union as best I could. Seems only fair, doesn't it?
target: 所以，我想我会尽力支持他们在一起。这样才公平，不是吗？

source: If you love that person, then you love the very act of them loving, because it brings them great happiness.
target: 如果你爱那个人，就也会爱那个人去爱别人这件事，因为那能带来莫大的幸福。

source: And if the target of their love isn't you... then you must relinquish your feelings for the sake of their happiness.
target: 而如果那个人爱的不是你……你就必须为了那个人的幸福，放下自己的感情。

source: But... that's... so sensible and mature!
target: 可是……这也……太理智、太成熟了！

source: I'm far too petty to think like that, ordinarily.
target: 我平时实在太小心眼，可想不到这些。

source: (And according to Quince, so is Othello, in reality...)
target: （而照奎因斯的说法，奥赛罗其实也一样……）

source: You're a little wiser than you look, humble barkeep.
target: 不起眼的酒馆老板，你倒比看上去明智一点。

source: He's right, though. Hamlet owes me nothing.
target: 不过，他说得对。哈姆雷特并不欠我什么。

source: Whatever's going on in his mind, he clearly has thought little of me lately.
target: 不管他心里在想什么，显然他最近都没怎么想起我。

source: Then you should think only of yourself, too.
target: 那你也该只为自己着想。

source: Find someone new to love.
target: 找个新的心上人吧。

source: Oh, that's all right, Rosie. You know I only ever really have eyes for you, in the end.
target: 哦，没关系，萝茜。你知道，说到底，我眼里真正在意的始终只有你。

source: And I for you, my little shadow.
target: 我也只在意你，我的小影子。

source: Cheers. I'll drink to that.
target: 干杯。这值得喝一杯。

source: To new love!
target: 为新的爱情干杯！

source: To forgetting old love!
target: 为忘掉旧爱干杯！

source: And to friendship!
target: 也为友谊干杯！

source: Old man, oughtn't you to be on duty?
target: 老头，你不是该去值勤吗？

source: Aye! I could ask you the same, hag.
target: 是啊！我也想问你这话呢，老太婆。

source: This is why yer supper-stew always smells like 'alf a casket of wine, ain't it? Yer down here drinking!
target: 难怪你晚饭做的炖菜总有半桶葡萄酒的味儿，是不是？原来你跑这儿喝酒来了！

source: Leave me to my vices. In my old age, they're the only friends I have.
target: 别管我这些坏习惯了。到了这把年纪，我就剩它们这些朋友了。

source: Well, well! An' here I thought we were friends.
target: 哟，哟！我还以为咱俩是朋友呢。

source: You? Bah. Never.
target: 你？呸。从来就不是。

source: What are you doin' here anyhow?
target: 话说回来，你到这儿干什么？

source: Came to see m' gran'daughter. The babe's not a babe any longer. She's walkin' now.
target: 来看我孙女。那小娃娃已经不是小娃娃了。她现在都会走路了。

source: You have children?
target: 你还有孩子？

source: Thirteen of 'em!
target: 十三个呢！

source: You never spoke of them. How do you feed all of those mouths?
target: 你从没提过他们。你怎么养得起这么多张嘴？

source: Well, now that they're grown, they feed themselves jes' fine. But yeh know, there were some rough years.
target: 嗯，如今他们都长大了，自己养活自己不成问题。不过你也知道，有些年头可不好过。

source: Before my sweet Isabella passed, she ran all thirteen of 'em like a military regiment.
target: 我亲爱的伊莎贝拉还在世的时候，把十三个孩子管得像一支军队。

source: She had t'older ones watch th'younger ones, an' all of them tilled the land an' ran the household.
target: 她让大的照看小的，所有人都得种地、操持家务。

source: She wos a lot like you, come t'think of it. A real bag o' nails.
target: 想想看，她跟你还挺像。真是浑身带刺。

source: Mind your tongue. There's still enough lady left in me to be offended.
target: 说话注意点。我好歹还算个淑女，听了这话也会生气。

source: How old is the youngest child now?
target: 最小的孩子现在多大了？

source: Fourteen. She's gone an' gotten married, too. Makin' her father proud.
target: 十四岁。她也已经嫁人了。可给她爹长脸了。

source: That's Anna. My oldest, Alexander, 'e's got grey at 'is temples, just like me.
target: 她叫安娜。最大的那个，亚历山大，两鬓都白了，就跟我一样。

source: Alexander? As in...
target: 亚历山大？是说……

source: Aye. King Alexander. Th'first man I ever served in Elsinore, an' the greatest.
target: 对。亚历山大国王。我在埃尔西诺最早效忠的人，也是最伟大的一位。

source: My lady Gertrude seems to believe... he was rather a cruel man.
target: 我侍奉的乔特鲁德王后似乎认为……他是个相当残酷的人。

source: The greatest, and the cruelest. Where d'you think Hamlet an' Claudius got their mean streak?
target: 最伟大，也最残酷。你以为哈姆雷特和克劳狄斯那股狠劲儿是从哪来的？

source: Ah, Alexander beat 'em without a second thought if they weren't polished an' hardy at all times!
target: 啊，只要他们没能时刻表现得体、坚强，亚历山大就会毫不犹豫地揍他们！

source: But yeh know, he applied that same work to all th'men who served 'im in the wars. Myself included.
target: 不过你知道，他对那些在战场上为他效命的人也是这么管教的。包括我。

source: It made us all th'better. We were made o' steel! We fought like hell! We sent our enemies packin' a dozen times.
target: 这让我们都更出色了。我们个个像钢铁一样！打起仗来拼了命！我们打跑了敌人十几回。

source: An' his rewards were all the sweeter. Casks o' wine so fat and round, three men wiv hands joined couldn't surround 'em.
target: 这样一来，他的赏赐就更让人痛快了。那酒桶又圆又大，三个人手拉手都围不住。

source: King Alexander sure knew how to discipline 'em like the best. I wos proud to name my son after 'im.
target: 亚历山大国王管教人确实有一套，谁也比不上。我用他的名字给儿子取名，心里可自豪了。

source: Such a pity and a shame to see his grandson behaving as he does. I wonder what King Alexander would say.
target: 看到他的孙子变成这副样子，真是既可惜又丢人。不知道亚历山大国王会怎么说。

source: Well, yeh know. Even the best tree produces a weird-lookin' fruit now an' then.
target: 嗯，你也知道。再好的树，偶尔也会结出个长得怪模怪样的果子。

source: A weird-looking fruit, indeed, that one.
target: 那个果子确实够怪模怪样的。

source: What o' yourself? Where are yer children now?
target: 那你呢？你的孩子现在在哪儿？

source: My husband died not long after I discovered I was with child. He fell under a horse cart and was trampled.
target: 我发现自己怀孕后不久，丈夫就死了。他摔到一辆马车底下，被马踩死了。

source: But I swore to build a great family, to move forward even as I prayed for his immortal soul.
target: 可我发誓要建立一个美好的家庭，一边为他不朽的灵魂祈祷，一边继续过下去。

source: I bore my daughter. Marie.
target: 我生下了女儿。玛丽。

source: She was a sickly little thing. Hardly the size of my hand when she was born. And she didn't cry.
target: 她是个体弱多病的小家伙。出生时几乎还没我的手大。而且她不哭。

source: I thought that made her a peaceful child. I remember marveling to the doctor--'isn't she a wonder, my quiet child?'
target: 我以为那说明她是个安静的孩子。我记得自己惊喜地对医生说——“我这安安静静的孩子，多奇妙啊，是不是？”

source: But it was bad, the silence. It meant her lungs were weak. She made a faint rattling sound when she breathed.
target: 可是，不哭并不是好事。那说明她的肺很弱。她呼吸时会发出微弱的咯咯声。

source: The night Marie was born, Her Majesty Gertrude was born as well. Little Gerta, they called her.
target: 玛丽出生的那一晚，乔特鲁德王后陛下也出生了。他们叫她小格尔塔。

source: Gertrude was a healthy child, but her mother made no milk. So they brought her to me.
target: 乔特鲁德很健康，可她母亲没有奶水。所以他们把她送到了我这里。

source: I fed her and Marie at the same time, looking down at both their faces as I held them close.
target: 我同时给她和玛丽喂奶，把她们搂在怀里，低头看着她们的脸。

source: Gerta cooed and smiled, and her eyes were curious, even then.
target: 格尔塔咿咿呀呀地笑着，连那时候，她的眼里就已经满是好奇。

source: But my daughter Marie—she looked at nothing. She refused my breast. She moved little.
target: 可我的女儿玛丽——她什么也不看。她不肯吃我的奶。也不怎么动。

source: I watched one babe wither away and the other flourish.
target: 我眼看着一个孩子日渐衰弱，另一个却茁壮成长。

source: One morning, I reached for my daughter, and her tiny body was cold. I called a priest.
target: 一天早上，我伸手去抱女儿，她小小的身子已经冰冷了。我叫来了神父。

source: They took her from me and buried her.
target: 他们从我身边带走了她，把她埋了。

source: And I continued to feed Gerta, little Gerta, who grew larger every day.
target: 而我继续给格尔塔喂奶，小小的格尔塔，一天比一天长得大。

source: And now Gerta is grown and married, every bit the graceful woman I knew she would become.
target: 如今格尔塔已经长大成人，嫁了人，成了一位优雅的女子，正如我一直相信她会成为的那样。

source: Aw, hell, Irma. I had no clue.
target: 唉，该死，伊尔玛。我一点都不知道。

source: Yeh know...
target: 你知道……

source: If it makes yeh feel any better, you can steal all o' my money th'next time we play cards.
target: 要是能让你好受一点，下回打牌，你可以把我的钱全赢走。

source: Hmm. The despairing look on all of your fat, ruddy faces when I fleece you does bring me great comfort.
target: 嗯。把你们的钱赢个精光时，你们那一张张又胖又红的脸上绝望的神情，确实让我很欣慰。

source: Well, now, let's not get ahead o' ourselves, yeh evil hag.
target: 好了，先别得意得太早，你这坏老太婆。

source: Better evil than a clod.
target: 坏也比蠢强。

source: 'Ey, I'm proud t'be a clod. Bein' smart never did anyone no good.
target: 嘿，我就以当个蠢蛋为荣。聪明从来没让谁捞到好处。

source: Look at us. Two drunken old fools trading insults. We both have better places to be.
target: 瞧瞧咱俩。两个醉醺醺的老傻瓜，在这儿互相挖苦。咱们都有更该去的地方。

source: Eh. I'd rather stay here an' drink with you. I'll let Bernardo lecture me later.
target: 唉。我宁可留在这儿陪你喝酒。回头让贝尔纳多数落我去吧。

source: Then... cheers. To the old, forgotten ones.
target: 那就……干杯。敬那些被人遗忘的老人。

source: My spring, my joy, my day, my beloved, my laughing rose...
target: 我的春天，我的欢喜，我的白昼，我的挚爱，我含笑的玫瑰……

source: My delight, my wine, my tavern, my lamp, my light, my candle...
target: 我的欢乐，我的美酒，我的酒馆，我的灯，我的光，我的烛火……

source: And what have we here, Othello?
target: 奥赛罗，你这是在做什么呢？

source: Ah, just a flight of fancy. The thing's out of tune.
target: 啊，只是一时兴起。这东西走音了。

source: Sounds tuned well enough to me.
target: 我听着音倒挺准。

source: And I do so love to be serenaded. Especially by the strong, silent type.
target: 而且我最喜欢有人为我唱情歌了。尤其是强壮又沉默寡言的那种。

source: Me? Silent? You must be joking.
target: 我？沉默寡言？你一定是在开玩笑。

source: Hmm. Excellent point. Strong, then.
target: 嗯。说得很对。那就只说强壮吧。

source: What would you like to hear?
target: 你想听什么？

source: Oh, there's a little old bit of something I heard in the barracks often...
target: 哦，有支老曲子，我以前在军营里常听到……

source: The barracks? You, a soldier?
target: 军营？你当过兵？

source: Ahh, believe it or not... once. Under King Hamlet in his infamous three-year chess match with Norway.
target: 啊，信不信由你……以前当过。哈姆雷特国王和挪威那场臭名昭著的三年棋局里，我就在他麾下。

source: Three years is but a blink of an eye in a war, back where I come from.
target: 在我的家乡，三年对一场战争来说，不过是一眨眼的工夫。

source: When the countries are but a week's travel apart, a three-year conflict feels like eternity.
target: 两国之间只有一星期的路程，打上三年就像永远也打不完。

source: But I wasn't cut out for that life, I'm afraid. I much prefer reasonable discussion to endless posturing and saber-rattling.
target: 不过，我恐怕不适合那种生活。比起没完没了地虚张声势、舞刀弄剑，我更喜欢心平气和地讲道理。

source: And I much prefer to rattle a literal saber.
target: 而我更喜欢拿把真刀来舞。

source: You have the look of an old soldier about you. In which war did you fight?
target: 你看起来像个老兵。你打过哪场仗？

source: Which war? Why, the unending war the Turks wage upon all who do not bow to the Sultan.
target: 哪场仗？当然是土耳其人对所有不肯向苏丹低头的人发动的那场无休无止的战争。

source: I served at the Sultan's pleasure for over a decade and fought for his causes against foreigners. I beheaded thousands of men.
target: 我听命于苏丹十多年，为了他的事业与外国人作战。我砍下过成千上万人的头颅。

source: I find that strangely charming. And possibly seductive.
target: 奇怪的是，我觉得这还挺有魅力。说不定还挺撩人。

source: Hmph. Well, I'm certain there's many a man willing to... grab your head around here.
target: 哼。嗯，我敢肯定，这儿有不少男人都愿意……抓住你的脑袋。

source: Toward the end of my decade, I was one of the Sultan's own viziers. I had gardens and treasures aplenty. This feels like a different world entirely.
target: 那十年快结束时，我已经是苏丹麾下的一名高级大臣了。我拥有许多花园和珍宝。这里简直像另一个世界。

source: You gave up all that to come to this rotten, pasty little country? Why on earth?
target: 你放弃了那一切，跑到这个腐烂、满是苍白面孔的小国家来？到底为什么？

source: Because it was not truly mine. I was an Ottoman slave. Everything I did was in my master's name, even when I surpassed his rank with my own.
target: 因为那一切并不真正属于我。我是奥斯曼帝国的奴隶。我做的每一件事都以主人的名义，即便我的地位已经超过了他。

source: In fact, my master's name—'Halil'—was appended to my name quite literally. I longed to be my own man. So I fled.
target: 事实上，我主人的名字——“哈利勒”——就明明白白地加在我的名字后面。我渴望做自己的主人。所以我逃走了。

source: I imagine you aren't welcome in Constantinople any longer.
target: 我想，君士坦丁堡如今已经不欢迎你了。

source: I'm sure they would welcome me. Right into an execution chamber.
target: 我相信他们会欢迎我的。直接把我迎进行刑室。

source: Heh. Well, with the way Denmark's trending, your fortunes may not be better here.
target: 呵。照丹麦如今的势头，你在这儿的命运也未必会更好。

source: Aye. What a pity, that.
target: 是啊。真可惜。

source: ...At least we've still got music.
target: ……至少我们还有音乐。

source: It is the only thing which transcends language or border.
target: 只有它能跨越语言和国界。

source: Even dance may offend. But music is immortal.
target: 就连舞蹈也可能冒犯人。但音乐永不消亡。

source: I wish you excellent fortune in getting that lute to tune.
target: 祝你顺利把那把鲁特琴的音调准。

source: Thanks, friend. We'll see.
target: 谢了，朋友。看情况吧。

source: The time has come, my noble ladies. Hop to it.
target: 时候到了，我高贵的女士们。赶紧动起来。

source: T-t-this is exploitation!
target: 这、这、这是剥削！

source: Yes! This is humane!
target: 没错！这太人道了！

source: You mean inhumane, Guilda.
target: 你是想说不人道，吉尔达。

source: That's what I said!
target: 我就是这么说的！

source: Need I remind you the sum of your debt to me?
target: 还需要我提醒你们欠了我多少钱吗？

source: Five years of losing every game you've played at my table. Plus interest.
target: 五年来，你们在我的牌桌上每一局都输。还得加上利息。

source: I must be repaid, if I have to rip those fine dresses off you two and sell them!
target: 这钱必须还我，哪怕要把你们俩身上那些漂亮裙子扒下来卖掉！

source: We helped you find your ingredients earlier!
target: 我们之前还帮你找食材了！

source: Feh! You think that is enough to make up your sum? Hardly!
target: 呸！你们以为那就够抵债了？差得远呢！

source: It's true we've failed to pay Irma in the past...
target: 我们以前确实没把钱还给伊尔玛……

source: But I must admit, I'd assumed she would have forgotten.
target: 但我得承认，我以为她早就忘了。

source: N-not to mention, I thought we'd have skipped town by now.
target: 再、再说，我以为我们这会儿早就溜出城了。

source: This was supposed to be a quick visit. Pay our respects and leave!
target: 我们本来只打算待一小会儿。致个意就走！

source: Enough! Now! Begin!
target: 够了！现在！开始！

source: Ugh! Fine!
target: 呃！好吧！

source: (You sing. I'll provide, er, emotional support.)
target: （你来唱。我来，呃，给你精神上的支持。）

source: (Why am I always the singer?!)
target: （为什么每次都是我来唱？！）

source: D-deathless Aphrodite, throned in flowers...
target: 不、不朽的阿佛洛狄忒，端坐于繁花之上……

source: Break my spirit, Lady, no longer!
target: 女神啊，莫再摧折我的心魂！

source: Hear anew the voice! O hear and listen!
target: 再听这呼声！啊，请听，请聆听！

source: Come, as in that island dawn thou camest...
target: 来吧，如那海岛黎明时你曾降临……

source: From thy father's golden house, hearing my pleading!
target: 听见我的恳求，从你父亲的金色宫殿而来！

source: Uhm, how does the rest of it go?
target: 呃，后面怎么唱来着？

source: You stood with a sudden brilliance, Goddess, before me...
target: 女神啊，你骤然光芒四射，站在我面前……

source: You asked me what I suffered, who was my cause of anguish...
target: 你问我受何苦楚，又是谁令我悲伤……

source: 'Now she runs away, but she'll soon pursue you;'
target: “如今她逃离你，不久却会追寻你；”

source: 'Gifts she now rejects, soon she'll give them...'
target: ‘她如今拒绝礼物，不久便会亲手相赠……’

source: 'Now she doesn't love you, but soon her heart will burn...'
target: ‘她如今不爱你，不久便会心燃爱火……’

source: Come to me again and abate my torment!
target: 再来我身边，减轻我的苦痛！

source: Give me what I long for!
target: 赐我心中所求！

source: Guilda, what song is that?
target: 吉尔达，这到底是什么歌？

source: I have absolutely no idea.
target: 我完全不知道。

source: It just sort of came to me. You know?
target: 它就这么冒出来了。你懂吧？

source: I guess Aphrodite really is my muse!
target: 看来阿佛洛狄忒真是我的灵感女神！

source: What in black hell was that? I asked you to play something that would attract a paying audience!
target: 刚才那是什么鬼东西？我让你们弹点能吸引人掏钱来听的曲子！

source: And that's exactly what we did. Look at all of these admiring fans!
target: 我们就是这么做的呀。看看这些仰慕我们的听众！

source: We've attracted quite the crowd, it's true.
target: 确实，我们引来了好大一群人。

source: You idiots. They're only here because they think you're going to take off your skirts.
target: 你们两个蠢货。他们留在这儿，只是以为你们要脱裙子。

source: What? Why would they think that?
target: 什么？他们为什么会这么想？

source: Ah, well, that verse you chose...
target: 啊，这个嘛，你选的那段诗……

source: It's a little—shall we say—romantic?
target: 有点——该怎么说呢——香艳？

source: Well, of course. That's the only sort of verse worth knowing.
target: 那当然。只有这种诗才值得记。

source: You two are a lost cause. A sunk cost. I'll never see a single coin of my money, will I?
target: 你们两个没救了。我这钱算是打水漂了。我一枚钱币也拿不回来了，是吧？

source: I've had enough. I'm returning to the castle.
target: 我受够了。我要回城堡。

source: Well, there goes our last chance to ever deal in at Irma's table again.
target: 唉，这下连重回伊尔玛牌桌的最后一点机会也没了。

source: There, there. It's all right. She's a cheat anyhow, and we both knew it.
target: 好啦，好啦。没事的。反正她会出千，我们两个都知道。

source: We'll simply have to find some other way to entertain ourselves in this dreadful place, I suppose.
target: 看来我们只能另找点乐子，打发在这个糟糕地方的日子了。

source: I can think of a few ways you can entertain each other!
target: 我倒能想到几种让你们彼此取乐的法子！

source: Aye! Take 'er sleeves down!
target: 对啊！把她的袖子扒下来！

source: We'll pay yeh!
target: 我们给你们钱！

source: Y-you're all vile!
target: 你、你们都太下流了！

source: Yeah! Shame on you! Our love is not for sale!
target: 就是！你们要不要脸！我们的爱不卖！

source: Wait. What?
target: 等等。什么？

source: Nothing, nothing. Rosie, let's get out of here!
target: 没什么，没什么。罗茜，我们快离开这里！

source: She's got a lovely sound.
target: 这琴的声音真好听。

source: Mm. First lute I ever bought. I've given it a touch-up and it's like new now.
target: 嗯。这是我买的第一把鲁特琴。我把它修整了一下，现在跟新的一样。

source: Thought I'd follow a lark or two.
target: 想着随兴找点乐子。

source: What's yours made of? Such a fascinating surface.
target: 你这把是什么材料做的？表面真特别。

source: No name you would recognize. It was made in my homeland.
target: 说了名字你也不会认识。它是在我的故乡做的。

source: Where are you from?
target: 你来自哪里？

source: Same as you, from the looks of it.
target: 看你的样子，应该和你来自同一个地方。

source: You're mistaken, sir.
target: 你弄错了，先生。

source: Some parts of you seem Danish, to a degree. Your fine clothes mark you a part of the local flock.
target: 你有些地方倒是有几分丹麦人的样子。你这身讲究的衣服，一看就是本地人。

source: My sister and I were born here.
target: 我和妹妹都是在这里出生的。

source: Ah. Then by reputation, you are that one they call Lord Laertes.
target: 啊。那照我听来的说，你就是那位雷欧提斯大人了。

source: I've seen your father. Pale little man. So I must admit, you fascinate me.
target: 我见过你父亲。一个肤色苍白的小个子。所以我得承认，我对你很好奇。

source: You're not the first to be curious. If you must know, my mother was a foreigner.
target: 你不是第一个好奇的人。既然你一定要知道，我母亲是外国人。

source: Of course. Hard to imagine she wouldn't be.
target: 当然。很难想象她不是。

source: What was it like, living with a father like that?
target: 和那样的父亲一起生活，是什么感觉？

source: He wanted—wants—to protect us. Sometimes that protection became unbearable.
target: 他以前想——现在也想——保护我们。有时那种保护让人难以忍受。

source: Often, as a boy, I would ask him why we looked strange, my sister and I. He always feigned confusion.
target: 小时候，我常常问他，为什么我们长得和别人不一样，我和妹妹。他总是装作不明白。

source: And his feigned confusion frightened me. I wondered if he didn't truly see that we were different.
target: 他那副装出来的不解让我害怕。我怀疑，他是不是真的没看出我们和别人不一样。

source: Because... others did.
target: 因为……别人都看出来了。

source: I've been called every horrid thing under the sun, in whispered breath or behind a lifted palm.
target: 世上所有难听的话，我都被骂过。他们或是低声嘀咕，或是抬手掩着嘴说。

source: Sometimes, when I wander through town, I'll find a stone skidded against my leg from afar, or hear the jeering of children.
target: 有时我在镇上闲逛，会有石头从远处滑过来，撞在我腿上，或是听见孩子们的嘲笑。

source: But I am who I am. I refuse to hide.
target: 可我就是我。我不会躲起来。

source: Oh, yes. I'm well familiar.
target: 哦，是啊。我再熟悉不过了。

source: We draw quite a crowd, don't we? But where there's numbers, there's strength.
target: 我们总能引来不少人围观，是吧？不过，人多就有力量。

source: And there's fear.
target: 也有恐惧。

source: Look around. Everyone's leaving the bar.
target: 看看周围。大家都在离开酒馆。

source: That'll be my doing, I'm afraid.
target: 恐怕是因为我。

source: Well. Those same townsfolk drop coins into my till every night by the dozen to have me pour their beer.
target: 嗯。就是这些镇民，每晚为了让我给他们倒啤酒，成打的钱币往我的钱匣里放。

source: They may be nervous now, but they'll be back tonight. This is the cheapest place they can drink. And then—my bar, my rules.
target: 他们现在也许不自在，但今晚还会回来的。这里是他们喝酒最便宜的地方。到时候——我的酒馆，我定规矩。

source: So much as the smallest smirk or slur is dropped, they're out of my establishment forever. By my own hand.
target: 只要露出一点嘲笑，或是说出一句侮辱的话，就永远别再进我的店。我会亲自把人赶出去。

source: I cannot promise that the world outside is kind, my lord.
target: 大人，我不能保证外面的世界会善待你。

source: But in here, things are different. At least for now.
target: 但在这里，事情不一样。至少目前如此。

source: If you would ever come to play by the fire a while, you would be in good hands and good company.
target: 你哪天要是愿意来炉火旁弹上一会儿琴，这里有人照应你，也有人陪伴你。

source: Bring your own lute next time. We'll play a ditty or three together.
target: 下次带上你自己的鲁特琴。我们一起弹上几首小曲。

source: You have my thanks. I shall consider the offer most intently.
target: 谢谢你。我会认真考虑你的邀请。

source: Claudius and Hamlet ran to the chapel. They looked upset. I ought to pay them a visit.
target: 克劳狄斯和哈姆雷特跑去礼拜堂了。他们看起来很难过。我该去看看他们。

source: Ah. Ophelia. You're back at last.
target: 啊。奥菲莉娅。你终于回来了。

source: I'd heard your ship was returned to port...
target: 我听说你的船被送回港口了……

source: And so was yours, it seems.
target: 看来你的船也是。

source: Ophelia. I've returned.
target: 奥菲莉娅。我回来了。

source: So soon? Oughtn't you to be in Paris by now?
target: 这么快？你现在不是应该已经到巴黎了吗？

source: I was at port in Aalborg when I heard the news. About everything happening back here, that is.
target: 听到消息时，我还在奥尔堡的港口。我是说，这里发生的这一切。

source: The situation in Elsinore has deteriorated quickly.
target: 埃尔西诺的局势恶化得很快。

source: Are you all right? No one's harmed you?
target: 你还好吗？没人伤害你吧？

source: I'm safe, for now.
target: 我目前还安全。

source: There's work to be done, and I intend to act swiftly.
target: 还有事情要做，我打算尽快行动。

source: Good. Then there's work to be done, and I intend to act swiftly.
target: 那就好。既然如此，还有事情要做，我打算尽快行动。

source: Father wrote me a letter, you know. He explained everything.
target: 你知道吗，父亲给我写了一封信。他把一切都解释了。

source: About Hamlet's attempt on his life. I doubt that Hamlet could have acted alone.
target: 说了哈姆雷特企图杀他的事。我不相信哈姆雷特能独自做出这种事。

source: And what do you intend to do about it?
target: 那你打算怎么做？

source: Ensure no one can ever threaten my family again.
target: 确保再也没人能威胁我的家人。

source: In the wake of his death, I have to imagine Hamlet acting against Father was not his own doing. Someone spurred him.
target: 他死后，我不得不猜想，哈姆雷特对父亲下手，并不是出于他自己的意思。有人煽动了他。

source: I intend to raise arms against this sea of troubles.
target: 我要拿起武器，抗击这无边的苦难。

source: I heard about what happened to Father. How Hamlet brutalized him.
target: 我听说了父亲的遭遇。哈姆雷特是怎么残忍地伤害他的。

source: But I cannot believe Hamlet acted alone. Someone spurred him.
target: 但我无法相信哈姆雷特是独自做的。有人煽动了他。

source: Even with Hamlet dead, the matter is not handled. And I intend to pursue it to its root.
target: 即使哈姆雷特死了，这件事也没有了结。我打算追查到底。

source: Father's gone, but we're still here. I'm concerned about your safety in all this.
target: 父亲不在了，但我们还在。这一切让我担心你的安全。

source: I heard about the circumstances around Hamlet's death.
target: 我听说了哈姆雷特死亡前后的情况。

source: I've come back to understand. And to sort through what's left.
target: 我回来是想弄清楚。也想理一理剩下的事。

source: That is to say, here, by the fire. I'm not ready to return to Elsinore just yet.
target: 我是说，留在这里，炉火旁。我还没准备好回埃尔西诺。

source: Thank you for coming swiftly. He's gone too far this time, Bernardo. Hamlet, I mean.
target: 谢谢你这么快就来了。贝尔纳多，他这次太过分了。我是说哈姆雷特。

source: Threatening Father's life-- he nearly killed the man.
target: 他威胁父亲的性命——差一点就杀了父亲。

source: You were there, were you not? I heard you rendered Hamlet unconscious. Prevented further bloodshed.
target: 你当时在场，对吧？我听说你把哈姆雷特打昏了。阻止了更多流血。

source: I was. I am uncertain what would have transpired had your sister not alerted me to the situation.
target: 是的。要不是你妹妹把情况告诉我，我不知道会发生什么。

source: That's why this has to end. I need you to help me, old friend.
target: 所以这件事必须结束。老朋友，我需要你帮我。

source: Will you ensure Hamlet is properly contained and brought to justice?
target: 你能确保哈姆雷特被严加看管，并受到应有的惩处吗？

source: I don't mean rotting in a cell. I mean gone. For good.
target: 我不是要他在牢里烂掉。我是要他消失。永远消失。

source: He's gone to England. What would you have me do? Hasn't he been punished sufficiently?
target: 他已经去英格兰了。你还要我怎么做？他受的惩罚还不够吗？

source: No. I want him dead, no matter whose soil he walks on. I know your family must have some connections.
target: 不够。无论他踏在哪个国家的土地上，我都要他死。我知道你家一定有些人脉。

source: Laertes, I'm afraid it is not so simple.
target: 雷欧提斯，恐怕事情没那么简单。

source: For all that Hamlet is not in his right mind as of late, the incident with your father was an accident.
target: 哈姆雷特最近确实神志不清，可你父亲的事是个意外。

source: He believed his uncle was behind the curtain in the Queen's bedroom, spying on him.
target: 他以为是他叔叔躲在王后卧室的帘子后面，监视他。

source: He never intended your father any direct harm. It was horrific, yes, but not a meditated act.
target: 他从没打算直接伤害你父亲。这件事的确很可怕，但并非蓄意为之。

source: Surely you cannot mean...
target: 你该不会是说……

source: That you intend to let Hamlet walk free as a result?
target: 就因为这样，你打算让哈姆雷特逍遥法外？

source: At this stage, I fear having Hamlet executed would only exacerbate the tension in Elsinore, not improve it.
target: 眼下处决哈姆雷特，恐怕只会加剧埃尔西诺的紧张局势，无法缓解它。

source: It appeared to be a regrettable incident, but a one-time incident nonetheless.
target: 这似乎是一件令人遗憾的事，但终究只是一次孤立的事件。

source: You-- you're my best friend. The man whose heart I believed in most ardently.
target: 你——你是我最好的朋友。我最深信不疑的，就是你的真心。

source: How can you stand here and defend my father's attacker?
target: 你怎么能站在这里，为伤害我父亲的人辩护？

source: You understand the great love I bear for you and your family, Laertes. Always have. Always will.
target: 雷欧提斯，你知道我对你和你的家人有多深的感情。过去如此，将来也如此。

source: I am the Captain of the Guard. It is not my place to mete out punishment and retribution and righteous judgement.
target: 我是卫队长。惩罚、报复和正义的裁决，都不是我的职责。

source: It is my place to keep as many people alive as I possibly can, and to maintain the sanctity of the state of Denmark.
target: 我的职责，是尽我所能让更多人活下去，维护丹麦这个国家的神圣尊严。

source: You're a man of God. Isn't it said in Matthew, 'An eye for an eye, and tooth for tooth'?
target: 你是信奉上帝的人。《马太福音》不是说过，‘以眼还眼，以牙还牙’吗？

source: Of course. But that is only the first line of that passage.
target: 当然。但那只是那段经文的第一句。

source: '...But I say unto you, that ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.'
target: ‘……但我告诉你们，不要与恶人作对；有人打你的右脸，连另一边也转过来由他打。’

source: It continues, 'Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you.'
target: 后面还说，‘要爱你们的仇敌，祝福那诅咒你们的人，善待那恨你们的人。’

source: I will not stand here and let Hamlet threaten all I hold dear.
target: 我绝不会站在这里，任由哈姆雷特威胁我珍视的一切。

source: If you won't stop him, rest assured that if he ever sets foot on Danish soil again, I will. Farewell.
target: 如果你不肯阻止他，那你放心，只要他有朝一日再次踏上丹麦的土地，我就会动手。告辞。

source: If you won't stop him, rest assured, I will. Farewell.
target: 如果你不肯阻止他，那你放心，我会动手。告辞。

source: You summoned me, my lord?
target: 陛下，您召见我？

source: Ah. Polonius. Come in.
target: 啊。波洛涅斯。进来吧。

source: So. Laertes is staying in Elsinore indefinitely, at least for the time being.
target: 那么，雷欧提斯要留在埃尔西诺了，归期未定，至少暂时是这样。

source: What are your thoughts on the matter?
target: 你对此有什么看法？

source: At first I was concerned, but now I find something rather timely in it.
target: 起初我有些担心，但现在觉得，他留下来倒正是时候。

source: Well. The mood has certainly shifted in the castle suddenly, don't you think?
target: 嗯。城堡里的气氛突然变了不少，你不觉得吗？

source: So much has happened in such a short time.
target: 这么短的时间里，发生了这么多事。

source: Mmm. I see.
target: 嗯。我明白了。

source: Polonius, do you often play chess?
target: 波洛涅斯，你常下国际象棋吗？

source: I must admit, I haven't quite kept my tactician's instincts sharp! Fancy a match?
target: 我得承认，我这运筹帷幄的本事有些生疏了！想来一局吗？

source: Of course, of course. I used to be quite the thorn in your brother's side, you know.
target: 当然，当然。你知道，我从前可没少让你哥哥头疼。

source: Don't think he beat me a single game in the last three years of his life--Hoh!
target: 我想，他生前最后三年，没赢过我一局——哈！

source: And that's after his chess tutor from Naples was through with him.
target: 那还是他跟那位那不勒斯来的棋艺老师学完之后呢。

source: Let's test your mettle, then. I'll give you first move.
target: 那就让我试试你的本事。你先走。

source: As always, I open with a pawn to center.
target: 跟往常一样，我先把兵走到中央。

source: And so shall I.
target: 我也一样。

source: Then where from here? Where, indeed. Hmm...
target: 接下来往哪儿走呢？到底往哪儿走。嗯……

source: I don't like to play sober, I'll admit. Shall I pour us a drink or two?
target: 说实话，我不喜欢滴酒不沾地下棋。要不要我倒点酒，咱们喝上一两杯？

source: But of course, but of course.
target: 当然好，当然好。

source: Ah, I quite like this opening. And here's my knight.
target: 啊，我很喜欢这个开局。接下来我走马。

source: Hmm. Let me think a moment.
target: 嗯。让我想一想。

source: Polonius, why did your son truly cancel his voyage?
target: 波洛涅斯，你儿子取消航行，真正的原因是什么？

source: Urgh... excuse me. I feel-- it's a little stifling in here, isn't it? Allow me to stand a moment and catch my breath.
target: 呃……失礼了。我觉得——这里有点闷，是吧？请容我站起来缓口气。

source: Didn't you know I'd hear of his return the minute he stepped foot on the dock? Didn't you think word would carry?
target: 你难道不知道，他一踏上码头，我就会听到他回来的消息？你没想过消息会传开吗？

source: The little conversation he had with that barkeep in town. How angry he seemed. How full of fire.
target: 他和镇上那个酒馆老板聊的那几句。他看起来多么愤怒。多么怒火中烧。

source: I don't understand. When did this conversation happen? What barkeep?
target: 我不明白。他们什么时候聊的？哪个酒馆老板？

source: Let's drop the pretenses. I know you brought Laertes here to run me out of my own kingdom, or else run me through.
target: 别装了。我知道你把雷欧提斯叫回来，是想把我赶出我自己的王国，或者一剑刺死我。

source: You think to put him on the throne over me. I saw through your move the minute he returned.
target: 你想让他取代我坐上王位。他回来的那一刻，我就看穿了你这步棋。

source: My lord, it's so hot in here, my throat is... it's tightening.
target: 陛下，这里太热了，我的喉咙……越来越紧了。

source: Can we not go outside into the fresh air?
target: 我们不能去外面透透气吗？

source: No, we can't.
target: 不，不能。

source: You tried to play me for a fool.
target: 你想把我当傻子耍。

source: You may think me a doddering, incompetent version of my brother. But allow me to assure you: I am much more.
target: 你或许觉得，我不过是个比我哥哥更老迈、更无能的国王。但我可以告诉你：我远不止如此。

source: (I thought I'd saved him. What a fool I am.)
target: （我还以为我救了他。我真傻。）

source: (But if I reveal myself, he'll only kill me, too.)
target: （可如果我现身，他只会把我也杀了。）

source: And unlike him, I'll do whatever vile thing I must in order to keep my country.
target: 而且我跟他不同，为了保住我的国家，我什么卑鄙的事都做得出来。

source: What a shame it is, that you should pass away in such an undignified manner.
target: 你竟要以这么不体面的方式死去，真是可惜。

source: (T-that vial--Where is it?)
target: （那、那个小瓶——在哪儿？）

source: Something amiss, my lord?
target: 陛下，有什么不对吗？

source: No. Nothing at all. Only... you must excuse me, Polonius.
target: 没有。什么事也没有。只是……波洛涅斯，恕我失陪。

source: I've just remembered I promised to meet with someone here in a moment.
target: 我刚想起来，我约了人，马上要在这里见面。

source: It's a private meeting.
target: 这是一次私下会面。

source: Ah. I... see. I'll take my leave, then.
target: 啊。我……明白了。那我就告退了。

source: Yes, I think that's wise.
target: 是的，我想这样很明智。

source: Guards! Guards, to me, to me!
