target: 卫兵！卫兵，过来，快过来！

source: My King? What's happened?
target: 陛下？出什么事了？

source: How... who ransacked my personal belongings?
target: 怎么……是谁翻了我的私人物品？

source: Someone must know. About me. About my brother.
target: 一定有人知道了。关于我。关于我哥哥。

source: Lord Polonius collapsed during our game. He's not breathing.
target: 波洛涅斯大人下棋时突然倒下了。他已经没了呼吸。

source: I shouldn't be here. They'll find me.
target: 我不该在这里。他们会找到我的。

source: I shouldn't be here. He'll find me.
target: 我不该在这里。他会找到我的。

source: Lady Ophelia. Surely you've seen her?
target: 奥菲莉娅女士。你总该见过她吧？

source: Guildenstern. She slipped away at some point, and I cannot find her.
target: 吉尔登斯吞。她不知道什么时候悄悄走了，我找不到她。

source: Please, will you watch for me? If you see her, tell me.
target: 拜托，你能帮我留意一下吗？要是见到她，就告诉我。

source: It's-- it's extraordinarily unusual for her to not tell me where she's gone.
target: 这——她竟然没告诉我去了哪里，这实在太反常了。

source: The last time it happened... was when Hamlet spurned her, years ago. I almost lost her then.
target: 上一次这样……还是几年前哈姆雷特拒绝她的时候。那次我差点就失去了她。

source: But this must be something else. Something she never told me. I'm afraid.
target: 但这次一定是别的事。是她从没告诉过我的事。我很害怕。

source: I-- I don't mean to trouble you. I apologize. I'll take my leave of you now.
target: 我——我不是有意打扰你。抱歉。我这就告辞。

source: What brings you down here, my lord?
target: 陛下，您怎么到这里来了？

source: Something delicate.
target: 有件棘手的事。

source: I have a favor to ask of you.
target: 我想请你帮个忙。

source: And what are you asking me to take care of now?
target: 这次又要我替您处理什么？

source: I'm ordering you to keep it private.
target: 我命令你保密。

source: It's something my wife cannot know about. Not yet. Not now. I'll tell her, but in my own time.
target: 这件事不能让我妻子知道。还不行。现在不行。我会告诉她，但得由我决定什么时候说。

source: I fear with the state she's in, this letter would only send her reeling into the abyss.
target: 以她现在的状态，我怕这封信只会让她跌入深渊。

source: You've threatened me in the past. What makes you believe I have any obligation to be discreet?
target: 您以前威胁过我。凭什么觉得我有义务替您保密？

source: Because of the love you bear for my wife, I should hope.
target: 我希望，是因为你对我妻子的爱。

source: This would be the end of her. Think on that, and keep this among your belongings.
target: 这会毁了她。想想这一点，把它收在你的私人物品里。

source: Do your men have a particular habit of snooping in your things?
target: 你的手下很喜欢偷翻你的东西吗？

source: They each understand the kind of severe and unrelenting punishment I would levy on them.
target: 他们每个人都清楚，我会如何严惩他们，绝不留情。

source: It's safe here, for now.
target: 暂时放在这里很安全。

source: Wah hah hah! That's the Bernardo I know.
target: 哇哈哈！这才是我认识的贝尔纳多。

source: Good. It's settled, then. I'll return to you in time, when I'm ready to show her what's written inside.
target: 好。那就这么定了。等我准备好让她看信里的内容时，我会再来找你。

source: Father. I've come to take you from this place.
target: 父亲。我来带您离开这里。

source: Unlock the door.
target: 把门锁打开。

source: What's happening? Who's there? I can hardly see.
target: 怎么回事？谁在那里？我几乎看不清。

source: Allow me to help you out, Lord Polonius.
target: 波洛涅斯大人，让我扶您出去。

source: Has the King determined my fate?
target: 国王已经决定如何处置我了吗？

source: Claudius? Truly? Then why are you here?
target: 克劳狄斯？真的？那你们为什么会来这里？

source: I did not believe the King's order to imprison you was done in good faith, or out of a genuine need for security.
target: 我不认为国王下令囚禁您是出于善意，也不认为真有什么安全上的必要。

source: It appeared he did this simply to punish you. In light of his passing, I would like to restore you to a place of dignity.
target: 看来他这么做只是为了惩罚您。如今他已去世，我想让您重新得到应有的尊重。

source: Of course, I will still expect your compliance in all matters of state. But for now, you are free.
target: 当然，在一切国事上，我仍然要求您服从。不过现在，您自由了。

source: Thank you. Thank you all.
target: 谢谢。谢谢你们所有人。

source: Laertes, please have the servants bring food and water. I have felt such a chill these last few days. All my strength has left me.
target: 雷欧提斯，请让仆人送些食物和水来。这几天我冷得厉害，浑身一点力气都没有了。

source: God's wounds, I thought I would die in there.
target: 天哪，我以为自己会死在里面。

source: Suspected I might find you here.
target: 我猜在这里可能找得到你。

source: I heard a little something from Ophelia, and had the thought to seek you out.
target: 我从奥菲莉娅那里听说了一点事，就想来找你。

source: A 'little something?' Very discriminating of you to reveal your source!
target: “一点事”？连消息来源都说出来了，你可真谨慎！

source: I want to ask about you and Hamlet. I rather suspect you won't want to be asked, which only makes the asking more worthwhile.
target: 我想问问你和哈姆雷特的事。我猜你多半不想被问起，这就更值得问了。

source: Your assessment is correct.
target: 你判断得没错。

source: I understand some of this may be painful for you now that Hamlet's gone.
target: 哈姆雷特已经不在了，我知道现在提起其中一些事，可能会让你痛苦。

source: But I also know-- or suspect-- that you are not someone who collapses under his grief.
target: 但我也知道——或者说，猜想——你不是那种会被悲伤击垮的人。

source: Correct again.
target: 又说对了。

source: As I recall, you remained close to his side for quite a long time, didn't you?
target: 我记得你陪在他身边很长时间了，对吧？

source: After all, when Guildenstern and I met you, Hamlet had already been at school for a year. And your presence in his life predated that.
target: 毕竟，吉尔登斯吞和我认识你的时候，哈姆雷特已经入学一年了。而在那之前，你就已经在他身边了。

source: When did you first begin following him around?
target: 你最初是什么时候开始跟着他的？

source: You make me sound like a little lap dog.
target: 你把我说得像只小宠物狗。

source: Aren't you?
target: 难道不是吗？

source: I began following Hamlet after the last war with Norway came to its conclusion, when Hamlet's father drove his blade through Fortinbras the Elder's heart.
target: 我开始跟随哈姆雷特，是在上一次与挪威的战争结束之后。那时，哈姆雷特的父亲一剑刺穿了老福丁布拉斯的心脏。

source: I was a soldier then, but never fancied myself a career military man.
target: 我当时是个士兵，但从没想过一辈子当军人。

source: Too much work. Not enough job security. And a poor use of my excellent taste in food, wine, and art.
target: 活儿太多。饭碗不够稳。而且我在美食、美酒和艺术上的绝佳品味也派不上用场。

source: King Hamlet, seeing that I was something of a learned man, made a request of me.
target: 哈姆雷特国王看出我多少有些学识，便向我提了个请求。

source: Hamlet was to be educated at Wittenberg soon. But Hamlet's father was worried about him.
target: 哈姆雷特不久就要去威滕贝格求学了。但他的父亲很不放心。

source: Of course, you remember what Hamlet was like before his father's death.
target: 当然，你也记得哈姆雷特在父亲去世之前是什么样子。

source: He was wild in a different sort of way then. I remember him diving nude into the Elbe river in midwinter.
target: 那时候他也很疯，只是疯法不一样。我记得他在隆冬时光着身子跳进了易北河。

source: And then he called out to us to join him...
target: 然后还喊我们一起下去……

source: Which of course we were never going to do. What was he thinking?
target: 我们当然绝不可能下去。他到底在想什么？

source: None of us ever really knew. And now it's too late to find out.
target: 我们谁都没真正弄明白过。现在再想知道，已经太迟了。

source: That's really Hamlet in a nut shell. One never knows what he's thinking.
target: 哈姆雷特这个人，说到底就是这样。谁也不知道他在想什么。

source: So King Hamlet sent you along to Wittenberg to watch over Hamlet. Is that it?
target: 所以哈姆雷特国王派你一起去威滕贝格，照看哈姆雷特。是这样吗？

source: Yes. That's it.
target: 对。就是这样。

source: Unlike other trusted men in the King's employ, Hamlet and I were not so dissimilar in age that it would appear strange for me to accompany him.
target: 我和国王手下其他受信任的人不同，跟哈姆雷特的年纪相差不大，陪着他也不会显得奇怪。

source: And Hamlet was well aware of my role. He and I disliked one another immensely at first. I found him far too bold a flavor for my tastes, and he found my very presence stifling.
target: 哈姆雷特也很清楚我的职责。起初，我们俩都非常讨厌对方。我觉得他这道菜味道太冲，不合我的口味，而他觉得只要我在，就让他喘不过气。

source: But over time, we developed a healthy respect for one another. That respect became trust, and that trust became friendship.
target: 但日子久了，我们渐渐懂得了尊重彼此。尊重变成了信任，信任又变成了友谊。

source: Just friendship?
target: 只是友谊？

source: What are you implying?
target: 你在暗示什么？

source: I want to leave no room for misinterpretation. After all, in many places, your mere insinuations could have me executed.
target: 我不想留下任何误解的余地。毕竟，在很多地方，光凭你这些暗示，就可能让我被处死。

source: Horatio, you ought to know me better than that. How many of my lady loves did you meet at Wittenberg?
target: 霍拉旭，你应该更了解我才对。在威滕贝格，你见过多少位我的女情人？

source: That's why I'm here. I knew I needed to speak with you if no one else would.
target: 所以我才来这里。我知道，如果别人都不肯，我就得来跟你谈谈。

source: So that's what this is about.
target: 原来你是为了这个。

source: Fine. If you must hear it, let me say it, then. I came to love Hamlet.
target: 好吧。如果你非要听，那我就说。我爱上了哈姆雷特。

source: I've never said it to anyone else, least of all to him.
target: 我从没对别人说过，更别说对他。

source: And now I never shall.
target: 现在，我再也没机会说了。

source: And he spent all these years not knowing?
target: 这么多年，他一直都不知道？

source: Well, I wouldn't say that. Just that I've never said the words.
target: 嗯，也不能这么说。我只是从没把那句话说出口。

source: There was... one evening. The both of us were staggeringly drunk. And the night got away from us, so to speak.
target: 有过……那么一个晚上。我们俩都醉得站不稳。可以说，那晚的事有些失控。

source: I thought--
target: 我以为——

source: I thought to myself the next morning: If he cares for you as you do him, he'll say something.
target: 第二天早上，我心想：如果他也像你爱他一样爱你，他会说些什么的。

source: But he never did.
target: 可他一直没说。

source: And so, neither did I. And the silence just sort of stretched all these years.
target: 于是，我也没说。这份沉默就这么持续了许多年。

source: You've been carrying the weight of something like this all alone. It must have been heavy.
target: 你一直独自背负着这样的事，一定很沉重。

source: Have you ever thought of sharing it with him?
target: 你有没有想过跟他说说？

source: I-- I have. But I am afraid, in my heart of hearts.
target: 我——我想过。但说心里话，我很害怕。

source: His life is full of so much darkness right now. He's in the worst place I've ever seen him. How can I contribute to that?
target: 他现在的生活已经够黑暗了。我从没见他这么糟糕过。我怎么能再给他添负担？

source: Horatio, I'm no expert when it comes to matters of social finesse, as you've no doubt witnessed. But there's one thing I know for certain.
target: 霍拉旭，我不擅长与人打交道时那些巧妙的手腕，这你肯定也见识过。但有一件事，我很确定。

source: You cannot shoulder this burden forever, waiting for a 'right moment' which may never arrive.
target: 你不能永远背着这个包袱，等一个可能永远不会到来的“合适时机”。

source: You've got to be earnest with Hamlet. What is it they say? Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
target: 你一定要向哈姆雷特坦白。那句话怎么说的？你们必认识真理，真理必使你们自由。

source: I have been afraid of this too long, and for what reason?
target: 我害怕这件事太久了，可到底是为什么？

source: I never thought myself a man who avoided the difficult conversations.
target: 我从不觉得自己是个会逃避难以启齿的话题的人。

source: So you'll speak with him?
target: 所以，你会去跟他谈？

source: If my lady suggests it.
target: 既然女士这么建议。

source: Then who am I to refuse?
target: 那我又怎好拒绝？

source: Thank you, Rosencrantz.
target: 谢谢你，罗森克兰兹。

source: Any time. Any time at all. I hope the conversation runs to its due course.
target: 随时都可以。无论什么时候。我希望你们能把该说的话都说清楚。

source: I-- I have. But something happened to him recently. I don't know that he even sees me when he looks at me, right now.
target: 我——我想过。但他最近出了些事。现在他看着我的时候，我都不知道他是不是真的看见了我。

source: His mind's fully gone.
target: 他已经完全失去理智了。

source: Then-- don't carry this alone. Let me carry it with you.
target: 那——别一个人扛着。让我和你一起分担。

source: Guilda and I are going to depart Elsinore soon. Circumstances being what they are, it simply feels like the right time to move on.
target: 吉尔达和我很快就要离开埃尔西诺了。如今情况变成这样，我们觉得是时候继续往前走了。

source: Won't you come with us?
target: 你不和我们一起走吗？

source: I-- I suppose I could. This place holds no meaning to me anymore without him.
target: 我——我想也可以。没有他，这个地方对我已经没有意义了。

source: Where will you go?
target: 你们打算去哪儿？

source: We've no idea. We never do. Perhaps we'll go somewhere a little warmer to shake the chill that's descended here.
target: 我们不知道。向来都不知道。也许会去个暖和一点的地方，摆脱笼罩这里的寒意。

source: That's all I needed to hear.
target: 听到这句就够了。

source: Consider me intrigued. But give me time to think upon it.
target: 我有些心动了。不过给我点时间考虑一下。

source: I think it took saying all this out loud to understand for myself what I needed to do.
target: 我想，只有把这些话说出口，我才能明白自己该做什么。

source: You have my thanks for being the echo I needed.
target: 谢谢你，给了我所需要的回应。

source: Any time.
target: 随时都可以。

source: Let me carry it with you.
target: 让我和你一起分担。

source: Guilda and I are going to depart Elsinore soon, now that Hamlet's gone.
target: 如今哈姆雷特不在了，吉尔达和我很快就要离开埃尔西诺。

source: Mind an interruption?
target: 介意我打扰一下吗？

source: From you? Never.
target: 是你？永远不会。

source: I see. Excellent. I have something to-- ah-- to discuss with you.
target: 明白了。太好了。我有件事想——啊——想跟你谈谈。

source: What's wrong? You're trembling.
target: 怎么了？你在发抖。

source: Has some new horror taken place?
target: 又发生什么可怕的事了？

source: No. No, it's nothing like that.
target: 没有。没有，不是那样的事。

source: I wanted to ask you about the past. There's something that's been on my mind for quite a while now.
target: 我想问你一些过去的事。有件事在我心里放了很久。

source: Do you remember that night in Wittenberg, during that first year?
target: 你还记得在威滕贝格第一年时的那个晚上吗？

source: Perhaps. It all feels so distant now. What night do you mean?
target: 也许吧。现在想来，一切都那么遥远。你说的是哪一晚？

source: I think you know precisely what I mean. And I don't think either of us can hide from it anymore.
target: 我想你很清楚我指的是什么。而且我觉得，我们谁都不能再逃避了。

source: Horatio, you're talking nonsense. I don't remember that night.
target: 霍拉旭，你在胡说什么。我不记得那一晚了。

source: Let's go inside, shall we?
target: 我们进去吧，好吗？

source: Wait. Don't run from this. Please.
target: 等等。别逃避这件事。求你了。

source: This is all so serious! Must it be so serious? Why? Why can't we leave what happened in the past?
target: 这也太严肃了！非得这么严肃吗？为什么？为什么不能让过去的事留在过去？

source: Because I need to understand.
target: 因为我必须弄明白。

source: I think you know what I'm about to say.
target: 我想你知道我接下来要说什么。

source: I've been in love with you for a long time, Hamlet.
target: 我爱你很久了，哈姆雷特。

source: Haven't you got anything to say in response?
target: 你就没有什么话要回应我吗？

source: I... I don't know. This is sudden.
target: 我……我不知道。这太突然了。

source: Let's say that I did remember what happened that evening.
target: 就算我确实记得那晚发生的事。

source: Have I ever given you any indication of inappropriate feelings since then?
target: 在那之后，我有向你流露过任何不合适的感情吗？

source: Hamlet, what would be inappropriate about feelings like that?
target: 哈姆雷特，那样的感情有什么不合适？

source: I don't know, exactly. But I know that whatever happened between us, I have put it to rest in the echoes of the past.
target: 我也说不清。但我知道，不管我们之间发生过什么，我都已经让它沉寂在过去的回声里了。

source: And I don't think I ever had the capacity to feel whatever it is you're feeling now.
target: 而且我觉得，我从来就不曾有能力体会你现在的那种感情。

source: Then that's the answer to my question. We needn't belabor the point further.
target: 那我的问题就有答案了。我们不必再多说。

source: I know what it's like to love someone who doesn't care for you.
target: 我知道爱上一个不爱自己的人是什么滋味。

source: I know how painful that is. And if that's how you've been feeling all this time, then it must be agonizing.
target: 我知道那有多痛苦。如果你一直以来都是这种感受，那一定备受煎熬。

source: I am far too old to agonize over unrequited love. Lingering disappointment, on the other hand, is not beyond me.
target: 我早过了为单恋痛不欲生的年纪。不过，久久挥之不去的失望，我还是会有的。

source: Of course this isn't the answer I wanted to hear. But it's the answer I have.
target: 这当然不是我想听到的答案。但这是我得到的答案。

source: I do love you in a way. But it isn't like that, and it never will be.
target: 某种意义上，我确实爱你。但不是那种爱，也永远不会是。

source: Maybe... if I weren't who I am... if I weren't a Prince of Denmark... maybe things would be different.
target: 也许……如果我不是现在的我……如果我不是丹麦王子……也许一切会有所不同。

source: But what I am is solid, by circumstance of my birth. I can be no other man. And it means that some pieces of me must remain locked away forever.
target: 但我的身份生来就已注定。我无法成为另一个人。这意味着，我内心的某些部分必须永远锁起来。

source: I will always be your most ardent and faithful friend. But when it comes to matters of love, that's different.
target: 我永远都会是你最热忱、最忠诚的朋友。但爱情是另一回事。

source: You deserve someone who isn't me, Horatio.
target: 霍拉旭，你值得拥有另一个人，而不是我。

source: So that's it, then. That's how this ends.
target: 那就这样了。这就是结局。

source: Somehow I thought it'd be more than that. I played that conversation in my head a thousand times.
target: 不知为什么，我以为不会仅仅如此。这场对话，我在脑海里演过上千遍。

source: And in the end, I had my answer in just a scant few minutes.
target: 可到头来，只用了短短几分钟，我就得到了答案。

source: I've a new wound to nurse.
target: 我又有一道新伤要慢慢养了。

source: But still, I sense that this wound will heal faster.
target: 但我还是觉得，这道伤会好得更快。

source: And when it heals, perhaps finally it will be healed for good.
target: 等它愈合时，也许这一次终于能彻底痊愈。

source: You have returned.
target: 你回来了。

source: King Hamlet? Surely that can't be you.
target: 哈姆雷特国王？不可能真的是你吧。

source: It is.
target: 是我。

source: It's been a long time.
target: 好久不见了。

source: Has it?
target: 有那么久吗？

source: Or at least, I think-- I think I've been gone a long time.
target: 至少，我觉得——我觉得我已经离开很久了。

source: It felt like an instant between the last time I saw you and this awakening, now. I suppose I must have been waiting for you, then.
target: 从上次见到你，到此刻醒来，感觉只过了一瞬。那么，我想我一定是在等你。

source: It's good to see you. We make an odd pair, don't we? But I've got some unfinished business.
target: 见到你真好。我们这对搭档还真奇怪，不是吗？不过，我还有些事没办完。

source: Evidently so.
target: 显然如此。

source: Say, there isn't a mirror in here. What do I look like?
target: 对了，这里没有镜子。我现在是什么样子？

source: My hands-- they're so soft!
target: 我的手——竟然这么柔软！

source: You look just as you did then.
target: 你看起来和当时一模一样。

source: It's a funny thing, these young, delicate hands. I spent the rest of my life not knowing how strong these hands already were.
target: 这双年轻、纤细的手，真有意思。在那之后的余生里，我一直不知道，这双手当时就已经有多大的力量。

source: Glad to see death hasn't sapped you of your steel.
target: 很高兴，死亡没有磨掉你的坚毅。

source: Of course not. Where are we? When are we?
target: 当然没有。我们在哪儿？现在是什么时候？

source: This is the afterwards. Neither Heaven nor Hell. Simply the nothingness in between.
target: 这里是死后的所在。既非天堂，也非地狱。只是两者之间的虚无。

source: I came here for a reason, I think.
target: 我想，我是为了某件事才来这里的。

source: I have to go back to Elsinore.
target: 我得回埃尔西诺去。

source: Go back?
target: 回去？

source: Can you help me? Do you still know how to return?
target: 你能帮我吗？你还知道怎么回去吗？

source: Of course I do. But why would you consider such a thing?
target: 当然知道。但你为什么会有这种念头？

source: After all this time...
target: 都过了这么久……

source: You chose, Ophelia!
target: 你已经做出了选择，奥菲莉娅！

source: You left that world behind. Why now?
target: 你已经告别了那个世界。为什么现在又要回去？

source: What if I chose wrong?
target: 可要是我选错了呢？

source: What difference does that make?
target: 那又有什么区别？

source: An entire lifetime of difference!
target: 那是一整个人生的区别！

source: And a difference in the lives of all those people. What if there's a different world, a better world? Don't I owe them that?
target: 还有所有那些人的人生，都会不同。要是还有另一个世界，一个更好的世界呢？我难道不该为他们争取吗？

source: Ophelia. Do you know what I would give to have left Elsinore behind in life, even just once?
target: 奥菲莉娅。你知道，为了能在生前告别埃尔西诺，哪怕只有一次，我愿意付出多少吗？

source: That chance was stolen from me.
target: 那个机会被人从我手里夺走了。

source: Now you treat it as though it's something easily exchanged. As though you could put your life back on the shelf and choose another.
target: 现在，你却把它当成轻易就能换掉的东西。仿佛你可以把自己的人生放回架子上，再另选一个。

source: I know it's painful. I'm sorry to have woken you again. I wanted to let you rest-- I didn't know coming back would be like this.
target: 我知道这很痛苦。对不起，又把你唤醒了。我本想让你安息——我不知道回来会变成这样。

source: You know I'd never intend to hurt you, Hamlet.
target: 你知道，我绝不会有意伤害你，哈姆雷特。

source: Truth be told, I'm not even certain I should be re-opening the Book of Fates.
target: 说实话，我甚至不确定自己该不该重新打开命运之书。

source: If I cannot find another fate worth pursuing, I may simply let the matter rest and return to the world I had chosen after all.
target: 如果找不到另一种值得追求的命运，我也许就会就此作罢，最终还是回到我原先选择的世界。

source: I can always return here, can I not?
target: 我随时都能回到这里，不是吗？

source: No, no. There is something you do not understand about the threads of fate, I think. They are woven together as one, a transcendent tapestry.
target: 不，不。我想，关于命运的丝线，有些事你还不明白。它们交织为一体，成为一幅超越凡俗的织锦。

source: This is not a simple matter of browsing what might have been.
target: 这并不是随意看看那些本可能发生的事那么简单。

source: By choosing the world you did, you pulled that world's thread forever. If you choose to return to Elsinore, you cannot return to the path you chose.
target: 当你选择那个世界时，你就永久地牵动了那个世界的丝线。如果你选择回到埃尔西诺，就再也无法回到你选过的那条路。

source: You're saying...
target: 你的意思是……

source: Yes. In other words, you will not be able to return to that particular fate.
target: 是的。换句话说，你将再也无法回到那一种命运。

source: It is shattered. Gone. And once you set foot back in Elsinore, you will lose all memory of what you chose.
target: 它已经破碎了。消失了。而你一旦重新踏入埃尔西诺，就会失去关于自己所选命运的一切记忆。

source: Please. I urge you not to do this, Ophelia. I urge you with everything in my heart.
target: 求你了。奥菲莉娅，我恳求你不要这么做。我发自内心地恳求你。

source: It's not too late to turn back!
target: 现在回头还来得及！

source: Disregard King Hamlet's words and return to Elsinore?
target: 不听哈姆雷特国王的劝告，返回埃尔西诺？

source: Here you are yet again.
target: 你又一次来到了这里。

source: Perhaps. Perhaps not.
target: 也许是，也许不是。

source: What do you recall?
target: 你还记得什么？

source: Only that I came here at the end of my life. And I know now-- though I did not know in Elsinore-- that you and I have spoken here before, in this place.
target: 只记得我在生命结束时来到了这里。现在我知道了——虽然在埃尔西诺时并不知道——你我以前曾在这里，在这个地方交谈过。

source: This... in-between.
target: 这片……夹在两者之间的地方。

source: And what before that? What before we last spoke?
target: 那之前呢？在我们上次交谈之前呢？

source: I cannot remember.
target: 我想不起来。

source: Then it is as I warned you. You have no memory of the fate you chose before.
target: 那就和我警告过你的一样。你完全不记得自己先前选择的命运了。

source: That must be true.
target: 一定是这样。

source: Still, I think I returned to this place because I have to go back to Elsinore.
target: 可我想，我回到这里，是因为我必须回埃尔西诺去。

source: You already have.
target: 你已经回去过了。

source: And evidently, I didn't find what I was looking for.
target: 而显然，我没有找到我想找的东西。

source: Yes. Your return on that occasion brought you no more happiness than your first fate.
target: 是的。那次回去，并没有让你比在最初的命运中更幸福。

source: What leads you to believe that this attempt shall yield more fruitful results?
target: 是什么让你相信，这次尝试会有更好的结果？

source: Besides, if you return to Elsinore again, you will lose all memory of this fate, too.
target: 况且，如果你再次回到埃尔西诺，你也会失去关于这一次命运的一切记忆。

source: This past time... when you chose your fate... that me, that Hamlet, had no knowledge of this in-between place. Neither did you.
target: 上一次……当你选择命运时……那个我，那个哈姆雷特，对这片夹在两者之间的地方一无所知。你也一样。

source: That version of me believed we were still friends. But now, looking at you, my wits about me, I am not so certain.
target: 那个我相信，我们仍是朋友。但现在，我清醒地看着你，却不再那么确定了。

source: You need not continue, you know. Will you finally allow all of us to rest?
target: 你知道，你不必再继续。你终于肯让我们所有人安息了吗？

source: Or will you force the both of us to continue to endure this hell?
target: 还是说，你要逼我们两个继续忍受这地狱般的折磨？

source: I had thought you'd surely not return.
target: 我原以为你肯定不会再回来了。

source: I thought the same.
target: 我也这么想过。

source: You know, I cherish you dearly when I am pulled back to Elsinore.
target: 你知道，每当我被拉回埃尔西诺，我都十分珍惜你。

source: I have no memory of this place, this in-between.
target: 我完全不记得这里，不记得这片夹在两者之间的地方。

source: Then I am brought back here when you die, and I remember you chose to return me to Elsinore too, and it aches so terribly.
target: 然后，当你死去，我又被带回这里，想起是你选择把我也送回埃尔西诺，那痛楚实在难以承受。

source: I'm forcing you to wake up again every time I do this, aren't I?
target: 每次我这么做，都是在逼你再次醒来，是吗？

source: And this is the third time.
target: 而这已经是第三次了。

source: But I can remember living only one fate. Only the last.
target: 可我只记得自己经历过一种命运。只有最近的那一次。

source: Say, Hamlet-- what were those other fates I chose?
target: 对了，哈姆雷特——我选过的其他命运是什么样的？

source: Were they-- was I-- happier?
target: 那些命运里——我是不是——更幸福？

source: I suspected you would find yourself wondering this.
target: 我猜到你会问自己这个问题。

source: But I do not know. I do not see your life beyond Elsinore. I am not a god. Just a man, or what was once a man, standing here as confused as you.
target: 但我不知道。我看不到你离开埃尔西诺后的生活。我不是神。只是一个人，或者说，曾经是人的存在，站在这里，和你一样困惑。

source: Please, Ophelia.
target: 求你了，奥菲莉娅。

source: Do not return to Elsinore again.
target: 不要再回埃尔西诺了。

source: If ever you did love me, if ever you did find me worthy of your time... then you will join me here in the quiet of oblivion, and take up an eternal rest.
target: 如果你曾爱过我，如果你曾觉得我值得你花时间……那就留在这里，与我一同归于虚无的寂静，永远安息。

source: You know I do, Hamlet.
target: 你知道我爱你，哈姆雷特。

source: But I must have returned here for a reason. I think my work in Elsinore is not yet complete.
target: 可我回到这里，一定是有原因的。我想，我在埃尔西诺要做的事还没做完。

source: It will never be complete.
target: 那永远也做不完。

source: I urge you to understand this!
target: 我恳求你明白这一点！

source: I harbored a deep and impenetrable respect for you in life, Ophelia. Do not prove me a fool in death.
target: 奥菲莉娅，生前我对你的敬意深切而坚定。别在我死后，证明我只是个傻子。

source: Do not show me that everything we went through together was trivial compared to your pining for the impossible.
target: 别让我看到，我们一同经历的一切，比起你对不可能之事的渴望，竟然微不足道。

source: If you return to Elsinore again, you will again lose all memory of the fate you just chose, and you will not be able to choose it again. In other words...
target: 如果你再次回到埃尔西诺，你又会失去关于刚刚所选命运的一切记忆，也再不能选择它。换句话说……

source: I have a rather unpleasant choice to make, it seems.
target: 看来，我得做一个很难受的选择。

source: You are no better than him, you know.
target: 你知道，你并不比他好。

source: You have shown me already that, like him, you will not grant mercy.
target: 你已经让我看清，你和他一样，不肯给予怜悯。

source: We are simply playthings to you.
target: 我们对你而言，不过是玩物。

source: I must remind you, as you abandon the fate you last chose...
target: 在你放弃上一次选择的命运时，我必须提醒你……

source: Let me give you what you desire, then. The chance to find something else. Something 'better.'
target: 那就让我给你想要的吧。一个寻找别的命运的机会。某种“更好”的命运。

source: Let me give you what you came here for. We have nothing more to say to one another, after all.
target: 就让我给你来这里所求的东西吧。毕竟，我们之间已无话可说。

source: I've already made my decision. I want to return to Elsinore.
target: 我已经决定了。我要回埃尔西诺。

source: I'm sorry, Hamlet.
target: 对不起，哈姆雷特。

source: I never thought you were quite this stubborn in life.
target: 生前，我从没想过你竟然这么固执。

source: Nevertheless, I will show you the way back to Elsinore.
target: 尽管如此，我还是会为你指明回埃尔西诺的路。

source: I would be a fool not to listen to you.
target: 要是不听你的劝，我才是傻子。

source: You have my eternal thanks.
target: 我会永远感激你。

source: You are wiser and more merciful than that broken world ever deserved.
target: 你的智慧与仁慈，远远超出了那个破碎的世界所配得到的。

source: Let us go away now, Ophelia. Forever.
target: 我们走吧，奥菲莉娅。永远离开。

source: Couldn't agree more, my friend. Wherever we are...
target: 我再同意不过了，我的朋友。无论我们身在何处……

source: I think we've both earned that sleep of death, and whatever dreams may come.
target: 我想，我们都该享有死亡的长眠，以及随之而来的任何梦境了。

source: I must return to Elsinore again.
target: 我必须再回埃尔西诺。

source: I know nothing I could say would make it any less of a cruelty.
target: 我知道，无论我说什么，都无法让这件事少一点残忍。

source: I mourn the fate you leave behind, for certainly neither you nor I will recall it if we ever meet again.
target: 我为你舍弃的命运哀悼，因为如果我们还能再见，你我都必定不会记得它。

source: I've already made my decision. I want to return to Elsinore again. A third time.
target: 我已经决定了。我要再次回到埃尔西诺。第三次。

source: I'm sorry, Hamlet. I truly am.
target: 对不起，哈姆雷特。我真的很抱歉。

source: So be it. I hope we never meet again, then.
target: 那就这样吧。我希望我们永远不要再见。

source: And if we ever do, I shall no longer try to stand in your way.
target: 就算再见，我也不会再试着阻拦你。

source: Trying to save someone from pain is a courtesy one only extends to friends.
target: 试着让一个人免受痛苦，是只有朋友才能得到的关怀。

source: Wherever we are...
target: 无论我们身在何处……

source: Your time with Grace-- the adventures you embarked on-- will vanish.
target: 你与格蕾丝共度的时光——你经历的那些冒险——都将消失。

source: That sacrifice you made for the sake of others will have been meaningless, for there is no such similar path.
target: 你为他人做出的那份牺牲，将变得毫无意义，因为再没有类似的道路可走。

source: Your memory of the time you spent with Laertes and your father, both the good and bad, will vanish.
target: 你与雷欧提斯和父亲共度的时光，无论好坏，相关的记忆都将消失。

source: You will never again have the power to overturn nations at your whim. At least-- not in the same way.
target: 你将再也没有随心所欲颠覆诸国的力量。至少——无法再以同样的方式做到。

source: You will never again live out the rest of your life at Hamlet's side.
target: 你将再也无法陪在哈姆雷特身边度过余生。

source: That perfect world you created will shatter. And I will warn you now: No other fate you could choose could possibly live up to its happiness.
target: 你创造的那个完美世界将会破碎。现在我要警告你：你能选择的其他命运，没有任何一种能带来与它相当的幸福。

source: You will never again be able to guarantee that everyone in Elsinore survives.
target: 你将再也无法保证埃尔西诺的所有人都活下来。

source: You will forego the life you and Othello built together. And without leaving Elsinore with you, he is likely to be killed here.
target: 你将放弃你和奥赛罗一起建立的生活。而如果没有和你一起离开埃尔西诺，他很可能会在这里被杀。

source: You will never again have a future you built away from Elsinore, on your own, free of others' misery.
target: 你将再也无法拥有那个远离埃尔西诺、独自建立、不受他人苦难牵累的未来。

source: Never again will you settle down with Lady Guildenstern and Lady Rosencrantz, though you had found peace with them.
target: 你曾与吉尔登斯吞女士和罗森克兰兹女士一起找到了安宁，却将再也无法和她们一同安定下来。

source: There is no other world with such a peaceful existence for Elsinore as the one where Fortinbras was its true King.
target: 没有任何其他世界，能让埃尔西诺像福丁布拉斯成为它真正国王的那个世界一样安宁。

source: Hamlet and I were together for two years, in secret. In that time, he was... different. Happier. He had a sense of humor then. Neither of us had ever loved another before, but he treated me with respect and an unfailing kindness.
target: 我和哈姆雷特曾秘密交往了两年。那时，他……很不一样。更快乐。那时候他还很有幽默感。我们此前都没有爱过别人，但他尊重我，始终温柔地待我。

source: When the King was young, his older brother used to beat him severely, and he spent much of his life afraid of Hamlet. Is it any wonder Claudius despises young Hamlet, the spitting image of his tormentor?
target: 国王年轻时，哥哥常常狠狠地殴打他，他大半辈子都活在对哈姆雷特的恐惧之中。年轻的哈姆雷特与折磨他的人简直一模一样，克劳狄斯厌恶他，又有什么奇怪的呢？

source: My father is so loyal to the King that he's still keeping secrets on the King's behalf after King Hamlet's death. I worry it's going to bring Father nothing but trouble in the long term.
target: 父亲对国王实在太忠诚了，哈姆雷特国王死后，他仍在替国王保守秘密。我担心长此以往，这只会给父亲带来麻烦。

source: I managed to save Father's life. It seems that anytime Hamlet is distracted or prevented from meeting his mother after the play, Father is safe.
target: 我成功救下了父亲。看来，戏演完后，只要哈姆雷特被分散了注意力，或被阻止去见母亲，父亲就会平安无事。

source: Father goes to visit Mother's grave often. He still mourns her all the time. He tells me she'd be proud of the person I became. I hope that's true. I don't remember her, so all I know of her is what Father and Laertes tell me. Can you love someone you don't remember?
target: 父亲常去母亲的墓前。他仍然无时无刻不在怀念她。他告诉我，她会为如今的我感到骄傲。我希望这是真的。我不记得她，所以关于她的一切，都来自父亲和雷欧提斯的讲述。一个人能爱自己不记得的人吗？

source: I've learned that Laertes will choose to stay in Elsinore if he believes that going to Paris might expose someone he cares about to danger.
target: 我发现，如果雷欧提斯认为去巴黎可能会让他在乎的人陷入危险，他就会选择留在埃尔西诺。

source: I recently uncovered that my brother and Lady Brit are involved romantically, and have been for quite some time. It's understandable they want to keep the relationship a secret, given the various political pressures at play. I, er... stumbled in on them by mistake.
target: 我最近发现，哥哥和布莉特女士正在交往，而且已经有很长一段时间了。考虑到其中牵涉的种种政治压力，他们想保密也可以理解。我，呃……是不小心撞见他们的。

source: I recently uncovered that my brother and Brit are involved romantically, and have been for quite some time. It's understandable they want to keep the relationship a secret, given the various political pressures at play. I, er... stumbled in on them by mistake.
target: 我最近发现，哥哥和布莉特正在交往，而且已经有很长一段时间了。考虑到其中牵涉的种种政治压力，他们想保密也可以理解。我，呃……是不小心撞见他们的。

source: When it came down to sacrificing me or standing against the orders of every man above her, Brit tried to save me. All it took was getting to know her. Whatever our relationship was before, I know this now: Brit is not my enemy. She might even be my greatest ally.
target: 当布莉特必须在牺牲我与违抗所有上级男人的命令之间做出选择时，她试图救我。我所做的，不过是去了解她。无论我们以前是什么关系，现在我知道了：布莉特不是我的敌人。她甚至可能是我最强大的盟友。

source: Brit has no desire to be here at Elsinore; she seems deeply unhappy, as though something's weighing heavily upon her. Maybe it's time I got to know her better.
target: 布莉特根本不想待在埃尔西诺；她似乎很不开心，仿佛有什么沉重的心事。也许我该多了解她一些了。

source: I saw Bernardo performing in town today, as Katherine. I never knew. We grew up together, and I never knew. This doesn't change my feelings towards Bernardo, however she or he chooses to live in the future—but for now, the Bernardos in other worlds would clearly prefer to keep this information private.
target: 今天我看见贝尔纳多以凯瑟琳的身份在镇上表演。我从来都不知道。我们从小一起长大，我却从来都不知道。无论贝尔纳多今后选择以女性还是男性的身份生活，这都不会改变我对贝尔纳多的感情——但目前，其他世界里的贝尔纳多显然更希望保守这个秘密。

source: Bernardo is Catholic, and prays in the mornings sometimes. He's deeply private about his faith, especially in light of the recent burnings of churches around the country. His father was also a religious man.
target: 贝尔纳多是天主教徒，有时会在早晨祈祷。他对自己的信仰极为保密，尤其是最近全国各地发生了焚烧教堂的事。他的父亲也是个虔诚的人。

source: Horatio is religious, but he isn't Catholic or Lutheran. He called himself a 'heathen,' and claimed to worship 'devas' and 'asuras.' I'm not sure what that means.
target: 霍拉旭有宗教信仰，但他既不是天主教徒，也不是路德宗信徒。他自称“异教徒”，说自己崇拜“提婆”和“阿修罗”。我不太明白那是什么意思。

source: Thanks to me, Irma's quest to kick up a regular game of cards has finally succeeded. I hope she doesn't get in too much trouble with Bernardo when he inevitably finds out.
target: 多亏了我，伊尔玛想定期组织牌局的愿望终于实现了。贝尔纳多迟早会发现，希望到时她不会惹上太大的麻烦。

source: I learned that Irma had a daughter and a husband once. But that was a long time ago. The child died while she served as wet nurse for Gertrude. That must be why she feels such an incredible drive to protect her.
target: 我得知伊尔玛曾有过一个女儿和一个丈夫。但那已经是很久以前的事了。她给乔特鲁德当乳母时，自己的孩子去世了。她如此强烈地想要保护乔特鲁德，一定就是因为这个。

source: Quince is a traveling player who occasionally comes to put on productions at Elsinore Castle. He writes and performs all of his own material, often on short notice. I recall he was rather close once with the late King Hamlet, and was a favorite performer of his.
target: 奎因斯是个巡回演出的演员，偶尔会来埃尔西诺城堡上演戏剧。他的所有剧目都由自己编写、表演，而且经常是在接到临时通知后赶出来的。我记得他曾与已故的哈姆雷特国王十分亲近，也是国王最喜爱的演员之一。

source: Quince is somehow stuck outside the flow of time, like me. He's offered me his assistance in solving my way out of my own quandary. I hope I can ask him about anything I might encounter.
target: 奎因斯不知为何也和我一样，被困在时间流之外。他愿意帮我找到脱离困境的办法。我希望无论遇到什么事，都能向他请教。

source: I see. Quince isn't just repeating time along with me. He also seems to have some small ability to alter the flow of events. But if that's true, then why doesn't he just... alter his way out? Is he here for my sake?
target: 原来如此。奎因斯不只是在和我一起重复这段时间。他似乎还有一点改变事态发展的能力。但如果真是这样，他为什么不直接……改变事态，让自己脱身呢？他留在这里，是为了我吗？

source: When I found Quince in the gallery, he spoke in riddles. Something about the nature and structure of a tragic work. Of course I've read many of the great tragedies-- and it sometimes feels like I'm living one-- but what does all that have to do with my predicament?
target: 我在画廊找到奎因斯时，他说话像在打哑谜。说的似乎是悲剧作品的本质和结构。我当然读过许多伟大的悲剧——有时也觉得自己正身处一出悲剧之中——但这一切和我的困境有什么关系？

source: Marcellus has thirteen children, and grandchildren at that. I had no idea he was so-- er-- prolific. Then again, having to raise thirteen children would explain why nothing fazes him.
target: 马塞勒斯有十三个孩子，甚至还有孙辈。我真不知道他竟然这么——呃——能生。不过，养大十三个孩子，也就难怪他遇到什么都能泰然处之了。

source: I found King Hamlet's abandoned notes describing the end of his life. He was like me. But he gave up, and let madness consume him. He knew and understood everything that was happening around him-- his brother's plot against him, his wife turning from him-- and he couldn't stop it. Now he remains in Elsinore, neither alive nor fully dead. But why? Will that happen to me, too?
target: 我找到了哈姆雷特国王遗弃的笔记，里面记述了他生命最后阶段的经历。他和我一样。但他放弃了，任由疯狂吞噬了自己。他知道并理解身边发生的一切——弟弟对他的阴谋、妻子对他的疏远——却无法阻止。如今他仍留在埃尔西诺，既非活人，也未彻底死去。但这是为什么？我也会落得同样的下场吗？

source: King Hamlet appeared before me one final time. He told me that there will be no true ending, no right ending. There is no such thing as happiness. All that remains is my power to choose. He urged me to use it wisely. He said that whatever I do, I must use it. Not simply give up, as he did. And... he called me... his friend.
target: 哈姆雷特国王最后一次出现在我面前。他告诉我，不会有真正的结局，也不会有正确的结局。幸福这种东西并不存在。剩下的，只有我选择的权力。他劝我明智地运用它。他说，无论我做什么，都必须行使这份权力。不能像他一样，就这么放弃。而且……他称我为……他的朋友。

source: A New Beginning
target: 新的开始

source: I've woken up in my bed again, but things feel - different. Strange.
target: 我又在自己的床上醒来，但感觉一切——不一样了。很奇怪。

source: My father was waiting, as usual, but not to chastise me -- rather, to invite me to some sort of feast in the Great Hall. I'll need to join everyone there.
target: 父亲像往常一样等着我，但不是为了训斥我——而是邀请我去大厅参加一场宴会。我得去那里和大家会合。

source: I'd forgotten what it was like to see them all happy. This world -- this new world -- is this the world that would have been without the Book of Fates, without any of it?
target: 我都忘了，看见大家都开开心心是什么感觉。这个世界——这个新的世界——难道就是没有《命运之书》、没有这一切时，本该存在的世界吗？

source: Laertes is late
target: 雷欧提斯迟到了

source: someone heard a report
target: 有人听到了一则报告

source: Hamlet is staying
target: 哈姆雷特会留下

source: Hrm. I should probably check on the meal.
target: 嗯。我大概该去看看饭菜了。

source: This fire is—wahh! Hot! Hot! Too hot!
target: 这火——哇！烫！烫！太烫了！

source: Look at you, Irma, dancing around like a village idiot!
target: 瞧瞧你，伊尔玛，蹦来跳去的，活像村里的傻子！

source: Have some dignity!—But ooh, that pan...
target: 有点体面吧！——可哎哟，那口锅……

source: Nothing but the walls and the chapel this way.
target: 这边只有城墙和礼拜堂。

source: Father said Laertes was meeting with the King, did he not? He wouldn't be back there.
target: 父亲说雷欧提斯正在觐见国王，不是吗？他不会在那边。

source: No one is on the walls right now. I should look somewhere else.
target: 现在城墙上没人。我该去别处找找。

source: The King and Queen's private chambers are up that way. Laertes won't be up there.
target: 国王和王后的寝宫在那边楼上。雷欧提斯不会在那里。

source: Guard Captain Bernardo, give me your report.
target: 卫队长贝尔纳多，向我汇报。

source: Better give me the report again, Bernardo.
target: 贝尔纳多，还是再向我汇报一遍吧。

source: The Prince of Norway demands we surrender the north.
target: 挪威王子要求我们交出北方领土。

source: Surrender to Fortinbras? Hah! The balls of a stallion, that young prince!
target: 向福丁布拉斯让步？哈！那个年轻王子的卵蛋可真跟公马一样大！

source: Fortinbras claims the late King Hamlet, rest his soul, won those swamplands unjustly from his father.
target: 福丁布拉斯声称，已故的哈姆雷特国王——愿他的灵魂安息——从他父亲手中夺走那些沼泽地，手段并不公正。

source: My brother won them for Denmark, certainly, but with all the fairness afforded to war.
target: 我哥哥确实为丹麦赢得了那些土地，但就战争而言，他的手段再公正不过。

source: He can shed all the tears he likes for that swampland. I won't bother to hear his complaints.
target: 他爱为那片沼泽地掉多少眼泪，就掉多少吧。我懒得听他的抱怨。

source: Yes, my lord. We'll send our reply.
target: 是，陛下。我们会送去答复。

source: Dearest, what will we do if Fortinbras wages war on our lands regardless?
target: 亲爱的，要是福丁布拉斯仍执意向我们的领土开战，我们该怎么办？

source: We'll fight him head-on. He's an impetuous young boy—no more threat than a gadfly to our throne, my love.
target: 我们就正面迎战。他不过是个鲁莽的毛头小子——亲爱的，他对我们王位的威胁，也就和一只牛虻差不多。

source: That's how my brother would have done it!
target: 我哥哥也会这么做！

source: May he rest in peace.
target: 愿他安息。

source: Yes, yes, my brother's passed—but now is a time for Denmark's new glory. Now is the time for us to expand.
target: 是，是，我哥哥已经去世了——但现在是丹麦开创新辉煌的时候。是我们扩张的时候了。

source: With my lovely Queen by my side, we will be a force far beyond anything the northern lands have seen before!
target: 有我美丽的王后陪伴在侧，我们的力量将远远超越北方诸国以往所见！

source: Prince Fortinbras will not retreat easily. He is hot-headed—as his father was. He has a temper, my lord.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子不会轻易退让。他性情冲动——和他父亲一样。陛下，他脾气很暴躁。

source: Are you questioning my ability to provide for Denmark's battle plan when the time comes, Guard Captain Bernardo?
target: 卫队长贝尔纳多，你是在质疑我到时为丹麦制定作战计划的能力吗？

source: Not at all, my lord. Merely... suggesting.
target: 绝无此意，陛下。只是……提个建议。

source: My lord... I tire of this. And besides, I believe young Laertes must meet his father's beckon.
target: 陛下……这些事让我有些疲倦了。况且，我想年轻的雷欧提斯还得应他父亲的召唤。

source: My wife is right. We've had enough of political affairs for now. Today is a day for celebration, after all!
target: 我妻子说得对。政事暂且谈到这里。毕竟，今天是个值得庆祝的日子！

source: Young Prince Fortinbras grows beyond his leash. We ought to engage not with him, but with his uncle, the true King of Norway.
target: 年轻的福丁布拉斯王子越来越不受管束了。我们该交涉的不是他，而是他的叔父，挪威真正的国王。

source: Bernardo, have Voltimand deliver a message to the King with our terms.
target: 贝尔纳多，让伏尔提曼德带信给那位国王，告知我们的条件。

source: At once, milord.
target: 马上去办，陛下。

source: Now then. Laertes, Hamlet? Please come forward.
target: 那么，雷欧提斯，哈姆雷特？请上前来。

source: I've been given word that the both of you wish to have my formal permission to leave Denmark.
target: 我听说，你们两人都希望得到我的正式许可，离开丹麦。

source: My King, I want to travel to Paris tomorrow morning, that I might learn about the breadth of life's offerings beyond Danish walls.
target: 陛下，我想明早启程去巴黎，见识一下丹麦城墙之外，人生还有怎样丰富的经历。

source: And I want to return to Wittenberg, because—I agree—these Danish walls are absolutely miserable.
target: 而我想回维滕贝格，因为——我也这么觉得——丹麦这城墙里的日子实在难熬。

source: I have some concerns about each of you. You are yet young men. Laertes, what does your father say?
target: 对你们两人，我都有些担忧。你们毕竟还年轻。雷欧提斯，你父亲怎么说？

source: He is worried, my King, but grants his blessing.
target: 陛下，他虽然担心，但还是同意并祝福我。

source: Then I must concede. Hamlet, on the other hand...
target: 那我也只好答应了。不过，哈姆雷特……

source: Your mother the Queen and I would prefer you near to us, Hamlet. You may not go back to Germany.
target: 哈姆雷特，你母亲，也就是王后，和我都更希望你留在我们身边。你不能回德国。

source: The funeral for my brother is two months past, and yet you still wear black!
target: 我哥哥的葬礼已经过去两个月了，你却还穿着黑衣！

source: I wear mourning attire while I still mourn my father.
target: 我仍在悼念父亲，自然要穿丧服。

source: The time for that has passed. You ought to think of me as your father now—your father the King. Nothing has changed.
target: 悼念的日子已经过去了。现在你该把我当作你的父亲——你的父亲，国王。一切都没变。

source: For your own health, I desire that you stay in Denmark.
target: 为了你的健康着想，我希望你留在丹麦。

source: If that's your wish, Uncle.
target: 既然这是您的意思，叔叔。

source: As is customary, I have no choice. I never do.
target: 和往常一样，我没有选择。我从来都没有。

source: Excellent! All is settled. And with that, let us break a little while. Court is dismissed.
target: 很好！一切都定下了。那么，大家歇息一会儿吧。散朝。

source: Thank you, my lord! Thank you!
target: 谢谢您，陛下！谢谢！

source: You are most welcome, Laertes. Swift travels, my boy!
target: 不必客气，雷欧提斯。孩子，愿你旅途顺畅！

source: Ophelia—whenever you are done here, come meet me outside. I've something I want to tell you before I meet with Father.
target: 奥菲莉娅——你这边忙完了，就到外面来找我。在见父亲之前，我有些话想对你说。

source: TEMP: You shouldn't see this! I am too busy to talk to anyone!
target: TEMP：你不该看到这句话！我太忙了，没空和任何人说话！

source: Ophelia! There you are, love.
target: 奥菲莉娅！原来你在这儿，亲爱的。

source: And, as usual, doesn't even give me so much as a 'Hello, Father.'
target: 还是和往常一样，连句“父亲好”都不肯说。

source: Hello, Father.
target: 父亲好。

source: That's better. And what are you doing all the way out here?
target: 这才对。你跑这么远来做什么？

source: I wanted to be alone a while. It's quiet here.
target: 我想一个人待一会儿。这里很安静。

source: Avoiding me, more like. Well, I've a small favor to ask of you.
target: 我看更像是在躲我。好了，我有个小忙想请你帮。

source: Your brother's in the throne room, visiting the King about his voyage. But His Majesty tends to run overlong...
target: 你哥哥正在王座厅，为出行的事觐见国王。但陛下总容易把时间拖得太长……

source: Won't you fetch Laertes for me? Tell him he's tardy. As usual, his trunks are sitting in his chambers, open and empty.
target: 你能帮我把雷欧提斯叫来吗？告诉他，他迟到了。还是老样子，他的行李箱都在房里敞着，里面空空如也。

source: At this rate, he'll go to Paris with nothing but the clothes on his back!
target: 照这样下去，他去巴黎时就只能带着身上这套衣服了！

source: That would come as no surprise to either of us.
target: 那我们俩都不会觉得意外。

source: Of course not.
target: 当然不会。

source: Much as I try, I cannot help but think of how terribly I'll miss him.
target: 不管我怎么努力，还是忍不住去想，他走后我会多么想念他。

source: And with all that's going on here in Denmark... war brewing, and such...
target: 再加上丹麦眼下的种种事情……战事一触即发，还有其他那些……

source: I think my hair has gotten a little whiter even as we stand here. The nerves are taking quite a toll on me.
target: 我觉得就连站在这里说话的这会儿工夫，我的头发都又白了一点。成天忧心忡忡，实在让我吃不消。

source: Father, go and have a stroll. Breathe. I'll fetch Laertes.
target: 父亲，去散散步吧。缓口气。我去叫雷欧提斯。

source: This is why you're my favorite daughter.
target: 所以说，你是我最喜欢的女儿。

source: Only daughter.
target: 是唯一的女儿。

source: And that as well!
target: 这也没错！

source: That meeting... we'd been in there an hour. You've freed me. Eternally grateful.
target: 那场会议……我们已经在里面待了一个小时。你把我解救出来了。感激不尽。

source: I sensed you needed rescuing, even though I know you've been waiting for a return to ordinary affairs.
target: 我感觉你需要有人解救，虽然我知道你一直盼着一切回归日常。

source: It's refreshing, no? After the dark cloud that's descended on Elsinore lately...
target: 让人轻松了不少，不是吗？毕竟最近埃尔西诺一直笼罩在阴云之下……

source: The last few months certainly have been odd.
target: 过去这几个月确实很不寻常。

source: What was it you wanted to discuss, then?
target: 那么，你想跟我说什么？

source: You know, Ophelia... I'm going to miss you.
target: 你知道吗，奥菲莉娅……我会想你的。

source: And I you, brother.
target: 我也会想你的，哥哥。

source: You and Prince Hamlet... you're not... anymore...?
target: 你和哈姆雷特王子……你们已经不……不再……？

source: Hamlet and I aren't... together anymore, Laertes. I swear it on Mother's grave.
target: 雷欧提斯，我和哈姆雷特已经不……不在一起了。我对着母亲的坟墓发誓。

source: Has he given you any trouble?
target: 他有没有找你的麻烦？

source: No. He's far more focused on glaring daggers at his Uncle Claudius.
target: 没有。他更忙着恶狠狠地瞪他叔叔克劳狄斯。

source: How long has it been since his father's funeral? A month? Two? And yet he scarcely seems to have recovered.
target: 他父亲的葬礼过去多久了？一个月？两个月？可他似乎还是没怎么缓过来。

source: King Hamlet could do no wrong in his son's eyes, I'm certain. No doubt Hamlet's grief has been overwhelming as of late.
target: 我敢肯定，在儿子眼里，哈姆雷特国王做什么都是对的。毫无疑问，哈姆雷特最近一定悲痛得难以承受。

source: And Hamlet hates his uncle for marrying his mother. I see the way he looks at him. His eyes...
target: 而且，哈姆雷特恨他叔叔，因为他娶了自己的母亲。我看见过他看叔叔的样子。他的眼神……

source: Like a kicked dog, angry, fuming, unpredictable.
target: 像一条挨了踢的狗，愤怒，满腔怨气，让人捉摸不透。

source: It is both proper and customary that Gertrude married her husband's brother after her husband's death. I've no idea why Hamlet's in a fit about it.
target: 乔特鲁德在丈夫死后嫁给他的弟弟，既合礼数，也合习俗。我真不明白哈姆雷特为什么要为这事发脾气。

source: It has me worried he might take out his anger upon you.
target: 这让我担心，他可能会把怒气撒在你身上。

source: Laertes. You needn't throw shoes any more.
target: 雷欧提斯。你不用再扔鞋子了。

source: Throw shoes?
target: 扔鞋子？

source: You remember when we were small, that one summer when that baroness and her children came to visit Elsinore?
target: 你还记得我们小时候，有一年夏天，那位男爵夫人带着孩子来埃尔西诺做客吗？

source: You mean those horrible little boys who pushed you down?
target: 你是说那几个把你推倒的讨厌小男孩？

source: Yes. And when one of them pulled my hair and said it looked odd--
target: 对。后来，其中一个扯我的头发，说它看起来很奇怪——

source: Ah. Right. I'd forgotten. I threw my boot at him.
target: 啊。对。我都忘了。我拿靴子砸了他。

source: And you've been doing it ever since.
target: 而且从那以后，你就一直这样。

source: No one pushes my sister around. Well, unless it's me, of course.
target: 谁也不许欺负我妹妹。嗯，当然，除了我。

source: They won't. That's what I'm telling you. I can fend for myself now. I promise.
target: 他们不会的。我就是想告诉你这个。我现在能保护自己了。我保证。

source: I'm not that little girl anymore. And I'm not going to let anyone do harm to me.
target: 我已经不是那个小女孩了。我不会让任何人伤害我。

source: I suppose that's true, isn't it?
target: 我想也是，对吧？

source: You really have changed.
target: 你确实变了。

source: I see something of Mother in you, now. She could be fierce like that.
target: 现在，我在你身上看到了母亲的影子。她有时也会这样强硬。

source: I likely won't see you before I leave tomorrow. But...
target: 明天走之前，我大概见不到你了。不过……

source: My son, I believe you still have some things to attend to?
target: 儿子，你应该还有些事要处理吧？

source: Your ship leaves tomorrow morning, after all. You have little time to dally.
target: 毕竟，你的船明天早上就开了。你没多少时间磨蹭了。

source: You're correct. As usual, I've packed nothing at all until the very eve of my departure.
target: 您说得对。我又跟往常一样，到了出发前一晚，还什么都没收拾。

source: Better throw a few of my best doublets in a trunk and call it a night.
target: 还是往箱子里塞几件我最好的紧身上衣，然后就睡吧。

source: Please get some sleep. You'll need it.
target: 好好睡一觉吧。你得养足精神。

source: I heard what your brother told you about Prince Hamlet.
target: 你哥哥对你说的那些关于哈姆雷特王子的话，我都听到了。

source: He's right. Prince Hamlet's poison to a young woman like you.
target: 他说得对。对你这样的年轻姑娘来说，哈姆雷特王子就是毒药。

source: And besides that, he's going to inherit the crown someday. It's a delicate situation, that one.
target: 况且，他迟早要继承王位。这件事可不好处理。

source: I know you loved him once. I'm your father. I see these things.
target: 我知道你曾经爱过他。我是你父亲，这些事我看得出来。

source: I know I ought not to be around him any longer.
target: 我知道，我不该再跟他来往了。

source: For another young noblewoman, things might be different. But not so for you.
target: 换作别的年轻贵族姑娘，事情或许会不同。但你不一样。

source: These matters become more difficult for you and Laertes.
target: 这些事对你和雷欧提斯来说，要更难一些。

source: I'm well aware, Father. We both are.
target: 我很清楚，父亲。我们两个都清楚。

source: But I am no scullery maid. I will not be forced to shrink from him.
target: 可我不是洗碗的女仆。我不会任人逼着我躲开他。

source: No. No, I wouldn't dream of asking that. I merely desire your safety.
target: 不。不，我绝不会要求你那样做。我只是希望你平安。

source: Of course. I understand, Father.
target: 当然。我明白，父亲。

source: Smart girl. Sweet dreams.
target: 聪明的姑娘。做个好梦。

source: It's late. I really ought to sleep.
target: 很晚了。我真该睡了。

source: I wish to offer you the advice of an old man, whatever little that's worth to the young.
target: 我想给你几句老人的忠告，尽管在年轻人看来，这些话可能没多少价值。

source: Laertes, Paris can be a... a... confusing place for a young man like yourself.
target: 雷欧提斯，对你这样的年轻人来说，巴黎可能是个……是个……让人迷失的地方。

source: There are rules, my son.
target: 儿子，有些规矩要守。

source: Remember, neither a borrower nor a lender be.
target: 记住，既不向人借钱，也不借钱给人。

source: Debt will sink even a good man in the end.
target: 即便是个好人，最终也会被债务拖垮。

source: Be kind, but don't be overly familiar.
target: 待人友善，但别过分亲近。

source: Treat every man with the respect fitting of your noble-born status.
target: 对每个人都要以礼相待，才配得上你贵族出身的身份。

source: Don't get in fights. But if you do—by God's blood, win them!
target: 别跟人打架。可要是打了——凭上帝的圣血，一定要赢！

source: You're my son, after all, and those dueling lessons weren't for nothing!
target: 你毕竟是我儿子，那些决斗课可不是白上的！

source: And—don't forget clothes.
target: 还有——别忘了衣着。

source: Clothing makes the man, as they say in France. And everywhere!
target: 人靠衣装，法国人都这么说。哪儿都这么说！

source: The servants have packed my trunk full to the brim with the finest -
target: 仆人们已经把我的箱子塞得满满的，里面都是最好的——

source: Better hire a French tailor, just to be sure!
target: 最好再雇个法国裁缝，才保险！

source: I won't have my son in outdated fashions like some pauper.
target: 我可不许我儿子像个穷光蛋似的，穿着过时的衣服。

source: Now, lastly, my son... be true to your character, above all else.
target: 最后，儿子……最要紧的是，忠于你自己的本性。

source: If you're true to yourself, then surely—as night follows day...
target: 如果你忠于自己，那么，就像白昼过后必有黑夜……

source: ...you cannot present yourself as false to any man.
target: ……你也必然不会以虚假的面目对待任何人。

source: That's all the wisdom I have to offer, my son.
target: 儿子，我能给你的忠告就这些了。

source: I'll try to remember... all that.
target: 我会尽量记住……这些话。

source: The boy is determined to hate me.
target: 那孩子铁了心要恨我。

source: He cannot yet understand what lies beyond the veil of youth, dearest.
target: 亲爱的，他还看不透青春这层面纱背后的世界。

source: Hamlet is... there is... such a darkness within him.
target: 哈姆雷特……他心里……有那么深的阴暗。

source: I fear it may fester if we allow him to leave us.
target: 我怕要是让他离开我们，那份阴暗会继续恶化。

source: And what form that festering might take... I fear more.
target: 而恶化下去会变成什么样……那才更让我害怕。

source: You've done right by him. I promise.
target: 你没有亏待他。我向你保证。

source: The Queen looks busy. Let us hold back.
target: 王后看起来正忙。我们先等等吧。

source: Maybe you should hold back, but I'm her lady-in-waiting of House Brockenhuus. She can see me whenever I like.
target: 也许你该等着，可我是她的宫廷侍女，出身布罗肯胡斯家族。我想什么时候见她，她就能见我。

source: Hah! You think your family name gives you power here? A beautiful face, but an ugly soul. That's all you are.
target: 哈！你以为凭你的姓氏，就能在这里有权有势？脸蛋漂亮，心灵丑陋。你也就这样了。

source: And you're an old hag who needs to find a hobby outside the Queen's personal life.
target: 而你就是个老巫婆，除了盯着王后的私生活，也该找点别的爱好了。

source: I bathed the Queen and wet-nursed her when she was naught more than the size of these two hands. She is like my own flesh and blood.
target: 王后还只有我这两只手那么大时，我就给她洗澡，给她喂奶。她就像我的亲骨肉。

source: And I'll watch over her until the minute you bury me. Mark my words, Lady Brit.
target: 我会一直照看她，直到你们把我埋进土里。记住我的话，布莉特女士。

source: No lady-in-waiting, or beautiful silken dress, can replace that bond.
target: 任何宫廷侍女、任何漂亮的丝绸裙子，都取代不了这份情谊。

source: Hmmph. We'll see, hag.
target: 哼。走着瞧，老巫婆。

source: W... what have yeh told the King?
target: 你……你跟国王说了什么？

source: Nothing yet, naturally.
target: 当然还什么都没说。

source: Ophelia wos askin' me questions earlier.
target: 奥菲莉娅先前问了我一些问题。

source: Well, were you shivering all knock-kneed?
target: 怎么，你当时浑身发抖，连腿都打颤了？

source: N-no! Of course not! That girl just has a keen sense...
target: 没、没有！当然没有！那姑娘就是特别敏锐……

source: All we can do is wait on Hamlet's word.
target: 我们只能等哈姆雷特发话。

source: Until then, we can merely wait, and watch, and hope it doesn't return.
target: 在那之前，我们只能等着、守着，盼着它别再回来。

source: If I could only dissolve... If it were only that easy to die...
target: 要是我能就此消融……要是死能那么容易……

source: God, would you spite me even then? You would, wouldn't you?
target: 上帝，连那样你也要跟我作对吗？你会的，对不对？

source: Even though you've brought me nothing but misery in this flat, weary world.
target: 明明在这个乏味、疲惫的世界里，你带给我的只有苦难。

source: And this castle is like an overgrown garden. How I despise it.
target: 这座城堡就像荒草丛生的花园。我多么厌恶它。

source: Hamlet... be at peace. Look at it this way. We'll drink to your health tonight.
target: 哈姆雷特……平静些。换个角度想想，今晚我们会举杯祝你健康。

source: I, and the rest of the guards. We'll drink ourselves silly. How does that sound?
target: 我，还有其他卫兵。我们会喝个酩酊大醉。怎么样？

source: Father gave her... anything. Everything. I've never seen a love like it. I've never loved like it.
target: 父亲给了她……她想要的一切。他的一切。我从没见过那样的爱。我也从没那样爱过。

source: And all too soon, my father's dead, and she's marrying my uncle, less than a month later.
target: 可转眼间，父亲死了，还不到一个月，她就要嫁给我的叔叔。

source: She had hardly gone from shedding tears to sharing his bed.
target: 她的眼泪还没流完，就跟他睡到一张床上了。

source: She had to move on, Hamlet. She is the Queen. She cannot afford her grief. And your uncle is a suitable match.
target: 她必须往前走，哈姆雷特。她是王后，没有沉溺于悲伤的余地。而且，你叔叔也是合适的对象。

source: Oh, shut up, Horatio.
target: 行了，闭嘴吧，霍拉旭。

source: Frailty and woman are one and the same.
target: 脆弱与女人，本就是一回事。

source: Come on, Hamlet. Get up off the floor, now. Let's get you to bed, shall we?
target: 来吧，哈姆雷特。别坐在地上了，起来。我们送你去睡，好吗？

source: Do you remember my father, Lord? How much he... loved her?
target: 主啊，你还记得我父亲吗？记得他有多么……爱她吗？

source: He gave her anything. Everything. I've never seen a love like it. I've never loved like it.
target: 她想要什么，他就给什么。他把一切都给了她。我从没见过那样的爱。我也从没那样爱过。

source: ...And then she marries him. Less than a month after my father's death.
target: ……可她随后就嫁给了他。父亲死后还不到一个月。

source: But I'm just a drunken idiot. What do I know, God? Huh? What do I know?
target: 可我只是个喝醉的蠢货。我懂什么，上帝？嗯？我懂什么？

source: Hamlet, you seem to be in an unusually foul mood—even for you.
target: 哈姆雷特，你看起来心情糟透了——比你平时还糟。

source: I was, certainly. But no longer.
target: 刚才确实是。可现在不是了。

source: I never believed I would reclaim such happiness again. I thought it beyond me.
target: 我从没想过还能重新找回这样的快乐。我以为自己再也做不到了。

source: Good things are coming to us, Ophelia.
target: 好事就要降临到我们身上了，奥菲莉娅。

source: My purpose is clear now, my aim true.
target: 现在，我的目的已清晰，目标已找准。

source: I still see my father's spirit, stained with blood.
target: 我仍能看见父亲的亡魂，浑身染着血。

source: I can't get him—it—out of my head... I can feel it driving into my skull like a hot nail...
target: 我没法把他——把它——从脑子里赶出去……我能感觉到，它像一根烧红的钉子，正往我的头骨里钻……

source: I just want to be alone. From everyone. From you.
target: 我只想一个人待着。远离所有人。远离你。

source: Leave me. What you saw was a mistake.
target: 离开我。你看到的那些，都是一场错误。

source: I... I was ill, and out of my mind, and... I didn't see anything. No, of course I didn't... how could I have? How could it be real?
target: 我……我当时病了，神志不清，而且……我什么都没看见。不，我当然没看见……我怎么可能看见？那怎么可能是真的？

source: Don't be ridiculous. I know you. This isn't normal for you.
target: 别说傻话。我了解你。你平时不是这样的。

source: Stop. Just—stop. Leave me alone! I need to think. I don't know anymore...
target: 别说了。就——别说了。让我一个人待着！我得想一想。我现在什么都搞不清了……

source: Get away from me. And don't come back.
target: 离我远点。别再回来。

source: The last time we fought, you were clear about holding no love in your heart for me.
target: 上次我们吵架时，你说得很清楚，你心里没有对我的爱。

source: I'm trying to respect that with everything in me. I truly am.
target: 我正尽全力尊重你的心意。我真的在努力。

source: Prince Hamlet is acting incredibly strangely.
target: 哈姆雷特王子的举止古怪极了。

source: Well, he would be, wouldn't he? Don't you know about the things he's seen?
target: 他会这样也很正常，不是吗？他见过些什么，你难道不知道？

source: His father's spirit, you mean?
target: 你是说，他父亲的亡魂？

source: Trace that thread, and you just might find yourself face-to-face with a dear old friend of mine.
target: 沿着那条线索追下去，你说不定会跟我一位亲爱的老朋友面对面。

source: I've already met King Hamlet myself.
target: 我已经亲自见过哈姆雷特国王了。

source: Why, then there's no need to acquaint you! Look at you. Such a self-sufficient child.
target: 哎呀，那就不用替你们介绍了！瞧瞧你，真是个能干的孩子。

source: What do you mean? What has Hamlet 'seen'?
target: 你什么意思？哈姆雷特“见过”什么？

source: Mmm. A dear old friend of mine.
target: 嗯。我一位亲爱的老朋友。

source: Were I in your position, I might consider asking Hamlet about the nature of his little malady.
target: 要是我处在你的位置，或许会考虑问问哈姆雷特，他那点小毛病究竟是怎么回事。

source: Being direct in these kinds of matters is often the way through them, after all!
target: 毕竟，遇到这种事，直截了当往往就能找到出路！

source: Ah, Hamlet, Hamlet, Hamlet.
target: 唉，哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特，哈姆雷特。

source: Don't you mind him. He'll be out of both our hair soon.
target: 别理他。他很快就不会再烦我们两个了。

source: What can you mean by that, my lord?
target: 陛下，您这话是什么意思？

source: Only that his actions recently have a price.
target: 只是说，他最近的所作所为是要付出代价的。

source: I've done all I can... I don't know what else to do. Even a manged dog responds more predictably than he does.
target: 我已经尽力了……不知道还能做什么。就连一条长满疥癣的狗，反应都比他好捉摸。

source: But I must keep trying to get through to him, for my wife's sake and sanity...
target: 可为了我的妻子，为了不让她精神崩溃，我还得继续设法跟他沟通……

source: I'll meet with him anon. This necessitates swift reaction, as Hamlet's new father.
target: 我一会儿就去见他。作为哈姆雷特的新父亲，我必须尽快处理这件事。

source: He's been through the most difficult time in his young life.
target: 他经历了年轻生命中最艰难的一段时光。

source: I remember losing my own father, long ago. I was much like Hamlet once. Lost in an angry fog.
target: 我还记得，很久以前失去父亲的时候。我也曾像哈姆雷特一样，迷失在愤怒的迷雾里。

source: Out for blood and trouble, as always.
target: 跟往常一样，一心要见血、惹事。

source: That boy is a problem someone ought to solve...
target: 那孩子是个麻烦，总该有人把它解决掉……

source: Hamlet is acting incredibly strangely lately. Do you know what's wrong?
target: 哈姆雷特最近举止古怪极了。您知道他出了什么事吗？

source: What? Again? Oh, my poor Hamlet...
target: 什么？又来了？唉，我可怜的哈姆雷特……

source: I fear he is well and truly mad. His behavior is beyond even regular mourning.
target: 恐怕他是真的疯了。他的行为已经超出了正常哀悼的范围。

source: My husband and I will speak to him. This is troubling news. Thank you for letting us know hastily.
target: 我和丈夫会去跟他谈谈。这消息让人担忧。谢谢你这么快就来告诉我们。

source: I've failed him as a mother. I'm sure that's the source of his anger.
target: 我没有尽到母亲的责任。我相信，这就是他愤怒的根源。

source: No, my lady, it seemed different from that.
target: 不，王后，看起来不像是因为这个。

source: I don't want to see him now. Please don't let him see me...
target: 我现在不想见他。求你别让他见我……

source: I'm sorry he gave you a fright, Ophelia!
target: 抱歉，奥菲莉娅，他吓到你了！

source: I'm sure it's just him up to his usual boyish tricks. You know how he can be.
target: 我相信他只是又在像个顽皮孩子一样胡闹。你知道他有时候就这样。

source: My lady, this is different. I'm sure he was out of his mind with—something!
target: 王后，这次不一样。我确信他是因为——什么事，神志不清了！

source: What? Certainly not. I'm sure it was just a trick!
target: 什么？绝不可能。我相信那只是个恶作剧！

source: Regardless, my husband and I have been meaning to take him aside. We'll do so as soon as we can. Thank you for letting us know hastily.
target: 不管怎样，我和丈夫早就想找他单独谈谈了。我们会尽快去的。谢谢你这么快就来告诉我们。

source: What you saw in my bedroom wasn't my doing. Hamlet burst into my room and accosted me.
target: 您在我卧室里看到的那一幕，不是我造成的。是哈姆雷特闯进我的房间，来纠缠我的。

source: He's out of his mind, Father. Something's wrong with him.
target: 他神志不清了，父亲。他出了什么问题。

source: Yes, something certainly is.
target: 是啊，他确实出了问题。

source: We'd best both avoid him. Let the King's hand deliver justice.
target: 我们两个最好都避着他。让国王亲自主持公道吧。

source: But I suspect he'll no longer trouble either one of us again. Not after his attempt on my life.
target: 不过，我想他不会再来找我们任何一个人的麻烦了。他企图杀了我，这之后就别想了。

source: I'm merely grateful he was foiled.
target: 我只庆幸他没能得逞。

source: Or... was, rather.
target: 或者……准确地说，是曾经如此。

source: I doubt we'll ever know the depth to which his demons plagued him.
target: 恐怕我们永远也不会知道，他的心魔把他折磨到了什么地步。

source: Just yesterday, I would have believed you. But with everything that's changed-- Hamlet might very well come out of this a new young man.
target: 就在昨天，我还会相信你的话。但如今一切都变了——哈姆雷特很可能会经历这一切，变成一个全新的年轻人。

source: Already he seems to carry himself a little taller, like a budding king. Let us see how the future unfolds.
target: 他现在似乎已经挺拔了几分，像个初露头角的国王。我们且看未来如何发展吧。

source: It is true that his mood has been exceptionally poor as of late, but that doesn't excuse—
target: 他最近的心情确实格外糟糕，但这不能成为借口——

source: —I mean, more than usual. His clothing was torn, he was completely out of sorts, speaking gibberish...
target: ——我是说，比平时更不对劲。他的衣服破了，整个人完全失了常，还胡言乱语……

source: Oh, dear. That is unusual, even for him.
target: 哎呀。就算是他，这也确实反常。

source: Once spurned, a young man's heart cannot be so easily tempered.
target: 年轻人一旦遭到拒绝，心里就没那么容易平静下来。

source: I don't think this is related to my 'spurning' him. Something else is wrong. I know it.
target: 我不觉得这跟我“拒绝”他有关。一定是别的事出了问题。我知道。

source: Hmm. Perhaps you'd bring up your experience the next time the King holds court?
target: 嗯。也许下次国王接见臣民时，你可以说说自己的遭遇？

source: Though I'm afraid I don't know whether the Queen has any intention of disciplining him.
target: 不过，恐怕我也不知道王后是否有意管教他。

source: Not even if he becomes... violent? What if he were a danger to you?
target: 即使他开始……动手伤人，也不管吗？要是他威胁到您的安全呢？

source: A danger to me? Come, now. He's never given me true reason to fear for my safety.
target: 威胁到我？别这样。他从没做过什么，能让我真的为自己的安全担心。

source: Hamlet is acting incredibly strangely, and I'm worried. You're his best friend. What do you know?
target: 哈姆雷特的举止古怪极了，我很担心。你是他最好的朋友。你知道些什么？

source: Was he ever not a strange fellow? But I suppose that makes sense.
target: 他什么时候不古怪了？不过，我想这也说得通。

source: He would turn to you of all people for comfort, I'm sure, after... uh...
target: 我相信，那么多人里，他当然会找你寻求安慰，在……呃……之后。

source: Well. The ghost.
target: 嗯。幽灵那件事。

source: Listen. I need you to be honest with me.
target: 听着。你得跟我说实话。

source: I have reason to believe Hamlet's behavior may endanger my father's life.
target: 我有理由相信，哈姆雷特的行为可能危及我父亲的性命。

source: I can't tell you. But I need you to have faith that this is a serious matter.
target: 我不能告诉你。但你得相信，这件事很严重。

source: I believe that ghost may be responsible for my father's death.
target: 我认为，我父亲的死可能与那个幽灵有关。

source: Y-you... think the ghost told Hamlet to kill your father?
target: 你、你……认为是幽灵让哈姆雷特杀了你父亲？

source: That's a little far-fetched even for my tastes.
target: 连我都觉得这有点牵强。

source: Maybe not to kill my father. But I think this spirit told Hamlet something which drove him mad.
target: 或许不是让他杀我父亲。但我觉得，那亡魂对哈姆雷特说了什么，把他逼疯了。

source: I think that ghost spurred Hamlet to take my father's life.
target: 我觉得，是那个幽灵怂恿哈姆雷特杀了我父亲。

source: Y-you... think the ghost told Hamlet to do that?
target: 你、你……认为是幽灵叫哈姆雷特那么做的？

source: Maybe not that exactly. But I think this spirit told Hamlet something which drove him mad.
target: 也许不完全是那样。但我觉得这个幽灵对哈姆雷特说了什么，把他逼疯了。

source: All I can tell you is this: Strange things are afoot in Elsinore.
target: 我只能告诉你：埃尔西诺正在发生怪事。

source: That being said, with everything that's transpired lately, I think Hamlet, too, has changed.
target: 不过，最近发生了这么多事，我觉得哈姆雷特也变了。

source: He's seriously considering his own ascension to the throne.
target: 他正在认真考虑自己登上王位的事。

source: I've been speaking with him, and he seems more clear-minded now than I've ever seen him before.
target: 我一直在和他交谈，他现在的头脑似乎比我以往见过的任何时候都清醒。

source: Give it time. His mood may lift on its own.
target: 再给他点时间吧。他的心情也许自己就会好起来。

source: Come to think of it, Ophelia... have you ever read the report of the late King Hamlet's death?
target: 说起来，奥菲莉娅……你读过已故哈姆雷特国王的死亡报告吗？

source: It's shelved in the gallery. If you were to, er, peruse it...
target: 那份报告放在画廊的架子上。如果你，呃，仔细读一读……

source: Perhaps you'd better understand what causes Hamlet's ailment.
target: 也许就能更明白哈姆雷特为什么会变成这样。

source: Regardless, if Hamlet is planning something, then the next few days will force his hand.
target: 无论如何，如果哈姆雷特确实在谋划什么，接下来几天的事就会逼他采取行动。

source: Given your history with him, you of all people should know he doesn't keep secrets very well.
target: 以你和他的过往，你应该比谁都清楚，他不太藏得住秘密。

source: Hamlet is acting incredibly strangely, and I'm worried.
target: 哈姆雷特的举止非常古怪，我很担心。

source: I think he's been going through an incredible darkness.
target: 我觉得他一直深陷黑暗之中。

source: I finally spoke to him, you know. First time in years. And it was illuminating.
target: 你知道吗，我终于和他谈了谈。这是几年来的头一次，也让我明白了不少事。

source: I do not think there will be a time when Hamlet is no threat to us.
target: 我觉得哈姆雷特永远都会对我们构成威胁。

source: But I think he and I reached a kind of understanding. At least for now.
target: 但我觉得，我和他算是达成了某种谅解。至少目前是这样。

source: I hope he troubles you no more. The monsters in his mind are loud.
target: 希望他不会再困扰你了。他心里的怪物吵得很。

source: Did he threaten you?
target: 他威胁你了？

source: No, no. It was nothing like that. Just being a fool.
target: 不，不。完全不是那回事。他只是在犯傻。

source: Well, that's not strange, is it? That's how he always is with you lately. A lovesick idiot, like a dog that comes crawling back even after it's been kicked.
target: 那也不奇怪吧？最近他在你面前不一直这样吗？一个为情所困的傻瓜，像条挨了踢还要爬回来的狗。

source: On top of that, he's now a betrothed man. He cares little for what's proper. Always has.
target: 何况他现在已经订婚了。他根本不在乎什么才合乎礼数。一向如此。

source: This time was different, somehow...
target: 这次总觉得有些不一样……

source: Are you concerned?
target: 你担心吗？

source: Possibly. He came into my room, partially-clothed, raving about nothing in particular.
target: 也许吧。他衣服都没穿全就进了我的房间，东一句西一句地胡言乱语。

source: A-and you didn't tell me that first?
target: 那、那你怎么不先告诉我这件事？

source: Then I must stay. To keep watch. Until this fit of his lifts.
target: 那我必须留下来。留心看着。直到他这阵疯劲过去。

source: I'd better not go to Paris. Not yet, at least. I'll ask the docksmen to hold in the bay.
target: 我最好别去巴黎了。至少现在不去。我会请码头的人把船暂时留在海湾里。

source: Father will be furious, of course.
target: 当然，父亲会大发雷霆。

source: (If he stays, things will change.)
target: （如果他留下，事情就会改变。）

source: That would make me feel much better.
target: 那会让我安心很多。

source: Well, then that settles it. You're more important than any trip, Ophelia.
target: 好，那就这么定了。奥菲莉娅，你比任何一次旅行都重要。

source: I'll stay here and keep an eye on the situation.
target: 我会留在这里，留意事态。

source: You're certain you want to stay just because Hamlet might do something inappropriate?
target: 就因为哈姆雷特可能做出什么不妥的事，你就确定要留下来？

source: You don't understand what men are capable of. That's a blessing. I promise you.
target: 你不知道男人能做出什么事。这是你的福气。相信我。

source: Maybe not, but I know what Hamlet is capable of. He doesn't frighten me.
target: 也许我不知道，但我知道哈姆雷特能做出什么事。我不怕他。

source: This is your one opportunity to go to Paris. Take it. Please.
target: 这是你去巴黎的唯一机会。抓住它吧。求你了。

source: All right. If you insist. But write me often. I want to hear when things improve.
target: 好吧。既然你坚持。不过要常给我写信。事情好转了，我想知道。

source: He's going to pay for this. First everything else, now he comes after my sister?
target: 他会为此付出代价。先前那些事还不够，现在又来找我妹妹的麻烦？

source: I'll kill him. I'll tear him down until he regrets leaving Wittenberg.
target: 我要杀了他。我要把他彻底打垮，让他后悔离开维滕贝格。

source: Hamlet is acting very strangely. Do you know the cause?
target: 哈姆雷特的举止很古怪。你知道原因吗？

source: Given current circumstances, I can't discuss it, my lady.
target: 眼下这种情况，我不能谈这件事，小姐。

source: Needless to say, very soon he won't be causing you any more pain. I'll make certain of that.
target: 可以肯定的是，他很快就不会再让你痛苦了。我会确保这一点。

source: Ah. I was afraid of this.
target: 唉。我一直担心会这样。

source: No. Nothing. It's nothing.
target: 不。没什么。没事。

source: Where is your father? Have you told him about this? I can have a man assigned to your hall in case the Prince should bother you further.
target: 你父亲在哪儿？你告诉他这件事了吗？我可以派个人守在你房间外的走廊，以防王子再来打扰你。

source: I can have a man assigned to your hall in case the Prince should bother you further.
target: 我可以派个人守在你房间外的走廊，以防王子再来打扰你。

source: It's quite all right. He's not a danger to me. Not yet, anyway.
target: 真的没事。他对我没有危险。至少目前还没有。

source: ... Lady Ophelia, before you depart...
target: ……奥菲莉娅小姐，在你离开之前……

source: Have you been to the gallery? There is a certain tome there... filled with the lives and deaths of royal men and women.
target: 你去过画廊吗？那里有一本书……里面记载着王室男女的生平与死亡。

source: The entry on King Hamlet may be of particular interest to you, if you're concerned about the Prince's well-being.
target: 如果你担心王子的状况，也许会特别想看看关于哈姆雷特国王的那一条。

source: Why the secrecy, Bernardo?
target: 为什么这么神秘，贝尔纳多？

source: Would that I could say, my lady. But I have promised my silence.
target: 我也希望能告诉你，小姐。但我答应过要守口如瓶。

source: Of course. As do you.
target: 当然。你也一样。

source: The ghost. His father's spirit.
target: 那个幽灵。他父亲的亡魂。

source: I suppose that would weigh on him.
target: 我想，这会让他心里很沉重。

source: I could see in his face that it was... well... something broke in him. I don't know what.
target: 我从他的脸上看得出来，那是……唉……他心里有什么东西碎了。我不知道是什么。

source: But even I am afraid of it, my lady.
target: 但连我都害怕，小姐。

source: Hamlet is acting incredibly strangely, and I'm not sure why.
target: 哈姆雷特的举止非常古怪，我不太清楚为什么。

source: I am not surprised. And now the former brat is to be our king.
target: 我一点也不意外。如今，当年的那个小混蛋竟要当我们的国王了。

source: He may seem determined, but his mind is no less fractured.
target: 他看着也许很坚定，可他的心智依然支离破碎。

source: His insolent attitude weighs on my lady's consciousness like a fat stone!
target: 他那无礼的态度，像块大石头一样压在我家夫人的心头！

source: A burden, a disgrace, nothing but a nuisance... my poor Gerta must deal with him day and night.
target: 一个累赘，一个耻辱，除了添乱一无是处……我可怜的格尔塔得没日没夜地应付他。

source: The boy needs a firm hand, and gets none!
target: 这孩子需要有人严加管教，却根本没人管！

source: The last noble who suffered from such a broken mind put everyone through even more strife before her death.
target: 上一个心智如此破碎的贵族，在她死前让所有人遭了更多的罪。

source: I hope his end is less... painful.
target: 希望他的结局能少些……痛苦。

source: What do you mean by... the last noble?
target: 你说的……上一个贵族，是什么意思？

source: Lady Astrid. You did not know of her?
target: 阿斯特丽德女士。你没听说过她？

source: No, no. I suppose you wouldn't... it happened long before you were born.
target: 不，不。想来你也不会知道……那件事发生时，离你出生还早得很。

source: Those of us with eyes in our heads know better than to speak of her. But visit the gallery...
target: 我们这些有眼力见的人，都知道不该谈起她。不过，你可以去画廊看看……

source: Yes, the gallery. Not all traces of a woman can be removed, especially one with blue blood.
target: 没错，画廊。一个女人留下的痕迹，不可能全被抹去，尤其是出身贵族的女人。

source: The gallery...
target: 画廊……

source: You mean Queen Astrid.
target: 你说的是阿斯特丽德王后。

source: Those of us with eyes in our heads know better than to speak of her. But... not all traces of a woman can be removed, especially one with blue blood.
target: 我们这些有眼力见的人，都知道不该谈起她。不过……一个女人留下的痕迹，不可能全被抹去，尤其是出身贵族的女人。

source: Some others around here still know the tale to tell it, if only in whispers. It happened several years before I came to Elsinore.
target: 这里还有些人记得那段往事，能讲给你听，只是只能悄悄地说。那件事发生在我来埃尔西诺的几年前。

source: Hamlet is acting incredibly strangely. Do you know why?
target: 哈姆雷特的举止非常古怪。你知道为什么吗？

source: A-ah-- it must be because of-- well, I heard the story about what happened with your father.
target: 啊、啊——一定是因为——嗯，我听说了你父亲的那件事。

source: We all know about what Hamlet did.
target: 哈姆雷特做的事，我们都知道了。

source: Ophelia, are you all right?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你还好吗？

source: You really can't imagine? You left him in pieces. Everyone knows it.
target: 你真的想不到吗？你让他心都碎了。所有人都知道。

source: Although it looks like I, as his future wife, get to be the one to pick those pieces up. I am obviously just giddy with joy.
target: 不过看来，作为他未来的妻子，收拾这些碎片的人倒成了我。我当然高兴得不得了。

source: This was beyond any lingering feelings he might have for me. This was madness. He was wild-eyed, raving.
target: 这已经不是他可能对我余情未了能解释的了。这是发疯。他眼神狂乱，满口胡言。

source: Oh. That is interesting, then.
target: 哦。那可确实有意思了。

source: You know, I overheard the most interesting argument before your brother left for Paris...
target: 你知道吗，你哥哥去巴黎之前，我无意中听到了一场特别有意思的争吵……

source: He and Hamlet were shouting at each other in the hallway. I could hear it from my chambers. The walls were practically shaking.
target: 他和哈姆雷特在走廊里互相吼叫。我在自己房间里都听得见。墙都快被震得发抖了。

source: Your brother said he was going to write your father a letter, and if the problem wasn't resolved by his return, he'd strangle Hamlet to death.
target: 你哥哥说，他要给你父亲写封信。如果等他回来，问题还没解决，他就要把哈姆雷特掐死。

source: He does seem to threaten to strangle Hamlet a lot, though.
target: 不过，他好像确实经常威胁要掐死哈姆雷特。

source: Either way, perhaps that letter's what's put Hamlet into such a fit. Were I you, I'd have a look, 'Feely.
target: 不管怎样，也许就是那封信让哈姆雷特发了这么大的疯。菲莉，要是我是你，就会去看看。

source: Hamlet came into my room and accosted me, seemingly mad. Do you know why?
target: 哈姆雷特闯进我的房间来纠缠我，看着像是疯了。你知道为什么吗？

source: Ophelia, horrid things're afoot here.
target: 奥菲莉娅，这里正在发生可怕的事。

source: Like what?
target: 比如什么？

source: ...I've been commanded not t'say.
target: ……我奉命不能说。

source: If yeh follow Hamlet, he may lead yeh to the answer himself.
target: 你要是跟着哈姆雷特，他也许会亲自带你找到答案。

source: It's strange. Th'last time somethin' like this happened... well...
target: 真奇怪。上次发生这样的事……唉……

source: It didn' end well for poor Queen Astrid.
target: 可怜的阿斯特丽德王后没落得个好下场。

source: Queen Astrid?
target: 阿斯特丽德王后？

source: I know I've heard of that name before, but... why do you say that?
target: 我记得以前听过这个名字，可是……你为什么这么说？

source: ... I shouldn't 'a said anything.
target: ……我就不该多嘴。

source: Still, I pray that Hamlet's state doesn' get any worse. For all of our sakes.
target: 不过，我还是祈求哈姆雷特的状况别再恶化了。为了我们所有人。

source: This is so unlike him.
target: 这太不像他了。

source: Rosie and I really ought to talk some sense into him.
target: 萝茜和我真该好好劝劝他，让他清醒清醒。

source: Not in the slightest! He's an iron fortress, that one.
target: 一点也没有！他呀，简直是座铁打的堡垒。

source: What makes you take such an interest in his state, Ophelia?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你为什么这么关心他的状况？

source: I seem to be a target of his mood swings. I'd prefer not to be, so I'm trying to find the root cause.
target: 他情绪一变，似乎就冲着我来。我不想这样，所以正试着找出根本原因。

source: Hmm. I think I need to speak with my compatriot Rosie here. In private.
target: 嗯。我想我得和我这位同乡萝茜谈谈。私下谈。

source: Oh, Hamlet!
target: 唉，哈姆雷特！

source: He was never like this at school...
target: 他在学校时从来不这样……

source: We're as clueless as you. We tried to talk with him, but...
target: 我们也和你一样，毫无头绪。我们试着和他谈过，可是……

source: No luck at all.
target: 一点进展都没有。

source: That does seem prudent. I'll speak with Guilda when I've a free moment.
target: 那样似乎确实比较稳妥。等我有空，就和吉尔达谈谈。

source: What do you know about the ghost haunting the walls of Elsinore?
target: 关于那个在埃尔西诺城墙上出没的幽灵，你知道些什么？

source: Such a delightful little pawn to have in the game, that one.
target: 这场游戏里有这么一枚小棋子，真叫人开心。

source: Consider him the audience to our match, if you will.
target: 你不妨把他当作我们这场较量的观众。

source: A match without anyone to cheer is no fun at all!
target: 一场较量要是没人喝彩，可就一点意思都没有了！

source: He's not cheering for you.
target: 他可不是在为你喝彩。

source: He'll cheer for whomever I tell him to. He is a puppet of mine.
target: 我让他为谁喝彩，他就会为谁喝彩。他是我的傀儡。

source: Don't you understand that yet?
target: 你还不明白吗？

source: And if ever he becomes an annoyance...
target: 而如果哪天他变得碍事了……

source: Then away he'll go!
target: 那就让他消失！

source: That he's been buried deep forever now.
target: 他如今已被永远深埋地下了。

source: Were you hoping he would make a glorious return? A wondrous comeback to save you?
target: 你还盼着他荣耀归来？奇迹般地重返此地，救你一命？

source: No. He's dead and gone, lady.
target: 不会的。他已经死了，彻底没了，女士。

source: I have written his grim conclusion.
target: 我已写下了他悲惨的结局。

source: A multitude of things. For what purpose are you eager to track down this spirit?
target: 我知道的可多了。你这么急着找到这个幽灵，是为了什么？

source: If this is what's causing Hamlet's madness, then this is what's causing him to kill my father.
target: 如果是它让哈姆雷特发疯，那也是它让他杀死我父亲的。

source: And... if... I, myself, have become a supernatural oddity, then perhaps finding another will pave the way forward.
target: 而且……如果……我自己也成了某种超自然的怪异存在，那么找到另一个，也许就能找到前进的路。

source: Hmm. Yes. I follow.
target: 嗯。是的。我明白了。

source: Then heed this: to track down the father, you must go through the son.
target: 那就记住：要找到父亲，就必须从儿子入手。

source: Once his mind has been swayed, follow it to its natural conclusion.
target: 一旦他的想法动摇了，就顺着事态追下去，直到它自然走向结局。

source: Your Highness, Hamlet claimed that he saw the ghost of his late father.
target: 陛下，哈姆雷特声称自己见到了已故父亲的幽灵。

source: Well, it matters little now.
target: 唉，现在这已经不怎么重要了。

source: They say all are reunited in death. Perhaps my brother and Hamlet are together.
target: 人们说，所有人死后都会重聚。也许我哥哥和哈姆雷特已经在一起了。

source: Ghosts, now?
target: 现在又说起幽灵来了？

source: I know the boy is still upset about my brother's unfortunate death, but if he's saying things like that...
target: 我知道这孩子还在为我哥哥的不幸去世而难过，但如果他开始说这种话……

source: Where did you get this information?
target: 你从哪里听来的？

source: I... overheard it. From the prince himself. Bernardo and Horatio also have seen it.
target: 我……无意中听到的。是王子亲口说的。贝尔纳多和霍拉旭也见过它。

source: I see. I'll have to have a word with them, I think.
target: 我明白了。我想，我得找他们谈谈。

source: Thank you for coming to me, Ophelia. Your father will be proud.
target: 谢谢你来告诉我，奥菲莉娅。你父亲会为你骄傲的。

source: Thank you for coming to me, Ophelia. Your father would have been proud.
target: 谢谢你来告诉我，奥菲莉娅。你父亲若还在，一定会为你骄傲。

source: Did Hamlet actually see his father's ghost?
target: 哈姆雷特真的见到了他父亲的幽灵吗？

source: Yes. I think... that's part of why he died.
target: 是的。我想……那也是他死去的部分原因。

source: I saw the spirit with my own eyes. Hamlet had a conversation with it. And after that, nothing was the same. He was changed.
target: 我亲眼看到了那个幽灵。哈姆雷特和它谈过话。从那以后，一切都不一样了。他变了。

source: I spoke with it, too.
target: 我也和它说过话。

source: What does it want, then?
target: 那它想要什么？

source: Revenge. As spirits always do, I imagine.
target: 复仇。我想，幽灵总是想要复仇的。

source: I see. I always had my suspicions about the way the King passed. Now, it seems, they've been confirmed.
target: 我明白了。我一直对国王的死因心存疑虑。如今看来，这些疑虑得到了证实。

source: Not that there's much a poor sod like me can do about that.
target: 不过，像我这样的倒霉蛋，也做不了什么。

source: How can I meet it myself? Perhaps—speak to it?
target: 我怎样才能亲自见到它？也许——和它说说话？

source: Ah. It would only speak to Hamlet. I tried to get its attention, but it didn't seem to care much for me.
target: 唉。它当时只肯和哈姆雷特说话。我试着引起它的注意，可它似乎不怎么想理我。

source: And with him gone, I wonder if it has any cause to appear at all now.
target: 如今他已经不在了，我不知道它究竟还有什么理由现身。

source: Oh! So he told you about it after all? I'm glad.
target: 哦！原来他还是告诉你了？那真好。

source: You know, I'm relieved you've learned about it. I do so hate keeping secrets.
target: 你知道了这件事，我也松了口气。我实在讨厌保守秘密。

source: Yes, he did, and we were rather shocked when we saw it. If the others hadn't seen it as well, surely I would have thought I was losing my mind.
target: 是的，他见到了。我们看到它时也很震惊。要不是其他人也看见了，我一定会以为自己疯了。

source: We were up on the walls. It wore the same armor as His Majesty did when he fought the King of Norway years ago.
target: 我们当时在城墙上。它穿的盔甲，和陛下多年前迎战挪威国王时穿的一样。

source: Ah. It'll only speak to Hamlet, you know. I tried to get its attention, but it didn't seem to care much for me.
target: 唉。你知道，它只肯和哈姆雷特说话。我试着引起它的注意，可它似乎不怎么想理我。

source: Spirits do tend to be awfully particular. Once heard of a poltergeist which could only be quieted if it was offered old wine.
target: 鬼魂往往都特别挑剔。我曾听说有个闹事的鬼，只有供上陈年葡萄酒才能让它安静下来。

source: Hrm. Did the ghost tell Hamlet to do anything in... particular?
target: 嗯。那个幽灵有没有让哈姆雷特做什么……特别的事？
