source: Kill my father, perhaps?
target: 比如，杀了我父亲？

source: What? Er, not that I know. None of us could hear what it said except for Hamlet, I'm afraid.
target: 什么？呃，据我所知没有。恐怕除了哈姆雷特，我们谁都听不见它说了什么。

source: Hamlet said he saw his father's ghost on the castle walls.
target: 哈姆雷特说，他在城墙上看见了父亲的幽灵。

source: I've seen it as well.
target: 我也见过。

source: The last few nights now, it's been appearing during the midnight watch. And it really did look a lot like the late king.
target: 最近几个晚上，它都会在午夜值守时出现。而且它确实很像先王。

source: But it wouldn't speak to us, so we brought Hamlet thinking it might speak to him.
target: 可它不肯跟我们说话，所以我们带来了哈姆雷特，想着它也许会跟他说。

source: Did it?
target: 那它说了吗？

source: Yes. But Hamlet wouldn't say a word about it. And now... we'll never know what it was he heard.
target: 说了。可哈姆雷特一个字都不肯透露。而现在……我们再也不会知道他听到了什么。

source: If only I had known things would turn out like this...
target: 要是我早知道事情会变成这样……

source: Given that it only spoke to Hamlet, I don't know if it'll ever appear again.
target: 它只跟哈姆雷特说话，所以我不知道它还会不会再出现。

source: Yes. But Hamlet wouldn't say a word about it.
target: 说了。可哈姆雷特一个字都不肯透露。

source: If I were to go to the walls at midnight, could I meet the spirit myself?
target: 如果我午夜去城墙上，能亲自见到那个幽灵吗？

source: Afraid not. We tried. It only drifted around, too far away for us to communicate.
target: 恐怕不行。我们试过了。它只是四处飘荡，离得太远，我们没法跟它说话。

source: I advised Hamlet that spirits are a sign of the devil's handiwork. I warned him to stay away.
target: 我告诉哈姆雷特，鬼魂的出现是魔鬼作祟的征兆。我警告过他，别靠近。

source: Still, I believe he may now know how to speak to it again.
target: 不过，我想他也许现在已经知道怎样再次跟它说话了。

source: I've heard you're seeing spirits, Hamlet.
target: 哈姆雷特，我听说你看见了鬼魂。

source: On the walls, at midnight. Is that right?
target: 在城墙上，午夜的时候。是吗？

source: You-- you believe what I said?
target: 你——你相信我说的话？

source: What can you tell me about the spirit? Where can I find it?
target: 关于那个幽灵，你能告诉我些什么？我去哪里能找到它？

source: Don't you think me mad?
target: 你不觉得我疯了吗？

source: Of course. But not because you talk to ghosts.
target: 当然觉得。但不是因为你跟鬼魂说话。

source: It's gone now, I expect. Its bloody desire has been fulfilled.
target: 我想它现在已经离开了。它那血腥的心愿已经实现了。

source: Claudius is dead. My father's soul can finally ascend to Heaven without further tarry.
target: 克劳狄斯死了。我父亲的灵魂终于可以升入天堂，不必再滞留于此。

source: Tell me, have you reported any of this to the King yet?
target: 告诉我，你有没有把这些事报告给国王？

source: No. This is between us.
target: 没有。这是我们之间的事。

source: How can I take your word?
target: 我怎么能相信你的话？

source: I'm afraid to trust you, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我不敢相信你。

source: You're ever-so-slightly too late on the matter of trust. You already divulged everything to me.
target: 现在才考虑信不信我，稍微晚了那么一点。你已经把一切都告诉我了。

source: And now I'm off to find that very spirit.
target: 现在，我要去找那个幽灵了。

source: You believed me when I spoke of your uncle's guilt. Why hesitate now?
target: 我说你叔父有罪时，你相信了我。现在为什么又犹豫了？

source: A murder among kings is one thing. Rumors have run wild these last few months about my father's death.
target: 国王之间的谋杀是一回事。过去这几个月，关于我父亲之死的传言早已满天飞。

source: But a spirit-- a vision, is something else entirely. You could have my reputation shattered. And my uncle would be all too gleeful over it.
target: 可一个幽灵——一个幻象，就完全是另一回事了。你可能会让我名誉扫地。而我叔父对此一定会乐不可支。

source: You must have learned this information from some of my closest companions. Men I trusted to keep their silence.
target: 你一定是从我最亲近的几个同伴那里听说的。我原本相信他们会守口如瓶。

source: If I can't trust even them, how can I speak of it further to anyone else?
target: 如果连他们都不能信任，我又怎么能再跟别人谈这件事？

source: But a spirit... a vision... is something else entirely. You could have my reputation shattered. And my uncle would be all too gleeful over it.
target: 可一个幽灵……一个幻象……就完全是另一回事了。你可能会让我名誉扫地。而我叔父对此一定会乐不可支。

source: Prove that I can trust you, and I'll tell you how to meet my father's ghost.
target: 证明你值得我信任，我就告诉你怎样见到我父亲的幽灵。

source: That's ridiculous. But—fine. How?
target: 真荒唐。不过——好吧。怎么证明？

source: My mother keeps a diary in her bedroom, detailing her every thought. She writes in it often. If the ghost is telling the truth...
target: 我母亲在卧室里放着一本日记，详细记下她所有的想法。她经常写。如果那个幽灵说的是真的……

source: Then that diary might have the proof we need.
target: 那么，那本日记里也许有我们需要的证据。

source: She's always been fond of you. You can get into her room. Find it, and we'll talk.
target: 她一直很喜欢你。你能进她的房间。找到日记，我们再谈。

source: But if you tell the King, not even God himself can save you.
target: 但你要是告诉国王，就连上帝亲自来，也救不了你。

source: I already asked you to find my mother's diary earlier. I will trust you when you succeed.
target: 我之前已经让你去找我母亲的日记了。等你找到，我就会相信你。

source: But if you tell the King about this spirit, it will mean my destruction.
target: 但你要是把这个幽灵的事告诉国王，我就毁了。

source: If you tell the King about this spirit, it will mean my destruction.
target: 你要是把这个幽灵的事告诉国王，我就毁了。

source: It was you who told him, wasn't it?
target: 是你告诉他的，对不对？

source: I was trying to help, Hamlet.
target: 哈姆雷特，我是想帮忙。

source: You did. I can hardly believe it.
target: 你真的告诉他了。我简直不敢相信。

source: Or perhaps I can. Either way, the more I think about it, the more it all begins to fall apart.
target: 也许我并非不敢相信。不管怎样，我越想，这一切就越开始分崩离析。

source: You know, Ophelia, I'm finished with you, well and truly. Leave me alone.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你知道吗，我跟你彻底完了。别再来烦我。

source: Hamlet believes he spoke to his father's spirit.
target: 哈姆雷特相信自己跟父亲的幽灵说过话。

source: ...What? But that can't...
target: ……什么？可那不可能……

source: You know, Ophelia... Something strange kept me awake in the night. Almost as though a presence at the foot of my bed spoke to me. Warm, familiar...
target: 奥菲莉娅，你知道吗……夜里有种奇怪的感觉，让我睡不着。仿佛有什么在我床尾跟我说话。温暖，又熟悉……

source: Heavens, what am I saying now? I must have been dreaming.
target: 天哪，我这是在说什么？我一定是在做梦。

source: It seems others have at least seen a spirit on the castle walls as well.
target: 看来，至少还有别人也在城墙上见过幽灵。

source: That couldn't be... could it?
target: 那不可能……对吧？

source: Surely if there were a spirit, it would have appeared to me as well?
target: 如果真有幽灵，它应该也会出现在我面前吧？

source: The walls, you said? At night?
target: 你说是在城墙上？夜里？

source: Yes, my dear?
target: 怎么了，亲爱的？

source: About Hamlet's late-night visit... He wasn't exactly professing his love to me.
target: 关于哈姆雷特深夜来找我的事……他并不是在向我表白。

source: Hamlet was acting deranged when he saw me last night.
target: 昨晚哈姆雷特来见我时，表现得像疯了一样。

source: Apparently he's distressed because he believes he saw the late King's ghost.
target: 看来他心神不宁，是因为他相信自己看到了先王的幽灵。

source: A... ghost, you say?
target: 你说……幽灵？

source: Oh. Well.
target: 哦。这样啊。

source: Clearly, the prince is more distraught over his father's death than I realized.
target: 显然，父亲的死让王子比我想象中更悲痛。

source: Though it would have been useful to know this information before I told the court!
target: 不过，要是在我告诉宫廷众人之前就知道这些，那可就好了！

source: No, perhaps it matters not. Surely, love plays some part in his madness...
target: 不，也许这并不重要。他的疯癫，肯定也有几分是因为爱情……

source: Yes, yes, my intuition is never wrong.
target: 对，对，我的直觉从来不会错。

source: Fascinating. Thank you for being honest with me, my dear.
target: 真有意思。亲爱的，谢谢你对我说实话。

source: This provides an improved perspective on things.
target: 这样我就能更清楚地看待这些事了。

source: Apparently he was distressed because he believed he saw the late King's ghost.
target: 看来他当时心神不宁，是因为他相信自己看到了先王的幽灵。

source: What a pity.
target: 真令人惋惜。

source: Clearly, the prince was more distraught over his father's death than any of us knew.
target: 显然，父亲的死让王子当时承受的悲痛，比我们任何人所知的都更深。

source: If only we could have helped break him from his spell.
target: 要是我们当时能帮他摆脱那种迷乱就好了。

source: Hamlet believes he spoke to his father's spirit. Do you know anything of it?
target: 哈姆雷特相信自己跟父亲的幽灵说过话。你知道这件事吗？

source: Aye! Rattled the poor boy somethin' fierce. Seemed to almost change 'im something dreadfully.
target: 是啊！可把那可怜的小伙子吓坏了。看着简直像变了个人，怪吓人的。

source: Whether it wos really King Hamlet though, or simply some demon sent from Hell...
target: 不过，那到底真是哈姆雷特国王，还是地狱派来的什么恶魔……

source: Well, I've heard Satan does tempt humans in this kind o' way.
target: 唉，我听说撒旦确实会用这种法子诱惑人。

source: So I don' trust what I saw, myself!
target: 所以，就连我自己也信不过亲眼看到的东西！

source: Someone wants me dead. I've come seeking your advice.
target: 有人想要我的命。我是来向你求教的。

source: How curious. You know precisely who wants you dead!
target: 真有意思。你明明很清楚是谁想要你的命！

source: Are you perhaps trying to frame the innocent?
target: 难道你想陷害无辜的人？

source: Devious... but fascinating! Bold, but meaningless!
target: 阴险……却很有趣！大胆，却毫无意义！

source: If this is the sort of sad, silly thing you've resorted to, allow me to grant you a tool which can help you.
target: 如果你已经沦落到要用这种可悲又愚蠢的手段，就让我给你一件能帮上忙的工具吧。

source: I have far more exciting methods of sussing out information.
target: 我有办法打探消息，精彩得多。

source: Mmm. A most precarious predicament.
target: 嗯。真是个凶险至极的困境。

source: I've seen your funeral, you know. After you're dead and the worms have gotten to you.
target: 你知道吗，我见过你的葬礼。那时你已经死了，虫子也已经开始啃食你了。

source: They'll have to fish your corpse out of the river, already prey for maggots.
target: 他们得把你的尸体从河里捞出来，那时它已经成了蛆虫的食物。

source: Lovely. Well, if you're of no help, I'll be on my way.
target: 真好。那么，如果你帮不上忙，我就告辞了。

source: Now, now... I was getting to the point. You can be so impatient.
target: 别急，别急……我正要说到重点。你可真是太没耐心了。

source: At your funeral, two men jump into the grave and fight over who loves you the most.
target: 在你的葬礼上，两个男人跳进墓穴，为谁更爱你而打了起来。

source: Your most passionate admirers: Hamlet, and your own brother!
target: 最热烈地爱着你的两个人：哈姆雷特，还有你自己的哥哥！

source: And of course, failing those two clowns, I suspect a man of the law could keep you under sword and guard for a bit!
target: 当然，要是那两个小丑都不管用，我想一位执法者应该能持剑守护你一阵子！

source: That's a lot of options. What do you recommend I do first?
target: 选择还真不少。你建议我先做什么？

source: Why, I often turn to the arts to solve such a dilemma.
target: 这个嘛，我常常借助艺术来解决这样的困境。

source: Performance can provide great catharsis, you know. If it rings true with a particular member of the audience, it can inspire great change.
target: 你知道，演出能让人充分宣泄情感。如果某位观众觉得它说中了自己的心事，就可能因此发生很大的改变。

source: I sense that you may have some familiarity with my work already.
target: 我感觉，你也许已经对我的作品有些了解了。

source: If you are interested in seeing me perform something special--maybe based upon some juicy gossip--feel free to let me know!
target: 如果你想看我演点特别的——也许以某个劲爆的传闻为题材——尽管告诉我！

source: Laertes, please, listen. I believe someone is trying to kill me.
target: 雷欧提斯，求你听我说。我相信有人想杀我。

source: I know how insane it sounds, but... it's true. Please.
target: 我知道这听起来很荒唐，可……这是真的。求你了。

source: What? Are you certain?
target: 什么？你确定？

source: I've never been more sure of anything in my life.
target: 我这辈子从没这么确定过。

source: How can you know this?
target: 你怎么会知道？

source: (If I tell him I know it's Brit, I'm certain he'll be furious.)
target: （如果我告诉他，我知道是布莉特，他一定会大发雷霆。）

source: (He'd never believe the truth, but...)
target: （他绝不会相信真相，可是……）

source: Someone has come to my chambers, late in the evening, and tried the knob. I hear footsteps in the hallway...
target: 有人深夜来过我的房门外，试着转动门把手。我听见走廊里有脚步声……

source: And a looming presence. Please, believe me, Laertes. I tell you the truth.
target: 还感觉到有什么在逼近。求你相信我，雷欧提斯。我说的都是真的。

source: I would doubt you, but... I haven't seen that look on your face in years.
target: 我本来会怀疑你的，可……我已经好多年没见过你脸上有那种表情了。

source: I believe you.
target: 我相信你。

source: I can't explain it, Laertes, but I swear to you, this is the truth.
target: 我解释不清，雷欧提斯，但我向你发誓，这是真的。

source: I know, dearheart.
target: 我知道，亲爱的。

source: Meet me in in the guards' quarters. We both have friends there. Let us discuss the evidence further then.
target: 到卫兵宿舍来找我。我们在那里都有朋友。到时候我们再仔细谈谈这些证据。

source: Someone is after my life.
target: 有人想要我的命。

source: I know it sounds insane, but—Hamlet, it's true. Please, you've got to believe me.
target: 我知道这听起来很荒唐，可——哈姆雷特，这是真的。求你了，你一定要相信我。

source: I see. So that's why you wanted to meet my father's spirit.
target: 我明白了。所以你才想见我父亲的幽灵。

source: Who would be after you, Ophelia?
target: 奥菲莉娅，会有谁想害你呢？

source: You've never hurt anyone in the castle. Present company excepted.
target: 你从没伤害过城堡里的任何人。除了眼前这个。

source: (Well, it's Brit-- or was-- but I'll feign ignorance.)
target: （是布莉特——或者说，曾经是——但我还是装作不知道吧。）

source: That's the thing. I haven't a clue.
target: 问题就在这里。我毫无头绪。

source: How, then, do you know someone wants you dead?
target: 那你怎么知道有人想要你的命？

source: I... I've seen it happen.
target: 我……我见过这件事发生。

source: As in, a... vision?
target: 你是说……幻象？

source: Y...Yes. Hamlet, you've got to trust me—please—
target: 是……是的。哈姆雷特，你一定要相信我——求你了——

source: Is there anyone whom you suspect? Have you spoken to Bernardo about this?
target: 你有怀疑的人吗？你跟贝尔纳多说过这件事吗？

source: Merely say the word, and he'll speak to anyone who troubles you. I'm certain he'll suss out ill intent.
target: 只要你开口，他就会去找那些让你不安的人谈谈。我相信他一定能查出谁心怀恶意。

source: Even if such a fear isn't unfounded, there's little I can do about it.
target: 就算你的恐惧并非毫无根据，我能做的也很有限。

source: Much as I hate to admit it, this is the kind of situation your lousy brother would know how to fix.
target: 虽然我很不愿意承认，但这种事，你那个讨厌的哥哥倒是知道该怎么解决。

source: But he left, did he not? His boat was scheduled to leave Thursday at ten, after all.
target: 可他已经走了，不是吗？毕竟，他的船原定星期四十点开。

source: But he's leaving so soon, isn't he? I saw him head down to the docks at daybreak.
target: 可他很快就要走了，不是吗？天刚亮的时候，我看见他往码头去了。

source: For now, remain close to Guard Captain Bernardo. He can protect you in ways I cannot.
target: 眼下，别离卫兵队长贝尔纳多太远。他能给你我无法给予的保护。

source: Someone is trying to kill me off, and I don't know why.
target: 有人想杀了我，我不知道为什么。

source: Ophelia! What a terrible thing to say.
target: 奥菲莉娅！这话也太可怕了。

source: You've never harmed a hair on anyone's head. What could someone have against you?
target: 你从来没伤过别人一根头发。谁会跟你有什么仇呢？

source: That's utter nonsense.
target: 这完全是胡说。

source: After the strange things you've been saying lately, I'm starting to worry about your health.
target: 你最近说了那么多奇怪的话，我开始担心你的身体了。

source: My dear, please stay indoors and get as much sleep as you can—all right? You're beginning to sound... well, like my son.
target: 亲爱的，待在屋里，尽量多睡一会儿，好吗？你说话开始有点……唉，像我儿子了。

source: If you ever truly had cause to fear for your life, Bernardo would watch over you, as he does us all.
target: 如果你真有理由担心自己的性命，贝尔纳多会保护你的，就像他保护我们所有人一样。

source: You can trust the Guard Captain's instincts. He's the finest warrior we have at Elsinore.
target: 你可以相信卫兵队长的直觉。他是我们埃尔西诺最出色的战士。

source: Someone is after my life, and I've experienced things I cannot explain.
target: 有人想要我的命，而且我经历了一些无法解释的事。

source: And you have some proof of this?
target: 那你有什么证据吗？

source: Someone has been rattling my doorknob late at night, trying to break into my rooms.
target: 有人深夜摇晃我的门把手，想闯进我的房间。

source: And there have been noises—voices—I fear someone is trying to find and harm me.
target: 而且还有响动——说话声——我怕有人想找到我，伤害我。

source: Furthermore, as I mentioned before, I've overheard... a conversation... implying that the King may want me dead.
target: 还有，正如我之前提过的，我无意间听到……一段谈话……其中暗示，国王可能想要我的命。

source: Laertes heard it too. We both have reason to believe the source may be telling the truth.
target: 雷欧提斯也听到了。我们都有理由相信，那人说的可能是真的。

source: From the moment you and Hamlet began your courtship, I did fear the King might feel threatened by it.
target: 从你和哈姆雷特开始交往的那一刻起，我就确实担心过，国王可能会因此感到受威胁。

source: We ought to proceed very delicately in situations like these. And of course, there's only one way to truly solve this.
target: 这种情况，我们应该极其谨慎地处理。当然，真正解决这件事的办法只有一个。

source: We must get you out of Elsinore.
target: 我们必须让你离开埃尔西诺。

source: Not now. But soon. Once the present moment has calmed somewhat.
target: 不是现在。但很快。等眼下的局势稍微平静一些。

source: Often young ladies who are too distracting at court go to Copenhagen to improve their standing in society.
target: 在宫廷里太过引人注目的年轻姑娘，常会去哥本哈根，提升自己的社会地位。

source: Such a thing would benefit you for a while, I think.
target: 我想，去那里待一阵子会对你有好处。

source: If Hamlet and Claudius are the ones with the problem, why must I be asked to leave the castle? I've done nothing wrong.
target: 如果有问题的是哈姆雷特和克劳狄斯，为什么非要让我离开城堡？我又没做错什么。

source: It's simply the way things are, my dear.
target: 事情就是这样，亲爱的。

source: Regardless, I don't believe there's an immediate danger to you. Still, stay far from Hamlet until we can find somewhere to place you in Copenhagen. Yes?
target: 不管怎样，我不认为你眼下有什么危险。不过，在我们找到哥本哈根的安置之处前，你还是离哈姆雷特远一些。好吗？

source: Furthermore, as I mentioned before, I overheard... a conversation... implying that the King may have wanted me dead.
target: 还有，就像我之前说的，我无意中听到……一段谈话……话里的意思是，国王可能曾想要我死。

source: Laertes heard it too.
target: 雷欧提斯也听到了。

source: Now that he's passed, of course, the threat seems far diminished.
target: 当然，如今他已经去世，这威胁似乎也小了许多。

source: Er... what makes you say that, dearest?
target: 呃……亲爱的，你为什么这么说？

source: It's... it's a... I have a sense I've experienced it before. I know how insane it sounds, but... it's true, I promise.
target: 这……这是……我有种感觉，觉得自己以前经历过。我知道这听起来有多荒唐，可……这是真的，我保证。

source: Dearest, have you been sleeping well?
target: 亲爱的，你最近睡得好吗？

source: No, I haven't—but that's not the reason for this, Father.
target: 不好——可这不是原因，父亲。

source: And Hamlet, has he been giving you trouble?
target: 那哈姆雷特呢，他最近有没有给你添麻烦？

source: A little more than usual—Father, listen. I'm telling the truth!
target: 比平时多一点——父亲，听我说。我说的是真的！

source: Love. You're worrying me.
target: 宝贝。你这样让我很担心。

source: If your brother were here, he'd only indulge you in this. Luckily for us both, he isn't.
target: 要是你哥哥在这儿，他只会由着你胡思乱想。幸好他不在，这对我们两个都好。

source: (He's always taken care of me when I've been in trouble before.)
target: （以前我遇到麻烦时，他总会照顾我。）

source: I assure you it will be fine. But I've got court affairs to attend to, and Laertes is preparing to leave from the docks as we speak.
target: 我保证，一切都会没事的。不过我还有宫廷事务要处理，雷欧提斯这会儿也正在码头准备启程。

source: Is this why Laertes cancelled his trip? Because of this?
target: 雷欧提斯就是为这个取消了行程？就因为这件事？

source: Not to mention, with the King frightened of a potential spy in his court—a rumor like this could be quite dangerous.
target: 更何况，国王正担心宫廷里可能有间谍——这样的传言可能相当危险。

source: Tell the good Bernardo of your concerns, if they run so deep.
target: 如果你实在这么担心，就去跟好心的贝尔纳多说说吧。

source: Someone is trying to threaten my life.
target: 有人正试图威胁我的性命。

source: What? Who?
target: 什么？谁？

source: I don't know. But they are.
target: 我不知道。但确实有人这么做。

source: How do you know?
target: 你怎么知道？

source: I don't have proof, but—I—I let's say I had an unnerving experience which made me doubt my safety.
target: 我没有证据，可——我——我，就当我经历了一件令人不安的事，让我觉得自己并不安全。

source: I can add more patrols to the night's watch, if you're worried. But Ophelia, you're a noblewoman of the court, and relatively unthreatening. Who would want you dead?
target: 如果你担心，我可以加强夜间巡逻。可是奥菲莉娅，你是宫廷里的贵族小姐，也没什么威胁。谁会想要你死呢？

source: Bernardo, please—haven't we known each other long enough for you to believe me?
target: 贝尔纳多，求你了——我们认识这么久了，你还不能相信我吗？

source: Well, if it will bring you comfort... you should know I've been asked by the King to meet with anyone deemed suspicious or threatening to the throne.
target: 好吧，如果这能让你安心……你该知道，国王已经命我约见所有被认为可疑或威胁王位的人。

source: Well, if it will bring you comfort... before he passed, His Majesty requested I meet with anyone deemed suspicious or threatening to the throne.
target: 好吧，如果这能让你安心……陛下去世前，曾命我约见所有被认为可疑或威胁王位的人。

source: I intend to continue that mission, even now.
target: 即便现在，我也打算继续执行这项任务。

source: If you sense someone's acting strangely, ask them to meet with me. I'll speak with them further and identify whether or not they're a danger to you.
target: 如果你觉得有人举止反常，就让那人来见我。我会进一步谈谈，查明那人是否会威胁到你。

source: It need not take the form of some solemn meeting. I'll keep it to a lightweight chat of sorts.
target: 不必搞成什么严肃的会面。我就跟他们随意聊聊。

source: My eternal thanks, Bernardo. That's all I wanted.
target: 我会一直感激你的，贝尔纳多。我想要的就只是这样。

source: Someone is trying to kill me off. But I don't know who.
target: 有人想杀了我。可我不知道是谁。

source: Oh! I love a good thriller. I'll play your sidekick.
target: 哦！我最喜欢精彩的惊险故事了。我来当你的助手。

source: Horatio, I'm not trying to be funny.
target: 霍拉旭，我不是在逗你笑。

source: Oh. Er, I thought we were sort of... play-acting. Really? Whoever would want to kill you?
target: 哦。呃，我还以为我们是在……演戏呢。真的？到底谁会想杀你？

source: No letter with a mysterious wax seal? No threatening silhouettes outside your bedroom door?
target: 没有带着神秘蜡封的信？卧室门外也没有吓人的人影？

source: Well, there was someone...
target: 嗯，倒是有个人……

source: Did you catch what they looked like?
target: 你看清那人长什么样了吗？

source: No. And even if I did, I've no idea if it was someone I knew or a stranger.
target: 没有。就算看清了，我也不知道那是认识的人，还是陌生人。

source: Well, that does it, then. You'll just have to wait for this antagonist to make another appearance.
target: 嗯，那就没办法了。你只能等这个反派再次登场。

source: If they do, surely Bernardo can dispatch them with one swing of the sword, right?
target: 要是那人再出现，贝尔纳多肯定能一剑解决，对吧？

source: In fact, you should go tell Bernardo of this. Watch him turn white as a sheet. He takes these sorts of things so seriously. Bless him.
target: 说真的，你该去把这事告诉贝尔纳多。看他吓得脸色煞白。他对这种事可认真了。真是个好人。

source: Someone is trying to kill me off. Maybe you'll believe me.
target: 有人想杀了我。也许你会相信我。

source: Is there a punchline here? This must be a joke, right?
target: 笑点在哪儿？这一定是个玩笑，对吧？

source: No. Someone wants me dead.
target: 不是。有人想要我死。

source: Well, that's melodramatic.
target: 哎，这话可真够夸张的。

source: It's sort of a... premonition, really. But I swear, it's true.
target: 其实，这有点像……一种预感。可我发誓，这是真的。

source: You mentioned earlier that you thought the King might be behind this.
target: 你之前提过，你觉得这背后可能是国王。

source: If he were after your life, how would you know?
target: 就算他真的想要你的命，你又怎么会知道？

source: Someone physically threatened me. Let's keep it at that.
target: 有人用武力威胁过我。我就说到这里。

source: They-- they did?
target: 那人——那人真这么做了？

source: No. That's impossible.
target: 不。这不可能。

source: I see through this. You're trying to persuade me to play into this little game, then set me up to look like a fool.
target: 我看穿你的把戏了。你想骗我陪你玩这场小游戏，再设法让我出丑。

source: Go away.
target: 走开。

source: I've heard of things like this before.
target: 我以前听说过这种事。

source: You have?
target: 你听说过？

source: Yes. It's a form of insanity that comes on to women during times of intense pressure.
target: 是的。女人在承受巨大压力时，会发作的一种疯病。

source: Ah. Hysteria! That's the word.
target: 啊，癔症！就是这个词。

source: I'm not hysterical, Brit. I'm right. I know I am.
target: 我没有癔症，布莉特。我说得没错。我知道自己没错。

source: I don't know why I thought you would help me.
target: 我真不知道自己为什么会以为你能帮我。

source: Someone is trying to kill me off.
target: 有人想杀了我。

source: Someone is trying to kill all of us off! His name is Death, and he comes for us all in time!
target: 有人想把我们全都杀了！他的名字叫死神，迟早会来找我们每一个人！

source: I lived through plague. Don't tell me about death, girl!
target: 我可是从瘟疫里活下来的人。丫头，别跟我讲什么死亡！

source: We must outrun it all our short lives!
target: 我们短短的一辈子，都得跑在它前头！

source: Irma, I'm being earnest. I'm afraid for my life. Can you help me?
target: 伊尔玛，我是认真的。我怕自己没命。你能帮帮我吗？

source: Oh. Apologies, Fräulein. W-well, ah, have you spoken to Guard Captain Bernardo?
target: 哦。对不起，小姐。那、那么，啊，你跟卫队长贝尔纳多说过了吗？

source: No woman can be afraid with a man twice her size at her side.
target: 有个块头是自己两倍的男人守在身旁，哪个女人还会害怕呢。

source: I haven't got time for your fanciful daydreams, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我没时间听你那些异想天开的白日梦。

source: When you were a child, I entertained them. Now that I'm King, I don't have time to entertain anyone.
target: 你小时候，我还会陪你胡思乱想。如今我当了国王，没时间再陪任何人玩了。

source: If you've a legitimate security concern, please report it to Bernardo.
target: 如果你确实有安全方面的顾虑，请向贝尔纳多报告。

source: Where is your father? He ought to mind you more closely, or take you to a doctor.
target: 你父亲在哪儿？他该把你看紧一些，或者带你去看医生。

source: Oh, Ophelia.
target: 唉，奥菲莉娅。

source: I can understand that with your father's death, much has changed.
target: 我能理解，你父亲去世后，很多事都变了。

source: That brother of yours ought to watch out for you.
target: 你那个哥哥该多照顾你。

source: And-- with young Laertes gone, I expect your heart is heavy right now.
target: 还有——年轻的雷欧提斯也不在了，想必你现在心情很沉重。

source: I find myself deeply concerned for your well-being, indeed. Just not for the reasons you propose.
target: 我确实很担心你的状况。只是原因并不是你说的那些。

source: Someone's after my life. Do you know who might want me dead?
target: 有人想要我的命。你知道谁可能想要我死吗？

source: You? Certainly not. But...
target: 你？当然不知道。不过……

source: If my plot to fake my own death works as nicely as I think it will, perhaps you ought to give it a try!
target: 如果我的假死计划能像我想的那样顺利，或许你也该试试！

source: At least if you died, people would probably be upset, right?
target: 至少要是你死了，大家大概会难过的，对吧？

source: That... doesn't make me feel better, Guilda.
target: 这……并没让我好受些，吉尔达。

source: Oh, dear. I suppose that is rather harrowing.
target: 哎呀。我想这确实挺吓人的。

source: Well, have you gravely offended anyone as of late?
target: 那么，你最近有没有严重得罪过谁？

source: Are you pregnant with anyone's illegitimate child?
target: 你是不是怀了谁的私生子？

source: N-not to my knowledge.
target: 据、据我所知，没有。

source: Hopped into bed with anyone's husband? Or wife, for that matter?
target: 跟谁的丈夫上过床？或者跟谁的妻子？

source: Again, no to both.
target: 还是没有，两种都没有。

source: Then I am pleased to announce that all possible reasons for your demise have been exhausted.
target: 那我很高兴地宣布，所有可能让你丧命的原因都已排除了。

source: Go, and live without fear!
target: 去吧，无所畏惧地生活吧！

source: I feel as though time is repeating itself for me, over and over again.
target: 我觉得，时间似乎在我身上一遍又一遍地重复。

source: Just as it was for my father...
target: 就像我父亲经历的那样……

source: There are so many things I don't understand about the universe.
target: 这个宇宙里，有太多我不明白的事。

source: I feel as though the fabric of things has been rended in two.
target: 我觉得，万物织成的布仿佛被撕成了两半。

source: And I am falling through the hole in the center...
target: 而我正从中央的破洞里坠落……

source: The last few hours have been enormously eventful for this dull place.
target: 对这个沉闷的地方来说，过去几个小时里发生的事可真够多的。

source: Rest a while, if you can. I've been sleeping whenever I have a moment. It will help settle the strangeness, I think.
target: 有空就休息一会儿吧。我最近一有时间就睡觉。我想，这能让那种怪异的感觉平息一些。

source: Yes, life in this castle does seem to drone on, ever repeating...
target: 是啊，这城堡里的日子似乎总是单调地延续着，永远重复……

source: Really repeating, Hamlet.
target: 是真的在重复，哈姆雷特。

source: You know, you really have gotten odd—
target: 你知道吗，你真的变得古怪了——

source: All these things you're saying about murdering and time and—
target: 你说的那些事，什么谋杀，什么时间，还有——

source: And they say I'm the mad one.
target: 他们竟然还说我才是疯了的那个。

source: Why is time repeating?
target: 时间为什么在重复？

source: You can end this game any time you like, my dear.
target: 亲爱的，只要你愿意，随时都能结束这场游戏。

source: Being obstinate will merely delay the inevitable.
target: 固执只会拖延那不可避免的结局。

source: ...You know, Quince. Every time you say that, I feel the strength to search a little longer.
target: ……你知道吗，奎因斯。每次你这么说，我就有了继续找下去的力气。

source: The more you try to break my spirit... the longer this world will be drawn out.
target: 你越想摧垮我的意志……这个世界就会延续得越久。

source: I operate on the scale of centuries. Not days. Let's chat again in a hundred years of this, shall we?
target: 我的时间是以世纪计算的。不是以天。等这样过上一百年，我们再聊，好吗？

source: I am, after all, an exceedingly patient man.
target: 毕竟，我可是个极其有耐心的人。

source: And if one loves a good story, one must adopt a certain level of patience. The good ones are... slow burns.
target: 如果一个人喜欢好故事，就必须有些耐心。好故事总是……慢慢酝酿的。

source: Why do you think time is repeating?
target: 你觉得时间为什么在重复？

source: Perhaps there's something I haven't done. Perhaps I'm being punished by... by God, or something.
target: 也许有什么事我还没做。也许我正在受到……受到上帝，或者什么的惩罚。

source: They say spirits roam the earth until they find their final purpose...
target: 人们说，灵魂会在人间游荡，直到找到自己最终的使命……

source: What rubbish. No, that's not it at all.
target: 一派胡言。不，根本不是这么回事。

source: This world is without purpose, divine or otherwise. There is only the meaning you make for yourself.
target: 这个世界没有目的，无论是神赋予的，还是别的。只有你为自己创造的意义。

source: After all, that person is still coming to kill you, aren't they?
target: 毕竟，那个人还是会来杀你，不是吗？

source: If other corpses could have another chance at life, they'd spend less time on philosophy than you are, I'm certain.
target: 如果其他尸体也能有一次重活的机会，我敢肯定，他们花在哲学上的时间会比你少。

source: Why don't you find a way to prevent your death?
target: 你为什么不想办法避免自己的死亡？

source: After all, the Prince of Norway himself has found a way to Elsinore's doorstep.
target: 毕竟，挪威王子本人都已经设法来到埃尔西诺门前了。

source: If all citizens of conquered countries could have another chance at deposing such coups... they'd be blindingly grateful.
target: 如果那些被征服国家的所有国民，都能再有一次机会推翻这种政变……他们一定会感激得忘乎所以。

source: After all, the spirit of King Hamlet still lingers within these walls.
target: 毕竟，哈姆雷特国王的灵魂仍在这城墙之内徘徊。

source: Haven't you found a way to free him yet, or have you spent all your time in crisis?
target: 你还没找到让他解脱的办法吗？还是说，你把时间全花在应付危机上了？

source: Certainly you've heard Hamlet saw the ghost of his father.
target: 你肯定听说过哈姆雷特看到了他父亲的幽灵。

source: Mightn't that be the source of his madness, from which your own father lost his life?
target: 那会不会正是他发疯的原因，而你的父亲也因此丧了命？

source: A good daughter might be more motivated to pursue that thread and spend less time on philosophy.
target: 一个好女儿，或许会更积极地追查这条线索，少花些时间琢磨哲学。

source: The two of us are outside the flow of all time, right?
target: 我们两个都在整个时间流之外，对吗？

source: Yes. In a way, it is peaceful.
target: 是的。从某种意义上说，这倒也安宁。

source: All suffering is, in one way or another, caused by death, or the fear of it...
target: 一切痛苦，都以这样或那样的方式源于死亡，或对死亡的恐惧……

source: Now that fear is removed forever, replaced by an equally-deep boredom.
target: 如今，那种恐惧永远消失了，取而代之的是同样深重的无聊。

source: Even still, this boredom is refreshing at the moment, though I anticipate it, too, will grow old.
target: 即便如此，眼下这无聊倒还让人觉得新鲜，虽然我料想，迟早也会厌倦它。

source: And when it does... well.
target: 到那时……唉。

source: To divest oneself of the fear of death, one need only give into it.
target: 要摆脱对死亡的恐惧，只需向死亡屈服。

source: How does one divest oneself of eternal boredom?
target: 可要如何摆脱永恒的无聊呢？

source: I suppose you'd start acting strangely. Doing all sorts of things to pass the time.
target: 我想，人会开始做出些古怪的举动。为了打发时间，什么事都做。

source: Indeed. A most frightening prospect.
target: 的确。那是极其可怕的前景。

source: I don't know how or why, but I've lived through this same day once before, as though time is repeating.
target: 我不知道怎么回事，也不知道为什么，但同样的这一天，我以前已经经历过一次，仿佛时间在重复。

source: Oh, Ophelia. You've been through so much in such a short time. No wonder you feel strangely.
target: 唉，奥菲莉娅。这么短的时间里，你经历了这么多。难怪你会有奇怪的感觉。

source: Perhaps you've been ill and are only just noticing it?
target: 或许你早就病了，只是现在才察觉？

source: When the color comes over me, I feel faint as well, and strange, as though time is passing slowly and yet quickly...
target: 我脸上泛起潮红时，也会觉得晕眩，感觉很奇怪，仿佛时间过得很慢，却又很快……

source: No, it's not like sickness, it's—it's real.
target: 不，这不像生病，这是——这是真的。

source: Oh, dear. Ophelia... hrm.
target: 哎呀。奥菲莉娅……嗯。

source: You've been saying the strangest things lately. Murders, repeating time...
target: 你最近说的话真是古怪。谋杀，重复的时间……

source: Have a lie down, have a bit of wine, and come back later, why don't you? I'm certain you'll feel good as new.
target: 不如躺下休息，喝点葡萄酒，晚些时候再来，好吗？我相信你会恢复如初的。

source: I feel as though time is repeating itself somehow.
target: 我觉得，时间似乎不知怎么在重复。

source: Time... time is going back and forth in a strange way.
target: 时间……时间正以一种奇怪的方式来回往复。

source: Oh hell, sister. Have you been drinking?
target: 见鬼，妹妹。你喝酒了？

source: No! I'm telling the truth!
target: 没有！我说的是真的！

source: I don't know how or why, but I've lived through this same day before.
target: 我不知道怎么回事，也不知道为什么，但同样的这一天，我以前已经经历过了。

source: It's odd, I know. But it feels as though time is...
target: 我知道这很奇怪。但感觉就像时间在……

source: It seems it's a common madness in this castle.
target: 看来，这种疯病在城堡里很常见。

source: And now it's gotten into your bones.
target: 如今，它也已经侵入了你的骨子里。

source: Well, I won't let you go the way they did.
target: 不过，我不会让你走上他们的老路。

source: Who? Who is 'they?'
target: 谁？“他们”是谁？

source: I love you, dearest. Get some rest.
target: 我爱你，亲爱的。去休息一下吧。

source: I have a sense that time is somehow repeating itself, and I've lived through this before.
target: 我感觉时间不知怎么在重复，而这一切我以前已经经历过了。

source: Ophelia... are you all right?
target: 奥菲莉娅……你还好吗？

source: Yes. It's not my health, it's... something else.
target: 我没事。不是身体出了问题，是……别的事。

source: Are you certain? The last time you were ill...
target: 你确定吗？上次你生病的时候……

source: I know. I covered it up. But I was a child then. It won't happen again.
target: 我知道。我把病情瞒了下来。可我那时还是个孩子。不会再那样了。

source: I'm not as fragile as I used to be, Bernardo. You don't always have to look out for me.
target: 贝尔纳多，我已经不像以前那么脆弱了。你不用总是照看我。

source: I wouldn't watch you so closely if you didn't make me worry so often.
target: 要不是你老让我担心，我也不会把你看得这么紧。

source: I don't know why, but I've lived through this same day once before, as if time is repeating.
target: 我不知道为什么，可同样的这一天，我之前已经经历过一次，就好像时间在重复。

source: Have a lie down for a bit. That usually does the trick when I feel that way.
target: 躺下歇一会儿吧。我有这种感觉的时候，这样通常就好了。

source: So... you feel this way, too?
target: 所以……你也有这种感觉？

source: Of course. A nice wine, an excellent book... so many things can make you feel so differently about the world!
target: 当然。一杯好酒，一本好书……好多东西都能让你对世界的感受大不一样！

source: Not what I meant.
target: 我不是这个意思。

source: Sure, 'Feely. Loony as a bat, huh?
target: 好吧，菲莉。疯得不轻，是吧？

source: Whatever you say! Just don't stab me to death in a fit of insane rage, or something.
target: 你说什么就是什么！只要别一发疯、一发怒，就把我捅死什么的。

source: How about this: I back away slowly, and you stop talking about time-repeating nonsense. Yes? Yes.
target: 这样如何：我慢慢退开，你也别再说什么时间重复的胡话了。好吗？好。

source: Thanks, Brit.
target: 谢谢你啊，布莉特。

source: It is a familiar tale.
target: 这种事，我听说过。

source: It's said Queen Astrid was overcome with similar illness once. But that was very long ago.
target: 据说阿斯特丽德王后也曾患过类似的病。不过，那是很久以前的事了。

source: Queen... Astrid?
target: 阿斯特丽德……王后？

source: And there I've said too much.
target: 这下我说得太多了。

source: Time is repeating itself, and I feel... lost.
target: 时间在重复，我觉得……很迷茫。

source: Is this a new game?
target: 这是个新游戏吗？

source: I'm sorry, Ophelia, but I haven't the time to play it.
target: 抱歉，奥菲莉娅，可我没时间陪你玩。

source: I'm a very busy man. And besides, I don't like games of any sort.
target: 我很忙。而且，我什么游戏都不喜欢。

source: Your wife was having an affair with Claudius before your death. Did you know?
target: 您去世之前，您的妻子就已经和克劳狄斯有了私情。您知道吗？

source: Yes. As we've discussed before, it has never been a concern of mine.
target: 知道。正如我们之前谈过的，我从来没有在意过这件事。

source: Yes. I knew.
target: 是的。我知道。

source: It doesn't seem to trouble you.
target: 您好像并不为此烦恼。

source: It does not.
target: 确实如此。

source: I made my peace with it long before my death.
target: 在我去世很久以前，我就已经接受了这件事。

source: Though they were only one in body near the end of my life... their feelings for one another extended to far before that.
target: 虽然他们直到我生命将尽时才有了肉体之亲……可他们对彼此的感情，早在那之前就有了。

source: Something in Gerta and I died far sooner, when the others did.
target: 早在其他人死去的时候，格尔塔和我心中的某些东西就已经死了。

source: The others?
target: 其他人？

source: Ah. It would not be common knowledge for anyone other than Irma and Gerta, I expect.
target: 啊。我想，除了伊尔玛和格尔塔，其他人应该都不太知道这件事。

source: Hamlet was our first living child. But Gerta was with child before that. Four times in all.
target: 哈姆雷特是我们第一个活下来的孩子。可在那之前，格尔塔也怀过孩子。算下来一共四次。

source: The first she lost very near to birth. We thought the child might live, but we were wrong.
target: 第一个孩子，她是在临近分娩时失去的。我们以为孩子也许能活下来，可我们错了。

source: The second and third emerged simply as a stream of blood.
target: 第二个和第三个孩子，出来时都只是一股血流。

source: She saw each loss as a failure unto herself.
target: 每失去一个孩子，她都觉得是自己的失败。

source: After we lost our third child, I no longer knew what to say to her, and she to me.
target: 失去第三个孩子以后，我再也不知道该对她说什么，她对我也是一样。

source: If she could not give me an heir, she could not fulfill her duties as Queen, as she saw them. And to her, that was the gravest failing of all.
target: 在她看来，如果不能为我生下继承人，她就无法尽到自己认定的王后职责。而对她来说，那是最严重的失职。

source: When she was with child a fourth time, she had already picked out a place to bury him in the graveyard, so certain was she that he would die.
target: 第四次怀孕时，她已经在墓地里选好了埋葬他的地方，因为她认定他一定会死。

source: But Hamlet lived. And our miracle son was born.
target: 可哈姆雷特活下来了。我们的儿子就这样奇迹般地诞生了。

source: Claudius knew nothing of the lost children, as far as I know. He was a comfort to her. He was warm and gentle to her in ways I was not.
target: 据我所知，克劳狄斯对那些失去的孩子一无所知。他给了她安慰。他对她的温暖与温柔，是我不曾给予的。

source: Over time that comfort grew to familiarity, then to affection, then to love. I witnessed it and I did not stop it.
target: 渐渐地，那份安慰变成了亲近，继而是好感，最后成了爱。我看在眼里，却没有阻止。

source: My wife has suffered enough in this life. Improper though it may be for a man to allow his wife to be wooed by his brother...
target: 我的妻子这一生已经受够了苦。虽说一个男人容许自己的兄弟向妻子求爱，或许有违礼法……

source: If it would purchase her one single shred of happiness, I would overlook nearly anything in the world for Gerta.
target: 只要能换来她哪怕一丝幸福，为了格尔塔，世上几乎任何事我都可以不计较。

source: I-- I had no idea. My sincerest apologies for prying, King Hamlet.
target: 我——我完全不知道。哈姆雷特国王，请原谅我冒昧打听这些私事。

source: The Queen was having an affair with Claudius before her husband passed away. Did you know?
target: 王后在丈夫去世之前，就已经和克劳狄斯有了私情。你知道吗？

source: Gertrude? I-- I don't know quite what to say about that.
target: 乔特鲁德？我——我真不知道该说什么。

source: Though I suppose it doesn't entirely surprise me.
target: 不过，想想倒也不算完全出乎我的意料。

source: If I recall correctly, the Queen came to Elsinore when she was quite young.
target: 如果我没记错，王后来埃尔西诺的时候，年纪还很小。

source: She was raised with both Hamlet senior and Claudius as two of her closest companions.
target: 她是和老哈姆雷特以及克劳狄斯一起长大的，他们两个都是她最亲近的伙伴。

source: She was always betrothed to Hamlet, I heard, but perhaps there was something in her friendship with Claudius as well.
target: 听说她一直与哈姆雷特有婚约，但也许她和克劳狄斯的友情里，也有些别的东西。

source: Regardless, that's the sort of unsavory thing I prefer not to discuss in depth.
target: 无论如何，这种不光彩的事，我不愿深谈。

source: It wouldn't be beyond Hamlet to lie about a thing like that. I don't know that I believe what I heard, myself.
target: 哈姆雷特也不是不会拿这种事撒谎。我自己都不确定是否相信听来的话。

source: Oh, my.
target: 哎呀，天哪。

source: I didn't. But what a devastating thing that might be.
target: 我不知道。可这事可能会让人多么痛苦啊。

source: Don't tell Guilda about it, or she'll never stop asking me what I think His Highness looks like in the nude.
target: 别告诉吉尔达，不然她会没完没了地问我，觉得殿下脱光了是什么样。

source: Are you quite serious? Everyone knows, now.
target: 你是认真的吗？现在所有人都知道了。

source: As I predicted, Guilda won't stop asking me what I think His Highness looks like in the nude.
target: 果然不出我所料，吉尔达没完没了地问我，觉得殿下脱光了是什么样。

source: Umm, no, but now I'm imagining them both naked.
target: 呃，不知道，可现在我脑子里都是他们两个人脱光了的样子。

source: So thanks for that.
target: 所以可真要谢谢你了。

source: I assumed you're the one who tipped off Hamlet. And we all saw how that turned out!
target: 我还以为是你给哈姆雷特通的风。而那件事闹成什么样，我们都看到了！

source: The Queen was having an affair with Claudius before King Hamlet's death.
target: 哈姆雷特国王去世之前，王后就已经和克劳狄斯有了私情。

source: Stale gossip is also the most tedious, 'Feely. Everyone knows that now.
target: 菲莉，过时的闲话也最无聊。现在大家都知道了。

source: And how could you possibly know that, exactly?
target: 你到底怎么可能知道这种事？

source: I have my ways.
target: 我自有办法。

source: Don't use that phrase. It makes you sound like a creep.
target: 别这么说。听着怪瘆人的。

source: Anyway, I already knew, of course. Rifling through the Queen's personal belongings has been my only means of entertainment recently.
target: 反正，我当然早就知道了。最近翻王后的私人物品，是我唯一的消遣。

source: But now that others are blathering on about it... well, I guess there's no reason to keep this a secret, is there?
target: 不过，既然别人都在喋喋不休地说这件事……那我想，也没理由再保密了，对吧？

source: I need access to the Queen's personal chambers. Can you help me?
target: 我需要进王后的私人寝室。你能帮我吗？

source: Have you some need to pay respects to her?
target: 你是有什么缘故，想去悼念她吗？

source: Either way, it matters little. I was ordered to hand over my key after her passing. And so I have.
target: 不管怎样，都不重要了。她去世后，我奉命交出钥匙。我也已经交了。

source: I have a key. What need do you have of it?
target: 我有钥匙。你要它做什么？

source: I'd just like to take a quick look around. There's something I'm looking for.
target: 我只是想进去稍微看看。我在找一样东西。

source: Rummaging around in my lady's chambers? Hah! Guts, but no tact!
target: 要在王后的寝室里翻来翻去？哈！胆子倒不小，就是不懂分寸！

source: Everyone knows you're too curious for your own good, my lady.
target: 小姐，大家都知道，你这好奇心迟早会给自己惹麻烦。

source: Isn't there something I could do for you in return? A favor of sorts?
target: 我就不能替你做些什么作为回报吗？比如帮你个忙？

source: Mmm. A woman who strikes deals. Far too few of those around. Ja, I'll bite.
target: 嗯。一个会谈交易的女人。这种女人可太少了。行，我有兴趣。

source: I've been known to gamble now and then. But the cowards who play with me are too delicate to play my favorite trick-taker: Ruff and Honours.
target: 大家都知道，我偶尔也赌上两把。可跟我一起玩的那些胆小鬼，个个都太娇气，不敢玩我最喜欢的吃墩牌戏：《王牌与荣誉》。

source: Instead, they stick to only the games they think they can win!
target: 他们只肯玩那些自以为能赢的游戏！

source: Round up my card partners, persuade them, and you'll have yourself an exchange.
target: 把我的牌友找齐，说服他们，这笔交易就成了。

source: (Not to mention, if the Guard Captain sees me rousing up his men for 'immoral' behavior... he'll be furious. The pious lout.)
target: （更别说，卫队长要是看见我招呼他的手下来干这种“不道德”的事……他准会大发雷霆。那个满嘴虔诚的粗人。）

source: That'd be Horatio, Marcellus, and the good Lady Brit, of course.
target: 当然就是霍拉旭、马塞勒斯，还有那位好心的布莉特女士。

source: That'd be Horatio and Marcellus, of course. Ordinarily, it'd be Brit too, but...
target: 当然就是霍拉旭和马塞勒斯。平时也会有布莉特，可是……

source: Rather a shame to hear the news.
target: 听到那个消息，真是挺遗憾的。

source: If you tell them all I want to strike up a game, come back here. Only then I shall unlock the room for you!
target: 告诉他们每个人，我想开一局牌，然后再回来。到时候我才会替你把房门打开！

source: Certainly. You're in luck -- Bernardo ordered me to turn over the key, but he hasn't come for it yet.
target: 当然。你运气不错——贝尔纳多命令我交出钥匙，可他还没来拿。

source: Gertrude was never my favorite noblewoman to wait upon, but for what it's worth, she was kind to me.
target: 在我服侍过的贵妇中，乔特鲁德从来不是我最喜欢的那位。不过，怎么说呢，她待我很好。

source: So all I ask is, whatever you find in there, be kind to her memory. Understand?
target: 所以我只求你，无论在里面发现什么，都给逝去的她留些体面。明白吗？

source: And you'll need to do me a favor, of course.
target: 还有，你当然得帮我一个忙。

source: What do you need?
target: 你需要什么？

source: Certainly, I have a key to her rooms.
target: 当然，我有她房间的钥匙。

source: But I smell the beginnings of a good deal. Nothing comes free in this world, 'Feely.
target: 不过，我闻到了一笔好交易的苗头。菲莉，这世上可没有白得的东西。

source: I want to speak to the Prince privately, but he won't even give me a second glance.
target: 我想私下跟王子说说话，可他连多看我一眼都不肯。

source: If you arrange a rendezvous, on the other hand... maybe he'll show.
target: 不过，要是由你来安排见面……他也许就会来了。

source: Tell him I want to meet him in the garden tonight and then I'll unlock that room for you.
target: 告诉他，我想今晚在花园见他，然后我就替你打开那个房间。

source: Oh, and definitely don't tell anyone else. I want privacy.
target: 哦，还有，千万别告诉别人。我想私下见他。

source: Oh, and definitely don't tell anyone else. I want the utmost privacy, and you know how Gertrude can be.
target: 哦，还有，千万别告诉别人。我绝不想被人打扰，乔特鲁德会怎么样，你也知道。

source: Not to mention I don't want you pining for him off in the corner somewhere.
target: 更别说，我也不想让你躲在哪个角落里，为他相思憔悴。

source: Everyone knows how that ended.
target: 大家都知道那件事最后是什么下场。

source: So keep it discreet, won't you?
target: 所以低调一点，好吗？

source: ... Fine. But don't say I haven't ever done anything nice for you.
target: ……好吧。可别再说我从来没对你好过。

source: Less talking, more working. Go.
target: 少说话，多办事。去吧。

source: My lord, I'd like to seek permission to enter the Queen's personal chambers.
target: 陛下，我想请求您准许我进入王后的私人寝室。

source: You what?
target: 你说什么？

source: My wife is dead, and you come to me seeking to rifle through her room?
target: 我的妻子已经死了，你却跑来求我让你翻她的房间？

source: Vultures. All of you. Disgusting little vultures.
target: 秃鹫。你们全都是。令人作呕的小秃鹫。

source: None of you ever understood us.
target: 你们没有一个人真正理解过我们。

source: No. Absolutely not.
target: 不行。绝对不行。

source: My apologies. It's just--
target: 抱歉。只是——

source: I don't think I can go back there again so soon.
target: 我想，我还没法这么快就再回到那里。

source: Perhaps soon I could find the strength to enter that place. But not now. I'll think on it.
target: 也许过不了多久，我就能鼓起勇气走进去。可现在还不行。我会想想的。

source: Ho ho... I haven't had access to my wife's rooms in months. Sorry, I don't have a key.
target: 呵呵……我已经好几个月进不了妻子的房间了。抱歉，我没有钥匙。

source: I appreciate that she's in mourning and needs her privacy. Only Irma and Brit are allowed to enter.
target: 我理解她还在哀悼，需要独处。只有伊尔玛和布莉特获准进去。

source: My lady, I'd like to seek permission to enter your personal chambers.
target: 王后，我想请求您准许我进入您的私人寝室。

source: Ophelia, if you'd like to chat, I'm perfectly happy to meet you in the garden. Or the gallery.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果你想聊聊天，我很乐意在花园见你。或者在画廊。

source: Might I just have a... quick peek at your rooms, then?
target: 那我能不能……只在您的房间里稍微看一眼？

source: No, Ophelia. This is strange of you. And unusually uncouth.
target: 不行，奥菲莉娅。你这样很奇怪，也太失礼了，不像平时的你。

source: I tried to get into your mother's chambers, but they were locked.
target: 我想进你母亲的寝室，可门锁着。

source: Oh, that. Never mind that now. I've little care for what has come before.
target: 哦，那件事。现在别管了。过去的事，我已经不大在意了。

source: It's time to focus on what lies before us.
target: 该把心思放在我们眼前的事上了。

source: Of course they're locked! Why do you think I haven't looked around myself?
target: 当然锁着！不然你以为我为什么没自己进去看看？

source: Brit and Irma have keys. Not even my uncle is permitted to enter.
target: 布莉特和伊尔玛有钥匙。连我叔叔都不许进去。

source: Why would you want to go in there?
target: 你为什么会想进去？

source: A den of sin and incestuous heat. That's all it is, in the end.
target: 一个充斥罪恶与乱伦欲火的巢穴。说到底，那里不过如此。

source: (Right. He didn't ask me to search her room in this timeline.)
target: （对了。在这条时间线里，他没让我搜查她的房间。）

source: (I bet he'd still be interested in whatever I learn, though...)
target: （不过，我想他还是会对我的发现感兴趣……）

source: There's nothing in there I want to know about anymore. Not now.
target: 里面的事，我已经什么都不想知道了。现在不想。

source: Even if that weren't wildly inappropriate, love, I haven't got a key.
target: 亲爱的，就算这事不是那么失礼，我也没有钥匙。

source: Her nosy little lady-in-waiting and that Bohemian bullish cook are the only people she ever trusted with that honor.
target: 她那爱管闲事的小小的宫廷侍女，还有那个蛮横的波希米亚厨娘，是她仅有的两个信任到愿意给她们这份殊荣的人。

source: But I stand resolute: you musn't go into her rooms, Ophelia.
target: 不过，我的立场很坚定：奥菲莉娅，你不许进她的房间。

source: I'm... not sure if I should, Ophelia. She locks her doors for a reason.
target: 我……不确定该不该帮你，奥菲莉娅。她锁门是有原因的。

source: Besides, I don't have a key. Only Lady Brit, Irma, and the Queen do. I'd need to request it from one of them.
target: 而且，我没有钥匙。只有布莉特女士、伊尔玛和王后有。我得找她们中的一位要。

source: Absolutely not. In fact, I've requested all available keys from both Lady Brit and Irma.
target: 绝对不行。事实上，我已经要求布莉特女士和伊尔玛把所有能找到的钥匙都交出来。

source: We're still uncovering details about the circumstances involved in her death. Please don't get underfoot.
target: 我们还在调查她死亡的相关细节。请别碍事。

source: I donno if I should, Ophelia. Queen likes 'er privacy. It's ladies-only, as far as I know.
target: 我也不知道该不该帮你，奥菲莉娅。王后喜欢清静。据我所知，那里只让女人进。

source: Only Brit, Irma, and Her Highness 'ave keys to get in.
target: 只有布莉特、伊尔玛和王后殿下有进去的钥匙。

source: I donno if I should, Ophelia. Bernardo asked for all of the keys back after she passed.
target: 我也不知道该不该帮你，奥菲莉娅。她去世后，贝尔纳多要求收回所有钥匙。

source: Feels wrong to be preyin' on the dead.
target: 打死人的主意，总觉得不对。

source: Only Brit, Irma, and Her Highness ever 'ad keys to get in, anyway.
target: 反正，从来就只有布莉特、伊尔玛和王后殿下有进去的钥匙。

source: Irma wants to play a specific card game with you. Ruff and Honors.
target: 伊尔玛想和你玩一种特定的纸牌游戏。《王牌与荣誉》。

source: Ugh. The last time I played that one with that witch, she destroyed me so badly I was out of drinking coin for three months.
target: 唉。上回跟那个女巫玩这个，她把我赢得惨不忍睹，害我整整三个月都没钱喝酒。

source: So... is that a 'no'?
target: 所以……你是不玩了？

source: Are you kidding? Of course I'll play.
target: 开什么玩笑？我当然要玩。

source: Now it's my turn to bring her to her knees.
target: 这回轮到我把她打得服服帖帖了。

source: (That's everyone, I think. I'll have to let Irma know when she's next avaliable.)
target: （我想，人都通知到了。等伊尔玛下次有空，得告诉她一声。）

source: This card game you mentioned -- it's unpopular with the others?
target: 你提到的那个纸牌游戏——其他人不喜欢吗？

source: Correct, Fräulein!
target: 没错，小姐！

source: Once they come to see it as I do, though, I'm certain they'll throw aside Runfa and Triomphe and see the light!
target: 不过，只要他们像我一样懂得欣赏它，我敢肯定，他们就会抛下伦法和凯旋牌，明白什么才是好游戏！

source: That old man Marcellus is asking for another defeat...
target: 马塞勒斯那个老头，是想再输一回啊……

source: And my fingers itch for a gamble if I go without too long!
target: 而且太久不赌一把，我就手痒！

source: Irma has asked me to invite you to a game of Ruff and Honors.
target: 伊尔玛托我邀请你玩一局将牌与荣誉。

source: Oh, music to my ears! We've been playing that awful Italian one... Runfa.
target: 哦，这话我爱听！我们一直在玩那个糟糕的意大利纸牌游戏……伦法。

source: I introduced it to the men, and they won't stop clinging to it. I've told them it's a dreadful game.
target: 是我把它介绍给那些人的，结果他们玩上就不肯换了。我都跟他们说了，这游戏糟透了。

source: Well, I suppose I have to gather every penny I own so I can lose it all to her!
target: 好吧，看来我得把所有的钱都凑起来，好全输给她！

source: Wait—I haven't got a cent. That's right.
target: 等等——我一分钱都没有。对，我想起来了。

source: You... don't have any money?
target: 你……一点钱都没有？

source: When one is an expert in the art of acquiring free meals, one wants for very little in this world, my dear girl.
target: 亲爱的姑娘，只要精通吃免费饭的本事，在这世上也就没多少东西会缺了。

source: Irma has requested your presence at a card game. Ruff and Honors, I believe.
target: 伊尔玛想请你去玩牌。我记得是将牌与荣誉。

source: Wah hah hah! Time for a rematch...
target: 哇哈哈！该再比一场了……

source: If she breaks out the trick deck again, I'll wring 'er neck, though!
target: 不过，她要是再拿出那副做了手脚的牌，我就拧断她的脖子！

source: Brit asked me to facilitate a 'rendezvous' between herself and Hamlet.
target: 布莉特托我安排她和哈姆雷特“幽会”。

source: You're certain?
target: 你确定？

source: Well, yes. She made the request directly to me. As a favor.
target: 嗯，是的。她亲口来拜托我的。说是请我帮个忙。

source: That's not good.
target: 这可不好。

source: A while ago, she told me her father told her he was beginning to take the the thought of a betrothal more seriously.
target: 前一阵子，她跟我说，她父亲告诉她，他开始更认真地考虑订婚的事了。

source: With Hamlet as the most likely suitor.
target: 而哈姆雷特是最有可能的人选。

source: Quite a love match, that one.
target: 他们俩还真是情投意合啊。

source: I... I just spoke with her. I thought... we were...
target: 我……我刚跟她谈过。我以为……我们已经……

source: Oh my god. She's going to wind up marrying him. I never had a real chance, did I?
target: 天哪。她最后会嫁给他。我从来就没真正有过机会，对不对？

source: I feel ill. I need to see her. To speak with her.
target: 我难受得很。我得见她。跟她谈谈。

source: This can't happen.
target: 不能让这种事发生。

source: So—you want to meet with Hamlet tonight?
target: 所以——你想今晚和哈姆雷特见面？

source: Yes, that is the precise thing we talked about already. Sharp as a spoon, you are!
target: 是啊，我们之前说的就是这件事。你的脑子可真像勺子一样，不怎么锋利！

source: We're going to have a lovely private little evening, he and I.
target: 他和我会单独度过一个美好的夜晚。

source: Lady Brit has asked me to facilitate a... meeting between the two of you.
target: 布莉特女士托我安排你们两个……见一面。

source: A private meeting?
target: 单独见面？

source: I think she wanted to ask you on a date, of sorts.
target: 我想，她是想约你出去，算是约会吧。

source: I cannot bear to think of seeing her again before I must meet her at the altar, now that we are to be wed.
target: 如今我们要结婚了，一想到在不得不与她站上婚礼祭坛之前还要再见她，我就受不了。

source: I've no interest in going, but thank you for letting me know.
target: 我没兴趣去，不过谢谢你告诉我。

source: Hm. I've little interest in that, whatever she might be scheming.
target: 嗯。不管她可能在打什么算盘，我都没什么兴趣。

source: She asked you this?
target: 她让你来问的？

source: Can she not be direct with her invitation?
target: 她就不能直接来邀请我吗？

source: I ask myself the same question. Trust me.
target: 相信我，我也在问自己同样的问题。

source: Making you her hound... I thought you above that.
target: 把你当她的走狗使唤……我以为你不至于如此。

source: Well, color me intrigued. If she wants to meet by moonlight, then let's meet.
target: 好吧，我倒有些好奇了。她既然想在月光下见面，那就见吧。

source: (Well, that's done. For better or worse. I'll have to let Brit know when I can.)
target: （好了，这事办完了。不管是好是坏。等有机会，得告诉布莉特一声。）

source: Lady Brit has asked me to facilitate a meeting between herself and Hamlet.
target: 布莉特女士托我安排她和哈姆雷特见面。

source: This should be good news, is it not?
target: 这应该是个好消息，不是吗？

source: It means he's moved on to some poor new girl!
target: 这说明他又盯上了另一个可怜的姑娘！

source: I always got the impression he didn't like her very much.
target: 我一直觉得，他不怎么喜欢她。

source: One is not always privy to the inner machinations of another's heart, dearest.
target: 亲爱的，别人的心里究竟在想什么，我们并不总能知道。

source: Anyway, enough waxing philosophical. The viper is out of your grass. For good.
target: 总之，哲理就不多谈了。你身边草丛里的毒蛇已经走了。永远走了。

source: My lady, Brit and the Prince intend to meet late tonight for a... 'rendezvous'.
target: 王后陛下，布莉特和王子打算今晚晚些时候见面，来一场……“幽会”。

source: Well, well!
target: 哎呀，哎呀！

source: How did you hear about this, Ophelia?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你是怎么听说这事的？

source: From the lady Brit herself.
target: 布莉特女士亲口告诉我的。

source: She's exploiting him at a particularly dark moment.
target: 她在趁他最艰难的时候利用他。

source: My son is going through so much right now. As are you. For Brit to make this request of you, and of him...
target: 我儿子眼下正承受着那么多事。你也一样。布莉特竟然向你、向他提出这种要求……

source: It's horrid.
target: 实在太可恶了。

source: I'll write to her father at once. Such behavior is incredibly unbecoming of a lady of the court.
target: 我马上写信给她父亲。这种行为实在有失宫廷贵女的体统。

source: Well. If it's a party of two, I'm sure Hamlet won't mind if his dear mother joins him.
target: 好吧。既然是两个人的小聚，我相信哈姆雷特不会介意他亲爱的母亲也去凑个热闹。

source: I love moonlight walks! Almost as much as I love my dearest lady-in-waiting exploiting my son's weakened emotional state.
target: 我最喜欢月下散步了！喜欢的程度，几乎赶得上我最亲爱的宫廷侍女利用我儿子脆弱的心境。

source: I'll meet them tonight. As you were, Ophelia.
target: 我今晚去见他们。你继续忙你的吧，奥菲莉娅。

source: Did you know the Queen was having an affair with King Claudius before her husband's death?
target: 你知道王后在丈夫去世之前，就和克劳狄斯国王有私情吗？

source: It matters not. Now all the others do, too.
target: 这已经不重要了。现在其他人也都知道了。

source: Where did you hear that?
target: 你从哪里听说的？

source: Her journal. I found it myself.
target: 她的日记。我自己找到的。

source: I see. Yes, I knew. But I would choose to keep any of my lady's secrets a hundred times over.
target: 明白了。是的，我知道。但就算让我选上一百次，我也会为王后保守她的每一个秘密。

source: Gerta died in such pain, alone.
target: 格尔塔死时那么痛苦，孤身一人。

source: Always be kind to those whose actions you disapprove of, Ophelia. Someday, you may be them.
target: 奥菲莉娅，即使不赞同一个人的所作所为，也始终要善待他们。有一天，你也可能变成他们那样。

source: And then you will wish someone had granted you mercy in return.
target: 到那时，你也会希望有人以同样的宽容待你。

source: Please, do not hurt Gerta further. It would devastate her. And she suffers so deeply now.
target: 求你别再伤害格尔塔了。那会让她崩溃的。她现在已经痛苦至极。

source: My lord, I know that the Queen was having an affair with you before her husband's death.
target: 陛下，我知道王后在丈夫去世之前，就和您有私情。

source: But tell me, does that matter now?
target: 但你说，这如今还重要吗？

source: Neither he nor she live. That part of my life is truly gone. There's nothing left to talk about.
target: 他和她都不在人世了。我生命中的那一段，已经彻底过去了。没什么可谈的了。

source: Of course. I see. Then let's not speak of it any more.
target: 当然。我明白了。那我们就不再提了。

source: Speak to me of it no more.
target: 别再向我提这件事。

source: My nephew's punishment was a fitting fate for such an insidious rumor.
target: 我侄儿受到的惩罚，正是散播这种阴险谣言应得的下场。

source: Do you have any idea how distressed she is? She won't even look at me.
target: 你知道她有多难受吗？她连看都不肯看我一眼。

source: And she... my beautiful wife... she holds a place at God's side. I know it.
target: 而她……我美丽的妻子……她在上帝身边有一席之地。我知道。

source: She was twice the human as I. And she died in shame, alone, afraid.
target: 她的为人比我好上一倍。可她却在羞耻中死去，孤独而恐惧。

source: There will be no peace for me until I, too, rest with her.
target: 直到我也与她一同长眠，我才会得到安宁。

source: Are you implying my wife—your queen—is a harlot?
target: 你是在暗指我的妻子——你的王后——是个娼妇？

source: Be silent, lest I break you! Whoever told you this will pay with their life!
target: 闭嘴，免得我毁了你！无论是谁告诉你的，都要拿命来偿！

source: I know that Queen Gertrude was having an affair with Claudius before King Hamlet's death.
target: 我知道乔特鲁德王后在哈姆雷特国王去世之前，就和克劳狄斯有私情。

source: Yes. Well, everyone does, now.
target: 是啊。如今人人都知道了。

source: Quite cruel of Hamlet to announce it so publicly, but admittedly I'm stunned at her indiscretion.
target: 哈姆雷特这样当众揭露此事，实在很残忍。不过说实话，她如此不检点，也着实让我震惊。

source: King Hamlet loved her with the fondness of ten men. And she betrayed him.
target: 哈姆雷特国王对她的爱，比得上十个男人的深情。可她却背叛了他。

source: I suppose we all harbor our dark secrets.
target: 我想，我们都藏着不可告人的秘密。

source: Ophelia, what are you thinking? You can't be spreading rumors like that!
target: 奥菲莉娅，你在想什么？这种谣言可不能乱传！

source: It's not a rumor.
target: 这不是谣言。

source: I've tried to tell you before what a delicate situation we're in, dearheart.
target: 心肝，我之前就试着告诉过你，我们的处境有多微妙。

source: Please don't do anything to bring shame upon us.
target: 求你了，别做任何让我们蒙羞的事。

source: Hamlet, I have reason to believe your mother had an affair with your uncle before your father's death.
target: 哈姆雷特，我有理由相信，在你父亲去世之前，你母亲就和你叔叔有私情。

source: I found the diary of hers you requested. Everything's in there.
target: 我找到了你要我找的那本她的日记。里面什么都写了。

source: I came across... a diary of hers. She wrote about it, extensively.
target: 我偶然找到……她的一本日记。她在里面详细地写了这件事。

source: And now she's dead.
target: 而现在她死了。

source: I... never... knew.
target: 我……从来……不知道。

source: I wonder what else Mother took to the grave, held close.
target: 不知道母亲还把什么秘密紧藏在心底，带进了坟墓。

source: Frailty, thy name is woman.
target: 脆弱啊，你的名字就是女人。

source: My father would have done anything for my mother.
target: 为了母亲，我父亲愿意做任何事。

source: Claudius was a satyr next to his Hyperion, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我父亲如同太阳神许珀里翁，克劳狄斯与他相比，不过是一只萨堤尔羊人。

source: My father desired such a gentle world for her that he would have kept the winds of heaven from visiting her face too roughly.
target: 父亲想让她的世界如此温柔，甚至不愿让天上的风太粗暴地拂过她的脸。

source: Before the slippers she wore to his funeral had even been broken in-- a funeral where she followed his body like Niobe, all tears--
target: 她穿去参加他葬礼的鞋还没穿软——在那场葬礼上，她跟在他的遗体后面，像尼俄柏一样，泪流不止——

source: She was already marrying him. My uncle! Such dexterity to incestuous sheets.
target: 她就已经要嫁给他。我的叔叔！钻进乱伦的床铺，动作竟如此敏捷。

source: Nothing about this is good, and it must never come to good.
target: 这件事没有半点好处，也绝不能有好结果。

source: She should suffer for what she's done.
target: 她应该为自己的所作所为受苦。

source: Hamlet, be reasonable...
target: 哈姆雷特，理智一点……

source: Ophelia, do you believe... in spirits?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你相信……鬼魂吗？

source: Listen. When I ran into your bedchamber earlier, I wasn't mad. I swear it.
target: 听我说。先前我跑进你卧室的时候，我没有疯。我发誓。

source: I saw my father's spirit on the castle walls. It spoke to me.
target: 我在城墙上看见了父亲的鬼魂。他跟我说话了。

source: Your father's ghost?
target: 你父亲的鬼魂？

source: I... saw the spirit in a dream, too, I think...
target: 我……好像也在梦里见过那个鬼魂……

source: My father's spirit claimed he had been murdered.
target: 父亲的鬼魂声称，他是被谋杀的。

source: He told me that my mother was unfaithful to him when he still lived.
target: 他告诉我，他还活着的时候，我母亲就背叛了他。

source: And if we now know that's true, it must be true as well that my uncle killed my father and covered up his crime.
target: 如果我们现在知道那是真的，那么我叔叔杀死了我父亲，还掩盖了自己的罪行，就一定也是真的。

source: Claudius... is a killer. This, I already knew.
target: 克劳狄斯……是个杀人凶手。这一点，我早就知道。

source: Were my mother to tell me now that she never suspected him, I wouldn't believe her for an instant.
target: 就算母亲现在告诉我，她从没怀疑过他，我也半点不会相信。

source: I was planning to just kill him, but knowing the both of them are equally complicit...
target: 我本来只打算杀了他，可如今知道他们两个同样脱不了干系……

source: I've something special in mind for the both of them, now.
target: 现在，我想到了一个特别的办法来对付他们两个。

source: Please, think carefully...
target: 求你仔细想想……

source: The time for that has passed. Now I want only revenge for my father.
target: 考虑的时候已经过去了。现在我只想为父亲报仇。

source: On her, and him.
target: 向她，还有他。

source: Tomorrow I'll make my move, when everyone is next gathered...
target: 明天，等大家再次聚齐，我就动手……

source: You must be there, Ophelia. You must bear witness to all this. Then I'll take you to meet Father's spirit, and you'll understand why it had to be this way.
target: 你一定要来，奥菲莉娅。你必须亲眼见证这一切。然后我会带你去见父亲的鬼魂，你就会明白，为什么非得如此。

source: Today I'll make my move, when everyone is next gathered...
target: 今天，等大家再次聚齐，我就动手……

source: It's too late for me to do something public about this-- expose them for who they are, on stage...
target: 现在再想为这件事做点什么，让众人都知道——在舞台上揭露他们的真面目……已经太迟了。

source: But they will all face justice soon enough. It seems inevitable, now.
target: 但他们很快都会受到制裁。如今看来，这已经不可避免了。

source: (This... won't end well.)
target: （这……不会有好结果的。）

source: I know, my lady, that you were with Claudius before your husband's death.
target: 王后陛下，我知道，在您丈夫去世之前，您就和克劳狄斯在一起了。

source: I suppose the worst has happened, now. And they all know.
target: 我想，最糟糕的事如今已经发生了。他们全都知道了。

source: I have nothing with which to defend myself. Let them hate me, however they will.
target: 我无从为自己辩解。他们想怎么恨我，就让他们恨吧。

source: It has been a miserable life in many ways, this one.
target: 我这一生，在许多方面都过得很苦。

source: And there it is. Someone knows.
target: 这一天还是来了。有人知道了。

source: I don't know how you know. But it doesn't matter, in the end.
target: 我不知道你是怎么知道的。但到头来，这也不重要。

source: I had expected that one day someone I love would approach me and say this very thing.
target: 我早料到，总有一天，我爱的人会走到我面前，说出这番话。

source: But perhaps I had thought it might be some distant day. Not now.
target: 但也许我以为，那会是很久以后的某一天。而不是现在。

source: I suppose the worst will soon happen. If you know, then the others soon shall.
target: 我想，最糟糕的事很快就会发生。既然你知道了，其他人也很快会知道。

source: If there is any love in your heart, you will not unveil me to them, Ophelia. I beg this of you. Please.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果你心里还有一点爱，就不要向他们揭露我的秘密。我恳求你。求你了。

source: I've found proof that the Queen was dishonest with her husband before his death, and loved King Claudius.
target: 我找到了证据，证明王后在丈夫去世之前就欺骗了他，爱上了克劳狄斯国王。

source: Oh, my! That sounds like precisely the sort of thing that'll get your head lopped off.
target: 哎呀！听起来，这正是会让你掉脑袋的那种事。

source: Do run and tell the others, won't you? It's gotten a bit dull around here.
target: 快去告诉其他人吧，好不好？这里最近有点无聊了。

source: Quince, I have proof that King Claudius is a murderer. He killed his own brother.
target: 奎因斯，我有证据证明克劳狄斯国王是个杀人凶手。他杀了自己的亲哥哥。

source: Proof, have we?
target: 有证据，是吗？

source: I heard him confess. And I think he's going to come after Hamlet next.
target: 我听见他亲口承认了。而且我觉得，他接下来就要对哈姆雷特下手了。

source: Mmm. And what are you going to do about it?
target: 嗯。那么你打算做些什么呢？

source: You already know how this particular move can play out, after all.
target: 毕竟，你已经知道这一步棋可能会落得什么结果。

source: But—perhaps—there's a way to use this information differently. Something I haven't found.
target: 可是——也许——还有别的办法利用这个消息。某个我还没找到的办法。

source: Oh, my. You still think I'm going to help you. That's rather cute.
target: 哎呀。你还以为我会帮你呢。真可爱。

source: Get lost, darling.
target: 滚吧，亲爱的。

source: I... don't know. King Hamlet's spirit seems to want revenge...
target: 我……不知道。哈姆雷特国王的鬼魂似乎想要复仇……

source: I told Hamlet. He was upset, horrified. He asked me to find his mother's private diary.
target: 我告诉了哈姆雷特。他很难受，也很惊恐。他让我去找他母亲的私人日记。

source: He believed it would contain some confession to the crime.
target: 他觉得，里面会有某种承认这桩罪行的记录。

source: What I found contained within was... less than savory, but not proof that Claudius killed anyone.
target: 我在里面发现的内容……不怎么光彩，却不是克劳狄斯杀过人的证据。

source: The way I see it, my dear, certain options lie before you.
target: 亲爱的，在我看来，你面前有几个选择。

source: You could find concrete proof of his actions. This, of course, would be kept in his most private of places.
target: 你可以找到他所作所为的确凿证据。当然，这种东西会藏在他最私密的地方。

source: Of course, a sufficiently motivated girl might take matters into her own hands and rid Elsinore of such a killer.
target: 当然，一个决心足够坚定的姑娘，也可能亲自出手，为埃尔西诺除掉这个杀人凶手。

source: The most difficult option would be to remove the teeth from his best-laid plans, keeping a close eye on his bare-backed nephew.
target: 最难的选择，是拔掉利齿，让他精心安排的计划失去杀伤力，同时紧盯着他那毫无防备的侄儿。

source: Sent to England, wasn't he, that boy? Such a gruesome way to die.
target: 那孩子被送去英格兰了，是吧？那种死法可真惨。

source: And if he avoids that, there's that awful poisoned sword incident...
target: 就算他躲过了那一劫，还有那桩可怕的毒剑事件……

source: So many primed traps lying in wait, so little time!
target: 这么多布置好的陷阱等着触发，时间却这么少！

source: My lord, I know now that you murdered your brother.
target: 陛下，我现在知道了，是您谋杀了您的哥哥。

source: Come now, Ophelia. Where did you hear a thing like that?
target: 好了，奥菲莉娅。你从哪儿听来这种话的？

source: My dear, I am so terribly sorry to hear about the brutal murder of your father.
target: 亲爱的，听说你父亲惨遭杀害，我实在痛心。

source: I heard they only just found his corpse.
target: 听说他们刚刚才找到他的尸体。

source: And I see that you are mad with grief. I cannot imagine your suffering.
target: 我看得出来，你悲痛得发了疯。我无法想象你有多痛苦。

source: I would be surprised if anyone would believe any accusation you'd make right now.
target: 你现在无论提出什么指控，要是有谁肯相信，我都会觉得意外。

source: I'm not 'insane.' I know it's true, Claudius. And you will pay.
target: 我没有“疯”。我知道这是真的，克劳狄斯。你一定会付出代价。

source: I am a seasoned man, my dear. It will take more than the idle threat of a little girl to make me afraid.
target: 亲爱的，我可是见过世面的人。一个小姑娘空口威胁几句，还吓不倒我。

source: Now, be off. I tire of you.
target: 好了，走吧。我已经厌烦你了。

source: As I told you before, we'll speak when next we're in private.
target: 我之前说过了，下次只有我们两个人的时候再谈。

source: I trust you won't divulge this story to anyone else until I've had a chance to explain myself further.
target: 我相信，在我有机会进一步解释之前，你不会把这件事透露给别人。

source: You think that Bernardo's protection earlier makes you invincible?
target: 你以为先前有贝尔纳多护着你，就没人能动得了你了？

source: You are a fool.
target: 你真是个蠢货。

source: So. You intend to... what? To threaten me in public?
target: 所以。你打算……干什么？当众威胁我？

source: No. If you really want to speak about it, let's speak in private.
target: 不行。你要是真想谈这件事，我们就私下谈。

source: I'll tell you everything there. Yes, the truth.
target: 到那里我会把一切都告诉你。没错，真相。

source: I'll even have Bernardo accompany you for safety, if that puts your mind at ease.
target: 如果这样能让你安心，我甚至可以让贝尔纳多陪着你，保护你的安全。

source: Come now, love. Where did you hear a thing like that?
target: 好了，亲爱的。你从哪儿听来这种话的？

source: Ophelia, if I have but one request of you, it is this.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果我只向你提一个请求，那就是这个。

source: I wish to forget everything which happened before you came to comfort me. All of it.
target: 在你来安慰我之前发生的一切，我都想忘掉。一切。

source: All the things I did for her--
target: 我为她——做的所有事

source: No. Let this be a new blank world we can impress ourselves upon anew.
target: 不。就把这当作一个全新的空白世界，让我们重新留下自己的印记。

source: Otherwise, if I start to think about it--
target: 否则，如果我开始想那些事——

source: I might break.
target: 我可能会崩溃。

source: So never ask me about the past. It doesn't matter any more. And it never shall.
target: 所以，永远别问我过去的事。那些已经不重要了。以后也永远不会重要。

source: My lady, I have unfortunate news about your husband's role in King Hamlet's death.
target: 王后，有个不幸的消息，是关于您的丈夫在哈姆雷特国王之死中扮演的角色。

source: Closer, Ophelia, and lower your voice. Please.
target: 靠近些，奥菲莉娅，小声一点。拜托。

source: What are you saying?
target: 你在说什么？

source: I believe King Hamlet was murdered, my lady. I overheard Claudius confessing it himself.
target: 王后，我认为哈姆雷特国王是被谋杀的。我无意间听见克劳狄斯亲口承认了这件事。

source: King Hamlet wasn't bitten by a snake at all.
target: 哈姆雷特国王根本没有被蛇咬过。

source: I don't understand. What are you saying?
target: 我不明白。你在说什么？

source: Please tell me this is a sick joke of yours.
target: 求你告诉我，这只是你开的一个恶劣玩笑。

source: B-because, if it's true—
target: 因、因为，如果这是真的——

source: I know it's difficult to hear, my lady.
target: 王后，我知道这很难接受。

source: Could Claudius have...
target: 难道克劳狄斯真的……

source: I understand you may have seen something you can't describe, Ophelia, but you must have been mistaken.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我明白，你可能看到了什么说不清的事，但你一定弄错了。

source: I'm certain Claudius didn't mean whatever he said. Or perhaps you heard it out of context.
target: 我确信，不管克劳狄斯说了什么，都不是那个意思。也可能是你只听到一部分，误会了。

source: Regardless, I shall seek him out myself and clear the air. I'll clarify that it was nothing after all.
target: 无论如何，我会亲自去找他，把误会说开。我会弄清楚，证明这到头来根本没什么。

source: Frankly, I had thought this kind of whisper-trading beneath you, Ophelia.
target: 坦白说，奥菲莉娅，我原以为你不屑于这样传闲话。

source: Laertes, I overheard the King confessing he murdered his brother.
target: 雷欧提斯，我无意间听见国王承认，他谋杀了自己的哥哥。

source: What? You're certain?
target: 什么？你确定？

source: Yes. He was in the chapel. I heard him praying.
target: 确定。他当时在礼拜堂里。我听见他在祈祷。

source: You're absolutely certain? Ophelia, this is the kind of accusation which gets both of us killed.
target: 你绝对确定吗？奥菲莉娅，这种指控会让我们两个都丢掉性命。

source: I'm certain. I saw it with my own eyes. Hamlet was there, too.
target: 我确定。我亲眼看到了。哈姆雷特也在场。

source: As much as I hate to admit it, I believe you.
target: 虽然我很不愿意承认，但我相信你。

source: After King Hamlet died, there were cruel rumors like that... but to have heard a confession is something else altogether.
target: 哈姆雷特国王死后，确实有过这种恶毒的传闻……可亲耳听到他认罪，就是完全不同的事了。

source: Normally I'd turn to Lady Brit in matters like these, but I've done so once already, and it was clear that it troubled her greatly.
target: 遇到这种事，我通常会找布莉特女士帮忙。但我已经找过她一次了，看得出来，这件事让她非常苦恼。

source: I'll have to think upon an alternative solution. Deal with this on my own.
target: 我得想个别的办法。自己处理这件事。

source: A confession from my own blood is as good as truth to me.
target: 对我来说，血亲亲口说出的事，就等同于真相。

source: Now, I shall take what must be taken.
target: 现在，我要取走必须取走的东西。

source: I think I know who to turn to for rumormongering of this sort.
target: 要打听这种传闻，我想我知道该找谁。

source: Lady Brit is one of the best. If other accounts of this kind of thing exist, she'd know.
target: 布莉特女士是这方面最拿手的人之一。如果还有别人说过类似的事，她会知道的。

source: And that might be the support we need.
target: 而那些说法也许就是我们需要的佐证。

source: You haven't heard the news?
target: 你还没听说那个消息吗？

source: What news?
target: 什么消息？

source: Ah... never mind it.
target: 啊……算了。

source: (He'll find out soon enough.)
target: （他很快就会知道的。）

source: In the past, I would have turned to Brit for something like this. But -- well.
target: 以前遇到这种事，我会去找布莉特。可是——唉。

source: Now I don't know where to go.
target: 现在我不知道该找谁了。

source: I will not be made gutless. I will not wait.
target: 我不会任人把我变成懦夫。我绝不再等。

source: Many have long suspected this King's treachery. Now, you confirm it.
target: 很多人早就怀疑这位国王做过背信弃义的事。现在，你证实了这一点。

source: Hamlet, I know that Claudius murdered your father.
target: 哈姆雷特，我知道是克劳狄斯谋杀了你的父亲。

source: I saw him confess myself. The truth is undeniable now.
target: 我亲眼见他认了罪。如今真相已经无可否认。

source: But it took so much for me to be sure. I no longer know what to do. And now everything's become stranger than before.
target: 可我经历了那么多，才终于确信。我已经不知道该怎么办了。现在，一切都变得比从前更奇怪。

source: What? You... know this?
target: 什么？你……知道这件事？

source: It's hard to explain, but I... heard him confessing it himself.
target: 这很难解释，但我……听见他亲口承认了。

source: He was praying, and he stated it plainly, without poetry.
target: 他当时在祈祷，说得明明白白，没有用什么诗意的说法。

source: And now he's dust.
target: 如今他已化为尘土。

source: I hope he's burning in Hell.
target: 我希望他正在地狱里受烈火煎熬。

source: I thought I was alone in this.
target: 我以为只有我一个人在面对这件事。

source: You're the only other person who suspects him.
target: 除了我，只有你也在怀疑他。

source: Now is the time. You have to do something, Hamlet.
target: 就是现在了。哈姆雷特，你必须做点什么。

source: If he truly confessed before you, then that's the proof I need to act.
target: 如果他真的在你面前认了罪，那就是我采取行动所需的证据。

source: Were it coming from anyone but you, Ophelia, I could scarce believe it.
target: 奥菲莉娅，要是这话出自别人之口，我几乎不可能相信。

source: My uncle must die. What a relief it is to feel that for certain.
target: 我的叔叔必须死。能确信这一点，真让我如释重负。

source: My father's spirit told me precisely what you've just said. That my uncle killed my father and covered up his crime.
target: 父亲的亡灵告诉我的，和你刚才说的一模一样。我的叔叔杀了我的父亲，还掩盖了罪行。

source: And now you've confirmed it for me. How wonderfully freeing it feels.
target: 现在，你替我证实了这件事。这种解脱的感觉真好。

source: For my own sanity, I must find out if my mother knew of this. I have to know if she was complicit, too.
target: 为了不让自己发疯，我必须查清母亲是否知情。我一定要知道，她是不是也参与其中。

source: How might we uncover that?
target: 我们能怎么查清这件事？

source: Her journal.
target: 她的日记。

source: My mother keeps a diary in her bedroom, detailing her every thought. She writes in it often. I thought she might speak of her guilty mind there, if she had one.
target: 母亲在卧室里放着一本日记，详细记下她的每一个念头。她经常写。我想，如果她心中有愧，也许会在里面写出来。

source: She's always been fond of you. You can get into her chambers.
target: 她一直很喜欢你。你能进她的寝室。

source: If she was part of this, I have to know for certain. Help me. Please.
target: 如果她参与了这件事，我一定要弄个明白。帮帮我。求你了。

source: If you help me find the diary, I'll take you to meet my father's spirit. Then you'll see that I'm not insane.
target: 如果你帮我找到日记，我就带你去见父亲的亡灵。到时你就会明白，我没有疯。

source: And my mother... she willingly betrayed my father for Claudius.
target: 而我的母亲……她心甘情愿地为了克劳狄斯背叛了父亲。

source: Were she to tell me now that she never suspected him, I wouldn't believe her for an instant.
target: 如果她现在告诉我，她从没怀疑过他，我半点也不会信。

source: No. She's as rotten as he. The both of them need to be exposed.
target: 不。她和他一样腐烂透了。他们两个的真面目都必须被揭穿。

source: No. Plans have changed. I've something special in mind for the both of them, now.
target: 不。计划变了。现在，我想到了一个特别的办法来对付他们两个。

source: Hamlet, please, think carefully...
target: 哈姆雷特，求你了，仔细想想……

source: It's too late for me to do something public about this-- to expose them for who they are, on stage...
target: 现在已经来不及公开做些什么了——在舞台上揭穿他们的真面目……

source: Bernardo, I have proof that King Claudius murdered his own brother.
target: 贝尔纳多，我有证据证明，克劳狄斯国王谋杀了自己的亲哥哥。

source: We both do, now.
target: 现在我们两个都有证据了。

source: But what am I to do? I cannot take a King into custody.
target: 可我能怎么办？我不能拘押一位国王。

source: Even if he shouted it from every rooftop, it would take the will of the nobility to stop him.
target: 就算他站在每一处屋顶上大声承认，也得贵族们愿意出手，才能制止他。

source: ...Nevertheless, I thank you. Because you see me for who I am, I was able to stand up to him.
target: ……尽管如此，我还是要谢谢你。因为你懂得真正的我，我才能站出来反抗他。

source: For the first time in my life, I feel entirely drained of fear. He has no control over me anymore.
target: 我这辈子第一次觉得，心里已经没有一丝恐惧。他再也控制不了我了。

source: And despite the dire circumstances we're in, I cannot help but feel like the future is a brighter one.
target: 尽管我们的处境如此险恶，我还是忍不住觉得，未来会更加光明。

source: So thank you, Ophelia. Thank you for standing with me.
target: 所以，谢谢你，奥菲莉娅。谢谢你站在我身边。

source: This isn't a joke.
target: 这不是玩笑。

source: Then how did you come to hear such a rumor?
target: 那你是怎么听到这种传闻的？

source: I heard him confess it when he thought he was alone. He was praying.
target: 他以为四下无人时，我听见他承认了这件事。他当时在祈祷。

source: We suspected, after King Hamlet died. Or at least, my men and I did.
target: 哈姆雷特国王死后，我们就怀疑过。至少，我和我的手下是这样。

source: But the physician who attended the body said nothing to us of murder.
target: 但检查遗体的医生并没有向我们提起谋杀。

source: Regardless, he has power over me.
target: 无论如何，他掌控着我。

source: He knows that I am also Katherine.
target: 他知道我也是凯瑟琳。

source: And he would use it against me in an instant if he thought it would benefit him.
target: 只要他觉得对自己有利，就会立刻拿这件事来对付我。

source: But you don't need to be afraid. You have me standing by you. And I'm sure others would, too.
target: 但你不必害怕。有我站在你这边。我相信，也会有别人支持你。

source: And my thanks for that. But even if that's true...
target: 谢谢你愿意这样支持我。可就算真是如此……

source: I cannot arrest a King.
target: 我不能逮捕一位国王。

source: I know now that King Claudius killed his own brother.
target: 我现在知道了，克劳狄斯国王杀了自己的亲哥哥。

source: This is why I'm smart enough to stay out of court affairs.
target: 所以说，我够聪明，才会避开宫廷里的事。

source: I wish I could say I was surprised. But knowing him? Look at him. The man's a nervous wreck.
target: 我也想说我很惊讶。可我了解他啊。你看看他，整个人都紧张得快垮了。

source: Something broke him. That must've been it.
target: 有什么事把他压垮了。想必就是这件事。

source: I saw King Claudius confess to killing his brother before my own eyes.
target: 我亲眼见到克劳狄斯国王承认，他杀了自己的哥哥。

source: Such a chilling message before we've even been acquainted.
target: 我们还没正式认识，你就带来了如此令人心寒的消息。

source: I am a man of manners. Please, excuse me. Are you that one they call Lady Ophelia? It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am Othello.
target: 我一向注重礼节。请容我失陪片刻。您就是人们所说的奥菲莉娅女士吗？很荣幸认识您。我是奥赛罗。

source: Regardless, as to what you asked about...
target: 无论如何，说回您刚才问的事……

source: I am unsurprised.
target: 我并不惊讶。

source: Snakes beget snakes. From what I've heard, the King's father was a ruinous man.
target: 毒蛇生毒蛇。据我所知，国王的父亲是个祸害。

source: He was savage on the battlefield, but, I'm told, even crueler as a King. He took anything he wanted, killed any who disobeyed. Even family.
target: 他在战场上凶残无比，但听人说，他当国王时更加残酷。想要什么就夺走，谁不服从就杀谁。连家人也不例外。

source: I've served many a King in battle, but I could never serve one like these.
target: 我曾在战场上为许多国王效力，但绝不会侍奉这样的国王。

source: Not for all the gold in the world.
target: 给我全世界的黄金也不行。

source: Father, did you know that King Claudius murdered King Hamlet?
target: 父亲，您知道克劳狄斯国王谋杀了哈姆雷特国王吗？

source: Where did you hear that? Who have you been speaking with?
target: 你从哪儿听来的？你一直在跟谁说话？

source: Is it true?
target: 这是真的吗？

source: Do you want to see me killed? Or you? Or your brother?
target: 你想看着我被杀吗？还是你自己？或是你哥哥？

source: I tried to tell you before what a delicate situation we... I... am in.
target: 我之前就想告诉你，我们……我……如今的处境有多微妙。

source: Please, don't do anything to bring public embarrassment to us.
target: 求你了，别做任何让我们当众难堪的事。

source: Your brother is already dead. Do you want to see me lose my head, too?
target: 你哥哥已经死了。你还想看着我也被砍头吗？

source: Ophelia, don't you understand how dire things are at the moment?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你难道不明白眼下的局势有多危急吗？

source: Father, I heard the King himself confess. I saw him with my own eyes.
target: 父亲，我亲耳听见国王自己认罪了。我亲眼看到了他。

source: You mean to tell me that the King, who is in good health and of sound mind, confessed a murder before your eyes? When? And where?
target: 你是说，国王身体健康、神志清醒，却在你眼前承认了一桩谋杀？什么时候？又是在什么地方？

source: Yes! In the chapel!
target: 是的！就在礼拜堂里！

source: Oh... dear.
target: 哦……天哪。

source: I realize what this is. You... you've been listening to the Prince's insane ravings, haven't you?
target: 我明白是怎么回事了。你……你一直在听王子那些疯话，对不对？

source: Be truthful. Did you hear all this from him? Did he ask you to come lie to me?
target: 说实话。这些都是你从他那里听来的？是他让你来骗我的？

source: No! Father, please, believe me!
target: 不是！父亲，求您了，相信我！

source: I've heard enough. You won't mention this to anyone. Not a soul. Understand?
target: 我听够了。这件事你不准向任何人提起。一个人也不行。明白吗？

source: We never spoke of this treason, and you never heard a thing.
target: 我们从没谈过这种谋逆之事，你也什么都没听见。

source: Horatio, please keep this quiet, but... I've learned that King Hamlet's death was no accident. He was murdered.
target: 霍拉旭，请替我保密，不过……我已经知道，哈姆雷特国王的死并非意外。他是被谋杀的。

source: Do you know anything about this?
target: 关于这件事，你知道些什么吗？

source: That's precisely what the spirit told Hamlet.
target: 那亡灵告诉哈姆雷特的，正是这件事。

source: He asked me to watch Claudius closely for any hint of-- well, guilt, I suppose.
target: 他让我密切留意克劳狄斯，看看有没有什么迹象——嗯，我想，是心虚的迹象。

source: He feels he needs proof before he can act.
target: 他觉得必须先有证据，才能行动。

source: He had asked me to watch Claudius closely for any hint of-- well, guilt, I suppose.
target: 他之前让我密切留意克劳狄斯，看看有没有什么迹象——嗯，我想，是心虚的迹象。

source: Felt he needed proof before he could act, I suppose. Ah, damn all of this sorry business.
target: 我想，他当时觉得必须先有证据，才能行动。唉，这一摊糟心事，真该死。

source: If there were some way you could prove what you heard was true... well, it would be calamity. But good calamity, I think.
target: 如果你有办法证明自己听到的是真的……那会酿成一场灾难。不过我想，会是一场好灾难。

source: What? How did you hear that?
target: 什么？你是怎么听说的？

source: S-so you must've seen... it?
target: 那、那你一定见过……它了？

source: You mean the ghost?
target: 你是说那个幽灵？

source: So you did hear?
target: 这么说，你确实听说了？

source: But there's no way...
target: 可这不可能……

source: I know he spoke to his father's spirit.
target: 我知道他和父亲的亡灵交谈过。

source: Well, go talk to him, then. You'll get nothing more out of me.
target: 那就去找他谈吧。你别想再从我这里问出什么。

source: And a lot of good it did him, in the end.
target: 到头来，这又给他带来了什么好处呢。

source: What is 'it'?
target: “它”是什么？

source: So you haven't, then.
target: 这么说，你没见过。

source: Horatio. Out with it.
target: 霍拉旭。说出来。
