source: Hmph! You may intimidate Hamlet, but you won't intimidate me. The King would guillotine me for a mere whisper of what you just said.
target: 哼！你也许吓得住哈姆雷特，但吓不住我。你刚才说的那些话，我只要透露半句，国王就会把我送上断头台。

source: As such, I am a metaphorical and literal stone wall. You'll get nothing out of me.
target: 所以，无论打比方还是按字面讲，我都是一堵石墙。你别想从我这里问出什么。

source: Now. Please, milady. I have some sudden unforeseen business to attend to, which involves keeping my head firmly attached to my body.
target: 好了。小姐，拜托了。我突然有件意料之外的事要处理，事关保住我脖子上的脑袋。

source: Irma, I feel I can confide in you: King Hamlet's death was no accident. I know the truth.
target: 伊尔玛，我觉得可以向你吐露实情：哈姆雷特国王的死并非意外。我知道真相。

source: What can you mean? And hush your voice!
target: 你这话是什么意思？还有，小声点！

source: I witnessed him confessing. He was praying. He said he'd poisoned his brother.
target: 我亲眼见到他忏悔。他当时在祈祷。他说自己毒死了哥哥。

source: Oh, my lady.
target: 唉，小姐。

source: Do you know how many bloody secrets these walls have heard?
target: 你知道这些墙听过多少血腥的秘密吗？

source: I don't doubt what you say is true. Mein Gott, the very servants believe it to be true.
target: 我不怀疑你说的是真的。我的天，连仆人们都相信这是真的。

source: And didn't you find the very poison he used to do it?
target: 而且，你不是找到了他行凶用的那份毒药吗？

source: Indeed. Now that I am its owner, he shan't ever use it again!
target: 没错。如今它归我了，他再也别想拿来用了！

source: Yes, perhaps it will come in handy for some little thing in the future. But if there's one thing I know for certain, it is this...
target: 是啊，或许以后有什么小事能用得上它。不过，有一件事我可以肯定，那就是……

source: He's even got the instrument of murder in his room.
target: 他甚至还把凶器放在自己的房间里。

source: You say this, but I found no such thing! You sent me on such a wild chase, for naught!
target: 你这么说，可我根本没找到！你让我到处瞎找，白忙一场！

source: We shall see about that, won't we? But unless that tree bears fruit, there is only one thing I know for certain.
target: 这事还得走着瞧，对吧？不过，除非这条线索有了结果，否则我只能肯定一件事。

source: You shall never, ever prove Claudius's guilt.
target: 你永远，永远也证明不了克劳狄斯有罪。

source: You're wrong. I know there's a way to prove this.
target: 你错了。我知道一定有办法证明。

source: Then I shall have no part in it, lady.
target: 那我也不会参与，小姐。

source: Marcellus, I don't believe King Hamlet's death was an accident. I think he was murdered.
target: 马塞勒斯，我不相信哈姆雷特国王死于意外。我认为他是被谋杀的。

source: Hmm. Yeh soun' just like that crazy ghost!
target: 嗯。你说起话来，跟那个疯鬼一模一样！

source: Oh, sure. We saw th'spirit o' King Hamlet up on the walls, all angry-like. It spoke to us. Wanted vengeance. The usual.
target: 哦，可不是嘛。我们在城墙上见过哈姆雷特国王的幽灵，怒气冲冲的。它跟我们说了话。想报仇。就那些老一套。

source: But, neh. I don' believe it.
target: 不过，算了吧。我不信。

source: You spoke to King Hamlet's spirit, but this is too far-fetched?
target: 你都跟哈姆雷特国王的幽灵说过话了，却觉得这件事太离谱？

source: Sure. If I don' believe you, I get ta' keep my job an' my conscience.
target: 是啊。只要不信你，我就能保住差事，良心也过得去。

source: An' the only person that ghost seems interested in hauntin' is Hamlet!
target: 而且那幽灵好像只想缠着哈姆雷特！

source: I know for certain that King Claudius murdered his brother, Hamlet's father.
target: 我确切地知道，克劳狄斯国王谋杀了他的哥哥，也就是哈姆雷特的父亲。

source: Now, Ophelia. What good can come of trading in rumors of that sort?
target: 好了，奥菲莉娅。传来传去的都是这种谣言，能有什么好处？

source: He might be brought to justice. He might be contained.
target: 也许能让他受到法律制裁。也许能把他控制住。

source: To whom is he an immediate danger now?
target: 他眼下直接威胁到谁了？

source: W-well, no one at the present moment, but...
target: 这、这个，目前没有谁，可是……

source: Then you aim to save no one, and only destroy the lives of those who work and live under Claudius.
target: 那你并不是要救谁，只是在毁掉那些在克劳狄斯手下做事、在他治下生活的人的人生。

source: Look, Ophelia. Guilda and I often gallivant from place to place.
target: 听我说，奥菲莉娅。吉尔达和我经常四处游玩。

source: We have just one rule: Don't get involved. If you get involved with people, you only shoulder their burdens.
target: 我们只有一条规矩：别掺和。掺和进别人的事，就只会把他们的担子背到自己身上。

source: Suffice to say, we cannot shoulder this one.
target: 我只说一句，这个担子我们背不起。

source: Guildenstern, surely you'll believe me. King Claudius is a murderer. I saw him confess.
target: 吉尔登斯吞，你总该相信我吧。克劳狄斯国王是个杀人凶手。我亲眼见到他忏悔。

source: Oh, we know!
target: 哦，我们知道！

source: We simply don't care.
target: 我们只是不在乎。

source: It isn't our business what becomes of this place. We're only visiting, after all!
target: 这里会变成什么样，不关我们的事。毕竟我们只是来做客的！

source: But those beady little eyes of his -- who knows what horrors he's capable of!
target: 不过，他那对贼溜溜的小眼睛——谁知道他能干出什么可怕的事！

source: What if he were to come for you, or someone you cared about? What then?
target: 要是他对你，或你在乎的人下手呢？到时候怎么办？

source: Well, it's rather difficult to kill me if he thinks I'm already dead, right?
target: 嗯，要是他以为我已经死了，想杀我可就难了，对吧？

source: That's why this plan is so infallible!
target: 所以这个计划才这么万无一失！

source: Oh, Ophelia. Mon dieu. I've just been struck by genius.
target: 哦，奥菲莉娅。我的天。我刚刚想到了一个天才般的主意。

source: What if I pretended to be dead, just to see what would happen?
target: 要是我假装死了，就为了看看会发生什么，怎么样？

source: (Oh no. Here we go again.)
target: （糟了。又来了。）

source: Er... I don't follow.
target: 呃……我没明白。

source: I've always wanted to know what my funeral would be like. Now's my chance! It's brilliant!
target: 我一直想知道自己的葬礼会是什么样。机会来了！真是妙极了！

source: Ophelia, you've got to tell everyone I'm dead.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你得告诉所有人我死了。

source: They'll all come to the graveyard for a magnificent funeral, and then... I'll jump out and surprise them.
target: 他们都会来墓地参加一场盛大的葬礼，然后……我就跳出来，吓他们一跳。

source: If you do that, we'll have a wonderfully funny time pranking the others, I just know it!
target: 你要是这么做，我们就能一起捉弄大家，肯定会笑得特别开心，我敢肯定！

source: And... when they find out you're alive and well after all?
target: 那……等他们发现你其实活得好好的呢？

source: Right! I'm sure they'll all be so relieved, they'll instantly forgive me!
target: 对呀！他们一定会大大松一口气，马上就原谅我！

source: Although, now that I think about it, with everything that's happened, this is no time for pranks.
target: 不过，现在想想，出了这么多事，这可不是恶作剧的时候。

source: Maybe if things were a little quieter!
target: 要是局面再平静一点，也许就行了！

source: Some other time, perhaps.
target: 或许改天吧。

source: All right, Ophelia. Go spread the word. Tell everyone there's to be a funeral. I'll be waiting!
target: 好了，奥菲莉娅。去把消息传出去吧。告诉大家要办一场葬礼。我等着！

source: In the meantime, as soon as I'm able to, I'll go run and hide so as not to spoil the fun.
target: 这期间，我一有机会就跑去藏起来，免得扫了大家的兴。

source: I've got to say hello to Hamlet first, though. It would be just rude to hide before that.
target: 不过，我得先去跟哈姆雷特打个招呼。还没打招呼就藏起来，那可太失礼了。

source: This can't possibly end well.
target: 这事绝不可能有好结果。

source: Horatio, I need to confide in you.
target: 霍拉旭，我有件事必须向你吐露。

source: I knew Hamlet was going to kill Father.
target: 我早就知道哈姆雷特会杀死父亲。

source: I had this dream recently. In it, Father died by Hamlet's hand.
target: 我最近做了个梦。梦里，父亲死在了哈姆雷特手上。

source: But it was more than a dream. It was like a vision. It felt so real.
target: 但那不只是一个梦。它像是一场预见。感觉那么真实。

source: Ophelia... it's natural to search one's memory for warning signs in the aftermath of a horrible tragedy.
target: 奥菲莉娅……经历可怕的悲剧之后，人会回想过去，寻找预警的迹象，这是很自然的。

source: But none of us can change what has come before. Only where we might go from here.
target: 但我们谁也改变不了过去。能改变的，只有今后走向何方。

source: I urge you not to dwell too long in the halls of memory. Nothing good happens there.
target: 我劝你不要在回忆的殿堂里流连太久。那里不会有什么好事。

source: My father will be murdered, and Hamlet will be his killer.
target: 我父亲会被谋杀，凶手就是哈姆雷特。

source: That I can't believe.
target: 这我不能相信。

source: Hamlet... isn't in his right mind. But I'm certain, however pitifully, that that wouldn't come to pass.
target: 哈姆雷特……精神状态不好。但我确信，哪怕这份确信很可悲，那种事也不会发生。

source: How can you be so sure?
target: 你怎么能这么肯定？

source: Because you, as I do, know his heart. He is an odd man, but he is not a murderer.
target: 因为你和我一样，了解他的本心。他是个古怪的人，但不是杀人凶手。

source: Well, he is now.
target: 可他现在是了。

source: Hamlet, I need to speak with you.
target: 哈姆雷特，我得跟你谈谈。

source: I know you took my father's life.
target: 我知道是你杀了我父亲。

source: Let me assure you that if you have any intention of turning the blame elsewhere, know this: I place every bit of fault with you.
target: 我把话说清楚：如果你打算把责任推到别处，你要知道，我认为一切都是你的错。

source: You're right to do so.
target: 你这样想是对的。

source: This may mean nothing to you right now. Perhaps it never will. But I did not intend to kill him, Ophelia.
target: 这话现在对你可能毫无意义。或许永远都没有。但我不是有意杀他的，奥菲莉娅。

source: I mistook him for my uncle. In the moment I saw your father's face... I knew what I'd done.
target: 我把他错当成了叔父。看到你父亲面容的那一刻……我就知道自己做了什么。

source: I know I can never seek your forgiveness. Not after all I've done.
target: 我知道，我永远也没有资格求你原谅。做了这么多事之后，更没有。

source: But perhaps someday, I can pay off some small amount of the sin I've committed.
target: 但也许有一天，我能赎清自己所犯罪孽中的一小部分。

source: Right now, that's all I can hope for.
target: 眼下，我也只能盼着这一点了。

source: You can start by revealing the location of my father's body to Bernardo.
target: 你可以先告诉贝尔纳多，我父亲的遗体在哪里。

source: I showed the very location to his men not long after he spoke with you. My mother-- was in shock. I couldn't leave him there with her.
target: 他跟你谈过之后没多久，我就给他的手下指明了位置。我母亲——受了惊吓。我不能把他留在那里，跟她待在一起。

source: It was never my intention to keep him from you. But I hope you need never look upon his state.
target: 我从没想过不让你见他。但我希望你永远不必看到他那副模样。

source: As I understand it, I am likely to soon leave Denmark forever.
target: 据我所知，我很可能很快就会永远离开丹麦。

source: May I go, and trouble you no more, and never give you cause to think of me again.
target: 愿我就此离去，不再打扰你，也再不给你任何想起我的理由。

source: Do you bear my father any murderous intent? Or any intent to visit your mother's chambers?
target: 你对我父亲有杀心吗？或者，你有没有打算去你母亲的寝宫？

source: If so, I implore you to—
target: 如果有，我恳求你——

source: I find your father an insufferable, intractable, insipid sod. But I bear him no ill will.
target: 我觉得你父亲是个让人受不了、固执又无趣的混蛋。但我对他没有恶意。

source: After all, he was steadfastly faithful to my father all his life.
target: 毕竟，他一生都坚定不移地忠于我父亲。

source: And I'm certain I shall visit my mother soon, though I loathe to look at her all the same.
target: 而且我肯定很快会去看母亲，尽管我还是厌恶看到她。

source: And, no. Now that mother's gone, I've no intent to visit her chambers ever again.
target: 还有，不会。如今母亲已经不在了，我再也不打算去她的寝宫。

source: (Then if Hamlet didn't kill my father intentionally, it must have been an accident.)
target: （那么，如果哈姆雷特不是有意杀死我父亲，那一定是场意外。）

source: (If I could only get inside the Queen's chambers and witness the awful deed myself...)
target: （要是我能进王后的寝宫，亲眼看见那件可怕的事就好了……）

source: Don't meet your mother alone. Nothing good can come of it.
target: 别单独去见你母亲。那不会有什么好结果。

source: And it will mean my father's demise. I implore you, Hamlet. Please.
target: 而且那会害死我父亲。我恳求你，哈姆雷特。求你了。

source: I don't understand. Why would I? Ophelia, are you... well?
target: 我不明白。我为什么会那样做？奥菲莉娅，你……还好吗？

source: Ophelia, there is only one person whose bloody death I desire, and it isn't your father, or my mother.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我只想让一个人死于血泊之中，那个人不是你父亲，也不是我母亲。

source: Ophelia, there is only one person whose bloody death I desire, and it isn't your father. Nor was it my mother.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我只想让一个人死于血泊之中，那个人不是你父亲，也从来不是我母亲。

source: If anything, my aim is to be slow and thorough in exposing my enemies.
target: 真要说的话，我想做的是慢慢来，彻底揭露我的敌人。

source: Peter Quince the playwright has helped with just this matter. Together we planned something incredible.
target: 剧作家彼得·奎因斯正是在这件事上帮了忙。我们一起策划了一件非同凡响的事。

source: Yes... very soon you'll see the fruits of our extensive labor.
target: 是的……你很快就能看到我们付出诸多心血的成果。

source: Father... I know how this sounds, but please believe me.
target: 父亲……我知道这话听着很奇怪，但求您相信我。

source: Hamlet made an attempt on your life, didn't he? I knew it was going to come.
target: 哈姆雷特企图杀您，对不对？我早就知道会有这一天。

source: Hush. Hush, Ophelia.
target: 别说了。别说了，奥菲莉娅。

source: Better to not discuss what took place. It was an embarrassing situation for all involved, to say the least.
target: 发生的事最好别再谈了。至少可以说，当时所有在场的人都很难堪。

source: No gain can come of spreading around what happened. What ought I to do, pursue action against Hamlet? I would never.
target: 把发生的事传出去，没有任何好处。我该怎么做，追究哈姆雷特的责任吗？我绝不会那么做。

source: I'm alive, my darling. Suffice to say, that's all that matters.
target: 我还活着，宝贝。只要知道，这才是最要紧的。

source: Hamlet is going to make an attempt on your life.
target: 哈姆雷特会企图杀您。

source: Hamlet? For what purpose? No...
target: 哈姆雷特？为了什么？不……

source: I-is it the King's wish?
target: 这、这是国王的意思吗？

source: I don't think so. I don't know, exactly. I believe Hamlet is the only man you need fear.
target: 我想不是。我也不确切知道。我认为您只需要提防哈姆雷特。

source: Does he think me an obstacle to ascending the throne, with his uncle gone?
target: 他叔父已经不在了，难道他觉得我妨碍他登上王位？

source: I don't think so. I don't know, exactly.
target: 我想不是。我也不确切知道。

source: Does this mean you believe me? And you'll stay away from him...?
target: 这么说，您相信我了？您会离他远一点……？

source: Well... you know it makes me ill when you say strange things like this.
target: 唉……你知道，你说这些怪话会让我难受。

source: It's on my mind at the very least. Now please, don't go spreading odd portents of doom to anyone else.
target: 至少我已经把这事放在心上了。现在，拜托你，别再向别人散播那些古怪的灾祸预兆。

source: (So he's believed my warning—at least a little.)
target: （看来他相信了我的警告——至少信了一点。）

source: (Perhaps that's enough to keep him alive this time.)
target: （也许这就足以让他这次活下来。）

source: Your Highness, we need to discuss Hamlet once more.
target: 殿下，我们得再谈谈哈姆雷特。

source: Oh, Ophelia. I'd meant to come find you. I didn't know what to say.
target: 哦，奥菲莉娅。我本想去找你，却不知道该说什么。

source: Yes, my lady. I just need to understand. What happened?
target: 是，王后。我只是想弄明白。到底发生了什么？

source: I... I couldn't save him. I wanted to. It all moved so quickly.
target: 我……我没能救他。我想救他的。一切发生得太快了。

source: Many a late evening has kept me staring at my ceiling, thinking about what might happen if my son were to ever act in violence.
target: 许多个深夜，我都盯着天花板，想着万一我儿子动起手来，会发生什么。

source: But when the moment came, I was rooted to the floor in fear.
target: 可那一刻真的到来时，我却吓得僵在原地。

source: My late husband Hamlet considered your father to be his greatest, most trusted friend in the world.
target: 我已故的丈夫哈姆雷特把你父亲视为世上最好的、最值得信赖的朋友。

source: On our wedding night, he told me that I could always run to your father, should I need help in a dire time.
target: 新婚之夜，他告诉我，如果我在危急时刻需要帮助，随时都可以去找你父亲。

source: And-- he was right.
target: 而且——他说得没错。

source: I wish I knew more than you did. I'm sorry. We simply don't have the answers, yet.
target: 我真希望自己知道得比你多。对不起。我们只是还没有答案。

source: My late husband considered your father to be his greatest, most trusted friend in the world.
target: 我已故的丈夫把你父亲视为世上最好的、最值得信赖的朋友。

source: I cannot imagine the depth and horror of what you're feeling right now. Of what Laertes will feel.
target: 我无法想象你现在的感受有多深、多可怕。也无法想象雷欧提斯到时会有什么感受。

source: Now it is my duty, as protector of my country, to do what I must to ensure my son never hurts any Dane again.
target: 如今，作为国家的守护者，我有责任采取必要的措施，确保我儿子不再伤害任何丹麦人。

source: My lady, I know how this sounds, but I believe Hamlet is going to kill my father—in your chambers. Can you help?
target: 王后，我知道这话听着很奇怪，但我相信哈姆雷特会杀死我父亲——就在您的寝宫里。您能帮忙吗？

source: That's a poor jest. And cruel of you to say.
target: 这玩笑一点也不好笑。你这么说，实在太残忍了。

source: Certainly my son is disturbed, but to call him a murderer is an insult I thought you incapable of.
target: 我儿子的精神确实不太正常，但称他为杀人凶手，我没想到你竟会说出这样侮辱人的话。

source: Do you have any plans to meet with my father and Hamlet?
target: 您有没有打算见我父亲和哈姆雷特？

source: Not the both of them at once, no. What brings you such concern?
target: 没有同时见他们两人的打算。你为什么这么担心？

source: If you're worried of any misdeeds taking place in my chambers—I keep them very private. Hardly anyone has access without my explicit permission.
target: 如果你担心我的寝宫里会发生什么坏事——我很注重那里的私密。没有我的明确许可，几乎没人能进去。

source: This is, of course, to prevent exactly that sort of sordid business from happening in the first place!
target: 当然，这正是为了从一开始就杜绝那种龌龊的勾当！

source: My lord, I come to you about my father.
target: 陛下，我是为父亲的事来找您的。

source: What will you do now that Hamlet has taken his life?
target: 如今哈姆雷特夺走了他的性命，您打算怎么办？

source: The thought of such a tragedy had never crossed my mind before this.
target: 在此之前，我从没想过会发生这样的悲剧。

source: As sovereign who swore to protect the lives of your father and all citizens, Ophelia, my sorrow is deep.
target: 奥菲莉娅，身为君主，我曾发誓保护你父亲和所有国民的生命，如今我深感悲痛。

source: The only element bringing me peace is the knowledge that your father's soul has ascended to Heaven.
target: 唯一能让我心安的，是知道你父亲的灵魂已经升入天堂。

source: I now believe it is in our collective interest to ensure Hamlet can never harm another.
target: 现在我认为，确保哈姆雷特再也不能伤害任何人，才符合我们所有人的利益。

source: Rest assured-- he will be dealt with in swift time.
target: 放心吧——很快就会处置他。

source: I have reason to believe Hamlet may act in violence against my father.
target: 我有理由相信，哈姆雷特可能会对我父亲动武。

source: What? Where? And when?
target: 什么？在哪里？什么时候？

source: In...in the Queen's chambers, my lord. I know not why.
target: 在……在王后的寝宫里，陛下。我不知道为什么。

source: Wah hah hah! I'd like to see him try. My nephew's a half-wit with any weapon in his hand.
target: 哇哈哈！我倒想看看他敢不敢。我那侄子不管拿什么武器，都笨得很。

source: And who could ever bear your father ill will, of all people?
target: 再说了，谁会对你父亲这样的人怀有恶意呢？

source: Have you spoken to my wife of these fears?
target: 你跟我妻子说过这些担忧吗？

source: She has far more patience and love for you than I.
target: 她对你可比我有耐心得多，也疼爱得多。

source: We need to discuss something.
target: 我们有件事得谈谈。

source: Hamlet killed my father in cold blood. And he's going to do it again.
target: 哈姆雷特冷血地杀了我父亲。而且他还会再杀一次。

source: I warned him to stay his hand, but he listened not.
target: 我告诫过他不要动手，可他不听。

source: Grow used to the sting of loss, Ophelia. You will see it yet many hundreds of times before you are free.
target: 习惯失去的刺痛吧，奥菲莉娅。在获得自由之前，你还会目睹这样的事数百次。

source: Bernardo. You're someone I know I can trust.
target: 贝尔纳多。我知道你是我可以信任的人。

source: I believe Hamlet may act in violence against my father. Can you protect Father from harm?
target: 我相信哈姆雷特可能会对我父亲动武。你能保护父亲，让他不受伤害吗？

source: I can't speak about this right now, my lady. Apologies for being evasive, but -- many things have taken place in the last few hours.
target: 小姐，我现在不能谈这件事。抱歉这样闪躲，可是——过去几个小时里发生了很多事。

source: I'll find you again very soon.
target: 我很快就会再来找你。

source: You should no longer affix such honor to me, my lady.
target: 小姐，你不该再这么抬举我了。

source: I will spend every night the rest of my life wondering why I wasn't there to stop Hamlet in time.
target: 往后余生的每个夜晚，我都会问自己，为什么当时没能在那里及时阻止哈姆雷特。

source: I grieve for your father. And my deepest condolences go out to you and to Laertes.
target: 我为你父亲的离世感到悲痛。也向你和雷欧提斯致以最深切的慰问。

source: For what it's worth, he was kind to me as a child in ways my own father never was.
target: 不管这有没有意义，我还是想说，小时候他对我的好，是我亲生父亲从未给过的。

source: I loved him too. I loved him dearly. And I will never forget the kindness he showed me.
target: 我也爱他。我很爱他。我永远不会忘记他对我的好。

source: Er... And where do you believe this violence may take place, precisely?
target: 呃……那你认为他具体会在哪里动手？

source: In the Queen's private chambers.
target: 在王后的私人寝宫里。

source: Hamlet has visited his mother's chambers a hundred times before without issue...
target: 哈姆雷特以前去过母亲的寝宫上百次，从没出过事……

source: Why now? What could have changed? What was he thinking?
target: 为什么偏偏是现在？究竟有什么变了？他当时在想什么？

source: Why do you believe him to be a murderer now?
target: 为什么你现在认定他会杀人？

source: I can't explain it, Bernardo. But please—in all the years we've known each other, have you not learned to trust me?
target: 我没法解释，贝尔纳多。但求你了——我们认识这么多年，你还不能相信我吗？

source: ...If it will put your mind at ease, I will ensure no one comes to harm in the Queen's chambers.
target: ……如果这样能让你安心，我会确保没人会在王后的寝宫里受到伤害。

source: You have my word.
target: 我向你保证。

source: Thank you. Thank you eternally.
target: 谢谢你。我会永远感激你。

source: Laertes, what if I told you I knew Hamlet would kill Father?
target: 雷欧提斯，如果我告诉你，我知道哈姆雷特会杀死父亲呢？

source: Premonitions are useless to the both of us now.
target: 现在，预感对我们两个都没有用了。

source: Father is dead. Mother is dead.
target: 父亲死了。母亲也死了。

source: I will bury him beside her.
target: 我会把他葬在她身边。

source: And you and I, we live on. We must never lose sight of each other's back. Not now. Not ever.
target: 而你和我，还要继续活下去。我们必须始终照应彼此。现在如此，永远如此。

source: I want Hamlet dead. The Queen merely wants him gone. We shall see which of us perserveres first.
target: 我要哈姆雷特死。王后只是想让他离开。就看我们谁先坚持到目的达成吧。

source: You know Hamlet to be capable of intense anger—
target: 你知道哈姆雷特发起火来有多厉害——

source: And intense inaction. The man couldn't determine what to eat for supper, let alone plot to take down Father.
target: 不肯行动的时候也一样厉害。那人连晚饭吃什么都拿不定主意，更别说谋划对付父亲了。

source: But what if he got angry? He's been unhinged as of late. What might he do then?
target: 可要是他发怒了呢？他最近一直疯疯癫癫的。到时他可能会做出什么事？

source: I don't know how to convince you, but I tell you the truth. Hamlet will take Father's life.
target: 我不知道怎样才能说服你，但我说的是真的。哈姆雷特一定会杀死父亲。

source: I do believe you in my heart, Ophelia. That's why I've decided to stay.
target: 我心里确实相信你，奥菲莉娅。所以我才决定留下来。

source: I will watch for the slightest sign of aggression in him. If I find him to threaten Father in any way, I'll not hesitate to act.
target: 我会留意他哪怕最细微的攻击迹象。如果发现他以任何方式威胁父亲，我都会毫不犹豫地采取行动。

source: I promise you that.
target: 这点我向你保证。

source: Irma, we ought to talk about Hamlet.
target: 伊尔玛，我们该谈谈哈姆雷特的事。

source: You've heard the news by now, I'm sure.
target: 我想你现在肯定已经听说了。

source: Oh, Ophelia. Oh, my little bird. I felt your pain from far away the instant I found out.
target: 唉，奥菲莉娅。唉，我的小鸟儿。听到消息的那一刻，隔着老远，我都能感受到你的痛苦。

source: My heart aches for you and your brother.
target: 我为你和你哥哥感到心痛。

source: Had Hamlet been... properly disciplined before now-- had someone intervened-- your father might yet live.
target: 如果哈姆雷特早些时候就……受到妥善管教——如果有人出面干预——你父亲也许还活着。

source: I believe Hamlet may act violently against my father.
target: 我相信哈姆雷特可能会对我父亲动武。

source: And I certainly believe it.
target: 这我当然相信。

source: He is murderous, uncontrollable. Everyone in Elsinore is afraid.
target: 他凶残得想杀人，根本管不住。埃尔西诺人人都害怕。

source: Perhaps someone his elder can calm him. Speak to him of his rage.
target: 也许有位年长的人能让他平静下来，跟他谈谈他的怒火。

source: He pushes away my lady and his uncle with all his might.
target: 他竭力拒绝王后和他叔叔接近。

source: But... perhaps someone else could... intervene.
target: 不过……也许有别的人能……出面干预。

source: I have to stop Hamlet.
target: 我必须阻止哈姆雷特。

source: You truly are an amateur at this, aren't you?
target: 你在这方面还真是个新手，不是吗？

source: And here I thought that the most basic of endeavours in this world!
target: 我还以为这是世上最简单的事呢！

source: Regardless, of course, the right performance could urge Hamlet to remain seated...
target: 不过嘛，当然，一场恰到好处的演出，或许能让哈姆雷特一直坐着……

source: Such a quandary. Truly. If only there were some way it could be prevented!
target: 真是个难题。确实。要是有什么办法能阻止就好了！

source: Perhaps the right performance could urge the unruly boy to remain seated...
target: 也许一场恰到好处的演出，能让那个桀骜不驯的小子一直坐着……

source: I sense that you may have some familiarity my work, already.
target: 我感觉，你可能已经对我的作品有所了解了。

source: If you are interested in seeing me perform something special, perhaps based upon some juicy gossip, you might consider a collaboration!
target: 如果你想看我演点特别的，比如以某些劲爆的传闻为题材，不妨考虑跟我合作！

source: I believe there's an assassin embedded into the members of the court, trying to have me killed.
target: 我相信有个刺客混在宫廷的人当中，想要置我于死地。

source: Oho! What a fascinating topic for a performance. Lavish, dangerous, exquisite... a tale of daggers lodged in spines!
target: 哦嚯！多么引人入胜的演出题材。华丽、危险、精妙……一个匕首刺入脊背的故事！

source: Unfortunately, you've missed your chance.
target: 可惜，你已经错过机会了。

source: That window of opportunity has, shall we say, been shut. I hope you enjoyed the performance.
target: 那扇机会之窗，可以说已经关上了。希望那场演出让你看得尽兴。

source: Hee hee. What great havoc shall we wreak with this juicy performance, dear?
target: 嘻嘻。亲爱的，我们要用这场精彩的演出掀起多大的乱子呢？

source: I'll let you find out!
target: 我会让你亲自揭晓！

source: Oho! What a fascinating topic for our upcoming production. Let's put on something lavish, dangerous, exquisite... a tale of daggers lodged in spines!
target: 哦嚯！这题材用在我们即将上演的戏里，多么引人入胜。让我们演一出华丽、危险、精妙的戏……一个匕首刺入脊背的故事！

source: Hamlet is acting unusually strangely.
target: 哈姆雷特的举止异常古怪。

source: Oho! What a fascinating topic for a production. Unfortunately, you've missed your chance.
target: 哦嚯！多么引人入胜的戏剧题材。可惜，你已经错过机会了。

source: Oh, indeed? I simply must work a brooding prince into my upcoming production. I have so, so many ideas...
target: 哦，真的？我一定要在即将上演的戏里加上一位忧郁的王子。我有好多好多点子……

source: I've heard that the Queen had an affair with King Claudius before her husband's death.
target: 我听说，王后在丈夫去世之前，就和克劳狄斯国王有私情。

source: They say the best drama is born of scandal, my dear!—Or at least, I do. I say that. Perhaps I can use this information in our upcoming performance.
target: 人们都说，最好的戏剧源于丑闻，亲爱的！——至少我是这么说的。对，这话是我说的。也许我们即将上演的戏能用上这条消息。

source: I'm certain that King Claudius murdered his own brother.
target: 我确信，克劳狄斯国王谋杀了自己的亲哥哥。

source: Hee hee. What great havoc shall we wreak with this juicy performance?
target: 嘻嘻。我们要用这场精彩的演出掀起多大的乱子呢？

source: Hmm. What a fascinating proposal... perhaps I can use this in my upcoming performance. It is a classic murder story, after all, isn't it? Even perhaps, hmm, a bit overdone.
target: 嗯。多么有趣的提议……也许我即将上演的戏能用上这个。毕竟，这是个经典的谋杀故事，不是吗？甚至可能，嗯，有点演烂了。

source: I believe I'm reliving the same days over and over again, as if time is repeating...
target: 我觉得自己在一遍又一遍地经历同样的几天，仿佛时间在不断重复……

source: Hee hee. What great havoc shall we wreak this time, dear?
target: 嘻嘻。亲爱的，这次我们要掀起多大的乱子呢？

source: How peculiar and yet wonderful. But have you figured out the reason for the repetition yet?
target: 多么奇特，却又多么美妙。不过，你找到这一切不断重复的原因了吗？

source: Without a motive, you'll keep uncovering the same tortuous twists and turns, failing to save everyone...
target: 找不到动机，你就会不断揭开同样曲折纠缠的内情，却救不了所有人……

source: Oh, I spoke out of turn! Terribly sorry.
target: 哦，我多嘴了！实在抱歉。

source: I have a most fascinating performance to put on, inspired by you!
target: 我有一出极其精彩的戏要上演，灵感正是来自你！

source: My father will die, and none of the royal family will mourn him—not even the King. If he knew that, maybe he wouldn't sacrifice himself for the Queen.
target: 我父亲会死，而王室里没有一个人会为他哀悼——连国王也不会。如果他知道这一点，也许就不会为王后牺牲自己了。

source: Ahh, a daughter's love. Such a tender little thing.
target: 啊，女儿的爱。多么柔软的小东西。

source: Yes, yes! Shall we see how this alters the course of history? I admit, I'm most curious!
target: 好，好！让我们看看这会如何改变历史的进程？我承认，我好奇极了！

source: I have a most fascinating performance to put on, inspired by you.
target: 我有一出极其精彩的戏要上演，灵感正是来自你。

source: Your lady-in-waiting Brit is a spy for the Prince of Norway.
target: 您的宫廷侍女布莉特是挪威王子的间谍。

source: I know. I can hardly believe it.
target: 我知道。我实在难以相信。

source: You think you know someone, Ophelia, and then...
target: 奥菲莉娅，你以为自己了解一个人，可到头来……

source: I knew she was unhappy. But to this extent-- to the point of treason? How can it be?
target: 我知道她不开心。可竟然到了这个地步——到了叛国的地步？怎么会这样？

source: I think someone must have put her up to this.
target: 我想，一定是有人唆使她这么做的。

source: She is too young to have chosen this for herself. I know it in my heart.
target: 她还太年轻，不会自己选择这条路。我心里很清楚。

source: Damn that father of hers.
target: 她那个父亲真该死。

source: My little Brit? Ha!
target: 我的小布莉特？哈！

source: I tell the truth, my lady. In fact, I think you'll find proof on her if you only look for it.
target: 我说的是真的，陛下。事实上，我想只要您搜一搜，就能在她身上找到证据。

source: That's quite a grave accusation, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，这可是很严重的指控。

source: And rather a stretch of an accusation, truth be told.
target: 说实话，也是个相当牵强的指控。

source: She does act strangely sometimes, but I'm sure it's nothing that can't be easily cleared up.
target: 她有时举止确实古怪，但我相信，这些事都很容易解释清楚。

source: Why don't you ask the good Guard Captain to speak with her, if you're so worried?
target: 如果你这么担心，何不请那位可靠的卫队长去跟她谈谈？

source: Brit, I know you've been leaking information to Fortinbras.
target: 布莉特，我知道你一直在向福丁布拉斯泄露情报。

source: Really? Is it because I just told you that?
target: 真的？是因为我刚刚才告诉了你吗？

source: You're a special kind of something, 'Feely.
target: 你可真是个奇人，菲莉。

source: I want you to help me stop the Prince from invading. I won't tell anyone you helped me.
target: 我想请你帮我阻止王子入侵。我不会告诉任何人你帮过我。

source: That contraption was set into motion long before I was involved, 'Feely. The Prince has been plotting with my father for months.
target: 菲莉，我参与进来之前，那架机器早就开始运转了。王子和我父亲已经密谋好几个月了。

source: There's got to be a way, Brit. I'm not asking for you to betray your father. Only to help me save lives.
target: 一定有办法的，布莉特。我不是要你背叛父亲，只是想让你帮我救人。

source: I'm begging you. Please.
target: 我求你了。拜托。

source: ...There might be a way. But you won't like it.
target: ……也许有个办法。但你不会喜欢的。

source: They meet late at night in the town square, long after all are asleep. They plan to meet next right before the seige begins on Sunday.
target: 他们深夜在镇上的广场见面，那时所有人都睡下很久了。他们计划下次在星期日围城开始前见面。

source: Understood. I won't expose you, Brit. I promise.
target: 明白了。我不会揭发你，布莉特。我保证。

source: Does anyone else know?
target: 还有别人知道吗？

source: I suppose it doesn't matter. I knew this would come eventually.
target: 我想也无所谓了。我知道这一天迟早会来。

source: Let them hang me, then. Go on. Run and tell the King. Let him snap my neck himself.
target: 那就让他们绞死我吧。去啊。跑去告诉国王。让他亲手拧断我的脖子。

source: The best part is, Claudius is too proud to see it. He thinks he's extending an olive branch. All he's doing is exposing his back.
target: 最妙的是，克劳狄斯太自负，根本看不出来。他以为自己在伸出橄榄枝，其实不过是在暴露自己的后背。

source: Then how can he be convinced?
target: 那要怎样才能说服他？

source: I don't know! I don't know. Why does everyone expect me to have the answers here? I'm just a pawn! What choice do I have?
target: 我不知道！我不知道。为什么人人都指望我知道这些事的答案？我只是个棋子！我有什么选择？

source: I hate this place. And I hate you especially. I wish you'd all leave me alone.
target: 我恨这个地方。尤其恨你。真希望你们都别来烦我。

source: (Perhaps that would have gone better if I'd found a way to earn her trust first.)
target: （也许，要是我先想办法赢得她的信任，事情就会顺利些。）

source: (It's odd to speak with Brit like this, knowing she'd kill me if she had to...)
target: （明知道布莉特如果不得不杀我，就会动手，却还这样跟她说话，感觉真奇怪……）

source: (Maybe we don't have to be this way—she and I. Maybe there's another option.)
target: （也许我们不必这样——我和她。也许还有别的选择。）

source: ...There is a way. But you won't like it.
target: ……有个办法。但你不会喜欢的。

source: I don't want you to be executed, believe it or not.
target: 信不信由你，我并不想让你被处死。

source: Then why are you speaking to me about this? Why not just turn me into the King directly? Did you... learn something?
target: 那你为什么要来跟我谈这件事？为什么不直接把我交给国王？你是不是……知道了什么？

source: Your Majesty, I know that Lady Brit is a spy, leaking information to Prince Fortinbras.
target: 陛下，我知道布莉特女士是个间谍，一直在向福丁布拉斯王子泄露情报。

source: I'm aware. Bernardo is dealing with her as we speak. And to think that we had such a rat in our own court!
target: 我知道。贝尔纳多此刻正在处置她。真没想到，我们自己的宫廷里竟然藏着这么一只老鼠！

source: I understand you were the one who brought this to our attention.
target: 我听说，是你让我们注意到这件事的。

source: It appears you are as clever as your are beautiful. I was truly a fool to have underestimated you for so long.
target: 看来你的聪慧丝毫不逊于你的美貌。我竟然低估了你这么久，真是愚蠢。

source: Lady Birgitta? Are you certain?
target: 比尔吉塔女士？你确定吗？

source: Of course, my king.
target: 当然，陛下。

source: If this was coming from any woman but you, Ophelia, I'd laugh off the notion. But...
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果这话是除了你以外的任何女人说的，我都会一笑置之。不过……

source: I promise you, I will make sure this information reaches the Guard Captain.
target: 我向你保证，我一定会把这条消息传给卫队长。

source: However, I'm sure she must have been acting of her own accord.
target: 不过，我确信她一定是自作主张。

source: We're in the middle of peace negotiations with the Prince. There's no reason for him to spy on my court.
target: 我们正在和王子进行和平谈判。他没有理由刺探我的宫廷。

source: It's good that we never offered peace to Fortinbras. It's clear he cannot be trusted.
target: 幸好我们从未向福丁布拉斯提出议和。显然，他不值得信任。

source: That's ridiculous. We're in the middle of peace negotiations with the Prince. There's no reason for him to spy on my court.
target: 荒唐。我们正在和王子进行和平谈判。他没有理由刺探我的宫廷。

source: And Brit? She's but a girl like yourself! What could she possibly have to do with grand political schemes?
target: 至于布莉特？她不过是个和你一样的小姑娘！她能跟那些政治大阴谋有什么关系？

source: This is precisely the sort of rumor that could disintegrate all the hard work I've done. So I ask that you cease it.
target: 这种谣言足以让我的全部心血毁于一旦。所以，我要求你停止散播。

source: A fascinating theory. Have you been standing in the summer sun too long?
target: 真是个有趣的说法。你是不是在夏日的太阳底下站得太久了？

source: Lady Brit is my wife's most faithful lady-in-waiting—and a young woman, too. She can do no harm to anyone.
target: 布莉特女士是我妻子最忠诚的宫廷侍女——何况她还是个年轻姑娘。她伤害不了任何人。

source: Don't allow your whimsy to undermine affairs of state.
target: 别让你的异想天开妨碍国事。

source: (Ugh. Looks like I'll have to find someone else to listen to me.)
target: （唉。看来我得另找个肯听我说话的人了。）

source: Bernardo, you've got to believe me—Lady Brit is leaking information to Fortinbras's army.
target: 贝尔纳多，你一定要相信我——布莉特女士正在向福丁布拉斯的军队泄露情报。

source: Ophelia, this is a very serious accusation.
target: 奥菲莉娅，这可是非常严重的指控。

source: Extremely, incredibly serious.
target: 极其严重，严重得不得了。

source: I know. But you've known me my entire life. Have you ever known me to lie about something like this?
target: 我知道。可你从小就认识我。你见过我拿这种事撒谎吗？

source: Won't you look into it as a favor?
target: 就当帮我个忙，调查一下，好吗？

source: Ah... you're correct in that regard, at least.
target: 啊……至少这一点，你说得没错。

source: But Lady Birgitta is a respected member of the court—this must be pursued gently. I will speak with her, at the very least.
target: 但比尔吉塔女士在宫廷里很受尊重——调查这件事必须采取温和的方式。至少，我会跟她谈谈。

source: Yes, I've been informed of your suspicions. I will speak with her shortly.
target: 是的，已经有人告诉我你的怀疑了。我很快就会跟她谈谈。

source: Yes, I'm already aware. Unfortunately, it seems that it's too late for me to do anything.
target: 是的，我已经知道了。遗憾的是，看来现在我做什么都太迟了。

source: If only I had known, perhaps circumstances would have taken a different turn.
target: 要是我早知道，事情或许就会有不同的转折。

source: Lady Brit is the one leaking information to Prince Fortinbras. I learned this firsthand.
target: 向福丁布拉斯王子泄露情报的人就是布莉特女士。这是我亲自查知的。

source: Well, yes. We all did. Because Bernardo just announced it.
target: 嗯，是啊。我们都知道了。因为贝尔纳多刚刚宣布了这件事。

source: I find it such an unfortunate turn of events. That poor girl.
target: 事情变成这样，真是不幸。可怜的姑娘。

source: And why are you telling me about this? If that's the case, report it to the Guard Captain at once!
target: 那你为什么把这件事告诉我？如果真是这样，立刻去向卫队长报告！

source: I thought you'd like to know.
target: 我以为你会想知道。

source: Everyone knows, now!
target: 现在大家都知道了！

source: But Ophelia, let me tell you something. She was a fool. Everyone knows there's a right way to commit treason.
target: 不过，奥菲莉娅，我告诉你。她真是个傻瓜。谁都知道，叛国也有正确的做法。

source: I'd like to know when she's in jail for it!
target: 等她为这事进了监牢，再来告诉我！

source: But Ophelia, let me tell you something. If you've caught her, she's a fool. Everyone knows there's a right way to commit treason.
target: 不过，奥菲莉娅，我告诉你。如果你抓到了她，那她就是个傻瓜。谁都知道，叛国也有正确的做法。

source: And that is?
target: 什么做法？

source: Well, it's really very simple. I'm shocked more usurpers don't do this.
target: 其实很简单。居然没更多篡位者这么做，真让我吃惊。

source: The first step is to ensure that any time you are committing treason, you're dressed exactly like your twin sister.
target: 第一步，确保你每次确实在干叛国勾当时，都穿得跟你的孪生姐妹一模一样。

source: Then, when caught, you simply claim it was her. Off to the dungeon she goes, and you're free!
target: 然后，被抓到时，你只要说那是她干的。她进地牢，你就自由了！

source: You... have a twin sister?
target: 你……有个孪生姐妹？

source: Well, of course. She lives at my parents' estate.
target: 当然有。她住在我父母的庄园里。

source: And you evidently don't like her very much.
target: 而且，你显然不怎么喜欢她。

source: Certainly not. She's dreadful.
target: 当然不喜欢。她讨厌透了。

source: How is one expected to acquire a twin sister in the first place?
target: 可人要怎么才能先弄到一个孪生姐妹呢？

source: Oh. Hmm. What an odd question! Ophelia, don't you know how children are made? You're old enough to know!
target: 哦。嗯。真是个奇怪的问题！奥菲莉娅，你不知道孩子是怎么来的吗？你这个年纪该知道了！

source: That's not what I was aski-- you know what, forget I said anything.
target: 我问的不是这——算了，当我什么都没说。

source: Irma, Lady Brit is a spy leaking information to Fortinbras.
target: 伊尔玛，布莉特女士是个间谍，正在向福丁布拉斯泄露情报。

source: Yes. We all heard the news!
target: 是的。我们都听说了！

source: She took advantage of my lady's trust. I cannot forgive her.
target: 她利用了王后对她的信任。我无法原谅她。

source: Still, to lose one's life so young-- it is a shame.
target: 可话说回来，这么年轻就丢了性命——实在可惜。

source: Many of us have done things worth regretting. Many of us are given a chance to redeem ourselves.
target: 我们很多人都做过值得后悔的事。我们很多人也得到了赎罪的机会。

source: But there can be no redemption in execution.
target: 可一旦被处死，就再没有赎罪的机会了。

source: Ophelia, please. I know Brit can be difficult, but this... this is too much.
target: 奥菲莉娅，别这样。我知道布莉特有时不好相处，可这……这太过分了。

source: You must come to love her as the Queen does. Do not try to overpower her. You are both strong, but not dissimilar...
target: 你得学着像王后一样喜爱她。别试着压过她。你们都很坚强，也并非那么不同……

source: Irma—you don't believe me?
target: 伊尔玛——你不相信我？

source: Oh, Ophelia. You are so young. I forget sometimes how I was as a girl. Always with my teeth bared. Like you.
target: 唉，奥菲莉娅。你还这么年轻。有时我都忘了自己还是个姑娘时是什么样。总是龇着牙，像你一样。

source: Laertes, I'm sorry to have to tell you this—but Brit is a spy working for Prince Fortinbras.
target: 雷欧提斯，很抱歉，我不得不告诉你——布莉特是为福丁布拉斯王子效力的间谍。

source: Brit? Working for... Norway?
target: 布莉特？为……挪威效力？

source: You're serious? Truly?
target: 你是认真的？真的？

source: Truly. I'm sorry. I really am. I know it may sound insane, but you of all people should speak with her. You'll learn the truth.
target: 真的。对不起。我真的很抱歉。我知道这听起来可能很荒唐，可最该去跟她谈谈的人就是你。你会知道真相的。

source: I want to believe you, but about Brit? I just...
target: 我想相信你，可你说的是布莉特啊？我实在……

source: I'll talk to her. I hope with all my soul you're wrong.
target: 我会跟她谈谈。我真心希望你错了。

source: I know it seems strange, but please believe me. I think she means to have me killed.
target: 我知道这听起来很奇怪，但请相信我。我觉得她打算让人杀了我。

source: And I don't know how to stop her without your help.
target: 没有你的帮助，我不知道该怎么阻止她。

source: I'll tell the docksmen they can forget the boat, at least, for now. I shan't go to Paris. Not until this matter is resolved.
target: 我会告诉码头的人，至少暂时不用安排船了。我不去巴黎了。这件事解决之前，我哪儿也不去。

source: Won't Father be upset about the waste of time?
target: 父亲不会因为耽误了时间而生气吗？

source: This is more important. Let me deal with Father separately.
target: 这件事更重要。父亲那边，我会另行处理。

source: I should have never trusted her.
target: 我根本就不该相信她。

source: It doesn't matter. None of it matters any longer.
target: 不重要了。现在这一切都不重要了。

source: I want her to pay for what she did. And yet...
target: 我想让她为自己的所作所为付出代价。可是……

source: Ergh. How can I travel with something like this weighing on me?
target: 唉。这种事压在心头，我怎么出得了远门？

source: Lady Brit is a spy working for Prince Fortinbras.
target: 布莉特女士是为福丁布拉斯王子效力的间谍。

source: Oh, my! You're drawing ever nearer, aren't you?
target: 哎呀！你越来越接近了，不是吗？

source: Not long now until she's paid for her crimes, I suspect.
target: 我猜，用不了多久，她就会为自己的罪行付出代价了。

source: Do keep this information moving towards the brawny arms of justice. I so love a good procedural drama.
target: 请继续把这条消息送向正义那强壮的臂膀。我可太喜欢精彩的探案剧了。

source: That may be, but she's no longer a threat to you. Don't you remember?
target: 或许是吧，但她已经不再威胁你了。你不记得了吗？

source: I made some edits to the tale! Snip, snip... those bits are on the floor!
target: 我给故事做了些修改！咔嚓，咔嚓……那些片段都掉在地上了！

source: Are you going to imprison an innocent woman just to see what happens next?
target: 你要把一个无辜的女人关进监牢，只为看看接下来会发生什么？

source: If so, I must confess, I rather like your style.
target: 如果是这样，我得承认，我还挺喜欢你的作风。

source: Errrr, this is a matter for Cap'n Bernardo!
target: 呃——这事得找贝尔纳多队长！

source: I dunno wot to do about spies... only loose chickens... an' rowdy servant boys.
target: 我可不知道该怎么对付间谍……我只会管乱跑的鸡……还有闹事的男仆。

source: Well, yeh! On account o' Bernardo announcin' it, we all know now!
target: 可不是嘛！贝尔纳多都宣布了，现在我们全知道啦！

source: It's always the ones yeh least expect, innit?
target: 总是你最想不到的那些人，对吧？

source: One time, someone stole my only good pair o' boots. Spent all day askin' around for 'em.
target: 有一回，有人偷了我唯一一双好靴子。我到处打听，找了一整天。

source: I interrogated a few o' the junior guards over it. Finally realized exactly who it was.
target: 我为这事盘问了几个资历浅的卫兵。最后总算弄清是谁干的了。

source: I'd gotten drunk an' lost them in the mud.
target: 是我喝醉了，把靴子丢在泥里了。

source: I was lookin' for the culprit... but the culprit was right under my nose all along!
target: 我一直在找罪魁祸首……可那家伙从头到尾就在我眼皮底下！

source: I hear Quince will be performing soon. And Hamlet will be helping run the show.
target: 我听说奎因斯很快就要演出了。哈姆雷特也会帮忙筹办。

source: So I've heard. The performance takes place soon, I believe, yes?
target: 我也听说了。我记得很快就要开演了，对吧？

source: Is that so?
target: 是吗？

source: Maybe it's good the boy is applying himself to something.
target: 这孩子肯用心做点什么，也许是件好事。

source: Have you heard that Peter Quince is returning to put on a performance—with Hamlet assisting?
target: 您听说彼得·奎因斯要回来演出了吗？哈姆雷特也会帮忙。

source: Heard? Why, love, I invited him myself.
target: 听说？亲爱的，可是我亲自邀请他来的。

source: It thrills me to see Hamlet getting involved. He needs something to perk his spirits.
target: 看到哈姆雷特参与其中，我真是高兴极了。他需要些能让他振作的事。

source: The last time we had players at Elsinore, he was so much younger.
target: 上次有演员来埃尔西诺时，他还小得多呢。

source: He fell asleep during the performance—his father had to carry him to bed.
target: 他看着演出就睡着了——他父亲只好把他抱到床上去。

source: I'm glad to see he's developed such an appreciation of the arts.
target: 看到他如今这么懂得欣赏艺术，我很高兴。

source: Have you heard that Peter Quince will perform? And Hamlet is assisting him.
target: 你听说彼得·奎因斯要演出了吗？哈姆雷特也在帮他。

source: So I've heard.
target: 我听说了。

source: What is this sudden interest in art? That boy never had any head at all for art, and now suddenly the bird sings a new tune.
target: 怎么突然对艺术感兴趣了？那孩子向来对艺术一窍不通，现在这只鸟倒突然换了个调子。

source: This old woman is suspicious and she doesn't like it.
target: 我这老太婆觉得有蹊跷，也不喜欢这样。

source: Have you heard Peter Quince is going to perform? Hamlet's going to help with the show, too.
target: 您听说彼得·奎因斯要演出了吗？哈姆雷特也会帮忙筹办。

source: So I've heard. 6:00 PM, I believe, yes?
target: 我听说了。我记得是下午6:00，对吧？

source: You know, Quince is an odd one. Always traipsing the countryside earning his coin from God-knows-what. It certainly isn't an honest living, at any rate.
target: 你知道，奎因斯是个怪人。总在乡下四处游荡，天知道靠什么挣钱。反正肯定不是正经营生。

source: And he's always smiling. What's so worth smiling about?
target: 而且他总是笑眯眯的。有什么那么值得笑的？

source: Are you looking forward to performing again in Elsinore?
target: 你期待再次在埃尔西诺演出吗？

source: I'm not here for them, my dear. I'm here for you.
target: 亲爱的，我不是为他们来的。我是为你。

source: But of course, I'm always up for a little fun.
target: 不过当然，有点乐子，我总是乐意的。

source: Remember that if you'd like to see a special performance, you have only to request the topic du jour.
target: 记住，如果你想看一场特别演出，只需点明当天的主题。

source: Remember you agreed to meet me in the gallery. It's long overdue.
target: 记住，你答应过到画廊来见我。你已经迟了很久了。

source: Of all the places a man can perform, none are so impressive as a royal castle.
target: 一个人能登台演出的地方，没有哪处比王家的城堡更气派。

source: Of course, none are so hard to please as a royal court—why, mock the wrong face, and you're sure to lose a limb or three.
target: 当然，也没有哪群观众比宫廷的人更难取悦——要是嘲弄错了人，你肯定会少掉一条胳膊腿，甚至三条。

source: I come here as often as I can. Each time, I seem to find new inspiration.
target: 只要有机会，我就会来这里。每次似乎都能找到新的灵感。

source: I've seen your performances. They are... rather on point, aren't they?
target: 我看过你的演出。它们……还挺切中要害的，不是吗？

source: I could almost swear they were about real people.
target: 我几乎敢肯定，演的就是真实的人物。

source: Oh ho ho! I do strive for believability, yes. I have my own patented technique!
target: 哦呵呵！没错，我确实力求让人信服。我有自己的独门技法！

source: I sense, however, that you may have some familiarity my work, already.
target: 不过，我感觉你或许已经对我的作品有所了解了。

source: If you are interested in seeing me perform something special - maybe based upon some juicy gossip - feel free to let me know!
target: 如果你想看我演点特别的——比如取材于某些劲爆的传闻——尽管告诉我！

source: So! You're going to help put on a play, I hear.
target: 对了！听说你要帮忙筹办一出戏。

source: What? Where... where did you hear that?
target: 什么？你……你从哪儿听说的？

source: Oh—ah—not yet, of course.
target: 哦——啊——当然，还没听说呢。

source: But you know, I've heard that Peter Quince's one-man show may be coming by the castle soon.
target: 不过，我听说彼得·奎因斯的独角戏可能很快就要来城堡演出了。

source: Interesting. I'll keep a watchful eye.
target: 有意思。我会仔细留意的。

source: Would that I had time for such an endeavor.
target: 但愿我有时间做这样的事。

source: What a distant thing that seems like, now.
target: 如今，这似乎已经是很遥远的事了。

source: That's correct.
target: 没错。

source: Any further thoughts?
target: 还有什么想说的吗？

source: You asked. I answered. What more do we have to discuss?
target: 你问了。我答了。我们还有什么好谈的？

source: I dearly hope you can attend the performance. Tragedy can be so cathartic.
target: 我衷心希望你能来看演出。悲剧能让人如此畅快地宣泄情绪。

source: I've heard Quince will be performing soon—and Hamlet is assisting him.
target: 我听说奎因斯很快就要演出了——哈姆雷特也在帮他。

source: Ho! It's been quite some time since I saw 'im last!
target: 嚯！我可好久没见着他了！

source: Yeh know, I saw 'im when King Hamlet was on the throne—God rest his soul—and King Alexander before him. This'll be the first time he's come to the present court.
target: 你知道，哈姆雷特国王在位时，我就见过他——愿上帝让国王的灵魂安息——再往前，亚历山大国王在位时也见过。这还是他头一回来如今的宫廷呢。

source: Makes me feel old! Har har har...
target: 这么一想，我真是老了！哈哈哈……

source: So you've heard that Peter Quince is to perform soon?
target: 你听说彼得·奎因斯很快就要演出了？

source: Oh, have I! And the man's one of those types, too.
target: 哦，当然听说了！而且他还是那种人呢。

source: Those types?
target: 那种人？

source: Theater people. You know the sort. Always bursting into song for no reason. Always jittering around like they've been seized by the Holy Ghost.
target: 搞戏剧的人。你知道的，就是那种人。总是莫名其妙地唱起歌来。总是抖来抖去，像被圣灵附了身。

source: Ugh. You stay away from them, Ophelia. Or before you know it, you'll be monologuing all over the place!
target: 呸。奥菲莉娅，你可离他们远点。否则一不留神，你就会到处念独白了！

source: Ah! So like Hamlet, you mean?
target: 啊！你是说，像哈姆雷特那样？

source: ...This has been a revelation. I need a moment.
target: ……这可让我恍然大悟了。让我缓一缓。

source: Oh, yes. His Highness himself informed us. It's all a grand ceremony to lift Hamlet's mood.
target: 哦，是啊。是殿下亲自告诉我们的。这一整场盛大的活动，都是为了让哈姆雷特开心起来。

source: I didn't realize Hamlet liked the theater so much these days.
target: 我都不知道哈姆雷特最近这么喜欢戏剧。

source: Yes, well, you know, you're one of his old friends. He's been at Wittenberg with us for so long, you see.
target: 是啊，不过，你也知道，你是他的老朋友嘛。他跟我们在威登堡待了那么久，你明白吧。

source: One's tastes do tend to change when one runs in new social circles, you know.
target: 你知道，换了社交圈，人的喜好往往也会跟着变。

source: Maybe I don't know him as well as I thought I did.
target: 也许我并没有自己以为的那么了解他。

source: I had a strange nightmare where I saw the entire royal court killed.
target: 我做了个奇怪的噩梦，梦见整个宫廷的人都被杀了。

source: And now you know it to be the truth.
target: 而现在，你知道那是真的了。

source: It is the original fate of this world. And your death the crux of it all.
target: 那是这个世界原本的命运。而你的死亡，是这一切的关键。

source: The Book of Fates, of course, saved you from death and chose you to be my unwilling partner in this game.
target: 当然，《命运之书》救你免于一死，选中了你，让你不情不愿地成为我在这场游戏中的搭档。

source: And yet you've opted not to make a move! So annoying.
target: 可你竟然选择一步也不走！真是烦人。

source: I won't give you that satisfaction yet.
target: 我暂时不会让你如愿。

source: As I've said before, I'm a very patient man. I'll be here. Waiting.
target: 我说过，我是个很有耐心的人。我会在这里。等着。

source: An ill omen.
target: 不祥之兆。

source: And what shall you do about it?
target: 那你打算怎么办？

source: I'm not certain. But do you know whether I can stop it?
target: 我还没想好。可你知道我能不能阻止这一切吗？

source: That depends on the genre of the performance!
target: 那就要看演的是哪种戏了！

source: In a comedy, of course. A comedy must always end happily.
target: 如果是喜剧，当然能。喜剧总得有个圆满的结局。

source: But in a tragedy... well.
target: 但如果是悲剧……嗯。

source: I wonder which one you're in?
target: 不知道你身处的是哪一种呢？

source: I had a strange nightmare where I saw the royal court killed.
target: 我做了个奇怪的噩梦，梦见宫廷的人被杀了。

source: ...Why are you wasting my time with this?
target: ……你为什么要拿这种事浪费我的时间？

source: I have far more important things to worry about than your night terrors.
target: 比起你的噩梦，我有重要得多的事要操心。

source: My lord, please believe me. It was far more than a mere dream. It felt so real. I saw you bloodied, a wound in your heart.
target: 陛下，请相信我。那绝不只是一个梦。感觉太真实了。我看见您浑身是血，心口有一道伤。

source: And Hamlet was your killer.
target: 杀死您的人是哈姆雷特。

source: No doubt he would be.
target: 真要有人杀我，肯定就是他。

source: I suppose even those outside my own family have noticed the tension between me and my young nephew.
target: 看来，就连家族以外的人，也注意到了我和年轻侄子之间的紧张关系。

source: Perhaps I ought to speak with him, trivial dreams aside...
target: 撇开这些无足轻重的梦不谈，也许我该找他谈谈……

source: The time has long come due.
target: 早就该谈了。

source: Well, then. That's how we know it's just a dream.
target: 那好。这就让我们确定，那只是个梦。

source: Hamlet can threaten no one any longer.
target: 哈姆雷特再也威胁不了任何人了。

source: A... a... nightmare?
target: 噩……噩……噩梦？

source: Killed... how?
target: 被杀了……怎么被杀的？

source: It's hard to remember. I saw... your father, somehow—the late King, but alive, somehow—and then everyone began to die.
target: 我记不太清了。我看见……你的父亲，不知怎么的——已经去世的国王，却不知怎么还活着——然后大家就开始一个接一个地死去。

source: Y-you saw my father?
target: 你、你看见了我父亲？

source: N-never mind. It doesn't matter. Leave me. I need... to be alone.
target: 没、没事了。不重要。你走吧。我需要……一个人待着。

source: So, we all died, eh?
target: 所以，我们全都死了，是吗？

source: Maybe that would be best for us all.
target: 也许那样对我们所有人都最好。

source: To just be erased, as though we'd never existed in the first place.
target: 就这样被抹去，仿佛我们从来没有存在过。

source: And you and I turned to nothing, not even dust, just gone.
target: 你和我都化为虚无，连尘埃都没留下，就这么消失了。

source: I rather like existing.
target: 我倒挺喜欢活着的。

source: Well, that makes one of us.
target: 好吧，那我们俩只有你这么想。

source: Having terrible dreams? That sounds awful. I'm sorry, my dear.
target: 做噩梦了？听着真难受。亲爱的，真替你难过。

source: Be glad it was but a dream.
target: 幸好那只是个梦。

source: I... worry that there was more truth in it than I'd have liked. It felt so real...
target: 我……担心梦里有些事是真的，比我愿意相信的还多。感觉太真实了……

source: Nightmares often do, don't they?
target: 噩梦往往都是这样，不是吗？

source: You know, I've also been having... strange dreams of my own.
target: 你知道吗，我也一直在做……一些奇怪的梦。

source: Of what nature, my lady?
target: 是什么样的梦，王后？

source: I'm... afraid it would be inappropriate to speak of them. I... just...
target: 我……恐怕不方便说出来。我……只是……

source: I already trouble poor Irma too often as it is. I've been spending my evenings in the kitchen, as though I were a girl again...
target: 我已经太常给可怜的伊尔玛添麻烦了。这些天晚上我都待在厨房里，仿佛又变回了小姑娘……

source: I-if you'll excuse me, Ophelia...
target: 恕、恕我先告辞了，奥菲莉娅……

source: I had a strange nightmare where I saw the royal court killed. But it felt... real.
target: 我做了个奇怪的噩梦，看见宫廷里的人都被杀了。可那感觉……像是真的。

source: My dear, I'm sorry you had a terrible dream, but fundamentally they are without consequence.
target: 亲爱的，你做了噩梦，我也替你难过，可梦终究不会造成什么后果。

source: It... felt as though I'd experienced it all before. I saw Hamlet run you through with a sword!
target: 那……感觉像是我以前经历过这一切。我看见哈姆雷特用剑刺穿了您的身体！

source: You went to spy on him over his behavior, and—and—
target: 您因为他的举止去暗中监视他，然后——然后——

source: Oh, no! Absolutely, absolutely not. Mad as he may be, Prince Hamlet would surely never hurt me.
target: 哦，不！绝不可能，绝不可能。他再怎么疯，哈姆雷特王子也绝不会伤害我。

source: Just earlier today I was speaking alone with him in the gallery. If he had ill intent, would he not have acted then?
target: 就在今天早些时候，我还在画廊里跟他单独谈过话。如果他心怀恶意，难道不会当时就动手吗？

source: Though... I will admit, his behavior is most peculiar. It seems random, but...
target: 不过……我得承认，他的举止实在古怪。看起来毫无规律，可是……

source: In fact, I have every intention of ensuring Hamlet causes no harm to anyone.
target: 其实，我正打算确保哈姆雷特不会伤害任何人。

source: I intend to find him at my earliest availability. He seems to frequent the same odd places these days.
target: 我打算一有空就去找他。这些天，他似乎总去那几个古怪的地方。

source: Love. Hamlet is gone.
target: 亲爱的。哈姆雷特已经不在了。

source: Whatever you dreamed of him, it matters little anymore.
target: 不管你梦见他做了什么，如今都不太重要了。

source: He shall live only in memory, now.
target: 如今，他只能活在记忆里了。

source: Are we in the business of exchanging dreams now, you and I?
target: 怎么，你和我现在开始交流各自的梦了？

source: It just felt so real. As though it were a memory.
target: 只是那感觉太真实了。就像一段记忆。

source: Was it the sort of dream where you can control things?
target: 是那种你能控制梦中事情的梦吗？

source: I tend to have more and more of those these days. A scholar once gave me some wisdom about those.
target: 我最近越来越常做这种梦了。有位学者曾教过我一些这方面的窍门。

source: He said that if every time you put on your shoes you think to yourself, 'Here I am, donning my shoes,' then over time, one can control one's dreams.
target: 他说，如果每次穿鞋时都在心里想：‘我现在正在穿鞋。’那么久而久之，就能控制自己的梦。

source: It's something to do with the way our memory functions.
target: 这跟我们的记忆运作方式有关。

source: Fascinating. Not quite what I was getting at, though.
target: 真有意思。不过，我想说的不太是这个。

source: Hmm. Perhaps the Queen could offer a sympathetic ear. Her Majesty's been suffering some nightmares herself lately.
target: 嗯。也许王后能体谅你，听你倾诉。陛下最近也一直受噩梦困扰。

source: You ge' em too?
target: 你也做噩梦啊？

source: I got one about a giant, man-eating sheep that is going to kill me.
target: 我梦见一只巨大的食人羊，它要杀了我。

source: E'ery night it closes in...
target: 每天晚上，它都越逼越近……

source: And then it bleats in m' face! BRAHH! BRAHH! An' I can't run away!
target: 然后它就冲着我的脸叫！咩啊！咩啊！我还跑不掉！

source: An' then I realize it's me mother!
target: 然后我才发现，那是我妈！

source: ...Not quite what I had in mind. Thank you, Marcellus.
target: ……跟我想说的不太一样。谢谢你，马塞勒斯。

source: Well, you're not the only one, 'Feely.
target: 嗯，又不止你一个，菲莉。

source: Gertrude's also been having trouble sleeping.
target: 乔特鲁德最近也睡不好。

source: Aren't you supposed to address her as 'My Lady'?
target: 你不是应该称她为‘王后’吗？

source: Only when I'm on the clock, 'Feely.
target: 当值的时候才要，菲莉。

source: Anyway, she's been sweating and saying strange things in her sleep. I think she's thinking about her dead husband. Pretty disgusting, if you ask me!
target: 总之，她睡着时一直出汗，还说些奇怪的话。我觉得她是在想她死去的丈夫。要我说，真够恶心的！

source: Maybe the two of you can find one another and grieve communally. I hear that can be very cathartic.
target: 也许你们俩可以找个机会，一起哀悼。我听说那样能大大宣泄心里的情绪。

source: My nightmare felt real. It didn't feel like a normal dream.
target: 我的噩梦感觉很真实。不像普通的梦。

source: Well, was I in it? Did I do anything interesting or fabulous? That's the only thing anyone cares about when you speak to them of your dreams.
target: 那里面有我吗？我有没有做什么有趣或者了不起的事？你跟别人说自己的梦时，人家只关心这个。

source: ...No. Your body... wasn't amongst the others. Still, I knew... that you were... already dead.
target: ……没有。你的尸体……不在那些尸体里。可我还是知道……你……已经死了。

source: ...I was... already... dead?
target: ……我……已经……死了？

source: What a tediously boring story. Leave me be, 'Feely.
target: 真是个乏味透顶的故事。别烦我了，菲莉。

source: I have places to be. Things to do.
target: 我还有地方要去。还有事要做。

source: The Queen was also having trouble sleeping.
target: 王后当时也睡不好。

source: Probably should've seen it as a warning sign, in hindsight.
target: 现在回头看，也许当时就该把那当成警兆。

source: Gertrude had a lot of darkness in her, you know? But even despite that, she was kind to me.
target: 你知道吗，乔特鲁德心里藏着很多阴暗的东西。但即便如此，她对我还是很好。

source: Don't let the darkness overcome you.
target: 别让黑暗吞噬你。

source: Anyway, that's all in the past. And I don't grieve. Let's just never speak of this again.
target: 总之，那些都过去了。而且我不会哀伤。以后都别再提了。

source: You as well?
target: 你也这样？

source: Have you been having nightmares, too?
target: 您也一直在做噩梦吗？

source: No! But the Queen, she has so many.
target: 没有！可王后，她总做噩梦。

source: I brought a cool cloth to her last night to calm her down. She was in such a fright.
target: 昨晚我给她拿了一块凉布巾，让她平静下来。她当时吓坏了。

source: She may be grown, but she's as much my little Gerta as ever.
target: 她虽然长大了，可在我心里，她始终是我的小格尔塔。

source: She comes to visit me nearly every night, but never tells me the contents of her fitful and bloody dreams.
target: 她几乎每晚都来看我，却从不告诉我，那些让她睡不安稳的血腥梦境里究竟有什么。

source: No! But my lady Gerta, she was having so many before she passed.
target: 没有！可我的格尔塔王后，她去世前总做噩梦。

source: I am worried for you, my sweet.
target: 我很担心你，亲爱的。

source: The Queen would not want you to follow in her footsteps. Of that, I am certain.
target: 王后不会希望你走上她的老路。这一点，我很确定。

source: My lord, I know for certain that Prince Fortinbras will invade very soon, violating the peace treaty.
target: 陛下，我确切知道，福丁布拉斯王子很快就会违背和平条约，发动入侵。

source: Hah! In what world should I listen to you on matters of the state?
target: 哈！国家大事，我凭什么听你的？

source: You know as well as I do that Lady Brit's family has been working for Norway. Who else might be?
target: 您和我一样清楚，布莉特女士的家族一直在为挪威效力。还有谁可能也在这么做呢？

source: My lord—if you would send an envoy outside the city's walls, you would see—
target: 陛下——如果您派一名使者到城墙外去，您就会发现——

source: An envoy! The little lady's learned to use the terms of war. Fascinating.
target: 使者！这位小姑娘竟然学会了战争用语。真有意思。

source: Your father already serves my war chamber needs most excellently. I hardly need two Poloniuses fretting in my ear.
target: 你父亲已经把我的军务参谋工作做得十分出色了。我可不需要两个波洛涅斯在我耳边忧心忡忡地念叨。

source: Let others handle the grand machinations. Worry less.
target: 这些大局谋划，就交给别人吧。少操点心。

source: I... know it's difficult to believe, but I was warned by someone I trust implicitly.
target: 我……知道这很难相信，但警告我的人，是我毫无保留地信任的人。

source: Normally I'd disregard this. But your kindness to me deserves a good turn.
target: 平时我不会理会这种事。但你待我这么好，我也该回报你。

source: If this is, in some way, true...
target: 如果这件事多少有些属实……

source: I'd need proof of his location if I were to act.
target: 要采取行动，我需要能证明他所在位置的证据。

source: Can your source bring me something of that nature?
target: 给你消息的人，能给我带来这样的证据吗？

source: I'll do my best, my lord.
target: 我会尽力的，陛下。

source: I've learned that Prince Fortinbras plans to invade, violating our peace treaty.
target: 我得知福丁布拉斯王子打算违背我们的和平条约，发动入侵。

source: Oh, Ophelia... while I'm sure that's entirely possible, it's above our heads.
target: 唉，奥菲莉娅……我当然知道这完全有可能，可这不是我们能管的事。

source: Better leave these matters to the men who order the troops, my love. The issue is being handled.
target: 亲爱的，这些事还是留给指挥军队的男人们吧。这件事已经有人在处理了。

source: I don't think it is. Have we considered Fortinbras might subvert—
target: 我觉得没有。我们有没有考虑过，福丁布拉斯可能会暗中破坏——

source: Ophelia. I am the daughter of an Emperor. You think I haven't? But who would listen to me—or to you?
target: 奥菲莉娅。我是皇帝的女儿。你以为我没考虑过吗？可谁会听我的——或者听你的？

source: Better not to rattle my husband. He's of a fragile mind now.
target: 最好别让我丈夫心神不宁。他现在精神很脆弱。

source: I know that Prince Fortinbras is going to invade soon, violating the treaty.
target: 我知道福丁布拉斯王子很快就会违背条约，发动入侵。

source: And I know that you know that.
target: 而且我知道，你也知道这件事。

source: We already spoke of this.
target: 我们已经谈过这件事了。

source: I'll see you soon. I hope I can still trust you. I'm not great at that part. Trusting, I mean.
target: 我们很快再见。希望我还能信任你。我不太擅长这个。我是说，信任别人。

source: I won't expose you, Brit. I promise.
target: 我不会揭发你的，布莉特。我保证。

source: We have to stop him.
target: 我们必须阻止他。

source: Even if that were true, what on earth makes you think I can do something about it?
target: 就算那是真的，你到底凭什么觉得我能做些什么？

source: Is there something you want to say to me? Spit it out, or stop wasting my time.
target: 你有什么话想对我说吗？有话就说，别浪费我的时间。

source: Father, I know for certain that Lord Fortinbras is going to invade, violating the peace treaty.
target: 父亲，我确切知道，福丁布拉斯大人将会违背和平条约，发动入侵。

source: Of course you do. You're my clever child. I wasn't certain you'd noticed... but I cannot say I am surprised.
target: 你当然知道。你是我的聪明孩子。我之前不确定你有没有注意到……但你能看出来，我也不意外。

source: The way the King refuses to listen to me! To any of his advisors—Bernardo included!
target: 国王就是不肯听我的话！任何顾问的话他都不听——连贝尔纳多也不例外！

source: Both Bernardo and I have been trying to convince my lord for weeks that a coup was on our doorstep. But he won't listen.
target: 贝尔纳多和我已经劝了陛下好几个星期，告诉他政变就在眼前。可他就是不听。

source: Even after Lady Brit was outed as a spy within our own walls, for God's sake!
target: 就连布莉特女士被揭穿是潜伏在我们城里的间谍之后，他还是这样，真是的！

source: He's too wrapped up in trying to please the Danish nobility, in making shows of force, in asserting his power...
target: 他一门心思只想着讨好丹麦贵族，炫耀武力，彰显自己的权威……

source: His desire for acknowledgement has left him blind to the tenuous position we're in.
target: 他太渴望得到认可，反而看不见我们的处境有多岌岌可危。

source: King Hamlet would never have misjudged so greatly for so long.
target: 哈姆雷特国王绝不会犯下如此严重的误判，还一错就是这么久。

source: Father, if you and I both know Fortinbras will come for us, can't we do something about it?
target: 父亲，既然您和我都知道福丁布拉斯会来攻打我们，难道我们不能做点什么吗？

source: ...Not without proof.
target: ……没有证据，就不行。

source: Had we any concrete evidence to show that Fortinbras is lying about his plans to invade the Polacks, we might succeed at convincing Claudius.
target: 如果我们有确凿证据，证明福丁布拉斯所谓入侵波兰人的计划是在撒谎，也许就能说服克劳狄斯。

source: Now that her allegiances have been exposed, if Bernardo could extract anything from Lady Brit... we might have a chance.
target: 如今她效忠哪一方已经暴露了，如果贝尔纳多能从布莉特女士那里问出些什么……我们也许还有机会。

source: But I'm uncertain whether she'll be willing to talk to him at all.
target: 但我不确定，她究竟愿不愿意跟他说话。

source: But to do that, we'd need to know someone connected to Norway—and we haven't anyone like that in Elsinore.
target: 可要做到这一点，我们得认识一个和挪威有联系的人——而埃尔西诺没有这样的人。

source: ...Maybe we do.
target: ……也许有呢。

source: Oho. Is Claudius's paranoia about spies and treason rubbing off on you?
target: 哦？克劳狄斯整天疑心间谍和叛国者，连你也受影响了？

source: Careful about that, love.
target: 可得当心，亲爱的。

source: Both Bernardo and I had been trying to convince the King for weeks that a coup was on our doorstep. But he wouldn't listen, up until the end.
target: 当时贝尔纳多和我劝了国王好几个星期，告诉他政变就在眼前。可他直到最后都不肯听。

source: Had we any concrete evidence to show that Fortinbras is lying about his plans to invade the Polacks, we might of succeeded at convincing Claudius.
target: 如果当时我们有确凿证据，证明福丁布拉斯所谓入侵波兰人的计划是在撒谎，也许就能说服克劳狄斯了。

source: I know for certain that Lord Fortinbras is going to invade, violating the peace treaty.
target: 我确切知道，福丁布拉斯大人将会违背和平条约，发动入侵。

source: (I'm a little early, I suppose. He hasn't heard anything about this yet.)
target: （看来我来得有点早。他还没听说过这件事。）

source: Never mind. It'll make sense later, perhaps.
target: 算了。也许过些时候你就明白了。

source: Step outside and enjoy the sunlight a little more. Don't go the way of Hamlet. I need at least one sane friend.
target: 出去多晒晒太阳吧。别变得跟哈姆雷特一样。我至少得有一个神志正常的朋友。

source: Ophelia. It's as if you're trying to have me deposed from my post.
target: 奥菲莉娅。你简直像是存心要让我被撤职。

source: You're correct that we all suspect Prince Fortinbras is subverting his uncle's wishes.
target: 你说得对，我们都怀疑福丁布拉斯王子在违背他叔父的意愿。

source: Still, without compelling evidence that Fortinbras has violated his agreement not to enter Denmark...
target: 不过，如果没有有力证据，证明福丁布拉斯违背了不进入丹麦的约定……

source: We have nothing.
target: 我们就什么依据也没有。

source: Have you found some trusted witness willing to confess everything they know?
target: 你找到可信的证人，愿意把自己知道的一切都交代出来了吗？

source: Hmm. Perhaps.
target: 嗯。也许吧。

source: Let us hear it then, if you have such compelling evidence.
target: 如果你有这么有力的证据，那就说来听听。

source: Until then, step outside and enjoy the sunlight a little more. Don't go the way of Hamlet. I need at least one sane friend.
target: 在那之前，出去多晒晒太阳吧。别变得跟哈姆雷特一样。我至少得有一个神志正常的朋友。

source: N... no. Not yet.
target: 没……没有。还没有。

source: But I will.
target: 但我会找到的。

source: All right. All right, Ophelia.
target: 好吧。好吧，奥菲莉娅。

source: Fortinbras has told the King he intends to pass through Denmark on his way to attack Poland, right?
target: 福丁布拉斯告诉国王，他打算借道丹麦去攻打波兰，对吧？

source: Isn't there a distinct possibility he's lying to us and intends to take Elsinore? After all, his father was killed by King Hamlet...
target: 他难道不是很有可能在骗我们，其实打算夺取埃尔西诺吗？毕竟，他父亲是被哈姆雷特国王杀死的……

source: Y...yes. There is that possibility. But Ophelia, we live in a time of constant war. That's always a possibility.
target: 是……是。有这种可能。但奥菲莉娅，我们生活在一个战乱不断的时代。这种可能始终都在。

source: Right now, Denmark needs allies, and Fortinbras is offering us that chance. Unless there's some compelling evidence to show otherwise, we must trust him.
target: 眼下，丹麦需要盟友，而福丁布拉斯给了我们这个机会。除非有有力证据证明他另有所图，否则我们必须信任他。

source: I know for a fact that Prince Fortinbras is going to stage an invasion.
target: 我确切知道，福丁布拉斯王子将会发动入侵。

source: Yes, yes. I anticipate he and his little cretinous attaché are somewhere in the marshes near this castle at the moment.
target: 是，是。我估计他和他那个蠢笨的小随员，眼下就在这座城堡附近的某处沼泽里。

source: But if we both know that, surely we can stop it.
target: 可既然我们都知道了，就一定能阻止这件事。

source: Oh? Can we, now?
target: 哦？我们真能吗？

source: ...And you know how I can achieve this.
target: ……而且你知道我该怎么做到。

source: Now leave me. Giving you a hint at this stage would be cheating, dearheart.
target: 现在走吧。亲爱的，这时候给你提示可就算作弊了。

source: Not while the men in charge of allocating this castle's defenses are unconvinced of any wrongdoing.
target: 只要那些负责调配城堡防卫的人还不相信有人图谋不轨，就办不到。

source: If only there were someone who knew Fortinbras closely who might be willing to come forward.
target: 要是有个十分了解福丁布拉斯的人，可能愿意站出来就好了。

source: Bernardo, I have proof of Fortinbras's plan to betray Denmark. He's hiding out in Castle Town.
target: 贝尔纳多，我有证据证明福丁布拉斯打算背叛丹麦。他正藏在城堡镇里。

source: You... Ophelia. My deepest pardons. Could you repeat that? I thought you said...
target: 你……奥菲莉娅。实在抱歉。能再说一遍吗？我好像听见你说……

source: You heard correctly. Fortinbras is hiding out in Castle Town as we speak.
target: 你没听错。福丁布拉斯此刻就藏在城堡镇里。

source: He and his officers are in disguise near the tavern, in a small apartment.
target: 他和手下的军官乔装打扮，待在酒馆附近的一间小公寓里。

source: If we act immediately and send men to arrest them, we may be able to stop their coup in its tracks.
target: 如果我们立刻行动，派人去逮捕他们，也许就能及时阻止他们的政变。

source: I believe you. That look in your eye. It frightens me to no end.
target: 我相信你。你的眼神……实在让我害怕。

source: Regretfully, I am unable to perform such an action without the King and Polonius's explicit consent.
target: 遗憾的是，没有国王和波洛涅斯的明确同意，我不能采取这样的行动。

source: As his advisor, your father must be consulted in situations like these. I'll call a War Council immediately.
target: 你父亲是国王的顾问，遇到这种情况，必须征询他的意见。我马上召集军事会议。

source: If possible, I request that you allow your father and me to break this news to the King. He may not trust your word on this matter.
target: 如果可以，请让你父亲和我来向国王禀报这个消息。在这件事上，他可能不会相信你的话。

source: I want to be present at that meeting.
target: 我想出席那场会议。

source: That's impossible. My apologies, my lady.
target: 那是不可能的。抱歉，小姐。

source: Upon second thought, it's only impossible if the King knows of your presence.
target: 不过再想想，只有国王知道你在场，才会行不通。

source: So you'll allow me to observe in secret?
target: 所以，你肯让我偷偷旁听？

source: You're certainly small enough to hide nicely.
target: 你的个头确实够小，很容易藏好。

source: One of the rare benefits.
target: 这算是少有的好处之一。

source: Come to the King's room when the meeting convenes. We'll speak further then.
target: 开会时到国王的房间来。到时候我们再谈。

source: Regretfully, I am unable to perform such an action without the King's explicit consent.
target: 遗憾的是，没有国王的明确同意，我不能采取这样的行动。

source: I'll call a War Council immediately.
target: 我马上召集军事会议。

source: If possible, I request that you allow me to break this news to the King. He may not trust your word on this matter.
target: 如果可以，请让我来向国王禀报这个消息。在这件事上，他可能不会相信你的话。

source: According to law, I'm unable to perform such an action without the King's explicit consent.
target: 按照法律，没有国王的明确同意，我不能采取这样的行动。

source: It could be perceived as an act of war, depending on the outcome.
target: 视结果而定，这可能会被视为战争行为。

source: Once the dust has settled, I'll gather the nobility and ask them to recommend an action.
target: 等局势平息，我会召集贵族，请他们建议该采取什么行动。

source: But Bernardo, we don't have time like that. Fortinbras could march on us today.
target: 可是贝尔纳多，我们没有那么多时间。福丁布拉斯今天就可能向我们进军。

source: I cannot act alone on a whim, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我不能凭一时冲动擅自行动。

source: The King is dead. There are bigger matters at play right now.
target: 国王已经死了。眼下还有更重大的事情要处理。

source: Father, I have proof of Fortinbras's plan to betray Denmark. He's hiding out in Castle Town.
target: 父亲，我有证据证明福丁布拉斯打算背叛丹麦。他正藏在城堡镇里。

source: Remember when we spoke earlier and you mentioned needing proof? I have it in hand.
target: 还记得我们先前谈过，你说需要证据吗？现在证据就在我手上。

source: This is the proof I know you've been searching for, Father.
target: 父亲，我知道这就是您一直在找的证据。

source: We must seize this fast, or we will all be conquered. The war is coming to our front.
target: 我们必须赶快抓住这个机会，不然就会全都沦陷。战火就要烧到我们面前了。

source: Please believe me!
target: 请相信我！

source: I believe it.
target: 我相信这是真的。

source: But I must also verify it.
target: 但我也必须核实。

source: Then send soldiers into town. He and his officers are hiding in disguise near the tavern, in a small apartment.
target: 那就派士兵进镇。他和手下的军官乔装打扮，藏在酒馆附近的一间小公寓里。

source: Hrm. Alas, I don't have the authority to propose such a move alone. I must consult with Bernardo and His Majesty.
target: 唔。唉，我无权独自提议采取这样的行动。我必须和贝尔纳多以及陛下商议。

source: Luckily, such a meeting can easily be arranged.
target: 好在，安排这样一场会议并不难。

source: Luckily, such a meeting has already been arranged. Perhaps due to your intervention?
target: 好在，这样一场会议已经安排好了。或许是因为你从中推动了？

source: The War Council will congregate as soon as we are able, in the King's personal chambers.
target: 我们会尽快在国王的私人寝室召开军事会议。

source: Am I... may I be permitted to witness it?
target: 我能……可以允许我旁听吗？

source: ...Under ordinary circumstances, absolutely not. No women are permitted to attend to matters of war.
target: ……正常情况下，绝对不行。女性一律不得参与军事事务。

source: And the King must not know this tip came from you, else he'll be unlikely to believe it.
target: 而且不能让国王知道这条情报来自你，否则他多半不会相信。

source: ...However, given that you seem to have been particularly interested in this matter lately...
target: ……不过，考虑到你最近似乎格外关心这件事……

source: Perhaps there's a way. Join us outside the King's quarters, and I'll see what we might do.
target: 也许有办法。到国王的寝室外来与我们会合，我看看能做些什么。

source: But with Claudius's death, we've entered a period of ambiguity.
target: 但克劳狄斯死后，我们进入了一段局势不明的时期。

source: No one in the castle has the authority to bring men down upon Fortinbras. It would essentially be an act of war.
target: 城堡里没有人有权派兵对付福丁布拉斯。那实质上就是战争行为。

source: If he's trying to come to our gates, isn't an act of war exactly what we need?
target: 如果他正打算进逼我们的城门，那战争行为不正是我们需要的吗？

source: It's more complicated than that.
target: 事情没那么简单。

source: Regardless, I expect the nobility will come together to vote upon a successor in just a few days. At that time, we'll speak further of pursuing Fortinbras.
target: 无论如何，我预计贵族们过几天就会聚在一起，投票选出继任者。到时候，我们再进一步商议追捕福丁布拉斯的事。

source: (We don't have days. Just hours. But he'd never believe that.)
target: （我们没有几天时间。只有几个小时。可他绝不会相信。）

source: Your Highness, I know for certain that Prince Fortinbras is hiding out in Castle Town as we speak.
target: 殿下，我确切知道，福丁布拉斯王子此刻就藏在城堡镇里。

source: Charming. Are we playing at something?
target: 真有趣。我们这是在玩什么游戏吗？

source: No. This is quite serious. I know it seems sudden, but I also think you might be the one to believe me.
target: 不是。这件事很严重。我知道这听起来很突然，但我也觉得，您也许会相信我。

source: I've seen them with my own eyes. They're in disguise, hiding out near the inn in a small apartment.
target: 我亲眼看见了他们。他们乔装打扮，藏在旅店附近的一间小公寓里。

source: Oh, dear. You are serious.
target: 哎呀。你真是认真的。

source: Why don't you speak about these things with Guard Captain Bernardo? I'm sure Bernardo can allay your concerns.
target: 你何不去和卫队长贝尔纳多谈谈这些事？我相信贝尔纳多能消除你的顾虑。

source: Even if I did believe you, I have no authority to act in these sorts of scenarios. Ansy matter of war rests between my husband, his chief advisor, and his military advisor.
target: 就算我相信你，在这种情况下，我也无权采取行动。所有军事事务都由我的丈夫、他的首席顾问和军事顾问共同处理。

source: His chief advisor was your father. But perhaps Bernardo can still assist.
target: 他的首席顾问曾是你的父亲。但也许贝尔纳多仍能帮上忙。

source: I think either of those latter two could lend you an ear for a moment. I imagine it might help to put your mind at ease.
target: 我想，后面这两位，无论哪一位都可以抽点时间听你说说。我觉得这样也许能让你安心些。

source: Prince Fortinbras is here, in town, hiding out with some of his men. I know you know this, too.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子就在这里，就在镇上，和他的一些手下藏在一起。我知道你也知道这件事。

source: Are you insane?
target: 你疯了吗？

source: I know about all of it. Your father pressured you into this. You didn't want to help him. To help Fortinbras. But you weren't given a choice.
target: 这一切我都知道。是你父亲逼你这么做的。你不想帮他。不想帮福丁布拉斯。可你没有选择。

source: You're going to continue meeting with him until he has all the information he needs to overtake Elsinore. And then, Brit-- then everyone will die.
target: 你会继续和他见面，直到他拿到攻占埃尔西诺所需的全部情报。然后，布莉特——然后所有人都会死。

source: And you don't want that any more than I do. Because despite your tough external demeanor, you actually like some of the people in this castle, don't you?
target: 你和我一样，都不希望发生这种事。因为尽管你表面上很强硬，你其实喜欢这座城堡里的一些人，对不对？

source: Witch. You're a witch. That's the only possible explanation. A nosy, no-good witch.
target: 女巫。你是个女巫。这是唯一可能的解释。一个爱管闲事、可恶的女巫。

source: But, fine. You called my bluff. And you're right about all of it, of course. So what now, witch?
target: 不过，好吧。你识破了我的虚张声势。没错，你说的当然全都对。那么接下来呢，女巫？

source: This meeting you're going to attend with him? It's not going to end the way you think it will. And when the dust settles, Brit, everyone here will die.
target: 你要去和他见面的那场会谈？结果不会像你想的那样。等一切尘埃落定，布莉特，这里的所有人都会死。

source: Soon, Brit, everyone here will die.
target: 布莉特，很快，这里的所有人都会死。

source: What, then? What exactly are the two of us supposed to do?
target: 那怎么办？我们两个到底能做什么？

source: I know that if we work together, we can find a way out of this.
target: 我知道，只要我们联手，就能找到摆脱这困局的办法。

source: We need to make sure Fortinbras is brought safely into Elsinore's custody.
target: 我们得确保福丁布拉斯被安全地带到埃尔西诺羁押。

source: Hah! Any idiot with a little political clout can do that. Try Bernardo, for one. But arresting him won't be the hard part, you know.
target: 哈！随便哪个有点政治权势的蠢货都能办到。比如去找贝尔纳多。但你要知道，逮捕他并不是难处。

source: Let's say Fortinbras is dragged back to Elsinore in chains and thrown into the dungeon. He's got eyes and ears all over the castle.
target: 假设福丁布拉斯被戴上镣铐，拖回埃尔西诺，扔进地牢。这城堡里到处都是他的耳目。

source: Those eyes will watch for any opportune moment-- and then they'll find him and release him back to his men.
target: 那些耳目会盯着一切可乘之机——然后找到他，把他放出来，让他回到自己的手下身边。

source: Any good chess player knows that check is the easy part. But the king can flee. It's checkmate you need to be worried about. Once you have this 'king', how will you keep him?
target: 任何棋艺高明的人都知道，将军很容易。可王还能逃。你需要费心的是将死。等你抓到了这个“王”，你要怎么留住他？

source: Look, Ophelia-- a little free advice between friends...
target: 听着，奥菲莉娅——朋友之间，免费给你一点忠告……

source: You need to control the chaos afterwards. Ensure that nothing goes wrong so that all attention can be focused on keeping ol' Norway Junior under lock and key.
target: 你得控制住之后的混乱。确保什么都不出岔子，这样大家才能把全部注意力都放在关牢那位挪威小少爷上。

source: That's the part neither of us are in a position to control, though. Unless you know something I don't.
target: 可这部分，我们谁都无力掌控。除非你知道什么我不知道的事。

source: (I know a few things, in fact.)
target: （其实，我确实知道一些。）

source: My King, I have proof of Fortinbras's plan to betray Denmark. He's hiding out in Castle Town.
target: 陛下，我有证据证明福丁布拉斯打算背叛丹麦。他正藏在城堡镇里。

source: Wah hah hah. Do tell, Ophelia. What have you dreamed up now?
target: 哇哈哈。快说说，奥菲莉娅。你这回又幻想出了什么？

source: It wasn't a dream. It was real. I saw him and some of his officers. They're all hiding out near the inn, in a small apartment.
target: 那不是梦。那是真的。我看见了他，还有他手下的一些军官。他们全都藏在旅店附近的一间小公寓里。

source: Silence. I tire of this.
target: 闭嘴。我已经听烦了。

source: Go trouble someone else with these assertions.
target: 拿这些说辞去烦别人吧。

source: (He won't even give it a second thought...)
target: （他连多想一下都不肯……）

source: (But someone else might.)
target: （但别人也许会。）

source: Are you being quite serious?
target: 你真是认真的？

source: I wouldn't tell you if I didn't think you'd believe me.
target: 如果我觉得您不会相信我，就不会来告诉您了。

source: Look into my eyes. Do you think I'd deceive you?
target: 看着我的眼睛。您觉得我会骗您吗？

source: Well, love, if it'll put your mind at ease, I'll call a small council.
target: 好吧，亲爱的，如果这样能让你安心，我就召集一场小规模的会议。

source: We can at least investigate the matter, I suppose. It's trivial to do so.
target: 我想，我们至少可以调查一下。这也不费什么事。

source: My father has, in his possession, some notes written by King Hamlet before his death.
target: 我父亲手里有一些哈姆雷特国王生前写的笔记。

source: Do you know how I might be able to read them?
target: 您知道我怎样才能读到它们吗？

source: Notes written by my brother...?
target: 我哥哥写的笔记……？

source: Thank you for alerting me to this, Ophelia. No doubt this is a matter your father and I ought to have settled.
target: 谢谢你告诉我这件事，奥菲莉娅。这无疑是你父亲和我早该处理好的事。

source: If they are possessions of my brother's, they belong with me, to be certain.
target: 如果那是我哥哥的东西，当然该由我保管。

source: Your forthcoming attitude towards this matter is admirable, especially among your own kin.
target: 你愿意坦诚说明这件事，令人赞赏，尤其这还牵涉到你自己的亲人。

source: Sadly, your father's passing has made reconciling this affair rather more difficult.
target: 遗憾的是，你父亲的去世让这件事更难解决了。

source: I cannot interrogate those who are no longer with us.
target: 我无法审问已经不在人世的人。

source: My father has, in his possession, some notes written by King Hamlet before his death. What do you know of them?
target: 我父亲手里有一些哈姆雷特国王生前写的笔记。关于它们，您知道些什么？

source: Notes... written by... my husband Hamlet?
target: 笔记……是……我的丈夫哈姆雷特写的？

source: Yes, my lady.
target: 是的，殿下。

source: Why... wouldn't he have given them to me? How could Polonius have something like that?
target: 为什么……他没有把它们交给我？波洛涅斯怎么会有这样的东西？

source: After my husband's passing, your father was ordered to hand over all such documents to myself and Claudius.
target: 我丈夫去世后，你父亲就奉命将所有这类文件交给我和克劳狄斯。

source: What could they contain?
target: 里面可能写了什么？

source: They must have been stolen. Confidential information withheld from me. Against my direct orders, no less.
target: 它们一定是被偷走的。有人向我隐瞒了机密信息。而且还公然违抗了我的命令。

source: And now he's gone. And I cannot even confront him about it.
target: 如今他已经死了。我甚至无法当面质问他。

source: I've wondered so many times whether my husband might have left any last words for me.
target: 我无数次想过，我丈夫会不会给我留了什么临终的话。

source: Now I'll never know.
target: 现在我永远也不会知道了。

source: Ahh... There's no proof of that yet, my lady.
target: 啊……殿下，现在还没有证据能证明这一点。

source: No. That's the only reason I wouldn't know about these notes, if they exist.
target: 不。如果这些笔记存在，那只能是这个原因，才会让我毫不知情。

source: I'll have his rooms searched immediately.
target: 我会立刻派人搜查他的房间。

source: King Hamlet evidently wrote some notes before his death, which my father now has hidden. What do you know of them?
target: 看来哈姆雷特国王生前写过一些笔记，现在被我父亲藏了起来。关于它们，你知道些什么？

source: It's true. Your father's spirit told me as much.
target: 是真的。你父亲的亡灵就是这么告诉我的。

source: My... father's spirit spoke to you, too? Then I believe it.
target: 我……父亲的亡灵也和你说话了？那我相信。

source: Thankfully, now that Claudius is dead, my father can be at peace.
target: 谢天谢地，既然克劳狄斯已经死了，我父亲也能安息了。

source: I'd like to follow up on his personal writings—next week, perhaps, if I find time.
target: 我想进一步查查他留下的私人文字——也许下周吧，如果我能抽出时间。

source: Perhaps they contain some uncharted wisdom on his own rule.
target: 也许里面有他对自己治国之道的一些心得，还无人知晓。

source: There would be no reason to keep those private, if they existed. Unless...
target: 如果那些笔记存在，就没有理由把它们藏着不让人看。除非……

source: Ophelia... do you think your father might be trying to hide something from me? Something about my father's... death?
target: 奥菲莉娅……你觉得，你父亲是不是想瞒着我什么？关于我父亲……死亡的事？

source: It's possible. But Hamlet, please don't be rash...
target: 有可能。但哈姆雷特，求你别冲动……

source: I think I'd better go see the dear old fool.
target: 我想，我最好去见见那位亲爱的老蠢货。

source: But your father is dead. And of course, all this is to blame for it.
target: 可你父亲已经死了。当然，都是这一切害的。

source: Just one more secret a man took to his grave.
target: 不过又多了一个被人带进坟墓的秘密。

source: Father... I know that you have, in your possession, the journals of King Hamlet. Can I see them?
target: 父亲……我知道哈姆雷特国王的日记在您手里。我能看看吗？

source: I have the—what?
target: 我手里有——什么？

source: How could you know...?
target: 你怎么会知道……？

source: Never mind that. I need to see them, father. Please—it's urgent.
target: 先别管这个。父亲，我必须看看那些日记。求您了——这事很急。

source: They're stored and locked in my personal chest, Ophelia. I find it eerie that you would know of such a thing.
target: 那些日记锁在我的私人箱子里，奥菲莉娅。你竟然知道这件事，实在让我觉得诡异。

source: They've been destroyed. The ashes are still warm, in fact.
target: 那些日记已经毁了。事实上，灰烬都还温着。

source: I saw to it last night that such documents can cause no harm.
target: 昨晚我就处理好了，确保这些文稿不会再造成任何祸害。
