source: I saw to it two nights past that such documents can cause us no harm.
target: 前天晚上我就处理好了，确保这些文稿不会再给我们带来任何祸害。

source: I saw to it three nights past that such documents can cause us no harm.
target: 三天前的晚上我就处理好了，确保这些文稿不会再给我们带来任何祸害。

source: The things they discuss... they could tarnish the reputation of the King forever, brand him a lunatic. I can't have that, not with the court in such a delicate state.
target: 里面写的那些事……可能让国王的名誉永远蒙羞，让他被认定是个疯子。我不能容许这种事，尤其现在宫廷局势如此微妙。

source: (So... I'm too late. He's gone and burned them.)
target: （所以……我来晚了。他已经把那些日记烧了。）

source: (If he burned them Thursday evening... perhaps there's a way I can stop him.)
target: （如果他是在星期四晚上烧的……也许我有办法阻止他。）

source: (I've missed my chance to salvage those notes in this world.)
target: （在这个世界里，我已经错过了保住那些笔记的机会。）

source: I don't know how you learned about them, but they are best left unread, with the court in such a delicate state.
target: 我不知道你是怎么得知那些日记的，但现在宫廷局势如此微妙，最好还是别读。

source: I thought no one but I knew of their existence. If that's not true... then I have some unfinished business to attend to.
target: 我以为除了我，没人知道那些日记的存在。如果并非如此……那我还有些没办完的事要处理。

source: Father, please, don't. Hand them to me.
target: 父亲，求您了，别这样。把它们交给我。

source: Leave me be, now. For your own good.
target: 现在，让我清静清静。这是为你好。

source: I've been told my father might have some notes which were written by the late King Hamlet.
target: 有人告诉我，我父亲手里可能有一些已故哈姆雷特国王写的笔记。

source: Ah, mysteries upon mysteries upon mysteries...
target: 啊，谜团叠着谜团，叠着谜团……

source: I would hate to think of the stir those might raise!
target: 真不敢想那些笔记可能掀起多大的风波！

source: Of course, they might also be soggy love poems. Harmless and simple.
target: 当然，也可能只是些缠绵腻人的情诗。简单又无害。

source: Who knows!
target: 谁知道呢！

source: Of course. You already know what they contain, don't you?
target: 当然了。你已经知道里面写了什么，对吧？

source: Look at you! Spreading dangerous information just to see what happens. There may be hope for you yet.
target: 瞧瞧你！四处散播危险的消息，就为了看看会发生什么。看来你也许还有点希望。

source: We're closing in on the end of the game, now. Just a few more threads to unravel.
target: 现在，这场游戏快要结束了。只剩几条线索还没理清。

source: You say my father has your personal journals. If so, where are they?
target: 您说您的私人日记在我父亲手里。如果是这样，它们在哪儿？

source: There are gaps in my knowledge between my death and my... awakening.
target: 从我死去到我……醒来，这之间的事，有些我并不知晓。

source: I know not where they live now. Only that he has certainly taken them from where they once lay.
target: 我不知道它们如今在何处。只知道他确实把它们从原来的地方拿走了。

source: Your brother was apparently searching for a strange old book before his death. Do you know anything about it?
target: 您的兄长生前似乎在寻找一本奇怪的旧书。您知道这件事吗？

source: Not in the slightest. What sort of a book? My brother always was the learned sort... Myself, I'm partial to the sword.
target: 一无所知。什么样的书？我兄长一向是个好学的人……至于我，我更喜欢刀剑。

source: I'm not certain what it might look like. But he was... obsessed with finding it. Did he ever do anything strange to that extent?
target: 我不确定那本书是什么样的。但他……一心想找到它。他有没有为此做过什么奇怪的事？

source: It's a little brown book with gold trim. He was obsessed with finding it. Did he ever do anything strange to that extent?
target: 那是一本镶着金边的棕色小书。他一心想找到它。他有没有为此做过什么奇怪的事？

source: I see. Yes, there was something like that.
target: 原来如此。是的，确实有过这样的事。

source: In the days leading up to his death, he spent every waking moment in the gallery, poring over every page he could find.
target: 在他去世前的那几天，只要醒着，他就待在长廊里，仔细研读能找到的每一页书。

source: It was as though he was consumed by something. Any time I spoke to him, it was as though he couldn't see me. Or he seemed frustrated that I'd disrupted him.
target: 他仿佛被什么事完全占据了心神。每次我和他说话，他都像是看不见我。又或者显得很烦躁，嫌我打扰了他。

source: I'd encourage you to have a look through the collection, but many of those books are a bit too stimulating for a young woman's mind.
target: 我本想建议你去翻翻那些藏书，但其中许多书对年轻姑娘的心智来说，未免太刺激了。

source: Mind your health first.
target: 先顾好自己的身体。

source: My lady, your late husband was searching for a strange old book before his death. Surely you know of it.
target: 王后，您的亡夫生前在寻找一本奇怪的旧书。您一定知道这件事吧。

source: What sort of book do you mean?
target: 你说的是什么样的书？

source: I'm not certain what it might look like. But he was... obsessed with finding it.
target: 我不确定那本书是什么样的。但他……一心想找到它。

source: It's a little dark book with gold trim. He was obsessed with finding it.
target: 那是一本镶着金边的深色小书。他一心想找到它。

source: I don't know anything about a book in particular, but it's true that in the week before he passed, my husband took frequent trips into town.
target: 具体是哪本书，我一无所知。不过，我丈夫在去世前的那一周，确实经常去镇上。

source: He never did tell me what he was searching for, mind you. But your father always accompanied him, ever faithful.
target: 不过，他从没告诉我，他找的究竟是什么。但你父亲总是陪着他，一如既往地忠诚。

source: I suppose I shall never know what consumed him, rest his soul.
target: 我想，我永远也不会知道是什么让他如此着迷了，愿他的灵魂安息。

source: Much though I might wish I did.
target: 尽管我那么想知道。

source: I've learned that your father may have come across a strange book. Do you know anything about it?
target: 我得知你父亲可能接触过一本奇怪的书。你知道些什么吗？

source: You mean... the one he mentioned in... those notes.
target: 你是说……他在……那些笔记里提到的那本。

source: I don't know. He never told me about anything like that. Or about... anything else he wrote.
target: 我不知道。他从没跟我说过这种事。也没说过……他写下的其他任何事。

source: I want to forget what I saw. But I can't. He was—completely and totally insane.
target: 我想忘掉我看到的东西。但我做不到。他那时——彻彻底底地疯了。

source: And now I'm going to be like that too, aren't I? My father, and me, and my grandmother, too.
target: 现在我也会变成那样，对不对？我父亲，我，还有我的祖母。

source: Astrid. She died long before I was born. But they say insanity runs in our blood. And now I know it must be true.
target: 阿斯特丽德。她在我出生很久以前就去世了。但人们说，疯病在我们家族的血脉里代代相传。现在我知道，这一定是真的。

source: (Hmm. That's a connection worth exploring.)
target: （嗯。这层联系值得查一查。）

source: You mean Astrid.
target: 你说的是阿斯特丽德。

source: Yes. She died long before I was born. But they say that because of her, insanity runs in our blood.
target: 对。她在我出生很久以前就去世了。但人们说，因为她，疯病在我们家族的血脉里代代相传。

source: Perhaps I was doomed a long time ago.
target: 也许我早就注定逃不过了。

source: He loved reading. Do you expect I tracked every tome in his library?
target: 他喜欢读书。难道你以为，他书房里的每一本书我都留意过？

source: No—it wasn't a book he owned. It was something he was searching for. Something special.
target: 不——那不是他已经拥有的书。那是他一直在找的东西。一件特别的东西。

source: What might it look like?
target: 那本书可能是什么样的？

source: I've no idea.
target: 我一点也不知道。

source: Then what can you expect from me? Of course I don't know how to find something with no description.
target: 那你还指望我做什么？连样子都说不出来的东西，我当然不知道该怎么找。

source: It's a little brown book with gold trim.
target: 那是一本镶着金边的棕色小书。

source: There are a hundred books fitting that description in the gallery. I can be of no help with this.
target: 长廊里符合这种描述的书有一百本。这事我帮不上忙。

source: Father, I know the King was searching for a strange book before he died. Do you know where to find it?
target: 父亲，我知道国王生前在寻找一本奇怪的书。您知道去哪儿能找到它吗？

source: How... how did you hear about that?
target: 你……你是怎么听说这件事的？

source: Never mind that. I'd like to find out where that book went. What do you know?
target: 先别管这个。我想查清那本书的下落。您知道些什么？

source: I don't know about any such book, Ophelia. And whatsoever you were told, whenever King Hamlet and I went into town together, I saw nothing of his activities!
target: 我不知道有什么这样的书，奥菲莉娅。而且，不管别人跟你说了什么，每次我和哈姆雷特国王一起去镇上，我都没看见他在做什么！

source: Wait, Father. Into town? What activities can you mean?
target: 等等，父亲。去镇上？您说他在做什么？

source: The King would often ask me to accompany him into town while he spoke to, shall we say, odd acquaintances. But I neither had any direct hand in it, nor overheard a word.
target: 国王经常让我陪他去镇上，他会在那里跟一些……姑且说是古怪的熟人谈话。但我完全没有直接参与，也没听见过半句话。

source: So, perhaps if I were to visit town...
target: 那么，也许我去一趟镇上……

source: Don't even think about it, dearheart. A terrible port town filled with thieves and vagrants. It's not for you.
target: 想都别想，宝贝。那是个糟糕的港口小镇，到处都是小偷和流浪汉。那地方不适合你。

source: Regardless, only the King himself knows what he was searching for in town. So it's lost to time forever, I expect. Better not to dally in it.
target: 无论如何，只有国王自己知道他在镇上找什么。所以我想，这事已经永远无从知晓了。最好别再纠缠。

source: About this cursed book...
target: 关于这本受诅咒的书……

source: Oh, dear, yes. That book is the source of all sorrow, all chaos.
target: 哦，亲爱的，没错。那本书是一切悲伤、一切混乱的源头。

source: And now you're bound to me until you hand it over.
target: 如今你已经和我绑在一起了，直到你把它交出来。

source: You can give it to me any time you like.
target: 你什么时候愿意，什么时候就可以把它给我。

source: I politely decline.
target: 恕我拒绝。

source: But what is it about the book's power that you so desire?
target: 不过，那本书的力量究竟有什么，让你如此渴望？

source: I don't know that I can impart it upon you, really.
target: 说真的，我不确定能不能向你讲明白。

source: It would be like trying to explain the fearsome quality of fire to a dust mote.
target: 那就像试着向一粒微尘解释火焰有多可怕。

source: The only way to do so would be to show you.
target: 唯一的办法，就是让你亲眼看见。

source: Perhaps someday, when you've used the Book's power enough, you'll be ready for me to show you something special.
target: 也许有一天，当你使用这本书的力量足够多次，你就会准备好，让我给你看点特别的东西。

source: But today is not that day.
target: 但那一天还不是今天。

source: I gave you the power to find out for yourself, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我给了你亲自找出答案的力量。

source: Stop being a coward and explore what that power has to offer.
target: 别再当个胆小鬼了，去探索那股力量能带来什么。

source: I had it under my control, once. But it's been lost.
target: 我曾经掌控过它。但它已经遗失了。

source: And so your fate and mine are tied, as well as that miserable spirit's.
target: 所以，你我，还有那个可悲的幽灵，命运都连在了一起。

source: So you know of it? And you never told me?
target: 所以你知道它？却一直没告诉我？

source: Would you have believed me?
target: 告诉你，你会信吗？

source: Likely not.
target: 大概不会。

source: If you find it, bring it to me immediately, lest it cause any more pain and loss.
target: 如果你找到了它，立刻带来给我，免得它再造成更多痛苦和损失。

source: As you've now realized, it's far too dangerous to occupy human hands.
target: 你现在也明白了，它太危险，绝不能留在人类手中。

source: I have every intention of destroying it immediately, as someone ought to have done long ago.
target: 我一心打算立刻毁掉它，早就该有人这么做了。

source: ...You haven't attended my little play about this very matter, have you?
target: ……你还没看过我那出讲的正是这件事的小戏，对吧？

source: Why, I must say, it truly is my magnum opus, if I do say so myself.
target: 哎呀，我得说，容我自夸一句，那真是我的巅峰之作，无疑。

source: Castle Town! Thursday morning! You'll be my guest of honor!
target: 城堡镇！星期四上午！你会是我的贵宾！

source: (That's before he's come to Elsinore. All right, I'll find him then.)
target: （那时他还没来埃尔西诺。好，我就那时候去找他。）

source: I found your notes. They mentioned you were looking for a 'cursed book'.
target: 我找到了您的笔记。里面提到，您在寻找一本“受诅咒的书”。

source: You were... trapped, weren't you? Just like I am now.
target: 您当时……被困住了，对吗？就像现在的我一样。

source: I can feel the cobwebs of my memory being dusted away gently.
target: 我能感觉到，蒙在我记忆上的蛛网正被轻轻拂去。

source: Ah, to be alive, to remember... my utter failure.
target: 啊，活着，记起……我那彻底的失败。

source: That book... I gave up in the end, didn't I? And I let... that cursed thing win, break me down...
target: 那本书……最后我放弃了，对吗？我让……那个该死的东西赢了，让它摧垮了我……

source: You mean the book?
target: 您是说那本书？

source: Please. I know it's confusing, but start at the beginning, if you can. What happened?
target: 求您了。我知道这些事很混乱，但如果可以，请从头说起。发生了什么？

source: Yes. Like you, I was doomed to repeat the occasion of my death. Hundreds of times. Thousands.
target: 是的。和你一样，我注定要一次次重历自己的死亡。几百次。几千次。

source: And like you, the timeline of my death was no more than a week. My son Hamlet was away at Wittenberg, my brother Claudius plotting to take my throne.
target: 也和你一样，我所经历的通往死亡的那段时间，不超过一周。我的儿子哈姆雷特远在威登堡，我的弟弟克劳狄斯正密谋夺取我的王位。

source: How long was I trapped in that insane void between life and death? Centuries? Millennia? I know not...
target: 我在那片生死之间的疯狂虚空里困了多久？几百年？几千年？我不知道……

source: It was peaceful to forget for a while, but even now, I cannot be truly dead. No, here I am, still animated, grimacing, like a starved dog brought back to life, forced to bare my teeth...
target: 暂时遗忘曾让我得到片刻安宁，可即使到了现在，我也无法真正死去。不，我还在这里，仍能活动，面目扭曲，像一条饿死后又被复活的狗，被迫龇出牙齿……

source: I cannot truly rest until my brother pays for his crime, the crime I spent a thousand years trying to avoid!
target: 我的弟弟不为他的罪行付出代价，我就无法真正安息——那是我花了一千年试图避开的罪行！

source: Why were you looking for the book? What did you expect to find?
target: 您为什么要找那本书？您希望找到什么？

source: A way out!
target: 一条出路！

source: A choice between versions of a private hell!
target: 能在只属于我的地狱的不同版本之间，做一次选择！

source: But I was not permitted that much! No, I had to give up! I lay there in the garden, being poisoned by my own brother over and over again, for years before I was freed!
target: 可连这点选择都不被允许！不，我只能放弃！我躺在花园里，一次又一次被自己的亲弟弟毒死，就这样过了许多年才获释！

source: I scoured every inch of the castle, every nook and flagstone and drawer—it isn't here, Ophelia! It simply isn't!
target: 我搜遍了城堡的每一寸地方，每个角落、每块石板、每个抽屉——它不在这里，奥菲莉娅！就是不在！

source: Why did I have to give up, to expire into madness alone?
target: 为什么我只能放弃，孤身在疯狂中死去？

source: I'm sorry, King Hamlet. I wish I could have found the book long ago, for your sake.
target: 对不起，哈姆雷特国王。我真希望自己能早早找到那本书，帮到您。

source: (But now that I have it, I have to decide what to do with it.)
target: （但现在它在我手里了，我必须决定怎么处置它。）

source: (...And figure out what to do about Quince.)
target: （……还得想好该拿奎因斯怎么办。）

source: Ophelia! Find the book! Find the book and save your own soul!
target: 奥菲莉娅！找到那本书！找到那本书，拯救你自己的灵魂！

source: I know about Simona. I know she hid it intentionally, took it with her.
target: 我知道西蒙娜的事。我知道她故意藏起了它，把它带走了。

source: You know that name? How? How can you know?
target: 你知道那个名字？怎么知道的？你怎么会知道？

source: ...I'm going to put you to rest, King Hamlet. I've decided.
target: ……我会让您安息，哈姆雷特国王。我已经决定了。

source: I'll find her and get the book from her. I'll end this for both of us. I swear.
target: 我会找到她，从她手里拿到那本书。我会为我们两个人结束这一切。我发誓。

source: It is eternally more worthwhile to fight than to give up as I did, Ophelia. Never forget that. For you, hope lingers.
target: 奥菲莉娅，抗争永远比像我这样放弃更有意义。永远别忘记这一点。你仍有希望。

source: I believe that you will live to see winter come to Denmark—putting an end to this cursed summer.
target: 我相信你会活着看到冬天降临丹麦——为这个受诅咒的夏天画上句号。

source: (So much is riding on me now.)
target: （现在，有太多事都系在我身上了。）

source: (I've got to find a way to get that damned book.)
target: （我一定得想办法拿到那本该死的书。）

source: I'm doing my best, but I don't know where to begin looking.
target: 我已经尽力了，但我不知道该从哪里找起。

source: Perhaps it is too late, after all.
target: 也许终究还是太晚了。

source: Insanity—death—they have always plagued our family. My mother Astrid was no exception.
target: 疯狂——死亡——它们一直纠缠着我们的家族。我的母亲阿斯特丽德也不例外。

source: I often wonder if she died like me, if she saw time repeating itself. I cannot bear to think of her suffering the same pain I did.
target: 我常常想，她是否也像我这样死去，是否也曾看见时间一再重复。我不忍想象她也遭受了和我一样的痛苦。

source: If she was, do you think she might have had something to do with this book's disappearance?
target: 如果她确实如此，您觉得这本书的失踪会不会和她有关？

source: If it's the only thing which can break us free—then mightn't she have found it?
target: 如果这是唯一能让我们脱身的东西——那她有没有可能已经找到它了？

source: Impossible to tell. My mother is long dead.
target: 无从知晓。我的母亲早已去世。

source: ...I'll bet someone in this castle knows something.
target: ……我敢说，这座城堡里一定有人知道些什么。

source: Farewell, King Hamlet. I'll find that book. At the very least, I have a theory on where to begin.
target: 告辞了，哈姆雷特国王。我会找到那本书的。至少，我已经有了从哪里找起的想法。

source: Yes. The Book of Fates. I remember our discussion.
target: 是的。《命运之书》。我记得我们谈过。

source: I've found it. The only question is what to do with it.
target: 我已经找到它了。现在唯一的问题是，该拿它怎么办。

source: Is there some unfinished buisness holding you back from making a choice?
target: 是还有什么未了的事，让你无法作出选择吗？

source: Do not turn away from this oppertunity, Ophelia.
target: 不要放弃这个机会，奥菲莉娅。

source: My best lead is that Simona is still alive. She's the last person who had the book.
target: 我目前最有希望的线索是，西蒙娜还活着。她是最后一个持有那本书的人。

source: I'm doing my best to find it, but I don't know where to begin looking.
target: 我正在尽力找它，却不知道该从哪里找起。

source: If only Astrid was still alive, or haunted these walls as I, we could ask her.
target: 要是阿斯特丽德还活着，或是像我一样在这座城堡里游荡，我们就能问问她了。

source: Someone has to know something. I'll keep looking.
target: 总会有人知道些什么。我会继续找。

source: What do you know of a strange, cursed book?
target: 关于一本古怪、受诅咒的书，你知道些什么？

source: A... cursed... book?
target: 一本……受诅咒的……书？

source: My apologies, my dear girl. You must have me mistaken for someone else.
target: 抱歉，亲爱的姑娘。你一定是把我认成别人了。

source: I bring quilts, clothing for babes. I am merely an old woman who wishes to love God and enjoy the joyful silence of a life well lived.
target: 我带来的是被子和婴儿衣服。我只是个老太婆，只想敬爱上帝，享受这一生过得充实所带来的欢喜与安宁。

source: I know nothing of any sort of books. Never had a mind for them.
target: 什么书我都不懂。我从来就不是读书的料。

source: (She's acting so peculiarly.)
target: （她的举止真奇怪。）

source: My King, I have reason to believe Lady Simona is alive. What do you know of her?
target: 陛下，我有理由相信西蒙娜女士还活着。关于她，您知道些什么？

source: I haven't heard that name in...
target: 我已经很久没听到这个名字了……

source: How? Can that be... possible?
target: 怎么会？这……可能吗？

source: No... certainly not.
target: 不……绝不可能。

source: She may be living nearby, in town. Again I ask, what do you know of her?
target: 她可能就住在附近的镇上。我再问一次，关于她，您知道些什么？

source: She was my father's consort. All knew of her presence. She was there when my mother died.
target: 她曾是我父亲的伴侣。所有人都知道她的存在。我母亲去世时，她也在那里。

source: I never asked my father about her... it simply isn't done. But... I assumed... she had passed, too.
target: 我从没向父亲问起过她……这种事不合规矩。不过……我以为……她也已经去世了。

source: Thank you for this information, Ophelia. I'll consider it further.
target: 谢谢你告诉我这些，奥菲莉娅。我会再想想这件事。

source: My Queen, I have reason to believe Lady Simona is alive.
target: 王后陛下，我有理由相信西蒙娜女士还活着。

source: Alexander's woman? But she passed away years ago.
target: 亚历山大的那个女人？可她多年前就去世了。

source: A-at least, I'd presumed as much... I wasn't living at Elsinore then. I was still in Bohemia.
target: 至、至少，我一直是这么以为的……那时候我还没住在埃尔西诺，还在波希米亚。

source: I'm afraid I don't know much about her. But even if she were alive, she'd be a very old woman by now.
target: 恐怕我对她了解不多。不过，就算她还活着，如今也已经很老了。

source: Father, I have reason to believe Lady Simona is alive.
target: 父亲，我有理由相信西蒙娜女士还活着。

source: Lady Simona? Goodness, where did you hear that name?
target: 西蒙娜？女士？天哪，你从哪里听到这个名字的？

source: No, my dear, I'm afraid not. She's buried in the graveyard. I recall that much at least. Her grave is there, if you'd like to visit.
target: 不，亲爱的，恐怕不是这样。她就葬在墓地里。至少这点我还记得。她的墓就在那里，你想去看看也可以。

source: Irma, do you think Lady Simona is alive? I have reason to believe she is.
target: 伊尔玛，你觉得西蒙娜女士还活着吗？我有理由相信她还活着。

source: Simona? I've scarcely heard that name. You do mean the Lady Simona?
target: 西蒙娜？这个名字我没怎么听人提过。你说的是那位西蒙娜女士？

source: The same one.
target: 就是她。

source: I never crossed paths with the woman. Gerta and I came to Elsinore after she had already perished.
target: 我从没见过那个女人。格尔塔和我来到埃尔西诺时，她已经死了。

source: There's a grave for her in the yard. You believe it to be empty?
target: 墓地里有她的坟墓。你觉得里面是空的？

source: Then this is a thread which presents too much danger for an old woman like me to be interested in pulling it.
target: 那这条线索追查起来就太危险了，我这样的老太婆可没兴趣碰。

source: Me, I stick to my drink and my cards and my cuisine, thank you!
target: 我嘛，还是喝我的酒、打我的牌、做我的菜吧，多谢了！

source: Hamlet, I have reason to believe Lady Simona, your grandfather's consort, is alive.
target: 哈姆雷特，我有理由相信，你祖父的伴侣西蒙娜女士还活着。

source: What do I care of old women and older men? Naught but bones now.
target: 老太婆和更老的男人，与我何干？如今都不过是枯骨罢了。

source: But... if she left the castle, aren't you concerned about why? Where did she go? And why won't anyone speak of her?
target: 可是……如果她离开了城堡，你就不关心她为什么离开吗？她去了哪里？又为什么谁都不肯提她？

source: I've never concerned myself with it. I observed my father and Claudius to be discomfited by her name as a boy.
target: 我从没关心过这件事。小时候，我注意到父亲和克劳狄斯一听到她的名字就会不自在。

source: There's a grave for her in the graveyard. But of course, it's fake.
target: 墓地里有她的坟墓。不过，那当然是假的。

source: It's... fake?
target: 是……假的？

source: One of the gravekeepers told me, when I grew a little older. They'd buried an empty coffin.
target: 我稍大些以后，一位守墓人告诉了我。他们埋下的是一口空棺材。

source: Wherever Simona's flown, it's somewhere far away...
target: 不管西蒙娜远走去了哪里，那地方一定很远……

source: I have reason to believe Lady Simona, Alexander's consort, still lives.
target: 我有理由相信，亚历山大的伴侣西蒙娜女士还活着。

source: I'm quite familiar with her, yes.
target: 是啊，我对她相当熟悉。

source: An obnoxious woman, isn't she?
target: 真是个讨厌的女人，不是吗？

source: I'll have to find a nice death for her, in time.
target: 迟早，我得替她找个美妙的死法。

source: Yes, something wonderful to repay her kindness in keeping my book from me for so long!
target: 没错，得找个绝妙的办法，报答她让我这么久都拿不回自己的书的好意！

source: Perhaps I'll go and pluck her eyes out with my fingers. Or saw out her tongue with a shard of glass!
target: 也许我会去用手指挖出她的眼睛。或者用玻璃碎片锯掉她的舌头！

source: You know, I've spent entire game matches doing nothing but dismembering my opponent.
target: 你知道吗，我曾有过整场游戏什么都不做，只管肢解对手的时候。

source: I remember a particular young man whom Zeus asked me to punish for stealing a flame...
target: 我记得有个年轻人，宙斯让我惩罚他，因为他偷了火种……

source: Yes, I took out his liver each morning, and it grew back each night!
target: 没错，我每天早晨掏出他的肝脏，每天夜里它又会长回来！

source: They say Hercules freed him, but that's a hopeful lie. He died in utmost agony.
target: 人们说赫拉克勒斯救了他，可那只是寄托希望的谎言。他是在极度痛苦中死去的。

source: Quite a lively performer, that one. Most excellent outlook. Disappointed me greatly, in the end.
target: 那一位，表演起来可真有活力。前景极佳。可到头来，还是让我大失所望。

source: I'm afraid she's long gone from this game board.
target: 恐怕她早就离开这块棋盘了。

source: She exists outside of my reach. Not even I could find her now.
target: 她所在之处，我触及不到。如今连我也找不到她。

source: Ah, but as to whether she's alive...
target: 啊，不过，要说她是否还活着……

source: I'm certain the answer is yes. Please do let me know if you find her.
target: 我确信她还活着。如果你找到她，请务必告诉我。

source: Your father's consort is still alive, but not in Elsinore. What became of her?
target: 您父亲的伴侣还活着，但不在埃尔西诺。她后来怎么样了？

source: It wasn't spoken of in my lifetime.
target: 我生前，没人谈起这件事。

source: Even Claudius and I have never passed her name between us. She... my mother...
target: 就连克劳狄斯和我也从未向彼此提过她的名字。她……我的母亲……

source: Terrible, bloody deeds were committed. My father was a cruel and greedy man.
target: 当年发生过可怕的血腥恶行。我的父亲是个残忍又贪婪的人。

source: I do not know her whereabouts, but if she left Elsinore, she must have passed through town.
target: 我不知道她的下落，但如果她离开了埃尔西诺，就一定经过了镇子。

source: <i>But I am confined to these walls. I may not leave the board's edges.
target: <i>可我被困在这城墙之内，无法越过棋盘的边界。

source: I know who you are. You're Lady Simona.
target: 我知道您是谁。您是西蒙娜女士。

source: No one's ever called me a lady, lass...
target: 姑娘，从来没人称我为女士……

source: But you are. You're King Alexander's former consort. I'm Ophelia. You knew my mother, Elise, didn't you?
target: 可您就是。您曾是亚历山大国王的伴侣。我是奥菲莉娅。您认识我的母亲伊莉丝，对吗？

source: You're the exact image of her.
target: 你和她长得一模一样。

source: But Lady Simona died a long time ago. You're too late.
target: 可西蒙娜女士早就死了。你来得太晚了。

source: She wanted nothing to do with that cursed, vile castle or any of the evil people dwelling within it.
target: 她不想再跟那座受诅咒的、肮脏的城堡，以及住在里面的任何恶人有半点瓜葛。

source: And I still don't. Good day to ye, lady. May no harm come to you.
target: 我现在也不想。告辞了，女士。愿你平安无事。

source: Or do you have some business with me I should be aware of?
target: 还是说，你找我有什么事，是我该知道的？

source: I... found my mother's diary. It spoke of you. I know about your time in the castle. And I think you found something, didn't you?
target: 我……找到了母亲的日记。里面提到了您。我知道您在城堡里的那段经历。而且，我想您找到过什么东西，对吗？

source: You still have that cursed book within your possession.
target: 那本受诅咒的书还在您手里。

source: I would assume you were mad, but I know your mother's face well. You have so much of Elise in you.
target: 本来我会以为你疯了，但我很熟悉你母亲的面容。你身上有太多伊莉丝的影子。

source: Not any longer. It wandered off from my personal items three days ago.
target: 已经不在了。三天前，它从我的私人物品里溜走了。

source: It has gone on to ruin some other poor soul's life.
target: 它又去毁掉另一个可怜人的一生了。

source: (I see. She doesn't have it any longer because it's sitting in my bedroom.)
target: （原来如此。它已经不在她手里，因为它就在我的卧室里。）

source: (So this, too, is an item that exists outside the timeline.)
target: （所以，这也是一件存在于时间线之外的物品。）

source: Do you know the power vested within this book?
target: 你知道这本书蕴藏着什么力量吗？

source: It's... just a blank book.
target: 它……只是一本空白的书。

source: Its pages are not blank for me.
target: 这本书的书页在我眼里并不是空白的。

source: It contains the many thousands of fragments of worlds I have seen. Of futures that never came to pass. Of pasts that never were.
target: 里面有我见过的成千上万个世界的碎片。有从未实现的未来，也有从未存在过的过去。

source: I know precisely what you mean, and I'm here to put an end to it.
target: 我完全明白您的意思，我就是来结束这一切的。

source: I need the Book to prevent time from repeating itself.
target: 我需要这本书来阻止时间不断重复。

source: My child, I am afraid you have been lied to.
target: 孩子，恐怕你被骗了。

source: The one causing your world to repeat isn't the Book of Fates. It's Peter Quince.
target: 让你的世界不断重复的，不是《命运之书》，而是彼得·奎因斯。

source: No. that can't be true. Quince is the one who asked me to find the Book. He helped me find you. Why would he do that?
target: 不。这不可能是真的。是奎因斯让我去找这本书的。他还帮我找到了您。他为什么要这么做？

source: That vile man... when I heard rumors that King Hamlet was searching for a particular book, I suspected Quince was behind it.
target: 那个卑鄙的男人……当我听到传闻，说哈姆雷特国王正在寻找某本书时，就怀疑是奎因斯在背后操纵。

source: He knows I am weak. Though I will never return the Book to him, I may give it to another one of his poor victims.
target: 他知道我心软。虽然我绝不会把书还给他，却可能把它交给另一个被他害了的可怜人。

source: His 'victims?' What are you saying?
target: 被他“害了”？您这是什么意思？

source: I've never told this story before. It is the story of my greatest sin.
target: 我从来没讲过这个故事。它讲的是我犯下的最深重的罪。

source: Many years ago, I was fated to die by Queen Astrid's hand.
target: 很多年前，我命中注定要死在阿斯特丽德王后手里。

source: She resented my relationship with her husband. She wanted me dead.
target: 她痛恨我和她丈夫的关系。她想让我死。

source: One night, while sleeping, I felt someone slit my throat in the darkness. I bled to death there, in my bed. It should have been the end. But it wasn't.
target: 一天夜里，我正在睡觉，感觉到有人在黑暗中割开了我的喉咙。我就在那里，在自己的床上失血而死。本该就此结束。可并没有。

source: Because I woke up. And I was alive once more.
target: 因为我醒了过来。我又活了。

source: Quince found me shortly afterwards. He seemed to know everything about my circumstances immediately. I grew comfortable speaking with him.
target: 不久之后，奎因斯找到了我。他似乎一开始就对我的处境了如指掌。渐渐地，我和他说话时也自在起来了。

source: This sounds painfully familiar.
target: 这听起来熟悉得让人难受。

source: And then he proposed a game of sorts.
target: 然后，他提出玩一场类似游戏的东西。

source: He offered me the Book and promised me that if I used it, I could change fate, like a god. In return, he offered to make time repeat, giving me infinite opportunity.
target: 他把书交给我，并向我保证，只要使用它，我就能像神一样改变命运。作为交换，他提出让时间重复，给我无限的机会。

source: He made just one thing clear: the Book was his, and his alone. Once I had gotten my revenge and used it, it would return to his hands.
target: 他只把一件事说得很清楚：那本书属于他，只属于他。等我用它报了仇，它就得回到他手里。

source: And so I explored every alley, every pathway of my world. He followed me eagerly, curious to observe every choice I made.
target: 于是，我探索了我的世界里的每一条小巷、每一条道路。他热切地跟着我，好奇地观察我作出的每一个选择。

source: I could have kept the both of us alive, Astrid and me. But I didn't. I was a woman spurned, and I was out for blood and the crown.
target: 我本可以让我们两个都活下来，阿斯特丽德和我。可我没有。我是个遭人弃绝的女人，我要见血，还要王冠。

source: Instead, I used the Book of Fates to have her driven mad. I wanted to be Queen. You know the story.
target: 我反而用《命运之书》逼疯了她。我想当王后。这个故事你是知道的。

source: And Quince helped me bring that world about. I saw how he took such glee in the horrific weeks which followed. My life became a living hell, one I'd created for myself.
target: 奎因斯帮我把那个世界变成了现实。在随后那几个恐怖的星期里，我看见他是多么欢喜。我的生活变成了人间地狱，一个我亲手为自己造出的地狱。

source: Ophelia, have you noticed that this world spins ever constantly towards disaster?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你有没有发现，这个世界总是在不断走向灾难？

source: I'd never known my family and friends to be capable of violence like this.
target: 我从不知道，我的亲人和朋友竟能做出这样暴力的事。

source: Surely you aren't saying that Quince is the one who makes them act this way?
target: 您该不会是说，是奎因斯让他们这么做的吧？

source: No. Their demons are truly theirs. But he has some ability to impose his will upon the world, to influence it. I'm certain you've witnessed it. And he enjoys that power.
target: 不。他们心中的恶确实属于他们自己。但他有某种能力，能把自己的意志强加给这个世界，影响它。我确信你见识过。而且他享受这种力量。

source: That disgusted me. I realized I had been used for his pleasure, that I had sold my friends and family for the sake of the power he'd offered me.
target: 这让我恶心。我意识到，他利用我来取乐，而我为了他给我的力量，出卖了自己的亲人和朋友。

source: The morning after Quince freed me from my game with him, I chose a new path.
target: 奎因斯让我脱离与他的那场游戏后的第二天早晨，我选择了一条新的路。

source: I knew I had to convince him to give me the book once more. In the end, it wasn't hard. He is an artist, and all artists can be played through their vanity.
target: 我知道，我必须说服他再把书交给我。结果并不难。他是个艺术家，而所有艺术家都能被人利用虚荣心来摆布。

source: I told him I wanted to learn from the Book, to learn to be like him. He indulged me by granting it to me once more-- of course he did.
target: 我告诉他，我想从书中学习，学着成为他那样的人。他满足了我的心愿，又把书交给了我——他当然会这么做。

source: And I ran for my life. I fled, and I hid. And the years passed in that silence.
target: 然后，我拼命逃走了。我逃了，藏了起来。岁月就在那片寂静中流逝。

source: And Quince never came for you?
target: 奎因斯从没来找过您？

source: He knew I wouldn't grant the Book to him. But he well knows I shall give it to you now.
target: 他知道我不会把书交给他。可他也清楚，我现在会把它交给你。

source: What? If what you say is true, why would I ever want it?
target: 什么？如果您说的是真的，我为什么还会想要它？

source: Because he will never let you leave your repeating world and die in peace. Not until you've used its powers, and it has returned to his hand. He made that mistake with me.
target: 因为他绝不会让你离开这个不断重复的世界，安然死去。除非你用了书的力量，让它回到他手里。他在我身上犯过这个错。

source: I hoped that when I died, the Book's power would simply die with me. But he knows me well. And he knows I would never allow Elise's daughter to suffer in infinite hell.
target: 我原本希望，我死后，这本书的力量也会随我一同消亡。可他太了解我了。他知道，我绝不会让伊莉丝的女儿在无尽的地狱里受苦。

source: He knows I loved your mother like my own flesh and blood. Very well, then. May this be my final gift to her.
target: 他知道，我爱你的母亲，就像爱自己的骨肉一样。那好吧。愿这是我送给她的最后一份礼物。

source: If you don't make the Book's power your own, the only world available to you will be whichever future Quince makes for you.
target: 如果你不把书的力量掌握在自己手里，你就只能活在奎因斯替你安排的某个未来里。

source: So... if I use this Book, I can determine the fate of this world?
target: 所以……只要我使用这本书，就能决定这个世界的命运？

source: To an extent. People are people. You cannot create a fate which is impossible for broken people to achieve.
target: 在一定程度上可以。人终究是人。你无法创造出一种命运，让内心破碎的人做到他们不可能做到的事。

source: But there is no turning back. Once you use the Book of Fates, the clock on Elsinore advances forever.
target: 但已经没有回头路了。一旦你使用命运之书，埃尔西诺的时间就会永远向前流逝。

source: I can hardly believe this is true. Magic books? Godlike powers? What does any of it matter?
target: 我简直不敢相信这是真的。魔法书？神一般的力量？这些又有什么意义？

source: I just wanted to find a way to save them all-- and myself.
target: 我只是想找到办法，救下他们所有人——还有我自己。

source: A perfect world is a notion held only by children and fools. And Ophelia, you are neither.
target: 只有孩子和傻瓜才会幻想完美的世界。而奥菲莉娅，你两者都不是。

source: Here. This cursed thing is yours now. May you use it and find peace.
target: 拿着。这件受诅咒的东西现在归你了。愿你借它找到安宁。

source: I have reason to believe Lady Simona is alive. Do you know anything about that name?
target: 我有理由相信西蒙娜女士还活着。这个名字，你知道些什么吗？

source: A Lady Simona? Can't say I do. There's an old hag by that name, comes 'round every week on Sundays. Pious, quiet woman.
target: 西蒙娜女士？那我可不认识。有个叫这名字的老太婆，每个星期天都会过来。人很虔诚，也很安静。

source: She ought to be coming by this Sunday, in fact, later in the day. But she's no 'lady'. Couldn't imagine she'd be the woman you're searching for.
target: 其实，她这周日应该也会来，晚些时候。不过她可不是什么“女士”。我想她不会是你要找的那个人。

source: Irma thinks you need a firm hand to set you straight.
target: 伊尔玛觉得得有人严加管教，你才能走回正道。

source: After all the grief I've given her lately, I cannot place blame with her.
target: 最近我给她添了那么多烦恼，也不能怪她这么想。

source: All I can do is work harder to show everyone the man I wish to become.
target: 我能做的，只有更加努力，让大家看见我想成为怎样的人。

source: Hmph. Is that so?
target: 哼。是吗？

source: Well. I've a few choice words for that old maid Irma.
target: 好啊。我倒有几句难听话，要送给伊尔玛那个老姑娘。

source: I'll find her on my own time, yes, on my own time...
target: 我会挑自己方便的时候去找她，没错，自己方便的时候……

source: Irma thinks Hamlet needs a 'firm hand' to set him straight.
target: 伊尔玛觉得哈姆雷特需要有人“严加管教”，才能走回正道。

source: I think Hamlet is his best self when he does that on his own.
target: 我觉得，哈姆雷特自己走回正道时，才能展现出最好的自己。

source: And now that he's to be King, I have faith he will.
target: 如今他就要成为国王了，我相信他会做到。

source: Not unless she wants to get a firm hand right back.
target: 除非她想反过来被他狠狠管教一番。

source: I don't think others understand the way a mind like his works. Not truly.
target: 我觉得别人并不明白他那样的人是怎么想的。并不真正明白。

source: When someone is in the grip of such a despair, such a continual darkness... you cannot shake them from it by force.
target: 一个人陷在那样的绝望里，被无尽的黑暗笼罩……靠强迫，是没法让他摆脱这一切的。

source: Only love can dispel such a thing. And even then, it may take many years. Or he may never change at all.
target: 只有爱能驱散这一切。即便如此，也可能需要很多年。也可能他永远都不会改变。

source: Maybe. Something's changed in him as of late. He returned my lute, and...
target: 也许吧。他最近有些不一样了。他把我的鲁特琴还给了我，而且……

source: Ophelia, do you think perhaps I've gotten Hamlet all wrong?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你觉得我是不是一直都误解了哈姆雷特？

source: I'm starting to believe that things can be different between us.
target: 我开始相信，我们之间也许可以有所改变。

source: Now that he's to be King, I don't know who would apply that hand to him.
target: 如今他就要当国王了，我不知道还有谁能严加管教他。

source: Several firm hands, more like. And a swift kick in the rear for additional security.
target: 依我看，得狠狠教训他好几回。再朝他屁股上踹一脚，才更保险。

source: So, Hamlet needs a firm hand?
target: 所以，哈姆雷特需要有人严加管教？

source: He did. But now the boy is to rule. And I see some small thing is changed in him.
target: 以前是。但如今这孩子就要执掌王权了。而且我看得出，他有了些许变化。

source: I once thought that boy could be King, before his father passed. And now I see it in him once more.
target: 在他父亲去世之前，我曾觉得这孩子能当国王。如今，我又从他身上看到了那份潜质。

source: The seasons turn... and a youth becomes a man. So it goes.
target: 四季轮转……少年也长成了男人。世事就是如此。

source: Provided Hamlet treats me with dignity, I may bury my hatchet.
target: 只要哈姆雷特尊重我，我也许会放下旧怨。

source: Truly, he's incorrigible. The boy must be stopped...
target: 他真是无可救药。必须阻止这孩子……

source: If not by me or my lady, then... who?
target: 要是我和我家夫人都不出手，那……还有谁？

source: (And... that vial of poison shall lead the charge.)
target: （而……那瓶毒药将打头阵。）

source: (I knew it would prove itself useful.)
target: （我早就知道它能派上用场。）

source: Irma thinks that Hamlet could use a firm hand to set him straight.
target: 伊尔玛觉得，严加管教能让哈姆雷特走回正道。

source: Oh, Irma. That's her way, I suppose.
target: 唉，伊尔玛。我想，她就是这样。

source: Well. I should know her well enough. She did partially raise me, after all.
target: 嗯。我应该足够了解她才是。毕竟，我长大也有她的一份功劳。

source: I wouldn't mind her. My son will soon go through a time of great change.
target: 不用在意她的话。我儿子很快就会经历一场巨大的变化。

source: He hasn't had to rule before, Ophelia. He doesn't know how it alters you, moves through you.
target: 奥菲莉娅，他以前从未执掌过王权。他不知道这会如何改变一个人，如何影响人的内心。

source: Already I see something great changing within him.
target: 我已经看到，他的内心正在发生重大的变化。

source: Irma said that...?
target: 伊尔玛这么说了……？

source: I'll speak with her further. Thank you for telling me, Ophelia.
target: 我会再找她谈谈。谢谢你告诉我，奥菲莉娅。

source: Irma thinks that Hamlet needs a good beating to set him straight.
target: 伊尔玛觉得哈姆雷特得挨一顿狠揍，才能走回正道。

source: I'm at a loss for what to do with the boy, truly.
target: 我真不知道该拿这孩子怎么办。

source: I ought to show him a thing or two about how my father, his grandfather, tolerated a poor mood...
target: 我该让他见识见识，我父亲，也就是他祖父，是怎么对待闹脾气的人的……

source: It involved the butt of a blade or the flat of his hand more often than not.
target: 多半是拿剑柄打，或是直接扇一巴掌。

source: I know that your brother murdered you by pouring poison in your ear.
target: 我知道你弟弟把毒药倒进你耳朵里，害死了你。

source: Then you know only one small piece of it.
target: 那你知道的，也只是其中很小的一部分。

source: I have suffered far more than anyone, even you, can understand.
target: 我所受的苦，远远超出了任何人所能理解的程度，连你也不例外。

source: Perhaps one year, one century from now—then you may come to comprehend.
target: 也许再过一年，或一个世纪——到那时，你才可能明白。

source: Do you know anything about the strange vision I've been having? The one where all the castle dies?
target: 我一直看到的那些奇怪幻象，你知道些什么吗？就是城堡里所有人都死去的那个？

source: You should know by now. Those are the events that were meant to come to pass.
target: 你现在应该明白了。那都是命中注定要发生的事。

source: That is the tragic fate which is written before you. For mine own self, it was my poisoning.
target: 那就是早已为你写下的悲惨命运。对我而言，则是被毒杀。

source: To think you can find a future where that does not happen is futile. Give up the sooner and you will drift into endless sleep.
target: 想找到一个能避开这一切的未来，只是徒劳。早些放弃，你便能渐渐沉入无尽的长眠。

source: I've never heard anything about Queen Astrid, King Hamlet's mother. What do you know?
target: 我从没听人说起过哈姆雷特国王的母亲，阿斯特丽德王后。你知道些什么？

source: Ahh, poor Astrid... She died young. I was in 'er service at the time.
target: 唉，可怜的阿斯特丽德……她年纪轻轻就死了。那时我还在为她效力。

source: Yeh know, she died in childbirth, but there were always those nasty lingering rumors...
target: 你知道，她是在分娩时死的，可那些难听的传闻一直没消停……

source: Rumors of her death?
target: 关于她死因的传闻？

source: King Alexander wouldn't let anyone see the body, not even us guards, or the priest who'd bury her.
target: 亚历山大国王不让任何人看她的遗体，连我们这些卫兵，还有要为她下葬的神父都不行。

source: I'm sure 'e had his reasons, and grief is strange, but... there's always questions left over...
target: 我相信他有他的理由，人悲伤起来也会有些古怪，可……总还是留下了些疑问……

source: An' that mistress of his sure was beautiful. Simona, I think her name was.
target: 还有，他那个情妇可真漂亮。我记得她好像叫西蒙娜。

source: Oh, look at me, prattlin' on about bones and dust. Excuse me, my lady!
target: 哎，瞧我，净在这儿絮叨些陈年旧事。请原谅我，小姐！

source: Very little, I'm afraid. Her reign was before my time. Your father and Marcellus were both in service during those years. Perhaps they'd know more.
target: 恐怕知道得很少。她当王后时，我还没来。你父亲和马塞勒斯那几年都已经在效力了。也许他们知道得更多。

source: Your mother, Queen Astrid... I don't know anything about her. What was she like?
target: 您的母亲，阿斯特丽德王后……我对她一无所知。她是个怎样的人？

source: Ah... I haven't heard that name in quite some years.
target: 啊……我已经好多年没听到这个名字了。

source: She passed when I was but a boy, and my brother little less than. I never knew her well.
target: 她去世时，我还只是个孩子，我哥哥也大不了多少。我从未真正了解过她。

source: When we were young, courtiers often praised my brother Hamlet for how strongly he resembled our mother, with her fair features. I've never spoken to him about her death.
target: 我们小时候，廷臣常常称赞我哥哥哈姆雷特，说他长得特别像母亲，继承了她俊美的容貌。我从没和他谈过她的死。

source: My father loved her deeply, in the time they were wedded. Then he, too, died, and it was just my brother Hamlet and I, stuck with one another.
target: 他们婚姻存续期间，我父亲深爱着她。后来他也死了，就只剩下我和哥哥哈姆雷特，不得不与彼此相伴。

source: Your father served Astrid greatly, as with my father. Now he provides me with his service. A family legacy, of sorts.
target: 你父亲为阿斯特丽德尽心效力，也同样为我父亲效力。如今，他又为我效力。也算是一种家族传承吧。

source: Brit. What do you know of King Hamlet's mother, Queen Astrid?
target: 布莉特。关于哈姆雷特国王的母亲，阿斯特丽德王后，你知道些什么？

source: Astrid? That's awfully specific. Who wants to know?
target: 阿斯特丽德？你问得可真具体。谁想知道？

source: Just me. Sheer curiosity.
target: 只有我。纯粹是好奇。

source: My grandmother knew her well. She attended court when Astrid was growing up. They were about the same age.
target: 我祖母和她很熟。阿斯特丽德长大那会儿，我祖母就常出入宫廷。她们年纪差不多。

source: And you've heard of her?
target: 所以你也听说过她？

source: Hmph. Of course. Unlike some women here, my pedigree runs deep.
target: 哼。当然。跟这里的某些女人不同，我的家世可是源远流长。

source: She didn't really die of childbirth, you know. That's just the nice story they tell.
target: 你知道，她其实不是死于分娩。那只是他们编出来的体面说法。

source: What's the truth, then?
target: 那真相是什么？

source: ...I've simply got to laugh, 'Feely. Here you are asking me for answers when your dear ol' father's the biggest Astrid expert of us all.
target: ……我真是忍不住要笑了，菲莉。你亲爱的老父亲，比我们所有人都了解阿斯特丽德，你却跑来问我要答案。

source: I know nothing at all about Claudius's mother, Queen Astrid. Did you know her?
target: 我对克劳狄斯的母亲，阿斯特丽德王后，一无所知。您认识她吗？

source: I... You know, I'm quite afraid I don't.
target: 我……说起来，恐怕我并不认识她。

source: I arrived in Elsinore some years after her passing, at the behest of Hamlet's father, King Alexander.
target: 她去世几年后，我奉哈姆雷特的父亲，亚历山大国王之命，来到埃尔西诺。

source: By that time, she was already long dead. Then there was that stir with Alexander's mistress running off...
target: 那时她已经去世很久了。后来，亚历山大的情妇又跑了，引起了一阵风波……

source: Just a moment. His mistress?
target: 等等。他的情妇？

source: You mean Simona?
target: 您是说西蒙娜？

source: Oh, yes, Simona. She was known to the court, and was something of a favorite of his, at least that's what I heard when I was young. But then she up and vanished.
target: 哦，对，西蒙娜。宫廷里的人都认识她，她也颇得他的宠爱，至少我小时候是这么听说的。可后来她突然就消失了。

source: Most peculiar. I never did think to wonder why. You don't think about these things when you're a child.
target: 真是奇怪。我却从没想过追问原因。人还是孩子的时候，不会去想这些事。

source: Irma, you've been here a long time. What do you know about Queen Astrid?
target: 伊尔玛，你在这里待了很久了。关于阿斯特丽德王后，你知道些什么？

source: Hrm! I may be old, but Gerta and I had not yet come to Elsinore then!
target: 哼！我年纪是大了，可那时我和格尔塔都还没来埃尔西诺呢！

source: Still, looking at King Alexander, Claudius's father... I cannot understand how any woman survived marriage to such a man.
target: 不过，看看克劳狄斯的父亲，亚历山大国王……我真不明白，哪个女人嫁给那样的男人还能活下来。

source: He had such a cruel manner to him. I often saw him cuff the boys across the backs of their heads. In public, no less.
target: 他为人那么残忍。我常看见他扇那两个孩子的后脑勺。而且还是当着众人的面。

source: And it's said he discarded her in favor of younger women quite often-- a womanizer who could not be satiated!
target: 听说他还经常把她抛在一边，去找更年轻的女人——一个永远不知满足的好色之徒！

source: The rumor goes that lady Astrid lost her mind. Wouldn't any of us do the same with a man like that?
target: 传闻说阿斯特丽德女士疯了。摊上那样一个男人，我们谁不会疯呢？

source: Or you'd kill him. One of the two!
target: 要不就杀了他。总得选一个！

source: Do you know much about Queen Astrid?
target: 你对阿斯特丽德王后了解得多吗？

source: Ah ha... Queen Astrid and Lady Simona, two peas in a pod.
target: 啊哈……阿斯特丽德王后和西蒙娜女士，真是一个模子刻出来的。

source: Both of them equally obnoxious, in the end.
target: 到头来，两个人都一样讨厌。

source: I'll have to find a nice death for that Simona woman, in time.
target: 迟早，我得给西蒙娜那个女人找个不错的死法。

source: You know, I've once spent entire game matches doing nothing but dismembering my opponent.
target: 你知道，我曾经在整场游戏里什么也不干，只顾着肢解对手。

source: Though, to be quite honest, Lady is a mite of a stretch.
target: 不过，说实话，称她为女士，有点勉强了。

source: They were both little bosom pals with your mother, if memory serves. How is your mother doing?
target: 没记错的话，她们俩都是你母亲的好闺友。你母亲现在怎么样了？

source: She's dead.
target: 她死了。

source: Oh. Oh, dear. Terribly sorry. I suppose that's what happens when you pop out for a bit and come back. In two decades.
target: 哦。哎呀。真是对不起。我想，出去一小会儿再回来，就会这样。只不过这一会儿，是二十年。

source: Your mother—Queen Astrid—What more can you tell me?
target: 您的母亲——阿斯特丽德王后——您还能告诉我些什么？

source: She passed when Claudius and I were both children.
target: 她去世时，克劳狄斯和我都还是孩子。

source: Evidently, she died of childbirth with my brother. One more life he's ruined in this world, I expect.
target: 据说，她是在生我弟弟时死的。我想，这世上又多了一条被他毁掉的生命。

source: It matters not. My father loved her, at least in front of the court, and I remember her very little.
target: 这不重要。父亲爱她，至少在廷臣面前是如此，而我对她的记忆寥寥无几。

source: Come to think of it, your father and your mother were both ardently devoted to her.
target: 说起来，你父亲和你母亲都曾满腔热忱地效忠于她。

source: What do you know about Queen Astrid?
target: 关于阿斯特丽德王后，您知道些什么？

source: Ah. Now that's a name I'd sworn not to speak again.
target: 唉。我曾发誓，再也不提这个名字。

source: Was there some ill omen about her death?
target: 她死的时候，有什么不祥的征兆吗？

source: Your mother was wonderfully faithful to Queen Astrid during her service. She served her as a handmaiden, in the same way I advised King Alexander.
target: 你母亲服侍阿斯特丽德王后时，对她极为忠诚。她是王后的侍女，就像我为亚历山大国王担任顾问一样。

source: I...it's strange. I just came from visiting your mother's grave.
target: 我……真奇怪。我刚去过你母亲的墓前。

source: Thinking of your mother is... painful.
target: 想起你母亲……让我很痛苦。

source: I wish you'd join me in visiting her too, now and then. We could pay our respects together. Perhaps then I could find the courage to talk about... what happened.
target: 我希望你偶尔也能陪我去看看她。我们可以一起祭奠她。也许到了那时，我就能鼓起勇气，说说……当年发生的事。

source: But now is not the time to unfurl feelings I've neatly tucked and folded away.
target: 可现在还不是时候，去展开那些被我叠好、收起的情感。

source: What happened to her, then? Why does no one speak of her?
target: 那她究竟出了什么事？为什么没人提起她？

source: I'm going to visit her grave, soon. Won't you come with me? Perhaps then I could find the courage to talk about... what happened.
target: 我很快就要去她的墓前看看。你愿意陪我一起去吗？也许到了那时，我就能鼓起勇气，说说……当年发生的事。

source: I'm sure your mother would be smiling in Heaven, to think of you visiting.
target: 我相信，你母亲在天堂想到你来看她，一定会露出笑容。

source: Certainly, Father. I'll be there.
target: 当然，父亲。我会去的。

source: I found out what you did to my mother.
target: 我已经查清了你对我母亲做过什么。

source: Your... mother?
target: 你的……母亲？

source: Yes. When the plague came. Don't you remember?
target: 对。瘟疫来袭的时候。你不记得了？

source: Death is a wall. Very little permeates it.
target: 死亡是一堵墙。几乎没有什么能穿透它。

source: Ah. Well, then. Allow me to refresh your memory.
target: 啊。那好吧。让我帮你回忆一下。

source: You sent my mother, the only woman who looked after your mother in her final moments, the wife of your chief advisor, to her death.
target: 你把我母亲送上了死路。她是你母亲临终时唯一照顾她的女人，也是你首席顾问的妻子。

source: When she was sick, you could have kept her in the castle. You could have had your servants bathe her with cool cloths, or bring her water when she vomited.
target: 她病倒时，你本可以让她留在城堡里。本可以让仆人用凉布替她擦身，或在她呕吐时给她送水。

source: And at night, a fire if she shivered. Isn't that what all sufferers deserve? Compassion?
target: 夜里，要是她冷得发抖，还可以为她生一堆火。所有受苦的人，不都该得到这些吗？得到怜悯？

source: She might have survived, then. She might have made it.
target: 那样，她也许就能活下来。她也许就能熬过去。

source: But you didn't do that.
target: 可你没有那么做。

source: Instead, because she was not herself nobility, you ordered that she be sent to a sanitarium far from her family.
target: 反而因为她自己不是贵族，你下令把她送进了一所远离家人的疗养院。

source: And she died, in pain, alone, far away from anyone she loved.
target: 于是，她独自一人，忍着痛苦死去了。她所爱的人，没有一个在她身边。

source: You're lying.
target: 你在撒谎。

source: You do remember, don't you?
target: 你确实记得，不是吗？

source: I am ashamed.
target: 我深感羞愧。

source: But I cannot hide the truth.
target: 但我不能隐瞒真相。

source: All I can do is offer my deepest apologies. My decision was clearly in error.
target: 我能做的，只有向你致以最深的歉意。我的决定显然错了。

source: Polonius and I never spoke of it at the time, but...
target: 当时，波洛涅斯和我从没谈过这件事，可是……

source: Your apology means nothing, now that both you and she are dead.
target: 如今你和她都死了，你的道歉已经毫无意义。

source: And it wouldn't help anything. It was a long, long time ago.
target: 而且也于事无补。那已经是很久、很久以前的事了。

source: I would understand if you no longer spoke to me.
target: 如果你不愿再跟我说话，我能理解。

source: No. I need you, and you need me.
target: 不。我需要你，你也需要我。

source: You can make it up to me by helping me survive this.
target: 帮我活着渡过这一劫，就算你对我的补偿。

source: Help me keep the people I love alive. That's how you can make this right.
target: 帮我保住我爱的那些人的性命。这样你才能弥补这一切。

source: In that case, I am at your service.
target: 既然如此，我愿为你效劳。

source: Nothing I could say could possible amend that crime.
target: 无论我说什么，都不可能弥补那桩罪行。

source: So I will say nothing more.
target: 所以，我不再多说了。

source: Father—I want to talk about the way Mother died, and about the dockhouse where her belongings might be.
target: 父亲——我想谈谈母亲是怎么死的，还有那间可能存着她遗物的码头小屋。

source: Ah. I'm sorry for that. It... was the sort of terrible news I had planned to tell you when you were older.
target: 啊。对此，我很抱歉。这……是个噩耗，我原本打算等你再大些才告诉你。

source: I see. So someone must have told you...
target: 我明白了。看来一定有人告诉了你……

source: I'm... really quite sorry for that. It was the sort of terrible news I had planned to tell you when you were older.
target: 我……对此真的很抱歉。这是个噩耗，我原本打算等你再大些才告诉你。

source: Well, you're older now, and you deserve to know. As does your brother, when he returns.
target: 如今你已经长大了，有权知道。等你哥哥回来，他也有权知道。

source: Well, you're older now, and you deserve to know. As does Laertes.
target: 如今你已经长大了，有权知道。雷欧提斯也一样。

source: I would never have wanted you to keep that from me. Even if it hurt to tell me. I deserved to know.
target: 我绝不会希望你瞒着我。哪怕告诉我会让你痛苦。我有权知道。

source: You're right. And yet... the heart works in strange ways, doesn't it? I told myself it was easier to bury it, to never speak of it.
target: 你说得对。可是……人心有时就是这么奇怪，不是吗？我告诉自己，把这件事埋在心里，永远不提，会更容易些。

source: As though if I did that, it wouldn't be true.
target: 仿佛只要这么做，它就不是真的了。

source: You told me some of her things are still in the dockhouse. Won't you help me see them?
target: 你告诉过我，她的一些东西还在码头小屋里。你不能帮我去看看吗？

source: Some of her things are still in the dockhouse. Won't you help me see them?
target: 她的一些东西还在码头小屋里。你不能帮我去看看吗？

source: Aah... Ophelia, that house is still used sometimes to house victims of illness.
target: 唉……奥菲莉娅，那间屋子现在有时还会用来安置病人。

source: The last thing I need is to lose you. Going in there is incredibly dangerous.
target: 我最不愿看到的就是失去你。进去实在太危险了。

source: My mother passed away alone in a plague quarantine—at King Hamlet's request. Her things are still there.
target: 我母亲独自死在了瘟疫隔离所里——是哈姆雷特国王要求把她送去的。她的东西还在那里。

source: You never told me, my lady. Why?
target: 您从来没告诉过我，王后。为什么？

source: I didn't feel it was my place to tell you, or your brother.
target: 我觉得不该由我来告诉你，或是你哥哥。

source: When they took your mother away, you were still nursing, and your brother clung to my skirts, crying. He was so young, he likely doesn't remember.
target: 他们带走你母亲时，你还在吃奶，你哥哥抓着我的裙子哭。他当时太小了，很可能已经不记得了。

source: Before your mother was forced onto the boat, she asked me to keep you both safe, to see that you grew up well attended to.
target: 你母亲被强行带上船之前，托我保护你们两个，让你们在悉心照料下长大。

source: And I always knew you would. Look at you. Beautiful, brave, and strong. Your mother, as I am, would be proud.
target: 而我一直知道，你们会好好长大的。看看你。美丽、勇敢又坚强。你母亲也会像我一样，为你骄傲。

source: Thank you, my lady. I... don't know what to say. You've been very kind.
target: 谢谢您，王后。我……不知道该说什么。您一直对我很好。

source: I just pray that your father tells Laertes. He deserves to know, too.
target: 我只祈愿你父亲能告诉雷欧提斯。他也有权知道。

source: Can you help me get into the dockside shack where her belongings rest?
target: 您能帮我进那间码头边的小屋吗？她的遗物都在那里。

source: I'm afraid I can't.
target: 恐怕不行。

source: You've never seen the town or castle ravaged by plague. When I was a girl, it was all too common here.
target: 你从没见过镇子或城堡遭瘟疫肆虐的样子。我还是个小姑娘的时候，这里常常发生那种事。

source: Hundreds would sicken and die in mere days. If any pestilence remains in that shack... it's a threat to us all.
target: 短短几天，就会有几百人染病死去。如果那间小屋里还残留着疫病……我们所有人都会受到威胁。

source: Your mother would want you and Laertes safe, Ophelia. I know that above all.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你母亲会希望你和雷欧提斯平平安安。这一点，我最清楚。

source: Laertes... did you know about mother's death? Did you know what she left behind?
target: 雷欧提斯……你知道母亲是怎么死的吗？你知道她留下了什么吗？

source: I knew she was ill. And then she passed. Father told me that.
target: 我知道她病了。后来她就去世了。父亲是这么告诉我的。

source: My memory of her is... faint, at best...
target: 我对她的记忆……最多也只剩些模糊的印象了……

source: Did father also tell you of her time spent in the sanitarium? That King Hamlet forced her into quarantine in the middle of nowhere before she died?
target: 父亲也告诉你她在疗养院的那段日子了吗？告诉你她死前被哈姆雷特国王强行送去一个偏僻的地方隔离了吗？

source: He... did that?
target: 他……竟然这么做了？

source: Cruel almost beyond belief. But of course, I'd expect nothing less of that man.
target: 残忍得几乎让人难以置信。不过，那个人会这么做，我一点也不意外。

source: I never thought I'd say it, but I'm glad he's dead.
target: 我从没想过自己会说这种话，但他死了，我很高兴。

source: I always knew King Hamlet didn't like us. We always stood out to him.
target: 我一直知道哈姆雷特国王不喜欢我们。在他眼里，我们总是格格不入。

source: We're not like them, Ophelia—the rest of the Danes, I mean—and we never will be. Don't forget that.
target: 我们和他们不一样，奥菲莉娅——我是说其他丹麦人——而且永远都不会一样。别忘了这一点。

source: But long after they've given in to madness, or lovesickness, or fainting over themselves, you and I will still be here fighting.
target: 可等他们早已陷入疯狂、相思，或是顾影自怜到昏厥时，你我还会在这里抗争。

source: Laertes. Some of mother's items are still in that shed on the docks.
target: 雷欧提斯。母亲的一些东西还在码头的那间棚屋里。

source: I need you to help me retrieve them.
target: 我需要你帮我把它们取回来。

source: Aye. Let's go. We deserve to reclaim what's hers, Ophelia.
target: 好。走吧。奥菲莉娅，我们有权拿回属于她的东西。

source: They can try to burn our family down at the roots, be ashamed of us, but we're still here, and we're not going anywhere.
target: 他们可以试着把我们一家连根烧毁，可以以我们为耻，可我们还在这里，而且哪儿也不去。

source: I've learned how Mother died. It was inhuman. Some of her things are still in a shack near the docks.
target: 我知道母亲是怎么死的了。那简直毫无人性。她的一些东西还在码头附近的一间小屋里。

source: Your mother? Lady Elise?
target: 你的母亲？伊莉丝女士？

source: What of her?
target: 她怎么了？

source: Did you know? Did you know about her death?
target: 你知道吗？你知道她是怎么死的吗？

source: I didn't. Your brother and I were... four years, perhaps five.
target: 我不知道。那时你哥哥和我才……四岁，也可能是五岁。

source: But it got worse. After she was sick, King Hamlet sent her to the sanitarium to die, alone and far from family.
target: 可事情比那更糟。她病了以后，哈姆雷特国王把她送进疗养院，让她远离家人，孤零零地死去。

source: She wasn't permitted to live out her days in the outer apartments, where the other plague victims go.
target: 其他染上瘟疫的人都会被安置在外围的住处，她却连在那里度过余生都不被允许。

source: Bernardo, nobody ever told me. Were they... ashamed?
target: 贝尔纳多，从来没人告诉过我。他们是……觉得羞耻吗？

source: I'm so sorry. I've never... heard of the way Lady Elise met her end.
target: 我很难过。我从来没……听说过伊莉丝女士是怎么去世的。

source: If I had known, rest assured, I would have told you.
target: 如果我知道，我一定会告诉你，你尽管放心。

source: Some of her personal items are still in a shack by the docks.
target: 她的一些私人物品还在码头边的一间小屋里。

source: I need entry. But I'm not strong enough to break the door.
target: 我得进去。可我力气不够，破不开那扇门。

source: That old shack? But the King had Marcellus board it up a decade ago. It's possible plague still lingers inside.
target: 那间旧小屋？可国王十年前就让马塞勒斯用木板把它封起来了。里面可能还残留着瘟疫。

source: To open it would present a grave danger to all living here now.
target: 打开它，会给现在住在这里的所有人带来极大的危险。

source: You're already in grave danger! From each other! What harm would it do?
target: 你们已经身处极大的危险中了！危险就来自你们彼此！打开它又能有多大害处？

source: I cannot disobey the King, Ophelia. You know that.
target: 我不能违抗国王，奥菲莉娅。你知道的。

source: ...So be it.
target: ……那就算了。

source: I'll find another way.
target: 我会另想办法。

source: Your brother sent my mother to die alone in plague quarantine. Some of her personal items remain.
target: 您哥哥把我母亲送去瘟疫隔离所，让她孤零零地死在那里。她的一些私人物品还留在那里。

source: My brother sent her to the sanitarium, did he? I never knew.
target: 我哥哥把她送进了疗养院，是吗？我从来不知道。

source: I'm afraid I didn't pay very close attention to your mother at the end of her life. I was... otherwise occupied. My apologies.
target: 恐怕在你母亲生命的最后那段日子里，我没怎么关注她。我当时……忙着别的事。抱歉。

source: Had I been King, she would have died a death fitting of her station, surrounded by her family.
target: 如果当时我是国王，她就会在家人的陪伴下，以符合她身份的方式离世。

source: Whether that's true or not...
target: 不管这话是真是假……

source: There's nothing I can do about that at the moment. But her personal items are still locked up in that shack on the docks.
target: 眼下我对此无能为力。不过，她的私人物品还锁在码头的那间小屋里。

source: If you could only let me in there—
target: 只要您能让我进去——

source: Into the plague shack? Are you insane?
target: 进那间瘟疫小屋？你疯了吗？

source: No. I'll not have my men go anywhere close. We require that shack to be opened solely by sailors and the ill. Do you want to catch plague?
target: 不行。我不会让我的人靠近那里。我们规定，只有水手和病人才能打开那间小屋。你想染上瘟疫吗？

source: I'm terribly sorry about your mother, Ophelia. But I forbid you to go into that shack.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你母亲的事让我很难过。但我禁止你进那间小屋。

source: There's nothing I can do about that at the moment. I just thought you should know.
target: 眼下我对此无能为力。我只是觉得您应该知道。

source: Your father sent my mother to die alone in plague quarantine. Some of her personal items remain.
target: 你父亲把我母亲送去瘟疫隔离所，让她孤零零地死在那里。她的一些私人物品还留在那里。

source: My father did that?
target: 我父亲竟然这么做了？

source: You never heard about this from him?
target: 你从没听他提起过这件事？

source: No. I remember your mother's passing very little. All I can recall is that she was with us one week, and missing the next, and no one would speak of her.
target: 没有。关于你母亲去世的事，我记得很少。我只记得，前一周她还和我们在一起，下一周就不见了，而且没人愿意提起她。

source: Where are her personal items?
target: 她的私人物品在哪里？

source: They're in the small dockhouse. You know the one. It's been boarded up for years. Can you help me get in?
target: 在码头的那间小屋里。你知道是哪间。它被木板封了好多年了。你能帮我进去吗？

source: Ah, but the plague...
target: 啊，可是瘟疫……

source: Yes, it's possible we'd catch plague. But if you could only let me in there, I'd go in alone. You wouldn't need to come.
target: 是，我们可能会染上瘟疫。但只要你能让我进去，我就一个人去。你不用跟来。

source: I... I want to, but...
target: 我……我想帮你，可是……

source: As I recall, you were rather prone to taking ill when we were young. What if some pestilence still lingers in there?
target: 我记得，小时候你很容易生病。万一里面还残留着疫病呢？

source: I couldn't live with myself if that happened.
target: 如果真出了事，我一辈子都不会原谅自己。

source: Hamlet, I want this more than anything.
target: 哈姆雷特，我比什么都更想要这么做。

source: You of all people. I thought I could come to you, at least.
target: 偏偏连你也这样。我以为至少还能找你帮忙。

source: Very well. I'll open it.
target: 好吧。我会把它打开。

source: I'll meet you near the docks as soon as I'm able.
target: 我一能抽身，就去码头附近跟你碰面。

source: Find me there.
target: 到那里找我。

source: They're in the small dockhouse. You know the one. It was boarded up until recently.
target: 在码头的那间小屋里。你知道是哪间。直到最近，它都还被木板封着。

source: I'll be fine, Hamlet. But I had to try to get in.
target: 我会没事的，哈姆雷特。但我必须试着进去。

source: I've learned about my mother's death. King Hamlet sent her to die in a sanitarium along the southern coast, alone.
target: 我知道母亲是怎么死的了。哈姆雷特国王把她送到南部海岸的一间疗养院，让她孤零零地死在那里。

source: But why not simply let her heal up within the castle, just like the others?
target: 可为什么不让她像其他人一样，留在城堡里养好病呢？

source: You and I both know why. Because we'll always be outsiders within Denmark.
target: 你我都知道为什么。因为在丹麦，我们永远都是外人。

source: ... Listen, my dear. I've a tale for you.
target: ……听我说，亲爱的。我给你讲个故事。

source: When I was a boy in Rome, my father and I often brought our spice wares to sale late at night and communed with the other traders before we passed the night there.
target: 小时候在罗马，我和父亲常常深夜带着香料去卖，和其他商贩聊聊天，然后在那里过夜。

source: For a long time, we were the only Indian-born men to do so. Our colleagues thought us savage. We were allowed at no fires, given no drink. We drank alone, together.
target: 很长一段时间，做这种买卖的、出生在印度的男人只有我们两个。同行觉得我们是野蛮人。不让我们靠近任何一堆篝火，也不给我们酒喝。我们父子俩只能独自在一起喝酒。

source: And then... others came. Others like us. And we made our own fires. We told our own stories, stories about gods with names the Romans had never heard.
target: 后来……其他人来了。和我们一样的人。于是我们生起了自己的篝火。我们讲自己的故事，讲那些罗马人连名字都没听过的神。

source: Eventually, we outnumbered the men who wouldn't let us drink with them, and they came to sit near our fires. They listened to our tales.
target: 渐渐地，我们的人数超过了那些不肯让我们一起喝酒的人，他们也来到我们的篝火旁坐下，听我们讲故事。

source: Someday all the places in the world like Denmark will be that Roman market.
target: 总有一天，世上所有像丹麦这样的地方，都会变成那个罗马集市。

source: And someday, you won't feel so alone, and neither will I.
target: 总有一天，你不会再觉得那么孤独，我也一样。

source: Until that day, we make our own fire, and they kill us piece by piece before we are well and truly dead.
target: 在那一天到来之前，我们生起自己的篝火，而他们一点一点地杀死我们，直到我们彻底死去。

source: I'm sorry to hear about your mother. You are living proof that there can be a better way, Ophelia. You're loved by all.
target: 听到你母亲的事，我很难过。奥菲莉娅，你就是活生生的证明，证明事情可以变得更好。大家都爱你。

source: ...If I am loved, it is only for my father's blood.
target: ……如果有人爱我，那也只是因为我身上流着父亲的血。

source: I think you do yourself too little service.
target: 我觉得你太小看自己了。

source: Let's look out for one another. Let's keep our own fire.
target: 我们彼此照应吧。守住我们自己的篝火。

source: Does Peter Quince seem a bit strange to you, my King?
target: 陛下，您觉得彼得·奎因斯有点奇怪吗？

source: Quince... that name is familiar. Ah. You mean that little traveling playmaster?
target: 奎因斯……这名字耳熟。啊。你是说那个四处巡演的小戏剧大师？

source: Oh, goodness, Lady Ophelia. The man's been coming to Elsinore for years. Always peculiar.
target: 哎呀，奥菲莉娅女士。那个人来埃尔西诺演出都好多年了。一直都很古怪。

source: My wife sent for him this time. I've no idea why. Perhaps to cheer Hamlet's dour mood.
target: 这次是我妻子请他来的。我也不知道为什么。也许是想让哈姆雷特的心情不再那么阴郁。

source: Does Peter Quince seem a bit strange to you?
target: 你觉得彼得·奎因斯有点奇怪吗？

source: Quince? I assume you mean that man who comes to perform at Elsinore now and then?
target: 奎因斯？你说的是那个时不时来埃尔西诺演出的人吧？

source: The Playmaster's job is to play the fool. If he was not strange, he would be a poor fool, would he not?
target: 戏剧大师的工作就是扮丑角。他要是不古怪，岂不是连丑角都演不好了？

source: To tell you the truth, I've always found him a little off-putting, myself. That hinged smile! Those eerie eyes!
target: 说实话，我自己也一直觉得他有点让人不舒服。那像铰链撑开的笑容！那双阴森的眼睛！

source: I wish the royal family weren't so enamoured with him, and his strange one-man 'acting troupe.'
target: 真希望王室别那么迷恋他，还有他那个古怪的、只有一个人的“剧团”。

source: My Queen, does Peter Quince seem... a bit strange to you?
target: 王后，您觉得彼得·奎因斯……有点奇怪吗？

source: I've always been fond of Quince, but I will admit his performances are... unique.
target: 我一直很喜欢奎因斯，不过我得承认，他的表演确实……别具一格。

source: Every time he puts on a show, I laugh.
target: 每次看他演出，我都会笑。

source: But then afterwards, thinking about the events they covered... I find myself strangely sad.
target: 可事后再想想戏里讲的那些事……我又会莫名地难过。

source: He has a funny way of finding humor in tragedy, and of hiding melancholy behind a smile.
target: 他有种奇妙的本事，能在悲剧里找到幽默，也能把忧伤藏在笑容背后。

source: I suppose that's why we keep inviting him back.
target: 我想，这就是我们一次次邀请他回来的原因。

source: Quince, why is it that you know things you ought not to?
target: 奎因斯，你为什么会知道那些你不该知道的事？

source: You are a simple one, aren't you.
target: 你还真是个单纯的人啊。

source: You very well know the answer to that.
target: 答案你明明心里清楚。

source: ...Would you like to have a little peek behind the curtain?
target: ……想不想往帷幕后面偷看一眼？

source: To know how I cause such chaos?
target: 看看我是怎么制造出这么多混乱的？

source: ...What do you mean by that?
target: ……你这话是什么意思？

source: So be off. Don't you have plans of your own to pursue?
target: 那就去吧。你不是还有自己的计划要去实现吗？

source: You were so adamant earlier, after all!
target: 毕竟，你先前可是那么坚决！

source: I find it quite endearing, to be honest.
target: 说实话，我觉得这还挺讨人喜欢的。

source: What's that, now? I merely observe what happens around me closely, looking for inspiration in every word.
target: 你说什么？我只是仔细观察身边发生的事，从每一句话里寻找灵感罢了。

source: Hmm! I merely choose what I say carefully. We only have so much influence to spend, after all.
target: 嗯！我只是说话时斟酌得仔细些。毕竟，我们能用来左右局面的力量就那么多。

source: Do you not do the same, my lady?
target: 小姐，你不也是这样吗？

source: But... you know things that haven't happened yet.
target: 可是……你知道那些还没发生的事。

source: You knew about my father dying. You warned me, in so many words.
target: 你知道我父亲会死。你已经用那些话警告过我了。

source: When you've seen as much as I have, you learn to guess how plots will unfold.
target: 等你见得和我一样多，也会学着猜出剧情将如何发展。

source: Don't be coy with me. I've earned more information than that, if you have it.
target: 别跟我卖关子。如果你还知道些什么，我理应得到比这更多的消息。

source: My darling girl, we've already had this conversation, and I've told you what you needed to know.
target: 亲爱的姑娘，我们已经谈过这个了，你需要知道的，我都告诉你了。

source: Let the world be your schoolbook, the ebb and flow of life your teacher!
target: 让世界成为你的课本，让人生的起落成为你的老师！

source: ...And come back to me when you have something truly juicy.
target: ……等你有了真正有意思的消息，再回来找我。

source: I could share the secret, if you like. You should see some of my newest material! In this humble playwright's opinion, it has a rare novel quality, I think.
target: 如果你愿意，我可以告诉你这个秘密。你该看看我最新的一些作品！依我这个小小剧作家之见，我觉得它们有种难得的新意。

source: Is that an invitation?
target: 你这是在邀请我吗？

source: I'm afraid our time here runs short. If only you had asked me earlier...
target: 恐怕我们在这里的时间不多了。你要是早点问我就好了……

source: Meet me in the gallery after my performance has concluded, and we'll talk.
target: 等我的演出结束，到画廊来找我，我们再谈。

source: You know, not every performance I give is here in the castle. Sometimes, on my way in or out, I do a little extra show. You know. For the children.
target: 你知道，我的演出并不全在城堡里。有时来去的路上，我也会额外演上一小场。你知道的。给孩子们看。

source: You'll come see me, won't you? I feel as though we've grown quite close, these last few days. How many 'days' has it been now? Hrm!
target: 你会来看我的，对吧？我觉得这几天我们已经亲近了不少。到现在究竟过了多少“天”呢？嗯！

source: This is my magnum opus! My true life's work! And as you know—vita brevis.
target: 这是我的巅峰之作！真正凝聚我毕生心血的作品！而你也知道——人生苦短。

source: When exactly is this unmissable performance?
target: 这场不容错过的演出究竟在什么时候？

source: Early Thursday morning. Be there if you can.
target: 星期四一大早。能来就来吧。

source: Does Peter Quince's behavior seem unusual to you?
target: 你觉得彼得·奎因斯的举止有什么异常吗？

source: You did just warn me about him.
target: 你刚刚确实提醒过我要小心他。

source: And now that I've spoken with my father, I can see why.
target: 现在我跟父亲谈过了，也明白你为什么这么说了。

source: It sounds like we are in grave danger from him.
target: 听起来，他给我们带来的危险极其严重。

source: That's why he has to be stopped. This cannot continue.
target: 所以必须阻止他。不能再这样下去了。

source: And given everything that happened afterwards, I have to wonder whether I'm going mad, or you are.
target: 而想到后来发生的那些事，我不得不怀疑，究竟是我要疯了，还是你疯了。

source: I find myself doubting that something so strange can be true, but Elsinore has been rather a strange place, lately.
target: 我不禁怀疑，这么离奇的事怎么可能是真的，但最近埃尔西诺也着实古怪得很。

source: I'll speak to my father's spirit about it as soon as I'm able.
target: 一有机会，我就会跟父亲的亡魂谈谈这件事。

source: Strange? How?
target: 古怪？怎么说？

source: He seems to have an uncanny knowledge of everything that happens in this castle.
target: 这座城堡里发生的一切，他似乎都了如指掌，简直不可思议。

source: Everything that could happen in this castle.
target: 是这座城堡里可能发生的一切。

source: 'Could' happen?
target: “可能”发生？

source: As if he's some sort of... fortune teller? You don't truly believe this, do you?
target: 就好像他是个……算命的？你不会真信这个吧？

source: What if he is?
target: 如果他真是呢？

source: I'd have to wonder whether I was going mad, or you were.
target: 那我就得怀疑，究竟是我要疯了，还是你疯了。

source: (Right. He hasn't heard of Quince's arrival just yet.)
target: （对了。他还没听说奎因斯要来的事。）

source: I've learned he's coming to Elsinore Castle soon to perform. Your mother requested his presence.
target: 我听说他很快就要来埃尔西诺城堡演出。是你母亲邀请他来的。

source: Well, that's the best news I've received in months.
target: 好啊，这是我几个月来听到的最好的消息了。

source: Quince always was an odd man. But I never found him odd in an off-putting sort of way.
target: 奎因斯一向是个古怪的人。但我从不觉得他古怪得让人反感。

source: Does Peter Quince seem at all odd to you?
target: 你觉得彼得·奎因斯有什么古怪的地方吗？

source: (Right. She hasn't heard of Quince's arrival just yet.)
target: （对了。她还没听说奎因斯要来的事。）

source: He's a traveling performer. Supposedly he's well known in the area, though I'd never met him until recently.
target: 他是个巡回表演的艺人。据说在这一带很有名，不过我也是最近才见过他。

source: Oh. That one. Yes, I've seen his work. You want to know if he's odd?
target: 哦。是他啊。是，我看过他的演出。你想知道他是不是很古怪？

source: Ophelia, we live in a walled castle at the edge of Denmark. All foreigners are 'odd.'
target: 奥菲莉娅，我们住在丹麦边境一座高墙围起的城堡里。外国人全都很“古怪”。

source: I meant—beside that.
target: 我是说——除此之外。

source: ...He always seems to know where to find me, I suppose. Even when I'm not expecting to be found.
target: ……要说的话，他似乎总知道上哪儿能找到我。就连我没想到会有人找到我的时候也是。

source: He... sought you out?
target: 他……特意去找过你？

source: Yes, when I was running errands in town.
target: 是啊，那时我正在镇上办事。

source: He offered me some peculiar advice. I-it was—well, no. It's nothing.
target: 他给了我一些奇怪的建议。那、那是——唉，不。没什么。

source: ...He edited your story.
target: ……他改写了你的故事。

source: Ah. Never mind.
target: 啊。没什么。

source: Always mumbling, you.
target: 你啊，总是嘀嘀咕咕的。

source: He's well known as a sort of... rabble-rouser, I think. He always performs alone.
target: 我想，他是出了名的那种……煽动闹事的人。他总是独自演出。

source: I rarely trust men who travel alone. They're often up to nothing good.
target: 我很少相信独自旅行的男人。他们往往没在干什么好事。

source: What do you know of Peter Quince, the Playmaster?
target: 关于戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯，你知道些什么？

source: Ah. Him.
target: 啊。是他。

source: The... details are indescribably hazy. It is hard to remember.
target: 那些……细节模糊得难以形容。很难想起来。

source: But I recall he was kind to me. Kinder than I deserved, considering I was not able to help him.
target: 但我记得，他待我很好。我没能帮上他的忙，实在不配让他待我那么好。

source: Of course. Now I now he was just using me for his own ends.
target: 当然。现在我知道了，他只是为了自己的目的利用我。

source: We must stop him, Ophelia. There are no limits to what that man will do.
target: 我们必须阻止他，奥菲莉娅。那个人什么事都做得出来。

source: Help him with what, exactly?
target: 究竟要帮他做什么？

source: ...It was a pressing request of his—something I could not... find...
target: ……他急切地请求我——找一样我没能……找到的东西……

source: My memories drift away like fog. Retrieve my final writings from your father. Perhaps then we can make sense of this nothingness.
target: 我的记忆像雾一样飘散。从你父亲那里取回我最后写下的那些文字。也许到那时，我们就能从这片空白中理出头绪。

source: To help him find the Book of Fates... the token which created this sad situation.
target: 帮他找到《命运之书》……那件造成这悲惨局面的信物。

source: I was never able to find it, of course... but even knowing gave me purpose.
target: 当然，我始终没能找到它……但哪怕只是知道这件事，也让我有了目标。

source: The will to try again indefinitely. The will to return, even now.
target: 让我愿意无休止地再试下去。让我即使到了现在，也愿意回来。

source: Father, I found a note from Laertes on your desk about his lute.
target: 父亲，我在你的书桌上发现一张雷欧提斯留下的字条，是关于他的鲁特琴的。

source: Aha! Yes, that old thing. He's certain the prince's gone and stolen it. But—well...
target: 啊哈！是，那件老东西。他认定是王子把它偷走了。可是——唉……

source: Frankly, now that your brother's abandoned his costly trip to Paris, he can sort out these petty squabbles himself.
target: 说实话，既然你哥哥已经放弃了那趟花费不菲的巴黎之行，这些小争执就让他自己解决吧。

source: I don't believe Hamlet would've taken it. You know how those two can be. How they've always been.
target: 我不信哈姆雷特会拿走它。你知道那两个人闹起来是什么样。他们一直都是那样。

source: I never thought two boys raised like brothers could hate one another more.
target: 两个像兄弟一样一起长大的男孩，竟能如此憎恨彼此，我实在没想到。

source: If I were to track it down and bring it back to Laertes, perhaps that tension would be resolved.
target: 如果我找到它，带回去给雷欧提斯，也许就能化解这场矛盾。

source: One tension of many, yes.
target: 是啊，许多矛盾中的一个。

source: I'm certain Hamlet or Bernardo will know where it's gone off to, even if they don't know where it is now.
target: 我相信哈姆雷特或贝尔纳多一定知道它被弄到哪里去了，就算他们不知道它现在在哪儿。

source: Little to resolve now, with Hamlet's passing. The poor lad.
target: 哈姆雷特已经去世，现在也没什么可化解的了。可怜的孩子。

source: I would have thought Bernardo to be an excellent voice in mediating this. The poor lad. May he rest in peace.
target: 我本以为，贝尔纳多很适合出面调解这件事。可怜的孩子。愿他安息。

source: I found a note from my brother accusing Hamlet of having stolen his lute. Do you know anything about it?
target: 我发现一张哥哥留下的字条，指责哈姆雷特偷了他的鲁特琴。你知道这件事吗？

source: A... stolen lute? From his room? Hrm...
target: 一把……被偷的鲁特琴？从他房间里偷的？嗯……

source: Oh. Oh. I see. Yes, I think I... know precisely what he means.
target: 哦。哦。我明白了。是，我想我……完全知道他说的是什么。

source: Have you spoken with Hamlet about this yet?
target: 你跟哈姆雷特谈过这件事了吗？

source: I have. He wants to meet with you to find it.
target: 谈过了。他想跟你见面，一起找那把琴。

source: Excellent. I'll find him anon.
target: 很好。我这就去找他。

source: I haven't, no.
target: 没有，还没谈过。

source: You ought to. For once, his hands are clean of this.
target: 你该去问问他。这回难得不是他干的。

source: You mean Laertes was right?
target: 你是说雷欧提斯说对了？

source: Certainly, but... I may have been the culprit. Tell Hamlet to meet me. I'll discuss it with him then.
target: 没错，不过……罪魁祸首可能是我。告诉哈姆雷特，让他来见我。到时我会跟他谈这件事。

source: Unfortunately, things are too hectic at the moment for me to look into Laertes' petty theft cases.
target: 可惜眼下事情太多，我没空调查雷欧提斯那些小偷小摸的案子。

source: Perhaps the next time there's a... lull, Ophelia? Things are tense in Elsinore.
target: 也许等下次……闲下来再说，奥菲莉娅？埃尔西诺的局势很紧张。

source: I found a note from my brother accusing you of having stolen his lute. Do you know anything about it?
target: 我发现一张哥哥留下的字条，指责你偷了他的鲁特琴。你知道这件事吗？

source: You've got to be joking, surely. Yes?
target: 你一定是在开玩笑。对吧？

source: Firstly, that lute hasn't been used in years. Why is he looking for it now? And secondly, I never laid a hand on the damn thing. I can't even play.
target: 首先，那把鲁特琴已经好几年没人用过了。他为什么现在才找？其次，我根本没碰过那该死的东西。我连弹都不会。

source: Does Bernardo know about this? I'm confident the lute is with him.
target: 贝尔纳多知道这件事吗？我确信那把鲁特琴在他那里。

source: I spoke to Bernardo. He asked me to speak to you in turn, so the two of you could meet.
target: 我跟贝尔纳多谈过了。他让我再来跟你说，好让你们两个见一面。

source: I'll find him and get to the bottom of this.
target: 我会去找他，把这件事弄清楚。

source: Not yet, no.
target: 没有，还没有。

source: Well, tell him I want to see him at once. Go on, then.
target: 那就告诉他，我要立刻见他。去吧。

source: Ophelia, leave me be. Things are stirring in Elsinore, and my priorities are elsewhere. I care little what Laertes thinks right now.
target: 奥菲莉娅，别来烦我。埃尔西诺正暗潮涌动，我有别的要紧事。眼下我不在乎雷欧提斯怎么想。

source: Can't you find me when things are peaceful once more?
target: 你就不能等局势重新平静下来再来找我吗？

source: My Lord, I know for certain Prince Hamlet will survive his trip to England. I know, also, that this is opposite of your desire.
target: 陛下，我确知哈姆雷特王子此去英格兰不会死。我也知道，这与你的愿望正好相反。

source: I-indeed, just this morning, I received word that he's quite alive. In the hands of pirates, no less.
target: 确、确实，就在今天早上，我收到消息，他还好端端地活着。而且竟然落在了海盗手里。

source: If you... if you're sympathetic to my thoughts and actions...
target: 如果你……如果你理解我的想法和做法……

source: If you knew of my intentions, why did you not tell me sooner?
target: 如果你知道我的意图，为什么不早点告诉我？

source: If you knew of my plan, why did you not tell me sooner?
target: 如果你知道我的计划，为什么不早点告诉我？

source: W-well, no matter. He's on the ocean now. I can't do anything. May his ship sink all the swifter.
target: 算、算了，无所谓。他现在已经在海上了。我什么也做不了。但愿他的船沉得更快些。

source: Why on earth would I desire my nephew's death? A trip to England will be just the thing he needs.
target: 我到底为什么会希望我的侄子死？去一趟英格兰正是他所需要的。

source: You and I both know that isn't true. You want Hamlet dead.
target: 你我都知道那不是真的。你想让哈姆雷特死。

source: How could you know about this?
target: 你怎么可能知道这件事？

source: Your secret's safe, my lord. For now, that is.
target: 你的秘密不会泄露，陛下。至少眼下不会。

source: Know, then, that I have ordered Rosencrantz and Guildenstern to deliver a letter to the Crown of England.
target: 那我就告诉你，我已命罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞向英格兰君主递交一封信。

source: And within that letter is writ my nephew's death warrant.
target: 那封信里，写着处死我侄子的命令。

source: I have faith in those two to bear my letter truly. Even so...
target: 我相信她们两人会忠实地送达我的信。即便如此……

source: A-as far as I know, you are the only one who knows my true intentions.
target: 据、据我所知，你是唯一知道我真正意图的人。

source: If you wish to avail yourself to a King, and so earn my personal favor, perhaps you can join Hamlet on his journey.
target: 如果你愿意为国王效力，从而赢得我本人的青睐，或许你可以随哈姆雷特一同出行。

source: And in doing so, ensure his demise.
target: 借此确保他丧命。

source: The ship sails at ten in the morning. Go with him. Ensure he does not return to Denmark, and you will be justly rewarded.
target: 船在上午十点启航。跟他一起去。确保他无法回到丹麦，你就会得到应有的奖赏。

source: Why on earth would I desire my nephew's death?
target: 我到底为什么会希望我的侄子死？

source: Because I suspect he's been rather a thorn in your side as of late.
target: 因为我猜，他最近已经成了你的眼中钉。

source: That's neither here nor there. My nephew is very much alive and well.
target: 那与此事无关。我的侄子还活得好好的。

source: And though things have been difficult as of late, I have hope to rectify the situation.
target: 尽管最近困难重重，我仍希望能扭转局面。

source: (I see. He hasn't hatched his plan yet.)
target: （明白了。他还没想出那个计划。）

source: Regardless, my lord. If the situation changes, may we discuss it further?
target: 不管怎样，陛下。如果情况有变，我们能再谈谈吗？

source: Hamlet—you ought to be wary. Your uncle desires your death at sea.
target: 哈姆雷特——你得小心。你叔叔想让你死在海上。

source: He means to have you sent away and quietly executed upon arrival. But he will be unsuccessful in this.
target: 他打算把你送走，等你抵达后悄悄处死你。但他的计划不会得逞。

source: ...I am, of course, unsurprised.
target: ……我当然并不意外。

source: I suspected something like that was his intention from the moment we boarded this ship.
target: 从我们登上这艘船的那一刻起，我就怀疑他有这样的意图。

source: There's nothing to be done now but watch and wait. I can trust no one but you, Ophelia.
target: 现在只能静观其变。除了你，我谁也不能信，奥菲莉娅。

source: After everything that happened last night...
target: 昨晚发生了那么多事之后……

source: I had heard there was a plan forming to have me sent to England.
target: 我听说，有人正在计划把我送去英格兰。

source: Ophelia, I swear to you it was a mistake. I never meant to harm your father.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我向你发誓，那是个意外。我从没想过要伤害你父亲。

source: But now, I can no more refuse Claudius sending me away than I can bring your father to life again.
target: 可现在，我无法拒绝克劳狄斯把我送走，就像我无法让你父亲死而复生一样。

source: Ophelia, I swear to you it was a mistake. I never meant to threaten your father.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我向你发誓，那是个意外。我从没想过要威胁你父亲。

source: But now, I can no more refuse Claudius sending me away than I can undo the attempt I made on your father's life.
target: 可现在，我无法拒绝克劳狄斯把我送走，就像我无法抹去我曾试图杀害你父亲的事实一样。

source: The alternative is to face legal punishment here, in Elsinore.
target: 不然，我就得留在埃尔西诺，在这里接受法律的惩罚。

source: This is functional exile, and it is one I go to willingly.
target: 这实际上就是流放，而我是自愿接受的。

source: Nevertheless, I hear your warning, and I shall watch carefully for any sign of this plot.
target: 不过，你的警告我记住了。我会仔细留意这个阴谋的任何迹象。

source: Death at sea?
target: 死在海上？

source: I'm not certain I understand what you mean.
target: 我不太明白你的意思。

source: (Ah, right. Claudius hasn't asked Hamlet to go to England...)
target: （啊，对了。克劳狄斯还没让哈姆雷特去英格兰……）

source: Guilda, I came to warn you. You and Rosie are both going to be killed.
target: 吉尔达，我是来警告你的。你和萝茜都会被杀。

source: K-killed?! But how?
target: 被、被杀？！怎么会？

source: When you're both sent to accompany Hamlet to England, the ship's going to be beseiged by pirates, and—
target: 等你们两个被派去陪哈姆雷特前往英格兰时，那艘船会遭到海盗围攻，然后——

source: Oh, I love this game. Are we telling tall tales? How fun!
target: 哦，我喜欢这个游戏。我们是在编离奇故事吗？真有意思！

source: No. I'm telling the truth. I wanted to let you know while there was still time.
target: 不是。我说的是真的。我想趁还来得及，告诉你这件事。

source: I'm not dead now... but I might die. Is that what you're saying?
target: 我现在没死……但我可能会死。你是这个意思吗？

source: Yes. Yes, that's it exactly.
target: 对。对，就是这个意思。

source: Well, they can't kill me if they think I'm already dead. This plan is infallible!
target: 那只要他们以为我已经死了，就没法杀我。这计划绝不会失败！

source: This is all a little much, Ophelia. I think I'll need a few hours to figure out what it means.
target: 这些事有点让人消化不了，奥菲莉娅。我想我需要几个小时，才能弄明白这到底是什么意思。

source: Rosie, please be careful. The King has set up a terrible plot involving you, Guildenstern, and Hamlet.
target: 萝茜，请小心。国王设下了一个可怕的阴谋，你、吉尔登斯吞和哈姆雷特都牵涉其中。

source: A plot? Of what sort?
target: 阴谋？什么样的阴谋？

source: He gave you a letter, did he not?
target: 他给了你一封信，对不对？

source: Yes, but...
target: 是的，可是……

source: There's something awful in that letter, isn't there?
target: 那封信里写着什么可怕的事，是不是？

source: Hamlet will find it soon, if he hasn't already. He'll believe you mean him harm.
target: 如果哈姆雷特还没发现那封信，他很快就会发现。他会以为你们想害他。

source: ...Well, now that I know of it, that's neither here nor there.
target: ……好吧，既然我现在知道了，那就不重要了。

source: I wouldn't hand over any such letter like that. Now that you've tipped me off, it shan't be a problem.
target: 我不会就这么把那种信交出去的。既然你已经提醒了我，就不会有问题了。

source: But Guilda would be crushed. She'd never want any harm to come to Hamlet.
target: 可是吉尔达会伤心透的。她绝不希望哈姆雷特受到任何伤害。

source: If you decide to tell her this news, please do it gently, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果你决定把这消息告诉她，请说得委婉些。

source: If he hasn't told you already, he means to send you and Guilda to England with Hamlet.
target: 如果他还没告诉你，他打算派你和吉尔达陪哈姆雷特去英格兰。

source: ...And he'll hand you a letter.
target: ……而且他会交给你一封信。

source: A letter? Saying what, precisely?
target: 一封信？具体写了什么？

source: That his uncle means to have him executed upon arrival.
target: 说他的叔叔打算让人一到那里就处死他。

source: Ah, no, you must be mistaken. The King denied Hamlet's request to leave Denmark.
target: 啊，不，你一定弄错了。国王已经拒绝了哈姆雷特离开丹麦的请求。
