source: Although, come to think of it, Guildenstern would be overjoyed if such a thing occurred.
target: 不过，仔细想想，如果真有这回事，吉尔登斯吞会高兴坏的。

source: (Ah, right. Claudius hasn't hatched a plan to send Hamlet away just yet.)
target: （啊，对。克劳狄斯还没想出把哈姆雷特送走的计划。）

source: I found a note on your desk accusing Hamlet of stealing your lute. Can we talk about it?
target: 我在你桌上发现了一张字条，说哈姆雷特偷了你的鲁特琴。我们能谈谈这件事吗？

source: It's been returned. The matter is resolved.
target: 琴已经还回来了。事情解决了。

source: Hamlet-- and I-- we spoke honestly. For perhaps the first time in our lives.
target: 哈姆雷特——和我——我们坦诚地谈了一次。也许是这辈子头一回。

source: I no longer desire his downfall. Whether I cheer for his success is another matter entirely.
target: 我不再盼着他倒霉了。至于会不会为他的成功喝彩，那完全是另一回事。

source: Oh... oh, Ophelia. I left that as an idle thought for Father. I'm a bit occupied at the moment—I've got to make my departure soon.
target: 哦……哦，奥菲莉娅。那只是我随手写给父亲的一个想法。我现在有点忙——我很快就得出发了。

source: When I return from Paris, we'll have endless time to hash through it. I promise.
target: 等我从巴黎回来，我们有的是时间好好谈这件事。我保证。

source: No. I demanded Hamlet return what is mine.
target: 不。我要求哈姆雷特把属于我的东西还回来。

source: If he's ready to bring my property back to me, then I'll speak with him further.
target: 如果他愿意把我的东西还给我，我才会继续跟他谈。

source: Until then, there's no reason to speak to him—or you.
target: 在那之前，我没理由跟他说话——也没理由跟你说话。

source: Hamlet - your uncle is not your enemy. Peter Quince is.
target: 哈姆雷特——你的叔叔不是你的敌人。彼得·奎因斯才是。

source: Don't even speak to me of that idiot. He's gone and ruined everything.
target: 别在我面前提那个白痴。他把一切都毁了。

source: I don't know why I ever trusted the man.
target: 我真不知道当初为什么会相信那个人。

source: (...He's in a frenzy by now. It's too late.)
target: （……他现在已经陷入狂乱了。太迟了。）

source: (If I'd caught him earlier...)
target: （要是我早点找到他……）

source: Peter Quince... the name's familiar...
target: 彼得·奎因斯……这名字很耳熟……

source: Ah, that playmaster? What... can you mean, Ophelia?
target: 啊，那个戏剧大师？你……是什么意思，奥菲莉娅？

source: I haven't seen the man in close to a decade, nor heard of him since.
target: 我已经快十年没见过他了，这期间也没听说过他的消息。

source: He's going to arrive in Elsinore soon. I've... heard... word that he plans to put on a performance here.
target: 他很快就会来到埃尔西诺。我……听说……他打算在这里演出。

source: Peter Quince the playmaster? What on earth do you mean?
target: 戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯？你到底是什么意思？

source: I know it seems far-fetched, but please, listen to me carefully.
target: 我知道这听起来很离谱，但请你仔细听我说。

source: Quince is evil. He means to take down all of us.
target: 奎因斯是个恶人。他想毁掉我们所有人。

source: Your father's death, your grandmother's insanity—it was all his doing. All of it.
target: 你父亲的死，你祖母的疯癫——都是他造成的。全都是。

source: He drove them insane from the shadows. He conspired to have them dead.
target: 他在暗中把他们逼疯，还密谋让人杀死他们。

source: You are saying... my father was not murdered by my uncle after all?
target: 你是说……我父亲其实不是被我叔叔谋杀的？

source: But how can that be? My father's spirit spoke to me. I heard it say that Claudius was my father's killer.
target: 可这怎么可能？我父亲的亡魂跟我说过话。我亲耳听见他说，克劳狄斯就是杀害我父亲的凶手。

source: Was the spirit some omen of the devil? Was I lied to?
target: 那亡魂难道是魔鬼的某种凶兆？我被骗了吗？

source: No, Hamlet, you weren't lied to. It—it's hard to explain. He... conspired... to help your uncle kill your father.
target: 不，哈姆雷特，你没有被骗。这——这很难解释。他……参与了密谋……帮助你叔叔杀死你父亲。

source: These are cruel allegations to make without proof, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，没有证据就提出这样的指控，未免太残酷了。

source: Then ask your father. Ask his ghost yourself. You know he appears on the walls at midnight.
target: 那就去问你父亲。亲自去问他的亡魂。你知道他会在午夜出现在城墙上。

source: (So long as I can convince the ghost of all this, he's the only one Hamlet will listen to...)
target: （只要我能让幽灵相信这一切……哈姆雷特只会听他的话……）

source: Your father will confirm everything I say. Please, Hamlet. If you don't believe me, no one else will.
target: 你父亲会证实我说的一切。求你了，哈姆雷特。如果你不相信我，就没人会相信我了。

source: And... then... I'll be out of options. He'll have won.
target: 那……到时候……我就无计可施了。他就赢了。

source: I don't know where else to turn.
target: 我不知道还能找谁帮忙。

source: Very well. Then let the visions of this night prove your words true.
target: 好吧。那就让今夜出现的亡魂证实你的话。

source: And come, now. You know I can't stand it when you make faces like that. Everything will be all right, Ophelia. I'm here to help.
target: 好了，别这样。你知道我最受不了你露出那种表情。一切都会好起来的，奥菲莉娅。我会帮你的。

source: (I've got to make sure his father's spirit understands the situation we're in.)
target: （我得确保他父亲的亡魂明白我们现在的处境。）

source: My lord, Peter Quince means to bring dissent to the court. We should act against him.
target: 陛下，彼得·奎因斯想在宫廷中挑起纷争。我们应该采取行动对付他。

source: That performance was truly horrid. Apologies for my reaction, but I simply couldn't tolerate it longer.
target: 那场演出实在令人厌恶。请原谅我当时的反应，我实在无法再忍受下去了。

source: Nevertheless, it's come to my attention that my nephew was the one pulling the strings on that circumstance.
target: 不过，我已经得知，那件事是我侄子在幕后操纵。

source: He means to do far more than that, my lord.
target: 陛下，他想做的远不止这些。

source: Oh? In what way?
target: 哦？具体怎么说？

source: It's... he'll... he sort of... manipulates people.
target: 就是……他会……他有点像是在……操纵别人。

source: ...You know, Ophelia, I'm rather busy at the moment.
target: ……奥菲莉娅，你也知道，我现在很忙。

source: Perhaps we might discuss your, er, theories at a later date.
target: 或许我们可以改天再讨论你的，呃，这些推测。

source: Oh? The playmaster my wife invited? In what way?
target: 哦？我妻子邀请来的那个戏剧大师？具体怎么说？

source: It's hard to explain, but he's going to bring harm to you.
target: 这很难解释，但他会伤害您。

source: Father. Please believe me... Peter Quince intends to do you great harm.
target: 父亲。请相信我……彼得·奎因斯打算狠狠地伤害您。

source: Do you mean that funny little man the Queen invited to perform?
target: 你是说王后请来演出的那个滑稽的小个子？

source: He's far more than that. I believe he intends to harm all of us.
target: 他远不只是这样。我相信他打算伤害我们所有人。

source: Oh, my love—if you're worried, we'll have the guards watch after him more closely.
target: 哦，亲爱的——如果你担心，我们就让卫兵把他盯得紧些。

source: That won't be enough. We have to find a way to rid him from the castle.
target: 那还不够。我们必须想办法把他赶出城堡。

source: Is everything all right, love? You've begun to sound an awful lot like... well...
target: 亲爱的，你没事吧？你说起话来越来越像……实在太像……唉……

source: Like Hamlet.
target: 像哈姆雷特。

source: I think we're quite done with this discussion for now. You're worrying me.
target: 我想这件事暂时就谈到这里吧。你让我很担心。

source: My lady, I believe the Playmaster you invited means to sow dissent in the court.
target: 王后陛下，我相信您邀请来的戏剧大师想在宫廷中挑起纷争。

source: He ought to be removed from the castle immediately.
target: 应该立刻把他赶出城堡。

source: Peter Quince? Why... but I just saw Hamlet speaking with him earlier.
target: 彼得·奎因斯？怎么……可我刚才还看见哈姆雷特在跟他说话。

source: I haven't seen my son so excited in quite some time.
target: 我已经很久没见我儿子这么兴奋了。

source: What? That little man? He's only come to put on a frivolous play. And now, perhaps not even that.
target: 什么？那个小个子？他只是来演一出无关紧要的戏。而现在，或许连戏都演不成了。

source: How could he be sowing dissent, Ophelia?
target: 他怎么会挑起纷争呢，奥菲莉娅？

source: ...He... means to kill us all, my lady.
target: ……他……想杀了我们所有人，王后陛下。

source: You included.
target: 也包括您。

source: Laertes. Please listen to me. The Playmaster—Peter Quince—he intends to cause serious harm to us.
target: 雷欧提斯。请听我说。那个戏剧大师——彼得·奎因斯——他打算严重伤害我们。

source: Who is that?
target: 那是谁？

source: (Right. I'm too early.)
target: （对。我来得太早了。）

source: He's a performer. A loner. He often travels through Elsinore.
target: 他是个艺人。总是独来独往。他经常途经埃尔西诺。

source: I know the one you mean, I think, though it's been years. I-- I see. So you believe he's trying to hurt someone?
target: 我想我知道你说的是谁，不过已经过去好多年了。我——我明白了。所以，你认为他想伤害谁？

source: In what way?
target: 怎么伤害？

source: He's going to have you all killed.
target: 他会让人把你们全都杀了。

source: A coup?
target: 政变？

source: Yes! Yes, precisely! A coup of sorts—
target: 对！对，正是这样！算是一场政变——

source: Where are his men?
target: 他的人马在哪里？

source: It's just him. But he has... strange... powers. Unearthly abilities.
target: 只有他一个人。但他有……奇怪的……力量。超乎常人的能力。

source: Oh, no. I knew Hamlet was beginning to rub off on you.
target: 哦，不。我就知道你开始受哈姆雷特影响了。

source: Goodness, you gave me an honest fright. What a strange joke.
target: 天哪，你真把我吓了一跳。这玩笑可真奇怪。

source: I met Simona, and she revealed to me the true culprit - Peter Quince, the playmaster, is behind us being trapped in Elsinore.
target: 我见到了西蒙娜，她告诉了我谁是真正的罪魁祸首——戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯就是让我们困在埃尔西诺的幕后黑手。

source: Yes. Hamlet, you, and I shall act anon.
target: 是的。哈姆雷特、你和我，三人不久便会行动。

source: A ghost, a mad prince, and... you. What a trio we shall be.
target: 一个幽灵，一个疯王子，还有……你。我们这三人，倒真是个奇妙的组合。

source: Peter Quince? He is but flesh and blood. What ill can he do to you?
target: 彼得·奎因斯？他不过是血肉之躯。能对你造成什么伤害？

source: I can assure you I had a conversation with him where he most certainly proved he was not human.
target: 我可以向您保证，我和他谈过一次，那次谈话确凿无疑地证明了他不是人。

source: No. Impossible. Quince encouraged me to find the Book of Fates.
target: 不。不可能。奎因斯曾鼓励我寻找《命运之书》。

source: He urged me to find a way out using the Book as my guide...
target: 他劝我以那本书为指引，找一条出路……

source: Because he wanted it for himself. He tried to threaten me into handing it over. But I didn't give it to him.
target: 因为他想把书据为己有。他试图威胁我，逼我交出那本书。但我没有给他。

source: For what purpose could he desire such an artifact?
target: 他想要这样一件奇物，究竟有何目的？

source: Because he's trapped in this world--our world--until I use the Book of Fates and free us both. That's why he's been in Elsinore for so long.
target: 因为他被困在这个世界——我们的世界——只有我使用《命运之书》，我们两个才能获得自由。所以他才会在埃尔西诺待这么久。

source: Queen Astrid, you, me... none of us were able to use the Book and conclude his time in this world.
target: 阿斯特丽德王后、您、我……我们谁都没能使用那本书，结束他在这个世界的停留。

source: Until that happens, he'll only make new victims out of people in this castle.
target: 在那之前，他只会继续让城堡里的人沦为新的受害者。

source: He... and I... I've realized what this is. It's just like chess or cards. We're taking turns telling this story.
target: 他……和我……我已经明白这是怎么回事了。就像下棋或打牌一样。我们在轮流讲述这个故事。

source: I do something, and then he bends the story in his favor. Simona told me the world would constantly spin towards disaster. She was right.
target: 我做了什么，他就把故事扭向对他有利的方向。西蒙娜告诉我，这个世界会不断转向灾难。她说得没错。

source: But I... can't figure out why. What does he get out of tormenting us? Of setting up these situations where everything devolves into blood?
target: 可是我……想不通为什么。折磨我们，他能得到什么？布置这些局面，让一切最终演变成血腥惨剧，他又能得到什么？

source: And what's the point of it all if he's still trapped in this world regardless?
target: 如果他无论如何都仍被困在这个世界里，那这一切又有什么意义？

source: What? How?
target: 什么？怎么会？

source: Boredom can be quite frightening. Even I, who have been dead but a scarce several months, understand how frightening it is.
target: 无聊可以十分可怕。即使我才死了短短几个月，也明白它有多可怕。

source: Unable to truly die, yet unable to engage with human life...
target: 无法真正死去，却也无法参与活人的生活……

source: It is like standing outside a window, watching those inside gorge themselves on a feast. I press my hands against the glass nightly.
target: 就像站在窗外，看着里面的人在盛宴上大快朵颐。每到夜里，我都把双手贴在玻璃上。

source: But try as I might, I cannot join them. I have relinquished my seat at that table, and a wolf now sits in my place.
target: 可无论我怎么努力，也无法加入他们。我已让出了桌前的席位，如今坐在我位置上的是一匹狼。

source: Here I remain, bored out of my bones, lingering like refuse.
target: 我留在这里，无聊深入骨髓，像废物一样滞留不去。

source: I-if that's true, then Quince is only... being cruel. Deeply, horribly cruel.
target: 如、如果真是这样，那奎因斯只是……在作恶。残酷至极，令人发指。

source: Yes. Cruelty is one cure for that boredom. A route I myself was inspired to take. And now my son wages revenge on my behalf.
target: 是的。残酷是消解那种无聊的一剂药。我自己也曾受启发，走上这条路。如今，我的儿子正在替我复仇。

source: You and Hamlet must speak. You must tell him. He'll only believe all this if he hears it from your mouth. It sounds insane otherwise.
target: 您必须和哈姆雷特谈谈。您必须告诉他。只有听您亲口说出来，他才会相信这一切。换成别人说，听起来只会像疯话。

source: And once you have, perhaps the three of us can find a way to stop Quince for good.
target: 等您告诉他以后，也许我们三个就能找到办法，彻底阻止奎因斯。

source: Agreed. You must bring my son to me.
target: 好。你必须带我的儿子来见我。

source: Yes -- bring him here with those same words, and the three of us shall conspire to end Quince.
target: 是的——用同样的话把他带到这里，我们三人便可共同谋划，终结奎因斯。

source: I did not understand when you brought him to me in this world. But now I do. Try once more, Ophelia.
target: 你在这个世界把他带到我面前时，我还不明白。如今我明白了。再试一次，奥菲莉娅。

source: I am aware.
target: 我知道。

source: He must be dealt with. But we cannot let him know of our plans.
target: 必须对付他。但不能让他知道我们的计划。

source: What's the point of watching us suffer? Why? What does he get out of it?
target: 看着我们受苦有什么意义？为什么？他能从中得到什么？

source: I-if that's true, then he's... being cruel. Deeply, horribly cruel.
target: 如、如果真是这样，那他就是……在作恶。残酷至极，令人发指。

source: You won't succeed with this.
target: 你这样做是不会成功的。

source: And what is 'this,' precisely?
target: 你说的“这样”，具体是指什么？

source: Torturing me. Causing me to break down. I won't do it.
target: 折磨我。让我崩溃。我不会崩溃的。

source: They all say that. Such a tired line.
target: 他们都这么说。真是句陈词滥调。

source: Oh! Let me guess, your next line is—
target: 哦！让我猜猜，你下一句台词是——

source: 'I'll never give up! I have the power... of heart!'
target: “我永远不会放弃！我拥有……心的力量！”

source: Lord, what fools these mortals be.
target: 天哪，这些凡人何其愚蠢。

source: I don't think you'll ever see it my way.
target: 我想你永远也不会认同我的看法。

source: Which is a shame, because I crave fresh dialogue.
target: 真可惜，我可渴望听到点新鲜台词。

source: Bernardo, I need you to help me protect the castle against Peter Quince.
target: 贝尔纳多，我需要你帮我保护城堡，抵御彼得·奎因斯。

source: Peter Quince? What's wrong?
target: 彼得·奎因斯？怎么了？

source: He's going to have you all killed off.
target: 他会让人把你们全都杀掉。

source: Y-you wouldn't believe me if I told you. But he isn't human.
target: 你、就算我告诉你，你也不会相信我的。但他不是人。

source: I know things have been rather rough as of late.
target: 我知道最近日子很不好过。

source: But please. Try to sleep more and take excellent care of your health. I worry for you.
target: 但求你了。尽量多睡些，好好照顾身体。我很担心你。

source: You sound just like Hamlet. And right now, that is... perhaps... a liability of sorts.
target: 你说话简直和哈姆雷特一模一样。而眼下，这……或许……会给你带来些麻烦。

source: Why were you rummaging around in odd places? What are you hiding?
target: 你为什么在那些奇怪的地方翻来翻去？你在隐瞒什么？

source: Nothing. When I'm taken by surprise I sort of, ah, make strange noises.
target: 没什么。我一受到惊吓，就会有点，呃，发出奇怪的声音。

source: Please don't tell anyone about what you saw. It'll be such an embarrassment to Guildenstern and me.
target: 请别把你看到的事告诉任何人。那会让我和吉尔登斯吞很难堪。

source: We weren't up to anything nefarious. I promise. Just errands for, ah, a friend. Hrrk...
target: 我们没在干什么坏事。我保证。只是帮，呃，一个朋友跑腿。咳呃……

source: Why were you rummaging around in odd places? What are you up to?
target: 你为什么在那些奇怪的地方翻来翻去？你在干什么？

source: Hmm! Who wants ta' know?
target: 哼！谁想知道啊？

source: Me. I want to know.
target: 我。是我想知道。

source: Well, it's a secret!
target: 这是秘密！

source: I witnessed Lady Rosencrantz and Guildenstern rummaging around in odd places. You were saying, about a spy...?
target: 我亲眼看见罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士在一些奇怪的地方翻找。您之前说，有个间谍……？

source: (Could it be... they're loyal to another above me?)
target: （难道……她们效忠的另有其人，而且更甚于我？）

source: I'll ask Bernardo to interrogate them shortly. Thank you for your vigilance, Ophelia.
target: 我一会儿就让贝尔纳多审问她们。谢谢你的警觉，奥菲莉娅。

source: I saw Lady Rosencrantz and Guildenstern acting in a most peculiar way. Could they be the spies you're looking for?
target: 我看到罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士举止十分古怪。她们会不会就是你在找的间谍？

source: Although they are outsiders to Elsinore, they have been long-time friends of Hamlet's. And they appear to have little interest in Danish affairs.
target: 虽然她们对埃尔西诺来说是外人，但她们和哈姆雷特已经是多年的朋友了。而且，她们似乎对丹麦的事务没什么兴趣。

source: Or any affairs, anywhere, for that matter.
target: 说起来，她们对任何地方的任何事务都没什么兴趣。

source: I'll speak to them, at the very least. Thank you for your vigilance, Ophelia.
target: 至少我会找她们谈谈。谢谢你的警觉，奥菲莉娅。

source: Do you know why Queen Gertrude might be rummaging through her husband's things in secret?
target: 你知道乔特鲁德王后为什么会偷偷翻找她丈夫的东西吗？

source: I don't know what she might be looking for, if that's what you're asking.
target: 如果你是想问她可能在找什么，那我不知道。

source: But I... understand why she might not want to simply ask him directly.
target: 但我……能理解她为什么可能不愿直接去问他。

source: Let me only say that there are secrets between King Claudius and Queen Gertrude.
target: 我只能说，克劳狄斯国王和乔特鲁德王后之间有一些秘密。

source: I suspect all marriages are prone to a little secrecy here and there, perhaps.
target: 我想，或许每对夫妻之间都难免会有些小秘密。

source: I wouldn't know, never having been wed myself.
target: 我也说不准，毕竟我自己从没结过婚。

source: Your mother was searching through your uncle's belongings. Do you know what she might have been looking for?
target: 你母亲在翻找你叔叔的东西。你知道她可能是在找什么吗？

source: After all I've learned about her other schemes lately, I hardly care anymore.
target: 最近知道了她那么多其他的阴谋之后，我已经几乎不在乎了。

source: Proof, perhaps.
target: 也许是证据。

source: You mean of your father's murder?
target: 你是说，你父亲被谋杀的证据？

source: Yes. But I doubt her loyalties, and I doubt my assessment of those loyalties.
target: 对。但我怀疑她究竟站在哪一边，也怀疑自己对此的判断。

source: So I shall not speak to her of it.
target: 所以我不会跟她谈这件事。

source: Of something larger than either of us. But I doubt her loyalties, and I doubt my assessment of those loyalties.
target: 某件比我们任何一个人都更重大的事的证据。但我怀疑她究竟站在哪一边，也怀疑自己对此的判断。

source: So I shall not speak to her of it, lest I be revealed.
target: 所以我不会跟她谈这件事，以免暴露自己。

source: Queen Gertrude was looking through the King's personal belongings. I don't think he knew it was happening.
target: 乔特鲁德王后在翻看国王的私人物品。我觉得他并不知道这件事。

source: Well, only seems fair, considering I do that to her all the time. Her private diary is something special!
target: 嗯，倒也算公平，毕竟我总是这么翻她的东西。她的私人日记可真精彩！

source: Is it really wise of you to come out and admit that?
target: 你就这么直接承认，真的明智吗？

source: I'm bored to tears. All I do is wait on Gertrude and help her choose her next soiree gown. Where else am I supposed to find fulfillment?
target: 我都无聊得快哭了。我整天就是伺候乔特鲁德，帮她挑下一场晚宴的礼服。不然我还能从哪儿找点满足感呢？

source: My lady, I saw you looking through the King's personal belongings. I know.
target: 王后，我看到您在翻看国王的私人物品了。我知道这件事。

source: You-- you did?
target: 你——你看到了？

source: What were you doing, if you don't mind my asking?
target: 如果您不介意我问一句，您当时在做什么？

source: I do mind, in fact.
target: 事实上，我确实介意。

source: It was something very personal, Ophelia. Something I'd like my husband and I to keep between us.
target: 那是很私人的事，奥菲莉娅。我希望这件事只留在我和丈夫之间。

source: But rest assured, it was no threat to anyone. Not even to him.
target: 不过你放心，那不会威胁到任何人。连他也不会。

source: My lady told me of this. She is searching for something private. Something which was taken.
target: 王后跟我说过这件事。她在找一件私人物品。那东西被人拿走了。

source: Her husband promised her their life would be one of openness, of honesty, of communication.
target: 她丈夫曾向她承诺，两人的生活会坦诚相待，彼此诚实，互相沟通。

source: After so many years with Hamlet-- he was so terribly cold to her.
target: 她和哈姆雷特过了那么多年——他对她实在太冷漠了。

source: But Claudius lies to her now in just the same way. Is this the fate of all men with a little power?
target: 可如今克劳狄斯也一样对她撒谎。难道男人一旦有了点权力，就都注定会变成这样吗？

source: My lady is a powerful woman in her own right. She has the blood in her to rule empires. Why is she reduced to digging through a man's closet?
target: 王后本身就是一位有权势的女人。她的血统足以让她统治帝国。为什么她却沦落到翻找一个男人的衣柜？

source: I saw the Queen rummaging through your things.
target: 我看到王后在翻找您的东西。

source: Yes. Bernardo is addressing it anon. What comes of my wife's dealings is none of your business.
target: 是的。贝尔纳多很快就会处理。我妻子的所作所为会有什么结果，与你无关。

source: You saw my wife? You're certain?
target: 你看到了我的妻子？你确定？

source: As the day is long, my lord.
target: 千真万确，陛下。

source: How odd. I inquired with my wife directly, assuming she would naturally have been in my chambers. And yet, she denied it.
target: 真奇怪。我直接问过我的妻子，觉得她进过我的寝室也很正常。可她却否认了。

source: I'll... have Bernardo speak to her privately. This is... disconcerting.
target: 我会……让贝尔纳多私下找她谈谈。这真是……令人不安。

source: I saw the Queen rummaging through the King's things in an odd, hurried way.
target: 我看到王后在翻找国王的东西，举止古怪，动作很匆忙。

source: Yes. We're addressing it anon. The King is aware - fear not.
target: 是的。我们很快就会处理。国王已经知道了——别担心。

source: The Queen is the one who went through his private items?
target: 翻看他私人物品的人是王后？

source: But... he asked her directly, and she denied it..
target: 可是……他直接问过她，她却否认了……

source: Ophelia, this is a very serious allegation. If it's true...
target: 奥菲莉娅，这项指控非常严重。如果是真的……

source: Then it means the Queen has lied to her husband directly.
target: 那就意味着王后当面对她的丈夫撒了谎。

source: I must bring her in and ask her some questions, I think. I'll notify the King.
target: 我想，我必须把她带来，问她几个问题。我会通知国王。

source: I saw Bernardo sneaking out of the castle in the early morning hours. You were saying, about a spy...?
target: 我看到贝尔纳多在凌晨偷偷溜出了城堡。您之前提到，有个间谍……？

source: You saw that? Hah! No, you needn't worry about him.
target: 你看到了？哈！不，你用不着担心他。

source: Then where is he going, my lord?
target: 那他是要去哪儿，陛下？

source: Nowhere holy or wholesome. That's all you need to know.
target: 不是什么神圣或正经的地方。你知道这些就够了。

source: But I've nothing to fear from Bernardo. No—him least of all.
target: 但贝尔纳多没什么能让我害怕的。不——他是最不需要我担心的人。

source: I saw Bernardo sneaking out of the castle in the early morning hours.
target: 我看到贝尔纳多在凌晨偷偷溜出了城堡。

source: Yes. Well.
target: 是啊。嗯。

source: As far as all that, let's simply say it's none of our concern at the moment.
target: 关于这些事，就当它们暂时与我们无关吧。

source: Not unless Bernardo would like to discuss any of it further.
target: 除非贝尔纳多自己愿意再谈谈。

source: You mean... about Katherine?
target: 你是说……凯瑟琳的事？

source: Ah. So you've learned already.
target: 啊。原来你已经知道了。

source: I suspect it's been causing him no small amount of anguish.
target: 我想这件事一直让他很痛苦。

source: Luckily, all that will be resolved soon enough. Bernardo and I are planning to leave town.
target: 幸好，这些事很快就会解决了。贝尔纳多和我正打算离开镇子。

source: Please don't tell anyone.
target: 请别告诉任何人。

source: I won't. I'd suspected something like that might happen.
target: 我不会的。我之前就猜到可能会有这样的事。

source: If Katherine ever wants to express herself fully, she's going to need to do it somewhere better. Happier.
target: 如果凯瑟琳想要毫无保留地表达自己，就得去一个更好的地方。更快乐的地方。

source: Far away from this sad place.
target: 远离这个悲伤的地方。

source: Do you think it'd help Bernardo if someone went and spoke to him about all this?
target: 你觉得，要是有人去找贝尔纳多谈谈这些事，会对他有帮助吗？

source: Perhaps it's worth a try.
target: 也许值得一试。

source: You're the most even-keeled among us. If you can't make Bernardo's life easier, no one can.
target: 你是我们之中最沉稳的人。如果连你都没法让贝尔纳多好过一点，就没人能做到了。

source: I do declare, Ophelia. That's the nicest compliment anyone's ever paid me. I shall try to live up to it.
target: 哎呀，奥菲莉娅。这是我听过最好的赞美了。我会努力不辜负这番话。

source: I saw Bernardo sneaking out of the castle in the early morning hours. What do you know?
target: 我看到贝尔纳多在凌晨偷偷溜出了城堡。你知道些什么？

source: Ahhhh, feckin' hell! Only that he's up to no good!
target: 啊——他妈的！我只知道他没干什么好事！

source: He always makes me take 'is post in his place.
target: 他总让我替他站岗。

source: Dunno if it's wine, women, or that other 'w' word. What's the one...
target: 不知道他是去喝酒、找女人，还是干另一个词以“w”开头的事。那词叫什么来着……

source: ...Waltzing? Wealth?
target: ……跳华尔兹？发财？

source: Whortleberries! That's th' one.
target: 越橘！就是那个。

source: You don' know 'em? All the guards collect 'em in the forest. Then they make pies. We love 'em!
target: 你不知道那是什么？卫兵们都去林子里采，再拿来做派。我们可爱吃了！

source: Yeh haven't truly lived until you've had a whortleberry pie with a big ol' mug of whortleberry wine!
target: 没吃过越橘派，再配上一大杯越橘酒，那可真算白活了！

source: I'll have to take your word on that one.
target: 那我就姑且信你了。

source: Bernardo, I overheard some mention of your business in town.
target: 贝尔纳多，我无意中听到有人提起你在镇上的事。

source: Well, you know precisely what.
target: 嗯，你很清楚是什么事。

source: Oh. I suppose I do, don't I? It all makes sense, now.
target: 哦。我想我确实知道，对吧？现在一切都说得通了。

source: ...It's nothing very interesting. I can assure you of that.
target: ……没什么有趣的。我可以向你保证。

source: I would give you the details, but it's quite a long and boring story. It is in your best interest that I spare you.
target: 我本可以告诉你详情，但这故事又长又无聊。我还是不让你受这份罪了，这对你更好。

source: Have you seen the Guard Captain, Bernardo? Perhaps late in the evening?
target: 你见过卫队长贝尔纳多吗？也许是在深夜？

source: Yes. That person has amassed quite the name around here. A rare talent.
target: 见过。那人在这里已经很有名气了。难得的人才。

source: But I'm afraid that's all I'm able to say on the matter.
target: 但这件事恐怕我只能说这么多。

source: I saw my father burning some documents in his room. You were saying, about a spy...?
target: 我看到父亲在房间里烧一些文件。您之前提到，有个间谍……？

source: Documents? Of what origin?
target: 文件？从哪儿来的？

source: No... Hrm. It matters not. Whatever he has to hide... all roads must be pursued.
target: 不……嗯。这不重要。不管他有什么要隐瞒的……任何线索都必须追查。

source: I'll have Bernardo bring your father in for a conversation immediately.
target: 我会让贝尔纳多立刻把你父亲带来谈谈。

source: Yes, Bernardo made his treachery clear. I'm thankful that you caught him in the act.
target: 是的，贝尔纳多已经查明了他的背叛之举。多亏你当场发现了他。

source: Hopefully some time in a cell will give him a better understanding of his position.
target: 希望在牢房里待上一阵，能让他更清楚自己的处境。

source: Father, I know you were burning some secretive documents in your room. Can you explain why?
target: 父亲，我知道您在房间里烧了一些秘密文件。您能解释一下为什么吗？

source: I expected never to speak of them again. And now, I won't.
target: 我本以为再也不用提起它们了。现在，我也不会说。

source: Those horrid notes are gone forever. And good riddance.
target: 那些可怕的笔记已经永远消失了。没了才好。

source: Love, please don't tell anyone about what you saw. Please. It could mean my head.
target: 亲爱的，请别把你看到的事告诉任何人。求你了。这可能会让我掉脑袋。

source: (Ah. Right. He hasn't burned them yet in this world.)
target: （啊。对了。在这个世界里，他还没把它们烧掉。）

source: I don't know what you mean, my love. Don't worry your head over it.
target: 我不知道你在说什么，亲爱的。别为这事费心了。

source: I saw my father burning some documents in his room. The King was saying earlier, about a spy...?
target: 我看到父亲在房间里烧一些文件。国王之前提到，有个间谍……？

source: In and of itself, that's not troubling, but I'd like to see him about it regardless.
target: 这件事本身倒没什么可担心的，不过我还是想找他谈谈。

source: I'll bring him in for questioning immediately. Thank you for your attentiveness, Ophelia.
target: 我马上把他带来问话。谢谢你的细心，奥菲莉娅。

source: Laertes, I saw Father burning something in his chambers late at night. Notes of some sort. Do you know what they were?
target: 雷欧提斯，我看到父亲深夜在房间里烧东西。像是某种笔记。你知道那是什么吗？

source: I don't.
target: 不知道。

source: But do you not trust Father to know what is right in these matters?
target: 可你难道不相信父亲知道这些事该怎么处理吗？

source: I do, but-- I also think those notes contain something important.
target: 我相信，可是——我也觉得那些笔记里有重要的东西。

source: If you were to describe what you saw to the wrong people, it would put Father-- and both of us-- in grave danger.
target: 如果你把看到的事告诉了不该告诉的人，就会让父亲——还有我们两个——陷入极大的危险。

source: I understand you're curious, Ophelia. But family comes first. Whatever Father was doing, I'm certain he was correct to do so.
target: 我理解你的好奇心，奥菲莉娅。但家人最重要。不管父亲当时在做什么，我相信他那么做是对的。

source: What if you bring down suspicion upon him in this climate, and it turns out to have been nothing much at all? Won't you feel silly then?
target: 眼下这种局势，要是你让他遭到怀疑，结果发现根本没什么大不了的呢？到时你不会觉得自己很傻吗？

source: Bernardo would like to meet with you privately. Could you report to him, please?
target: 贝尔纳多想私下见你。麻烦你去找他，好吗？

source: This is very sudden... are you certain, my lady? I-if it is your request, of course...
target: 这太突然了……您确定吗，小姐？如、如果这是您的要求，那当然……

source: T...this is an insult! How dare he waste my time!
target: 这……这是羞辱！他怎么敢浪费我的时间！

source: I'm going to give him a piece of my mind.
target: 我要好好骂他一顿。

source: Ha. Yes, Ophelia, I'll play along.
target: 哈。好啊，奥菲莉娅，我就配合一下。

source: Come to think of it, I did see something strange. I'll tell him of it.
target: 说起来，我确实看到过一件怪事。我会告诉他的。

source: If he insists. Whatever can he want from me now?
target: 如果他坚持的话。他现在找我到底有什么事？

source: O-of course, at once! I must wonder... why he didn't come to me himself? Oh, bother it, never mind...
target: 当、当然，我马上去！不过我不明白……他为什么不亲自来找我？唉，算了，不管了……

source: Well, of course. I wonder what he's so keen about?
target: 嗯，当然。不知道他为什么这么急切？

source: Oh, 'sblood, what have I done now? Mus' be somethin' worth scoldin' me for...
target: 唉，该死，我这回又干了什么？肯定又有什么事要挨骂了……

source: Hah! I no longer take orders from you.
target: 哈！我已经不听你的命令了。

source: Charming... but I don't answer to you any more, love.
target: 真讨人喜欢……可我已经不归你管了，亲爱的。

source: If the good Guard Captain wishes it, then so may it be, of course. Hee hee!
target: 既然我们这位好卫队长有此意愿，那当然就照办。嘻嘻！

source: Really? The Guard Captain and I already spoke earlier today.
target: 是吗？今天早些时候，我已经和卫队长谈过了。

source: I think he's heard all he needs to from me today.
target: 我想，他今天需要从我这里听到的，都已经听到了。

source: Of course. Did he say what it was about?—Ah, I suppose it matters little. I'll see him shortly.
target: 当然。他说是什么事了吗？——啊，我想这也不重要。我一会儿就去见他。

source: Oh, goodness. Whatever have I done now?
target: 哎呀，天哪。我这回又做了什么？

source: Yes, of course, I'll find him when I'm able.
target: 好，当然，我有空就去找他。

source: We've already met him. Guilda dragged me along after you told her the same thing.
target: 我们已经见过他了。你跟吉尔达说了同样的话之后，她就拉着我一起去了。

source: We've already met him. Don't you remember? We went to prison.
target: 我们已经见过他了。你不记得了吗？我们都进监狱了。

source: I think we've been questioned quite enough.
target: 我觉得我们被盘问得够多了。

source: Tell him I didn't steal it! I was only, ahem, borrowing it indefinitely!
target: 告诉他，我没偷那东西！我只是，咳，无限期借用而已！

source: Steal what?
target: 偷什么？

source: Oh, so this isn't about any of the things I've pilfered?
target: 哦，所以这事跟我顺走的那些东西都没关系？

source: Guilda, you've only been in Elsinore for a little while. How many things did you borrow indefinitely?
target: 吉尔达，你来埃尔西诺才多久。你到底无限期借用了多少东西？

source: Guilda, you haven't even reached the castle yet. How many things did you borrow indefinitely?
target: 吉尔达，你甚至还没到城堡呢。你到底无限期借用了多少东西？

source: Hmm. I so hate doing sums in my head. Let's not worry about the precise numbers here.
target: 嗯。我最讨厌心算了。咱们就别纠结具体数字了。

source: Regardless, I shall meet with Bernardo whenever I can pencil the good Guard Captain into my busy schedule!
target: 总之，等我能从繁忙的日程里给这位好卫队长排出时间，就去见贝尔纳多！

source: Ummm... no, thank you.
target: 呃……不用了，谢谢。

source: I already met with him once, with Rosey. I've done my part!
target: 我已经和罗茜一起见过他一次了。我该做的都做了！

source: I even went to jail! Absolutely <i>no interest<i> in doing that again.
target: 我甚至还坐了牢！我绝对<i>不想<i>再来一次。

source: Horatio, do you know about Bernardo's performance career?
target: 霍拉旭，你知道贝尔纳多演出的事吗？

source: ...As Katherine, I mean. Bernardo plays a woman in town performances.
target: ……我是说，他扮演凯瑟琳的事。贝尔纳多在镇上的演出里扮演女人。

source: Oh, of course.
target: 哦，当然知道。

source: Isn't she just fantastic? I caught a show last week.
target: 她难道不是精彩极了吗？我上周看了一场演出。

source: How could you already know about it?
target: 你怎么早就知道了？

source: Honestly, Ophelia, I'm mildly offended you even have to ask. I adore the arts. And Elsinore is where culture goes to die.
target: 说真的，奥菲莉娅，你居然还要问，我都有点不高兴了。我热爱艺术。而埃尔西诺就是文化的坟墓。

source: Thus, I must go into town to satiate myself. Katherine's stage makeup is good, but it isn't that good.
target: 所以，我得去镇上满足一下自己。凯瑟琳的舞台妆容是不错，但也没好到那个地步。

source: I don't think she's ever noticed me among the crowd. I keep to myself.
target: 我想她从没在人群中注意到我。我一向不爱与人来往。

source: Well, Bernardo-- or Katherine-- is more than a little tormented over others finding out about this.
target: 嗯，贝尔纳多——或者说凯瑟琳——非常害怕别人知道这件事，为此备受煎熬。

source: So you... immediately... ran to... come tell me and everyone else you know?
target: 所以你……立刻……跑来……告诉我，还有你认识的所有人？

source: No! Well, you. I thought you might be able to help Bernardo, for precisely the reason you mentioned.
target: 没有！好吧，是告诉了你。我以为你能帮到贝尔纳多，正是因为你刚才说的那个原因。

source: I'm just trying to find someone Bernardo can talk to.
target: 我只是想找个能让贝尔纳多倾诉的人。

source: You've traveled all over and met all kinds of people. Have you ever met anyone like Bernardo?
target: 你走遍各地，见过各种各样的人。你遇到过像贝尔纳多这样的人吗？

source: Putting aside my utter disgust at you for the moment... yes, many a time.
target: 暂且放下我对你的极度厌恶……是的，遇到过很多次。

source: My dear, I have just the thing to cure this forlorn spirit. Allow me to handle this.
target: 亲爱的，我正好有办法抚慰这颗失落的心。交给我来处理吧。

source: May I speak with you?
target: 能和你谈谈吗？

source: About you as Katherine.
target: 关于你以凯瑟琳身份出现的事。

source: As I said before, please don't tell anyone anything, and let me handle the matter.
target: 我之前说过，请你什么都别告诉任何人，让我自己处理这件事。

source: I understand. And I'll heed that. But I'd like you to know something, too.
target: 我明白，也会听你的。不过，我也想让你知道一件事。

source: I also know this might seem sudden, and strange. But I want you to know once more that I have your back.
target: 我也知道，这可能显得很突然，很奇怪。但我想再告诉你一次，我会支持你。

source: And that I am, as always, your faithful friend. No matter how you want to be called.
target: 我也会一如既往，做你忠实的朋友。不管你希望别人怎么称呼你。

source: It's been a strange life, this one.
target: 我这一路活过来，真是奇怪啊。

source: I never meant for you to find out, truth be told.
target: 说实话，我从没打算让你知道。

source: I thought I could keep the two parts of me separated. As though we were different people.
target: 我以为能把自己的两面分开，就像我们是两个不同的人。

source: But the pressure of it felt like I was being ripped in two.
target: 可那种压力让我觉得，自己仿佛正被撕成两半。

source: No one can live like that forever.
target: 没有人能永远那样活下去。

source: I'm glad I can be honest with you, Ophelia. Thank you.
target: 能对你坦诚相待，我很高兴，奥菲莉娅。谢谢你。

source: Certainly. What about?
target: 当然。谈什么？

source: I know that you go by both Bernardo and Katherine.
target: 我知道你既用贝尔纳多这个名字，也用凯瑟琳这个名字。

source: I also know this might seem sudden, and strange. But I want you to know that I have your back.
target: 我也知道，这可能显得很突然，很奇怪。但我想让你知道，我会支持你。

source: I-I'm afraid I don't know what you mean. It's...
target: 我、我恐怕不明白你的意思。这……

source: Please, ah, please pardon me, Ophelia. But I really must go.
target: 请，啊，请原谅我，奥菲莉娅。但我真的得走了。

source: Whatever you think you saw, please don't tell anyone.
target: 不管你以为自己看到了什么，请别告诉任何人。

source: (Hmm. I don't think it was wise of me to spring the news like that.)
target: （嗯。我就这样突然把事情说出来，恐怕不太明智。）

source: Do you know where Bernardo goes at night?
target: 你知道贝尔纳多晚上去哪儿吗？

source: Is... it bad news?
target: 是……坏消息吗？

source: No. Merely worth sharing.
target: 不是。只是值得告诉你。

source: Bernardo performs in a theater troupe, where he performs as a woman: Katherine.
target: 贝尔纳多在一个剧团里演出，以女性身份登台，名叫凯瑟琳。

source: I often thought... well... er... suspected...
target: 我常常觉得……嗯……呃……怀疑……

source: Never mind it.
target: 算了，不说了。

source: I must speak to him immediately.
target: 我必须立刻和他谈谈。

source: Ahh, I see the news has broken at last. A good secret can only stay hidden so long!
target: 啊，看来消息终于传开了。一个有意思的秘密，总归藏不了太久！

source: Yes, I've been keeping the good captain's dirty little secret under hat. But really, Lady Ophelia, I was doing him a service.
target: 没错，我一直替咱们这位好队长守着他那见不得人的小秘密。不过说真的，奥菲莉娅小姐，我是在帮他。

source: Can you imagine the fresh hell it would raise if Marcellus and the other guards found out? Or his friends?
target: 你能想象，要是马塞勒斯和其他卫兵知道了，会闹出多大的乱子吗？或者他的朋友们知道了呢？

source: If I really wanted to shame Bernardo, I would have told the other men a long time ago.
target: 如果我真想让贝尔纳多蒙羞，早就告诉其他男人了。

source: Who do you think you can trust with something like that, girl? I implore you to find out, both to sate your curiosity and mine.
target: 姑娘，你觉得这种事能放心告诉谁？我恳请你去弄清楚，也好满足你我的好奇心。

source: ...The bar?
target: ……酒馆？

source: Ah, no, never mind it. I forgot he'd given up drink a while back. That pious fool. Honestly.
target: 啊，不，算了。我忘了他前阵子已经戒酒了。那个虔诚的傻瓜。真是的。

source: He performs with an amateur theater troupe in town, as a woman. Katherine.
target: 他在镇上的一个业余剧团演出，以女性身份登台。名叫凯瑟琳。

source: One of those sorts of players?
target: 他是那种演员？

source: How did he never... how did I never know?
target: 他怎么从来没……我怎么一直都不知道？

source: I wish I had time to discuss this with him, but my ship is about to depart.
target: 真希望我有时间和他谈谈这件事，可我的船就要开了。

source: Still, sister, I urge you to be silent on this matter.
target: 不过，妹妹，我劝你别把这件事说出去。

source: And he never told me. No. I won't stand for it.
target: 而他从没告诉过我。不行。我不能接受。

source: I must speak with him as soon as possible.
target: 我必须尽快和他谈谈。

source: Bernardo believes there might be a spy in the castle. What do you know?
target: 贝尔纳多认为城堡里可能有间谍。你知道些什么？

source: Well, there's Guilda and I. The King asked us to sort of keep an eye on Hamlet.
target: 嗯，吉尔达和我就是啊。国王让我们稍微留意一下哈姆雷特。

source: I mean something more nefarious. An attempt by Norway to meddle in Danish affairs, that sort of thing.
target: 我指的是更险恶的事。比如挪威企图干涉丹麦事务之类的。

source: Oh. Well, Guilda likes to pretend to be a multinational spy at inns when she's had too much to drink...
target: 哦。嗯，吉尔达喝多了的时候，喜欢在旅店里假装自己是个为好几个国家效力的间谍……

source: It hasn't exactly made us many friends.
target: 这可没让我们交到多少朋友。

source: But I don't think that's what you mean here. So no, I've not heard anything, but shall let you know if I do.
target: 不过，我想你说的不是这个。所以，没有，我没听说什么，但要是听说了，我会告诉你的。

source: Me! It's me!
target: 我！就是我！

source: Yes, I'm the Norwegian spy! I just couldn't help but lend myself to Norway's cause.
target: 没错，我就是挪威间谍！我实在忍不住要为挪威效力。

source: On account of Prince Fortinbras being so dre-e-e-eamy, and all. I'd kill a hundred men for him!
target: 还不是因为福丁布拉斯王子太——迷——人——了。我愿意为他杀一百个人！

source: Guilda, this isn't a make-believe scenario.
target: 吉尔达，这不是在玩假装游戏。

source: Oh. It isn't?
target: 哦。不是吗？

source: Well, then. That's no fun. I thought we were pretending.
target: 那好吧。真没意思。我以为我们是在玩假装游戏呢。

source: Hmm, speaking of pretending...
target: 嗯，说到假装……

source: Don't forget that once I start hiding, you'll need to invite absolutely everyone to my funeral!
target: 别忘了，等我开始躲起来，你得把所有人都请来参加我的葬礼！

source: Show me someone who isn't a spy in this castle, and I'll show you a fool or a corpse.
target: 你在这座城堡里找个不是间谍的人给我看看，我就能指出一个傻瓜，或者一具尸体。

source: Very funny. But truly--have you seen anything... suspicious?
target: 真好笑。不过说正经的——你有没有看到什么……可疑的事？

source: If I had, that would be our good friend Bernardo's little problem, wouldn't it?
target: 就算有，那也是我们那位好朋友贝尔纳多该操心的小问题，不是吗？

source: Although, come to think of it...
target: 不过，这么一想……

source: It's likely nothing. Something odd. I'll speak to Bernardo about it when I can.
target: 大概没什么。就是有件怪事。等有机会，我会跟贝尔纳多谈谈。

source: Bernardo believes a spy may be hiding in Elsinore. What do you know?
target: 贝尔纳多认为可能有间谍藏在埃尔西诺。你知道些什么？

source: Oh, of course! Ask the dark-skinned outsider what he knows of spies and treachery.
target: 哦，那当然！问问这个肤色深的外乡人，看他对间谍和背叛知道些什么。

source: I... I didn't mean it that way, Horatio. I merely wanted to know if you had information I didn't.
target: 我……我不是那个意思，霍拉旭。我只是想知道，你有没有我不知道的消息。

source: My apologies, Ophelia. I'm a bit on edge. I can sense the bluebloods of this castle looking at me sidelong and clutching their bosoms with fear.
target: 抱歉，奥菲莉娅。我有点紧张。我能感觉到，这座城堡里的贵族都在斜眼打量我，吓得捂住胸口。

source: Luckily, the good Bernardo believes I'm pure of heart... for now. And as he's running the investigation, his opinion is the only one that matters.
target: 幸好，好心的贝尔纳多相信我心地纯良……至少目前如此。而且调查由他负责，只有他的看法才重要。

source: Still, if you haven't spoken to him, perhaps you ought to. Just to set your mind at ease.
target: 不过，如果你还没跟他谈过，也许应该去谈谈。就当让自己安心。

source: Bernardo believes a foreign spy may be embedded in Elsinore. What do you know?
target: 贝尔纳多认为可能有外国间谍潜伏在埃尔西诺。你知道些什么？

source: Why must the spy be foreign? Why not someone with hatred of the throne?
target: 为什么间谍一定是外国人？为什么不能是个憎恨王室的人？

source: Many would see a knife in my lady's back. Many would slit her husbands' throats.
target: 有很多人巴不得看到王后背上插着一把刀。也有很多人想割断她历任丈夫的喉咙。

source: Many people wanted my lady dead, I'm certain, for the simple reason of her station.
target: 我敢肯定，很多人想要王后的命，仅仅因为她的身份地位。

source: But the true threat is under their very noses, in the last place they look.
target: 可真正的威胁就在他们眼皮底下，在他们最不会去查的地方。

source: And who might that be?
target: 那会是谁呢？

source: My lady listens to nothing I say... but that boy... he will be the end of her. And Claudius, too.
target: 王后对我的话一句也听不进去……可那个孩子……他会害死她的。还有克劳狄斯。

source: My lady listens to nothing I say... but that boy... he will be the end of her.
target: 王后对我的话一句也听不进去……可那个孩子……他会害死她的。

source: Who is to say where the boy goes at night and to whom he speaks? He's friends with that snake-whisperer of a scholar, that Horatio!
target: 谁知道那孩子晚上去哪儿，又跟谁说话？他还跟那个耍蛇的学者，那个霍拉旭，是朋友！

source: What are the two of them doing constantly? That's what I want to know!
target: 他们两个整天都在干什么？这才是我想知道的！

source: Bernardo believes a spy in Elsinore. Have you seen anything amiss?
target: 贝尔纳多认为埃尔西诺有间谍。您有没有发现什么不对劲的地方？

source: I... I'm afraid I try not to think about these sorts of things right now, Ophelia.
target: 我……恐怕我现在正尽量不去想这类事情，奥菲莉娅。

source: If you've seen anything amiss...
target: 如果你发现了什么不对劲的地方……

source: Then I urge you to go to Captain Bernardo and tell him, of course. That's his profession—not mine.
target: 那我当然劝你去找贝尔纳多队长，告诉他。这是他的职责——不是我的。

source: Of course, my lady.
target: 当然，王后陛下。

source: I've heard the news about a spy in Elsinore. What do you know?
target: 我听说埃尔西诺有间谍。你知道些什么？

source: Ah. You've heard of that already? Did Voltemand tell you?
target: 啊。你已经听说了？是伏尔提曼德告诉你的？

source: Despite how worrying it may sound, I feel certain the danger to you is very little, my lady.
target: 小姐，虽然这消息听起来可能很令人担忧，但我确信，你面临的危险很小。

source: I don't care about that. I want information. What can you tell me?
target: 我不在乎那个。我想要消息。你能告诉我什么？

source: It is an ongoing investigation. At the moment, it is up to myself and my men to get to the bottom of it.
target: 调查还在进行。目前，要由我和我的手下查清真相。

source: I never expected to need to arrest your father, of all people. So this really is a strange and sensitive circumstance.
target: 我从没想到，需要逮捕的竟然会是你的父亲。所以，这确实是个反常又敏感的情况。

source: I never expected to need to arrest Hamlet's schoolmates, of all people. So this really is a strange and sensitive circumstance.
target: 我从没想到，需要逮捕的竟然会是哈姆雷特的同窗。所以，这确实是个反常又敏感的情况。

source: I've been asking all with suspicious information to report it to me. That is—if you think someone knows something about all this...
target: 我一直要求所有掌握可疑线索的人向我报告。也就是说——如果你觉得有人知道这件事的内情……

source: Tell them I've requested a meeting with them.
target: 就告诉他们，我要求与他们见面。

source: I'll interrogate them further. Politely, of course.
target: 我会进一步审问他们。当然，会很客气。

source: My lord, I'd like to discuss the rumors of a spy in Elsinore Castle.
target: 陛下，我想谈谈埃尔西诺城堡里有间谍的传闻。

source: A spy?
target: 间谍？

source: Pah hah hah! Wherever did you hear a story like that?
target: 哈，哈哈！你到底是从哪儿听来这种故事的？

source: (Ah, right. He hasn't found out about it yet.)
target: （啊，对。他还不知道这件事。）

source: Yes? And what of them?
target: 是吗？那些传闻又怎么了？

source: Have you seen something awry?
target: 你发现什么不对劲的事了吗？

source: If you have cause for suspicion, speak to Captain Bernardo immediately. He has my explicit trust in handling this matter swiftly.
target: 如果你有理由怀疑，就立刻去找贝尔纳多队长。我完全相信他能迅速处理此事。

source: Bernardo's found the traitor. I think that puts an end to the matter for the time being. Don't you?
target: 贝尔纳多已经找到了叛徒。我想，这件事暂时就算了结了。你不觉得吗？

source: What news are you talking about? You're making that up, aren't you?
target: 你说的是什么消息？是你编的吧？

source: Classic. Your life is so boring, you have to invent some flair.
target: 又是这套。你的生活太无聊，只好编点花样出来。

source: (Ah, right. No one in the castle knows about the spy yet.)
target: （啊，对。城堡里还没人知道间谍的事。）

source: As much as you do, 'Feely.
target: 跟你知道的一样多，菲莉。

source: I must admit, Claudius's constant paranoia gets tiresome. I don't know how the Queen stands it!
target: 我得承认，克劳狄斯整天疑神疑鬼，实在让人厌烦。真不知道王后是怎么受得了的！

source: Powerful men can be so odd. Did you hear about the last King of England? Some said he was madder than Hamlet.
target: 有权势的男人有时真是古怪。你听说过上一任英格兰国王的事吗？有人说他比哈姆雷特还疯。

source: He even had his pretty young wife killed. In public! With the way Claudius has been carrying on lately...
target: 他甚至命人杀了自己年轻漂亮的妻子。当众杀的！看克劳狄斯最近这副样子……

source: Anyhow, isn't it Bernardo's occupation to worry about such things? Bother him, why don't you?
target: 不管怎么说，操心这些事不就是贝尔纳多的职责吗？你干吗不去烦他？

source: Father, I heard the worrying news about a spy in the castle.
target: 父亲，我听说城堡里有间谍，这消息让人很担心。

source: A spy? Where? Who told you?
target: 间谍？在哪儿？谁告诉你的？

source: (Ah. Right. Morning court hasn't happened yet—they don't know.)
target: （啊。对。早上的朝会还没开——他们还不知道。）

source: I, er, overheard Bernardo discussing it.
target: 我，呃，无意中听到贝尔纳多在谈这件事。

source: I see. I certainly find the notion very interesting, but not substantial as of yet.
target: 明白了。我确实觉得这个说法很有意思，不过目前还没有实据。

source: You don't think there's a spy going around after all?
target: 这么说，您不认为真的有间谍在活动？

source: Oh... I'm not saying that necessarily, dearest. Everyone's on high alert lately. Suspicions are running high.
target: 哦……我也不完全是这个意思，亲爱的。最近大家都高度警惕，疑心也很重。

source: I find it odd, but not noteworthy unless some evidence turns up to reinforce this rumor.
target: 我觉得这事古怪，但除非出现证据支持这个传闻，否则还不值得重视。

source: Regardless, if you see anything concerning, I urge you to speak with the good guard captain Bernardo about this. He can put your mind at ease.
target: 无论如何，如果你发现什么令人担忧的事，我劝你去找那位可靠的卫队长贝尔纳多谈谈。他能让你安心。

source: Hamlet is going to try to overthrow Grace and escape. He intends for you and Guilda to perish.
target: 哈姆雷特将会试图推翻格蕾丝，逃出去。他打算让你和吉尔达丧命。

source: What? That couldn't be so.
target: 什么？不可能吧。

source: Although, given Hamlet's mood swings as of late...
target: 不过，想想哈姆雷特最近的情绪起伏……

source: I suppose it wouldn't be surprising. How can you know this?
target: 我想，这也不算奇怪。你怎么会知道这件事？

source: He told me himself. He asked that I be ready to escape with him.
target: 他亲口告诉我的。他让我做好准备，跟他一起逃走。

source: Evidently he really has forgotten us.
target: 看来，他确实把我们忘了。

source: Thank you for informing us. We'll keep a close watch.
target: 谢谢你告诉我们。我们会密切留意。

source: Hamlet is going to try to overthrow Grace and escape. He intends for you and Rosencrantz to perish.
target: 哈姆雷特将会试图推翻格蕾丝，逃出去。他打算让你和罗森克兰兹丧命。

source: What? How d'you know that?
target: 什么？你怎么知道的？

source: Y-you think he'd let us die?
target: 你、你觉得他会让我们死？

source: But... he's our friend!
target: 可是……他是我们的朋友啊！

source: This was all supposed to be a relaxing trip. But all of us might die... how's anyone supposed to relax like that?
target: 这本来应该是一次轻松的旅行。可我们所有人都可能会死……这样还叫人怎么放松？

source: It's murder on all sides, Ophelia. It's murder soup. Served ice cold!
target: 到处都是谋杀，奥菲莉娅。简直是一锅谋杀汤。端上来还是冰凉的！

source: Even on the open sea, everyone's trying to have everyone else killed.
target: 就算到了茫茫大海上，大家还是想方设法要让别人送命。

source: I felt you ought to know, in the interest of protecting yourself.
target: 我觉得应该让你知道，好保护自己。

source: Thanks for telling me. Rosie and I will keep a look-out.
target: 谢谢你告诉我。萝茜和我会留意的。

source: So. This plan of yours.
target: 那么。说说你这个计划。

source: Can you not clear up any misconceptions with Lady Rosencrantz and Lady Guildenstern?
target: 你就不能和罗森克兰兹女士、吉尔登斯吞女士把误会解释清楚吗？

source: Misconceptions? Ophelia, they were carrying my death warrant.
target: 误会？奥菲莉娅，她们带着的是我的处决令。

source: I can bear no further trust for them.
target: 我再也无法信任她们了。

source: They seem so... guileless. How could they be plotting your death?
target: 她们看起来那么……毫无心机。怎么会密谋害死你呢？

source: All women seem so guileless. Hardly any are truly as harmless as they seem.
target: 女人看起来都那么单纯。可几乎没有谁真的像表面上那样无害。

source: They may seem like idle gossips, but there's steel in both of them. I'm keeping my distance.
target: 她们看着也许只是闲来搬弄是非，但两个人都不是软柿子。我会离她们远点。

source: Keep an eye out. My mutiny begins shortly.
target: 留意着吧。我的兵变很快就要开始了。

source: About what?
target: 关于什么？

source: I know about the plan you're hatching. The one to overthrow Grace.
target: 我知道你正在酝酿的计划。就是推翻格蕾丝的那个。

source: How, exactly, can you know that?
target: 你到底是怎么知道的？

source: You're not as opaque as you think you are.
target: 你没有自己以为的那么难看透。

source: I also suspect your contingency plan. You'd trade my life for Rosie and Guilda's if it came to it, wouldn't you?
target: 我也猜到了你的后备计划。真到了那一步，你会拿我的命换萝茜和吉尔达的命，对不对？

source: Well, of course.
target: 那当然。

source: But if you've come here to dissuade me, you won't change my mind about that.
target: 不过，如果你是来劝阻我的，这件事上你改变不了我的心意。

source: Prince Hamlet has a plan to retaliate against you violently. I'd be willing to share details...
target: 哈姆雷特王子计划用暴力报复你。我愿意告诉你详情……

source: Does he, now? Do tell.
target: 他真有这打算？说来听听。

source: I see. Fascinatin'. Thank yeh much, lady.
target: 明白了。真有意思。多谢你，女士。

source: I've much respect for those whose hearts I can trust. I won' forget this.
target: 我很敬重那些真心值得信赖的人。这件事我不会忘。

source: I heard you speaking of your adventures. Can you... tell me more?
target: 我听见你讲自己的冒险经历了。你能……再给我讲讲吗？

source: Certainly. Though I must admit, the bulk of my tales are to an audience.
target: 当然。不过我得承认，我的故事大多是讲给一群听众的。

source: I'll have to charge you a very steep price if you want a private story.
target: 如果你想让我单独给你讲故事，那我可得收个非常高的价钱。

source: I've got a little coin on me—
target: 我身上带了点钱——

source: I was talking about your company and private conversation. The attention of a fair woman is all the prize in the world.
target: 我说的是你的陪伴，还有私下聊聊。能得到一位美丽女子的关注，就胜过世间所有奖赏。

source: I... that wouldn't be proper. We haven't even met before.
target: 我……这不太合适吧。我们以前都没见过。

source: What's to know? I'm Othello, humble barkeep. And you, of course, are the lady Ophelia—I've seen your brother, too.
target: 还有什么需要了解的？我是奥赛罗，一个不起眼的酒馆老板。而你，自然就是奥菲莉娅小姐——我也见过你哥哥。

source: Why should the black sheep not flock together?
target: 不合群的黑羊，为什么不能聚在一起呢？

source: Ah... I didn't know I was so well-known.
target: 啊……我还不知道自己这么出名。

source: Of course. And the subject of some mystery, too! Hardly anyone in town has laid eyes on you. And now I've met you for myself.
target: 当然。你还挺神秘呢！镇上几乎没人见过你。现在，我也终于亲自见到你了。

source: If the sad old tales of a washed-up sailor are of interest to one as fair as you, come see me at midnight, when the bar closes.
target: 如果你这样美丽的女子，对一个落魄水手那些伤感的旧事感兴趣，就在午夜酒馆打烊时来找我吧。

source: We'll speak further then.
target: 我们到时再聊。

source: I hear you've been beset by thugs as of late.
target: 听说你最近被一伙恶棍缠上了。

source: It would appear my fortune has quickly changed.
target: 看来我的运气这么快就转好了。

source: I was warned that the castle guard has decided to make their presence known in town, in order to protect me.
target: 有人提前告诉我，城堡卫兵决定到镇上露露面，好保护我。

source: Rumor has it a young noblewoman pleaded my case to them. I wonder who that might be?
target: 传闻说，有位年轻的贵族小姐替我向他们求了情。不知道会是谁呢？

source: If you'd be so inclined, I'd like to speak with you in private later this evening.
target: 如果你愿意，今晚晚些时候，我想和你私下聊聊。

source: Both to extend my deepest gratitude... and to get to know the fair woman to whom I owe my life and limb.
target: 既是为了表达我最深的谢意……也想认识一下那位保住了我的性命，让我免受伤害的美丽女子。

source: The bar closes at midnight. Meet me then.
target: 酒馆午夜打烊。到时候来找我。

source: I'll make do.
target: 我会想办法撑下去。

source: That wasn't what I asked. Haven't you asked the city guard for assistance?
target: 我问的不是这个。你没找城镇卫兵帮忙吗？

source: You should well know, my lady, that the guard doesn't help people like us.
target: 小姐，你应该很清楚，卫兵不会帮我们这种人。

source: To them, we look better smeared beneath their heels.
target: 在他们眼里，我们被碾在他们脚底下才更顺眼。

source: I... Listen. I know some of them personally. Maybe they'll help me.
target: 我……听我说。我认识他们当中的一些人。也许他们会帮我。

source: Othello the Barkeep seems to be in trouble.
target: 酒馆老板奥赛罗好像遇到麻烦了。

source: Yes. It's been that way nearly ever since he moved here.
target: 是啊。几乎从他搬来这里开始，就一直这样。

source: Vile insects that won't leave the poor man alone!
target: 一群恶心的臭虫，死活不肯放过那个可怜人！

source: Their violence upon him is new, and I fear it will grow worse. But Castle Town is an outside world.
target: 他们最近才开始对他动手，我怕会越来越严重。可城堡镇是外面的世界。

source: I do not meddle in its affairs, nor it in mine.
target: 我不干涉那里的事，那里也不干涉我的事。

source: But don't you think there's some way we could help him?
target: 可你不觉得，我们总能想个办法帮他吗？

source: Something-- anything?
target: 做点什么——什么都好？

source: The good Guard Captain may have the answer you seek.
target: 那位好心的卫队长，也许能给你想要的答案。

source: Bernardo demonstrates remarkable softness whenever it comes to your requests.
target: 每次你提出请求，贝尔纳多总是格外心软。

source: Othello's in trouble. Can you help?
target: 奥赛罗遇到麻烦了。你能帮忙吗？

source: Me? What do you think I can do?
target: 我？你觉得我能做什么？

source: You could help defend his inn. I've seen you fight. You were a soldier once.
target: 你可以帮忙守住他的旅店。我见过你打斗。你以前当过兵。

source: O-Ophelia, that isn't how this works.
target: 奥、奥菲莉娅，事情不是这么简单的。

source: I'm no Dane. I'm merely passing through. Inviting that kind of attention could be very dangerous for me.
target: 我不是丹麦人。我只是路过。引来那样的关注，对我可能很危险。

source: Othello's a good man, and I care for him greatly, and he serves good wine, but...
target: 奥赛罗是个好人，我很关心他，他的酒也很好，可是……

source: But you're afraid to get involved.
target: 可是你不敢插手。

source: Yes. And so should you be.
target: 是的。你也该有所顾忌。

source: Othello's in trouble. Can you assist?
target: 奥赛罗遇到麻烦了。你能帮帮他吗？

source: Oh, my, no. What do I look like to you? A personal army?
target: 哎呀，不行。你把我当什么了？你的私人军队吗？

source: I've never even held a weapon before. It is my belief that the pointed side goes outwards...
target: 我以前连武器都没拿过。我想，尖的那头应该朝外……

source: But one can never truly be certain, can they?
target: 可谁也没法完全确定，对吧？

source: I fear Othello will simply have to work out his woes on his own.
target: 恐怕奥赛罗只能自己解决那些烦心事了。

source: What would you like me to do?
target: 你想让我做什么？

source: Help me find someone who can make sure Othello's bar is defended.
target: 帮我找个能确保奥赛罗的酒馆有人保护的人。

source: Ah. Well. Allow me to share this helpful technique for doing just that.
target: 啊。好吧。我来告诉你一个管用的办法，正好能做到这一点。

source: Whenever I'm in need of assistance, I simply go to the most crowded location I can find.
target: 每当我需要帮助时，我就去找我能找到的人最多的地方。

source: Then I lie face down on the ground, and I scream.
target: 然后脸朝下趴在地上，尖叫。

source: It's had a one hundred percent success rate of people inquiring as to whether I need help.
target: 这样每次都会有人来问我是不是需要帮助，成功率百分之百。

source: I-- I don't think this is the kind of help they mean.
target: 我——我觉得他们说的不是这种帮助。

source: Really? I've never said 'yes' before, so I wouldn't know. The pure joy of the cry for help is enough for me.
target: 真的？我从没回答过“是”，所以我也不知道。光是呼救带来的纯粹快乐，就足够让我满足了。

source: Othello the Barkeep has been beset by thugs. He needs assistance from the Castle.
target: 酒馆老板奥赛罗被一伙恶棍缠上了。他需要城堡这边的帮助。

source: Wah! That sorry ol' man's twice a thug over himself!
target: 什么！那个糟老头自己就是个恶棍，比他们还恶劣一倍！

source: The way I see it, innocent people in Castle Town are being threatened and have no recourse.
target: 在我看来，城堡镇的无辜百姓正受到威胁，却求助无门。

source: M'lady, we don't... ah... get involved in those kinds o' matters.
target: 小姐，我们不……呃……不插手这种事。

source: Marcellus, please. I'm begging you to get involved in this one. He needs help.
target: 马塞勒斯，拜托。我求你管一管这件事。他需要帮助。

source: F-f-fine! Fine. Stop lookin' at me wiv those big green eyes! Yer just like yer damn mother!
target: 好、好、好吧！好吧。别用那双绿色的大眼睛盯着我了！你跟你那该死的母亲简直一模一样！

source: Othello, the barkeep in town, has been beset by thugs. Can't you do anything?
target: 镇上的酒馆老板奥赛罗被一伙恶棍缠上了。你就不能做点什么吗？

source: We don't ordinarily have jurisdiction over the town.
target: 通常情况下，镇上不归我们管。

source: I know Othello. He ought to ask his local guards for protection.
target: 我认识奥赛罗。他应该找当地卫兵保护他。

source: He's tried. None of them will stand by him.
target: 他试过了。他们没一个愿意帮他。

source: And how did you hear about this man's case, exactly? How do you know Othello?
target: 你到底是怎么听说这个人的事的？你又是怎么认识奥赛罗的？

source: I... he... well...
target: 我……他……这个……

source: Ophelia! You've been rummaging around in town alone? With that barkeep?
target: 奥菲莉娅！你居然一个人在镇上到处乱逛？还跟那个酒馆老板来往？

source: Well, now I'm obligated to send Marcellus down for your own safety, if you're making friends with criminals.
target: 好吧，既然你在和罪犯交朋友，为了你的安全，我现在不得不派马塞勒斯过去了。

source: My lady, be aware you are making things very difficult for all of us.
target: 小姐，你要知道，你这样让我们所有人都很为难。

source: Be safe. Please.
target: 注意安全。拜托了。

source: I will. You have my word. I just want to make sure he's all right.
target: 我会的。我保证。我只是想确保他没事。

source: My lord, you know of Hamlet's affections for me. Do you bear me any ill will as a result?
target: 陛下，您知道哈姆雷特对我的感情。您会因此对我怀有恶意吗？

source: Wah hah hah! No. I care not a whit what Hamlet feels on this front. His feelings don't factor in here.
target: 哇哈哈哈！不会。哈姆雷特在这方面有什么感受，我一点也不在乎。这件事不需要考虑他的感情。

source: In fact, I'm about to arrange a suitable match for him with Lady Birgitta.
target: 事实上，我正要为他和比尔吉塔女士安排一桩合适的婚事。

source: We've been holding back on the betrothal because of the war effort, but we should move quickly now that we have reached tentative peace.
target: 为了战事，我们一直推迟订婚，但既然如今达成了暂时的和平，就该尽快推进了。

source: In fact, I was about to arrange a match between Hamlet and Lady Birgitta, before she proved herself a liar.
target: 事实上，在比尔吉塔女士暴露出骗子的真面目之前，我正要安排她和哈姆雷特的婚事。

source: There are, of course, other suitable candidates in the wings.
target: 当然，还有其他合适的人选等着呢。

source: None of them you, naturally.
target: 自然，其中没有你。

source: Well, no, of course not. Right now, I trust you implicitly. How could I ever mean to do you harm?
target: 啊，不，当然不会。现在，我对你毫无保留地信任。我怎么可能想伤害你呢？

source: I didn't think so.
target: 我也觉得不会。

source: My lady, you know of Hamlet's affections for me. Do you believe the King finds me inconvenient?
target: 王后陛下，您知道哈姆雷特对我的感情。您觉得国王认为我碍事吗？

source: What? No! Absolutely not!
target: 什么？不！绝对不会！

source: Ophelia... it hurts my heart to hear you even suggest such a thing.
target: 奥菲莉娅……听见你竟然有这样的想法，我就很心痛。

source: Please, don't take it as an offense that he disapproves of a union between you and my son.
target: 请别因为他不赞成你和我儿子的婚事，就觉得他是在冒犯你。

source: He is trying to make the best match possible, and we have only one heir, after all. It can sometimes be an inscrutable process.
target: 他是在尽力安排最好的婚事，毕竟我们只有一个继承人。这个过程有时确实让人难以理解。

source: In fact, my husband is about to arrange a suitable match for him with Lady Birgitta.
target: 事实上，我丈夫正要为他和比尔吉塔女士安排一桩合适的婚事。

source: He'll arrange for a meeting between them soon.
target: 他很快就会安排他们见面。

source: Brit, do you believe King Claudius truly wants me dead because of my prior relationship with Hamlet?
target: 布莉特，你觉得克劳狄斯国王真的会因为我以前和哈姆雷特的关系，就想要我死吗？

source: Since you know the truth about me -- No. Not a chance. Who told you that rubbish?
target: 既然你知道了我的真相——不。不可能。谁告诉你这种鬼话的？

source: Well, you did, to my brother. Offhand.
target: 是你啊。你跟我哥哥随口提过。

source: Hmm. Did I? That was to persuade him, I think.
target: 嗯。我说过吗？我想，那是为了说服他吧。

source: But no -- I don't believe that for an instant. Claudius is far too dull to play chess like that.
target: 不过，不——我一点也不信。克劳狄斯太迟钝了，下不出那样的棋。

source: No, 'Feely, I have-- had, at least-- a special monopoly on wanting you dead.
target: 不，菲莉，想要你死这件事，一直是我独有的特权——至少以前是。

source: I think you're safe for the time being. I seem to have lost my nerve.
target: 我想你暂时是安全的。我似乎没那个胆量了。

source: Maybe. Maybe not.
target: 也许会。也许不会。

source: Why? Is there something ominous happening in your personal life?
target: 怎么？你私下遇到什么不祥的事了？

source: Something's got you looking over your shoulder? If so, do tell.
target: 有什么事让你总提防着身后？如果有，务必说来听听。

source: Hamlet, I believe your uncle may want me dead because of our 'history' together.
target: 哈姆雷特，我觉得你叔叔可能因为我们之间的那段“过去”，想要我死。

source: I fear he wishes to make a more appropriate match with you. Lady Brit, perhaps.
target: 我怕他想给你安排一桩更合适的婚事。也许是和布莉特女士。

source: I fear he wishes to make a more advantageous match with you.
target: 我怕他想给你安排一桩更有利的婚事。

source: And... I'm an obstacle to that.
target: 而……我挡了路。

source: My father's ghost warned me of this. It told me Claudius was a killer.
target: 我父亲的幽灵警告过我这件事。它告诉我，克劳狄斯是个杀人凶手。

source: My father's ghost appeared before me on the walls. It warned me about this. It told me Claudius was a killer.
target: 我父亲的幽灵在城墙上出现在我面前。它警告过我这件事。它告诉我，克劳狄斯是个杀人凶手。

source: I believe you, Hamlet.
target: 我相信你，哈姆雷特。

source: And now you tell me my uncle intends to take your life, too.
target: 而现在，你告诉我，我叔叔还打算取你的性命。

source: It's... almost too much to bear.
target: 这……几乎让我无法承受。

source: Not while I live.
target: 只要我还活着，就绝不可能。

source: I'll not allow him to harm you.
target: 我不会让他伤害你。

source: This only adds conviction to my crime. I shall do the world a favor.
target: 这只会让我更坚定地犯下罪行。我要为世人做件好事。

source: ...I can see only blood ahead of me.
target: ……我眼前的路上，只看得到鲜血。

source: For now, let me play the part he expects of me. But soon, Ophelia, he'll be gone.
target: 暂且让我扮演他期望的角色吧。但很快，奥菲莉娅，他就会消失。

source: And then he'll trouble you no more. I swear it.
target: 到那时，他就再也不会来烦扰你了。我发誓。

source: For my own sanity, I must find out if my mother knew of this. I have to know if she was complicit, too.
target: 为了不让自己发疯，我必须查清母亲是否知情。我一定得知道，她是不是也参与了这件事。

source: Father, you know of Hamlet's affections for me. Couldn't this be cause for the King to harm me?
target: 父亲，您知道哈姆雷特对我的感情。这难道不会成为国王伤害我的理由吗？

source: Why do you ask? Did something happen?
target: 为什么这么问？发生什么事了吗？

source: Do you have reason to believe you might be... harmed?
target: 你有什么理由觉得自己可能会……受到伤害吗？

source: I've overheard a conversation implying that the King may want me dead.
target: 我无意中听到了一段谈话，话里的意思似乎是，国王可能想要我死。

source: Suggesting he would harm you feels inordinately strong, love. However...
target: 亲爱的，说他会伤害你，似乎有些言过其实。不过……

source: You know how Hamlet feels about me. I'm worried the King may act against me because of that.
target: 你知道哈姆雷特对我的感情。我担心国王可能会因此对我下手。

source: Yes. Brit has the same worry.
target: 是啊。布莉特也有同样的担忧。

source: What makes you think this? Did Claudius say something to you?
target: 你为什么会这么想？克劳狄斯跟你说什么了吗？

source: No. But I heard something I wasn't meant to hear. Let's leave it at that.
target: 没有。但我听到了不该让我听到的话。就说到这里吧。

source: If Claudius does intend to act, it won't be by his hand. He'll send someone else. Someone he can distance himself from.
target: 如果克劳狄斯真的打算下手，他不会亲自动手。他会派别人来。一个他能撇清关系的人。

source: Meet me in the guards' quarters. We both have friends there. Let us discuss the evidence further then.
target: 来卫兵宿舍找我。我们在那里都有朋友。到时候再进一步讨论这些证据。

source: You need to be careful, Ophelia. Asking questions might only draw more attention to yourself.
target: 你得小心，奥菲莉娅。四处打听可能只会让你更加引人注意。

source: Please, leave this to me. I will investigate.
target: 拜托，把这件事交给我。我会去调查。

source: Exit POLONIUS.
target: 波洛涅斯退场。

source: Exit HAMLET.
target: 哈姆雷特退场。

source: Exit CLAUDIUS.
target: 克劳狄斯退场。

source: Exit GERTRUDE.
target: 乔特鲁德退场。

source: Exit LAERTES.
target: 雷欧提斯退场。

source: Exit BERNARDO.
target: 贝尔纳多退场。

source: Exit MARCELLUS.
target: 马塞勒斯退场。

source: Exit LADY BRIT.
target: 布莉特女士退场。

source: Exit IRMA.
target: 伊尔玛退场。

source: Exit HORATIO.
target: 霍拉旭退场。

source: Exit ROSENCRANTZ.
target: 罗森克兰兹退场。

source: Exit GUILDENSTERN.
target: 吉尔登斯吞退场。

source: Exit OTHELLO.
target: 奥赛罗退场。

source: Exit QUINCE.
target: 奎因斯退场。

source: Hmmm. Nothing.
target: 嗯……什么也没发生。

source: Clearly you need more practice. Run along and try that on someone else, why don't you?
target: 显然，你还得多练练。不如走吧，找别人试试这一招？

source: Oho. Not a bad plan.
target: 哦呵。计划不错。

source: Alas, I am no pawn, and cannot be removed from play. Invalid move!
target: 可惜，我不是任人摆布的棋子，不能被移出棋局。这一步无效！

source: But I can hardly fault you. That's the first thing I would have tried, myself.
target: 不过我也没法怪你。换作我，第一件事也会试试这个。

source: What on earth?
target: 这到底怎么回事？

source: Ugh-- Waaah! What's happening?!
target: 呃——哇啊！怎么回事？！

source: This cannot be real.
target: 这不可能是真的。

source: What was that? O-oh...
target: 刚才那到底是什么？哦、哦……

source: Ophelia? Did-- did you do that?
target: 奥菲莉娅？那——那是你做的吗？

source: What have you done, Ophelia? What was that?
target: 你做了什么，奥菲莉娅？刚才那是什么？

source: Oy! I-is-- wos that-- what just-- Ophelia?
target: 喂！那、那是——刚才那——刚刚怎么——奥菲莉娅？

source: What in God's name...
target: 天哪，这到底是……

source: Ophelia? What was that? What did you do?
target: 奥菲莉娅？那到底是什么？你做了什么？

source: What am I seeing? Ophelia...?
target: 我这是看到了什么？奥菲莉娅……？

source: What is this? What's happening?
target: 这是怎么回事？发生什么了？

source: Ophelia? You're... some kind of...
target: 奥菲莉娅？你是……某种……

source: No. What are you?
target: 不。你到底是什么？

source: Oh god. It's true.
target: 天哪。竟然是真的。

source: What? What just...
target: 什么？刚才怎么……

source: That was me? I did that?
target: 那是我？是我做了那种事？

source: Quince tricked me, again. This isn't a gift. This is something horrifying.
target: 奎因斯又骗了我。这不是恩赐。这是可怕的东西。

source: I shouldn't use this. I should just reset this world and leave. I can't stay here.
target: 我不该用这个。我应该重置这个世界，然后离开。我不能留在这里。

source: I'm... I'm not a killer. I'm not like him.
target: 我……我不是杀人凶手。我和他不一样。

source: This is evil, this power.
target: 这种力量是邪恶的。

source: It doesn't matter if they'll return in the next world. This is wrong.
target: 就算他们会在下一个世界回来，也无关紧要。这是不对的。

source: It's almost like a little game. Watch them run, seek them out--
target: 这简直像个小游戏。看着他们逃跑，再把他们找出来——

source: No. What am I saying?
target: 不。我在说什么？

source: Why do I continue this? I could stop. I ought to stop. I could reset this world.
target: 为什么我还在继续？我可以停下来。我应该停下来。我可以重置这个世界。

source: It's so easy. They don't even feel real.
target: 太容易了。他们甚至都不像是真实的。

source: I know it's not too late to turn back. To reset. To leave. But I've wrought so much.
target: 我知道现在回头还来得及。重置。离开。可我已经做了这么多。

source: This is sort of fun, in a sick way, isn't it? A way to play with them.
target: 这还挺有趣的，虽然有些病态，不是吗？可以这样玩弄他们。

source: Besides, I can revive them any time I like. They won't remember a thing.
target: 再说，只要我愿意，随时都能让他们复活。他们什么都不会记得。

source: They all looked down on me. I was just some nothing girl to them.
target: 他们都瞧不起我。在他们眼里，我只是个无足轻重的姑娘。

source: Perhaps now I desire their fear. Crave it.
target: 也许现在我想让他们怕我。无比渴望。

source: Or -- perhaps this is merely a tool I can use to amuse myself.
target: 或者——也许这只是我用来取乐的工具。

source: Either way, I clearly have no desire to give it up.
target: 不管怎样，我显然不想放弃它。

source: What's done cannot be undone.
target: 做过的事，无法挽回。

source: I think something must have gone a bit broken in my head. Hee, hee...
target: 我想，我脑子里一定有什么地方坏掉了。嘻，嘻……

source: Every time I kill one, I feel the strangest sense of satisfaction.
target: 每杀一个人，我都会有一种无比奇怪的满足感。

source: Yes, if they're all dead, I can tell something marvelous will happen!
target: 对，如果他们全都死了，我能感觉到，会有奇妙的事情发生！

source: I'll truly have won then!
target: 到那时，我就真的赢了！

source: What an ugly way to die.
target: 死得真难看。

source: Too simple.
target: 太简单了。

source: Yes. Die.
target: 对。去死吧。

source: That strange incident you witnessed? That was my doing. You ought to be afraid of me.
target: 你亲眼看到的那件怪事？是我做的。你应该怕我。

source: What? You?
target: 什么？你？

source: There's a strangeness to your countenance I've never seen before.
target: 你脸上有一种我从未见过的异样神情。

source: I don't know what you are -- spirit or demon or otherwise. But no justice could apply to you.
target: 我不知道你是什么——幽灵、恶魔，还是别的东西。但任何司法手段都无法制裁你。

source: Father, I'm the one behind that strange death.
target: 父亲，那场离奇的死亡是我造成的。

source: No, nono. You must be mistaken. I must be mistaken.
target: 不，不不。你一定弄错了。我一定弄错了。

source: I refuse to believe it. My... my sweet Ophelia...
target: 我不相信。我的……我亲爱的奥菲莉娅……

source: At a time like this, I find that sort of joking absolutely inappropriate, Ophelia.
target: 这种时候，我觉得开这种玩笑绝对不合适，奥菲莉娅。

source: Can you not see how terrified the others are? And so ought you to be.
target: 你看不出其他人有多害怕吗？你也该害怕才对。

source: Not another word of that. Not until this horror is contained.
target: 别再说这种话了。在这场恐怖事件得到控制之前，一句也不许说。

source: Ophelia... everything we've been through... does it mean nothing?
target: 奥菲莉娅……我们一起经历的一切……难道都毫无意义吗？

source: Please! Don't hurt anyone else!
target: 求求你！别再伤害任何人了！

source: I can kill someone without laying a hand on them. I could kill you, were I so inclined.
target: 我不用碰到一个人，就能杀死他。只要我想，我也能杀了你。

source: You've gone mad.
target: 你疯了。

source: I've been mad a long time. This is a new gift.
target: 我早就疯了。这是新得到的恩赐。

source: Hamlet, I'm the killer. It was my doing.
target: 哈姆雷特，我就是凶手。是我做的。

source: I-I know. I know.
target: 我、我知道。我知道。

source: But... you wouldn't hurt me, would you, Ophelia?
target: 可是……你不会伤害我，对吧，奥菲莉娅？

source: Please... you are better than this. You can stop. Don't make me...
target: 求求你……你不该是这样的人。你可以停下来。别逼我……

source: What? That strange whatever-it-was... that was you?
target: 什么？那件不知道算什么的怪事……是你做的？

source: That's not possible. No human could have done something like that. You heard so yourself.
target: 这不可能。没有人类能做出那种事。你自己也听到了。

source: And I'm not human.
target: 而我不是人类。

source: There are so many things you don't know about me, Hamlet. Not in this world. Not now.
target: 关于我，你不知道的事太多了，哈姆雷特。在这个世界，你还不知道。现在还不知道。

source: I have the power to kill with a single word. I could kill you, were I so inclined.
target: 我有只说一个词就能杀人的力量。只要我想，我也能杀了你。

source: Your... your eyes. They're...
target: 你的……你的眼睛。它们……

source: Laertes, I'm the killer. It was my doing.
target: 雷欧提斯，我就是凶手。是我做的。

source: You ought to be afraid of me. I can kill someone with the merest word.
target: 你应该怕我。我只需说一个词，就能杀人。

source: This isn't funny. Not right now. Not at a time like this.
target: 这不好笑。现在不好笑。这种时候更不好笑。

source: Look at me. Look closely. You know me. Do I seem as though I'm being facetious?
target: 看着我。仔细看。你了解我。我看起来像是在开玩笑吗？

source: The body was in a state no human could have created. That was the proclamation, wasn't it?
target: 尸体的样子，绝不是人类能造成的。公布的说法是这样，对吧？

source: Surely you're not claiming... you're not human?
target: 你该不会是在说……你不是人类吧？

source: I was, once. But no longer.
target: 曾经是。但现在不是了。

source: There are things you don't know about me, Laertes. I've already killed, and I'm ready to kill again.
target: 关于我，有些事你还不知道，雷欧提斯。我已经杀过人了，也准备好再杀了。

source: Why did you give me this? Why did you do this to me?
target: 为什么要给我这个？为什么要这样对我？

source: Do I detect a tinge of whinging in your voice?
target: 我怎么听出你的声音里有点抱怨呢？

source: I didn't ask for this 'gift' of yours.
target: 我可没要你这份“恩赐”。

source: Look at you! So petulant! Adorable.
target: 瞧瞧你！这么爱闹脾气！真可爱。

source: Tell me, Ophelia. If I leave a pretty cake on your threshold, and you gorge yourself on it...
target: 告诉我，奥菲莉娅。假如我在你家门口放了一块漂亮的蛋糕，而你狼吞虎咽地吃了它……

source: Who, pray, is to blame?
target: 请问，该怪谁呢？

source: You couldn't resist. And now you've indulged. What comes next?
target: 你抵挡不住诱惑。现在也已经放纵了自己。接下来呢？

source: Still not thrilled, are we?
target: 还是高兴不起来，是吧？

source: I'll tell you what I told you last time. Your lack of self-control is hardly my doing.
target: 我再说一遍上次告诉你的话。你缺乏自制力，可不是我造成的。

source: How many times shall we go round and round?
target: 我们还要这样兜多少圈子？

source: Perhaps I wanted you to understand my view of it all.
target: 也许我是想让你明白，我是怎么看待这一切的。

source: How even the most heart-wrenching human emotions become trite and silly with enough repetition.
target: 哪怕是人类最令人心碎的情感，只要重复得足够多，也会变得陈腐可笑。

source: I've been at this game for centuries. You think me a monster, I'm certain.
target: 我玩这个游戏已经几百年了。我敢肯定，你觉得我是个怪物。

source: But someday, you'll be just like me, too. And then -- you'll know.
target: 但总有一天，你也会变得和我一模一样。到那时——你就明白了。

source: Oh, dear heart. We've discussed this so many times. You can stop whenever you like.
target: 哎，亲爱的。我们都谈过这么多次了。你想停，随时都可以停。

source: Or -- well -- how many times have you used that gift now? Been quite a few, hasn't it?
target: 或者——嗯——你到现在已经用过多少次那份恩赐了？已经不少次了吧？

source: Perhaps you're just like a broken clock at this point, stuck ticking the same hour.
target: 也许现在的你就像一座坏掉的钟，卡在那里，反复走着同一个小时。

source: You've taken quite a shining to this, haven't you?
target: 你已经很喜欢这个了，对吧？

source: Yes. My star pupil!
target: 没错。我的得意门生！

source: Don't forget. If you kill them all by midnight on Friday evening, you'll win a special prize.
target: 别忘了。如果你在星期五晚上午夜之前把他们全杀了，就会赢得一份特别的奖品。

source: And you do seem to like prizes, don't you?
target: 而你似乎确实很喜欢奖品，对吧？

source: Die, then -- whoever you are.
target: 那就去死吧——不管你是谁。

source: That strange incident you heard about? That was my doing. You ought to be afraid of me.
target: 你听说的那件怪事？是我做的。你应该怕我。

source: That was-- you?
target: 那是——你做的？

source: How could you pull that off? No human could have killed someone that way!
target: 你怎么可能做到？没有人类能用那种方式杀人！

source: Y-you should fear what will come when your work is done.
target: 你、你该害怕的是，等你做完这一切，会有什么在等着你。

source: There is no reward for the devil's agents. O-only hellfire.
target: 魔鬼的爪牙不会得到奖赏。只、只有地狱的烈火。

source: What can you mean?
target: 你这是什么意思？

source: Are you telling me you are the one responsible for that-- that-- mauling?
target: 你是说，那场——那场——撕咬惨案，是你干的？

source: It was you. You killed Gerta.
target: 是你。你杀了格尔塔。

source: How can such a thing be possible?
target: 这种事怎么可能？

source: I have a power no one else has. I can kill you with just two words.
target: 我有别人都没有的力量。我只要说两个词，就能杀了你。

source: It's-- the Devil's work. It must be!
target: 这是——魔鬼干的。一定是！

source: The girl's possessed, made into His pawn...
target: 这姑娘被附身了，成了魔鬼的棋子……

source: S-stay away from me!
target: 离、离我远点！

source: Guh-- Get away from me! From all of us!
target: 呃——离我远点！离我们所有人远点！

source: Wah! Really?! Then you're going to kill me too, aren't you!
target: 哇！真的？！那你也要杀了我，对不对！

source: But, really, is that possible? After all, you're so short.
target: 不过，说真的，这可能吗？毕竟你这么矮。

source: You probably can't reach Irma's cheese stash on top of the hearth, let alone my neck.
target: 你大概连伊尔玛藏在壁炉上面的奶酪都够不着，更别说我的脖子了。

source: I don't need to reach you. I can kill you with a single word. I have a power--
target: 我不需要够到你。我只要说一个词，就能杀了你。我有一种力量——

source: Oh! I read this book, too!
target: 哦！这本书我也读过！

source: This is the one where the main character goes to that Nunnery for Witches and learns magic, right?
target: 就是主角去那个女巫修道院学魔法的故事，对吧？

source: And then she falls in love with her super cute canoness. Such a great series.
target: 然后她爱上了她那位超级可爱的女教士。这系列真是太棒了。

source: This isn't a story, Guilda. It's the truth.
target: 这不是故事，吉尔达。这是真的。

source: Oh, really? You mean the cute canoness is walking around the real world somewhere? So there's hope!
target: 哦，真的？你是说，那个可爱的女教士就在现实世界的某个地方走动？那还有希望！

source: Anyway, have fun playing make-believe!
target: 总之，祝你扮演游戏玩得开心！

source: S-stay away from me! I don't want to play this game anymore, Ophelia.
target: 离、离我远点！我不想再玩这个游戏了，奥菲莉娅。

source: Tell everyone to come back out. Tell them to stop pretending.
target: 叫大家都出来。叫他们别再装了。

source: No one is pretending, Guilda. They're all really dead.
target: 没有人在装，吉尔达。他们全都真的死了。

source: No. No! God, this can't be real, can it?
target: 不。不！天哪，这不可能是真的，对不对？

source: I've had enough. First King Hamlet, now you? Spirits, demons, whoever you are: this place is a haunt.
target: 我受够了。先是哈姆雷特国王，现在又是你？幽灵、恶魔，不管你们是什么，这地方已经成了鬼窟。

source: Leave us alone. Leave us in peace. Please.
target: 放过我们吧。让我们安安稳稳地过日子。求求你。

source: I wanted to speak to you about... us. Perhaps it's not too late to make amends.
target: 我想和你谈谈……我们的事。也许现在弥补还来得及。

source: ...I cannot, Ophelia.
target: ……我做不到，奥菲莉娅。

source: On board the ship, Lady Guildenstern took me aside.
target: 在船上，吉尔登斯吞女士把我叫到了一旁。

source: I cannot be a good partner to anyone, least of all you.
target: 我做不了任何人的好伴侣，尤其是你的。

source: I've brought harm to a lot of women. I cannot undo that. But I can reconsider my path moving forward.
target: 我伤害过很多女人。我无法挽回。但我可以重新考虑今后该走的路。

source: Especially in light of... your uncle's passing.
target: 尤其是考虑到……你叔叔的去世。

source: And not a moment too soon, at that.
target: 而且早就该这样了。

source: Truly—though—nothing would bring me greater joy.
target: 不过——说真的——没有什么能让我更高兴了。

source: After the news is made public, we should... go somewhere private. My chambers, perhaps.
target: 等消息公布后，我们应该……找个私密的地方。也许去我的房间。

source: I'm not that eager.
target: 我可没那么心急。

source: You have my word. I mean only to talk. Nothing more.
target: 我向你保证。我只是想谈谈。没有别的。

source: I'll find you when I can.
target: 等我能抽身，就来找你。

source: You wish to speak with me? Truly?
target: 你想和我谈谈？真的？

source: ...Then let's find somewhere away from prying eyes. The riverbank, perhaps.
target: ……那我们找个没人窥探的地方吧。也许去河边。

source: You always were rather fond of those kinds of places, weren't you?
target: 你一直都挺喜欢那样的地方，对吧？

source: You're afraid you won't make for a great King?
target: 你担心自己当不了一位好国王？

source: One of my many fears, yes. If only my father were here to guide me.
target: 是的，这是我众多担忧中的一个。要是父亲还在，能指点我就好了。

source: Or someone else who could offer me their thoughts...
target: 或者有别的人能给我些意见……

source: Hamlet seeks advice on how to be a great ruler. Can you help?
target: 哈姆雷特想请教怎样才能成为一位好君主。你能帮忙吗？

source: Ah. I suspected this day would come, but... so soon.
target: 啊。我料到会有这一天，可是……来得这么快。

source: There would have been a time when Hamlet and I were equals in our ignorance.
target: 要是放在从前，我和哈姆雷特大概会同样一无所知。

source: But my knowledge of the political sphere has grown these last ten years. Sometimes in ways I wish it hadn't.
target: 但这十年来，我对政界的了解越来越多。有些事，我倒宁愿自己不知道。

source: I've learned some ugly lessons. Some unfortunate things about the workings of this world.
target: 我受过一些残酷的教训。也了解了这个世界如何运转的一些不幸事实。

source: I'll speak to him and see what golden words I can give him.
target: 我会和他谈谈，看看能给他什么金玉良言。

source: Wah hah hah! I knew that boy would come around eventually.
target: 哇哈哈！我就知道那小子迟早会想通的。

source: As much as I despise the Prince, it would do my lady great harm to know I begrudged him my advice.
target: 我再怎么厌恶王子，要是我的女主人知道我不肯给他建议，也会很伤心。

source: I'll speak to him. Fret not, Ophelia.
target: 我会和他谈谈。别担心，奥菲莉娅。

source: Hamlet? Seeking advice? Is he broken?
target: 哈姆雷特？在寻求建议？他脑子坏了？

source: It's a little sad how worried it makes me to hear this.
target: 听到这事，我竟然会这么担心，想想也有点可悲。

source: It's a positive change, Horatio. He's a new man in some ways.
target: 这是好变化，霍拉旭。在某些方面，他已经像换了个人。

source: Well, that's a relief. I've got all the time in the world for him. I'll find him.
target: 那就放心了。我愿意为他花多少时间都行。我会去找他。

source: My son? Seeking... advice?
target: 我儿子？在寻求……建议？

source: Has he... is... is all well? He isn't sick? Or raving mad?
target: 他是不是……是……一切都好吗？他没生病吧？也没发疯吧？

source: Yes. All is well. He's ready to become King.
target: 是的。一切都好。他已经准备好当国王了。

source: This is a mother's dream come true. I'll speak to him as soon as I'm able.
target: 做母亲的愿望终于实现了。我一有机会就去和他谈谈。

source: Oh, yes! We're full of wonderful advice! Such as 'always bring a spare meal.' And 'never do today what can be delayed indefinitely.'
target: 哦，当然！我们有一肚子好建议！比如“总要多带一顿饭”。还有“能无限拖延的事，今天就别做”。

source: Time to interrogate him!
target: 该去审问他了！

source: Truth be told, I'm not certain.
target: 说实话，我也不确定。

source: But at the very least, we'll speak to him.
target: 不过，至少我们会和他谈谈。

source: Though I must wonder if being a great ruler is what he truly desires.
target: 但我不禁想，他真正想要的，是成为一位好君主吗？

source: Can you encourage Hamlet to be a great king? He's seeking advice from friends.
target: 你能鼓励哈姆雷特做一位好国王吗？他正在向朋友们寻求建议。

source: I've encouraged a number o' kings an' gilded men! Of course I can.
target: 我鼓励过不少国王和那些穿金戴银的大人物！当然能。

source: So Hamlet's lookin' for a kind word? I've got just the thing for him. Thanks fer findin' me!
target: 所以哈姆雷特想听几句暖心的话？我正好有话对他说。谢谢你来找我！

source: Well, great might be an excessively lofty goal. Let's start with adequate.
target: 嗯，优秀这个目标也许太高了。先从合格开始吧。

source: Fine. An adequate king. I'll take it.
target: 好吧。一个合格的国王。我也接受。

source: In that case, yes. I have a few choice words for him. Not that I expect him to listen.
target: 那倒可以。我有几句不客气的话要对他说。虽然我也不指望他听进去。

source: But I'll try all the same.
target: 但我还是会试试。

source: Can you encourage Hamlet to be a great King? He seeks the advice of wise folk.
target: 你能鼓励哈姆雷特做一位好国王吗？他正在向有智慧的人请教。

source: Why, I thought he'd never ask.
target: 哎呀，我还以为他永远不会开口呢。

source: I remember when his father was his age. So young and impressionable.
target: 我还记得他父亲在他这个年纪的时候。那么年轻，很容易受人影响。

source: Having a hardened, grizzled veteran by his side will make all this much easier!
target: 有一位久经磨炼、饱经风霜的老将在他身边，这一切都会容易得多！

source: Father, I would stretch to call you grizzled.
target: 父亲，说你饱经风霜，恐怕有点勉强。

source: W-well, that's just because I'm your father. I can be quite the warhorse! You'll see.
target: 那、那只是因为我是你父亲。我也能像匹老战马一样勇猛！你会看到的。

source: I'll find him as soon as I'm able.
target: 我一有机会就去找他。

source: I bear some unfortunate information about Lady Guildenstern.
target: 我带来了关于吉尔登斯吞女士的坏消息。

source: She passed away recently. Very recently, in fact.
target: 她最近去世了。其实，就是刚刚的事。

source: You're serious? She owed me a small fortune in losings at my table!
target: 你说真的？她在我赌桌上输的钱，还欠着我一大笔呢！

source: How am I to ever recover it now? Good-for-nothing wandering noblewomen...
target: 这下我还怎么讨得回来？这些四处游荡、没用的贵族女人……

source: Goodness. And despite it all, I really did like the woman.
target: 天哪。可话说回来，我确实挺喜欢她的。

source: I'd half believe something like this was just another idiot prank of hers.
target: 我都有点觉得，这种事不过又是她搞的蠢恶作剧。

source: Oh. Er.
target: 哦。呃。

source: Hamlet, I have something to discuss about Lady Guildenstern.
target: 哈姆雷特，关于吉尔登斯吞女士，我有件事想和你谈谈。
