source: She's passed away suddenly. I'm sorry to be the one to have to break this to you.
target: 她突然去世了。很抱歉，得由我来告诉你这个消息。

source: How did she pass? When did this happen?
target: 她是怎么去世的？什么时候的事？

source: She, er... she... was... she... drowned. Yes. Drowned.
target: 她，呃……她……是……她……淹死了。对。淹死了。

source: Off the docks, I'm afraid.
target: 很遗憾，就在码头边的水里。

source: How horrible.
target: 太可怕了。

source: Who let this happen? Where were the guards? Why wasn't anyone watching?
target: 是谁让这种事发生的？守卫在哪儿？为什么没人看着？

source: Does Rosie know? If not, she ought to.
target: 罗茜知道吗？要是不知道，就该告诉她。

source: And-- I want this investigated at once. I want to know exactly what took place.
target: 还有——我要立刻调查这件事。我要知道到底发生了什么。

source: I need to understand what happened, first. The rest will follow.
target: 我得先弄清楚发生了什么。其他的事之后再说。

source: (I feel awful lying to him, but Guilda asked me to...)
target: （骗他让我很难受，可吉尔达让我这么做……）

source: There's... something I need to talk with you about.
target: 有……有件事我得和你谈谈。

source: I'm so sorry to be the one to tell you this, but... Guildenstern has passed away.
target: 很抱歉，得由我来告诉你这件事，可是……吉尔登斯吞去世了。

source: She, er, drowned. By the docks.
target: 她，呃，淹死了。就在码头边。

source: It came as a surprise to me, too.
target: 我也没想到会这样。

source: This is one of her idiot pranks again, isn't it?
target: 这又是她搞的蠢恶作剧，对不对？

source: No. No... if you're coming to tell this to me... it must be true.
target: 不。不……如果是你来告诉我……那一定是真的。

source: She's never involved someone else in a prank before.
target: 她以前搞恶作剧，从来没找过别人帮忙。

source: So it's true, then.
target: 那就是真的了。

source: Guilda... I...
target: 吉尔达……我……

source: (This is cruel.)
target: （这太残忍了。）

source: What was she doing down by the docks? She can't swim. We both know that.
target: 她去码头边干什么？她不会游泳。我们两个都知道。

source: Ophelia, it's so strange. I know what you're saying is true, but it doesn't feel real.
target: 奥菲莉娅，真奇怪。我知道你说的是真的，可就是觉得不真实。

source: You know, when my father died it felt the same way. I expected sorrow. But-- nothing. Just nothing.
target: 你知道吗，我父亲去世时，我也是这种感觉。我以为自己会悲伤。可是——什么感觉都没有。什么都没有。

source: Just the sense that the bottom's fallen out of the world.
target: 只觉得整个世界突然失去了支撑。

source: I... I have to make arrangements. No one else will.
target: 我……我必须安排后事。不会有别人来做了。

source: Please excuse me.
target: 请容我失陪。

source: (I feel awful lying to her, but Guilda asked me to.)
target: （骗她让我很难受，可吉尔达让我这么做。）

source: She passed away recently, as you may or may not have known.
target: 她最近去世了，不知道你有没有听说。

source: Oh. Hmm? Guildenstern? Ah, yes, with the hat. I recall now.
target: 哦。嗯？吉尔登斯吞？啊，对，戴帽子的那位。我想起来了。

source: A nice lady. A shame she had to pass so young.
target: 是位不错的女士。这么年轻就去世了，真可惜。

source: (He didn't seem to particularly care...)
target: （他似乎并不怎么在意……）

source: Well, yeh, that's wot happens now an' then! Unfortunate an' sad!
target: 嗯，是啊，这种事时不时就会发生！真不幸，真让人难过！

source: Oh. That Lady Guildenstern? The one from Hamlet's school?
target: 哦。那位吉尔登斯吞女士？和哈姆雷特同一所学校的那位？

source: Well, I'm sure he's devastated. I'm sorry to hear it, Ophelia.
target: 他一定伤心极了。听到这个消息，我很难过，奥菲莉娅。

source: I bear some unfortunate information about Lady Guildenstern..
target: 我带来了关于吉尔登斯吞女士的坏消息……

source: Which one is Guildenstern again?
target: 吉尔登斯吞是哪位来着？

source: Ah, never mind it. I was on my way to find something to eat. We can talk about this later.
target: 啊，算了。我正要去找点东西吃。这事我们晚点再谈。

source: Ah. I'm sorry to have lost her, Ophelia. She was a good friend to Hamlet.
target: 啊。失去她，我很难过，奥菲莉娅。她是哈姆雷特的好朋友。

source: These things do happen, I suppose.
target: 我想，这种事总是会发生的。

source: (She didn't seem to particularly care...)
target: （她似乎并不怎么在意……）

source: She's dead?
target: 她死了？

source: Ergh. I'll need to think of—something—to—honor her, then.
target: 唉。那我得想个——什么办法——来——纪念她。

source: (And some way to keep an eye on Hamlet...)
target: （还得想个办法盯着哈姆雷特……）

source: I suppose you will.
target: 我想是得如此。

source: Ah. I'm sorry to hear it. Seemed to be a nice, pleasant, well-bred lady.
target: 啊。听到这消息，我很难过。她看起来是位和善、讨人喜欢、有教养的女士。

source: I bear some unfortunate news about Lady Guildenstern.
target: 我带来了关于吉尔登斯吞女士的坏消息。

source: Oh, really? How?
target: 哦，真的？怎么死的？

source: She, er, drowned.
target: 她，呃，淹死了。

source: You're a terrible liar, 'Feely. Your big green eyes give you away instantly.
target: 你真不会撒谎，菲莉。你那双绿色的大眼睛一下就把你出卖了。

source: I-It's that easy to tell?
target: 这、这么容易看出来吗？

source: All I'll say is this: You will never have a career at the card table. Never.
target: 我只说一句：你永远别想靠打牌谋生。永远。

source: Were it anyone else I might believe you, but Guildenstern's never done a single real thing in her entire life. Or death, for that matter.
target: 换成别人，我或许会信你，可吉尔登斯吞这辈子就没做过一件真事。说起来，就连死也不例外。

source: So she's gone and faked her death, eh? Can't wait for that to come full circle.
target: 所以她跑去装死了，是吧？我都等不及看这件事最后怎么绕回她头上了。

source: So. This fake death business. There's no chance this goes wrong?
target: 那么，装死这件事。真的绝不会出岔子吗？

source: Absolutely not! It's impossible. All of my plans work flawlessly.
target: 绝对不会！不可能。我的所有计划都天衣无缝。

source: And even when they don't, well...
target: 就算不是，嗯……

source: I'm a very fast runner, you know. They'll never catch me.
target: 你知道，我跑得可快了。他们绝对抓不到我。

source: My lady, you're close to Brit. Do you know what's got her so doom and gloom?
target: 王后，您和布莉特很亲近。您知道她为什么这么消沉吗？

source: Oh, Brit... I've had just about enough of her lately.
target: 哦，布莉特……最近我真是快受够她了。

source: She's been so short-tempered with me—and all because she hasn't heard from her mother since she came here.
target: 她对我动不动就发脾气——就因为她来了这里之后，一直没收到母亲的消息。

source: Her mother hasn't written her? But she lives just a crow's fly away.
target: 她母亲没给她写信？可她母亲就住在不远的地方啊。

source: Oh, heavens, she's written Brit, of course! That dratted woman can't stop writing to Brit. A new one comes through the gate nearly every day.
target: 哦，天哪，她当然给布莉特写了信！那个讨厌的女人给布莉特写信就没停过。几乎每天都有一封新信送进城门。

source: But I hid them all, obviously.
target: 不过，我当然把信全藏起来了。

source: Hid the... letters?
target: 把……信藏起来了？

source: Yes. This is my duty, Ophelia. Brit's father sent her here to become a lady of the court and to set aside childish things.
target: 是的。这是我的职责，奥菲莉娅。布莉特的父亲送她来这里，是要她成为一位宫廷贵女，抛开那些幼稚的事。

source: He warned me Brit would look for every possible excuse to run along home again. But he won't have it. She is to become Lady Brockenhuus.
target: 他提醒过我，布莉特会找尽各种借口再跑回家去。但他绝不允许。她要成为布罗肯胡斯女士。

source: Hiding Brit's mother's letters was all I could think to do. If she read them, it'd only make her terribly homesick, and what then?
target: 我能想到的办法，就只有把布莉特母亲的信藏起来。要是她读了那些信，只会更想家，到时候怎么办？

source: Besides, they were so depressing. 'I wish you'd come home, darling.' 'I wish you'd never left.' Well, I put all those silly letters where unheard wishes go.
target: 再说，那些信实在太让人消沉了。“亲爱的，真希望你能回家。”“真希望你从没离开过。”所以，我把那些傻乎乎的信都放到了无人倾听的愿望该去的地方。

source: 'Where unheard wishes go'?
target: “无人倾听的愿望该去的地方”？

source: Ooh. Never mind. Forget what I said!
target: 哦。没什么。忘了我说的话吧！

source: You and Brit both often spend your days in the gallery. Have you spoken to her closely?
target: 你和布莉特白天都常待在画廊。你和她深入聊过吗？

source: Most certainly.
target: 那当然。

source: Do you know what ails her?
target: 你知道她在为什么苦恼吗？

source: It is a malady of the soul. Lady Brit and I are kindred spirits in that way, you know.
target: 那是心灵的病痛。你知道，在这方面，布莉特女士和我是同道中人。

source: Did you know she's an artist? And quite a good one, at that. But she's been disallowed from painting.
target: 你知道她是个画家吗？而且画得相当好。可她被禁止画画了。

source: Artists who aren't doing work waste all their time being poisonously jealous of those who are.
target: 不创作的艺术家，会把所有时间都浪费在恶毒地嫉妒那些正在创作的人上。

source: It's a shame about all her oils. I wonder if she'll ever get them back.
target: 她那些油彩真是可惜了。不知道她还能不能拿回来。

source: Oils? You mean oil... paints?
target: 油彩？你是说油……画颜料？

source: Yes. When she came here, I understand her father confiscated them all. She wasn't to use them within Elsinore.
target: 是的。据我所知，她来这里时，父亲把那些颜料全没收了。不准她在埃尔西诺使用。

source: I had no idea. Couldn't she have made more?
target: 我完全不知道。她不能再做一些吗？

source: Of course. New tools are made easily enough, but Brit is not one to ask for help. If you're looking to lend Madame Artiste a hand, I can be of service.
target: 当然能。做些新画具并不难，可布莉特不是会开口求助的人。如果你想帮帮这位画家女士，我可以出力。

source: I've got the pigments to make colors, but I'll need bases for the oils, some canvas materials, and some charcoal. Luckily, all highly procurable!
target: 我有调色用的色粉，不过还需要调制油彩的基料、一些做画布的材料，还有木炭。好在这些都很容易弄到！

source: I'll need some eggs, charcoal for sketching, and some linen cloth for canvas.
target: 我需要一些鸡蛋、画素描用的木炭，还有做画布用的亚麻布。

source: Linen... I've got a number of undergarments made of the stuff... Hrm.
target: 亚麻布……我有好几件贴身衣服就是用它做的……嗯。

source: Let me know when you've found everything, and I'll assist with the finer details.
target: 等你把东西找齐了，就告诉我，我来帮忙处理那些精细的活儿。

source: You know Lady Brit better than most. Do you know what's got her in such a strange mood?
target: 你比大多数人都了解布莉特女士。你知道她的心情为什么这么反常吗？

source: I don't know what to say on the matter of Lady Brit these days.
target: 说起布莉特女士最近的事，我真不知道该说什么。

source: All I know is, given what you've already told me, I must speak with her immediately.
target: 我只知道，听了你之前告诉我的那些事，我必须立刻和她谈谈。

source: That will give me a chance to clear the air with her. I'm sure of it.
target: 这样我就有机会和她把话说开了。我相信一定能。

source: Now that I know she intended to betray our country and have us all killed, what does it matter?
target: 现在我知道了，她本来打算背叛我们的国家，让我们全都被杀，那些又有什么要紧？

source: She lied to us, Ophelia. And most of all, she lied to me. I loved her, and she looked into my eyes and she told me falsehoods.
target: 她骗了我们，奥菲莉娅。尤其是，她骗了我。我爱她，她却看着我的眼睛，对我说谎。

source: What kind of twisted person does that? I hardly think I want to know anymore. I'd rather discard her, pretend she never existed.
target: 什么样的扭曲之人才做得出这种事？我想我已经不愿再了解她了。我宁愿抛开她，假装她从未存在过。

source: I wish I had but a moment's peace to be with her.
target: 我只希望能有片刻安宁，和她待在一起。

source: Right now, though, as things have been proceeding—I don't know when I'll next have that peaceful moment.
target: 可眼下，事情一路发展到现在——我不知道什么时候才能再有那样安宁的片刻。

source: (I've caught him too late, it seems.)
target: （看来，我找他找得太晚了。）

source: What's wrong with Brit?
target: 布莉特怎么了？

source: Did she say something to you?
target: 她对你说了什么吗？

source: Not exactly—but something's amiss. I can tell.
target: 也不算——但有些不对劲。我看得出来。

source: I just met with her the other night. She... has a lot on her mind.
target: 前几天晚上我才和她见过面。她……有很多心事。

source: I'd give her some space, Ophelia. Let her sort things out.
target: 我觉得该让她自己待一会儿，奥菲莉娅。让她理清这些事。

source: (Perhaps if I had approached him before this meeting, he would have spoken on my behalf.)
target: （也许，如果我在他们见面之前就找他，他会替我和她谈谈。）

source: You aren't sailing for Paris?
target: 你不坐船去巴黎了？

source: I was. But Paris will still be there in a week.
target: 本来要去的。不过，晚一周巴黎也不会跑掉。

source: My thanks for your excellent timing on this, sister.
target: 谢谢你，妹妹，这件事你说得正是时候。

source: Had you caught me a moment later, I'd have left her alone.
target: 你要是再晚一点找到我，我就把她独自留下了。

source: Why does Lady Brit act the way she does?
target: 布莉特女士为什么会那样待人？

source: Without impunity, you mean?
target: 你是说，她这样不会免受惩罚？

source: Mother tried to get us to be close friends the moment she set foot in this castle. I refused.
target: 她刚踏进这座城堡，母亲就想让我们成为好友。我拒绝了。

source: On some level, I shall never truly be anything to her other than a tool.
target: 从某种意义上说，在她眼里，我永远都只会是个工具。

source: You know Lady Brit better than most. Do you know why she's so ill-tempered?
target: 你比大多数人都了解布莉特女士。你知道她为什么脾气这么坏吗？

source: Aye. She is not here of her own accord.
target: 知道。她不是自愿来这里的。

source: She was brought here in the name of good will between Denmark's crown and its nobility.
target: 她被送来这里，打的是维系丹麦王室与贵族之间友好关系的名义。

source: Her family's roots run deeper than any other. Kings and Queens of days long past, and the like.
target: 她的家族比任何其他家族都更源远流长。祖上有很久以前的国王、王后之类的人物。

source: But despite all the power afforded to her status, she is little more than prisoner to it.
target: 可尽管她的身份给了她那么多权力，她也不过是被这身份囚禁的人。

source: You of all women ought to understand that.
target: 在所有女人里，你最该明白这一点。

source: Cygnus at the town gate is acting strangely. Something about being 'on thin ice' and 'winnings.' Do you know why?
target: 镇门口的西格纳斯举止很奇怪。说什么“处境危险”，还有“赢的钱”。你知道是为什么吗？

source: Ah... ah... I don' know!
target: 啊……啊……我不知道！

source: Don' look at me with those big angry eyes! I won't talk for no one!
target: 别瞪着那双大眼睛，气冲冲地看我！谁来问我都不会说！

source: (All right, so clearly the answer is yes, but he won't tell me.)
target: （好吧，显然他知道，只是不肯告诉我。）

source: (Then who?)
target: （那该问谁呢？）

source: Irma, the guard at the town gate mentioned something odd. Something to do with 'recouping his losses.' Any ideas?
target: 伊尔玛，镇门口的守卫说了些奇怪的话。好像和“把输的钱赢回来”有关。你知道是怎么回事吗？

source: Some fools cannot keep their mouths shut.
target: 有些蠢货就是管不住自己的嘴。

source: This old woman knows differently.
target: 我这个老太婆可知道该怎么做。

source: (All right, so clearly the answer is yes, but she won't tell me.)
target: （好吧，显然她知道，只是不肯告诉我。）

source: What have your men been getting up to lately, Bernardo?
target: 贝尔纳多，你手下的人最近都在干些什么？

source: Lately? Nothing at all. Of course...
target: 最近？什么也没干。当然……

source: We had some incidents with gambling a few weeks ago. I know they do it, but I've banned them from doing it within the castle.
target: 几个星期前，赌博闹出过一些事。我知道他们会赌，但我已经禁止他们在城堡里赌博了。

source: It's sinful behavior, it leads to a lack of discipline, and I won't stand for it in the guard quarters.
target: 这是罪恶的行为，会败坏纪律。我绝不容许守卫宿舍里发生这种事。

source: And you're certain they aren't doing it any longer? Cygnus mentioned something about playing 'at night'.
target: 你确定他们已经不赌了？西格纳斯提到过，说他们“晚上”玩。

source: And you're certain they aren't doing it any longer? I've seen Irma heading into the guards' quarters.
target: 你确定他们已经不赌了？我见过伊尔玛往守卫宿舍里去。

source: ...Those idiots.
target: ……那群蠢货。

source: I'll keep an eye out. And if I see anything in the future...
target: 我会留意的。以后要是让我发现什么……

source: I will handle it with swift and merciless justice.
target: 我会立刻严惩，绝不留情。

source: I will handle this with swift and merciless justice.
target: 这件事我会立刻严惩，绝不留情。

source: Brit, do you know why the guards would believe they were on 'thin ice' with Bernardo?
target: 布莉特，你知道守卫为什么觉得自己在贝尔纳多那里“处境危险”吗？

source: All that sneaking about with their dice games, I'm certain. Marcellus and Irma are the ringleaders.
target: 我敢肯定，是因为他们偷偷摸摸地玩骰子赌博。马塞勒斯和伊尔玛是带头的。

source: Bernardo banned them from doing it, but that obviously hasn't stopped them, because they're not very smart, which is why they beat things with their fists for a living.
target: 贝尔纳多不准他们赌，但显然没能拦住他们，因为他们不怎么聪明，所以才靠挥拳头打东西谋生。

source: They play in the evenings, I think. In the guard house.
target: 我想，他们是晚上在守卫室里玩。

source: How do you know so much about this?
target: 你怎么对这事知道得这么清楚？

source: Uncovering the worst parts of people is my special talent.
target: 挖出别人最不堪的一面，是我的独门本领。

source: Horatio, do you know why the guards would believe they were on 'thin ice' with Bernardo?
target: 霍拉旭，你知道守卫为什么觉得自己在贝尔纳多那里“处境危险”吗？

source: What, again?
target: 什么，又来了？

source: Irma's reignited their little gambling circle. Against Bernardo's wishes, naturally.
target: 伊尔玛又把他们那个小赌局张罗起来了。当然，是违背贝尔纳多意愿的。

source: It's impossible to sleep in the guard house on the nights they do it. I've had to curl up in the stables more often than I'd like to admit.
target: 他们赌博的那些晚上，在守卫室里根本没法睡觉。我不得不蜷在马厩里睡，次数多得我都不愿承认。

source: You'd think they'd develop a modicum of discretion about it... but... sadly, that's not their forte.
target: 按理说，他们总该学会稍微收敛一点……可是……遗憾的是，他们不擅长这个。

source: My lord, the guard at the front gate of Elsinore appears to be nervous about something.
target: 陛下，埃尔西诺正门的守卫似乎在为什么事紧张。

source: Is there a particular grievance you aim to air in light of this?
target: 你提起这件事，是有什么具体的不满要说吗？

source: No, my lord. Just wondering if you knew the cause behind it.
target: 没有，陛下。我只是想问问您知不知道原因。

source: Bernardo, no doubt. He keeps them in line with a swift hand and a strict command. They're all terrified of disappointing him.
target: 肯定是因为贝尔纳多。他管教起来雷厉风行，号令严明。他们都怕让他失望。

source: Bernardo does a most excellent job of handling them. I trust all such matters of their odd behavior to him.
target: 贝尔纳多把他们管得非常好。他们举止异常之类的事，我都放心交给他处理。

source: My lady, do you know why the guards would believe they were on 'thin ice' with Bernardo?
target: 王后，您知道守卫们为什么觉得自己在贝尔纳多面前“如履薄冰”吗？

source: What's Bernardo got them doing now?
target: 贝尔纳多这回又让他们干什么了？

source: A few weeks ago, I'd heard a little rumor from Brit about a gambling circle of some kind in the evenings... run by Irma, no less.
target: 几个星期前，我从布莉特那里听到一点传闻，说有人晚上聚在一起赌博……主持赌局的居然还是伊尔玛。

source: And just a day later, I saw them running laps in the courtyard. Bernardo was there with a willow rod, smacking their heels if they were too slow. Even Irma was forced to run!
target: 结果才过了一天，我就看见他们在庭院里跑圈。贝尔纳多拿着一根柳条站在那里，谁跑慢了，就抽谁的脚后跟。连伊尔玛都被逼着跑！

source: He really does take his work rather seriously.
target: 他对自己的工作还真是认真。

source: So if they're starting trouble again, I've no doubt Bernardo should know about it!
target: 所以，要是他们又在惹事，当然该让贝尔纳多知道！

source: I know the King keeps a private stash of poison in his chambers, and he intends to use it.
target: 我知道国王在寝宫里私藏了毒药，而且他打算用它。

source: That's a rather insidious thing to assert, isn't it?
target: 你这么说，未免有些险恶吧？

source: Only if you don't believe me.
target: 只有在你不相信我的情况下，才算险恶。

source: You have access to his chambers. Can't you verify what I'm saying is true?
target: 你能进他的寝宫。难道不能去核实一下我说的是不是真的？

source: ...The King would not want to hear of this, regardless of the veracity of your words.
target: ……不管你说的是真是假，国王都不会想听到这种事。

source: But he's not always in his rooms. He often meanders.
target: 可他又不是一直待在房里。他经常到处走走。

source: I will investigate. I'll let you know if I find anything worthwhile.
target: 我会去查的。如果发现什么有价值的东西，我会告诉你。

source: That potato-headed clod would keep such a thing in such an obvious place, wouldn't he.
target: 那个土豆脑袋的蠢货，果然会把这种东西放在那么显眼的地方，是吧。

source: If harm might come to my lady as a result, then I cannot ignore this.
target: 如果这可能危及王后，那我就不能坐视不管。

source: Do you know how to acquire a key to his rooms?
target: 你知道怎么弄到他房间的钥匙吗？

source: Wah hah hah! A key!
target: 哇哈哈！钥匙！

source: Girl, these walls are ancient. All doors are keyless if you have the right tools.
target: 姑娘，这城堡可有年头了。只要有合适的工具，什么门都不用钥匙。

source: I will look into this so-called poison. And if I find anything, you will know.
target: 我会去查查你说的毒药。如果发现什么，我会告诉你。

source: My lady, your husband is keeping a private stash of poison in his chambers. I believe he intends to use it.
target: 王后，您的丈夫在寝宫里私藏了毒药。我认为他打算用它。

source: Faith, what are you saying, Ophelia?
target: 天哪，奥菲莉娅，你在说什么？

source: Poison? For what purpose?
target: 毒药？用来做什么？

source: I... think the King may plan to use it to... eliminate Hamlet.
target: 我……觉得国王可能打算用它来……除掉哈姆雷特。

source: I'm sorry. I understand this must be difficult to hear. But if you can stop him, then your son will be safe.
target: 对不起。我知道这些话一定让您很难受。但如果您能阻止他，您的儿子就安全了。

source: I think he may have... planned to use it on Hamlet.
target: 我觉得他之前可能……打算用它对付哈姆雷特。

source: I'm sorry. I understand this must be difficult to hear.
target: 对不起。我知道这些话一定让您很难受。

source: I don't know whether to believe you, but I have a key to my husband's chambers.
target: 我不知道该不该相信你，不过我有丈夫寝宫的钥匙。

source: At the very least, I can look around and see what I might find the next time he departs.
target: 至少，下次他离开时，我可以进去找找，看能发现什么。

source: I... pray... I don't find anything. I truly do.
target: 我……祈求……什么都找不到。真心祈求。

source: Your uncle keeps a private stash of poison in his chambers, and I believe he intends to use it.
target: 你叔叔在寝宫里私藏了毒药，我认为他打算用它。

source: That cannot come to pass.
target: 不能让这事发生。

source: Perhaps this is the proof I've been seeking.
target: 也许这就是我一直在找的证据。

source: Not even a locked door can stop me now.
target: 现在，就算门锁上了，也拦不住我。

source: I'll enter when he's gone and uncover the truth, one way or another.
target: 等他离开，我就进去，无论如何都要查出真相。

source: I'll enter when he's gone and take his tools, one way or another.
target: 等他离开，我就进去，无论如何都要拿走他的工具。

source: Your Majesty, I know you keep a stash of poison in your innermost chambers, and that you plan to use it.
target: 陛下，我知道您在寝宫最里面的房间藏了毒药，而且打算用它。

source: Poison! That's quite an accusation, girl.
target: 毒药！姑娘，这指控可相当严重。

source: And what leads you to believe something like that?
target: 你凭什么相信会有这种事？

source: I know you used it to rid yourself of your brother. You can stop pretending you don't know what I'm talking about.
target: 我知道您用它除掉了您的哥哥。您不用再装作不知道我在说什么了。

source: Ah. I see.
target: 啊。我明白了。

source: I wondered if something like that might happen. If you might betray my trust. My confidence.
target: 我曾想过，会不会发生这样的事。你会不会辜负我的信任。泄露我向你吐露的秘密。

source: Now I know that to be true.
target: 现在我知道，果然如此。

source: I was the more deceived.
target: 原来我受的骗更深。

source: I came here not to assault you with this, but rather to let you know that... I understand.
target: 我来这里，不是要拿这件事指责您，而是想让您知道……我理解。

source: I understand why you did it. Why you killed him.
target: 我理解您为什么这么做。为什么杀了他。

source: That's all I think needs to be said.
target: 我想，该说的就这些了。

source: I never saw myself as a man who would take his brother's life. Not once.
target: 我从没觉得自己会是一个杀害亲哥哥的人。一次都没有。

source: It was the sort of dark place I came to after years. Years of his hatred, his injustice.
target: 是多年之后，我才走到了那般黑暗的境地。多年承受他的憎恨，他的不公。

source: It was all I could think of. It consumed me. I needed him gone.
target: 我满脑子只有这个念头。它吞噬了我。我必须让他消失。

source: Let-- Let us speak of that no more, Ophelia. Let it accumulate yesterdays upon its grave.
target: 别——别再说这件事了，奥菲莉娅。让一个个昨日堆在它的坟头吧。

source: Father, I've learned Claudius keeps a stash of poison in his private chambers. Shouldn't we do something to rid him of it?
target: 父亲，我得知克劳狄斯在私人寝宫里藏了毒药。我们难道不该想办法把毒药拿走吗？

source: Oh, God above.
target: 啊，上帝啊。

source: Certainly you must do nothing until such a claim has been verified, dearest.
target: 亲爱的，在这种说法得到证实之前，你当然必须什么都不做。

source: For your own safety, and mine.
target: 为了你自己的安全，也为了我的安全。

source: But certainly we have to find out whether or not the claim is true, don't we?
target: 可我们总得查清这说法是不是真的，对吧？

source: You always told me we had an obligation to be honest, to be brave.
target: 您一直告诉我，我们有责任诚实，有责任勇敢。

source: If there's even a chance Claudius might use this poison, mustn't we stop him?
target: 只要克劳狄斯有一点可能会用这毒药，我们不就必须阻止他吗？

source: Drat. And to think, my own child parroting my wisdom back to me!
target: 真是的。没想到我自己的孩子，竟拿我的至理名言来回敬我！

source: Very well. I shall have a look. But I promise nothing.
target: 好吧。我会去看看。但我什么都不保证。

source: I have an old key from when King Hamlet occupied the room. I don't believe His Majesty has changed the locks.
target: 我有一把旧钥匙，是哈姆雷特国王还住在那里时留下的。我想陛下应该没换过锁。

source: I'll slip in when he goes for a stroll and see what I can find.
target: 等他出去散步，我就悄悄进去，看看能找到什么。

source: Don't take this the wrong way, but -- what if Hamlet and I began seeing each other again?
target: 你别想歪了，不过——要是我和哈姆雷特又开始交往呢？

source: The 'wrong way', she says. Is there a right way to court Hamlet?
target: 她还说“别想歪了”。跟哈姆雷特谈恋爱，难道还能想得正吗？

source: That was rhetorical, sister. You already know my feelings on this.
target: 那是反问，妹妹。你早就知道我对此的看法。

source: You'll put Father into an early grave that way.
target: 你这样会让父亲早早进坟墓的。

source: Father's newly passed, and your head's already on ignoring the advice he spent so many months giving you.
target: 父亲才刚去世，你就已经想着把他劝了你那么多个月的话抛到脑后了。

source: So don't speak to me of this, but listen to your inner voice of reason. What does it tell you?
target: 所以别跟我谈这个，听听你心里理智的声音吧。它是怎么说的？

source: What do you know of Othello, the barkeep in town?
target: 你对镇上开酒馆的奥赛罗了解多少？

source: Ah. I've met the man himself, in fact, when I landed at his establishment.
target: 啊。其实我见过他本人，那次我去了他的酒馆。

source: After my ill-fated and too-soon return to Elsinore... I needed a drink.
target: 我倒霉地提前回到埃尔西诺之后……需要喝一杯。

source: A grand storyteller, they call him.
target: 大家都说他是个讲故事的好手。

source: I've never met the man, but I know of him. A storyteller, they call him.
target: 我没见过他，但听说过他。大家都说他会讲故事。

source: But... he's the only one like us. Who looks the way we do.
target: 可是……只有他和我们一样。外貌和我们一样。

source: Of course, Ophelia. Do you think I didn't notice?
target: 当然，奥菲莉娅。你以为我没注意到吗？

source: Aren't you the least bit curious about where he comes from? Why he's in Denmark?
target: 你难道一点都不好奇他是从哪里来的？为什么会在丹麦？

source: Mother came to Denmark. It's not all that peculiar.
target: 母亲也来到了丹麦。这没什么好奇怪的。

source: Oh, come on. Look around, Laertes. There is no one else like us. Mother was an oddity. We're oddities.
target: 得了吧。看看周围，雷欧提斯。确实没有别人和我们一样。母亲是异类。我们也是异类。

source: I know that just as well as you do.
target: 这一点，我和你一样清楚。

source: I go walking through town at night, and everyone knows who I am. Everyone knows the little black lord, Polonius's son.
target: 我晚上在镇上走走，人人都知道我是谁。人人都认得那个黑人小少爷，波洛涅斯的儿子。

source: Every single day I struggle to keep my voice calm, my hands gentle.
target: 每一天，我都竭力让自己的声音保持平静，让手上的动作保持轻柔。

source: I see how people flinch when I laugh too loudly, or glance at them across a darkened street.
target: 我看得见，我笑得太大声，或是在昏暗的街道另一头看他们一眼，他们就会畏缩。

source: And if I were to go and strike up a friendship with some no-name man who pours the ale... would they think me like him, then?
target: 要是我再去跟一个无名无姓、替人倒啤酒的男人交朋友……他们会不会就觉得我和他是一类人？

source: Because Ophelia, we are not like him. We are of noble blood.
target: 因为奥菲莉娅，我们和他不一样。我们有贵族血统。

source: And every moment we spend in the company of men like him, others will put us in the mold of some lower, baser image.
target: 我们每和他那样的人待在一起一刻，别人就会把我们看得更低贱、更卑下。

source: I don't believe that.
target: 我不相信会这样。

source: That you do not believe me is a blessing, for it means you truly don't know what strangers can be like.
target: 你不相信我的话，是一种福气，因为这说明你真的不知道陌生人会是什么样。

source: Some day you'll understand.
target: 总有一天你会明白的。

source: Until then, be careful how you associate with Othello.
target: 在那之前，跟奥赛罗来往时要谨慎。

source: What do you know of Othello the barkeep?
target: 你对开酒馆的奥赛罗了解多少？

source: It is what I try not to know that is of interest to you, I think.
target: 我想，你感兴趣的恰恰是我尽量不去了解的事。

source: He came to town only a short while ago, but has accumulated rather a lot of history in that span.
target: 他才来镇上没多久，却已经在这段时间里闹出了不少事。

source: Though he tells a tall tale and has always shown me kindness, so I look away from it.
target: 不过他会讲些夸张的故事，对我也一直很友善，所以我就睁一只眼闭一只眼。

source: Sells the cheapest ale you can find in town!
target: 他卖的啤酒是全镇最便宜的！

source: And his patrons are some of the cheapest whores, too.
target: 他的客人里也有些最廉价的妓女。

source: His lifestyle's catching up with him at last, of course. Men attacking at all hours of the day.
target: 当然，他那种过法终于招来祸事了。一天到晚都有男人来袭击他。

source: That sort of thing always catches up, in the end.
target: 那种事，到头来总会招来报应。

source: Guildenstern will not cease chattering about him, despite knowing almost nothing about him.
target: 吉尔登斯吞明明对他几乎一无所知，却怎么也不肯停止念叨他。

source: She fancies him a poet-warrior of sorts, or something like that. She's writing him a sonnet.
target: 她把他想成了什么诗人兼勇士之类的人物。她正在给他写一首十四行诗。

source: At this point, it's difficult to recall which things she's told me as fact versus girlish fantasy.
target: 到了现在，我都很难想起她告诉我的哪些是事实，哪些是少女的幻想了。

source: Cutest warrior-poet in all Denmark, if you ask me!
target: 要我说，他是全丹麦最可爱的勇士诗人！

source: I'm writing him a sonnet!
target: 我正在给他写一首十四行诗！

source: How's it go?
target: 怎么写的？

source: Oh, Othello, who gives generous pours, and whom my soul adores...
target: 啊，奥赛罗，你斟酒慷慨，我的灵魂将你钟爱……

source: That's it.
target: 就这些。

source: That's not a sonnet at all. Fourteen lines of ten syllables -- isn't that how it goes?
target: 这根本不算十四行诗。十四行，每行十个音节——不该是这样吗？

source: Stop putting labels on my art!
target: 别给我的艺术贴标签！

source: Mm. Let's see. Think he was a slave, then a warrior, then he escaped and was a pirate for a bit, and now he's here.
target: 嗯。我想想。他好像先是奴隶，后来成了战士，再后来逃了出来，当过一阵子海盗，现在就在这里了。

source: Mother's name was Adi... Told me his father's once, but I cannot recall it.
target: 他母亲叫阿迪……他也告诉过我一次他父亲的名字，但我想不起来了。

source: You know quite a lot, then.
target: 这么说，你知道的还真不少。

source: Oh, yes. You see, I ask.
target: 哦，是啊。你看，我会问。

source: Isn't it strange how so many people never ask a true question of those around them?
target: 那么多人从不真心向身边的人问个问题，你不觉得奇怪吗？

source: It's always, 'how is your health?' Or 'isn't it lovely outside?' And never, 'what makes you truly happy?' or 'what was your mother like?'
target: 总是问“你身体好吗？”或者“外面天气真好，是吧？”从来不问“什么能让你真正快乐？”或是“你母亲是个什么样的人？”

source: Well, for everyone except you. You're quite the little inquisitor.
target: 嗯，除了你。你可真是个爱盘问的小姑娘。

source: Always seem to be on the heels of your next interrogation.
target: 你好像总是紧接着就要开始下一场盘问。

source: Did you know Prince Hamlet and I were once in a relationship?
target: 你知道我和哈姆雷特王子曾经交往过吗？

source: Ought I to be concerned you're telling me this?
target: 你告诉我这件事，我该担心吗？

source: I merely wanted to bring it to your attention.
target: 我只是想让你知道。

source: You know, I am a man rather easily possessed of jealousy.
target: 你知道，我是个很容易嫉妒的男人。

source: I-- I must admit it has been described to me as a fault of mine.
target: 我——我得承认，有人说过，这是我的一个缺点。

source: I have no qualms with your past, Ophelia. But that you raise this matter now...
target: 我不介意你的过去，奥菲莉娅。但你现在提起这件事……

source: Please don't trifle with me. I care for you too much for that nonsense, and we are far too grown for it besides.
target: 请别拿我的感情开玩笑。我太在乎你，受不了这种胡闹，而且我们也早就过了玩这种把戏的年纪。

source: Well, as you've shown little interest in me, I can only imagine the man still has your heart.
target: 既然你对我没表现出多少兴趣，我只能猜想，你心里还装着那个男人。

source: Will you go to him?
target: 你会去找他吗？

source: I thought I'd heard every rumor in the country, but I suppose I was short one.
target: 我还以为全国的传闻我都听过了，看来还是漏了一条。

source: Given your family resides at Elsinore, I imagine you had quite some time to make his acquaintance.
target: 你家住在埃尔西诺，想必你有不少时间结识他。

source: Tell me, was it a torch bursting to life? Or a slow-burning flame?
target: 告诉我，那感情是火把骤然燃起？还是一簇慢慢燃烧的火焰？

source: You are forward, aren't you.
target: 你还真是唐突啊。

source: I prefer to call it 'honest.' But please forgive me. Some find that honesty rather coarse.
target: 我更愿意称之为“坦诚”。不过，请原谅我。有些人觉得这种坦诚很粗鲁。

source: What would you say if Hamlet and I were to rekindle our relationship?
target: 要是我和哈姆雷特重续旧情，你会怎么说？

source: Well, nothing nice, I suppose.
target: 嗯，想必没什么好话。

source: That's all you have to say on this?
target: 你就只有这句话要说？

source: Ophelia, I like to joke, and even this isn't funny to me.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我是喜欢开玩笑，可连我都觉得这事不好笑。

source: For so many reasons, the least of which is my own history with Hamlet.
target: 原因有很多，我自己和哈姆雷特的过去，反倒是最不重要的一个。

source: Must you be cruel?
target: 你非要这么残忍吗？

source: Nothing, only to ask that you not say anything to Guildenstern about it.
target: 没什么，只想请你别跟吉尔登斯吞提起这件事。

source: She's-- well, she and Hamlet--
target: 她——嗯，她和哈姆雷特——

source: They weren't together long when we were at school, but she was left feeling sour over the whole ordeal.
target: 我们还在学校时，他们在一起的时间并不长，但这段经历让她一直耿耿于怀。

source: Vita brevis, occasio praeceps.
target: 人生苦短，机不可失。

source: 'Life is short, opportunity fleeting?' What's that supposed to mean?
target: “人生苦短，机不可失”？这是什么意思？

source: One ought to pursue whatever whim crosses one's mind. In this case, for you, Hamlet.
target: 心里冒出什么念头，就该去追求。在这件事上，对你而言，就是哈姆雷特。

source: For if we all might be dead tomorrow, what good does it do to deny yourself a worldly pleasure today?
target: 要是我们明天都可能死去，今天不让自己享受一点人间乐趣，又有什么好处呢？

source: Although I must admit myself a jealous man, I cannot keep Hamlet all to myself.
target: 虽然我得承认自己爱吃醋，但我不能独占哈姆雷特。

source: Because you love him.
target: 因为你爱他。

source: That I do. And despite my best efforts, I don't believe I shall ever stop.
target: 是的，我爱他。尽管我已经尽力了，我想自己永远也放不下这份爱。

source: 'All to myself?'
target: “独占？”

source: You're a little slow on the uptake, aren't you?
target: 你反应有点慢，是不是？

source: My lady, your husband has been concealing some information about your sister. She's passed away.
target: 王后，您的丈夫一直瞒着您一些关于您姐妹的消息。她已经去世了。

source: Yes. Margaret.
target: 是的。玛格丽特。

source: Margaret is...
target: 玛格丽特她……

source: Margaret is dead?
target: 玛格丽特死了？

source: The King felt it best to keep this information private from you. Because of everything you've been through lately.
target: 国王觉得最好先不让您知道这件事。因为您最近经历了太多。

source: But I didn't feel it was right to hide this.
target: 但我觉得不该瞒着您。

source: Your husband received a letter describing the situation. It was addressed from her nephew. Charles.
target: 您的丈夫收到了一封说明情况的信。寄信人是她的侄甥。查尔斯。

source: Oh, my God in Heaven. Margaret is dead. I can hardly believe it. It doesn't feel true.
target: 啊，天上的上帝。玛格丽特死了。我简直不敢相信。感觉这不是真的。

source: But if it is true...
target: 可如果这是真的……

source: Why would he hide this from me?
target: 他为什么要瞒着我？

source: Does he think me so weak that I cannot stand to hear about the well-being of my own family?
target: 他觉得我这么脆弱，连自己家人的安危都听不得吗？

source: Ah. What am I saying? It doesn't matter.
target: 唉。我在说什么？这已经不重要了。

source: She's dead. Margaret is dead. It sounds strange on my lips.
target: 她死了。玛格丽特死了。这话从我嘴里说出来，听着真陌生。

source: One believes there is always time, Ophelia. That's the problem. I thought there'd be time to see her again.
target: 人总以为还有时间，奥菲莉娅。问题就在这里。我以为还有时间再见她一面。

source: And then...
target: 可后来……

source: My sister was the only one in the whole world who ever understood me.
target: 我的姐妹是这世上唯一真正理解过我的人。

source: My son, my husbands, my closest friends. None of them knew me as she did.
target: 我的儿子，我的两任丈夫，我最亲近的朋友。他们都没有她那么了解我。

source: And now the only person who truly grasped the inner workings of my heart is dead.
target: 而现在，唯一真正懂得我心中所思所想的人死了。

source: I-- I feel exhausted.
target: 我——我觉得累极了。

source: My lady, you're going through so many things right now. Sleep if you must.
target: 王后，您现在承受的事情太多了。要是需要，就睡一会儿吧。

source: Yes. Sleep. I must sleep.
target: 是啊。睡觉。我得睡一会儿。

source: It feels so strange. I spent the last six years trying to find a way to see Margaret.
target: 这感觉真奇怪。过去六年，我一直在想办法去见玛格丽特。

source: Yet now no manner of travel can ever bring me to her. No letter I write can ever reach her.
target: 可现在，无论怎么走，我都再也到不了她身边了。我写的信，也再不会送到她手里。

source: Thank you for letting me know, Ophelia. But I need to be alone now.
target: 谢谢你告诉我，奥菲莉娅。但我现在需要一个人待着。

source: I understand, my lady.
target: 我明白，王后。

source: You know as I do that Gertrude's sister is dead, and you've kept the news from her. Why?
target: 你和我一样，知道乔特鲁德的姐妹已经死了，却一直瞒着她。为什么？

source: What? How on earth did you learn of it?
target: 什么？你到底是怎么知道的？

source: Heard a rumor in town. Word travels fast, I suppose.
target: 在镇上听到了传闻。我想，消息传得很快吧。

source: Bloody hell. It'll be just a moment before my wife learns of it, then.
target: 该死。那我妻子很快也会知道了。

source: I wanted to shield her, Ophelia. I wanted to save her the pain. She's not in her right mind.
target: 我是想保护她，奥菲莉娅。我想让她免受痛苦。她现在头脑不清醒。

source: If I could keep her from suffering just a little longer... she might be strong enough to bear the news.
target: 如果能让她再多安稳一阵子……她也许就能坚强到足以承受这个消息了。

source: Or so I thought. Please don't tell her.
target: 至少我原本是这么想的。请别告诉她。

source: I've learned that the Queen's sister has passed away. Margaret. Did you know her?
target: 我得知王后的姐妹去世了。玛格丽特。你认识她吗？

source: What a great woman she was. How horrid.
target: 她是个多么了不起的女人啊。真是噩耗。

source: She lived a full life. Like me, she bore no children.
target: 她的一生过得很充实。和我一样，她没有生过孩子。

source: I suspect she always envied Gerta on some level for that.
target: 我猜在这件事上，她心里多少一直有些羡慕格尔塔。

source: Gerta will be devastated when she finds out.
target: 格尔塔知道后会伤心欲绝的。

source: No. I didn't. As far as I know, she's never visited Denmark.
target: 不。我不认识她。据我所知，她从没来过丹麦。

source: Still, Gertrude talks about her a lot. And she doesn't seem to be in the... best of states.
target: 不过，乔特鲁德经常提起她。而乔特鲁德现在的状态似乎……不太好。

source: I worry about what Gertrude will do when she hears of the death.
target: 我担心乔特鲁德听到死讯后会做出什么事来。

source: Your aunt has passed. Margaret. Your mother's sister.
target: 你的姨母去世了。玛格丽特。你母亲的姐妹。

source: My mother's sister? Ah, yes. I vaguely recall the one. I've never met her.
target: 我母亲的姐妹？啊，是的。我隐约记得有这么个人。我从没见过她。

source: Well, that's a pity. But it can't be helped.
target: 唉，真遗憾。但也没办法。

source: Can you tell me anything about your history with Horatio?
target: 能跟我说说你和霍拉旭的往事吗？

source: Well, history makes it sound so dry.
target: 唉，说成往事，听着真没意思。

source: Would you believe there was a time when we weren't friends? In the beginning, I didn't care for him much at all.
target: 你信吗？我们也曾不是朋友。最初，我一点也不喜欢他。

source: My father had asked him to dog me, you see, and report on my comings and goings.
target: 你看，我父亲让他寸步不离地跟着我，汇报我的行踪。

source: I called him 'Nursemaid' for several months. I do not believe he enjoyed the title.
target: 我叫了他好几个月的“保姆”。我想他并不喜欢这个称呼。

source: I could have, I think. But we had a rather distressing conversation, and now I'm questioning it all.
target: 我想，我原本可以的。但我们谈了一次，谈得很不愉快，现在我对这一切都产生了怀疑。

source: Horatio has been one of the most impactful people in my life. I shall leave it at that.
target: 霍拉旭是我这一生中对我影响最深的人之一。我就说到这里吧。

source: What's your history with Hamlet?
target: 你和哈姆雷特之间有过哪些往事？

source: In what regard?
target: 你指哪方面？

source: You two have known each other for quite some time, haven't you?
target: 你们两个认识很久了，对吧？

source: Yes. We certainly have.
target: 是的。确实很久了。

source: I think the full description of our friendship would be at best saccharine, and at worst boring.
target: 我想，要把我们的友谊从头到尾讲一遍，往好了说是肉麻，往坏了说就是无聊。

source: But you know, the moment I began to like Hamlet was the night we first discussed you.
target: 不过，你知道吗，我开始喜欢上哈姆雷特，就是在我们第一次谈起你的那个晚上。

source: We had come from hearing one of the great writers of the area lecture on his work. Afterwards, we went for a drink.
target: 我们去听了当地一位大作家讲他自己的作品。听完以后，我们去喝了一杯。

source: I remember feeling Hamlet was unusually well equipped to discuss literature for a surly teenage boy.
target: 我记得当时觉得，哈姆雷特虽然是个脾气不好的少年，谈起文学来却格外有见地。

source: When I pressed him on where he had developed such a liking, he mentioned you'd given many of the great works to him to read.
target: 我追问他怎么会对文学这么感兴趣，他说你给了他许多名作读。

source: I thought, goodness, this Ophelia woman sounds like quite the scholar!
target: 我当时想，天哪，这位奥菲莉娅听起来可真是个学问人！

source: And yet I feel as if my time at Hamlet's side is soon to come to a close.
target: 可我却觉得，我陪在哈姆雷特身边的日子快要结束了。

source: He will always be one of my closest friends. But maybe some distance from him would do us both good.
target: 他永远都会是我最亲近的朋友之一。但也许和他保持些距离，对我们两个都有好处。

source: My lady, what do you know of Hamlet and Horatio's friendship?
target: 王后，您对哈姆雷特和霍拉旭的友谊了解多少？

source: Quite a lot! My husband was rather fond of Horatio when Horatio served as a soldier, and he first introduced the two boys.
target: 了解不少！霍拉旭当兵时，我丈夫就很喜欢他，最初也是他介绍这两个年轻人认识的。

source: I never got to know Horatio properly until he came here to Elsinore recently. It's rather a shame.
target: 直到霍拉旭最近来到埃尔西诺，我才真正有机会了解他。想想真有些遗憾。

source: But, you know, before they went to Wittenberg, the two of them didn't get along very well at all. It's wonderful to see things have changed.
target: 不过，你知道吗，在去维滕贝格之前，他们两个相处得很不好。看到他们如今变了，真让人高兴。

source: After all, my son has often had a number of hangers-on, but very few true friends of the heart.
target: 毕竟，我儿子身边常有不少攀附他的人，却没几个真正交心的朋友。

source: You went to school with them both. Can you tell me anything about Hamlet and Horatio's history?
target: 你和他们两个一起上过学。能跟我说说哈姆雷特和霍拉旭的往事吗？

source: I could write volumes. What in particular are you concerned with?
target: 那可够我写上好几本书了。你具体想知道什么？

source: I believe I can trust you with this: I suspect there may have been something more to their relationship than friendship.
target: 我相信这件事可以告诉你：我怀疑他们之间曾经可能不只是友谊。

source: And I also suspect he might be struggling with it alone.
target: 而且我还怀疑，他可能正独自为这件事苦恼。

source: Oh. That.
target: 哦。那件事啊。

source: Yes. There is certainly something like that, isn't there?
target: 是啊。确实有那么回事，不是吗？

source: I think this is something Horatio won't admit to on his own.
target: 我想霍拉旭不会主动承认这件事。

source: Has anyone spoken to him about it in further detail?
target: 有人就这件事和他深入谈过吗？

source: But I might be the one best able to do so. I think I understand what's happening here.
target: 不过，也许我最适合去跟他谈。我想我明白这是怎么回事。

source: I'll see if I can find Horatio and have a word with him.
target: 我去看看能不能找到霍拉旭，跟他聊聊。

source: I spoke to Horatio earlier about this very thing. I hope what I had to say was helpful.
target: 我之前刚和霍拉旭谈过这件事。希望我说的话能帮到他。

source: Whatever he chooses to do next, we have to support him as best as we can.
target: 不管他接下来决定怎么做，我们都得尽力支持他。

source: Oh, yes! So many things. Why? What?
target: 哦，当然！知道的事可多了。怎么了？什么事？

source: I believe I can trust you with this: I suspect there may be something more to their relationship than friendship.
target: 我相信这件事可以告诉你：我怀疑他们之间可能不只是友谊。

source: I'm not sure whether they ever spoke of it.
target: 我不确定他们有没有谈起过这件事。

source: And Hamlet's gone now, and, well--
target: 而现在哈姆雷特已经不在了，而且，唉——

source: You know, Rosie should go have a chat with Horatio about it. She always knows just what to say.
target: 你知道吗，萝茜该去找霍拉旭聊聊这件事。她总知道该说些什么。

source: I'd just put my foot in my mouth! I'm certain!
target: 要是我去，肯定只会说错话！我敢肯定！

source: I'll tell Rosencrantz to find Horatio. Then she'll have to tell me if she hears anything really juicy.
target: 我会叫罗森克兰兹去找霍拉旭。这样，要是她听到什么特别有趣的秘闻，就必须告诉我了。

source: Rosey went off to talk to Horatio earlier. She gives far better advice than I ever could.
target: 萝茜之前去找霍拉旭谈了。她给的建议比我能给的好得多。

source: Does everyone not know that already?
target: 这不是大家早就知道的事吗？

source: Well, I'm not certain Hamlet does.
target: 可是，我不确定哈姆雷特知不知道。

source: I suppose the ones who need to know have been informed now.
target: 我想，该知道的人现在都已经知道了。

source: What do you know of Horatio's history with Prince Hamlet?
target: 你对霍拉旭和哈姆雷特王子的往事了解多少？

source: Not much. Merely that Hamlet went away to Wittenberg with Horatio, and when the both of them returned, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern were in tow.
target: 不多。只知道哈姆雷特和霍拉旭一起去了维滕贝格，等他们两个回来时，罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞也跟着来了。

source: I believe it would be better to ask one of the latter two ladies. I have little context on the matter.
target: 我想你最好去问问后面那两位女士中的一位。这件事的来龙去脉，我不太清楚。

source: Let's just say that when you tend the bar, you hear things.
target: 这么说吧，在酒馆里招呼客人，总会听到些事情。

source: Horatio's made mention of a thing or two which gave me pause. There are feelings there he hasn't surfaced.
target: 霍拉旭提过一两件事，让我有些在意。他有些感情还没有表露出来。

source: I think I might be able to help him with that.
target: 我想我也许能在这件事上帮帮他。

source: Oh? The poor man's had quite a rough life. It might do him some good to have a friend step in on his behalf.
target: 哦？这个可怜人一生经历了不少坎坷。要是有朋友出面帮他，也许对他有好处。

source: All
target: 全部

source: The Royal Family
target: 王室

source: Courtiers, Servants & Guests
target: 廷臣、仆人与宾客

source: Father desires to speak to my brother Laertes before he leaves for Paris tomorrow.
target: 父亲想在我哥哥雷欧提斯明天启程去巴黎之前，跟他谈一谈。

source: Father's Request
target: 父亲的请求

source: The King denied Hamlet's request to return to Wittenberg, on the grounds that the Queen needs him here.
target: 国王拒绝了哈姆雷特返回维滕贝格的请求，理由是王后需要他留在这里。

source: Hamlet Is Staying
target: 哈姆雷特要留下

source: Changing the Play
target: 修改戏剧

source: Nobles & Servants
target: 贵族与仆人

source: Political Matters
target: 政事

source: Otherworldly Occurrences
target: 超自然事件

source: The Castle's Past
target: 城堡往事

source: A Journey at Sea
target: 海上之旅

source: Castle Town
target: 城堡小镇

source: There's a spy in Elsinore Castle. Perhaps the right performance could elicit a reaction in this person.
target: 埃尔西诺城堡里有个间谍。也许恰当的演出能让这个人有所反应。

source: A Spy in Elsinore
target: 埃尔西诺的间谍

source: There's a spy in Elsinore Castle.
target: 埃尔西诺城堡里有个间谍。

source: Time is repeating itself. What is going on?
target: 时间正在重复。这到底是怎么回事？

source: Frozen in Time
target: 困在时间里

source: Time is repeating itself.
target: 时间正在重复。

source: Hamlet will kill my father, and not even the King will mourn him. His loyalty to the throne is misplaced.
target: 哈姆雷特会杀死我的父亲，就连国王也不会为他哀悼。他对王室的忠诚给错了人。

source: The King knows of Hamlet's affections for me, and may wish to get rid of me as a result.
target: 国王知道哈姆雷特对我的感情，可能因此想除掉我。

source: Inconvenient Affections
target: 碍事的爱意

source: I have undeniable proof that Claudius murdered his brother, the late King Hamlet, by pouring poison into his ear.
target: 我有无可辩驳的证据，证明克劳狄斯将毒药倒入他哥哥、先王哈姆雷特国王的耳中，谋杀了他。

source: Claudius Killed King Hamlet
target: 克劳狄斯杀了哈姆雷特国王

source: Hamlet is acting strangely. He showed up in my room, barely clothed. What's going on with him?
target: 哈姆雷特举止古怪。他出现在我的房间里，身上几乎没穿衣服。他到底怎么了？

source: What's Wrong With Hamlet?
target: 哈姆雷特怎么了？

source: Even before King Hamlet's passing, Claudius and Gertrude had been intimate. Gertrude herself wrote about it in her diary.
target: 在哈姆雷特国王去世之前，克劳狄斯和乔特鲁德就已经有了亲密关系。乔特鲁德亲自在日记里写下了这件事。

source: The Affair
target: 私情

source: Hamlet is acting strangely. He showed up in my room, his hair a mess and his eyes wild. What's going on with him?
target: 哈姆雷特举止古怪。他出现在我的房间里，头发凌乱，眼神狂乱。他到底怎么了？

source: Hamlet is acting very strangely. Something must be amiss.
target: 哈姆雷特的举止非常古怪。一定有什么不对劲。

source: Someone close to the Queen ought to have a key. Maybe I can persuade them to open that door for me.
target: 王后身边亲近的人应该有钥匙。也许我能说服他们替我打开那扇门。

source: The Queen's Chambers Are Locked
target: 王后的寝宫锁着

source: Irma has proposed a card game for later on this evening, and she wants Lady Brit, Horatio, and Marcellus to attend.
target: 伊尔玛提议今晚晚些时候打牌，希望布莉特女士、霍拉旭和马塞勒斯都来参加。

source: Irma Wants To Play Cards
target: 伊尔玛想打牌

source: Lady Brit wants to go for a walk with Hamlet, outside the castle grounds, alone. I'm expected to facilitate this somehow.
target: 布莉特女士想和哈姆雷特两个人单独去城堡范围外散步。她希望我想办法促成这件事。

source: Brit Wants To Meet Hamlet
target: 布莉特想见哈姆雷特

source: This so-called 'spy' put a dagger in my heart. Surely someone can help me stay alive this time.
target: 这个所谓的“间谍”把匕首刺进了我的心脏。这一次，总该有人能帮我活下来。

source: I'm In Danger
target: 我有危险

source: Rumors are flying that Elsinore Castle is haunted... by the ghost of the late King Hamlet himself.
target: 到处都在传埃尔西诺城堡闹鬼……据说那幽灵正是已故的哈姆雷特国王本人。

source: A Ghost in Elsinore
target: 埃尔西诺的幽灵

source: I believe time is repeating itself, but I haven't any idea why. I was certain I should have died, but—I woke up in my own bed.
target: 我相信时间正在重复，却完全不知道为什么。我确信自己本该死了，可——我却在自己的床上醒来。

source: I have undeniable proof that Claudius murdered his brother, the late King Hamlet, by pouring poison in his ear.
target: 我有无可辩驳的证据，证明克劳狄斯将毒药倒入他哥哥、先王哈姆雷特国王的耳中，谋杀了他。

source: The King has a private stash of poison, and he plans to use it soon.
target: 国王私藏了一批毒药，而且打算很快就用上。

source: The King's Poison Cache
target: 国王私藏的毒药

source: My father died by Hamlet's hand.
target: 我父亲死在了哈姆雷特手里。

source: My Father's Murder
target: 父亲被杀

source: Even before King Hamlet's passing, Claudius and Gertrude were lovers. Gertrude herself wrote about it in her diary.
target: 在哈姆雷特国王去世之前，克劳狄斯和乔特鲁德就已经是情人。乔特鲁德亲自在日记里写下了这件事。

source: Brit is an agent of Fortinbras and a daughter of a powerful Danish noble. She's assisting Norway in planning a coup.
target: 布莉特是福丁布拉斯的密探，也是一位有权势的丹麦贵族的女儿。她正在协助挪威策划政变。

source: Brit Is A Spy
target: 布莉特是间谍

source: Guard Captain Bernardo believes there is a spy in Elsinore, but doesn't know their identity. What do you think?
target: 卫队长贝尔纳多认为埃尔西诺有个间谍，却不知道是谁。你怎么看？

source: The esteemed Peter Quince will be performing one of his odd one-man plays with Hamlet's help.
target: 备受尊敬的彼得·奎因斯将在哈姆雷特的帮助下，上演他那些古怪独角戏中的一出。

source: Peter Quince's Performance
target: 彼得·奎因斯的演出

source: I had a terrible nightmare in which I witnessed death and disaster. It felt so real, like an omen.
target: 我做了一个可怕的噩梦，梦里亲眼见到了死亡与灾难。那感觉无比真实，像是某种预兆。

source: Tragic Nightmare
target: 悲惨的噩梦

source: Whatever he claims are his intentions, I know Fortinbras plans to ransack the castle and install himself as King.
target: 不管他声称自己有什么意图，我知道福丁布拉斯打算洗劫城堡，自立为王。

source: Fortinbras Will Invade
target: 福丁布拉斯将入侵

source: According to the Ghost of King Hamlet, my father has the last records of Hamlet's life before he died.
target: 据哈姆雷特国王的幽灵所说，父亲手里有国王生前最后一段日子的记录。

source: The King's Notes
target: 国王的笔记

source: King Hamlet was trapped in a time loop, like me. He sought a mysterious book which he believed was connected to it all.
target: 哈姆雷特国王和我一样，曾被困在时间循环里。他寻找过一本神秘的书，认为它与这一切有关。

source: The King's Cursed Book
target: 国王的诅咒之书

source: Simona--King Alexander's consort--did not die, but fled the castle. Where could she be?
target: 亚历山大国王的配偶西蒙娜并没有死，而是逃离了城堡。她会在哪里？

source: Simona Lives
target: 西蒙娜还活着

source: Margaret of Austria, Gertrude's sister, has died.
target: 乔特鲁德的姐妹，奥地利的玛格丽特，已经去世了。

source: Gertrude's Sister is Dead
target: 乔特鲁德的姐妹已死

source: Irma believes that Hamlet is unruly and needs disciplining. She's suggested that Queen Gertrude apply a firmer hand.
target: 伊尔玛认为哈姆雷特不守规矩，需要管教。她建议乔特鲁德王后对他严厉些。

source: Hamlet Must Be Disciplined
target: 必须管教哈姆雷特

source: Who was she? Why doesn't anyone mention her?
target: 她是谁？为什么没人提起她？

source: Mysterious Queen Astrid
target: 神秘的阿斯特丽德王后

source: Something is strange with Quince. He seems to know things he shouldn't.
target: 奎因斯有些古怪。他似乎知道一些他不该知道的事。

source: Mysterious Playmaster
target: 神秘的戏剧大师

source: My brother believes Hamlet stole his lute.
target: 哥哥认为哈姆雷特偷了他的鲁特琴。

source: My mother died alone, of plague. Her belongings are still in the dockhouse.
target: 母亲因瘟疫孤独地死去。她的遗物还在码头屋里。

source: My Mother's Death
target: 母亲之死

source: Claudius intends to give Rosencrantz and Guildenstern a letter calling for Hamlet's death when he sets sail for England.
target: 克劳狄斯打算在哈姆雷特启航前往英格兰时，交给罗森克兰兹和吉尔登斯吞一封要求处死哈姆雷特的信。

source: The Ship Plot Fails
target: 船上阴谋失败

source: Quince means to cause us all harm and confusion. He cannot be trusted.
target: 奎因斯意图伤害我们所有人，让我们陷入混乱。他不可信。

source: Banishing the Playmaster
target: 驱逐戏剧大师

source: I spotted the Queen going through the King's private possessions.
target: 我看见王后在翻查国王的私人物品。

source: Gertrude's Searching For Something
target: 乔特鲁德在找什么

source: My father burned some notes in a secretive way. He may be hiding something.
target: 父亲偷偷摸摸地烧掉了一些笔记。他可能在隐瞒什么。

source: What My Father Burned
target: 父亲烧掉的东西

source: I spotted Lady Rosencrantz & Guildenstern behaving strangely, and I think they may be up to no good.
target: 我看见罗森克兰兹女士和吉尔登斯吞女士举止古怪，觉得她们可能没安好心。

source: An Odd Duo
target: 古怪的二人组

source: Bernardo has requested your presence in a private counsel with him. You ought to meet with him as soon as possible.
target: 贝尔纳多请你与他私下商谈。你应该尽快去见他。

source: Bernardo Has Summoned You
target: 贝尔纳多召你见面

source: Bernardo has requested your presence in a private meeting.
target: 贝尔纳多请你与他私下见面。

source: By night, Bernardo plays a woman onstage--Katherine--in Castle Town.
target: 夜里，贝尔纳多在城堡镇的舞台上扮演一名女性——凯瑟琳。

source: Bernardo And Katherine
target: 贝尔纳多与凯瑟琳

source: Hamlet has a plan to wrest control of the ship from the Pirate Queen, but Rosie and Guilda won't survive.
target: 哈姆雷特计划从海盗女王手里夺取这艘船的控制权，但萝茜和吉尔达会丧命。

source: Mutiny
target: 哗变

source: Othello, the barkeep in town, is being extorted by thugs.
target: 镇上的酒馆老板奥赛罗正遭到恶徒勒索。

source: Barkeep in Trouble
target: 酒馆老板的麻烦

source: Othello's been through some incredible adventures. I wonder what others know of him?
target: 奥赛罗有过一些不可思议的冒险经历。不知道别人对他了解多少？

source: Long-Lost Adventures
target: 尘封的冒险往事

source: Hamlet and I were in a relationship once, but it ended poorly. I could rekindle the flame, if I wanted
target: 我曾和哈姆雷特交往过，但最后闹得很不愉快。如果我愿意，也可以让我们旧情复燃

source: The Prince and Me
target: 王子与我

source: Hamlet and I were in a relationship once, but it ended poorly. I could rekindle the flame, if I wanted.
target: 我曾和哈姆雷特交往过，但最后闹得很不愉快。如果我愿意，也可以让我们旧情复燃。

source: What makes a King great? Some trustworthy folk around the castle might know.
target: 怎样才能成为一位伟大的国王？城堡里一些值得信赖的人或许知道。

source: Making a King
target: 成就一位国王

source: Brit has seemed chronically unhappy since I met her. What do others know about her?
target: 自从认识布莉特以来，她似乎一直郁郁寡欢。别人对她了解多少？

source: Lady Brockenhuus
target: 布罗肯胡斯女士

source: Prince Fortinbras is hiding out in town with his advisors. He's planning an invasion from there.
target: 福丁布拉斯王子和他的顾问们藏在镇上。他正在那里策划入侵。

source: Fortinbras' Hideout
target: 福丁布拉斯的藏身处

source: Please leave the stage immediately.
target: 请立刻离开舞台。

source: Exeunt All
target: 全体退场

source: Yes. I'm the murderer. I can kill you with a word. And I won't hesitate.
target: 没错。我就是凶手。我只要一句话就能杀了你。而且我不会犹豫。

source: You Ought To Fear Me
target: 你该怕我

source: Lady Guildenstern would like me to inform you that she's dead.
target: 吉尔登斯吞女士希望我通知你，她已经死了。

source: Guildenstern's Death
target: 吉尔登斯吞之死

source: Cygnus, one of the guards, mentioned something about 'being on thin ice.' What's going on?
target: 卫兵西格纳斯提到自己“处境危险”。这是怎么回事？

source: The Guards Are Acting Strangely
target: 卫兵举止古怪

source: The guard at the gate to town seems troubled. What might be wrong?
target: 通往镇上的大门处，那名卫兵似乎心事重重。可能出了什么事？

source: What can people tell me about Horatio and Hamlet's long-standing friendship?
target: 关于霍拉旭和哈姆雷特多年的友谊，大家能告诉我些什么？

source: Horatio, Friend to Hamlet
target: 哈姆雷特的朋友霍拉旭

source: Lord have mercy. Lord have mercy.
target: 主啊，求你怜悯。主啊，求你怜悯。

source: Please, god, please god, please.
target: 求求你，上帝，求求你，上帝，求求你。

source: Lord have mercy, please god, have mercy.
target: 主啊，求你怜悯，上帝，求求你，发发慈悲。

source: Don't let her kill me. Please. Protect us.
target: 别让她杀了我。求求你。保佑我们。

source: Queen Gertrude
target: 乔特鲁德王后

source: King Claudius
target: 克劳狄斯国王

source: Lady Brit
target: 布莉特女士

source: Quince
target: 奎因斯

source: Lady Rosencrantz
target: 罗森克兰兹女士

source: Lady Guildenstern
target: 吉尔登斯吞女士

source: Hooded Figure
target: 戴兜帽的人

source: Servant
target: 仆人

source: Gonzago
target: 贡扎古

source: Lucianus
target: 卢西安纳斯

source: Baptista
target: 巴普蒂斯塔

source: Foreign Soldier
target: 外国士兵

source: Cygnus
target: 西格纳斯

source: Townsperson
target: 镇民

source: Old Woman
target: 老妇人

source: Elise
target: 伊莉丝

source: Captain Grace
target: 格蕾丝船长

source: Captain
target: 船长

source: Brigand
target: 强盗

source: Villager
target: 村民

source: Sailor
target: 水手

source: Richard
target: 理查德

source: Aldous
target: 奥尔德斯

source: Soldier
target: 士兵

source: Finnegan
target: 芬尼根

source: Kubilius
target: 库比利乌斯

source: Kistler
target: 基斯特勒

source: Murphy
target: 墨菲

source: Katherine
target: 凯瑟琳

source: Petruchio
target: 彼特鲁乔

source: Corambis
target: 科兰比斯

source: Reynaldo
target: 雷纳尔多

source: McDonald
target: 麦克唐纳

source: Voltemand
target: 伏尔提曼德

source: Father has likely already gone to bed.
target: 父亲大概已经上床睡觉了。

source: Father always fancied himself a scholar, I think. He certainly carried on like one.
target: 我想，父亲从前总以学者自居。他的言谈举止确实也像个学者。

source: Father fancies himself a scholar, I think. He certainly carries on like one.
target: 我想，父亲以学者自居。他的言谈举止确实也像个学者。

source: These must be Bernardo's things. That was his father's dagger. He died two summers ago.
target: 这些一定是贝尔纳多的东西。那把匕首原本是他父亲的。他父亲在两年前的夏天去世了。

source: It's... my mother's grave. Elise.
target: 这是……我母亲的坟墓。伊莉丝。

source: She died before I can even remember. I know Father loved her a lot.
target: 我还没记事，她就去世了。我知道父亲很爱她。

source: This massive fireplace is kept burning by the servants day and night. It's the true castle hearth, I suppose.
target: 仆人们让这座巨大的壁炉日夜燃烧。我想，它才是城堡真正的炉火中心。

source: The cell door is locked right now.
target: 牢门现在锁着。

source: Could I have actually broken free?
target: 难道我真的已经挣脱了？

source: Please, God, let it be so.
target: 上帝啊，求你让这一切是真的。

source: Irma maintains these plants herself. I guess it's her hobby.
target: 这些植物都是伊尔玛亲自照料的。我猜这是她的爱好。

source: TODO THIS IS A FASCINATING YET INDESCRIBABLE OBJECT
target: 待完成：这是个令人着迷却又难以描述的东西

source: Father's hearth. It looks warm.
target: 父亲的壁炉。看起来很暖和。

source: Just books, here.
target: 这里只有书。

source: The servants draw water from this well to wash our belongings.
target: 仆人们从这口井里打水，清洗我们的物品。

source: It's uncomfortably warm in here, considering the season. But I suppose Hamlet likes it this way.
target: 这个季节，屋里这么热实在让人不舒服。不过我想哈姆雷特就喜欢这样。

source: Various herbs, ingredients, and salted meat. All of Irma's raw materials.
target: 各种香草、食材和腌肉。都是伊尔玛做饭用的原料。

source: Irma's hearth, used to cook and bake every meal.
target: 伊尔玛的炉灶，每顿饭都在这里烹煮烘烤。

source: It rarely seems to sputter out entirely--Irma is always working.
target: 炉火似乎很少彻底熄灭——伊尔玛总在忙。

source: My dresser, where some of my simpler garments are kept.
target: 我的衣柜，里面放着一些比较朴素的衣服。

source: I'm partial to this gown, though.
target: 不过，我还是偏爱这条裙子。

source: There are armed guards outside. I don't think they'll take kindly to my trying to leave.
target: 外面有武装卫兵。我想，要是我试着离开，他们不会高兴的。

source: No sense in going all the way down there right now.
target: 现在没必要一路走下去到那儿。

source: The castle armory is well stocked.
target: 城堡的军械库储备充足。

source: I can't sleep now.
target: 我现在不能睡。

source: Father's desk, as messy as ever.
target: 父亲的书桌，还是一如既往地乱。

source: The gate is locked.
target: 大门锁着。

source: It's unlocked.
target: 没锁。

source: And... empty.
target: 而且……是空的。

source: Nothing's hidden here.
target: 这里没藏什么东西。

source: The gate to town is locked.
target: 通往镇上的大门锁着。

source: I still won't touch that bucket.
target: 我还是不愿碰那个桶。

source: This bar's fireplace has a pleasant feel to it.
target: 这间酒馆的壁炉让人觉得很舒服。

source: He's unusually upset. I don't think he'd listen to anything I could say right now.
target: 他难得这么心烦。我想，现在我说什么他都听不进去。

source: She's unusually upset. I don't think she'd listen to anything I could say right now.
target: 她难得这么心烦。我想，现在我说什么她都听不进去。

source: He looks... devastated. I don't think there's anything I could say at this point.
target: 他看起来……悲痛欲绝。我想，眼下我也说不了什么。

source: She looks... devastated. I don't think there's anything I could say at this point.
target: 她看起来……悲痛欲绝。我想，眼下我也说不了什么。

source: There are so many people in town whom I've never met or seen...
target: 镇上有那么多人，我既不认识，也从没见过……

source: The captain of this vessel. I didn't catch his name. I haven't met him before.
target: 这艘船的船长。我没听清他的名字。以前也没见过他。

source: Looks like a tough, scruffy sort. I'd better not try to intervene.
target: 看起来是个不好惹、不修边幅的人。我最好别插手。

source: One of the sailors who man Denmark's royal fleet. There are dozens in the castle.
target: 丹麦皇家舰队的一名水手。城堡里有几十名这样的水手。

source: Looks like a tough, scruffy sort. The sea is a harsh mistress, I suppose...
target: 看起来是个粗犷、不修边幅的人。我想，大海这位女主人可不好伺候……

source: One of the many guards who patrol the castle. It's hard to tell who's who when the visors are down.
target: 在城堡巡逻的众多卫兵之一。面甲放下来时，很难分清谁是谁。

source: One of the guards who protects the castle walls. I'm afraid I don't know him well, although I sometimes hear him snoring through my bedroom floor...
target: 守卫城墙的卫兵之一。我和他实在不熟，不过有时能听见他的鼾声穿过卧室地板传上来……

source: Ah. Cygnus. You're assigned to the outer gate this week?
target: 啊，西格纳斯。这周你被派来守外门？

source: I-Indeed, your ladyship.
target: 是、是的，小姐。

source: If you go into town, please be cautious, your ladyship... or it'll be my head!
target: 小姐，如果您要去镇上，求您小心些……不然我就要掉脑袋了！

source: The royal gardener. I imagine it's a full day's work keeping all these flowers sprightly.
target: 王室园丁。我想，要让这些花一直生机勃勃，得忙上一整天。

source: She's one of the friendlier servants. I haven't spoken to her often, but she seems to be a kindly sort.
target: 她是仆人里比较友善的一位。我不常和她说话，但她看起来是个和善的人。

source: My father's attendant, who manages his financial affairs. Poorly, I might add.
target: 父亲的侍从，替他打理财务。顺带一提，打理得很差。

source: Evidently, he moonlights as a performer here in town. I suppose I ought not to be surprised there's another side to him.
target: 看来，他还在镇上兼职当演员。我想，他有另一面也没什么好惊讶的。

source: The royal messenger. Given the recent brewing war, he's out of the castle more often than not.
target: 王室信使。最近战事一触即发，他大多数时候都不在城堡里。

source: One of Grace's lieutenants. Staunchly loyal, I imagine. No sense trying to persuade him of much.
target: 格蕾丝的一名副手。我想，他一定忠心耿耿。想说服他改变什么，恐怕没用。

source: I know it's been a while.
target: 我知道，已经有一阵子了。

source: Mm. Three thousand, nine hundred and eighty-two days since we last spoke, to be exact.
target: 嗯。准确地说，距我们上次交谈，已经过了三千九百八十二天。

source: A little less than that if one considers withering glares a form of speech.
target: 如果把恶狠狠的瞪视也算作一种说话方式，那就短一些。

source: I don't. But I'm glad you're counting.
target: 我不这么算。不过很高兴你还在数。

source: Are you still... do you...
target: 你还……你是不是……

source: Do I hate you still?
target: 我是不是还恨你？

source: In a thousand ways, yes. But each of them pales in comparison to this:
target: 是的，我有一千种理由恨你。但每一种都比不上这一点：

source: I am bored.
target: 我很无聊。

source: I have had my fun in killing you any number of horrid ways. Frightening you. Breaking you...
target: 我用无数种可怕的方式杀死你，已经尽兴了。恐吓你。让你崩溃……

source: And from you now, I suspect a monologue...
target: 接下来，我猜你又要来一段独白了……

source: You are correct. For at the end of it all, only then did the strangest thing happen. You truly did give up. You lost the fight.
target: 你说对了。因为直到这一切的最后，最奇怪的事才发生。你确实放弃了。你输掉了这场较量。

source: As you have ceased to be a player in this game these past years, retreating entirely, I find all of Elsinore has merged into one shapeless mass. Boredom has sanded off all the edges.
target: 这些年来，你彻底退缩，不再参与这场游戏。我发现，整个埃尔西诺已经融成了没有形状的一团。无聊磨平了所有棱角。

source: Each of its inhabitants is both alive and dead, joyful and grieving, clever and cruel, all at once. For I can no longer remember what is true any longer.
target: 这里的每个人都同时活着又死去，欢喜又悲伤，聪明又残忍。因为我已经再也记不清什么是真的了。

source: And I--
target: 而我——

source: I fear I have gone quite mad, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我恐怕已经彻底疯了。

source: Perhaps I never was sane to begin with. Perhaps it's always been this way. Or perhaps this will always be our shared delusion, you and I.
target: 也许我从一开始就没清醒过。也许一直都是这样。又或者，这永远都会是你我共有的妄想。

source: They say love is that sort of thing. A shared delusion. I wouldn't know. I've never been in love.
target: 人们说爱情就是这样。一种共同的妄想。我不知道。我从没爱过谁。

source: This feels more like an endless nightmare neither of us can ever awaken from.
target: 这感觉更像一场无尽的噩梦，你我永远都无法醒来。

source: And I must admit, I find the need to contend with whatever God has put me here.
target: 而且我必须承认，无论是哪个神把我放在这里，我都觉得有必要与他抗争。

source: The Book came to me for a reason. It chose me. Or it was granted to me. Why?
target: 那本书来到我手里，是有原因的。它选择了我。或者，是谁把它赐给了我。为什么？

source: Why, indeed, if my fate was merely to become trapped in my own creation like a fool?
target: 如果我的命运只是像个傻瓜一样，被困在自己创造的东西里，那究竟是为什么？

source: ...But, no.
target: ……不过，不。

source: I have let all these thoughts crash over me ten thousand times. And there they go, washing away again out to sea.
target: 这些念头已经像海浪一样，冲击了我一万次。如今它们又退去了，再次流回大海。

source: I don't know why I'm telling all this to you.
target: 我不知道为什么要对你说这些。

source: Let us go back to silence, then.
target: 那就让我们继续沉默吧。

source: I don't want to spend eternity at odds with you.
target: 我不想永远和你作对。

source: Unfortunately for you, darling, I do.
target: 亲爱的，可惜的是，我想。

source: Can we talk?
target: 我们能谈谈吗？

source: I think we have precious little to say to one another anymore.
target: 我想，我们如今已经没什么话可对彼此说了。

source: Ah. Cygnus. You're assigned to the outer gates?
target: 啊，西格纳斯。你被派来守外门？

source: My father's attendant, who manages his financial affairs. I don't speak to him—he used to be rather unpleasant and cold towards me. His loyalty is purely to my father's estate.
target: 父亲的侍从，替他打理财务。我不和他说话——他以前对我相当不友善，也很冷淡。他只忠于父亲的家产。

source: One of Grace's lieutenants. Staunchly loyal, I imagine - no sense trying to persuade him of much.
target: 格蕾丝的一名副手。我想，他一定忠心耿耿——想说服他改变什么，恐怕没用。

source: Miscellaneous
target: 杂项

source: What happens now? For me—for everyone?
target: 接下来会怎样？我会怎样——大家会怎样？

source: What Dreams May Come
target: 将有何梦

source: Seems things are going well in Elsinore, and we have long lives ahead. What are your plans?
target: 看来埃尔西诺一切顺利，我们往后还有漫长的人生。你有什么打算？

source: Something has changed, but I don't understand why.
target: 有些事情变了，但我不明白为什么。

source: What's Going On?
target: 怎么回事？

source: Better rest my head a while.
target: 最好躺下休息一会儿。

source: I'm not tired right now.
target: 我现在不累。

source: Wha... what time is it?
target: 什……现在几点了？

source: I suppose I was more exhausted from the previous night than I'd thought...
target: 看来昨晚让我比想象中还要疲惫……

source: It's far too late for me to have remained in bed.
target: 我竟然睡到现在，实在太晚了。

source: No point. I know what's down there.
target: 没必要。我知道下面有什么。

source: Not that it does us any good when Fortinbras arrives.
target: 可等福丁布拉斯来了，这些也帮不了我们。

source: No need to look through his things anymore if he's not here.
target: 如果他不在这里，就没必要再翻他的东西了。

source: What are you doing amongst my personal effects?
target: 你在我的私人物品里翻什么？

source: Leave me and my items be.
target: 别烦我，也别碰我的东西。

source: (I suppose I ought to wait until he's gone to rummage around...)
target: （看来我该等他走了再翻找……）

source: There are some notes inside the chest.
target: 箱子里有一些笔记。

source: Something's very wrong. He's so cryptic... what does he mean? What did he see?
target: 很不对劲。他写得这么隐晦……到底是什么意思？他看到了什么？

source: I refuse to believe Hamlet's in this state on my behalf alone.
target: 我不相信哈姆雷特变成这样，仅仅是因为我。

source: I need to have a closer look at the gallery.
target: 我得去画廊仔细看看。

source: A-and, combined with the report I found in the gallery...
target: 再、再加上我在画廊找到的那份报告……

source: Can this be saying... King Hamlet's death... that he was... killed?
target: 这难道是在说……哈姆雷特国王的死……他是……被人杀害的？

source: No. I have no proof of that. I should keep a close eye on Hamlet.
target: 不。我没有证据。我得密切留意哈姆雷特。

source: He'll lead me to the truth. I'm sure of it.
target: 他会带我找到真相的。我确信。

source: So Hamlet suspected his father was murdered even before he knew.
target: 原来哈姆雷特还没得知真相，就已经怀疑父亲是被谋杀的了。

source: So Hamlet suspects his father was murdered after all.
target: 原来哈姆雷特果然怀疑父亲是被谋杀的。

source: This old shack is older than I am, but not by much.
target: 这间旧棚屋比我年纪还大，不过也没大多少。

source: This is where all of the plague victim's things were stored. Including my mother's.
target: 瘟疫死者的东西全都存放在这里。也包括我母亲的。

source: I can see nails coming through from the other side. It won't budge for my weight.
target: 我能看见从另一面钉穿过来的钉子。凭我的体重，撞不动它。

source: I need someone stronger. Who might want to help?
target: 我需要一个力气更大的人。谁会愿意帮忙呢？

source: This is the lazzaretto where my mother was held...
target: 这就是母亲当年被隔离的疫病所……

source: I'm not certain what that dock-shack is for. It's been locked up tight for as long as I can remember.
target: 我不太清楚码头那间棚屋是做什么用的。从我记事起，它就一直锁得严严实实。

source: When the Book erased them, where did they go, I wonder?
target: 那本书抹去他们的时候，他们去了哪里呢？

source: Am I damned? Is this hell?
target: 我受到了永罚吗？这里是地狱吗？

source: What kind of God could allow this to happen?
target: 什么样的上帝会容许这种事发生？

source: I hope you're at peace, father.
target: 父亲，希望您已经安息。

source: I've come here to pray before the Virgin ever since I was a girl. When I think of praying these days... nothing comes to mind.
target: 从小我就来这里，在圣母面前祈祷。可最近想到祈祷时……我却什么也想不出来。

source: The King's bedchamber is under even tighter watch than Gertrude's.
target: 国王寝室的守卫比乔特鲁德那边还严。

source: Even now, I'll have to wait for Claudius to invite me in again.
target: 即使现在，我也得等克劳狄斯再次邀请我进去。

source: I've been in there before. But only when... well...
target: 我以前进去过。但只有在……嗯……

source: Only in worlds where the Queen's passed away.
target: 只有在王后已经去世的那些世界里。

source: I've been in there before, when Claudius held private council over Fortinbras's hiding out nearby.
target: 我以前进去过，当时克劳狄斯召集秘密议事，商讨福丁布拉斯藏身附近的事。

source: But... I wonder if it's possible to find a way to explore that room on my own.
target: 不过……不知道能不能想个办法，独自探查那间房间。

source: Only two people have ever been allowed inside, as far as I know: the Queen, when the two of them are 'together'...
target: 据我所知，只有两个人获准进去过：王后，在他们俩“共处”的时候……

source: And Bernardo, who comes to deliver private news to him from time to time.
target: 还有贝尔纳多，他偶尔会来向国王私下汇报消息。

source: Not even my father is permitted entry unless the circumstances are dire.
target: 除非情况危急，否则连我父亲也不许进去。

source: Hmm. Father locked his door. That's unlike him.
target: 嗯。父亲把房门锁了。这可不像他。

source: There are a lot of books here, but I see the bit of parchment I'm looking for.
target: 这里有很多书，不过我看见要找的那张羊皮纸了。

source: 'Uncommon circumstances?'
target: “情况异常？”

source: I wonder how much Hamlet suspects of his father's death.
target: 不知道哈姆雷特对父亲的死有多少怀疑。

source: ... And to what extent a snake was really involved.
target: ……还有，那条蛇究竟在其中起了多大作用。

source: I cannot act without evidence. I must follow Hamlet, and see where his path leads him. ...For now.
target: 没有证据，我不能行动。我得跟着哈姆雷特，看看他会走向何处。……暂且如此。

source: It's clear that Claudius took great pains to cover up his crime. Such a sad, unfortunate man.
target: 显然，克劳狄斯为了掩盖罪行煞费苦心。他真是个可悲又不幸的人。

source: This shelf is cluttered with books, both old and new.
target: 这架子上乱堆着各种新旧书籍。

source: This is a perfect source of linen. Horatio can use this to make canvas.
target: 这里正好有亚麻布。霍拉旭可以用它做画布。

source: Er... I'll use one of my older garments.
target: 呃……就用我一件旧衣服吧。

source: I now have everything Horatio needed. Just need to find a time with he and Brit are both free.
target: 霍拉旭需要的东西，现在都齐了。只要找个他和布莉特都有空的时间。

source: Gertrude mentioned she'd hid Brit's letters somewhere with 'unheard wishes'. A wishing well does make sense.
target: 乔特鲁德提过，她把布莉特的信藏在了一个有“无人听见的愿望”的地方。许愿井确实说得通。

source: Let me see... ah!
target: 让我看看……啊！

source: There's a loose stone inside the well. And... here they are.
target: 井里有块松动的石头。而且……信就在这里。

source: I'll bring these to Brit as soon as she's free.
target: 布莉特一有空，我就把这些交给她。

source: Ah! There are some eggs here.
target: 啊！这里有些鸡蛋。

source: Don't even think about 'borrowing' from my food stores.
target: 别想从我的食物储备里“借”东西。

source: I promise you, you won't like the consequences.
target: 我保证，后果有你好受的。

source: (...Maybe later...)
target: （……还是晚点再说吧……）

source: Better collect them to give to Horatio.
target: 还是把它们拿上，交给霍拉旭吧。

source: This is a perfect source of charcoal. Better collect some to give Horatio.
target: 这里正好有木炭。还是拿一些给霍拉旭吧。

source: How did my father find anything on a desk this messy?
target: 桌子这么乱，父亲以前怎么找得到东西？

source: Father, how do you find anything on a desk this messy?
target: 父亲，桌子这么乱，您怎么找得到东西？

source: Messy? What on earth do you mean? It's organized precisely the way I like it!
target: 乱？你这话到底是什么意思？我就是喜欢这样摆的！

source: It's unclear how Father finds anything on a desk this messy.
target: 真不知道父亲怎么在这么乱的桌子上找到东西。

source: Hmm—there's a note here.
target: 嗯——这里有张便条。

source: A missing lute... I wonder if I could find it for him?
target: 一把丢失的鲁特琴……不知道我能不能帮他找到？

source: That's the late Queen Astrid, Hamlet's grandmother.
target: 那是已故的阿斯特丽德王后，哈姆雷特的祖母。

source: Come to think of it, I've often heard about King Alexander, but nothing about Queen Astrid. I wonder why?
target: 说起来，我常听人提起亚历山大国王，却从没听过阿斯特丽德王后的事。这是为什么呢？

source: How peculiar.
target: 真奇怪。

source: She looks so peaceful there.
target: 画里的她看起来那么安详。

source: Hard to imagine her dying the way she did.
target: 很难想象她竟会那样死去。

source: What are you rummaging around over there for? You know those books are the oldest in the gallery, right? They're delicate.
target: 你在那边翻来翻去找什么？你知道那些是画廊里最古老的书吧？它们很容易损坏。

source: Oh. I was only... looking for something new to read.
target: 哦。我只是……想找点没读过的书。

source: That's a book on pregnancy sickness.
target: 那是一本讲孕吐的书。

source: Something you want to tell me?
target: 你有什么事想告诉我吗？

source: Ah. No.
target: 啊。没有。

source: (I just grabbed the first book I saw...)
target: （我只是随手拿了第一本看到的书……）

source: You're so strange.
target: 你真奇怪。

source: It's an old bookshelf—but tucked away between these books, there's a bound set of notes...
target: 这是个旧书架——不过这些书之间，藏着一册装订好的笔记……

source: ...The notes bear the emblem of a noble Danish house. ...House Brockenhuus. Brit's family?
target: ……笔记上印着一个丹麦贵族家族的纹章。……布罗肯胡斯家族。布莉特的家族？

source: Why would Brit keep personal notes in the gallery...?
target: 布莉特为什么要把私人笔记放在画廊里……？

source: '... No longer shall we meet before three in the morning. The docks are too busy at any other hour.' The docks... Hmm.
target: “……今后我们不再于凌晨三点之前见面。其他时间码头都太繁忙。”码头……嗯。

source: It sounds like she's meeting someone late at night. But who? And why?
target: 看来她在深夜与某个人见面。可那是谁？又是为什么？

source: These are the letters from Fortinbras's emissary. Brit evidently hid them here.
target: 这些是福丁布拉斯的使者寄来的信。显然是布莉特把它们藏在这里的。

source: This is where Brit hid her notes.
target: 布莉特就是把笔记藏在这里的。

source: Another old, dusty bookshelf.
target: 又一个积满灰尘的旧书架。

source: I could never have been the savior you wanted. Not really.
target: 我从来都不可能成为你想要的救世主。真正意义上的救世主。

source: It's Hamlet's father, and his namesake, the late King Hamlet.
target: 这是哈姆雷特的父亲，已故的哈姆雷特国王。哈姆雷特的名字也是沿用他的。

source: ...Come to think of it, I noticed a blank space on the walls in the gallery...
target: ……说起来，我注意到画廊墙上有一处空白……

source: ...Sorry that I doubted you. I promise we'll stop Quince.
target: ……对不起，我曾怀疑过你。我保证，我们会阻止奎因斯。

source: ...I liked him enough when he was alive, now that he's dead I'm not sure what to make of him.
target: ……他活着的时候，我对他印象还不错。如今他死了，我反倒不知道该怎么看他了。

source: ...Could the King's ghost really be haunting this castle?
target: ……国王的幽灵真的在这座城堡里游荡吗？

source: I recognize her handwriting. This must be it.
target: 我认得她的笔迹。一定就是这个。

source: Mother's diary...
target: 母亲的日记……

source: Simona. She was trapped in time just like me.
target: 西蒙娜。她曾经和我一样，被困在时间里。

source: She's been through this before. She must know the way out of it all. And-- and if this is right, she's still alive!
target: 她以前经历过这些。她一定知道摆脱这一切的方法。而且——而且如果这里写的没错，她还活着！

source: But where is she?
target: 可她在哪里？

source: This is... incredible. If this is true... I've got to find Simona and speak to her.
target: 这真是……难以置信。如果这是真的……我得找到西蒙娜，和她谈谈。

source: Sounds like she's living in town nearby.
target: 看来她住在附近的镇上。

source: Still hard to believe, even now.
target: 即使到了现在，还是难以相信。

source: I still need to see if I can find Simona. She must know something more.
target: 我还是得看看能不能找到西蒙娜。她一定还知道些什么。

source: To think that Simona escaped Quince for so many years.
target: 真没想到，西蒙娜竟然躲过了奎因斯这么多年。

source: I wonder what she must have gone through, living all alone, unable to share what she'd been through with anyone.
target: 她独自生活，无法向任何人诉说自己的经历，不知道她究竟承受了些什么。

source: It's my father's lockbox. He kept all his personal items in there.
target: 这是父亲的上锁箱子。他以前把所有私人物品都放在里面。

source: It's my father's lockbox. He keeps his personal items in there.
target: 这是父亲的上锁箱子。他把私人物品放在里面。

source: Nothing but the key can open it, I presume.
target: 我想，只有钥匙才能打开它。

source: ...But it's unlockable now.
target: ……不过现在可以开锁了。

source: There are pages in here, scattered and frayed.
target: 里面散落着一些纸页，边缘都磨破了。

source: H-how could... this reads like... it's almost as if...
target: 怎、怎么会……这些文字读起来……简直就像……

source: As if time were repeating for him, too.
target: 就像他的时间也在不断重复。

source: Is this what Father was afraid I'd find? The mad rantings of a man in my exact predicament?
target: 这就是父亲怕我找到的东西吗？一个与我处境完全相同的人留下的疯言疯语？

source: He mentions a strange cursed book—what he was searching for, his way out—perhaps if I can find it... there's still an escape.
target: 他提到一本奇怪的受诅咒的书——他一直在寻找的东西，他的出路——也许只要我能找到它……就还有逃脱的希望。

source: No wonder Father didn't want the others to find out about this.
target: 难怪父亲不想让别人发现这些。

source: Everyone saw Hamlet as a strong king. No one ever thought him insane.
target: 所有人都认为哈姆雷特是位强大的国王。从没人觉得他疯了。

source: But if people believe that insanity runs in the family's bloodline...
target: 可如果人们相信，疯病会在这个家族里遗传……

source: Then that's cause to remove not just Hamlet, but Gertrude and Claudius from Elsinore.
target: 那就有理由把哈姆雷特、乔特鲁德和克劳狄斯都赶出埃尔西诺了。

source: It's empty. Nothing but... ashes.
target: 空了。只剩下……灰烬。

source: I've often heard him open and close it in the evenings. I know he had something in here, but... I'm too late.
target: 我常在晚上听见他打开又关上这个箱子。我知道他在里面放了东西，可……我来晚了。

source: A-ha! And here is Irma's key to Gertrude's Chambers.
target: 啊哈！伊尔玛那把乔特鲁德寝室的钥匙就在这里。

source: I already retrieved the key Irma hid here.
target: 伊尔玛藏在这里的钥匙，我已经拿走了。

source: The Queen has a private hearth to toast her feet at night, of course. It vents through the center of the castle tower.
target: 王后当然有自己的壁炉，晚上用来烤脚取暖。烟道从城堡塔楼的中央穿过。

source: This massive fireplace... it's kept burning by the servants day and night. It's the true castle hearth, I suppose.
target: 这座巨大的壁炉……仆人们让它日夜燃烧。我想，这才是城堡真正的炉火吧。

source: Hmmm. Locked.
target: 嗯……锁着。

source: What're yeh doin' here, my lady?
target: 小姐，您在这儿干什么呢？

source: I dunnah how you got yerself a key, but the Queen's chambers are private!
target: 我不知道您怎么弄到的钥匙，可王后的寝室不能随便进！

source: (Evidently I must attempt this when he's gone.)
target: （看来我得等他走了再试。）

source: And now it isn't. Key, meet keyhole.
target: 现在就不锁着了。钥匙，来认识一下锁孔。

source: The key to this room is supposed to be hidden in the planter...
target: 这间房的钥匙应该藏在花盆里……

source: Who would have access to Gertrude's chambers?
target: 谁能进出乔特鲁德的寝室呢？

source: I know Father will be... killed here.
target: 我知道父亲会在这里……被杀。

source: If I can get inside somehow... I can be there when it happens.
target: 如果我能想办法进去……那件事发生时，我就能在场了。

source: Father has been killed here before.
target: 父亲以前曾在这里被杀。

source: Father was murdered here.
target: 父亲是在这里被谋杀的。

source: I wonder if it's possible to find a way to enter Queen Gertrude's room and understand what happened.
target: 不知道能不能找到办法，进入乔特鲁德王后的房间，弄清楚发生了什么。

source: I suppose the Queen must want her privacy.
target: 我想，王后一定不希望有人打扰吧。

source: Forgive me, Lady Ophelia, but I cannot let you leave.
target: 请原谅，奥菲莉娅小姐，但我不能让您离开。

source: The King himself ordered that I disbar you.
target: 是国王亲自下令，让我禁止您外出的。

source: And now His Majesty is dead.
target: 可如今陛下已经死了。

source: T-the way you said that... Your face...!
target: 您、您说这话的语气……您的表情……！

source: Go right ahead, Lady Ophelia. My apologies.
target: 您请便，奥菲莉娅小姐。抱歉。

source: I still know about your little gambling ring, Cygnus.
target: 西格纳斯，我可还知道你们那个小赌局的事。

source: With all due respect, that ain't enough to overrule a member of the Royal Family's word.
target: 恕我直言，光凭这个还不足以让我违抗王室成员的命令。

source: (...This won't work. I need to find someone who has the power to help me regain access.)
target: （……这样不行。我得找个有权力的人，帮我恢复通行许可。）

source: Ah! I see. Perhaps I ought to tell the Guard Captain about your gambling ring, then?
target: 啊！我明白了。那我是不是该把你们赌局的事告诉卫队长呢？

source: What? Y-you... know about that?
target: 什么？您、您……知道这事？

source: Er... I'll let you through. Just please don't tell Bernardo about what you saw. He'll have all of us running laps for hours.
target: 呃……我让您过去。只是求您别把看到的事告诉贝尔纳多。他会罚我们所有人跑上好几个小时的。

source: Especially not after yeh ratted us out to Bernardo. My thighs are still pudding. I can hardly stand!
target: 您向贝尔纳多告了我们一状以后，就更不行了。我的大腿还软得像布丁，连站都快站不住！

source: Dunnah how you found out about our gambling, but... y'must be some kind of sorceress...
target: 不知道您怎么发现我们赌博的，不过……您一定是个会法术的女巫……

source: If I can learn about that, what other dirty secrets might I find if I spend long enough in the guard chambers?
target: 既然我能发现这件事，那要是我在卫兵的房间里多待一阵，又会发现别的什么见不得人的秘密呢？

source: ...As I was sayin', go right on ahead, m'lady. The gates are open.
target: ……就像我刚才说的，您请便，小姐。大门开着呢。

source: Ah. Yeh saw us, then. Hell. I knew our secret'd get out eventually...
target: 啊。原来您看见我们了。该死。我就知道这秘密迟早会泄露……

source: Er, I'll let you through. Just please don't tell Bernardo about what you saw. He'll have all of us running laps for hours.
target: 呃，我让您过去。只是求您别把看到的事告诉贝尔纳多。他会罚我们所有人跑上好几个小时的。

source: Why not? I'd like to go for a stroll.
target: 为什么不行？我想出去散散步。

source: Your father decreed to Guard Captain Bernardo that you were not to leave the castle grounds after... well... you and Hamlet.
target: 您的父亲吩咐过卫队长贝尔纳多，不许您离开城堡范围，是在……嗯……您和哈姆雷特那件事之后。

source: And with all of us guards on thin ice lately, I'd hate to anger the Guard Captain.
target: 而且最近我们这些卫兵都得小心行事，我可不想惹卫队长生气。

source: At least, not before I recoup my losses tomorrow night!—Er, I've said too much.
target: 至少也得等我明晚把输的钱赢回来！——呃，我说得太多了。

source: (Hmm. Sounds like there's more to this situation.)
target: （嗯。看来这事另有隐情。）

source: (I wonder if the other guards know more.)
target: （不知道其他卫兵是不是知道得更多。）

source: (Maybe if I knew what they were getting up to in the evenings.)
target: （要是我知道他们晚上都在干些什么，也许就有办法了。）

source: The gate's locked. Cygnus must have stepped out. Hopefully he'll return shortly.
target: 大门锁着。西格纳斯一定是暂时离开了。希望他很快就回来。

source: It's Gertrude's diary.
target: 这是乔特鲁德的日记。

source: Ophelia, what are you doing?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你在做什么？

source: That's private.
target: 那是私人物品。

source: (Right. Can't have a look while she's here.)
target: （好吧。她在这里，我就没法看。）
