source: I'm right here. Hoping to open her little diary?
target: 我就在这里呢。你想翻开她的小日记？

source: Oh, don't worry, I've already read the whole thing, obviously. But you don't have that privilege.
target: 哦，别担心，我当然早就从头到尾看过了。不过你可没有这个特权。

source: Get out before I report you.
target: 赶紧出去，不然我就告发你。

source: Oh, no. Gertrude...
target: 哦，不。乔特鲁德……

source: This is the information Hamlet wanted. Let's see what he wants to do with it.
target: 这就是哈姆雷特想要的信息。看看他打算怎么用吧。

source: This... this information could really tear apart the court.
target: 这……这些信息真的可能让宫廷分崩离析。

source: It's a letter. Hmm.
target: 是一封信。嗯。

source: Is something troubling you?
target: 有什么事让你烦心吗？

source: What are these papers?
target: 这些文件是什么？

source: Nothing of consequence. Come away from them.
target: 没什么要紧的。别在那边待着了。

source: (Right. Can't have a look while he's here.)
target: （好吧。他在这里，我就没法看。）

source: T-this is...
target: 这、这是……

source: Claudius must have hated his father far more than I realized.
target: 克劳狄斯对父亲的恨，一定比我原先以为的深得多。

source: Apologies, my lord. I was, er, trying to leave without waking you.
target: 抱歉，陛下。我是，呃，想悄悄离开，免得吵醒您。

source: I wonder if there's something inside this vase...
target: 不知道这只花瓶里是不是藏着什么……

source: This vase has fingerprints on it. Is there something inside?
target: 这个花瓶上有指纹。里面有东西吗？

source: It needs dusting. I'll have to have my wife arrange for the servants to come by.
target: 该掸掸灰了。我得让妻子安排仆人过来清理。

source: There's something in here.
target: 这里面有东西。

source: (A... vial?)
target: （一只……小瓶？）

source: (It stinks of... some kind of noxious fumes.)
target: （它散发着……某种有毒气体的臭味。）

source: (This must be the poison he used to kill King Hamlet.)
target: （这一定是他用来杀害哈姆雷特国王的毒药。）

source: (I'd better pocket it.)
target: （我最好把它装进口袋。）

target: 你对未来有什么打算？

source: The future? Goodness, Ophelia! What d'yeh expect I am? Some kind o' all-knowin', all-sentient god of knowledge?
target: 未来？天哪，奥菲莉娅！你当我是什么？什么无所不知、无所不觉的知识之神吗？

source: I canna' even think about breakfast tomorrow, let alone anythin' past that.
target: 我连明天的早饭都想不过来，更别说那之后的事了。

source: Isn't the guards' breakfast the same each day? I thought it was porridge and cold meats.
target: 卫兵的早饭不是每天都一样吗？我记得是粥和冷肉。

source: Lord above, yer right!
target: 天哪，你说得对！

source: Oho! I feel like I've been freed up t'ponder all kinds o' vast mysteries, now...
target: 哦嚯！我觉得这下腾出脑子，能琢磨各种深奥的大谜题了……

source: The future... hmmm... the future...
target: 未来……嗯……未来……

source: Me? Why, I've no idea. Best to ask Guilda on that one. She makes all our travel decisions.
target: 我？哎呀，我也不知道。这事最好问吉尔达。我们出行的事全由她决定。

source: So long as whatever hearth we find ourselves before is warm and well-fed, that's all I need.
target: 不管最后到了哪一家的炉火旁，只要暖暖和和，吃得饱饱的，我就满足了。

source: Why are you asking me? Rosie always knows where we're going next. I have no clue!
target: 你怎么问我？罗茜总知道我们下一站去哪儿。我可一点头绪都没有！

source: I just hope the food's good. It's been excellent here, but you Danes are so sewn-up.
target: 我只希望吃的不错。这里的饭菜一直很棒，可你们丹麦人太拘谨了。

source: Bring on the drama, I say! We just came from Wittenberg, after all. The bar is set high.
target: 要我说，就该多来点热闹！毕竟我们刚从威登堡来，眼光可高着呢。

source: Oh, me? I'm returning to Wittenberg shortly.
target: 哦，我？我很快就要回威登堡了。

source: Now that Father is properly buried and memorialized, it's time to go.
target: 如今父亲已被妥善安葬，也受到了应有的悼念，是时候走了。

source: I realized recently I had the aptitude for scholarship. Thinking myself to death is my favorite sport.
target: 我最近才意识到，自己有做学问的天分。把自己想得死去活来，是我最喜欢的消遣。

source: I think I'd do well with a scroll under each arm lecturing to young people. Don't you think?
target: 我觉得我两边胳膊各夹一卷书，给年轻人讲课，应该挺像样的。你说呢？

source: ...You know, now that you say it, I can picture it.
target: ……你这么一说，我还真能想象出那副样子。

source: Let's be honest. I was never going to be King, nor did I have the desire for it.
target: 说实话，我本来就不会当国王，也从来没想过要当。

source: Claudius seems to be invested in Denmark's future. I wish him all the best.
target: 克劳狄斯似乎很关心丹麦的未来。我祝他一切顺利。

source: Well, with the proposal, certainly things have changed!
target: 嗯，既然求了婚，事情当然就不一样了！

source: I've been thinking. Ought we to winter at our old estate?
target: 我一直在想，我们是不是该去老庄园过冬？

source: It's old, and decrepit, and fallow. But His Majesty has bequeathed me a generous sum to have it refitted.
target: 那里又老又破，田地也荒着。不过陛下留给了我一大笔钱，用来翻修庄园。

source: And you and Brit could manage the home, if you liked! ...It would certainly do your father proud.
target: 你和布莉特要是愿意，还可以一起操持家务！……你父亲一定会为你们骄傲的。

source: At least, until Laertes is able to acquire an estate of his own. I've no doubt he'll make short work of that.
target: 至少可以这样安排，直到雷欧提斯有了自己的庄园。我相信他很快就能办到。

source: I'll think about it, Father.
target: 我会考虑的，父亲。

source: At the very least, let's pay it a visit. We can start the big hearth and settle in for the snows.
target: 至少我们先去看看吧。可以把大壁炉生起来，安顿下来过雪季。

source: Anything, and everything.
target: 什么都想做，一切都想做。

source: Before today, I didn't even dare to dream that she might accept me-- that we could be together.
target: 今天之前，我连想都不敢想，她可能会接受我——我们能在一起。

source: But it's real, Ophelia. She accepted me. I want to build a world with her.
target: 可这是真的，奥菲莉娅。她接受了我。我想和她一起建立属于我们的世界。

source: I want to take her somewhere far away from her father. Somewhere the Brockenhuus legacy will never be able to hurt her again.
target: 我想带她去一个远离她父亲的地方。在那里，布罗肯胡斯家族留下的一切再也伤害不了她。

source: She'll be a part of our family from now on.
target: 从今以后，她就是我们家的一员了。

source: And I know that someday soon, you two will come to love each other as dearly as I love her.
target: 我知道，用不了多久，你们就会像我爱她那样，深深地爱着彼此。

source: Ah. It's been a troublesome year, Ophelia.
target: 唉，奥菲莉娅，这一年真是多事之秋。

source: But as the season trends towards autumn, I think often on my people...
target: 不过，随着秋天临近，我常常想起我的子民……

source: I have failed them in the last few months. I thought the process of becoming a King a natural one.
target: 过去这几个月，我辜负了他们。我原以为，成为国王是件自然而然的事。

source: Now I understand a kingdom must be earned—through work. Nothing in it is 'natural.' One must take great care with it.
target: 现在我明白了，要靠努力，才能赢得一个王国。这其中没有什么是“自然而然”的。必须用心照料才行。

source: I want to understand the needs of my people and help Denmark flourish.
target: 我想了解子民的需要，让丹麦繁荣起来。

source: And... I want... to understand what Hamlet needs, too.
target: 还有……我也想……了解哈姆雷特需要什么。

source: I have reacted with dislike towards him in the past. But now all that must change. Let us build a new love, he and I.
target: 过去，我对他总是心怀反感。但现在，这一切都必须改变。就让他和我重新建立感情吧。

source: Ah, me? Ay... I think I'd like to visit my sister.
target: 啊，我吗？嗯……我想去看看我的姐妹。

source: It's been a long while. The both of us grow old. But watching Claudius mourn his brother, I've realized...
target: 我们很久没见了。我们都在变老。不过，看着克劳狄斯悼念他的哥哥，我意识到……

source: There is so little time in this world to show the ones we love how deeply we prize them.
target: 我们在世上的时间太短，能让所爱的人知道我们有多珍惜他们的机会太少。

source: It is long to Austria. A boat, then a carriage over land. But I believe it would be good to see her face once more before we die.
target: 去奥地利路途遥远。要先坐船，再坐马车走陆路。不过，我觉得，在我们离世之前能再见她一面，总是好的。

source: And then—I turn my thoughts to helping Claudius rule!
target: 然后——我就要把心思放在帮助克劳狄斯治国上了！

source: I never saw myself as a stateswoman, but Claudius believes I'm capable. It'll be a new role for me.
target: 我从没想过自己能成为政治家，但克劳狄斯相信我有这个能力。这对我来说是个全新的角色。

source: But a happy one, I think.
target: 不过，我想，这个角色会让我很开心。

source: Oh, anywhere but here!
target: 哦，只要不是这里，去哪儿都行！

source: I find myself drawn back to Firenze. Back to my old masters, to the old workshops. To perhaps hold a brush once more.
target: 我发现自己又想回佛罗伦萨了。回到从前的老师们身边，回到那些老画室。也许还能再拿起画笔。

source: Or perhaps I'll visit one of the great Italian universities and see if they'll have a poor old footsoldier like me.
target: 或者，我会去意大利的一所名校看看，看他们肯不肯收下我这个穷老步兵。

source: My feet grow itchy to wander once more. It's time, I think. But I'll stay to see this evening's gala through.
target: 我的脚又不安分了，想再出去走走。我想，是时候了。不过我会留下来，等今晚的盛宴结束。

source: It's nearly autumn. A whole new menu change shall soon arrive!
target: 快到秋天了。很快就要换上全新的菜单了！

source: Thick stews, hearty rye bread, sausages as big around as my arm...
target: 浓浓的炖菜、管饱的黑麦面包、跟我胳膊一样粗的香肠……

source: I aim to marvel every foreign dignitary who comes to dine at our table.
target: 我要让每一位来我们这里用餐的外国显贵都赞叹不已。

source: Let them see what Danish cuisine truly looks like!
target: 让他们见识一下丹麦菜真正的模样！

source: Unfortunately, becoming related to you.
target: 很不幸，要和你成为亲戚了。

source: Not sure why I asked.
target: 真不知道我为什么要问。

source: Hang on a moment. I was only joking.
target: 等一下。我只是开个玩笑。

source: I'm happy, Ophelia. For the first time in a long time.
target: 我很幸福，奥菲莉娅。好久没有这么幸福过了。

source: I said and did things to you when I was in the depths of my unhappiness.
target: 在我最不快乐的那段日子里，我对你说过一些话，也做过一些事。

source: And I can never take those things back. I know I can't. If you hate me for them, I won't blame you an instant.
target: 那些话和事，我永远都收不回来了。我知道收不回来。你要是因此恨我，我一点也不会怪你。

source: But your brother is an amazing man. And-- for what it's worth-- I think you and he are cut from the same cloth.
target: 不过，你哥哥是个很了不起的人。而且——不管你在不在意我的看法——我觉得你和他是一样的人。

source: I'm sorry, I must have misheard you. Was that you paying me a compliment?
target: 不好意思，我一定是听错了。你刚才是在夸我吗？

source: Hmm. Bask in the moment. It'll be gone soon, and you only get one compliment per decade, I've decided.
target: 嗯，好好享受这一刻吧。很快就过去了，而且我决定了，每十年只夸你一次。

source: Regardless. Sisters?
target: 不管怎么说。做姐妹？

source: So, what now?
target: 那么，接下来呢？

source: Ah. you can still see me.
target: 啊，你还看得见我。

source: Of course. Ought I not to?
target: 当然。难道我不该看得见吗？

source: My son cannot see me any longer. He seems to have no memory of ever meeting me.
target: 我的儿子已经看不见我了。他似乎完全不记得曾经见过我。

source: ...It's for the best that way. They're happier, each of them.
target: ……这样最好。他们每个人都比以前快乐了。

source: But with Quince gone, why would you linger on?
target: 可奎因斯已经不在了，你为什么还留在这里？

source: Perhaps some outstanding task of mine still remains. I know not.
target: 也许我还有什么未竟之事。我也不知道。

source: Either way, let us enjoy the world we have built, you and I. The others will never understand.
target: 无论如何，就让你我好好享受我们共同建立的世界吧。其他人永远不会明白。

source: Excellent work, Ophelia.
target: 做得很好，奥菲莉娅。

source: To you as well, Your Majesty.
target: 您也是，陛下。

source: Hamlet. I need to ask you something.
target: 哈姆雷特。我有件事要问你。

source: Do you still-- did Claudius-- kill your father?
target: 你还——克劳狄斯——杀了你父亲吗？

source: Ophelia, I know you like your games, but even that one's a bit cruel.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我知道你喜欢捉弄人，可这次也有点太残忍了。

source: I miss Father as much as anyone.
target: 我和任何人一样想念父亲。

source: You know, they might not have loved one another deeply, but... in the end, Claudius came to kiss him goodbye.
target: 你知道，他们之间的感情也许并不深厚，但……最后，克劳狄斯还是来吻了他，向他告别。

source: They say plague can be contagious. He risked his life for that small gesture.
target: 听说瘟疫可能会传染。他为了这个小小的举动，冒了生命危险。

source: Meanwhile, I had to be content with speaking to him through the door. They wouldn't let me inside.
target: 而我却只能隔着门跟他说话。他们不让我进去。

source: (Plague? What is he talking about?)
target: （瘟疫？他在说什么？）

source: (He seems to think-- his father died of plague?)
target: （他似乎觉得——他父亲是死于瘟疫的？）

source: I'm sorry, Hamlet. I didn't mean to be hurtful. Please excuse me.
target: 对不起，哈姆雷特。我不是有意伤你的心。请原谅我。

source: Father, can I ask something of you?
target: 父亲，我能问您一件事吗？

source: Has... Hamlet been acting strangely lately?
target: 哈姆雷特……最近有没有什么奇怪的举动？

source: Why, if anything, he's twice the boy he was last summer.
target: 哎，要说有什么变化，那也是他比去年夏天强多了。

source: He came from Wittenberg to see his father before the elder Hamlet passed of plague.
target: 在老哈姆雷特因瘟疫去世之前，他从维滕贝格赶回来看望父亲。

source: That's the sort of gesture I wouldn't have expected the wanton boy of a year ago to undertake.
target: 要是一年前那个任性放纵的小子，我可没想到他会做出这样的事。

source: But of course, I'm certain the grief will eventually wear on him in its own time.
target: 不过，当然了，我相信时候到了，悲痛终究会让他难以承受。

source: Still -- he seems happy.
target: 不过——他看起来很开心。

source: I see. Thank you, Father.
target: 我明白了。谢谢您，父亲。

source: (So Father has no memory of Hamlet behaving oddly...)
target: （这么说，父亲不记得哈姆雷特有过什么奇怪的举动……）

source: (Does that mean Hamlet never met his father's ghost in this world?)
target: （这是不是意味着，在这个世界里，哈姆雷特从未见过他父亲的幽灵？）

source: Laertes. Wait a moment.
target: 雷欧提斯，等一下。

source: Can you tell me what's happening to Denmark at the moment?
target: 你能告诉我，丹麦现在是什么情况吗？

source: Is it true Norway asked for safe passage through Danish lands?
target: 挪威真的请求过安全借道丹麦吗？

source: You're so strange sometimes, sister.
target: 妹妹，你有时候真是奇怪。

source: Come on. There's supper in the Hall.
target: 走吧。大厅里有晚餐。

source: And besides, I think Norway's rather too busy with their own civil war at the moment.
target: 再说，我觉得挪威现在忙着打自己的内战，恐怕顾不上别的。

source: I don't believe we've had any affairs with that country since King Hamlet fought King Fortinbras years ago.
target: 我想，自从多年前哈姆雷特国王与福丁布拉斯国王交战之后，我们就没和那个国家有什么往来了。

source: Whatever made you think of Norway, of all places?
target: 那么多地方，你怎么偏偏想起了挪威？

source: Ah, never mind it. It was nothing.
target: 啊，别在意。没什么。

source: Brit. Wait a moment.
target: 布莉特，等一下。

source: Can't. Too hungry.
target: 不行。太饿了。

source: Is all this real?
target: 这一切都是真的吗？

source: What is happening right now? Am I in a dream?
target: 现在到底是怎么回事？我是在做梦吗？

source: If you are, then I'm in your dream too, which begs the question: Why are you <i>so<i> obsessed with me?
target: 要是你在做梦，那我也在你的梦里，这就有个问题了：你为什么<i>这么<i>迷恋我？

source: Fortunately for you, this is real as can be -- and we're missing the party.
target: 你运气不错，这一切千真万确——而我们都要错过宴会了。

source: The guards' quarters and our bedchambers are that way.
target: 卫兵住处和我们的卧室都在那边。

source: But I can't retire to my room until I find Laertes, like Father asked.
target: 不过，我得先按父亲的吩咐找到雷欧提斯，才能回房休息。

source: My room isn't down that way.
target: 我的房间不在那边。

source: I'd better rest a while.
target: 我最好休息一会儿。

source: So little happened today, and yet my eyelids are already heavy.
target: 今天没发生多少事，可我的眼皮已经开始发沉了。

source: Maybe it's all the 'advice' I received.
target: 也许是因为听了太多“忠告”。

source: Father said Laertes was meeting with King Claudius.
target: 父亲说雷欧提斯正在会见克劳狄斯国王。

source: That way leads to the grounds outside Elsinore. They wouldn't be out there.
target: 那条路通往埃尔西诺城堡外的庭院。他们应该不会在那里。

source: Even in t his timeline, this bucket is still gross.
target: 就算在这条时间线里，这个桶还是那么恶心。

source: This bar's fireplace has a pleasent feel to it.
target: 这间酒馆的壁炉让人感觉很舒服。

source: My father needs to meet with Laertes. Can you give him permission to leave this meeting?
target: 我父亲需要见雷欧提斯。你能准许他离开这场会议吗？

source: Oh, are we on speaking terms now? You were the one who asked me to leave you alone.
target: 哦，我们现在又能说话了？当初可是你让我别来烦你的。

source: Hamlet. That's all behind us. I need your help. Please.
target: 哈姆雷特，那些事都过去了。我需要你帮忙。求你了。

source: I'm as much a prisoner to this awful meeting as your brother.
target: 我和你哥哥一样，都被困在这场糟糕的会议里。

source: You'll have to talk to someone who has any power over my uncle. My Queen Mother, for instance.
target: 你得去找能对我叔父说得上话的人。比如我的母后。

source: My lady, my father wishes to speak with Laertes as soon as possible.
target: 王后陛下，我父亲希望尽快和雷欧提斯谈谈。

source: Oh, no! Have we run overlong? I'm sure Polonius is in an absolute fit...
target: 哎呀，糟了！我们是不是拖得太久了？波洛涅斯肯定急坏了……

source: Give me a moment. I'll whisper in my husband's ear.
target: 稍等一下。我去在我丈夫耳边说几句。

source: Polonius wants me to retrieve Laertes for him.
target: 波洛涅斯让我把雷欧提斯找回去。

source: Not now, girl! Be silent!
target: 现在不行，姑娘！安静！

source: You are too bold.
target: 你太放肆了。

source: Laertes is going to be late for his party.
target: 雷欧提斯参加自己的宴会都要迟到了。

source: (Oph—Lady Ophelia, I'm on duty at the moment. And must you be so loud?)
target: （奥菲——奥菲莉娅小姐，我现在正值勤呢。你非得这么大声吗？）

source: Something amiss, Bernardo?
target: 有什么事吗，贝尔纳多？

source: N-nothing, my lord!
target: 没、没什么，陛下！

source: Laertes is trapped in a meeting, but my father wants to speak with him.
target: 雷欧提斯被困在一场会议里，可我父亲想和他谈谈。

source: Ah! The good and fair Lady Ophelia. Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
target: 啊！善良又美丽的奥菲莉娅小姐。我可否将你比作夏日？

source: Enough with the poetry, Horatio. You flatterer.
target: 别念诗了，霍拉旭。你可真会奉承。

source: I was a poet in another life, you know. That was before I was a footsoldier. Then a student. Now I'm... what? A professional friend?
target: 你知道，我从前还当过诗人。那是在当步兵之前。后来又当了学生。现在我算……什么？专职朋友？

source: That's not a bad life. You've been many things at many times.
target: 这样的人生也不坏。你在不同的时候做过那么多事。

source: My apologies for the wallowing. You asked about your brother. Court's being held in the Great Hall, I believe.
target: 抱歉，光顾着自怨自艾了。你问的是你哥哥。我想，他们正在大殿议事。

source: ...Oh. I suppose you're right.
target: ……哦。我想你说得对。

source: Head there, and I'm certain you'll be able to tear him away.
target: 去那里吧，我相信你一定能把他带出来。

source: ...You know, back in Florence, there is no sense of 'lateness'.
target: ……你知道，在佛罗伦萨，可没有“迟到”这个概念。

source: Men arrive precisely when they mean to, and meals are six hours long!
target: 人们想什么时候到，就什么时候到，一顿饭能吃上六个小时！

source: I'd be much slower and larger if that were the case here.
target: 要是这里也这样，我肯定会慢得多，也胖得多。

source: Yes, bless Denmark. You Danes are always hurrying somewhere.
target: 是啊，天佑丹麦。你们丹麦人总是急着赶去什么地方。

source: Laertes is meeting with the King, but my father needs him.
target: 雷欧提斯正在会见国王，可我父亲有事找他。

source: He's in the Great Hall, then. Have you been in there yet?
target: 那他就在大殿里。你进去过了吗？

source: Ay, Maike... What's got your father all in a rush so?
target: 哎，姑娘……你父亲怎么急成这样？

source: Laertes heads to Paris tomorrow. I think Father's merely overly worried about his departure.
target: 雷欧提斯明天就要去巴黎了。我想父亲只是太担心他这次远行了。

source: Is that so! Seems the boy has become a man, all in a flash. It's been so long since I chased him and Hamlet out of my kitchen with a broom.
target: 是吗！那孩子好像一眨眼就长大成人了。上回我拿扫帚把他和哈姆雷特赶出厨房，已经是好久以前的事了。

source: Then again, probably for the better. My old back can hardly stand that kind of violence.
target: 不过，这样大概也好。我这把老腰可受不了那么折腾了。

source: They were little terrors once upon a time. I'll miss him.
target: 他们以前可是两个小捣蛋鬼。我会想他的。

source: The Queen asked I have the food ready for the evening meal an hour ago—and yet, no one here. Least of all your brother.
target: 王后让我一个小时前就备好晚餐——可到现在一个人都没来。你哥哥更是没影。

source: My food does not wait for Danes. Danes wait for my food!
target: 我做的饭菜可不会等丹麦人。该是丹麦人等我做的饭菜！

source: I'm going to look for Laertes, Father.
target: 父亲，我去找雷欧提斯了。

source: He'll be with the King, no doubt.
target: 他一定和国王在一起。

source: As I mentioned before...
target: 就像我之前说的……

source: Everything must go smoothly today!
target: 今天一切都必须顺顺利利！

source: I'm looking for my overly-tardy brother. Have you seen him around?
target: 我在找我那个迟迟不来的哥哥。你见到他了吗？

source: Marcellus! Are you all right?
target: 马塞勒斯！你没事吧？

source: Sorry, Lady Ophelia, yeh gave me a bit of a spook. Been on edge since last night.
target: 抱歉，奥菲莉娅小姐，你有点吓着我了。从昨晚起，我就一直紧张兮兮的。

source: Just, er... a difficult night's watch.
target: 只是，呃……昨晚值夜有些难熬。

source: You look like you've seen a ghost, Marcellus. I'm sorry to have troubled you.
target: 马塞勒斯，你看起来像是见了鬼。抱歉，打扰你了。

source: Been up a little too late playing cards again, have we?
target: 是不是又打牌打到太晚了？

source: No! Not at all. ... Irma cleaned me out after the last game. An' I haven't gone back to her for a game since.
target: 没有！绝对没有。……上回打牌，伊尔玛把我的钱赢了个精光。从那以后，我就没再找她打过牌。

source: Besides, some of the other boys thought that maybe, yeh know, the most senior guard ought not to gamble as much...
target: 再说，其他几个小伙子觉得……资历最老的卫兵，也许该少赌一点……

source: Well, I won't tell if you won't. Try to get some sleep tonight.
target: 好吧，你不说，我也不说。今晚尽量睡一会儿吧。

source: I'll try, I will...
target: 我会尽量的，会的……

source: As for yer brother...
target: 至于你哥哥……

source: I reckon he's meeting with m'lord the King to get formal permission for his trip to Paris.
target: 我猜他正在会见国王陛下，好正式获准去巴黎。

source: Seems a strange thing to do on the eve of his departure.
target: 临出发前一天才办这事，好像有点奇怪。

source: Well, yeh know how court formalities are, milady. I don't make the rules'.
target: 唉，您也知道宫里的礼节是怎么回事，小姐。规矩又不是我定的。

source: You'll probably find him... in the Great Hall!
target: 您大概能在……大厅找到他！

source: Very dramatic, Marcellus.
target: 真会卖关子，马塞勒斯。

source: Just tryin' ta be helpful!
target: 我就是想帮个忙！

source: Psst! Have you spoken to Father today? He's in a fit!
target: 喂！你今天跟父亲说过话了吗？他正大发脾气呢！

source: Ah! Right! I'd completely forgotten. My mind's on Paris already.
target: 啊！对了！我忘得一干二净。我的心早就飞到巴黎去了。

source: Hamlet and I both are waiting for an audience with the King, but it's dragging on.
target: 哈姆雷特和我都在等国王召见，可这事一直拖着。

source: Won't you speak to the Queen, Ophelia? She's fond of you. She can move this meeting along.
target: 你能去跟王后说说吗，奥菲莉娅？她很喜欢你。她能让这次会面快一点。

source: My father desires to speak with Laertes.
target: 我父亲想跟雷欧提斯谈谈。

source: If Laertes leaves, this already-desolate place will become a lot more dismal.
target: 雷欧提斯要是走了，这个本来就冷清的地方会更凄凉。

source: Somehow, I feel this is thoroughly your fault.
target: 不知怎么，我觉得这全是你的错。

source: You could have convinced him to stay, couldn't you?
target: 你本来能劝他留下的，不是吗？

source: I don't control my brother—or his itinerary, for that matter.
target: 我可管不了我哥哥——他的行程也一样。

source: Hmmph. Now what will I do? Being a lady-in-waiting is so dismal! Attending to the Queen's every little whim, following her from court function to court function...
target: 哼。那我现在怎么办？当宫廷侍女真是苦闷！王后随便有什么小念头都得伺候，还要跟着她参加一场又一场宫廷活动……

source: It's tedious, Lady Ophelia. If only I were a sad little half-rank girl with no prospects like you. Then I'd be excused from this banality.
target: 真是无聊透了，奥菲莉娅小姐。要是我也像你一样，是个可怜巴巴、身份不上不下、毫无前途的小姑娘就好了。那我就能免去这些琐事。

source: Just tell me where he is, Brit.
target: 告诉我他在哪儿就行了，布莉特。

source: ...You see the door to the Great Hall there. Fetch him yourself. I'm not your scullery maid.
target: ……大厅的门就在那儿，你看得见。自己去叫他。我又不是你的洗碗女佣。

source: ...Perhaps if he's late enough, he won't have to go to Paris after all...
target: ……也许他要是迟到得够久，就不用去巴黎了……

source: Unlikely. A French coastal gale is calling his name.
target: 不太可能。法国海岸的狂风正呼唤着他呢。

source: Oh, what a divine punishment it is for him to sail off to France, leaving me with the boring sibling...
target: 唉，他坐船去了法国，却把那个无趣的妹妹留给我，真是上天对我的惩罚……

source: Sorry to disappoint.
target: 抱歉，让你失望了。

source: Alas, can't be helped. You've got disappointment written all over you. Poor little orphan girl.
target: 唉，也没办法。你浑身上下都写着让人失望。可怜的小孤女。

source: You may be the Queen's lady-in-waiting, but I am a lady of the Court. Keep your tongue in check.
target: 你虽是王后的宫廷侍女，可我也是宫廷贵女。说话注意分寸。

source: Oh, I know precisely who you are...
target: 哦，你是什么人，我清楚得很……

source: Hamlet is staying in Denmark after all.
target: 哈姆雷特最终还是留在丹麦了。

source: And Laertes?
target: 那雷欧提斯呢？

source: Still leaving.
target: 还是要走。

source: What's the bloody point if all the attractive ones are ditching Danish soil? Ugh.
target: 有魅力的人全都要离开丹麦，那还有个什么劲？真烦。

source: At least Bernardo's still around.
target: 至少贝尔纳多还在。

source: So Hamlet will be staying in Denmark after all?
target: 这么说，哈姆雷特最终还是会留在丹麦？

source: I did it for my wife's sanity, really.
target: 说真的，我这么做是为了让我妻子安心。

source: Bless her heart, you don't know how much of her energy that boy's sapped in recent months.
target: 可怜的她，你不知道这几个月那孩子耗费了她多少心力。

source: She needs some time to mother him here. If he goes to Wittenberg, what then? She'll be a worried tangle for the whole year.
target: 她需要一些时间，让他留在这里，好好照顾他。要是他去了维滕贝格，那怎么办？她会一整年都忧心忡忡。

source: My lady, are you happy to hear Hamlet will be staying in Denmark?
target: 王后陛下，听说哈姆雷特会留在丹麦，您高兴吗？

source: Oh, it's wonderful!
target: 哦，真是太好了！

source: He needs all the love I can shower on him. I'll try my best to rouse his spirits.
target: 他需要我倾尽所有的关爱。我会尽力让他振作起来。

source: My husband is a kind man for stopping the trip. Though Hamlet can't understand now, I'm certain he will someday...
target: 我丈夫阻止了这次出行，真是体贴。虽然哈姆雷特现在还不能理解，但我相信总有一天他会明白……

source: So. You're stuck here?
target: 所以。你被困在这里了？

source: While your brother's gallivanting around Paris, I shall be thinking of him fondly from my seat on the chamberpot.
target: 你哥哥在巴黎四处寻欢作乐的时候，我就坐在夜壶上，满怀深情地想着他。

source: Elsinore Castle becomes more oppressive each day.
target: 埃尔西诺城堡一天比一天让人压抑。

source: It must be so terribly oppressive, being Prince.
target: 当王子一定压抑得不得了吧。

source: If I didn't know you well enough to tell otherwise, I'd think you were being kind.
target: 要不是我够了解你，听得出你的意思，还真会以为你是在安慰我。

source: There are still good things about Denmark, Hamlet.
target: 丹麦还是有美好的东西的，哈姆雷特。

source: My father was one. You were the other. Now both are gone.
target: 我父亲曾经是其中之一。另一个是你。如今两个都不在了。

source: Looks like Hamlet is staying.
target: 看来哈姆雷特要留下了。

source: I'm glad, honestly. This castle wouldn't be the same without him.
target: 说实话，我很高兴。没有他，这座城堡就不一样了。

source: Though... now I need to get him to cheer up, somehow.
target: 不过……现在我得想个办法让他开心起来。

source: Hamlet is staying in Denmark.
target: 哈姆雷特要留在丹麦了。

source: Humph! And the cloud over the castle grows.
target: 哼！城堡上空的阴云又更浓了。

source: That boy brings his soot wherever he walks. I wish he were gone.
target: 那小子走到哪儿，就把乌烟瘴气带到哪儿。我真希望他走。

source: He's done nothing but cause trouble since he was at the wet-nurse's teat!
target: 他从还在吃奶妈的奶时起，就只会惹麻烦！

source: Due to recent game updates, your game has been reverted to the start of the most recent loop. All progress up to that point has been preserved.
target: 由于近期游戏更新，你的游戏已回退至最近一次循环的起点。此前的所有进度均已保留。

source: Due to recent game updates, your game has been reverted to the start of the prologue. We apologize for the inconvenience.
target: 由于近期游戏更新，你的游戏已回退至序章的起点。给你带来不便，我们深表歉意。

source: Due to recent game updates, your game has been advanced to the start of the next loop. All progress up to that point has been preserved.
target: 由于近期游戏更新，你的游戏已推进至下一次循环的起点。此前的所有进度均已保留。

source: Just yesterday, I would have believed you. But with everything that's changed—Hamlet might very well come out of this a new young man.
target: 就在昨天，我还会相信你的话。但如今一切都变了——经历了这些，哈姆雷特很可能会变成一个全新的年轻人。

source: A-ah—it must be because of—well, I heard the story about what happened with your father.
target: 啊、啊——一定是因为——嗯，我听说了你父亲的事。

source: But a spirit— a vision, is something else entirely. You could have my reputation shattered. And my uncle would be all too gleeful over it.
target: 但幽灵——幻象，那就完全是另一回事了。你可能会让我名誉扫地。而我叔叔只怕会乐坏了。

source: If you are interested in seeing me perform something special—maybe based upon some juicy gossip—feel free to let me know!
target: 如果你想看我演点特别的——也许以某些劲爆的传闻为题材——尽管告诉我！

source: (Well, it's Brit—or was— but I'll feign ignorance.)
target: （嗯，是布莉特——或者说，以前是——不过我还是装作不知道吧。）

source: They—they did?
target: 他们——他们真这么做了？

source: And—with young Laertes gone, I expect your heart is heavy right now.
target: 还有——年轻的雷欧提斯走了，想必你现在心里很沉重。

source: Yes. In a way, it is peaceful.
target: 是的。从某种意义上说，这很平静。

source: All suffering is, in one way or another, caused by death, or the fear of it...
target: 一切痛苦，归根结底，都源于死亡，或对死亡的恐惧……

source: Now that fear is removed forever, replaced by an equally-deep boredom.
target: 如今，那份恐惧已永远消失，取而代之的是同样深重的无聊。

source: Even still, this boredom is refreshing at the moment, though I anticipate it, too, will grow old.
target: 即便如此，这份无聊眼下倒也让人耳目一新，虽然我料想，总有一天连它也会令人厌倦。

source: And when it does... well.
target: 而到了那时……唉。

source: To divest oneself of the fear of death, one need only give into it.
target: 要摆脱对死亡的恐惧，只需向死亡屈服。

source: How does one divest oneself of eternal boredom?
target: 可要怎样摆脱永恒的无聊呢？

source: Indeed. A most frightening prospect.
target: 确实。那前景实在可怕。

source: Yes. As we've discussed before, it has never been a concern of mine.
target: 是的。正如我们之前谈过的，我从未为此忧虑。

source: It does not.
target: 并不会。

source: I made my peace with it long before my death.
target: 早在死去之前，我就已经坦然接受了这件事。

source: Though they were only one in body near the end of my life... their feelings for one another extended to far before that.
target: 虽然直到我生命将尽时，他们才有了肉体上的结合……但他们对彼此的感情，早在那之前就有了。

source: Something in Gerta and I died far sooner, when the others did.
target: 早得多的时候，当其他人死去时，格尔塔和我心里的一部分就已经随之死去了。

source: Ah. It would not be common knowledge for anyone other than Irma and Gerta, I expect.
target: 啊。我想，除了伊尔玛和格尔塔，其他人应该都不知道这件事。

source: Hamlet was our first living child. But Gerta was with child before that. Four times in all.
target: 哈姆雷特是我们第一个活下来的孩子。但在那之前，格尔塔就怀过孕。总共怀了四次。

source: The first she lost very near to birth. We thought the child might live, but we were wrong.
target: 第一个孩子，她在临近分娩时失去了。我们以为那孩子或许能活下来，但我们错了。

source: The second and third emerged simply as a stream of blood.
target: 第二个和第三个，流出来的只有鲜血。

source: She saw each loss as a failure unto herself.
target: 每失去一个孩子，她都认为是自己的失败。

source: After we lost our third child, I no longer knew what to say to her, and she to me.
target: 失去第三个孩子以后，我再也不知道该对她说些什么，她对我也是一样。

source: If she could not give me an heir, she could not fulfill her duties as Queen, as she saw them. And to her, that was the gravest failing of all.
target: 在她看来，如果不能为我生下继承人，就无法履行王后的职责。而对她而言，这是最严重的失职。

source: When she was with child a fourth time, she had already picked out a place to bury him in the graveyard, so certain was she that he would die.
target: 第四次怀孕时，她已经在墓地为他选好了埋葬的地方，她是那么确信他会死。

source: But Hamlet lived. And our miracle son was born.
target: 但哈姆雷特活了下来。我们的儿子，那个奇迹，就这样诞生了。

source: Claudius knew nothing of the lost children, as far as I know. He was a comfort to her. He was warm and gentle to her in ways I was not.
target: 据我所知，克劳狄斯对那些夭折的孩子一无所知。他给了她安慰。他待她温暖而温柔，那是我没能给她的。

source: Over time that comfort grew to familiarity, then to affection, then to love. I witnessed it and I did not stop it.
target: 渐渐地，那份安慰变成了亲近，继而是好感，最后成了爱情。我看在眼里，却没有阻止。

source: My wife has suffered enough in this life. Improper though it may be for a man to allow his wife to be wooed by his brother...
target: 我的妻子这一生已经受够了苦。纵容自己的兄弟追求自己的妻子，对一个男人来说或许有失体统……

source: If it would purchase her one single shred of happiness, I would overlook nearly anything in the world for Gerta.
target: 但只要能为她换来哪怕一丝幸福，为了格尔塔，这世上几乎任何事我都可以不计较。

source: I—I had no idea. My sincerest apologies for prying, King Hamlet.
target: 我——我完全不知道。哈姆雷特国王，请原谅我冒昧打听这些。

source: Gertrude? I—I don't know quite what to say about that.
target: 乔特鲁德？我——我真不知道该说什么。

source: Certainly. You're in luck—Bernardo ordered me to turn over the key, but he hasn't come for it yet.
target: 当然。你来得正巧——贝尔纳多命令我交出钥匙，不过他还没来拿。

source: My apologies. It's just—
target: 抱歉。只是——

source: This card game you mentioned—it's unpopular with the others?
target: 你提到的那个纸牌游戏——其他人不喜欢吗？

source: Before the slippers she wore to his funeral had even been broken in—a funeral where she followed his body like Niobe, all tears—
target: 她穿去参加他葬礼的那双鞋，还没穿合脚呢——葬礼上，她跟在他的遗体后面，像尼俄柏一样泪流不止——

source: It's too late for me to do something public about this—expose them for who they are, on stage...
target: 我现在想为这事公开做些什么，已经太迟了——在舞台上揭露他们的真面目……

source: All the things I did for her—
target: 我为她做了那么多事——

source: Otherwise, if I start to think about it—
target: 不然，要是我开始想这件事——

source: In the past, I would have turned to Brit for something like this. But—well.
target: 以前碰到这种事，我会找布莉特帮忙。但——唉。

source: It's too late for me to do something public about this—to expose them for who they are, on stage...
target: 我现在想为这事公开做些什么，已经太迟了——在舞台上揭露他们的真面目……

source: He asked me to watch Claudius closely for any hint of—well, guilt, I suppose.
target: 他让我仔细观察克劳狄斯，看他有没有流露出一丝——嗯，我想，是愧疚吧。

source: He had asked me to watch Claudius closely for any hint of—well, guilt, I suppose.
target: 他之前让我仔细观察克劳狄斯，看他有没有流露出一丝——嗯，我想，是愧疚吧。

source: But those beady little eyes of his—who knows what horrors he's capable of!
target: 可他那双贼溜溜的小眼睛——谁知道他能干出什么可怕的事！

source: I showed the very location to his men not long after he spoke with you. My mother—was in shock. I couldn't leave him there with her.
target: 他和你谈过之后没多久，我就把具体位置指给他的手下看了。我母亲——当时惊魂未定。我不能把他留在那里，和她待在一起。

source: And—he was right.
target: 而且——他说得对。

source: Rest assured—he will be dealt with in swift time.
target: 放心——很快就会处置他。

source: I warned him to stay his hand, but he listened not.
target: 我警告过他不要动手，但他不听。

source: Grow used to the sting of loss, Ophelia. You will see it yet many hundreds of times before you are free.
target: 习惯失去的刺痛吧，奥菲莉娅。在获得自由之前，你还会见到数百次这样的事。

source: I can't speak about this right now, my lady. Apologies for being evasive, but—many things have taken place in the last few hours.
target: 小姐，我现在没法谈这件事。抱歉这样遮遮掩掩，可——过去几个小时发生了太多事。

source: Had Hamlet been... properly disciplined before now—had someone intervened—your father might yet live.
target: 要是之前就有人……好好管教哈姆雷特——要是有人出面干预——你父亲或许还活着。

source: I knew she was unhappy. But to this extent—to the point of treason? How can it be?
target: 我知道她不开心。可竟然到了这种地步——甚至不惜叛国？怎么会这样？

source: That's not what I was aski—you know what, forget I said anything.
target: 我问的不是这——算了，当我什么都没说。

source: Still, to lose one's life so young—it is a shame.
target: 不过，这么年轻就丢了性命——实在令人惋惜。

source: You're going to continue meeting with him until he has all the information he needs to overtake Elsinore. And then, Brit—then everyone will die.
target: 你会继续和他见面，直到他掌握攻占埃尔西诺所需的全部情报。然后，布莉特——然后所有人都会死。

source: Those eyes will watch for any opportune moment—and then they'll find him and release him back to his men.
target: 那些眼线会伺机而动——然后找到他，把他放回他的手下那里。

source: Look, Ophelia—a little free advice between friends...
target: 听着，奥菲莉娅——朋友之间，免费给你一点忠告……

source: There are gaps in my knowledge between my death and my... awakening.
target: 从我死去到我……苏醒，这期间的事，有些我并不知道。

source: I know not where they live now. Only that he has certainly taken them from where they once lay.
target: 我不知道它们如今在何处。只知道，他肯定已经把它们从原来存放的地方带走了。

source: I can feel the cobwebs of my memory being dusted away gently.
target: 我能感觉到，记忆中的蛛网正被轻轻拂去。

source: Ah, to be alive, to remember... my utter failure.
target: 啊，活着，记起……我那彻底的失败。

source: That book... I gave up in the end, didn't I? And I let... that cursed thing win, break me down...
target: 那本书……我最后还是放弃了，不是吗？我让……那个该死的东西赢了，让它把我击垮……

source: Yes. Like you, I was doomed to repeat the occasion of my death. Hundreds of times. Thousands.
target: 是的。和你一样，我注定要反复经历自己的死亡。数百次。数千次。

source: And like you, the timeline of my death was no more than a week. My son Hamlet was away at Wittenberg, my brother Claudius plotting to take my throne.
target: 也和你一样，我走向死亡的这段时间不超过一周。我的儿子哈姆雷特远在维滕贝格，我的弟弟克劳狄斯则在密谋夺取我的王位。

source: How long was I trapped in that insane void between life and death? Centuries? Millennia? I know not...
target: 我被困在那片生死之间的疯狂虚空里，到底有多久？几百年？几千年？我不知道……

source: It was peaceful to forget for a while, but even now, I cannot be truly dead. No, here I am, still animated, grimacing, like a starved dog brought back to life, forced to bare my teeth...
target: 暂时忘却曾让我平静，可即使到了现在，我也无法真正死去。不，我还在这里，仍能活动，面目扭曲，像一条饿死后又被复活的狗，被迫龇着牙……

source: I cannot truly rest until my brother pays for his crime, the crime I spent a thousand years trying to avoid!
target: 只有我的弟弟为他的罪行付出代价，我才能真正安息。那罪行，我花了一千年都没能阻止！

source: A way out!
target: 一条出路！

source: A choice between versions of a private hell!
target: 在不同的个人地狱之间做个选择！

source: But I was not permitted that much! No, I had to give up! I lay there in the garden, being poisoned by my own brother over and over again, for years before I was freed!
target: 可我连这点选择都没有！没有，我只能放弃！我躺在花园里，一次又一次被自己的弟弟毒死，过了许多年才得到解脱！

source: I scoured every inch of the castle, every nook and flagstone and drawer—it isn't here, Ophelia! It simply isn't!
target: 我搜遍了城堡的每一寸地方，每个角落、每块石板、每个抽屉——它不在这里，奥菲莉娅！它就是不在！

source: Why did I have to give up, to expire into madness alone?
target: 为什么我只能放弃，独自在疯狂中死去？

source: Ophelia! Find the book! Find the book and save your own soul!
target: 奥菲莉娅！找到那本书！找到那本书，救你自己的灵魂！

source: You know that name? How? How can you know?
target: 你知道那个名字？怎么知道的？你怎么可能知道？

source: It is eternally more worthwhile to fight than to give up as I did, Ophelia. Never forget that. For you, hope lingers.
target: 奥菲莉娅，抗争永远比像我这样放弃更有意义。永远别忘了这一点。你仍有希望。

source: I believe that you will live to see winter come to Denmark—putting an end to this cursed summer.
target: 我相信你会活着看到丹麦迎来冬天——让这个受诅咒的夏天结束。

source: Perhaps it is too late, after all.
target: 或许，终究还是太迟了。

source: Insanity—death—they have always plagued our family. My mother Astrid was no exception.
target: 疯狂——死亡——它们始终纠缠着我们的家族。我的母亲阿斯特丽德也不例外。

source: I often wonder if she died like me, if she saw time repeating itself. I cannot bear to think of her suffering the same pain I did.
target: 我常常想，她是否也像我这样死去，是否也看着时间不断重演。一想到她可能承受过和我一样的痛苦，我就受不了。

source: Impossible to tell. My mother is long dead.
target: 无从得知。我的母亲已经死去很久了。

source: Yes. The Book of Fates. I remember our discussion.
target: 是的。《命运之书》。我记得我们谈过它。

source: Is there some unfinished buisness holding you back from making a choice?
target: 是有什么未了之事，让你迟迟无法做出选择吗？

source: Do not turn away from this oppertunity, Ophelia.
target: 别放弃这个机会，奥菲莉娅。

source: If only Astrid was still alive, or haunted these walls as I, we could ask her.
target: 要是阿斯特丽德还活着，或者像我一样以幽灵之身徘徊在这城堡里，我们就能问问她了。

source: I told him I wanted to learn from the Book, to learn to be like him. He indulged me by granting it to me once more—of course he did.
target: 我告诉他，我想从那本书里学习，学着成为他那样的人。他顺着我的意思，又把书给了我——他当然会这么做。

source: I just wanted to find a way to save them all—and myself.
target: 我只是想找到一个办法，救下他们所有人——还有我自己。

source: It wasn't spoken of in my lifetime.
target: 我生前，没有人谈论这件事。

source: Even Claudius and I have never passed her name between us. She... my mother...
target: 就连克劳狄斯和我，也从没对彼此提起过她的名字。她……我的母亲……

source: Terrible, bloody deeds were committed. My father was a cruel and greedy man.
target: 有人犯下了可怕的血腥暴行。我的父亲是个残忍又贪婪的人。

source: I do not know her whereabouts, but if she left Elsinore, she must have passed through town.
target: 我不知道她的下落，但如果她离开了埃尔西诺，就一定经过了镇子。

source: But I am confined to these walls. I may not leave the board's edges.
target: 可我被困在这些城墙之内。我不能越过棋盘的边界。

source: Then you know only one small piece of it.
target: 那你知道的只是其中很小的一部分。

source: I have suffered far more than anyone, even you, can understand.
target: 我承受的苦难，远非任何人所能理解，连你也不例外。

source: Perhaps one year, one century from now—then you may come to comprehend.
target: 也许再过一年，或是一个世纪——到那时，你或许就能理解了。

source: You should know by now. Those are the events that were meant to come to pass.
target: 你现在应该明白了。那些事本就注定要发生。

source: That is the tragic fate which is written before you. For mine own self, it was my poisoning.
target: 那就是为你写定的悲惨命运。至于我，则是被毒死。

source: To think you can find a future where that does not happen is futile. Give up the sooner and you will drift into endless sleep.
target: 想找到一个不会发生那种事的未来，终究是徒劳。早些放弃，你就会渐渐沉入无尽的睡眠。

source: And it's said he discarded her in favor of younger women quite often—a womanizer who could not be satiated!
target: 而且据说，他常常为了更年轻的女人而抛下她——真是个永不知足的好色之徒！

source: She passed when Claudius and I were both children.
target: 她去世时，克劳狄斯和我都还是孩子。

source: Evidently, she died of childbirth with my brother. One more life he's ruined in this world, I expect.
target: 看来，她是在生我弟弟时难产而死的。我想，这世上又多了一条被他毁掉的生命。

source: It matters not. My father loved her, at least in front of the court, and I remember her very little.
target: 这不重要。我的父亲爱她，至少在宫廷众人面前是如此，而我对她的记忆已经很少了。

source: Come to think of it, your father and your mother were both ardently devoted to her.
target: 说起来，你父亲和母亲都曾对她忠心耿耿。

source: Death is a wall. Very little permeates it.
target: 死亡是一堵墙。几乎没有什么能穿透它。

source: I am ashamed.
target: 我很惭愧。

source: But I cannot hide the truth.
target: 但我不能隐瞒真相。

source: All I can do is offer my deepest apologies. My decision was clearly in error.
target: 我只能向你致以最深的歉意。我的决定显然是错的。

source: Polonius and I never spoke of it at the time, but...
target: 当时，波洛涅斯和我从未谈过这件事，可是……

source: I would understand if you no longer spoke to me.
target: 如果你不再和我说话，我也能理解。

source: In that case, I am at your service.
target: 既然如此，我愿为你效劳。

source: Nothing I could say could possible amend that crime.
target: 无论我说什么，都不可能弥补那桩罪行。

source: So I will say nothing more.
target: 所以，我不会再多说了。

source: The... details are indescribably hazy. It is hard to remember.
target: 那些……细节模糊得难以形容。很难回想起来。

source: But I recall he was kind to me. Kinder than I deserved, considering I was not able to help him.
target: 但我记得他待我很好。我没能帮上他的忙，他却给了我不配得到的善意。

source: Of course. Now I now he was just using me for his own ends.
target: 当然。现在我知道了，他只是在利用我达到自己的目的。

source: We must stop him, Ophelia. There are no limits to what that man will do.
target: 我们必须阻止他，奥菲莉娅。那个人什么事都做得出来。

source: ...It was a pressing request of his—something I could not... find...
target: ……他急切地要求我找一样东西——可我没能……找到……

source: My memories drift away like fog. Retrieve my final writings from your father. Perhaps then we can make sense of this nothingness.
target: 我的记忆像雾一样飘散。去你父亲那里取回我最后写下的东西。也许到那时，我们就能弄明白这片虚无。

source: To help him find the Book of Fates... the token which created this sad situation.
target: 帮他找到命运之书……那件造成这悲惨局面的信物。

source: I was never able to find it, of course... but even knowing gave me purpose.
target: 当然，我始终没能找到它……但仅仅知道它的存在，就让我有了目标。

source: The will to try again indefinitely. The will to return, even now.
target: 让我有意志无休止地再试下去。即使到了现在，也有意志归来。

source: Hamlet—and I—we spoke honestly. For perhaps the first time in our lives.
target: 哈姆雷特——还有我——我们坦诚地谈了谈。也许这在我们一生中还是第一次。

source: Hamlet—your uncle is not your enemy. Peter Quince is.
target: 哈姆雷特——你的叔叔不是你的敌人。彼得·奎因斯才是。

source: I know the one you mean, I think, though it's been years. I—I see. So you believe he's trying to hurt someone?
target: 我想我知道你说的是谁，虽然已经过去好些年了。我——我明白了。所以你认为他想伤害某个人？

source: I met Simona, and she revealed to me the true culprit—Peter Quince, the playmaster, is behind us being trapped in Elsinore.
target: 我见到了西蒙娜，她告诉了我真正的罪魁祸首是谁——我们被困在埃尔西诺，幕后主使就是戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯。

source: Yes. Hamlet, you, and I shall act anon.
target: 是的。哈姆雷特、你，还有我，很快就要行动。

source: A ghost, a mad prince, and... you. What a trio we shall be.
target: 一个幽灵，一个疯王子，还有……你。我们三个凑在一起，真是绝妙。

source: Peter Quince? He is but flesh and blood. What ill can he do to you?
target: 彼得·奎因斯？他不过是血肉之躯。他能对你造成什么伤害？

source: No. Impossible. Quince encouraged me to find the Book of Fates.
target: 不。不可能。奎因斯曾鼓励我去寻找命运之书。

source: He urged me to find a way out using the Book as my guide...
target: 他催促我以那本书为指引，寻找出路……

source: For what purpose could he desire such an artifact?
target: 他想要这样一件宝物，究竟是为了什么？

source: Because he's trapped in this world—our world—until I use the Book of Fates and free us both. That's why he's been in Elsinore for so long.
target: 因为他被困在这个世界——我们的世界——只有我使用命运之书，让我们两人都获得自由，他才能离开。这就是他在埃尔西诺待了这么久的原因。

source: Boredom can be quite frightening. Even I, who have been dead but a scarce several months, understand how frightening it is.
target: 无聊会变得相当可怕。就连我这个才死了短短几个月的人，也明白它有多可怕。

source: Unable to truly die, yet unable to engage with human life...
target: 无法真正死去，却也无法参与活人的生活……

source: It is like standing outside a window, watching those inside gorge themselves on a feast. I press my hands against the glass nightly.
target: 这就像站在窗外，看着里面的人在盛宴上大快朵颐。我每夜都把双手贴在玻璃上。

source: But try as I might, I cannot join them. I have relinquished my seat at that table, and a wolf now sits in my place.
target: 但无论我怎么努力，都无法加入他们。我已经让出了桌旁的席位，如今坐在我位置上的是一匹狼。

source: Here I remain, bored out of my bones, lingering like refuse.
target: 我依旧留在这里，无聊透骨，像废物一样滞留不去。

source: Yes. Cruelty is one cure for that boredom. A route I myself was inspired to take. And now my son wages revenge on my behalf.
target: 是的。残忍是排解那种无聊的一种办法。我自己也曾受驱使走上这条路。如今，我的儿子正在替我复仇。

source: Agreed. You must bring my son to me.
target: 我同意。你必须把我的儿子带来见我。

source: Yes—bring him here with those same words, and the three of us shall conspire to end Quince.
target: 是的——用同样的话把他带到这里，我们三人便一起谋划，除掉奎因斯。

source: I did not understand when you brought him to me in this world. But now I do. Try once more, Ophelia.
target: 你在这个世界把他带来见我时，我还不明白。但现在我明白了。再试一次，奥菲莉娅。

source: I am aware.
target: 我知道。

source: He must be dealt with. But we cannot let him know of our plans.
target: 必须对付他。但我们不能让他知道我们的计划。

source: You—you did?
target: 你——你真的做了？

source: After so many years with Hamlet—he was so terribly cold to her.
target: 她和哈姆雷特在一起那么多年——他对她实在太冷淡了。

source: Yes. We're addressing it anon. The King is aware—fear not.
target: 是的。我们很快就会处理。国王已经知道了——别担心。

source: I do, but—I also think those notes contain something important.
target: 是，但——我也觉得那些笔记里有重要的东西。

source: If you were to describe what you saw to the wrong people, it would put Father—and both of us—in grave danger.
target: 如果你把所见告诉了不该告诉的人，就会让父亲——还有我们两个人——陷入极大的危险。

source: Well, Bernardo—or Katherine—is more than a little tormented over others finding out about this.
target: 嗯，贝尔纳多——或者说凯瑟琳——非常害怕别人发现这件事，为此备受煎熬。

source: Very funny. But truly—have you seen anything... suspicious?
target: 真好笑。但说正经的——你有没有看到什么……可疑的事？

source: I—I don't think this is the kind of help they mean.
target: 我——我觉得他们说的帮忙，不是这种帮忙。

source: Since you know the truth about me—No. Not a chance. Who told you that rubbish?
target: 既然你知道了我的真实情况——不。绝不可能。是谁告诉你那种鬼话的？

source: But no—I don't believe that for an instant. Claudius is far too dull to play chess like that.
target: 但不——我一点都不信。克劳狄斯太迟钝了，布局不了这样的棋局。

source: No, 'Feely, I have—had, at least—a special monopoly on wanting you dead.
target: 不，菲莉，想让你死的人只有我——至少曾经只有我。

source: Ophelia? Did—did you do that?
target: 奥菲莉娅？那——那是你干的？

source: Oy! I-is—wos that—what just—Ophelia?
target: 喂！这、这是——那是——刚才怎么——奥菲莉娅？

source: It's almost like a little game. Watch them run, seek them out—
target: 这简直像个小游戏。看着他们逃跑，再把他们找出来——

source: Or—perhaps this is merely a tool I can use to amuse myself.
target: 或者——也许这只是个能让我用来消遣的工具。

source: I don't know what you are—spirit or demon or otherwise. But no justice could apply to you.
target: 我不知道你是什么——幽灵、恶魔，还是别的什么。但任何公道都制裁不了你。

source: But someday, you'll be just like me, too. And then—you'll know.
target: 但总有一天，你也会变得和我一样。到那时——你就明白了。

source: Or—well—how many times have you used that gift now? Been quite a few, hasn't it?
target: 或者——嗯——你现在已经用了多少次那份天赋？已经不少次了，对吧？

source: Die, then—whoever you are.
target: 那就去死吧——不管你是谁。

source: That was—you?
Are you telling me you are the one responsible for that—that—mauling?
target: 你是说，那次——那次——撕咬，是你干的？

source: It's—the Devil's work. It must be!
target: 那是——魔鬼干的。一定是！

source: Guh—Get away from me! From all of us!
target: 滚——离我远点！离我们所有人远点！

source: I don't need to reach you. I can kill you with a single word. I have a power—
target: 我不必碰到你。只要一句话，我就能杀了你。我有一种力量——

source: And—I want this investigated at once. I want to know exactly what took place.
target: 还有——我要立刻调查这件事。我要知道到底发生了什么。

source: You know, when my father died it felt the same way. I expected sorrow. But—nothing. Just nothing.
target: 你知道吗，我父亲死的时候，我也是这种感觉。我以为自己会悲伤。但——什么都没有。什么感觉都没有。

source: Let—Let us speak of that no more, Ophelia. Let it accumulate yesterdays upon its grave.
target: 别——别再提那件事了，奥菲莉娅。让一个个昨日堆积在它的坟头吧。

source: Don't take this the wrong way, but—what if Hamlet and I began seeing each other again?
target: 别误会我的意思，但——如果我和哈姆雷特重新交往呢？

source: That's not a sonnet at all. Fourteen lines of ten syllables—isn't that how it goes?
target: 那根本不是十四行诗。十四行，每行十个音节——不该是这样吗？

source: I—I must admit it has been described to me as a fault of mine.
target: 我——我得承认，有人说过这是我的一个缺点。

source: She's—well, she and Hamlet—
target: 她是——嗯，她和哈姆雷特——

source: I—I feel exhausted.
target: 我——我觉得累坏了。

source: And Hamlet's gone now, and, well—
target: 而哈姆雷特现在也走了，而且，嗯——

source: I've witnessed destruction wrought by the very stars themselves, which I thought once were mere fixed illusion—until I'd been to them.
target: 我亲眼见过星辰本身造成的毁灭。我曾以为它们只是固定不动的幻象——直到我亲自去过那里。

source: We traveled for two days until we reached the outer limits of Denmark's borders—a small castle of no repute, crumbling away into snow and dirt.
target: 我们走了两天，终于抵达丹麦边境的最外围——那里有一座默默无闻的小城堡，正在风雪与泥土中逐渐坍塌。

source: Norway is deflected successfully. But not forever. Fortinbras must be returned to his people, and returned he is—for a price.
target: 挪威的攻势被成功挡住了。但这不会长久。福丁布拉斯必须被送回他的人民身边，而他也确实被送了回去——代价却不可避免。

source: But—what I did—it was the best choice, was it not?
target: 但——我所做的——那是最好的选择，不是吗？

source: Ferdinand assures me that Kalmar is not so different—another country, yes, but very alike. And so we pack our things, and one month after our wedding day, we set forth.
target: 费迪南德向我保证，卡尔马并没有那么不同——没错，那是另一个国家，但两地很相似。于是我们收拾好行李，在婚礼一个月后启程。

source: It rarely seems to sputter out entirely—Irma is always working.
target: 它似乎很少会彻底熄灭——伊尔玛总在忙活。

source: She's been through this before. She must know the way out of it all. And—and if this is right, she's still alive!
target: 她以前经历过这些。她一定知道怎么摆脱这一切。而且——而且如果这是真的，她还活着！

source: Let me see if I can find what Claudius asked Bernardo to hide.—Ah. This must be it.
target: 让我找找克劳狄斯让贝尔纳多藏起来的东西。——啊。一定就是这个。

source: I'm sorry, Father. I don't feel well. I had such an odd vision last night—
target: 对不起，父亲。我不太舒服。昨晚我看到了一个特别古怪的幻象——

source: Be careful, love. That's all I ask. Carrying on like this—it terrifies me. I don't want you hurt.
target: 要小心，亲爱的。我只求你这一点。你一直这样下去——我真的很害怕。我不想你受伤。

source: The more I think on it, the heavier my heart becomes. I—
target: 我越想，心里就越沉重。我——

source: Things are almost peaceful, here at the start of it all.
target: 在这一切的开端，这里几乎称得上平静。

source: It is impossible, yes. It is the rules of the larger game.
target: 是的，那不可能。这是一场更大的游戏的规则。

source: I did not give it that name. But it is a game all the same, and you the one forecasted to lose.
target: 这个名字不是我起的。但它终究是一场游戏，而你是被预言会输的那个人。

source: Now then. What news do you bring?
target: 那么，你带来了什么消息？

source: Death becomes you.
target: 死亡很衬你。

source: Be wary of every familiar face.
target: 小心每一张熟悉的面孔。

source: One of them will betray you.
target: 他们中的一个会背叛你。

source: Would that I could. But I am unable, through no law of my own.
target: 但愿我能。可我做不到，限制我的规则并非由我定下。

source: I'm sure you'll find out soon enough.
target: 我相信你很快就会知道的。

source: I see one of your compatriots has had you killed.
target: 看来你的一个同胞派人杀了你。

source: Welcome to the ranks of the famous and esteemed. Those who die before their time live on in memory longer.
target: 欢迎加入名扬四方、受人敬重的行列。早逝的人，会在人们的记忆中留存得更久。

source: Though yours is a more heroic fate than dying on your stomach in the garden.
target: 不过，你的命运比趴在花园里死去要英勇些。

source: Of course, they will find your waterlogged corpse in the pond and say you drowned...
target: 当然，他们会在池塘里找到你被水浸透的尸体，说你是溺水而死……

source: Leaving out the gash in your neck when they tell the tale.
target: 讲述这件事时，却不提你脖子上的那道深伤口。

source: Because a gash on an innocent maiden defies explanation. Suicide is a story easily told.
target: 因为一个无辜少女身上的深伤口难以解释。自杀的故事却很容易讲。

source: Yes. There is. Your killer may be known to you, as mine was.
target: 是的。有。杀你的人可能是你认识的人，就像杀我的人一样。

source: Who do you trust to help you unmask them?
target: 你信任谁，愿意让谁帮你揭开凶手的真面目？

source: The hourglass empties. The days have passed.
target: 沙漏将空。日子已经过去。

source: Less than one cock's crow remains.
target: 剩下的时间，已不足等到下一声鸡鸣。

source: I understand now why my son adores you so.
target: 我现在明白，我的儿子为什么那么爱你了。

source: By the by, I've noticed you are free of your assassin, are you not? You have won this battle.
target: 顺便说一句，我注意到你已经摆脱那个刺客了，是不是？这场仗，你赢了。

source: No. Not the war.
target: 不。整场战争还没赢。

source: Indeed, it appears he has already done so. See for yourself if he speaks true.
target: 的确，看起来他已经这么做了。你亲自看看，他说的是否属实。

source: Though by what power he does these things, I know not.
target: 不过，他凭什么力量做到这些，我并不知道。

source: Ah. Still living, I see. So you managed to stay your fate.
target: 啊。看来你还活着。你果然设法延缓了自己的命运。

source: I'm impressed. But tomorrow, it will save you no more than the others.
target: 我很佩服。但到了明天，它救不了你，也救不了其他人。

source: It's what the dead do best.
target: 这是死者最擅长的事。

source: Fortinbras marches even now. Less than a day, Ophelia.
target: 福丁布拉斯此刻已在行军。不到一天了，奥菲莉娅。

source: Can you save them from him?
target: 你能从他手里救下他们吗？

source: They are tearing each other apart like men on patrol in a starving winter.
target: 他们彼此撕咬，仿佛饥荒寒冬中巡逻的士兵。

source: It shall not end until Elsinore lies silent.
target: 直到埃尔西诺归于死寂，这一切才会结束。

source: Now. What news do you bring?
target: 现在，你带来了什么消息？

source: S-Spirit? Do you—are you here?
target: 幽——幽灵？你——你在这里吗？

source: Indeed. I am that body once called King Hamlet.
target: 正是。我就是那曾被称为哈姆雷特国王的躯体。

source: In vague silhouettes and shadows. Memory in death is a struggle. It is faint and infrequent.
target: 只有模糊的轮廓与影子。死后回忆往事很艰难。记忆淡薄，也很少浮现。

source: I recall you were a young girl once. Such a rambunctious child. I knew you then.
target: 我记得，你曾是个小女孩。多么顽皮的孩子。那时我就认识你。

source: Yes. A world now forever locked behind time's barrier.
target: 是的。那个世界，如今已永远锁在时间的屏障后面。

source: The desire to see her safe is often the only thing powerful enough to rouse me.
target: 想看到她平安的愿望，往往是唯一足以唤醒我的力量。

source: But in this world, she does not even know of my existence. Would that she and I could speak alone just once.
target: 但在这个世界里，她甚至不知道我的存在。但愿我和她能单独说说话，哪怕只有一次。

source: I have only a single selfish request.
target: 我只有一个自私的请求。

source: But it may be of use to you.
target: 但它也许能帮到你。

source: Seek out your father. Watch what he does when he believes he is alone.
target: 去找你的父亲。看看他自以为独处时，都做些什么。

source: My notes—my notes, taken by him, out of love, out of protection—
target: 我的笔记——我的笔记，他拿走了，出于爱，出于保护——

source: They contain the terrifying details of my ordeal. Details I cannot recall. Things too hazy to remember fully.
target: 里面记着我那场苦难的可怕细节。那些我想不起的细节。那些太过模糊，无法完整记起的事。

source: But that ordeal is the reason I still linger, trapped here.
target: 但正是那场苦难，让我至今仍在徘徊，被困在这里。

source: Find the notes, and there may be freedom for us both.
target: 找到那些笔记，我们两人也许就能获得自由。

source: I have witnessed that your father keeps my possessions under most private lock and key.
target: 我亲眼见过，你父亲把我的物品锁在极隐秘的地方。

source: The key is on his person at all times. Only he may access what is mine.
target: 他时时刻刻都把钥匙带在身上。只有他能取到我的东西。

source: There are stronger forces than I at work. Even now, I can only hold my form for so long. Everything from before I walked these walls is... distant.
target: 有比我更强大的力量在起作用。即使现在，我也只能维持形体片刻。在我开始游荡于这些城墙之前的一切，都已……遥远。

source: Find those pages. They rest in your father's care. Please.
target: 找到那些纸页。它们由你父亲保管。求你了。

source: Did you cause them to happen? Are you some sort of—sorcerer?
target: 那些事是你造成的吗？你是什么——巫师吗？

source: A-and—someone's coming to kill me too, aren't they?
target: 而、而且——也有人要来杀我，是吗？

source: It is with my last fragments of will that I appear to you. I do not know how long I can linger.
target: 我是凭着最后残存的意志，才得以出现在你面前。我不知道自己还能停留多久。

source: No, Ophelia. There is no other way.
target: 不，奥菲莉娅。没有别的办法。

source: What he says is true.
target: 他说的是真的。

source: I know that now more than ever. The confines surrounding this world are insurmountable.
target: 我如今比以往任何时候都更清楚这一点。环绕这个世界的界限，无法逾越。

source: Ophelia, there will be no way out from this.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你将无法摆脱这一切。

source: That kind of world was never a possible outcome for you, Ophelia.
target: 奥菲莉娅，那样的世界从来都不是你可能得到的结局。

source: No such world of eternal bliss exists. For you, or for anyone on earth.
target: 那种永享幸福的世界并不存在。对你如此，对世上任何人都如此。

source: And it never shall.
target: 也永远不会存在。

source: But there is something even more powerful.
target: 但还有一种更强大的力量。

source: It is the oldest, most primal power of humankind.
target: 那是人类最古老、最原始的力量。

source: The power to choose with kindness and wisdom is the only thing separating human beings from utter darkness.
target: 凭善意与智慧作出选择的力量，是人类与彻底的黑暗之间唯一的屏障。

source: You have seen the possibilities of this universe. Now it's up to you to envision its fate.
target: 你已见过这个宇宙的种种可能。现在，该由你来设想它的命运了。

source: Let me be clear. There is no perfect world to be found.
target: 我把话说清楚。你找不到一个完美的世界。

source: But the choice between worlds is a power so critical as to be divinely given, is it not? Freedom of will! The first and last gift granted to Eve herself!
target: 但在不同世界之间做出选择，是一种至关重要、堪称神赐的力量，不是吗？自由意志！那是夏娃得到的第一份，也是最后一份礼物！

source: Yes... free will is a sword to cut through the darkness. It is a small boat we cling to in this lifelong storm!
target: 是的……自由意志是斩破黑暗的剑。它是我们在这场贯穿一生的风暴中紧紧抓住的小舟！

source: In that, Ophelia, is everything. You must choose, and you must then live in the world which comes from it.
target: 奥菲莉娅，这就是一切的关键。你必须做出选择，然后在由此产生的世界里生活。

source: You must do the thing you fear most, and move forward rather than back.
target: 你必须去做最令你恐惧的事，向前走，而不是退后。

source: You would punish Quince. But you would condemn every human heart in this castle to their fates. You'd abandon them.
target: 你会惩罚奎因斯。可你也会让这座城堡里的每一个人都逃不过自己的命运。你会抛弃他们。

source: I—This is—But there has to be another way! A good way—a best path!
target: 我——这——可一定还有别的办法！一个好办法——一条最好的路！

source: No. Perfection is impossible. No such world could ever exist. Not so long as imperfect human beings fill it.
target: 没有。完美是不可能的。这样的世界永远不可能存在。只要其中生活的还是不完美的人，就不可能。

source: Use the Book of Fates, Ophelia. Do what I could not.
target: 使用命运之书吧，奥菲莉娅。做我没能做到的事。

source: Refuse to give up!
target: 绝不放弃！

source: Not long now...
target: 就快了……

source: If only I had known the kind of strength you possess when I was alive, child.
target: 孩子，要是我活着的时候就知道你拥有这样的力量，该多好。

source: Though your body might be frail, you are brilliant as the sun.
target: 你的身体或许柔弱，你却像太阳一样耀眼。

source: Someday many years hence, let us play a game of chess together sometime.
target: 多年以后的某一天，我们一起下盘棋吧。

source: Or walk amongst those verdant, shimmering gardens I once slept in peacefully...
target: 或者去那些翠绿流光的花园里散步，我曾在那里安然入睡……

source: I... hope it is permissible that I call you a friend in death, though I hardly knew you in life.
target: 我……希望死后能称你为朋友，虽然生前我几乎不了解你。

source: I'm certain we'll see one another again.
target: 我相信我们一定会再见。

source: It is the end.
target: 结束了。

source: And I am not afraid.
target: 而我并不害怕。

source: Indeed. For a small while, the Book of Fates can make even this miracle possible.
target: 确实。命运之书能让这样的奇迹也成为可能，哪怕只有片刻。

source: Yes. Although death is what I wished for, once—in my heart I've always been uncertain.
target: 是的。虽然我曾经渴望死亡——可我心里一直没有拿定主意。

source: This was the fate I brought upon myself by virtue of my inaction, once.
target: 曾经，我的无所作为为自己招来了这样的命运。

source: I did not know I had a choice to make at the time. I never found the Book of Fates. But in my heart of hearts, I chose it all the same.
target: 当时我不知道自己还有选择。我从未找到命运之书。但在内心最深处，我仍然选择了它。

source: If this is the future you desire, choose it with intent, Ophelia.
target: 如果这就是你想要的未来，奥菲莉娅，那就明确地选择它。

source: Do not shy away from the world, as I did. Go into the darkness with strength. Go with purpose.
target: 不要像我那样逃避世界。带着力量走进黑暗。带着目标前行。

source: That is all.
target: 就这些。

source: Ophelia. Cease this.
target: 奥菲莉娅。停下吧。

source: You cannot stay in this world.
target: 你不能留在这个世界。

source: It has lingered long past its due.
target: 它早就该消失，却一直留存至今。

source: This version of Elsinore... is merely a fantasy.
target: 这样的埃尔西诺……不过是个幻想。

source: It is a trick invented by your own mind.
target: 这是你自己的头脑编造出来的骗局。

source: This version of events may never come to pass. This is the reality of this world when all illusion is wiped away. You are alone.
target: 这样的事态也许永远不会发生。当所有幻象都被抹去，这个世界的真相就是如此。你孤身一人。

source: In life, I did not fight Insanity. I relinquished myself to her. I was subjugated, consumed, and finally death took me.
target: 生前，我没有与疯狂抗争。我把自己交给了她。我被她征服、吞噬，最终死亡带走了我。

source: Think carefully on whether you wish to do the same.
target: 仔细想想，你是否也想这么做。

source: While you lie in the grip of your delusion, everyone still alive will meet a grisly fate. No amount of dreaming can save them from that.
target: 在你受妄想控制的时候，所有还活着的人都会迎来惨烈的命运。无论做多少梦，都无法救他们逃过这一劫。

source: T-they're all dead—all of them—
target: 他、他们都死了——所有人都死了——

source: But Guilda—pranks aside, your funeral was attended by those who truly love you. Isn't that enough?
target: 可是吉尔达——撇开恶作剧不说，来参加你葬礼的都是真心爱你的人。这还不够吗？

source: Because my father thought, if Claudius were dead—
target: 因为我父亲觉得，要是克劳狄斯死了——

source: You have returned.
target: 你回来了。

source: It is.
target: 是的。

source: Has it?
target: 是吗？

source: Or at least, I think—I think I've been gone a long time.
target: 至少，我觉得——我觉得自己已经离开很久了。

source: It felt like an instant between the last time I saw you and this awakening, now. I suppose I must have been waiting for you, then.
target: 从上次见到你，到现在这次醒来，我感觉只过了一瞬。那我想，我应该一直在等你吧。

source: Evidently so.
target: 看来是的。

source: My hands—they're so soft!
target: 我的手——好柔嫩！

source: You look just as you did then.
target: 你的模样和那时一模一样。

source: Glad to see death hasn't sapped you of your steel.
target: 很高兴死亡没有磨去你的坚毅。

source: This is the afterwards. Neither Heaven nor Hell. Simply the nothingness in between.
target: 这里是死后之境。既不是天堂，也不是地狱。只是夹在两者之间的虚无。

source: Of course I do. But why would you consider such a thing?
target: 我当然会。但你为什么会考虑这种事？

source: After all this time...
target: 都过了这么久……

source: You left that world behind. Why now?
target: 你已经告别了那个世界。为什么偏偏是现在？

source: What difference does that make?
target: 那又有什么区别？

source: Ophelia. Do you know what I would give to have left Elsinore behind in life, even just once?
target: 奥菲莉娅。你知道我愿意付出多大的代价，换来生前离开埃尔西诺的机会吗？哪怕只有一次。

source: That chance was stolen from me.
target: 那个机会被人从我手中夺走了。

source: Now you treat it as though it's something easily exchanged. As though you could put your life back on the shelf and choose another.
target: 如今你却把它当成可以随意交换的东西。仿佛能把自己的人生放回架子上，再挑一个。

source: I know it's painful. I'm sorry to have woken you again. I wanted to let you rest—I didn't know coming back would be like this.
target: 我知道这很痛苦。对不起，我又唤醒了你。我本想让你安息——我并不知道回来会变成这样。

source: No, no. There is something you do not understand about the threads of fate, I think. They are woven together as one, a transcendent tapestry.
target: 不，不。我想，有些关于命运之线的事，你还不明白。它们交织成一体，成为一幅超凡的织锦。

source: This is not a simple matter of browsing what might have been.
target: 这可不是随意看看那些本可能发生的事那么简单。

source: By choosing the world you did, you pulled that world's thread forever. If you choose to return to Elsinore, you cannot return to the path you chose.
target: 当你选择那个世界时，你就将那个世界的丝线永久地抽了出来。如果你选择回到埃尔西诺，就再也无法回到你选过的那条路。

source: Yes. In other words, you will not be able to return to that particular fate.
target: 是的。换句话说，你将无法再回到那个特定的命运。

source: It is shattered. Gone. And once you set foot back in Elsinore, you will lose all memory of what you chose.
target: 它已经破碎。消失了。而一旦你重新踏入埃尔西诺，就会失去关于自己所选命运的一切记忆。

source: Your time with Grace—the adventures you embarked on—will vanish.
target: 你与格蕾丝共度的时光——你经历的那些冒险——都会消失。

source: That sacrifice you made for the sake of others will have been meaningless, for there is no such similar path.
target: 你为他人做出的那份牺牲将变得毫无意义，因为再没有与之相似的路可走。

source: Your memory of the time you spent with Laertes and your father, both the good and bad, will vanish.
target: 你与雷欧提斯和父亲共度时光的记忆，无论好坏，都会消失。

source: You will never again have the power to overturn nations at your whim. At least—not in the same way.
target: 你再也不会拥有随心所欲颠覆各国的力量。至少——无法再用同样的方式。

source: You will never again live out the rest of your life at Hamlet's side.
target: 你再也无法在哈姆雷特身边度过余生。

source: That perfect world you created will shatter. And I will warn you now: No other fate you could choose could possibly live up to its happiness.
target: 你创造的那个完美世界将会破碎。而我要现在就警告你：你能选择的其他命运，都不可能带来那样的幸福。

source: You will never again be able to guarantee that everyone in Elsinore survives.
target: 你再也无法保证埃尔西诺的每个人都能活下来。

source: You will forego the life you and Othello built together. And without leaving Elsinore with you, he is likely to be killed here.
target: 你会舍弃与奥赛罗共同建立的生活。而如果他没有和你一起离开埃尔西诺，很可能会在这里被杀。

source: You will never again have a future you built away from Elsinore, on your own, free of others' misery.
target: 你再也无法拥有那个远离埃尔西诺、靠自己建立、不受他人苦难牵累的未来。

source: Never again will you settle down with Lady Guildenstern and Lady Rosencrantz, though you had found peace with them.
target: 你再也无法与吉尔登斯吞女士和罗森克兰兹女士一起安定下来，尽管你曾在她们身边找到安宁。

source: There is no other world with such a peaceful existence for Elsinore as the one where Fortinbras was its true King.
target: 在福丁布拉斯成为埃尔西诺真正国王的那个世界里，埃尔西诺享有的安宁，是其他任何世界都无法给予的。

source: Please. I urge you not to do this, Ophelia. I urge you with everything in my heart.
target: 求你了。奥菲莉娅，我恳求你不要这么做。我全心全意地恳求你。

source: It's not too late to turn back!
target: 现在回头还来得及！

source: Here you are yet again.
target: 你又一次来到了这里。

source: Perhaps. Perhaps not.
target: 也许是。也许不是。

source: What do you recall?
target: 你还记得什么？

source: Only that I came here at the end of my life. And I know now—though I did not know in Elsinore—that you and I have spoken here before, in this place.
target: 只记得我在生命结束时来到了这里。而且我现在知道了——虽然在埃尔西诺时并不知道——你我以前就在这里，在这个地方交谈过。

source: And what before that? What before we last spoke?
target: 那之前呢？我们上一次交谈之前呢？

source: Then it is as I warned you. You have no memory of the fate you chose before.
target: 那就和我警告过你的一样。你已经不记得自己先前选择的命运了。

source: You already have.
target: 你已经做过了。

source: Yes. Your return on that occasion brought you no more happiness than your first fate.
target: 是的。那次回去，并没有给你带来比最初的命运更多的幸福。

source: What leads you to believe that this attempt shall yield more fruitful results?
target: 是什么让你相信，这次尝试能带来更好的结果？

source: Besides, if you return to Elsinore again, you will lose all memory of this fate, too.
target: 况且，如果你再次回到埃尔西诺，也会失去关于这一次命运的一切记忆。

source: This past time... when you chose your fate... that me, that Hamlet, had no knowledge of this in-between place. Neither did you.
target: 上一次……当你选择自己的命运时……那个我，那个哈姆雷特，对这片夹缝之境一无所知。你也一样。

source: That version of me believed we were still friends. But now, looking at you, my wits about me, I am not so certain.
target: 那个我相信我们仍是朋友。但现在，我头脑清醒地看着你，却不那么确定了。

source: You need not continue, you know. Will you finally allow all of us to rest?
target: 你知道，你不必继续下去。你终于肯让我们所有人安息了吗？

source: Or will you force the both of us to continue to endure this hell?
target: 还是说，你要逼我们两个继续忍受这地狱般的折磨？

source: I had thought you'd surely not return.
target: 我原以为你肯定不会再回来了。

source: You know, I cherish you dearly when I am pulled back to Elsinore.
target: 你知道吗，每当我被拉回埃尔西诺，我都十分珍视你。

source: I have no memory of this place, this in-between.
target: 我不记得这个地方，不记得这片夹缝之境。

source: Then I am brought back here when you die, and I remember you chose to return me to Elsinore too, and it aches so terribly.
target: 然后，当你死去，我又被带回这里，想起你选择把我也送回埃尔西诺，那痛苦实在难以承受。

source: And this is the third time.
target: 而这已经是第三次了。

source: Say, Hamlet—what were those other fates I chose?
target: 哈姆雷特，你说——我选过的其他命运都是什么样的？

source: Were they—was I—happier?
target: 它们是不是——我是不是——更幸福些？

source: I suspected you would find yourself wondering this.
target: 我猜到你会想知道这个。

source: But I do not know. I do not see your life beyond Elsinore. I am not a god. Just a man, or what was once a man, standing here as confused as you.
target: 但我不知道。我看不到你在埃尔西诺之外的人生。我不是神。只是一个人，或者曾经是人的存在，站在这里，和你一样困惑。

source: Do not return to Elsinore again.
target: 不要再回埃尔西诺了。

source: If ever you did love me, if ever you did find me worthy of your time... then you will join me here in the quiet of oblivion, and take up an eternal rest.
target: 如果你曾经爱过我，如果你曾经觉得我值得你花时间相伴……那就来这里与我一起，在这虚无的寂静中永远安息吧。

source: It will never be complete.
target: 它永远不会完整。

source: I urge you to understand this!
target: 我恳求你明白这一点！

source: I harbored a deep and impenetrable respect for you in life, Ophelia. Do not prove me a fool in death.
target: 奥菲莉娅，生前我对你怀着深切而不可动摇的敬意。不要在死后证明我是个傻子。

source: Do not show me that everything we went through together was trivial compared to your pining for the impossible.
target: 不要让我发现，与我们共同经历的一切相比，你对不可能之事的渴望才更重要。

source: If you return to Elsinore again, you will again lose all memory of the fate you just chose, and you will not be able to choose it again. In other words...
target: 如果你再次回到埃尔西诺，就会再次失去关于你刚刚选择的命运的一切记忆，也无法再选择它。换句话说……

source: You are no better than him, you know.
target: 你知道吗，你并不比他好。

source: You have shown me already that, like him, you will not grant mercy.
target: 你已经让我看清，你和他一样，不肯施以仁慈。

source: We are simply playthings to you.
target: 对你来说，我们不过是玩物。

source: I must remind you, as you abandon the fate you last chose...
target: 在你抛弃上次选择的命运之际，我必须提醒你……

source: Let me give you what you desire, then. The chance to find something else. Something 'better.'
target: 那就让我给你想要的东西吧。一个寻找别的可能的机会。寻找“更好的”可能。

source: Let me give you what you came here for. We have nothing more to say to one another, after all.
target: 让我把你来这里想要的东西给你吧。毕竟，我们已经没什么可对彼此说的了。

source: I never thought you were quite this stubborn in life.
target: 生前，我从没想过你竟会这么固执。

source: Nevertheless, I will show you the way back to Elsinore.
target: 不过，我还是会为你指出回埃尔西诺的路。

source: You have my eternal thanks.
target: 我会永远感激你。

source: You are wiser and more merciful than that broken world ever deserved.
target: 你的智慧与仁慈，远远超出了那个破碎的世界所配得到的。

source: Let us go away now, Ophelia. Forever.
target: 我们走吧，奥菲莉娅。永远离开。

source: So be it, then.
target: 那就这样吧。

source: I mourn the fate you leave behind, for certainly neither you nor I will recall it if we ever meet again.
target: 我为你抛下的命运哀悼，因为如果我们再次相见，你我必定都不会再记得它。

source: So be it. I hope we never meet again, then.
target: 那就这样吧。既然如此，我希望我们永不再见。

source: And if we ever do, I shall no longer try to stand in your way.
target: 即使我们再见，我也不会再试图阻拦你。

source: Trying to save someone from pain is a courtesy one only extends to friends.
target: 试着让一个人免受痛苦，是只有对朋友才会给予的关照。

source: Indeed. It is possible, though difficult, for me to manifest.
target: 确实。我能够显形，只是很困难。

source: I find it most curious that you are still here.
target: 你竟然还在这里，我觉得十分奇怪。

source: At the end of the last cycle Fortinbras was rebuked. Was he not?
target: 上一次循环结束时，福丁布拉斯受到了斥责。不是吗？

source: A natural assumption, of course. And yet, here you are, and here I am, trapped under the lip of the goblet still.
target: 当然，这样想很自然。可你仍在这里，我也仍在这里，依然被困在酒杯的杯沿之下。

source: There exist certain undiscovered elements of this world.
target: 这个世界里还有一些尚未被发现的事物。

source: Would that I could tell you. These lips are sealed with a far more gruesome power than death.
target: 但愿我能告诉你。有一股比死亡可怕得多的力量封住了我的嘴。

source: But that information, created when I still lived, sleeps inside the castle's walls...
target: 但那些在我生前留下的信息，正沉睡在城堡的墙内……

source: In plain sight of all, and accessible to those curious enough to find it.
target: 就在众人眼前，只要有足够的好奇心去寻找，就能找到。

source: What... What just—
target: 什么……刚才发生了什——

source: His death—I've seen it with my own eyes! And the traitor is my own blood, and my mother—Oh, dear God, my mother!
target: 他的死——我亲眼看见了！那个叛徒竟是我的血亲，还有我的母亲——哦，天啊，我的母亲！

source: M-midnight. On the walls. It was around the witching hour. But how did you—
target: 半、半夜。在城墙上。大概是午夜鬼魅出没的时候。可你怎么会——

source: But maybe—maybe there's a way out of this, for both of us...
target: 但也许——也许我们两个都有办法摆脱这一切……

source: You—You killed him. You'd known him all your life. And still you killed him.
target: 你——你杀了他。你从小就认识他。可你还是杀了他。

source: You—You tried to kill him. You'd known him all your life. And still you tried to kill him.
target: 你——你想杀他。你从小就认识他。可你还是想杀他。

source: I—I cannot recall.
target: 我——我想不起来了。

source: Everyone's looking at you as though—as if—this is some bizarre game.
target: 大家看着你的样子，就像——仿佛——这是什么离奇的游戏。

source: On the contrary, this performance has just begun.
target: 恰恰相反，这场演出才刚刚开始。

source: Brother, Gerta, be not afraid.
target: 弟弟，格尔塔，别害怕。

source: Gerta, be not afraid.
target: 格尔塔，别害怕。

source: Everyone, be not afraid.
target: 各位，别害怕。

source: I come not to destroy, but to rebuild.
target: 我来不是为了毁灭，而是为了重建。

source: I am a spirit, but not here to claim you, Gerta.
target: 我是亡魂，但我不是来带走你的，格尔塔。

source: Don't weep, my love. I have heard your prayers and whispers. I was with you in your loneliest moments.
target: 别哭，我的爱人。我听见了你的祈祷和低语。在你最孤独的时刻，我一直陪着你。

source: You were never alone. Not for a minute. And now I wish you only happiness.
target: 你从来都不是孤身一人。一刻也不曾是。如今，我只愿你幸福。

source: Yes. It is true.
target: 是的。这是真的。

source: Look upon your husband's face. You have only to look to see the truth.
target: 看看你丈夫的脸。只需看一眼，你就能明白真相。

source: Do not hate him, my love. His hand was forced by the plodding pace of fate.
target: 不要恨他，我的爱人。是命运迟缓的脚步逼他动了手。

source: I am a spirit, but not here to claim you, Bernardo.
target: 我是亡魂，但我不是来带走你的，贝尔纳多。

source: Don't weep. I have heard your prayers, Bernardo.
target: 别哭。我听见了你的祈祷，贝尔纳多。

source: You were the most stalwart man any King could hope for. I wish you only happiness.
target: 任何国王都盼望能有你这样坚定可靠的人。我只愿你幸福。

source: And do not hate Claudius, my good man. My brother's hand was forced by the plodding pace of fate.
target: 也不要恨克劳狄斯，我的好伙计。是命运迟缓的脚步逼我弟弟动了手。

source: And the one cranking that wheel was Peter Quince.
target: 而转动那轮盘的人，正是彼得·奎因斯。

source: If ever you trusted me, then know also that this man is a danger to you, innocent though he seem.
target: 如果你曾信任过我，就也请相信，这个人虽然看似无辜，却会危及你。

source: It is because of him that I linger here in this world, unable to pass on.
target: 正是因为他，我才徘徊在这世间，无法离去。

source: Do not leave me in this state any longer, brother. Let me pass on. Kill this man.
target: 别再让我困在这种境地了，弟弟。让我安息。杀了这个人。

source: Do not leave me in this state any longer, Bernardo. Let me pass on. Kill this man.
target: 别再让我困在这种境地了，贝尔纳多。让我安息。杀了这个人。

source: You've returned.
target: 你回来了。

source: Of course I know him, but of what might I be afraid?
target: 我当然认识他，可我有什么可怕的？

source: What cause would I have to believe that? If anything, he was a great help to me.
target: 我有什么理由相信这种话？真要说起来，他倒是帮了我大忙。

source: I believe you, my son.
target: 我相信你，我的儿子。

source: My son, listen carefully to me.
target: 我的儿子，仔细听我说。

source: I was wrong.
target: 我错了。

source: Claudius is not our enemy. A more insidious foe awaits.
target: 克劳狄斯不是我们的敌人。还有一个更阴险的敌人在等着我们。

source: I misspoke in accusing my brother of my death. He was driven by something far more peculiar. Quince is such a peculiar man.
target: 我指责弟弟害死了我，那话说错了。驱使他的，是某种远为诡异的东西。奎因斯就是这样一个诡异的人。

source: He is not human, Hamlet. He is a demon of some twisted persuasion. Or a god. I do not know which.
target: 他不是人，哈姆雷特。他是某种扭曲的恶魔。或者是神。我不知道是哪一种。

source: I do not know. But I do know that I have seen many strange things in this life of mine.
target: 我不知道。但我确实知道，我这一生见过许多怪事。

source: You know I am dead, my son, and yet here I stand before you.
target: 你知道我已经死了，我的儿子，可我此刻却站在你面前。

source: The power we discuss is something greater than the bounds of this world, greater than anything we know.
target: 我们所说的力量超越了这个世界的界限，也超越了我们所知的一切。

source: His can even transcend death. It caused me years of anguish and grief. I was trapped in Elsinore, unable to live or die, in some hellish version of this world where time repeated itself.
target: 他的力量甚至能超越死亡。它让我痛苦悲伤了多年。我被困在埃尔西诺，求生不得，求死不能，置身于这个世界某个地狱般的版本里，时间不断重复。

source: And now Ophelia is trapped, too.
target: 如今，奥菲莉娅也被困住了。

source: In a manner of speaking. Quince is the one who kept me in that shadowy version of Elsinore. I knew Claudius was trying to murder me from the start. But...
target: 可以这么说。是奎因斯把我困在了那个阴暗的埃尔西诺里。我从一开始就知道克劳狄斯想谋杀我。但是……

source: Whenever I stopped him, things only became worse. In one world, your mother drowned herself and took you with her.
target: 每当我阻止他，事情只会变得更糟。在一个世界里，你母亲投水自尽，还带着你一起死了。

source: In another, Claudius created a conspiracy, then convinced my own men to turn against me and have me imprisoned indefinitely.
target: 在另一个世界里，克劳狄斯策划了一场阴谋，又说服我的部下反叛我，把我关了起来，永不释放。

source: Every world was more vile than the world where I did nothing at all.
target: 每一个世界，都比我什么也不做的那个世界更加恶劣。

source: And so, eventually, I gave up. I lay in that garden for years, broken into three-day spans of time.
target: 所以，最终我放弃了。我在那座花园里躺了多年，时光被切成一段段，每段只有三天。

source: Eventually, I did not return to life. And yet my spirit still lingers.
target: 最终，我没有再活过来。可我的灵魂仍在徘徊。

source: It is Peter Quince's power that keeps me here. Ophelia has helped me realize this. We were merely the puppets to his infinite jest.
target: 是彼得·奎因斯的力量把我留在这里。奥菲莉娅帮我明白了这一点。我们不过是他那无尽玩笑中的傀儡。

source: Please, my son. Save me. Save my soul. Kill him. It's the only choice I have left.
target: 求你了，我的儿子。救救我。救救我的灵魂。杀了他。这是我仅剩的选择。

source: Merely destroying your uncle will not free me, or Ophelia.
target: 只杀死你叔叔，无法让我或奥菲莉娅得到自由。

source: I do not know.
target: 我不知道。

source: My form is feeble. I feel my flesh disintegrating. I must go.
target: 我的形体很虚弱。我感觉自己的血肉正在崩解。我必须走了。

source: Be careful, my son. Think long upon your plans. I don't wish to cause you any more suffering than I've already brought you.
target: 小心，我的儿子。你的计划要仔细考虑。我已经给你带来了痛苦，不愿再让你承受更多。

source: It's—it's extraordinarily unusual for her to not tell me where she's gone.
target: 她没告诉我去了哪里，这——这实在太反常了。

source: I—I don't mean to trouble you. I apologize. I'll take my leave of you now.
target: 我——我无意打扰你。对不起。我这就告辞。

source: Er, I feel suddenly ill. I'm going to be sick here, I fear. Can someone—
target: 呃，我突然有些不舒服。恐怕要吐在这里了。有没有人能——

source: Can someone help me to—
target: 有没有人能扶我去——

source: Her mouth— blood—
target: 她的嘴——血——

source: Men, t-to me, at once! Urgh—
target: 来人，快、快到我这里来！呃——

source: N-no! My lady, I meant—I intended—
target: 不、不！夫人，我是说——我本来想——

source: The thought of him being frightened and cloudy, alone, in England—it's too much for me.
target: 一想到他独自在英格兰，惊恐又神志不清——我就受不了。

source: (If I kill him while praying—)
target: （如果我趁他祈祷时杀了他——）

source: (But if I do it now, while he's praying, he'll go to Heaven—)
target: （可如果我现在动手，趁他还在祈祷，他就会上天堂——）

source: This is her final chance to prove her loyalty and renounce her sin.
target: 这是她证明忠诚、摒弃罪恶的最后机会。

source: I warned you to stay your hand. It's happened again.
target: 我警告过你不要动手。事情又发生了。

source: Hamlet. Leave her. She is not your enemy. See how amazement sits upon her face. Speak to her gently.
target: 哈姆雷特。放过她。她不是你的敌人。看看她满脸的惊愕。温柔些跟她说话。

source: Can you not tell she is innocent?
target: 你看不出她是无辜的吗？

source: My son—My son—No...
target: 我的儿子——我的儿子——不……

source: E-everyone's against me—
target: 所、所有人都在跟我作对——

source: My brother lives.
target: 我的兄弟还活着。

source: You had every chance to extinguish him.
target: 你有过那么多机会杀死他。

source: My son. Remember what I told you in life: One must prevail until no other possible method remains.
target: 我的儿子。记住我生前告诉你的话：必须坚持争取胜利，直到所有可能的办法都用尽。

source: I know, my son.
target: 我知道，我的儿子。

source: I can sense that you are in the throes of darkness.
target: 我能感觉到，你正在黑暗中苦苦挣扎。

source: This—This isn't real, is it?
target: 这——这不是真的，对吧？

source: Soon he will have no memory of his pain.
target: 很快，他就会忘记自己受过的痛苦。

source: No. It makes it 'nothing.' Neither right nor wrong. It is meaningless. Rid yourself of guilt. You will need all wits about you if you are to prevail.
target: 不。这让它变成了“虚无”。无所谓对，也无所谓错。它毫无意义。放下你的愧疚。要想取胜，你必须保持头脑清醒。

source: We shall see how your opinion evolves as your time spent in this world does.
target: 等你在这个世界待得更久些，我们再看看你的想法会如何变化。

source: Next time around, perhaps, will be different.
target: 下一次，也许会有所不同。

source: But they always do t—
target: 可他们总是那——

source: Rosencrantz? Guildenstern? Why are you here? I thought—
target: 罗森克兰兹？吉尔登斯吞？你们怎么在这里？我还以为——

source: —Errrr, what Guilda means is, we made a secret promise that we would take utmost care of you on this journey!
target: ——呃……吉尔达的意思是，我们私下约好了，这一路上一定要尽心尽力地照顾你！

source: And so—you feel that 'all women' like myself and Lady Guildenstern are somehow—different?
target: 所以——你觉得，像我和吉尔登斯吞女士这样的女人，“全都”跟她们——不一样？

source: I've—I've actually been here with you before.
target: 我——我其实以前就和你一起到过这里。

source: Threatening Father's life—he nearly killed the man.
target: 威胁父亲的性命——他差点就把父亲杀了。

source: You—you're my best friend. The man whose heart I believed in most ardently.
target: 你——你是我最好的朋友。我曾那么坚定地相信你的为人。

source: Don't think he beat me a single game in the last three years of his life—Hoh!
target: 我想，他生前最后三年里，一局都没赢过我——哈！

source: Urgh... excuse me. I feel—it's a little stifling in here, isn't it? Allow me to stand a moment and catch my breath.
target: 呃……失礼了。我觉得——这里有点闷，不是吗？容我站起来缓一缓，喘口气。

source: (T-that vial—Where is it?)
target: （那、那个小瓶——在哪儿？）

source: Shut up! Just—die! I have to do this!
target: 闭嘴！给我——去死！我必须这么做！

source: And—that means—
target: 而且——那就意味着——

source: What happened to Hamlet—it was horrible. Though he was no son of mine, I've known the boy since he was born.
target: 哈姆雷特的遭遇——太可怕了。他虽然不是我的儿子，但这孩子一出生我就认识他了。

source: But Hamlet had changed. If he hadn't been struck down, he might have—he would have done something worse.
target: 可哈姆雷特已经变了。如果他没被杀死，他可能会——他一定会做出更糟的事。

source: I could never hold such a thing against you, Polonius.
target: 我绝不会因为这种事责怪你，波洛涅斯。

source: After all, you let even your own lands and estates go fallow in your mission to uphold the throne.
target: 毕竟，为了维护王位，你甚至让自己的土地和庄园都荒废了。
